"But Longxia Country’s defense construction lags behind other countries." Wei Yuan suddenly changed the topic, "Do you know why?"
Gu Xing furrowed his brow, thinking: "Is it because... the defense construction isn’t going smoothly?"
"Exactly!!!"
Wei Yuan’s fingers sketched out a map on a light screen in the void, "Three years ago, we discovered a gigantic Land of Trial at a critical location."
On the light screen, a scarlet dot was right at the defense hub.
"Normally, discovering a Land of Trial is a good thing."
"But this Land of Trial is located at the most crucial node of our defenses."
"Without overcoming this Land of Trial, the defense will always have a gap, through which those demon race creatures can invade at any time."
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing couldn’t help but look up at Wei Yuan.
"But it seems like I can’t help much!"
Wei Yuan raised his hand to interrupt, tapping the void lightly, a three-dimensional projection unfolded instantly.
The projection clearly marked the various areas of the Land of Trial, most of which were shown in green, indicating "completed," whereas only the core area blinked with a glaring red light.
"Other trial areas of different levels have been fully conquered by our forces."
"Only this final place—"
He pointed at the patch of red light, "Requires Awakening Tier Five and below, in teams of three to challenge."
The projection magnified suddenly, showing detailed data of the area:
[Difficulty Level: Abyssal Level]
The Land of Trial is a special secret realm within the Alternate Space, and those who pass it can gain rich rewards.
According to difficulty, Longxia Country officially classifies them into five levels.
Common, Hard, Nightmare, Hell, and at the top—Abyss!
"I need you," Wei Yuan stared into Gu Xing’s eyes, "to team up with two other SSS-class talents and complete this ultimate challenge, helping Longxia Country build its defense!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing finally understood.
Why would a military area chief personally seek out a newbie beast master in the awakening stage.
As he absorbed this information, Wei Yuan misunderstood his hesitation.
"The trial is indeed risky. So as long as you participate, you will qualify to select one item from the Southern Military Region’s treasury."
Wei Yuan said while raising his hand to unfold a light screen,
Countless virtual shadows of rare materials swirled on the screen.
Gu Xing glanced up casually, but his gaze was instantly drawn to one material.
Light Crystal?!
A whole piece of Light Crystal?!
"Chief Wei!" Gu Xing’s voice trembled slightly, "Does the military treasury... contain a whole piece of Light Crystal?"
He didn’t expect to find the first material needed for cultivating Liu Li here.
Wei Yuan’s eyes flashed with surprise, his fingertips lightly touched to enlarge the projection of that crystal:
"It seems this item is very important to you?"
Gu Xing nodded.
"Alright, as long as you agree to participate in the trial, whether you fail or succeed, it’s yours."
"Deal!"
Gu Xing agreed without hesitation.
He had initially intended to accept such tasks for the country, and now the "Light Crystal" was purely a pleasant surprise.
As Wei Yuan saw Gu Xing agree, he let out a sigh of relief.
He had pledged to complete the entire defense line construction this year.
If he hadn’t encountered Gu Xing, he would have thought there’s no way to accomplish it this year.
It wasn’t that they hadn’t dispatched talents to participate in trials before, but even SS-class potential talents couldn’t break through half the progress.
Thus he could only madly search within Longxia Country for talents with SSS-level potential.
Now, he’s finally found one!!
"Time waits for no one; let’s set off now. Each day delayed, the defense gap may claim more lives of Longxia Beast Masters."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 12: The Trial Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 12: Chapter 12: The Trial Begins!
The military district leader’s style is indeed swift and decisive.
Before Gu Xing could react, he felt a tightness around his waist...
Wei Yuan unexpectedly took him and Liu Li soaring into the sky!
"Whoosh——"
Amidst the sound of breaking wind, a giant bird that blotted out the sky suddenly tore through the clouds.
The three landed steadily on its broad back. Gu Xing instinctively probed for information on this Guardian Beast:
[Cloud-eating Sparrow]
[Talent: ???]
[Level: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Skills: ???]
The uniform question marks sent a shock through Gu Xing’s heart.
But what surprised him even more was that, despite the Cloud-eating Sparrow’s speed fast enough to tear through the air, they could not feel any wind pressure.
This meant that the Guardian Beast beneath them was at least of Commander Level, and it was very likely to have reached Monarch Level.
Soon, a distorted blue curtain of light appeared on the horizon.
"This is the space portal connecting the two realms. Passing through here and flying for a few more hours will lead to the Land of Trial." Wei Yuan’s voice was still clear amidst the howling wind.
The Cloud-eating Sparrow let out a long cry and swooped into the light curtain.
And beneath them——
More than twenty elite teams clustered around Chen Ziming and that Enchanting Demon like stars surrounding the moon.
The leading captain said ingratiatingly, "Young Master Chen, don’t worry. With our elite teams assisting, you will surely break through to Awakening Tier Seven!"
But Chen Ziming turned a deaf ear.
He stared intently at the space portal, his eyes filled with a gloomy cold light.
"Gu Xing..." His clenched fists snaked with blue veins, "Comparing resources with the Chen Family? I will show you what despair means."
"With twenty teams helping me to level up... what do you have to compete with me?!"
...
Three hours later, the Cloud-eating Sparrow landed at a military base surrounded by mountains.
As Gu Xing leapt off the giant bird’s back, he immediately noticed that there were two young people on the campsite plaza, aside from soldiers.
These two must be the companions he would trial with!
"Ying Bing, Qin Tian, both from Kyoto, SSS-Class potential."
"Gu Xing, from Lin Yuan City, also SSS-Class potential."
"This trial will be tackled by the three of you together!"
Wei Yuan briefly introduced their information.
Standing on the left, Ying Bing wore a white dress, with an ice crystal-like delicate bird perched on her shoulder.
Upon hearing Wei Yuan’s introduction, she nodded slightly at Gu Xing.
Yet her gaze lingered a few more seconds on Liu Li, with a hint of surprise flashing in her ice-blue pupils.
Gu Xing also courteously greeted, before checking the information on this lady’s Guardian Beast.
[Frost Profound Ice Phoenix]
[Talent: Legendary One Star]
[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Power: 120]
[Constitution: 130]
[Spirit: 178]
[Speed: 150]
[Skills: Cold Cone Piercing, Frost Storm, Frost Ring Imprisonment (after use, Guardian Beast enters a weakened state)]
As for Qin Tian on the right, his arms were crossed, and beside him stood a three-meter-tall bronze treant.
He gave Gu Xing a sidelong glance, with a hint of disdain in his eyes.
Lin Yuan City?
Never heard of it!
Could there be a genius in such a small city?
It’s likely that he achieved an SSS-Class rating by grinding points!
However, considering Wei Yuan’s presence, he didn’t voice his thoughts, merely standing aloof nearby.
Gu Xing didn’t mind Qin Tian’s attitude.
He wasn’t there to make friends; his goal was that Light Crystal.
If the companions suited him, that would be great.
If not, it didn’t matter, because they would likely not see each other again after this trial.
Nevertheless, he still checked the information on Qin Tian’s Guardian Beast:
[War Treant]
[Talent: Legendary One Star]
[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Power: 160]
[Constitution: 165]
[Spirit: 112]
[Speed: 105]
[Skills: Root Strangulation, Giant Wood Bombardment, Ironwood Barrier]
Gu Xing carefully compared the data of the three Guardian Beasts and gradually formed a judgment in his heart.
"Even with the same Legendary One Star talent, the difference is this pronounced..."
Liu Li’s various attributes weren’t top-notch but were balanced, with no obvious weaknesses.
More critical was that she had four skills, one more than the other two Guardian Beasts.
Ying Bing’s Frost Profound Ice Phoenix was clearly superior to Qin Tian’s War Treant, especially the skill [Frost Ring Imprisonment], which Gu Xing paid special attention to...
Like Liu Li’s [Song of the End], it required a certain sacrifice to unleash.
He suspected that the higher the cost of using a skill, the more terrifying its power.
This was akin to a Guardian Beast’s finishing technique!
[Song of the End (after use, Guardian Beast falls asleep)]
Seeing Liu Li’s skill, he decided that he would never unleash it unless it was a matter of life and death.
Then, he turned his gaze to Qin Tian’s War Treant...
Aside from its excellent power and constitution attributes....
It seemed to lack other standout features!
Its three skills were quite unremarkable, and it didn’t possess a "finishing technique"!
Gu Xing mentally calculated that this War Treant barely touched the threshold of Legendary Talent.
Having understood the strength of Ying Bing and Qin Tian’s Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing’s gaze finally settled on Liu Li.
Overall, his own little angel still satisfied him the most.
"Master?" Liu Li tilted her head in confusion.
His slender fingers unconsciously stroked Liu Li’s silver hair, and the soft touch warmed his heart.
"Master?"
Liu Li tilted her face up in confusion, her golden eyes full of incomprehension.
She instinctively nuzzled Gu Xing’s palm, and this affectionate gesture made his heart tremble.
A sin... a sin...
Thankfully, Wei Yuan spoke again, capturing Liu Li’s attention, which kept the little angel from noticing her master’s strange behavior.
"Do any of you need to prepare anything else? If not, I’ll take you to the Land of Trial." Wei Yuan’s gaze swept between the three of them.
Gu Xing lightly cleared his throat, discreetly retracting his hand, the smooth touch of Liu Li’s hair still lingering on his fingertips.
"Ready to depart at any time."
The nearby Ying Bing and Qin Tian also indicated they were ready.
Soon, Wei Yuan led them to an ancient hall.
Although the hall was in ruins, remnants still hinted at its past grandeur.
"This was once the holy land of the Elf Race, but for some reason, the entire Elf Race disappeared, leaving only this trial ground."
"By passing this trial, you should receive some decent rewards."
"But if you encounter danger, choose to withdraw in time, as your safety is most important."
"Rest assured, Chief Wei!" Qin Tian patted his chest in assurance: "With me, this trial is in the bag!"
Wei Yuan gave him a deep look: "I hope so!"
"No more words," Wei Yuan pointed to the stone platform at the center of the hall, "place your hands on it, and the trial will begin."
"Finally," with his booming voice, all soldiers stood at attention and saluted, "wish you all triumphant return!"
Under everyone’s gaze, the three simultaneously placed their hands on the stone platform.
In an instant, a blinding white light shot up to the sky, completely engulfing their figures.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 13: A Man Can’t Admit He’s Weak!
chapters.content:
Chapter 13: Chapter 13: A Man Can’t Admit He’s Weak!
When the figures of the three completely vanished in the white light, the adjutant beside Wei Yuan approached and lowered his voice to ask:
"Leader, do you think they will... succeed this time?"
Wei Yuan’s gaze remained fixed on the empty stone platform, his knuckles unconsciously tapping against his pants leg.
After a long pause, he slowly began to speak:
"With that girl from the Ying Family, the chances of passing this trial... it’s a fifty-fifty chance."
After all, it’s the highest level trial; even though all three of their Guardian Beasts are at the Legendary Level, Wei Yuan still felt uncertain.
Last time, the participants were a genius with SSS-Class potential and two with SS-Level potential.
Yet, the three couldn’t even pass the second challenge.
After letting out a sigh, he took a final look at the stone platform and turned to walk outside the hall.
"We’ve done everything we can, and next..."
"It’s up to destiny now!"
...
Within the Land of Trial.
The pitch-black soil seemed soaked with ink, ruins scattered all around, an expanse of desolation.
"Hey, you country folk."
Qin Tian suddenly halted, the sturdy branches of the War Treant rustling behind him.
"No matter how you managed to get an SSS evaluation, when danger approaches, just stay behind me and Sister Ice obediently."
He lifted his chin, his face full of pride.
"With us here, if danger arises, at least your little life can be spared."
Gu Xing raised an eyebrow with interest.
Although this young master from Kyoto is arrogant, he doesn’t have a bad nature.
It’s just that he hasn’t tasted the harshness of the world, so he’s somewhat overconfident.
Fortunately, in the trial, the various monsters encountered cannot boost the Guardian Beast’s level upon defeat.
He’s more than happy to take action; Gu Xing is quite pleased.
"No problem, you lead ahead; I won’t steal your spotlight."
Saying this, he deliberately stepped back two steps and made an exaggerated "after you" gesture.
Liu Li tilted her head in confusion but obediently stepped aside under Gu Xing’s glance.
"You do have good sense."
Qin Tian snorted with satisfaction and boldly marched to the front of the team.
Meanwhile, Ying Bing seemed to pay no attention to these matters, wholeheartedly communicating with the Ice Phoenix on her shoulder.
Soon, the three encountered three monsters.
[Trial Puppet · Balanced Type]
[Level: Awakened Tier Six]
[Power: 100]
[Constitution: 100]
[Spirit: 100]
[Speed: 100]
[Skills: Thousand Machines Heavy Fist, Balanced Force Field]
Seeing the information about these three Trial Puppets, Gu Xing finally understood the difficulty of the Abyssal Trial.
Trial Puppets with all attributes at 100 had reached the level of excellent Tier Six Magic Beasts.
Due to balanced attributes, their strength even surpassed beasts of the same level.
More frightening is that this is merely the first wave of monsters.
The monsters encountered next will have increasing strength.
However.
Qin Tian seemed oblivious to the gravity of the situation.
Qin Tian already strode forward, "Sister Ice, don’t intervene; I can handle these metal lumps."
Ying Bing thought it over and slightly nodded in agreement.
No matter what, with Qin Tian receiving an SSS-Class potential evaluation, defeating these three Trial Puppets shouldn’t be a problem at all.
"Treant, Root Strangulation!"
At Qin Tian’s command, the robust roots of the War Treant burst from the ground, wrapping around the three puppets like giant serpents.
The friction between wooden fibers and metal shells produced an ear-piercing sound, culminating in three explosive bangs, leaving the trial puppets in a mess of fragments.
"How’s that? My Treant!"
Qin Tian turned proudly to look at the others, his expression eager for praise.
Gu Xing and Liu Li exchanged a glance and nodded in unison, giving a thumbs up.
Liu Li thoughtfully added, "Very impressive!"
Qin Tian, buoyed by the compliments, became even more elated, his voice rising by eight octaves.
"Although your skills might be a bit lacking, carefully observing my battles will surely give you plenty to learn!"
"Absolutely, absolutely!"
Gu Xing nodded repeatedly, holding back Liu Li, who wanted to retort.
Following that, Qin Tian continued in his role as the pathfinder.
But, as they ventured deeper, the Trial Puppets they faced grew increasingly formidable.
When five Awakened Tier Seven Trial Puppets barred their path, Qin Tian could finally no longer keep his smile.
His forehead became drenched with sweat!
[Trial Puppet]
[Level: Awakened Tier Seven]
[Power: 120]
[Constitution: 120]
[Spirit: 120]
[Speed: 120]
Five Trial Puppets with an average attribute value of 120 points; the War Treant clearly struggled significantly.
Fine sweat appeared on Qin Tian’s forehead, and his clenched fists trembled slightly.
"Young Master Qin, could you use a hand?" Gu Xing kindly leaned closer to ask.
"No...no need!"
Qin Tian ground his teeth, forcing himself, but anyone could see his strain.
Yet Ying Bing beside him gently patted the Ice Phoenix on her shoulder, her voice cool:
"I’ll control, you attack."
Upon hearing Ying Bing’s words, Gu Xing raised his eyebrows in surprise.
The ice-cold beauty actually spoke!
And Qin Tian, hearing Ying Bing was about to engage, exhaled a huge sigh of relief.
These five Trial Puppets, he could handle, but it would require a certain price.
And now, they’re only at the first checkpoint...
Next, with Ying Bing joining the fray, the situation suddenly turned around.
The Frost Profound Ice Phoenix spread its wings, instantly freezing the joints of the Trial Puppets with frost.
The War Treant seized the opportunity, lifting its sturdy branches and shattering the frozen puppets one by one.
For the rest of the journey, Gu Xing enjoyed a leisurely pace.
With Ying Bing and Qin Tian working together, the Trial Puppets could hardly survive a single round.
He and Liu Li became mere bystanders for a while.
Before long, Qin Tian and Ying Bing stormed through the first checkpoint effortlessly.
The three reached the end of the first checkpoint, where they were confronted with three deep passages.
This is where the second challenge of the Abyssal Level trial begins.
According to the information provided by Wei Yuan, each of the three passages must be chosen by each person independently, completing the entire trial within the passage, in order to enter the third checkpoint.
What’s the content of the third checkpoint?
Even Wei Yuan doesn’t know!
The last batch of Trial Takers only reached the second checkpoint at most.
At this moment, Qin Tian suddenly turned around, his gaze lingering on Gu Xing for quite a while, with an evident hint of doubt:
"You...can you manage?"
He’s obviously unconcerned about Ying Bing’s strength!
As the top performer in the rookie trials in Kyoto City, her strength even exceeded his own.
But this rural genius before him—if he held them back...
Even if he and Ying Bing managed to pass the second checkpoint, this trial would still be a failure.
And the usually indifferent Ying Bing also glanced sideways, awaiting Gu Xing’s response.
After all, Gu Xing hadn’t made any moves the whole way, so she couldn’t judge his capability as a companion.
Facing Qin Tian’s doubts, Gu Xing didn’t defend himself, he merely lifted the corners of his mouth, and confidently strode toward the middle passage.
"A man should never claim he can’t!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 14: Second Trial, Cleared!
chapters.content:
Chapter 14: Chapter 14: Second Trial, Cleared!
The moment he stepped into the passage, Gu Xing felt as if he was in another world.
He quickly turned his head but found that the entrance he came from had already disappeared, replaced by a void of darkness.
And before him, a mechanical figure slowly solidified—
[Trial Puppet·Enhanced Type]
[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Power: 90]
[Constitution: 90]
[Spirit: 90]
[Speed: 90]
[Skills: Thousand Machines Heavy Fist, Attribute Enhancement, Balanced Force Field (stackable)]
"Enhanced type?" Gu Xing furrowed his brow slightly.
Compared to ordinary balanced puppets, this one in front was evidently stronger by more than one grade.
Not only had it gained the beneficial skill of "Attribute Enhancement," but the trickiest part was that "Balanced Force Field"...
If several enhanced trial puppets appeared simultaneously later, that would be troublesome.
But for now...it’s not a big problem!
"Liu Li, deal with it!"
Before the words fell, Liu Li’s silver-white wings were fully extended, and a blazing long sword took shape in her hands.
She lightly flapped her wings, her figure instantly flashing in front of the puppet.
The golden sword light sliced like a crescent moon—
"Swish!"
The enhanced puppet snapped with a sound, collapsing into two pieces.
Though this awakening Tier Five puppet was quite powerful, it was still overwhelmed in the face of Liu Li, whose attributes all surpassed 150 points.
As the puppet dispersed, the blue barrier blocking the way ahead also vanished.
Gu Xing continued forward with Liu Li.
In the second space, waiting for them were still enhanced trial puppets, only the level had risen to awakening Tier Six.
Looking at the enemy whose attributes had soared to 120 points, Gu Xing couldn’t help but tense his brows.
No wonder previous trial takers failed to pass this checkpoint.
With each space passed, the puppet’s strength increased exponentially.
The awakening Tier Six enhanced puppet before him had attributes rivaling that of a Tier Five epic guardian beast!
And this was only the second checkpoint...
Liu Li’s sword light flashed again, and the trial puppet fell promptly.
In the next space...
Two awakening Tier Six puppets appeared simultaneously, the balanced force field started to show its effectiveness, suppressing Liu Li’s attributes by about 10 points.
Fortunate enough, even weakened, Liu Li still held an absolute advantage and quickly resolved the two awakening Tier Six trial puppets.
The difficulty of the trial continued to escalate.
Three, four, five, awakening Tier Seven...
When Gu Xing and Liu Li reached the final space, three trial puppets radiating a terrifying aura were in battle formation!
[Trial Puppet·Enhanced Type]
[Level: Awakening Tier Seven]
[Power: 150]
[Constitution: 150]
[Spirit: 150]
[Speed: 150]
[Skills: Thousand Machines Heavy Fist, Attribute Enhancement, Balanced Force Field (stackable)]
Watching the trio of enhanced trial puppets standing off against Liu Li.
With the triple overlap of balanced force fields, Liu Li’s attributes were suppressed by nearly 30 points.
This meant that even with Liu Li’s strength, it would be quite tricky to deal with these puppets without activating the Blazing Angel Form.
But at this moment, what he worried about was not the battle ahead, but...
Could the other two really pass this checkpoint?
Ying Bing’s Ice Phoenix spiritual attribute reached a formidable 170 points, paired with excellent skills, passing should not be an issue.
However, Qin Tian’s war treant...
Facing the three awakening Tier Seven enhanced puppets, it might be on the verge!
In the thought of a moment, Gu Xing made a decision:
"Liu Li, activate the Blazing Angel Form, finish them quickly!"
"Got it!"
The crisp response came from the little girl, as crimson flames burst forth from her body.
Four wings of light unfolded behind her, a wave of sacred burning energy swept through the entire space.
Attributes—doubled!
A crushing 300 points!
Three golden sword rays streaked across the sky like meteors, the three enhanced puppets did not even have time to react, split neatly in two.
The remains quickly turned to ashes under the burn of the Blazing Angel Flame, scattering with the wind.
The barrier at the end of the passage finally dissipated gently.
...
Meanwhile, in the core control room of the Land of Trial.
A gigantic stone platform hovered in the center, displaying the trial takers’ progress in real-time.
"Sir, they have entered the second checkpoint!"
Wei Yuan nodded slightly at the news, looking gravely at the stone platform.
He knew better than anyone that from the second checkpoint onwards, this trial was technically challenging.
During last year’s trial, except for one SSS-Class promising talent who barely made it to the end, the other two SS-Class talents completed only 70% of the progress before being eliminated.
Wei Yuan unconsciously clenched his fist, his knuckles pale from the force.
If they fail again this time, they would have to wait until next year...
"Send the order down, let the border legion enter first-level alert status!"
After passing the second checkpoint, part of the Land of Trial would vanish, and when that happens, demon race creatures are sure to swarm in through the gap.
Although it’s still unclear whether the three can pass the second checkpoint, it’s always good to be prepared early on.
"Yes!"
The adjutant was about to turn and leave, when he suddenly caught a glimpse of dazzling light flashing on the stone platform.
He widened his eyes in disbelief:
"Sir... Sir! It seems someone has passed the second checkpoint!"
"What?!"
Wei Yuan turned sharply, his gaze locked on the stone platform.
Seeing clearly displayed above the words "One person has passed."
Who could it be?
Remember, it had only been half an hour since the three entered the second checkpoint!
From what he learned from the previous trial takers, the final space contained three awakening Tier Seven trial puppets!New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Awakening Tier Five VS Awakening Tier Seven.
Even if the three’s guardian beasts were of legendary level, it was still incredibly challenging!
"Sir, I think it must be Ying Bing?"
The adjutant cautiously analyzed after regaining his senses:
"After all, the Ying Family’s bloodline is unique, only able to contract one guardian beast in a lifetime..."
The adjutant’s thoughts were in concord with Wei Yuan’s internal speculation.
The Ying Family, as one of the oldest families of Longxia Country, had a very unique bloodline legacy—
Family members can only contract one guardian beast for their whole life, yet the bloodline power can gradually enhance the beast’s talent.
For this reason, the Ying Family’s guardian beasts were at least epic level from the start!
"The girl from the Ying Family is the one with the highest talent in nearly a hundred years. Her ability to pass swiftly is within expectations."
"Only..."
Speaking of this, Wei Yuan’s expression turned solemn:
"But now the issue is, if Gu Xing and Qin Tian cannot pass, no matter how strong Ying Bing is, it won’t make a difference..."
After all, this trial was a trinity; as long as one person failed to pass, the entire trial would be deemed a failure.
However.
Just then, the adjutant suddenly exclaimed again:
"Sir... Sir! Another, another person passed!"
"What?!"
Wei Yuan’s eyes turned back to the stone platform.
Seeing the words "One person has passed" had abruptly become "Two people have passed!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 15: Saving the Day!
chapters.content:
Chapter 15: Chapter 15: Saving the Day!
Central Hall, Land of Trial.
As Ying Bing stepped out of the passage, her cold gaze quickly swept across the surroundings.
Just as she was about to find a corner to meditate and wait for the other two—
"Hey!"
A clear voice suddenly rang out.
Ying Bing’s steps abruptly halted, a flicker of surprise flashing in her usually calm eyes.
She turned around swiftly, looking incredulously toward the source of the sound.
Only to see Gu Xing lazily leaning against a stone pillar, with Liu Li quietly hovering by his side.
The familiar Angel Guardian Beast was tilting its head curiously, sizing her up.
"You..."
Ying Bing, normally composed, was at a rare loss for words.
During the trial, she had held nothing back, with the Ice Phoenix exerting its full strength.
Even so... she was still slower than this person?
After a moment of silence, Ying Bing finally stepped forward, her cold voice tinged with hesitation:
"How long have you been here?"
Gu Xing raised his eyes, meeting the slightly furrowed brows of the ice beauty, and replied casually:
"About ten minutes or so."
"!"
Ying Bing’s pupils contracted slightly.
A ten-minute gap!
This meant that the other person’s Guardian Beast was far more powerful than the Ice Phoenix!
Perhaps sensing its master’s thoughts, the Ice Phoenix on Ying Bing’s shoulder defiantly flapped its wings.
Ying Bing reached out to soothe the Ice Phoenix, nodded toward Gu Xing, and then turned to walk to the other side of the hall.
Yet her indifferent gaze continued to wander between Gu Xing and Liu Li.
Time slipped away in silence, with no movement from the third channel.
Gu Xing’s expression gradually grew serious.
It seemed Qin Tian had encountered an accident; otherwise, he couldn’t possibly take so long without clearing the trials.
Ying Bing also furrowed her slender brows, her long fingers unconsciously caressing the Ice Phoenix’s feathers.
This year, they had finally gathered three SSS Level geniuses, and if they couldn’t clear the trial this year...
It was at this moment that Gu Xing suddenly stood up.
"Liu Li, let’s go!"
"Where are you going?" Ying Bing turned her head in surprise.
"To the rescue."
Two simple words caused Ying Bing’s pupils to contract.
She watched Gu Xing stride toward the entryway of Qin Tian’s passage and instantly understood his intention.
"You’re insane!"
Her normally calm voice was raised unusually high.
The second-round assessment was about individual ability; once someone intervened, the difficulty would immediately triple!
If the final round had ten Awakening Tier Seven Enhanced Puppets alongside the compounded Balanced Force Field...
Even with Gu Xing’s strength being greater than hers, he would have no chance of passing.
But Gu Xing’s stride showed no hesitation.
Although Wei Yuan promised that regardless of this trial’s outcome, he would give him the Light Crystal.
But he was not a person who liked to owe favors.
What could be done, must be done best.
"Liu Li!"
The little angel’s eyes burned with a fierce fighting spirit.
The master’s will was the beast’s highest mission!
Wherever the master pointed, even if ahead was an abyss or fiery mountains, she would pave the way for the master!
"Blazing Angel·Complete Liberation!"
Under Ying Bing’s shocked gaze, Liu Li transformed into a War Angel bathed in Holy Flame, the crimson brilliance lighting up the whole hall.
"Liu Li, once inside, you must immediately take out half of the puppets; otherwise, with ten Balanced Force Fields compounded, even you would be suppressed."
"Understood!" Liu Li’s response carried an unprecedented seriousness.
"Then—" Gu Xing took a deep breath, "Charge!"
The two figures instantly disappeared into the dark passage.
Ying Bing stood in place, stunned, her ice-blue eyes reflecting the gradually fading glow of the Holy Flame.
After a long while, she gently patted the Ice Phoenix on her shoulder, her voice soft as if murmuring to herself:
"Ice Phoenix, do you think... we truly deserve to be called geniuses?"
...
The dark passage, with War Tree Man’s knotted branches firmly protecting Qin Tian in the core.
"Boom!"
Another heavy punch struck the tree trunk fiercely, wood chips flying, as the Awakening Tier Seven Trial Puppet’s eyes flashed with scarlet light.
If not for War Tree Man’s "Ironwood Barrier" skill, Qin Tian might have already been eliminated.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Damn it..."
Curling up inside the tree cocoon, Qin Tian gritted his teeth, his joints whitening from the excessive force.
The War Tree Man’s vines whipped the puppet, but only left shallow marks...
The two sides were thus caught in an eerie stalemate.
"Damn it, why is this Trial Puppet so strong!? Is this trial really something humans can clear?"
Watching the Trial Puppet’s relentless attacks on War Tree Man’s trunk, Qin Tian’s expression was incredibly grim.
"Tree Man, Root Strangulation."
War Tree Man’s knotted roots burst from the ground, striking the puppet’s chest like a giant python, yet only leaving shallow marks on the metallic shell.
The Trial Puppet merely staggered backward a few steps, its scarlet eyes flashed twice, and it lunged again.
The previous attack hadn’t caused any real damage to the Trial Puppet.
The alloy-made Trial Puppet was a natural nemesis of physically-oriented Guardian Beasts like the War Tree Man.
And after defeating this Trial Puppet....
In the next room, there were still three Awakening Tier Seven Trial Puppets.
Thinking of this, a wave of despair surged in Qin Tian’s heart.
"Should... I give up?"
However.
This thought had just surfaced, when a deafening explosion suddenly echoed from deep within the passage.
Blazing white light surged like a tide, instantly swallowing the Trial Puppet!
When the dust settled, Qin Tian’s widened eyes reflected an impossible figure.
"How... how can it be you?!"
His voice stuck in his throat, his fingertips trembling involuntarily.
He never expected that the one to rescue him from the depths of the passage would be the Gu Xing he initially despised.
Gu Xing’s presence here... Qin Tian knew perfectly what it meant.
Gu Xing raised an eyebrow at Qin, covered in wood chips, "Oh, is Young Master Qin so beaten by the puppets he can’t recognize his savior?"
"You! You..."
Qin Tian’s face was flushed, his pointed finger traced an agitated arc in the air, yet he couldn’t utter a coherent sentence.
"Enough," Gu Xing put away his playful demeanor, "Time to go, Young Master Qin."
In the final space, the Trial Puppet had already been dealt with by Gu Xing, leaving the whole passage clear.
When Gu Xing returned to the hall with the dazed Qin Tian, the once prideful scion was still in shock.
His gaze mechanically shifted between Gu Xing and Ying Bing, eventually accepting a ludicrous reality.
This "country bumpkin," not only outpaced him but might be even much stronger than Kyoto’s top genius.
And Ying Bing at this moment—
Her cold gaze was firmly locked onto Gu Xing, as if observing a creature defying all logic.
He really cleared the trial with a tripled difficulty on his own!
He truly defeated ten Awakening Tier Seven Enhanced Trial Puppets!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 16: Trial Puppet: Ultimate
chapters.content:
Chapter 16: Chapter 16: Trial Puppet: Ultimate
Next, the three did not rashly initiate the final trial.
The difficulty of the second stage was already so high, and the third stage would be even more challenging on this basis.
To ensure absolute safety, before starting the third trial, they must let their respective guardian beasts recover to their peak condition.
When the three’s beasts were all adjusted to their peak, Ying Bing slowly walked towards Gu Xing.
She stopped in front of Gu Xing, her ice-blue eyes rarely showing a ripple:
"The third stage..." Her usually cool voice paused, "You take the lead attack."
This suggestion made Gu Xing slightly stunned.
With Qin Tian’s arrogance, would he accept such an arrangement?
He turned his head and saw that this young master, who usually looked down on everyone, didn’t have any rebuttal to this statement.
If the strength gap wasn’t too large, Qin Tian might still have the thought of competing.
But witnessing Gu Xing swiftly defeating ten Tier Seven Enhanced Trial Puppets, he completely let go of his pride.
"I also agree with Sister Bing’s idea," Qin Tian patted his chest, "My tree man is durable and can definitely help delay some time."
Seeing both of them say this, Gu Xing could only nod in agreement.
After all, in terms of the skills of the Ice Phoenix and the tree man, the offensive capabilities of these two guardian beasts were indeed weaker than Liu Li.The most update n0vels are published on
After confirming their tactics, the three of them walked to the center of the circular hall.
There, a stone platform to initiate the third trial awaited them.
When their palms simultaneously touched the cold surface of the stone platform, the entire hall suddenly lit up with a ghostly blue light.
A mechanized voice echoed in the void: "Final trial confirmation procedure initiated."
A light screen unfolded in front of the three, with blood-red text that was particularly eye-catching:
[Final Trial Warning]
[Rule 1: Once the trial begins, it cannot be exited midway]
[Rule 2: Only passing the trial allows you to leave the Trial Space]
[Rule 3: Failures will remain here forever]
[Please confirm]
[Yes/No]
Gu Xing noticed a line of almost transparent small words in the lower right corner of the light screen:
"Since the establishment of the Land of Trial, final trial success rate: 0.00%"
Seeing this prompt, Gu Xing’s expression was somewhat grave.
To know, in the first two stages, if one felt they couldn’t hold on, retreating to a safe area could ensure their safety.
But the final trial, seemingly different...
Only completing it would end it!
This meant that if the three failed the trial, the lives of all three would remain here.
Gu Xing’s gaze first landed on Qin Tian.
Unexpectedly, this young master was full of seriousness at this moment:
"I participate!" Qin Tian suddenly spoke up.
"Before the journey, the old man laid down the law..."
"Either return with the glory of passing the trial, or... never step into the Qin Family gates forever!"
"More importantly..."
Qin Tian suddenly lifted his head, stubbornness filling his eyes.
"I want to let that old stubborn know, his son is not a coward who fears death!"
Gu Xing was slightly stunned upon hearing this, then he understood.
The Qin Family and the Ying Family were alike, both were aristocratic families with hundreds of years of heritage.
As the heir of the Qin Family...
He could be proud, he could be arrogant, but he absolutely could not be a coward fearing death!
When his gaze turned to Ying Bing, this cool girl only lifted her eyelids.
Her slender fingers gently stroked the feathers of the Ice Phoenix, and her thin lips softly opened:
"Participate!"
Just two simple words, yet with immense determination.
Aware of Qin Tian and Ying Bing’s choices, the corners of Gu Xing’s mouth unconsciously curved into a smile.
He took a deep breath and unhesitatingly chose "Yes" with his fingertips.
"Boom——"
Accompanied by deafening roars, a massive boulder thunderously fell, completely sealing the only retreat route.
And in the center of the hall, space suddenly distorted, a blurry giant shadow was condensing.
With every bit it manifested, a suffocating pressure increased in the air.
[Trial Puppet: Ultimate]
[Talent: Epic Nine Stars]
[Level: Awakening Tier Eight]
[Power: 301]
[Constitution: 340]
[Spirit: 256]
[Speed: 240]
[Skills: Balanced Force Field·Complete, Realm-Breaking Hammer, Stable Barrier]
Seeing the object of the final trial, even Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch his mouth slightly.
With power and constitution exceeding 300 points, even the slightly weaker spirit and speed attributes reached 250 points!
Is such a thing really something a newbie Tier Five Beast Master can beat?
Qin Tian and Ying Bing naturally also felt the imposing presence emanating from the giant puppet.
Qin Tian unconsciously took a half step back, his Adam’s apple bobbing:
"Xing... Brother Xing, can we really take down this thing?"
His gaze swept to his proud war tree man.
In front of this trial puppet, his three-meter-high war tree man was like a chick.
Ying Bing also furrowed her brows seeing this trial puppet.
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix on her shoulder uneasily cried out, clearly feeling the puppet’s terrifying nature as well.
At this moment, Gu Xing looked at the completed trial puppet, quickly calculating a way to slay this trial puppet in his mind.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Legendary One Star]
[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Power: 148]
[Constitution: 150]
[Spirit: 142]
[Speed: 153]
[Skills: Judgment (increased damage to Demon Race beings), Divine Protection (immune to one lethal attack), Blazing Angel Form (All attributes increased by 200%), Song of the End (after use, the angel enters a slumber phase)]
If Liu Li activates the Blazing Angel mode, her attributes would be increased to around 300 points.
Although her constitution and power would still fall short of this guardian beast, with the increase from Judgment skill, it should be enough to cut through the puppet’s high constitution of 340 points.
However, this trial puppet wouldn’t just stand still and let Liu Li attack.
Ying Bing and Qin Tian’s beasts would need to buy Liu Li 3 seconds of time.
If the plan fails...
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the little girl’s "Finishing Technique, Song of the End."
With the Blazing Angel form already so strong, the Song of the End, which is even stronger than the Blazing Angel form, should definitely handle the Ultimate Trial Puppet.
But...
Gu Xing really didn’t want to use this skill unless absolutely necessary.
After all, once used, the little girl would enter a slumber phase.
Nobody knows how long this time would last!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing cleared his mind of distractions.
No problem!
We can definitely do it!
"Ying Bing, Qin Tian, I need you to buy Liu Li at least three seconds."
Hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Ying Bing and Qin Tian’s bodies trembled.
"Brother Xing, rest assured, we might not be able to kill this puppet, but dragging out time—my war tree man can do that!"
At the side, Ying Bing also nodded.
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, though not good at attacking, is excellent at controlling.
She and Qin Tian working together to control this trial puppet for three seconds should be feasible!
Looking at their beasts, Gu Xing wasn’t optimistic.
The trial puppet’s attributes were nearly double that of their beasts.
With such a huge gap, trying to delay for three seconds was extremely difficult.
Moreover, this trial puppet also has skills.
But at present, there’s no other choice!
We can only gamble!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 17: Frost Ring Imprisonment
chapters.content:
Chapter 17: Chapter 17: Frost Ring Imprisonment
"Qin Tian, use the War Tree to bind the Trial Puppet with Root Strangulation!"
Qin Tian is undoubtedly one of Kyoto’s top talents.
As soon as Gu Xing gave the command, Qin Tian promptly directed the War Tree to launch an attack.
"War Tree, deploy Ironwood Barrier to enhance root strength! Then use Root Strangulation, target the puppet’s limbs!"
The War Tree’s dark, thick roots burst from the earth like massive pythons, tightly wrapping around the Trial Puppet’s limbs just as it began to form.
The metallic sheen of these layered roots enveloped the puppet airtight.
While Qin Tian took action, Gu Xing was not idle either.
Almost simultaneously, Liu Li was engulfed in crimson flames as she fully entered her Blazing Angel Form.
She transformed into a fiery streak, shooting straight toward the puppet, distorting the air in her path.
Gu Xing turned to Ying Bing, "Ying Bing, let the Ice Phoenix unleash a Frost Storm! Freeze its joints!"
"Understood!"New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix let out a clear cry and rose from Ying Bing’s shoulder.
With its wings spread, its form expanded rapidly, and in moments it returned to its true self over two meters tall.
It flapped its wings, and a biting cold rush flowed toward the puppet, forming thick ice crystals at the joints entwined by roots.
Gu Xing’s gaze remained locked on Liu Li.
This was currently the only way he could think to defeat the Trial Puppet.
If the Trial Puppet were to activate its Stable Barrier, its defense would further strengthen.
Their chance to kill this Trial Puppet would be exceedingly slim.
Therefore, they had to resolve it before the Trial Puppet could react.
"Judgment!"
Liu Li’s momentum soared as she flew, leaving a dazzling trail of fire with the Blazing Angel’s Wings behind her.
As she approached the puppet, the flames enveloping her became as bright as the rising sun.
Upon seeing this, Qin Tian and Ying Bing’s eyes flickered with joy.
They could clearly sense that Liu Li’s current aura was comparable to that of the Trial Puppet.
As long as their control remained steady...
They would definitely pass this trial!
However—
Gu Xing’s expression was somewhat grave at that moment.
His gaze was firmly fixed on the Trial Puppet, with a rising tide of unease in his heart.
It’s too easy!
Everything was proceeding far too smoothly!
According to his expectations, Qin Tian and Ying Bing’s success in controlling the Trial Puppet was less than thirty percent, but the reality was...
They had managed to bind it almost effortlessly!
Something was off!
At the moment when the red light in the Trial Puppet’s eyes surged, Gu Xing’s heart tightened sharply, and a strong sense of crisis overwhelmed him.
"Liu Li, retreat immediately!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s shout, although Liu Li was puzzled, she did not hesitate to follow her master’s orders.
She swiftly retracted the Blazing Angel’s Wings, retreating at high speed!
"Boom—!"
Almost simultaneously—
The War Tree’s roots crumbled inch by inch!
The ice from the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix instantly melted!
The Trial Puppet clenched its fists and slammed them into the ground like a meteor!—
"Realm-Breaking Hammer!"
"Boom—!"
The violent shockwave swept out, cracking the ground and sending shards flying!
Liu Li narrowly dodged the blow, though the edge of the Blazing Angel’s Wings was brushed by the aftermath, causing the blazing flames to flicker intensely.
Liu Li was shocked within:
"If I had been half a second slower..."
With the Trial Puppet’s terrifying power of 340 points, plus skill amplification...
Even in her Blazing Angel Form, this strike would have gravely injured her, bringing her near death!
Upon seeing Liu Li successfully avoid the attack, Gu Xing sighed in relief.
But soon enough, looking at the situation on the field, his heart tensed once again.
He guessed correctly!
This Trial Puppet...
Is not a lifeless object, but possesses combat wisdom!
The Trial Puppet’s initial target was Liu Li.
That’s why it feigned being controlled by the War Tree and Profound Frost Ice Phoenix.
The purpose was merely to lure Liu Li closer, then launch a surprise attack.
To eliminate the strongest threat on the field.
"Roar—!"
Missing its strike, the Trial Puppet’s scarlet mechanical eyes swiftly turned toward the War Tree!
"Qin Tian! Quickly have the War Tree retreat!"
However—
Too late!
The Trial Puppet’s speed was as fast as lightning; almost as Gu Xing spoke, it turned into a blur charging at the War Tree!
"Realm-Breaking Hammer!"
The War Tree hastily raised an Ironwood Barrier, but the huge attribute gap left it unable to defend—
"Bang—!"
Amidst the dull sound of impact, the War Tree was hurled away like a kite with a broken string, crashing heavily into the circular hall’s wall, its fate unknown!
"Puff—!"
Qin Tian’s face turned pale, spitting blood and then fainting.
A Beast Master’s spiritual power is linked to the Guardian Beast; with the War Tree critically damaged, he could not escape harm.
The Trial Puppet’s gaze shifted again, this time—
It locked onto the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix!
"Liu Li! Save the Ice Phoenix!"
Gu Xing shouted sharply.
If the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix suffered further damage, this trial... could be declared a failure.
Fortunately, Liu Li’s Speed Attribute at that moment was nearly 50 points higher than the Trial Puppet!
She turned into a scarlet stream of light, pulling the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix out of danger before the Trial Puppet’s massive fist slammed down!
"Swish—!"
The Blazing Angel’s Wings stirred up a scorching gust, and Liu Li landed steadily beside Gu Xing with the Ice Phoenix.
Then she spread her wings, shielding the two people and the beast behind her, vigilantly watching the distant Trial Puppet.
The battle situation had taken a drastic turn!
Qin Tian was unconscious, and the War Tree lost combat power.
The original plan to encircle and kill collapsed in the face of this Trial Puppet with instinctive combat awareness!
Ying Bing’s expression was grim, turning to Gu Xing and speaking in a low voice:
"Gu Xing, what should we do now?"
Gu Xing did not immediately answer.
His mind was racing as his gaze swept back and forth between the Trial Puppet and Liu Li.
"Awakened 8th Rank strength, crushing-level attributes..."
Unless using Liu Li’s Finishing Technique, it’s nearly impossible to defeat it head-on!
But if that happens, his only Guardian Beast will enter slumber, and Liu Li’s growth rate will undoubtedly be greatly delayed.
As he weighed the pros and cons, Ying Bing suddenly spoke in a deep voice:
"If I can control it, can you guarantee a kill?"
Gu Xing turned sharply, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
Noticing the skills of the Ice Phoenix, he immediately grasped Ying Bing’s intent.
Profound Frost Ice Phoenix’s Finishing Technique!
Although it would also leave the Guardian Beast weakened, the cost was far smaller than Liu Li’s!
Gu Xing’s gaze returned to Liu Li, then without hesitation, he nodded:
"As long as you can control it, Liu Li can certainly resolve this Trial Puppet."
Ying Bing heard his words, and fighting spirit ignited in his eyes!
"Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, unleash Frost Ring Imprisonment!"
...

chapters.content:
Chapter 18: Chapter 18: Master, I Can Do It!!
As Ying Bing’s command fell, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix suddenly radiated a blinding icy blue light.
Gu Xing’s pupils narrowed slightly, and a new data panel appeared before him:

It seems...
This Finishing Technique of the Guardian Beast also relies on enhancing the various attributes of the Guardian Beast to achieve the purpose of improving the skill’s effect.
However, to reach this Special State, there are certain aftereffects!
A bold guess suddenly emerged in Gu Xing’s heart——
If Liu Li, in her Blazing Angel State, were to execute her Finishing Technique, could it achieve a secondary amplification based on the doubled attributes?
However, the more the enhancement, the higher the aftereffects for the Guardian Beast!
But now is not the time to think about these things!
"Liu Li, get ready!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s command, Liu Li’s flame-imbued eyes locked onto the Trial Puppet tightly, and her flames surged violently.
Simultaneously, the Ice Phoenix’s aura climbed to its peak state.
Two forces of ice and fire wreaked havoc in the Trial Space, weaving frost and flame throughout the battlefield.
The Trial Puppet obviously sensed the threat as well, its eyes briefly flashing red.
"Stable Barrier!"
A black shield with a metallic sheen instantly took shape.
However.
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix’s Finishing Technique was not simply freezing from the outside.
Quite the opposite!
"Crack!"
With the crisp sound of ice crystals shattering, the entire body of the Trial Puppet suddenly became encased in glistening frost within the shield, and the ice crystals spread rapidly across its surface.
Under attack, the Stable Barrier released by the Trial Puppet immediately fell apart.
"Gu Xing, fast! The Ice Phoenix’s explosive state can only last for 5 seconds!"
Gu Xing naturally wouldn’t miss such an opportunity.
"Liu Li, now!"
"Understood!"
A crimson flash tore through space as Liu Li, wielding the burning long sword, charged forward like a meteor.
The blade aimed directly at the mechanical head of the Trial Puppet.
For the first time, a human-like panic appeared in the electronic eyes of the Trial Puppet, but the ice crystals had completely immobilized it, unable to move even a finger, it could only watch as the fatal red gleam approached.
"Judgment!"
The blade clashed with the alloy head, erupting in an ear-piercing metallic screeching.
"Bang!"
Liu Li’s hand went numb, the recoil from the sword made her heart tremble.
Hard!
That was Liu Li’s only thought at that moment.
Even in the peak state of the Blazing Angel Form, facing a metallic monster with constitution attributes as high as 340...
She felt like she was cutting through diamond, every inch of progress was incredibly arduous.
Fortunately...
Although slow, the Red Flame Long Sword was gradually embedding into the puppet’s head, the fiery blade and melting metal bursting into brilliant sparks.
However.
Just when everyone thought this trial would end here.
The dying Trial Puppet’s eyes suddenly burst into blinding blood light.
Pitch-black energy mist gushed from the joints, instantly corroding the ice crystals on its surface.
Gu Xing and Ying Bing saw this scene and their pupils quaked.
"What is this?"
In Gu Xing’s vision, the attribute panel was frantically twisting and reorganizing:
[Trial Puppet: Ultimate (Demonization)]
[Talent: Epic Nine Stars]
[Level: Awakening Tier Eight]
[Power: 301→400]
[Constitution: 340→450]
[Spirit: 256→350]
[Speed: 240→360]
[Skills: Balanced Force Field·Complete, Realm-Breaking Hammer, Stable Barrier]
"Demon Race Transformation!"
Gu Xing and Ying Bing exchanged glances, both gasped coldly.
At this moment, all mysteries were suddenly clear——
Why was the difficulty of the Abyssal Level Trial so abnormal?!
Even though the entry standard was Awakening Tier Five, they ended up facing a nearly Extraordinary Level enemy.
It turns out the entire Trial Space had long been permeated by Demonic Qi!
Under the influence of Demonic Qi, the attributes of the Trial Puppets within the Land of Trial were slowly increasing.
If these things were not inanimate, their enhancement would be even more terrifying...
Knowing these things made their hearts sink instantly.
In the regular state, the Ultimate Trial Puppet was already difficult enough for them to battle.
And now...
Due to demonization, the attributes of this Trial Puppet rose by another hundred points.
What should they do?!
"Crack——"
Liu Li’s sword blade emitted a screeching friction sound at the puppet’s neck, the blade could no longer advance.
What’s more fatal, the extreme cold imprisonment of the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix was quickly fading, the crystal surface had already started crawling with spider-like cracks.
Both of them knew, once this monster with over 400 attribute points regained its freedom...
This trial might truly lose all possibility of being completed!
"Crack!"
The ice crystals on the Trial Puppet’s head began to crack.
Its head regained mobility!
At this moment its gaze turned slowly, directly locking onto Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
Upon demonization, its intelligence had evidently further increased!
No matter how powerful the two Guardian Beasts were, as long as they dealt with their Beast Master...
Gu Xing and Ying Bing both felt a chill pierce through them, the Trial Puppet’s gaze locked onto them like a deadly serpent.
"Crack!"
With a crisp cracking sound, the ice crystals covering the puppet’s entire body exploded dramatically.
Its mechanical arm grabbed the flying shards of ice cones with astonishing speed and completed the aim-charge-throw process in the blink of an eye!Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Whoosh——!"

"Tweet——!"
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix let out a heart-wrenching cry, desperately trying to flap its wings to block.
But having just executed its Finishing Technique, it struggled to even stand upright, forced to watch helplessly as death closed in on its master.
Ying Bing’s mind went blank, the shadow of death enveloping his entire being.
The icy brilliance of the ice cone enlarged rapidly in his pupils...

Divine Protection!

chapters.title: Chapter 19: Trial Cleared!
chapters.content:
Chapter 19: Chapter 19: Trial Cleared!
"I can definitely do it!"
Liu Li’s golden pupils suddenly contracted, staring fixedly at the crack on the neck of the Trial Puppet.
The blade was only three inches away from completely severing it, yet it seemed as insurmountable as a chasm.
"Just a bit stronger... just a bit stronger..."
The flames of unwillingness raged wildly in her chest, hotter than the red flames surrounding her.
She would never allow her master to show such a troubled expression for her, she mustn’t be the weak and helpless self anymore!
The Trial Puppet’s scarlet electronic eyes suddenly turned towards Liu Li, its mechanical arm emitting an ear-piercing metallic friction sound.
Since it can’t kill the Beast Master, it would destroy this most threatening angel first!
"Liu Li, retreat quickly!"
Gu Xing’s shout tore at the heart.
But this time, the girl didn’t move a muscle.
Her red hair danced wildly in the energy storm, as she poured all her strength into the sword blade:
"This time... I must...!"
"Boom——!"
The red flames soared into the sky, and four light wings suddenly stretched to their limit.
More shocking, two illusory outlines of light wings appeared behind her!
The phantom of a Six-winged Angel loomed in the sea of fire, sacred and majestic.
[Liu Li (Special State)]

But Liu Li clearly hadn’t released any ultimate skills...
Ying Bing, who had narrowly survived, steadied herself, and when her gaze fell on Liu Li, her pupils shrank to pin-point size.
"C-Critical State?!"
Gu Xing turned his head sharply, full of confusion:
"What Critical State?"
Ying Bing took a deep breath, trying to calm her voice:
"This state should be a domain only reachable at the Extraordinary Level."
"A Beast Master in the Awakening Stage can forcibly enter it through special skills, but there would be very strong side effects after release!"
"Only by reaching the Extraordinary Level will these side effects disappear!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing frowned.
He was sure that Liu Li had not used the ultimate skill "Song of the End" now!
"Then are there any other ways to bring the Guardian Beast into this state?"
Ying Bing thought for a moment, then spoke slowly: "There is another possibility!"
"According to my family’s ancient texts, when a beast’s talent and conviction reach the point of perfect resonance... there’s a slight chance of entering this state."
"This state is extremely rare! And with nearly zero side effects, just a slightly smaller boost for the Guardian Beast."
Knowing there were no side effects, Gu Xing finally felt relieved, his gaze refocusing on the battlefield center.
At this moment.
The Trial Puppet’s mechanical arm stopped just one inch away from Liu Li, being firmly held back by a blood-red energy shield.
Its scarlet eyes flickered violently, and the demonic qi inside trembled uncontrollably.
At this moment, in the Trial Puppet’s perception, the aura of the Guardian Beast before it was already equal to or even surpassed its own!
Danger!
Extreme danger!
In Liu Li’s golden pupils, the terrified electronic eyes of the puppet were reflected, and six light wings spread fully behind her, each feather flowing with liquid flames.
At this moment, only one thought burned in her mind:
Must win!
"Die for me...!!!"
Accompanied by this earth-shattering roar, the halted long sword suddenly burst forth with a piercing red glow.
"Clang——"
The instant the sword edge cut through the air, time seemed to freeze.
The red sword gleam falling like a meteor, and the alloy body of the Trial Puppet was effortlessly torn apart like paper under absolute power.
The flames dancing on the blade melted the metal at the incision into red molten iron, dripping onto the ground with a "sizzling" sound.
"Boom——!!!"
With an earth-shattering collapse, the Trial Puppet’s massive mechanical body slammed heavily to the ground, raising clouds of dust.
At the moment its core extinguished, a pure blue energy orb rose from the wreckage, splitting into two in the air.
Killing a demon race creature was the only way for a Guardian Beast’s level to increase.
And this Trial Puppet, after demonization, also counted as a type of demon race creature.
Perhaps because Qin Tian’s War Treant played too small a role in this battle, it did not meet the minimum distribution standard.
After receiving this blue orb, Liu Li shone with a blinding golden light.
And Gu Xing also felt his spiritual power grow stronger!
Level up!

[Talent: Legendary One Star]
[Level: Awakened Tier Six]

[Spirit: 173]
[Speed: 181]

Gu Xing looked at the soaring stats on the panel, his fingertips trembling slightly.
Such a monster!
The peak attribute values for an ordinary Awakening Tier Eight Guardian Beast are only around 150, but Liu Li...
Each attribute was close to 180 points!
Not to mention Liu Li also possessed the even more monstrous Blazing Angel Form!
"Both are Legendary Talent..."
Gu Xing glanced at the War Treant embedded in the wall, suddenly understanding the textbook phrase "same tier, different fate!"
Although both the War Treant and Liu Li had Legendary One Star Talent, the gap in power was... worlds apart!
Shaking his head, Gu Xing turned his gaze to Liu Li.
However.
Liu Li stood frozen in place as if under a petrification spell, her silver wings in an unfolded position but unmoving.
"Liu Li?"
His heart skipped a beat, and the worst assumptions flashed in his mind.
Something went wrong?
Without thinking further, he dashed forward.
But as he got closer, he realized...
"Hehe... I did it... hehe..."
The little angel was grinning foolishly at the air, her cheeks flushed with an abnormal red.
"Mas... Master... will definitely be happy..."
Gu Xing: "...."

chapters.title: Chapter 20: Talent Enhancement, Beast Taming Space Condensation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 20: Chapter 20: Talent Enhancement, Beast Taming Space Condensation!
Looking at the three items floating in front of him, Gu Xing focused his attention on the golden potion.
[Beast Taming Talent Enhancement Potion (Legendary Level)]
[Effect: Increase Legendary Talent Guardian Beast by Two Stars talent]
Seeing the effect of this potion, Gu Xing’s breathing quickened.
The leap in two stars talent is enough to significantly boost Liu Li’s various attributes.
Currently, Liu Li’s average attribute is 180 points.
If she takes this potion, perhaps her attributes could break through the 200 threshold.
Such a reward... is indeed commensurate with the difficulty of this trial!
As for the Beast Taming Space Condensation Core, it was a crystal-clear rhombic crystal, with starlight-like flickers flowing inside.
[Beast Taming Space Condensation Core (Legendary Level)]
[Effect: Enables Beast Masters to preconstruct a complete Beast Taming Space]
Upon seeing its introduction, Gu Xing was taken aback in his heart.
Preconstruct a complete Beast Taming Space?!
It’s known that only those who reach the Extraordinary Realm can condense a personal Beast Taming Space.
Yet through this core, a Beast Master can achieve this even during the Awakening Stage.
Defying the heavens!
As for the last item, Gu Xing felt a bit puzzled.
Because he couldn’t view the information of this key!
He slightly reached out his hand to touch it.
"Buzz—"
The key turned into a stream of light and entered his forehead, and a vast amount of information emerged instantly:
[Elf Ancestral Land·Burial Secret Realm]
[Admission Conditions: Gather 3 keys]
[Remaining Time: 49 days 23 hours 59 minutes]
[Note: Will be permanently sealed if overdue!]
Elf Ancestral Land?!
After decoding all the information of this key, Gu Xing roughly understood the function of this key.
This trial is equivalent to an assessment.
Only geniuses who pass this assessment can enter the Burial Grounds of the Elf Clan to obtain their left heritage.
However, entering the Secret Realm requires three keys.
Currently.
He has one, Ying Bing has another one.
As for the last one, it seems... its whereabouts are unknown!
But as long as the last person wants to enter this Secret Realm, within these 50 days, they must meet at the entrance to the Secret Realm!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing looked up at Ying Bing and happened to meet her gaze.
She must have also learned this news!
But the remaining time is still 50 days, so there is no rush about entering the Secret Realm.
Gu Xing reached for the Beast Taming Talent Enhancement Potion and was about to give it to Liu Li, only to find the little girl’s gaze tightly following the movement of this bottle.
He deliberately twirled the bottle on his fingertip, and Liu Li’s golden pupils immediately drew a curve.
And when Gu Xing’s gaze moved over, the little girl immediately pretended not to care and looked away.
But the little Angel who was sneakily peeking, unaware that her little movements completely exposed her inner thoughts.
Seeing his little Angel in this state, Gu Xing decided to tease her.
"Liu Li, what do you think about giving this potion to the second contracted Guardian Beast?"
"Her talent surely isn’t as good as yours, why don’t we let her have this..."
Liu Li’s wings suddenly froze.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
She mechanically turned her neck, forcing out a smile with a twitching corner of her mouth:
"Master... Master is... right..."
The little girl’s voice held a noticeable tremble, and tears began to glisten in her eyes.
"Pfft—"
Gu Xing finally couldn’t hold back his laughter, casually tossing the potion over, "Catch it!"
Liu Li frantically caught the potion bottle and blinked in a daze.
Only when she saw her master’s mischievous smile did she realize she had been teased.
She instantly puffed out her cheeks, looking disgruntled at her owner.
But.
As she looked down at the potion, her fingers subconsciously tightened.
She knew all too well the value of such a Legendary Level potion!
But without any hesitation, Gu Xing handed this potion over to her.
The Master’s trust in her, she must perform well, must work harder.
And Gu Xing had no idea what the little girl was thinking.
To him, the Beast Taming Talent Enhancement Potion was not as valuable as Liu Li imagined.
He could discern the cultivation path of Guardian Beasts, as long as he found the materials.
Through the cultivation plan provided by the system, the enhancement of the Guardian Beast’s strength would surely far exceed the boost from this potion.
Therefore, the Guardian Beast potion was merely icing on the cake for him.
As for what truly mattered...
Gu Xing’s gaze finally locked onto the crystal-clear Beast Taming Space Condensation Core.
This core would lead him to substantial transformation!
Once a complete Beast Taming Space was successfully condensed, Liu Li’s growth would no longer be restricted to hunting Demon Race creatures.
She could stay within the Beast Taming Space, enhancing her strength at any time.
Moreover, through the Beast Taming Space, Gu Xing and her could develop entirely new tactical cooperation, achieving true telepathy.
Gu Xing activated the starry core without hesitation.
The crystalline core instantly transformed into a stream of light that merged into his forehead.
In a flash, a surge of Spiritual Power rushed through his sea of consciousness like a tide.
The originally vague outline of the Beast Taming Space was now being rapidly clarified and solidified, with every detail quickly taking shape.
Meanwhile, Liu Li tilted her head and drank the golden-glowing enhancement potion.
Dazzling golden Light Cocoon immediately enveloped her in entirety, and powerful energy fluctuations rippled throughout the circular hall.
The transformation begins!
...
On the outskirts of the Land of Trial, the dusk was bloodred.
Wei Yuan stood with hands behind his back at the frontline of the defense, with hundreds of soldiers standing ready behind him.
The gap unsealed after the second level was passed had already been fortified with tight defenses by him.
Now, all that remained was the last step!
As long as the three pass, the defense of Longxia Country could be connected as a whole.
At that time, the upgrade difficulty for new Beast Masters would drastically decrease.
"Chief, it’s been half a day, and the third level hasn’t been passed yet, could they have... failed?"

Yet, Wei Yuan’s gaze was unwavering, staring at this restriction.

Five brief and powerful words, resounding loudly.

Indeed, this batch of trial takers was hailed as the strongest lineup in recent years.
If they couldn’t break through, then this trial might...
be impossible to pass!
Suddenly——
"Crack, crack—"
The crisp sound of shattering broke the silence.
Upon hearing this sound, Wei Yuan and the deputy turned nearly simultaneously.
This was... the sound of the restriction breaking!
This signified that they had... passed!
"All units attention!" Wei Yuan roared, his voice echoing far and wide, "Restriction is broken, prepare to face the enemy!"
Hundreds of soldiers responded in unison: "Understood!"
The sound wave was thunderous.
"Crack!"
With one final crisp sound, the restriction completely shattered.
From the enormous gap, countless Demon Race creatures shrieked wretchedly and flooded in like a tide.
Wei Yuan watched the Demon Tide, the presence of the Monarch Level Beast Master dominating the battlefield.
"If any of these Demon Race creatures escape, military law will deal with it!"
The battle was about to commence!

The Demon Race creatures fought fearlessly, but the soldiers led by Wei Yuan were equally the elite of Longxia Country.
To close this gap and make the entire defense line of Longxia Country whole.

In the Land of Trial, unlike the battlefield front lines, it was incredibly silent here.

Merge!

Ying Bing’s fingers gently stroking the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, Qin Tian’s nervous fist-clenching knuckles, and...
