chapters.title: Chapter 29: Wei Yuan Arrives!
chapters.content:
Chapter 29: Chapter 29: Wei Yuan Arrives!
In the throes of extreme agony, the enchanting demon finally couldn’t hold on and completely lost consciousness.
Seeing this, Gu Xing gave Liu Li a knowing glance.
The little angel understood and immediately withdrew the Red Flame covering the enchanting demon’s body.
After all, this was under the watchful eyes of the public; if he truly killed this enchanting demon in front of everyone, it would inevitably draw criticism.
Moreover...
To simply destroy an Epic-level Enchanting Demon like this would be... too much of a waste!
He looked down at the unconscious enchanting demon, pondering slightly.
As per the gambling agreement, Chen Ziming had lost completely, so the right to handle this enchanting demon naturally fell into his hands.
Take back the Guardian Beast that once betrayed him?
He had no such perverse interest!
However...
Because of his involvement, Shen Ruoxue had lost her Guardian Beast.
And now... isn’t this the perfect chance to make amends?
Although this enchanting demon had malintent, its talent was still considered decent.
If Shen Ruoxue signs a "Servant Contract" with it, not only can she compensate for her loss, but it will also ensure this enchanting demon dares not harbor any impure thoughts again.
Ordinary Beast Taming Contracts stress equality and mutual assistance, but Servant Contracts are entirely different.
Once signed, the Guardian Beast’s life, soul, and even thoughts will be entirely under the master’s control.
Although such contracts have been banned, given this enchanting demon’s special situation...
Xia Xiu probably won’t reject it!Thɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
After deciding the fate of the enchanting demon, Gu Xing’s gaze returned to Chen Ziming.
At this moment, Chen Ziming still lay prostrate on the ground, his forehead pressed against the rough surface of the arena, hoarsely pleading:
"Gu... Brother Gu... I beg you to spare me..."
Gu Xing’s eyes darkened.
He vowed to repay a multiple of the debt, and he must fulfill that vow!
From the team members of Shen Ruoxue, he had just learned of the entire situation.
Just because Shen Ruoxue delayed him for a few minutes, Chen Ziming had lashed out so poisonously against her.
Gu Xing stepped forward slowly, his boots making a muffled sound on the arena.
"It’s time to end this!"
Tormenting wasn’t his intention; the previous punishment had already vented enough anger.
Gu Xing looked down at the trembling Chen Ziming.
"The debts between you and me are settled. Next... is the debt you owe Shen Ruoxue."
"Of course—" He flexed his wrist, "She can’t settle it personally, so I’ll do it on her behalf."
Chen Ziming jerked his head up, fear flashing in his eyes.
"You broke one of her legs... I’ll break your limbs!"
Before the words could fully land, four crisp bone-breaking sounds rang in succession.
"Crack! Crack! Crack! Crack!"
The intense pain hit like a tidal wave; Chen Ziming couldn’t even scream before flipping his eyes and fainting.
His limbs twisted at odd angles, resembling a disassembled marionette.
The onlookers collectively gasped at the sight.
"Gu... God Gu, this is too cruel! He actually disabled Chen Ziming’s limbs in public! Isn’t he afraid of the Chen Family’s revenge?"
"Open your eyes and look... Chen Shan has been sitting in place the whole time, so evidently the City Lord has intervened."
"That’s right, if the City Lord hadn’t intervened, the referee would have stopped it long ago, not waiting until now."
At the edge of the arena, the referee stumbled suddenly.
The terrifying energy locking him completely finally dissipated.
Still shaken, he glanced at Xia Xiu on the high platform, who was meditating, and loudly announced:
"In this match, Gu Xing wins!"
The entire square fell silent briefly, then erupted in thunderous cheers.
In stark contrast was the distinguished seats on the high platform.
Chen Shan’s fingers dug deeply into the armrest, creating five marks on the solid wood structure.
His son had been publicly crippled, and yet he couldn’t move a single finger.
Utterly egregious!!
Chen Shan’s eyes turned blood red, fury bubbling within his chest.
Seeing the match was over, Xia Xiu spoke leisurely:
"Vice Principal Chen, it should be time to announce Gu Xing as this year’s exam champion!"
Smooth as his voice was, it carried a sharp warning.
If they still couldn’t see the situation clearly, he wouldn’t mind helping make Lin Yuan City a little less bustling by removing a chamber of commerce president and vice principal.
However.
Chen Shan suddenly turned his head, blood vessels visible in his eyes:
"City Lord Xia, you think you can protect him like this?"
"Oh?"
Xia Xiu’s eyes turned cold, his aura surging like a deep ocean.
A city lord like himself being repeatedly challenged by Chen Shan, a High-Tier Beast Master, even with his cultivation, ignited anger in his heart.
Yet, Chen Shan had already lost his reason completely.
His only son publicly crippled, his eyes showed nothing but a dangerously insane persistence.
"Gu Xing wasn’t qualified to compete at all! He was over half an hour late, disqualifying him according to the rules!"
"Those are the Longxia Regulations; even as City Lord, you can’t change the fact that Gu Xing is disqualified."
Xia Xiu furrowed his brow; after verifying the information with his attendant, his expression turned solemn.
He indeed overlooked this point...
Upon arriving and seeing Gu Xing already in the arena, he hadn’t delved into the qualification issue.
He hadn’t anticipated this before!
Now it’s troublesome.
Chen Yan reacted swiftly, swiftly adding:
"City Lord Xia, the rules are the rules. Even an SSS-Class genius can’t override them."
"Therefore, Gu Xing’s exam qualification must be canceled!"
Xia Xiu found himself in a dilemma.
This was something that could have been small or big.
The school could have simply overlooked it and let it slide.
But now, Chen Shan and his son clung stubbornly to the "Longxia Regulations," elevating a simple tardiness issue to a matter of national law.
Even as the City Lord of Lin Yuan City, he couldn’t have special privileges.
Trouble!
The delay in announcing the championship results gradually stirred unrest on site.
"What’s happening? God Gu clearly won the match, why haven’t they announced the result yet?"
"Could something have gone wrong? God Gu followed the rules throughout!"
"Wait... Was God Gu late before the start?"
In the center of the ring, Gu Xing furrowed his brow slightly.
In this world surrounded by exotic beasts, Longxia Country is under wartime management regulations, with rules reigning supreme.
That’s why he followed every rule during the match, leaving no one any grounds for complaint.
But now it seems...
He glanced up at the high platform, fixing his gaze on Chen Shan’s distorted smile.
After a brief thought, he understood what went wrong.
But...
Gu Xing’s lips curled into a cold smile.
Even if he was truly disqualified, so what?
With Liu Li’s strength, special recruitment channels, military recommendations...
There are plenty of avenues to enter a top academy!
Just a bit more hassle is all.
On the high platform, Chen Yan was rising slowly, deliberately adjusting his elegant cuffs.
His face bore a victorious smile as he began to speak:
"After our discussion..."
He intentionally elongated his speech, drawing all eyes.
"Candidate Gu Xing is disqualified for severe tardiness!"
Before the last word landed, a piercing sound broke through the sky.
Everyone looked up to see a gigantic bird with a wingspan of over thirty meters tearing through the clouds, casting a shadow over the entire square.
"How dare you!"
A thunderous roar erupted from the sky.
"I want to see who dares cancel the college entrance qualification of a First-class Honor Medal recipient!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 30: What the Hell Are You?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 30: Chapter 30: What the Hell Are You?!
Before the voice fell, Wei Yuan’s figure appeared like a phantom in front of everyone.
The aura of a Monarch Level expert instantly enveloped the entire square, freezing the air.
Seeing the newcomer.
Chen Yan’s pupils shrank abruptly, and beads of sweat broke out on his forehead.
This person is the head of the Southern Military Region.
He may ignore Xia Xiu, but he definitely doesn’t dare to cause trouble in front of Wei Yuan.
"Sir..." Chen Yan hurriedly stepped forward, bowing so deeply he was almost folded in half, "Why did you personally..."
Wei Yuan glanced at him faintly and walked straight to Xia Xiu:
"Xia Xiu, tell me what’s going on!"
At this moment.
Xia Xiu was digesting the information in Wei Yuan’s previous statement.
This is only awarded to those who have made great contributions to Longxia Country!
You must know that he has been in the military for thirty years, and he has only barely received a Second-class Honor Medal.
But Gu Xing...
How old is he?!
Suppressing the shock in his heart, he began to recount the origin of what happened on the scene.
And with each sentence he spoke, Wei Yuan’s face grew darker.
"Snatching Guardian Beast? Harboring fraud?"
Thunder was already brewing in his eyes.
When he heard that the Chen father and son wanted to cancel Gu Xing’s qualifications, Wei Yuan suddenly erupted with terrifying killing intent.
Not long ago, he had just learned from Qin Tian and Ying Bing that the entire Abyssal Trial was passed almost entirely due to Gu Xing’s efforts.
For this reason, he hurriedly finished his military duties to come personally and commend this young hero.
But now...
The hero is being humiliated!
"You... want to cancel Gu Xing’s college entrance exam qualifications?!"
Wei Yuan’s voice was like Nine Netherworld Ice, with each word carrying piercing murderous intent.
"Thud!"
Chen Yan’s knees slammed heavily on the ground, and cold sweat poured down from his forehead like rain.
"Wei... Wei Head!" His voice trembled, "We really didn’t know Gu Xing is a First-class Medal recipient! This... this is just following regulations!"
But noticing Wei Yuan’s displeased look, he hurriedly changed his tune:
"Since the situation is special, naturally we need special arrangements! Gu Xing’s qualification for assessment will be restored immediately!"
At this moment, Chen Yan dared not have a single stray thought.
After all, Wei Yuan’s fame resounded throughout the Southern region.
Although he appeared gentle and elegant on the surface, his methods were extremely decisive and ruthless.
If not for this, he wouldn’t have been able to become.
However.
Chen Shan was still unwilling.
So, he braced himself and spoke:
"Wei Head!..."
But upon hearing this, Chen Yan immediately turned his gaze away in fear.
Chen Shan had stayed in Lin Yuan City for too long, living within the rules for many years.
"Boom!"
A whip-like kick exploded like thunder; Chen Shan’s entire body flew sideways like a torn sack, slamming heavily in the center of the ring, and he passed out on the spot.
Seeing Chen Shan’s miserable state, Chen Yan’s body went limp, almost collapsing to the ground.
Wei Yuan’s gaze returned to Chen Yan, "You know what to do, right?"
"Wei... Wei Head, I... I understand!"
Chen Yan’s voice trembled, forcing himself to stand up and announce:
"The champion of this assessment is — Gu Xing!"
The entire venue instantly fell into an eerie silence, followed by deafening cheers.
Gu Xing, with Awakened Tier Six, defeated Awakening Tier Eight to claim first place in the competition, but he was disqualified.
Then the Southern Military Region’s leader personally arrived, and the situation reversed again.
Today was simply too exciting for these people.
Unlike others’ excitement, Chen Yan felt as if he had fallen into an ice cave.
He didn’t know what kind of fate awaited him next!
However.
Wei Yuan didn’t even glance at him, turning to walk towards the ring.
Just when he thought he had escaped a disaster.
Wei Yuan’s voice slowly came:
"Someone like you doesn’t deserve to teach and educate people. Submit your resignation to the military department yourself, report to the Vanguard Team tomorrow!"
This sentence struck like a thunderbolt on Chen Yan’s head.
The Vanguard Team!
Also known as Cannon Fodder Camp!
Specially accommodates serious offenders and derelict military officers, with a death rate as high as seventy percent!
Chen Yan’s face was as pale as paper, yet he didn’t dare utter a single "no."
"Thank... thank Wei Head for your mercy; I’ll report tomorrow."
His voice was hoarse, instantly aging ten years.
Wei Yuan lightly nodded.
If not for the old principal’s face, with his temper, he would have slapped this scoundrel dead on the spot.
Soon, Wei Yuan reached the top of the ring.
A smile instantly appeared on his face.
"Student Gu Xing, thank you; you’ve helped Longxia solve a deep concern."
Gu Xing still felt a bit bewildered at this moment.
After all, just now, he was planning to enter the university through military recommendation.
Unexpectedly, in just an instant, the situation reversed.
Quickly recovering, he hurriedly spoke:
"Wei Head, why have you come to Lin Yuan City again? Is there a problem with the trial?"
"Good boy, hearing your tone, I can’t come to Lin Yuan City for other matters?"
Wei Yuan intentionally kept a straight face.
"No, no!" Gu Xing quickly waved his hands.Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
With his current identity, how could he disdain Wei Yuan?
Seeing Gu Xing’s appearance, Wei Yuan laughed and tossed out an item.
"You ran off too quickly; you even forgot to take your thing. I’ve brought it to you."
Gu Xing hastily reached out to catch it.
[Light Crystal: Contains extreme Light Attribute power]
Seeing this palm-sized Light Crystal, Gu Xing finally realized.
His purpose in participating in the trial was for this... yet he finished the trial and left too quickly, causing him to forget about it.
"Thank you, Wei Head." Gu Xing sincerely expressed his gratitude.
"Why be polite to me," Wei Yuan laughed heartily, suddenly changing the topic, "By the way, after graduation, are you interested in developing in our military region?"
His visit to Lin Yuan City this time had one purpose to thank Gu Xing for his contributions.
As for the other purpose, it was to pull this genius into the Southern Military Region ahead of time.
If he waited until Gu Xing showed his prowess in university, his competitors would be numerous.
Gu Xing was stunned upon hearing this.
He hadn’t even entered college, and this head was already scheduling for four years later?
"Wei Head, my college entrance exam hasn’t even ended... Isn’t it too early to talk about this?"
"Early what? With your ability, isn’t being the top scorer in the college entrance exam a certainty? Young people should plan early!"
Looking at Wei Yuan’s serious expression, the corners of Gu Xing’s mouth slightly twitched.
Four years is long enough for countless changes; who can say for sure what the future holds?
"I’m really sorry, Wei Head, but I truly don’t have plans in this area now."
Seeing Gu Xing’s resolute attitude, Wei Yuan had to settle for the second-best option:
"Then, if you ever consider joining the military, you must prioritize our Southern Military Region!"
"Certainly."
Only then did Wei Yuan show a satisfied smile.
Initially, he didn’t think he could succeed; now, this result was already very good.
Afterward, Wei Yuan pointed towards the Chen father and son, who were lying like dead dogs:
"What do you want to do with them?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 31: Stinky Demon! Who Are You Calling Master?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 31: Chapter 31: Stinky Demon! Who Are You Calling Master?!
Gu Xing’s gaze followed Wei Yuan’s fingertip.
On the stage, the once high and mighty Chen father and son were now in complete disarray, sprawled on the ground like two dead dogs.
Chen Shan’s usually stern and cold face was now ashen and forlorn.
And Chen Ziming appeared even worse, with blood at his lips and twisted limbs, long gone were his days of arrogance and insolence.
Gu Xing looked at them coldly, with not a hint of emotion in his heart.
Chen Shan had bullied and bribed others over the years, forcefully snatching the guardian beasts of countless students.
And Chen Ziming, relying on his father’s authority, ran rampant through Lin Yuan City, oppressing classmates recklessly.
Their downfall today was entirely of their own making.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
"Commander Wei, proceed according to the law!"
Hearing this, Wei Yuan nodded slightly.
He had specifically kept the Chen father and son alive to give Gu Xing a chance to vent his anger.
Yet apparently, Gu Xing had no such intention.
After a brief contemplation, his gaze swept over the unconscious Chen father and son:
"Assign Chen Shan to the Vanguard Team!"
When it came to Chen Ziming, he deliberately slowed his pace:
"As for this one... intended harm to classmates, slaughtered guardian beasts."
Wei Yuan enunciated clearly: "Imprison in Lin Yuan City dungeon for life."
With Wei Yuan’s judgment declared, the fate of the Chen father and son was sealed.
Soon, personnel arrived to carry away the unconscious Chen father and son.
Before leaving, a Spiritual Type Beast Master conjured a bluish light in his palm, swiftly severing the Spiritual Link between Chen Ziming and the Enchanting Demon.
They hadn’t forgotten, this Enchanting Demon now belonged to Gu Xing!
Wei Yuan looked around to ensure everything had been properly settled.
"With military matters at hand, I must depart now. Remember, after graduation, consider the Southern Military Region as a priority."
Gu Xing solemnly nodded.
Seeing this, Wei Yuan departed, satisfied.
After taking a few steps, as if recalling something important:
"Oh, regarding the second phase of the military assessment..."
"Considering that you and Ying Bing are about to go to the Elf Secret Realm, this one-and-a-half-month assessment, you may choose not to participate."
"Your score, without assessment, will be ranked first in this round!"
Wei Yuan’s decision made Gu Xing’s eyes light up.
Earlier he was torn; the result of the second assessment clashed with the Elf Secret Realm’s timing, unsure of how to resolve it.
Now, not having to participate in the military assessment directly saved him a headache.
This military commander came and went like the wind, and in a blink had left Lin Yuan City.
Leaving behind only two precious gifts:
The Light Crystal emitting warm rays, and a First-class Honor Medal.
"These are really valuable things!"
Xia Xiu, who had arrived unnoticed, gazed with fervor at the medal, filled with envy.
"A First-class Honor Medal can not only mobilize the City Defense Army, but in a critical moment can also request a special squad, don’t underestimate the weight of this badge."
Prompted by Xia Xiu, Gu Xing realized the preciousness of the objects in his hand, quickly and solemnly putting them away.
He initially thought it was merely a medal symbolizing honor, unaware of its actual authority.
After seeing Gu Xing stow it away, Xia Xiu continued:
"By the way, that injured girl, I’ve sent the best healer over, she’ll likely recover soon."
"Thank you, City Lord!"
Xia Xiu casually waved.
Gu Xing’s glance inadvertently fell on the bound Enchanting Demon, his gaze cold:
"City Lord Xia, I want Shen Ruoxue to sign a Slave Contract with this Enchanting Demon."
"Slave Contract?"
Xia Xiu raised an eyebrow, then knowingly nodded.
"Indeed, such a master-devouring guardian beast should be bound with the strictest contract, I agree!"
After getting acquainted with Gu Xing, Xia Xiu turned and left the stage, leaving the scene to Gu Xing.
Immediately, deafening cheers erupted around the stage, the sound waves crashing like tides repeatedly.
At this moment, Gu Xing’s name echoed throughout Lin Yuan City!
Amidst the cheers, the Enchanting Demon slowly awoke.
In her dark purple pupils, the figure standing under the sunlight was reflected.
Gu Xing was clad in glory, surrounded by all the cheers and praises.
Beside him, a silver-haired girl tightly gripped his hand, the two looking perfectly suited.
Her heart suddenly tightened.
A tidal wave of unprecedented regret welled in her heart.
If she had not betrayed Gu Xing initially, if she had upheld the contract, would she be the one standing in that position now?
But it seems it’s not too late!
As a wager’s spoils, she had already been lost by Chen Ziming to Gu Xing.
This means she still had a chance, hoping to become Gu Xing’s guardian beast again...
She could also enjoy everything that Angel enjoys!
...
Medical room.
"Captain, God Gu avenged you! Chen Ziming had his limbs broken on the stage, and Commander Wei personally intervened, the Chen family is completely finished!"
"Captain, don’t be sad, our whole team pooled money to surely buy you a better guardian beast!"
"Yes, Captain, the second assessment is still waiting for you to lead!"
"Captain, hurry and perk up!"
Gu Xing had just reached the medical room’s entrance when he heard Shen Ruoxue’s team members’ consolations inside.
Gu Xing turned to look at the Enchanting Demon.
"Ma... Master, why did you bring me here?"
At this moment, the Enchanting Demon’s voice trembled, her scarlet pupils slightly contracting.
A feeling of ominous foreboding suddenly emerged within her.
Yet...
"Stinky Demon! Who are you calling master?!"
The little girl standing beside Gu Xing immediately protested.
Her master must seek her consent even if he wanted to sign a contract with the guardian beast.
This Enchanting Demon...
Clearly hadn’t met her standards!
"Don’t call him that!"
Liu Li puffed her cheeks in anger, a cluster of red flames slowly appearing in her palm.
The sight of the flames made the Enchanting Demon shiver all over; memories of the burning agony came flooding back instantly.
The pain of having one’s soul scorched, she no longer wished to endure again.
"I’m sorry!" she hastily bowed her head, admitting her fault.
Only then did Liu Li contentedly extinguish the flame, letting out a proud snort.
Gu Xing found himself both amused and exasperated at his little angel.
The little girl was perfect in every way, just tended to be a bit jealous.
Helplessly shaking his head, Gu Xing gently knocked on the medical room door.
"Knock, knock, knock——"
Conversation inside abruptly stopped.
A moment later, the door cracked open, revealing a familiar face.
"Gu... God Gu?!"
The team member who answered the door widened her eyes, hurriedly stepping aside, "Please, come in!"
Gu Xing politely nodded and stepped inside.
Upon seeing Gu Xing, the room fell into an instant tumult.
"Gu... God Gu... please, sit here."
"God Gu... would you like some fruit, I’ll prepare it for you!"
Most eye-catching was Shen Ruoxue on the sickbed.
Her originally vacant gaze regained focus upon recognizing the visitor, even a noticeable blush adorned her pale cheeks.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Master, Is That Sister’s Hand Soft?
chapters.content:
Chapter 32: Chapter 32: Master, Is That Sister’s Hand Soft?
In the medbay, a quick-witted female team member was the first to react and immediately started shooing people away.
"Everyone out, everyone out!" She pushed the team members out like driving chickens, "Don’t be a nuisance here!"
After she pushed the last team member out of the door, she turned around and winked at Gu Xing:
"God Gu, we’ll leave our captain to you!"
She made a cheering gesture before gently closing the door.
With the door shut, the room suddenly became quiet.
Shen Ruoxue clutched the corner of her blanket, her fingertips trembling slightly.
"Gu... Gu Xing, why are you here?"
Even though she had wanted to find Gu Xing before to express her gratitude,
now, seeing Gu Xing actually in front of her, she was so nervous her voice trembled.
Gu Xing calmly picked up an apple and started peeling it.
"Your injury was caused by me, isn’t it only right I come to visit?"
Shen Ruoxue hurriedly replied, "It’s... we’re all classmates, helping each other is what we should do."
Her face turned even redder, as even she didn’t believe the clumsy excuse she gave.
Seeing this, Gu Xing didn’t expose her!
"Besides coming to see you this time, there’s another matter."
After saying this, Gu Xing turned his head, his gaze falling onto the Enchanting Demon.
At this moment, the Enchanting Demon felt an increasingly ominous premonition.
"Apologize!"
Gu Xing’s voice suddenly turned sharp.
The Enchanting Demon, frightened by the sudden voice, immediately knelt to the ground.
"I’m sorry! I’m sorry!"
The Enchanting Demon repeated the words of apology, but her gaze remained fixed on Gu Xing, with no sincerity in her eyes.
Seeing this, Gu Xing shook his head, and the last trace of hesitation in his eyes vanished completely!
It’s hard to change a person’s nature!
He had been hesitating whether to use a Slave Contract on his Guardian Beast; now it seemed the decision was very right.
Shen Ruoxue, seeing the Enchanting Demon’s action, was momentarily stunned but quickly understood.
"Gu Xing, there’s no need for this; it was because of Chen Ziming’s orders at the time that she acted this way..."
From her teammates, Shen Ruoxue already knew that this Enchanting Demon now belonged to Gu Xing, meaning she would be Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast from now on.
Even if she still held resentment towards the Enchanting Demon, she should let it go now.
"Gu Xing, please let her up; it’s not her fault!"
However, Gu Xing did not listen and instead handed the peeled apple to Shen Ruoxue.
"This matter involves her, and she must apologize!"
Looking at Gu Xing’s incredibly serious eyes, Shen Ruoxue’s heart skipped a beat.
She carefully took the apple, her fingertips inadvertently touching the back of Gu Xing’s hand, immediately drawing back as if scalded.
Since being saved by Gu Xing in the Newbie Trial Space, she seemed to have developed a unique feeling towards him.
Therefore, even though she lost her Guardian Beast, she did not regret it.
However...
"Call me Master!"
Gu Xing’s sudden command froze the room instantly.
The apple in Shen Ruoxue’s hand fell to the ground with a "thud"; she looked at Gu Xing in disbelief, questioning her own hearing.
"Wasn’t your Guardian Beast killed by Chen Ziming because of me? Now I’m giving you one back!"
"No, no... I can’t, how could I accept this!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words clearly, Shen Ruoxue quickly waved her hands to refuse, tears welling up in her eyes with anxiety.
She indeed had no Guardian Beast now, but...
She couldn’t accept Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast!
If she took away this Epic Level Guardian Beast, what would Gu Xing contract when he ascends to the Extraordinary Level?
"I’ve already made up my mind! Refusing is useless!"
Gu Xing showed a firm attitude, leaving Shen Ruoxue no chance to refuse.
Meanwhile, the Enchanting Demon kneeling on the ground felt cold all over.
She could accept failure, and even death, but she couldn’t accept...
Being transferred to an ordinary human!
"No... I don’t want to go with her!"
The Enchanting Demon stood up abruptly, her dark purple eyes reddened, filled with confusion.
"Gu Xing! Even if I betrayed you in the past, you shouldn’t humiliate me like this!"
"I can’t compare to that Angel, but I’m also a genuine Epic Level Guardian Beast! And yet you want to give me to..."
Watching the emotionally broken Enchanting Demon, Gu Xing chuckled coldly, his eyes icy.
"Epic Level? Is that powerful?"
"As for saying you don’t want to... do you have a choice?"Google seaʀᴄh
Before he finished speaking, Liu Li reached over and firmly restrained the Enchanting Demon in place.
Gu Xing slowly raised his hand, a blood-red Pentagram Array appearing in the void.
"A Slave Contract?!"
The Enchanting Demon’s pupils contracted to pinpoints, her voice twisted with fear.
She struggled desperately, dark purple magic power surging around her, yet completely unable to break free of Liu Li’s control.
Gu Xing, expressionless, pulled Shen Ruoxue’s hand over, gently slicing her forefinger.
As the drop of red blood fell into the center of the Array, the entire Contract Array burst into a brilliant red light.
"I don’t want the contract, I don’t want..."
However, Gu Xing’s actions showed no hesitation.
In the Enchanting Demon’s despairing gaze, the blood-colored runes mercilessly embedded into her brow.
[Enchanting Demon]
[Master: Shen Ruoxue]
[Status: Slave Contract]
[Talent: Epic Two Stars]
[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Attributes: Dark Element, Spiritual Type]
[Power: 70]
[Constitution: 72]
[Spirit: 137]
[Speed: 81]
[Skills: Desire Absorption, Enchanting Eyes]
Seeing the contract successfully completed, Gu Xing breathed a sigh of relief.
This was his first time using a Slave Contract, never expecting it to work on the first try.
However, since Shen Ruoxue was only at Awakening Tier Five, the Enchanting Demon, originally Awakening Tier Eight, had her level dropped as a result.
But once Shen Ruoxue’s level increases, the Enchanting Demon’s strength would also quickly recover.
"This..."
Shen Ruoxue finally awoke as if from a dream, looking at her palm in disbelief.
An Epic-level Guardian Beast just became her contracted beast this way?!
And with a Slave Contract enforcing absolute obedience?!
The Enchanting Demon knelt on the ground, her face full of unwillingness, but bound by the contract, she couldn’t resist.
Her dark purple eyes shimmered with tears of humiliation, yet she dared not utter a single complaint.
"Alright, the matter is done."
Gu Xing clapped his hands and stood up.
With this task completed, he could finally rest for two days.
Though Wei Yuan had granted him special permission to skip the second stage assessment, he was currently only Awakening Tier Six.
So, after careful consideration, he decided to participate in the second assessment to raise his level, planning to leave midway when necessary.
"Class monitor, if there’s nothing else, I’ll be off then."
After bidding farewell to Shen Ruoxue, Gu Xing mentioned his departure.
Watching Gu Xing turn to leave, Shen Ruoxue instinctively reached out a hand, wanting to stop him.
But ultimately, no words came out of her mouth, and she could only let her arm fall powerlessly.
"Bang!"
As soon as the door to the medbay opened, several figures, stacked like acrobats, fell in awkwardly.
They had tried to eavesdrop on the gossip of the captain and God Gu but were caught red-handed.
Shen Ruoxue’s teammates scrambled to get up, their faces adorned with awkward smiles.
Of course, Gu Xing didn’t mind any of this — he nodded slightly and left with Liu Li.
However.
As soon as he stepped out of the medbay, Gu Xing felt a chill behind him.
"Master, was that sister’s hand... soft?"
"You haven’t even given me an apple you peeled..."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Farewell, Ying Bing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 33: Chapter 33: Farewell, Ying Bing!
Finally, under Gu Xing’s repeated assurances, the little girl returned to normal.
In the next two days, Gu Xing rarely took Liu Li on a leisurely tour around Lin Yuan City.
From food to local customs, he let the little girl experience it all.
Until the day the second assessment began.
As soon as Gu Xing arrived at the gathering square with Liu Li, he saw an unexpected person.
"Ying... Ying Bing?!"
The girl in white, akin to snow, approached slowly, followed by a spirited elder.
"Why are you here?"
Upon seeing Gu Xing, Ying Bing paused slightly, a hint of panic flashing through her cool eyes.
Ying Bing pressed her lips together, hesitated for a long time before slowly speaking:
"Secret Realm!"
The girl’s voice was very light, and Gu Xing did not notice her anomaly.
After all, in his impression, Ying Bing was always taciturn.
But Ying Xinghe standing nearby squinted his eyes.
As Ying Bing’s Guardian who watched her grow up, he keenly sensed his lady’s difference!
His lady used to be entirely focused on her Guardian Beast, never distracted by external matters.
But now...
Ying Xinghe’s sharp gaze swept over Gu Xing, silently pondering:
The lady insisted on coming to Lin Yuan City...
Could it possibly be because of this boy?!
However, thinking it over again.
His duty was merely to protect Ying Bing’s safety; as for her emotional issues...
Let the Clan Leader worry about those!
"There’s still over forty days before the Secret Realm closes, I plan to first participate in the military assessment, elevate my strength to Awakened Tier Nine before entering."
"So, I want to take part in the military-organized second assessment first, then you..."
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Ying Bing.
His intention in saying this was for Ying Bing to make her own arrangements first, then reconvene when the time was right.
Yet...
"I’m joining too!"
Gu Xing: "???"
For a moment, Gu Xing was tongue-tied, he opened his mouth wanting to say something.
But seeing Ying Bing’s matter-of-fact expression, he ultimately could only let out a helpless sigh.
Join if you must.
With Ying Bing’s strength, plus that deeply hidden elder’s protection, certainly nothing dangerous will happen.
Moreover, he couldn’t decide Ying Bing’s thoughts.
Thus, he just let it be.
Soon, the Deputy Principal finished his address, and everyone arranged themselves to set off towards the second assessment point.
This assessment was set up by the military, located within an Alternate Space.
Its purpose was to ensure newbie Beast Masters swiftly adapted to the brutality of the battlefield.
Although the military had initially cleared the Demons within the area, still every year numerous students lost their lives here.
...
The second assessment zone.
Gu Qianqian stared at the scene before her, slightly entranced.
Although the site was provided by the military, each student’s performance was evaluated by representatives from various universities.
As a talented student of the National Academy, she need not participate in proctoring such a fundamental assessment.
But thinking of Gu Xing, she took the initiative to apply as an assessor.
"Qianqian, still worrying about your brother?"
A gentle tap on her shoulder, Tang Xinrou’s voice brought her back to reality.
Gu Qianqian turned, meeting her best friend’s concerned gaze, she shook her head.
But Tang Xinrou, seeing Gu Qianqian’s demeanor, knew her friend was simply putting up a front.
"Qianqian, don’t worry! With such an excellent sister like you, how bad could your brother do?"
"Besides, I’m here too!"
"I’ve already informed my junior brothers and sisters, asking them to pay special attention to Gu Xing’s safety. You can rest assured!"
Gu Qianqian looked at her friend’s caring expression and nodded lightly:
"Thank you, Xinrou!"
Seeing her friend’s mood improve, Tang Xinrou finally felt relieved.
Then, she mysteriously glanced around, leaned closer to Gu Qianqian’s ear, and lowered her voice:
"Actually, I’ve not only asked them to protect your brother but also reminded them..."
"Even if his performance is slightly lacking, they’ll generously award high marks."
Gu Qianqian snickered: "Xinrou, that’s really unnecessary. I believe he can get into the National Academy on his own strength."
Tang Xinrou dismissively pouted.
Getting into the National Academy is no easy feat?
It’s the top institution in Longxia Country.
Back then, Gu Qianqian barely met the admission line; it wasn’t until her Extraordinary Level awakening with top-tier Talent that she truly shone.
While her brother stayed in a small city, his chance of getting in...
Less than ten percent!

"Alright, I need to head to my designated assessment area now."
Tang Xinrou waved goodbye, then suddenly sternly added:
"By the way, the military reported that during earlier clearance in this area two Extraordinary Level Demons were missed, Qianqian, be cautious."
"Hmm!"
...
Elsewhere.
After experiencing the familiar dizziness.
The fifty students who passed the first round found themselves in a completely new world.
Towering ancient trees rose from the earth, a faint mist drifted in the air.
In the distance, in front of the military’s temporary command post, the flag of Longxia Country flapped in the peculiar breeze of the Alternate Space.
Last time, led by Wei Yuan, he couldn’t discern what the entrance to the Alternate Space looked like.
For Gu Xing, this considered his first formal entry into the Alternate Space.
And as soon as their group of fifty entered the Alternate Space, they attracted a lot of attention.
Besides examinees from Lin Yuan City, advanced students from several surrounding cities also converged here.
"That should be the Lin Yuan City team, right? As expected, they arrived last again."
"Their scores are always at the bottom in each assessment, yet their display is grand."
"Yeah, with barely a few students passing their assessments each time, why wait for them?"
Amidst the whispers, Gu Xing frowned slightly.
"In previous assessments, Lin Yuan City’s results weren’t great, even arguably bottom-ranked."
"However, with you here this year, it’s estimated Lin Yuan City could win first place this time."
Just then, Shen Ruoxue led her team over, clarifying his doubt.
And the Enchanting Demon beside Shen Ruoxue, seeing Gu Xing, immediately shrank her head, not daring to act rashly.
During this period under Shen Ruoxue’s training, she had become notably more obedient.
"I probably won’t participate in this assessment."
Shen Ruoxue was initially taken aback, then understood.
With Gu Xing’s capabilities, there’s really no need to prove anything through such assessments.
However.
Her gaze shifted to the girl beside Gu Xing...
What a beautiful girl!
She looks perfectly matched with Gu Xing!
Though she had anticipated this scene long ago, she couldn’t help but feel a pang of disappointment, pulling a forced smile and tentatively asking:
"Who might this be?"
Gu Xing was about to speak.
"Ying Bing!"
Ying Bing calmly introduced herself, her voice cold.
After Shen Ruoxue nodded politely, she wisely decided to take her leave.
Staying here disturbing the two of them... felt wrong!
"We’ll head off first, the assessment is about to begin."
She barely maintained a poised smile, yet the disappointment in her tone was evident even to the perceptive Liu Li.
The little girl suddenly reached out, viciously pinching Gu Xing’s waist from behind.
Her master seemed...
Unexpectedly quite popular!

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Far Beyond Average, an Absolute Monster!
chapters.content:
Chapter 34: Chapter 34: Far Beyond Average, an Absolute Monster!
"Hiss——"
Liu Li’s sudden small action made Gu Xing take a breath of cold air.
He turned his head to meet the dangerous gaze of his own guardian beast, immediately showing a pleading look asking for mercy.
"Hmph!"
Liu Li turned her head proudly, finally letting Gu Xing off the hook.
Seeing this, Gu Xing felt quite helpless.
Ever since meeting Shen Ruoxue last time, his little angel seemed to have awakened the "jealousy" attribute.
And once the little angel got jealous...
The one to suffer was the soft flesh on his waist!
"Sigh!"
The once well-behaved little angel was no longer; now she even learned to lay hands on her master.
Just as Gu Xing was sighing, an officer came out.
"The assessment begins!"
As the command was given, the students rushed towards the assessment area like arrows off a string.
The sooner they entered the assessment area, the more likely they were to advance to a higher level!
Gu Xing subconsciously glanced around and discovered...
Shen Ruoxue’s Enchanting Demon... seemed to rank among the top five among the guardian beasts!
In addition to her tactical command ability, far superior to Chen Ziming...
Even if he didn’t participate, Lin Yuan City was very likely to take first place this time.
Watching the students enter the assessment area gradually, Gu Xing then turned to look at Ying Bing.
"Um... do you want to go with me?"
"Uh-huh!"
Looking at Ying Bing, who seemed to glue herself to him, Gu Xing felt somewhat helpless.
If he didn’t know that Ying Xinghe was lurking nearby, he would have thought he was like a pervert abducting a naive girl.
According to Ying Xinghe, unless they encountered life-threatening danger, he would not intervene.
But Gu Xing knew that Ying Xinghe should be hiding nearby.
Yet, with his current Extraordinary Level spiritual power, he couldn’t perceive Ying Xinghe’s presence at all.
However, after thinking for a moment, Gu Xing accepted Ying Bing following him.
After all, with her Ice Phoenix assisting in control, Liu Li’s leveling efficiency would surely increase significantly.
Thinking of this, he hesitated no more and led Ying Bing directly toward the assessment area.
The entire assessment area was divided into low, medium, and high-level areas.
Gu Xing directly took Ying Bing into the high-level area.
Here, almost all the Demon Race creatures were above Awakened Tier Six.
This should have been an area only open later in the assessment, but the two just swaggered in.
Coincidentally, this area was managed by Tang Xinrou.
At this moment, she was eating chips, idly teasing her guardian beast.
As an Extraordinary Level Beast Master, if not to accompany Gu Qianqian, she certainly wouldn’t have come here.
Moreover, with the assessment just beginning, no one was expected to come to this area.
"How do I get through this month....."
As she was muttering, the guardian beast suddenly sounded an alarm.
Two students had entered the high-level area!
"What?!"
The chips in Tang Xinrou’s hand fell to the ground.
"Which reckless guy dares to rush in here straight away?"
Despite the complaint, her movements were as fast as lightning.
As both an examiner and a safety officer, she had to rush immediately to check the situation.
With a flash of her figure, she sped toward the location of the two.
...
Meanwhile.
Soon after Gu Xing and Ying Bing ventured into the high-level area, three massive Ogres blocked their path.
These Awakened Tier Nine Demon Race creatures emitted a nauseating stench, their dark purple skin covered with hideous demon patterns.
[Ogre]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine]
[Talent: Demon General]
[Power: 193]
[Constitution: 182]
[Spirit: 102]
[Speed: 132]
[Skills: Frenzied Bite, Giant Power Strike]
Gu Xing’s eyes narrowed.
The Demon Race is different from Magic Beasts.
The latter are demonized due to the infection of Demonic Qi.
Whereas the former are born from Demonic Qi.
No one knows where they come from, only that they are the common mortal enemies of all intelligent races.
The Demon Race is divided into six levels based on talent:
Demon Soldier, Demon Captain, Demon General, Demon Monarch, Demon King, Demon God.
Corresponding to Guardian Beast’s common, elite, excellent, epic, legendary, myth level, respectively.
The three Ogres in front of him were all at the Demon General Level!
But seeing these three Demon Race creatures, Gu Xing was delighted.
The purpose of entering the high-level area was to kill Demon Race creatures to level up.
Now that they proactively came to him, it was exactly what he wanted!
However.
When Tang Xinrou arrived at the scene, the sight made her pupils constrict suddenly.
Three Awakened Tier Nine Demon General-level Ogres!
These were not opponents a newly graduated Beast Master could handle.
Her gaze swept over the boy in the field, suddenly feeling a sense of familiarity.
She hurriedly took out the photo Gu Qianqian gave her for comparison—
"Isn’t this Qianqian’s brother?!"
Tang Xinrou took a sharp breath.
Why did this kid rush to the high-level area on the first day of the assessment?
She immediately assumed a combat stance; if Qianqian’s brother got hurt under her watch, she’d never face Gu Qianqian again.
But just as she was preparing to intervene, an unbelievable scene unfolded...
Instead of escaping, the two in the field assumed an offensive stance!
At this moment.
Gu Xing and Ying Bing exchanged a tacit glance.
"You control, I attack!"
"Okay!"
Before Ying Bing finished speaking, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix had already spread its wings and let out a long cry.
"Frost Storm!"
The bone-chilling Frost Storm swept out, covering the three Ogres in ice crystals instantly, slowing them down immediately.
Gu Xing naturally wouldn’t miss this opportunity.
"Liu Li!"
"Judgment——!"
Carmine sword light flashed like a sudden burst of thunder, and the middlemost Ogre, not yet escaping the frost, was cut in half with a single sword.
The remaining two demons roared angrily but were swiftly approached by Liu Li’s ghostly figure.
Despite being only Awakened Tier Six, her attributes had long been on par with these Tier Nine demons.
The sword light flashed again, and the two Ogres fell to the ground.
As three blue halos merged into the brow, Liu Li’s aura suddenly surged——
Leveled up again!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Legendary Three Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier Seven]
[Power: 237]
[Constitution: 240]
[Spirit: 241]
[Speed: 132]
[Skills: Judgment, Divine Protection, Blazing Angel Form]ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
[Cultivation Suggestion: Use Light Crystal, Holy Spirit Marrow Liquid]
Upon advancing to Awakened Tier Seven, Liu Li’s attributes increased once more.
Beside her, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix also used this battle to successfully break through to Awakened Tier Seven.
When Tang Xinrou, watching from a distance, witnessed the whole scene, she rubbed her eyes in disbelief.
She had joked with Gu Qianqian, saying, "Your genius brother is as good as slaying three Awakened Tier Nine Demon Generals like cutting melons."
For back then, when she was at Awakened Tier Six, dealing with one Awakened Tier Eight Demon General was quite challenging.
"Gulp!"
With talent like this, the National Academy is going to break their heads recruiting them.
Gu Xing and Ying Bing continued into the depths, and Tang Xinrou suddenly looked forward to seeing Gu Qianqian’s reaction when she saw her brother’s strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 35: Perfect Score!
chapters.content:
Chapter 35: Chapter 35: Perfect Score!
In the days that followed, Tang Xinrou felt her worldview reshaped.
In front of these two individuals, any Demon Race at any Awakening Tier seemed as fragile as paper.
It was under such circumstances that their abilities soared at an astonishing speed, both breaking through to Awakening Tier Eight in just two days.
When the two finally left her supervision area, Tang Xinrou was still immersed in shock and unable to recover.
She stood dazed for a long time, and finally, solemnly wrote a perfect score on Gu Xing’s evaluation form.
However, what she didn’t know was...
At this moment, at the Southern Military Region Headquarters, Wei Yuan was personally writing a recommendation letter!
With such abilities as Gu Xing’s, participating in the college entrance exam is a complete waste of time!
And the ink was not yet dry on the recommendation letter, with the recipient impressively being——
Long Zhenguo, Principal of the National Academy, For Your Eyes Only!
...
Meanwhile, in the deepest part of the examination area.
Gu Qianqian frowned tightly.
As the strongest among the students sent by the National Academy, she was responsible for supervising the most dangerous area.
At this moment, her perception clearly captured the aura of an Extraordinary Level Demon Race.
"Star Tear Butterfly, Jade-faced Fox!"
With a soft call, two Guardian Beasts responded to the summon.
The Star Tear Butterfly was an Epic Talent Guardian Beast she earned through diligent efforts at school, now at Extraordinary Tier Two.
As for the other, it was her first Guardian Beast that accompanied her from the Awakening Stage, currently at Awakened Tier Nine.
Looking at her two Guardian Beasts, she knew she had to resolve this Extraordinary Level Demon Race before the candidates arrived!
Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable!
If an Extraordinary Level Demon Race were to strike at these Awakening Stage candidates, it would be a massacre!
With this in mind, she immediately rushed toward the direction of the aura she perceived.
Yet, what she didn’t know was...
At this moment, Gu Xing and Ying Bing had silently stepped into this area.
"At this rate, we’ll soon reach Awakened Tier Nine."
Gu Xing turned his head to look at the ice beauty beside him, "Then we’ll head straight to the Secret Realm."
The past few days of close association had allowed him to gradually understand Ying Bing’s nature.
Rather than cold, it was more like indifference to most things.
However, he was unsure if it was his illusion...
This frosty girl seemed to treat him more gently than others.
"Mm!"
Ying Bing’s slender finger gently stroked the wing of the Ice Phoenix, nodding almost imperceptibly.
These few days often left her in a daze.
From childhood to now, this was her first time being with a peer of the opposite gender for so long.
She quietly glanced sideways, her gaze sweeping across the boy’s handsome profile.
The inexplicable emotional fluctuation confused her...
Unable to understand the reason, she turned to gaze at her Ice Phoenix.
Perhaps...
It’s simply because they’ll soon explore the Secret Realm together that she pays extra attention to him.
However, at that moment.
"Watch out!"
Gu Xing’s voice of warning had just fallen.
Liu Li’s silhouette flashed in front of Ying Bing, her snow-white wings drawing a streak of silver light, precisely deflecting the incoming black bone spike.
Ying Bing’s pupils contracted, a drop of cold sweat sliding down her forehead.
If not for Liu Li’s timely intervention, this strike might have pierced her chest.
"Chirp——!"
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix let out an angry cry, its ice-blue wings fully spread, sharply focusing on the shadows deep in the forest.
And Gu Xing also looked serious at this point.
The speed of that attack just now was extremely fast, and with his Extraordinary Level Spiritual Power...
Only when the attack reached Ying Bing’s presence did he clearly perceive it.
At that time, he could only instinctively shout a warning.
Fortunately, Liu Li’s reaction speed was incredibly fast.
At the first moment of his reminder, Liu Li had already flashed to block the attack.
The Demon Race capable of launching such an attack could not possibly be of Awakening Level!
Just as Gu Xing expected, with a series of "crackling" friction sounds, two eerie figures slowly revealed themselves.
On the left, the Skeleton Demon was engulfed in black mist, its pale skeleton covered with sinister spikes.
As for the Demon Race on the right, completely shrouded in a black robe, its appearance was entirely obscure.
Gu Xing dared not be careless and hurriedly checked the information of the two Demons.
[Skeleton Demon]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Two]
[Talent: Demon General]
[Power: 482]Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
[Constitution: 511]
[Spirit: 358]
[Speed: 493]
[Attribute: Bone Repair]
[Skills: Bone Barrier, Thousand Thorn Bone Spike]
...
[Disguiser]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine (Disguise)]
[Talent: Demon General]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: ???]
[Speed: ???]
[Attribute: Disguise Deception]
[Skills: ???]
Seeing the two Demons in front of him, Gu Xing’s expression tightened.
Extraordinary Level Demons!
Just the Skeleton Demon’s attributes nearing 500 points in three aspects made him feel a mountain-like pressure.
At present, Liu Li’s attributes are only about 270 points each, even if she activates the Blazing Angel Form, she may not be able to guarantee victory.
After all, there is a qualitative gap between Extraordinary and Awakening!
But what truly sent chills down his spine was the eerie "Disguiser" beside him.
Although its displayed level was Awakened Tier Nine, all its attributes were ???.
Coupled with its attribute being Disguise Deception, this set off a subtle alarm in Gu Xing’s heart.
And Ying Bing also quietly retreated to his side, a hint of seriousness flashing in her ice-blue eyes:
"What should we do? It seems one of them is an Extraordinary Level Demon..."
After weighing the situation, Gu Xing decided to retreat!
With his current fighting power alongside Ying Bing.
If they fully unleashed their power, they might have no problem dealing with the Skeleton Demon.
But the unknown depth of the Disguiser made a strong attack obviously too risky.
"Let’s retreat for now!" Gu Xing whispered.
Ying Bing nodded slightly.
Even though there was protection from Ying Xinghe in the shadows, they couldn’t act recklessly.
Just as the two tacitly prepared to retreat, the two Demons suddenly burst forth!
Skeleton Demon waved its pale skeletal claws, and several sharp bone spikes "shush" nailed into the ground, instantly sealing all retreat paths.
They had been lurking in this area for days, already starving, how could they let prey sent to them slip away?
Gu Xing and Ying Bing looked at the blocked path and exchanged a glance.
As their eyes met, they understood...
This battle was unavoidable!
In the shadows, Ying Xinghe’s fingers gathered ice-blue Domain, ready to assist.
To fight the Extraordinary Level with Awakening Stage was ultimately too strenuous.
But just as he was about to reveal himself, a sudden urgent sound came from afar
A figure approached the battlefield at an astonishing speed!
That figure arrived in an instant, accompanied by a sharp gale.
"Star Tear Butterfly, Cage of Light!"
With a clear shout, starlight suddenly scattered like rain, transforming into a dazzling cage that trapped the two Demons within.
Gu Qianqian gracefully arrived, the Star Tear Butterfly circling around her.
"Sister... Sister?"
Gu Xing stared wide-eyed, unable to believe the figure that appeared suddenly.

chapters.title: Chapter 36: Six-winged Blazing Angels Descend!
chapters.content:
Chapter 36: Chapter 36: Six-winged Blazing Angels Descend!
Upon hearing this voice, Gu Qianqian turned back abruptly, her pupils suddenly contracting.
The candidate who had recklessly barged into the danger zone was actually her brother!
She instinctively put on a stern face, the words of reprimand already on her lips.
But when her gaze fell upon the girl with an icy demeanor beside her brother, she swallowed the words back.
Forget it, in front of outsiders, one must save some face for this kid.
However, after hearing Gu Xing call out "sister," Ying Bing’s body visibly froze.
Her cold appearance seemed a bit unnatural at the moment.
Fortunately, Gu Xing was fully focused on the battlefield and didn’t notice her abnormality.
"I’ll deal with you later!"
Gu Qianqian glared at Gu Xing before turning to face the Skeleton Demon.
As long as she dealt with this Extraordinary Level Demon, the battle could be declared over.
As for the other "Awakened Tier Nine" Demon, the Jade-faced Fox could handle it easily.
"Stay back! These two Demons are not ones you can handle!"
Gu Qianqian stood in front of them indubitably.
Gu Xing looked at Gu Qianqian’s figure from behind, wanting to speak but ultimately remaining silent.
He had just examined the attributes of the Star Tear Butterfly; dealing with the Extraordinary Tier Two Skeleton Demon should be manageable.
As for the other Demon...
[Jade-faced Fox]
[Awakened Tier Nine]
[Qualification: Excellent Nine Stars]
[Power: 153]
[Constitution: 142]
[Spirit: 186]
[Speed: 177]
[Skills: Fox Spirit Substitute, Fox Spirit Clone, Spirit Fox Sharp Claws]
Gu Xing quickly compared the figures on the data panel; the Jade-faced Fox’s attributes couldn’t surpass Liu Li.
And the other Demon’s depth was completely incomprehensible, making him even more wary.
He unobtrusively turned sideways and whispered in Liu Li’s ear:
"Liu Li, if anything goes awry later, you should strike immediately!"
Liu Li’s little face was tightly tensed, solemnly nodding.
This is in front of the honorable elder sister; I must perform well!
The battle was on the verge of breaking out.
The Star Tear Butterfly first launched an attack, the brilliant butterfly wings trembling slightly, causing the sky full of starlight to condense into sharp light blades and pour down like a torrential storm.
The Skeleton Demon let out a piercing shriek, a bizarre black glow emanating from the surface of its skeleton, deflecting most of the light blades.
"Starlight Chain!"
Gu Qianqian called out distinctly.
In an instant, dazzling radiance burst from the Star Tear Butterfly, seven chains formed from pure starlight shot towards the Skeleton Demon’s body, winding around it like a spirit snake.
The starlight flowing on the chains continually corroded the pale white skeleton, producing a teeth-gnashing "Zizi" sound.
On the other side, the Jade-faced Fox leapt agilely, trailing three indistinct shadows behind it.
The Disguiser appeared flustered, clawed by the fox leaving several wounds, retreating step by step.
"Looks like it can be resolved soon..."
Watching the situation come under control, Gu Qianqian slowly sighed in relief.
However, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed tighter and tighter.
This Disguiser exhibited strength... too weak!
Moreover, this Disguiser seemed overly deliberate, as if...
acting!
As if confirming his guess—
"Roar!!!"
The Disguiser suddenly let out an earth-shattering roar, its form swelling dramatically, a pitch-black demonic qi surging out like waves.
It instantly grabbed the Jade-faced Fox’s throat, smashing it heavily against the ground!
The situation reversed in an instant!
In the nick of time, the Jade-faced Fox used "Fox Spirit Substitute" to narrowly escape danger.
But due to exhausting its spiritual power, it completely lost its combat capability!
[Disguiser]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Three]
[Qualification: Demon Monarch]
[Power: 589]
[Constitution: 482]
[Spirit: 612]
[Speed: 554]
[Talent: Disguise Deception]
[Skills: Perfect Disguise, Spiritual Shock, Shadowy Demon]
Once the Disguiser voluntarily revealing all its aura, he finally saw clearly the various attributes of this Demon.
With a Spirit attribute as high as 612 points, combined with the double effect of talent and skills, it successfully deceived everyone’s perception.
And this also made Gu Xing realize the importance of talents at the Extraordinary Level!
Using its talent, even the system displayed its level as Awakened Tier Nine!
When Gu Qianqian recognized the Disguiser’s true strength, her face turned deathly pale.
"Extraordinary Tier Three... Demon Monarch Level Disguiser!"
Her voice quivered from shock.
Only now did she understand why the military’s Heaven and Earth Net setup failed to capture these two Demons...
It was all because of this Disguiser’s presence!
"Gu Xing! Take that girl and leave immediately! The further the better!"
Gu Qianqian almost shouted out this sentence, while directing the Star Tear Butterfly to shatter the bone spikes blocking the escape route.
Her slender fingers unconsciously clenched, knuckles turning white from the force.
Though the Star Tear Butterfly’s strength was decent, to deal with two Extraordinary Level Demons...
It was completely impossible!Google seaʀᴄh
But behind her were her brother and the candidate!
At this moment, both emotionally and rationally...
She couldn’t retreat!
In the dark, Ying Xinghe’s heart also trembled greatly.
Even with his experience, he hadn’t anticipated this Disguiser to actually reach Demon Monarch Level!
Due to the Disguiser’s talent, its true strength couldn’t be judged before it released its power.
Thus, although he had determined based on experience that this could be a Disguiser previously.
He never expected this Disguiser was Demon Monarch Level, and its rank was Extraordinary Tier Three!
In this case, that little girl from the National Academy... might seem unable to handle the situation.
Just as he was preparing to take action, a new twist emerged on the scene!
At this moment.
Gu Xing and Ying Bing not only did not retreat, but rather assumed an offensive stance!
"Ying Bing, can you control it for a moment?" Gu Xing’s voice was exceptionally calm.
Ying Bing nodded without hesitation, her ice-blue eyes resolute.
Though she didn’t understand Gu Xing’s plan, she chose to trust him unconditionally.
And to control an Extraordinary Tier Three Disguiser with an Awakening Eight rank.
There’s only one way!
Ultimate Skill!
"Profound Frost Ice Phoenix! Frost Ring Imprisonment!"
The Ice Phoenix, primed and ready, let out a clear and long cry, its entire body surged with chilling air.
Awakening Eight Tiers in full prowess, already a world apart from Awakening Tier Five.
Crystalline ice rapidly formed around the Disguiser, noticeably slowing its movements.
"Three seconds at most!"
Ying Bing’s forehead leaked fine sweat beads.
Yet the eyes of the Demon Monarch, imprisoned by frost, revealed a hint of contempt.
Even amidst Demon Monarchs, it was considered weak, but the strength of Extraordinary Tier Three, how could mere Awakening Level shake it?
However.
At this moment, Gu Xing was fully immersing all his spiritual power in the Beast Taming Space.
This was a special technique he discovered after acquiring the Beast Taming Space.
That is...
Establishing a deep resonance through the Beast Taming Space to help Liu Li stabilize at the Critical State!
"Liu Li! Blazing Angel Form!"
Silvery wings unfolded abruptly, crimson flames erupted like a volcanic explosion, instantly enveloping her maiden-like figure.
Four burning wings unaffiliatedly expanded behind her!
Four-winged Blazing Angel Form activated!
Yet, Liu Li’s transformation did not stop!
Gu Xing’s spiritual power completely resonated with Liu Li through the Beast Taming Space, two forces perfectly integrated at the soul level!
"Critical State——Open!"
Under Gu Xing’s continuous infusion of spiritual power, Liu Li’s sacred flame suddenly surged.
Along the edges of the four wings appeared new luminous pathways, accompanied by the breaking sound of air, a pair of even more dazzling wings burst forth from the flames!
Six-winged Blazing Angel, descends!
...
