chapters.title: Chapter 47: How Did Your Wings Recover?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 47: Chapter 47: How Did Your Wings Recover?!
As soon as Gu Xing left the Inheritance Land, he immediately sensed something was amiss!
The entire city was under martial law, and all the tribes of the Beastman Race were in battle readiness.
"You inferior races, hand over the angel hidden in the city! If you refuse, don’t blame me for slaughtering the city!"
With spiritual power enveloping his voice, Miller’s words echoed throughout the Holy City.
Angel?!
Hearing this word, Gu Xing realized that the visitor might not be from the Demon Race!
Moreover...
The entire Holy City currently had only Liu Li as the sole angel.
Which means...
This enemy came specifically for him?!
Gu Xing carefully recalled everything and realized that since entering the Secret Realm, he didn’t seem to have offended anyone?
Then this person...
Although puzzled, he immediately summoned Liu Li.
Since the enemy outside came for him, there was no way he could back down.
Besides, having reaped benefits from the Elf Clan, he naturally had to protect the subordinate races of the elves.
After Liu Li emerged from the Beast Taming Space, she first rolled her eyes at her master.
Fickle in love!
Clearly, he could have summoned her from the Beast Taming Space long ago, but he waited until now.
Indeed, men are a species that loves every new love they meet!
However.
Even though Liu Li felt resentful, her actions were quick.
Wrapping her arms around Gu Xing’s waist, she carried him straight to the battlefield.
At this moment.
Miller looked down upon the group of beasts, his gaze growing colder.
The Beast Race was already considered a very weak race in the entire Alternate Space.
Not to mention, those blocking his way belonged to one of the weakest factions within the Beast Race.
"Hand over that angel and the Elf Princess, and I can spare your lives!"
However, all the beastmen showed no sign of fear.
Although the Beast Race was weak, their loyalty was unwavering.
According to the instructions left by the Elf Race, seeing the Prophet was akin to seeing an elf.
Moreover, that Prophet had recently rescued them from the hands of the Demon Race.
To think they could be made to betray...
Absolutely impossible!
"Seeking death!"
Miller’s expression darkened.
As a higher race, stopping to warn these natives was already his greatest mercy.
Yet these natives not only showed no gratitude but even dared to resist him!
"Leopard!"
Veronica turned her head and looked at the Nether Spirit Leopard.
She certainly didn’t want these adorable beastmen to get into trouble.
"Understood!"
The Nether Spirit Leopard tensed its entire body, its gaze fixed on Miller.
Planning to confront an angel at the Extraordinary Level with an Awakening Stage...
No blood will be spared today!
However.
Before Miller could make a move, Gu Xing and Liu Li arrived first.
After Liu Li put Gu Xing down, she immediately directed her gaze at Miller in the sky.
It was her first time seeing another of her kind.
However.
Why did this fellow angel harbor such murderous intent towards her?!
Gu Xing, too, frowned slightly as he looked at this angel.
[Divine Angel (Miller)]
[Talent: Legendary Seven Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Three]
[Power: 1054]
[Constitution: 1063]
[Spirit: 862]
[Speed: 1024]
[Skills: War Angel Form (increase self-attributes by 1.5 times), Angel Holy Shield, Angel Holy Sword]
Just like Liu Li, he was also from the Divine Angels Race.
However.
Liu Li was a Blazing Angel, while this one was a War Angel!
But looking at the skills of the two, it seemed the Blazing Angels Race had the upper hand.
After all, Liu Li’s Blazing Angel Form could enhance her attributes by two times.
Yet that said, there was a fundamental gap between them.
Although Liu Li had gained 50 points in each attribute after killing that Demon King.
But for now...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Legendary Three Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine]
[Power: 473]
[Constitution: 478]
[Spirit: 481]
[Speed: 490]
[Skills: Judgment, Divine Protection, Blazing Angel Form, Song of the End]
Even if Liu Li activated her Blazing Angel Form in advance, coupled with the boost from critical status...
It would only amount to about 1200 points in attributes!
In which case...
It seems there’s only one solution!
Song of the End!
A skill he dared not use because of its side effects until now.
However, if it becomes absolutely necessary...Google seaʀᴄh Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
At this moment.
Miller’s face was full of mockery as he looked at Liu Li.
"For someone of the Blazing Angels Race bloodline to willingly become a human’s guardian beast, it’s truly... a disgrace to the Angel Race!"
However, such words from Miller had no effect on Liu Li.
The one whom Gu Xing personally pulled out from the abyss, how could she possibly despise her master?
Moreover, she didn’t think her angelic bloodline was particularly noble!
However.
Liu Li’s disregard toward him made Miller’s expression darken.
Back when the leader of the Angel Race, Liu Li’s father, was still around, this girl seemed...
to always have such an arrogant attitude!
And now...
She still looked down on him like this!
But he was no longer that humble angel who could only envy Liu Li’s status from the shadows.
Now.
He was the Young Clan Leader of the Angel Race!
"Liu Li, looking at you... it seems you’ve forgotten what happened in the Angel Race! Do you need me to remind you?"
Miller must be credited for successfully grabbing Liu Li’s attention.
Besides Liu Li, Gu Xing also perked up his ears, for he was very curious about the little girl’s origins.
Seeing Liu Li’s interest piqued, Miller took his time.
"If you want to know your origins, first tell me... how your wings were restored!"
Everything the Angel Race had came from the wings on their backs!
Without one’s wings, one loses the hope of growth, the possibility of fighting, everything!
Yet...
Liu Li’s wings had been completely severed!
Then why now...
Were her wings still intact?!
The method to regenerate the wings of the Angel Race.
Miller greedily licked his lips.
If he could obtain this method and improve it, could he further enhance his own power?!
When asked about her wings, Liu Li instinctively turned to look at Gu Xing.
However.
That small gesture.
Immediately made Miller realize the instigator might very well be this human!
Human?!
How could that be possible?
A race despised by all others.
With weak combat abilities, relying solely on other races...
Yet somehow possessing this kind of ability?!
It seems, besides Liu Li, this human must also be captured.
Miller’s gaze swept across the people on the ground.
Aside from two or three worthless Extraordinary Beastmen.
There was only Liu Li barely worth noticing!
"Liu Li, in light of you volunteering for a death trip, I’ve decided to spare these beastmen and those two humans!"
On hearing this, the Nether Spirit Leopard nearly lost it!
Spare her?!
"Leopard! Leopard, don’t do anything yet!"
Veronica turned her head to look at the Nether Spirit Leopard.
Her words succeeded in calming its rage.
"Leopard, now’s not the time for you to act!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 48: Song of the End
chapters.content:
Chapter 48: Chapter 48: Song of the End
The two people’s actions caught Gu Xing’s attention.
Gu Xing turned his head and saw the foreign girl with long pale golden hair and emerald green eyes.
In terms of appearance, she was on par with Ying Bing!
Being stared at by Gu Xing, Veronica also realized her gaffe, hurriedly placing it on the Nether Spirit Leopard, elegantly tidying her dress, and then extending her hand:
"Hello, nice to meet you, my name is Veronica!"
After saying this, Veronica playfully blinked her eyes.
Seeing this scene, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
Although he had realized earlier that this girl was not simple.
However.
He did not expect her contrast to be so great.
When she first met him and Ying Bing, she appeared shy and innocent.
But now...
If it weren’t for Gu Xing being certain that the leopard was the same cat Lanny was holding before.
He would never believe that such a stark contrast was the same person.
Gu Xing did not extend his hand, only nodding politely.
Seeing Gu Xing not extend his hand, Veronica pouted in dissatisfaction.
Sneaky man!Follow current novᴇls on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
She just hid her identity a little, and he’s holding a grudge for that!
However.
At this moment, Gu Xing’s attention was entirely drawn to Miller.
"About your origins... I can tell you!"
Miller wore a smug smile.
After all, not only could he solve the problem of the Blazing Angels Race, but he also found a way to possibly grow stronger!
Feeling better, even the sight of this Blazing Angel became pleasing.
More importantly, he was eager to know...
He couldn’t wait to see Liu Li’s reaction once she learned the truth!
"You are the princess of the Blazing Angels Race, can you really forget such an important thing?"
Miller’s face had a mocking expression, "But now that the Blazing Angels Race is nearly extinct, it seems understandable that you would forget this identity!"
Extinct?!
Hearing this news, Gu Xing frowned.
Although he didn’t know the relationship between Blazing Angels and War Angels.
However.
Liu Li clearly belonged to the Blazing Angels Race.
And with the Blazing Angels Race nearly wiped out...
At this moment, Veronica suddenly interjected:
"Blazing Angels and War Angels both belong to the Angel Race! And the Blazing Angels Race is the royal family of the Angel Race, their numbers extremely scarce!"
"But not long ago, the king of the Blazing Angels disappeared, and the War Angels took over, and those with Blazing Angel bloodline..."
"Are likely to have met a grim fate!"
"Of course, this is just what I’ve heard! You can judge the truth for yourself!"
Veronica added one last note.
Though Gu Xing had been indifferent to her earlier, Miss Vero wouldn’t take it to heart.
Upon hearing Vero’s explanation, Gu Xing realized...
Why Liu Li had lost her wings!
It turned out to be the handiwork of the War Angels!
Immediately, Gu Xing looked worriedly at Liu Li.
At this moment, the little girl was the one bearing the most in her heart.
Liu Li stared blankly at Miller.
Looking at his wings behind him, memories in her mind slowly awakened.
The slaughter of the Blazing Angels Race, her wings torn apart...
The images in her mind kept resurfacing!
Involuntarily, tears began to slide down her cheeks.
"Blazing Angels Race?"
"Princess?!"
Seeing Liu Li’s appearance, Miller was evidently very satisfied.
"Haha, you remembered! Those connected to you are all suffering, and you are completely unaware of it all!"
"As the princess of the Blazing Angels Race... are you even worthy?!"
This sentence clearly struck Liu Li’s inner heart.
At this moment, the little girl looked at her hands, her body shaking continuously.
Her kin were all suffering...
And as for her?
Is she really worthy of this identity?!
Seeing Liu Li’s status, Gu Xing’s brow tightened.
If it continued like this, Miller wouldn’t even need to act; Liu Li would collapse on her own.
This can’t go on!
"Sovereign!"
Without hesitation, Gu Xing decisively used his talent.
The Emperor’s Gaze reappeared!
At this moment, persuading Liu Li was obviously the least efficient way.
Since persuasion was useless, then let the little girl feel his heart.
His spiritual power emerged from his body, tightly connecting with Liu Li.
Spiritual power could not only be used for battle, but also to explore the hearts of others.
In the spiritual world.
Gu Xing saw a small figure hugging her knees, curled up in a corner.
This was a depiction of Liu Li’s inner self.
Even if Liu Li was powerful, having experienced many battles, in essence...
She was still just a little girl!
Looking at the little girl with her head buried in her knees, trying hard to escape reality.
Gu Xing’s heart tightened fiercely.
All of this, was too cruel for her!
Gu Xing took a deep breath, slowly stepped forward, and extended his hand firmly to Liu Li.
"Liu Li, stand up, no matter what happens, I’m here with you!"
The little girl raised her head, her pale little face covered with tearstains.
"Master..."
Liu Li raised her tear-filled face, her golden eyes reflecting Gu Xing’s resolute expression.
"Liu Li, no matter what, I will resolutely choose you!"
"Since the War Angels stand in your way, I’ll help you crush them!"
Through the tears, Liu Li saw the hand stretched out, just as firm as it was during their contract in Lin Yuan City.
Yes, now she had a master to rely on!
No matter what, her master would resolutely choose her!
In the sky above the Holy City, Miller had lost his patience.
It’s time to end this!
"Liu Li, I will send you to meet your kin underground!"
A long sword slowly appeared in Miller’s hand, and in the next moment...
He suddenly thrust it towards Liu Li!
However.
In the inner world.
A slender hand firmly grasped Gu Xing’s hand.
How could she run away again?
She was an angel chosen by the gods!
How could she fall here!
"Grant, Slaughter!"
"Blazing Angel Form activated!"
Two voices echoed almost simultaneously.
In the next moment.
The scarlet aura of slaughter intertwined with flames, completely enveloping Liu Li.
Miller’s attack was easily deflected.
Gu Xing gazed at Liu Li, her attributes soaring to thousands, his eyes focused.
"It’s still not enough!"
"To this extent, it’s still not enough!"
"At this level, it’s still impossible to defeat this War Angel!"
"Liu Li!"
Without Gu Xing needing to issue an order, the two of them, connected spiritually, understood each other’s thoughts immediately.
Want to take another step forward, there’s only one way!
"Song of the End!"
The unison chant echoed across the battlefield.
Four wings behind Liu Li suddenly ignited with crimson gold flames, and amid the flaring tongues of fire, four brand new wings emerged abruptly...
Eight-winged Blazing Angel!
"This is..."
Miller’s pupils contracted violently, and the Holy Sword in his hand started to tremble uncontrollably.
How is this possible?!
Not reaching Divine Level, how could one become an Eight-winged Blazing Angel!
This is impossible!!!
Illusion!!
Miller’s eyes were bloodshot, filled with madness.
How could a crippled angel reach such a level!
"War Angel Form!"
Six wings instantly unfolded.
"Today, even if you are an Eight-winged Blazing Angel..."
"You must die!!!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 49: Angel Sacred Blood! Breaking Realm Blade!
chapters.content:
Chapter 49: Chapter 49: Angel Sacred Blood! Breaking Realm Blade!
In Gu Xing’s vision, Miller’s attributes suddenly soared.
[Divine Angels (Miller)]
[Talent: Legendary Seven Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Three]
[Power: 1054→1581]
[Constitution: 1063→1594]
[Spirit: 862→1293]
[Speed: 1024→1536]
[Skills: War Angel Form (1.5x attribute boost), Angel Holy Shield, Angel Holy Sword]
Under the blessing of the War Angel Form, Miller’s attributes reached a terrifying level.
Power, Constitution, and Speed all exceeded 1500 points!
Seeing this, Gu Xing unconsciously clenched his fist.
"Liu Li, today you must die!"
Miller’s six wings suddenly flapped, and a holy sword with a golden shimmer took shape in his hand.
The golden light on his body also burst out, dyeing the clouds within a hundred meters golden.
"Holy Sword·Judgement!"
Without any extra movements, Miller dived down like a golden lightning bolt.
Where the holy sword passed, the space slightly twisted.
At the same time...
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Legendary Three Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine]
[Power: 473→1446]
[Constitution: 478→1456]
[Spirit: 481→1462]
[Speed: 490→1480]
[Skills: Judgment, Divine Protection, Blazing Angel Form, Song of the End]
The Blazing Angel Form doubles Liu Li’s attributes, and then using an ultimate skill on top of it...
Liu Li’s attributes increased by another 500 points!
Therefore, Liu Li’s attributes already approached 1500 points.
Although at this moment, compared to Miller, Liu Li’s attributes still have a certain gap, but...
"Grant, protect!"
Gu Xing gritted his teeth, his spiritual power surged like a flood breaking a dam.
An ice-blue Power of Guardian solidified into light armor around Liu Li.
If "slaughter" is the sharpest spear, then "guard" is the strongest shield.
"Ugh!"
Gu Xing groaned, veins bulging on his temples.
Maintaining two top states simultaneously made his mental sea nearly collapse.
But looking at the petite figure standing in front of him, his eyes turned blood red as he held on forcibly.
This battle, no matter what, Liu Li must win!
"Liu Li!"
This roar seemed to switch something on.
The last trace of hesitation in Liu Li’s golden pupils vanished completely.
"Boom——!"
The eight wings fully spread, and Liu Li turned into a crimson flame line, soaring into the sky.
Wherever she passed, the space burned with a distorted trajectory.
And as Miller watched Liu Li charging at him, his pupils contracted sharply, and for the first time, a look of horror appeared on his face:
"You’re insane!"
He clearly saw that Liu Li had completely abandoned her defensive stance, pouring all her power into this one strike.
If Gu Xing couldn’t hold on and the guardian state was released, her petite body would be instantly torn apart by the holy sword!
Yet there wasn’t a trace of fear in Liu Li’s golden eyes.
She believed in Gu Xing, believed in her master!
The golden holy light and the crimson flame line collided.
"Boom——"
"Boom——!"
When the golden holy light and the crimson flame line touched, time seemed to stand still for a moment.
Immediately, a light brighter than the sun burst from the collision center, and a visible energy ripple spread out in a perfect arc.
On the ground.
The raging energy storm blew Veronica’s pale golden hair wildly.
The massive body of the Nether Spirit Leopard stood in front of her, yet she could still feel the scorching heat wave.
"Leopard...," Veronica’s voice trembled with disbelief, "he... is really just in the Awakening Stage?"
The Nether Spirit Leopard’s pupils contracted sharply, its jet-black fur stood on end in the energy turbulence.
As a former Monarch Level Guardian Beast, even though it had fallen to the Awakening Stage due to contract restrictions, its full combat power far surpassed its tier.
However, this scene before her was still beyond her comprehension.
"Indeed!" the Nether Spirit Leopard’s voice carried an unusual gravity, "That young man and that angel are both still at Awakened Tier Nine!"
If another magic beast had told her that someone at the Awakening Stage could contend against an Extraordinary Tier Three Angel Race Guardian Beast, she would undoubtedly dismiss it with a paw.
But at this moment, this absurd scene was playing out before her eyes.
What shocked her even more was—
that young man had already awakened his talent!
It should be noted, even for a genius like Veronica, one must reach the Extraordinary Tier to awaken a talent.
And this young man, at Awakened Tier Nine...
"Miss," the Nether Spirit Leopard lowered its voice, "that boy might become your biggest competitor in the future. Should I take this opportunity..."
Its sharp claws slightly extended.
Veronica abruptly turned her head, her emerald eyes devoid of their usual playfulness, replaced by a strange calm.
The Nether Spirit Leopard immediately fell silent.
She understood this look too well—
whenever Veronica showed this expression, it meant the young lady was truly angry.
"I understand."
The Nether Spirit Leopard obediently retracted its claws and swallowed the rest of its words.
Veronica looked back at the center of the battlefield, a flash of complexity crossing her eyes.
And in the sky.
The confrontation between the two was nearing its end.
Despite being slightly inferior in attributes, under the dual support of "slaughter" and "guardian".
Each of Liu Li’s strikes brought great threat to Miller.
The slaughter state completely ignored defense, which also meant Miller’s defense skills were useless in front of Liu Li.
"Bang!"
The holy sword and light blade collided for countless times, and Miller finally managed to distance himself slightly from Liu Li.
But at this moment, there was no longer a trace of arrogance in the eyes of the War Angel, only deep-rooted fear.
"Madmen! You are all madmen!"
Miller’s voice trembled uncontrollably, his six wings flapping frantically as he turned to flee.
Forget about eliminating potential threats, or seizing the power of the human Beast Master, right now survival instinct was the sole focus.
But—ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
Do you think you can just come and go as you please?!
"Doomsday!"
Liu Li’s eight wings spread wide, the crimson flames instantly sealed the entire airspace.
Miller crashed headlong into the Flame Barrier, horrified to find the flames burning away his spiritual power.
"This is... the Doomsday Barrier of the Blazing Angel?!"
When Miller turned around, there was already a hint of pleading in his eyes.
"Liu Li! You can’t kill me! Your clan is still—"
Before the words were finished, Liu Li’s judgment had already descended.
"Lament."
With this whisper, the crimson barrier with a hundred-meter diameter suddenly collapsed.
Miller’s screams were engulfed by the highly compressed light flames, eventually reduced to an ultimately radiant crimson dot.
"Boom——!!!"
In the thunderous explosion, the hurriedly erected barrier of the beastmen trembled violently.
Where the shockwave passed, even the space showed fine black cracks.
When the light dissipated, there were only drifting golden feathers left in the sky, and—
the proud, standing figure with eight wings.
The Holy City fell into dead silence at that moment.
All the beastmen held their breath, looking up at this shocking spectacle.
That arrogant War Angel had completely disappeared.
In the sky where the smoke has cleared, only two items suspended quietly.
[Angel Sacred Blood]
[Category: Legendary Material]
[Effect: Can greatly enhance the talent level of Angel Race Guardian Beasts]
[Note: The core blood of the War Angel Race, containing pure Divine Power]
[Breaking Realm Blade]
[Category: Angel Race’s Sacred Artifact]
[Effect: Can break barriers and restrictions of the world]
[Note: The treasured artifact passed down through generations of the Angel Race]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 50: The Secret Realm Ends!
chapters.content:
Chapter 50: Chapter 50: The Secret Realm Ends!
The moment he saw the Angel Sacred Blood, Gu Xing’s pupils constricted sharply.
The second material for Liu Li’s advancement!
He already possessed the Light Crystal and Angel Sacred Blood, now there’s only...
Holy Spirit Marrow Liquid!
According to Xinghe, the Holy Spirit Marrow Liquid can be found in the treasure vault of the National Academy!
As long as he joins the National Academy...
Then he is sure to obtain this final material!
By then, using these three materials to cultivate Liu Li...
Could it elevate Liu Li’s level to Myth Level?!
As for another item!
Since it is the sacred relic of the Angel Race, it should be entrusted to Liu Li, this princess of the Angel Race.
However, it was at this moment.
The figure of the Eight-winged Angel in the sky suddenly shook violently, the crimson flames visibly faded, and the eight dazzling wings shattered inch by inch.
Liu Li’s body seemed to be drained of all power, plummeting straight from high altitude.
The aftermath of using Ultimate Skills!
Gu Xing’s heart tightened, disregarding his body and rushing forward.
However...
Just as he stepped forward, a wave of dizziness hit him swiftly.
His overextended spiritual power finally reached its limit, and the world before him abruptly plunged into darkness.
His body uncontrollably leaned forward, but at the moment he was about to hit the ground, he was caught securely by a pair of soft arms.
In a daze, a wisp of orchid-like fragrance lingered at his nose.
...
At this moment, outside the Secret Realm.
Xinghe was pacing back and forth anxiously.
After all, this was a brand new Secret Realm, no one knew what existed inside.
If Ying Bing and Gu Xing encountered any accident...
How would he explain to his family and country?
Thinking of this, Xinghe’s back was already soaked with cold sweat.
One was the heir of his family, and the other...
Was a beast-master prodigy rarely seen in a hundred years in Longxia Country!
Such a loss was absolutely unbearable for him!
It was at this time.
The space suddenly rippled like waves.
"They emerged!"
Xinghe quickly raised his head, but froze instantly—
Only to see the originally empty plain suddenly populated by a tide of beastmen.
Hundreds of beastman warriors formed into lines, their bodies still bearing battle scars, yet each stood tall.
And at the forefront of the group, amazingly, was Ying Bing carrying the unconscious Gu Xing!
Watching this mighty group, Xinghe’s mouth involuntarily twitched.
These people...
Ying Bing currently had no time to concern herself with these.
She rushed to the battlefield at the first moment after completing her bloodline enhancement, just in time to witness Gu Xing collapsing in exhaustion.
Almost by instinct, she dashed forward before Veronica, catching the young man firmly in her embrace.
"Grandpa Xinghe! Check on Gu Xing quickly!"
The voice of the usually composed Ying Bing was now filled with unprecedented panic.
"It seems like he fainted due to talent overextension!"
Ying Bing herself didn’t notice that her arms holding Gu Xing were slightly trembling, and her eyes, usually as cold as ice, were now full of anxiety.
However.
Xinghe was stunned at the spot, severely doubting if he had heard wrong.
Did he really hear it correctly?
It seemed like his lady said "Gu Xing’s talent has been overexerted"?
???
Xinghe reconfirmed Gu Xing’s level.
That’s right!
He was at Awakened Tier Nine!
Which meant...
Gu Xing had prematurely awakened his talent?!
Xinghe’s Adam’s apple rolled violently a few times, forcibly suppressing the surging waves in his heart.
This situation must be immediately reported to the principal. If such an exceptional talent were to slip through their fingers...
"Grandpa Xinghe!"
Seeing Xinghe has not answered for a long time, Ying Bing’s tone carried a hint of anger.
It was only then that Xinghe snapped out of his daze, quickly bending down to examine Gu Xing’s condition.
"His body is not seriously harmed, just fainted from overused spiritual power!"
Said Xinghe, then turned his gaze to Liu Li, who was being carefully held by Sally:
"As for his Guardian Beast..."
This is clearly the aftermath of using the Guardian Beast’s Ultimate Skills.
It will naturally heal over time.
However.
That the ultimate skill from this Guardian Beast has such a severe aftermath?
It should be noted, the greater the aftermath, the stronger the ultimate skill.
When using the ultimate skill once, the Ice Phoenix merely faints.
But this Guardian Beast, actually fell into a deep sleep!
Xinghe’s mouth twitched.
Indeed!
A formidable Beast Master inevitably has formidable Guardian Beasts!
Upon hearing Gu Xing was not in grave danger, Ying Bing’s tense shoulders finally relaxed a bit.
Sneaking a glance at the beastman tribe behind, she seemed to remember something, and slowly explained:
"These Beast Race were previously refugees in the Secret Realm, with the realm now invaded by the Demon Race, and Gu Xing saved them, so they chose to stay with us."
Under Ying Bing’s explanation, Xinghe suddenly realized.
Longxia Country does not repel the Alien Race!
In the Alternate Space, many races have sought Longxia Country’s protection.
And Longxia Country, being inclusive, does not refuse them.
Thus, having an additional Beastman tribe poses not much of a problem.
Merely—
"The journey to Longxia Country from here is far, are you all..."
Clan Leader Rone stepped forward, respectfully performed the highest salute of the Beastman Race:
"Sir, I will lead my tribe to Longxia Country. Please, take the Prophet back for treatment first."
Xinghe nodded approvingly.
Though Longxia Country is inclusive, it will not unconditionally support every race.
This Beastman tribe’s ability to cross obstacles and reach Longxia is itself a test for them.
Before departing, Rone requested Xinghe to bring his daughter Sally along.
Considering the unconscious Gu Xing indeed needed care, he did not refuse.
...
Elsewhere.
Just as Veronica stepped out of the Secret Realm, a dark shadow kneeled before her like a specter.
"Miss, the head of the family commands you to return immediately."
The voice of the man in black was low and respectful, yet carried an uncompromising determination.
A trace of impatience flashed in Veronica’s emerald green eyes, her delicate hand waved dismissively:
"The old man has such a lot of things to bother about!"
She disdainfully glanced at the kneeling Beast Master, "And you, Black Ten, do not appear before me next time, just seeing your stinky face annoys me!"
The Beast Master known as Black Ten maintained his humble stance, not daring to lift his head:
"Yes, Miss!"
Seeing the other’s servile manner, Veronica suddenly found it tasteless.
She sighed lightly, her tone softened a bit:
"Alright, it’s not right to be harsh on you."
Then, she turned to the Nether Spirit Leopard, a spark of inspiration flashing.
"Leopard, leopard, what do you think... how about I enroll at Longxia Country?!"Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
The corner of the Nether Spirit Leopard’s eye twitched.
This lady of theirs really acts on whims.
With her identity, enrolling in Longxia Country would stir up a storm.
But thinking further, these troubles would naturally be taken care of by others.
"I see no problem, Miss Veronica!"
"Good, then it’s happily decided!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 51: Stepping Into the Extraordinary, Second Talent!
chapters.content:
Chapter 51: Chapter 51: Stepping Into the Extraordinary, Second Talent!
Blood-red!
Gu Xing’s spiritual world was filled with blood-red!
The color was like flowing blood, making him feel suffocated!
Yet, surrounded by the sea of blood, his spiritual power surged crazily!
Inside the room.
Realizing Gu Xing’s status, Ying Xinghe urgently reminded:
"Miss, it seems Gu Xing is about to... step into the Extraordinary!"
Extraordinary?!
Upon hearing this, Ying Bing’s pupils suddenly contracted as she quickly turned to look at Gu Xing on the bed.
She saw the young boy enveloped by eerie blood light, even his breath becoming scorching.
It truly is a breakthrough to the Extraordinary!
But...
Why is it blood-red?!
Ying Bing remembered that during Gu Xing’s Talents awakening, it was clearly silver!
But now...
Without any time for Ying Bing to collect her thoughts, Ying Xinghe pulled her aside, performed a seal, and immediately an icy blue Barrier enveloped the entire room.
Ying Xinghe watched the blood light on Gu Xing’s body surface, his brows slightly furrowing.
If he wasn’t mistaken, Gu Xing was not only breaking through to the Extraordinary...
He was also synchronously awakening his Talent!
However.
Didn’t Ying Bing say that Gu Xing had awakened prematurely?
Then now this...
A huge shock surged within Ying Xinghe’s heart, a hypothesis quickly occupying his mind!
Second Talent!!
At this moment, Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space was undergoing drastic changes.
The surge of spiritual power brought by the breakthrough to the Extraordinary nearly caused the Beast Taming Space to double in size.
And within the Beast Taming Space, the green Light Cocoon that had been dormant for a long time suddenly began to tremble vigorously.
It actively drew Gu Xing’s soaring spiritual power, sketching contract runes inside the cocoon.
Voluntary Contract!!
With the completion of the final contract rune, Gu Xing distinctly felt a dormant consciousness surfacing in his spiritual sea.
And that green cocoon, after the contract was completed, returned to tranquility as if nothing had occurred.
Simultaneously, his Second Talent—
"Soul-devouring" was fully awakened!
The effect of this Talent was simple yet domineering:
Unconditionally doubles all Attributes of the Guardian Beast!
Take Liu Li for example.
When Blazing Angel State is activated, her Attributes will become double.
And through the Soul-devouring Talent, her Attributes will be boosted another twofold.
Thus, Liu Li’s final combat power enhancement reached a staggering fourfold!
However, Gu Xing sensed.
He couldn’t simultaneously use the Sovereign and Soul-devouring Talents.
Otherwise, relying on the state provided by Sovereign, combined with the Soul-devouring Talent.
Liu Li could easily dominate the Extraordinary Level.
When Gu Xing fully grasped the newly awakened power, slowly opened his eyes, he met Ying Bing and Ying Xinghe’s extremely complex expressions.
"You guys..." Gu Xing touched his face in confusion, "Why are you looking at me like that?"
Ying Xinghe’s facial muscles slightly twitched.
Yet ultimately didn’t voice out...
Whether Gu Xing had awakened a Second Talent!
After all, he had already reported Gu Xing’s situation.
The headmaster naturally had already made a decision about it!
"How long did I sleep?"
Ying Bing roughly calculated, then slowly spoke.
"From when we left the Secret Realm to now, you’ve been unconscious for half a month."
"Where you are now is in Imperial Capital Ying’s house, which is my home!"
Upon hearing he had been unconscious for half a month.
Gu Xing frowned slightly.
The sequel of depleted spiritual power seemed extremely severe.
However, the result was also pleasing.
Noticing two materials in the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li’s evolution materials were almost fully collected!
Wait!!!
Liu Li?!
What happened to the little girl after using the Ultimate Skills?!
Gu Xing immediately sensed through the contract.
At this moment, the little girl seemed to be just next door.
Moreover, she appeared to be about to complete the transformation from the Awakening Stage to the Extraordinary Level.
Thinking about this.
Gu Xing immediately flipped off the bed.
From the Awakening Stage to the Extraordinary Level, his body felt no discomfort from lying for half a month.
At this moment, he felt in excellent condition.
With three steps in two strides, he rushed next door, and as he pushed open the door, scarlet flame surged.
Liu Li’s petite body was enveloped entirely by Divine Flame, four wings stretched within fiery light.
Under Gu Xing’s gaze, all the flames suddenly collapsed inward, transforming into streams of light and merging into Liu Li’s body.
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Legendary Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Power: 820]
[Constitution: 810]
[Spirit: 800]
[Speed: 830]
[Skills: Judgment, Divine Protection, Blazing Angel Form, Song of the End]
[Evolution: Angel Sacred Blood (Acquired), Light Crystal (Acquired), Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid (Not Acquired)]
Liu Li’s Attributes welcomed a qualitative leap!
After stepping into the Extraordinary Realm, her various Attributes leapt directly from less than 500 points to over 800 points.
Gu Xing felt the power fluctuations transmitted through the contract, a slight smile on his lips.
Now, if Liu Li were to face War Angels Miller again, she probably wouldn’t need to use the Song of the End to slay him.
Even more pleasantly surprising was the contract with the Natural Spirit Vera.
Though she fell back into slumber after the contract was established, this was an authentic Myth Talent Guardian Beast!
Gu Xing speculated, guessing the spiritual power fluctuations emitted during his breakthrough to the Extraordinary triggered Vera’s instinctual response, prompting her to complete the contract.
"As long as there’s a way to awaken her, then assist her in breaking through to the Extraordinary Level..."
Gu Xing’s eyes sparkled with excitement.
If he could smoothly enter the National Guardian Academy and obtain the Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid, elevating Liu Li’s Talent to the Myth Level as well...
Two Myth Talent Guardian Beasts!
This thought made Gu Xing’s heart race.
At that time, even facing High Tier Extraordinary Beast Masters, he would have the power to compete!
Meanwhile.
Liu Li slowly opened her brilliant golden eyes.
The moment her gaze focused, she unhesitatingly pounced toward Gu Xing.
Gu Xing instinctively spread his arms, and the little girl immediately burrowed into his embrace like a fledgling returning to its nest.
No one noticed the trace of slyness in Liu Li’s eyes.
Through contract sensing, she had long realized her master had newly contracted a Natural Spirit.
This made her feel a strong sense of crisis.
"Can’t wait any longer..."
Liu Li secretly pledged.
To make her master understand, she must take initiative.
She discreetly tightened her arms around Gu Xing, burying her small face into his chest.
Watching this scene, Ying Bing felt an inexplicable bitterness rise within her heart.
She frowned in confusion, puzzled by where this emotion came from.
To disguise her odd feelings, she lightly coughed to remind:
"Gu Xing, the third assessment is about to begin."
This sentence was like pouring a bucket of cold water.
Gu Xing swiftly regained alertness.
Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid!
He must pass the assessment to enter the National Academy!
If he missed this opportunity...
What if he couldn’t join?
However, Gu Xing’s worry was entirely unnecessary!
At this moment, the National Guardian Academy’s headmaster Long Zhenguo and other major academy principals were already gathering toward the assessment site.
These legendary figures, elusive daily, had surprisingly unified goals for this trip—
It was the genius personally recommended by Wei Yuan—
Gu Xing!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Examination Site, the Principal Arrives in Person!
chapters.content:
Chapter 52: Chapter 52: Examination Site, the Principal Arrives in Person!
Angel Race’s residence.
Several elders suppressing the Blazing Angels noticed something was amiss.
Why hasn’t the Young Clan Leader returned yet?
"Could something have happened?"
An elder of the Angel Race tilted his head, asking his companion.
"Impossible! Didn’t the Young Clan Leader have someone accompanying him?"
Suddenly, the Holy Flame in the grand hall stilled abruptly.
A majestic figure appeared out of nowhere, eight pairs of brilliant golden wings spreading out behind him...
It was none other than the War Angel Clan Leader, Mi Zhan!
"Miller is dead."
Mi Zhan’s voice was like eternal ice, "Investigate thoroughly who did this."
The elders looked at each other in dismay.
They naturally knew the Clan Leader didn’t genuinely care about this son’s life or death...
Mi Zhan had many heirs, he could appoint another Young Clan Leader at any time.
What truly enraged the clan leader was...
The Breaking Realm Blade!
The Angel race’s supreme treasure had been stolen by Miller and subsequently lost!
"We will investigate immediately!"
Four elders kneeled on one knee, their eyes filled with disbelief.
With Miller’s strength, how could he fall in such a mere Secret Realm?
Once the elders departed, Mi Zhan turned and walked towards the underground prison.
At the end of the dark passage, the last batch of Blazing Angels was detained.
"Mi Zhan! You traitor!"
An elderly Blazing Angel cursed upon seeing him, "The Clan Leader treated your War Angel Race with great kindness, yet you dare to betray him!"
Mi Zhan turned a deaf ear, his cold gaze locked on Liu Xia at the center of the crowd.
Though the Blazing Angel Princess was covered in scars, she still stood with a straight back.
"Liu Xia, last chance."
Mi Zhan’s voice was like a venomous snake hissing, "Tell me Liu Li’s whereabouts, or else..."
Liu Xia suddenly laughed, with a smile full of mockery:
"You don’t dare kill us! My brother is just missing, not dead!"
"That’s why you’re desperately searching for Liu Li like a mad dog, fearing he might show up suddenly one day!"
Mi Zhan’s pupils contracted abruptly.
Indeed, it was precisely this fear that kept him from killing these Blazing Angels.
Just however.
Seeing the mockery in Liu Xia’s eyes, his gaze darkened.
"You’re right; I truly don’t dare kill you all..."
He slowly raised his hand.
Soon after, several War Angels carried tools gleaming with cold light and approached.
"But I can make you wish for death."
As Mi Zhan’s figure vanished at the end of the passage, heart-wrenching screams echoed through the dungeon.
...
The third test site.
A sea of people.
Various media simultaneously rushed here, just to report this annual college entrance examination event.
"Every year, these colleges come up with new tricks! I wonder what this year’s examination topic is?"
"No matter what it is, we just need to find out who this year’s champion is! They are the strongest among this cohort!"
"That’s impossible! The real geniuses have long been specially recruited by major colleges, as for those left behind..."
"That’s not necessarily true; five years ago, the National Academy’s principal personally came for special recruitment!"
"You did mention that was five years ago, back when the exams were still imperfect, leading to that genius’s oversight; but now..."
"Such special recruitment is absolutely impossible!"
Amidst the crowd’s discussions.
Candidates who passed the first two rounds of tests entered one by one.
Shen Ruoxue was naturally among them.
At this moment.
She frantically scanned the venue, trying to find that familiar figure.
However.
She found nothing.
"Captain, stop looking, God Gu isn’t here. I think he hasn’t arrived yet! If we spot God Gu, we’ll surely notify you immediately."
"Yeah, Captain, with us around, as soon as God Gu enters here, we’ll spot him right away!"
Upon hearing her team members’ teasing, Shen Ruoxue’s face flushed red.
Being teased closely by her teammates, she felt quite embarrassed.
The Succubus beside her, hearing the conversation, quietly lowered her head.
Now she had fully grasped the situation, no longer daring to have any illusions about Gu Xing becoming her master!
Perhaps, from the day she betrayed Gu Xing, she was destined for this kind of outcome!
However, at least Gu Xing spared her life!
Nonetheless, at this moment.
The sky suddenly darkened.
A large group of Flying Guardian Beasts abruptly appeared over the examination venue.
In the crowd’s astonished gaze, principals from various colleges descended.
Among them, the most eye-catching was naturally the silver-haired elder among this group.
This was the principal of the National Academy, Long Zhenguo.
Also the backbone of the entire Longxia Country.
A Monarch Level Beast Master!
"My goodness! Why is the National Academy’s principal here at the exam site?"
"Not just the National Academy, the Black Dragon Academy, Yellow Dragon Academy... Almost all famous academy principals in Longxia have arrived!"
"Why are they here? Are they possibly going to supervise the exams?"
"Silly! There must be a true genius appearing; their sole purpose here is surely special recruitment!"
"Special recruitment?! Really? Who could be worth such a grand occasion?"
Amid the crowd’s discussions, these principals seemed to spark off each other too.
They had all received the news!
A genius deemed extraordinarily promising by Wei Yuan, no matter the cost, they had to recruit for their own schools.
Only, the biggest competitor currently...
Everyone’s gaze was fixed on that figure up front.
National Academy!
They hadn’t expected, this time the National Academy’s principal himself had come.
"Old Long, why are you here this time?"
Black Dragon Academy’s principal Li Bo hesitated multiple times but still stepped forward.
As one of the two Monarch Level Beast Masters present, he believed he had the qualification to converse with Long Zhenguo.
"What do you think?"
Long Zhenguo gave him a sidelong glance, not giving Li Bo any face.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Everyone knew why they were here; who still doesn’t get it?
Why pretend to be aloof here!
Li Bo’s facial muscles twitched slightly but dared not act out.
Against Long Zhenguo, he had no means.
But although he respected Long Zhenguo, he had to fight for Gu Xing, this student.
He took a deep breath and bowed:
"Forgive me, Old Long, but our Black Dragon Academy has to fight for this genius student too!"
This statement was like pouring water into a hot oil pot, other principals almost immediately protested:
"Our Celestial Phoenix Academy also..."
"We at Purple Cloud Academy..."
The scene suddenly plunged into chaos.
In the corner, a principal wearing gold-rimmed glasses weakly reminded:
"Everyone... Should we find the right person first? Argue till red-faced, what if..."
Before finishing his sentence, the entire venue suddenly went silent.
When the crowd calmed down, they had to admit, his advice made sense.
Long Zhenguo frowned, his overwhelming Spiritual Power instantly covering the entire exam site.
Other principals followed suit, weaving dozens of strands of Spiritual Power into a net, scanning all the students present.
"Strange..."
Li Bo’s frown grew tighter, "Why isn’t the kid Wei Yuan mentioned detected?"
The venue’s atmosphere suddenly became eerie.
A dozen principals who usually dominated the scene now looked at each other in confusion.
???
The genius was missing?!
"Could it be..."
One principal suddenly thought of something, his expression turning peculiar.
"The kid hasn’t shown up at all?"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: Fierce Competition Among Academies, The Whole Venue Is Stunned!
chapters.content:
Chapter 53: Chapter 53: Fierce Competition Among Academies, The Whole Venue Is Stunned!
At this moment, Gu Xing realized he couldn’t catch up with the assessment, so he decided to let go.
He asked Ying Xinghe if he could still enter the National Academy if he missed the assessment.
And Ying Xinghe’s answer was:
No problem at all!
After all, talents like Gu Xing who awaken early, if the National Academy doesn’t accept them...
That would really mean their brains are messed up!
With Ying Xinghe’s assurance, Gu Xing felt relieved.
On his way to the assessment site, he took the chance to buy a bunch of food.
After all, during the coma, his body’s energy was almost depleted, and he needed to replenish it.
Liu Li was also a little foodie, so naturally, she wholeheartedly supported Gu Xing’s decision.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
When the two appeared at the assessment site with bags in hand and mouths full of kebabs...
The whole venue fell silent.
Everyone was dumbfounded!
There were thousands of students, plus the principals of various academies waiting for you.
And yet you still have the leisure to eat.
Realizing the situation, Gu Xing quickly took all the food from his hands and the snacks in Liu Li’s arms and stored them into the Beast Taming Space.
"Hey? Where’s my candied hawthorn?"
Liu Li blinked her big eyes in confusion, and only after following Gu Xing’s gaze did she realize she had become the center of the attention.
"Hey?!"
With a cute exclamation, the little girl instantly turned into a streak of light and hid in the Beast Taming Space.
But that left Gu Xing in a tough spot.
He had nowhere to hide!
Standing alone in the center of the field, he felt the scrutiny of thousands of gazes.
Fortunately, at the next moment.
A gentle force suddenly lifted him up.
Long Zhenguo waved his sleeve and directly brought him to the podium.
A dozen principals cast resentful glances at him, looking like a group of abandoned spouses.
They had been waiting there staring at each other for a whole half hour!
"Hello, principals! Thank you for your hard work!"
Gu Xing reacted quickly and immediately bowed ninety degrees, his voice loud enough to be heard throughout the venue.
Seeing this transformation in expression, Long Zhenguo’s eye twitched.
This kid’s face-changing speed... is quite fast!
But for a genius...
Being a bit unusual is perfectly normal!
"Gu Xing, would you like to join our National Academy?"
Hearing this, Gu Xing turned his head and saw a silver-haired elder smiling at him.
Gu Xing immediately realized this elder must be the principal of the National Academy.
Faced with Long Zhenguo’s invitation, Gu Xing was not planning to agree immediately.
After all, from Ying Xinghe’s words, Wei Yuan had sent his information to the admissions offices of all colleges.
Wei Yuan’s only goal for doing this was!
To attract a frenzy from the academies and help him gain the greatest benefit!
"Principal Long, I haven’t yet decided which school to join; my talent is a bit unique, and I’m not sure why..."
"Moreover, this talent has already awakened during the Awakening Stage!"
Saying this, Gu Xing used Sovereign!
His silver eyes struck the hearts of the principals present!
Early Awakening!!!
Gu Xing’s worth skyrocketed once again!
Everyone at the scene had keen eyesight; who couldn’t see the value in Gu Xing’s awakened talent?
Moreover, they sensed that Gu Xing’s spiritual power seems far superior to ordinary Beast Masters!
Being merely Extraordinary Tier One, his spiritual power already seemed to rival those of Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Masters!
"Gu Xing, our Celestial Phoenix Academy..."
"Gu Xing, our Black Tortoise Academy..."
The group of principals were eagerly introducing their schools.
Only Li Fu and a few top college presidents stood silently in place.
They had all picked up on the subtext in Gu Xing’s words!
To get him to join, they must put the benefits before him!
Long Zhenguo laughed silently at this moment.
He didn’t expect Gu Xing to deliberately reveal his early awakening situation.
Yet he fully understood Gu Xing’s intention to seek benefits for himself.
After all, resources are all fought for on one’s own!
Seeing Gu Xing’s gaze still lingering on him, he knew the kid was definitely waiting for him to speak.
Just that...
Given that the kid wanted to enter the National Academy, he was in no hurry to offer his conditions.
At this time, Li Fu slowly stepped forward and spoke sincerely to Gu Xing:
"Gu Xing, as long as you join our Black Dragon Academy, we will dedicate all our resources to cultivating you!"
"You will receive the highest treatment in the history of our academy!"
Gu Xing found himself at a loss.
Facing the eager gaze of this Monarch level powerhouse, the words of refusal turned round several times at the tip of his tongue, yet he couldn’t bring himself to say them.
His gaze repeatedly shifted towards Long Zhenguo, his eyes filled with "Would you please say something?".
"Cough cough!"
Thankfully, Long Zhenguo was worried he might impulsively agree to Li Fu’s terms.
"Gu Xing, if you are willing to join the National Academy, I can fulfill one request for you!"
Though these words sounded light, they brought the venue to a sudden silence.
While Long Zhenguo’s offer seemed modest, one should know he is one of the strongest in Longxia Country.
Basically, his promise means there’s no request within Longxia Country that cannot be fulfilled.
Finally hearing Long Zhenguo speak up, Gu Xing could breathe a sigh of relief.
"I’m really sorry, Principal Li, but I would like to learn more about the National Academy!"
Li Fu was not surprised by this outcome.
Although his Black Dragon Academy ranked second, compared to the National Academy, the gap might be even greater than between him and the last ranked college.
The title ’National’ isn’t just for show.
And seeing the clear gaze of Long Zhenguo, Gu Xing immediately understood that his little trick had long been seen through.
So he straightforwardly stated his demands.
"Principal Long, actually I have two requests, first, I want the Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid, as for the second request..."
Under Long Zhenguo’s gaze, Gu Xing hesitantly opened his mouth:
"I want my Guardian Beast to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s requests, Long Zhenguo frowned slightly.
The first request was nothing; however precious, Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid was a material, not as valuable as a genius.
But the Beast Taming Holy Pool...
This is the foundation of the National Academy!
Generally, it’s only awarded to Monarch level Beast Masters who make significant contributions.
And Gu Xing, an Extraordinary level Beast Master...
Long Zhenguo gazed into Gu Xing’s eyes and slowly opened:
"What is your reason for wanting to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
"I have a Guardian Beast that needs the Holy Pool for healing!"
Long Zhenguo tapped his fingers as he considered the pros and cons of this decision.
Seeing Gu Xing’s pleading eyes, he finally spoke slowly:
"The first condition I can agree to, as for the second condition..."
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s eyes showed a hint of disappointment.
Long Zhenguo’s tone already suggested that this condition was unlikely.
However.
Long Zhenguo changed his tone:
"As long as you can prove your worth at the freshman ceremony, this condition, I will allow it!"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Angel Evolution, Myth Beast!
chapters.content:
Chapter 54: Chapter 54: Angel Evolution, Myth Beast!
And as soon as Long Zhenguo spoke, the entire audience was astonished!
What does the Beast Taming Holy Pool symbolize?
It’s the foundation upon which the National Academy has stood for a thousand years!
The opportunity sought by countless Monarch-level experts, the old principal actually agreed?!
Receiving Long Zhenguo’s answer, Gu Xing’s expression lit up with joy.
He had initially prepared for the worst, but now...
The tables have turned!
There’s hope to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!
Yet the deeper meaning in Long Zhenguo’s words made him ponder.
Why did he specifically emphasize proving himself at the new student ceremony?
Gu Xing felt a hint of realization as he raised his head, meeting the old principal’s meaningful gaze.
In an instant, it dawned on him.
Though Long Zhenguo is the principal of the National Academy, the school is not solely governed by him.
Even if he agrees for Gu Xing to enter the Holy Pool, other Monarch-level elders would not easily allow a new student to step in.
If one wants those Monarch-level Beast Masters to shut their mouths, there’s only one way...
And that is to prove oneself!!
Prove one’s potential!!
Prove oneself capable of suppressing all peers!!
The reason Long Zhenguo emphasized the new student ceremony is one.
It’s because only during the new student ceremony will all new students who join the National Academy be present!
And what he must do is right in front of everyone!
Defeat the thousand students who joined the National Academy!
"Principal Long, I understand!"
Gu Xing nodded heavily towards Long Zhenguo.
Seeing this, Long Zhenguo’s eyes flashed with a hint of comfort.
This kid certainly gets it instantly.
Gu Xing’s guess was spot on.
In principle, not to mention at the Extraordinary Level, even Commander-level Beast Masters can dream of touching the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
But if it’s Gu Xing...
Who can suppress all the students of the same cohort.
Then the qualification to enter the Holy Pool, why not give it to him?!
A prodigy unrivaled throughout history, having some privileges, who dares to say a word...
His fists, as a seasoned veteran, are no joke!
"Then I look forward to your performance at the new student ceremony! As for the Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid, someone will soon deliver it to you!"
With that, the old principal waved his sleeve and turned away.
Seeing Gu Xing’s fate decided, the other principals all had faces full of regret.
Missing out on someone like Gu Xing, it’s uncertain when such a talented student will be encountered again.
But anyhow.
The principals were here, so naturally, they needed to make a good selection from those present.
Although missing out on Gu Xing, choosing some standout talents is also good.
Very soon, their eyes were drawn to a female student...
Relying solely on an Epic-level Succubus, she managed to achieve a top ten score among the candidates.
"Such exquisite control!"
Li Fu couldn’t help but exclaim.
To develop Beast Taming potential to such an extent shows that this girl’s battle talent is exceptionally outstanding, with a high potential for awakening strong talents in the future.
Several principals exchanged glances and immediately approached her.
But when they enthusiastically offered olive branches, the answer they received was unexpected:
"Sorry, esteemed principals, I must join the National Academy."
Shen Ruoxue slightly bowed, her gaze continuously following the direction where Gu Xing had left.
The girl’s voice was full of determination:
"There, is someone I must catch up to."
...
After leaving the assessment site, it was only then that Gu Xing realized...
He surprisingly had nowhere to go in the Imperial Capital!
In desperation, he turned back to Winning Bing.
Living off others isn’t so bad!
And Ying Bing was naturally very welcoming of Gu Xing’s arrival.
He immediately arranged accommodation for Gu Xing.
Not long after settling down, the Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid promised by Long Zhenguo was also delivered into Gu Xing’s hands.
At that moment.
Gu Xing gazed at the three materials before him, his fingertips slightly trembling.
Only he knows the hardships of collecting these materials.
[Light Crystal: Enhances the Blazing Angels Race’s control over their abilities]
[Angel Sacred Blood: Purifies the Blazing Angels Race’s bloodline]
[Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid: Contains vast energy, provides the energy needed for the Blazing Angels Race’s evolution]
Each one radiates a golden aura, intertwining in the dim room.
Any piece of material would cause a scramble in the outside world.
But now...
All three materials are to be spent on Liu Li’s cultivation!
Gu Xing’s heart ached slightly!
Painful!
But there’s no choice... he’s responsible for his own Guardian Beast!
"Liu Li, come out."
The contract light flickered, and the little angel gradually appeared.
As she saw the materials on the table, her golden eyes suddenly contracted.
Gu Xing had once used three materials to repair her wings.
And now, the same three materials lay before her.
Clearly, her master’s intention is obvious.
The little girl looked gratefully towards Gu Xing.
"Thank you, Master!"
Gu Xing waved his hand indifferently.
Though Liu Li hadn’t shown it during this time.
Gu Xing noticed that the little girl basically spends her free time in the Beast Taming Space to enhance herself.
Her extreme desire to become stronger proves that what Miller said about the Blazing Angels Race’s situation deeply affected this little girl.
"Liu Li, close your eyes!"
Liu Li obediently closed her eyes, her long eyelashes casting delicate shadows in the light.
Gu Xing took a deep breath, slowly lifting the three treasures, letting them float above the little angel’s head.
In an instant, a sacred glow poured down like a waterfall, completely enveloping Liu Li’s petite figure...
The three materials transformed into brilliant streams of light, rapidly rotating around the little angel like planets.
"Buzz——"
Accompanied by a clear ringing sound, Liu Li instantly entered the Blazing Angel Form.
Four pairs of radiant wings unfolded mightily, each feather blooming with dazzling crimson light.
The three treasures, as if summoned, precisely fused into the four primary feathers at her back.
"Boom!"
Blazing Holy Fire soared into the sky, transforming into a column of light that pierced through heaven and earth.
Pure Myth-level awe spread like tides, causing flying creatures and beasts within a hundred miles to tremble and bow.
Within the National Academy, the tea cup in Long Zhenguo’s hand shattered with a "pop".
He stood up abruptly, the peak Monarch-level aura explosively bursting forth:
"Myth Level?!"
His reaction was lightning-fast, his vast spiritual power instantly weaving into a Heaven and Earth Net, firmly sealing the Myth-level aura.
The other Monarch-level experts were just about to investigate but were continuously pushed back by this pressure.
Only after confirming the complete concealment of the aura did Long Zhenguo relax.
Yet his pupils still slightly contracted...
From that aura just now.
He felt a sense of familiarity.
It’s surprisingly...
Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast!
"Myth Level..."ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Long Zhenguo murmured, fingers unconsciously rubbing the cuff.
Never before in the history of Longxia Country has there been a Myth-level Beast, and now it is born like this!
What’s even more astonishing is that the owner of this Myth-level Beast also possesses precocious prodigious talent and possibly dual incredible potentials...
He suddenly laughed heartily.
"Good! Good! Good! Indeed, I didn’t misjudge him!"

chapters.title: Chapter 55: Power Surges as Storms Gather
chapters.content:
Chapter 55: Chapter 55: Power Surges as Storms Gather
Meanwhile.
Under the influence of three materials, Liu Li’s back once again revealed wings!
Six shining wings fully spread out, each burning with red Holy Fire.
Violent energy formed a flame storm around her, making the area look like a furnace.
In Gu Xing’s gaze, Liu Li’s momentum kept rising.
It quickly reached a critical point.
Seeing this, Gu Xing clenched his fists.
He could feel that if Liu Li could break through this barrier.
Her level would break through to the Myth Level!
If she couldn’t break through, her talent would remain at Legendary Nine Stars.
But at this moment.
Everything could only rely on her.
"Boom——!"
Red Flame suddenly went berserk, transforming into a surging wave of flames sweeping through the entire room.
Surprisingly, these flames seemed to have life, automatically dispersing when about to touch Gu Xing.
Yet the violent explosion still alarmed the entire Winner clan.
"By order of the Clan Leader, no one may approach!"
Ying Xinghe’s dignified voice echoed through the sky.
A sapphire barrier instantly descended, tightly sealing the berserk energy.
The people of Winner who were ready to check the situation stopped in their tracks...
The Clan Leader’s personal order, who dared to act rashly?
However.
A slender figure dashed against the crowd, heading towards the direction of the barrier.
Ying Bing bit her lip hard, her eyes filled with worry.
The moment she touched the barrier, the sapphire curtain parted like ripples of water...
This barrier posed no obstacle to her!
Deep within the Winner ancestral land.
The Clan Leader stood with hands behind his back, eyes like sharp swords.
He was naturally aware of what was happening within the barrier...
That young person was actually enhancing his Beast Mastery talent!
This was unprecedented in the millennia-long history of Beast Mastery in Longxia Country!
"Bing’er..."
The Clan Leader murmured softly, a glimmer of hope flashing in his eyes.
"Perhaps the flaw in our Winner’s Bloodline might be completely resolved on this young person..."
Inside the barrier.
Ying Bing was shocked speechless by the scene in front of her.
The crimson sea of flames surged, yet avoided the center where Gu Xing stood.
Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, seeing this, instantly deployed an ice crystal shield.
Staring at the eight-winged angel amidst the blazing flames, her eyes were full of vigilance, and even a hint of fear.
Ying Bing felt the emotions of the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, her pupils shrinking.
To know, last time in the Elf Secret Realm, after bloodline purification and breaking through Extraordinary level.
Relying on the Winner’s bloodline, the talent of Profound Frost Ice Phoenix had already reached Legendary Seven Stars.
Yet even so...
The Ice Phoenix still felt a thread of fear.
Just what terrifying realm had that eight-winged angel’s talent reached?
And now, Liu Li’s breakthrough was at the final juncture.
Liu Li suddenly opened her eyes!
In those golden pupils, intricate divine patterns appeared!
"Break!"
With a clear shout, the boundless red flames froze instantly.
The next moment, all flames seemed touched by the hand of God, instantly transforming into radiant crimson gold!
The terrifying high temperature even began to crack the ice shield formed by Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, fine cracks spreading like a web.
"Chirp——!"
The Ice Phoenix let out an urgent cry, the ice crystals on her wings beginning to melt.
Ying Bing felt her heart tremble, casting a deep glance at Gu Xing, decisively retreating from the barrier with the Ice Phoenix.
She understood that if she stayed longer, her guardian beast might suffer irreparable damage!
Inside the barrier, the crimson gold Divine Fire danced like living creatures.
Liu Li hovered in the center of the fiery sea, the divine patterns on the eight wings lighting up one by one.
When the last divine pattern was illuminated—
"Boom!"
A sky-piercing beam of light shot into the clouds, Liu Li’s aura finally breaking the shackles, stepping into a whole new domain!
Gu Xing stared in awe at the scene before him...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Power: 1020]
[Constitution: 1010]
[Spirit: 1000]
[Speed: 1030]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form (Eight-winged Status) (includes Judgment, Divine Protection!), Doomsday Angel Form (Ten-winged Status, falls into weakness after use), Celestial Fire Domain (Initial Tier)]
[Evolution: Angel Divine Blood, Light Holy Crystal...]
Gu Xing’s eyes slightly contracted as he stared at the data dancing on the screen before him.
Although Liu Li’s attributes only increased by 200 points, her skills had completely renewed.
Now she possessed two forms!
Blazing Angel and Doomsday Angel!
The current Blazing Angel Form...
Had reached eight wings!
Whereas the Doomsday Angel Form...
Could elevate Liu Li to the level of a ten-winged Doomsday Angel!
According to what Miller previously said, seems like Liu Li’s father had only reached the level of an eight-winged angel!
And now, his little angel had touched the threshold of ten wings!
As for the final Celestial Fire Domain...
Carried the word ’Domain’!
Not a power that could be grasped at the Extraordinary level!
Summed up.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Liu Li’s current strength, unless an Extraordinary Peak Beast Master acted, otherwise...
She could sweep through the entire Extraordinary Level!
The little girl’s talent reaching Myth, Gu Xing finally fulfilled a wish of his.
And next.
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the green cocoon within the Beast Taming Space.
Helping this little buddy awaken!
To obtain a second myth-level guardian beast!
...
In the National Academy.
Several Monarch-level Beast Masters barged into the principal’s office.
"Principal Long, why would you agree to such a ridiculous request from that student!"
"Even we Monarch-level concede queue to apply for the Beast Taming Holy Pool, and you agreed to give it to an Extraordinary Level kid?!"
"Exactly, if you set such a precedent, what if other geniuses start emulating?"
Long Zhenguo slowly put down the teacup in his hand, his gaze sweeping over everyone like a sharp blade.
These monarchs from noble families, each with their heads full of family interests...
Except for families like Qin and Winner truly serving the nation, the rest were simply parasites!
"You all..." his voice suddenly turned cold, "Questioning my decision?"
"Dare not!"
The Monarch-level Beast Masters quickly lowered their heads.
It’s known that monarchs also have hierarchy.
And they, just entering Monarch Level, couldn’t compare at all with Long Zhenguo, a Monarch Peak Beast Master.
However...
Although they feared Long Zhenguo, the Beast Taming Holy Pool concerned their own interests.
Retreat was not an option!!
"This isn’t only our opinion; more than seventy percent of the Academy’s Monarch-levels also..."
"Enough!"
Long Zhenguo’s cold grunt shook the office windows to resonating hums.
"That’s decided! If Gu Xing can awe all freshmen at the welcoming ceremony, he’ll be admitted to the Holy Pool! Otherwise, the matter is off!"
Witnessing Long Zhenguo’s unforgiving gaze.
The few understood well; this was Long Zhenguo’s bottom line!
They pondered briefly, then consented.
After all, even if Gu Xing is a genius, he’s just one person.
And how many freshmen get admitted to the National Academy?
Thousands!
Moreover, many freshmen had already reached Extraordinary Level lately.
Plus many exceptionally recruited talents among them.
Despite Gu Xing’s strength, he’s still human!
To awe thousands of students single-handedly?
Dream on!!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Opening Ceremony, Dominant Entrance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 56: Chapter 56: Opening Ceremony, Dominant Entrance!
Very soon.
The day of the entrance ceremony arrived.
The central training ground was transformed into a massive venue, with crowds bustling in the stands, and the sound of discussions rising and falling.
"Did you hear? There’s something special about this year’s freshman ceremony!"
"Special? What’s so special? Isn’t it the same every year? The principal gives a speech, then a freshman representative says a few words, and it’s over?"
"No, I heard this year, one of the students was personally invited back by Principal Long!"
"Moreover, Principal Long is setting an assessment at the freshman ceremony. If this freshman passes, they can enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!"
"What, the Beast Taming Holy Pool? Isn’t that only for Monarch Level Beast Masters?"
Gu Qianqian stood amidst the crowd, the corners of her mouth twitching slightly.
She didn’t expect her little brother to cause such a big commotion!
This year’s entrance ceremony...
Not only were all the freshmen present, but many old students also joined in the fun because of this matter.
"Qianqian, your brother is impressive! And he’s quite good-looking, maybe introduce him to me!"
Tang Xinrou nudged Gu Qianqian with her elbow, her face full of little stars in her eyes.
Handsome, powerful, and her best friend’s brother!
Keep the good things within the family!
Why not?
Gu Qianqian pushed her best friend’s face away expressionlessly:
"No way!"
"Why not?!"
"You’re too old!"
Tang Xinrou’s body suddenly stiffened!
Ouch!Follow current novᴇls on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
As the entrance bell rang, the freshmen gradually entered the venue.
Qin Tian from the special invitation area immediately spotted Ying Bing and quickly headed over with a few underlings.
"Sister Bing!" Qin Tian scratched his head, "Where’s Brother Xing? Why isn’t he with you?"
Ying Bing saw Qin Tian and calmly explained:
"He said he has his own pace and told me to go ahead!"
Qin Tian nodded.
The underlings behind Qin Tian looked at each other.
Then one of them bravely asked:
"Boss, who is this Brother Xing you’re talking about?"
"Yeah, Boss, with your strength, why are you calling someone else ’brother’?"
"Besides Sister Bing, who else in this batch could be your match?"
Qin Tian suddenly turned around, his sharp gaze made the underlings fall silent immediately:
"Listen up! Gu Xing is my brother! Whenever you see him, treat him just like me!"
These underlings knew Qin Tian’s character.
If Qin Tian says something like that, it means...
Gu Xing must be stronger than him!
And not just by a little!
"Understood!"
A few voices replied in unison, already engraving the name "Gu Xing" in their hearts.
Just then, a grating voice came from the side.
"Oh, isn’t this Young Master Qin?"
Wang Teng waltzed over with a few followers, a mocking smile on his face.
"Since when did you recognize a wild brother? Is it that fool who dreams of entering the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
He had received instructions from the family’s old patriarch...
To utterly defeat Gu Xing at the entrance ceremony!
He had also received news that at this opening ceremony, it might be Gu Xing facing all the freshmen alone.
He held great disdain for this kind of fool.
Beast Taming Holy Pool?
Does an Extraordinary Level even qualify?
"Swish—"
A green vine suddenly flew through the air, stopping just an inch from Wang Teng’s throat.
The war tree’s massive figure loomed behind Qin Tian.
"Dare insult Brother Xing again," a chilling glint flashed in Qin Tian’s eyes, "and this vine will go right through your mouth."
Cold sweat instantly appeared on Wang Teng’s forehead, he opened his mouth but dared not speak further.
Qin Tian was known to be as good as his word!
Moreover, whether in strength or family background, he was slightly inferior to Qin Tian.
His expression changed multiple times before he turned around, gritting his teeth.
"Let’s go!"
As he turned, he transferred all his anger onto the unfamiliar Gu Xing.
If he can’t beat Qin Tian, surely he can handle a clown who relies on creating a stir for attention?
Even though Long Zhenguo personally invited him to the assessment site...
But that also means he couldn’t even meet the requirements for pre-admission before the college entrance exam!
Special admission?
He just awakened a powerful talent!
Talent alone doesn’t make one a Beast Master!
A student like this, could he not surpass?!
At this moment.
Long Zhenguo had already ascended the rostrum, narrating the history of the National Academy.
But his spiritual energy was focused on...
Gu Xing, who had slipped into the venue unnoticed!
While he publicly implied that Gu Xing would battle all the freshmen alone...
However...
He had no intention of forcibly arranging these students to fight Gu Xing.
How Gu Xing would get over a thousand freshmen to willingly take action was also a crucial test!
Besides Long Zhenguo, this training ground was also watched by several Monarch Level Beast Masters.
They were very curious, what kind of skills does this kid have?!
To dare make such a request to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!
"Next, please welcome freshman representative Classmate Ying Bing to give a speech!"
The host’s voice echoed in the venue.
Ying Bing was just about to get up when she caught a glimpse of a familiar figure sneaking towards the podium.
She smiled slightly and stopped in her tracks.
"Please, freshman representative, come up to speak!" the host called again.
However.
The Ying Bing everyone was eagerly anticipating did not appear; instead, a nimble figure leapt onto the podium.
In the astonished gaze of the staff, Gu Xing raised his hand and snapped his fingers...
"Boom!"
The sacred golden flame suddenly erupted, and eight-winged angels spread their radiant wings, hovering in mid-air, illuminating the entire podium as if it were an altar.
Gu Xing’s fingertip swept across the freshmen, his voice carried by spiritual power to every corner:
"Pardon my bluntness! Besides me, who here deserves to be called the top freshman?"
He curled his lips into a defiant smile:
"Is it perhaps... all of you trash?!"
"Whoa—"
The crowd first froze, then erupted into a tsunami of commotion.
"Who the hell is this guy?!"
"Can’t stand it! I’m going to kill him today!"
"Where’s the staff? Get this lunatic off the stage!"
In the crowd, Ying Bing heard Gu Xing’s speech.
She could no longer maintain her icy façade.
With a "pfft", she burst out laughing.
And Qin Tian quietly gave a thumbs up to Gu Xing on stage.
No wonder he’s Brother Xing; he knows how to rock it!
Even the old students in the stands were collectively stunned:
"What the hell! This freshman is off the charts!"
"He just infuriated everyone; won’t he get beaten to death?"
"Wait... Could this be the Gu Xing they’re talking about?"
But at this moment, Tang Xinrou clung to Gu Qianqian’s sleeve, her expression excited.
"Qianqian! My husband! My husband!"
Gu Qianqian’s mouth kept twitching.
This...
Is this really her well-behaved brother?!
Long Zhenguo looked at the overly arrogant Gu Xing on stage, almost pulling his own beard out.
He also didn’t expect Gu Xing to provoke everyone like this!
But the effect...
Seemed unexpectedly good!
However.
Just as the entire crowd of freshmen was about to erupt, Gu Xing suddenly made a "pause" gesture.
"Sorry, misspoke just now."
He put on an innocently sweet smile, and just as everyone was about to breathe a sigh of relief—
"Swish!"
His finger suddenly pointed towards the stands, his voice rising sharply:
"I meant to say, including all seniors and juniors in the stands, you’re all garbage!"
...
