chapters.title: Chapter 57: Entrance Exam Trial, Shock Across the Arena!
chapters.content:
Chapter 57: Chapter 57: Entrance Exam Trial, Shock Across the Arena!
Dead silence.
An absolute dead silence enveloped the entire venue.
The freshmen’s mouths were still open in shock, while the older students in the stands had already stood up in unison.
If there had been just a stir in the freshmen’s area before, now the entire training ground was boiling!
"Holy crap, the new students this year are defying the heavens!"
"Damn it, if we don’t beat the crap out of him today, it doesn’t count!"
"Principal! Aren’t you going to do something about this?!"
Long Zhenguo covered his forehead, both amused and exasperated.
This kid...
Actually brought the fight directly to the seniors’ heads!
But on second thought...
To prove his worth, indeed, he can’t just limit himself to battles of the same level.
"Interesting..."
Long Zhenguo squinted his eyes and, instead of stopping it, waved his hand, and a barrier enveloped the entire training ground.
At the same time, a staff member’s voice echoed throughout the venue via the amplification system:
"After consideration by the school, due to Gu Xing’s egregious behavior, everyone within the barrier may attack freely!"
As soon as the words were spoken, this Extraordinary Level staff member flashed out of the barrier.
Are you kidding? With thousands of furious genius students, if he wasn’t careful, he’d be caught in the crossfire!
Gu Xing looked at the densely packed crowd below, who seemed like they wanted to swallow him whole, and subconsciously swallowed hard.
Although he was confident in Liu Li’s strength, being stared at by so many angry eyes...
In such a situation, who wouldn’t be nervous?
However.
Apart from the group of classmates glaring at him fiercely.
Several figures quickly leapt onto the stage and lined up beside Gu Xing.
Shen Ruoxue, Ying Bing, Qin Tian, Gu Qianqian, Tang Xinrou...
"Bro Xing, I give full marks for your maneuver!"
Qin Tian grinned, with his Treant Guardian standing protectively behind him.
"But just to be clear, I can at most help you hold off three to five Extraordinary Level Guardian Beasts..."
Ying Bing looked grim.
Though she was stronger than Qin Tian, apart from the freshmen present.
There were also quite a few Extraordinary Tier Three, even Tier Four, seniors present.
She wasn’t sure how many she could hold off!
But no matter what, she would do her utmost to help Gu Xing.
However, Qin Tian’s underlings didn’t have that kind of psychological strength.
Seeing the fierce classmates ahead, their legs trembled like sieves:
"T-t-t-tian-ge, are we going to get beaten to death?"
"Getting beaten to death is probably unlikely with the principal around, but I’m afraid we won’t escape getting half-killed!"
"It’s okay, the school has a medical team, we won’t die!"
"The way you put it, I’m even more scared now!"
However.
Some people were extremely excited to face such a scene.
At this moment, Tang Xinrou’s face was full of excitement.
"Honey! This is too exciting! I love you!"
Swish——
Liu Li, Ying Bing, and Shen Ruoxue’s gazes instantly locked on.
"She’s joking!"
With a swift step forward, Gu Qianqian covered her friend’s mouth firmly and dragged her to the corner.
Her gentle eyes were now piercingly cold, and her lowered voice carried unprecedented menace:
"Tang Xinrou! If you dare talk nonsense again, I’ll kill you!!!"
Tang Xinrou was so shocked by the sudden menace that she nodded vigorously like a pecking chicken.
Only when she confirmed that her loose-lipped friend had finally settled down did Gu Qianqian release her grip, returning to her normal demeanor as she turned back to Gu Xing’s side.
"Xing, what’s your plan?"
"With just the few of us, taking on thousands of students... is a bit challenging, isn’t it!"
Gu Qianqian had put it very conservatively.
In reality, it wasn’t just a challenge, it was an utter power disparity!
Even if Gu Xing’s strength was great, so many people, simply using quantity they could overwhelm him.
Moreover.
Gu Qianqian’s gaze passed over several seniors in the front row who exuded extraordinary power, and her heart sank.
Those Extraordinary Tier Five monsters were just standing there with their arms crossed, watching for entertainment, yet the oppressive aura alone was suffocating.
Not to mention there were dozens of Extraordinary Tier Three and Four experts below.
Each one would be a top genius in any other academy!
And her brother...
Had managed to provoke all these people in one go!
However.
Gu Xing suddenly stepped forward, shielding everyone behind him.
"Do not interfere, this is the assessment I promised Principal Long! I must complete it myself!"
"But..."
Shen Ruoxue still wanted to speak.
Shen Ruoxue tried to say more, but Gu Xing raised his hand to stop her.
"Don’t worry! I never do things I’m not sure about!"
After saying this, Gu Xing’s gaze swept over the densely packed students, and he spoke calmly:
"Sovereign!"
A silver-white light burst forth from Gu Xing’s eyes, and an aura of regality instantly enveloped the entire venue.
With Liu Li’s current attributes.
Activating the Blazing Angel Form, Liu Li had enough offensive power to crush any student!
So for Liu Li, offensively, she was already more than sufficient.
However...
On the defensive side.
Although Divine Protection could grant absolute immunity from one attack.
There were simply too many students present...
In the chaos of battle, if Liu Li was careless, things could go awry.
Therefore, defense was up to him to compensate for.
"Grant, protection!"
A blue shield instantly covered Liu Li’s exterior.
Beyond that.
The Blazing Angel Flame then rose, forming a second fiery barrier.
Seeing this, Gu Xing nodded with satisfaction.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Generally, the outermost Flame Shield was enough to block standard attacks.
Even if one or two attacks broke through the outer shield, the Shield of Protection he provided would still stand as a barricade.
"Sister Bing, aren’t we really going to help?"
Behind Gu Xing, Qin Tian spoke in a low voice.
Ying Bing was silent for a moment, gazing at the Angel floating in the sky.
She remembered how even at Ying’s home, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix feared the Angel’s aura.
"No need! I trust him!"
Seeing Ying Bing so confident, Qin Tian had no choice but to step back a few paces.
Though he had no idea where Ying Bing’s trust came from.
But now, all he could do was watch as Gu Xing walked alone toward the dark crowd.
"Heh, you’ve got some guts!"
Wang Teng pushed through the crowd to the front, wearing a grim smile.
"If Ying Bing and the others were helping you, it might cause us some trouble, but you actually came to us alone..."
"While we can’t beat you to death here, smashing you to pieces, I’m sure the principal won’t mind!"
Wang Teng’s cronies chimed in:
"Yeah, calling us trash, let’s see today just what gives you the nerve to say that."
Gu Xing’s eyes flickered with a hint of coldness.
He was just worrying about not finding the right person to make an example of, and now someone had actually dared to step forward!
This was exactly what he wanted!
"Liu Li, do it!"
With Gu Xing’s command, Liu Li in mid-air burst forth with a bright crimson-golden light.
Eight sets of wings fully unfurled, the Blazing Angel Form was fully activated!
"Boom——"
A crimson-golden fireball descended from the sky, accurately striking the position where Wang Teng stood.
Wang Teng’s Extraordinary Tier One Guardian Beast didn’t even have time to react and was instantly obliterated.
The entire venue fell into sudden silence.
Gu Xing stood with hands behind his back, his silver-white eyes sweeping over the dumbfounded crowd:
"Continue?!"

chapters.title: Chapter 58: Standing Alone Against a Thousand, Shocking the Crowd!
chapters.content:
Chapter 58: Chapter 58: Standing Alone Against a Thousand, Shocking the Crowd!
"Thud!"
Wang Teng fell to the ground on his butt, his face still frozen with an expression of disbelief.
In that moment, it was as if he saw his great-grandmother waving at him.
"This... this is impossible..."
He mumbled to himself, lips trembling, fine beads of sweat forming on his forehead.
His guardian beast had Epic Talent at Monarch Peak, and its level was Extraordinary Tier One!
How could this be?!
How could it be defeated so effortlessly?!
No one paid attention to the collapsing Wang Teng. The remaining freshmen looked at Gu Xing with eyes full of gravity.
Wang Teng was ranked among the top twenty of the freshmen, but just now...
He was utterly defeated without any resistance!
This meant that even if they went up, their fate would be no different from Wang Teng’s.
For a moment, everyone was stunned, with no one daring to step forward.
Meanwhile, a few Extraordinary Tier Five seniors watching the scene with crossed arms exchanged glances.
With their strong powers, they saw more of Gu Xing’s background.
The power displayed by that angel just now was entirely on par with Extraordinary Tier Five, even faintly surpassing it.
The corners of several people’s mouths twitched slightly.
Extraordinary Tier One yet possessing Extraordinary Tier Five strength.
No wonder this freshman had dared to propose entering the Beast Taming Holy Pool to the principal.
However.
This freshman hadn’t just challenged the newcomers, but also them, the seniors.
If they didn’t let this newcomer suffer a bit, how could they establish their authority as seniors?
Soon, after exchanging glances, they reached a consensus.
That was, they must not let Gu Xing pass this assessment.
Outside the barrier.
Long Zhenguo had already anticipated Gu Xing’s strength.
And he knew...
That angel’s talent was at Myth Level.
If it couldn’t crush an Epic Level guardian beast, that would indeed be strange.
However.
His gaze focused on Gu Xing’s eyes.
This talent...
Such a record had never been chronicled in the history of Longxia Country!
Moreover...
When his gaze settled on those silvery-white eyes, he faintly felt a threat.
One must know, he stood at the pinnacle of the Human Race.
The Monarch Peak was the limit for humans!
Yet even so, he could feel a hint of threat; how terrifying must Gu Xing’s talent be?
At this moment.
After some initial hesitation.
The freshmen reached a consensus.
"He’s just one person, and we have over a thousand. Could his single guardian beast defeat us all?"
"Exactly, if we all attack together, his guardian beast, even if it had three heads and six arms, couldn’t withstand it!"
"Everyone, don’t hesitate. Listen to my command and attack together!"
"For the guardian beasts with long-range attacks, strike together in three seconds, while those with melee attacks will charge after the long-range onslaught ends."
Seeing someone quickly step out from the crowd to take command.
Gu Xing couldn’t help but marvel:
Truly a genius worthy of entering the National Academy.
Though initially stunned by his strength, they quickly regrouped and organized an offensive.
However.
The number of people, which might work against average guardian beasts,
Was utterly ineffective against Liu Li, who currently had two layers of shielding...
It was useless!
The attacks from the long-range guardian beasts fell upon Liu Li’s Flame Shield without stirring the slightest ripple.
They couldn’t even break through the first layer of the shield!
But Gu Xing was quite troubled now.
Because with Liu Li’s current attributes, if she got a bit serious.
Those Extraordinary Level guardian beasts would either die or be severely injured.
Not to mention, many of the guardian beasts were still at Awakening Level.
Not to mention taking a direct hit from Liu Li, even a slight graze would result in heavy injuries.
And after all, this wasn’t a battlefield, merely an assessment.
If his actions led to severe injuries or deaths among the guardian beasts...
Liu Li, too, was in a dilemma at this moment.
Though she could easily dispatch these guardian beasts.
Achieving just knocking them out without killing was another story...
There were over a thousand guardian beasts here!
Each requiring such precise control of her strength, the difficulty was exceedingly high!
Yet Liu Li’s lack of counterattack seemed to give this group hope.
"Don’t give up, everyone. Let the melee guardian beasts attack once more. That guardian beast doesn’t dare to fight back; surely it’s because her defense skills have a significant flaw!"
In an instant, various energy attacks rained down on the Blazing Angel in the air like a storm.
Watching this scene, Qin Tian stomped his foot anxiously.
"Sister Bing, what’s Brother Xing waiting for?!"
"Just taking the hits without fighting back, how can he win?!"
Even Ying Bing’s eyebrows furrowed slightly.
She didn’t understand why Gu Xing wasn’t counterattacking either.
Logically speaking, with Gu Xing’s power, this group of guardian beasts should be easy to wipe out with a wave of his hand!
Wait a minute!
Ying Bing suddenly understood why!
Gu Xing was dismissing this group of classmates as too weak, worried they couldn’t withstand his attacks.
The seniors also began to sense something was amiss!
"What’s with this kid? Why isn’t he fighting back against those freshmen? Looks like he’s defending quite effortlessly! His attack power shouldn’t be weak, right?!"
"Weak? Don’t you know the Angel Race is purely offensive guardian beasts?"
"But this group of freshmen’s attacks can’t even break the defense; I feel like they’re unreliable!"
"This can’t go on, let’s join in! We can’t let this kid keep pretending anymore!"
Soon, all the seniors joined the battle.
Only those few Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Masters remained outside the field.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
"What do we do?"
An Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Master with a crew cut had a fiery look in his eyes, turning to ask his companion.
"Let’s go together! That angel withstood so many skills alone without budging! It’s clear we haven’t pushed that angel to her limits! Let’s go and fan the flames!"
"Alright, I’ve been itching to try my hand at this for a while. Let’s see just how strong this newcomer really is!"
As these Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Masters joined the fray, a faint tremor appeared in the Blazing Angel Flame surrounding Liu Li.
Even with her current attributes, enduring the continuous attacks from thousands of Beast Masters was gradually becoming strenuous.
"It’s working!"
Seeing their attacks taking effect, the students’ eyes flashed with excitement.
"As long as we break the angel’s outer flame shield, we can win! Everyone, give it all you’ve got!"
The attacks soared once more.
"Crack!"
With a crisp sound of breaking, the shield constructed by the Blazing Angel Flame finally shattered into pieces.
The students erupted into cheers, but before the sound could fully spread, it was abruptly choked back in their throats—
A dazzling azure barrier, even more brilliant than the Flame Shield, stood erectly behind the shattered shield!
"This... how is this possible?!"
"Must be joking! Why is there another shield?"
The faces of the students were filled with despair.
Breaking the first shield had already drained all their strength.
And now...
There was an even stronger shield waiting for them!
Gu Xing, at this moment, finally made up his mind.
He trusted that with Long Zhenguo around, there was no way he’d let these students get hurt.
"Liu Li!" He raised his right hand, his voice resonating throughout the arena, "Celestial Fire Domain!"

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Crushing the Competition, Holy Pool Admission!
chapters.content:
Chapter 59: Chapter 59: Crushing the Competition, Holy Pool Admission!
In an instant, the air within the barrier seemed to be ignited, and the temperature soared at an astounding pace.
In the void, clusters of crimson golden Fire Lotus blossomed successively, with every petal flowing with a palpable aura of destruction.
Gu Xing’s choice to unleash the Celestial Fire Domain wasn’t impulsive but a result of deep consideration!
Looking at Liu Li’s various skills...Follow current novels on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
This little angel is evidently an ultimate single-attack Guardian Beast!
Facing the assault of thousands of people, both Liu Li’s Blazing Angel Form and Doomsday Angel Form had minimal effect.
Hence, Gu Xing directly had Liu Li use the Celestial Fire Domain!
One reason was that the Celestial Fire Domain seemed to be Liu Li’s only group attack skill.
Another reason was out of sheer curiosity; Gu Xing was deeply intrigued by the power of a skill with the word "Domain"!
Outside the barrier.
Long Zhenguo suddenly stood upright.
He watched the crimson golden flames within the barrier slowly coagulate into a Domain, his pupils contracting sharply.
How is it possible?!
Having just entered the Extraordinary Realm... actually touched the threshold of the Domain!
Though it’s merely a prototype, one must understand that Gu Xing has only just stepped into the Extraordinary Realm!
If this Domain continues to mature with level advancement...
Long Zhenguo dared not imagine what heights this young man’s future might achieve!
Perhaps he truly could transcend the curse on the Human Race!
The curse of not being able to break through to Monarch Level!
Within the barrier, time seemed to freeze.
Thousands of students gazed up in terror at the crimson golden Fire Lotus spinning slowly in the void.
"Is this... really a skill that can be used at the Extraordinary Level?"
"Damn it! Why am I sensing the aura of death coming from that Fire Lotus!"
"Something’s wrong! This seems to be a Domain of a Commander Level Beast Master!"
"Domain? Are you joking?! He’s only at Extraordinary Tier One!!"
Several Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Masters now also looked extremely grim.
Although they had tried to overestimate Gu Xing’s strength, reality told them...
Their guesses were just the tip of the iceberg of Gu Xing’s power!
"What kind of monster is this guy?!"
A crew-cut Extraordinary Tier Five Beast Master swallowed hard.
He now completely abandoned the thought of competing with Gu Xing.
Their strengths were on entirely different levels!
Looking at the terrifying Fire Lotus floating in the air...
He had a premonition that even a slight contact would turn his Guardian Beast into ashes.
"Surrender, we can’t fight this!"
At this moment, the other Tier Five Beast Masters had the same thought.
Inside the school, if their Guardian Beasts were severely injured or even died...
The losses outweigh the gains!
With several Tier Five Beast Masters giving up resistance, the remaining students also surrendered one after another.
If there was a slight chance of victory, they could fight desperately.
But now...
They couldn’t see any hope of winning!
Gu Xing raised his eyebrows in surprise at the students surrendering one by one.
He had originally planned to launch an attack and test the power of this Domain.
After all, with Long Zhenguo present, nothing could go wrong.
But as a result, halfway through the Domain’s release...
Everyone surrendered!
This caught Gu Xing completely off guard.
However, as long as he won this trial!
He waved his hand, signaling the little girl to cancel the Domain.
The Domain was still too strenuous for Liu Li right now.
Successfully using it was already a blessing.
Maintaining it for a long time was extremely burdensome for her!
After canceling the Blazing Angel Form, Liu Li lightly floated back to Gu Xing’s side.
Her big, lively eyes revealed a hint of fatigue.
This battle seemed like she didn’t do anything, but precisely defending against thousands of Guardian Beast attacks consumed a terrifying amount of her Spiritual Power.
"Liu Li, you’ve worked hard!"
Gu Xing gently rubbed the little one’s head, bringing her back into the Beast Taming Space.
There, she could recover at the fastest speed.
Behind Gu Xing, Qin Tian was completely dumbfounded by this moment!
He turned his head stiffly, looking at Ying Bing:
"Sister Bing, did you notice, I feel Brother Xing is like someone from another world now."
Ying Bing, hearing this sentence, also fell into slight contemplation.
She recalled when the three of them participated in the Abyss Level trial together, she could feel...
Although Gu Xing’s strength was superior to hers, she still had a chance to catch up.
But now...
Though her strength has also been continuously improving during this time...
Yet for some reason, the gap between her and Gu Xing...
Seems to be widening!
Gu Qianqian likewise gazed at Gu Xing’s back, slightly lost in thought.
Her younger brother has now completely surpassed her and reached a level she can only look up to.
"Sister!"
Tang Xinrou suddenly approached from beside Gu Qianqian.
"Qianqian sister, please, introduce your brother to me! I’ve already been conquered by him!"
Gu Qianqian wanted to turn around and scold, but found Tang Xinrou’s eyes were filled with earnestness.
The words of refusal were stuck in her throat for a moment.
She knew her friend’s personality well; although she usually seemed very carefree and liked joking.
But when she became serious, it meant she genuinely had that thought.
Gu Qianqian’s gaze swept over Shen Ruoxue and Ying Bing, and suddenly realized that both were discreetly listening for her answer.
Her lips twitched, eyeing her brother.
Up till now, she discovered three girls falling for her brother.
No... even the little angel...
In front of her, appearing so tense, clearly had such thoughts.
Four girls!
Just thinking about it made her feel a headache for Gu Xing.
Coming to her senses and looking at Tang Xinrou waiting for her answer, Gu Qianqian took a deep breath:
"Xinrou, even though you’re my best friend, I won’t intervene in whom Xiao Xing likes. If you truly can end up together with him, I’d still be willing to bless you!"
Receiving Gu Qianqian’s reply, Tang Xinrou breathed a sigh of relief.
At least Gu Qianqian didn’t outright refuse!
However...
Her competitors seemed a bit numerous!
She just noticed...
When Gu Qianqian said, "I won’t intervene in whom Xiao Xing likes," both girls simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
But, who said a girlfriend can only be one?
If she can’t be the main, can she not be a concubine?
At this moment, Gu Xing was wholly unaware that a girl had already set her eyes on him.
His attention was entirely on Long Zhenguo.
Waiting for the headmaster of the National Academy’s answer!
According to Long Zhenguo, he had already demonstrated his value...
As for whether he could enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool...
It wasn’t something he could decide himself!
Though that was the case, he absolutely had to go to the Beast Taming Holy Pool!
The recent battle made him realize that relying solely on Liu Li was still too thin.
If he had already contracted a Natural Spirit as a group attack type Guardian Beast, why would he need such elaborate effort?
Long Zhenguo, sensing the young man’s intense gaze, couldn’t help but chuckle.
Does this kid think he would break his word?
Is this old man so disreputable?
Long Zhenguo shook his head and took a step forward, his imposing voice resonating throughout the venue:
"I approve Gu Xing’s entry into the Beast Taming Holy Pool, who objects?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Fame Across the School, Holy Pool Opens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 60: Chapter 60: Fame Across the School, Holy Pool Opens!
The moment Long Zhenguo’s voice fell, the entire venue plunged into a deathly silence.
The Monarch Level Beastmasters observing this assessment naturally knew...
Long Zhenguo’s words were meant for them!
But at this moment, who would dare to raise objections?
Gu Xing’s performance just now had proven everything.
The young man, with the bearing of an Extraordinary Tier One, had forcibly suppressed over a thousand geniuses of the same level.
More importantly...
Long Zhenguo’s attitude at this moment couldn’t be more obvious.
He intended to support Gu Xing to the end!
The Monarch Level Beastmasters exchanged glances, ultimately choosing silence.
They knew this principal’s temper too well; if they opposed him now, they might be immediately suppressed!
As for the students present, they had already been completely convinced by Gu Xing’s performance.
Fighting a thousand alone!
With the strength of Extraordinary Tier One, he nearly single-handedly challenged half the school.
Who among them had the right to oppose?
Long Zhenguo’s sharp gaze swept across the room; seeing no one dared to speak, he finally restrained his aura.
He turned to Gu Xing, his voice carrying a hint of authority:
"The Beast Taming Holy Pool will open for you tomorrow."
Gu Xing nodded solemnly.
Once he entered the Holy Pool, his dormant second Guardian Beast could fully awaken.
Two Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
His power would undoubtedly undergo a qualitative leap!
Soon after, he turned around.
Directly meeting the complex gaze of Ying Bing and Shen Ruoxue.
The few of them understood, the gap between them and Gu Xing...
Was growing ever wider!
As for the Succubus, the moment Gu Xing’s gaze swept over, she lowered her head in shame, trying hard to minimize her presence.
Recalling her past actions, at this moment she only felt utterly ashamed.
"Brother Xing!"
Qin Tian’s little followers suddenly shouted in unison, bowing ninety degrees uniformly.
Qin Tian, the instigator, looked at Gu Xing with anticipation, hoping for praise.
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly but finally nodded helplessly.
After all, it was Qin Tian’s heartfelt gesture.
He finally locked his gaze on that familiar figure across the crowd.
Gu Qianqian stood not far away, a proud smile on her face.
This was her brother!
At the same time, the news of Gu Xing single-handedly challenging the entire school swept through the academy like a hurricane:
"Have you heard? A new student took on the whole school single-handedly!"
"One person challenging the entire school? Are you joking?"
"It’s no joke! That new student even got the qualifications to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool."
"Damn! I remember some of the top-tier geniuses at our school have tried multiple times to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool and haven’t been approved!"
"The newcomers these days are terrifying..."
...
Soon, it was the next day.
On his way to the agreed location with Long Zhenguo, Gu Xing’s mind kept echoing with yesterday’s conversation with his sister...
"Xiao Xing, what do you think of the few girls around you?"
Suddenly asked this question by his sister, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
What did he think?
Could he just use his eyes to look?
But seeing his sister’s serious eyes.
He braced himself to answer:
"Sis, right now, I only think about growing stronger, as for romance, I haven’t considered it yet."
Gu Qianqian nodded seeing this.
She liked Ying Bing and Shen Ruoxue, those two.
As for her best friend Tang Xinrou...
She’s carefree! Being hurt doesn’t matter.
As for the other two girls, if Gu Xing chooses any one of them, the remaining one would probably be deeply hurt.
Right now, Gu Xing not making a choice...
Seems to be the best outcome!
"Sigh!"
Gu Xing shook his head, shaking the messy thoughts out of his mind.
He simply didn’t have time for these things now!
Awakening the Natural Spirit was what mattered most to him now!
As for the rest...
They all had to take a back seat!
However.
Inside the Beast Taming Space.
Liu Li stared at the green cocoon suspended above the Spring of Life, grinding her teeth!
Seeing the increasing number of females surrounding her master, she had bought quite a few romance novels from the human world to read yesterday.
Now, she understood a term.
Green Tea!
This Natural Spirit.
Was green!
She was Green Tea!
The definition of a Green Tea is someone very charming.
This Natural Spirit had captured her master’s attention without even awakening.
Perfectly fitting!
"Damn Green Tea Spirit!"
Liu Li angrily tore off a few leaves from the Tree of Life, but as soon as they left the branch, they turned into green spots of light and returned to the tree.
The poor Tree of Life couldn’t speak, but its slightly trembling branches clearly expressed its helplessness.
Outside.
Gu Xing had already arrived at the designated location.
He stood before the ancient teleportation array, the complex runes beneath his feet glowing a faint blue.
This was one of the entrances to the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
The Beast Taming Holy Pool wasn’t in this world, nor in Alternate Space...
But in the seam between this world and Alternate Space.
It could only be reached through the teleportation array.
Three Beast Taming Holy Pools had been discovered by humans.
Thus, they were divided among Longxia Country, the Holy See, and the Council’s three forces.
For Monarch Level powerhouses, this was almost the only way to upgrade their level...
After all, at this realm, trying to level up by hunting the Demon Race had become extremely difficult.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Yet, the energy produced by the Holy Pool each year was extremely limited, even Monarch Level powerhouses would fight fiercely over it.
For this reason, those Beastmasters from noble families were so resistant to a newcomer at the Extraordinary Stage getting the qualification to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
As Gu Xing was lost in thought, steady footsteps approached from afar.
Long Zhenguo came with his hands behind his back, his robe fluttering slightly in the morning breeze.
"You should already know the basic information about the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
Gu Xing nodded; he had specifically researched the information last night.
"Good. Since you know the function of the Beast Taming Holy Pool, you must understand its importance. Be sure to cherish this opportunity." He said, tossing an ancient Bronze Token at him.
Gu Xing quickly caught it. It was heavy in his hand, engraved with intricate dragon patterns.
"If you encounter other Monarch Levels in the Holy Pool, show them this Token, or they might kick you out."
After saying this, Long Zhenguo waved his robe, and a water-blue spatial gate slowly opened before them.
"Go now!"
Gu Xing took a deep breath and bowed deeply to Long Zhenguo.
He held sincere respect for this elder.
If it weren’t for him shouldering all the pressure and forcibly giving him a qualification to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool, he would not be able to awaken the Natural Spirit at the Extraordinary Level.
As for Long Zhenguo’s words about making the most of this opportunity...
The Holy Pool not only could improve the level of Monarch Level Beastmasters, but the huge energy it contained also had a certain probability...
To enhance Talent!
When he stood up, determination filled Gu Xing’s eyes.
He turned and stepped into the light curtain, his figure instantly swallowed by the dazzling rays of light...

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Reunion with Wei Yuan! The Myth Returns!
chapters.content:
Chapter 61: Chapter 61: Reunion with Wei Yuan! The Myth Returns!
When the blinding light dissipated, Gu Xing found himself standing on a cloud platform suffused with prismatic glow.
Beneath his feet was a translucent crystal floor, faintly visible was the slowly flowing liquid energy below.
This was the water of the Holy Pool, condensed from the purest Heaven and Earth Spiritual Power!
"Is this... the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
Gu Xing gazed at the scene before him in shock.
The entire space seemed like a fairyland, with a massive pool radiating golden splendor.
"A new Monarch Level? No, wait! That Spiritual Power intensity... Extraordinary Level?!"
"Since when could Extraordinary Level enter the Holy Pool? Throw him out!"
Several Monarch Level experts noticed Gu Xing’s presence and began to discuss animatedly.
One of the elders in a red robe even raised his hand intending to expel Gu Xing from the Holy Pool space.
Just as the elder’s Spiritual Power was about to touch Gu Xing...
"Stop!"
A commanding voice rang out like thunder.
The water’s surface in the center of the Holy Pool suddenly surged violently, and a towering figure appeared instantly beside Gu Xing, the gust of wind even dispersing the elder’s Spiritual Power waves.
Gu Xing turned his head, his pupils contracting suddenly:
"Commander Wei?!"
Standing before him was none other than the highest commander of the Southern Military Region...
Wei Yuan!
Yet Wei Yuan appeared somewhat puzzled at this moment.
Wasn’t Gu Xing’s level Extraordinary?
Why was he here?
Gu Xing immediately got the hint and succinctly explained the assessment set by Long Zhenguo.
When Wei Yuan heard "single-handedly subduing over a thousand of the same level," his unwavering face showed a rare trace of astonishment.
Although he already knew about Gu Xing’s impressive strength and talent, he did not expect Gu Xing to reach such an extent!
Gu Xing passing the Abyssal-level trials was indeed a great help to him.
Furthermore, he learned that Gu Xing hadn’t been specially recruited into a university.
Therefore, he personally wrote a recommendation letter and sent it to various university admissions offices.
His intention was to help Gu Xing gain some benefits.
But he didn’t expect...
Gu Xing not only gained significant benefits but also qualified to enter the Holy Pool.
"Commander Wei, thank you for the recommendation letter you wrote at that time!"
Gu Xing also understood that without Wei Yuan’s recommendation, it would have been impossible for Long Zhenguo to personally recruit him.
And he even agreed to such an outrageous condition.
However, Wei Yuan shook his head, wearing an expression of appreciation:
"If your talent didn’t reach such heights, you wouldn’t have been able to gain these benefits. This is all the result of your own effort!"
"But the people here are not friendly, you better stay by my side!"
Gu Xing nodded.
He had indeed felt just now that the Monarch Level Beast Masters here were rather hostile.
Without much provocation, they wanted to expel him from the Holy Pool.
Being by Wei Yuan’s side was naturally much safer.
"Where did this connected insider come from? An Extraordinary Level in the Holy Pool is one thing, but Wei Yuan even offers personal protection."
"But an Extraordinary Level in the Holy Pool is useless! Could he really absorb the energy here?"
"Indeed, he might just willingly leave soon enough!"
Several mocking voices came from the edge of the Holy Pool.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Wei Yuan’s gaze suddenly turned icy, his sharp look sweeping across like a blade...
Instantly, those people fell silent.
If Long Zhenguo was acknowledged as the top power in Longxia Country,
then Wei Yuan and the other three military district leaders were second only to him.
These newly promoted Monarch Level Beast Masters did not even have the right to breathe loudly in front of Wei Yuan.
"Scram."
With just one simple word, those disrespectful Monarch Levels turned and left hastily, not daring to look back.
However, what those Monarch Levels said was not without reason.
"The energy of the Holy Pool becomes more violent towards the center, with your current strength..."
At this point, Wei Yuan chose his words carefully:
"It’s best to only let your Guardian Beast operate in the outer edges."
This was already a very conservative remark.
The Beast Taming Holy Pool was restricted to Monarch Level entries not only for their strategic value but also because the energy of the pool required at least Commander Level to withstand.
Even in the outer edges...
An Extraordinary Level Beast Master could suffer severe injuries from reckless contact!
The reason Wei Yuan offered such advice was entirely considering Gu Xing’s Legendary Level Guardian Beast.
With a Legendary Level constitution, it might withstand the edge for a while.
Though the Guardian Beast could enter, the Beast Master himself...
Without awakening the Domain, don’t even think about touching it!
Gu Xing knew that Wei Yuan’s words were for his good, so he solemnly nodded.
Then, Gu Xing slowly approached the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
As he got closer, Gu Xing discovered the pool’s liquid was actually gaseous, appearing liquid only due to its high concentration.
However, perhaps it was precisely because of this that it could successfully awaken the Natural Spirit.
Taking a deep breath, Gu Xing summoned the Natural Spirit, placing it in the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
The mint-green Light Cocoon elicited a dazzling light instantaneously upon touching the Spiritual Qi.
The Spiritual Qi in the pool, as if summoned, fervently converged on the Light Cocoon, forming a small whirlpool of Spiritual Qi in the blink of an eye.
Monarch Level Beast Masters observing this scene gasped in surprise:
"What’s going on with this Guardian Beast? Isn’t it Extraordinary Level? How is it absorbing the Holy Pool energy so fiercely?"
"Something’s not right, even with Legendary-grade Talent, it shouldn’t withstand such energy impact at Extraordinary Level?"
An Extraordinary Level Guardian Beast, completely unfazed by the Holy Pool’s ferocity?
What grade of Talent could this Guardian Beast possibly have?
Wei Yuan’s eyes gleamed brightly, his Spiritual Power rapidly scanning the Natural Spirit.
The next second, this war-weathered general was struck like thunder, frozen where he stood.
Mythical... Mythical Level?!
Dazed for a moment, Wei Yuan immediately sprung into action, summoning a light blue Barrier which swiftly enveloped Gu Xing.
The first Mythical Level Guardian Beast in human history...
This discovery made his breathing even more labored.
No wonder Long Zhenguo permitted Gu Xing to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!
It was because of this Mythical Level Guardian Beast!
At this moment, all his attention was captured by the Natural Spirit, this was truly humanity’s treasure!
However, Gu Xing at the Holy Pool’s edge was daringly teetering on the brink of disaster.
At this moment, his full attention was absorbed by the Holy Pool...
The Tree of Life in the Beast Taming Space was swaying frenetically, every leaf transmitting the same message:
Go in! Quickly go in!
This intense prompting left Gu Xing somewhat perplexed.
Wasn’t it said that Extraordinary Level shouldn’t touch the Holy Pool?
Yet, as if guided by an unseen force, he slowly extended his finger, gently touching the pool water...
To his surprise, the expected pain didn’t come.
What he felt at his fingertips was an indescribable sensation of pleasure, as if countless pores were simultaneously infused with sweet spring water.
Even more incredible was that the once-violent Spiritual Qi flowed endlessly through his meridians into the Beast Taming Space, as if homing swallows returning to their nest.
"This is..."
In his inner mind, Gu Xing saw the Tree of Life greedily devouring the influx of Spiritual Qi, each leaf exuding an emerald glow.
What surprised him even more was that in the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li was transmitting a strong yearning.
Gu Xing swallowed hard, glancing surreptitiously at the still-startled Wei Yuan.
Since even Principal Long broke the rules for me to enter, then...
Absorbing a bit more shouldn’t be an issue, right?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 62: Natural Spirit! Mere Angel!
chapters.content:
Chapter 62: Chapter 62: Natural Spirit! Mere Angel!
After confirming that Wei Yuan hadn’t noticed his actions, he steeled himself.
"Splash!"
Hearing the sound, Wei Yuan turned his head, only to find...
Gu Xing’s figure had already vanished from the shore.
???
Where is he?
Looking at the bubbling Holy Pool, Wei Yuan instantly realized something.
"You reckless kid!"
He blinked to the edge, only to see bubbles rising from the water’s surface.
However.
Instead of feeling any pain, Gu Xing submerged at the pool’s bottom felt...
Sensation so ecstatic that he trembled all over!
Pure spiritual power surged into his veins like tides, nourishing his physical body while continuously pouring into the Beast Taming Space.
At the same time, he felt Liu Li’s strong desire.
Gu Xing immediately summoned the little girl!
As soon as Liu Li emerged from the Beast Taming Space, her gaze locked onto the Natural Spirit.
The little girl saw it absorbing the pool’s energy extensively and instantly widened her eyes.
"Can’t let that green tea spirit outdo me!"
The Six Wings state instantly unfolded!
In a flash, two spiritual qi whirlwinds roared into form at the pool’s bottom.
Besides.
The Tree of Life and the Spring of Life within the Beast Taming Space were not to be outdone.
The third whirlwind soon appeared!
And upon seeing this, the indifference on Wei Yuan’s face became uncontrollable.
Three spiritual qi whirlwinds appeared simultaneously!
What’s more shocking was...
It seemed Gu Xing had more than one Myth Level Guardian Beast!
He had two!!!
No Myth Level Guardian Beast had ever appeared in human history, yet Gu Xing controlled two.
Wei Yuan’s eyes showed a trace of envy.
Myth Level Guardian Beast...
He wanted one too!
But as he reluctantly withdrew his gaze from the two Myth Guardian Beasts and turned his attention to Gu Xing, the envy instantly turned into shock.
Gu Xing’s energy absorption speed was in no way inferior to the two Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
Seeing this, Wei Yuan’s pupils suddenly shrank.
How is it possible?!
The two Myth Guardian Beasts could absorb the Holy Pool’s energy due to their extraordinary talent.
But a mere human like Gu Xing...
How was he absorbing the Holy Pool’s energy without getting hurt?!
Outside the barrier.
The Holy Pool’s energy suddenly began to fluctuate violently.
"What’s happening? The Holy Pool’s energy is madly flowing towards the barrier!"
The surrounding spiritual power density was decreasing at a visible speed, awakening several Monarch Level Beast Masters who were cultivating.
"Isn’t Wei Yuan inside the barrier? Could it be that he’s breaking through again?"
"Impossible! Even Lord Wei Yuan couldn’t absorb energy at such a speed!"
"Could it be... that extraordinary-level brat?"
"Are you crazy? An extraordinary-level absorbing the Holy Pool’s energy? You dare to say such things?"
Though dissatisfied, they dared not trouble Wei Yuan.
After silently grumbling, everyone quietly distanced themselves from here.
Meanwhile.
Gu Xing’s spirit was completely immersed in his Beast Taming Space.
The Spring of Life that was less than a meter now expanded to several meters, with incredible life force contained within the spring water.
The once one-person-high Tree of Life was now lush, with the trunk thickened multiple times, and each leaf shimmering with emerald-like glimmers.
Gradually, their absorption speed began to slow.
They seemed to perceive the limits of Gu Xing’s body’s endurance, spontaneously ceasing energy plunder.
If absorption continued, it would burden Gu Xing’s body tremendously.
Yet even so...
When seeing the energy Gu Xing was absorbing, Wei Yuan was still startled.
He needed to know that the energy Gu Xing had just devoured was enough to help a Monarch Level Beast Master advance 2-3 tiers.
Though it didn’t sound like much, those were Monarch Level tiers.
And what level was Gu Xing now?
Extraordinary Level!
And after consuming so much energy, Gu Xing’s level had not increased.
Strange!
At this time, the Natural Spirit’s energy absorption also reached its conclusion.
A crisp "click" sound suddenly came from the green cocoon.
Gu Xing’s heart trembled.
The next moment, cobweb-like cracks appeared on the cocoon’s shell!
Additionally, he clearly sensed the awareness waves emanating from inside the cocoon.
The second Myth Level Guardian Beast...
Awakened!
Finally, under Gu Xing’s expectant gaze, the green cocoon exploded!
In the sky full of light petals, a delicate figure slowly emerged.
Golden long hair cascading like a waterfall, alabaster skin gleamed under the Holy Pool’s glow.
Most amazing was that flawless little face!
Elves are indeed darlings of the gods!
However...
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
No matter how you looked at it, she was just a seven or eight-year-old little girl!
"Master~"
The little elf suddenly opened her eyes, emerald pupils reflecting Gu Xing’s figure.
Before he could react, a soft little body had already cuddled into his arms.
The sweet call paired with those wet large eyes directly hit Gu Xing’s heart.
Adorable!
"Hug~"
Gu Xing instinctively caught this willful little creature, not noticing the fleeting cunning in her eyes.
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth One Star → Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier One]
[Power: 30]
[Constitution: 35]The most update n0vels are published on N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
[Spirit: 102]
[Speed: 42]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain (Beginner)]
[Natural Lament: Unlocks a triple chained catastrophe using this skill: Bone-Eroding Vine Sea, Azure Sky Thunderfall, Earth Vein Suction]
[Elf Monarchy: Upon use, triples Spirit Attribute and automatically refreshes Natural Lament skill]
[Natural Domain (Beginner): All skills gain Overload mode upon domain activation]
[Evolution: Heart of Nature, Spring of Life, Earth Marrow]
Seeing Vera’s attribute panel, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
The Spiritual Attribute surprisingly showed an astonishing "100"!
Terrifying!
Indeed worthy of Myth level talent!
"This..."
He swallowed hard.
One must know when Liu Li awakened initially, her average attribute was only 30 points.
And Vera’s Spiritual Attribute was three times Liu Li’s!
Even more shocking was that after absorbing vast amounts of Holy Pool energy, Vera’s talent advanced from Myth One Star to Myth Two Stars.
His gaze slipped downward, and the skills tab made Gu Xing gasp:
Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain!
Each claimed as terrifying mass attack skills suitable for battlefield sweeping!
Powerful Spiritual Attribute, combined with titanic skills.
Battlefield grinder!
The term instantly emerged in Gu Xing’s mind!
Should it be coupled with defense-ignoring slaughter...
This little girl alone could dominate a battlefield!
Gu Xing looked down at the innocent and pure Vera in his arms.
Who could have imagined...
This little girl’s body harbored world-ending power.
Yet...
Currently, the little girl’s level is still quite low.
To truly wield these skills’ might, she must quickly attain Extraordinary Level.
Gu Xing suddenly remembered the Secret Realm at the National Academy, designed for cultivating the second Guardian Beast...
Might be worth checking out then!
"Mmm..."
Vera gently rubbed against Gu Xing’s chest in his embrace.
The green eyes fixed intently on Liu Li nearby.
Master is mine!!
Mere angel...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 63: Myth Three Stars! Liu Li’s Advancement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 63: Chapter 63: Myth Three Stars! Liu Li’s Advancement!
Under Gu Xing’s gaze, Liu Li’s talent boost also reached its conclusion.
The crimson golden Holy Flame gradually retracted, with the Divine Pattern on her six wings flowing like a living creature.
As the last trace of energy perfectly merged into her body, Liu Li slowly opened her pair of dazzling golden eyes.
However.
The first scene that came into view made her pupils constrict sharply.
In Gu Xing’s arms, a guardian beast was proudly sticking its tongue out at her!
More annoyingly, it even intentionally snuggled in Gu Xing’s arms, showing a contented expression.
"This... green tea spirit"
Liu Li’s mouth twitched uncontrollably.
She clenched her fists tightly but could do nothing about this cunning elf.
Her disguise... was too good!
This elf had been sleeping from thousands of years ago until now. Her actual age...
Was over a thousand years.
Yet she still intentionally turned into a child’s appearance.
Seeing Vera flaunting in her master’s arms, Liu Li felt the joy of her talent breakthrough instantly vanished.
She just woke up a little late, and unexpectedly...
Her home was stolen!
At this time, Gu Xing’s attention was entirely on Liu Li’s attribute panel, completely unaware of the little antics happening between his beasts.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Power: 1220]
[Constitution: 1210]
[Spirit: 1200]
[Speed: 1230]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain (Basic)]
[Evolution: Angel Divine Blood, Light Divine Crystal, Ultimate Fire]
Gu Xing carefully examined the attribute panel, a hint of satisfaction flashed in his eyes.
The talent upgrade not only boosted Liu Li by two stars but also skyrocketed all basic attributes by 200 points.
With the enhancement of the Blazing Angel Form, the actual increase reached an astonishing 400 points!
"The attributes of Extraordinary Tier One have already surpassed Miller of Extraordinary Tier Three at that time..." Gu Xing muttered to himself.
But thinking of Miller’s father....
A War Angel at the Monarch Peak!
His brow slightly furrowed again.
With the current strength, attempting to break into the Angel Race’s stronghold to save someone is no different from striking a stone with an egg.
"Master..."
Liu Li gently tugged his sleeve, her voice tinged with grievance.
Gu Xing, immersed in his own planning at the moment, didn’t notice the little girl’s low spirits, merely rubbed her hair habitually.
"Right, Liu Li," Gu Xing suddenly remembered something, lifting the Natural Spirit in his arms.
"This is Vera, she will be our new companion from now on!"
Vera, lifted in front of Liu Li, immediately flashed a pure smile, her large eyes blinking adorably as she greeted:
"Hello, Sister Liu Li~"
While saying this, Vera cheekily blinked her big eyes.
Liu Li’s mouth twitched slightly.
But under Gu Xing’s expectant gaze, she could only force a smile:
"Hello, Green... Vera."
The last word was almost squeezed out through her teeth.
Just you wait, little green tea spirit!
Gu Xing watched the two in front of him "getting along harmoniously," nodding in satisfaction.
As expected, rumors aren’t to be fully trusted.Thᴇ link to the origɪn of this information rᴇsts ɪn
Though he had heard that multiple guardian beasts might fight for favor, in this case...
No such thing at all!
His two guardian beasts got along beautifully!
Wei Yuan finally snapped out of his shock, his gaze sweeping complexly over the two Myth-level guardian beasts beside Gu Xing.
An eight-winged Blazing Angel, a millennial Natural Spirit, and this monstrous master...
He had no doubt that in time, Gu Xing’s achievements would surely surpass his own!
Following that, with Wei Yuan’s help, he teleported back to the National Academy.
Upon returning to the academy, he discovered that Long Zhenguo had already left ahead.
"It’s still early..."
Gu Xing glanced at the sky, his gaze falling on Vera in the Beast Taming Space.
The grade of Awakened Tier One was indeed too low, incapable of unleashing the true prowess of a Natural Spirit.
"Time to level her up!"
...
In front of the Awakening Secret Realm at National Guardian Academy, people were bustling around, with new students lining up to enter.
This special secret realm dedicated to cultivating the second guardian beast was currently bustling with activity.
When Gu Xing appeared with Liu Li, the entire square fell silent for a moment, then erupted into waves of discussion.
"Look! It’s that Gu Xing who single-handedly took on half the academy! The guy who single-handedly took on half the school!"
"He’s entering the Awakening Secret Realm... could it be that he has contracted a second guardian beast?"
"Could it be something as monstrous as an angel again?"
"How possible is that?! You think guardian beasts as strong as an angel are common?"
Under everyone’s gaze, Gu Xing walked straight toward Ying Bing and her group.
"Brother Xing!"
Qin Tian was the first to spot him, waving excitedly.
Ying Bing also nodded slightly, but inadvertently, when she and Gu Xing made eye contact, her heart suddenly skipped a beat.
She couldn’t contract a second guardian beast, nor did she have a second guardian beast that needed cultivating.
She didn’t even know why she came here!
Fortunately, at this moment, Qin Tian suddenly spoke, drawing everyone’s attention.
"Brother Xing, have you contracted your second guardian beast yet?"
The question immediately piqued everyone’s interest, even Ying Bing couldn’t help but look back at Gu Xing.
After all, the strength of Gu Xing’s first guardian beast was evident to all.
Everyone was quite curious about what Gu Xing’s contracted second guardian beast was.
Gu Xing gave a faint smile, raising his hand to summon the Natural Spirit Vera.
The little one bowed slightly, "Hello everyone, I am Vera!"
Seeing such an adorable little creature, everyone immediately took a liking to her.
Yet, at this moment, an abrasive voice came from the side:
"Guardian beasts are for fighting, what’s the use of just being cute?"
Upon hearing this, Qin Tian immediately turned his head in anger.
He saw Wang Teng standing with arms crossed, beside him was a Dragon Lizard engulfed in blazing flames.
Qin Tian frowned upon seeing this guardian beast, then turned to explain in Gu Xing’s ear:
"Brother Xing, be careful, this guardian beast is no simple creature. I heard that his family spent a lot to obtain this Dragon Lizard, supposedly having dragon bloodline..."
Dragon bloodline?
Gu Xing raised his eyebrow, intrigued.
[Molten Dragon Lizard]
[Talent: Legendary Seven Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier One]
[Power: 35]
[Constitution: 31]
[Spirit: 28]
[Speed: 34]
[Skills: Dragon Flame Breath, Scale Armor Defense...]
Gu Xing quickly scanned the attribute panel, his mouth twitching slightly.
An average of around 30 points in attributes; this is the so-called "dragon bloodline"?
Even compared to the former Liu Li, it’s far behind!
At this moment, Wang Teng raised his chin, his face full of smugness.
He firmly remembered his father’s bold claim:
"With this Dragon Lizard contracted, my son Wang Teng is destined for greatness!"
Yesterday he just reached the extraordinary level and hadn’t had the chance to contract this guardian beast yet.
It was merely an Epic level guardian beast at the time...
That’s why he made a fool of himself at the opening ceremony.
But now...
It’s time to wash away the shame!
Wang Teng clenched his fists tightly.
Although he didn’t dare say his Dragon Lizard could rival that monster angel, defeating this cute little elf in front of him...
He looked dismissively at Vera, who was blinking her innocent big eyes.
Wang Teng’s lips curled into a cold smile.
"This time, I will surely win!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 64: What?! Entering the Secret Realm?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 64: Chapter 64: What?! Entering the Secret Realm?!
Looking at the triumphant Wang Teng, Gu Xing found it hard to contain himself.
If he couldn’t see the attributes of the guardian beast clearly, he would have been fooled by him.
Dragon lineage?
Gu Xing secretly shook his head.
If it were a pure-blooded Dragon Race, it would be worth taking seriously, but this lizard barely qualifies...
Let’s just forget it!
However, Wang Teng was already completely absorbed in the praise of the surrounding students:
"If I remember correctly, the one beside Wang Teng is the Molten Dragon Lizard with Legendary level talent!"
"I’ve heard the Wang Family had to use almost all its connections to get this guardian beast!"
"With such a powerful guardian beast, it seems Wang Teng intends to break the record in this Awakening Secret Realm and win the principal’s reward!"
Gu Xing, hearing this discussion, felt somewhat surprised.
What record? What reward?
As a freshman, he was not very familiar with many of the rules at the National Guardian Academy.
"Look over there, Star Brother." Qin Tian timely pointed to the entrance of the secret realm, "The record stele over there has the best results from all previous editions."
Gu Xing followed Qin Tian’s finger and looked over, only to see an ancient stone stele engraved with gilded characters:
[First Place: Qin Chuxue, 9 hours 15 minutes]
[Second Place: Ying Chuan, 28 hours 17 minutes]
[Third Place: Wang Kai, 28 hours 25 minutes]
...
[Tenth Place: Zhang Jian, 30 hours 7 minutes]
Seeing this ranking list, Gu Xing furrowed his brows slightly.
The gap between first and second place...
Why is it so big?
The difference between third and tenth place is only two hours.
But between first and second place...
There is a difference of a full 19 hours!
Gu Xing instinctively turned to look at Qin Tian.
"Star Brother, this list records the time it takes a guardian beast to break through from Awakened Tier One to Tier Nine."
"That person at the top was a genius specially recruited by Principal Long five years ago, just like you."
Upon hearing about the special recruitment, Gu Xing remembered!
Long Zhenguo had specially recruited students twice in total.
Once was him.
And the other time was this Qin Chuxue.
"Because Senior Qin’s record was too extraordinary, the academy declared a long time ago that her result should not be taken as a reference."
"Principal Long once promised personally that anyone who could exceed the second place could select a treasure from the National Treasure Vault!"
Speaking this, Qin Tian glanced at Wang Teng and lowered his voice to continue:
"Wang Teng’s possession of this guardian beast is likely because the Wang Family has their eyes on certain treasures in the National Academy Vault, hence such a significant investment."
Hearing the words National Treasure Vault, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted slightly.
He clearly remembered the last time Liu Li evolved, the "Holy Marrow Spirit Liquid" came from there.
And as long as he broke the record, he could go in and select a type of material...
Gu Xing thought of his two guardian beasts.
Currently, both guardian beasts’ talents have reached Myth level!
Still...
Who wouldn’t want their guardian beast to become stronger?
Entering the National Treasure Vault, if he could encounter the evolutionary materials for both guardian beasts...
He must go in!
Gu Xing immediately made up his mind.
If he missed this chance, it would be unknown when he could qualify to enter the National Treasure Vault again.
Moreover....
His gaze unconsciously fell on the dazzling name at the top of the list.
Qin Chuxue!
Like him, both were geniuses specially recruited by Principal Long to be dominant in an era.
Gu Xing’s lips slightly curved, and the long-lost desire for victory and defeat suddenly burned fiercely in his chest.
He really wanted to know, compared to this legendary senior sister...
Who is stronger!
Wang Teng noticed Gu Xing completely ignoring him, and his fury instantly ignited.
He was about to explode when he suddenly sensed the fear emanating from the Molten Dragon Lizard through the contract.
"What’s going on?"
He turned his head in astonishment, only to see his guardian beast lying weakly on the ground, its scales trembling continuously, not displaying a hint of the majesty of a Legendary guardian beast.
Could it be...
Wang Teng suddenly looked at Gu Xing.
Did that terrifying angel appear again?
But then he thought, the Awakening Secret Realm prohibited Extraordinary level guardian beasts from entering!
Even if that angel’s strength was exceptional, it couldn’t determine the outcome of this secret realm!
The first place this time is definitely his!Thɪs NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
Yet seeing his lizard trembling, he wisely decided to leave with his guardian beast quietly.
Ying Bing looked at Vera in bewilderment; her spiritual power was quite strong.
She could sense the source of the aura just now was this cute little girl.
To make a Dragon Lizard with Legendary level talent feel fear means...
This guardian beast’s level may be equivalent to Liu Li...
Both are Myth level?!
Gu Xing slightly turned his head, his gaze falling on Vera, who was feigning innocence by his side.
She was the one who just scared that lizard.
When this little girl saw Gu Xing looking over, she immediately stuck out her tongue.
"Master, I just couldn’t stand his arrogance, sorry~"
Gu Xing chuckled, gently ruffling her blonde hair with his slender fingers.
For such a small matter, he naturally wouldn’t blame his guardian beast.
After all, she was doing it for his own good!
"It’s fine!"
Seeing her master not get angry, Vera immediately took advantage and opened her arms, speaking sweetly:
"Master, hug~"
This endearing and playful look was like a little daughter asking for candy.
Making Gu Xing’s heart soften, he instinctively hugged her.
However.
In the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li stomped his foot in anger witnessing the entire scene:
"This little conniving green tea spirit!"
He glared at Vera, who was outside acting spoiled, his golden pupils almost spewing fire.
Feigning innocence, deceiving the master’s feelings!!
Hateful!!
The more he thought, the angrier he got. His gaze fell on the trembling Tree of Life.
And at that moment.
"The time has come!"
An instructor dressed in a green robe stood in mid-air, waving his sleeve to make the barrier at the entrance of the secret realm ripple like water.
Numerous mysterious runes swirled in the void, ultimately condensing into a radiant light gate.
"The Awakening Secret Realm is officially open! All students enter in order!"
...
In the principal’s office, Long Zhenguo was frowning at Gu Xing’s profile file.
Gu Xing’s background was unfortunate.
This meant the academy had to take responsibility for Gu Xing’s second guardian beast.
"What guardian beast should he be paired with..." Long Zhenguo muttered, stroking his beard.
His gaze swept back and forth over the list of the academy’s remaining Legendary level guardian beasts but was never satisfied.
The first beast was already Myth level, so the second must be Legendary level at the very least!
Just as he pondered, the office door was suddenly pushed open forcefully.
"Principal! Something big has happened!"
Fu Yanjie rushed in, panting heavily.
Long Zhenguo frowned displeased: "Director Fu, what kind of conduct is it to panic!"
"Gu Xing... Gu Xing entered the Awakening Secret Realm!"
Upon hearing this news, Long Zhenguo initially didn’t care much.
Isn’t it simply entering a secret realm?
But the next moment, Long Zhenguo suddenly stood up, his wooden chair sliding half a meter back with him.
"What?! He entered the secret realm!"
Entering the Awakening Secret Realm meant what?
It meant Gu Xing had already contracted his second guardian beast!
But he was completely unaware!
If the talent of the second guardian beast was too poor...
Long Zhenguo’s heart dropped!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 65: Secret Realm Mutation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 65: Chapter 65: Secret Realm Mutation!
As Gu Xing stepped into the secret realm, the sight before him made his breath catch.
This was scorched earth soaked in blood.
The black and red land was cracked with countless sinister fissures, bones half-buried in the dust, and the air was filled with an indelible stench of blood.
What kind of secret realm was this?
It was clearly a brutal battlefield!
Gu Xing recalled the information about this secret realm...
This was once a spatial rift connecting to the Otherworld.
Seventy years ago, the Demon Race army flooded in like a tide, attempting to use this as a springboard to invade the present world.
That battle lasted a full three months, and in the end, Longxia Country thwarted the disaster at the cost of a million soldiers’ lives.
Because so many members of the Demon Race fell in this area, new demons continually emerged due to the accumulated Demonic Qi.
To prevent these demons from growing and ultimately breaking the seal from within.
Thus, Long Zhenguo ordered that this passage be used as an Awakening Secret Realm for students to train their second Guardian Beast.
It not only cultivates students at the National Academy but also provides an opportunity to eradicate the demons produced in the secret realm.
Killing two birds with one stone!
"Roar—"
Suddenly, a piercing roar shattered the secret realm’s silence.
Gu Xing’s eyes narrowed, and he saw ten decaying-skinned demonic creatures surrounding him from all directions.

[Level: Awakening Tier Five]
[Talent: Demon Captain]
[Power: 60]
[Constitution: 51]
[Spirit: 21]
[Speed: 45]

These low-tier demons, infamous for their cruelty, love skinning their prey alive, thus earning the name Skinning Demon!
Although these are the most numerous bottom-tier demon race...
Why did ten suddenly appear at once?
Gu Xing’s brow furrowed slightly.
Not everyone’s Guardian Beast is as abnormal as his.
When Vera was at Awakened Tier One, her Spiritual Attribute had already surpassed 100.
But other students...
Even the Legendary Level Molten Dragon Lizard.
Their attributes are only around 30 points or so.
Facing ten Awakening Tier Five demons right from the start, unless the Beast Master possesses exceptionally strong talent...
They would likely encounter danger immediately!
Just as the group of Skinning Demons was about to pounce, Vera, nestled in Gu Xing’s arms, frowned in displeasure...
These ugly creatures dared to interrupt her cozy time with her master!
A hint of coldness flashed in her emerald eyes.
The Elf Race was destroyed because of the Demon Race, so Vera naturally harbored no goodwill towards these demons.
Moreover, they were now affecting her bond with her master.
Vera lightly raised her slender fingers, needing not even to use her skills—
Ten thick brambles suddenly broke through the earth, binding the demons into cocoons like living creatures.
This was the innate talent of the Elf Race, and as royalty, Vera’s ability to manipulate plants was unparalleled.
A few crisp cracks later, the brambles visibly turned from green to red.
Within a few breaths, ten withered demonic corpses scattered on the ground like ragged cloth.
And Vera was enveloped in a faint glow of advancement...

Seeing the exaggerated numbers on Vera’s attribute panel, Gu Xing’s eye twitched slightly.
If Liu Li was a hexagonal warrior, then Vera was a completely unbalanced specialist!
With just Awakening Tier Four, her Spiritual Attribute was nearing the 500-point threshold...
This number even surpassed many Extraordinary Level Guardian Beasts!
"Master~"
The little elf tilted her charming face up, her emerald eyes full of anticipation.
Gu Xing understood and reached out to ruffle her golden hair.
From now on, they just needed to have Vera reach Awakened Tier Nine at the fastest speed.
With Vera’s current Spiritual Attribute...
With her skills, she could bulldoze the Awakening Stage demons!
Thus, Gu Xing’s gaze was fixed on the center of the Secret Realm.
With his Spiritual Power perception...
The demon aura was strongest there, naturally the gathering place of the demons.
It was also the best leveling ground!
...
At the entrance to the secret realm, students continued to exit in embarrassment, their faces full of lingering fear.
"It’s crazy! I ran into five Awakening Tier Five demons right after going in!"
"Aren’t there usually just a few scattered around each year? Why does it seem like we’ve stirred up a demon nest this year!"
"My Epic Level Guardian Beast saw the situation and directly retreated...

It was said that a demon uprising in the secret realm back then led to a multiplied increase in their numbers.

Although Qin Tian had reached the Extraordinary Level, the family had yet to find him a suitable second Guardian Beast, so he did not participate in the Awakening Secret Realm this time.
Now, looking at the chaotic scene, a hint of worry appeared on his face.
Even though he had confidence in Gu Xing’s strength, right now Gu Xing could only use a single Awakening Stage Guardian Beast.
No matter how great Gu Xing’s talent was, it was unlikely he could create miracles with just one Awakening Stage Guardian Beast, right?
The mentor in charge of the Awakening Secret Realm’s complexion changed drastically, realizing the seriousness of the situation.
This brought back memories of the demon uprising five years ago—
Had it not been for Qin Chuxue single-handedly pacifying the secret realm back then, the demons would have broken the seal, causing a major disaster.
And now...
"This time there’s no prodigy like Qin Chuxue sitting in guard!"
The mentor dared not delay for even a second, immediately initiating the emergency contact protocol.
At the same moment, in the principal’s office—
Long Zhenguo had just seen Fu Yanjie off when the red alert suddenly sounded.
"What?! Awakening Secret Realm mutation?!"
The communicator in Long Zhenguo’s hand cracked with a "crack" sound.
"Another high-tier demon birth..."
His expression turned ashen.
The truth of the uprising five years ago was all too clear to him...
Back then, the secret realm nurtured a Demon King Level demon. Had Qin Chuxue not intervened, the consequences would have been unimaginable.
The old principal drummed his fingers on the desk, pacing back and forth in the office.
There were only two choices:
First, he could personally make a move to erase the entire secret realm.
But doing so would sever an important path for freshmen to train their second Guardian Beast.
Second, he could send students with Awakened Tier Nine Guardian Beasts into the secret realm to conduct a sweep.
As long as the demons could be eliminated before the situation worsened, he wouldn’t need to destroy the secret realm himself.
In this way, they could both defuse the crisis and preserve the secret realm.

"Attention all faculty and students! The secret realm has shown abnormal fluctuations, please all students with Awakened Tier Nine Guardian Beasts proceed immediately to the secret realm entrance to assemble! Repeating...

chapters.title: Chapter 66: I’m Sorry, Master, It’s All Vera’s Fault!
chapters.content:
Chapter 66: Chapter 66: I’m Sorry, Master, It’s All Vera’s Fault!
With the urgent summons issued, eligible students quickly gathered at the entrance to the Secret Realm.
Gu Qianqian and Tang Xinrou were both present.
Despite her strength, Ying Bing couldn’t participate due to the restriction of her Guardian Beast Level.
Among the crowd, Shen Ruoxue, who had just broken through to the Extraordinary Level, was particularly conspicuous.
Although she hadn’t contracted a second Guardian Beast...
She was specially approved to participate because she had awakened a rare space teleportation talent.
This ability not only allowed her to travel back and forth between the Secret Realm and reality, but most importantly, it provided a means of information delivery!
When the last student arrived, Long Zhenguo appeared before everyone.
Uncharacteristically, Long Zhenguo put away his usual kindness and solemnly said:
"According to monitoring, a Demon King Level demon race may be emerging in the Secret Realm. But due to the constraints of the Secret Realm’s rules, its level will not exceed the Awakening Stage."
"Your mission is to eliminate the demon race as much as possible, with a focus on taking down that Legendary Level demon race."
"But remember—" he swept his gaze across every young face.
"If you encounter danger, immediately retreat! Your safety is above all else."
After all, if they couldn’t kill that Demon King, he could always erase this Secret Realm directly.
But if a student were to die...
That would be an irreparable loss!
"Open the Secret Realm!"
With Long Zhenguo’s command, a spatial rift slowly unfolded.
In the crowd, Tang Xinrou sidled up to Gu Qianqian, swearing confidently.
"Qianqian, you only have a Superior Level Guardian Beast, it’s too dangerous, let me go! I guarantee to bring my husband back safely!"
Gu Qianqian rubbed her temples helplessly.
Honestly, she wasn’t too worried about Gu Xing!
Given the school’s level of attention to Gu Xing, the school definitely wouldn’t contract him with a Guardian Beast of poor talent.
Plus, with Gu Xing’s talent, in a Secret Realm of the Awakening Stage, as long as he doesn’t encounter that Demon King, he should be fine!
"Xinrou, Gu Xing can take care of himself, just make sure you’re safe after you go in!"
"Don’t worry!"
Tang Xinrou patted her chest confidently.
Next, the spatial passage fully opened.
...
Within the Secret Realm.
Gu Xing moved constantly toward the center of the dungeon with Vera.
The demons along the way were increasing rapidly in both numbers and levels!
But to Vera beside Gu Xing, these demons were still quite easy to handle.
There was no need to even use skills.
With her Myth Talent and overwhelming Spiritual Attributes, Vera merely raised her hand slightly...
And numerous blood-colored vines burst from the ground and twisted these demons to death.
Not far away.
A Beast Master witnessed this scene and rubbed his eyes in disbelief.
"My heavens! Did I see that right!"
"A bunch of Awakening Eight, Nine Tier demons, slaughtered in an instant by a single Guardian Beast?"
This Beast Master’s talent was Perception!
And it was precisely because of this talent that he could avoid demon attacks when entering the Secret Realm.
As he approached the center of the Secret Realm, he also ran into a few comrades who had also avoided demon attacks.
At that moment, the teammates hearing his outburst looked on skeptically.
"Stop joking, we can barely handle two or three High Tier demons by collaborating with our talents. How could anyone wipe out a large group at once!"
"Exactly, most students got eliminated as soon as they came in, right? It’s good enough if someone can keep up with our pace as we push forward together!"
"Brother, you should focus on detecting solitary demons and stop looking at those impossible scenarios!"
The teammate patted his shoulder. "Right now, these demons are all moving in groups, how can we level up our Guardian Beasts?"
The Beast Master rubbed his sore eyes.
Indeed, with his level of Spiritual Power and at such a distance, it was likely a hallucination from earlier.
He shook his head, mocking himself:
"It’s true, even a Beast Master at Wang Teng’s level couldn’t instantly wipe out a large group of High Tier demons. I must have been seeing things."
Elsewhere.
Gu Xing slightly frowned, detecting something amiss.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
With his deepening journey, he realized that the energy obtained from killing these demons seemed a little less than initially.
And the closer he got to the center of the Secret Realm, the more pronounced this phenomenon became.
It was as if something was absorbing the Demonic Qi from these demons.
He checked Vera’s level.
Upon first entering the Secret Realm, after killing ten Tier Five demons, her level had reached Awakening Tier Four.
But now...
It’s been half an hour, and he’s slain quite a few High Tier demons, yet Vera had only just reached Awakening Tier Six!
If those Beast Masters from earlier knew Gu Xing’s thoughts, they’d likely want to find a post to bash their heads against.
After all, they risked their lives coordinating to kill demons.
And so far, their levels had only barely reached Awakening Tier Three.
But Gu Xing...
Reached Awakening Tier Six in half an hour, and still not satisfied!
Greedy!
So greedy!
Meanwhile.
Gu Xing was contemplating how to increase the speed of level advancement.
With Vera’s power, she could easily crush all demons within the Secret Realm.
Plus, with her potent area attack skills...
It meant that if he could attract enough demons at once...
Vera’s strength would then be able to annihilate the gathered demons instantly.
"Vera, when the demons gather, release your skills with full force!"
Vera turned her head in confusion.
Though she understood that congregating demons would be much more efficient...
The biggest issue was how to attract them all at once.
However.
In her astonishment.
Gu Xing cut his hand without hesitation, letting the fresh blood drip.
Demons are extremely sensitive to blood.
As long as there’s the scent of blood nearby, they can quickly gather in large numbers.
What’s more, the demons in the Secret Realm are already excessive!
But in the next moment, she widened her eyes in shock.
Gu Xing sliced his palm without hesitation, and the crimson blood droplets fell onto the charred ground.
"Master! You..."
Vera’s pupils contracted violently, then she lowered her head with reddened eyes.
"I’m sorry, Master, it’s all because Vera is useless, making you resort to this..."
Seeing the deeply remorseful little elf, Gu Xing was a bit taken aback.
But soon, he understood.
For a Guardian Beast, allowing their master to get injured is the greatest failure.
Seeing the little girl on the brink of tears.
Gu Xing quickly reassured her:
"It’s just a small wound, nothing much, besides, letting some blood out is actually good for health!"
"R-really?"
Vera looked up with doubt.
Under Gu Xing’s repeated assurances, she reluctantly calmed down.
Then, at Gu Xing’s request, Vera used Wind Magic to disperse the scent of blood.
It spread like a tide over a radius of three kilometers!
Upon catching its scent, all the demons simultaneously halted and turned their crimson eyes in one direction—
"Roar!!!"
Amid the continuous roars, the overwhelming Demon Tide frenziedly surged toward the source of the blood scent.
...
...

Chapter 67: Chapter 67: Wang Teng Is Destined for Imperial Greatness!
However.
This reckless move by Gu Xing brought calamity upon Wang Teng, who had just arrived nearby.
At this moment.
He was curled up within the crevice between rocks, holding his breath, staring intently at the demon race surging like a tide in the distance, his forehead beading with cold sweat.
"Damn it! Which idiot deliberately lured so many demons over here, do they have a death wish?"
He gritted his teeth and cursed under his breath, shrinking further into the crevice, wishing he could embed himself into the stone.
Even though he had contracted the Molten Dragon Lizard with Legendary Level talent, the current number of demon race...
Even an Awakened Tier Nine, let alone an Extraordinary Level, would likely be torn to shreds!
"Damn it! This idiot ruined my leveling plan!"
He cursed again, his voice kept extremely low, fearing he might attract the demon race’s attention.
Since he entered the Secret Realm, he sensed something anomalous—
The demon race were far more numerous than before, almost identical to the mutation five years ago.
Originally, he was secretly excited, thinking he could easily break records this time, but reality dealt him a harsh blow—
The energy gained from slaying the demon race was pathetically little!
"Damn it..."
He glanced at the Dragon Lizard beside him, although it was of Legendary Level talent, it only barely managed to rise to Awakening Tier Four, still one step away from Tier Five.
But, if he could raise the Dragon Lizard’s level by another two tiers, he would be able to completely turn the tables, no longer having to hide like this!
Then, his Dragon Lizard would surely sweep through the entire Secret Realm!
"Boom——"
Suddenly, the ground trembled, as an Awakened Tier Nine demon race appeared with a thunderous presence, the terrifying pressure sweeping outwards.
Wang Teng’s body tensed, instantly holding his breath, shrinking further into the crevice, almost merging with the shadow.
"Let’s lay low first..."
He gritted his teeth and thought darkly, a fierce light flashing in his eyes.
"Once I grow to power..."
"I will have the talent of an emperor!"
...
At this moment.
