If the quality is insufficient, make up for it with quantity!
If one monster lure isn’t enough for Vera to rise to Awakening Tier Nine, then it’s two lures!
The demon race caught the scent of blood, and instantly went berserk, roaring as they lunged at Gu Xing.
The densely packed demonic tide almost blotted out the sky, the ground shook mightily under the trampling of countless demon race.
But Gu Xing stood his ground unmoved.
He slowly raised his head, his gaze falling on Vera beside him.
"Vera! Take action!"
With Gu Xing’s signal, Vera elegantly soared into the air.
Even though Vera was currently only at Awakened Tier Six, as a group attack type Guardian Beast, she’s best at—
Winning with less against more!
Moreover...

chapters.title: Chapter 68: Turning Tail and Fleeing! As If Resolutely Determined!
chapters.content:
Chapter 68: Chapter 68: Turning Tail and Fleeing! As If Resolutely Determined!
Within the Secret Realm.
Gu Xing was preparing to continue forward with Vera.​
Suddenly.
A violent surge of Demonic Qi swept from the center of the Secret Realm.
"Damn human! You’ve slaughtered so many of the demon race!"
Accompanied by a deafening roar, a wolf-shaped demon race entwined with blood-red demon patterns appeared before the two.
His eyes, burning with hellfire, locked deadly onto Gu Xing!
He was Vorn, a legendary level Demon King slain by humans seventy years ago.
Only...
With the help of the blood and Demonic Qi in the Secret Realm, he successfully resurrected five years ago.
Moreover, the unique environment of the Secret Realm allowed him to advance to the Demon God Level!
This corresponds to the Myth Level of the human race!
Five years ago, when Vorn first awakened, he encountered a powerful human.
At that time, he cleverly found a scapegoat to escape unscathed.
And now...
His level had reached Awakened Tier Nine.
In this Secret Realm, he was invincible!
"Human, you’re very unlucky."
Vorn’s claws ignited with dark purple flames.
"You remind me of that woman from five years ago! Prepare to face divine wrath!"
Vorn had no idea that the being he was facing now was even more terrifying than that "freakish human" from five years ago.
Gu Xing looked at this muddleheaded demon race, full of doubt.
Does this demon race have a problem with its brain?
With the power Vera just displayed, he still dared to approach?

Demon God Level!

Killing a Demon God could allow a Beast Master to contract one more Guardian Beast!
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Vorn’s body, his eyes narrowing slightly.
This might be the only opportunity to kill a Demon God!
He was well aware that in the Alternate Space, Demon King Level demons were exceedingly rare, let alone Demon God Level.
Even encountering a Demon King, the level would at least be King Level.
With his current strength, trying to provoke a King Level...
That’s a pipe dream!
"Human race, as long as you’re willing to serve the demon race, I can spare your life!" Vorn continued his bluster.
Meeting a human race face-to-face for the first time, he felt compelled to show this human race the greatest leniency!
However.
He completely failed to notice that Gu Xing’s eyes were growing increasingly dangerous!
If only he could kill this Demon God...
He could contract one more Guardian Beast at the Extraordinary Level!
This thought made Gu Xing’s heartbeat race.
A Beast Master’s strength directly relates to the number of contracted beasts; having one more Guardian Beast isn’t just a simple numerical addition but a qualitative leap....
Several Guardian Beasts working together could enhance strength exponentially.
"Human race, I’m talking to you!"
In his anger, Vorn’s frustration grew as Gu Xing didn’t kneel to beg for mercy.
The last time he awakened, his power hadn’t fully recovered, but now he was an Awakened Tier Nine Demon God...
This human dared to look down on him like this!
Unforgivable!
However, at this moment, Gu Xing had already given an order to Vera.
This Demon God must not be spared!
It must be a one-hit kill!

Three thousand points of terrifying spiritual power surged in the void, yet Gu Xing remained unsatisfied.
"It’s still not enough!"

"Sovereign! Slaughter!"
Blood-red slaughter energy wrapped around Vera’s body, intertwining with emerald divine light.
If not constrained by the awakening level, Gu Xing wished Vera could unleash her domain.
"Natural Lament!"

Vorn’s menacing face suddenly froze.
This oppressive power... how is it possible?!
In terror, he realized that even though they were both Awakened Tier Nine, the oppressive sensation from the other side made his soul tremble.
But wasn’t he supposed to be the strongest Demon God Level?
But the situation before him left him no time to think!
"Demon God’s Body!"
Not daring to hesitate, Vorn immediately activated his strongest skill.
In Gu Xing’s vision, Vorn’s power and speed instantly doubled.
Yet.
The difference was still tremendous compared to the current Vera!
Not to mention, Vera had his talent as support.
Vera slowly raised her slender arm, the seemingly gentle motion twisting the space...
But just as this deadly strike was about to land...
Vorn suddenly turned and fled!
Completely disregarding the dignity and honor of the demon race!
The fleeing motion showed no hesitation!
What’s going on?
Gu Xing was momentarily stunned.
In his understanding, the demon race had always been synonymous with brutality and bloodlust, never retreating even at the risk of death.
Yet this self-proclaimed Demon God actually... fled?
Watching Vorn’s retreating figure without a backward glance, Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch his lips.
This is a Demon God?
However, the Secret Realm was only this big, where could he possibly escape to?
"Vera, pursue!"
This Demon God must die today!
...
Due to Long Zhenguo personally opening the Secret Realm, Gu Qianqian and her group weren’t dispersed and were directly teleported to the central area of the Secret Realm.
Upon landing, everyone immediately formed a defense formation, warily scanning their surroundings.
After all, given the mutations within the Secret Realm, the number of demon races should be extraordinarily large.
However.
It’s too quiet...
After waiting for a long time, they couldn’t even spot a single demon race.
"Strange, where have all the demon races gone? Did they somehow know we are coming?"
"Impossible, even a Legendary Level Demon King couldn’t have such high intelligence."
"I have a feeling... it’s like the demon race here has been cleared out?"
"Impossible! 90% of the new students were sent away, who could clear out the demon hoard?"
They didn’t know that Gu Xing had already massacred all the demon races within a three-kilometer radius.
As everyone speculated, a sound suddenly broke through the air from afar.
"Something’s coming! That speed..."
"Could it be that Legendary Level Demon King? It’s charging toward us!"
"Everyone on alert! Prepare to engage!"
As Vorn approached, everyone commanded their Guardian Beasts to attack this demon race.
Yet.
All the attacks fell on Vorn without leaving a mark.
"The attacks are completely ineffective... Is this really a Demon King?"
Under their terrified gazes, Vorn charged straight toward them.
But unexpectedly, this Demon God dashed directly over their heads without even glancing at them.
"What’s going on? Why didn’t he attack us?"
"I... I feel like he... seems to be fleeing for his life?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 69: Ghost Race Girl
chapters.content:
Chapter 69: Chapter 69: Ghost Race Girl
After some discussion, everyone decided unanimously that Shen Ruoxue should report the situation.
The threat posed by the Demon Race before them had clearly surpassed their ability to handle.
Shen Ruoxue didn’t refuse, and immediately used her Talent Ability to leave the Secret Realm and found Long Zhenguo.
"Principal Long, we’ve discovered a special Demon Race."
"Its appearance resembles a bipedal war wolf, and attacks from Awakened Tier Nine are completely ineffective against it..."
Long Zhenguo initially thought it was a newly risen Demon King, but upon hearing the characteristic "bipedal war wolf", his expression changed drastically.
Vorn?!
The Demon King close to Monarch Peak from seventy years ago had actually resurrected?
More shocking was Shen Ruoxue’s subsequent description...
The full-strength attacks from many Awakened Tier Nine couldn’t leave a single mark.
He immediately realized the gravity of the situation.
If Vorn’s Level was still Demon King Level, it absolutely wouldn’t be this powerful!
Then there’s only one possibility...
Vorn has already transcended Demon King Level!
"Immediately notify everyone to evacuate the Secret Realm!" Long Zhenguo made a decisive decision.
The situation in the Secret Realm was clearly not something this group of students could handle.
Expecting them to kill a Demon God Level Demon Race...
Too difficult!
He was planning to take action himself!
Though it would mean losing a Secret Realm, there was no other choice now.
Besides, this was a Demon God Level Demon Race.
If it escapes the Secret Realm and returns to the Demon Race, it will surely become a great enemy for the Human Race in the future.
Upon receiving Long Zhenguo’s order, Shen Ruoxue immediately turned back to the Secret Realm to pass on the directive.
Within the Secret Realm.
Gu Xing showed a confused expression upon seeing Gu Qianqian and others inside the Secret Realm.
"Sister, hasn’t your second Guardian Beast already Awakened Tier Nine? Why are you still coming to the Secret Realm?"
Gu Qianqian’s mouth twitched slightly.
Her little brother clearly didn’t realize what had happened in the Secret Realm at all.
After some explanation, Gu Xing finally understood everyone...
They wanted to seize his target!
How could that be?!
This Demon God had already become his designated target, and he was even considering the third Beast Taming Contract’s race...
If someone took it from him, who would he complain to?
No way, absolutely not!
At that moment, Shen Ruoxue’s figure reappeared in the Secret Realm.
"Principal Long orders everyone to evacuate immediately; he’s going to take action personally."
Meanwhile, Wang Teng and others also arrived here.
When his gaze fell on Gu Xing, the competitive spirit in his eyes had already dissipated.
The skill that destroyed the Demon Race group had left an indelible shadow in his heart.
This kind of disparity...
He glanced at his own Molten Dragon Lizard, a hint of disdain flashing in his eyes.
Then his gaze fixed on Vera beside Gu Xing, jealousy burning inside.
Why...
Why does he get to have such a powerful Guardian Beast?
As if sensing the malice, Vera suddenly turned her head.
Elves have always been sensitive to malice, and she instantly locked onto the source.
This person poses a threat to her master!
Vera silently memorized Wang Teng’s scent, a cold glimmer passing through her emerald eyes.
Subsequently, everyone began to prepare to evacuate the Secret Realm.
However.
"You all leave the Secret Realm first! I want to give it a try."
This sentence struck everyone like a thunderbolt, freezing them in place.
He just said...
He wants to attempt to challenge the Demon God?!
Gu Qianqian also looked at her brother in surprise but soon felt relieved.
She understood her brother wasn’t a reckless person.
If he said this, he must have his own plans.
"Xinrou, let’s go!"
She pulled Tang Xinrou beside her but found her friend gazing dazedly at Gu Xing.
"Qianqian..." Tang Xinrou’s eyes were dreamy, "I find your brother becoming more and more handsome..."
Gu Qianqian’s mouth twitched, pulling the infatuated one out of the Secret Realm.
Soon, besides Wang Teng, everyone else had left.
As Shen Ruoxue was about to follow the evacuation, she was stopped by Gu Xing.
"Ruoxue, your Talent...is related to space, right? Can you help me out?"
Although Vera’s Spiritual Attribute is remarkable, her other Attributes are somewhat ordinary.
To catch up with Vorn with a Speed breaking through a thousand, external help is necessary...
And Shen Ruoxue’s Space Talent is, of course, the best choice.
"No problem!"
Faced with Gu Xing’s request, Shen Ruoxue didn’t hesitate and agreed immediately.
Just as the two were about to set off, they noticed Wang Teng still standing motionless.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"You’re not leaving?" Shen Ruoxue was a bit surprised.
But Wang Teng appeared confident.
"My Guardian Beast is very strong, and I want to take this opportunity to further enhance its Level. If there’s danger later, I’ll back out myself."
Upon hearing Wang Teng’s response, Shen Ruoxue frowned slightly but didn’t say much.
After all, Long Zhenguo’s intentions had already been conveyed.
Wang Teng is not Gu Xing; she wouldn’t care about his life or death.
Then, she turned to look at Gu Xing, her fair cheeks suddenly blushing.
It’s worth noting, although she could move with others, it required physical contact between the two.
"Gu...Gu Xing, I need...to hold you to activate the Talent."
The voice was as soft as a mosquito.
Gu Xing opened his arms calmly.
"Come on."
After all, having been flown by Liu Li often, he was already used to it.
Seeing Gu Xing so natural, Shen Ruoxue took a deep breath, hugging him from behind.
Though Vera was not happy, she knew having Shen Ruoxue lead them was the fastest way.
She stepped up, leaning into Gu Xing’s arms.
In the next second, the figures of the three disappeared amidst spatial fluctuations.
Wang Teng remaining on the spot had a grim expression, hesitating for a moment before chasing after them.
If he could take advantage of the battle between Gu Xing and the Demon Race, maybe he could benefit?
Since he couldn’t break the record this time, the Wang Family had lost the qualification to enter the treasury.
He had to find a way to regain some losses!
...
After the group vanished from here.
The space gently rippled, and two graceful figures quietly emerged.
"Sister, that human surprisingly possesses Space Talent!"
The unicorn girl on the right excitedly shook her sister’s arm, her gorgeous face full of anticipation:
"Should we pledge allegiance to her?"
The unicorn woman on the left gently held her sister still, her gaze still following the direction where Gu Xing vanished:
"No rush."
Her voice was as melodious as flowing water, "Let’s observe a while longer."
"After all..."
"Surviving after such a long time, there’s no hurry!"
The girl on the right pouted slightly upon hearing her sister’s voice.
"Okay!"
"Moon, let’s go!"
The girl on the right raised her slender hand, and as her fingertips brushed through, the space tore like satin.
The two beautiful shadows merged into the Void, as if they had never existed.
If a knowledgeable person were here, they would surely be astonished.
This was clearly the most mysterious Ghost Race of the Alternate Space!
In the Alternate Space where the law of the jungle prevails, the Ghost Race ranks among the high races, relying on two great Talents:
The first is strength, able to lift mountains with a single arm, regarded as the Peak of Alien Race power.
The second is Void, naturally harmonized with space, able to dwell forever between the void.
However, the sisters, who should possess full horns, now each miss one.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 70: Fei Yue, Qing Shuang!
chapters.content:
Chapter 70: Chapter 70: Fei Yue, Qing Shuang!
The other side.
The space slightly distorted as Shen Ruoxue once again activated her talent, teleporting with Gu Xing to the front of Vorn.
This was the third jump.
When their figures solidified completely, Vorn’s footsteps halted abruptly, a trace of undisguised fear flashing in his eyes.
He had just witnessed the strength of that elf guardian beast...
Even if he exerted all his strength, he seemed not to be its match.
How could this be possible?
A sense of absurdity surged in Vorn’s heart.
He was a Demon God!
The first human he encountered after awakening could push him to such a sorry state?
Seventy years have passed...
Could it be that the human race has already grown to such a degree of strength?
"Human!" Vorn’s eyes were blood-red as he roared savagely, "Do you really think I have no way to deal with you?!"
It must be known that beings of the Demon God level possess not only powerful personal combat power but also the ability to command all low-tier demon races!
And at this moment, this secret realm is not lacking demons!
"Roar——!"
With a command, the demons within the secret realm suddenly went into a frenzy!
The earth trembled, and countless shadows gathered from all directions, like a black tide, crazily surging towards this place!
Shen Ruoxue’s face changed slightly, but when she turned to Gu Xing, she found him still calm, even...
With a faint smile at the corner of his mouth!
Her tightly held heartstrings slightly relaxed.
And Gu Xing quietly observed Vorn’s movements, scanning the demons swarming over, with a hint of anticipation in his eyes.
Just in time!
Vera is currently at the bottleneck of Awakened Tier Nine, if she can kill all these demons...
Perhaps she can use this opportunity to break through to Extraordinary Level!
The most important point is——
In the face of absolute power, numbers have never been a problem!
When the army of demons gathered behind Vorn, the Demon God’s face finally revealed a ferocious smile.
"Human, you were too careless!"
Vorn spread his arms wide, his voice twisted with pride.
The next moment, an astonishing scene unfolded.
The demonic qi on all demons’ bodies squirmed like living things, transforming into countless black threads, crazily flowing into Vorn’s body.
His physique began to expand, muscles knotting, and strange demon patterns surfaced on his skin.
His attributes increased to a terrifying point.
[Wolf God: Vorn]
[Talent: Demon God One Star]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine]
[Power: 802→1802]
[Constitution: 804→1804]
[Spirit: 642→1642]
[Speed: 820→1820]
[Skills: Demon God’s Body, Blood Escape...]
Gu Xing squinted his eyes, the numbers on the data panel making his expression slightly focused.
High-tier demons can absorb low-tier demons to forcibly enhance their strength...
Has always been the most troubling point for humans when fighting demons.
And this ability of the Demon God to absorb its kin is evidently more powerful!
Each attribute directly increased by a thousand points!
If coupled with the Demon God’s Body which can once again enhance attributes...
This time, it seems I have to bring out something real, or I really can’t deal with this demon!
"Hahaha!" Vorn’s laughter shook the surrounding debris, "Humans, letting me summon these demons is the worst decision of your life!"
However, Gu Xing simply shook his head lightly, with a hint of pity in his eyes.
Some people always live in their self-woven fantasies, only by dragging them out in the cruelest way can they see reality.
Gu Xing’s mouth curved into a dangerous arc.
Currently, even if Vera uses Elf Monarchy, her Spiritual Attribute is only around 3000 points.
With that strength, wanting to instantly kill this demon...
Is somewhat difficult!
It seems...
I’ll have to use the second talent!
He slowly closed his eyes, the spiritual world surged violently.
In an instant, his consciousness was pulled into a blood-red ocean...
The scarlet spiritual power swept across his body like a tide, every nerve trembling.
"Soul-devouring!"
The moment the talent was activated, a monstrous blood-red light exploded from Gu Xing’s body.
This simple and crude talent has only one effect:
Double all attributes of the guardian beast!
"Vera!" Gu Xing suddenly opened his eyes, blood light flowing in his pupils, "Elf Monarchy!"
Under the dual amplification, Vera’s aura skyrocketed.
The spiritual power entwining her body turned from emerald green to scarlet, finally transforming into brilliant gold-red.
And the numbers on her data panel jumped wildly:
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Awakened Tier Nine]
[Power: 310→620]
[Constitution: 320→640]
[Spirit: 1130→6780]
[Speed: 300→600]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain (Initial)]
The perfect overlap of Soul-devouring Talent’s doubling amplification and Elf Monarchy’s tripling effect actually allowed Vera’s Spiritual Attribute to directly break through the heavens!
point spiritual power...Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
This is almost more than triple Vorn’s!
Both are Awakened Tier Nine and Myth Level.
But at this moment, the attributes are a world apart!
This is precisely where the terror of the Soul-devouring Talent lies!
With the enhancement of the guardian beast’s basic attributes, the percentage amplification’s gain will increase geometrically!
Now...
He looked up at the stunned Vorn.
It’s time for this Demon God to witness what true despair is!
Shen Ruoxue, on one side, saw the blood-colored spiritual power surrounding Gu Xing, her pupils suddenly contracting.
This color... isn’t right!
She clearly remembered that at the opening ceremony, Gu Xing’s exhibited talent was pure silver-white.
But now this monstrous blood-red glow...
"Second talent?!"
This thought exploded like a thunder in her mind.
The textbooks indeed recorded relevant theories:
Only those with exceptional talent have a minuscule chance of awakening dual talents.
But in reality... she had never heard of any real cases!
In the void, the breath of the Ghost Race sisters also paused.
"How is this possible..."
Qing Shuang’s pupils slightly trembled, her violet eyes fixed on Vera.
That elf of Awakened Tier Nine was now emitting such pressure it made them, both Extraordinary Tier Ninth, feel suffocated!
It must be known that their talent is of the highest Myth Talent.
As members of the Void Race, she has seen countless methods for temporary enhancement.
But to strengthen an Awakened level guardian beast to such a point...
That man’s talent...
So terrifying!
"Sister!" Fei Yue suddenly tugged Qing Shuang’s sleeve, excitement flashing in her crimson eyes, "How about we become his guardian beasts..."
"If he applies such a status to you, sister, you’d definitely crush those old geezers in the clan!"
Qing Shuang faintly shook her head:
"Yue, humans at Extraordinary Level can only contract two guardian beasts, and that human already has two guardian beasts!"
Hearing her sister’s answer, Fei Yue felt a bit disappointed.
"Then... sister, when can we find our own master? If we don’t contract... because of bodily defects, we’ll always be trapped at Extraordinary Level!"
Qing Shuang gently embraced her sister, lightly caressing her unicorn horn.
"Yue, let’s wait a bit more, if that human proves worthy..."
"Then we will wait for him to reach Commander Level!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 71: Master, I’m So Tired, I Want a Hug~
chapters.content:
Chapter 71: Chapter 71: Master, I’m So Tired, I Want a Hug~
The bloodstorm swept across the battlefield, and Vorn’s pupils violently contracted.
The scent of death enveloped his entire body once again!
"Blood Escape!"
Without hesitation, he activated his survival skill, his figure instantly turning into a blood mist.
But this time...
How could they let him run away again?!
"Ruoxue!"
Shen Ruoxue instantly understood.
As space rippled, their figures had already blocked the path of the blood mist.
Vorn’s Blood Escape was forced to halt, and his reformed figure stumbled in mid-air.
He looked desperately at the yet-to-disperse spatial ripples and finally realized...
Today, there’s no way to escape!
This human has pushed him to the brink!
Vera slowly raised her hand, and destructive energy gathered at her fingertips once more.
Witnessing this scene, Vorn steeled his heart.
Suddenly.
His knees collapsed onto the ground, the hard surface shattered with web-like cracks.
"Please! My Lord, spare me!"
Once, he was a brave and fearless warrior of the Demon Race, but as time passed...
Seventy years later, resurrected once more, now he...
Fears death!Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
As long as he could survive, he was willing to give up everything.
However.
Gu Xing looked down indifferently at the kneeling demon, his eyes devoid of any emotion.
What he had his sights set on was the reward for slaying him!
Surrender?
Not allowed!
"Vera!"
"Natural Lament! Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
The world suddenly changed colors!
Under six thousand points of Spiritual Power fully unleashed, the entire Secret Realm began to tremble fiercely.
The cloud layer was torn apart by the violent Thunder Element, and a Thunder Dragon formed purely of thunder emerged from the vortex, each scale flashing with a destructive blue light.
Seeing this, Vorn’s body trembled continuously with fear.
Divine Retribution!
The term suddenly echoed in his mind.
Though he was at the Demon God Level, the power Vera displayed at this moment had exceeded his comprehension!
Yet after fear comes madness!
He is a Demon God!
How could he die here?!
He still wants to return to the Demon Race and enjoy the reverence of the Low Tier demons!
He still has a beautiful future!
"Demon God Body·Absolute Defense!"
Dark Demonic Qi continuously flowed toward him.
In front of his body, a giant Bone Shield gradually formed, with countless wailing spirits floating on its surface.
However.
"Boom!!!"
The moment the Thunder Dragon dove down, the Bone Shield, which claimed to be Absolute Defense, shattered like paper.
The last thing Vorn saw was the all-consuming light of thunder...
The Thunder Dragon, its momentum unabated, crashed heavily to the ground, transforming into countless thunder snakes rampaging wildly.
Wherever they went, the demons were reduced to ashes.
This area, under the baptism of lightning, briefly transformed into a pure white thundering prison!
Wang Teng cowered behind a Rock Wall, his pupils contracting in terror.
Gu Xing, this madman
He stared intensely at the figure in the distance illuminated by the light of thunder, his knuckles turning white from gripping too tightly.
Not only did he kill a Demon God, but he’s also planning to cleanse the entire Secret Realm of demons?!
So how can my Guardian Beast level up?!
Jealousy and anger surged in his chest, yet he dared not make a sound.
Silver thunder spread like a tide, consuming all demons in its path.
No, I must retreat first!
Swearing angrily through gritted teeth, he decided to exit the Secret Realm.
However.
"Swish!"
A green vine wrapped around his ankle like a venomous snake and instantly tightened!
Wang Teng froze, the chill rushing from his back straight to his head.
It’s that Guardian Beast!
He abruptly turned around, meeting Vera’s icy gaze from afar.
She noticed me long ago?!
Fear washed over his reason like a tide, he struggled madly, but the vine only tightened further.
Silver thunder had reached his feet, the blinding electric light reflecting his twisted visage.
"No——!!"
As the lightning engulfed him, Wang Teng’s eyes were filled only with endless regret and despair.
Had I known...I shouldn’t have provoked this monster...
In the next moment, his figure was completely annihilated by the light of thunder, not even leaving ashes.
Afterward, the thunder light dissipated, the world returned to silence.
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on where Vorn vanished.
A dark Divine Pattern hovered in mid-air, emanating a mysterious ripple.
With a light gesture, the Divine Pattern fell into his palm like a swimming fish.
This thing... can increase Contract eligibility?
His finger rubbed the rough pattern as Gu Xing frowned slightly.
Suddenly, a faint tremor came from his palm.
The black Divine Pattern seemed to sense something and slowly began to writhe, climbing up along his fingertips like a living creature.
"Hmm?"
Just as Gu Xing wanted to react, the Divine Pattern suddenly accelerated, transforming into a dark stream, and instantly merged into his brow!
"Swish——"
His brow cooled slightly, as if a drop of icy water seeped into his mind.
Gu Xing’s vision went dark, his consciousness was instantly pulled into the Beast Taming Space.
In the darkness, the Divine Pattern swam like a fish, finally hovering above the Spring of Life, rotating slowly.
An intricate piece of information flowed into his mind:
[Demon God Pattern: Allows contracting an additional Guardian Beast]
In the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li circled around the newly appeared black Divine Pattern curiously.
She reached out with her slender finger, cautiously poking the pattern.
Cool...not dangerous...
Having confirmed, she transmitted information to Gu Xing through the Spiritual Link:
"Master, it seems that besides letting you contract an additional Guardian Beast, there are no other functions..."
Midway through her sentence, Liu Li suddenly froze.
Her amber eyes blinked, her small face gradually falling.
Contract an additional Guardian Beast?
Doesn’t that mean...
Her status would decrease again?
Meanwhile, Gu Xing’s consciousness returned to reality.
With the Contract eligibility acquired, he could finally breathe a sigh of relief.
However, he didn’t notice Vera’s eyes covertly watching him from behind, her elf ears twitching uneasily.
After confirming that the master hadn’t noticed the previous small incident, she quietly breathed a sigh of relief.
Although she helped the master eliminate a hidden threat, but...
A Guardian Beast acting against humans is ultimately unreasonable.
After calming down, Vera suddenly jumped into Gu Xing’s arms, rubbing against his chest like a spoiled cat:
"Master, so tired, want to cuddle~"
Gu Xing: "..."
....
Outside the Secret Realm.
Long Zhenguo stood motionlessly at the exit like a statue.
He stood with hands behind his back, a faint flow of Domain Power swirling between his fingers.
As soon as Shen Ruoxue and Gu Xing appeared, the Secret Realm would instantly be obliterated by him.
Time passed by slowly, and the crowd started to become restless.
"Could it be...they died inside?"
"He was so arrogant, serves him right if he’s dead, thinking he could face Demon God Level demons alone!"
"But it’s one thing if he sent himself to death, he even took Shen Ruoxue along!"
Before the words finished, Long Zhenguo’s gaze swept like lightning.
The intangible pressure fell suddenly, causing several students to kneel instantly, cold sweat soaking their backs.
"Discussing your classmates is wrong and punishable!"
"I’m sorry, Principal Long!"
Their faces pale, they bowed heavily to the ground.
After they were punished, Long Zhenguo focused his gaze back on the Secret Realm.
Suddenly, the Secret Realm began to tremble intensely.
Long Zhenguo frowned slightly.
What’s going on?
For the Secret Realm to tremble, it indicates that someone inside has unleashed at least an Extraordinary Level battle.
Though confident in Gu Xing, this is indeed the first confrontation between humans and Demon Gods...
No one can say for certain if Gu Xing will be victorious.
However.
As he worried, space rippled, and two figures appeared!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 72: Extraordinary! The Foundation of the Domain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 72: Chapter 72: Extraordinary! The Foundation of the Domain!
When Gu Xing and Shen Ruoxue’s figures appeared at the exit of the Secret Realm, they instantly attracted everyone’s attention.
"They came out! Could it be that the Demon Race inside the Secret Realm..."
"Could it be that they couldn’t win and escaped?"
Amidst the crowd’s discussions, Long Zhenguo’s gaze instantly locked onto the two.
Although he could erase this Secret Realm, regarding what happened inside...
He knew nothing!
But seeing Gu Xing and Shen Ruoxue unharmed, he could roughly guess that the Demon Race inside...
Had most likely been slain by Gu Xing!
Gu Xing was about to explain when his expression suddenly tensed.
He sensed the energy in the Beast Taming Space of Vera was violently fluctuating.
The energy accumulated by killing a large number of Demons in the Secret Realm had finally broken through the critical point!
"Whoa—"
Vera’s figure appeared out of thin air, accompanied by the Molten Dragon Lizard.
In the Secret Realm, although she was ruthless to Wang Teng, to this Guardian Beast...
She merely knocked it unconscious!
After all, the Guardian Beast was innocent!
At this moment, Vera could no longer suppress the surging energy within her.
Her body slowly floated in the air, her whole being surrounded by dazzling emerald light.
Long Zhenguo saw this and immediately realized what was happening.
Considering the numerous onlookers on the scene...
He waved his hand.
"Swish!"
A spatial ripple flashed, and Gu Xing and Vera were instantly transferred to a special training room.
Meanwhile, the students left at the scene looked at each other, causing an uproar:
"Wang Teng didn’t come out? Isn’t that Guardian Beast his Molten Dragon Lizard?"
"Against a Demon God, he didn’t even have a chance to escape..."
"But Gu Xing is truly righteous, even thinking of saving someone else’s Guardian Beast at a time like this..."
...
In the training room.
Long Zhenguo stood aside, shock filling his eyes as he watched the scene before him.
Vera was surrounded by a dense emerald green glow, her Myth Level aura surging like a tide.
As expected!The source of thɪs content is Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Gu Xing’s second Guardian Beast was also of Myth Level!
However.
Wasn’t the Elf Race long extinct?
How could there still be a Myth Level Elf existing?
As he was in a daze, Vera’s transformation neared completion.
The once-diffused energy began to contract inward, the emerald light gradually condensing, finally retracting entirely into her body.
Gu Xing watched Vera’s transformation closely, seeing her figure gradually lengthen within the light, morphing from a young girl into a tall, mature lady.
However.
At the moment Vera opened her eyes—
Swish!
Her body rapidly shrunk, reverting to the petite, cute elf girl once more.
???
Gu Xing was dumbfounded.
Why remain in the form of a young child?
He had thought that Vera maintained her juvenile form due to the Awakening Stage level limit.
But now that she had broken through to Extraordinary Level, she should have grown.
Gu Xing didn’t understand, but didn’t think much more of it.
After all, Vera’s strength had genuinely increased.
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth 2 Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Power: 710 (+400)]
[Constitution: 720 (+400)]
[Spirit: 1830 (+700)]
[Speed: 700 (+400)]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain (Basic)]
Seeing these outrageous attribute growths, Gu Xing couldn’t help but click his tongue.
The Spiritual Attribute was still absurdly high, but the other attributes barely caught up to half of Liu Li’s level.
"Master~"
Having just completed her enhancement, Vera happily spread her arms, wanting to leap into Gu Xing’s embrace as usual.
However.
Swish!
A silver figure suddenly appeared between her and Gu Xing.
Liu Li’s slender fingers accurately seized Vera’s collar, lifting her into the air like a kitten.
The silver-haired girl elegantly turned and slightly bowed to Gu Xing:
"Master, please allow me to... have a little talk with Vera!"
Ssss~
Hearing Liu Li’s calm and collected tone.
A chill ran down Gu Xing’s back.
A familiar feeling!
"Woo... Master, save me!"
Vera paddled her little legs pitifully in the air.
Gu Xing decisively averted his gaze.
"You... have a good talk!"
With that, he quickly retrieved both Guardian Beasts into the Space.
It’s entirely normal for Guardian Beasts to communicate and bond!
After forcibly convincing himself, Gu Xing turned to look at Long Zhenguo.
The situation in the Secret Realm certainly needed to be reported!
Considering humanity’s lack of knowledge about Demon God Level Demons...
Gu Xing reported everything about Vorn to Long Zhenguo, without omitting a single detail.
"Awakened Tier Nine can already display Extraordinary High Tier battle power?"
Long Zhenguo’s brows gradually furrowed, his fingers unconsciously tapping on the table.
To be so powerful merely at the Awakening Stage.
Then what about at King Level...
Or even Demon God Level above King Level Demons?
Can humanity really withstand such enemies?
His gaze involuntarily fell on Gu Xing.
Currently, in the entire Longxia Country, no, in all of humanity, the only one able to oppose a Demon God Level existence at the same level is...
This young man right before him!
But Gu Xing’s current level is only Extraordinary Tier One...
Far too low!
He must be cultivated to grow quickly!
Long Zhenguo suddenly slammed the table, causing the teacup on top to jump.
He instantly overthrew the idea of standard student cultivation plans.
Advancing gradually through school to Extraordinary Tier Five, then entering the battlefield.
This approach is simply a waste of time for Gu Xing!
With two Myth Level Guardian Beasts, even though Gu Xing is currently only Extraordinary Tier One...
His real combat strength is likely at the pinnacle of the Extraordinary Level!
"Gu Xing, how much do you know about the cultivation system at the Extraordinary Level?"
This sudden question left Gu Xing momentarily stunned.
As a newly admitted student, he indeed hadn’t systematically learned the relevant theory yet.
Seeing his confusion, Long Zhenguo paced with his hands behind his back and said:
"The Awakening Stage is simple! Kill Demons, enhance your Guardian Beast, the Spiritual Power will naturally grow."
He suddenly turned, "But the Extraordinary Level..."
"Is the cornerstone to reaching Commander Level!"
"Upgrading your Guardian Beast can only nourish Spiritual Power, but to awaken a Domain..."
Long Zhenguo suddenly grabbed the inkstone on the table, slowly clenching his fingers.
The hard inkstone made a "crack" sound under the pressure of his grip, finally crumbling into powder.
"Without a corresponding physical constitution, you can’t manifest the Domain at all!"
Long Zhenguo opened his palm, letting the fine powder sift through his fingers.
"The stronger the physical constitution, the stronger the awakened Domain."
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
He thought he could level up in the Extraordinary Level by just grinding Demons...
It turns out, he had underestimated it.
However, physical constitution...
He subconsciously checked his own information.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 205]
[Constitution: 201]
[Spirit: 434]
[Speed: 202]
Looking at his attributes, he made a rough estimate.
An ordinary Extraordinary Tier One would have each attribute around 100 points.
Except for his Spiritual Power, which was four times that of an ordinary Extraordinary Level Beast Master, his other attributes didn’t seem much stronger than an ordinary one!
In order to enter the Commander Level and awaken a Domain, each of his attributes needs to be at least...
A thousand points or more!
This means that his focus from now on must be on improving all these attributes.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 73: Northern Territory! Heart of Nature!
chapters.content:
Chapter 73: Chapter 73: Northern Territory! Heart of Nature!
As Gu Xing got lost in thought, Long Zhenguo continued:
"Originally, I planned to let you advance to Extraordinary Tier Five at the National Academy, but that would limit your talent too much!"
"Therefore, I’ve decided to send you to the Northern Territory ahead of time!"
Northern Territory?
Gu Xing searched his memory for this location.
It is situated outside the northern defense line of Longxia Country’s Alternate Space, a special area where the three major forces of the Human Race and various Alien Races coexist.
The most remarkable thing is—
It is the primary battleground where all races unite against the Demon Race!
"In the Northern Territory, not only can you hunt enough demons to increase your level..."
"You can also obtain local specialties... a kind of ore that specifically enhances physical qualities!"
"More importantly, there are countless alien races there. If you can conquer them, you can contract them to become your Guardian Beasts!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing had already made up his mind.
The three benefits mentioned by Long Zhenguo are exactly what he currently lacks the most.
Both Guardian Beasts need to level up.
And his physical qualities also need enhancement.
More importantly...
He now has an extra contract quota and indeed needs to select his third Guardian Beast.
Moreover, he felt that staying at the National Academy wouldn’t provide much more growth.
But before leaving...
"Principal Long," Gu Xing suddenly looked up, "the promise you made about breaking the record to enter the National Treasure Vault..."
"You cheeky brat!"
Long Zhenguo was initially stunned, then he grinned and scolded:
"I, Long Zhenguo, keep my word! Not only are you allowed to choose, but you can also pick two items!"
"It’s a deal!"
...
Inside the Awakening Secret Realm.
The once heavily demonic fortress now lay silent, with terrifying traces of lightning still lingering on the shattered ground.
Suddenly, the void cracked open, and two graceful figures landed lightly.
"This..."
Fei Yue’s scarlet eyes widened, her small mouth slightly agape.
The destructive power demonstrated by that Awakening Stage Guardian Beast...
Was truly terrifying!
Even compared to her sister, it seemed no less formidable!
But her sister’s level was Extraordinary Tier Ninth!
That human’s talent...
So frightening!!
"S-Sister, where are we going now? That human seems to have gone to another world, I can’t follow!"
As incomplete Ghost Race members, they each only inherited half of the Ghost Race’s powers!
The lively Fei Yue inherited the Void Power!
While the seemingly gentle Qing Shuang inherited the Ghost Race’s power!
"Yue’er, it’s okay!"
She knew her sister’s abilities well!
The void path was almost applied to perfection.
If even Fei Yue couldn’t follow, it means that world did not welcome their arrival.
However...
At this moment, Qing Shuang’s exquisite face held a rare hint of confusion.
She turned to her sister, her voice gentle yet hesitant:
"Yue’er... do you think we should wait for him? Wait for him to reach Commander Level and recognize him as our master!"
That human just now was indeed the most talented human she has seen over the years.
And that human’s talent...
Also matches extremely well with their Ghost Race!
Upon hearing Qing Shuang’s question, Fei Yue was stunned.
They had been wandering in the void for years, truly finding a master...
For a moment, both were unable to decide.
After a long time.
Fei Yue finally raised her head, determination flickering in her eyes:
"Sister, if we don’t contract a human, we can only stay at the Extraordinary Level forever!"
"I refuse to resign to fate!"
"I want to fight back with you, so those old stubborns will know just how gravely wrong they were back then!"
Qing Shuang’s pupils contracted, her sister’s words piercing her heart like a sharp sword.
Likewise...
She still harbored resentment over that incident from back then.
Yes...
Why should they accept their fate?
Just because they have only one horn, should their own clansmen discriminate against them?
Treating them like trash and casting them out of the Ghost Race!
Suddenly, a decisive smile appeared at the corner of Qing Shuang’s lips:
"Yue, let’s go to the Northern Territory!"
"When he reaches Commander Level, we will acknowledge him as our master!"
"But before that, we need to let him understand our value!"
"Otherwise... even if he becomes our master, we won’t be valued!"
Upon hearing Qing Shuang’s decision, Fei Yue was first stunned, then delighted.
"Sister, do you mean it?"
All these years, they had deliberately avoided other races, wandering through the void.
For the naturally lively Fei Yue, such days were incredibly hard to bear!
But now...
Her sister finally relented!
As for the Northern Territory...
They had long understood its patterns.
All geniuses of the Human Race would, without exception, go to that region to train.
Moreover, only in the Northern Territory, with its abundance of alien races, would the sisters be less conspicuous.
Watching her jubilant sister, Qing Shuang nodded slightly.
"Really!"
"Sister, I love you the most!"
...
Within the National Academy.
With a special approval from Long Zhenguo, Gu Xing, guided by the staff, passed through numerous restrictions and arrived at a seemingly ordinary warehouse.
Despite its plain appearance, Gu Xing keenly felt the faint presence of Monarch Level auras!
As expected of the National Treasure Vault...
After verifying his identity, the heavy alloy door slowly opened.
In an instant, a myriad of rare treasures greeted his eyes.
However...
Gu Xing had a very clear purpose for this trip to the National Treasure Vault.
Which was to find materials for the evolution of his two Guardian Beasts!
Previous evolutions allowed Liu Li’s talent to advance from Legendary Level to Myth Level.
If he could gather all the materials again for another evolution of the two Beasts...
Is there a possibility they could reach beyond Myth Level?
Therefore, he directly bypassed ordinary materials, focusing on searching for the six materials needed for the evolution of the two Beasts.
However.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
After a round, he didn’t find any of Liu Li’s evolution materials in the vault.
Angel Divine Blood, Light Divine Crystal, Ultimate Fire!
For these three materials, he hadn’t been optimistic about finding the Angel Divine Blood and Ultimate Fire in the first place.
But he didn’t expect...
That even the Light Divine Crystal was absent from the vault.
As for the materials Vera needed...
Spring of Life, Heart of Nature, Earth Marrow!
He already possessed the Spring of Life.
As for the other two materials...
Suddenly.
A charred oval object caught his attention.
"What’s this?!"
Upon recognizing the item’s information, Gu Xing’s heartbeat accelerated abruptly:
[Heart of Nature (Incomplete)]
[Level: Myth Level]
[Function: Enhance the talent of the Elf Race]
Then, he helplessly pouted.
Finally finding a material, yet it was...
Incomplete!
But something is better than nothing!
Accept it first!
After another round confirming no other useful materials were discovered...
He had no choice...
But to take away one of the few remaining Myth Level materials in the vault.
[Twin Hearts]
[Level: Myth Level]
[Function: Unknown]
Though its function was unclear, its Myth Level quality was undisputed.
Moreover, among all the Myth Level materials, only this Twin Hearts was the most complete.
Therefore...
Take it directly!
Just in case it proves useful in the future...
...
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 74: I Want to Go to the Northern Territory!
chapters.content:
Chapter 74: Chapter 74: I Want to Go to the Northern Territory!
After securing the two pieces of Myth Level materials, Gu Xing left the treasury.
The next flight using the Flying Guardian Beast to the Northern Territory is in three days, so he decided to take this opportunity to explore the Imperial Capital well.
And also take this opportunity to bond with his two Guardian Beasts!
But as the blue Seven-pointed Star Array appeared...
Only Liu Li appeared in front of Gu Xing.
The silver-haired girl lifted her skirt slightly as she curtsied, her silver hair shimmering with a gentle luster under the sunlight.
Seeing Gu Xing lost in thought, Liu Li breathed a sigh of relief.
As expected!
Men all like gentle girls!
Gu Xing blinked, a bit confused.
Didn’t he summon two Guardian Beasts?
Why is it just Liu Li?
"Liu Li, Vera..."
Upon hearing Gu Xing mention that "green tea spirit," Liu Li’s expression slightly shifted but quickly returned to a gentle smile:
"Master, Vera said she wasn’t feeling well..."
Lately, that green tea spirit had been occupying Master’s time.
Finally, now that Gu Xing had some free time, how could she let that green tea spirit disturb her.
Hearing Liu Li’s explanation, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
The strong physique of a Guardian Beast...
Can still have problems?
Inside the Beast Taming Space.
Vera was sitting under the Tree of Life, hugging her knees and looking glum.
Recalling the "friendly education" by Liu Li just now, she kicked the tree root in frustration.
If only she could defeat that Angel...
The Tree of Life shivered and curled its branches, fearing this little ancestor’s wrath.
However.
Just as Gu Xing was planning to spend some time with Liu Li.
Ying Xinghe came over.
Seeing this, Liu Li’s mouth twitched.
Why come now, of all times!
Ying Xinghe keenly sensed the resentful look from Liu Li and was taken aback.Thɪs
Since when did he offend this Guardian Beast?
But he couldn’t worry about that now; the Clan Leader’s instruction was more important.
"Gu Xing, our Clan Leader wishes to meet you."
Gu Xing pondered for a moment and agreed.
He had been staying with the Winners for some time, not to mention that Liu Li had blown up a house during her advancement...
Now that the Clan Leader personally invited him, it would be unreasonable not to go.
"Sure, no problem!"
Gu Xing nodded, giving Liu Li an apologetic look.
Under Ying Xinghe’s guidance, Gu Xing soon arrived at a conference room of the Winners.
The fragrance of tea lingered over the sandalwood long table, and the shadow of trees swayed outside the window, but inside was eerily quiet.
Before long, footsteps echoed from outside.
Ying Xinghe assisted an elder as they walked in slowly, and Gu Xing looked up, his pupils contracting sharply.
According to what he knew, Ying Bing was the daughter of the Winner Clan Leader.
Calculating by age...
The Winner Clan Leader should be around a half-century old.
But the man who appeared before him...
Had snow-white hair and numerous wrinkles!
The only thing defying his age was his bright and spirited eyes.
"Did I startle you!"
The elder’s hoarse voice carried a hint of laughter, and he smiled as he explained the reason for his appearance.
The Winner’s Bloodline is unique, allowing only the contract with one Guardian Beast.
However.
Through a special bloodline power, this Guardian Beast’s strength continually grows.
Not just in talent, but also in attributes.
However...
This growth is not unlimited.
The maximum it can support is to elevate the Guardian Beast to Legendary Level.
But this enhancement comes with a side effect...
Which is continuously extracting the life force of the Winners.
This is why Ying Tian appears so aged.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing furrowed his brow slightly.
No wonder every time he saw Ying Bing, her Guardian Beast’s power had increased rapidly.
At this rate, her Guardian Beast was likely nearing Legendary Level...
Seemingly realizing Gu Xing’s thoughts, Ying Tian’s face, filled with wrinkles, broke into a smile:
"Although Bing’er is nearing the limit with her Guardian Beast, her bloodline concentration is very high, and she had a fortunate encounter in the Elf Secret Realm. In the short term, her body won’t have issues, but in the future..."
Saying this, the elderly man suddenly turned serious.
He straightened his bent back, his voice hoarse yet solemn:
"Gu Xing! I earnestly implore you to help Bing’er!"
"I know you have methods to enhance the talent of Guardian Beasts; I beseech you to help her when she can no longer manage."
"If her Guardian Beast can break through to Myth Level, the feedback from enhancing the Beast’s talent may overcome her bloodline defects."
Upon hearing Ying Tian’s words, Gu Xing was momentarily stunned.
But he quickly understood; it wasn’t surprising Ying Tian could see this.
After all, Liu Li evolved from Legendary Talent to Myth Level while within the Winners.
As a Monarch Level Beast Master, it was inevitable Ying Tian would notice this.
Seeing Ying Tian’s pleading eyes, Gu Xing made a decision in his heart.
He took a deep breath and solemnly said:
"Ying Bing and I are friends. If I can be of assistance, I’ll certainly do my best."
Upon hearing this, Ying Tian’s wrinkled face filled with a sense of relief.
He gently pushed away Ying Xinghe’s support and shakily bowed to Gu Xing:
"On behalf of the entire Winner family, thank you, young friend."
Gu Xing hurriedly stepped forward to assist.
This elder was a Monarch Level powerhouse renowned alongside Long Zhenguo, who had rendered great service to Longxia Country.
Though now unable to act freely due to physical reasons.
That this esteemed elder would bow to him felt unearned to Gu Xing.
"You’ve overpraised me, elder. I truly do not deserve this."
Upon leaving the conference room, Gu Xing’s thoughts were still a bit scattered.
The earnest request from Ying Tian left him feeling a sense of responsibility.
As he stepped out the door, he coincidentally encountered Ying Bing.
A flash of surprise appeared in the usually cold girl’s eyes.
"Gu Xing? You..."
Gu Xing hesitated a moment but ultimately did not mention the conversation with Ying Tian.
Instead, he found an excuse:
"I’m departing for the Northern Territory in three days, and I wanted to bid you farewell, but you weren’t present."
Upon hearing that Gu Xing had specially come to say goodbye, a rare blush appeared on her icy face.
A warm feeling flowed through her heart, like a small lamp being lit there.
Soon after, Gu Xing took his leave.
Watching Gu Xing’s departing figure, Ying Bing suddenly realized something...
Gu Xing was leaving here!
Suddenly, the little light in her heart went out, leaving a hollow void.
What’s happening to her?
Her hand unconsciously clutched her heart.
Why did hearing about Gu Xing leaving the Imperial Capital make her feel so uneasy?
It was as if a world once lit by a ray of light had returned to cold desolation.
In a daze, she instinctively sought out her father.
Seeing the puzzled look Ying Tian cast upon her, she stood there blankly.
After a long pause, she finally raised her head to voice her request.
This was also the first time she had ever made a request!
"Father, I wish to enter the Ying Family Secret Realm, to quickly advance to extraordinary Tier Five, to head to the Northern Territory!"
She had always known what it meant to advance in level.
The stronger the power, the more the Guardian Beast would draw from her life force.
Her life would then be on a countdown.
But even so...
She still wanted to quickly reach extraordinary Tier Five, to swiftly head to the Northern Territory, to meet that person!
Ying Tian gazed deep into his daughter’s eyes, seeing a flame within them he’d never seen before.
After a moment’s silence, the elder’s wrinkled face slowly formed a smile, and he nodded:
"Alright!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 75: Rise of a New Deity!
chapters.content:
Chapter 75: Chapter 75: Rise of a New Deity!
Northern Frontier, City of Chaos.
Whistling cold winds swept with fine ice crystals, swirling above the City of Chaos.
This is the only city in the Northern Territory, where all races gather.
In the plaza at the city center, three ancient stone arenas were arranged in a triangular shape.
They corresponded to the Extraordinary Level, Commander Level, and Monarch Level, three levels!
These arenas were not only places for races to resolve disputes, but they also held another special significance...
When a masterless Guardian Beast steps alone onto the arena, it signifies...
That it is seeking its master!
Qing Shuang told Fei Yue to wait in place and stepped onto the arena.
A commotion instantly erupted around the arena.
The strong ones from various races noticed there was only one figure on stage and immediately realized this was no ordinary private fight.
"Look quickly, someone has stepped onto the arena again, it seems they are looking for their master!"
"But...what race is this? Why have I never seen it before?"
"Wait...doesn’t she resemble the legendary Ghost Race a little? But shouldn’t the Ghost Race have two horns?"
"A single-horned Ghost Race? The Ghost Race’s power comes from two horns; with only one horn...could it be a defect?"
Qing Shuang ignored those harsh comments.
Over the years, even if she deliberately avoided other races, she still encountered quite a bit of similar ridicule.
But...
The only thing she could do to respond to these doubts...was to answer with her fists!
She slowly scanned the crowd, her cold voice echoed in the plaza:
"Is there anyone who dares to challenge?"
This sentence was like a spark, instantly igniting the emotions of the Beast Race spectators.
You must know, gaining attention through the arena is indeed the fastest way, but this method...
Was tantamount to trampling on the dignity of all races!
Climbing up by stepping on us?
How can this be tolerated?
"Climbing up by trampling on our dignity? Such audacity!"
A thunderous shout exploded, and the werewolf Walker leapt onto the arena.
His whole body rippled with muscular knots, and his eyes burned with the will to fight.
However...
Qing Shuang merely waved her fist casually.
That seemingly slender arm erupted with astonishing power.
The punch’s wind trembled the air!
"Bang!"
Walker couldn’t even manage to assume a defensive posture before his whole body flew backward like a kite with a broken string, crashing heavily ten meters away on the ground.
"Cough...cough cough..."
The werewolf struggled to stand, his eyes filled with sheer disbelief and shock.
Only at this moment did he truly experience the terror of this single-horned Ghost Race.
In that instant, it seemed as if an entire mountain range was crashing toward him!
This...was this really Extraordinary Level power?
The surrounding area of the arena fell silent in an instant.
The warriors of various races, who had been eager to move, now swallowed hard unconsciously.
Qing Shuang slowly withdrew her fist, her cyan hair fluttering in the wind.
"Next."
Her cold voice echoed on the arena, forming a sharp contrast with the silence below.
Fei Yue, at some point, had already dashed to the front row of the audience, waving a colorful flag from who knows where:
"Sister, you’re amazing! Sister, you’re invincible!"
Apart from Fei Yue, the other beast race strong ones looked at each other in disbelief.
"Walker...defeated just like that? He is Extraordinary Tier Ninth!"
"Epic Level Walker, defeated by her in just one move..."
"Then this Ghost Race’s Talent...is absolutely above Legendary!"
"Could we be witnessing the birth of a future king?"
Besides the Beast Race, the human Beast Masters watching had fiery gazes.
Extraordinary Tier Ninth, Legendary Talent Guardian Beast, actively seeking a master!
Such an opportunity is once in a lifetime!
Soon, an Extraordinary Tier Ninth Beast Master couldn’t hold back and jumped onto the arena.
He suppressed his excitement, trying to demonstrate his sincerity:
"Hello, my name is..."
However, before his words were complete—
Qing Shuang’s fist had already arrived!
"Damn!"
The Beast Master’s face changed drastically, hurriedly summoning his two Guardian Beasts to block in front of him.
Yet, under this punch, both Guardian Beasts along with himself flew backward like broken kites, crashing heavily outside the arena.
And this was because Qing Shuang intentionally held back.
If she had been more serious, this punch would have been enough to demolish them into pieces!
Silence enveloped the whole area.
The Beast Masters who had previously been eager were all now frozen in place, cold sweat streaming down their faces.
Such strength...
Without enough ability, stepping up is just seeking death!
Qing Shuang withdrew her fist and calmly scanned the entire scene:
"Is there anyone else?"
Below the stage, no one responded.
Strong individuals from various races exchanged glances, but none dared to step forward.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Qing Shuang frowned slightly.
"Is there not a single person in such a vast Northern Territory who can fight?"
This sentence was like a spark falling into a powder keg, instantly igniting the entire scene!
This statement clearly insulted all the alien races of the Northern Territory.
"Damn, Ghost Race thinks they’re hot stuff! Hell, if I can’t beat you, can’t I call someone?"
"Exactly, we might be weak, but surely someone in the Northern Territory can knock her down."
"I know Kaike, the one who dominated the arena last time. I’ll ask him to come over and teach this beast a lesson."
Seeing the restless crowd, a trace of satisfaction flickered in Qing Shuang’s eyes.
This was the effect she wanted to achieve.
Taking a top position throughout the Northern Territory is the fastest way.
She secretly apologized to the defeated opponents, but her gaze soon turned resolute.
It was a carefully thought-out decision to challenge all alien races in the Northern Territory!
If she brought her sister recklessly...
And that Human Race individual can only contract one Guardian Beast. What if he doesn’t agree to keep her sister by his side?
Fei Yue is skilled in Void Power, but her Attributes are extremely weak, while she...
Qing Shuang unconsciously tightened her fist, and her single horn gleamed with an eerie light.
Although she cannot use Void Talent, her Power is several times that of an average Ghost Race member!
Before long, a commotion was heard at the edge of the arena.
A burly figure leapt into the air, landing heavily in front of Qing Shuang, causing the arena to tremble slightly.
Dark cyan scales gleamed with a metallic sheen under the sunlight, a sturdy dragon tail slowly swayed behind him.
He was Kaike, the Dragon-man warrior who made a name for himself across the Northern Territory by challenging the entire arena last time!
But as soon as he stepped onto the scene, he felt a strong sense of oppression.
Kaike’s golden, slit-pupil eyes suddenly contracted.
He originally thought it was just another fool showing off, yet unexpectedly encountered a true expert!
"Kaike." The Dragon-man spoke in a deep voice filled with battle intent, "Your name?"
Qing Shuang’s silver eyes flickered, showing a serious expression for the first time.
Extraordinary Tier Ninth, with Talent from the very top legendary group.
To such an opponent, she slowly replied:
"Qing Shuang!"
Hearing this answer, Kaike bared his fangs, and his dragon tail excitedly slapped the ground.
In the Dragon Race tradition, exchanging names signifies mutual recognition of each other’s qualification as opponents.
Despite the oppressive aura from the opponent, despite every battle instinct screaming "you will lose," yet...
When has the Dragon Race ever feared defeat?
Kaike suddenly spread his wings, draconic might surged to the skies: "Come fight!"
No flashy Skills, no unnecessary pretenses.
The Ghost Race is renowned for their strength, and Kaike, carrying the blood of the Dragon Race, is equally strong!
"Boom——!"
The two fists collided fiercely in the air, erupting in a deafening roar.
A violent shockwave exploded centered around the two, causing the front row of spectators from low-tier alien races to be thrown off their feet.
Capable of fighting!
Kaike felt joyous, the muscles beneath his dragon scales bursting.
Yet, Qing Shuang’s next words made his hot blood instantly cold:
"Your strength is good."
This was genuine praise from the heart...
To withstand a punch using fifty percent of her power, Kaike did indeed have the right to stand above the crowd.
But that’s all.
When Qing Shuang truly exerted her Power, the outcome was already decided.
"Bang!"
On the second clash of fists, Kaike’s burly body flew backward like a broken kite.
Precise control over Power allowed him to land firmly on the edge of the arena, unharmed...
And that was precisely the most frightening aspect.
To control Power to such a precise degree...
Kaike kneeled on one knee, dragon tail drooped:
"I concede!"
The whole scene turned silent.
The once most dominant champion of the arena, just like that...
Lost?!
They witnessed...
The emergence of a new champion!!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 76: Departure for the Northern Territory!
chapters.content:
Chapter 76: Chapter 76: Departure for the Northern Territory!
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
The day of departure finally arrived.
After bidding farewell to Gu Qianqian and others, Gu Xing arrived at the starting point for heading to the Northern Territory.
This was a flying guardian beast base outside the Imperial Capital.
The flying guardian beasts here could travel to any place.
The team heading to the Northern Territory included several Extraordinary Tier Five students from the National Academy, as well as elites from other academies.
Coincidentally, those from the National Academy were the seniors he had suppressed during the opening ceremony.
Seeing Gu Xing, their eyes reflected a hint of awe, and they warmly greeted him.
Although Gu Xing could hardly remember their appearances, he nodded slightly in response to their friendly demeanor.
Soon, a Commander-level Beast Master began checking the list.
Once confirming everyone was present, he loudly announced:
"All listen up, we’ll now distribute accommodations!"
The journey to the Northern Territory was long; one must first enter an alternate space and then fly for nearly a month to reach the border.
Hence, the backs of the flying guardian beasts were equipped with small accommodations, ensuring everyone could rest during the lengthy journey.
However, the number of rooms was limited, accommodating only three to four people, while the rest had to squeeze into a large shared bunk.
Of course, this was intentionally set this way, considered as preferential treatment for the strong, and as motivation for the weak.
This Commander-level Beast Master was from the National Academy and naturally recognized Gu Xing.
Without hesitation, he assigned the largest room to Gu Xing.
However, this decision instantly fueled dissatisfaction among the students from other academies.
"Why! He’s just Extraordinary Tier One, why does he get to monopolize a room?"
"Heh, connections are different! Even the slot to the Northern Territory was probably obtained through background, huh?"
"Damn it, a mere Extraordinary Tier One, sitting above us?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
Although according to the original allocation rules, these people wouldn’t necessarily get an individual room,
Watching an "Extraordinary Tier One" enjoy privileges right before their eyes, they felt more upset than anyone else.
This was the jealousy in human nature!
However, before Gu Xing could respond, several Extraordinary Tier Five students from the National Academy couldn’t sit still.
Insult Gu Xing as trash? Isn’t that saying they’re worse than trash?
How could they tolerate that?!
The short-tempered buzz-cut Beast Master glared fiercely, stepped forward sharply, and shouted angrily:
"Dare to insult people from the National Academy? Asking for death!"
Before finishing his words, he waved his hand and instantly summoned his guardian beast—
An Epic Talent, Extraordinary Tier Five Gale Wolf!
Remember, Epic level guardian beasts were not uncommon in the National Academy, but in the eyes of students from other academies, they’re definitely a crushing existence!
The Gale Wolf merely growled lightly, and the terrifying pressure made everyone’s faces turn pale.
Three minutes later...
A group of bruised and battered students lined up and bowed deeply in front of Gu Xing, apologizing shakily:
"We’re sorry, Xing Bro! We had no eyes to recognize you!"
"Sorry! We shouldn’t have been so lame-mouthed!"
...
Looking at this group of bruised, submissive students, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly, momentarily speechless.
And that buzz-cut Beast Master...
Raleigh scratched his head and gave Gu Xing a sincere and honest smile.
Gu Xing nodded politely to him:
"Thank you!"
Raleigh heard that and suddenly felt a bit embarrassed, stutteringly said:
"Uh, well... nothing much! I’m Raleigh, from Chuanshu! I just think... you’re so handsome, and strong..."
"Shouldn’t be insulted by them!"
The more he spoke, the more excited he became, his eyes even faintly shining.
Not right!
Liu Li sharply noticed something odd and immediately cast a wary glance at Raleigh.
This guy... surely hasn’t fallen for the master, right?!
Thinking of this possibility, Liu Li’s pupils suddenly shrank!
"Master, we should go inside!"
Not waiting for Gu Xing’s reaction, she quickly grabbed his sleeve and forcibly pulled him towards the room on the flying guardian beast’s back.
Raleigh stood in place, looking bewildered.
Meanwhile, his classmates silently exchanged glances, unanimously stepping back and distancing themselves from him.
There’s something wrong!!
...
Villa Verona.
"Old man! I’m going to the National Academy to study!"
Veronica stomped her foot on the mahogany table, hand on hip, glaring down at the chief Beast Master of the council....
Verocan!
He had another identity, which was Veronica’s father!
This top human race powerhouse who ranked alongside Long Zhenguo twitched his mouth, but had to suppress his anger:
"No way! The Netherworld told me, you just wanna go to Longxia for that brat named Gu Xing!"
"Any random punk trying to take my daughter? Dream on!"
"It’s not up to you!" Veronica slammed the table, "Dare to stop me, and I’ll turn against you!"
Kaven’s temples throbbed.
Across the entire human race, only this Veronica dared to confront him like this.
"Nika..." he forced a stiff smile, "Even if I agree, Longxia wouldn’t possibly agree, right?"
Veronica tilted her head and thought.
Indeed, with her identity as the chairman’s daughter, if something happens in Longxia...
She could almost foresee her dad leading the council army to overturn Longxia.
"Then I want to go to the Northern Territory!"
"Nonsense! I can send someone to bring you all the extraordinary materials you need. Why go to that ghostly place?"
"Old, man, sir!" The girl approached word by word, "Stop me again, and I’ll turn against you now!"
Seeing Veronica’s serious look, Kaven sighed longly.
He understood this daughter too well...
Even if he doesn’t agree, this girl would sneak out.
"Fine." He suddenly looked serious, "But you must contract with the White Emperor."
"No! It’s so ugly!"
Kaven almost choked.
That’s a Monarch-level guardian beast with Demigod talent, a unique treasure in the entire council!
"No contract with White Emperor, no talk." He said firmly.
Veronica’s eyes rolled.
She knew this was her father’s final bottom line...
If her safety couldn’t be guaranteed, Kaven would never let her leave!
"Deal!"
Beside them, the Nether Spirit Leopard turned its face away, unable to watch this father-daughter confrontation.
Their young lady was purely stifled by the head of the house...
Suffocating, oppressed!
"Little Leopard~" Veronica suddenly rushed over to hug its neck, her eyes sparkling, "I heard there’s a special Secret Realm in the Northern Territory..."
The Nether Spirit Leopard helplessly swept her wrist with its tail lightly.
Although it liked peaceful days, yet...
Who told her to have this kind of young lady!
At this point...
Veronica’s face suddenly deflated, murmured sulkily:
"It’s just that I’d have a contract with that stupid bear..."
The Nether Spirit Leopard’s mouth twitched.
If someone else had such a powerful guardian beast, they’d be overjoyed...
Only their young lady looked disgusted.
"Whatever, contract is done, we’re heading to the Northern Territory!"
"Gu Xing definitely will go to the Northern Territory! Little Leopard, then we’ll find him!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 77: No Means No!
chapters.content:
Chapter 77: Chapter 77: No Means No!
The center of the Northern Territory, City of Chaos.
A month later, Gu Xing and his party finally arrived at the core city of the Northern Territory.
As soon as they landed, Gu Xing unexpectedly saw a familiar figure.
"Gu Xing!​"
Sally stood in the crowd, excitedly waving her little hand, a joyful smile on her face.
Gu Xing walked over with Liu Li and Vera.
Upon seeing this, Sally immediately bent over respectfully and greeted them.
"Gu Xing, Liu Li, Vera!"
Gu Xing smiled helplessly and advised:
"Sally, no need to be so formal, just call me by my name."
"No way!" Sally shook her head firmly, "You are who you are!"​
Seeing her insistence, Gu Xing didn’t press further and let her be.
However, he was very curious about why Sally appeared here.​
Earlier, after leaving the Beast Race to Ying Xinghe, Gu Xing didn’t bother with it anymore.
It was through Sally’s explanation that Gu Xing understood the reason.
Due to certain risks still existing for Alien Races entering the Longxia Defense Line, after discussion, the Beast Race was unanimously settled in the Northern Territory.​
Since this place was already a mix of various races, adding a Beast Race wouldn’t cause any waves at all.​
Later, at Sally’s enthusiastic invitation, Gu Xing decided to stay at her residence instead of going to the National Academy’s station.​
On the streets of the City of Chaos, Sally guided while introducing the city’s rules to Gu Xing.​​
"The most precious resource in the Northern Territory is the Star Stone."
She pointed to the towering exchange hall in the distance, "For Beast Masters, it can enhance physical constitution, and for us Alien Races, it can purify bloodlines."​
Gu Xing nodded thoughtfully.​
However, Star Stones are rather precious.​
"Must hunt Demon Races to exchange them?"​
"Yes, different Demon Races are worth different points, and you can use points to exchange for Star Stones of corresponding quality."​
Upon learning this information, Gu Xing nodded.​
Hunting Demon Races can both enhance Guardian Beast Level and exchange for resources...​​
A twofold benefit!
During the conversation, they arrived at the Cat Race’s post. Upon seeing Gu Xing, Clan Leader Rone immediately led the whole clan to bow in greeting.​
When he learned that Gu Xing needed Star Stones, this white-haired elder turned around without hesitation and instructed his clan members:
"Bring all the Star Stones from the warehouse!"​
"This won’t do!" Gu Xing hurriedly raised his hand.​
But Rone insisted on handing over the animal skin bag stuffed with Star Stones, his eyes glinting with tears:
"You saved our entire clan, what does this small token of appreciation mean?"​
Seeing him clutching the bag tightly without letting go, Gu Xing sighed helplessly.​
Forget it...
He solemnly accepted the Star Stones, mindfully noting:
Once he hunts Demon Races, he’ll return them all.​
Soon after, Sally led Gu Xing to a guest room to rest.​
Except Sally didn’t leave but respectfully waited by the side.​
"Sally?"
"Gu Xing!"​
The girl suddenly bowed deeply.​
"I... I specially went to learn maid courses! Please let me stay by your side to serve you!"
Gu Xing opened his mouth, about to speak only to be hurriedly interrupted by her...​
"I promise not to disturb you! Just want to take care of your daily needs!"​
After saying this, Sally bowed again deeply.​
"I’m begging you..."
This can’t be termed as a request...​
Gu Xing watched the little girl biting her lips tightly, as if he could hear the threat of "If you refuse, I’ll cry for you".​
Gu Xing could only agree reluctantly.​
Most of the time he won’t be in the city anyway, Sally would just be a maid in name.​
Upon seeing Gu Xing agree, Sally’s face lit up.​
"Then Gu Xing, please rest first, I’ll be right outside, call me if you need anything."​
Gu Xing wanted to reach out, but Sally quickly rushed out of the room.​
Forget it...
Gu Xing shook his head, indicated Liu Li and Vera could move freely, then turned his attention to the animal skin bag on the table.​
As he untied the knot, dozens of Star Stones shimmering with starlight rolled out, colliding on the table with a crisp sound.​
Star Stones!
Though they were merely the lowest grade!​
According to Sally, using them with specific materials could greatly enhance constitution.​
Unfortunately, due to the Beast Race’s strong physicality, there’s no need to use auxiliary materials; they only collected the Star Stones themselves!​
Gu Xing suddenly raised his eyebrows, his consciousness sinking into the Beast Taming Space.​
The Spring of Life rippled, and the ancient tree’s leaves moved without wind.​
Speaking of auxiliary materials...​
Is there anything better than these materials?​
But considering these two items are sacred materials of the Elf Clan, Gu Xing decided to seek Vera’s opinion first.​The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Vera, I’d like to use some Spring of Life and World Tree leaves..."
"Use them!" Before he finished speaking, Vera excitedly jumped up, "How much do you need? I’ll get them right away!"​
Gu Xing was momentarily speechless.​
Wait a minute...​
Isn’t her reaction somehow off?​
Logically speaking, aren’t these objects sacred materials of the Elf Clan?​
But Vera’s behavior...​
Before he could gather his thoughts, Vera had already dashed into the Beast Taming Space.​
Three seconds later—​
"Whoa!"​
A large oak barrel landed heavily, filled with the emerald gleaming Spring of Life, with dozens of leaves swirling with golden patterns floating on the surface.​
"Is this enough?" Vera’s eyes sparkled, "If not, I’ll go pick more!"​
It’s like taking a bath in the Spring of Life...​
If this gets out, other Beast Masters would hunt him down!​
While he was lost in thought, Vera turned to head back into the Beast Taming Space again.​
Gu Xing quickly grabbed the hem of her clothes:
"That’s enough! More would be wasteful!"​
After confirming the materials were complete, Gu Xing undid his coat’s buttons, suddenly realizing something as he froze in place.​
Turning his head, sure enough, Liu Li and Vera were staring straight at him, their eyes full of anticipation.​
"You two..." Gu Xing rubbed his forehead, "How about going back to the Beast Taming Space?"​
"No way!" x2​
The two Guardian Beasts flatly refused, yet their bodies leaned closer.​
"..."
Gu Xing swiftly decided, grabbed each by their collars, and tossed them out the door.​
"Bang!"​
The door shut and locked in one smooth motion.​
"Thump thump" came the knocking and whimpering from outside.​
Even for Guardian Beasts, men and women must maintain propriety!​
Outside the hallway, Sally tilted her head, bewildered seeing Liu Li and Vera being "invited" out.​​
"Why did the two of you come out?"​
She blinked her cat-like emerald eyes, her tail curiously swaying.​
Upon learning that Gu Xing was bathing, she instinctively tried to push the door open.​
"I’ll go help Gu Xing with a back rub!"​
"Stop!" x2​
Liu Li and Vera instantly twisted, blocking the door like two walls.​
This cat...​
Is she genuinely naive or pretending?!​
Seeing Sally’s innocent expression, the two Guardian Beasts felt their temples throb.​
"But it’s a maid’s duty?"​
Sally perplexedly counted on her fingers, "Prepare towels, adjust water temperature, massage shoulders and neck..."​
With each word, Liu Li and Vera’s faces darkened a shade.​
"In short!" Liu Li firmly pressed Sally’s restless tail,"No entry means no entry!"​
Vera even used Skills to weld the door shut!​​
...
