chapters.title: Chapter 78: North of the North! Demon Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 78: Chapter 78: North of the North! Demon Realm!
On the other side.Follow current novels on NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
The mist swirled.
Gu Xing quickly took off his clothes and leapt into the wooden tub filled with the Spring of Life.
The emerald-colored spring water instantly rose to his chest, its cool and gentle energy enveloping his body like silk.
Then, he picked up the beast leather bag and poured dozens of Star Stones into the water.
"Splash—"
The moment the Star Stones plunged into the spring water, the entire tub suddenly lit up in three colors!
The Spring of Life enhanced the spirit, and the Star Stone strengthened the physique...
Along with the life essence of the World Tree Leaves...
What kind of effect would the combination of the three have?
Gu Xing closed his eyes and focused, his spiritual power spreading out like a web.
In his perception, three distinctly different energies were intertwining in the water.
Gu Xing carefully felt them.
Blue was the energy from the Star Stones, white was the energy from the Spring of Life, and as for green, it was the energy contained by the Life Tree Leaves.
"Come!"
His spiritual power transformed into an invisible hand, drawing the three-colored energy into his body simultaneously.
"Boom—"
In an instant, a raging storm surged in his sea of consciousness!
The Sovereign Talent radiated a silvery white glow, while the Soul-devouring Talent erupted with scarlet brilliance...
The two forces battled within his meridians like beasts fighting for territory!
Damn...
Sweat beaded on Gu Xing’s forehead, his neck veins bulging, his skin flashing alternately silver and crimson.
If this continued, his spiritual power would definitely collapse!
However.
Just as his spiritual power was about to lose control at the critical point, the opposing sides suddenly paused.
The silvery white light cluster and the blood red glow each took a step back, striking a boundary line as if reaching an agreement.
In the blink of an eye, the three-colored energy was evenly split in two, being absorbed by the two talents in an orderly manner.
Watching the delicate balance achieved by the two forces within him, Gu Xing exhaled a long breath.
But...
If the two talents absorbed all the energy...
How would his physical attributes improve?
Thus, Gu Xing forcibly controlled his spiritual power and began to snatch food from the tiger’s mouth...
Soon, the water mist in the bathroom dissipated.
Gu Xing slowly opened his eyes, a fleeting stream of silver and red light flashing in the depths of his pupils.
He looked at the tub...
The Spring of Life had already dried up, the Life Tree Leaves had turned to ash and dispersed, and even the once radiant Star Stones had become dull, turning into a heap of spiritless rubble.
He shook his head helplessly.
Clearly it was his body absorbing the energy, yet the two talents seemed like starving wolves, nearly devouring all the benefits...
If he hadn’t forcibly suppressed them, even the last wisp of energy would have been consumed by them.
However, the result was still quite good.
Gu Xing focused his thoughts, pulling up his attribute panel.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Talent: Sovereign (enhancing...), Soul-devouring (enhancing...)]
[Power: 205→250]
[Constitution: 201→250]
[Spirit: 434→520]
[Speed: 202→250]
Gu Xing stared at the attribute panel, his eyelid twitching.
"As expected..."
Most of the energy had been divided by Sovereign and Soul-devouring, causing a surge in spiritual power.
Meanwhile, the attributes of power, constitution, and speed, although improved, did not increase as significantly as the spiritual attribute.
"These two talents..."
Gu Xing rubbed his temples, feeling some headaches.
Given this trend, trying to achieve balanced enhancement in the future might require several times the resources...
Especially in Star Stones!
However.
His gaze fixed firmly on the two lines on the attribute panel.
[Talent: Sovereign (enhancing...), Soul-devouring (enhancing...)]
"This..."
His breath slightly froze.
Typically, once awakened, talents are fixed...
Yet Sovereign and Soul-devouring could actually continue to evolve?!
It should be noted that Sovereign and Soul-devouring were already extremely rare top-level talents.
And now... they were still growing?!
"Gulp."
Gu Xing unconsciously swallowed, his heart racing.
If these two talents continued to enhance...
To what extent would they become strong?
Realizing this, he suddenly stood up from the tub.
"Done! Isn’t it just some Star Stones? Tomorrow I’ll hunt Demons in the Demon Realm!"
Since these talents can devour so much...
Then let them feast!
...
Next day.
City of Chaos, exchange center.
Gu Xing stood at the counter, receiving the black token from the staff.
The token was cold to the touch, engraved with complex Demon Patterns, and a dim crystal embedded at its center.
This served as proof of the number of Demon Race kills!
"Name? Level?"
The staff asked without looking up.
"Gu Xing, Extraordinary Tier One."
"Oh, Extraordinary Tier... wait!"
The staff suddenly raised his head, his eyes widened:
"What did you say? Extraordinary Tier One?!"
His voice instinctively elevated, and the entire hall fell silent for a moment.
The next second, the surrounding crowd erupted.
"Extraordinary Tier One? Did I hear that right?"
"Is this kid crazy? Heading to the Demon Realm at that level?"
"Not sure which young master this is, treating the Demon Realm like child’s play! If he loses his life there, he’ll learn to behave!"
Mocking, disdainful, and sympathetic glances were cast his way.
However.
Gu Xing appeared oblivious, his gaze locked on the giant screen at the top of the hall.
[Points Exchange List]
[Low-Level Star Stone (10 points/each)]
[Intermediate Star Stone (1000 points/each)]
...
At the very top, a prominent line of golden text flashed.
[1,000,000 points: Special Secret Realm entry qualification ×1]
Special Secret Realm?
Under the staff’s explanation, Gu Xing understood the meaning of this Special Secret Realm.
Although it required a million points for redemption, it was worth the cost.
This secret realm had three layers.
Each time a layer was cleared, the participant’s attributes would be significantly enhanced within the realm.
Though it required one million points, the value was undeniable.
"Where does this secret realm originate?" Gu Xing asked curiously.
The staff shook his head.
"Before the City of Chaos was established, this secret realm already existed, and no one knows when it came to be."
Gu Xing thoughtfully nodded.
In hundreds of years, humans trying to unravel the mysteries of the Alternate Space is entirely impossible.
"Are you really sure you want to go to the Demon Realm alone?"
The staff couldn’t help but advise again, "There, the lowest level Demons are Extraordinary Level, and it’s easy to encounter Commander Level Demons if you’re not careful..."
He paused, speaking solemnly:
"Even a full team of High Tier Guardians suffers over thirty percent losses."
Implying...
A solo Extraordinary Tier One simply faces death!
Gu Xing smiled, placing the token into his pocket:
"Register, please."
Seeing his determination, the staff could only sigh as he completed the procedures.
Quickly, teams of Beast Masters boarded the Flying Guardian Beast to North of the North...
Which was the Demon Realm!
As Gu Xing boarded the Flying Guardian Beast solo, ridiculing remarks reached his ears.
"Bet or not? I wager he won’t survive the night!"
"Hahaha, I’ll up the ante! This kid won’t even leave a corpse behind!"
Gu Xing glanced at them indifferently, jotting them down in his mind.
...

chapters.title: Chapter 79: Kindness Is Foolishness!
chapters.content:
Chapter 79: Chapter 79: Kindness Is Foolishness!
Demon Realm boundary line.
The massive Flying Guardian Beast slowly descended, kicking up a cloud of sand and dust.
The Beast Master in charge of transportation stood atop the beast, his voice icy cold:
"Remember, once you enter the Demon Realm, life or death is on your own! I’ll be here to rendezvous in ten days..."
His sharp gaze swept over everyone, pausing on the lone Gu Xing.
"Miss the time, and you’ll end up as Demon Race fodder."
The crowd buzzed with unrest.
Gu Xing surveyed his surroundings and saw that, besides the three major Human Race forces, many Alien Race individuals were entering the Demon Realm.
Just then, a man from the Tiger Race quietly approached Gu Xing.
"Human, do you want to travel with us? We can ensure your safety."
Immediately, whispers of discussion erupted around them.
"This newbie is done for, targeted by Hu Li!"
"But the newbie doesn’t have any Star Stones, why would Hu Li want him?"
"Fool, no Star Stone but they can be bait!"
"Serves him right, an Extraordinary Tier One coming to the Demon Realm is a death wish! Serving as bait is a contribution at least!"
In the midst of the chatter, Gu Xing slowly turned his head to look at Hu Li approaching him.
The discussions reminded him of something.
This is the Demon Realm, no laws, no regulation, everything relies on strength.
Gu Xing summoned two Guardian Beasts.
As for strength...
His Guardian Beasts were the real power!
"Human, are you deaf? I’m asking you!"
Gu Xing did not respond, he merely raised an eyebrow and looked at him indifferently.
However, this disdainful attitude thoroughly enraged Hu Li.
"Damn it, you don’t know what’s good for you! Today, whether you go or not, you’re coming with me!"
Saying this, Hu Li suddenly reached out to grab Gu Xing’s shoulder.
But his hand hadn’t yet touched Gu Xing’s shoulder...
"Swish!"
A scarlet sword light flashed.
"Thud."
A severed arm fell to the ground.
Hu Li froze, glancing down at his now-empty arm, blood gushes out from the severed end.
"Ah—!"
The intense pain brought him back to his senses, and his eyes turned bright red.
A mere Extraordinary Tier One human, dared lay a hand on him?!
He roared savagely, turning to shout at his teammates:
"Kill him for me!"
"You’re dead! How dare you harm our Brother Hu!"
Five Tiger Race warriors charged in rage, with murderous intent.
Yet they had no idea what kind of monster they faced...
With All Attributes of 1400 points, and the Princess of the Angel Race with Blazing Angels blood!
Though these Tiger Race members were at Extraordinary Tier Seven or Eight, none of their attributes exceeded a mere thousand.
For Liu Li, it was all but a casual strike.
"Swish—"
The scarlet sword light flashed again.
"Thud, thud, thud..."
Five sturdy tiger arms fell to the ground simultaneously, blood splattering.
The entire scene went silent.
The crowd watching widened their eyes, faces filled with shock.
"Is this really Extraordinary Tier One? Hu Li’s team ranks top ten among us, and they were taken out in an instant?"
"Looking at that Angel’s ease, she probably didn’t even use half her strength..."
"No wonder he dared come to the Demon Realm alone!"
In the exclamations of the crowd, those who had previously mocked Gu Xing on the Flying Magical Beast turned visibly pale.​​
They had only just stepped into Extraordinary Tier Five, unable to match even the weakest of Hu Li’s team, let alone contend against the beast who effortlessly crushed them.
"Gulp—"
A few swallowed hard, cautiously shuffling away to escape.
However, just as they took the first step—
"Boom!"
A wall of thorns surged from the ground, instantly sealing all escape routes.
"Damn it!"
The few hastily summoned their Guardian Beasts, furiously launching various Elemental Attacks at the thorn wall.
Yet, in terms of Spiritual Attribute, Vera was even more terrifying than Liu Li!
"Bang bang bang!"
Their attacks landed on the thorns without causing the slightest ripple.
Meanwhile, Vera gracefully rose into the air, with an emerald Divine Ring appearing behind her.
She gently lifted her hand, and four walls of thorns shot up from the ground, trapping all present Human Race and Alien Race individuals inside.
"What... what does this mean?"
"Does he intend to take us all down? We number over a hundred!"
Amidst the fearful whispers, Gu Xing slowly spoke up:
"Everyone, I’m announcing two things now."
"First, all hand over your Star Stones... Yes, it’s a robbery."
"Second, people from Longxia Country are exempt and may leave now."
Vera, upon hearing this, immediately opened a passage in the thorn wall.
The Longxia Country Beast Masters, as if granted amnesty, quickly cast grateful looks at Gu Xing and swiftly evacuated the scene.
And those few who had mocked Gu Xing earlier from Longxia Country, tried to blend in with the crowd to slip away...
"Swish!"
Vines suddenly wrapped around them tightly, binding them.
"When I said people from Longxia Country, I didn’t mean you."
Their faces changed drastically, cold sweat forming on their foreheads:
"S-Sorry! We shouldn’t have been so mouthy, we really know we’re wrong!"
"Please, have mercy!"
They desperately pleaded, but clutched their Star Stone Bags tight at their waist...
For Beast Masters, Star Stones were life itself.
"Heh."
Gu Xing sneered, and Liu Li’s sword light flashed.
"Ah—!"
A few left arms fell to the ground.
"Not handing over?" Gu Xing narrowed his eyes, "Next time it’ll be the right hand."
They shivered in pain but did not dare to play tricks, trembling as they handed over all their Star Stones.
Only then did Gu Xing turn satisfied to the others:
"What about you? Make your choice."
Everyone present looked livid, but under the watchful eyes of those two beasts in the sky, they ultimately trembled as they handed over all their Star Stones.
"Very good."
Vera dispelled the thorn walls, allowing the crowd to flee in complete relief without a backward glance.
As for the Tiger Race members...ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Gu Xing curled a cold smile at the corner of his mouth.
Lives and Star Stones, he wanted them all!
As for whether those he spared would seek revenge?
He wasn’t worried in the slightest.
Vera possessed the ability to perceive malicious intent, none of those harboring ill will could escape!
Indeed, shortly after—
"Rustle rustle..."
Vines dragged back dozens of corpses, these were the ones who ran and intended revenge.
Seeing this, Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction.
He wasn’t some goody two-shoes!
With those who wished to retaliate, he wouldn’t leave a threat.
As for being ruthless...
In the Demon Realm, kindness is foolishness!
When he first arrived here, Vera warned him that a substantial number of people bore malice towards him.
Given that...
They would all be snuffed out in their cradles!
As for Star Stones?
Since he’s taking action, he might as well rob thoroughly!
Two talents and physical quality enhancements require this...
He is in short supply now!
These people ran into the lion’s den!
"Well done."
Gu Xing rubbed Vera’s head, and she contentedly squinted her eyes.
Subsequently, Vera controlled the vines to wrap up the bodies, and they headed towards the depths of the Demon Realm.
After all...
To hunt a sufficient number of Demon Race, how could one go without bait?

chapters.title: Chapter 80: 9,000 Spiritual Attribute Points! Comparable to a Cheat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 80: Chapter 80: 9,000 Spiritual Attribute Points! Comparable to a Cheat!
On the other side.
The atmosphere at the United Military Command Center was solemn.
Representatives of Longxia Country, the Council, the Holy See, and several strong members of the Alien Race were seated in order.
Heite, the Council representative, waved his hand, and a map of the Demon Realm unfolded on the screen on the military wall.
The densely packed red dots on the map represented the personnel from all parties who had entered the Demon Realm.
"I wonder how many Commander-level demons this batch of bait can lure out?"
Heite stroked his chin, his tone indifferent.
Upon hearing this, Laine, representing the Holy See, spoke with some displeasure:
"Heite, watch your words! What bait? They are clearly warriors executing a combat mission!"
But in the next moment, his tone softened again:
"However... the quality of this batch is indeed underwhelming, it will likely be hard to lure out High Tier demons."
The stronger the individuals entering the Demon Realm, the greater the likelihood of luring out High Tier demons.
And this batch entering the Demon Race...
Laine shook his head!
At this time, a few representatives of the Alien Race also spoke up:
"What kind of personnel has the Human Race recently sent into the Demon Realm?"
"Yes, I heard there’s even an Extraordinary Tier One among those you sent into the Demon Realm this time!"
"The Human Race has been becoming more and more complacent lately."
But at this point.
"Shut up!"
A cold female voice suddenly rang out, instantly silencing the entire command center.
All eyes were focused on the graceful silhouette standing with her back to everyone, staring at the map.
The representative of Longxia Country, Qin Chuxue!
She slowly turned around, her sharp gaze sweeping over everyone present:
"Using Low Tier Beast Masters and the lives of aliens as pawns, and you still find it appropriate to bicker here?"
Both the Human Race and Alien Race present hung their heads at Qin Chuxue’s words.
The reason was none other than...
Because this woman was too strong!
The undisputed strongest at the Commander Level!
After a while, a cautious representative of the Alien Race spoke up:
"Commander Qin... this was a result of a joint discussion among all races..."
Qin Chuxue coldly glanced at the person.
But she said nothing more.
Though she was strong, she could not change the result of this decision.
After all, the overall strength of the Demon Race far surpassed the combined forces of the Human Race and the major Alien Races.
Although it was unclear why the Demon Race had not launched a full-scale attack.
No race dared to let their guard down. After several discussions, they finally devised a cruel yet effective plan—
Using Star Stones as bait, Low Tier Beast Masters and aliens were driven into the Demon Realm to hunt demons.
When the number of Low Tier demons killed reached a certain level, High Tier demons would emerge for revenge.
At that point, the strong members of all races would act to slay the High Tier demons.
This plan was indeed highly effective.
So far, they had successfully hunted down dozens of Commander-level demons.
But the cost was equally severe—
Countless Low Tier Beast Masters and aliens were forever left in that dark land.
Qin Chuxue detested such methods, but could not deny their effectiveness.
If a Commander-level strong person personally entered the Demon Realm, those demons would immediately go into hiding without a trace.
Her icy gaze swept over the command room once more, finally returning to the flickering holographic map.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
It was at this moment that Qin Chuxue’s eyes suddenly froze!
On the map, a lone red dot was advancing deeply into the Demon Realm at an astonishing speed, leaving all other light points far behind.
Her eyebrows knitted tightly.
By normal standards, an Extraordinary Level’s exploration range in the Demon Realm was extremely limited, yet this red dot was nearing the limits of the Extraordinary Level’s exploration area!
Ahead... lay the domain of Commander-level demons!
"Get me some data on who this is!"
Pointing at the red dot, Qin Chuxue instructed a nearby staff member.
The tokens provided by the exchange hall not only recorded the number of demons killed but also stored personal information and served as temporary communication.
After retrieving the data, the staff member’s expression suddenly changed.
"Re-report... Chief, this person seems to be a student from the National Academy!"
Hearing this information, Qin Chuxue was not surprised.
The National Academy was the elite of Longxia Country; a student at Extraordinary Tier Ninth approaching the border of the Extraordinary region was quite normal.
However, even so, he could not be allowed to continue any further.
"Notify him to retreat, going further is something that an Extraordinary Tier Ninth cannot handle!"
However...
"Chief! B-but his registration data shows..."
"He is Extraordinary Tier One!"
"What?!"
Upon hearing this, Qin Chuxue’s pupils shrank!
Extraordinary Tier One?
It’s known that the deeper one delves into the Demon Realm, the stronger the demons encountered become.
And the position this person was at was almost entirely filled with Extraordinary Tier Ninth demons.
More importantly...
This person had managed to reach this position at just Extraordinary Tier One.
How strong must his talent be?!
Perhaps even more remarkable than her own!
After all, when she was at Extraordinary Tier One, she couldn’t achieve such feats.
Upon realizing this, Qin Chuxue immediately gave an order.
"You stay here and continue monitoring. If a Commander-level demon appears, act immediately! I’m heading to the Demon Realm right now!"
Upon issuing the order, Qin Chuxue promptly moved.
A second longer, and the talented junior would be in greater danger.
However.
Just as she was about to dash out of the command room—
"Chief!" The staff suddenly exclaimed, "Detected Commander-level demon energy response! Right near him!"
Qin Chuxue’s figure froze abruptly.
Then, with a boom, she vanished from where she stood.
...
...
Simultaneously.
Gu Xing stood with his hands behind his back, coldly observing the tide of demons surging towards him.
The number of demons here...
Far exceeded his expectations!
Additionally, the bodies of the Tiger Race and several humans served as bait.
These demons went completely berserk!
But this was exactly what he wanted.
In face of absolute power, numbers held no sway!
Especially with...
Vera’s attributes under the enhancement of the Elf Monarchy skill, practically indistinguishable from an external cheat!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Seven]
[Power: 1310]
[Constitution: 1320]
[Spirit: 3030→9090]
[Speed: 1300]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy (Increases Spiritual Attribute by 300%), Natural Domain (Initial)]
These data points made even Gu Xing feel pity for the demons.
Even the Demon Monarch-level demons of Extraordinary Tier Ninth had attributes only around 2000 points.
And the opponent they faced...
Was the Earth’s favored with a Spiritual Attribute reaching 9000 points and skills that could refresh...
Natural Spirit!
"Natural Lament!"
Vera parted her red lips, and a surge of violent Spiritual Power erupted.
In an instant—
"Boom!"
The entire world seemed to freeze.
A silver-white Thunder Dragon descended from the sky; wherever it passed, demons disintegrated into ashes without even a scream.
The ground cracked, the sky trembled.
With just one strike, all demons within a thousand meters were obliterated!
This area, under Vera’s power, was forcibly erased down to a new layer of the earth’s surface!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 81: The Method to Break Through to Monarch Level!
chapters.content:
Chapter 81: Chapter 81: The Method to Break Through to Monarch Level!
It was precisely this strike...
Directly propelled Vera to the peak of the Extraordinary Level.
Extraordinary Tier Nine!
Only one step away from Commander Level!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 1510]
[Constitution: 1520]
[Spirit: 3430]
[Speed: 1500]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy (Enhances Spiritual Attribute by 300%), Natural Domain (Basic)]
Having successfully advanced to Extraordinary Tier Nine, Vera immediately turned her head to look at Liu Li, shooting her a provocative glance.
She’s in charge now!
Leveraging the advantage of her group attack skills, she single-handedly took on most of the Demon Race on the battlefield.
This also caused...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Seven]
[Power: 2620]
[Constitution: 2610]
[Spirit: 2600]New ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄhapters are published on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
[Speed: 2630]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain (Basic)]
Looking at Liu Li, still stuck at Extraordinary Tier Seven...​
Vera floated mid-air, hands on her hips, with a smug expression on her little face.
She’s feeling high!
"A mere angel..."
Before she finished her sentence——
"Shush!"
A silver light flashed, and Liu Li was already in front of Vera, her six wings unfurled:
"What did you say?"
Vera instantly froze.
She’s being suppressed!
Despite her spiritual attribute being as high as 3400 points, Liu Li’s frightening figure of all attributes 2600 points...
In a real fight, this fragile mage would definitely be ground into the dirt!
"I, I meant..."
Vera decisively surrendered.
"Angel Liu Li and the master are a perfect match!"
"Hmm."
Liu Li snorted softly, satisfied enough with this answer.
But then, a sense of urgency surged within her——
Even this little green tea spirit has reached Extraordinary Tier Nine, how can she fall behind?
But the problem is...
Vera’s recent "Natural Lament" practically cleared out all the Demon Race within a kilometer radius!
It’s a bit troublesome now to find Demon Race to level up!
While Liu Li was secretly anxious——
"Boom!"
A sudden, earth-shaking sound came from afar!
A pitch-black demonic qi approached like lightning!
In the blink of an eye, a tall demon with wings on its back appeared not far from the three.
Gu Xing’s pupils slightly shrank, this demon’s aura...
Far more terrifying than the previous Extraordinary Level demons!
He immediately checked the opponent’s information...
[Winged Demon]
[Level: Commander Tier Three]
[Talent: Demon Monarch (equivalent to Epic Talent)]
[Power: 5300]
[Constitution: 5700]
[Spirit: 5000]
[Speed: 6000]
[Domain: Sky Domain, Demon Wings Protection, Wind Blade Storm]
Looking at the attribute panel of the demon before him, a trace of solemnity flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.​​
A Commander Level demon is an entirely different concept from an Extraordinary Level!
All attributes exceed 5000 points, especially the Speed Attribute which is as high as 6000!
The most troublesome part——
​Domain Power!​​
Though Liu Li and Vera both possess the ability to initiate domains, their domains are still at the basic stage.
But the "Sky Domain" of the Winged Demon before them is clearly in perfect form!
"This is trouble..."
Gu Xing’s mind raced.
It’s impossible to escape now——
Even if Liu Li activated her Blazing Angel Form, she couldn’t possibly match the speed of this Winged Demon.
Moreover, she’d have to take him along, this "burden"!
The Winged Demon looked down at Gu Xing condescendingly, cold intent piercing from its pitch-black eyes:
"Human, having killed so many demons, it’s time to pay the price."
It had long since noticed this human——
Watching him slaughter demons along the way, cultivating his Guardian Beast to Extraordinary Tier Nine!
One has to admit, he’s truly a talent.
At the Extraordinary Level, probably even the Demon King isn’t his match.
But...
Commander Level and Extraordinary Level are worlds apart!
The Winged Demon grinned savagely, spreading its wings, "Killing you would surely make humans feel pained, right?"
Liu Li and Vera simultaneously positioned themselves in front of Gu Xing.
The demon before them is the strongest enemy they’ve ever faced!
"Master! Be careful later!"
Liu Li’s gaze fixated on the Winged Demon, battle intent boiling.
Gu Xing nodded emphatically.
Though the difference in power is evident, fear was nowhere to be found in his eyes——
Purely comparing attributes, the two Guardian Beasts are by no means inferior!
The key is...
Can the basic domain withstand a complete Sky Domain?
"Liu Li, Celestial Fire Domain!"
"Vera, Natural Domain!"
With Gu Xing’s command——
"Boom!"
Scorching white flames and resplendent emerald divine light burst simultaneously, colliding fiercely with the pitch-black demonic qi!
...
Elsewhere.
The rapidly flying figure of Qin Chuxue suddenly halted!​
"Human, no rush to leave, huh~"
A voice, lazy yet dangerous, came from the void.
Qin Chuxue’s pupils contracted rapidly, unleashing her domain power instantly!
"Shush——"
The space ahead rippled like water, revealing a lean figure slowly.
Apart from the pitch-black demonic qi entwining its body, this demon looked indistinguishably human!
"Monarch Level..."
Qin Chuxue’s red lips parted slightly, her voice icy as a blade.
"Allow me to introduce myself~" the demon graciously made a gentleman’s bow, "Demon King Sri Lanka, it’s a pleasure to meet such a beautiful lady as yourself."
Though spoken kindly, the scarlet eyes conveyed nothing but bone-chilling murderous intent!
"Clang——"
Without hesitation, Qin Chuxue summoned her Guardian Beast——
It turned out to be a long, silver-white sword in its entirety!
"Interesting~" Sri Lanka squinted, "Encountering a Monarch Level demon in the Demon Realm, and you choose not to flee?"
"Flee?"
Qin Chuxue sneered, gently caressing the sword.
Yet her eyes showed no trace of fear.
Half a year ago, she had already achieved the peak of Commander Level, and had not gone to the Holy Pool to break through...
Just for the Monarch Level demon!
Commander Level Beast Masters have two ways to break through to Monarch Level.
One is breaking through to Monarch Level using the potent energy from the Holy Pool.
The other is elevating to Monarch Level by slaying Monarch Level demons.
Though both methods enable one to break through to Monarch Level, they differ fundamentally.
The first method allows oneself to break through to Monarch Level, but keeps the Guardian Beast perpetually fixed at Commander Level.
Thus, those who break through to Monarch Level through the first method are termed false Monarchs.
Whereas the second method involves slaying Monarch Level demons at the Commander Level, breaking through to Monarch Level.
Though unbelievably challenging, success ensures...
A true Monarch Level!
Among hundreds of Monarch Level warriors in Longxia Country, fewer than ten reached it via demon slaying!​​
For Qin Chuxue——
If you’re going to do it, do it to the extreme!
She preferred to wait at Commander Level for half a year, rather than choose the shortcut breakthrough.
"Qing Li, are you ready?"
The long sword in hand emitted a clear hum, its blade emanating an awe-inspiring cold light.
The reason she held the title of the top Commander was entirely due to her unique "Sword Heart" talent!
Unlike other Beast Masters——
She is the strongest sword!
"Monarch Level..."
Qin Chuxue’s gaze flickered like lightning as she stared at Sri Lanka.
"Is it that strong?!"
Before the words settled——
"Zing!"
A dazzling sword light sliced through the sky!
Man and sword united, attributes compounded!
This strike was so swift it warped the very space around it!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 82: Qin Chuxue! Monarch Level!
chapters.content:
Chapter 82: Chapter 82: Qin Chuxue! Monarch Level!
Originally, Sri Lanka thought that the ambush this time was bound to succeed.
After all, a King Level Demon King personally took action.
How could it possibly fail?
However.
At the instant he saw this human woman draw her sword, he knew clearly...
He was wrong!
And terribly wrong!
The momentum of Qin Chuxue attacking him was no different from that of a true King Level!
"Demon Shield!"
In haste, he frantically mobilized his Domain Power, forming a pitch-black giant shield in front of him.
"Hiss——"
Where the sword’s edge passed, the Demon Shield was easily sliced through like tofu!
Sri Lanka twisted desperately to dodge, the sword’s edge grazing his neck and drawing a spray of pitch-black Demon Blood!
"Damn it!"Thɪs ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
He appeared a hundred meters away, still shaken, the elegance on his face replaced by ferocity and rage.
By a hair’s breadth...
He nearly got decapitated by this human’s sword!
He slowly raised his hand to touch his neck, the fury in his eyes blazing forth.
A mere Commander Level human...
Almost killed him!
"Human, you’re courting death!"
He suddenly clasped his hands together...
"Boom!"
The pitch-black Domain expanded instantly, completely enveloping Qin Chuxue!
The greatest difference between Commander Level and King Level is the control over the Domain.
If Commander Level is but a shallow application of the Domain.
Then King Level...
Is complete mastery over the Domain.
Watching Qin Chuxue trapped in the pitch-black Demon Realm, Sri Lanka’s lips curled into a cruel smile.
Indeed, he was careless just now——
He never thought this woman’s strength would be so close to King Level!
But now...
The murderous intent in his eyes boiled over!
Such a genius must be snuffed out!
In the center of the Domain, Qin Chuxue’s expression was calm.
She slowly unfolded the Sword Domain——
The azure Sword Domain amid the overwhelming Demonic Qi was like a lone boat amidst raging waves, ready to capsize at any moment.
When choosing this path of breakthrough, she had already anticipated the worst-case scenario.
Taking on a King Level while being at Commander Level was already a defiance of the heavens.
And the enemy before her...
"King Tier Three, huh..."
She gripped her long sword, her gaze like ice.
Even more troublesome than expected!
The only thing to be glad about was that her various Attributes could match this Demon King.
The real gap lay only in the Domain!
"Only one chance..."
Her gaze grew colder, a resolution forming in her heart——
To detonate the Sword Domain and forcibly break open the Demon King Domain!
And then...
One lethal strike!
But if she missed...
Without the shelter of the Domain, she would lose all ability to resist.
She would be like a lamb to the slaughter before this King Level Demon King!
"Hoo——"
She held her breath, seeking that one opportunity.
On the other side, Sri Lanka completely relaxed.
Within the King Domain, he was the absolute master!
Unless this human’s Domain was stronger than his!
However...
A Commander Level Domain surpassing a King Tier Three Demon King—it’s impossible.
Sri Lanka looked down at the blue Sword Domain tottering amidst the Demonic Qi, confident of his victory.
"Human, I acknowledge your strength. If it were an ordinary Demon King, perhaps they would indeed fall by your hand."
Seeing Qin Chuxue unmoved, he shifted his tone:
"Do you want to know why I personally intercepted you?"
Hearing this, Qin Chuxue’s gaze flickered.
It was indeed rather unusual!
Previously, not to mention King Level.
Even Commander Level would not confront them head-on.
Seeing Qin Chuxue’s interest, Sri Lanka slowly spoke:
"Your Human Race is truly interesting, sending real geniuses into the Demon Realm."
"With Extraordinary Tier One capable of sweeping through the Extraordinary Level of my race! Such a monstrous talent, you even dare use as bait?"
"But it’s precisely such a genius, that’s worth my intervening!"
"Once I kill you, as for that Extraordinary Level human, do you think... he can contend with the Commander Level of the Demon Race?"
As he said this, a cruel smile played on Sri Lanka’s lips.
It’s known that the gap between Extraordinary Level and Commander Level is even greater than the gap between Commander Level and King Level.
If it’s possible for a Commander Level to defeat a King Level!
Then an Extraordinary Level defeating a Commander Level is mere fantasy!
Whether one possesses a Domain makes a world of difference!
In resolving two human geniuses at once, a touch of joy appeared on Sri Lanka’s face!
When Qin Chuxue heard this, her eyes reflected some understanding.
For Gu Xing, whose Talent may not lose to hers, or may even surpass her...
Why didn’t the National Academy notify her before sending him to the Demon Realm?
This is most unreasonable!
It seems someone deliberately arranged this!
But now, there’s no time to ponder such matters...
She only hoped that talent could hold on!
"Having said so much, are you ready to die!"
Sri Lanka also lost interest in toying with Qin Chuxue, preparing to deliver the final blow to this human.
At this moment, Qin Chuxue’s eyes focused sharply.
She had found her opportunity!
When Sri Lanka struck, that was when the Demon King Domain was the most vulnerable!
"Now’s the time!"
She mobilized her Domain with all her might.
Qin Chuxue’s eyes shone with a cold light, as Spiritual Power surged madly within her.
This was the make-or-break moment!
"Sword Domain, explode!"
The azure Domain abruptly contracted, then expanded explosively like a starburst.
"Boom!"
The violent Sword Qi transformed into a stream of light, tearing a rift in the Demon King Domain.
Blood trickled from the corner of Qin Chuxue’s mouth, yet she didn’t even frown.
The backlash from the Domain’s self-destruction would bring unbearable pain to a common Beast Master, yet she seemed incapable of feeling pain.
She held the Qingli Sword across her chest, the blade humming clearly.
Now, there was no longer any barrier between her and the Demon King.
"Sword Flash!"
In a split second, Qin Chuxue became a dazzling sword of light, charging straight at Sri Lanka.
This was her most potent move, and also her final killing strike!
When Sri Lanka felt the Domain being torn open by Qin Chuxue, he sensed something amiss.
Now, seeing Qin Chuxue rush towards him like a blue lightning bolt, a glint of terror flashed in his eyes.
Death loomed!
Without a moment’s hesitation.
He quickly controlled the Demon King Domain to close up, patching the gap before him.
Only...
It was too late!
Qin Chuxue’s Basic Attributes were on par with his; earlier, it was only the Domain’s advantage that allowed him to suppress her.
And now——
With the Demon King Domain forcibly torn, the two stood on equal footing.
"Swish!"
The sword light flashed like lightning, vanishing in an instant.
Sri Lanka only felt a piercing chill at his neck, the scene before him suddenly spinning.
In the last moment before his consciousness faded, he saw...
His headless body slowly kneeling, the spraying Demon Blood turning the ground pitch black.
The King Tier Three Demon King had fallen!
"Buzz——"
After slaying Sri Lanka, the aura around Qin Chuxue suddenly fluctuated violently, a new power awakening within her.
She had now taken the final step!
The last thread of Commander Level...
Completely obliterated by her!
And Longxia Country was soon to have another true King Level!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 83: Weakened? So What!
chapters.content:
Chapter 83: Chapter 83: Weakened? So What!
Meanwhile, high above the Demon Realm.
A towering figure stood with hands behind his back, his sharp gaze piercing through the clouds, silently watching the battlefield below.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
He was the person in charge of the Northern Military Region, Lei Zhan!
"It’s done."
Lei Zhan’s tensed muscles slightly relaxed, a hint of a smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
Qin Chuxue had been stuck at the peak of Commander Level for too long!
When Long Zhenguo delivered the news that Gu Xing was about to arrive in the Northern Territory, a bold plan formed in his mind:
Use this genius as bait to lure out Monarch Level demons!
Assist Qin Chuxue in reaching the pinnacle of Monarch Level!
Although the success rate was less than fifty percent...
But at this moment, seeing that monarch aura rising to the sky, he knew...
He had won the gamble!
Longxia Country, with another Monarch Level combat power!
His plan had succeeded, and Gu Xing’s mission as bait was accomplished.
Lei Zhan was about to lend a helping hand...
After all, Extraordinary Level against Commander Level was an impossible task.
However, just as he was about to act, his pupils suddenly contracted!
"This is..."
He looked incredulously at the center of the battlefield——
He was prepared to help Gu Xing escape.
The two guardian beasts of that young man...
Why could they use domains?!
...
At this moment.
Liu Li and Vera simultaneously activated their domains.
The blazing Celestial Fire Domain and the vibrant Natural Domain instantly enveloped the Winged Demon!
"What?!"
The Winged Demon’s pupils shrank suddenly, looking at the scene before him in disbelief——
This human wasn’t at an Extraordinary Level?
How could he possess domains?!
Its body began to tremble involuntarily.
Only domain can counter domain!
Without any hesitation, it used its own Sky Domain.
The pitch-black Sky Domain abruptly burst forth, brutally pushing back the Celestial Fire and Natural Domains!
Under the pressure of the Sky Domain, the area occupied by the Celestial Fire Domain and Natural Domain shrank to half its original size.
Gu Xing frowned slightly upon seeing this.
It seems that even though the two guardian beasts could use domains, there was still a certain gap compared to a true domain.
However, just how big is this gap?
"Vera, unleash the Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
With Gu Xing’s command, Vera acted without hesitation.
The Thunder Dragon roared as it charged into the Sky Domain, but it dissipated instantly upon touching the Winged Demon.
This strike was not in vain...
A spark of brilliance flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes, finally grasping the suppression effect of the opponent’s domain!
With the support of the Celestial Fire and Natural Domains, the guardian beast’s attack power was only weakened by 50%.
This meant that Vera’s Spiritual Attribute of 3400 points could still exert 1700 points of actual combat power!
This discovery brought a sense of relief to Gu Xing’s heart.
Normally, an attack from an Extraordinary Level against Commander Level, entering the domain, would be reduced by at least more than 90%.
This is one of the reasons why Commander Level is the core combat power of a race.
No matter how many Extraordinary Levels, under Domain Suppression, they are like ants!
The two are completely on different levels.
And now...
Thanks to the domains of the two guardian beasts, the gap between Extraordinary Level and Commander Level has been greatly narrowed.
"Humans are ultimately just ants at the Extraordinary Level!"
After witnessing Vera’s attacking power, the Winged Demon finally relaxed, a hint of mockery flashing in its eyes.
Initially, seeing the two guardian beasts wield domains, it had been greatly frightened!
After all, in terms of attributes alone...
The strength exhibited by the two guardian beasts was even more terrifying than its own at Commander Level!
It had witnessed with wide eyes as those Extraordinary Level demons were easily slaughtered by the two guardian beasts!
Upon first seeing the two guardian beasts wield domains, it almost wanted to turn and run.
After all, besides the domain, compared to the two guardian beasts...
It had no advantage at all!
But now...
Seeing the Thunder Dragon that didn’t even make a ripple, the Winged Demon finally put its mind at ease.
It seems that the domains of those two guardian beasts are just for show!
"Human, I will let you understand... what it means to be better off dead!"
Thinking about being intimidated by a human of Extraordinary Level just now, the Winged Demon burned with violent rage.
This humiliation must be washed away in the cruelest manner!
However, it didn’t notice.
Gu Xing looked at it without a trace of fear, but with a hint of eager anticipation!
Hearing the demon race wanting to make him better off dead, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
This demon race seemed to think it was in control?!
Then let him shatter its illusion!
"Soul-devouring!"
Scarlet spiritual power instantly enveloped the two guardian beasts!
Weakened by 50%?
So what!
He just needed to make up for it!
"Liu Li, Doomsday Angel Form!"
"Vera, activate Elf Monarchy!"
With Gu Xing’s command.
Golden-red flames instantly swept out from Liu Li’s body surface, in the Winged Demon’s incredulous gaze.
Ten wings gradually solidified with the burning of Red Flame!
And with the appearance of ten wings, the golden-red flames on Liu Li’s body surface gradually converted to golden.
Ten-winged Blazing Angels!
This was the first time Liu Li wielded this form since acquiring it!
Under the support of this form, the extraordinary nature of Myth Level angels began to truly manifest.
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Seven]
[Power: 2620→15720]
[Constitution: 2610→15660]
[Spirit: 2600→15600]
[Speed: 2630→15780]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
Liu Li’s attributes exceeded 15000 points!
Even with a 50% reduction from the Sky Domain.
Liu Li’s average attributes still approached 8000 points!
And feeling the momentum radiating from that Ten-winged Angel, the Winged Demon was completely frozen!
This momentum seemed to surpass his by more than double!
It gulped with difficulty.
Looking at the Sky Domain surrounding him, he felt for the first time that the domain couldn’t bring him even a shred of security!
And what chilled his heart even more...
Besides this Ten-winged Angel...
There seemed to be an even more overpowered Elf!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 3020]
[Constitution: 3040]
[Spirit: 3430→20580]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy (boosts Spiritual Attribute by 300%), Natural Domain (beginning)]
Under the enhancement of Soul Devouring Talent and Elf Monarchy, Vera’s Spiritual Attribute directly broke through the twenty-thousand mark!
With the Spiritual Attribute reaching this level, Vera merely hovered in the air.
The air around her began to slightly distort!
The Winged Demon watched the two guardian beasts unleash their full force...
It regretted!
It regretted volunteering to blockade this Extraordinary Level human race!
Even if he were to confront Commander Level Beast Masters, he would be willing.
But...
There was no medicine for regret in the world!
Above the battlefield!
Lei Zhan watched the aura emanating from the two guardian beasts.
The corner of his mouth kept twitching!
Is Gu Xing human?
Even though he learned from Long Zhenguo that Gu Xing’s two guardian beasts were Myth Level!
But...
Even Myth Level guardian beasts shouldn’t reveal the aura of a High Tier Commander at Extraordinary Tier Nine!
Given the strength this young man is displaying now, if he successfully advances to Commander Level...
He’s poised to directly become an un-crowned King of Commander Level!
Even some of the weaker Monarch Level...
May not be his match!
Earlier, he was prepared to help Gu Xing deal with this Commander Level demon race, but now...
He felt sorry for this demon race!
Truly pitiful!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 84: Max Out! Absolutely Max Out!
chapters.content:
Chapter 84: Chapter 84: Max Out! Absolutely Max Out!
Center of the battlefield.
Three Domains rival each other.
The Sky Domain still holds the upper hand.
The pitch-black Sky Domain remained dominant, but the arrogance had vanished from the Winged Demon’s face, replaced by an unmistakable terror.
Gu Xing’s gaze casually swept across the Winged Demon, slowly giving the order...
"Vera, Bone-Eroding Vine Sea!"
Vera’s level had already advanced to Extraordinary Tier Nine, while Liu Li’s level was only at Extraordinary Tier Seven.
Therefore, the final blow to this Demon Race must be left to Liu Li!
But before that...
We must not let the prey escape!
"Rumble——"
The ground trembled, countless massive vines burst forth from the earth, spreading like a tide, covering the entire Sky Domain in an instant!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the
Even more terrifying, these vines, glowing with a ghastly green light, began slowly infiltrating the Domain, pressing closer to the Winged Demon step by step!
"No!"
The Winged Demon’s pupils contracted sharply, wings flaring open behind him!
"Wind Blade Storm!"
He frantically vibrated his wings, sending countless sharp wind blades whistling out, fiercely slashing at the approaching vines.
However——
"Ting ting ting!"
The wind blades struck the vines but couldn’t leave even a trace!
The Bone-Eroding Vine Sea, driven by Vera’s twenty thousand points of Spiritual Attribute, even when weakened by 50% by the Domain...
It still wasn’t something the Winged Demon could compete with.
"This is impossible..."
The Winged Demon’s voice began to tremble, the pride of a Commander Level being collapsing in this instant.
Even his worldview started to crumble!
"You’re not even at the Extraordinary Level!" He hysterically pointed at Gu Xing, "You are a Commander Level! You must be!"
Gu Xing simply spread his hands lightly, a smile forming at the corners of his mouth.
This gesture became the last straw that broke the camel’s back——
"You are a Commander Level! You tricked me!"
The Winged Demon shook his head frantically, the battle intent in his eyes already replaced by fear.
The Demon Race is bloodthirsty, but they also value their lives!
As he watched the deathly vines inch closer, only one thought remained in his mind——
Escape!
He must escape!
The Winged Demon’s wings flapped wildly, but in the moment he turned to flee, he froze...
From every direction, the Bone-Eroding Vines wove into a Heaven and Earth Net!
He gazed around in terror, discovering...
The sky above, not yet sealed, seemed to hold a glimmer of hope!
There was still a chance!
He could escape!
Hope flared bright in his eyes, and he shot up like an arrow!
But...
The Angel Race is undoubtedly the rulers of the sky!
Moreover...
In the Doomsday Angel state, Liu Li’s attributes were nearly twice that of the Winged Demon.
The Winged Demon had just prepared to move when a golden stream of light streaked across the sky, blocking his path.
A Ten-winged Blazing Angel hovered in the air, Holy Flame swirling on the sword’s edge.
In the face of the Demon Race, Liu Li would show no mercy.
In the Winged Demon’s eyes filled with despair, Liu Li slowly raised the sword in her hand.
The sword tip pointed directly at him!
The Winged Demon instinctively attempted to retaliate.
Only...
Liu Li, at that moment, was faster than him.
In his eyes, filled with terror, a golden meteor hurtled towards him.
The Sky Domain he prided himself on posed no hindrance in front of this golden figure.
"Puff!"
The moment the Holy Sword pierced him, the Winged Demon’s pupils contracted sharply.
He looked down incredulously, watching the golden flames spread from the wound.
As he brushed past the Ten-winged Blazing Angel, the Winged Demon finally confirmed one truth:
The being that pierced his chest was actually an Extraordinary Level Angel!
Extraordinary Level hunting Commander Level...
He used his last ounce of strength to turn his head, trying to once again discern the appearance of that human Beast Master.
Only...
The golden flames of the Ten-winged Blazing Angel gave him no chance!
In an instant, his shattered body turned into sparks, dissipating into the sky and earth.
Above the Northern Battlefield, the aura of this Commander Level...
was thus extinguished!
At the edge of the battlefield.
Qin Chuxue, rushing in haste, witnessed this scene firsthand.
Her rapidly advancing body abruptly halted!
Having just slain a Monarch Level Demon Race, she didn’t even take time to stabilize her realm breakthrough but rushed against all odds to rescue.
Yet this scene before her——
Made her pupils contract sharply!
The Extraordinary Level junior, actually confronting a Commander Level Winged Demon on his own!
What shocked her even more was...
She watched as Gu Xing’s two Guardian Beasts coordinated seamlessly, ultimately achieving the kill by the Ten-winged Angel.
Extraordinary reverse slash Commander!
In the Beast Taming World, this is regarded as absolutely impossible, now unfolding genuinely before her eyes!
In the sky above the battlefield.
Lei Zhan’s burly body suddenly shuddered, nearly falling from the clouds.
Previously seeing Gu Xing’s two Guardian Beasts unlock Domains, he had already tried to overestimate Gu Xing’s strength...
He could safely escape from the Winged Demon’s clutches!
Going further, he could contend with the Winged Demon on equal footing!
Such a conjecture was already bold enough!
If someone had told him anyone could match a Commander Level Demon Race at an Extraordinary Level,
he would have surely called that person insane.
Extraordinary Level and Commander Level, how can they be compared?
But now...
Gazing, wide-eyed, as Gu Xing almost effortlessly vanquished that Commander Level Winged Demon.
Lei Zhan’s worldview was overturned!
And Gu Xing at this moment was completely unaware that two Monarch Levels had been shocked into disarray by his recent actions.
At this moment, his attention was solely focused on Liu Li.
After slaying this Commander Level Winged Demon, Liu Li successfully advanced to Extraordinary Tier Nine.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 3020]
[Constitution: 3010]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 3030]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
All attributes reaching 3000 points!
Now, even in just the Blazing Angel Form, Liu Li’s attributes could match those of the earlier Winged Demon.
Gu Xing evaluated the strength of his two Guardian Beasts quietly.
Facing a Commander Low Tier Demon Race, the two Guardian Beasts undoubtedly had the strength to face them head-on.
But he quickly calmed down...
Domain Suppression would intensify with the rise in the Demon Race Level.
If encountering high-tier Demons, where suppression on the two Guardian Beasts reaches over 80%...
Even then, activating the Soul Devouring Talent might not secure victory!
In summary.
Currently, he should be capable of fighting low-tier Commander Level Demons.
However, if the level is higher, it might pose some difficulty.
Knowing this, Gu Xing also realized that he must awaken his Domain as soon as possible!
Now, with both Guardian Beasts advancing to Extraordinary Tier Nine.
This also led to...
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angel, Natural Spirit]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 250]
[Constitution: 250]
[Spirit: 1634]
[Speed: 250]
His Spiritual Attribute, influenced by the two Guardian Beasts, had already surpassed a thousand.
But the other attributes...
Are tough to comment on!
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
It seems the next goal is to enhance the other attributes.
However....
According to common logic, reaching 1000 points in all attributes should allow an attempt to break through to Commander Level.
But that would be the weakest of Commander Level Beast Masters!
And he could not be satisfied with just that!
How could he justify this to his two Myth Level Guardian Beasts?!
Max it out!
He silently set a small goal for himself!
To max out all attributes at the Extraordinary Level!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 85: First-class Honor Medal? That’s Too Stingy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 85: Chapter 85: First-class Honor Medal? That’s Too Stingy!
When Gu Xing snapped back to reality, he realized...
At some point, a figure in a straight military uniform had appeared at the edge of the battlefield.
He was about to speak, but his vision blurred!
"Tap."
The soft sound of military boots landed right beside him.
Gu Xing looked at the woman who suddenly appeared in front of him, his gaze unconsciously resting on the gleaming star on her shoulder.
Even more startling to him was that momentary movement...
She was definitely Monarch Level!
"Senior! You..."
"Qin Chuxue, you can just call me Senior Sister!"
Qin Chuxue replied casually, her gaze fixed on the two Guardian Beasts.
The Qing Li she contracted was Demigod Level, yet...
Even at the Extraordinary Level, Qing Li’s capabilities couldn’t match the two Guardian Beasts by her junior’s side.
This means...
These two Guardian Beasts must exceed Demigod Level!
And exceeding Demigod Level...
Divine Level!
Her junior possessing two Divine Level Guardian Beasts...
Qin Chuxue’s lips twitched uncontrollably.
Upon hearing the name Qin Chuxue, Gu Xing was also taken aback.
It’s been only a month since leaving the National Academy.
He had not forgotten the numerous stories about this Senior Sister at the Academy.
Even his ability to obtain two Divine Level materials from the National Treasure Vault...
was because he broke her records!
"Hello, Senior Sister!"
Gu Xing immediately played along.
A little obedience never hurts.
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Qin Chuxue withdrew her gaze from the two Guardian Beasts and turned to him.
Originally having many questions, but seeing the surrounding Demonic Qi...
This was not the place for a conversation!
Her red lips parted lightly:
"Let’s head back to the Northern Territory, we’re too close to the Commander Level Demon Realm here."
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing nodded.
Both of his Guardian Beasts have reached the Extraordinary Tier Ninth.
Staying here to hunt the Demon Race only serves one function...
Which is to earn points for exchanging Star Stones!
However, he had just slain a Commander Level Demon Race...
The value for a Commander Level Demon Race isn’t listed in the exchange hall.
But likely, the points he can earn should be substantial!
"Alright, Senior Sister!"
In the skies.
Lei Zhan watched the direction Gu Xing and Qin Chuxue departed.
After pondering for a while, he chose not to reveal himself.
With Gu Xing’s talent, it won’t be long before his level ascends to Commander Level.
By then, naturally, there will be an opportunity to meet.
Just, however...
He rubbed his chin, suddenly let out a cold laugh:
"Wei Yuan, oh Wei Yuan, I wondered why you insisted on helping this kid apply for the First-class Honor Medal! Turns out you wanted to trick this kid into the Southern Military Region!"
Truly a cunning fox!
"But..."
"What you can offer, can’t the Northern Military Region also offer?"
Lei Zhan’s figure transformed into lightning, heading straight for the Northern Territory.
Gu Xing had slain a Commander Level Demon Race with his Extraordinary Level, so he could use this as a pretext to bond with Gu Xing.
First-class Honor Medal?
Too modest!
...
Northern Territory.
In a courtyard within the City of Chaos.
Fei Yue sat on the window sill, swinging her pale little feet, lightly biting a candied hawthorn.The source of thɪs content is ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
"Sister, I saw that human come to the Northern Territory earlier!"
"Didn’t you already make your name known? Why hasn’t he come to find us yet?"
Generally speaking, Extraordinary Level Beast Masters would pick out their beasts at this stage.
After all, wait until they truly break through to Commander Level to find their Contracted Beast...
It’s a bit too late!
Upon hearing her sister’s words, Qing Shuang did not lift her head.
Qing Shuang’s fingertips trembled lightly on the strings, but the tone remained steady:
"Yue, he hasn’t broken through to Commander Level, so it’s normal he hasn’t come for a third beast!"
"But as long as he wants to find his beast in the City of Chaos, he’ll surely come to find us!"
Fei Yue pouted, forgetting to bite the candied hawthorn.
Her sister spoke lightly, but who knew if the human already fancied another beast?
If that human broke through to Commander Level and contracted his own beast, wouldn’t her sister lose her chance?
Thinking of this, Fei Yue couldn’t sit still!
"No way!"
Fei Yue suddenly leaped off the window sill, bare feet landing.
She had to prevent such a situation.
If nothing else, she had to catch his eye!
But just as Fei Yue took half a step, the courtyard door suddenly echoed with a light knock.
"Is Miss Qing Shuang available? A Monarch Level Beast Master wants to visit you!"
The music abruptly halted.
These days, many Beast Masters have come to visit her.
Not only Extraordinary Level but also numerous Commander Level Beast Masters.
But their goal was singular...
To have her as their Contracted Beast!
Yet for those Beast Masters, she refused each and didn’t see a single one!
However...
Now a Monarch Level Beast Master has appeared.
She pondered for a while and decided to at least meet him.
After all, a Monarch Level Beast Master is considered among the Northern Territory’s top combatants.
She and her sister intend to stay in the Northern Territory, so she should show face to this human.
She slowly got up, her gaze turning to her sister.
Fei Yue shook her head, "Sister, I’m not going!"
She had no interest in meeting other humans.
Moreover, she needs to keep an eye on that human to prevent him from contracting other beasts.
She had no time for idle chit-chat with other humans.
Seeing this, Qing Shuang didn’t insist.
After all, the human came for her.
At this moment.
In the small courtyard’s reception hall.
Monarch Level Beast Master Wang Yu sipped a cup of tea, quietly awaiting.
Although Wang Yu wasn’t anxious, the Commander Level Beast Master beside him was restless.
"Brother Yu, this Ghost Race is so inconsiderate!"
"Having you wait here... no matter how good this Ghost Race’s talent is, they shouldn’t be this arrogant."
Wang Yu raised his hand to stop, his voice filled with calm:
"No worries!"
"The City of Chaos’s acknowledged strongest Guardian Beast naturally has reason for pride."
Upon hearing this, the Commander Level Beast Master changed his tone instantly:
"Hehe, indeed!"
"Only Brother Yu is suitable for her... but I’m still a bit confused about why you insist on picking an Extraordinary Level Beast?"
Upon hearing this, Wang Yu’s lips curved, recalling the scene from the arena that day.
He had been present.
Witnessed Qing Shuang effortlessly dominating the scene.
She handily defeated a Dragon-man with legendary peak Talent, which signified that Ghost Race’s talent...
Eighty to ninety percent was Demigod Level!
With this thought, a flash of fervency appeared in his eyes.
Back then, his level was only Commander Peak.
He wasn’t certain that he could surely contract with that Guardian Beast.
So, after that day ended.
He immediately returned to the Wang Family, applied for Holy Pool qualification, and broke through to Monarch Level.
All to ensure everything went smoothly!
And now, his level has reached Monarch Level, the human race’s pinnacle combat ability!
Plus, he was still missing his fourth Guardian Beast...
What reason does that Ghost Race have to refuse him?!
Seeing this, the Commander Level Beast Master beside him also started buttering up:
"Brother Yu’s foresight is unmatched!"
"This Ghost Race will inevitably be yours!"
"Here, I prematurely congratulate Brother Yu on acquiring your fourth Guardian Beast!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 86: I Have No Intention of Contracting with a Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 86: Chapter 86: I Have No Intention of Contracting with a Master!
At this moment.
Qing Shuang stepped slowly into the room.
Faced with the Monarch Level Beast Master, she did not show any fear or fawning.
She merely nodded politely.
Seeing this demeanor from Qing Shuang, the Commander Level Beast Master could no longer sit still.
No matter how talented this Guardian Beast might be, it should not be arrogant with favor.
"Bang—"
The Commander Level Beast Master slammed the table.
He was just about to speak, but was stopped by Wang Yu once more.
Wang Yu stood up slowly, a hint of eagerness on his face.
"Miss Qing Shuang, let me be frank."
"The reason I came here is to form a contract with you!"
"Your talent will surely find the best expression in my hands!"
As he spoke, his voice brimmed with confidence.
This Guardian Beast had stepped onto the arena back then to find her owner.
And during these days, she had consistently refused to meet with Extraordinary Level and Commander Level Beast Masters.
Doesn’t that mean...
She wants to find a Monarch Level Beast Master?
And throughout the entire City of Chaos...
Among Monarch Level Beast Masters possessing contract eligibility...
Currently, there’s only him!
If this Guardian Beast doesn’t choose him?
Who else could she choose?
Therefore, when Wang Yu said these words, he had already imagined the scene of Qing Shuang bowing in agreement.
However...
Toward Wang Yu’s proffered olive branch, Qing Shuang’s eyes were calm as water, merely shaking her head politely:
"I’m very sorry, Qing Shuang currently has no intention of forming a contract with an owner!"
Indeed, she and her sister need a contract to compensate for their innate defect.
Only by contracting with a Beast Master can she and Fei Yue break through to the Commander Level.
But that doesn’t mean...
She would randomly choose a Beast Master to contract with.
Otherwise, over these many years, they would have long found their owner.
And this Monarch Level Beast Master in front of her...
No, this Fake King Level Beast Master obviously did not meet her requirements.
Following someone like this, her life’s limit would just be the Commander Peak.
With such strength, how could she fight back to the Ghost Race with her sister and show those stubborn old men?
Upon hearing Qing Shuang’s refusal, Wang Yu’s eyes darkened.
He had gone to such lengths for this Ghost Clan...
Yet this Ghost Clan was so ignorant!
He discreetly signaled to the Commander Level Beast Master beside him.
Recognizing the cue, the Commander Level Beast Master immediately stepped forward and said:
"Miss Ghost Clan, I advise you to think carefully. You Ghost Clan have no kin in the City of Chaos."
"With your and your sister’s weak position, finding a human to rely on is your best option!"
"Otherwise, while your strength might suffice for self-preservation, your sister..."
The Commander Level Beast Master stopped suddenly, his tone laced with a hint of threat.
In the City of Chaos, the overall strength of the Alien Race surpasses that of the Human Race.
But the Alien Race is not a united front, quite the contrary...
The conflicts between different races are severe, and some races are even mortal enemies.
Thus, the Human Race, though weaker, actually rules the entire City of Chaos.
Upon hearing this, Qing Shuang’s gaze turned icy.
Fei Yue was her only relative in this world!
The one that was her reverse scale!
Whoever dared to lay a hand on her sister...
She would fight to the death, risking everything!
"What did you say?"
At the moment Qing Shuang’s gaze lifted, the room’s temperature plummeted.
The Commander Level Beast Master, not yet sensing the danger, continued to sneer:
"Be careful of your sist..."
But before he could finish his sentence.
"Boom!"
The Commander Level Beast Master was flung into the wall like a rag doll, without even the chance to summon his Guardian Beast!
Qing Shuang’s sudden attack left Wang Yu stunned for a moment, but he quickly regained his composure and summoned his Guardian Beasts.
In a flash, three Commander Level peak Guardian Beasts surrounded Qing Shuang.
"Miss Qing Shuang, breaking the rules comes at a cost! If you form a contract with me now, I can overlook this!"
The City of Chaos has laws, and combat is strictly forbidden within the city!
The penalties for violators are extremely severe!
Upon hearing this, Qing Shuang cast a cold glance at Wang Yu.
How could she not understand that the words of the Commander Level Beast Master were tacitly approved by this Monarch Level Beast Master.
However, trying to use threats to make the Ghost Race yield?
Impossible!
"Buzz——"
Pitched-black Ghost Patterns spread across her like living beings, her pupils transformed into pure blood red.
Ghost King Status!
Greatly enhancing the attributes of the Ghost Race!
This signified that Qing Shuang was now going all out.
Although Wang Yu was merely a Fake King Level, but...
His three were nonetheless all at Commander Level.
Her chances of victory were almost zero!
Yet, the Ghost Race never retreats!
As Wang Yu watched Qing Shuang’s actions, his eyes deepened.
If he engaged today, this Ghost Race would surely never be contractable by him again.
Then, all the effort he put into gaining the Holy Pool qualification to advance to Monarch Level would be for naught?
With that in mind, he waved his hand, and the three Guardian Beasts returned to the Beast Taming Space.
"Miss Qing Shuang, I’ll give you ten days to think it over!"
"As long as within these ten days you form a contract with me, I’ll pretend this never happened."
"Otherwise..."
Wang Yu’s eyes narrowed slightly, his Monarch Level aura sweeping across the room.
"You can try facing the consequences!"
After saying these words, Wang Yu turned and left.
If this Guardian Beast isn’t foolish, she should know how to choose.
Watching Wang Yu’s retreating figure, the Ghost Patterns on Qing Shuang receded like the tide, though her eyes carried a trace of worry.
Ten days!
She surely wouldn’t be able to wait for that human to advance to Commander Level.
It seems...
She must forsake the contract with that human!
Although this human has, over the years, been the most suitable owner for her and Fei Yue.
But now it only shows...
There is no fate between them and that human.
Qing Shuang turned back to the courtyard.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.nᴇt
She had made up her mind.
After ten days, she would leave the City of Chaos!
Although her strength is immense, she is still not at the level to contend with Commander Level.
Opposing a Monarch Level Beast Master...
She currently lacks the strength!
But, with Fei Yue by her side.
If they want to leave, no one can stop them.
On the other side.
As soon as Wang Yu walked out the door, he instructed several Commander Level Beast Masters.
"Keep a close eye on her, don’t let her leave the City of Chaos!"
Though he allowed ten days, he’d certainly not give this Ghost Clan a chance to flee.
However, what he didn’t know was...
Fei Yue’s mastery over the Void Power had vastly surpassed that of an ordinary Ghost Race.
If she wanted to leave, these Commander Level Beast Masters wouldn’t detect the slightest disturbance with their Spiritual Power.
Not only these Commander Level Beast Masters, even when Fei Yue left just now, he, the Monarch Level Beast Master, was completely unaware.
"Understood!"
Several Commander Level Beast Masters received the order and immediately extended their Spiritual Power over the entire small courtyard.
As for Wang Yu, he adjusted his collar and turned toward the United Military Department.
Not long ago, he had received news.
Qin Chuxue had stepped into the Monarch Level!
And in the most awe-inspiring way!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 87: Man, I’ve Got My Eye on You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 87: Chapter 87: Man, I’ve Got My Eye on You!
In front of the United Army Department.
Gu Xing was still a bit dazed at this moment.
Qin Chuxue’s advice kept echoing in his mind.
"The Extraordinary Level is the foundation for breaking through to Commander Level. The stronger the foundation, the further you can go!"
"Before breaking through to Commander Level, you must push all your attributes to the limit!"
"Only then will the Domain you awaken upon reaching Commander Level be even stronger!"
Qin Chuxue also told him,
If you break through to Commander Level with all attributes above 1000, you’re an ordinary Commander-level Beast Master.
If you break through to Commander Level with all attributes above 1500, you’re an elite Commander-level Beast Master.
If you break through to Commander Level with all attributes above 2000, you’re a top Commander-level Beast Master.
As for herself, she had even reached the very limit of the Human Race...
All attributes at 2500 points!
She had once tried to break past that limit, but when she failed, she reluctantly broke through to Commander Level.
Gu Xing rubbed his temples.
He wasn’t worried about reaching 2500 attribute points himself.
But rather...
Those two bandit-like Talents!
Every time he absorbed Star Stone energy, they would loot most of it.
To get his attributes up to 2500, how many Star Stones would he have to burn?
Still, there was some good news!
Because he leapfrogged in rank at Extraordinary Level and killed a Commander-level demon in the Demon Realm, Qin Chuxue had personally granted him a special Secret Realm entry.
This special Secret Realm can only be entered once per person!
If you clear this Secret Realm, you can massively boost your attributes.
This is also the most crucial step in pushing Extraordinary Level attributes to their absolute limit.
If you can’t clear this Secret Realm...
Most people could never max out their attributes in their entire lives!
In addition, Qin Chuxue also rewarded him with a million points.
Originally, other members of the United Military Department had some complaints about Qin Chuxue favoring him like this.
But under the pressure of her Monarch-level aura, they all obediently shut up.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing silently put away the Secret Realm Pass into his Beast Taming Space, making a note of Qin Chuxue’s kindness in his heart.
The Secret Realm would open in two days. For now, he needed to head to the redemption center and exchange star stones to boost his attributes first!
Thinking of this, he immediately brought his two guardian beasts and rushed toward the City of Chaos Redemption Center.
He didn’t notice that on the street corner, a pink-clad figure was pacing back and forth, restless.
Fei Yue hugged her arms, biting her cherry lips:
"Should I just say my big sister wants to make a contract with you?"
No way, no way!
Fei Yue immediately shook that idea out of her head.
Way too blunt!
That would make it look like her sister was practically throwing herself at this human for a contract.
Seeing Gu Xing walk into the redemption hall...
"No way!"
Fei Yue stamped her foot, steeling her gaze.
Whatever!
I’ll just go straight for it.
No more hesitation!
Steeling herself, she strode into the redemption hall.
Inside the redemption hall.
This time, the staff member who greeted Gu Xing happened to be the same one from last time.
When the staff member looked up and saw who it was, he completely froze.
His eyes went wide, and his pen dropped to the desk with a "clatter."
He remembered this Extraordinary Tier One Beast Master very well.
Last time during registration, he’d even felt regret for this young life.
But he never expected...
He’d actually come back alive.
"You... you... you actually...."
Gu Xing saw his reaction and naturally understood what he was thinking.
Still, he wouldn’t trouble a staff member over this.
"Hello, I’d like to exchange for some Star Stones!"
He took out his Token from his Beast Taming Space and gently placed it on the counter.
The staff accepted the Token mechanically. When his eyes landed on the numbers, it was as if he’d been struck by lightning.
"Th... three million five hundred thousand?!"
He rubbed his eyes hard, then blinked repeatedly, worrying that he’d read it wrong.
Five zeros.
With trembling fingers, he counted each zero, one by one.
Once.
Twice.
Three times.
After confirming several times, his Adam’s apple rolled with difficulty as he looked at Gu Xing in disbelief.
"Sir, are you... are you sure you want to exchange all your points for Star Stones?"
Gu Xing nodded calmly: "All of them."
Three million five hundred thousand points!
One million of that was Qin Chuxue’s reward, while the remaining 2.5 million...
That was the result of his record against the extraordinary-level demon race in the Demon Realm!
The crowd around noticed what was happening and then exploded...
"How much? Three and a half million?! Did I hear that right?!"
"One person? Extraordinary Level? How is that possible?!"
"Wait... I think I’ve seen him before! Isn’t he that Extraordinary Tier One Beast Master from before?!"
"He came back alive from the Demon Realm and brought back three and a half million points?! The world’s gone mad!"
Facing all the chatter, Gu Xing remained calm.
Soon, the staff member, hands trembling, handed over a delicate jade box, neatly packed with 35 high-level Star Stones.
Star Stones come in three levels: Low-level (10 points), Intermediate (1,000 points), High-level (100,000 points).
Intermediate = 100 low-level Star Stones’ worth of energy.The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
High-level = 100 Intermediate Star Stones’ energy!
Now, he had 35 high-level Star Stones in his possession!
He didn’t believe it...
Those two bandit Talents can’t possibly eat up all that energy!
After finishing his exchange, Gu Xing was just about to turn and leave.
But then...
Suddenly, a pink figure blocked his way.
When he saw the figure clearly, Gu Xing was a little confused.
This was a girl, around sixteen or seventeen years old.
Most striking was the single horn on her forehead.
He didn’t think he knew this guardian beast!
On instinct, he checked her information.
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Status: Innate Defect]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 100]
[Constitution: 100]
[Spirit: 100]
[Speed: 100]
[Skills: Void]
Seeing these stats, even Gu Xing couldn’t help letting his jaw drop.
Not because this beast’s attributes were strong, but because...
She was too weird!
A Myth-level Talent beast, but all her attributes were only 100?
And under Skills, she had just the single "Void" skill!
With stats like that, she wasn’t even as good as an ordinary Excellent-ranked beast!
"Could it be, like Liu Li back then, it’s because of the Innate Defect?"
Gu Xing instinctively thought of his first guardian beast.
But after a closer look, he realized—no!
According to the system, even if she was cured of the defect, apparently...
Her attribute values wouldn’t increase.
Her attributes were stuck at 100—across the board!
As Gu Xing drifted into thought, Fei Yue stood there, frozen.
Though she acted confident and open, any time she interacted with someone these years, Qing Shuang had been present.
But this time...
Her big sister wasn’t here!
With so many people watching, she grew more flustered.
In a panic, she stomped her foot and blurted out:
"M-man... Sis has her eye on you!"
The moment she said it, every eye in the room snapped toward her.
But even scarier...
Two dagger-like gazes locked onto Fei Yue at the same time!
This beast wanted to snatch their master?!
And right in front of them?!
Courageous, aren’t we...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 88: I’ll Come Find You After I Decide!
chapters.content:
Chapter 88: Chapter 88: I’ll Come Find You After I Decide!
"What does this Guardian Beast mean? Is it confessing love? Truly straightforward like an Alien Race!"
"I’ve never seen a Guardian Beast initiate a confession to a human before!"
Every sentence was like a fire, making Fei Yue’s cheeks flush red.
She felt like her horn was burning, and steam was about to rise from her head.
For the first time in years, she directly experienced what it meant to be...
Socially dead!
She actually meant to say her sister wanted to contract with him!
But when she got nervous, she just... just...
"Man, sister’s got her eyes on you!"
Blurted out that line!
Fei Yue’s pink toes awkwardly dug into the ground, with a slight shimmer of moisture appearing in her pink eyes.The source of thɪs content is
This is the end!
Could this human possibly think she’s a pervert?!
And Gu Xing was indeed stunned by this sudden "confession."
However, seeing the crowd gathering...
He decided it was best to take this Guardian Beast away first.
This isn’t a good place to talk!
"Come with me."
Without much ado, he grasped Fei Yue’s slender wrist, which felt slightly cool and trembled a bit.
"W-wait a minute!"
Fei Yue exclaimed, but she was still pulled along, stumbling as she went.
Liu Li and Vera exchanged a glance and immediately followed.
...
Cat Race Settlement.
Sally respectfully served flower tea for everyone, then quietly stepped aside to stand by.
Amid the lingering fragrance of tea, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Fei Yue, seated upright across from him...
Since entering, the Ghost Race girl had kept her head down, her delicate fingers nervously twisting the hem of her garment.
"Uh... why don’t you tell me your name first?"
Hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Fei Yue snapped back to reality. After a moment of hesitation, she softly spoke:
