"Fei... Fei Yue!"
She originally intended to straightforwardly tell Gu Xing that her sister wanted to contract with him.
However...
Her gaze unconsciously drifted to Gu Xing’s side.
An Elf Race and an Angel Race!
Both are among the top races in this world.
And she could clearly sense....
The Myth Level pressure emanating from these two Guardian Beasts!
Fei Yue couldn’t help but swallow hard.
According to the original plan she and her sister Qing Shuang had:
When this human Beast Master broke through to Commander Level, her sister would contract with Gu Xing.
With her sister’s help, this human should be able to quickly grow to Monarch Level.
After reaching Monarch Level, this human would gain another contract qualification.
By that time, she would have the chance to contract with this human!
But this plan had a crucial prerequisite...
Her sister must occupy an important place in this human’s heart.
This was the only way she could ensure there would be a precious contract quota saved for her, due to her sister’s presence.
But as it stands now....
Fei Yue’s gaze drifted between Vera and Liu Li.
This human already had two powerful Guardian Beasts...
Her sister’s strength might not lose to them, but what about herself?
She knew her situation better than anyone.
Except for that special "Void" skill, she almost had no combat ability.
Someone like her...
Is she really worth wasting a precious contract position on?
At this thought, a nearly imperceptible sadness flickered in Fei Yue’s eyes.
But she quickly concealed it.
As long as her sister could contract, that would be fine!
As for her....
It’s not important!
However, Gu Xing was puzzled when he saw the girl’s shifting expression.
What is this Guardian Beast thinking about?
If she wants to contract with him, why doesn’t she just say it?
He was ready to agree!
Though her Basic Attributes were indeed terribly low, Gu Xing knew better than anyone...
If the system rated her Myth Level!
That meant she must have the strength to match that Talent.
The biggest possibility is...
That Void skill!
And now that he had a contract quota, this Guardian Beast...
Why let her leave instead of bringing her over?
But she wouldn’t speak up...
It was driving him crazy!
No way!
As Sally came over to refill the tea for the third time, Gu Xing finally lost his patience.
"Ahem....."
He cleared his throat and cut straight to the chase: "So... are you here to contract with me?"
Saying that, he felt his face flush.
After all, contracting was normally proposed by the Guardian Beast.
And this was his first meeting with this Guardian Beast...
He felt like a bad uncle trying to entice a young girl.
Liu Li and Vera both twitched their lips at their owner’s demeanor.
They understood their master’s thoughts clearly.
They could sense that this Guardian Beast wasn’t strong.
Even if the master contracted with her, she would definitely play a supporting role.
On the battlefield, the bond between combat type Guardian Beasts and their master is deeper.
The two Guardian Beasts exchanged a knowing glance and instantly reached a consensus.
This Guardian Beast poses no threat!
Appearance? Pass!
Talent? Pass!
Strength...
Not important!
Overall, she can be contracted!
However.
When Fei Yue heard those words, her small body visibly trembled.
She glanced around the group, finally fixing her gaze on her own hands.
Regarding this contract matter...
She still needed to think carefully.
If she directly told her sister to contract and withdrew herself, with her sister’s personality, she would definitely refuse.
She must first come up with a perfect plan to persuade her sister.
As for giving up...
Gu Xing was the only human over the years that her sister was pleased with.
"I’m very sorry! I’ll think it over and come to you later!"
Fei Yue suddenly stood up and deeply bowed to Gu Xing.
Before anyone could react, the space behind her suddenly cracked open.
The next second, her figure vanished without a trace.
Gu Xing’s outstretched hand froze in mid-air.
Rejected?!
He mechanically turned to his two Guardian Beasts: "Was I... too eager just now?"
Both Liu Li and Vera shook their heads.
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
What on earth is going on here?
That Guardian Beast came to him, it was obvious she wanted to contract with him....
But why did she reject his olive branch?
His gaze returned to the empty seat across.
Not a single trace of her was left, as if no one had ever been there.
This skill... really is something else.
No warning, no incantation needed, freely traversing the Void, she truly was a child of the Void!
No wonder her other attributes were suppressed so low...
If she had strong combat abilities on top of that, how could other Guardian Beasts stand a chance?
Even as it is, this Guardian Beast’s strategic value is terrifyingly high.
Imagine, if she suddenly appeared in front of enemies with Liu Li, combined with Liu Li’s explosive power...
Even a Commander Level Beast Master might find themselves in trouble without activating their Domain!
No way!
This Guardian Beast must be contracted!
Gu Xing made up his mind.
But then his expression fell again.
This Guardian Beast left so decisively...
Where on earth would he find her?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 89: Sister Is So Hard to Persuade!
chapters.content:
Chapter 89: Chapter 89: Sister Is So Hard to Persuade!
"Sigh!"
Gu Xing sighed heavily.
The next time he sees that mysterious guardian beast, who knows when it’ll be...
But just at that moment...
He suddenly sensed an unusual fluctuation coming from the Beast Taming Space.
The Myth Level material he had chosen from the National Treasure Vault, whose use was unknown until now, was emitting a soft pink glow.
"What’s this...?"
Gu Xing puzzledly took it out.
The crystal, transparent and bright, slowly rotated in the palm of his hand.
[Twin Hearts]
[Quality: Myth Level]
[Function: Repairs the innate defect of Twin Guardian Beasts, allowing them to occupy only one contract position]
Gu Xing stared at the information on the system screen, understanding the material’s function.
So, that’s how it is...
Most races possess only a single talent ability.
Like Liu Li’s Blazing Angels bloodline, or Vera’s Power of Nature.
But some special races have dual talents...
For example, the Ghost Race possesses both "Ghost Power" and "Void," two completely different abilities.
And the so-called "Twins" refers to a very rare exception within these races.
Due to certain special reasons, the dual talents meant to be combined into one body are instead inherited separately by two individuals.
Such occurrences often mean the abilities inherited by each twin are far stronger than ordinary ones.
However.
This isn’t necessarily a good thing...
Having abilities that are too strong can place a tremendous burden on the twins’ bodies!
Therefore, from birth, there are certain innate defects.
For example.
Once reaching a certain stage, they cannot continue to break through!
Excessive use of talents can lead to bodily collapse...
And the function of Twin Hearts...
Not only can it perfectly repair all innate defects, but it also allows twins inheriting dual talents to occupy only one contract quota when binding.
However, upon seeing this information, he couldn’t help but twitch his mouth a few times.
What kind of nonsense is this!
Where is he going to find a pair of twins that meet the conditions?
After painstakingly selecting from the vault, he ended up choosing such an unusable myth material, isn’t he just setting himself up!
"Forget it..." Gu Xing rubbed his temples, "I’ve already chosen, regretting it now is useless."
The urgent task is still to enhance his own strength.
But before starting cultivation, there’s something that must be dealt with first...
He needs to repay the favor owed to the Cat Race.
He took out a high-level Star Stone emitting an eerie blue glow from the Beast Taming Space.
"Sally." Gu Xing handed the Star Stone to the Cat Race girl standing by, "Please give this to your father."
Upon seeing the item in her hand, Sally’s cat ears trembled, almost dropping the Star Stone.
"Thi-this is... a high-level Star Stone?! Lord Gu Xing, this is too precious!"
She hurriedly tried to return the Star Stone, her slender fingers trembling slightly.
Last time, the Cat Race only gave Gu Xing dozens of low-level Star Stones, but now...
The price of this high-level Star Stone is over a hundred times greater!
Moreover, Lord Gu Xing is the one who saved the entire Cat Race; it’s only right for the clan to give a gift of gratitude.
How can they turn around and accept such a reward?
"No refusals allowed, and moreover..."
He intentionally dragged his tone, waiting until he saw Sally’s cat ears twitching in tension before continuing:
"Aren’t you going to be my exclusive maid? This is your first mission, you must have your father accept it."
At the mention of the word ’maid,’ Sally’s body straightened abruptly.
Maid Training Lesson One.
Absolute obedience to reasonable requests of the master.
She took a deep breath, respectfully holding the Star Stone to her chest, unconsciously adopting the most standard attendant posture:
"As you command, Lord Gu Xing, I will personally hand it to my father."
Sally courteously bowed and carried the Star Stone carefully out of the room.
As her figure disappeared outside the door, Gu Xing’s gaze subconsciously turned to Vera.
"Um..."
He awkwardly rubbed his hands together, swallowing back the words he was about to say.
After all, last time he used a large amount of the Spring of Life and Life Tree Leaves, and now he needs to...
But before Gu Xing could speak, Vera had already vanished from the spot.
The next moment, accompanied by a burst of emerald light, a wooden bathtub three times larger than the last appeared in the center of the room.
Gu Xing was dumbfounded, staring at the bathtub.
Inside it was filled with the Spring of Life, with a thick layer of Life Tree Leaves floating on top, so green that the water’s color was barely visible.
"Master, don’t worry, the Elf Clan lacks nothing else but the Spring of Life and the Life Tree Leaves are abundant!"
Vera patted her chest, her face full of pride.
Saying this, she threw a triumphant glance at Liu Li.
What’s the use of physical might?
To win the master’s favor, you need real resources!
While Liu Li’s mouth twitched hard.
She suddenly realized a harsh truth...
In this regard, she truly can’t offer any help!
Her only possession now is the "Breaking Realm Blade."
But in this situation, it’s completely useless...
Looking at Vera’s smug demeanor, she suddenly felt a sense of defeat from being surpassed.
But when Liu Li returned to the Beast Taming Space, she discovered...
The previously lush Tree of Life now had its leaves halved, appearing desolate.
...
On the other side.
A rift silently unfolded.
Qing Shuang’s slender fingers flowed gracefully over the strings, the melodious sound of the zither uninterrupted.
She didn’t even turn her head, only spoke in a faint tone:
"Back again?"
She always knew her sister couldn’t stay idle.
However, with Fei Yue’s ability, as long as she doesn’t provoke any Monarch Level beings, there truly aren’t many in this City of Chaos who can hold her back.
Therefore, after arriving here, she didn’t overly inquire about Fei Yue’s matters.
"Hehe! I knew I couldn’t hide it from Sister~"
Fei Yue landed lightly barefoot, nimbly hopping beside Qing Shuang.
Regarding the visit to find Gu Xing, Fei Yue temporarily didn’t plan to tell her sister.
But from this meeting, she at least confirmed one thing.
That human definitely deserves her sister.
Otherwise, it wouldn’t make two Myth Talent Guardian Beasts willingly follow him.
But the current dilemma is...
How to persuade her sister?
Fei Yue cupped her cheeks with both hands, elbows resting on the redwood table beside the zither, staring intently as her sister played.
"Sister~"
She suddenly spoke.
"Do you think, if I don’t find a master, what would happen? I feel having a master might be uncomfortable!"
Qing Shuang’s elongated fingers paused slightly on the strings, eyes lifting a bit, but quickly refocused on the zither.
"Fine, if you don’t want to find one, we won’t!"
There’s nothing more important than her sister.
Though she harbors grievances against the Ghost Race’s old geezers for kicking them out.
But...
As long as her sister doesn’t want it, she won’t hesitate to let those old folks go.
However, Fei Yue immediately refuted.
"Sister, what I mean is... you bind with a human! Once you break through the Monarch level, we can fight back against the Ghost Race!"
Once Fei Yue said this.
The zither music suddenly halted.
Realizing her sister was upset, Fei Yue quickly waved her hands:
"Sister, I’m just joking!"
Not until the zither music resumed did Fei Yue quietly sigh in relief.
"No joking about such things next time!"
"I’m your sister, if you don’t want to bind, I’ll always be with you."
"If we need to bind... it must be together!"
Upon hearing this, Fei Yue nodded fervently like a pecking chick.
Saying so, but her eyes held a trace of worry.
Sister is really hard to persuade!
What to do?
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 90: Talent Metamorphosis
chapters.content:
Chapter 90: Chapter 90: Talent Metamorphosis
Meanwhile.
Gu Xing expertly dragged the two little creatures trying to peek out the door and casually locked it.
Turning to face the Spring of Life shimmering with a luminous green glow, he took a deep breath and stepped into the water without hesitation.
The cool spring water instantly enveloped him, every pore relaxing.
Swish——
With the addition of 34 high-level Star Stones, the entire barrel of spring water boiled suddenly.
The surging energy transformed into a visible blue stream of light, madly pouring into his body.
He immediately closed his eyes to concentrate, feeling the flow of this energy within him.
In his perception, the two talents were like sharks smelling blood, greedily devouring this energy.
However...
This time was different from the last, as the energy from the Star Stones was thousands of times greater.
Even with both talents fully activated and absorbing at full power, there was still a large amount of energy dispersing and being absorbed by his body.
And his various attributes were rapidly improving under such circumstances.
Gradually, the absorption speed of the two talents began to slow down, like a sated beast eating more slowly.
When the absorption of both energies reached saturation...
Gu Xing felt a buzz in his mind, as if a veil had been suddenly lifted.
The world appeared unprecedentedly clear before his eyes.
Instinctively, he checked all his information.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit]
[Contract Quota: 2/3]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Sovereign (Enhanced), Soul-devouring (Enhanced)]
[Power: 500]
[Constitution: 500]
[Spirit: 2434]
[Speed: 500]
Under the influence of the two talents, his Spirit attribute had soared to 2434 points!
Almost touching the limits of humanity!
Although his other attributes were still low, at least...
These robber-like talents were finally satiated!
Looking at the two talents marked as "Enhanced", he immediately felt in detail the transformation within them...
[Sovereign (Enhanced)]
[Effect: Grants Guardian Beast three combat states!]
The Sovereign talent now provides an additional state!
[Slaughter: Attacks ignore defenses, cutting through all!]
[Guard: Greatly increases defense, holy protection, impenetrable!]
[Celestial Grace: Purifies negative states, imbued with Holy Light, divine majesty descends!]
Observing this new state, Gu Xing nodded silently.
Although this state did not greatly enhance the Guardian Beast’s combat abilities, it did allow them to be immune to all negative states...
In actual combat, it could bring a significant boost!
And as for the other talent—Soul-devouring.
It completed a transformation as well...
[Soul-devouring (Enhanced)]
[Effect: Indiscriminately enhances Guardian Beast’s attributes by 200%]
[Special State​: Sacrifice (Can double enhancement to 400% by sacrificing one contracted Guardian Beast)]
At the moment he saw the word "Sacrifice", Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply!
Sacrifice a Guardian Beast?!
The images of Liu Li and Vera instantly flashed through his mind.
If either of his two Guardian Beasts were gone...
The thought of this possibility made him shake his head instantly, dispelling the idea.
No way!
Even if this ability could lead to a qualitative leap in strength, the power gained in exchange for their disappearance...
He could not accept it!
Seal it off!
This special state...will never be used in his lifetime!
After thoroughly reviewing the two talents, his various attributes had also been enhanced to their limits.
[Power: 1500]
[Constitution: 1500]
[Spirit: 2434]
[Speed: 1500]
When all the attributes stabilized at 1500 points, Gu Xing clearly felt...
His body had reached a saturated state.
With a splash, he stood up from the tub, crystalline beads of water rolling down his muscle contours.
The Life Water in the barrel had already turned crystal clear, with only a few tattered leaves of the Tree of Life floating.
Except for two lonely Star Stones lying at the bottom of the barrel.
With a casual wave, he collected them into his Beast Taming Space.
It seems that the enhancement using Star Stones...
points is the limit this method can achieve!
As for his Spirit attribute reaching such a terrifying level...
This is purely due to the influence of his two talents!
Thinking of this, he retrieved a special Secret Realm Pass with a purple glow from his Beast Taming Space.
No wonder Qin Chuxue reminded him to perform well in the special secret realm.
Only in this special secret realm...
Can various attributes be further enhanced!
Casually throwing on a bathrobe.
With some time left before entering the secret realm, he planned to take his two Guardian Beasts to look around, see if he could find that Ghost Race girl.
After all, the position for the third Guardian Beast has been vacant for a long time now!
...
On the other side.
Council headquarters.Follow current novels on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
"Bang!"
The heavy oak door was kicked open by someone, the door panel slammed against the wall, causing dust to fall from the ceiling.
Heite abruptly raised his head, his heart flooded with rage.
Even if the council is one of the Human Race’s three major forces, who here has such audacity...
However, upon recognizing the visitor’s face, he froze instantly.
"Miss Vero, what brings you here!"
The anger on Heite’s face instantly transformed into a fawning smile.
"Didn’t the old man inform you? I’m here at the Northern Territory for the secret realm!"
The girl casually slapped an order onto the table.
Upon confirming it was indeed an order from Lord Kaven, the corners of Heite’s mouth twitched hard.
Only this young lady dares to be so blunt with one of the Human Race’s pillars, Verocan.
"Miss Vero, the day after tomorrow is when the special secret realm opens! I’ll accompany you to the entrance then!"
Given Veronica’s status, she wasn’t required to personally kill Demon Race in the Demon Realm to gain points for entering the secret realm.
Veronica nodded.
Her level had also reached Extraordinary Tier Ninth, and all attributes had reached 1500 points.
To continue enhancing...
Entering the special secret realm was necessary.
And this was the reason Kaven allowed her to travel to the Northern Territory.
This special secret realm is divided into three layers.
With each layer conquered, one can gain certain attribute enhancements.
She was confident of passing the first two layers.
Except for the third layer...
Cannot be passed!
Strictly speaking...
It seemed more like a challenge level!
Every time you defeat the enemy before you, the secret realm condenses an even stronger opponent.
Qin Chuxue, hailed as the "Human Race’s number one genius," kept succeeding in challenges of the third layer until...
Faced with a Commander Level opponent, that’s where she fell.
It’s precisely due to this reason that the growth limit for the entire Human Race was defined at 2500 points!
This number represents Qin Chuxue’s attributes at the Extraordinary Level!
Contemplating this, a look of seriousness flickered in Veronica’s eyes.
Currently contracted Guardian Beasts...
The White Emperor and the Nether Spirit Leopard were both once Monarch Level.
Kaven was willing to pay such a high price, allowing Monarch Level Guardian Beasts to fall from their realm and contract with her.
For one purpose only...
That’s to help her break the limits of humanity!
Veronica seemed nonchalant but understood the old man’s expectations for her.
She could play and act willfully, but must never stop growing stronger!
Though the seriousness in her eyes only flickered for a moment before reverting to her usual demeanor.
"Oh yeah, has anything interesting happened in the Northern Territory lately? Tell me all about it."
Heite dared not hesitate, promptly recounting the two major events recently occurred in the Northern Territory.
"A Ghost Race girl appeared in the Northern Territory looking for a master, she seems to have become the strongest Guardian Beast around!"
"Anything else?"
Regarding Guardian Beasts, Veronica wasn’t interested.
After all, her Guardian Beasts were arranged by the old man, there’s no chance she’d contract this Ghost Race girl.
"And an Extraordinary Level human who surpassed levels to kill a Commander Level Demon Race!"
Upon hearing that, the pupils of White Emperor and Nether Spirit Leopard beside Veronica simultaneously constricted.
As former Monarch Level, both beasts knew the difficulty of an Extraordinary Level killing a Commander Level.
Even now without using domains...
Against a Commander Level Demon Race, it’s merely an even match!
"What’s that human’s name?"
Veronica instantly showed interest.
"Gu Xing!"
Upon hearing this name again, Veronica’s eyes suddenly brightened.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 91: Holy Daughter of the Holy See · Cecilia!
chapters.content:
Chapter 91: Chapter 91: Holy Daughter of the Holy See · Cecilia!
Two days passed by in a blink.
During these two days, Gu Xing almost traversed the entire City of Chaos, yet he never saw the mysterious Ghost Tribe girl again.
This was naturally because Fei Yue deliberately avoided him.
She still hadn’t come up with a way to persuade her sister, and seeing Gu Xing would certainly lead her to make a contract...
Therefore, she simply avoided Gu Xing and didn’t appear!
Gu Xing sighed lightly and temporarily put aside this regret.
There are more important matters awaiting him now.
The entrance to the special Secret Realm is not far from the City of Chaos, and it wasn’t long before he arrived at the entrance.
Because there are few who can achieve a million points and exchange it for the qualification to enter the special Secret Realm.
Gu Xing glanced around and found only forty or fifty people participating in this Secret Realm.
But each person standing here is...
the cream of the crop of human talents!
However, just at this moment...
a delicate hand suddenly patted his left shoulder.
He turned instinctively, only to find no one behind him.
Then, his right shoulder was gently tapped again.
Gu Xing turned around in surprise...
Veronica was elegantly crossing her legs, one hand behind her back, the other lightly twisting her waterfall-like golden hair.
The sunlight cast a soft light on her exquisite profile, even her voice was deliberately lightened:
"Long time no see, Gu Xing~"
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched uncontrollably.
If he didn’t know this lady’s bad personality, he might really be fooled by Veronica’s ladylike act.
"Hey!" Veronica instantly broke character, "What’s with that expression? Can’t you play along with me?"
Gu Xing barely mustered a smile, "Long time no see, Miss Veronica..."
Only then did Veronica raise her chin, showing a triumphant smile.
Gu Xing shook his head helplessly, his gaze falling on the Guardian Beasts beside her.
He had already seen the Nether Spirit Leopard on the left last time.
As for the two-meter-tall white giant bear on the right...
The most striking feature is the ferocious scar over its left eye, almost splitting the bear’s entire face in two!
Is this the young lady’s new Guardian Beast?
[Polar Bear King (White Emperor)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Status: Special (Suppressed)]
[Power: 3000]
[Constitution: 3000]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Bear King Bloodline, Eternal Frost Freeze, Frosty Winter Majesty]
Seeing its half-step mythic talent, Gu Xing was a bit surprised.
This should be the peak batch of Guardian Beasts among the Human Race!
Besides the talent...
This bear’s attributes are quite monstrous!
Almost catching up to Liu Li!
Meanwhile.
The White Emperor also appraised Gu Xing, a hint of scrutiny flashed in its single eye.
Is this the human who killed the Commander-level Demon Race?
Since Gu Xing didn’t summon his Guardian Beast, the White Emperor couldn’t gauge his true strength.
But from Gu Xing’s aura... this human seemed quite ordinary!
Being able to kill a Commander-level Demon Race...
Could it be because his Guardian Beast is very powerful?
The Nether Spirit Leopard nearby noticed the White Emperor’s gaze and immediately guessed its thoughts, quickly reminding:
"White Emperor, don’t underestimate him, this human’s talent..."
She paused, unable to find suitable words.Follow current novels on
"Is terrifying!"
Scenes from the Elf Secret Realm flashed through her mind.
Gu Xing’s disdainful gaze left a deep impression on her heart.
Upon hearing the Nether Spirit Leopard’s reminder, the White Emperor’s single eye squinted sharply, retracting its earlier contempt.
Being given such an assessment by a former Monarch Level companion, this human must not be underestimated.
And Veronica, seeing Gu Xing staring at the White Emperor, couldn’t help but speak:
"Gu Xing, you think the White Emperor is ugly too, right? I think so too!"
Ugly?
Gu Xing almost couldn’t hold it in.
For a Demigod Level Guardian Beast to be disliked for its appearance by this lady, it’s truly unique.
Gu Xing was about to retort when a cold voice suddenly interjected.
"Miss Veronica."
Gu Xing turned his head to see a young girl in a pure white nun’s robe walking gracefully towards them.
The most striking feature was the silver cross on her chest.
Meeting his gaze, the girl slightly curtsied with a smile.
However, Gu Xing could feel that her eyes held a cold aloofness.
"This Secret Realm is bustling! Both the Verlo family’s young lady and the Church Saintess are here!"
"Wait, who’s that black-haired young man standing with them?"
"From Longxia Country, right? Judging by his age, he’s probably a student from the National Academy..."
"Do you think the three of them can surpass the record set by Commander Qin?"
"Miss Verlo and Lady Saintess very likely can, but that black-haired young man from Longxia... seems doubtful to me!"
From the discussions around, Gu Xing finally confirmed the identity of this nun girl...
Church Saintess—Cecilia!
She’s also the strongest among the younger generation of the Church.
However...
Veronica seemed to have no good feelings for the Saintess.
"Ugh, always wearing that fake mask... the Church people are all hypocrites!"
Veronica rolled her eyes.
She suddenly wrapped her arm around Gu Xing’s shoulder, deliberately raising her voice:
"Gu Xing, you must work hard in the Secret Realm, strive to trample some Saintess underfoot!"
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched, his gaze slipping to Cecilia.
To say such things right in front of the person, this young lady indeed didn’t fear creating a stir!
However, Cecilia completely ignored Veronica’s disdain, reassessing Gu Xing.
To be spoken of so highly by Veronica, this man’s strength must...
at least be at her and Verlo’s level!
In the Church, only the strong are respected.
She gracefully lifted her skirt, proactively extending her right hand clad in white silk gloves:
"Nice to meet you, I’m Cecilia."
The voice remained gentle, but her eyes held more seriousness.
Veronica frantically tugged at Gu Xing’s sleeve from behind, trying to stop him from extending his hand.
But at least Cecilia was the Saintess of the Church, the basic etiquette couldn’t be ignored.
He lightly touched her fingertips, separating instantly:
"Gu Xing!"
Knowing Gu Xing’s name, Cecilia, seeing Veronica’s unwelcome demeanor, didn’t continue to linger here pointlessly.
"See you in the Secret Realm!"
After leaving these words, Cecilia turned and left.
Once he saw the white figure disappear into the crowd, Gu Xing lowered his voice to ask Veronica:
"Do you have any grudges with her?"
Hearing this question, Veronica rarely put away her playful demeanor, gently shaking her head:
"No grudges, just don’t agree with the Church’s ideology!"
"Once you see with your own eyes what the Church does... you’ll naturally understand!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing’s brows furrowed slightly.
To be honest, he didn’t know much about the Council and the Church.
But he knew the Council was managed by the Verlo Clan, as for the Church...
He only knew the Church was managed by the Holy See across the country.
About specifics, he wasn’t very clear either.
Yet before he could ask more, Veronica shifted back to normal, changing the topic:
"But although we know each other, in the Secret Realm, I won’t hold back when I encounter you!"
Seeing Veronica unwilling to speak further, he could only nod.
Next, a man in military uniform slowly walked to the center of the square.
"All trial takers, please enter the Trial Teleportation Array."
Veronica pulled him along towards the ancient array spanning a hundred meters in diameter on the ground.
As the last person stepped into the array, the military-clad man’s hand came down:
"Activate!"
Hundreds of Star Stones suddenly shattered, the runes on the array began to flow like living creatures.
Space began to distort, and the figures of the crowd gradually turned transparent in the strong light...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 92: Beyond Monarchs! The Shackles of the Human Race!
chapters.content:
Chapter 92: Chapter 92: Beyond Monarchs! The Shackles of the Human Race!
United Military Department.
Qin Chuxue, who was reviewing documents, suddenly paused, but soon the pen continued to move.
Moments later, the air in the command room suddenly warped, and a burly figure tore through space and stepped out.
"Commander Lei, how do you have time to come to the Northern Territory?"
Qin Chuxue didn’t look up, her tone cold.
Lei Zhan waved his hand, unconcerned, and casually found a spot to sit down:
"Qin girl, you’ve broken through to Monarch Level, can’t I come to congratulate you?"
Qin Chuxue remained expressionless, her attention still on the document in hand.
"Commander Lei, wasn’t this within your expectations?"
She initially thought her breakthrough to Monarch Level was unexpected, but the more she thought about it later, the more it didn’t seem right...
Gu Xing’s astonishing talent, how could he quietly appear alone in the Northern Territory?
And then proceed to the Demon Realm without any protection!ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Isn’t this giving the Demon Race an opportunity?
Clearly, someone did this on purpose.
This was a meticulously designed scheme!
And in the Northern Territory, who has the qualifications to set up such a scheme...
Qin Chuxue raised her head, her gaze fixed on the man not far away.
The chief officer of the Northern Military Region, Lei Zhan!
Only he has this qualification!
Meeting Qin Chuxue’s serious gaze, a rare hint of embarrassment appeared on Lei Zhan’s rugged face. He subconsciously touched his nose, his gaze drifting out the window.
This indeed was not a decent thing he did.
Qin Chuxue is responsible for the Northern Territory, and acting on his own without informing her about the arrangement of this action was his fault.
"This... I truly didn’t consider it enough, didn’t notify you in advance, I was wrong!"
Upon hearing Lei Zhan’s apology, the frosty expression on Qin Chuxue’s face finally softened.
The beneficiary of this operation was her, and she couldn’t blame Lei Zhan much.
As for Gu Xing, who Lei Zhan used as bait...
She has already tried to compensate him.
But at this moment, Lei Zhan suddenly shifted the conversation:
"Qin girl, where’s that kid Gu Xing? Has he entered that Secret Realm?"
When it came to the main topic, Qin Chuxue’s expression turned serious again.
"Mm! Besides Gu Xing... the Verlo Family’s eldest daughter and the Holy See’s Holy Daughter are participating in this Secret Realm!"
Upon hearing this, Lei Zhan furrowed his brows slightly.
The lineup attending the Secret Realm was unexpectedly luxurious.
But...
Only in such a way can the secret of this Secret Realm be thoroughly uncovered.
After all, this special Secret Realm has another alias.
"Ascension Realm!"
This is also the reason why the Council and the Holy See are fully cultivating Veronica and Cecilia.
This Secret Realm involves the secret of breaking through beyond Monarch.
Initially, Qin Chuxue dominated an era.
They originally thought Qin Chuxue could clear the entire Secret Realm and learn the truth.
But...
She failed!
Fell at the last step.
"Qin girl, do you think Gu Xing has a chance?"
Qin Chuxue recalled the moment Gu Xing killed a Commander Level Demon Race.
The strength he displayed at that moment had already far exceeded her own Extraordinary Level.
She pondered for a moment and slowly spoke:
"I believe in him! He’s stronger than me!"
Upon hearing this, Lei Zhan’s eyes also hardened.
Initially, after Qin Chuxue’s failure, they planned to give up on this Secret Realm.
After all, Longxia Country couldn’t possibly produce another talent stronger than Qin Chuxue.
But Gu Xing’s appearance rekindled their hopes.
"Beyond Monarch, huh..."
Lei Zhan suddenly stood up, his eyes resolute.
"Qin girl, I will immediately contact Elder Long."
"From now on, Longxia enters Level One combat readiness status!"
"I have a feeling that the shackles disturbing the Human Race will be thoroughly broken in this event!"
Upon hearing these words, Qin Chuxue’s gaze also grew solemn.
Only when the Human Race possesses beings beyond Monarch can they truly gain a foothold in the Alternate Space!
"Understood, I will manage the entire Northern Territory well! As for those Alien Races..."
Lei Zhan’s eyes hardened, his tone decisive:
"If they dare to harbor malicious thoughts, then fight!"
The fierce aura emanated from his body, Lei Zhan’s eyes filled with killing intent.
Any force hindering the growth of the Human Race must be eradicated.
...
Inside the Secret Realm.
When Gu Xing opened his eyes again, the scene before him was entirely different.
In front lay a haze-blanketed wasteland, with dead trees standing twisted like skeletal remains.
Behind him, however, was a vibrant oasis, with towering city walls shimmering warmly under the sun.
The stark contrast was clear!
He surveyed the area.
Didn’t see Veronica or the humans who entered with him.
"Seems like this layer’s challenge must be completed alone!"
But just then, a cold mechanical voice suddenly echoed in the Void.
[Welcome, challenger, to the first layer of the Ascension Realm!]
[Challenge content: Please protect the city from being destroyed by the Demon Race in the tide of their assault!]
[Endure for two hours to proceed to the next layer!]
[Remaining time: 02:00:00]
[This challenge will begin in 30 seconds!]
[Note: Death in the Secret Realm will result in being transported out of the Secret Realm!]
Upon hearing the four words "Ascension Realm" in the prompt...
He frowned slightly.
This Secret Realm seems not as simple as he thought!
The gods here referred to...
Definitely not merely those with Guardian Beast Myth Level talent, but...
Gu Xing drew a breath.
Almost instantly, he understood the meaning of this Secret Realm.
[Countdown: 10 seconds]
[Countdown: 9 seconds]
...
Seeing the countdown dwindling, Gu Xing knew that the most important thing now was to clear the first layer of the Secret Realm.
As for the secret of "god"...
As long as he’s in this Secret Realm, he’s sure he’ll figure it out!
He gently waved his hand, and a blue Summoning Array appeared, two Guardian Beasts instantly materialized in front of him.
Seeing Vera and Liu Li, Gu Xing suddenly realized...
It seems Vera’s mother and Liu Li’s father both surpass Monarch!
Why not ask them?
Thinking of this, Gu Xing immediately spoke:
"Vera, Liu Li, do you understand what’s beyond Monarch?"
Upon hearing the question, the two Guardian Beasts shook their heads simultaneously.
Seeing this, Gu Xing could only abandon this thought.
First, handle this challenge!
[Countdown: 3 seconds]
[Countdown: 2 seconds]
[Countdown: 1 second]
[Challenge begins!]
With the sound of the prompt falling, the distant Demon Race seemed to receive orders, instantly becoming agitated.
Like a tide, the Demon Race rushed toward the only city.
Witnessing this scene, Gu Xing felt no ripples in his heart.
Under siege by the Demon Race...
He’s been through it plenty of times!
For these Extraordinary Level Demon Races, Vera is their god!
"Vera, Elf Monarchy!"
"Understood!"
Vera responded.
The next moment, a verdant Divine Ring appeared behind her!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Power: 1510]
[Constitution: 1520]
[Spirit: 3430→10290]
[Speed: 1500]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain]
Even though it’s only a spiritual attribute of 10000 points!
Yet for these Extraordinary Level Demon Races...
It’s more than enough!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 93: Master! I... I Like You!
chapters.content:
Chapter 93: Chapter 93: Master! I... I Like You!
Where Gu Xing’s gaze fell, all he saw were the ferocious figures of the Demon Race.
Although the Demon Race’s individual levels weren’t high, the numbers...
Were terrifyingly large!
Gu Xing estimated.
If an ordinary Extraordinary Tier Ninth Beast Master were to survive in this scale of Demon Tide, the chances would be less than ten percent.
Let alone protecting the city behind them amid the Demon Race’s assault!
However...
He is no ordinary Extraordinary Tier Ninth!
"Vera!"
The young girl’s eyes narrowed, scanning the Demon Race pouring in like a tide.
Though her strength far surpasses these Low Tier demonic creatures, still...
This time, the task is to hold out for a full two hours!​
This extremely tests the endurance capacity of the Guardian Beast.
Facing such a situation, among the Triple Heavenly Calamity...
"Earth Vein Suction!"
The Divine Ring behind her suddenly erupted with dazzling light, a massive earth-colored Array unfurled on the ground thousands of meters ahead of Gu Xing!
Within the Array, intangible power is frantically devouring the Demon Race stepping into it.
Their life force is forcibly drained, transformed into pure energy, continuously replenishing Vera’s Spiritual Power consumption.
Three seconds...
Only three seconds!
These Low Tier demon creatures are completely drained, collapsing into shriveled husks!
Yet, even so, the Demon Tide remains relentless.
The front Demon Race just fell, those from the back fearlessly step into the Array, like endless waves...
Gu Xing frowned, a trace of confusion flashed in his eyes.
He could sense these Demon Race weren’t illusions but real living entities.
Because whenever Vera killed a Demon Race, a wisp of weak energy would be absorbed into her body.
"In the Secret Realm, where did so many Demon Race come from?"
This thought had just crossed his mind when he caught sight of Liu Li standing beside him.
The silver-haired Angel at that moment was pursing her lips, gazing complexly at the mighty Vera.
Since the master contracted this Green Tea Spirit, she found her opportunities to take action had dwindled!
As a combat-type Guardian Beast, this wasn’t a good omen.
"If master contracts a new guardian beast..."
She wouldn’t be reduced to guarding the Beast Taming Space, right?!
Just imagining that scene made Liu Li involuntarily clench her fists.
No way!
Absolutely not!
The master has a talent enhancement ability, which means...
In battle, she doesn’t have much advantage!
If that’s the case, then...
Just then, Gu Xing’s voice came.
"Liu Li, come with me to the front and see where these demons are coming from!"Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Liu Li’s body trembled, her eyes suddenly lit up.
A chance had arrived!
This mission was to hold the city for two hours.
That means...
Vera cannot leave here!
Then she could be with the master...
Alone!​​
This thought made her heart race suddenly.
Since Vera joined, she had hardly had a chance to be alone with the master.
The romantic novel plot sneakily collected in the Beast Taming Space involuntarily popped into her mind, Liu Li felt her cheeks heat up, even the tips of her ears turning faintly pink.
"Vera, I’m leaving this to you."
Gu Xing gave a crisp command,
The elf maiden who was maintaining the Array jerked her head around, her emerald eyes widening instantly.
Master is taking that Angel and leaving...
Leaving her alone to work here miserably?
Vera opened her mouth, wanting to protest, but Gu Xing decisively turned his back, ignoring her.
When it came to handling the Demon Race, Vera’s effect was much better than Liu Li’s.
"Protect the city well."
After simply instructing, Gu Xing motioned for Liu Li to lead him to the Demon Race’s source.
Upon hearing this request, Liu Li’s body visibly stiffened.
She quietly gulped, cautiously wrapping her slender arms around the master’s waist.
So close...​​
The familiar crisp scent wafted from him, Liu Li’s face instantly flushed to her ears.
Seeing this scene from afar, Vera angrily gritted her teeth.
Damn Angel!​​
Sneaking out!
...
Liu Li flew swiftly low with Gu Xing, the closer she got to the demonic source, the higher the Demon Race’s level became.
Several elite demonic creatures with bone wings already discovered them, leaping continually in attempts to attack.
"Humph!"
Liu Li sneered coldly, instantly condensing translucent Flame Shield around herself with the crimson-gold Holy Flame.
The attacks of those Demon Race couldn’t even create a ripple on the shield.
Yet now, Liu Li paid no mind to these minions.
The master in her arms was right within reach, she could even feel Gu Xing’s steady breath brushing against her neck.
This realization quickened her heartbeat, and the edge of her wings inadvertently ignited a faint Red Flame.
If only... a kiss...
This bold thought suddenly entered her mind, and Liu Li was instantly embarrassed, even the tips of her ears became pink.
The temperature of the Holy Flame Shield escalated with her emotions, even the surrounding air began to distort.
"Liu Li?"
Noticing the unusually high heat, Gu Xing turned around in doubt, just in time to meet the Angel’s blushing cheeks and uncertain gaze.
"Are you alright?"
"Yes, I’m... I’m fine!"
Liu Li frantically averted her face, stammering her answer.
But as she met Gu Xing’s concerned eyes again, years of bottled-up emotions suddenly burst.
"Master! I... I like you!"
This phrase, bursting out of her mouth, left Liu Li herself stunned.
She said it!
She really said it!
She had shared her inner thoughts.
She instinctively tightened her embrace of Gu Xing, the flames on her wings surged higher.
But excitement quickly turned into tension.
If her master rejected her...
Hearing these words, Gu Xing was visibly taken aback.
But soon, he realized...
This definitely wasn’t the romantic kind of like!
His understanding of Guardian Beasts was completely based on memory.
In his predecessor’s perception...
Guardian Beasts are companions, with an intense dependency on their Beast Master.
So...
Liu Li saying she likes him must only be that Guardian Beast’s dependency on the master!
"Liu Li, I like you too!"
Hearing Gu Xing’s response, Liu Li was instinctively happy.
But seeing the completely serene eyes of Gu Xing...
She knew her master definitely misunderstood her.
Her mood instantly fell.
"Stupid master..."
She muttered softly, her voice almost lost in the wind.
"Huh? What did you say?"
Gu Xing leaned closer with puzzlement.
"N-Nothing!"
Liu Li hurriedly pointed towards the swirling Demonic Qi ahead.
"I meant... we’re almost there! Master!"
After Gu Xing turned his head, Liu Li discreetly buried her face in his shoulder, taking a deep breath.
Even if treated as mere dependency...
At least at this moment, she is the closest to the master.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 94: Encountering the Demon Pattern Again!
chapters.content:
Chapter 94: Chapter 94: Encountering the Demon Pattern Again!
Under the reminder of Liu Li, Gu Xing looked ahead.
What appeared before him was a corpse.
No, rather than say it was a corpse...
It’s better to say it was a complete, mountain-sized Demon Race carcass!
And strangely, there wasn’t a single shadow of the Demon Race around the enormous carcass.
However, the thick Demonic Qi permeating the air was a hundred times stronger than anywhere before.
Gu Xing observed carefully.
The incessant stream of Demon Race earlier, the source was right here.
"Put me down."
Liu Li slowly descended upon hearing the words. Just as Gu Xing was about to step forward to inspect, he "bang" hit an invisible barrier.
Restriction?
As he frowned and pondered, a sudden disturbance emerged from the Beast Taming Space.
The mysterious Demon Pattern suspended above the Spring of Life began to tremble violently, continuously transmitting an urging thought.
Does it want me to approach that corpse?
Gu Xing frowned slightly.
The function of this Demon Pattern was originally unclear, and now it was guiding him to touch an ancient corpse emitting terrifying Demonic Qi?
Something seems off any way you look at it!
What if the Demon Race corpse inside suddenly reanimated?
However, just as he was about to turn and leave, he suddenly thought of....
Check the information!
[Fallen Demon God]
[Level: Totem Level]
[Talent: Demon God]
[Status: Completely Dead]
[Note: Contains a special Demon Pattern, recommend acquisition]
Gu Xing’s pupils shrank slightly.
Totem Level!
This was an existence that surpassed the King Level. Even though it was dead, the remaining pressure still made him palpitate with fear.
But since the system judged it as "completely dead," it eased his mind a bit.
What concerned him more was...
The system actually actively suggested acquiring the Demon Pattern?
This was the first time!
Although he wasn’t clear about the specific utility, anything specially marked by the system was definitely not simple.
The current problem is...
How to break through this restriction?
"Master, do you want to go in?"
Liu Li’s voice suddenly echoed.
Gu Xing turned his head, only to see in her hand, suddenly, a uniquely shaped short blade, the blade body swirling with the fluctuation of Space Law.
Breaking Realm Blade!
Gu Xing then remembered, this was the spoils gained after defeating War Angel Miller.
"Can you open it?"
Liu Li nodded confidently, the short blade in her hand emitting a faint hum.
The Breaking Realm Blade, being one of the treasures of the Angel Race, any restriction would be ineffective before it.
With a slight wrist rotation, she drew a graceful arc in the void with the blade’s tip.
The originally indestructible barrier instantly split open, creating a gap wide enough for passage.
Liu Li stepped in without hesitation, her wings slightly spread, shielding Gu Xing behind her.
In an unknown environment, she would not let the master face any risk.
Fortunately, everything went smoothly.
Soon, the two of them approached the corpse.
When they finally stood before the Demon God’s carcass, they truly felt their insignificance.
Just a single finger of the corpse was akin to a giant boulder.
Such a massive presence, how terrifying must it have been in life...
The Demon Pattern within the Beast Taming Space became restless, continuously transmitting the urging thought.
Gu Xing took a deep breath, slowly placing his hand on the cold corpse.
In an instant, another dark purple Demon Pattern emerged from the corpse, spiraling up his arm like a serpent, finally merging into his brow, aligning alongside the previous Demon Pattern above the Spring of Life.
It was at the moment when the Demon Pattern was acquired, an unforeseen change occurred!
The entire corpse of the Demon God began to crumble and disintegrate at a visible speed, scattering as countless black light particles.
Even more shocking, all the Demons in the Secret Realm froze simultaneously and then shattered like bubbles one after another.
Meanwhile.
The mechanical prompt echoed in the void:
[Congratulations on passing the trial perfectly!]
[Due to the complete elimination of the Demon Race crisis, the rewards are doubled!]
[Distributing rewards——]
Before the words were even finished, a torrent of overwhelming energy instantly poured into Gu Xing’s body.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Under the wash of this energy, his attributes increased once more.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit]
[Contract Quota: 2/3]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 1500→1900]
[Constitution: 1500→1900]
[Spirit: 2434→2834]
[Speed: 1500→1900]
Originally, clearing this level of the Secret Realm would only increase attributes by 200 points, now...
He had increased by 400 points!
This directly boosted his various attributes to 1900 points.
And now his Spiritual Attribute...
Has even exceeded 2500 points!
Exceeded the limits of the Human Race?!
Gu Xing pondered for a moment, finally attributing it to his exceptional talent.
Subsequently, Gu Xing hastily instructed Liu Li to return.
After all, the little spirit was still left alone at the original spot!
On the way back, Gu Xing was surprised to discover...
The wasteland once eroded by Demonic Qi, now bursting with vibrant vitality.
It seemed to be due to the disappearance of the Demonic corpse!
When the two landed on the city wall, they were greeted by an elf with a face full of resentment.
Seeing this, Gu Xing immediately apologized.
It was at this moment that the mechanical prompt echoed once more.
[In three minutes, the Challenger will be transported to the next level]
Not just Gu Xing, everyone else in the Secret Realm received this message.
Veronica and Saint Cecilia discovered the abnormality of this Secret Realm.
It originally required a persistence of two hours, but now...
In less than an hour, the challenge had ended prematurely!
What was wrong with this Secret Realm?
So unusual?
...
Meanwhile.
In the City of Chaos.
Wang Yu stared at the command in his hand, his knuckles involuntarily tapping the tabletop.
Qin Chuxue’s "Level One Alert" instruction tightened the atmosphere of the entire city abruptly.
Not just Longxia Country...
The Council, the Holy See, even those Alien Races were all itching to move.
It seemed necessary to speed up the progress...
He squinted his eyes, his gaze piercing through the window looking towards the southern part of the city.
It was urgent to quickly contract that Ghost Race and cultivate it to Commander Level.
Only then could he have a greater measure of self-preservation in the approaching storm.
"Come here."
With a soft call, a Commander Level Beast Master stepped forward.
"My lord, what are your orders?"
"How’s that Ghost Race?"
This Commander Level Beast Master hesitated for a moment, yet replied:
"Under our surveillance, that Ghost Miss has remained behind closed doors! But... her sister often vanishes without a trace."
Upon hearing this Beast Master’s response, Wang Yu snorted coldly.
"Her sister is unimportant! Just a low-attribute, useless Guardian Beast!"
"But..."
"Ten days is too long, I don’t want to delay any further!!"
"Pass my order, give her a final three-day deadline, if she still doesn’t comply..."
Wang Yu’s voice turned cold.
Three days later, if that Ghost Race still refused to contract.
Then don’t blame him for resorting to any means!
The Commander Level Beast Master immediately understood upon hearing this:
"I will handle it right away!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 95: Sis, I’m in Love!
chapters.content:
Chapter 95: Chapter 95: Sis, I’m in Love!
The order given by Wang Yu was quickly delivered to the Beast Masters monitoring Qing Shuang.
"Miss Qing Shuang, my master asks us to inform you that you only have three days left. Please quickly decide whether to form a contract!"
This message was enveloped in Spiritual Power and delivered into the courtyard.
Fei Yue, who had just returned to the courtyard, heard these words after watching Gu Xing enter the Secret Realm.
???
"Sister, what’s happening?"
Once Fei Yue reacted, she immediately went up to Qing Shuang.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Why has her sister been pressured to form a contract just while she wasn’t in the courtyard?
But upon hearing this, Qing Shuang’s expression remained unchanged.
Ten days being reduced to three days merely meant her time in the City of Chaos had been shortened.
Looking at the somewhat anxious Fei Yue, she spoke indifferently:
"Yue, it’s nothing. Last time a Monarch Level Beast Master was forcing me to form a contract with him!"
"But it doesn’t matter, I’ve already decided to leave here in two days! With you by my side, they can’t stop us!"
However.
Hearing this, Fei Yue instantly panicked.
If her sister leaves here, how can she form that contract with the human?
"Sister, wait! We can’t leave so easily; that human was hard for you to find. How can you give up so easily?"
Upon hearing this, Qing Shuang gently stroked Fei Yue’s hair.
"Yue, not everything develops according to our expectations!"
"The results just show that we don’t have fate with that human! No need to force the issue!"
Looking at her sister’s attitude that forming a contract doesn’t matter either way,
Fei Yue felt something bad was happening!
Her sister’s decisions are never easily changed.
Moreover...
Now Gu Xing has just entered the Secret Realm, and he can’t come to form the contract with her sister!
If things continue like this...
They will really miss out!
No way!
They absolutely can’t let things continue like this!
Fei Yue’s face wrinkled into a ball.
Silly mind!
Think quickly!
What matters most to her sister?
Wait!
Although her sister has always been indifferent, if it involves her own matters...
"Sister! I can’t leave!"
Qing Shuang immediately cast a puzzled look.
Fei Yue forced herself to meet her sister’s gaze, eyes determined.
"Sister, I can’t leave!"
She repeated firmly.
"Why?"
Qing Shuang frowned slightly.
Her younger sister had always been obedient, but today she refused to leave with her?
Facing her sister’s questioning gaze, Fei Yue swallowed hard.
Human...
Sorry!
I have no choice!
Next time we meet, I’ll apologize to you.
Quietly apologizing to Gu Xing in her heart, Fei Yue took a deep breath:
"Sister, do you know why I’ve been going out recently?"
Qing Shuang slightly furrowed her brows, her blue eyes showing a hint of interest.
This question indeed piqued her interest!
"Sister, I’ve fallen in love! I’m fond of a human! I can’t leave here!"
"These days, I’ve been going to meet that human!"
Love?!
Qing Shuang’s pupils suddenly contracted.
She knew her sister too well...
Fei Yue had never defied her for years, yet today’s behavior was so unusual...
There’s only one explanation:
She was telling the truth!
"Boom——!"
The pitch-black Ghost Patterns climbed across Qing Shuang’s body like living creatures, and the rampaging Ghost Qi shot into the sky.
The bricks of the entire courtyard shattered under the pressure, the walls tearing apart like paper.
Her sister was so pure; how could she suddenly fall in love with a human?
There was only one possibility...
That human was deceiving her sister’s feelings!
"Where is that human...?"
Qing Shuang’s voice seemed to echo from the Nine Netherworld Hell.
Under this oppressive force, Fei Yue’s body trembled inadvertently, yet she stubbornly raised her head:
"My boyfriend... he went to the Secret Realm! He’ll be back in two or three days! Sister, I won’t go with you!"
Boy...friend?
The Ghost Patterns around Qing Shuang began to surge violently, and the temperature dropped to freezing point within a hundred-meter radius.
She recalled those rumors about despicable humans——
Scum who specialized in deceiving innocent Alien Race girls...
Now daring to target my sister!
"Rumble——"
Even more terrifying Ghost Qi formed a towering column of light, causing the buildings in the entire block to tremble violently.
The Commander Level Beast Masters monitoring from afar felt this aura, their faces instantly pale!
"What is happening to this Ghost Race? Why is she suddenly releasing such terrifying aura? Does she intend to force her way out of our blockade?"
"No wonder Wang Yu insisted on forming a contract with her!"
"I feel like this Ghost Race is now stronger than my Guardian Beast! And I’m a Commander Level!"
"Quickly report to Lord Wang Yu, this Ghost Race is about to escape!"
...
In the Secret Realm.
Gu Xing didn’t know that Fei Yue had gotten him into big trouble.
At this moment, everyone had been transported to the second layer of the Ascension Realm!
Perhaps because he drew the Demon Pattern from the demon corpse, this led to...
Of the 50 people who originally entered the Secret Realm during the first-layer challenge.
None of them...
Were eliminated.
At this moment, everyone was gathered in a plaza.
All the members were discussing the abnormality of this first-layer Secret Realm challenge!
"This Secret Realm challenge wasn’t right? It ended in less than two hours!"
"Yeah, senior participants from previous years mentioned this first layer is particularly difficult! Many are eliminated every year, but this year..."
"But passing this level is our limit, there are only three slots to enter the third layer, and among us from Longxia Country, we’re the least, probably no one can get in..."
Among those participating in the Secret Realm this time, Longxia Country only accounted for 10 people.
While the Holy See accounted for 25 people, and the Council for 15.
There are only five slots for promotion to the second layer.
This means...
people will be eliminated on site!
In previous trials, there often appeared a dominant force ensuring those entering the third layer were its own members.
And the weaker side with fewer numbers was often the first to be eliminated!
This time Longxia Country is the weaker side!
To avoid such a situation...
Unless, like four years ago!
A genius from the weaker Longxia Country emerges to dominate the scene!
In the Holy See team, a blonde knight stepped forward and whispered:
"Holy Daughter, I suggest eliminating the members from Longxia Country first. As for the Council..."
His gaze involuntarily drifted to Veronica, his Adam’s apple moving, swallowing his remaining words.
Can’t beat!
Even his own Holy Daughter was evenly matched with that one!
If he really said it, he had no doubt his Holy Daughter would kick him in apology to the other side.
However...
At this moment, Veronica suddenly stepped back and lazily waved her hand:
"Members of the Council, you can deal with it as you want, I am not involved!"
This sentence was like a thunderbolt, causing an uproar among the Council members.
But regarding Veronica’s decision, no one dared question it within the Council.
At present, the Council members naturally weren’t going to be cleared first.
Thus, all eyes turned to the only "soft target" in the field——
Longxia Country team!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 96: Blood-colored Church
chapters.content:
Chapter 96: Chapter 96: Blood-colored Church
The alliance between the Council and the Holy See...
The people of Longxia Country quickly reacted.
The strong parties allied to first eliminate the weaker ones!
This situation has long been commonplace in past Secret Realm trials.
"Contract the formation!"
Someone shouted, and several Beast Masters of Longxia instinctively gathered back-to-back.
During their movement, they unconsciously protected Gu Xing in the center.
"Brother." A strong man with piercing tiger-like eyes said in a low voice, "Everyone’s listening to your command now!"
"Although the chances for promotion are slim, we can’t let them succeed easily!"
The other few people entering the Secret Realm were acquainted with him, and all were familiar with each other’s strengths.
Only Gu Xing...
So young and already qualified to enter the Secret Realm!
His identity wasn’t hard to guess...
He must be a genius from the National Academy!
Here in the Secret Realm, the command naturally fell to the strongest person.
Thus, the responsibility naturally fell to Gu Xing!
With the strong man’s reminder, Gu Xing slowly came back to his senses.
Upon entering the second layer, some information about the "Ascension Realm" suddenly flooded into his mind.
This Secret Realm was originally a gift from this world to the Human Race!
Capable of helping Extraordinary Level Beast Masters of humans to advance to Commander Level with greater power!
However...
Hundreds of years ago, the Demon Race invaded here and deliberately left the corpse of a Demon God, leading to a low passage rate for humans through the first layer.
Therefore, unless one was a top genius, it was impossible to pass this Secret Realm’s first layer and enhance one’s attributes.
It directly led to...
Human Commander Level Beast Masters being inexplicably weaker.
But now things are different...
The Demon God’s corpse has vanished, and the Secret Realm is restored to normal!
As long as humans enter the Secret Realm, they can directly pass through the first layer!
Obtain the rewards from this Secret Realm, enhancing their attributes!
At this moment.
The remaining nine individuals from Longxia Country all focused their gaze on him, awaiting his instructions.
On the opposite side, the Council and Holy See had surrounded several individuals!
Yet, Gu Xing had no worries about the scene in front of him.
Watching the tense faces of his compatriots, Gu Xing reassured,
"No worries! Numbers never decide the key to victory."ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The people of Longxia Country behind him didn’t yet understand Gu Xing’s intention; he stepped forward to block everyone’s front.
Although only five can be promoted this time, among the Council and Holy See...
Besides Veronica and Cecilia, he doesn’t intend to let any other person enter the third layer.
Seeing Gu Xing standing alone in front of the Longxia people, Cecilia felt a sense of impending doom.
Veronica’s previous stance of staying out seemed profoundly intriguing now.
She had directly chosen not to involve herself with her fellow Council members, choosing to back down!
Cecilia speculated that there were two reasons for her action.
One was that Veronica might have refrained because she knew Gu Xing and chose not to intervene.
But knowing Veronica’s character, this probability was extremely low.
Therefore, the other possibility was the most likely.
That man named Gu Xing possesses power enough for Veronica to dread!
At this thought, Cecilia’s gaze grew more intense.
As a Church Saintess, she couldn’t be as capricious as Veronica.
If she ignored the Holy See members, it would undoubtedly undermine her authority within the Holy See.
"Saintess, act now!"
"Yes, Longxia Country only has ten participants this time; just a little action from you, Saintess, and..."
With the urging of the Holy See members, Cecilia had no choice but to summon her Guardian Beast.
With the descent of two blood-colored beams of light, her two Guardian Beasts slowly revealed themselves—
One was a unicorn as translucent as a blood jade.
The other was a handsome man with an exotic appearance, unfolding a pair of dark bat wings on his back.
Seeing these two Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing slightly frowned.
It’s a name as holy as the Holy See, but the Guardian Beast...
[Blood-Colored Unicorn]
[Status: Blood Transformation]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Legendary Nine Stars]
[Power: 2200]
[Constitution: 2300]
[Spirit: 2500]
[Speed: 2700]
[Skills: Crimson Trample...]
...
[Blood Prince]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 2900]
[Constitution: 2900]
[Spirit: 2900]
[Speed: 2900]
[Skills: Blood Shadow Clone, Blood Fury...]
Blood Race?
Gu Xing searched his memories for relevant information.
These are a race comparable to Ghosts, feasting on blood, possessing nearly eternal life.
Also one of the top races in Alternate Space!
He glanced around and noticed that besides Cecilia’s Blood Race Guardian beasts, the other Holy See members’ Guardian beasts also showed different degrees of blood transformation traits.
Scarlet pupils, sharp fangs, blood-red patterns faintly visible under the skin...
"Now you understand why I hate dealing with these people, right?"
Veronica had somehow sidled up next to him, her red lips slightly parted,
"They call themselves the Holy See, but their full name is—Blood-colored Church."
She deliberately emphasized the words "Blood-colored."
Gu Xing didn’t understand this knowledge and thus looked at Veronica with puzzled eyes.
Blood-colored Church?
Veronica shrugged.
"Their land borders the Demon Realm. To resist the Demon Race invasion, Her Majesty the Empress..."
"Actually harbored the Blood Race, willingly offering the country’s populace as voluntary food for the Blood Race!"
Sacrificing citizens as food?!
At this, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
He finally understood why Veronica cursed the Holy See as hypocrites!
"I suggest you eliminate Cecilia too! She’s nothing good!"
Seeing the eager Veronica, Gu Xing automatically ignored this suggestion.
If Cecilia were truly prevented from advancing.
That would really be a slap in the face for the Holy See.
Veronica saw Gu Xing’s expression and knew there was no hope.
She spread her hands and walked to the side.
But...
Her gaze towards Gu Xing grew more attentive!
She knew Cecilia’s strength comparable to hers.
But Gu Xing...
Veronica had no assurance.
Though she’d seen Gu Xing act in the Elf Secret Realm before...
She had a premonition that it was definitely not Gu Xing’s limit.
And this time...
She can finally observe properly!
Both the White Emperor and Nether Spirit Leopard also grew solemn upon seeing the situation.
They were also curious about what extent Gu Xing’s strength had reached!
Being able to leap tiers to kill a Commander Level at the Extraordinary Level!
At that moment, an artificial female voice resumed in the void.
[Second layer examination begins!]
[Promotional slots available: 5]
[Successful promotions are eligible for rewards!]
Upon hearing this voice, Gu Xing summoned his own Guardian Beast.
Dazzling blue light brightened!
Divine Angels and Natural Spirit simultaneously appeared, their terrifying aura sweeping the entire scene!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 97: Him? Win?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 97: Chapter 97: Him? Win?!
The moment Gu Xing summoned his two guardian beasts.
The Blood Prince’s pupils contracted.
His gaze fixated on the Angel’s wings!
Six wings!ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
As one of the oldest races in the alternate space, he knew well what six wings signified for the Angel Race.
Myth level talent!
Moreover, judging from the aura emanating from that Angel’s body...
It seemed she was the strongest of the Blazing Angels in the Angel Race!
As for the other guardian beast...
Upon seeing Vera clearly, his gaze also contracted.
The extinct Elf Clan!
According to legends, only one Elf survived from their clan.
The daughter of the Elf Empress!
Her talent is also Myth level!
Either of these, he’s no match for.
And now...
Both guardian beasts appeared simultaneously!
No point in fighting!
Yet Cecilia hadn’t realized this, she slightly bowed and respectfully said:
"Lord Prince, only with your intervention can the Holy See achieve victory in this battle!"
Hearing Cecilia’s request, the Blood Prince’s mouth twitched.
Him?
Victory?!
"Get lost!"
After cursing angrily, the Blood Prince immediately returned to Cecilia’s Beast Taming Space!
Hearing this, Cecilia was completely dumbfounded!
Though the Blood Prince was contracted with Cecilia.
Even the contract was because the Prince liked her blood and thus made the contract.
Therefore, forget commanding the Blood Prince.
For her to make the Prince fight, she needed to request it.
However...
Generally, the Prince wouldn’t refuse her requests.
But today...
The surrounding members of the Holy See were also taken aback by this scene.
"What’s wrong with the Prince? Is he in a bad mood? Why refuse to fight!"
"It’s the first time I heard the Prince curse! But even if the Prince doesn’t act..."
"The Holy Daughter still has the unicorn, this battle is still stable!"
"Holy Daughter, please step in and eliminate Longxia Country!"
Seeing this unusual situation, the Council members also focused their gaze on Cecilia.
Something seems off!
First, let the Church Saintess test the depths of Longxia Country.
Under the gaze of everyone, Cecilia could only bravely send the unicorn to act.
However...
The unicorn looked at Liu Li, yet dared not approach.
Both possessing sacred attributes, the Legendary Level unicorn was directly suppressed by Liu Li before...
Let alone acting; it didn’t even dare to directly look into Liu Li’s eyes.
One could say, Cecilia’s guardian beasts were greatly suppressed by Gu Xing!
Veronica, nearby, also twitched her mouth.
She initially thought she could observe Gu Xing’s strength, but now found...
There was no fight at all!
Observing the awkward situation, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched too.
He thought, at the very least, it would take some effort.
After all, the Blood Race was a half-step Myth talent.
Who would have thought...
"Master, that Blood probably saw me and Liu Li sister, thus afraid to act! Blood creatures are the shrewdest!"
Vera said while trying to approach Gu Xing.
But Liu Li was quick-eyed, lifting Vera by the neck to the side.
Green Tea Spirit talks, but trying to touch too?
"Master, what Vera said is correct. My flames greatly suppress him; he likely doesn’t dare to fight me!"
Her Blazing Angel Fire not only greatly harms the Demon Race but also heavily suppresses the Blood Race.
Furthermore, given the subordinate relationship between the Blood Race and those of the Holy See, it was unlikely to fight their nemesis for these humans.
After hearing his beasts’ explanations, Gu Xing nodded.
Still, even if the Saintess didn’t act against him...
He wouldn’t show mercy.
"Liu Li, keep Cecilia, as for the rest...eliminate them all!"
"Understood!"
Liu Li nodded slightly.
The next moment, she flashed before a member of the Holy See.
Before the Holy See member could react, the Blazing Angel Flames brushed past and burned him to ashes.
With Liu Li’s current attributes, dealing with humans of the Extraordinary Tier Ninth was effortless.
No need to activate Blazing Angel state; just relying on attribute suppression, she could easily eliminate them.
Seeing Liu Li leave, Vera initially wanted to leap into Gu Xing’s arms.
Liu Li had been blocking her recently, and it’s been ages since Gu Xing held her.
However, just as she prepared to act...
"Vera, go deal with those Council members!"
Vera’s stealthy approach to Gu Xing reluctantly halted!
She turned back, looking towards the Council members with resentment.
Damn humans!
The Council seeing Liu Li easily eliminate the Holy See members realized Gu Xing’s terrifying strength.
Watching Gu Xing direct another guardian beast to strike them, they became vigilant.
"No worries, that human can’t possibly have two equally strong beasts!"
"Right! The Angel’s already that monstrous; this beast’s impossible to be as strong!"
"Group together, have the beasts patrol outside. She won’t be able to split us apart!"
The Council’s actions were swift.
Within moments, everyone grouped together.
However.
Vera wouldn’t eliminate them one by one like Liu Li.
Especially since this group just interrupted her bonding with her master.
"Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
Vera gently raised her hand.
A Thunder Dragon gradually manifested, its body materializing more firmly.
For Vera, dealing with these humans was simpler than handling the Demon Race of the first layer!
The continuous tide-like attacks from the Earth Demon Clan required her sustained skill usage.
But this group of Extraordinary Tier Ninth humans...
She merely waved!
The Thunder Dragon, with unstoppable momentum, charged towards the clustered group.
The assembled crowd, facing Vera’s skill...
Within moments, they were utterly wiped out.
Longxia Country’s people were already dumbfounded witnessing this.
Mere moments, and the Church and Council forces were obliterated completely by Gu Xing.
The man who had spoken earlier swallowed as he watched Gu Xing’s figure retreat.
So this is the talent of the National Academy?
The gap to their Extraordinary Tier Ninth is this vast!
Veronica showed no surprise witnessing this.
She slightly bent down and asked White Emperor:
"White Emperor, how do you assess the strength of those two guardian beasts?"
A hint of thought flashed in White Emperor’s solitary eye before he slowly spoke:
"That Angel seemed to not fully exert herself when killing the Holy See members; I can’t ascertain her full strength!"
"However, the Elf earlier, when releasing that Thunder Dragon, I could tell she exerted all her efforts."
"Though she’s very strong, if I go all out, I should be able to defeat her!"
Listening to White Emperor’s words, Veronica nodded.
After all, this guy was personally selected by the old man...
His strength should be decent!
Should be!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 98: The Third Trial!
chapters.content:
Chapter 98: Chapter 98: The Third Trial!
But, if the Blood Prince in Cecilia’s Beast Taming Space heard this sentence from the White Emperor, he would definitely roll his eyes.
You’re bullshitting!
Even a Blood Prince like him can only cower in the Beast Taming Space in front of those two Guardian Beasts.
And you, with your Half-step Myth Talent Polar Bear...
claim you can defeat the top two races of Angels and Elves?!
However...
The Blood Prince’s gaze penetrated the Beast Taming Space and fell on Gu Xing.
That human actually managed to gain the favor of two top races!
Such an unusual situation must be reported to the Blood Ancestor!
This human is too special!
As one of the oldest surviving races in this space, they know that this space has a particular fondness for the Human Race!
Even this Secret Realm, if it weren’t for his contract with Cecilia, he wouldn’t be able to enter!
Thinking of Cecilia, he cursed under his breath again:
"Fool!"
Outside.
With the joint effort of Liu Li and Vera, the other members of the Council and Holy See were already cleared by the two Guardian Beasts.
Returning to Gu Xing’s side, Liu Li once again dragged aside a little elf trying to pounce on Gu Xing.
This elf has been getting a bit too audacious lately!
And after eliminating the other members of the Council and Holy See.
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the remaining members from the Longxia Country.
He, Veronica, and Cecilia were about to occupy three quotas.
That means there are two quotas left!
And among the remaining people from Longxia...
there are nine!
"You all..."
Before Gu Xing could speak, the nine remaining people from Longxia Country raised their hands in indication.
"I withdraw!"
"I withdraw too!"
...
With the words of withdrawal spoken, they swiftly wiped their own necks cleanly.
"I’ll also wit..."
The big guy who had just squeezed next to Gu Xing took out the dagger he was carrying, ready to wipe his neck.
Gu Xing hurriedly stretched out his hand to stop him.
"Wait! Enough is enough!"
Gu Xing hurriedly spoke.
And the big guy turned around to look.
Only then did he realize...
that besides a female teammate left beside him, everyone else had wiped their necks and exited the Secret Realm!
A blush instantly appeared on his face!
But it was not too visible under his dark skin.
"Well... I’m Gao Qiang!"
He scratched his head, speaking a bit shyly.
The other female teammate also introduced herself: "Shen Man!"
"Gu Xing!"
After greeting the two of them, this layer of trial had ended!
[Congratulations to the five Trial Takers for passing!]
[Rewards will be distributed now!]
The same sensation as the first layer appeared once again, and Gu Xing checked his information.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angel, Natural Spirit]
[Contract Quota: 2/3]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 1900→2200]
[Constitution: 1900→2200]
[Spirit: 2834→3000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 1900→2200]
Besides the Spiritual Attribute, the other three attributes increased by 300 points again.
But...
The Spiritual Attribute can no longer be increased!
Gu Xing frowned slightly.
It looks like 3000 points is the limit for the Human Race!
While Qin Chuxue reached 2500 points...
Calculating based on the first layer increasing by 200 points and the second layer by 300 points...
That means in the third layer, Qin Chuxue gained a total of 500 attribute points!
However, Qin Chuxue failed to pass the third layer.
That implies, as long as he can pass the third layer...
is there a chance to exceed all of his attributes to 3000 points?!
When Gu Xing came back to his senses, he discovered that five platforms had appeared during that time.
A mechanical female voice sounded again.
[Initiating the third trial!]
[Platform challenge competition!]
[Fail the challenge and you will be transported out of the Secret Realm!]
Looking at the five identical platforms, Gu Xing casually chose one and stepped onto it.
Veronica, Cecilia, and others also selected one and stepped onto the platforms one after another.
But Cecilia’s gaze stayed on Gu Xing.
She wasn’t stupid...
Earlier, witnessing the Blood Prince’s behavior, she was momentarily stunned.
Now coming back to her senses, she realized one thing...
that the Blood Prince might have been fearful of Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast, which was why he returned to the Beast Taming Space immediately.
However, realizing this made her inhale sharply.
A Guardian Beast capable of intimidating the Prince...
how strong must it be?!
And as the five ascended onto the platforms, a demon race slowly appeared on each platform!
[Skinning Demon]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Demon Captain (equivalent to excellent level)]
[Power: 1400]
[Constitution: 1600]ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
[Spirit: 1100]
[Speed: 1600]
[Skills: Flesh Stripping...]
Regarding the initially appearing Extraordinary Level demon race...
Too weak!
The demon race’s form was not even solidified before the vine summoned by Vera drained it.
And with this demon race slain.
Gu Xing clearly felt his attributes, except for Spiritual Attribute, increase by 10 points!
It seems rather simple!
Yet...
with this demon slain, the newly appearing demon race...
had increased tenfold!
Now standing before him were a whole ten Skinning Demons!
But it posed no threat to him.
Without needing Liu Li to act, Vera’s vine alone easily managed to grasp these demons.
And with the death of these ten Demon Captain level Skinning Demons, next appeared before Gu Xing...
were ten Demon General level Skinning Demons!
This posed no threat to Gu Xing, but for Gao Qiang and Shen Man...
it was a bit pressing!
With extreme difficulty, the two managed to kill these ten demon races!
Coming next...
was a Supernatural Tier Ninth Demon King!
Such a level was far beyond Gao Qiang and Shen Man’s abilities.
After exchanging a glance with Gu Xing, the two could only resign to exit the Secret Realm!
And facing this Supernatural Tier Ninth Demon King!
Veronica and Cecilia also took it slightly seriously!
