Though both their Guardian Beasts surpass even legendary levels, stronger than this Demon King.
Nonetheless, since it was Demon King Level, the two did not act carelessly.
Cecilia called the Blood Prince once more.
The Blood Prince did not refuse this time, though Cecilia had acted foolishly before...
With the orders from the Blood Ancestor, he must give his all to assist Cecilia in passing this Secret Realm.
Watching the Demon King appear before him, Gu Xing wasn’t overly worried.
[Fallen Demon King]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Demon King]
[Power: 2500]
[Constitution: 2600]
[Spirit: 2500]
[Speed: 2400]
[Skills: Demon King’s Body...]
Each attribute around 2500 points.
Compared to Liu Li, it was far worse.
Not to mention Liu Li also possessed the Blazing Angel Form.
For Liu Li...
Demon King Level should be considered a warm-up?!
No need for Gu Xing’s commands, Liu Li, with all attributes over 3000, practically instantly obliterated this Demon King.
The Blood Prince, seeing this scene, secretly rejoiced he didn’t face that Angel.
Though being killed in this Secret Realm doesn’t result in death...
the agony of being burned by the Blazing Angel Fire, he definitely does not want to experience!
Soon, Veronica and Cecilia passed one after the other.
Next to appear were demon races...
that both simultaneously felt immense pressure from!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 99: Demon King of Commander Level!
chapters.content:
Chapter 99: Chapter 99: Demon King of Commander Level!
[Fallen Demon God]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Half-Step Demon God]
[Power: 2800]
[Constitution: 2700]
[Spirit: 2999]
[Speed: 2600]
[Skills: Eternal Night Gaze, Original Sin Furnace, Dark Shield]
When the form of this Half-Step Demon God fully solidified, Gu Xing raised an eyebrow.
He finally understood why Qin Chuxue didn’t clear this level of the Secret Realm!
After killing one member of the Demon Race, the next one would immediately appear.
And the newly emerged Demon Race’s power increases exponentially.
This is not only a test of the challenger’s strength but also a test of endurance!
Perhaps under such circumstances, Qin Chuxue would fail the challenge.
On the other side.
Upon seeing the Demigod Level Demon Race appearing in the arena.
Veronica and Cecilia simultaneously tensed their bodies.
Although their Guardian Beasts possess Demigod talent, the power of the Demon Race before them is completely equal to that of their Guardian Beasts.
It’s just because of the Secret Realm’s condensation that the Demon Race shows no trace of intelligence!
This causes a slight gap between its true power and that of a Demigod Level Demon Race.
But...
Before entering the Secret Realm, both knew what enemies they would face on this level!
Therefore, upon seeing this Demigod Level Demon Race, neither of them panicked.
"White Emperor!"
"Prince Sir!"
They both spoke almost simultaneously.
Under this command, both Guardian Beasts quickly charged forward to battle with the Demigod Level Demon Race.
Meanwhile Gu Xing...
Looking at the Demigod Level Demon Race, there was no trace of worry in his eyes.
Compared to the Commander Level Demon Race he previously faced...
It’s still too far off!
All Attributes not even reaching 3000 points!
"Liu Li, settle it!"
Once he finished speaking, Liu Li’s gaze tightened without any hesitation.
"Blazing Angel Form, release!"
"Boom——"
Eight crimson-golden wings suddenly spread from her back, and the blazing Holy Fire instantly swept through the entire space.
Her attributes skyrocketed!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 3020→6040]
[Constitution: 3010→6020]
[Spirit: 3000→6000]
[Speed: 3030→6060]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
Under the support of the Blazing Angel State, Liu Li’s attributes were completely equal to that of Commander Level Demon Race.
To this Extraordinary Level Demon Race, it’s overwhelmingly powerful!
With just a slight flap of her wings, amidst the flow of blazing flames, her form seemingly teleported before the Fallen Demon God.
The opponent didn’t even manage to raise a hand before Liu Li’s Holy Sword slashed out a brilliant arc.
"Swish!"
The body of the Demon God was split in two like thin paper, and blazing Angel Flames ignited at the cut.
Instant kill!
Seeing this, Gu Xing roughly estimated Liu Li’s strength.
In the Blazing Angel State, aside from the Celestial Fire Domain being slightly weaker than the Domain of Commander Level Guardian Beast.
In other aspects...
Liu Li is already no different from a Commander Tier One Guardian Beast!
While in the Doomsday Angel Form...
Liu Li’s attributes could rival even Commander Tier Two, or even Commander Tier Three Guardian Beast.
If the Soul Devouring Talent is added on top...
Gu Xing shook his head, casting that thought aside.
As things stand...
He has yet to encounter a Demon Race that could endure this much!
Under the enhancement of Soul Devouring Talent, Liu Li’s attributes are close to 20000 points!
With such sky-defying attributes, even if suppressed by a Domain...
It is enough for Liu Li to easily defeat her opponents!
Yet.
What seemed like an ordinary battle to Gu Xing stunned Veronica and Cecilia.
Demigod Level Demon Race...
This easily?!
Both stared at the Demon God’s remnants beneath Liu Li’s feet, their pupils violently shaking.
Though they had already tried to overestimate Gu Xing’s strength, they didn’t expect...
Gu Xing’s strength would be to such an extent!
What’s even more terrifying...
Gu Xing hadn’t even used his Talent!
"Gulp."
Simultaneously, they both swallowed hard.
Meanwhile.
The White Emperor and the Blood Prince nearly simultaneously dispatched their own opponents.
Both Guardian Beasts were panting heavily, bearing injuries of varying degrees.
Though the power of this Demon Race was one notch below theirs.
But still, it was Demigod Level...ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
Their bodies inevitably suffered some minor injuries.
After the battle ended, the Blood Prince’s gaze involuntarily shifted to the other side of the arena.
When he saw Liu Li’s pristine, sacred form...
He once again felt wise about his choice!
No wonder the Angel Race is the best at combat...
Perhaps, aside from the more fiercely combative Ghost Race, no other race can compare to the Angel Race!
Even the White Emperor took full note of Liu Li’s performance.
It no longer dared to say anything about defeating Liu Li now!
The Angel could easily settle the Demigod Level Demon Race, which means...
She could easily take him out as well!
Gu Xing completely ignored Veronica and the others’ thoughts.
At the moment.
After killing this Demigod Level Demon Race, his attributes increased again!
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angel, Natural Spirit]
[Contract Quota: 2/3]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 2200→2700]
[Constitution: 2200→2700]
[Spirit: 3000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 2200→2700]
Now the Power, Constitution, and Speed attributes are just 300 points away!
From reaching the ultimate limit of the human body!
With no more room for improvement!
As for the upcoming challenge...
Gu Xing’s gaze slightly narrowed.
Must take things seriously!
The formation speed of the Demon Race before him compared to earlier is noticeably slower.
However, though the body of this Demon Race hasn’t fully solidified yet, Gu Xing can already feel the terrifying pressure emanating from it.
Commander Level!
And this level...
Seems a bit high!
And when Veronica and Cecilia saw the Demon Race form...
Veronica pulled out a golden clock, while Cecilia revealed a Blood Core!
Using only their Guardian Beast to pass this challenge is clearly impossible!
If this Commander Level Demon Race was below a Demon General, they might stand a chance to clear it!
But the Demon Race appearing in the arena...
[Fallen Demon King]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Half-Step Demon God]
[Power: 6000]
[Constitution: 6100]
[Spirit: 6400]
[Speed: 6000]
[Skills: Eternal Night Gaze, Original Sin Furnace, Fallen Domain]
Commander Tier One Demon King!
All Attributes reaching 6000 points!
And also possessing a Domain!
The average Attributes of their Guardian Beasts are less than 3000 points, plus the suppression from the Fallen Domain...
How can they fight?!
Hence, for them to pass this Secret Realm.
The Council and Holy See chose a clever strategy!
[Time-Travel Pocket Watch]
[Quality: Myth]
[Function: Temporarily restore a portion of contracted strength]
[Blood Core]
[Quality: Myth]
[Function: Communicate with the Blood Ancestor]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 100: Blood Ancestor, Lilith!
chapters.content:
Chapter 100: Chapter 100: Blood Ancestor, Lilith!
Gu Xing’s lips twitched when he saw the items appearing in Veronica and Cecilia’s hands.
Opening cheats when losing?!
But the Council Holy See is indeed generous, two Myth Level items...
Just like that, given for both of them to use!
Shaking his head, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the Demon King in front of him, which was about to fully manifest.
Long Zhenguo didn’t give him any Myth Level gear, so he had to rely on his own strength to tough it out!
But still...
Can’t win without cheats?!
"Liu Li, Celestial Fire Domain!"
"Understood!"
Before the words even finished, fiery golden flames erupted, completely engulfing the Commander Level Demon Race!
Almost simultaneously, the Demon Race also unfolded its Fallen Domain...
"Boom!"
The two opposing Domain Powers clashed violently in the air, black and gold energies corroding each other!
Domain showdown!
However, Gu Xing could clearly feel...
This Demon King’s domain strength wasn’t as formidable as the Winged Demon encountered before!
Although its Basic Attributes were higher, it only had a 30% suppression on Liu Li...
Nevertheless, its attributes did surpass that Winged Demon’s by quite a bit!
But such attributes to Liu Li...
"Liu Li, Doomsday Angel Form!"
Liu Li was never short of ways to boost attributes!
The Holy Fire around Liu Li suddenly turned golden as the ninth and tenth wings abruptly appeared!
Ten-Winged Doomsday Angel!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Power: 6040→9060]
[Constitution: 6020→9030]
[Spirit: 6000→9000]
[Speed: 6060→9090]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
All attributes breaking through the 9000 threshold!
No need to activate the Soul Devouring Talent.
Even enduring 30% Domain Suppression, Liu Li’s attributes at this moment still crushed the Commander Level Demon King ahead!
Looks like this Secret Realm isn’t deliberately creating trouble!
At the same time.
A crisp "click" sound came from another arena.
The Myth Level "Time-Travel Pocket Watch" in Veronica’s hand was reversing, and the White Emperor’s sole remaining eye emitted a pressure only a Monarch Level can possess.
Although it only briefly restored one-tenth of its peak strength...
It’s enough to handle a Commander Tier One!
"Boom!"
The White Emperor’s massive hand cleanly crushed the Demon King’s skull.
As it turned to look at Gu Xing’s arena, it happened to witness Liu Li’s Sword of the End slice off the Demon King’s head.
???
The White Emperor’s bear mouth gaped wide, disbelief filling its lone eye.
A Commander Tier One can still be defeated instantly?!
Hacks?!
And on Cecilia’s arena...
The Blood Prince knelt on one knee, Cecilia’s hands crossed over her chest, both gazing reverently at the blood-red crystal suspended mid-air.
"Blood Ancestor, your people humbly welcome your descent!"
Their voices trembled, like the most devout believers.
Blood Ancestor?!
Gu Xing’s brows raised slightly, his eyes drawn irresistibly.
The strongest existence among the current Blood Race?
Under everyone’s watchful gaze, the blood-red crystal slowly rotated, a dense blood mist spreading forth.
As the red mist churned, a bewitching figure gradually solidified...
A long dress, scarlet like blood, moved without wind, its wild aura sweeping across the entire arena.
"We beg you, Blood Ancestor, to aid us in passing the trial!"
Cecilia’s forehead almost touched the ground, her voice full of awe.
The Blood Ancestor merely glanced at them indifferently, lifting a slender hand—
"Swish!"
A crimson breath instantly enveloped the Commander Level Demon King.
Before everyone could even register what happened, the Demon King turned into a pool of boiling blood in the mist!
This strength...
Gu Xing’s pupils constricted, reflexively checking the attributes!
[Blood Race Ancestor (Lilith)]
[Status: Extremely Weak (Essence Damaged)]
[Level: King Tier Nine (Suppressed)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: ???]
[Speed: ???]
[Skills: ???]
All shrouded in ???
Gu Xing’s pupils contracted abruptly.
Even in an extremely weak state, this being still maintained the Monarch Peak rank!
At full strength...
Surely at least Totem Level!
Suddenly, as if sensing something, Lilith slowly turned her head.
Her eyes, seemingly harboring an endless sea of blood, directly met Gu Xing’s, and in that instant...
"Buzz!"
Gu Xing felt as if his blood would freeze, cold sweat instantly soaking his back.
Fortunately, she merely glanced indifferently and then looked away.
"Cecilia."
Lilith’s voice was icy, like a frozen blood river.
"This trial, you must pass."
Upon hearing this, Cecilia dared not hesitate, immediately replying:
"As you command!"
Seeing Cecilia’s obedience, Lilith’s scarlet dress began to dissolve into wisps of blood fog.
Until the last trace dissipated in the air, Cecilia exhaled deeply, shakily standing to her feet.
"Huff——"
She wiped the cold sweat from her forehead.
Each encounter with the Blood Ancestor felt like a brush with death.
The Blood Prince also stretched his stiff joints, his bat wings trembling naturally:
"Remember the Blood Ancestor’s command! You must pass this Secret Realm!"
After saying this, his body transformed into a streak of blood light, retreating back to the Beast Taming Space.
And at this moment.
The cold, mechanical voice sounded once more.
[Congratulations to the three challengers for successfully passing the stage!]
[Now proceeding to distribute rewards!]
A familiar warmth coursed through his body.
Gu Xing checked his various attributes.
[Power: 3000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 3000 (MAX)]
[Spirit: 3000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 3000 (MAX)]
All four attributes reaching the Extraordinary Tier limit!
Glancing at the others, Veronica and Cecilia’s attributes seemed not to receive such enhancements.
Perhaps because they relied on external forces?
Gu Xing made an estimate...
At this moment, their respective attributes should be on par with a Monarch Peak!
As the familiar warm current swept through his body.
The corner of Gu Xing’s eyes caught a glimpse of the other two; it seemed that Veronica and Cecilia’s attributes didn’t experience such enhancement.
The side item for both seems to have its drawbacks?
At this time, the cold mechanical voice once again rang out.
[Congratulations to the three challengers for passing successfully!]
[Now proceeding with the reward distribution!]
...
Meanwhile.
Back at the Blood-colored Church Kingdom, Central Castle.
A blood-red crystal figure lay helplessly on a luxurious couch woven with silver threads.
"Huh..."
Lilith’s pale fingers fell limply.
"I hope Cecilia... doesn’t disappoint me..."
She struggled to keep her head up, watching her body slowly shrink.
It’s the self-protection mechanism of the Blood Race’s essence to minimize size and conserve its energy.
In a blink of an eye, the majestic Blood Race Ancestor transformed into a small cat with silver hair and red eyes, curled helplessly on the gigantic silver bed, looking extraordinarily fragile.
"I must obtain the Human Race’s Divine Pattern!"
"Only with the blood stained by the Divine Pattern can..."
Dizziness washed over her, and she fell back into a deep sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 101: Golden Divine Pattern!
chapters.content:
Chapter 101: Chapter 101: Golden Divine Pattern!
Inside the Secret Realm.Follow current novels on No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
The moment the three stepped into the fourth layer, they simultaneously froze...
No mechanical prompt, no trial rules explained, just a suffocating silence.
"What is this...?"
Before Veronica’s words were finished, the ground suddenly shook violently!
"Boom——"
Under their shocked gaze, a colossal willow tree that seemed to reach the heavens erupted from the ground.
Its trunk was like a pillar supporting the sky, straight into the clouds.
Except for a few green branches, all others were scorched.
This is...
Gu Xing’s pupils shrank, and he immediately checked its information.
[World Tree]
[Level: ???]
[Talent: ???]
[Attributes: ???]
[Current Status: Dying]
[Introduction: The supreme existence accompanying the first descent of the Alternate Space, witnessing the birth and extinction of countless civilizations]
....
At the instant he saw this introduction, Gu Xing realized...
The most important thing in the Ascension Realm is this World Tree!
The World Tree existed since the initial descent of the Alternate Space...
It must know why the Human Race cannot break through to Monarch Level!
Seeing this, Veronica and Cecilia almost simultaneously took out a crystal radiating a mysterious light from their bosoms.
[Memory Crystal Stone]
[Quality: Legend]
[Function: Record images]
Seeing the Memory Crystal Stone appear in their hands, Gu Xing froze in place.
Wait!
Why does he have nothing?!
The Council and Holy See were obviously well-prepared, but he...?
Little did he know, when Lei Zhan saw him, he planned to help Qin Chuxue rise to King Level, forgetting to even give him a small thing like a Memory Crystal Stone.
Gu Xing’s lips twitched.
Though he didn’t have a Memory Crystal Stone...
He took out his phone from the Beast Taming Space.
This should work too.
After Liu Li recorded the footage well beside him, Gu Xing, Veronica, and Cecilia exchanged nods and stepped forward.
"Rustle—"
The few green branches of the World Tree suddenly swayed gently, sweeping around the three as if probing.
A moment later, an ethereal voice arose:
"I’ve finally waited for you... the race favored by the Alternate Space."
???
Favored?
The three simultaneously showed bewildered expressions.
The Human Race can’t even break through to Monarch Level, where does the favor come from?
As if sensing their confusion, the World Tree’s branches quivered slightly, and three dazzling golden light shadows slowly appeared in the void.
"These are called Divine Patterns, the keys to a higher dimension."
"Only races that obtain Divine Patterns can give birth to existences beyond Monarch Level."
Gu Xing’s gaze fell upon the golden Divine Pattern shadows in the sky.
He discovered...
Among these, his magic patterns in the Beast Taming Space were not the same thing?
It’s just that...
One is dazzling gold and the other is deep black!
"The reason you are said to be the race favored by the Alternate Space is that... other top races in the Alternate Space only possess a single Divine Pattern, whereas the Human Race..."
"Possesses all three!"
Upon hearing the number "three," Gu Xing was startled.
Three times more than other races!
This number indeed fits the term "favored," but the greater doubt then surged in his heart.
If that’s the case, why hasn’t the Human Race obtained even one Divine Pattern to this day?
Perhaps able to see the thoughts in his heart, the World Tree continued:
"The only way to obtain Divine Patterns is to pass the corresponding Myth Level Secret Realm."
"You have passed the trial of the Ascension Realm; seven days later, the first Divine Secret Realm will open."
"But remember, not only can alien races without Divine Patterns participate, but those strong races who already possess them will covet..."
"This is the Human Race’s only chance to obtain the first Divine Pattern."
"The first Divine Secret Realm’s level restriction is at the Extraordinary Tier. Though challenging, I believe you can do it."
When saying this, Gu Xing felt...
It seemed that the World Tree was speaking directly to him!
After answering all questions, those scorched branches suddenly intertwined into a Teleportation Array.
"Finally, I hope you can unite all powers to defeat the Demon Race!"
With a gentle glow, the three had returned to the initial plaza.
A breeze brushed past, and Gu Xing found a green willow leaf in his hand unbeknownst to him.
Seizing the moment unnoticed by anyone, he promptly stored it in his Beast Taming Space.
"Boom—"
A moment later, three Monarch Level pressures simultaneously descended upon the plaza.
Lei Zhan stood in mid-air, his gaze sweeping over the two council members of the Council and Holy See.
"Iron Wall" Tucker from the Council’s ninth seat, and "Crimson Duke" Walter from the Blood-colored Church’s Twelve Knights.
They are tough opponents...
The three exchanged a glance and instantly reached a consensus.
For now, it’s best if there is no internal conflict within the Human Race.
"Each takes their own people, no objections?" Lei Zhan broke the silence first.
Tucker crossed his arms and nodded, while Walter elegantly performed a knight’s salute to express agreement.
Their strengths were evenly matched; all had truly reached Monarch Level by slaying the Demon Race!
If conflict arose, none would benefit.
Taking their own people away was clearly the best solution.
In the plaza.
Veronica saw the scene and knew it was time for farewells.
She waved at Gu Xing, "Monster, see you in seven days!"
To have the Verlo Family’s eldest daughter acknowledge his monstrous strength, over the years...
He was the only one!
However, hearing that title, Gu Xing’s forehead immediately sprouted a few black lines.
Monster... how unpleasant!
On the other side, Cecilia looked at Gu Xing with a hint of fear in her eyes.
After all, the Blood Prince dared not make a move in front of Gu Xing!
"Let’s go!"
Lei Zhan’s large hand heavily clapped Gu Xing’s shoulder, and Monarch Level spiritual power burst forth.
"Boom!"
The two transformed into streams of light, soaring into the clouds, rushing towards the Longxia base in the City of Chaos.
At this moment, Lei Zhan’s heart was itching with excitement...
Clearing the Ascension Realm was already a guaranteed matter.
But what happened inside the Secret Realm?
Only they knew!
...
In the City of Chaos.
The courtyard previously destroyed by Qing Shuang had been restored.
Qing Shuang leaned against the window, her azure hair gently swaying in the breeze.
Sensing the Monarch Level aura sweeping across the sky, her blue eyes slightly narrowed...
The Secret Realm had concluded!
The human who deceived Fei Yue’s feelings... should appear now.
Her gaze shifted to her sister facing the wall, and she slowly spoke:
"Your boyfriend seems to have emerged. Do you want to find him?"
Though Qing Shuang’s tone was calm, Fei Yue knew it was all a façade.
Without hesitation, she shook her head emphatically.
"Good!"
Upon hearing those words, Fei Yue instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
But soon, her heart was again tense.
"Though I don’t know who that human is... we will see him soon enough!"
"If you dare to tip him off..."
The black Ghost Pattern flashed swiftly across Qing Shuang’s face.
Fei Yue’s body shrank, her head shaking like a rattle.
She originally wanted to notify Gu Xing, thinking she might have caused him major trouble.
But seeing her sister’s current state...
She immediately abandoned that thought!
If she left now, she had no doubt her sister would take righteous action by breaking her legs!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 102: Guardian Beast Limits!
chapters.content:
Chapter 102: Chapter 102: Guardian Beast Limits!
City of Chaos.
Longxia Country base.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
In less than a minute, Lei Zhan had already brought Gu Xing back from the Secret Realm entrance to the City of Chaos.
As soon as they landed, Gu Xing was yanked by Lei Zhan towards the secret meeting room.
The moment he opened the door, his pupils contracted slightly...
Besides Qin Chuxue and Lei Zhan, there was another familiar person.
"Principal Long, you’re here too?"
"Long time no see!"
Long Zhenguo’s eyes were full of comfort.
From Gu Xing being specially recruited, to passing through the "Ascension Realm" in just a month and a half.
His level had risen from Extraordinary Tier One to Extraordinary Tier Ninth, just one step away from reaching Commander Level.
But this also proved that sending Gu Xing to the Northern Territory early was a correct decision!
Next, after exchanging a few casual words, Gu Xing took out the recorded video from the Secret Realm.
Long Zhenguo stared at the smartphone plastered with stickers, his forehead was full of black lines.
This scoundrel Lei Zhan didn’t even prepare a Memory Crystal Stone?!
Feeling Long Zhenguo’s displeased gaze, Lei Zhan’s body instantly tensed up!
It’s worth noting that the leaders of the Four Major Military Regions were all students of Long Zhenguo.
To avoid being beaten by Long Zhenguo, he quickly projected the video.
As the equipment started, the holographic screen in the center of the meeting room suddenly lit up.
An enormous image of a willow tree stretching across the heavens and earth instantly filled the entire view.
Gu Xing timely explained from the side:
"This tree is called the World Tree..."
After a while, as the video finished playing, the meeting room fell into a deathly silence.
The faces of the three Monarch Level experts were frozen with disbelief.
It turns out it wasn’t their talent that was inadequate, preventing them from breaking through Monarch Level...
It’s actually because the limit of the Human Race has been set in stone!
Without Divine Patterns, it’s impossible to reach beyond Monarch!
But realizing this point, Long Zhenguo’s expression became grave.
The importance of Divine Patterns is self-evident!
However...
According to the World Tree, any race is able to snatch the Divine Pattern from the Human Race.
A troubling situation!
In the City of Chaos alone, there are hundreds of alien races, large and small.
Besides the City of Chaos, there are also some top races that don’t cooperate with the Human Race!
If all the races join in together...
Then in the Divine Secret Realm, the Human Race will be surrounded by enemies!
But when he looked at Gu Xing, his furrowed brows relaxed a bit, feeling slightly assured.
After all, the first Divine Secret Realm is limited to the Extraordinary Level, with Gu Xing present...
The likelihood of Longxia Country obtaining the first Divine Pattern... is still relatively high!
"Gu Xing," Long Zhenguo suddenly stood up, pressing his hands heavily on the meeting table:
"In this Divine Secret Realm, you are Longxia’s hope! Any requests, feel free to ask!"
Looking at Long Zhenguo full of sincerity, Gu Xing nodded.
This time he will definitely participate in the Divine Secret Realm!
Therefore, even though he has already reached the peak of the Extraordinary Level, he’s not in a hurry to breakthrough.
As for the needs...
Gu Xing tentatively informed Long Zhenguo about the materials needed for improving Liu Li and Vera’s talent.
"Light Divine Crystal?"
"Earth Marrow?"
...
Every time a name was mentioned, Long Zhenguo’s brows furrowed tighter.
When the last material name fell, the old principal shook his head helplessly:
"These materials, I’ve never seen, or even heard of them!"
However, Gu Xing was prepared for this mentally.
Last time in the National Treasure Vault, what he saw should be all of Longxia Country’s mythical materials.
He’s just giving it a try; knowing that there’s none doesn’t disappoint him.
Subsequently, he turned to ask another question.
"Principal Long, the Human Race has its limits at the Extraordinary Level, but does the Guardian Beast have limits?"
Earlier he noticed that the bear contracted by Veronica had 3000 points in all attributes!
Why precisely this number?
Upon hearing this, Long Zhenguo’s gaze immediately turned to Qin Chuxue.
Qin Chuxue has reached the limit at the Extraordinary Level, so she should understand this issue better.
Qin Chuxue pondered for a moment before speaking:
"I only know Qing Li’s situation... its talent is at the demigod level."
"Years ago after Qing Li’s attributes reached a specific value, it indeed couldn’t continue to improve!"
"Qing Li’s attributes... should be comparable to the White Emperor contracted by the council miss."
Qin Chuxue couldn’t see the specific attributes of Guardian Beasts, so she can only compare with others.
And Gu Xing, hearing this, immediately understood.
Similar to the White Emperor, it means the Guardian Beast Qin Chuxue had also reached 3000 points in attributes.
It seems like 3000 points is indeed the limit for Guardian Beasts below myth level!
But 3000 points are certainly not the limit for his two Guardian Beasts.
Liu Li’s attributes have already exceeded 3000, and Vera’s Spiritual Attribute has even exceeded 3400!
Evidently, the limit for myth-level Guardian Beasts completely surpasses 3000 points!
However, now both Guardian Beasts have reached Extraordinary Tier Ninth.
How to continue enhancing the attributes of Guardian Beasts?
For some reason, Gu Xing suddenly thought of the Demon Gods earlier.
Whether it was Wolf Demon God Walker or Fallen Demon God...
There are demon patterns in their bodies!
Could it be that myth-level Guardian Beasts need to merge with Divine Patterns to enhance to their limits?
At this thought, Gu Xing’s eyes brightened!
It makes sense!
The Demon Race at the Demon God Level all have demon patterns, surely myth-level Guardian Beasts should have them too!
Considering the attributes of Liu Li and Vera right now...
They are only slightly higher than demigod-level Guardian Beasts.
This is clearly unreasonable!
Realizing this, he no longer worries about it.
Seven days later, the Divine Secret Realm will open.
Are his thoughts correct?
Obtaining the Divine Pattern and testing it out will make it clear!
However, before that...
He must first contract his third Guardian Beast!
His level is about to break through to Commander Level, unlocking the chance to contract a fourth Guardian Beast!
But now...
He doesn’t even have a third Guardian Beast in sight!
Next, after informing Long Zhenguo and the others about all the information he knew, he hurriedly rushed to the arena at the center of the City of Chaos.
Never mind!
Even if he can’t find that Ghost Race girl, he must select a Guardian Beast to contract first.
After all, upon entering the Divine Secret Realm, it’s hard to know what kind of enemies will be encountered.
A little caution is never wrong!
He has to maximize the combat power enhancements!
Even if the combat power of the third Guardian Beast is a bit weaker, but....
It’s better than having none!
Inside the meeting room.
After Gu Xing left, the room fell silent.
After a long time, Long Zhenguo slowly stood up.
"This time the Divine Secret Realm is not just a problem for Longxia Country alone, but a problem faced by the entire Human Race!"
"The council first seat, Blood Empress... it’s time to gather with these old friends."
"Chuxue, keep an eye on the alien races in the City of Chaos. If any race crosses the line, make an example of them first."
"As for you..."
Long Zhenguo’s gaze turned to Lei Zhan.
"Notify Longxia Country’s Four Major Military Regions to impose martial law; at this critical moment, precautions against the Demon Race must be taken to prevent them from attacking!"
Upon hearing Long Zhenguo’s instructions, both Lei Zhan and Qin Chuxue immediately complied.
"Understood!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 103: No! No Contract Allowed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 103: Chapter 103: No! No Contract Allowed!
The Longxia base is not far from the arena.
It wasn’t long before Gu Xing arrived at the most bustling area in the City of Chaos.
Chaos Arena!
As he stepped in, deafening cheers surged like waves.
On the towering arena, two alien guardian beasts were fiercely battling.
Gu Xing randomly selected a spectator to ask:
"Hello, I’d like to ask, if one wants to find a powerful guardian beast contract, is there a quicker way?"
The person didn’t even turn their head, impatiently waving their hand:
"If you have the ability, get on stage and fight! Make these aliens submit, and they’ll naturally scramble to contract with you!"
Then went back to shouting at the arena.
So that’s how it is...
Gu Xing understood the rules here!
As long as you can prove your strength, the aliens will naturally vie to contract with you.
If that’s the case, then get on stage and fight!
Just as well, the battle between the two aliens on stage had already ended.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
Gu Xing leaped and landed steadily on the blood-stained arena.
With a wave of his hand, two summoning arrays appeared, and Vera and Liu Li simultaneously appeared on the stage.
The audience below began to discuss immediately upon seeing this.
"What does this human intend to do? Challenge the entire arena?"
"Looks like... this human plans to choose his third guardian beast!"
Gu Xing stood with his hands behind his back, waiting on the arena for a long time, but realized no aliens came up to challenge him.
What’s going on?
Gu Xing turned slightly, his gaze falling on Vera beside him.
Vera immediately understood Gu Xing’s intention.
If these aliens aren’t coming on stage, then provoke them!
"Citizens of the City of Chaos, have you lost the courage to even step on the stage?"
Vera’s crisp voice was particularly piercing in the silent arena zone, yet still, no one responded.
Not long ago, they were just beaten thoroughly by the Ghost Race, so they didn’t dare to casually step on the stage now.
This guardian beast belongs to the Elf Race, a top-tier race on par with the Ghost Race.
If you’re not strong enough, stepping up is just embarrassing!
However, at this moment, the crowd suddenly parted like a tide.
"Let me!"
A burly figure leaped into the air, the heavy landing shaking the arena slightly.
Half-dragon Kaike stood proudly across from Gu Xing.
His purpose in coming to the Northern Territory was to find a human contract!
Now, finally encountering a human with decent strength, he definitely couldn’t miss this chance!
Seeing this half-dragon, Gu Xing immediately checked its information.
[Half-Dragon (Kaike)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Legendary Nine Stars]
[Power: 2700]
[Constitution: 2600]
[Spirit: 2100]
[Speed: 2500]
[Skills: Dragon-man Bloodline (Attributes increased by 1.3 times)...]
Extraordinary Tier Ninth, Legendary Nine Stars talent!
And all attributes are excellent!
Seems like...
Contracting this Dragon-man wouldn’t be bad!
Facing Gu Xing, Kaike realized this elf wasn’t simple after stepping onto the arena.
A powerful spiritual wave flowed around her.
A strong foe!
Facing this elf, he felt as pressured as when confronting the Ghost Race.
The pressure was immense!
Kaike’s dragon tail anxiously slapped against the ground.
This elf shouldn’t be of Myth Level as well, right?
His luck shouldn’t be that bad...
But at this moment, Vera suddenly exclaimed softly.
Then she took a step back, pushing Liu Li forward.
Fighting isn’t suitable for her!
Besides, her situation isn’t suited for one-on-one combat.
At this moment, hiding beside her master is the best outcome.
"Master~" She tugged on Gu Xing’s sleeve pitifully, "This guy covered in scales is so scary..."
Like a frightened little bunny, she timidly wanted to burrow into Gu Xing’s arms.
However.....
Before her trick succeeded, Liu Li’s little hand already precisely grabbed her by the nape.
Be obedient!
Liu Li’s golden pupils coldly swept over her.
Vera immediately nodded obediently, showing a "I’m very well-behaved" look.
Yet, when Liu Li turned around, Vera immediately hugged Gu Xing’s waist from behind, pressing her cheek against his back:
"Master, Sister Liu Li was fierce to me just now, I’m so scared..."
Seeing Vera like this, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
But, this creature is his guardian beast, so Gu Xing helplessly rubbed Vera’s head.
Across from him, Kaike saw this scene, a hint of displeasure flashed in his dragon eyes:
"Human, by sending this Angel up, are you looking down on me? That elf’s aura was clearly stronger just now!"
But before Gu Xing could answer, Liu Li’s gaze abruptly turned cold.
Not as good as that Elf?
She was already in a bad mood because of that Green Tea Spirit, and now this Half-Dragon dared to add fuel to the fire?
"Heh!"
Liu Li laughed coldly, and fiery golden flames suddenly erupted.
"Blazing Angel Form, release!"
In an instant, Liu Li’s eight wings extended from her back, a terrifying aura sweeping over the entire arena.
Kaike’s dragon scales bristled instantly, a chill surging from his spine straight to his head.
This feeling...
Why does it seem familiar?
His dragon eyes constricted, heart pounding wildly.
Could he be doomed to repeat the same failure again?
No!
As a descendant of the Dragon Race, he would never allow himself to fail once more!
"Roar——!"
Kaike roared to the sky, dragon blood boiling within him!
The dark red scales shimmered with a metallic sheen, muscles bulging like steel.
[Dragon-man Bloodline activated!]
[Power: 2700→3510]
[Constitution: 2600→3380]
[Spirit: 2100→2730]
[Speed: 2500→3250]
Yet in front of Liu Li, whose attributes in Blazing Angel Form exceeded 6000 points.
It was insignificant!
However, Dragon-man Kaike seemed unaware of this fact.
"The glory of the Dragon Race cannot be tarnished!"
"Even when facing strong enemies, we will only stand..."
However, before he could finish his slogan...
"Boom!"
Liu Li, moving at a speed indiscernible to the naked eye, pressed his head directly into the arena’s stone slab.
The hard bluestone ground instantly cracked, web-like fissures spreading wide.
"Hiss——"
The entire audience gasped in unison, many subconsciously touching their own heads.
"This Angel is just too ruthless..."
"But, the power of this Angel... is truly strong!"
"Kaike in front of her didn’t even have the slightest chance to fight back!"
The scene that followed made everyone involuntarily twitch their eyes.
Liu Li, as if venting, tossed Kaike back and forth like a sandbag.
Fortunately, with the thick skin of the Dragon-man, plus Liu Li deliberately holding back, although the scene was brutal, they were only superficial wounds.
"Stop... I admit defeat!"
The battered and bruised Kaike finally seized a gap, trembling as he raised his hand.
Liu Li then stopped, elegantly turning back to Gu Xing’s side.
Seeing Vera still clinging to Gu Xing, Liu Li immediately shot a cold glance.
Eek!
Vera stiffened all over, immediately letting go of Gu Xing, sliding three meters away, and flashed a flattering smile at Liu Li.
This Green Tea Spirit knows her place!
Liu Li snorted softly, finally retracting her warning gaze.
And at this time, Kaike cleared his mind a bit.
If the Dragon-man Race were to be defeated by humans...
He suddenly stepped forward and knelt on one knee heavily:
"I, Dragon-man Kaike, am willing to make a contract with you!"
And upon hearing this voice, the scene instantly erupted.
"What?! Kaike actually voluntarily pledged allegiance?!"
"Damn, I’m so jealous! That human already has such a powerful Angel, and now he’s getting Dragon-man Kaike too!"
Although Kaike had previously been defeated by Qing Shuang.
But besides Qing Shuang, he was the strongest known Extraordinary Level Guardian Beast of the City of Chaos!
At this moment, he was kneeling before a human, acknowledging him as master!
Gu Xing, seeing this scene, pondered slightly.
He intended to agree. After all, the Ghost Race girl from last time was nowhere to be found.
He would soon have the fourth contract position, so contracting this Legendary Nine Stars Guardian Beast first...
Should work!
But...
Before he could speak!
"No way!"
"No way!"
"No way!"
Three decisive voices of rejection rang out simultaneously!
In Vera and Liu Li’s eyes, this Dragon-man.....
Regardless of appearance, character, or even gender...
Was not acknowledged by the two Guardian Beasts!
As for the third voice...
It was shouted out by Fei Yue, who had just arrived!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 104: Battle for Supremacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 104: Chapter 104: Battle for Supremacy
Time rewinds to a few minutes earlier.
"Miss Qing Shuang!"
An alien attendant rushed into the courtyard in a panic.
"There’s a human Beast Master in the arena—his Angel Guardian Beast just defeated Kaike!"
Angel?!
Fei Yue heard that word and immediately realized who the human was.
Gu Xing!
Only he has an Angel as his Guardian Beast!
Qing Shuang sharply caught her sister’s strange reaction.
Looks like this human is her real target!
"Fei Yue, show the way!"
Hearing her sister call her full name, Fei Yue instantly froze all over.
But faced with Qing Shuang’s unyielding gaze, Fei Yue could only apologize in her heart to Gu Xing once more.
Sorry, human!
I really didn’t mean for this, I truly had no other choice!
After psyching herself up, Fei Yue gritted her teeth and grabbed Qing Shuang’s hand.
Void Power surged forth, and a rift in space tore open in an instant.
The next moment.
The two sisters appeared atop the Chaos Arena.
Unexpectedly, just as they entered the arena, they saw...
A Dragon-man was kneeling on one knee, trying to pledge loyalty to Gu Xing!
And...
Gu Xing actually seemed ready to accept!
???
This Dragon-man is trying to steal her prize!
After everything Fei Yue paid, if the human didn’t contract with her sister...
"No way!"
Fei Yue mustered all her strength in this lifetime and shouted out!
Gu Xing turned in surprise and found himself face to face with two suddenly-appearing Ghost Race girls...
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Innate Defect]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 100]
[Constitution: 100]
[Spirit: 100]
[Speed: 100]
[Skills: Void]
...
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Innate Defect]
