[Power: 4000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 2000 (Defect Suppressed)]
[Spirit: 2000]
[Speed: 2000 (Defect Suppressed)]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Strength Domain (Basic)]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (Strength Attribute x1.5), Sea Break (Cannot use due to physical restriction), Heaven-Breaking (Insufficient level), Star Shattering (Insufficient level)]
[Ghost King’s Body: All Attributes x1.5!]
[Strength Domain: Cannot use due to physical restriction]
Seeing this Ghost Race girl’s attributes, Gu Xing gulped down hard.
These attributes are a perfect template born for battle!
Power!
The limit for Myth Level!
With Ghost King’s Body and the Ghost Race Four Techniques as well.
Gu Xing did a quick calculation.
Power Attribute, Ghost King’s Body boosts by 1.5x, then Mountain Opening further boosts by 1.5x, adding up to...
Power Attribute!
This is almost equal to Liu Li unleashed in Doomsday Angel Form!
But this is even with the Ghost Race girl unable to use Ghost Race Second Technique Sea Break due to her Innate Defect!
If he could repair her defect...
He was tempted!
This Ghost Race’s attributes were just too extravagant!
So extravagant... he couldn’t bear to pass up this chance!
Except...
The look on this Ghost Race girl’s face seemed less than pleasant.
And Qing Shuang, seeing Gu Xing, instantly realized she’d misunderstood Fei Yue.
There’s no way she got tricked in love by this human!
On the contrary...
Fei Yue had racked her brains making so many excuses, but her ultimate goal must have been to get her (Qing Shuang) to contract with this human.
But even so...
This battle is unavoidable!
No matter if Fei Yue lied to her for this human, or wanted this human to keep a spot for her sister,
She had to win this battle!
However, that Angel...
Is very strong!
Liu Li felt the same!
She could sense the chilling pressure pouring off the Ghost Race girl.
She stepped forward, slowly, blocking Gu Xing with her body.
"Master, step back. This Ghost Race... is no pushover!"
Liu Li’s voice was more serious than ever.
Among Guardian Beasts of the same tier, she rarely felt such crushing pressure!
Gu Xing looked at Fei Yue, then at Qing Shuang.
So that’s how it is...
He finally understood why Fei Yue hadn’t contracted with him before.
Turns out, it was all because Qing Shuang was there!
But now...
Gu Xing saw the intense focus on Liu Li’s little face.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
He understood exactly what Liu Li was thinking.
Maybe the instant Liu Li saw Fei Yue, she understood both these Ghost Race twins would become his Guardian Beasts.
But even among Guardian Beasts, there are rankings.
This Ghost Race girl in front was clearly not convinced by Liu Li’s status as chief Guardian Beast!
This battle was Liu Li’s battle for status, too!
And for Qing Shuang, the same logic applied.
"Qing Shuang!"
"Liu Li!"
The two announced their names to each other.
In the next instant, golden Blazing Angel Flames engulfed Liu Li!
She felt immense pressure!
Without hesitation, she transformed into Doomsday Angel Form.
Ten-winged Doomsday Angel Form—activate!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 6040→9060]
[Constitution: 6020→9030]
[Spirit: 6000→9000]
[Speed: 6060→9090]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
All Attributes 9000!
At the same time, Qing Shuang went all out.
"Ghost King Form, activate!"
Pitch-black Ghost Patterns, like living creatures, rapidly climbed across her cheeks.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 6000]
[Constitution: 3000]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Strength Domain]
Meanwhile, the spectators outside the arena were already stunned by the scene before them.
"Why did Miss Qing Shuang get on the stage? Does she also want to contract with this human?"
"How lucky is this guy! Why would such a strong Guardian Beast as Miss Qing Shuang choose him?"
"Not good—someone report to Lord Wang Yu, or his Guardian Beast will get poached!"
A Commander Level Beast Master in the crowd saw this and instantly turned to leave.
At the same time, the Dragon-man Kaike—still kneeling on the platform—was thoroughly baffled.
Out of nowhere, the Angel and the Ghost Race girl started fighting each other.
And his wish to pledge loyalty...
was rejected by all three Guardian Beasts!
He looked up at Qing Shuang, covered in Ghost Patterns, then at Liu Li, blazing with golden flames in her ten wings.
The two of them...
He couldn’t compare to either!
So, disappointed, he turned and left the arena!
At this moment, Fei Yue suddenly flashed to Gu Xing’s side and blurted out:
"Gu Xing, once you reach Commander Level, you must contract with my sister!"
"I’m not staying here! You have to treat my sister well!"
As she spoke, a spatial rift appeared behind her.
With so many powerful Guardian Beasts, this human was never going to want a useless weakling like her.
If that’s the case, it’s better to leave on her own!
She’d come back once her sister and the human finished the contract.
But when Gu Xing heard Fei Yue’s words,
he instantly realized what this silly girl was thinking.
Did she think she was too useless, and that he’d just toss her aside?
But that’s not the issue at all...
His Beast Taming Space still had the Twin Hearts, that Myth Level treasure!
The very twins he’d wanted for so long are right here, aren’t they?
If Fei Yue ran, how could he contract her?
"Vera, tie her up for me!"
Vera moved fast—at Gu Xing’s order, a vine instantly cocooned Fei Yue like a zongzi.
She snapped her fingers, and the tip of the vine neatly sealed Fei Yue’s lips.
"Mmmph!"
Fei Yue was all trussed up, her eyes full of grievance.
She was already having such a hard time—yet this human was still so rough with her!
Gu Xing squeezed her puffed-up cheeks. "Watch closely, this is your sister’s stage."
At this moment, in the center of the arena,
Netherworld Ghost Qi billowed to the left; on the right, Holy Fire burned bright.
Neither of these top-tier Guardian Beasts would give an inch.
The fight was about to erupt!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 105: The Reason I Can’t Lose!
chapters.content:
Chapter 105: Chapter 105: The Reason I Can’t Lose!
"Ghost Race First Technique: Mountain Opening!"
Ghost Qi around Qing Shuang’s body suddenly contracted, jet-black patterns flowed across her skin like living things.
In the moment her hands crossed, the tangible ghost qi actually rang out with a metallic clank.
[Power: 6000→9000]
With this skill activated, her Power attribute was boosted another 1.5 times.
Now she was even with Liu Li, both reaching 9000 points!
Facing such a powerful opponent, Liu Li didn’t dare slack off for an instant.
"Judgment!"
She muttered low, and the golden Holy Sword suddenly burst into blazing gold flame, winding around the blade like a serpentine dragon.
This move—she hadn’t unleashed it in ages.
But confronting this Ghost Race foe, she had to go all out!
In the next instant, both their auras surged to the peak!
"Boom——!"
Almost simultaneously, ghost qi swirling around Qing Shuang and golden flames blazing on Liu Li struck out, full force!
"Rumble——!"
The two utterly opposite forces crashed at the heart of the arena, their savage shockwaves billowing out like angry surf.
The ancient bluestone stage eroded by centuries cracked and splintered inch by inch under their power, debris flying everywhere!
The nearby Extraordinary Level Beast Masters were swept off their feet by the aftermath, tumbling down in disarray.
The handful of Commander Level Beast Masters who managed to steady themselves now stared at the battle’s center, faces filled with shocked disbelief.
"Wait... aren’t these two Guardian Beasts supposed to be at Extraordinary Level? Why is the energy fluctuation they’re giving off totally on par with Commander Level!"
"Besides the lack of Domain Clash, this is Commander level combat, plain and simple!"
However, the chaos wasn’t limited to the arena—
The violent energy waves swept across the entire City of Chaos like a hurricane, even shocking several true Monarch Levels within the city.
Several mighty spiritual powers instantly locked onto the Chaos Arena!
Longxia Country headquarters.
Long Zhenguo was preparing to set out for talks with the Council and Holy See about the Divine Secret Realm in seven days.
Suddenly, a powerful energy fluctuation burst from the direction of the Chaos Arena.
"What’s that..."
Qin Chuxue, Lei Zhan, and Long Zhenguo sensed this aura almost simultaneously.
The trio channeled their spiritual power toward the Chaos Arena without hesitation.
As they laid eyes on the Guardian Beasts dueling atop the stage, surprise flickered across their faces.
But they immediately understood...
It had to be Gu Xing selecting his third Guardian Beast.
But...
That Ghost Race beast was fighting Liu Li to a perfect draw.
Did that mean the Ghost Race’s level...
Was also at Myth Level!
At the same moment, the previously curious Monarch Level spiritual powers locked onto the Ghost Race beast on the stage, perceiving its abnormality.
Any beast with stellar talent attracts covetous eyes.
Even Monarch Levels aren’t exempt!
Yet before any of them could move, an utterly domineering aura blanketed the arena in an instant.
Long Zhenguo made a move!
His action was clear: Longxia Country’s stance—
Anyone who dares interfere, becomes an enemy of the entire Longxia Country!
Feeling this intimidation, all those restless Monarch Level experts promptly contained their thoughts.
This man was one of the Human Race’s top three powerhouses. If anyone truly contravened his will...
The Council and Holy See would absolutely offer them up to Longxia Country as a sacrifice to make amends.
Seeing the Monarch Levels quiet down, Long Zhenguo just gave an icy snort, focusing his attention once again on the stage.
About this battle...
He was just as curious—who would triumph!
Chaos Arena.
In mere breaths, Qing Shuang and Liu Li had clashed hundreds of times.
Though Liu Li overpowered Qing Shuang in speed, defense, and nearly every other attribute...Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Yet Qing Shuang relied on near-instinctive battle intuition to force a deadlock with this Myth Level Angel.
However, as time wore on, Qing Shuang’s weaknesses began to show.
"Clang!"
Liu Li’s Holy Sword collided with Qing Shuang’s fist once more, showering blinding sparks.
And in that flash, Qing Shuang abruptly switched tactics, her hands clamping the sword tight as a pair of iron pincers!
"Zzzzzz——"
The Blazing Angel Flame clashed violently with thick Ghost Qi, issuing a tooth-grating corrosive hiss.
Golden holy flames punched through layers of ghost qi, scorching Qing Shuang’s hands; the stench of burned and charred flesh instantly suffused the air.
Yet the stubborn Ghost Race girl didn’t even flinch, her cyan eyes locked on Liu Li, her voice eerily calm:
"You... are strong."
Her tone was flat, but it held a sincerity she’d never shown before.
This Angel was the strongest opponent she’d faced in her life.
Liu Li’s expression tightened likewise.
She could feel her absolute dominance in attributes, but this Ghost Race foe had closed the gap with near-perfect technique.
"You’re not bad yourself."
Liu Li answered solemnly.
Hearing that recognition, Qing Shuang’s lips curled into a rare little smile.
As a Ghost, born loving battle, she hadn’t fought this freely in ages.
"Even though you’re strong..."
Suddenly, ghost qi surged madly around Qing Shuang.
"This time, I have to win! I have a reason that won’t let me lose!"
Liu Li’s heart skipped a beat.
Had this Ghost Race fighter been holding back all along?
Yet, Fei Yue—bound by Vera—began violently struggling at the sight.
Her eyes were huge with fear, gurgling "mmph mmph" as she thrashed.
Gu Xing instantly understood, signaling Vera to release her restraints.
The moment the vine slipped from Fei Yue’s mouth, she ignored the pain in her jaw and wailed out:
"Gu Xing! Stop big sis! If she keeps amping power like that, her body’ll collapse!"
Fei Yue’s cry made Gu Xing’s heart clench.
He immediately checked Qing Shuang’s attributes—
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 12000]
[Constitution: 3000 (On the verge of collapse)]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Strength Domain]
[Note: Guardian Beast is force-using "Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker"; body is at the edge of collapse!]
Seeing "on the verge of collapse" on the status board, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed tight.
This fight didn’t need to continue!
If they kept going, there was only one outcome...
Mutual Destruction!
But right now, the fighting intent in the two beasts burned so hot, no advice would reach them.
How could he stop them?
Gu Xing’s gaze flashed urgently, finally landing on Vera.
At the center of the stage—
"Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker!"
Qing Shuang’s fierce shout echoed through the arena. In an instant, her surging ghost qi contracted to nothingness.
The whole stage shuddered madly under this energy; even space began to warp and twist.
Liu Li’s ten luminous wings trembled wildly under the crushing weight, but she stubbornly held her head high.
She could feel it clearly...
Right now, Qing Shuang fully surpassed her in raw power!
However...
Liu Li’s knuckles whitened on her Holy Sword, gold flames flaring even hotter in her eyes.
Except for Master...
I will never retreat—not a single step!
"I—will—never—give—in!"
With this shout, the Blazing Angel Fire cloaking Liu Li shrank, turning pure white.
Behind her, the beginnings of an eleventh and twelfth wing were forming.
Gu Xing saw, shocked...
This moment, Liu Li’s every attribute was climbing again, bizarrely skyrocketing!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Star]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Status: Critical]
[Power: 9060→10060 (breakthrough limit)]
[Constitution: 9030→10030 (breakthrough limit)]
[Spirit: 9000→12000 (on the verge of collapse)]
[Speed: 9090→10090 (breakthrough limit)]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
[Note: Spirit attribute has broken safe limit; continued fighting will cause irreversible damage!]
Seeing this warning, his pupils contracted sharply.
Damn it!
These two idiots!
They’re willing to risk their lives just to win?!
"Shit! You morons!"
He snapped his gaze to Vera, voice leaving no room for argument:
"Vera! Elf Monarchy! Now! Right now!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 106: Elf Monarchy: Full Liberation
chapters.content:
Chapter 106: Chapter 106: Elf Monarchy: Full Liberation
"Understood!"
She also realized the seriousness of the situation on the scene.
At this moment, even a second’s delay could lead to irreparable consequences.
"Elf Monarchy: Full Liberation!"
A dazzling Jade Divine Ring roared open behind her, countless light vines burst forth from the void.
At the same time, a dark light flashed across Gu Xing’s eyes:
"Soul-devouring!"
Under the double amplification, Vera’s attribute panel frantically refreshed:
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Power: 3020]
[Constitution: 3040]
[Spirit: 3430→20580]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain]
"Vera, stop them!"
"Understood!"
Vera’s tender little face was full of solemnity at this moment.
This was the first time she faced such a thorny situation.
This task of forcibly stopping the battle without harming the two Myth Level Guardian Beasts kept her spirit stretched to its limits.
Vera didn’t dare hold back anything, her surging spiritual power rushed out like a breached dam.
In the situation of fully exerting her power, she could no longer maintain the disguise of her juvenile form.
Brilliant golden hair cascaded like a waterfall, her slender figure gradually stretching under the encirclement of the Power of Nature.
Pointed elf ears revealed themselves from her hair, the transparent light wings on her back fully unfolded.
This is... the true form of the Natural Spirit!
But at this moment, Gu Xing had no time to appreciate Vera’s true appearance.
His gaze was fixed intently on the center of the arena, fine beads of sweat seeping from his forehead.
Qing Shuang’s body was already beginning to collapse...
Liu Li could still manage, but she must not continue to fight!
Damn it!
At this rate, Qing Shuang’s body would surely collapse completely once she finished unleashing this blow.
What to do? What to do?
His brain was racing.
Suddenly, a flash of inspiration struck him.
Celestial Grace!
That skill capable of purifying all negative status!
It might be able to stop Qing Shuang’s body from collapsing!
And at this very moment, the two people in the arena were already at their peak momentum...
"Boom!"
Qing Shuang and Liu Li erupted simultaneously, transforming into two streams of black and gold light, rushing towards each other with a destructive force!
The energy storm interwoven with Ghost Qi and Holy Flame began distorting the entire arena space.
Just as the two figures were about to collide...
"Natural Lament·Bone-Eroding Vine Sea!"
Vera’s cool voice echoed across the sky.
With the terrifying support of 20,000 points of spiritual power, tens of thousands of Jade Vines burst forth from the void, instantly constructing a green barrier that spanned heaven and earth.
"Boom——!!!"
At the moment the black and gold energy torrents struck the vine barrier, the entire City of Chaos trembled.
The surrounding Beast Masters and Alien Races struggled to resist the shockwaves coming from the arena.
As they gritted their teeth and held on, their eyes were filled with shock.
The confrontation between the Angel and the Ghost Race had already gone beyond their understanding, and now...
The masses stared blankly at the Natural Spirit hovering in mid-air.
The power this Guardian Beast revealed unexpectedly crushed the Angel and the Ghost Race in the arena.
Within the Longxia Country’s station.
Long Zhenguo’s pupils contracted upon witnessing this scene.
Initially, he intended to take action and forcibly stop the two Guardian Beasts.
But...
If he intervened, the two Guardian Beasts would undoubtedly suffer serious injuries due to backlash.
It was during this moment of hesitation that Gu Xing completely resolved this crisis.
Relieved to feel the safety of the two Guardian Beasts, Long Zhenguo exhaled a sigh of relief.
If either of the Myth Level Guardian Beasts was lost due to this match, the loss would be immeasurable.
Suddenly, Long Zhenguo’s brow furrowed as he sensed a presence rapidly approaching the arena.
Realizing this person’s intentions, Long Zhenguo’s gaze hardened.
"Lei Zhan" his voice turned icy, "The Wang Family has overstepped."
Lei Zhan also felt the intent of this person.
His bronze face was covered with frost.
"A fake King Level dares to covet a Myth Level Guardian Beast?"
"It seems the Wang Family has been living too comfortably lately."
Before he finished speaking, thunder exploded!
The figure of the Northern War God had already disappeared from the spot, leaving only sizzling arcs in the air.
Chaos Arena.
Seeing Vera successfully control the situation, Gu Xing’s anxious heart finally eased slightly.
At the center of the battlefield, Liu Li and Qing Shuang were now tightly enveloped by the Jade Vines.
The two Guardian Beasts had finally settled down!
After confirming Liu Li was unharmed, Gu Xing immediately moved to Qing Shuang’s side.
Upon approaching, he discovered...
Qing Shuang’s formerly fair skin was covered with fine cracks, as if she were a porcelain about to shatter.
Immediate action was needed!
Without hesitation, Gu Xing switched his talent, golden light surging in his eyes:
"Sovereign, Celestial Grace!"
A dazzling golden halo enveloped Qing Shuang like flowing water.
With the help of the Celestial Grace status, the cracks on Qing Shuang’s body surface began healing at a speed visible to the naked eye.
It’s effective!Google seaʀᴄh Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Gu Xing’s tensed nerves finally relaxed.
"Sister!"
Fei Yue broke free from her restraints, stumbling to Qing Shuang’s side, tears rolling down her cheeks.
Her trembling fingers lightly touched Qing Shuang’s face, her voice choked with sobs:
"I’m sorry... Sister... I shouldn’t have lied..."
"I’m sorry... really sorry!"
If not for her, would her sister not have fought?
Would things not have escalated to this point!
Seeing this, Gu Xing crouched down, gently patting the girl’s trembling shoulder:
"Don’t worry, your sister is fine, she just fainted from exhaustion!"
After hearing these words, Fei Yue finally lifted her tear-filled, blurry face, tiny teardrops still clinging to her eyelashes:
"Re... really?"
"Yes!"
"But this isn’t the place to talk, I’ll take you away from here first."
It was a mixed crowd here, clearly not a good place to remain.
He was just about to signal Vera to take everyone away, when suddenly...
"Did I say you could leave?"
A sinister voice suddenly called out.
Wang Yu’s eyes were bloodshot, veins popping on his face, his gaze filled with a ferocious killing intent as he stared at Gu Xing.
A mere Extraordinary Level Beast Master...
Dared to covet his Guardian Beast?!
He didn’t know how many sacrifices he made to contract this Ghost Race.
Seeing Gu Xing crouch beside the Guardian Beast that he had set his eyes on, Wang Yu’s gaze darkened.
His voice curled into a cruel smirk, "But kill a mere Extraordinary Level, and no one would dare to hold me accountable!"
"Swish——"
Three Commander Level Guardian Beasts blurred into motion, their menacing auras sweeping the area, causing bystanders to quickly retreat.
"Kill him for me!"
"How dare you!"
A thunderous shout exploded in the sky.
A figure descended from the heavens, leaving crackling arcs in the air.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The movements of the three Commander Level Guardian Beasts suddenly froze, and their forms were abruptly halted.
"Woosh!"
Wang Yu spewed a mouthful of fresh blood, staggered back a few steps, his eyes filled with horror.
A Thunderbolt suddenly struck, leaving only crackling arcs in the air.
The figure of the Northern War God had already vanished from sight.
With only the trace of electricity in the air, he realized that Lei Zhan had taken action against him!
His pupils trembled violently as he gazed at the figure descending from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 107: Twins, Contract Complete!
chapters.content:
Chapter 107: Chapter 107: Twins, Contract Complete!
Although Wang Yu is the top genius of the younger generation in the Wang Family.
But...
Lei Zhan doesn’t need to save face for the Wang Family!
The next moment, he appeared in front of Wang Yu.
He reached out and directly grabbed Wang Yu’s throat, lifting him into the air, his eyes full of coldness.
"Cough... cough cough!"
In front of Lei Zhan, Wang Yu had no ability to fight back.
His legs kicked helplessly in the air, and his flushed face finally showed fear.
From Lei Zhan’s eyes, he felt a hint of killing intent.
And that hint of killing intent was infinitely magnified.
At this moment...
He became afraid, he became terrified!
"Lei... General Lei! I realize I was wrong! I was possessed by ghosts..."
"Heh."
Lei Zhan sneered, his fingers slowly tightening.
Some mistakes can’t be erased with a mere apology.
Feeling the sharp pain from his neck, Wang Yu panicked completely:
"You can’t kill me! The Wang Family... the Wang Family won’t... let it go..."
"The Wang Family?"
Lei Zhan suddenly interrupted him, "...what’s it to me!"
"Crack!"
A crisp sound of bones breaking rang out.
Wang Yu’s widened pupils instantly scattered, and the Beast Master who once dreamt of contracting Myth Beasts now hung limply like a rag.
After killing Wang Yu, Lei Zhan loosened his grip.
"Bang!"
Wang Yu’s corpse fell to the ground, the dull sound silencing the entire scene.
All the Alien Races and Beast Masters’ pupils contracted abruptly...
Though he was a Fake King Level, he was still considered a Monarch Level Beast Master...
Killed so mercilessly!
Lei Zhan’s chilling gaze swept across the scene, his voice echoed like Thunder Power:
"From this day forward, any force, any race, anyone——"
"Dares to lay a hand on Gu Xing, challenges the baseline of Longxia Country!"
"Those with such thoughts, be prepared for an unceasing fight with Longxia."
"Boom!"
As if responding to this declaration, several terrifying auras suddenly erupted throughout the City of Chaos.
Long Zhenguo!
Qin Chuxue!
And dozens of Longxia Country Beast Masters in the City of Chaos!
Their aura intertwined into a net, covering the entire City of Chaos.
The Monarch Level Beast Masters, watching from the Alien Race, Council, and Blood-colored Church, had faces all grave.
This time, Longxia Country...
Is serious!
If anyone dared to touch this Extraordinary Level Beast Master, the whole Longxia Country would really fight them to death!
After a long time.
Seeing the intimidation effect achieved, Lei Zhan slowly restrained his aura and approached Gu Xing:
"How about returning to Longxia Country’s base? It’s safe there!"
Gu Xing thought for a moment but still refused.
With Lei Zhan’s actions, no one in the City of Chaos would dare to lay a hand on him now.
Therefore, it didn’t matter where he went!
Seeing this, Lei Zhan didn’t insist either.
After instructing Gu Xing a bit, he left there.
He still had his own tasks to complete.
Until Lei Zhan’s figure disappeared, the audience finally came to realize:
"Who exactly is this human? That he could make Longxia Country go to such lengths for him!"
"Who cares who he is, he’s truly famous now! His name will surely ring throughout the City of Chaos!"
And while everyone was discussing, Gu Xing had already left with a few Guardian Beasts.
Leaving only the messy arena, bearing witness to this city-shaking battle.
...
A day later.Thɪs updatᴇd by
Cat Race base.
Qing Shuang’s eyelashes trembled and she slowly opened her eyes.
When she saw the figure standing by her bed, her pupils contracted abruptly.
That Angel?!
She suddenly sat up, her body instinctively surrounded by surging Ghost Qi.
The last battle hadn’t determined a winner yet!
However...
"I’m sorry!"
Liu Li suddenly bowed deeply, her silver hair cascading down with the motion.
This gesture left Qing Shuang frozen in place, a hint of astonishment in her eyes.
She’s... apologizing?
At this moment, Liu Li bit her lower lip tightly.
After Fei Yue’s explanation, she finally understood why this Ghost Race in front of her fought so desperately...
It turns out she..... was fighting for her sister.
And herself?
Had fought fiercely with this Ghost Race just for the position of a chief Beast Master.
Thinking of this, a pang of guilt welled up in her heart once more.
"I truly apologize!"
"That day... I shouldn’t have fought to that extent with you..."
Liu Li bowed deeply a second time, then quietly walked to a corner, facing the wall.
Reflecting on her actions!
It was Gu Xing’s command.
"Sister!"
Fei Yue finally awaited Qing Shuang’s awakening and couldn’t hold back, throwing herself into her sister’s arms, her tears soaking Qing Shuang’s collar:
"Sob sob... I’m sorry! I shouldn’t have deceived you!"
Qing Shuang instinctively embraced her sister, gently stroking her long hair:
"Yue, it’s alright, I already guessed!"
"Guessed when I reached the arena!"
After comforting Fei Yue for a few sentences, Qing Shuang then turned to look at Gu Xing:
Although the last battle didn’t reach a conclusion, but.... she must bring it up concerning her sister.
She looked at Gu Xing, her voice low:
"I can make a contract with you, but I have a condition."
And Gu Xing didn’t hesitate, nodded decisively:
"I agree!"
Eh?
Seeing this human so resolute, Qing Shuang was stunned.
She hadn’t even stated her condition, yet this human...
Noticing Qing Shuang’s confusion, Gu Xing spoke again:
"No matter what the condition is, I agree!"
If he let this Ghost Race with her amazing Attributes slip through, he would truly regret it for a lifetime.
Therefore, regardless of what condition Qing Shuang proposed, he agreed.
Despite seeing Gu Xing agree, Qing Shuang took a deep breath and finally voiced her condition:
"I hope after you reach Commander Level and contract me, you’ll reserve a Monarch Level contract position to contract my sister!"
Hearing her sister’s request, Fei Yue raised her head from Qing Shuang’s embrace.
Although she felt her sister’s request was excessive.
Forcing this human to accept herself as the useless one!
But after this matter, she understood.
Nothing is more important than being with her sister.
Even if this human disagreed, they could still continue wandering together.
However, Gu Xing shook his head at this moment.
Seeing this, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue’s eyes dimmed instantly.
It seems, after finally finding a human, they still couldn’t make a contract?
Noticing the sisters’ forlorn expressions, Gu Xing instantly understood their thoughts.
He extended two fingers, chuckled:
"No need to wait until Monarch Level, you don’t have to make separate contracts either!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue froze.
What does this human mean?
At this moment, Gu Xing took out the Twin Hearts and placed them in front of the two.
"You two are essentially a whole, so the contract should naturally be together!"
"If you trust me, place your hands on top of it."
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue exchanged glances.
Though unsure about the human’s meaning, but...
The two sisters, together, feared nothing!
They placed their overlapping hands slowly on Twin Hearts.
The next moment.
Twin Hearts split into two and transformed into streaks of light that entered the sisters’ foreheads.
Meanwhile, a brilliant Contract Array blossomed under the feet of the three.
Before Qing Shuang and Fei Yue could be surprised, they saw Gu Xing’s palm already firmly placed at the array’s core.
A profound message simultaneously exploded in the minds of the three:
[Twin Contract · Completion]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 108: Ghost Race Qingshuang, Swearing Lifelong Loyalty to Master!
chapters.content:
Chapter 108: Chapter 108: Ghost Race Qingshuang, Swearing Lifelong Loyalty to Master!
As this information entered his mind, Gu Xing knew...
The ghost race sisters before him had already become his Guardian Beasts!
Previously, the attributes of both girls were suppressed to lower numbers due to their Innate Defect, but now...
He was dying to find out, after Twin Hearts had fixed them, just how far the sisters’ attributes had risen.
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 100→1000]
[Constitution: 100→1000]
[Spirit: 100→1000]
[Speed: 100→1000]
[Skills: Void]
With the influence of Twin Stars, Fei Yue’s Innate Defect had already been fixed.
All her attributes had skyrocketed from 100 points to 1000—a tenfold increase!
Although even such numbers still fell short of matching the standards of a Myth Level Guardian Beast...
It was still a world of difference compared to before!
Still, Gu Xing had never planned for Fei Yue to be his main battle Guardian Beast in the first place.
Her skills and traits destined her to not be strong in face-to-face combat.
After looking over Fei Yue’s attributes, Gu Xing’s gaze slowly turned to Qing Shuang.
She was the real target of this contract.
And also...
The third main battle Contracted Beast he was about to gain!
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 4000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 2000→3500]
[Spirit: 2000]
[Speed: 2000→3000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body (All Attributes increased by 1.5x!), Strength Domain (Available)]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (Strength Attribute increased 1.5x), Sea Breaker (Strength Attribute increased 2x), Heaven-Breaking (insufficient level), Star Shattering (insufficient level)]
When Qing Shuang’s complete attribute panel was displayed before his eyes, Gu Xing couldn’t help but swallow hard.
There were only two words for this—
Terrifying!
Maybe it was because she had absorbed Fei Yue’s Myth Level attributes, but Qing Shuang’s stats far surpassed those of ordinary Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
Bear in mind, Liu Li’s current talent was Myth Three Stars...
But aside from Spiritual Attribute and Speed Attribute, every other stat of hers was completely crushed by Myth One Star Qing Shuang!
Gu Xing’s gaze unconsciously drifted to the corner of the wall.
If Qing Shuang were to fight Liu Li now...
Liu Li would find it extremely hard to win!
It was only now that Qing Shuang and Fei Yue finally snapped out of their daze.
Qing Shuang lowered her head to look at her hands, then turned to look at her sister, shock and disbelief glinting in her eyes.
She and her sister... had both been contracted?
And at the same time?
What shocked her even more was....
The Innate Defect that had plagued them for so many years had completely disappeared!
Qing Shuang tentatively circulated her Ghost Qi, and the energy rushed forth like a river with no more hindrance.
Was she really... cured?
Her only wish before had been to find a human contractor who could help her and her sister break through Extraordinary with the power of the Human Race.
As for her own defect, she’d long resigned herself to live with it forever.
But now...
Qing Shuang lifted her head, looking intensely at the human before her.
How did this human do it?
Not only had he healed her injury...
He could even contract both her and Fei Yue at the Extraordinary Level at the same time.
But as she met the smiling eyes of Gu Xing, all her confusion vanished.
Why could this human do all these things....
Does it matter?
No, it doesn’t!
What matters is...
She and her sister no longer had to wander; they had finally found their own home.
They had overcome their defect, and the Extraordinary Level was no longer their ceiling.
With that, the gratitude in her gaze towards Gu Xing was obvious.
This human...
Had given them a second life!
Qing Shuang immediately rolled off the bed, dropped to one knee, and declared resolutely:
"Ghost Race Qingshuang, pledges her life to follow her Master!"
Seeing that, Fei Yue froze for a second, then hurried to mimic her sister, dropping to her knees and bowing:
"G-Ghost Clan Feiyue, greets her Master!"
This sudden show of loyalty completely caught Gu Xing off guard.
By the time he had recovered, the sisters were already kneeling respectfully before him.
He hurried forward and gently lifted the two girls up:
"From now on, we’re partners. No need to be so formal."
When Gu Xing’s warm hands touched Qing Shuang, this usually calm ghost girl looked uncharacteristically flustered.
For decades, she had never been so close to anyone.
Now, suddenly having a master and feeling this unfamiliar bond left her at a total loss.
Gu Xing keenly noticed Qing Shuang’s discomfort, and kindly suggested:
"How about you head to the Beast Taming Space first and get familiar with the place?"
At those words, Qing Shuang visibly relaxed, immediately replying respectfully:
"As you command, Master!"
Seeing Qing Shuang like this, Gu Xing felt a little helpless.
But...
He understood that, for this ghost race girl to truly open her heart and join them, it would still take some time.
After settling the Qing Shuang sisters’ affairs, Gu Xing turned to look at Liu Li, still facing the wall in the corner.
At that moment, Vera was tilting her head, circling Liu Li restlessly:
"Sister Liu Li~ Why are you daydreaming at the wall?"
"Standing like that looks so tiring, how about coming to sit with Vera?"
Liu Li’s mouth twitched, and a vein started to pop out at her temple.
This little green tea spirit... was getting bolder by the day.
Just as she was about to teach Vera a lesson, the latter suddenly changed her tone:
"Wuwu... Sister Liu Li, you don’t know—when I saw you get hurt yesterday, Vera’s heart almost shattered..."
Vera wiped away fake tears in a dramatic fashion.
Seeing this, Gu Xing couldn’t help but cover his forehead.
He’d pretty much figured out this elf’s personality by now.
On second thought though, while Vera usually seemed totally carefree, at critical moments...
If it hadn’t been for her timely help, who knows how the fight between Liu Li and Qing Shuang would have ended up.
So Gu Xing just let her be.
After that, he stepped in front of Liu Li and purposely put on a stern face:
"Liu Li, do you know what you did wrong?"
Liu Li immediately bowed her head in apology:
"Sorry, Master, I shouldn’t have treated a future comrade that way."
"Bang!"
Hearing Liu Li’s answer, Gu Xing flicked her lightly on the forehead.
"That’s only part of it!"
"More importantly, you risked your own wellbeing for a fight!"
"If Vera hadn’t acted when she did, I’d like to see how you’d have cleaned up that mess!"
With that, Gu Xing couldn’t help but flick her once more.
This girl really makes people worry...
Off to the side, Vera perked up with pride when praised, sticking out her little chest and looking smugly at Liu Li.
Too bad her tiny size made the pose completely lack impact.
Liu Li, though, paid no attention to Vera’s provocation.
All she focused on was the care and concern in Gu Xing’s words.
Master was worried about my safety...
He... he cares about me!
The angel girl’s cheeks instantly flushed rosy red.
Seeing her reaction, Gu Xing thought maybe he’d been too harsh and hurried to soften his tone:
"Um... I’m not rejecting everything you did. Just be more careful next time, okay..."
But before he’d even finished speaking...
Liu Li suddenly threw herself into his arms:
"Thank you, Master!"
This sudden move instantly froze Vera’s smug expression.
Oh no!
The angel’s caught on!
This is bad!
"Master~ Vera wants a hug too! Wuwu~"
...
...
