chapters.title: Chapter 109: I... Don’t Look Good Anymore, Do I?
chapters.content:
Chapter 109: Chapter 109: I... Don’t Look Good Anymore, Do I?
Gu Xing helplessly soothed the two clingy guardian beasts.
As time passed, seeing no intention of the two to let go, he planned to forcibly separate them.
However, just at this moment...
"Knock knock knock!"
Upon hearing the knock on the door, Liu Li and Vera simultaneously released their grip.
In front of outsiders, the two guardian beasts were not so bold.
Seeing this, Gu Xing tidied up his shirt that had been wrinkled from being rubbed against, then cleared his throat:
"Please come in."
Sally pushed the door open and entered, bowing respectfully:
"Lord Gu Xing, someone is seeking an audience outside the base."
Upon hearing Sally’s words, Gu Xing was a bit taken aback.
Someone looking for him?
Who?
With doubts in mind, Gu Xing followed Sally to the entrance of the base.
At this moment, Ying Bing was leaning against the doorpost, gently stroking the Ice Phoenix on her shoulder with slender fingers.
Sunlight poured over her, outlining a serene and beautiful scene.
However...
Upon moving closer and getting a clear view of Ying Bing’s figure, Gu Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
He noticed that Ying Bing’s signature ice-blue long hair was now half transformed into dazzling silver-white.
This discovery made his heart suddenly sink.
This is...
He hurriedly turned his gaze to the Ice Phoenix on her shoulder.
[Profound Frost Ice Phoenix]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 3000]
[Constitution: 3000]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 3000]
[Skills: Cold Cone Piercing, Frost Storm, Frost Ring Imprisonment]
[Cultivation: Snow Crystal, Snow Lotus, Cold Marrow]
When the Ice Phoenix’s attributes panel appeared before his eyes, Gu Xing’s brows unconsciously furrowed.
He clearly remembered that when they last met, this guardian beast’s talent was only at the Legendary Five Stars, but now...
Half-Step Myth!
His gaze fell back onto Ying Bing’s half-white long hair...
What the silver-white strands represented, he knew all too well.
The Winner’s Bloodline could help guardian beasts elevate their talent, but at the cost of life force.
Now, with the Ice Phoenix’s talent reaching Half-Step Myth, this meant...
Ying Bing sacrificed nearly half of her life force!
"I... now look worse, don’t I?"
Ying Bing hung her head, her voice carrying a hint of unease.
After all, a girl cares about her appearance, and she was no exception.
A trace of disappointment flashed in her eyes, but she quickly raised her face and regained her composure.
The Divine Secret Realm will soon open.
And the geniuses of the Extraordinary Tier from Longxia Country are rare.
She didn’t want Gu Xing to face everything alone...
Therefore, despite everyone’s objections, she forcibly burned her bloodline, sacrificing half her life force for this power.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing quickly shook his head:
"How could it be? You have always been beautiful."
Saying this, the look he gave Ying Bing was filled with complexity.
He could actually guess a little about Ying Bing’s purpose for doing this.
This sluggish girl unknowingly harbored feelings for him beyond friendship.
At this moment, staring at the striking silver among her hair, Gu Xing made a decision:
After dealing with all matters in the Myth Secret Realm, he must help her solve the bloodline issue!
Receiving Gu Xing’s affirmation, Ying Bing’s mood visibly improved.
She turned to Sally, with a hint of anticipation in her tone:
"I temporarily have no place to go, can I stay here?"
In the Ying Family Secret Realm, during the one-and-a-half-month separation from Gu Xing.
She seemed to have realized her true feelings.
She just wanted to be by his side.
Even if she could help just a little, she would be satisfied.
So as soon as she arrived in the Northern Territory, she eagerly inquired about Gu Xing’s whereabouts and hurried here non-stop.
Upon hearing Ying Bing’s request, Sally suddenly came to her senses and hurriedly replied:
"Of course you can! Lord Ying Bing, I’ll arrange a place for you right away."
For this esteemed guest who had also aided the Cat Race, she naturally dared not neglect.
Soon, with Sally’s proper arrangements, Ying Bing settled down at the Cat Race base.
...
Meanwhile.
The atmosphere inside the United Military Department’s meeting room was heavy.
Long Zhenguo, the council’s first chair Verocan, and the Blood-colored Church Empress Isabelle sat facing each other, with Monarch Level beast masters from their respective countries standing respectfully behind them.
"You must have already figured out the intelligence of the Divine Secret Realm, right?"
Long Zhenguo broke the silence first.
This time the Divine Secret Realm concerns the entire Human Race.
It is not merely a matter for one faction in Longxia Country.
Therefore, the United Council and the Blood-colored Church...
This is the best solution!
Upon hearing Long Zhenguo’s words, Verocan and Isabelle nodded.
Through Veronica and Cecilia, they both understood what the Divine Secret Realm meant.
"Since that’s the case, I’ll be direct."
"This time in the Divine Secret Realm, I hope we can join forces."
"Aside from the Alien Race of the City of Chaos, recently quite a number of alien races have already arrived here!"
"At this moment, the Human Race should unite and resist the alien races together!"
Long Zhenguo’s resolute words echoed in the meeting hall.
Verocan and Isabelle exchanged glances, and after a brief silence...
"The council agrees!"
"The Holy See also agrees!"
However, Verocan suddenly changed the subject:
"I have no objection to Human Race unity, but the ownership of the Divine Pattern..."
He didn’t finish his sentence, but everyone present understood what he meant.
After all, completing the Divine Secret Realm grants only one Divine Pattern.
And here, there are three factions.
How to distribute?
Long Zhenguo pondered for a moment and said solemnly:
"How about this, in the Divine Secret Realm, as long as a Human Race acquires the Divine Pattern, the holder upon leaving the realm is the custodian, okay?"
Since as long as the Human Race acquires the Divine Pattern, their shackles beyond Monarch would be broken.
As for owning the Divine Pattern...
It wasn’t really that important.
"Alright, as you say!"
Kaven was the first to decide.
Isabelle also nodded.
Regarding the ownership of the Divine Pattern, she was confident.
With the Blood Ancestor personally taking charge...
The Divine Pattern would surely belong to the Holy See!
Seeing the agreement reached, Long Zhenguo stood up to summarize:
"It’s decided then!"
"As for the Divine Secret Realm in a few days, at that time I hope all Monarch Level experts will be present to prevent alien races from forcibly seizing it after the realm ends!"
"Of course!"
"The Holy See will certainly cooperate fully."
Isabelle looked at everyone present, a flash of sharp light in her blood-colored eyes.
After the meeting ended, the three parties left separately.
Verocan returned to the council base and immediately gave orders:
"Send the order, gather all contract Legendary Level beast masters of Tier Nine from the council, be prepared to enter the realm!"
Meanwhile, Isabelle came alone to a dark chamber deep within the Holy See.
She kneeled on one knee and reported respectfully:ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ
"Blood Ancestor, Longxia and the council have already joined forces..."
"But..."
She raised her head, her eyes igniting with fervent light:
"With you presiding, the Divine Pattern will certainly belong to the Holy See!"
In the shadows, a figure shrouded in a black robe slowly appeared.
However——
Surprisingly, this figure exuding a terrifying presence had an unusually petite silhouette.
Beneath the wide black robe, slender limbs were vaguely visible.
....
...

chapters.title: Chapter 110: The Mere Human Race—Just Slaughter Them!
chapters.content:
Chapter 110: Chapter 110: The Mere Human Race—Just Slaughter Them!
In the following days, the City of Chaos lived up to its name, with the situation becoming increasingly tumultuous.
Those ancient alien races, which had originally remained hidden, began to reveal themselves, causing undercurrents to surge throughout the city.
During this time, Gu Xing revealed to Ying Bing the entire list of materials needed for the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix’s upgrade.
Under the guise of his own needs, he asked her to relay the message to her family for assistance in searching.
Ying Bing didn’t hesitate much after hearing Gu Xing’s request and immediately agreed:
"No problem, I’ll immediately send a message to my father to ensure he searches with all his might!"
Her expression was serious and exceptionally earnest.
After all, this was one of the few requests Gu Xing had proactively made, and she was determined to fulfill it at all costs.
Upon seeing Ying Bing’s agreement, Gu Xing finally felt at ease.
Although these materials were somewhat hard to find, the Ying family is one of the four ancient clans of Longxia...
Even if they couldn’t collect all three evolution materials for the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, finding one or two shouldn’t be an issue!
Having arranged matters on Ying Bing’s end...
Sally hurriedly arrived, holding a stack of organized intelligence reports.
"Lord Gu Xing, Lady Ying Bing, this is the intelligence the Cat Race recently collected regarding the new alien races that have arrived in the City of Chaos."
Her eyes briefly stopped on Liu Li and Fei Yue, then she lowered her voice:
"The strongest among them are those similar to Lord Liu Li and Lord Fei Yue... the Angel Race and the Ghost Race!"
"The Angel Race?"
Gu Xing frowned slightly, instinctively turning his gaze toward Liu Li.
Liu Li’s expression momentarily froze.
During this time, she had been deliberately avoiding matters related to the Angel Race, but that didn’t mean she had completely forgotten the Blazing Angels Race.
It was just that her current power was weak...
She was unwilling to dwell on it, but hearing the words "Angel Race" again, a hint of worry flashed in Liu Li’s eyes.
Gu Xing, keenly aware of her emotions, gently patted her shoulder in solace:
"Liu Li, once we break through to Monarch Level, we’ll head straight to the Angel Race."
Hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Liu Li took a deep breath and nodded, the worry in her eyes easing slightly.
Thinking too much now won’t help; bettering her own strength is the best choice.
After comforting Liu Li, Gu Xing turned his gaze toward Fei Yue.
As for the Ghost Race...
"Fei Yue, is your Ghost Race also interested in the Human Race’s Divine Patterns?"
Fei Yue shook his head in confusion.
At that moment, Qing Shuang emerged from the Beast Taming Space, kneeling on one knee, saying respectfully:
"Master, regarding this matter, I might have some information."
"The Ghost Race seldom leaves their base unless... there is a treasure that can compensate for our fatal flaw."
The flaw of the Ghost Race?
Gu Xing recalled Qing Shuang’s various attributes and nodded thoughtfully.
There was a clue from Qing Shuang’s attributes...
The Spiritual Attribute of the Ghost Race was alarmingly low.
Even for a unique existence like Qing Shuang, her Spiritual Attribute was only 2000 points, far weaker for ordinary Ghost Race members.
According to Qing Shuang, this appearance by the Ghost Race was to make up for their shortcomings.
That implies that there are items in the Divine Secret Realm that could enhance the Spiritual Attribute.
However, the Spiritual Attribute...
Gu Xing’s gaze unconsciously turned to Vera.
Though this little girl always acted indifferent, he could sense...
The fleeting look of disappointment every time she saw Liu Li.
Among the combat-type Guardian Beasts, who could stand being persistently inferior in strength?
With this thought, Gu Xing had already decided:
No matter how intense the competition in the Divine Secret Realm, besides the Divine Patterns, this treasure that enhances Spiritual Power...
He must obtain it!
Upon making this decision, Gu Xing noticed that Qing Shuang was still kneeling on one knee.
Looking at this stubborn ghostly girl, a tinge of helplessness crossed his eyes.
Several days had passed, yet Qing Shuang showed no sign of change.
"Qing Shuang, get up now; there’s no need for this in the future!"
"As you command, Master."
Qing Shuang respectfully stood up, her movements precise and disciplined.
Gu Xing knew, his words... were probably in vain again!
But...
He suddenly had a spark of insight.
"Qing Shuang, how about you teach me some combat techniques?"
His attributes were no longer inferior to those of the Guardian Beasts!
Learning some combat techniques could also form a decent combat force.
Moreover, breaking through to the Commander Level, a Beast Master no longer just serves a supplementary role.
With a domain, a Beast Master also possesses considerable combat strength.
On another note, having Qing Shuang teach him combat techniques could also quickly bring him closer to this ghostly girl!
Qing Shuang immediately answered respectfully upon hearing Gu Xing’s request:
"As you command, Master!"
Since she recognized Gu Xing as her master, the stronger he became, the greater the benefit for her.
Thus, she decided:
To train her master with the most stringent standards.
As Gu Xing and Qing Shuang met eyes filled with a hint of excitement, he suddenly felt a chill down his spine.
A premonition of misfortune suddenly emerged in his mind.
It’s just training, it should...ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
be nothing, right!
....
At the same time.
At the highest point in the City of Chaos.
Two pure white figures stood against the wind, overlooking the entire city below.
"Miss Miffy, it’s wiser to keep a low profile on Human territory."
The War Angel Elder cautiously advised.
However.
The blonde girl let out a cold snort.
The night wind swept up her waterfall-like hair, her golden eyes filled with disdain and arrogance.
"Lowly Humans, how dare they be equated with us?"
Witnessing this, the Elder sighed to himself.
This young lady is different from Miller!
She is a genius with Half-Step Myth Level talent; even before the War Angels came to power...
The treatment she received was second only to the former Blazing Angel Princess Liu Li.
For this reason, she developed such an overbearing personality.
But since she is the daughter of the Clan Leader, the Elder cautiously advised:
"But Miller’s demise seems related to the Humans, so..."
"If the trash died, so be it!"
Miffy suddenly interrupted harshly, her eyes glinting with cold light.
"To lose the Angel’s treasure before death is hardly better than trash!"
"You... you are correct."
The Elder wiped the cold sweat off his forehead.
Across the entire clan, perhaps only this young miss dared to unabashedly critique the Young Clan Leader Miller like this.
However...
If she wasn’t disinterested in power, the position of the next Clan Leader wouldn’t have fallen to Miller.
"Have you determined the Ghost Race’s intentions?"
When mentioning proper business, the Elder immediately straightened his back, solemnly stating:
"Yes, their objectives do not conflict with ours."
"The Ghost Race’s aim this time is the Soul Nourishing Pool in the Divine Secret Realm."
"Very well."
Miffy’s brow slightly eased from its chill.
After all, as an ancient race famed alongside Angels, the Ghost Race’s combat prowess should not be underestimated.
"Considering the Ghost Race’s different goal, I must acquire the Ultimate Fire in the Divine Secret Realm!"
Miffy’s eyes flashed with longing when mentioning the Ultimate Fire.
The Blazing Angels are born with bloodline true fire, but what of the War Angels?
Nothing!
This innate disparity has always left the War Angel Race trailing behind.
Even though the Blazing Angels are now history, the humiliation brought by that golden flame is something she will never forget!
If she obtains the Ultimate Fire...
Not only could she wash away the shame, but more importantly...
Absorbing the Ultimate Fire might likely allow her to break through to a true Myth Level talent!
Now everything is ready, just waiting for the Human Divine Secret Realm to open.
"Let’s go!"
Hearing this, the Elder felt as if a great burden had been lifted.
In that brief moment, several Monarch Level spiritual powers had already swept through this place.
If he hadn’t concealed them with Monarch Peak spiritual power, they might have been discovered.
Before leaving, he hesitated and reminded:
"Miss, should we investigate the truth behind Miller’s fall..."
"No need." Miffy sneered, her wings suddenly spread wide, "Once my father has the time..."
"Lowly Humans can be slaughtered!"
"As you command, Miss!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 111: The Divine Secret Realm Opens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 111: Chapter 111: The Divine Secret Realm Opens!
In the days that followed, Gu Xing was completely subjected to Qing Shuang’s relentless torment.
Once this Ghost Race girl entered instructor mode, she entirely forgot the distinction between master and apprentice.
The unrelenting intensity of the training even made Gu Xing suspect...
She was conducting a personal vendetta!
But whenever he met Qing Shuang’s serious eyes, he immediately dismissed the thought.
She was clearly giving her all to teach him, how could he think like that?
Though painful, the gains were tremendous for him.
In just a few short days, his combat experience multiplied several times over.
When Lei Zhan personally arrived to pick them up, Gu Xing and Ying Bing were already geared up and ready.
Unexpectedly, the entrance to this Divine Secret Realm was right next to the "Ascension Realm."
The restrictions originally shrouding the area had dissipated, revealing a shining secret realm entrance.
On the ancient stone tablet at the entrance, the words "Divine Secret Realm · One" were boldly carved.
And on its two sides, two restrictions existed.
Those were obviously the locations for the second and third secret realms.
By the time Gu Xing and the others arrived, various races had already gathered at the scene.
In the sky, the pressure from Monarch Level experts clashed and confronted one another.
On the side of the Human Race, led by Long Zhenguo, Verocan, and Isabelle, dozens of Monarch Level experts were ready and waiting.
However, in the air opposite them, the number of Monarchs from the Alien Race was three times that of the Humans, creating a suffocatingly oppressive presence.
At that moment, a Monarch Level expert from the Alien Race stepped forward.
"What, do the Humans want to monopolize this Divine Secret Realm?"
Such questioning was anticipated by everyone present.
In the City of Chaos, races stood side by side, many of which had yet to obtain the Divine Pattern.
For them, this secret realm was undoubtedly the last hope to break the Monarch shackles; how could they give it up easily?
And Long Zhenguo and the others knew, it was impossible to prevent the Alien Race from participating in this Divine Secret Realm.
Long Zhenguo stepped forward, his voice steady and strong:
"After deliberation by our race, we are willing to share the opportunity of the secret realm with other races. But..."
He glanced around, his tone suddenly sharp:
"The fight for the Divine Pattern is limited to within the secret realm! Any race that obtains the Divine Pattern in the realm cannot be robbed externally!"
As soon as he said this, Monarchs from the Alien Race nodded in agreement.
After all, with the Divine Pattern yet to appear, they had to go along with the Humans for now.
However, the moment the Divine Pattern leaves the secret realm...
Wouldn’t it be, whoever has the bigger fist, gets to call the shots?
After reaching a consensus, the scene fell into a brief calm, with everyone waiting for the secret realm to open.
Gu Xing took the opportunity to look around, carefully scrutinizing the participants dispatched by each race.
Within the Council’s faction, apart from Veronica’s contracted Guardian Beasts, others came along with Legendary Level Guardian Beasts, but those who could pose a threat to him...
There were almost none!
But when his gaze turned to the Blood-colored Church, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed slightly.
Aside from the familiar Cecilia, there were hardly any Humans among the Church’s ranks.
A glance around revealed...
A uniform group of Blood Race!
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
Although the Blood-colored Church waved the Human Race’s banner, if the Divine Pattern landed in their hands...
It would be no different than if it fell into Alien Race hands!
At the core of the circle formed by these Legendary Level Blood Race members, a petite figure cloaked in black stood out conspicuously.
Gu Xing instinctively activated his detection ability...
Upon seeing the information, his pupils shrank rapidly.
This is...
[Blood Race Ancestor (Lilith)]
[Status: Blood Clone]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 4000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 4000 (MAX)]
[Spirit: 4000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 4000 (MAX)]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Upon seeing these attributes, Gu Xing took a sharp breath.
Blood Race Ancestor?
She actually descended personally!
Although the words "Blood Clone" indicated this was merely an avatar of the main body, but...
His gaze remained fixated on the glaring 4000 points in all attributes!
This was already the limit value for Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
Moreover, this Blood Ancestor possessed a terrifying four skills!
Gu Xing’s throat bobbed.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Troublesome!
This secret realm journey...
The greatest adversary has appeared!
Lilith beneath the black robe suddenly lifted her head, her youthful face faintly visible in the shadows.
Her scarlet eyes pierced through the crowd, locking directly onto Gu Xing.
This human...
The second time!
If the first time could be attributed to illusion, then this time...
The corners of her lips curled into a dangerous arc.
Interesting...
Yet Gu Xing, sensing the oppressive gaze, promptly averted his eyes without revealing anything.
Now was not the time to engage directly with the Blood Race Ancestor.
Shifting his attention to the Alien Race camp, his expression grew progressively solemn.
The Alien Race’s overall strength clearly overpowered the Human Race, with no fewer than ten Demigod level entities.
The ones most notable among them...
His gaze lingered on two silhouettes.
Belonged to the representatives of the Ghost Race and Angel Race!
[Ghost Race (Cang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 3000]
[Constitution: 3000]
[Spirit: 1000]
[Speed: 2700]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques...]
Though weaker than Qing Shuang, within the Demigod category...
They were top-notch existence!
Apart from this Demigod level Ghost Race entity, the others in their race were not worth worrying about.
They were all Legendary Level!
As for the Angel Race, astonishingly only one person participated!
[War Angel (Miffy)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 2800]
[Constitution: 2900]
[Spirit: 2900]
[Speed: 2800]
[Skills: War Angel Form...]
Similarly...
Far less impressive compared to Liu Li, this Angel was clearly inferior.
However, due to the complicated relations Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Fei Yue had with their respective races...
Gu Xing refrained from summoning them, letting them remain in the Guardian Beast Space for the time being.
Qing Shuang and Liu Li, perceiving the presence of the Ghost Race and War Angel, showed noticeable emotional fluctuations.
Gu Xing hurriedly calmed them with his Spiritual Power, letting them cool down.
Outside the Divine Secret Realm, naturally, no actions could be taken.
But within the secret realm...
Gu Xing’s eyes turned cold.
Upon confirming the various forces present, Gu Xing felt slightly relieved.
Though numerous Alien Race participants joined the Divine Secret Realm this time...
The real threats to him...
Only that Blood Ancestor!
Just then, Ying Bing beside him gently reached out, her cheeks slightly flushed:
"Later... shall I hold your hand? This way, perhaps we can be transported to the same place."
After a brief hesitation, Gu Xing grasped her offered hand.
This time, Longxia Country, under his request, only dispatched him and Ying Bing to attend.
Originally, he planned to visit the realm alone...
No matter how much he tried to dissuade, Ying Bing insisted on accompanying.
Ultimately, he had to concede.
Ying Bing’s competency was decent, capable of self-defense in the secret realm at least.
As time ticked by, finally...
"Buzz——"
With a booming sound shaking heaven and earth, the entrance to the Divine Secret Realm suddenly blossomed with a dazzling blue light curtain!
An energy storm shot straight into the sky.
And the moment the realm opened, Monarch Level experts hovering in air instantly became alert; tension shot up abruptly!
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 112: Kill Without Mercy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 112: Chapter 112: Kill Without Mercy!
Meanwhile.
In the deepest part of the Demon Realm, several pitch-black Demon Gates stood eternally.
Suddenly, one of the Demon Gates rippled with an eerie wave, causing the entire space to tremble.
Almost at the same moment, all the Monarch Level Demon Kings appeared, kneeling uniformly with suppressed fanaticism in their voices:
"Welcome, Lord Demon God!"
The fluctuation of the Demon Gate paused for a moment, then a deep voice as if from the depths of the Underworld slowly emerged:
"The Human’s Divine Secret Realm has opened."
"Act according to the plan."
"The Divine Pattern... must be obtained!"
With this command, the Demonic Qi surged like a tide.
All the Demon Kings lowered their heads, responding in unison:
"We obey the divine decree!"
As this order spread, the entire Demon Realm seemed like a waking ferocious beast.
The Demon Race hidden in various places started to operate like precise gears, with dark currents spreading rapidly in the shadows.
...
At the entrance of the Divine Secret Realm, an aura of killing intent lingered.
Long Zhenguo and the other two stood firmly at the forefront.
Whoever enters first can grasp the initiative!
Therefore, regarding the order of entering the Secret Realm, the three would not compromise in the slightest.
However...
As the deadlock continued, two figures emerged from the crowd.
The Ghost Race and Angel Race’s monarch powerhouses stood side by side, forming a united front.
"We have no objection to the Humans entering first, but..."
"The Ghost Race and Angel Race must enter with you!"
"Otherwise..."
Before the words were finished, two terrifying auras exploded!
The oppressive force was so strong that it matched Long Zhenguo’s group of three!
Their stance was clear, if the Humans did not agree to their terms.
They would unite with all the present Alien Races to act against the Humans!
Long Zhenguo and the other two exchanged glances, reaching a consensus instantly.
If these two races were to side with the Alien Race camp, the Humans would be at an absolute disadvantage.
And only a few from the Ghost Race participated in the Divine Secret Realm, and the Angel Race only one.
It was worth the concession!​
"Alright!"
With Long Zhenguo’s agreement, the Ghost Race and Angel Race powerhouses immediately turned their auras towards the Alien Race camp.
Although the other races felt discontent, the five peak powerhouses present reached an agreement...
They could only swallow their discontent!
Under the majesty of several Monarch Levels...
Soon, the Human Race, Angel Race, and Ghost Race entered the Divine Secret Realm one after another.
Only Gu Xing keenly noticed...
The Ghost Race and Angel Race powerhouses looked at the Humans with undisguised disdain, like superior races scrutinizing inferior beings.
Only when their gaze swept over the Holy See’s Blood Race did they return to normal.
Gu Xing’s eyes narrowed slightly.
These two races truly had arrogance etched on their foreheads!
But if there is only arrogance without strength...
Gu Xing glanced at these people, then took Ying Bing’s hand and stepped into the Divine Secret Realm.
The next moment, time and space seemed to shift instantly.
By the time the two regained their senses, they were already in another world.
Before they could take in their surroundings, a cold mechanical voice came from the sky:
[Welcome to the Divine Secret Realm]
[Divine Pattern will appear in: five days]
[Two special areas in the Divine Secret Realm have been activated—Extreme Fire Domain, Land of Soul Nourishing]
[Good luck to you all!]
"Extreme Fire Domain?!"
Gu Xing’s eyes flashed with sharp light.
He instantly connected this term with the materials needed for Liu Li’s evolution...
Ultimate Fire!
The three materials currently needed by Liu Li:
Light Divine Crystal, Angel Divine Blood, Ultimate Fire.
Except for the first material, there was no information yet.
As for the other two...
The Ultimate Fire was already known... it was inside the Divine Secret Realm.
As for Angel Divine Blood...
Gu Xing thought of the War Angel who entered the Divine Secret Realm...
Would the blood of a War Angel with Demigod Talent qualify?
As for the other Land of Soul Nourishing...
This should be the place where the Ghost Race seeks to enhance their Spiritual Power.
Right now, Qing Shuang and Vera...
Both were eager to enhance their Spiritual Power.
This place could not be missed!
Realizing this, Gu Xing’s goal suddenly became clear.
Both the Extreme Fire Domain and Land of Soul Nourishing had to be visited!
But just then...
"Um..."
A voice as faint as a mosquito’s suddenly spoke.
Gu Xing turned his head, only to see Ying Bing’s cheeks flushed to the tips of her ears, and even her fair neck tinged with a faint pink.
He suddenly realized something, hurriedly lifted his hand, and then noticed...
He was still holding Ying Bing’s hand, and quickly let go:
"Sorry, I got too focused!"
Ying Bing gently shook her head, her hair fluttering lightly in the breeze:
"It’s... it’s okay."
She said, lowering her head shyly.
However, her fingertips unconsciously rubbed against the place they had just touched.
Since reuniting with Gu Xing in the Northern Territory, she gradually realized...
Only by his side could her ever-tensed heart find peace.
And the touch just now not only did not elicit the slightest resistance but seemed to ignite some kind of strange...
Special feeling!
This unprecedented feeling made Ying Bing’s heart race like a drum, her cheeks burning hot as if about to ignite, her head feeling dizzy.
Sensing the subtle atmosphere between them, Gu Xing immediately summoned his Guardian Beast to break the awkwardness.
And the moment Liu Li and Vera appeared, they turned vigilant eyes towards Ying Bing.
This woman...
Has ill intentions!
Under the watchful eyes of Liu Li and Vera, Ying Bing also slowly regained her senses.
When she saw Gu Xing’s summoned Guardian Beasts, her eyes suddenly widened.
A whole four of them!
Gu Xing’s level was merely Extraordinary Level.
By logic, he could only contract two Guardian Beasts, but now...
Ying Bing opened her mouth, wanting to speak but ultimately held back.
But in the end, she just pressed her lips together, swallowing her full of questions.
If Gu Xing was willing to expose this secret in front of her, it meant he trusted her.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
There was no need to ask why Gu Xing could contract four Guardian Beasts at the Extraordinary Level; she only needed to quietly keep this secret.
When Gu Xing wanted to talk about it, he would naturally tell her everything.
But for now...
"Next..." she softly asked, handing the decision entirely to Gu Xing, "What should we do?"
The time for the appearance of the Divine Pattern was still five days.
And she had no interest in those two special areas, naturally following Gu Xing’s thoughts.
Gu Xing was silent for a moment, his gaze falling on his four Guardian Beasts.
Since these Alien Races wanted to seize the Human Race’s Divine Pattern, then...
Paying a little price should be expected!
"Fei Yue, Qing Shuang, enter the Void! Act according to the situation!"
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue nodded immediately upon hearing Gu Xing’s command.
The next moment, a deep spatial fissure appeared behind them.
Their figures were swallowed by the darkness, vanishing in an instant.
After that, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Vera, his tone suddenly turning cold:
"Vera, conduct Spiritual Detection!"
"All Alien Races appearing within the perception range..."
"Kill without mercy!"
Since they dared to seize the Human Race’s opportunity, they must be prepared to be buried here forever!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 113: Location of the Extreme Fire Domain
chapters.content:
Chapter 113: Chapter 113: Location of the Extreme Fire Domain
On the desolate plains, several Tiger Race beastmen gathered, with the Young Clan Leader at the forefront, vigilantly surveying the surroundings.
"Young Clan Leader, what should we do now?"
"The divine patterns won’t appear for another five days. We can’t just wait here idly, right?"
"The Angel Race and Ghost Race have already declared that anyone who dares approach the Land of Trial is their enemy!"
Hearing these words, the Tiger Race Young Clan Leader pondered for a moment before slowly speaking:
"We can’t go to the Land of Trial; going there will only invite trouble!"
He paused, a gleam flashing in his eyes, "However, this is actually a good thing."
"A good thing?"
The surrounding Tiger Race members looked at each other in confusion.
"At least it shows that the Angel Race and Ghost Race aren’t interested in the Human Race’s divine patterns."
His deep voice carried a hint of scheming:
"This way, the ones truly eager for the divine patterns are just us aliens and the Human Race!"
"But among the alien races, there are hardly any that would fight us Tiger Race desperately, so our main competitor... is only the Human Race!"
Upon hearing this, the Tiger Race beastmen nodded in agreement.
"Young Clan Leader, what should we do next?"
The eyes of the Tiger Race Young Clan Leader flashed with cold light as he slowly spoke:
"Since the Human Race is the biggest competitor, then we’ll..."
His voice suddenly turned icy, "Capture a batch of humans!"
"Compassion is the biggest weakness of the Human Race." He let out a cold laugh, "As long as we use these hostages as a threat..."
The surrounding Tiger Race members suddenly grew excited, cruel glints flashing in their eyes.
"As expected of the Young Clan Leader! Your mind works quickly!"
"By then, the Human Race will definitely hand over the divine patterns obediently!"
However, just at this moment...
"Swoosh!"
A dark green vine shot through the air like a venomous snake!
The Young Clan Leader’s pupils contracted, and he retreated several meters, barely avoiding the deadly strike.
But the Tiger Race warrior beside him wasn’t so lucky; the vine pierced through his chest in an instant, and the visible essence of his flesh was frantically devoured, leaving only a shriveled husk.
"Who goes there?!"
The fur of the Tiger Race members bristled all over.
Gu Xing emerged from the shadows, accompanied by Ying Bing.
"Capturing humans?"
He hadn’t even gone to trouble this group of aliens, and they were already planning to act against the Human Race!
Thanks to Vera’s detection, he had spotted this team from afar.
And this was the strongest alien group encountered recently.
Gu Xing scanned the area, and they were almost all of Legendary Level.
Except for the leader of the Tiger Race....
[Tiger Race (Young Clan Leader)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 2800]
[Constitution: 2600]
[Spirit: 2400]
[Speed: 2700]
[Skills: Tiger King Bloodline...]
Gu Xing narrowed his eyes slightly at this Tiger Race’s information.
The Tiger Race’s Young Clan Leader!
Killing him outright seemed a bit wasteful!
A thought suddenly appeared in Gu Xing’s mind.
If captured alive...​​
​A substantial ransom from the Tiger Race should be possible, right?​
The more Gu Xing thought about it, the more brilliant the idea seemed.
In the Secret Realm, defeating him at most would yield some materials, but capturing alive...
He gently stroked his chin with his fingertip.
"A Young Clan Leader of the Tiger Race should be worth a few thousand high-level Star Stones, right?"
However...
"Ying Bing, if we capture this Tiger Race, do you have a way to take him away?"
Capturing the Tiger Race isn’t difficult, but keeping him by their side would be a bit troublesome.
"We can inscribe a temporary Slave Contract and confine him in my Beast Taming Space."
"But... its duration is only seven days."
Ying Bing thought for a moment and proposed a solution.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing’s eyes lit up.
Seven days was more than enough time.
And the Tiger Race Young Clan Leader, witnessing these two humans completely ignoring him and even planning to capture him, was instantly enraged.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on
"Humans, aren’t you being too arrogant!"
"Don’t think that just because of your angel...."
Before finishing this sentence, the Young Clan Leader’s eyes suddenly widened.
He recalled something...
Before entering the Secret Realm this time, his father specifically warned him.
In the City of Chaos, there was a human who had contracted an extremely terrifying angel!
As long as he avoids this human, with his strength, there are few who could threaten him.
At this moment, he stiffly raised his head to gaze at the sky.
Liu Li’s six sacred wings glistened brilliantly under the sunlight.
The Adam’s apple of the Young Clan Leader from the Tiger Race rolled with difficulty, his beast eyes shrinking violently.
Could it be...I’m that unlucky?
"The Human Race..."
His voice unconsciously lowered a few notches, "We have no deep-seated hatred between us. If we really fight, it will only lead to mutual destruction. How about...we stay out of each other’s way?"
However, the Tiger Race warriors behind him were completely oblivious to the unusual atmosphere and continued to shout arrogantly:
"Young Clan Leader, it’s just a mere human. You could crush him with a flick of your finger!"
"Exactly! Showing up alone in front of us is practically asking for death!"
"Even if he has some skills, we have so many brothers, are we really afraid of him?"
Gu Xing ignored this group of Tiger Race members who couldn’t see the situation clearly, focusing his gaze on the Young Clan Leader.
Mutual destruction?!
He lazily raised his hand and waved lightly towards Vera in the air.
"Natural Lament."
In an instant, countless dark green vines burst out of the ground, entangling upwards like living creatures.
Although without engaging the "Elf Monarchy" status, Vera indeed needs to exert some effort to deal with the Young Clan Leader, as for this group of ordinary Tiger Race members with only Legendary Talent...
It’s like cutting vegetables!
"Roar——!"
A few Tiger Race members tried to struggle, their sharp claws frantically tearing at the vines.
But soon, their roars were drowned in the surging green tide.
In just a few breaths, the previously noisy plain had only the isolated Young Clan Leader of the Tiger Race standing in place.
Cold sweat instantly trickled down the Young Clan Leader’s forehead.
Even if he had faced that attack just now, he wouldn’t have fared well.
But...
His gaze shifted to the natural spirit in the air.
This seems to be... just a casual strike from this Guardian Beast!
At this moment, Gu Xing asked with a half-smile:
"Now..."
"Do you want to obediently sign the contract, or shall I beat you half to death first and then you sign?"
Upon hearing this, the pupils of the Young Clan Leader shrank violently.
Though he felt immense fear in his heart, yet the Tiger Race’s dignity...
"Seems like you’ve chosen the second option, Liu Li!"
"Wait! I choose the contract!"
The Young Clan Leader almost shouted, as his voice carried an unprecedented panic.
His reaction was astonishingly fast, fearing that if he were even a second slower...
However.
"Ah——!"
The heart-wrenching tiger roar echoed across the plain, and the Young Clan Leader heavily knelt on the ground, both hind legs twisted at a bizarre angle.
He trembled while raising his head, his golden beast eyes filled with disbelief:
"You..."
Gu Xing spread his hands innocently:
"You spoke too slowly."
The eyes of the Young Clan Leader of the Tiger Race burned with the flames of humiliation, but under Liu Li’s cold gaze, he had no choice but to lower his proud head.
As Ying Bing’s fingertip contract runes sank into his brow, a ghostly blue mark slowly emerged on his forehead.
"Contract established."
Ying Bing withdrew her hand, her tone indifferent.
Gu Xing, seeing this, curled his lips in satisfaction.
It’s a Star Stone!
The Human Race is lacking in this thing!
Otherwise, why establish a points system to exchange for it!
After the contract was completed, this Tiger Race member also disclosed the location of the Extreme Fire Domain.
Knowing where the Extreme Fire Domain is, he definitely has to take Liu Li there.
But the matter of capturing the Alien Race...
Can’t be left behind!
After a brief consideration, Gu Xing spoke into the air:
"Qing Shuang, apprehend all the Demigod Alien Races entering the Secret Realm!"
"Understood."
A cold female voice came from the void, yet no figure was seen.
Gu Xing turned to look at Ying Bing.
To complete this plan, her contract ability is indispensable.
Ying Bing bit her lip, her fingertips unconsciously clutching at the hem of her clothes.
Though she was reluctant to leave Gu Xing’s side, she knew this was not the time for whims.
She nodded in agreement.
It was only after Ying Bing’s figure vanished into the space rift that Gu Xing withdrew his gaze.
With Fei Yue present, he didn’t need to worry about the safety of the group.
Even if they encountered the strongest Blood Ancestor, even if they couldn’t win....
They could still retreat unscathed!
Subsequently, Gu Xing’s gaze landed on the southern part of the Secret Realm.
There lies the location of the Extreme Fire Domain!
Also the location of Liu Li’s evolution materials!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 114: Magma Clan
chapters.content:
Chapter 114: Chapter 114: Magma Clan
Familiar pose! Familiar movement!
Once again, he was held in Liu Li’s arms, heading towards the location of the Extreme Fire Domain.
The girl’s soft body emitted a faint, subtle fragrance, carried by the breeze brushing against his cheek.
Gu Xing’s ears involuntarily grew hot.
Although the sensation was definitely comfortable...
He still gritted his teeth inwardly:
I have to break through to Commander Level as soon as possible!
At the Commander Level, he’d be able to fly on his own, using Domain Power!
Being carried by his own Guardian Beast while flying...
It gave him a special kind of shame!
"Master, we’ve arrived."
Liu Li gently set him down, her snow-white wings folding elegantly.
Even though her tone was still calm, Gu Xing keenly noticed...
A blush flashed across the girl’s porcelain cheeks, vanishing in an instant.
At the moment their eyes met, his heart skipped a beat.
Some unfamiliar stirring spread through his chest...
In the midst of this subtle atmosphere, a vibrant green figure suddenly bounced out from the Beast Taming Space.
"Master! You and Liu Li... you don’t have something going on, do you?"
Vera tilted her little head, gazing suspiciously at Gu Xing and Liu Li.
Earlier, Liu Li had thrown her into the Beast Taming Space.
As soon as she got out, she immediately noticed something weird going on between her master and that Angel.
This Angel... she’s not stealing snacks, is she!
As the possibility occurred to her, Vera’s pupils shrank, and she doubled her efforts to search for any clues between the two.
Gu Xing coughed lightly and changed the subject. "Kids shouldn’t ask so many questions."
Liu Li cooperatively grabbed Vera by the back of her collar and set her aside. "Go play over there!"
As Liu Li put her aside, Vera dumbly pointed at herself.
She— a kid?!
At that moment, she really wanted to transform back into her true form, and tell Gu Xing:
"She’s not small at all, on the contrary..."
"She’s actually huge!"
But then, suddenly remembering something, she wilted instantly.
With her master’s slow-on-the-uptake personality, if she turned back to her real form...
She’d probably be waiting for the rest of her life for him to take the initiative!
So honestly...
Staying in kid form was pretty nice.
Thinking that, she pounced towards Gu Xing at once.
"Master, Liu Li’s bullying me~"
Liu Li intercepted her precisely, lifting her by the collar like a kitten.
"Behave."
After warning Vera, Liu Li looked around and reminded Gu Xing:
"Master, something’s getting closer!"
Gu Xing looked ahead— before them stretched a world of fire.
And from within the flames, a group of defeated-looking figures walked out.
Their entire bodies were made of fire!
Upon seeing Gu Xing, they showed no signs of attacking.
Seeing this, Liu Li explained in a low voice:
"Master, that’s the Magma Clan. They only obsess over devouring flames, they’re not hostile to humans."
As if to confirm her words, a particularly fierce flaming Magma Clan Leader stepped forward from among the group.
"Lea-- leave this place."
"This place has already been taken over by an Angel! She doesn’t allow anyone near it!"
As soon as he said this, the group behind him immediately looked crestfallen.
For the Magma Clan, not being able to devour the flames here was like having a banquet placed before them— but they’re not allowed to eat!
Gu Xing casually checked the info on this little flame person.
[Magma Clan (Clan Leader)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Legendary Nine Stars]
[Power: 1]
[Constitution: 1]
[Spirit: 2500]
[Speed: 1]
[Skill: Flame Domain]
[Introduction: A special race, born relying on fire, spending their entire life pursuing flames (maximum King Level)]
Seeing the introduction for the little flame guy, Gu Xing stroked his chin.
No wonder they’re not interested in Divine Patterns...
Turns out it’s a race limited by their own racial cap!
They could only reach Monarch Level at best, even if they got Divine Patterns it’d be useless!
Still, this race... is really unique!
Aside from their shocking Spiritual Attributes, all their other stats were pathetically low.
What was even odder, the entire clan apparently shared only one skill.
[Flame Domain: All clan members linked as a single entity]
Seeing that description, Gu Xing pretty much wrapped his head around their mechanics.
So the stronger the individual, the stronger the entire clan gets.
Except right now...
Gu Xing gave them a once-over.
Other than this Clan Leader, it looked like not a single other Magma Clan member even reached Extraordinary Level.
No wonder they got kicked out by that War Angel!
But this kind of clan...
Could he lure them back to Longxia Country?
The thought suddenly popped into his mind!
This race had no conflict whatsoever with humans, and their desire was as simple as could be.
All they wanted was fire!
And fire...
Gu Xing’s gaze swept over the Fire Domain ahead.
I definitely need to get the Ultimate Fire. If he used that as bait, could he lure this group of little flame guys back to Longxia?
If he managed to grow all of them to Monarch Level...
That’d be a huge boost to Longxia Country’s strength!
Thinking that, Gu Xing tried asking tentatively:
"Magma Clan Leader, if I let you absorb all the Ultimate Fire you want here..."
He deliberately drew out the words, "Would you consider living somewhere else?"
"Li... live somewhere else?"
The Magma Clan Leader’s flames flickered, clearly struggling to comprehend the proposal.
After half a minute, his face made of fire suddenly brightened:
"Absorb flame! Human, as long as you let us devour flames, we’ll go with you!"
The little flame folk behind the leader kept bouncing in place, clearly all for the idea.
Hearing the clan leader agree, Gu Xing smiled at the corner of his mouth.
This was going even smoother than he’d hoped.
"Then it’s settled! Wait here for me!"
"Liu Li, let’s go."
Liu Li’s wings opened, and in the blink of an eye, she whisked Gu Xing off into the scorching waves of heat.
The Magma Clan left behind began to get restless, their fiery bodies constantly shifting shapes.
"Chief... can that human really beat that six-winged monster?"
"Are we really supposed to follow that human?"
The Magma Clan Leader stared in the direction Gu Xing left, his flames trembling gently.
After a long pause, he issued an order that rippled among the clan:
"Wherever there is flame, that’s where the Magma Clan will be."
Meanwhile—
The deeper they went into the Fire Domain, the wilder the heat wave in the air became.
Maybe it was because of being contracted with Liu Li, even though the temperature was high...
But he realized he felt totally comfortable.
As for Liu Li, it was as if she had returned to her comfort zone. She unconsciously spread her wings, greedily absorbing the fire elements around them.
Suddenly, Liu Li paused mid-air.
About a hundred meters ahead, the flames had shifted from scarlet to a profound, dark golden hue— and at the center of that boiling sea of fire...
A charred, blackened figure kneeled on one knee.
"Master, you should stay here!"
Liu Li gently set Gu Xing down, her eyes locked onto that charred silhouette.
The blackened figure seemed to sense something, and slowly turned around.
When she saw who it was, the black silhouette trembled violently:
"Liu Li?!"
Miffy’s pupils contracted sharply, her gaze sweeping over Gu Xing and the six wings behind Liu Li.
Contracted human... Myth Level...
A flash of seriousness appeared in Miffy’s eyes.
Even though she looked down on the Human Race, after forging a contract, the Guardian Beast’s strength really did rise a notch thanks to human Talents.
And more than that, Liu Li was—
A Six-winged Blazing Angel!
But, seeing the fifth and sixth pair of wings slowly unfolding behind herself—
The gravity faded from her eyes.
Both being at Myth Level, she definitely wouldn’t be any weaker than a Blazing Angel!
"Liu Li, you’re too late!"
Miffy grinned viciously, spreading out the six wings behind her with a roar.
A wild aura erupted!
[War Angel (Miffy)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 3000]Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
[Constitution: 2900]
[Spirit: 3000]
[Speed: 2900]
[Skills: War Angel Form, Holy Angel Form, Divine Domain (Basic)]
[War Angel Form: Doubles all attributes]
[Holy Angel Form: Triples all attributes]
...

chapters.title: Chapter 115: Demon Pattern? Divine Pattern!
chapters.content:
Chapter 115: Chapter 115: Demon Pattern? Divine Pattern!
Seeing that this War Angel had already reached Myth Level.
Gu Xing was truly shocked.
The buff from Ultimate Fire to the Angel Race was actually this terrifying!
It actually managed to raise Miffy’s level from Demigod to Myth Level.
But even at Myth Level...
There are still degrees of strength!
Clearly, Liu Li’s strength was a bit above that of this War Angel.
"Master." Liu Li suddenly spoke up, "This fight... please let me handle it myself."
Her voice was soft but held an unmistakable firmness.
Back in the Angel Race, her talent was only at Legendary Level.
In front of Miffy, she hadn’t the slightest chance of victory.
But now...
With her master’s help, she was at Myth Level!
If she still couldn’t defeat this War Angel, how could she be worthy of being her master’s Guardian Beast!
Gu Xing turned his head slightly, seeing the little girl’s tense profile.
In that moment, he seemed to sense what Liu Li was thinking.
No questions, no doubts, he nodded gently:
"Go!"
With permission, Liu Li took a deep breath, stepping alone into the Core Fire Domain.
In an instant, the terrifying heat forced her to instantly invoke Blazing Angel Form...
"Heh." Miffy looked mockingly at Liu Li’s awkward appearance, "Liu Li, you’re still so weak!"
"But..."
Miffy’s eyes chilled suddenly.
"But no matter how weak you are, you shouldn’t follow a human! You’re an embarrassment to the Angel Race!"
Nevertheless, Liu Li’s eyes remained calm as water.
Even though the Ultimate Fire around her was constantly eroding her body, and her power inside was sluggish due to the heat...
"Miffy." Liu Li suddenly raised her eyes, her golden pupils locking onto the other, "Is all you know how to do run your mouth?"
That sentence was like a sharp blade, instantly stabbing through Miffy’s arrogance.
Her gaze became ice cold in an instant.
This former rival!
When they were young, she could trample Liu Li beneath her feet.
Now...
She could still do it!
Without any hesitation, War Angel Form exploded forth!
Also eight wings!
"The same level?" Miffy sneered, gripping the Holy Sword tightly, "Liu Li, what can you possibly compare with me?"
Unexpectedly, Liu Li suddenly asked an unrelated question:
"Are my clansmen... still alive?"
Suddenly the Core Domain fell into a strange silence!
Miffy’s wings trembled almost imperceptibly.
After a long pause, she squeezed out a word through her teeth:
"Alive!"
Just one word, but Liu Li was finally able to relax.
She knew better than anyone...
This arrogant War Angel before her was never one to lie.
Next, the Core Domain sunk back into silence, only the Ultimate Fire flickering anxiously between them.
They were both waiting...
Waiting for that inevitable moment!​
"Doomsday Angel Form—"
"Unleash!"
"Holy Angel Form—"
"Unleash!"
Almost in the same millisecond, two clear shouts tore through the congealed air!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Power: 6040→9060]
[Constitution: 6020→9030]
[Spirit: 6000→9000]
[Speed: 6060→9090]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Celestial Fire Domain]
....
[War Angels (Miffy)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 6000→9000]
[Constitution: 5800→8700]
[Spirit: 6000→9000]
[Speed: 5800→8700]
[Skills: War Angel Form, Holy Angel Form, Divine Domain]
Looking at the two attribute panels, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed.
The same Ten-winged Form!
Their basic attributes were nearly identical!
If Liu Li had his help, she could easily defeat this War Angel.
But the little girl refused his help from the very start!
This meant Liu Li...
Wanted to personally overcome the mountain that once oppressed her!
"Who do you think will win, Master!" Vera suddenly asked.
"Pa!"
A crisp knock landed on someone’s head.
"What are you saying!"
He didn’t worry at all about whether Liu Li could claim victory.
He trusted her, just as Liu Li wholeheartedly trusted him.
Core Fire Domain.
The situation was already at the breaking point.
In the next moment, two golden meteors violently collided.
"Boom—"
The impact of the Holy Swords split open a massive crack in the sea of fire.
The two golden silhouettes flashed through the Fire Domain, shaking the space every time they clashed.
"Liu Li, just admit defeat! You can’t beat me!"
Miffy’s blade pressed hard against Liu Li.
"All you’ve got is the title of Princess of the Blazing Angels Race, but you’re nothing! No, now your princess identity is worthless!"
"Bang!"
Another violent collision.
Faced with Miffy’s mockery, Liu Li’s eyes never wavered.
She was no longer that...
Fragile girl hiding in the shadows, crying her eyes out.
Now...​​...
​She was the sharpest sword in her master’s hand!​
To cut down every obstacle in front of him.
No matter how tough the road ahead, she wouldn’t show a hint of retreat.
Strike after strike.
Liu Li’s assault grew faster and faster.
Miffy’s expression grew uglier and uglier.
Why?!​
Their attributes were nearly the same...​...
But as time passed, the fight just kept getting harder.
What she didn’t know was...
With every swing, Liu Li was burning something even hotter than her battle spirit.
Her faith!
With Liu Li’s strikes, her Blazing Angel Flames gradually fused with the Ultimate Fire of the Core Region.
And of course, Gu Xing noticed this.
But he wasn’t surprised.
If Miffy could use Ultimate Fire to evolve from Half-step Myth Level to Myth Level...
Then why shouldn’t Liu Li!
Now, Liu Li’s actions proved it beyond doubt.
Yet just then...
He suddenly sensed movement in the Beast Taming Space.
The long-dormant Demon Pattern and World Tree Leaf both started to tremble!
"What’s this...?"
The two items frantically wanted to leave the Beast Taming Space, their target—
​Liu Li!​​
Gu Xing hesitated for only a moment, then decisively let them out.
There’s no way the World Tree would harm him...
"Whoosh!"
The Demon Pattern and World Tree Leaf turned to streaks of light, darting toward the battlefield.
Liu Li saw this, immediately pushing Miffy back.
"What the hell is that?!"
Liu Li stared blankly at the two divine artifacts hovering in front of her, not able to react yet...
"Rumble!"
The entire Core Fire Domain suddenly boiled over!
All of the Ultimate Fire rushed in torrents into the World Tree Leaf.
The leaf quivered softly across the Demon Pattern, and its pitch-black veins gradually transformed to dazzling gold!
Golden Divine Pattern?!
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
The Demon Pattern was actually evolving into Divine Pattern!
And the instant Miffy saw the Divine Pattern, she suddenly realized something and rushed madly at Liu Li.
But in the next second, the raging energy flung her hard away!
"Liu Li!"
As Gu Xing cried out in alarm, the Divine Pattern perfectly fused into Liu Li’s chest.
The girl’s wings spread wide, and her attribute panel started madly updating!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 116: Twelve-Winged Blazing Angel
chapters.content:
Chapter 116: Chapter 116: Twelve-Winged Blazing Angel
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars → Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Power: 3020...3520...4000]
[Constitution: 3010...3510...4000]
[Spirit: 3000...3500...4000]
[Speed: 3030...3530...4000]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn (Ultimate Fire Control 10%), Celestial Fire Domain]
After fusing the Divine Pattern, Liu Li’s talent has broken through to Myth Five Stars.
All her attributes...
Have reached the limits of the Extraordinary Level!
And her skills list has gained yet another entry.
[Blazing Burn: Ultimate Fire · Initial Stage Control]
[Activate Blazing Burn status, and the Blazing Angel Flame evolves into the eternal, indestructible Ultimate Fire]
[When Liu Li spreads her wings, the battlefield transforms into an Eternal Fire Domain, the flames never dying, the battle never ending!]
Seeing the introduction about this skill, Gu Xing nodded.
Once this status is activated, the Ultimate Fire circulates on its own, endlessly replenishing her energy so she never needs to worry about running out.
At this moment, Liu Li has deactivated the Doomsday Angel Form and returned to her normal state.
But even so—
Her wings are no longer Six Wings, but...
Eight Wings!
The Ultimate Fire coils around her like it serves her, accepting her as its master, and no longer resisting at all.
The sluggishness she once felt controlling fire has completely vanished.
When Miffy saw that Liu Li’s default state was now Eight Wings, her pupils contracted violently!
Even though Liu Li hadn’t activated any battle form, she felt an unprecedented sense of crisis.
Eight-winged Angel...
This meant Liu Li’s strength had made a qualitative leap!
"Miffy, you’ve lost!"
Liu Li’s calm voice echoed across the battlefield as she stared straight at the distant Ten-winged War Angel.
If earlier their strengths could barely be considered evenly matched, now...
Liu Li had utterly crushed Miffy!
All Her Attributes had reached the limits of the Myth Level!
If she activated Doomsday Angel Form...
Her attributes would soar past a terrifying 12,000 points!
And with the addition of Blazing Burn status...
Miffy... had no chance of victory!
Clearly, Miffy realized this too.
She stared at Liu Li, wreathed in Ultimate Fire, like a goddess descended—then suddenly let out a cold laugh:
"Admit defeat?!"
"Are you kidding me?!"
From birth, she was the undisputed strongest of the Angel Race’s younger generation!
And now...
A ’Disabled Angel’ once cast out of the clan, had actually surpassed her!
And now you want her to admit defeat aloud?!
Impossible!
"The past me never lost, and I won’t now!"
Miffy’s roar thundered across the battlefield. "Liu Li, so what if you’ve ascended to Eight Wings? I’m not going to lose!"
Her warped obsession with victory contorted her face completely.
The opponents she’d casually crushed before were now standing above her...
This earth-shattering reversal drove her half-insane!
Before Liu Li’s stunned gaze, Miffy suddenly pulled out an obsidian-black Crystal Stone and shattered it without hesitation!
"Boom—"
Towering Demonic Qi erupted, engulfing Miffy completely!
Seeing this, Liu Li’s pupils tightened!
Demon Stone!
This forbidden Demon Race item’s only function was storing tremendous Demonic Qi...
And Miffy’s action now had only one purpose...
Voluntary Demonization!
Absorbing the Demonic Qi within the Demon Stone, turning herself into a Demon!
Realizing this, Liu Li’s expression darkened.
Why would such a demon-exclusive item appear in the hands of a War Angel?
Could it be...
The War Angel Race had colluded with the Demon Race?
This chilling thought left Liu Li momentarily breathless!
Soon, boundless fury swept over her:
"Miffy! You talk about Angel Race honor, but look what you’re doing now?!"
"What is this supposed to be?!"
Black Demonic Qi twisted around Miffy like venomous snakes, her face grotesque and twisted from demonization.
"Power is everything!"
Miffy howled, her voice frenzied:
"If I can claim true power, why not stand with the Demon Race?!"
With a hideous rending sound, Miffy’s wings turned utterly black.
Now—
Her entire body was striped with black Demon Patterns, eyes glowing blood-red, consumed by Demonic Qi!
"I didn’t want to go this far..."
Miffy’s voice was hoarse and terrifying. "You forced me!"
The final torrent of Demonic Qi erupted and consumed Miffy completely.
When the darkness dissipated...
The proud War Angel was no more, replaced by an out-and-out Demon!
Gu Xing focused and checked—after Miffy’s fall into demonhood, her attributes had skyrocketed again!
[War Angel Miffy (Demonized)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 9000→12000]
[Constitution: 8700→12000]
[Spirit: 9000→12000]
[Speed: 8700→12000]
[Skills: War Angel Form (Demon), Fallen Angel Form (Ten Wings), Fallen Angel Domain (Basic)]
Gu Xing gazed at Miffy’s surging stat screen, brows furrowed tightly.
He’d never imagined this proud War Angel would so resolutely surrender herself to the Demon Race...
But what was even more disturbing...
Even the mightiest races...
Even within the Angel Race, there were those who sided with demons.
What about the others?
At this thought, Gu Xing felt a heavy weight inside.
But right now...
He couldn’t worry about all that.
Looking up at Liu Li in the battlefield’s center, Gu Xing could clearly sense...
This always-gentle little Angel was now burning with unprecedented rage!
At that moment.
The Ultimate Fire raged wildly around Liu Li.
It seemed to reflect Liu Li’s emotions, becoming ever more savage.
Liu Li stared at Miffy, now fully turned Fallen Angel, demon patterns crawling her skin.
She slowly raised her arm.
Ultimate Fire from the entire Core Fire Domain began gathering explosively.
"I never wanted to take your life..."
Liu Li’s voice was low and heavy.
Since childhood, Miffy was the one she looked up to.
Precisely for that reason, she had refused Gu Xing’s help, determined to defeat Miffy with her own strength and honor.
But now...The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"Miffy!"
Liu Li’s roar shook the whole battlefield!
"Even when my father vanished, when the War Angel Race seized our clan, when my wings were shattered, not once have I been so angry!"
Ultimate Fire condensed ever tighter in her grasp, reflecting her flaming-red eyes.
"Why?! Why did you join the Demon Race?!"
"How many kin have died to demons?!"
"Answer me! WHY?!"
Every question from Liu Li detonated with Ultimate Fire—even her voice was forced hoarse in the end.
Amidst her earth-shattering fury...
All the flames of the Core Fire Domain suddenly contracted, surging into Liu Li’s palm like swallowed by a black hole.
A spear burning with Eternal Fire slowly took shape in her grasp, its dazzling brilliance seeming able to pierce all the world’s darkness.
Drawn by this world-shaking force, Liu Li unconsciously entered Doomsday Angel Form...
Twelve wings burning Ultimate Fire burst wide from her back!
At this moment, she was like the War Goddess ruling over all flames.
Her mere presence warped and fractured the space around her!
