chapters.title: Chapter 117: Blazing Flame Spear!
chapters.content:
Chapter 117: Chapter 117: Blazing Flame Spear!
Facing the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel Liu Li, Miffy suddenly burst into mad laughter.
The laughter was filled with distortion and frenzy!
"Power is everything! Liu Li!"
She roared hysterically, without hesitation, and crushed two Demon Stones again.
From the spear in Liu Li’s hand, burning with Ultimate Fire, Miffy had already smelled the scent of death.
But she—
Absolutely would not retreat!​
"I am Miffy, the strongest talent of the Angel Race!"
"Even if I fall and become a demon, I will only become stronger!"
"Boom—!"
Even more violent Demonic Qi erupted from her body, the dark airflow tearing her flesh like blades.
"Ahhh—!"
The severe pain caused her body to convulse violently, but a terrifying grin appeared on her lips.
"Fallen Angel Domain, open!"
In an instant—
Endless dark Demonic Qi swept forth, completely consuming the Core Fire Domain!
The entire space was instantly shrouded in darkness.
Only that golden flame continued to burn unyieldingly.
The light of the flame, like the dawn, gradually dispelled the darkness, dyeing the entire domain a dazzling gold.
In the center of the light, the Twelve-winged Blazing Angel Liu Li held the fully formed Golden Flame Spear.
At this moment, there was no expression on her face.
She understood that at this moment, Miffy had already...
Block out any reason!​​
Only by crushing her with absolute power can she truly awaken!
"True power..."
"Is never about strength!"
Liu Li’s voice echoed in the domain.
"It’s the bonds! Bonds with the master, with the clansmen, with this world!"
"Blazing Flame Spear!"
With this declaration, the golden spear infused with all of Liu Li’s conviction pierced the sky, directly attacking Miffy with unstoppable momentum!
Upon witnessing this, a sneer flashed in Miffy’s eyes:
"Foolishness! Don’t you know? Only those who can oppose a domain are..."
However.
Miffy’s mockery came to an abrupt halt, as if her throat were being gripped, freezing her in place.
The moment the golden Flame Spear touched the Fallen Angel Domain...
"Boom!!!"
With a deafening roar, the entire Extreme Fire Domain trembled violently, and even the space appeared with web-like cracks.
On the outskirts of the Fire Domain, members of the Magma Clan gazed fearfully at the changed sky.
The young fire child tugged at the Clan Leader:
"Clan Leader, what is happening inside?"
The Clan Leader remained silent, his face intermittently illuminated by the firelight.
His gaze slowly turned towards the center of the Extreme Fire Domain.
He sensed two extremely terrifying energies at the center of the Fire Domain!
Inside the Extreme Fire Domain.
Vera’s pupils shrank abruptly.
The wave of energy sweeping over was absolutely unbearable for a human body!
"Elf Monarchy: Full Liberation!"
A burst of vibrant green light erupted, revealing Vera’s true form.
Without hesitation, she embraced Gu Xing, simultaneously waving her delicate hand...
Countless emerald vines wove into a cocoon, wrapping the two layer by layer.
The moment the Barrier formed—
"Boom!!!"
A world-shattering shockwave swept by, causing the entire space to wail!
The center of the battlefield.
Within Miffy’s perception...
The Fallen Angel Domain she meticulously constructed was being destroyed!
Where the golden Flame Spear passed, the dark domain’s barriers started to crack!
"This is impossible!"
Miffy’s pupils contracted violently, waves of panic surged in her heart.
She hadn’t initiated a domain contest, so why...
"Crunch—"
The crisp sound of breaking echoed like a death sentence, the cracks spreading at an astonishing pace.
How could it be?
She hadn’t released her domain!
How could someone counteract her domain!
She could accept defeat, but not being overwhelmingly defeated!
Yet, at the next moment—
"Boom!!!"
The entire Fallen Angel Domain collapsed, scattering into countless black shards!
Miffy stood dumbstruck, watching as the destructive Flame Spear pierced her demonic body.
Without giving her any time to react, the golden spear struck the earth behind her relentlessly...
"Boom!!!"
With a deafening explosion, a massive crater with a diameter of several hundred meters formed instantly!
Liu Li’s figure instantly flashed before Miffy, her fist aflame with gold stopping just inches from her face.
The scorching waves seared Miffy’s skin but did not ultimately fall.
"Answer me!" Liu Li’s voice carried a hint of urgency, "Did the War Angels ally with the Demon Race?"
Miffy suddenly laughed.
At the moment the spear pierced her, she seemed to see her whole life.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Under her father’s influence, she spent her life chasing after power!
But what was the outcome...
Even demonized, she was still not as good as a Blazing Angel with broken wings, forced away!
She relaxed her entire body, allowing herself to fall backward into the massive pit prepared for her—
As if it were her destined resting place.
Slowly closing her eyes, a hint of relief appeared on her face.
The power she chased all her life, at this moment, finally...
Could rest.
As for the War Angels?
What does allying with the Demon Race matter to her now?
Liu Li understood Miffy’s intentions from her final gaze.
She silently watched as the Ultimate Fire burned on Miffy’s pierced chest, gradually turning the body to ashes...
Only a drop of golden blood shone brilliantly amongst the ash.
It should have been a joyous trophy.
But at this moment, Liu Li’s heart felt an unspeakable heaviness.
At this moment, Gu Xing disentangled himself from Vera’s embrace.
He was speechless at the sight of the golden-haired elf lady before him.
Vera keenly sensed her master’s embarrassment...
"Master~"
With a clear child’s voice, her form rapidly shrank, instantly returning to her familiar elf girl appearance.
"I want a hug!"
Upon hearing Vera’s familiar voice, Gu Xing finally came to his senses.
Facing Vera in this form was more relaxing.
He casually held Vera in his arms, then turned towards Liu Li, who stood frozen at the battlefield’s center.
The little girl in his arms.
At this moment, her face was flushed.
The true form... finally holding... the master!
This feeling... is wonderful!
Gu Xing’s attention was entirely on Liu Li, oblivious to the peculiarities of the little one in his arms.
He hesitated for a moment, then walked forward to pat Liu Li on the shoulder.
"Don’t worry too much, Liu Li!"
"Since the War Angels have imprisoned your clansmen, they won’t easily harm them."
"Moreover, the War Angels definitely won’t all ally with the Demon Race. Maybe it’s just Miffy or a few clansfolk associated with them."
"After all, not all members of the Angel Race could let go of their hatred for the Demon Race."
Relieved at his words, Liu Li’s tense shoulders finally relaxed a little.
The master had a point!
Not every one of the Angel Race, including the War Angels, could let go of their hatred for the Demon Race!
Once her mind was at ease, Liu Li turned around...
Only to see Vera clinging in the master’s arms.
Her lips instantly puckered.
Just now she could perceive the true form of this elf...
She lowered her head to glance at her bosom, secretly clenching her fists!
The bothersome green tea elf!
Why so big?!
Gu Xing was unaware of his little angel’s thoughts, his gaze fixed onto the gold blood left by Miffy’s death.
[Angel Divine Blood]
[Quality: Myth]
[Function: Enhance Angel Race’s Talent]
Liu Li’s upgrade material had finally found its second type!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 118: Encounter with the Ghost Race!
chapters.content:
Chapter 118: Chapter 118: Encounter with the Ghost Race!
Next.
Liu Li directly swept away all the flames within the Extreme Fire Domain!
The flames of the entire Extreme Fire Domain ultimately condensed into a flickering golden flame in her palm.
She skillfully delivered this Origin Fire into Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space.
From now on, she also has her own territory within the Beast Taming Space!
Seeing Liu Li’s actions, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
His spiritual power entered the Beast Taming Space.
The Extreme Fire Liu Li had just thrown in has already formed a Fire Domain!
And next to this Fire Domain is Vera’s Tree of Life and Spring of Life.
Fortunately, the area where the two Ghost Race sisters stayed had nothing...
Just at this moment, the Magma Clan Leader arrived here with his tribe.
Looking at the empty remains of the Fire Domain, this group of little fire beings were dumbfounded!
Only after Gu Xing’s laborious explanation did the Magma Clan Leader finally understand that the Extreme Fire now acknowledges Liu Li as its master.
If they want to absorb the Extreme Fire, they must follow him to Longxia Country.
And after understanding Gu Xing’s intentions...
"We are willing to follow the Master of Flames!"
The Magma Clan Leader immediately led his tribe to kneel on one knee.
Seeing this group of little fire beings so sensible, Gu Xing instantly felt relieved.
After instructing them to leave the Divine Secret Realm and go to Longxia Country to find him, Gu Xing then directed Liu Li to head to another Land of Trial.
Not long ago, Qing Shuang had already transmitted the location of the Soul Nourishing Pool through the contract.
Quickly, Liu Li led Gu Xing to arrive here in a familiar manner.
The Ghost Race sisters and Ying Bing were already waiting at the entrance.
Upon seeing Gu Xing, Qing Shuang approached to report:
"Master, five Demigod-level Alien Races have been captured, and all have temporarily contracted with Miss Ying Bing!"
Hearing that five Demigod-level Alien Races were captured, Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction.
After all, the Divine Secret Realm is incredibly vast, and searching for Alien Races is the most labor-intensive part.
And Qing Shuang being able to capture five so quickly...
This completely exceeded his expectations!
At this moment, Ying Bing stared at Gu Xing as if looking at a monster.
During this time, she had been by Fei Yue’s side...
Witnessing the strength of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue as two Guardian Beasts.
It was precisely because she knew their strength that she felt Gu Xing’s terrifying power.
No matter the level of a Guardian Beast, in front of this Ghost Race girl, there wasn’t a shred of resistance.
Whether at Legendary Level or Demigod Level, all were resolved with a single punch.
In the end, those Alien Races even hid themselves.
Except for Qing Shuang...
Ying Bing’s gaze fell on Fei Yue.
This Ghost Race girl’s ability is equally terrifying, even though she hasn’t been seen attacking.
But she could keep Ying Bing hidden in the void throughout.
This kind of power...
Let alone just a group of Extraordinary Level in the Divine Secret Realm.
Even a few Commander Levels would have no way to counter her.
Now she understood...
Why Gu Xing initially applied to Longxia Country for only him to enter the Secret Realm.
Because he... is an army on his own!
Just one person can handle all threats in the Secret Realm.
After understanding the situation, Gu Xing turned his attention to the Trial Area before him.
Next is to enter the second Land of Trial!
On the barren land ahead, there is a faint perception of spiritual power fluctuations...
Clearly, the core area is at the center.
"Master, there’s only one entrance here."
Qing Shuang’s tone remained respectful.
Gu Xing nodded and then entered this area with Ying Bing.
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, as usual, concealed themselves in the void.
A short distance in, the sound of a heated argument suddenly came from ahead:
"You Ghost Race are too overbearing! This is the Divine Secret Realm’s Land of Trial, why won’t you let us in?"
"Exactly! The Soul Nourishing Pool isn’t the private property of your Ghost Race!"
The leading Ghost Race sneered, looking at everyone contemptuously:
"Want to go in? Sure, as long as you can beat us. If you don’t have the skills, obediently wait outside!"
When Gu Xing and Ying Bing approached, they found two Ghost Race members blocking the passage, while a group of council members were being held outside.
One person quickly advised them, "Friends, don’t go further! These two Ghost Race members will attack!"
Others chimed in, "We tried to force our way in just now, but we were all beaten out!"
Blocking the way?!
Gu Xing looked at the two Ghost Race members blocking the only road to enter.
Compared to other races, the Ghost Race seemed to harbor less hostility towards the Human Race.
The council members wanted to enter the Soul Nourishing Pool, and these two Ghost Race members merely drove them back.
However...
Both Qing Shuang and Vera’s spiritual power needed enhancement!
Now Liu Li’s attributes have all reached their limits, but Vera and Qing Shuang still have room for improvement.
So this Soul Nourishing Pool...
Cannot be missed!
He thought for a moment, planning to summon Liu Li to deal with the Ghost Race.
Because according to Qing Shuang, she and Fei Yue were merely repelled by the Ghost Race.
Not mortal enemies, so having Qing Shuang take action seemed inappropriate.
Just as Gu Xing intended to summon Liu Li.
Qing Shuang slowly revealed herself beside him.
"Master, let me handle these Ghost Race members!"
Qing Shuang slightly bowed to Gu Xing, her eyes carrying seriousness.
And seeing Qing Shuang’s words, Gu Xing hesitated for a moment but agreed.
After all, it’s the choice of his Guardian Beast, and he chose to respect it!
Upon witnessing Qing Shuang, the two Ghost Race members were startled.
This unique horn...
Only two individuals in the entire history of the Ghost Race have ever had it.
"You’re Qing Shuang? Where’s your sister?"
Upon hearing her name, Fei Yue also emerged from the void, landing beside Gu Xing.
The two Ghost Race members understood immediately.
These sisters who were exiled identified the humans as their master!
"Traitors who were expelled from the clan, reduced to serve humans!"
"Since you’re no longer of our clan, retreat swiftly! The place ahead is not for your kin!"
Qing Shuang’s eyes showed no ripple.
Just as these two Ghost Race members said, she and her sister were already exiled from the Ghost Race.
Therefore, neither she nor Fei Yue had much sense of belonging to the Ghost Race.
But the Soul Nourishing Pool could compensate for the Ghost Race’s weak spiritual power.
She certainly couldn’t miss it.
She took a deep breath, focusing her gaze on the two Ghost Race members blocking the way.
Won’t let us in?
Then we’ll fight our way in!
Gu Xing glanced at the information of the two Ghost Race members.
[Ghost Race (Ordinary Member)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Legendary Nine Stars]
[Power: 2700]
[Constitution: 2700]
[Spirit: 800]
[Speed: 2600]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques...]
The attributes of the other Ghost Race member were similar.
Seeing these attributes, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
Spirit is indeed a shortcoming for the Ghost Race.
These two Ghost Race members, as Legendary Nine Stars, have a pitifully low spiritual attribute of only 800 points.The source of this content ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Even lower than Fei Yue!
Just...
Seeing Qing Shuang wanting to take action, the two Ghost Race members sneered.
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were nailed to the pillar of shame of the Ghost Race!
The sisters couldn’t even fully inherit the abilities of the Ghost Race, how could they possibly be opponents!
However, their thoughts lasted only a moment.
The next instant.
Qing Shuang’s fist had already landed brutally on their faces!
"Boom!"
In the next moment, the two Ghost Race members’ figures were deeply embedded in the ground.
The surrounding council members saw this scene and were completely stunned.
"How could this be? These two Ghost Race members... defeated so easily?"
"This Beast Master from Longxia Country, so strong?"
...

chapters.title: Chapter 119: Demon Race Disturbance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 119: Chapter 119: Demon Race Disturbance!
Two members of the Ghost Race lay on the ground awkwardly, faces full of disbelief.
Wasn’t this Ghost Race member exiled due to a congenital defect?
Why do they feel utterly powerless in front of this Ghost Race?
Is this even right?!
Fortunately, the Ghost Race are naturally robust, and the two quickly struggled to their feet.
However, when they looked at Qing Shuang again, there was deep apprehension in their eyes.
After all, defeating them without even seeing the attack...
This Ghost Race member’s strength clearly far exceeded theirs.
Even compared to the strongest Ghost Race member entering the Divine Secret Realm this time—Cang—they were not much different!
Witnessing this, Vera sneakily approached Fei Yue and asked in a low voice:
"Fei Yue, do you Ghost Race have poor vision? You’re so powerful yet you choose to exile your own?"
Hearing the term "sister," Fei Yue immediately looked at Vera.
Seeing Vera’s childish appearance, Fei Yue reached out and poked Vera’s forehead.
"No way, call me ’sister,’ and I’ll tell you!"
After hearing this, a black line appeared on Vera’s forehead.
She has existed for thousands of years, call a little girl ’sister’?
Impossible!
Seeing Vera frozen, Fei Yue glanced at Gu Xing, mischievously leaned toward Vera’s ear:
"If you call me ’sister,’ I’ll tell you how to pursue the Master, how about that?"
Hearing this offer, Vera’s eyes suddenly lit up.
Despite existing for thousands of years, she had been asleep all along.
From her birth to now, only a few months had passed.
Compared to romantic experiences...
This Ghost Race member seems more knowledgeable!
Thinking of this, Vera decided to go for it.
Isn’t calling ’sister’ just a word?
Call that Angel ’sister’ and call the Ghost Race ’sister’ too!
No difference if there’s one more!
"Sister Fei Yue~, please teach me!"
Yet...
Fei Yue’s expression changed, and she directly refused:
"I won’t tell you!"
She hasn’t forgotten.
At the Chaos Arena, this Elf tied her up tightly and stuffed that thick and long... vine into her mouth.
Treating her like this, asking for her help?ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Impossible!
Absolutely impossible!
"Swish——"
A spatial rift instantly opened, and Fei Yue jumped back into it.
She’s no match for this Elf!
Now that she’s offended this Elf, it’s better to hide for a while!
Seeing the Ghost Race dare to mess with her, Vera’s mouth twitched.
Although currently, her strength ranks near the bottom among the Master’s Guardian Beasts...
But at least it’s stronger than this little girl!
However...
Looking at Fei Yue, who had already disappeared into the Void, Vera’s expression darkened.
This little girl runs really fast!
At the entrance.
Qing Shuang looked at the two Ghost Race members blocking her way again, her eyes suddenly turned cold.
She held back just now!
If these two Ghost Race members didn’t read the situation correctly, she wouldn’t mind teaching them a lesson!
But in the next moment...
"Swish!"
The two Ghost Race members suddenly retreated to the sides, letting the passage open.
In the Ghost Race’s survival law, strength is the truth.
Clearly, Qing Shuang’s strength had already conquered them!
Moreover, even if the two continued to block Qing Shuang...
That would be self-humiliation!
More than that...
The order given by "Cang" was merely to hinder people from entering the Soul Nourishing Pool as much as possible.
"You and your... Master may enter."
"And the human girl who is with you!"
"But the other Human Race... cannot enter!"
Seeing these two Ghost Race members acting smart, Gu Xing stopped Qing Shuang from taking further action.
As long as he could enter!
As for these Council members...
Not familiar!
Subsequently, Gu Xing calmly passed through with Ying Bing.
Upon witnessing this, the Council members suddenly awakened and began asking Gu Xing for help.
"Mr. Beast Master from Longxia Country, can you put in a good word for us? We also want to enter!"
"Yeah, the Human Race is one whole, you shouldn’t mind helping us with this small favor, right?"
Seeing Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast able to crush the two Ghost Race members, these Council members started plotting.
But the moment the two Ghost Race guards heard that, their nerves immediately tensed, exchanging a glance in secret.
If only letting a few more people through could be explained, but allowing the whole Human Race in...
The two would be waiting for a beating then!
Thinking of this, they immediately cast a wary eye toward Gu Xing.
If this human really wanted to help, they could only fight with all they had.
However.
Gu Xing didn’t even stop, walking straight to the depths of the Land of Trial.
If it were Veronica here today, he wouldn’t mind helping.
But seeing these Council members...
No way!
....
Outside the Secret Realm.
With a grave expression, Lei Zhan approached Long Zhenguo and reported in a low voice:
"I just got word that the Demon Race’s numbers in the Demon Realm have multiplied several times, not only emerging in large numbers at the Commander Level, but multiple Monarch Level auras have been detected!"
Upon hearing this, Long Zhenguo’s brows furrowed tightly.
Ever since the Human Race settled in the Northern Territory, the Demon Realm had never been this active.
Those Demon Race members always avoided battles, forcing them to formulate a bait plan.
Yet now...
Not only Commander Level Demon Race but even Monarch Level Demon Race had appeared in considerable numbers!
This situation clearly wasn’t normal!
Why did it have to be now?!
Long Zhenguo’s gaze unwittingly turned to the Secret Realm’s entrance, a terrifying speculation rising within his mind:
"Could it be... that the Demon Race is also aiming for the Divine Pattern?"
At this moment, Verocan and the Church Court Empress also received the same intelligence.
The three exchanged glances, instantly realizing the severity of the situation.
No matter the outcome of the Divine Secret Realm, if the Demon Race invaded...
It wouldn’t matter who obtained the Divine Pattern!
It’s the same for the Human Race and the Alien Race alike!
"Everyone!" Long Zhenguo’s resonant voice echoed throughout.
"With the Demon Race’s sudden movement and the Divine Secret Realm’s contest unresolved, should we first jointly resist the Demon Race?"
The Alien Race present considered for a moment after hearing this and all agreed.
After all, the result of the Divine Secret Realm was yet unknown.
Their kin in the Divine Secret Realm might very well obtain the Divine Pattern.
This moment, they absolutely couldn’t let the Demon Race near the Divine Secret Realm.
Yet once the Divine Secret Realm ended...
To these Alien Races, they could survive anywhere in the Alternate Space.
A portion of them came to the Northern Territory for its Star Stone resources alone.
And now, the Northern Territory evidently had caught the Demon Race’s eye.
If they stayed any longer, not only would they reap no benefits...
They might sacrifice all their kin!
Understanding the stakes, these Alien Races promptly ordered!
"Everyone, unite and head to the Northern Territory’s border to repel the Demon Race!"
After leaving the entrance to the Secret Realm, Long Zhenguo realized...
These Alien Races certainly couldn’t be relied upon!
Once the Divine Secret Realm ended, these Alien Races would never continue resisting the Demon Race!
Therefore, he turned and commanded Lei Zhan:
"Mobilize all Monarch Level from Longxia to the Northern Territory to stand by!"
There are still two Divine Secret Realms in the Northern Territory that have yet to open. If the Demon Race occupied here...
The consequences would be unimaginable!
Not daring to delay, Lei Zhan immediately took Long Zhenguo’s orders back to Blue Star.
The great battle is imminent, leaving no room for hesitation!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 120: Ghost Race With Muscles for Brains!
chapters.content:
Chapter 120: Chapter 120: Ghost Race With Muscles for Brains!
The group pressed on without stopping, and soon arrived at the core area of the Land of Trial.
The Soul Nourishing Pool before their eyes was even more spectacular than they had imagined—
The pool, a hundred yards in diameter, shimmered with a starlit blue radiance, as if the entire sky had been captured within.
Yet at this moment, the poolside had long since been occupied by a group from the Ghost Race.
The closer one drew to the water, the more significant the effect on Spiritual Power became, but what also followed was an ever-stronger assault of illusions.
Only by holding fast to one’s core self amid the Illusion Realm could the true forging of spirit begin.
Sensing the presence of outsiders, the seated ghosts slowly opened their eyes.
At their head, the Ghost Race’s prodigy—Cang, swept his gaze across them, frowning slightly.
But he quickly understood—those two Ghost Race guards blocking the road must have already been defeated.
Otherwise, these people would never have gotten here!
When his gaze landed on Qing Shuang, his eyes narrowed slightly.
Unicorn Ghost Race?
Wasn’t this the same outcast that his father had personally banished from the clan all those years ago?
Cang slowly rose, and as if given a signal, the ghosts around him all stood at the same time.
He led his group closer to Gu Xing, not even bothering to look at the human, but fixing his eyes right on Qing Shuang:
"To have defeated our clan’s guards, your strength..."
He tilted his chin slightly upward, his tone full of condescending praise:
"You’ve earned my recognition."
Cang gave Gu Xing a cursory glance, his tone indifferent:
"As long as you break the Contract with this human, I can report to my father and have you and your sister welcomed back to the Ghost Race."
The corner of his mouth curled into a playful smile.
Anyone who could defeat both Ghost Race guards was approaching the top five of the younger generation’s strength.
"And not only that..."
Cang’s gaze roamed freely over Qing Shuang. "I could even make an exception and allow you to serve under me."
Though she only had a single horn, that cold, spellbinding face of hers truly stirred his heart.
The surrounding Ghost Race members chimed in at once:
"Young Master Cang is being gracious, how could you not agree?"
"What can you possibly achieve staying with a human?"
"Didn’t you come here to fix your Spiritual Power deficiency? Agree to serve Young Master Cang and you’ll get to train with us at the Soul Nourishing Pool!"
"Otherwise... you know what happens to trespassers here!"
Cang, seeing his clansmen this cooperative, nodded with satisfaction.
However.
On hearing her sister so humiliated, the first to lose it was Fei Yue.
"And what the hell are you supposed to be? Think you’re good enough for my sister? Pah! Shameless bastard!"
She appeared from the Void, materializing midair.
At this moment, she couldn’t even spare a thought for being caught by Vera, and pointed at Cang’s nose, spewing curses.
Yet when Cang saw Fei Yue appear, his pupils shrank.
It was known that even his command over Void Power was among the best of his generation in the Ghost Race.
But just now, he hadn’t sensed Fei Yue’s presence at all.
Which meant, this Ghost Race girl surpassed even him in the mastery of the Void!
Another genius!
He raised a hand to still his restless clansmen, staring intently at Fei Yue:
"Besides your sister, you can serve me as well—the treatment...will be just as good!"
And when Gu Xing saw how this Ghost Race idiot now set his sights on Fei Yue, he quietly gave him a thumbs up.
Fei Yue was Qing Shuang’s reverse scale—her bottom line.
Forget anyone else...
Even if he wanted to harm Fei Yue, he figured Qing Shuang would come for him no matter the cost.
This Ghost Race guy had managed to nail Qing Shuang’s death button...
All Gu Xing could say was: Good luck, pal!
Just as Gu Xing expected, Qing Shuang’s eyes had grown icy cold.
Earlier, Cang’s rude words hadn’t even registered for her.
But dare to set your sights on Fei Yue...
At this point, Cang still hadn’t realized how bad things were. Looking back and forth between Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, he became more and more excited.
"With both of you sisters by my side, you’ll enjoy the best this clan can offer!"
The Ghost Race trained their bodies above all. Aside from Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, these two exceptions...
All the other Ghost Race women...
Barrel-chested, thick-waisted, broad-shouldered—typical for them.
He’d finally found two Ghost Race females who were nice to look at—how could he ever let them go?!
"So? I’ll treat you both plenty well!"
However.
What came faster than Qing Shuang’s answer—
—were the living Ghost Patterns crawling over her cheeks.
"Boom—"
Raging Ghost Qi exploded like a tsunami.
The instant this surge of frenzied energy erupted, all the Ghost Race present except for Cang turned pale.
This power...
It completely crushed them!
And even Cang finally grew serious now!
This aura...
Not bad!
But...
The Ghost Race didn’t rely on Ghost Qi alone to win!
"Boom—!"
Identical Ghost Patterns. Identical Ghost King’s Body.
"Woman, you’ve caught my attention now!"
"Since you won’t accept my offer, I’ll beat you till you do!"
Watching this Ghost Race clown showing off,
Gu Xing was a bit speechless.
If he couldn’t see the attributes of this Ghost Race, he might really have thought the guy was terrifyingly strong.
[Ghost Race (Cang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 3000→3900]
[Constitution: 3000→3900]
[Spirit: 1000→1300]
[Speed: 2700→3510]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques (Mountain Opening [raises Strength Attribute 1.2x], Sea Breaker [unusable]), Ghost King’s Body [All Attributes raised 1.3x]]
And as for Qing Shuang right now...
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 4000→6000]
[Constitution: 3500→4550]
[Spirit: 2000→2600]
[Speed: 3000→3900]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body (All Attributes raised 1.5x!), Strength Domain]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (Strength Attribute raised 1.5x), Sea Breaker (Strength Attribute raised 2x), Heaven-Breaking (level too low), Star Shattering (level too low)]
Just in the attribute the Ghost Race excelled at—Strength—
Cang was trailing Qing Shuang by over 2000 points.
Not to mention the differences in Constitution and Speed Attributes...
And on top of that...
When Qing Shuang used Mountain Opening and Sea Breaker, her strength soared to an utterly terrifying level.
Gu Xing glanced at the already furious Qing Shuang, then at Cang, brimming with confidence.
He shook his head and shot Cang a look of pity.
But Cang couldn’t make heads or tails of it.
He thought Gu Xing was begging for mercy, and grew even more arrogant:
"Human! Now you know your place? Hurry up and break the Contract!"
"Otherwise, I’ll break your legs!"
Gu Xing couldn’t even be bothered to answer these threats.
Having spent time with Fei Yue and Qing Shuang, he’d never thought the Ghost Race were stupid.
But having met Cang...
Turned out their brains really were just packed with muscle!
"Qing Shuang, just leave him alive."
Gu Xing left her with those words, turning to make his way to the Soul Nourishing Pool.
He’d planned on letting the Ghost Race off, but now...
Better make them submit, then squeeze that Monarch Level Ghost King for all he could!
After all, these ghosts offered themselves up—wasn’t his fault!
"Yes, Master!"
With that simple reply, Qing Shuang’s Ghost Qi surged even higher!
Ghost Race First Technique: Mountain Opening!
[Power: 6000→9000]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Master! I Want to Enter the Soul Nourishing Pool!
chapters.content:
Chapter 121: Chapter 121: Master! I Want to Enter the Soul Nourishing Pool!
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, Cang was instantly furious.
"Human, do you think you know who you are facing?!"
"Ghost Race First Style: Mountain Opening!"
Almost instantly, Cang used the skill ingrained within the bones of the Ghost Race.
The same skill, but different users yield different effects.
Under the blessing of the Ghost Race First Style...
[Power: 3900→4680]
Although Cang’s attributes rose again, compared to Qing Shuang...
It’s only half of Qing Shuang’s attributes!
This gap is directly reflected in their battle.
"Whoosh!"
The space tore open like a fragile curtain, and Cang’s figure instantly vanished into the void.
This is precisely another talent of the Ghost Race!
Void!
Seeing this scene, Qing Shuang was not surprised at all.
Even though she didn’t possess this talent, what she had was...
Extreme power and battle instincts honed to the peak!
"Boom!"
Her right fist suddenly blasted backward, accompanied by a piercing sound of breaking through the air.
Just emerging from the void, Cang’s pupils shrank suddenly.
He never expected Qing Shuang to react so quickly.
His appearance was without warning, yet this Ghost Race could attack in an instant.
In a rush, Cang could only cross his arms to block.
But, with a strength attribute exceeding 4000 points...
Such a vast difference, how could he easily block it?
"Bang——!"
At the moment of contact, Cang seemed to be hit head-on by a towering mountain.
His body transformed into a human cannonball, smashing several boulders consecutively before barely coming to a stop.
And the surrounding Ghost Race, witnessing this scene, were completely dumbfounded.
"Cang... Lord Cang, how could he be defeated by this Unicorn Ghost Race..."
"Impossible! Isn’t she talent-deficient? How could she be so strong!"
But at this moment, Qing Shuang slowly turned around, looking directly at the group of Ghost Race who spoke rudely about Fei Yue earlier.
Gu Xing’s tone just now was as if to leave this group of Ghost Race a breath!
In the next moment, Qing Shuang suddenly appeared in front of this group of Ghost Race.
She wasn’t using the Ghost Race talent, but rather...
Pure physical attributes!
And as this group of Ghost Race witnessed this, they realized something, one Ghost Race shouted:
"Quick, hide into the void, this Ghost Race can’t deal with us then!"
But as they said this, they seemed to have forgotten about Fei Yue, who had control over the void many times stronger than them!
"Void: Lockdown!"
As Fei Yue’s voice appeared, in the next moment.
This group of Ghost Race was horrified to find that their void ability could not be used.
More bluntly, the space they were in was already controlled by a stronger Ghost Race!
Thus, they completely lost the qualification to enter the void.
But there was no time for them to continue being shocked.
Qing Shuang’s fist was already close by.
Facing this group of Ghost Race considerably weaker than Cang, Qing Shuang took them down one by one...
Before long, this group of Ghost Race was all on the ground, passed out.
Due to the strong physical attributes of the Ghost Race, Qing Shuang even delivered an additional punch to ensure they were knocked out!
On the other side.
In the pile of rubble, Cang struggled to get up, shaking his buzzing head.
Qing Shuang’s earlier punch had made his mind a bit clearer.
He now looked at Qing Shuang, and the previous arrogance was gone.
It seemed like... he couldn’t win!
But Qing Shuang didn’t care about Cang’s thoughts.
She only knew this Ghost Race was more resilient than the others.
But if it’s resilient, then just hit more punches!
"Bang! Bang! Bang!"
Three heavy punches accurately hit the head, Cang’s whites instantly rolled up, and his body collapsed like a rag doll.
He successfully passed out.
Thus, all the Ghost Race present were resolved by Qing Shuang.
And Gu Xing was unsurprised by Qing Shuang’s ability to handle these Ghost Race, as he had already arrived at the edge of the Soul Nourishing Pool.
But he didn’t feel any pressure from the Soul Nourishing Pool.
He stroked his chin, speculating.
Perhaps it was because his Spiritual Attribute had reached its limit, unable to improve.
This is possibly why...
The Soul Nourishing Pool has no effect on him?
Contrarily.
A few steps behind him, Ying Bing’s face looked somewhat pale.
Apparently affected by the Soul Nourishing Pool!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the NovᴇlFirenᴇt
Gu Xing asked with concern:
"Are you okay?"
Ying Bing stubbornly shook her head.
Though her body felt extremely uncomfortable, she understood that persisting would only benefit her!
Beside Ying Bing, Vera appeared at ease.
Gu Xing speculated maybe it was because of Vera’s higher spiritual power!
Nonetheless, the Soul Nourishing Pool can increase spiritual power...
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Power: 1510]
[Constitution: 1520]
[Spirit: 3430 (improving)]
[Speed: 1500]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain]
3430...3431...3432...
Though the improvement speed isn’t fast, Vera’s Spiritual Attribute is indeed increasing.
Only then did Gu Xing realize...
Besides spiritual attributes, Vera’s other attributes...
Seem to be wrong!
Earlier, he didn’t think much about Vera’s other low attributes due to unfamiliarity with the various attributes of a myth-level Guardian Beast.
But now...
Having encountered so many Demigod-level Guardian Beasts and Ghost Race sisters.
He realized Vera’s other attributes were somewhat too low!
After some thought, Gu Xing could only attribute it to...
The Elves’ Divine Pattern had been taken by the Demon Race, leading to this result.
After all, no other reasonable explanation exists!
And by this time, Qing Shuang had already reached his side.
"Master, I want to enter the Soul Nourishing Pool!"
Gu Xing turned, meeting a pair of stubborn cyan eyes.
Enter the Soul Nourishing Pool?
Judging from Qing Shuang’s performance, even close to the Soul Nourishing Pool, one’s spirit suffers enormous pressure.
If entering the Soul Nourishing Pool...
Gu Xing looked again, seeing Qing Shuang’s face somewhat pale.
Clearly, she was already affected by the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Seeing Gu Xing not answer for a long time, Qing Shuang repeated.
"Master, I want to enter the Soul Nourishing Pool!"
When she met Liu Li earlier, she could clearly feel...
That angel’s power had already...
Transformed!
Back in the City of Chaos, she could sense her power was slightly stronger than the angel.
But now...
Even though both her sister and she contracted.
However...
She was unwilling to fall behind others!
And to quickly improve her Spiritual Attribute shortcoming!
Entering the Soul Nourishing Pool...
Was evidently the best result!
Gu Xing understood Qing Shuang’s thoughts.
"Alright! But be careful!"
After pondering for a moment, Gu Xing agreed.
Though uncertain if the Soul Nourishing Pool would affect Qing Shuang negatively,...
With the protection of the "Celestial Grace" skill!
At least it guarantees that he can solve any problems arising promptly!
Seeing this scene, Vera similarly spoke:
"Master!"
Seeing the little elf’s eyes, he understood the little elf’s thoughts.
Adding one isn’t much!
Let’s go together!
"I agree!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 122: The Past of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue 1
chapters.content:
Chapter 122: Chapter 122: The Past of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue 1
Divine Secret Realm center.
Veronica, the Blood-colored Church, and many Alien Races all gathered here.
They did not choose to head to the two Lands of Trial within the Divine Secret Realm.
Their goal was only one...
And that was the Divine Pattern!
At this moment, the fan-shaped area in front of the Divine Pattern was empty.
The Alien Races gathered, standing in opposition to the Council and the Blood-colored Church.
However, for now, neither side chose to take action, and the situation reached a deadlock.
But the true eruption was just one spark away.
And that spark was...
The center of this fan-shaped area!
There, a Divine Pattern was slowly forming.
According to the speed at which this Divine Pattern was forming, it would be fully formed in about a day.
Within the team of the Blood-colored Church.
Cecilia respectfully approached the black-robed figure in the center.
"Blood Ancestor, Gu Xing from Longxia Country, whom you asked me to monitor, has not arrived here yet!"
"I suspect he might have gone to the two Lands of Trial in the Divine Secret Realm."
A nearby Half-step Myth Level Blood Prince heard Cecilia’s voice and immediately spoke with disdain:
"Blood Ancestor, if you leave that human to me, I can definitely bring back his head as an offering to you!"
However.
In the next moment, a petite, delicate right hand pierced through this Blood Clan’s chest and grasped his heart.
The heart is the source of a Blood Clan’s power; once the heart is shattered, even a Blood Race with super strong healing ability would die.
"Blood...Blood Ancestor!"
His life was in Lilith’s hands, and his body trembled endlessly with fear.
Even though he was a Blood Prince with Demigod-like talent, in front of Lilith, he was like a child with no power to fight back.
Lilith slowly lifted the hood with her left hand, revealing silver hair like moonlight under the black robe.
Though her body was petite, her blood-red pupils carried endless majesty.
"Since when could you make decisions for me?"
Though Lilith’s voice was youthful, it caused the Blood Prince’s heart to sink to the bottom.
His body suddenly went limp, immediately kneeling before Lilith, trembling as he replied:
"Blood...Blood Ancestor, I’m sorry! I overstepped my bounds!"
However, there was not a single ripple in Lilith’s eyes.
Her five alabaster fingers gradually tightened.
In the next moment, the Blood Prince’s heart shattered with a boom.
A scarlet aura instantly merged into her body.
The surrounding Blood Race members witnessed this scene as if they were accustomed to it, only looking at Lilith with greater respect.
The Blood Race is different from other races.
There are no family ties within their race.
In this race, the strong are revered.
If any Blood Race member can kill Lilith, then he or she would be the next Blood Ancestor.
Lilith’s position as Blood Ancestor was also obtained through endless slaughter.
Therefore, to her, these Blood Race members could not be considered family.
Unreliable, untrustworthy!
Even less so than the respectful Cecilia nearby.
At least, Cecilia wouldn’t constantly want her dead and replace her.
"Continue to stand by, if anyone else wants to act stupid, I don’t mind sending him on his way."
The remaining Blood Race members heard this voice, their bodies instantly quivering, immediately responding respectfully:
"We await your command, Blood Ancestor!"
...
Soul Nourishing Pool.
At this moment, Qing Shuang and Vera had completely entered the Soul Nourishing Pool.
This also meant that their spirits were enduring inhuman tempering.
Qing Shuang’s eyes were tightly shut, her complexion pale, evidently completely lost in illusion.
At this moment.
Her consciousness was once again dragged back to that hellish day.
Torrential rain poured down, and the sky seemed to be torn apart.
At the central square of the Ghost Clan’s residence, all clan members gathered there.
The childlike Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were confined at the center of the square by a barrier.
The gazes directed at them were filled with unparalleled disgust.
"These two sisters are simply a disgrace to the Ghost Race! When in history was there a Unicorn Ghost Race? They are an ominous sign!"
"Because of their existence, the Ghost Race was discovered by the Demon Race, and the Clan Leader’s daughter met a tragic end!"
"That’s right! Since their birth, disasters have occurred continuously!"
"Such calamities should be executed immediately! Keeping them alive will only bring destruction to the Ghost Race!"
"Agreed, execute them!"
"Execute them!"
As the first shout rang out, the entire square boiled over.
Countless Ghost Race members roared in agreement, the waves of sound like knives, slicing into the young hearts of the two sisters again and again.
Fei Yue trembled all over, cowering in Qing Shuang’s arms, her frail body curled up like a ball.
"Sis...Sister, will we die?"
Her voice trembled, tinged with a sob.
Qing Shuang stared fiercely at the faces filled with malice surrounding them, her arms tightly holding onto her sister, her knuckles turning white from exertion.
She could feel Fei Yue’s body trembling with fear, her jaw clenched tightly, but her childish face was full of defiance.
"No, we won’t!" Her voice was hoarse, yet resolute as steel, "I will never let anything happen to you!"
"No matter what the cost..."
"I will make sure we leave here alive!"
On the other side of the square.
A few Ghost Race Elders looked coldly at the man kneeling in the rain.
His body was covered in scars, blood mixed with rainwater pooling into a dark red stream beneath him.
"Qing, why be so obstinate? Is it worth sacrificing your future for two naturally flawed abominations?"
"If you stand up and leave now, we assure you with the Elder Council’s authority that the position of Clan Leader is yours."
"Isn’t the entire Ghost Race more important than your two crippled daughters?"
"That’s right, Qing, as the most outstanding talent of the Ghost Race in these years, don’t ruin yourself!"
Qing kept his head bowed, rainwater dripping down his hair, unable to wash away the determination in his eyes.
"I am willing to forfeit my eligibility for Clan Leader candidacy," his voice was hoarse.
"And accept the tribe’s severe punishment... just begging all of you, please spare Qing Shuang and Fei Yue."
"They are the last bloodline left by Fei in this world... and the only thing I have left to hold onto!"
Before his voice fell silent, he kowtowed heavily.
The stone slabs cracked under the impact, blood seeping through spiderweb-like fissures.
When Qing mentioned the name of the Clan Leader’s daughter, Fei, the faces of the Elders visibly darkened.
Since the Clan Leader lost his beloved daughter, he shut himself in his grief and no longer concerned himself with the tribe’s affairs.
However, these defective Ghost Race sisters were nonetheless the Clan Leader’s bloodline.
Actually executing them seemed inappropriate.
The Elders exchanged glances, silently sharing thoughts.
Finally, the Great Elder, Cang’s father, slowly stepped forward.
"Qing, we can grant your request, but you must face the consequences you deserve."
"As a protector and as the husband of the Clan Leader’s daughter, you failed to protect her, leading to her death because of those two ominous beings! This is an unshirkable responsibility."
"From today, you shall be imprisoned in the Ghost Race Forbidden Land, never to take a single step out! As for your two daughters..."
The Great Elder’s figure rose suddenly:
"They will be exiled from the Ghost Race immediately, never to return!"
Upon hearing the words "Ghost Race Forbidden Land," Qing’s gaze surprisingly remained calm, even showing a hint of relief.
If only he had returned in time, Fei wouldn’t have died!
His daughters wouldn’t have suffered today’s humiliation either!
"Thank you, Great Elder, for your leniency," he said hoarsely.
Then bowed deeply.
The stone slab resounded with the impact of his head.
Looking through the rain, his gaze fell upon his two daughters, confined.
That gaze held an abundance of guilt and longing.

chapters.content:
Chapter 123: Chapter 123: The Past of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue 2
Watching Qing’s figure disappear at the entrance of the Forbidden Land, the Great Elder walked slowly towards the imprisoned sisters.
However——
When he truly approached, those cyan eyes, identical to Qing Ru’s, surprisingly flickered with a chilling ferocity.
That gaze, like a wounded young wolf, fixedly stared at the hunter’s throat.
Cang Xuan’s pupils slightly contracted.
So young, yet already possessing such a powerful desire for revenge... If this girl grows up...
He discreetly scanned the surroundings, his gaze pausing briefly among the crowd.
A figure of the Ghost Race immediately understood and quietly vanished into the rain curtain.
At this moment, the Great Elder’s face bore a seemingly amiable smile.
"Your father has already taken all the blame; from this moment on, you’re free."
"However... you must leave the Ghost Race immediately, never to return!"
Fei Yue lifted her head from Qing Shuang’s embrace, a hint of confusion in her eyes.
They don’t have to die?
The relief of surviving the ordeal had just surged in her heart but was ruthlessly suppressed by the reality of her father’s eternal imprisonment.
Only Qing Shuang noticed the fleeting coldness beneath the Great Elder’s smiling facade.
She tensed up, protecting her sister more closely.
Subsequently, the Great Elder unlocked the barrier that had confined the two.
At the moment the barrier was lifted, the observing clan members reluctantly made way for a narrow passage, but curses followed closely:
"How dare these two calamities survive! It’s truly cheap for them!"
"They caused Fei’s death, they should’ve gone down to accompany him!"
"Indeed, bad luck is just bad luck! But they can never return to the Ghost Race... Then we can be at ease!"
Amid these curses from the Ghost Race, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue supported each other and left the Ghost Race.
But at this moment, Qing Shuang silently made a vow in her heart.
Someday, she’ll return to the Ghost Race with her sister!
Let these people see whether they are truly a bad omen!
Soon, the sisters were getting farther and farther away from the Ghost Race, gradually leaving the Ghost Clan’s Residence behind.
Fei Yue raised her head, eyes filled with uncertainty for the future:
"Sister, we’ve left the Ghost Race, we... Where should we go?"
Qing Shuang wiped the rain off her sister’s face, "Anywhere!"
"As long as we’re together, any place will do!"
Qing Shuang comforted Fei Yue.
As the elder sister, she must shoulder more responsibility!
Yet, just as the sisters were about to head off.
The space suddenly twisted, and a figure emerged out of thin air.
It was that Ghost Race strongman who had vanished from the crowd earlier!
"Why bother thinking where to go?" he sneered coldly, "Your journey ends here."
Qing Shuang’s pupils contracted sharply, shielding Fei Yue behind her:
"Yue! Run! Don’t look back!"
Upon hearing her sister’s command, Fei Yue hesitated no longer and turned to flee.
However, this scene amused the Extraordinary Level Ghost Race who blocked them.
"Run? Competing with Void Talent for speed on foot?"
He shook his head disdainfully:
"Indeed useless, hasn’t awakened even the most basic Power Talent and Void Talent... No wonder you killed your own mother."
"Nonetheless, all this shall end."
The next moment, the Extraordinary Level Ghost Race attacked Qing Shuang forcefully.
But Qing Shuang, almost out of instinct, rolled backward at that instant.
She narrowly avoided this deadly strike.
This unexpected turn surprised the Extraordinary Level Ghost Race, a hint of astonishment flashing through his eyes.
"Interesting!"
"An Awakened Tier One can dodge my attack..."
"Your combat instinct is really strong! You’re just like your father!"
"If it were the same level, I might really have trouble against you!"
"But that’s all there is to it!"
Before his words fell, the Extraordinary Ghost Race’s ghost qi surged, his fingers hooked straight at Qing Shuang’s chest!
Qing Shuang stiffened——
The opponent actually employed Void Power, completely sealing off the space around her!
As death approached instantly, she instinctively turned her head...
To take one last look at her sister.
Yet this glance threw her into an icy abyss——
Why is Fei Yue still here?!
Is she stupid?!
"Run, you fool!" she screamed silently in her heart.
At this moment, Fei Yue was trembling all over.
She indeed took two steps...
But ground to a halt.
Her sister was still there, how could she leave alone?!
Each time it was her sister shielding her from danger!
No matter how many times, when danger arises, her sister was always shielding her!
She’s truly always been protected by her sister!
Watching her sister struggling vainly in the hands of the Extraordinary Ghost Race, an unprecedented sting swept over her.
Why? Why? Why?
Does she have to be protected by her sister!
No...
Can’t be like this!
She must protect her sister, even if just once!
Her immature hands clenched pale, the unwillingness in her chest almost tearing her apart!
"Sister——!"
Fei Yue’s shout seemed to tear through time and space.
In an instant, the world became extremely slow in her eyes.
Void unveiled like a veil, revealing its most fundamental arteries.
She, awakened!
One of the Ghost Clan’s talents:
Void!
The ghost claw about to pierce her sister’s chest slowed like a snail in her eyes, but she couldn’t stop it!
However...
Without a moment’s hesitation, Fei Yue’s figure instantly dissolved into the void.
"Splurge!"
The Extraordinary Level Ghost Race’s palm penetrated her abdominal cavity.
In that instant, with Awakened Tier One power, she instantly crossed the distance and stood in front of Qing Shuang.
"Drip!"

The sound of blood splattering on the ground roared like thunder in Qing Shuang’s ear.
Her cyan pupils contracted violently, the whole world seemed to freeze at that moment.
How could this be?!
"Fei... Fei Yue?"
The voice trembled uncontrollably, the sight before her like a sharp knife stabbing into her heart.
The sister she had always protected was now using her frail body to shield her from a lethal blow!
"Sis... Sister..." Fei Yue’s blood-stained lips curved up with difficulty, "Fei Yue... can protect you too..."
"Poof——"
Another mouthful of blood gushed out, splattering on Qing Shuang’s pale face.
Her sister will die!
Her own sister will die!
This thought gnawed at Qing Shuang’s sanity like a venomous snake.
Her countless times protected sister is going to die right in front of her?
This sort of thing...
This sort of thing... how can that be allowed?!
Blood threads crazily spread in her eyes.
Her hands unconsciously clenched tight, nails piercing the palms, blood dripping to the ground.

Have to strike again, so troublesome!

chapters.content:
Chapter 124: Chapter 124: Demon Pattern Rampages Again!
At this moment, boundless rage drowned Qing Shuang.
Her reason was fading away.
Her mind was consumed by a single thought.
The one who hurt Fei Yue...
Kill her!
She must be killed!
She suddenly lifted her head, and the scarlet pupils reflected the figure of this Ghost Race foe.
And when this Extraordinary Level Ghost Race saw the look in Qing Shuang’s eyes, his whole body shuddered.
Those eyes, truly terrifying!
But...
A mere Awakened Tier One ghost, still dares to look at him like that!
Tired of living!
His gaze darkened and he attacked again!
However...
This time, his strike did not land.
Qing Shuang, cradling Fei Yue with one arm and surrounded by Ghost Qi, reached out and firmly grasped the hand of this Extraordinary Level Ghost Race.
Upon witnessing this, the Extraordinary Level Ghost Race’s pupils contracted violently.
How is this possible?!
Isn’t this Ghost Race just Awakened Tier One?
How could she take his attack?
This can’t be!
"What kind of monster are you?!"
Yet, Qing Shuang at this moment could no longer hear a single word from the Ghost Race opponent.
The Ghost Qi that had lain dormant within her for many years exploded, boosting all her Attributes to a terrifying level.
She began to tighten her grip on the hand of this Extraordinary Level Ghost Race.
In the next moment, a crisp bone-cracking noise rang out.
"Crack!"
This Extraordinary Level Ghost Race’s hand bones were shattered alive by Qing Shuang.
The pain—even for a Ghost Race—was excruciating beyond words.
"You little beast, let go! Let me go!"
The Ghost Race repeatedly struck Qing Shuang’s head with his only remaining hand.
But Qing Shuang made no attempt to defend herself, letting him strike as he pleased!
Seeing that his attack was useless, this Ghost Race began to gather all his Ghost Qi into his palm.
Yet, in this very instant, Qing Shuang—guided purely by battle instinct—spotted her chance.
She saw her opportunity to kill the one who hurt her sister!
With all the Ghost Qi focused in his palm, this Ghost Race suddenly left his throat unguarded.
Of course, Qing Shuang would never miss this one opportunity.
The very next second, like a rabid dog, she lunged at the Ghost Race’s body.
Her teeth sank savagely into the throat of that Extraordinary Level Ghost Race.
Blood sprayed out at once, splashing into Qing Shuang’s eyes, dyeing her already blood-red pupils even redder.
The Ghost Race opponent realized what this girl intended to do.
She actually wanted to bite his throat out alive.
"Damn it! Let go of me!"
He kept attacking Qing Shuang.
But by now, Qing Shuang’s mind held no more fear.
Bite after bite, again and again.
The struggles of the Extraordinary Level Ghost Race grew weaker and weaker, until finally he fell completely still.
Yet Qing Shuang still did not stop, not until she had completely bitten through the Ghost Race’s neck.
With the sound of the head hitting the ground, Qing Shuang’s body faltered, her intent to keep attacking freezing as her consciousness slowly returned.
Her vision became clear once more, and her trembling body crawled toward Fei Yue.
"Yue...Yue, are you alright!"
When she touched Fei Yue, Qing Shuang realized her sister’s body had gone cold.
Fei Yue, so frail since childhood—how could she possibly endure such a heavy blow?
Feeling her sister’s body grow ever colder, Qing Shuang’s gaze became unfocused.
Her entire world began to collapse.
If her sister died, then everything...
Would be meaningless!
...
At this moment, Vera too was trapped in the Illusion Realm.
But...
She was not like Qing Shuang.
Since her birth, she had always been by Gu Xing’s side.
So the Illusion Realm she experienced now was filled with things from before she fell asleep.
The Demon Race kept attacking the Elf Clan.
Members of the Elf Clan kept falling, one after another.
But Vera’s Spiritual Power was now approaching the limit of a Myth Level Guardian Beast, so she already sensed something was amiss.
She had become her master’s Guardian Beast, and the days of war among the Elf Race were long past.
She would never be trapped in the past forever.
Now, the only one she cared about was...
Her master!
Her body slowly floated into the air.
In the next second, a verdant Divine Ring appeared behind her.
"Boom!"
Violent Spiritual Power erupted.
"Elf Monarchy: Full Liberation!"
Even more Spiritual Power surged forth!
And as if unable to withstand Vera’s might, the Illusion Realm began fracturing, piece by piece.
"Natural Lament: Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
World-destroying thunder dragons began to materialize around Vera.
In the next moment, with a wave of Vera’s hand,
the apocalyptic thunder dragon attacked the entire space!
"Boom——!"
Under the might of this furious attack,
the entire Illusion Realm shattered with a roar!
Outside the Soul Nourishing Pool.

she saw that Gu Xing’s gaze was dark as thunder.

This Ghost Race girl usually seemed so strong—how could she not endure this Illusion Realm?

In the Illusion Realm.

This golden glow was expanding rapidly before her very eyes!
Little by little, the golden light enveloped both Fei Yue and Qing Shuang.
Fei Yue’s battered body visibly healed at a miraculous pace!

chapters.content:
Chapter 125: Chapter 125: Qing Shuang’s Advancement!
At the moment the World Tree Leaf resonates with the magical sigil, Gu Xing realized...
This magical sigil could be absorbed by Qing Shuang!
Without hesitation, he retrieved both items.
As soon as the World Tree Leaf and the magical sigil appeared, they eagerly rushed towards Qing Shuang.
And during this process...
With the purification of the World Tree Leaf, the pitch-black magical sigil gradually shed its shadow, transforming into a brilliant golden divine pattern!
Then, this golden light gently rotated above Qing Shuang’s head!
In the Illusion Realm, Qing Shuang’s sealed memories began to awaken—
In her childhood, when Fei Yue was severely injured and on the brink of death, and her world was about to collapse...
A figure enveloped in golden light had once descended to earth!
This figure also bestowed "Celestial Grace," pulling Fei Yue back from the edge of death.
Only...
A young Qing Shuang, for some unknown reason, had forgotten this memory.
Until she once again felt the divine blessing from Gu Xing, combined with the enchanting pull of the Illusion Realm, the images of the past gradually became clear.The source of thɪs content is
The blurry figure in her memories was gradually merging with the Gu Xing before her...
"So... it was you..."
Her spiritual world trembled violently!
Her Spiritual Attribute began to soar rapidly!
The hovering golden divine pattern seemed to sense the summons, transforming into a stream of light and entering her forehead.
"Boom—!"
The violent Ghost Qi erupted from Qing Shuang’s body like a volcanic explosion, instantly sweeping across the entire space!
In Gu Xing’s sight.
Qing Shuang’s attributes ascended rapidly to their peak!

Seeing Qing Shuang’s attributes, Gu Xing nodded.
Just like Liu Li!
After merging the divine pattern, Qing Shuang’s attributes directly broke through to the limit!
Even her talent broke through to Myth Five Stars!
More surprisingly...
A skill called Returning Ruins was added!
The longer the battle lasts, the stronger Qing Shuang’s combat power becomes!
This skill combined with Qing Shuang’s nearly perfect combat instinct...
Gu Xing can already imagine Qing Shuang on the battlefield, like a war god.
At this moment.
The water in the Soul Nourishing Pool rippled, and Qing Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
Her gaze fell on Gu Xing.
The figure that appeared during her darkest moments...
But why does her current master have no recollection of it?
And at that time, her master’s aura...
Was far stronger than now!
Though puzzled, Qing Shuang didn’t speak of this matter aloud.
She felt in her heart...
This issue is vast, something they cannot tackle now!
"Qing Shuang?"
Gu Xing’s voice pulled her back to reality.
Qing Shuang suddenly raised her head, a long-forgotten feeling named "nervousness" arose within her.
Her fingers clenched unconsciously, her heart was a bit unsettled, even her voice trembled slightly:
"Mas... Master?"
Seeing Qing Shuang in this unusual state, Gu Xing was momentarily surprised.
What’s wrong with this girl?
How did she change so much after entering the Soul Nourishing Pool?
Could it be the Soul Nourishing Pool’s effect on Spiritual Power hasn’t dissipated yet?
While Gu Xing pondered, Fei Yue’s eyes widened.
It was the first time she’d seen her sister like this!
The face that always remained calm now surprisingly showed a faint blush!
Could her sister have been swapped?!
Otherwise, how could there be such a big change!!
Meanwhile, Vera, seeing Qing Shuang’s behavior, suddenly felt a sense of foreboding.
This Ghost Race...
Could she be trying to steal her master?
Previously, Qing Shuang’s state didn’t concern her much...
But now...
Hiss~
Something’s off! Very off!
With already one angel in her way, if another Ghost Race appears...
Her chances of success would be even smaller!
No way!
Gu Xing snapped back and checked Qing Shuang’s information again...
Only to find, there was nothing abnormal!
Seeing this, he relaxed!
At least the Soul Nourishing Pool didn’t leave any aftereffects!
However, due to Vera and Qing Shuang’s time in the Soul Nourishing Pool, quite a bit of time was wasted.
Estimating the current time...
It’s already nearing the divine pattern’s appearance time!
As if to confirm his guess.
The next moment.
"Boom!"
The entire Divine Spirit Space suddenly trembled, followed by a cold mechanical female voice echoing throughout the Secret Realm:
[Countdown to divine pattern arrival: 60 minutes]
[Please be prepared!]
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s pupils constricted.
No more delays!
He must obtain the divine pattern as soon as possible, which is the safest course of action.
Especially since the Blood Ancestor from the Blood-colored Church is present.
Her own strength...
Is likely above Monarch level, with unknown contingencies.
If she gets the divine pattern...
The consequences would be dire!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing immediately spoke to Fei Yue:
"Fei Yue, take me to where the divine pattern will appear!"
Hearing Gu Xing’s order, Fei Yue quickly nodded in agreement.
Only before leaving, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the Soul Nourishing Pool behind him.
Can this be taken away?
After all, items that can enhance Spiritual Attributes...
Are extremely rare!
Even though now, except for Fei Yue, whose attributes cannot be enhanced...
He and his Guardian Beasts’ Spiritual Attributes have reached their limits!
But what about Commander Level?
And even above Monarch Level?
The Soul Nourishing Pool can enhance Spiritual Attributes!
This is indeed a treasure!
Leaving it here... would be a waste!
Gu Xing attempted to envelop the entire Soul Nourishing Pool with Spiritual Power, and discovered...
It’s really possible!
Gu Xing’s mind stirred slightly, the hundred-zhang-wide Soul Nourishing Pool suddenly vanished, quietly suspended within the Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, the Beast Taming Space presented a fascinating tripartite structure—
Extreme Fire Domain, Soul Nourishing Pool, Spring of Life, and Tree of Life!
A three-person alliance!
Extreme Fire Domain is Liu Li’s territory.
The area occupied by the Spring of Life and Tree of Life belongs to Vera.
As for the newly emerged Soul Nourishing Pool, it’s temporarily managed by Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
Just right, each of them has a territory!
Gu Xing’s gaze returned to reality.
The two Lands of Trial in the Divine Secret Realm were already completed.
Next...
Is the very center of the Divine Secret Realm!
Obtaining the divine pattern!
This is also the most crucial part of the Divine Secret Realm!
The prosperity or decline of the entire Human Race hinges on this divine pattern!
Though as long as the Human Race acquires it, the current Monarch Level holds the chance to advance to Totem Level.
However...
Such valuable items are best kept in one’s own hands!
Under Gu Xing’s eye signal, Fei Yue immediately used the Ghost Race’s talent.
With a slight lift of her slender hand, the Void instantly cracked open.
Then she grasped Gu Xing with her left hand, Ying Bing with her right, and their three figures were instantly swallowed by the space crack, disappearing from sight!

The situation instantly became tense!
Except for the Blood-colored Church’s camp, where there wasn’t a single movement!
All the Blood Race stood quietly in place, under their scarlet cloaks, silently watching the central figure...
Without Lilith’s command, no one dared to move!
Seeing this, Cecilia hesitated for a moment but still cautiously approached Lilith.
"Blood Ancestor, aren’t we going to snatch it?"
Lilith glanced at Cecilia; if a Blood Race had asked this question...
She would definitely, without hesitation, send that Blood Race to meet their maker.
But this was Cecilia...
"No rush, let them snatch it first, it’s not important to have the Divine Pattern now as in the hands, but when leaving the Secret Realm, it must still be in hand!"
Lilith wasn’t in a hurry at all.
Even though this body only has the strength at the Extraordinary Peak, however...
With each attribute at the peak, plus her terrifying skills, and her battle experience honed from slaughter...
Even if she swept through the entire scene alone, it wouldn’t be much of a problem.
But she wouldn’t do that!
After falling into a weakened state, condensing this body had cost her great effort.
Moreover, the energy within this body was limited.
Savings where savings could be!
Because as long as the Divine Pattern is in her hands at the end, that’s all that matters.
The process wasn’t important!
Lilith watched the battle for the Divine Pattern with keen interest, a hint of amusement flashing in her blood-red eyes.
She was also very curious...
Who could seize the Divine Pattern first!
Suddenly!
Her pupils contracted abruptly!
"Swoosh—"
Before the Divine Pattern, an unexpected space rift opened, Fei Yue emerged with Gu Xing through it!
Gu Xing raised his right hand lightly, taking the dazzling golden Divine Pattern into his Beast Taming Space in an instant!
At the same time.
Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang were summoned by Gu Xing from his Beast Taming Space.
Blazing Angel Fire, Life Energy, Netherworld Ghost Qi, three distinctly terrifying pressures intertwined!
"Boom—"
Their combined force instantly swept across the entire scene.
The alien races and the Council’s members found themselves abruptly halted in surprise.
The fastest rushing White Emperor and Nether Spirit Leopard saw the scene, simultaneously turning their heads to look at Veronica.
Seeing this, Veronica reached out and made a stopping gesture.
The Council’s members instantly halted their advance.
Now that the Divine Pattern was in Gu Xing’s hands, she didn’t intend to fight for it.
But the alien races reacted differently.
Seeing a human suddenly appear, and even taking away the coveted Divine Pattern.
The alien races instantly went mad!
"Human, hand over the Divine Pattern, or prepare to die here today!"
"Human, not only must you hand over the Divine Pattern, but you must also respectfully bring it to us!"
"Yes! Hurry! Bring it to us immediately!"
To these alien races, Gu Xing barely gave them a cursory glance before ignoring them.
After all, it’s not worth his attention to waste on dead people!
Ever since these alien races entered this Secret Realm, he hadn’t planned to let them go.
Except for a few demigod-level alien races that needed to be kept for extorting their tribes, all others...
Would stay within the Divine Secret Realm!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 127: Facing the Blood Ancestor, Lilith!
chapters.content:
Chapter 127: Chapter 127: Facing the Blood Ancestor, Lilith!
Gu Xing’s gaze swept across the Blood Race camp.
The most troublesome among them...
His eyes locked onto Blood Ancestor Lilith!
Even though Liu Li and Qing Shuang had fused the Divine Pattern, reaching peak attributes, compared to this Blood Ancestor...
The gap was still immense!
What shocked him more was that the system could only display the names of Lilith’s skills, while their specific effects were all marked with question marks!
At the same time, Lilith’s gaze also locked onto Gu Xing.
The spatial fluctuation just now...
Her eyes seemed to penetrate the void, directly locating the hidden Fei Yue!
A little ghost from the Ghost Race!
Then, her gaze swept over Liu Li and Qing Shuang, and Lilith’s lips curved slightly.
This human can actually cultivate two guardian beasts to the Myth Level extreme!
How interesting!
Besides those two...
The spiritual attribute of that elf also seems to have reached the extreme!
At this moment, Lilith suddenly became interested in this human!
Such powerful cultivation ability, could it be of help to her?
If it is....
She must capture this human!
But now....
Blood burst forth from Lilith’s scarlet eyes, her silver hair fluttering without wind!
"Attack, retrieve the Divine Pattern!"
Although this group of Blood Race lacks strength, their numbers are vast.
They can always exhaust some status from those three guardian beasts!
As for herself...
"Immortal Blood Body!"
"Boom!"
A pair of massive blood-red bat wings erupted from her body, her petite figure began to grow rapidly.
Silvery white hair transformed into a blood-red waterfall in the blink of an eye!
As the stunning figure in a red dress was fully revealed——
The entire Secret Realm fell silent!
Even Gu Xing couldn’t help but pause his breath.
This is...
The figure standing in mid-air, with bat wings spread and blood-red hair flying, resembling a descent from hell...
The Blood Queen!
[Blood Race Ancestor (Lilith)]
[Status: Blood Clone]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 4000→16000]
[Constitution: 4000→16000]
[Spirit: 4000→16000]
[Speed: 4000→16000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Watching the enhancement of Lilith’s skills, Gu Xing’s throat bobbed, and his pupils slightly contracted.
Terrifying!
This seems like just a common skill of this Blood Ancestor, but it can boost her attributes fourfold.ᴛhis ᴜpdated by NovᴇlFirenᴇt
This already surpasses the enhancement of Liu Li’s Doomsday Angel state!
Is this the foundation of a Totem Level guardian beast?
Frightening!
If this Blood Ancestor attacks with full force...
His expression immediately turned serious.
Don’t be careless!
Absolutely cannot be careless!
And those demigod-level Alien Races, seeing that Gu Xing completely ignored them.
At this moment, they were utterly enraged.
"Human, you choose the hard way!"
"Since you seek death, we’ll grant it to you!"
"Tear him to pieces!"
In a flash, apart from the Council and the Blood Ancestor, all enemies surged like a tide!
Gu Xing, seeing this, slowly withdrew his gaze from Lilith.
He was shocked only by the strength of this Blood Ancestor, but these ordinary Blood Race and Alien Race...
Gu Xing’s voice was indifferent, as he slowly spoke!
"Vera, Elf Monarchy!"
"Qing Shuang, Ghost King’s Body!"
"Liu Li, Doomsday Angel!"
Three commands were issued.
"Boom——!"
Vera, the first to transform, burst forth with green light.
Her petite figure instantly stretched, transforming into the tall Elf Queen.
The overwhelming life energy swept across the entire field like a tidal wave!
Opposite her, her attributes had also been boosted to the peak!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth 2 Stars]

[Power: 1510]
[Constitution: 1520]
[Spirit: 4000→12000]
[Speed: 1500]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain]
Apart from Vera...
Endless Netherworld Ghost Qi simultaneously enveloped Qing Shuang.
This was also Qing Shuang’s first full-force strike after reaching the limit.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth 5 Stars]
[Power: 4000→6000]

Although Qing Shuang’s attributes were only 6000, but...
The aura she exuded even surpassed Vera by a notch!
At this moment, the entire sky was tainted by Ghost Qi, transforming into the Netherworld Ghost Realm!
Beside Qing Shuang.
"Boom——!"
Within the golden Holy Flame, four additional sets of wings broke through the flames!
Liu Li activated the Doomsday Angel form!
The twelve-winged Doomsday Angel descends!
