The three figures surrounded and protected Gu Xing at the center.
Faced with the tide of approaching enemies, the three pairs of enchanting eyes dared them.
Not far away, Ying Bing looked at the three guardian beasts surrounding Gu Xing, her ice-blue eyes slightly lost in thought.
In front of these three guardian beasts surrounding Gu Xing, her own role seemed to be infinitely diminished.
She reached out to touch her silver hair, a surge of indescribable bitterness rising within her heart.
This time in the Secret Realm, it seemed she couldn’t be of any help!
But Gu Xing did not notice anything unusual about Ying Bing.
His only focus was on the Blood Ancestor.
As for the swarm of Alien Races and Blood Race rushing at him, he had no worries at all!
"Vera, Qing Shuang, deal with these alien and Blood Race!"
Liu Li, you handle the Blood Ancestor!
But, dealing with the Blood Ancestor with Liu Li’s current attributes...
It’s a bit challenging!
But if there’s an attribute difference...
Then raise it again!
"Natural Lament: Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
"Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker!"
With Vera and Qing Shuang able to handle these small fry, Gu Xing turned his gaze to Liu Li.
As for the Blood Ancestor, it’s only natural to leave it to the strongest, Liu Li!
However, with Liu Li’s current attributes, dealing with the Blood Ancestor...
It’s a bit difficult!
But there exists an attribute gap...
Then Raise it again!
"Soul Devouring·Start!"
All Attributes increased by 200%!
Liu Li’s attributes refreshed once more!
[Power: 12000→24000]
[Constitution: 12000→24000]
[Spirit: 12000→24000]
[Speed: 12000→24000]
His blood-red eyes were fixated on Lilith.
Was this Blood Ancestor’s avatar stronger, or was his most powerful guardian beast, Liu Li, stronger?
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 128: The Terrifying Blood Ancestor—Lilith!
chapters.content:
Chapter 128: Chapter 128: The Terrifying Blood Ancestor—Lilith!
At this moment.
Vera had already made her move.
"Boom——!"
Nine Thunder Dragons roared as they charged into the enemy formation, silver-white lightning descending like divine punishment!
The low-tier aliens didn’t even have time to scream before they turned to ash in the lightning.
As for the demigod level alien leaders, they paled with horror at the sight of the nine Thunder Dragons.
The destructive aura swirling within the Thunder Dragons made their souls shiver!
"Quick, defend!"
The demigod level alien at the forefront screamed hoarsely.
In the next moment, all the demigod aliens simultaneously unleashed their life-saving skills hidden as a trump card.
However...
Vera’s Spiritual Attributes surpassed theirs by several times.
And Vera held nothing back, launching a full-force attack.
"Rumble——!"
The instant the lightning collided with various shields, the world turned white!
When the light faded away...
"Cough..."
This group of demigod level aliens had managed to survive, but their physical condition was far from optimistic.
These blood-soaked aliens looked at Vera as if watching a demon.
"How can it be? This Elf... so terrifying in strength?"
"Damn it! What kind of monster is that human to contract such a powerful Guardian Beast!"
"Such strong skills could only be used once, impossible to use a second time!"
"Furthermore, this Elf’s Spiritual Attributes are strong, but her other Attributes surely aren’t as powerful. As long as we can get close..."
"Charge! Avenge our fallen kin!"
The remaining demigods roared as they charged, yet in the next second...
"Swoosh!"
Countless bone-eroding vines of ghostly purples burst from the ground, instantly transforming into an all-encompassing cage!
Vera clearly knew Gu Xing’s mind: these aliens must be detained...
She couldn’t continue using the strongest attack "Azure Sky Thunderfall"!
Otherwise, these remaining defeated soldiers certainly wouldn’t hold out!
Following this, the cage began to slowly shrink.
In the terrified eyes of the aliens, it swallowed them whole.
The vines Vera released could absorb Spiritual Power.
Plus, these demigod level aliens weren’t strong, mid-to-low level within their rank.
Therefore, Vera dealt with them effortlessly, without spending much mental energy!
On the other side.
The Blood Race attacking Gu Xing were all intercepted by Qing Shuang’s slender figure.
Netherworld Ghost Qi roamed around her like a living entity, keeping the attacking Blood Race at bay three feet away.
Facing the wave-like enemies, her jade-green eyes remained as tranquil as a deep pool.
She simply raised her delicate hand, assuming an ancient starting stance.
"Arrogant!"
The leading Blood Prince’s pupils contracted dramatically, his pale face twisted with fury.
"Just a Guardian Beast trying to stop us, really thinking the Blood Race is like those aliens?"
"We are both top races, even if you’re the Ghost Race best at combat..."
"Today, you must remain here!"
With the Blood Race’s enraged roars, they clashed fiercely with Qing Shuang.
Qing Shuang’s figure transformed into an azure lightning in the crimson tide, each movement precisely calculated a thousand times over.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
She sidestepped lightly, a blood claw barely grazing her hair.
Then, with a spinning back kick, three low-tier Blood Race members instantly turned into blood mist!
In this battle, she exerted her combat abilities to the fullest.
Dodging Blood Race attacks while launching counter-attacks against the group.
With a punch and a kick, those Blood Race who hadn’t reached the demigod level were easily handled by Qing Shuang.
As for the demigod level Blood Race, to Qing Shuang...
They were just slightly troublesome!
As long as she didn’t shatter their hearts first, they could regenerate their bodies the fastest.
Adding to that, the numerous demigod Blood Race protected each other.
The battle temporarily reached a stalemate.
But Gu Xing wasn’t worried about this.
After all, Qing Shuang wasn’t going all out yet, she hadn’t even activated the "Returning Ruins" status.
Therefore, dealing with the Blood Race was just a matter of time.
But...
His gaze crossed the battlefield, falling on the ever-standing Blood Ancestor.
To this moment, the Blood Ancestor showed no sign of acting.
Even when Qing Shuang slaughtered her kin, there was no ripple in her gaze.
Meanwhile, Liu Li’s gaze was similarly locked onto Lilith.
Even though her Attributes currently surpassed hers, she still sensed overwhelming threat from Lilith.
Therefore, even with Gu Xing’s talent boost, she was cautious.
"Blazing Burn·Ignite!"
"Boom!"
Gilded Ultimate Fire erupted from Liu Li’s body, twelve wings spread to their fullest in the fire wave.
Liu Li’s most powerful form!
Combining Blazing Burn state and Doomsday Angel form!
Following that, a Holy Sword dripping liquid flames condensed in her palm.
Since the Blood Race showed no sign of acting, she would strike first!
"Boom!"
Liu Li’s twelve wings shook violently.
Liu Li transformed into a dazzling golden meteor, the Holy Sword dragging its blazing wrath toward Lilith’s heart!
"Clang!"
The clear metallic vibration reverberated across the battlefield.
Lilith remained elegantly poised, only raising her right hand gracefully.
Those seemingly slender fingers gripped the sword tip firmly.
"Nearly perfect Blazing Angel bloodline! And you’ve harnessed Ultimate Fire... your strength is impressive!"
Lilith spoke slowly, with a hint of praise in her voice.
Before she was injured, she had seen a Totem level Blazing Angel.
The man’s aura, identical to Liu Li’s now.
That Blazing Angel, except for not possessing Ultimate Fire, his aura was almost identical to Liu Li’s.
Recalling this, Lilith curiously spoke:
"Little one, who is your father?"
However, Liu Li had no intention of responding to Lilith.
Her eyes flashed coldly, twelve wings swiftly folding, her whole being spinning rapidly like a golden top!
The centrifugal force of the Holy Sword emitted a piercing buzz as it attempted to break Lilith’s grip.
"Hehe..."
Lilith’s lips curled slightly, effortlessly releasing her fingers.
Just as Liu Li’s sword momentum waned, that pale hand like a phantom clinched the blade again...
Accurately catching her second slicing attack!
"How is this possible..."
Liu Li’s pupils trembled slightly.
Even under her master’s talent boost, her Attributes overwhelmingly superior, yet each attack failed to achieve her desired effect.
Observing from afar, Gu Xing suddenly squinted his eyes.
He keenly noted a thin, blood-colored aura perpetually enshrouding Lilith’s hand.
But upon comprehending the blood-hued aura’s nature, his pupils quivered fiercely.
"This is... Domain!"
To condense a Domain in the palm!
This Blood Race’s Domain control... to what extent had it reached?
Gu Xing’s throat involuntarily bobbed slightly.
Bear in mind, though Liu Li and Qing Shuang possessed Domains, they could only barely expand them when used.
Even fully controlling them was immensely difficult, let alone like this Blood Ancestor...
Compressing Domain to palm size!
Gu Xing’s eyes were profoundly serious.
So far, Blood Ancestor Lilith was him and Liu Li’s...
most formidable opponent!
No exceptions!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 129: The Game Is Over
chapters.content:
Chapter 129: Chapter 129: The Game Is Over
Just at this moment.
Lilith’s blood-colored bat wings suddenly unfolded!
"Boom!"
The Domain Power originally gathered in the palm suddenly erupted, like a bloody tidal wave trembling.
Liu Li’s pupils suddenly contracted, the Holy Sword slipping from her grasp at the critical moment, and she flipped backwards with the momentum.
She narrowly avoided the strike!
"Not a bad reaction."
After casually complimenting Liu Li, she turned to look at Gu Xing.
"How about a trade? Hand over the Divine Pattern... and I’ll spare this Angel. How about it?"
Gu Xing raised his head, his gaze meeting Lilith’s.
It was impossible to hand over this Divine Pattern!
No one knew when the next Divine Secret Realm would open.
If the next Divine Secret Realm could not open...
Then this Divine Pattern would be the only hope for humanity!
Although both Qing Shuang and Liu Li have fused with a Divine Pattern, Gu Xing could sense...
The Divine Pattern transformed from a Demon Pattern seemed to be of no help to the Human Race in breaking through to Monarch Level!
But the Divine Pattern obtained now...
Gu Xing’s Spiritual Power immersed into the Beast Taming Space.
It was like a lively child, shuttling through the entire space.
Now diving into the Extreme Fire Domain, now entering the Soul Nourishing Pool...
Feeling the aura of this Divine Pattern, he had a special feeling...
This Divine Pattern seemed to contain the fortune of the Human Race!
As long as it was brought into the native world of Blue Star, this Divine Pattern could truly exert its function!
Therefore, it was even more impossible to hand it over to this Blood Race!
Coming back to his senses, Gu Xing calmly ordered:
"Liu Li, activate the Celestial Fire Domain!"
Since Lilith was using a Domain to resist, Liu Li could also activate her Domain.
Although Liu Li’s control over her Domain was not as good as Lilith’s, at least she could narrow the gap slightly!
With Gu Xing’s command issued.
"Boom——!"
The crimson golden Fire Domain instantly engulfed a hundred meters around, even twisting the air in the high temperature.
However.
Lilith still stood gracefully.
The blood-colored light film as thin as the wings of a cicada completely isolated the Celestial Fire capable of melting gold and iron.
"Truly chilling~"
Lilith’s fingertips gently swept through the Celestial Fire, creating a ripple.Google seaʀᴄh No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
She gazed at Gu Xing, her scarlet pupils reflecting the flickering flames:
"For a Divine Pattern... would you even sacrifice your contracted partner’s life?"
Seeing Lilith continuously ignore her and provoke her master, Liu Li’s hand tightened fiercely, golden Holy Flame boiling in her eyes.
The Ultimate Fire on the twelve wings surged wildly.
She would never be a burden to Gu Xing!
Never!
"Judgment!"
The Holy Sword burst into a blinding golden light as Liu Li turned into a stream of light, stabbing straight at Lilith’s back.
However, just as the sword tip was about to touch...
"Hmm?"
Lilith just casually glanced.
Liu Li’s advancing body instantly froze.
At that moment, she felt her blood suddenly coagulate.
This caused... her Judgment skill to suddenly break off.
"Now, do you understand?"
Lilith elegantly turned around, her gaze falling back on Gu Xing, carrying a hint of mockery:
"Your little Angel seems... completely not my match!"
"Continuing to fight, how much of a chance do you think you have to win?"
Upon hearing these words from Lilith, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Liu Li.
Just in that moment, he saw Lilith’s move clearly.
"Blood Manipulation!"
That look from Lilith was precisely when she used this skill.
Almost instantly, the blood in Liu Li’s entire body solidified!
Therefore, let alone launching an attack...
Liu Li being able to stand in place could be considered thanks to her high Constitution Attribute.
Thus, only Liu Li, wanting to defeat Lilith...
Is incredibly difficult!
Just as he fell into distress.
Vera and Qing Shuang solved their enemies.
Vera drained all the Demigod Level Beast Race spiritual power, and they now had no ability to resist.
And Qing Shuang, relying on her combat experience, killed the last few Demigod Level Blood Race!
At this moment, both saw Lilith’s strength clearly and came to Gu Xing’s front, respectfully speaking to him:
"Master, let us join the fight!"
Gu Xing’s gaze swept over his Guardian Beasts, slowly shaking his head.
"No!"
His gaze fixed on Vera.
The Blood Ancestor’s Blood Manipulation ability is extremely terrifying!
Even Liu Li...
Under the dual blessings of Doomsday Angels and the Soul Devouring Talent, her Constitution Attribute reached 24,000 points, yet she would instantly lose fighting power.
And Vera’s Constitution...
Only 1,500 points!
Even with his Soul Devouring Talent, she only reached 3,000 points!
With such Attributes...
If that Blood Ancestor attacked Vera, just manipulating her blood could cause her to explode and perish.
Therefore, Vera absolutely could not be on the stage!
"Damn Blood Manipulation!"
Gu Xing clenched his fists, a trace of unwillingness flashing in his eyes.
If only the Soul Devouring Talent could be used simultaneously with the Sovereign Talent...
With the Celestial Grace skill, that Blood Ancestor’s Blood Manipulation would completely lose effect!
Only that...
Whenever he attempted to use the two talents simultaneously, the two forces repelled each other like water and fire, unable to coexist!
After taking a deep breath to calm down, his gaze swept over Qing Shuang.
Although Vera couldn’t step into the fight, Qing Shuang could.
With the Ghost Race’s Constitution, she should barely manage to resist Lilith’s Blood Manipulation.
"Vera, stay put! Qing Shuang, join the battle!"
"Yes!"
Hearing Gu Xing’s command,
Vera’s jade-like eyes dimmed for an instant, her fist clenching unwillingly.
She understood her master’s concerns...
In her current state, she indeed would only become a burden.
Meanwhile.
Qing Shuang’s figure suddenly transformed into a dark shadow, instantly joining the battle!
As she entered the fray, Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent had already been enhanced, blood-red patterns crawling over her skin.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Nine]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 6000→12000]
[Constitution: 6000→12000]
[Spirit: 6000→12000]
[Speed: 6000→12000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Strength Domain]
It was Qing Shuang’s first time receiving Gu Xing’s talent boost.
The surging power inside almost made her moan.
The pleasure of instantly doubling the attributes washed over every nerve like a tide.
Is this the power of the master’s talent?
Such terror!
The attributes instantly doubled!
"Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker!"
Without any hesitation, she directly unleashed her strongest killing move.
On the attribute panel, the power value crazily surged:
[Power: 12000→24000]
The Strength Attributes were the same as Liu Li’s, both reaching 24,000 points!
Meanwhile, the dark Strength Domain exploded forth, intertwining with Liu Li’s Celestial Fire Domain.
"Boom——!"
Under the suppression of the Double Domain, a crack finally appeared in Lilith’s graceful mask.
Her fingertips trembled slightly...
Blood Manipulation, though powerful, couldn’t target both simultaneously.
While she manipulated one, the other would launch an attack on her.
After exchanging a few moves with Qing Shuang and Liu Li, Lilith realized she couldn’t deal with the two of them.
Suddenly, she retreated quickly!
She no longer intended to continue like this!
"Playtime, over!"
With this soft whisper, the blood-colored aura on her body suddenly ran wild!
Just before, she hadn’t wanted to exert herself fully, depleting the energy in this body.
But now...
Wanting to deal with these two Guardian Beasts, hiding power...
Was no longer possible!
The Blood Domain fully erupted!
The entire space seemed as if plunged into a sea of blood, the viscous Domain Power expanding with overwhelming force—
The domains wielded by Liu Li and Qing Shuang were instantly suppressed by Lilith.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 130: A Major Turnaround!
chapters.content:
Chapter 130: Chapter 130: A Major Turnaround!
The Blood Domain erupted with full force.
The scarlet light reflected on Lilith’s face, making her look even more eerie.
Two Extraordinary Level Guardian Beasts could actually force her to go all out!
"Truly... exhilarating."
Lilith’s gaze swept across the battlefield, ultimately fixed on Gu Xing.
This human’s talent...
She unconsciously licked her sharp canines, a hunger-induced pant escaping her throat.
Really want to taste this human’s blood!
But...
Her eyes shifted back to Liu Li and Qing Shuang, first she had to deal with these two Guardian Beasts!
Blood light suddenly flashed in Lilith’s eyes.
"Crimson Calamity!"
With this low chant, Lilith’s nails suddenly elongated into sharp claws, her fangs prominent near her lips.
Scarlet runes floated around her, amplifying her already terrifying presence once more!
Under the influence of this skill, Lilith’s attributes surged again!
[Blood Race Ancestor (Lilith)]
[Status: Blood Clone]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 16000→26000]
[Constitution: 16000→26000]
[Spirit: 16000→26000]
[Speed: 16000→26000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Lilith felt the attributes of her body, a trace of disdain flickered in her eyes.
If not for the limitations of this Divine Secret Realm, she could elevate the energy stored in this blood clone to the limit.
But now...
With full effort, the energy in the blood clone wouldn’t last long at all.
This had to be a swift victory!
Within the council team, Veronica widened her eyes at this scene.
The battle between Gu Xing and Lilith had completely surpassed her ability range.
Initially, she intended to join forces with Gu Xing to fight the Blood Ancestor, but now...
She glanced at the three domains within the battlefield!
Such a battle, even White Emperor...
cannot participate!
At this moment, White Emperor’s single eye was also filled with trepidation.
Though he had once been at the Monarch Peak, now his power had fallen to Extraordinary Tier Ninth.
While he was stronger than a typical Demigod Level Extraordinary Tier Ninth!
Yet compared to those three freaks on the battlefield...
there was no comparison!
"White Emperor, what do you think are the odds of Gu Xing winning!"
Veronica suddenly spoke!
And White Emperor, after glancing at Lilith who had completely suppressed the domains of Liu Li and Qing Shuang, contemplated for a moment before speaking gravely:
"The probability of that human winning is less than ten percent!"
The Blood Race not only had its domain superior to Gu Xing’s two Guardian Beasts, but even its attributes...
were now also dominant!
Plus, the Blood Ancestor’s nearly perfect domain control...
the ten percent mentioned by White Emperor was already an exaggeration!
The actual probability of winning was infinitely close to 0!
Hearing White Emperor’s words, Veronica’s eyes also instantaneously grew serious.
If Gu Xing lost, that Divine Pattern...
"White Emperor, be ready to assist at any moment!"
Meanwhile, Ying Bing, gazing at the battlefield where Liu Li and Qing Shuang were, had equally solemn eyes.
Her other hand clenched instinctively, if Liu Li and Qing Shuang were defeated...
She caressed her ice-blue hair, of which only half remained.
Even if she had to sacrifice the last half of her Life Force...
At the edge of the battlefield.
Gu Xing felt equally immense pressure at this moment.
Now Lilith’s attributes reached 26000 points!
Exceeding Liu Li and Qing Shuang!
And Lilith’s degree of domain control was far superior to Liu Li and Qing Shuang.
Wanting to win today...
The chances were indeed very small!
"Damn it!"
"Do I really have to relinquish the Divine Pattern?"
Gu Xing cursed angrily.
He couldn’t see where his chance for a comeback was!
Yet, right at that moment...
The Divine Pattern within the Beast Taming Space seemed to sense something, and in the next moment...
It erupted with dazzling golden light like a blazing sun.
Golden light surged like tides across every inch of space, then—
"Boom!"
An unprecedented surge of force flowed frantically into his limbs and bones!
His bones crackled, blood boiled, and Gu Xing distinctly felt his flesh undergoing some fundamental metamorphosis.
Instinctively, he checked his attributes.
And was horrified to discover...
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beast: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit, Ghost Race Qingshuang, Ghost Clan Feiyue]
[Contract Quota: 3/3]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier Ninth]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 3000→4000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 3000→4000 (MAX)]
[Spirit: 3000→4000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 3000→4000 (MAX)]
[Special State: Human Race’s Blessing!]
At the moment he saw his attributes clearly, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted.
This...
Wasn’t the human race’s limit at 3000?
Now under the influence of this Divine Pattern, his attributes...
actually equated to those of a Myth Level Guardian Beast!
More strangely, there was now an additional special state in his attributes panel...
Human Race’s Blessing!
Gu Xing tried to feel it but did not find anything different from before.
Suddenly, his pupils shrunk violently!
"Sovereign—Activate!"
With a low shout, the mutation abruptly arose.
Left eye remained scarlet as before, while the right eye shimmered with an eerie silver glow!
Moreover, the silver glow was spreading at a visible speed!
Gu Xing slowly raised his hand, feeling two forms of power intertwining in his body.
The two once irreconcilable forces, were incredibly submissive thanks to the harmonization of the Divine Pattern’s power.
Using two Talents simultaneously!
Realizing this, his eyes lit up.
Then he suddenly lifted his head, eyes locking onto Lilith.
The chance for a comeback...
He had found it!
The battle would reverse from this moment!
On the battlefield.
Lilith, as a former Totem Level mighty one.
With her own possession of a Divine Pattern, was naturally extremely sensitive to its aura.
Earlier in that instant, she sensed that the Divine Pattern unexpectedly...
recognized this human!
How could it be?!
One must know, to gain recognition from the Blood Race’s Divine Pattern, it required...
reaching Totem Level!
Yet, this human...
was merely at Extraordinary Level!!
More importantly...
Why did this human’s body contain three forms of energy.
Besides the Divine Pattern, the other two forms of power...
Lilith’s gaze fell on Gu Xing’s eyes, one silver, one blood-colored.
A speculation suddenly surfaced in her mind!
Two Talents!
This human awakened two Talents!
Moreover, now under the Divine Pattern’s regulation, these two Talents coexist harmoniously!
He could now use them simultaneously!
Lilith turned her gaze toward Liu Li and Qing Shuang.
She had already witnessed this human’s first Talent before.
Incredibly abnormal!
Irreverently doubling Guardian Beasts’ attributes.
And this second Talent...ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Lilith’s eyes instantly grew grave.
At this moment, she realized the situation was in peril.
As if confirming Lilith’s conjecture, volatile Spiritual Power swept out from Gu Xing’s being.
To defeat the Blood Ancestor, he couldn’t hold back at all!
Bet everything!
"Grant · Slaughter!"
"Grant · Protection!"
"Grant · Celestial Grace!"
All three states stacked up!
And under the accumulation of these three states, Liu Li and Qing Shuang...
achieved the most extreme offensive, the most solid defense!
Additionally, Celestial Grace nullified Lilith’s Blood Manipulation skills.
At this moment, Gu Xing unleashed everything!
This was also his strongest state he could presently reach!
Until this moment, the real battle began!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 131: Lilith—Defeated!
chapters.content:
Chapter 131: Chapter 131: Lilith—Defeated!
The crimson aura of slaughter surged like blood-red flames!
The azure light of protection was akin to a shield of ultimate ice!
The gilded power of Celestial Grace pierced dawn like the morning light.
The three talents intertwined, forming a dazzling vortex of energy around the two Guardian Beasts...
Pushing their combat strength to unprecedented peaks!
Liu Li slowly raised her head, her golden eyes blazing with fierce battle spirit, her gaze piercing towards Lilith like a sharp blade.
Her master could break through the limits... simultaneously using two talents!
How could she fall behind?!
How could she lose to this Blood Race?!!
"Boom——!"
The Ultimate Fire erupted entirely from her body!
The wildly burning Ultimate Fire transformed into nine World-Purifying Fire Lotus that danced around Liu Li.
The crimson gold fire lotuses continuously compressed as they spun, finally condensing into a flaming spear engraved with ancient runes in her palm.
Meanwhile, three-colored energy intertwined and merged on Liu Li’s body.
A crimson gold battle armor of golden flames slowly appeared on her body!
The instant this battle armor formed, Liu Li’s aura abruptly broke through its shackles!
The energy storm bursting from her body shredded the clouds within a hundred-meter radius into pieces!
Meanwhile, on the other side.
Qing Shuang’s hair moved without wind, the Celestial Grace energy flowing within her resonated intensely with her bloodline.
Feeling this familiar sensation, her body couldn’t stop trembling.
This was not fear...
But excitement!
The thrill of fighting for her master!The latest_epɪ_sodes are on_the Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
"Returning Ruins!"
With a clear shout, the overwhelming Netherworld Ghost Qi erupted dramatically!
Thick like ink, the ghostly fog surged and condensed in the air, instantly transforming into a hundred-meter-tall Ghost King illusion.
The illusion had twin horns atop its head, its fangs were bared!
Gu Xing’s Triple Talent Power circulated across its surface, slowly draping the Ghost King illusion with a ghostly purple armor!
As the armor completed its coverage, the Ghost King blood within Qing Shuang boiled fiercely.
Her slender figure trembled violently, the Netherworld Ghost Qi bursting from her body continuously corroded the surrounding air.
The next moment, Qing Shuang and Liu Li simultaneously exerted their Domains to the fullest.
"Boom—— Boom——"
The pressure generated by the overlapping Double Domains caused Lilith’s Blood Domain to retreat step by step.
The scarlet fog hissed and evaporated like it met a natural enemy.
The Blood Domain released by Lilith was suppressed firmly by the two of them!
"Crack—— Snap!"
The Blood Domain emitted a wailing sound like shattering glass, and under the crushing pressure of the Double Domains, the scarlet barrier started to crack!
Lilith’s enchanting face turned extremely unsightly, her crimson nails digging deeply into her palm.
She had thought that by giving her all, she could certainly crush these two Guardian Beasts.
But now...
On the left, the flames scorched the skies, the fire lotuses blossomed like the rising morning sun.
On the right, the ghostly aura loomed, the hundred-foot Ghost King dominating all directions.
The strength of these two Guardian Beasts was actually on par with her!
"Boom!"
Another crack exploded in the Domain, causing Lilith to stagger back half a step.
Her heart sank to the bottom.
If not for her control over the Blood Domain being pushed to its limits.
Perhaps she would have already been defeated under their combined assault!
Outside the battlefield.
The rock layers suddenly exploded, and the White Emperor’s snow-white mane stood on end, its single eye shrank to the size of a needle.
As a former Monarch Level peak, it understood better than anyone——
The Domains released by Liu Li and Qing Shuang...
Were indistinguishable from those released at the Commander Level!
They even surpassed the usual Commander Level!
"How is this possible?!"
How could the Extraordinary Tier Ninth Level possibly achieve such a degree...
Veronica was stiff all over, mechanically turned her head to look at the White Emperor:
"Is this what you mean by... a ten percent chance?"
The White Emperor didn’t respond!
Now he finally understood...
Gu Xing, this human, absolutely cannot be judged by common sense!
Ordinary Myth Level Guardian Beasts facing Lilith...
Would undoubtedly result in instant defeat!
But that Ghost Race and Angel Race...
Under the blessing of this human’s talent, not only did they forcibly level the gap with this Blood Race.
They even... exceeded it by a large margin!
At the center of the battlefield.
"Boom—— Crack!"
At the core of the intertwining Triple Domain, the ground had long been obliterated into nothingness.
The fragmented spatial rifts spread like cobwebs, exposing the chaotic Void turbulence behind.
It is time!
Liu Li and Qing Shuang’s pupils simultaneously ignited with Divine Pattern, and two clear shouts sounded abruptly:
"Blazing Flame Spear!"
"Returning Ruins·Netherworld!"
An astonishing scene appeared——
That hundred-meter Ghost King illusion reached out its claws and grasped the World-Purifying Flame Spear thrown by Liu Li steadily!
On the spear shaft entwining Ultimate Fire, the ancient rune resonated perfectly with the ghost pattern on the Ghost King Armor!
"Roar——!"
The Ghost King smashed through the Void in a charge, wherever it passed, the space shattered layer by layer like a mirror.
The space of the Divine Secret Realm emitted a pained moan under unbearable strain!
This ultimate strike from Liu Li and Qing Shuang had already surpassed the limits of what the Secret Realm could bear!
"Crack——..."
Lilith’s enchanting face suddenly split with web-like blood patterns, and her scarlet pupils fully transformed into two blood-red moons.
Her body began to dissolve, every drop of falling blood pearl merged into the Blood Domain!
She had begun to integrate the energy that constructed this body into the Blood Domain.
The combined attack from Qing Shuang and Liu Li had exceeded what Lilith could withstand.
Interesting... too interesting!
Her blood-like eyes were filled with excitement.
These two Guardian Beasts had truly piqued her interest.
Not to mention, it was Gu Xing, this human...
Who made her heart, which never fluctuated before, ripple once more.
She never thought that a member of the Human Race could achieve such a degree!
"Human, we will meet again!"
Lilith’s voice echoed in the Void, her blood-formed body had become nearly transparent.
Just as the Ghost King illusion’s flame spear was about to pierce through her——
"Crimson Blood Domain!"
The whole space contracted suddenly!
"Buzz——"
The air emitted an unbearable tremor, the Blood Domain with a hundred-meter diameter shrank into a needle-sized crimson singularity in an instant.
The ultimate compression caused rippling distortion in the surrounding space.
"Boom!"
Heaven and earth changed color!
The Blood Domain singularity exploded with a bang, the dazzling white light engulfed everything.
The pure energy torrent surged out like a bursting heavenly river, tearing even space itself to pieces wherever it passed.
"Crack!"
The first spatial rift bloomed at the center of the explosion, followed by the second, third...
The terrifying shockwave diffused in a spherical shape, obliterating everything within several miles into nothingness!
And Liu Li and Qing Shuang, seeing this, dared not hesitate for a moment.
They flashed instantly to the front of Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
Ultimate Fire and Netherworld Ghost Qi intertwined!
As soon as this barrier took shape, the destructive shockwave had already arrived!
The Council’s area experienced earth-shattering tremors!
All Council members almost simultaneously made a move, a gigantic barrier momentarily enveloped everyone in the Council.
Moreover, with the full efforts of the White Emperor and Nether Spirit Leopard, two Demigod Level Guardian Beasts...
Everyone struggled tremendously to fend off the residual energy wave.
"The Secret Realm is going to collapse!"
Amidst an unknown person’s roar, the entire Divine Secret Realm began to collapse dimensionally.
Everyone knew they couldn’t remain any longer!
"Retreat!"
Gu Xing grabbed Ying Bing by the waist and immediately chose to exit the Divine Secret Realm.
All members of the Council followed closely, leaving the Divine Secret Realm!
Subsequently, the Divine Secret Realm that had existed for an unknown duration shattered like a broken mirror.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Light Divine Crystal
chapters.content:
Chapter 132: Chapter 132: Light Divine Crystal
Blood-colored Church Empire Center.
Blood-colored moonlight streamed through stained glass, casting eerie spots on the silver silk canopy.
Lilith suddenly sat up from the silver satin, her sharp nails leaving marks on the gilded bedpost.
"Interesting!"
The moment the Blood Body died, everything in the Secret Realm became known to her!
She unconsciously licked her red lips, her throat moving.
That human’s Talent...
Truly terrifying!
This time she personally made a move, yet still suffered at the hands of that human!
Thinking about this, she slowly stood up.
In her silver-haired loli form, Lilith stood before the full-length mirror, observing her noticeably shrunken figure.
Her silver hair, once reaching her waist, now barely touched her shoulders, her slender wrists seemed as if they could break with a twist.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
She felt the Energy within her!
Weakened again!
The death of the Blood Body this time caused her Power to weaken once more.
Originally king Tier Nine Level, now only king Tier Five.
"This Level..."
Lilith’s eyes slightly darkened.
She absolutely cannot reveal her reduced strength!
If those Monarch Level Blood Race discovered her Power had diminished to such an extent.
They would surely rise en masse to attack, kill her, and replace her as the new Blood Ancestor.
"I must restore strength quickly!"
Now the only Divine Pattern was obtained by that human, and the Divine Pattern has successfully recognized its master...
Her eyes narrowed slightly.
Then she doesn’t need to search for a Divine Pattern, as long as she can capture this human...
Realizing this, a brilliant plan flashed in her mind.
Light Divine Crystal!
That Angel’s Talent is already Myth Tier Five...
To advance further, it must possess such material.
Her pale lips curved into a smile.
This Myth Level material is now the only one within the Alternate Space.
The only Light Divine Crystal is located at the Blood-colored Church Imperial Capital!
As long as that human wishes for that Angel to continue advancing, he will certainly come to the Blood-colored Church.
Then...
She unconsciously licked her lips.
As long as she can capture him, use his blood to awaken the Divine Pattern within her body.
At that time, not only will her strength be restored to its Peak, but it may even advance further—
With this thought, she waved her hand.
Scarlet Energy surged like a tide, her petite figure instantly expanded.
Silver hair grew down to her ankles, and the blood-colored gown fluttered without wind in the shadows, the Blood Ancestor’s aura once again enveloped the entire sleeping chamber.
"Send the order—"
...
Outside the Secret Realm.
Entrance of the Divine Secret Realm.
The initial lively scene here was long gone.
Due to the Demon Realm’s anomaly, most of the Monarch Level experts had already headed to the borders.
It seemed like a beautiful moment where the Alien Race and Human Race joined forces to resist the enemy together!
But...
This apparent calm concealed a surge underneath.
"Buzz!"
Suddenly the space trembled, and the figures of Gu Xing and Ying Bing abruptly appeared.
Lei Zhan, who had been waiting for a long time, instantly flashed in front of the two, keeping them firmly protected.
And the Monarch Level Aliens stationed there, upon seeing people leave the Divine Secret Realm, their eyes suddenly turned dangerous!
Lei Zhan’s gaze cautiously swept over all present Aliens, without turning back, he spoke in a low voice:
"Gu Xing, how is it?"
"Everything went smoothly!"
Gu Xing’s brief answer slightly relaxed Lei Zhan’s tense nerves, but tension soon returned.
The real crisis had only just begun.
The surrounding Alien Monarchs had quietly formed an encirclement, and even the space was sealed by them.
"Lei Zhan, we won’t make a move against you."
"But until our clansmen come out and the Divine Pattern’s ownership is clear, no one can leave!"
"That’s right! We must confirm who has obtained the Divine Pattern in the Divine Secret Realm this time!"
Upon hearing these words, Lei Zhan’s face immediately turned as dark as water.
These Aliens don’t want to let them leave?
Can they really stop him?!
Gu Xing’s eyes scanned the entire scene behind Lei Zhan.
Only then did he notice...
There were few Monarch Level experts remaining here, each Race only had one representative left.
Long Zhenguo, Verocan, even the Blood-colored Church’s Empress had disappeared.
He instantly understood, something must have happened in the Northern Territory, otherwise, they wouldn’t have left here.
"Gu Xing, you two go first!"
Lei Zhan’s voice was extremely low.
Fortunately, Long Zhenguo had anticipated such a situation before.
They were also prepared for it!
Immediately, a black-cloaked figure behind Lei Zhan approached Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
A slender hand simultaneously grasped the wrists of Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
Gu Xing instinctively wanted to resist, but upon hearing a familiar voice...
"Do not resist!"
The resistance movement of Gu Xing instantly stopped.
"Go!"
Lei Zhan suddenly shouted, and the Monarch Level aura erupted.
The space barrier under multiple seals was forcibly torn open in a crack.
The black-cloaked person seized this fleeting opportunity, and the three figures dissipated into the air like foam.
"Space Talent?!"
The Alien experts’ pupils contracted, their expressions instantly turning grim.
"Damn it! The Divine Pattern must be on those two!"
"Chase! They absolutely cannot escape!"
However—
"Boom!"
Lei Zhan’s sturdy body stood like a mountain, the muscles under his uniform tautly straining the fabric.
He gently flexed his wrist joints, joints crackled like beans popping.
Earlier he had restrained somewhat for Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
Now...
"With you bunch of trash—"
Lei Zhan’s mouth twisted into a cruel smile, Monarch Level Peak aura swept like a tsunami, the ground beneath his feet cracking inch by inch.
"Dare to make a move against me?!"
And at that moment...
Space twisted again, and Veronica staggered out with council members.
The second seat of the council guarding here instantly appeared in front of Veronica.
"Miss, this time’s Divine Pattern..."
"In the hands of the Human Race!"
Upon hearing this, the second seat’s tightly wound nerves visibly relaxed.
As long as the Divine Pattern is in the hands of the Human Race, it means either the council or Longxia has obtained it.
Both forces have good relations, so it doesn’t matter whose hands it falls into.
"Miss, I shall escort you away!"
The situation on-site is complex, he must ensure Veronica’s safety!
Meanwhile, the Elders of the Angel Race and Ghost Race waiting there grew increasingly agitated...
They were waiting for a long time without seeing their clans return, realizing something was amiss.
"Something’s not right... It’s not just our people, not even other Aliens have come out."
"Where are the Blood-colored Church’s people? Not a single one is visible?"
"Let’s wait a bit longer, we’re not here for the Divine Pattern..."
"That Blood Race cannot possibly make a move against our clan members!"
At that moment, Aliens and Lei Zhan started fighting.
But...
Lei Zhan was already at Monarch Peak.
Plus, he had four Guardian Beasts at Monarch Peak!
How could these Aliens possibly be Lei Zhan’s match?!
After dealing with these Aliens, Lei Zhan then withdrew from here!
As for killing these Monarch Level ones...
Currently, the Human Race and Alien Race are still in an alliance state, killing them would cause too much trouble.
It’s inadvisable!
However, what he didn’t know was, once he returned to the City of Chaos...
He discovered... a huge surprise was waiting for him.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Thank You, Lord Gu Xing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 133: Chapter 133: Thank You, Lord Gu Xing!
City of Chaos.
A space rift silently tears open.
The next moment, three figures step out from it.
After reaching safety, Gu Xing and Ying Bing turn their heads to look at the figure in the black robe.
Under the burning gaze of the two, the person’s slender fingers slowly lift the hood—
Chestnut-colored long hair, a familiar face.
"Class leader?!"
"Shen Ruoxue!"
In their exclamations, the girl presses her lips together a little nervously, the tip of her ears turning slightly red:
"It’s been...a long time."
Gu Xing slowly returns to himself, indeed it’s been a long time since they met!
But...
Shen Ruoxue has changed so much!
Even her level...
After sensing for a moment, Gu Xing confirms that Shen Ruoxue’s level has already reached Commander Level.
Higher than him!
"After you left school... due to my unique Space System talent, Principal Long made an exception and let me enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool."
"So reaching Commander Level is all thanks to the Holy Pool!"
Hearing Shen Ruoxue’s explanation, Gu Xing suddenly understands and nods his head.
Just earlier when Shen Ruoxue spoke, he had noticed something.
The only thing was, sensing Shen Ruoxue’s Commander-level aura, he was a bit hesitant to recognize her.
Now it seems, his feeling was indeed correct!
But...
Although entering the Beast Taming Holy Pool can speed up level-up speed.
It doesn’t provide much benefit for the future.
Feeling the worried gazes of Gu Xing and Ying Bing.
Shen Ruoxue smiles, slowly speaking:
"This is my own choice, Principal Long and the others didn’t force me!"
"I know, with my talent, even if I follow the path of a Beast Master, I can’t compare to you and Sister Ying Bing."
"Therefore, I might as well upgrade as quickly as possible, after all, my talent... is more valuable to Longxia Country."
Upon hearing Shen Ruoxue’s words, Gu Xing is a bit at a loss for how to respond.
Just earlier he realized...Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
He previously misjudged Shen Ruoxue’s talent.
After contracting Fei Yue, he gained some understanding of the Void.
If Fei Yue’s talent is to plunge into the Void, shuttling within it.
Then Shen Ruoxue’s talent...
Is more akin to teleportation between two points.
As long as she leaves Spiritual Power at one location, next time no matter how far she is, she can directly teleport to that location.
Such a talent... indeed has extremely high strategic value!
Whether it’s transmitting information, transporting supplies... or even as a Beast Master!
Just as they were exchanging information, a thunderous light flashed, and Lei Zhan’s figure appeared here.
Once steady, his gaze immediately turned to Gu Xing.
Gu Xing knows Lei Zhan is in a hurry, so he uses the briefest words to narrate the events that happened in the Secret Realm.
Hearing Gu Xing seriously say "almost annihilated the alien race" the Iron-blooded Military God’s eye twitches fiercely.
Currently, the defense line is already precarious, only briefly united due to the Divine Secret Realm not yet ending.
And now...
Gu Xing has killed all their clansmen.
How can they unite now!
Despite his silent mutterings, Lei Zhan still nods heavily:
"Killed well!"
This group of alien races wanted to snatch the Human Race’s Divine Pattern, killing them is not too much!
"However, these alien races, I have kept some alive!" Gu Xing says again.
Previously he was planning to extort something from these alien races, but now...
They seem to have another use!
Ying Bing timely opens the Beast Taming Space, releasing all the alien races under temporary contract.
Seeing these Demigod-level alien races, Lei Zhan’s eyes light up.
Within them are Young Clan Leaders from several races...
With these chips, at least we’ll be sure those alien races won’t turn hostile immediately!
Only Ying Bing’s actions do not stop.
A group of Ghost Race members follow from her Beast Taming Space.
On the side, Fei Yue also appears from the Void, throwing Saint Cecilia from the Holy See onto the ground.
In the Secret Realm, Cecilia also took part in attacking Qing Shuang, but Qing Shuang spared her life.
Upon leaving the Secret Realm, Fei Yue brought her out incidentally.
"Among all the members that entered the Divine Secret Realm, aside from those here and those from the Council, the rest... I’ve killed them all."
Lei Zhan looks at the plaza filled with "spoils of war," feeling a headache!
He opens his mouth but doesn’t know what to say.
But the matter has already happened...
The Angel Race was already hostile towards humans, so killing them is done.
However, this group of Ghost Race...
Lei Zhan hesitates for a moment, still deciding to release them.
Offending the Angel Race is already troublesome enough, to add another Ghost Race.
Lei Zhan shakes his head.
Even with his big heart, he feels tremendously troubled.
As for the Holy See, he does not worry much.
After all, the Blood Ancestor from the Holy See views the lives of this group of Blood Race lightly.
Killed is simply killed!
After understanding everything, Lei Zhan takes a deep breath, slowly speaking:
"Now with Divine Secret Realm ended, Northern Territory is extremely dangerous, you three immediately return to Blue Star."
"Gu Xing, as for you..."
"Dragon Elder asked me to convey to you, your situation is special, when breaking through to Commander Level... be sure to enter Beast Taming Holy Pool!"
"The token he gave you before allows you to enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool!"
Gu Xing nods to indicate he understands.
"If there’s nothing else, you should set off now!"
Saying this, Lei Zhan swiftly leaves.
He still needs to go to the edge of the Demon Realm, to deliver these messages to Long Zhenguo.
Then, Shen Ruoxue looks at the two, as if asking whether to depart immediately.
Just as Gu Xing is about to nod, a Beast Master rushes in:
"Report! Outside the post, a Cat Beastman seeks to see you."
Upon hearing Cat Beastman, Gu Xing instantly realizes.
This might be Sally!
Indeed, he needs to bid farewell to them.
Gu Xing tells Ying Bing and Shen Ruoxue to wait for him, then turns towards the gate.
At this moment.
In front of the gate of the post, Sally’s cat tail wraps anxiously around her leg.
How should she start...
While biting her pink lips and hesitating, her ears suddenly stand upright like exploded fur—
"Sally?"
"Lord...Lord Gu Xing!"
The girl’s tail instantly goes taut, and her fluffy ear tips are stained with a blush.
Seeing Sally’s flustered manner, Gu Xing is somewhat confused.
But he doesn’t think too much, slowly speaking:
"Sally, I’m returning to Blue Star!"
"You, Cat Race..."
Gu Xing hesitates a bit, still deciding to advise:
"First head to the vicinity of Longxia Country’s defense line, it’s not very safe here in the Northern Territory anymore!"
According to Lei Zhan, the Demon Race is ready to attack the Northern Territory with full force.
Now the Divine Secret Realm has ended...
The alien races certainly won’t foolishly stay here to help the Human Race resist the Demon Race.
By then, with merely the Human Race, to resist the Demon Race...
Very difficult!
And Sally, upon hearing this, nods her head, then shakes it.
"Master Gu Xing, Father will surely make a decision! I came here for another matter."
"Master Gu Xing, I...I want to request you to sign a temporary contract with me."
Upon hearing this request, Gu Xing is taken aback.
But seeing Sally’s nervousness, he ponders for a moment.
The temporary contract lasts only a few days, and Sally has been wholeheartedly loyal.
Moreover, it’s just a temporary contract, it doesn’t occupy the contract quota.
"Alright!"
Gu Xing nods, agrees.
Seeing this, Sally immediately bows at a ninety-degree angle:
"Thank you, Master Gu Xing!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Mi Zhan’s Wrath
chapters.content:
Chapter 134: Chapter 134: Mi Zhan’s Wrath
After Gu Xing and the others left the Northern Territory, the entire situation there became increasingly chaotic.
In the City of Chaos, those weaker races seemed to sense the danger in the air and began to evacuate one after another.
Within the Cat Race territory, the atmosphere was heavy.
A Commander Level cat warrior briskly walked up to Clan Leader Rone, reporting gravely:
"Clan Leader, Miss Sally has already followed Lord Gu Xing back to Blue Star."
"Moreover, various races in the City of Chaos are evacuating consecutively...."
"The situation at the edge of the Demon Realm... doesn’t seem too optimistic either."
After listening, Rone silently nodded.
Since leaving the Elf Secret Realm and losing its suppression, the Cat Race’s limit was no longer confined to the Extraordinary Level.
Now, several Commander Level warriors have emerged within the clan.
But even so, the Cat Race is still an insignificant small race in the Northern Territory.
He took a deep breath, a flash of determination in his eyes.
"Issue the order—"
"All clan members below Extraordinary Level, immediately relocate to the northern border of Longxia Country."
"Warriors above Extraordinary Level, follow me to the border to assist the Human Race in resisting the Demon Race!"
The cat warrior nodded heavily:
"Yes, Clan Leader!"
Once this cat warrior’s figure disappeared out the door, Rone’s stiff back suddenly relaxed.
He stood there, motionless for a long time.
Eventually, he slowly closed his eyes, a hint of indescribable grief showing between his brows.
"I’m sorry...daughter."
The Empress’s prophecy...
Ultimately... has come true!!
...
At the entrance of the Divine Secret Realm, the Ghost Race elder finally awaited his clansmen.
But the Angel Race elder’s heart felt as if it had fallen into an icy abyss.
Miffy...
Has not returned.
Or rather—
She has forever remained in the Divine Secret Realm!
His eyes reddened, grabbing those Ghost Race members released by Lei Zhan, his voice hoarse like scraping rusty iron:
"Speak! What happened in the Divine Secret Realm?!"
Under this Angel Race elder’s pressure, a Ghost Race member trembled and revealed the truth:
"Inside the secret realm... besides that Blood Race member, there was a Human Race member... strong to the point of despair!"
"We... were swept away by him alone!"
Upon hearing this information, the Angel Race elder’s pupils suddenly contracted!
That Blood Race member did not come out...
But that Longxia Country human left the secret realm unharmed!
This means—
Miffy and that terrifying Blood Race member are highly likely to have died at the hands of that human!
Filled with cold dread, he dared not linger a second longer, turning and streaking like a comet towards the Angel Race territory.
This matter must be reported immediately!
But just imagining the Clan Leader’s reaction upon hearing this...Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
The elder’s body began to uncontrollably tremble.
Soon after.
Within the pure gold-crafted Holy Hall, the radiant Holy Light suddenly dimmed slightly.
The angel elder was kneeling on the ground, wings trembling incessantly.
Amidst the heavy footfalls, the figure of War Angel Clan Leader Mi Zhan gradually appeared.
Seeing only this elder present, Mi Zhan furrowed his brows.
"Where’s Miffy? Why doesn’t she come to see me! Does she not acknowledge me as her father anymore?"
Although Miffy was usually quite arrogant, she would never be so disrespectful.
With the end of the Divine Secret Realm, even if her talent reached Myth Level, she should have come to see her father first.
"Clan... Clan Leader..."
The Angel Race elder trembled like a sieve.
He could not think of a way to share this news with Mi Zhan.
But now, Mi Zhan also noticed the elder’s abnormality, his gaze immediately darkening.
The Holy Light around him vibrated violently, the temperature in the hall plummeting to freezing.
"Speak!"
This shout rang like thunder, causing the elder’s forehead to hit the marble floor heavily:
"Cl-Clan Leader, Miss Miffy... has fallen in the Divine Secret Realm!"
After uttering this, he pressed himself tightly against the ground, not daring to lift his head.
Mi Zhan’s body froze upon hearing this.
If Miller’s death left him indifferent, then Miffy’s death—
Truly pained him deeply!
This daughter was the most gifted among all his progeny!
"Boom!"
Violent momentum instantly engulfed the entire hall.
Mi Zhan, just a step away from Totem Level, now unleashed pressure making the Monarch Peak elder like a lone leaf in a raging sea, powerless.
"Who did it?!"
Mi Zhan questioned word for word, each syllable seeming to carry a bloody taste.
The elder dared not hide anything, immediately divulging all the intel he had gathered:
"According to the Ghost Race’s account from within the Divine Secret Realm... it was likely a Human from Longxia Country who assassinated Miss!"
"Human Race!"
Mi Zhan’s gaze turned extremely dangerous in an instant.
First was Miller, then the Angel Race treasure, now even his most valued Miffy had fallen to the Humans’ hands—
Furious anger reddened his eyes.
Staring at the kneeling elder, he fiercely flicked his sleeve.
"Bang!"
The elder’s body crashed hard against the hall’s stone pillar like a rag.
"Useless waste!"
Mi Zhan suppressed his rage, took deep breaths only to barely calm his emotions.
Killing this elder would accomplish nothing now.
"Order all War Angels to assemble immediately, I want to slaughter the Human Race!"
"Cough—"
The elder spat a mouthful of blood but dared not delay, struggling to kneel straight and tremblingly respond:
"As you command, Clan Leader!"
After saying this, he trembled and prepared to relay Mi Zhan’s orders.
But just then...
"Hold on!"
A cold voice suddenly sounded, stopping the elder’s steps.
Mi Zhan looked displeasedly at the shadow within the hall.
Only to see a figure wrapped in Demonic Qi slowly appearing, its raspy voice leaving no room for argument:
"Human Race, must not be touched!"
"What did you say?!"
Mi Zhan instantly assumed the Ten-winged War Angel Form, Holy Light mingling with fury:
"First was Miller’s death, then the treasure’s loss, now even my favored daughter has died to the Humans’ hands..."
"And now you’re telling me... Humans cannot be touched?!"
However.
That demon ignored Mi Zhan’s anger, merely said coldly:
"I said, Humans must not be touched! If Lord Demon God’s plans are disrupted—"
"You won’t ever reach Totem Level, and the Angel Race could vanish from this world!"
Before finishing, the demon’s figure had vanished into the shadows.
He showed no concern about Mi Zhan defying the orders.
He knew Mi Zhan too well—
Just like when they had taken down the former Blazing Angels Clan Leader together.
Only regrettably... the plan eventually went awry...
"Bang!"
Mi Zhan’s clenched fist cracked, nails piercing his palm.
Again, Lord Demon God...
Grinding his teeth, his chest heaved heavily before barely suppressing his murderous intent.
"Get out!"
This roar startled the elder who was frozen, causing him to scramble out.
Immediately after—
"Boom!"
Mi Zhan’s unwilling roar intertwined with violent energy, shaking the Angel Race territory’s buildings!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 135: I Have Decided to Abandon the Northern Territory
chapters.content:
Chapter 135: Chapter 135: I Have Decided to Abandon the Northern Territory
At the same time.
Under Shen Ruoxue’s talent function, the three appeared at the Void Gate behind the northern defense line of Longxia Country.
This Void Gate connects the native world of Blue Star with Alternate Space.
It’s just that...
At this moment, leadership level powerhouses are continuously stepping from the native Blue Star into the Alternate Space.
Seeing Gu Xing and Ying Bing’s puzzled expressions, Shen Ruoxue explained:
"For the past period, Longxia Country has entered a level one war readiness state. Except for leaving the most basic defenses in the native world, all leadership level and above beast masters must go to the frontline!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing frowned slightly.
The native Blue Star only leaves the most basic defenses, if the Demon Race takes the opportunity to attack...
Shen Ruoxue seemed to see his concern and spoke again:
"This Void Gate can only be passed through by the Human Race."
"Perhaps it is the reason this world favors the Human Race; even alien races must contract with the Human Race before they can enter the native Blue Star world."
"As for the Demon Race, it is even less likely to enter the native Blue Star world!"
Upon hearing Shen Ruoxue’s explanation, Gu Xing nodded slightly.
The relationship between alien races and the Human Race now can be described as a rope scorched by fire, ready to break at any time!
As long as alien races leave the Northern Territory, then capable of resisting the Demon Race would be...
Only Longxia Country and the council’s two forces!
As for the Blood-colored Church...
Gu Xing was unsure!
After all, that country is governed by the Blood Race, and this Blood Race as a species....
Seems to be a presence of both good and evil towards humans!
Though they feed on blood, they protect the safety of the entire church populace!
Therefore, Gu Xing is also uncertain whether this group of Blood Race would stand with the Human Race!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing now somewhat understands why Long Zhenguo made such a decision!
Now, the Human Race seems to have reached the edge of a cliff, a single mistake...
Could lead to utter disaster!
If they can’t withstand the Demon Race’s attack...
The Northern Territory will inevitably fall!
By then, not only the Star Stone mine in the Northern Territory, but also...
Those two unopened Divine Secret Realms will become possessions of the Demon Race.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing’s heart tightened.
He must enhance his power quickly!
Currently, he is only at the peak of the Extraordinary level.
He must break through to leadership level——
Only by reaching leadership level can he have the qualification to stand on this battlefield!
So he hesitated no more, exchanged a glance with Ying Bing and Shen Ruoxue, then the three stepped into the Void Gate simultaneously.
He must return to the National Academy at the fastest speed!
According to Long Zhenguo’s arrangement, he must leverage the power of the Holy Pool to complete his breakthrough.
A glimmer of expectation flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
His all attributes had long surpassed human limits and he possessed dual talents...
This breakthrough, what sort of domain will awaken?
And his contracted four Myth level guardian beasts——
If they grow to leadership level, what heights will they reach?!
...
Edge battlefield of the Demon Realm.
Lei Zhan brought the group of demigod level alien race captives of Gu Xing to the battlefield, and reported all situations in the Divine Secret Realm to Long Zhenguo.
After Long Zhenguo learned everything, he decisively made a decision:
Direct retreat!
Hold the northern defense line of Longxia Country.
As for the Northern Territory, it can be reclaimed when there’s an opportunity in the future.
The alien races that entered the Divine Secret Realm almost perished, surely they won’t easily give up.
To prevent these alien races from backstabbing...
They must plan in advance!
Soon, a meticulous plan took shape in Long Zhenguo’s mind.
He dared not delay, urgently contacted Verocan and the Church Court Empress...
Inside the temporary meeting room, the atmosphere was heavy.
The three sat across from each other, expressions solemn.
Long Zhenguo was the first to break the silence:
"Regarding the matter of the Divine Secret Realm, I deeply regret the Blood Race’s ordeal."
He slightly bowed to the Blood-colored Church Empress to show his apology.
In the Blood-colored Church, though civilians are considered food sources by the Blood Race, more often they are raised, causing little harm.
Even so, these Blood Race indeed guard the entire church’s safety.
Overall, this blood-feeding species is considered friendly towards humanity.
Because of this, Long Zhenguo gave the Empress plenty of face at this moment.
Upon hearing Long Zhenguo say only the Church Saintess survived out of the entire team that entered the Divine Secret Realm...
The Empress’s pupils shrank, lips trembled, leaving her momentarily speechless.
She knew very well who from the Blood-colored Church went into the Divine Secret Realm this time!
This time almost all the young generation of demigod level Blood Race was mobilized.
Beyond that...
Blood Ancestor Lilith herself participated!
How could they fail?
How could Blood Ancestor’s clone fall in mere Divine Secret Realm?
As a former Totem level powerhouse, Lilith’s blood clone may only hold an Extraordinary Tier Ninth status, but her true combat power reaches at least commander middle tier, even high tier.
How could such an entity fall in a Divine Secret Realm, restricted to Extraordinary level at most?
Seeing the Empress’s disbelief, Long Zhenguo signaled Lei Zhan to bring in the surviving Church Saintess.
When Cecilia walked in, she was still in a dazed state.
To this day, she couldn’t accept the fact——
The invincible Blood Ancestor...
Actually lost!Follow current novᴇls on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
The Empress gazed at Cecilia’s soulless appearance, her last hope shattered.
Blood Ancestor really lost!
She suppressed her surge of emotions and tried to calm her own feelings.
The fallen Blood Race?
She did not care!
Blood Ancestor also did not care!
Blood Ancestor Lilith alone executed more of her kind than this number.
Most crucial now...
Blood Ancestor’s clone fell, then the next instructions from the Church...
At this time, she also did not know how to proceed.
However, before Lilith entered the Divine Secret Realm, she was instructed to cooperate fully with Longxia Country and the council.
Therefore, she could only continue with this instruction now!
But before that, she must understand Long Zhenguo’s intentions!
"Long Zhenguo, you summoned us, it’s not just to inform us of the Blood Race’s deaths, right?"
Facing the Empress’s burning gaze, Long Zhenguo slowly nodded.
"This time I’ve called the two of you to discuss another important matter."
He took a deep breath, each word firm:
"I decided, to abandon the Northern Territory!"
"What?!"
Kaven slammed the table, making the solid wood meeting table buzz.
"Abandon the Northern Territory? Have you gone mad! What about the Star Stone Mines? What about those two Divine Secret Realms?!"
Losing Star Stones means extraordinary level beast masters will lose their foundation for advancement.
This is self-sabotage!
The Empress also cast a questioning look.
Long Zhenguo’s expression unchanged, he asked sternly:
"Without alien race support, do you think... we can block the Demon Race?"
This sentence was like a bucket of cold water, instantly silencing the two.
The heavy reality lay before them...
This time the Demon Race was serious.
Even with alien race assistance, they barely resisted the Demon Race’s offensive.
And this, under the premise of the Demon Race not giving their all.
If the alien races withdraw, for the Human Race to resist the Demon Race....
As impossible as reaching the heavens!
"Alien races leaving is a foregone conclusion."
"The Star Stone reserves we’ve accumulated over the years are enough to sustain for a while."
"As for the Divine Secret Realms..."
Long Zhenguo’s voice is extremely serious:
"One day, we will reclaim them ourselves!"
Kaven and the Empress fell into a long silence.
Finally, the two exchanged a look and had to accept this bitter decision.
"Alright!"
At least leaving now...
Can prevent the alien races from putting a knife in their back!
...
