chapters.title: Chapter 136: Void Gate Lockdown!
chapters.content:
Chapter 136: Chapter 136: Void Gate Lockdown!
The battlefield took a sharp turn for the worse.
The sudden withdrawal of the Human Race’s troops caught the Alien Race off guard.
Moreover, with the Demon Race’s assault suddenly intensified, the entire defense line collapsed in an instant.
The Northern Territory thus completely fell into the hands of the Demon Race.
Those Alien Races who attempted to reap benefits from the Human Race barely managed to withdraw from the Northern Territory after paying a heavy price.
However, all this no longer concerned the Human Race.
As the forces of Longxia Country, the Council, and the Blood-colored Church pulled back their lines, the Demon Race army fully occupied the Northern Territory, and the pressure on each faction suddenly lessened.
The situation temporarily stabilized!
Meanwhile, Gu Xing, far away on Blue Star, was completely unaware of the drastic changes in the Alternate Space.
With Shen Ruoxue’s leadership, the three of them smoothly returned to the National Academy.
"Swish!"
A spatial rift appeared out of thin air, and the trio’s figures suddenly emerged in the campus center.
This scene immediately drew exclamations from the surrounding students:
"Look! It’s God Gu! And Senior Sister Shen and Senior Sister Ying Bing!"
"Oh my God! I’ve finally seen the legendary God Gu in person!"
The legendary tale of Gu Xing "facing a thousand opponents alone" was still circulating on campus, coupled with Long Zhenguo personally announcing his passing through the Ascension Realm. Now, no one at the National Academy was unaware of Gu Xing’s fame.
However, Gu Xing was quite uncomfortable with this kind of stardom.
He did not linger and went directly to the entrance of the Beast Taming Holy Pool that Long Zhenguo had promised.
Taking out the specially made token, a spatial passageway immediately opened.
But just at that moment...
Sally suddenly requested to leave the Beast Taming Space.
After Gu Xing released her, she solemnly bowed and earnestly said:
"Lord Gu Xing, during the time you break through to Commander Level, may I wander around this world?"
Seeing the seriousness on Sally’s face, Gu Xing was slightly stunned.
Although he didn’t understand why she suddenly made such a request, still...
From what Gu Xing knew about her, this obedient little girl was not the type to cause trouble.
Moreover, considering Sally’s level was merely at the Extraordinary Level, even if she wanted to cause trouble...
After thinking for a moment, Gu Xing nodded:
"Go ahead."
Sally’s eyes lit up upon receiving permission, and she bowed deeply once more:
"Thank you, Lord Gu Xing! I will surely wait here for your return when you leave!"
After watching Sally depart, Gu Xing turned and stepped into the spatial passageway.
After a familiar wave of dizziness, he returned to the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
Unlike the last time, the Holy Pool was deserted at this moment—
All Monarch Level Beast Masters had gone to the Alternate Space battlefield to repel the Demon Race invasion.
Gu Xing wasted no time, raising his hand to summon his Guardian Beasts.
Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, and Fei Yue appeared one after another, surrounding him.
Next was to utilize the power of the Holy Pool to elevate both himself and the levels of his four Guardian Beasts to the Commander Level!
Just as Gu Xing was about to break through to Commander Level, the Divine Pattern within his Beast Taming Space suddenly trembled violently!
"Buzz!"
The Divine Pattern rushed out of the Beast Taming Space, ravenously devouring the Holy Pool’s energy.
"Not good!"
Witnessing this scene, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
If the Divine Pattern devoured all of the Holy Pool’s energy...
He immediately sat cross-legged, and his four Guardian Beasts simultaneously closed their eyes, meditating and focusing, absorbing the energy with all their might.
In an instant, six energy whirlpools formed within the Holy Pool—Googlᴇ search
The largest whirlpool came from the Divine Pattern, consuming almost half of the Holy Pool;
next were the three whirlpools formed by Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Gu Xing;
Vera’s whirlpool was slightly smaller;
and Fei Yue’s whirlpool was the smallest.
At this moment, Gu Xing clearly felt:
The energy absorbed from the Holy Pool this time was different from before!
The Holy Pool’s energy was no longer intercepted by the Spring of Life and the Tree of Life, but truly flowed into his entire body.
Upon sensing this energy, the Sovereign and Soul-devouring talents in his mind began autonomously devouring energy.
However, after the last encounter in the Divine Secret Realm, the two talents were no longer at odds like before!
These two talents surprisingly presented an unprecedented state of harmony.
Gradually, two peculiar light spots appeared within the Beast Taming Space:
One was blood-red like crimson, and the other was silver-white like the moon.
"What is this...?"
There had never been a precedent in history of a Dual Talents Beast Master breaking through to Commander Level.
No one knew whether the breakthrough would lead to a fusion of talents, or...
Form a Double Domain!
Feeling the distinctly separated energies within his body, Gu Xing vaguely had a premonition.
Aside from Gu Xing, the four Guardian Beasts were also rapidly enhancing their attributes through energy absorption!
...
Meanwhile.
At the Demon Race’s frontline command center.
If any Human Race were here, they would surely be scared to death by the sight before them.
Dozens of peak Monarch Level Demon powerhouses stood solemnly among them. More terrifyingly, in front of them stood more than a dozen half-step Totem Level Demon powerhouses.
Leading the half-step Totem Level Demon calmly spoke, his voice echoing like an abyss:
"Everything is proceeding according to plan."
"The Alien Races have all withdrawn from the Northern Territory, and the Human Race has shrunk back into their territory."
"Both Divine Secret Realms have also fallen into our hands."
"All this was within Lord Demon God’s prediction!"
Before the words settled, all the Demons knelt in unison on the ground, their fervent shouts shaking the heavens:
"Long live Lord Demon God!"
"Long live Lord Demon God!"
The leading Demon raised his hand in a gesture, and the clamor instantly fell silent.
"Lord Demon God does not need these empty praises; what he wants is..."
"The Human Race’s Divine Pattern!"
The atmosphere in his voice turned cold!
"It has been confirmed, the Divine Pattern is in the hands of Longxia Country."
"Therefore, our primary objective—seize the Divine Pattern!"
"Immediately execute the Demon King’s order: seal all Void Gates within Longxia Country’s borders!"
The Demons responded in unison, acting in perfect harmony.
The leading Demon produced an ink-black Demon Lock, and the space around tensed up at once.
This was a treasure personally bestowed by the Demon God!
Its sole function was to temporarily sever the connection between the Human Race’s Blue Star and the Alternate Space!
"Begin!"
With a single command, all the Demons simultaneously infused Demonic Qi into the Demon Lock.
In an instant, a dark pillar of light shot skyward, endless darkness engulfing the entire sky of Longxia Country like a tide.
Simultaneously, the five Void Gates within Longxia Country started trembling violently, the passages closing at a speed visible to the naked eye...
"Not good!"
The stationed Beast Masters’ faces changed drastically, immediately reporting the anomaly as an emergency.
When Long Zhenguo received the news, his face turned instantly pale.
Void Gates sealed...
This meant——
The connection between Blue Star and the Alternate Space had been completely severed!
Meanwhile, the Demon Race army had the northern defense line completely surrounded, yet delayed their attack...
"So that’s it!"
Long Zhenguo suddenly clenched his fist, his knuckles turning white from excessive force.
"Their true target is... to invade Blue Star!"
This terrifying thought caused Long Zhenguo’s heart to plummet.
With Longxia Country’s current defenses on Blue Star...
Dangerous!
Blue Star is at risk!
And even though he realized the Demon Race’s plan, he was powerless to stop it!
It was his grievous decision that led to this situation, and now...
He is powerless!
"""

chapters.title: Chapter 137: Commander Level! A New Domain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 137: Chapter 137: Commander Level! A New Domain!
Blue Star.
National Academy.
Ying Tian stood with his hands behind his back, his aged body standing tall and straight.
After Long Zhenguo led all Monarch-level powerhouses away, he was appointed in a crisis as the Chief Commander of Blue Star Longxia Country!
As the last trump card Long Zhenguo left on Blue Star, he was now staring intently at the urgent battle report in his hands.
"Clan Leader, the fluctuations of Demonic Qi at the Void Gate have been confirmed to be the work of the Demon Race."
Ying Xinghe reported in a deep voice:
"Now all passages are blocked. I suspect..."
"The Demon Race is planning to attack Blue Star."
Ying Tian picked up the conversation, a sharp light flashing in his eyes.
This speculation was not groundless.
The Demon Race had caused such a commotion; there must be a major plot.
But on second thought, limited by the spatial barrier between the two realms, the number of Monarch-level Demons that could cross into Blue Star must be limited. The main force should still be low-tier Demons.
"Pass on my orders!"
Ying Tian made a decisive decision and issued the command.
"Mobilize all students at Extraordinary Tier Five or above in the National Academy and assign them to guard the four Void Gates."
"At the same time, order the City Lords of surrounding cities to immediately lead their troops to reinforce!"
There were a total of five Void Gates in Blue Star Longxia Country.
One of them was right in the Imperial Capital!
As for the other four, they were located in the east, south, west, and north of Longxia Country.
The southern Void Gate...
Was close to Lin Yuan City!
"Try to contact the Council again and request support."
Ying Tian added, but his brows furrowed even tighter.
At this moment, only after extending his Spiritual Power did he realize that the entire Longxia Country seemed to be shrouded by some kind of Barrier, making the distress signal most likely...
Very difficult to send out successfully!
Not long after Ying Tian’s orders were issued—
Above the Imperial Capital, a hideous spatial rift slowly tore open, thick Demonic Qi oozed out like ink from the fissure, diffusing in the sky.
"They’re here already!"
Ying Xinghe, carrying out the orders, sharply shrank his pupils and shouted sternly:
"All Commander-level instructors, immediately lead your students to the Void Gate for defense!"
The few dozen remaining Commander-level Beast Masters in the National Academy quickly organized the students and departed in formation at the order.
Ying Xinghe gazed up at the ever-widening spatial fissure, silently praying in his heart:
Pray that the Demons arriving this time... aren’t too strong...
...
Three days passed in a flash.
Within the Beast Taming Holy Pool, Gu Xing’s energy absorption had reached a critical point.
At this moment, in his Beast Taming Space, one red and one silver Domain coexisted in harmony....
Under the reconciliation of Divine Patterns, the two originally repelling forces perfectly merged.
"Boom!"
Gu Xing’s eyes snapped open as a raging aura surged out like a tidal wave.
The brand new power flowing inside him made him involuntarily reach out both hands:The source of thɪs content is N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
His left hand was surrounded by a silvery aura, his right hand wrapped in blood-red energy.
"This is... the power of Domains?"
With a thought, his body slowly floated into the air.
Just like he had anticipated, upon reaching Commander Level, gravity could no longer restrain a Beast Master!
Once at this level, one could use Domain abilities to fly.
He pulled up the Attributes panel, and the new data leapt before his eyes:
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beasts: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit, Ghost Race Qingshuang, Ghost Clan Feiyue]
[Contract Quota: 3/4]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul Devouring]
[Power: 4000→5000]
[Constitution: 4000→5000]
[Spirit: 4000→5000]
[Speed: 4000→5000]
[Special State: Blessing of the Human Race]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might (Evolved from Sovereign), Absolute Forbidden Domain (Evolved from Soul Devouring)]
After leveling up to Commander Level...
All Attributes rose by another thousand points!
From the original 4000 points in each Attribute, they had all increased to 5000 points!
Besides that...
The most important new thing was the Domains.
Just as he’d suspected, he awakened two Domains.
[Emperor’s Might]
[Effect: Beast Master’s All Attributes enhanced by 300%]
[Note: Innately carries Emperor’s Pressure, with a deterrent effect on all life forms (This bonus applies only to the Beast Master themselves)]
This discovery completely overturned Gu Xing’s understanding of Domains.
If Talent was a tool to strengthen his beasts, then Domain was the key for a Beast Master to break their own limits.
An ordinary Commander-level Beast Master’s Domain, at most, only allowed them to use special abilities, with merely a slight boost to Attributes.
But "Emperor’s Might" actually tripled his Basic Attributes, directly rivaling Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
Though he lacked powerful Skills, his combat power now was already comparable to a Myth Level Beast!
Even more importantly...
His even stronger second Domain!
When Gu Xing saw the effect of the second Domain, he couldn’t help but swallow:
[Absolute Forbidden Domain]
[Effect: Using this Domain prohibits any creature from using Domains within a one-kilometer radius]
[Note: Whether Commander or Monarch Level, after activating Absolute Forbidden Domain, none can use Domains]
This Domain, evolved from the Soul Devouring Talent, perfectly inherited its straightforward and overbearing character.
It directly forbids Domain ability usage.
And, most importantly, this effect made no distinction between Monarch and Commander Level!
That means...
Even if a Monarch Level is within this Domain, that Monarch and their Guardian Beast can only compete in Attributes and combat experience!
As for Attributes...
Gu Xing instinctively glanced at his Soul Devouring Talent.
[Soul Devouring: Unconditionally boosts Guardian Beast Attributes by 200%]
[Special Effect: Sacrifice (Can sacrifice a Contracted Beast to double the bonus to 400%)]
With this heaven-defying Talent in hand, Gu Xing was now confident he could face any opponent in a battle of Attributes!
Thinking of this, a sharp light flickered in Gu Xing’s eyes.
If he added the terrifying enhancements of his other Guardian Beasts...
Take Liu Li’s "Doomsday Angels" form for example!
With the powerful 200% boost from Soul Devouring Talent, her Attributes were quickly approaching High Tier Commander Level.
Once she truly broke through to Commander Level, the effect of these boosts would become even more terrifying!
Gu Xing could already visualize the despair on Commander-level Demons’ faces when his Myth-level Guardian Beasts went all out.
"Master..."
A soft voice pulled Gu Xing’s thoughts back to reality.
Fei Yue and Vera had completed their breakthroughs and were standing quietly before him.
Vera radiated a suffocating pressure, especially the vast, ocean-like mental fluctuations that made even Gu Xing’s heart jolt.
Clearly, this Natural Spirit’s Spiritual Attribute had completely surpassed his own!
Gu Xing immediately pulled up Vera’s Attributes panel:
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Power: 1510→4510]
[Constitution: 1520→4520]
[Spirit: 4000→9000]
[Speed: 1500→4500]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Natural Domain]
Seeing Vera’s Attributes panel, Gu Xing’s expression froze instantly—
Except for Spiritual Attribute, the other three were actually lower than his own?!
Something was off!
Very off!
But Vera’s Spiritual Attribute was ridiculously high!
It increased by 5000 points, reaching 9000!
Far exceeding an ordinary Commander Level!
As for Fei Yue...
[Ghost Clan (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Power: 1000→3000]
[Constitution: 1000→3000]
[Spirit: 1000→3000]
[Speed: 1000→3000]
[Skills: Void, Void Domain]
Although all Attributes had increased by 2000, Fei Yue’s actual combat power...
Was honestly hard to compliment.
But when Gu Xing saw her newly awakened "Void Domain," he still nodded contentedly.
After all, Fei Yue was never a combat-type Guardian Beast; awakening a Domain at all was an unexpected surprise.
"Up next..."
Gu Xing turned his gaze to Qingshuang and Liu Li, who were still absorbing energy.
Once they completed their breakthroughs, they could leave the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 138: Blue Star in Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 138: Chapter 138: Blue Star in Crisis
The atmosphere above the Imperial Capital was almost suffocating.
In the rift that stretched across the sky, the Demonic Qi surged ever more fiercely.
It spread like ink, dyeing the entire sky into a foreboding dark color.
The whole Longxia Country was shrouded in this suffocating pressure, like the calm before the storm.
Ying Tian gazed at the ever-expanding rift, the furrow in his brow deepening slightly.
The strength of the existing Beast Masters in Blue Star was too weak, if this time the Demon Race descends...
With this thought, a shadow passed through his eyes.
At that moment, all the teachers and students of the National Academy had been deployed to guard the Four-direction Void Gates, leaving only the most dangerous portal of the Imperial Capital for him to oversee personally.
After careful investigation, it was indeed the rift above the Imperial Capital that emitted the most terrifying Demonic Qi—
Which meant, the strongest Demon Race would appear here!
Even so, Ying Tian still straightened his back.
Protecting this land was his lifelong conviction.
"Boom—!"
Suddenly, the rift in the sky trembled violently, and torrential Demonic Qi flooded downward like a burst dam!
The passage was completely opened!
"All units on high alert!"
Ying Tian’s commanding shout resounded throughout the Imperial Capital.
The Beast Masters who had long been ready instantly tensed up, countless heavy glances were locked firmly on the sky.
Under the tense gaze of the crowd, a sinister figure broke through the Void—
A tall Demon Race stood in the air, with twisted demon horns on its head and surrounded by pitch-black Demon Patterns.
Upon clearly seeing the figure, Ying Tian’s pupils contracted suddenly:
"Monarch... Peak!"
But at that moment, Ying Tian’s greatest concern was not the battle situation in the Imperial Capital.
His gaze seemed to penetrate the Void, looking toward the directions of the other four Gates of Space—
There were only a few Fake King Level Beast Masters stationed there.
If a Monarch Level Demon Race appeared...
With this thought, Ying Tian’s tightly clenched hand bulged with green veins.
If a Monarch Level Demon Race appeared, all those who went there to obstruct...
Would all die!
And not only that, with the brutality of the Demon Race...
The surrounding cities would also not be spared!
"Rumble—"
With the violent trembling of the space rift, behind that Monarch Peak Demon Race, countless shadows began to emerge:
Commander Level, Extraordinary Level Demons surged like a black tide.
On the other side.
Ying Xinghe’s Adam’s apple moved, sweat dotted his forehead.
He knew, the Clan Leader must dedicate all his efforts to counter that Demon King, which meant...
The massive amount of Demon Race left would have to be held off by those at Commander Level like them.
"Damn! We’re really gonna end up here this time... There are dozens just at Commander Level!"
"Not just at Commander Level, the number of Extraordinary Level Demon Races is equally terrifying!"
"If this space channel cannot be closed... it means a continuous stream of Demon Race will pour forth!"
"No matter, we’ll fight until the last moment, these Demon Races can only tread over our corpses."
The Commander Level Beast Masters next to Ying Xinghe looked at the Demon army swarming the sky, the last glimmer of hope in their eyes extinguished.
Originally, against ten or more Commander Level Demon Races, they could still desperately fight.
But at this moment—
Gazing far and wide, in the densely packed Demon Race formation, the aura of Commander Level rose and fell, at least triple the number on their side!
With such a disparity of power, any strategy became a joke.
Chances of victory?
Simply nonexistent.
But Ying Xinghe didn’t speak, merely silently summoned his Guardian Beast.
Behind was their homeland, everything they swore to protect at all costs.
This battle could be lost, could lead to death, but...
Retreat was not an option!
At this moment, the leading Demon King Level Demon Race took a deep breath, a look of delight on its face:
"Is this the ancestral land of the Human Race? Even the air is so... sweet."
Its crimson tongue licked over the fangs:
"As long as this land is demonized and the Divine Pattern is converted to Demon Pattern, our task will be complete."
The dozens of Commander Level Demon Races behind it immediately chimed in with flattery:
"With the Demon King himself taking action, isn’t this as easy as pie?"
"That old thing is their strongest force, right? Truly pitiful."
"No wonder Lord Demon God has been laying out plans for so long, just so we could enter this region."
"If not for the fact that exterminating all Humans would prevent further generation of two Divine Patterns..."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"We would have wiped out this bunch of Humans long ago."
The Demon Races laughed heartily without regard, not even taking the well-prepared Human Beast Masters seriously.
With such a stark difference in power, how could they possibly lose?!
"No more meaningless talk!"
The leading Demon King Level Demon Race thundered, "If willing to submit to the Demon Race, I may spare your lives!"
Ying Tian’s white hair fluttered as he rose into the air, confronting the Demon King:
"The Human Race would rather stand and die than kneel and live!"
"Heh!"
This Demon Race, upon hearing this statement, burst into laughter instantly.
In the past thousands of years, the Demon Race had slaughtered countless races.
Some refused to surrender, but in the end...
They all were utterly eradicated!
And now encountering another race unafraid of death!
Its crimson eyes flashed with cruelty, a demonic claw suddenly swung down:
"Since you won’t surrender, then..."
"Massacre here first!"
Exterminating a city would barely affect the Divine Pattern!
This thunderous voice exploded above the Imperial Capital.
In just three days, millions of civilians hardly had time to evacuate.
Countless people on the streets looked up at the Demon army obscuring the sky, eyes full of despair—
Many had never set foot in Alternate Space in their lives, yet they clearly understood that these dreadful monsters were the Human Race’s deadliest enemies.
"Finished... all finished..."
"Mom, are we all going to die?"
"Why... why is it happening to us..."
"Oh divine beings, please save us..."
Desperate cries echoed throughout the city.
Upon hearing the words "massacre the city", Ying Tian’s eyes turned blood-red instantly.
Without hesitation, he began to burn the remaining life force within himself, pouring it all into his Contracted Beast.
He understood his function was to kill this Monarch Peak Demon Race.
Otherwise...
There would be no hope of turning the tides.
Now he could only wish...
Gu Xing... must not leave the Holy Pool at this juncture!
If Gu Xing, carrying the Divine Pattern, were to appear and fall into Demon Race hands...
The Human Race would truly have no chance of recovery!
Meanwhile, within Longxia Country, other fissures around four Void Gates gradually opened with sinister cracks.
"Boom—"
Pitch-black Demonic Qi spewed forth, figures of the Demon Race broke through the Void and descended.
But somewhat reassuring was—
Those stepping forth from these rifts were, at most, Commander Level Demon Races, no terrifying presence of Monarch Level appeared.
Deep within the Beast Taming Holy Pool, Gu Xing remained oblivious to the dramatic changes occurring in Blue Star.
His entire focus was devoted to the final two Guardian Beasts—
Liu Li was radiant with a brilliant golden Light Cocoon, while Qing Shuang was completely encased in Netherworld Ghost Qi.
Two distinctly yet equally powerful Energy Fluctuations continued to rise intensely!
"Finally... it’s about to be completed!"
Gu Xing unconsciously tightened his fist.
He could feel that their breakthrough was at the final moment!
About to break through to Commander Level!!
...

chapters.title: Chapter 139: Commander Level Qing Shuang!
chapters.content:
Chapter 139: Chapter 139: Commander Level Qing Shuang!
Inside the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
The divine pattern still hovered at the center, while Liu Li and Qing Shuang were nearing the end of their absorption of the pool’s energy.
Gu Xing could clearly feel—
Within the bodies of the two Guardian Beasts, a terrifying aura was brewing.
"Ooh..."
Vera bit her lip, a hint of emotion flickering in her emerald eyes.
Since the Divine Secret Realm started, the gap between her and the two Guardian Beasts had widened.
Especially after merging with the divine pattern, she felt even more...
In comparison to Liu Li and Qing Shuang, she was lacking!
Now, she had finally reached the Commander Level, and her Spiritual Power surged once again.
However...
Judging by the aura emanating from these two Guardian Beasts now...
Liu Li and Qing Shuang’s Spiritual Attributes alone were soon to match hers!
As for the other attributes...
She couldn’t catch up with the two even on horseback!
"Boom—!"
A violent momentum swept out again, and in an instant, the chilling Netherworld Ghost Qi surged like a tide, enveloping the entire Beast Taming Holy Pool.
However, as this cold aura neared Liu Li and the divine pattern, it was silently blocked by the energy emitted by the two, unable to advance.
Amidst the turbulence of Ghost Qi, Qing Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
Her gaze fell directly on Gu Xing, the depths of her calm pupils brimming with profound gratitude.
Finally... the breakthrough.
She had finally broken free from the shackles of her bloodline, successfully stepping into the Commander Level!
Once, when she and her sister wandered, they fantasized about the best outcome—
Merely finding a Beast Master of the Human Race to contract with, using human’s special Talent to barely break through the Extraordinary, stepping into the Commander Realm.
And now...
With Gu Xing’s help, they not only compensated for their congenital deficiencies but also smoothly advanced to Commander Level.
Moreover, she confirmed one thing—
Gu Xing was the savior who rescued her and Fei Yue when they were children.
Now, she and Fei Yue had miraculously become the Guardian Beasts of this life-saving benefactor.
It all seemed like the will of heaven!
But this was also the best result!
Gradually calming her emotions, Qing Shuang slowly raised her arm.
"Hoo—"
In an instant, the Netherworld Ghost Qi, which filled the Holy Pool, converged back into her body like rivers returning to the sea.
Once the last wisp of Ghost Qi dissipated, she lightly leapt out of the nearly exhausted energy of the Beast Taming Holy Pool, stood before Gu Xing, knelt on one knee, and respectfully spoke:
"Master, I am fortunate not to have failed, Qing Shuang has reached Commander Level!"Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
Gu Xing quickly reached out, helping Qing Shuang up from the ground.
"Qing Shuang, we are companions, not master and servant!"
His voice was gentle yet firm, Qing Shuang was slightly surprised, subconsciously looked up, meeting Gu Xing’s earnest eyes—
Not a trace of deceit...
All sincerity!
After a brief silence, she slowly lowered her head, with a hint of a smile quietly emerging in her eyes.
"Qing Shuang understands, Master! I won’t do it again in the future."
Sensing the relaxation in her tone, Gu Xing knew that this stubborn Ghost Race girl had finally listened to his words.
This also meant that Qing Shuang had truly integrated into his team.
Though he caught a hint of a special emotion from Qing Shuang’s eyes...
He didn’t mind, dismissing it as his imagination.
Then he took a deep breath, calmed his mood, and began to check Qing Shuang’s Attributes.
As one of his currently strongest two Guardian Beasts, Qing Shuang’s growth directly affected the entire team’s combat strength.
Now, what level would Qing Shuang reach...
An overdue tension welled up in his heart.
The next second—
Qing Shuang’s Attributes panel unfolded slowly before his eyes.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 4000→9000]
[Constitution: 4000→8000]
[Spirit: 4000→7000]
[Speed: 4000→8000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body (All Attributes enhanced by 1.5X!), Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
[Ghost King’s Body: All Attributes enhanced by 1.5X!]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (Strength Attribute enhanced by 1.5X), Sea Breaker (Strength Attribute enhanced by 2X), Heaven-Breaking (Strength Attribute enhanced by 3X), Star Shattering (Level insufficient)]
[Returning Ruins: Forms Ghost King Illusion! And as the battle goes on, the Guardian Beast’s combat power gradually enhances!]
[Special State: Twin Resonance (Contracted Twins share Talents while both in Domain!)]
When Qing Shuang’s Attributes panel was fully revealed, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply, his breath halting.
This...
He swallowed subconsciously, and only one word remained in his mind—
Heaven-defying!
Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute increased by 5000 points, reaching 9000 points.
The other three Attributes also gained over 3000 points!
One must know, when they encountered that Winged Demon of Commander Tier Three in the Demon Realm...
His Attributes were only around 6000 points or so.
And now...
Qing Shuang’s Level is only Commander Tier One, yet her Attributes have far surpassed that Commander Tier Three Winged Demon.
And besides the Attributes...
Qing Shuang also unlocked the third technique of Ghost Race Four Techniques!
Heaven-Breaking!
The threefold increase in Strength Attribute...
This meant at full power, without Domain Suppression...
She could crush all Commander Level opponents with her Ultimate Fire Attribute.
What surprised Gu Xing the most was that after reaching Commander Level.
Qing Shuang gained a Special State!
Twin Resonance.
As long as Fei Yue is also within the Domain.
Then they can share Talents, meaning Qing Shuang could also use Fei Yue’s Void Talent.
Insane!
Too insane!
Qing Shuang’s extreme burst, combined with Fei Yue’s powerful Space Manipulation Ability...
Insoluble!
This word suddenly popped into his mind.
Even Liu Li, who completed his enhancement, would find it incredibly difficult to defeat Qing Shuang and Fei Yue...
After checking all of Qing Shuang’s Attributes, Gu Xing’s gaze landed on Liu Li, enveloped entirely by the Ultimate Fire.
Now he was more eager to see what level Liu Li would reach!
"Boom—!"
As if responding to Gu Xing’s anticipation, the energy surrounding Liu Li suddenly erupted!
The Ultimate Fire, like an awakened beast, surged wildly over her body.
Her momentum climbed sharply, breaking through the critical point in an instant—
"Wow!"
Eight pure white wings behind her suddenly revealed mysterious Fire Patterns.
The patterns, like living entities, traversed, each pattern lighting up, igniting the wings a little more fiercely!
"Rumble—"
A torrent of violent flames erupted suddenly!
The entire Holy Pool was instantly engulfed in a sea of red-golden fire, and the pool water vaporized crazily under the extreme heat, with dense Spiritual Qi turning into white mist and soaring skyward.
"Buzz—"
The hovering divine pattern in the air suddenly trembled, like a beast smelling its prey, it began to frantically devour the dissipating Spiritual Qi!
As each pattern lit up, the wings themselves shone brightly.
As the divine pattern devoured nearly all the energy of the pool, the pupils in Gu Xing’s eyes contracted slightly.
This...
He focused his gaze more intently on Liu Li, who was completely wrapped in the near-infinite energy fire within the Ultimate Fire.
The energy soared higher and higher, and suddenly broke through a critical point—
"Boom—!"
His heart racing with a familiar tension as he anticipated what level Liu Li could achieve now!

chapters.title: Chapter 140: Divine Pattern Awakening!
chapters.content:
Chapter 140: Chapter 140: Divine Pattern Awakening!
"Boom——!"
The Ultimate Fire erupted once more!
Qing Shuang lightly twisted her wrist, forming a barrier from the dense Netherworld Ghost Qi to block the advancing Ultimate Fire.
But her eyes gradually grew serious——
This intimidating pressure...
The angelic girl before her was actually exuding an aura faintly surpassing her own!
"Buzz——"
As the last Fire Pattern fully illuminated, the blazing flames suddenly recoiled, drawn into Liu Li’s body like rivers returning to the sea.
When the flames dissipated, that familiar silhouette finally appeared in front of Gu Xing.
"M-Master..."
Liu Li nervously twisted her fingers, her eight wings engraved with Fire Patterns trembling slightly.
She instinctively wanted to rush into her master’s arms but stopped, blushing when she sensed the gazes around her.
So many people are watching...
Gu Xing looked at the newly transformed girl before him, momentarily dazed.
The golden-red glowing patterns on her wings added an aura of divinity and nobility to her.
Even her originally bright golden pupils flickered with a faint flame——
This signified Liu Li’s enhanced control over the Ultimate Fire!
"Ugh..."
Seeing that her master was speechless, Liu Li timidly gathered her wings, the Fire Patterns flickering with her movements:
"I can’t control these patterns..."
Her voice grew softer, trembling with unease.
Her wings had always been pure white, but now they were adorned with fiery patterns.
Girls are always sensitive about their feelings.
She feared that her master would disdain her due to these changes!
However, Gu Xing’s reaction was contrary to her expectation.
Gu Xing gently shook his head and slowly spoke:
"No need to control them, these Fire Patterns... suit you well!"
"R-really?"
Liu Li’s eyes instantly sparkled, her wings fully unfurled with a "swish".
Gu Xing nodded in agreement, but secretly pulled up her Attributes panel.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Power: 4000→9000]
[Constitution: 4000→9000]
[Spirit: 4000→9000]
[Speed: 4000→9000]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain]
[Special State: Oath Guardian]
[Oath Guardian: Use vows as a shield, the Power of Guardian strengthens with belief! Attributes increase with belief when guarding cherished things!]
[Blazing Burn: When Liu Li unfolds her Blazing Flame Wings, the battlefield transforms into an indestructible Fire Domain, the Ultimate Fire forming Battle Armor!]
When Liu Li’s Attributes panel fully expanded, Gu Xing’s heart skipped a beat.
All Attributes... 9000?!
This terrifying number even surpassed Qing Shuang, causing him to hold his breath.
What was more startling was that if he combined it with his Soul Devouring Talent...
Commander Tier One, yet her combat power neared Tier Nine!
Especially when the Second Domain unfolds, the greatest advantage of Commander Level, "Domain Suppression," will be completely nullified.
Furthermore, it might be due to the fusion of a Divine Pattern.
Liu Li unexpectedly had a Special State as well.
Oath Guardian!
Cherished thing?
Gu Xing subconsciously turned, meeting Liu Li’s eyes burning with golden-red flames.
The girl’s gaze was so intense and steadfast, causing his spiritual sea to tremble...
Wait...
An absurd thought suddenly surfaced:
Could the cherished thing...
possibly be... me?
However, before he could ask, the Divine Pattern hovering above the Holy Pool suddenly burst into a brilliant golden light!
The radiant light pierced through the barrier of the Holy Pool, instantly illuminating the entire sky of Blue Star.
The Divine Pattern quivered like a living creature, suddenly transforming into a stream of light shooting straight into Gu Xing’s forehead——
"Buzz!"
The Divine Pattern imprinted a golden mark on his forehead.
Gu Xing mobilized his Spiritual Power to try and make it disappear, but found it had no effect at all!
This was troublesome...
Gu Xing helplessly touched the mark on his forehead.
This conspicuous mark would undoubtedly make him a prime target for the Demon Race, but...
This was not entirely a bad thing!
This thing would also attract the Demon Race’s attempts to attack him.
Just as well, now that he had ascended to Commander Level, he wanted to level up by slaying Demons...
The Extraordinary Level Demons could hardly provide him with any Energy!
As for the Commander Level Demons, they contained significant Energy, but were rarely encountered.
Therefore, many Beast Masters would be stuck at Commander Tier One for a long time.
Of course, there is a special method to level up, which is to absorb Energy from the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
However, now...
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the empty Beast Taming Holy Pool.
This was not the result of him and his Guardian Beasts.
On the contrary, it was the result of the Divine Pattern on his forehead absorbing Energy.
But it was precisely by absorbing the Energy from the Holy Pool that Gu Xing clearly felt this Divine Pattern truly came alive.
However, the function of this Divine Pattern...
Gu Xing attempted to touch the Divine Pattern on his forehead with his Spiritual Power.
"Buzz——!"
In that instant, his consciousness seemed to resonate with the entire Blue Star!
He could clearly perceive the mountains, rivers, cities, and wilderness within Longxia Country, even the slightest breeze.
Is this the power of the Divine Pattern?
Suddenly, an astonishing thought flashed through his mind.
Three Divine Patterns corresponding to three major forces, and each Divine Pattern required the absorption of Holy Pool Energy to awaken...
Doesn’t this perfectly match with the three existing Holy Pools on Blue Star?
It felt like Gu Xing had captured a glimpse of the truth!
However, in the next second, he frowned.
Five twisted spatial nodes suddenly appeared in his sea of consciousness, each exuding a nauseating dark aura.
What’s going on?
Gu Xing carefully perceived them and discovered that these five locations coincided with the five Void Gates within Longxia Country’s borders.
Could it be... something has happened?
Realizing this, Gu Xing couldn’t sit still any longer!
Without much hesitation, he decided to return to Blue Star immediately!
When Gu Xing crossed the space channel and returned to Blue Star, Sally had long been waiting.
Before she could speak, Gu Xing felt a strong sense of discomfort stemming from the Divine Pattern on his forehead.
This is...
His brow furrowed, discovering that the Divine Pattern was emitting unusual fluctuations.
At that moment, Sally’s urgent voice came through:
"Lord Gu Xing! While you were in the Holy Pool, the Demon Race breached the Alternate Space channel!"
She reported the urgent situation at a rapid pace, each word sinking Gu Xing’s heart further.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Looking up, he finally understood where that discomfort was coming from!
It was precisely from these Demonic invasion channels!
Bad news!
Gu Xing swiftly retracted Sally into the Beast Taming Space.
Through the Divine Pattern’s perception, he could clearly sense Ying Xinghe and others were in a desperate situation on the battlefield high above.
"Go!"
Without any hesitation, he leaped toward the battlefield.
Simultaneously, four dazzling lights flashed beside him——
Liu Li, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, and Vera appeared simultaneously!
From his earlier perception, he detected dozens of Commander Level Demons.
And countless Extraordinary Level Demons!
This information made his heart sink further...
With Blue Star’s current defensive capabilities...
It’s entirely impossible to withstand such a group of Demons!
Moreover, he sensed similarly grim situations on the other four battlefields at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 141: Ying Family Talent—Life Burning!
chapters.content:
Chapter 141: Chapter 141: Ying Family Talent—Life Burning!
Outside the Imperial Capital.
Ying Xinghe stood back-to-back with a few other Human warriors, covered in blood, breath chaotic, yet still resolutely guarding the final defense.
But for now, the Demon Race wasn’t in a hurry to kill them; it was more about playing around.
These demons had been confined in the Demon Realm for so many years, and it had driven them to madness.
Now they’ve finally made it to this Human World.
And they encountered a few foolish Humans who swore never to surrender and fought to the end.
They couldn’t kill these Humans so easily!
The group of demons laughed shrilly like cats playing with mice.
"Why struggle on the verge of death? Do you think the few of you can withstand our dozens of elite demons?"
"Not killing you now is just because we find it interesting!"
"Once our Demon King kills that old man... do you think the lot of you can stand for much longer?!"
Ying Xinghe’s expression remained calm as water, ignoring the demons’ taunts.
But his gaze involuntarily turned to the battle in the sky, a trace of concern flickering in his eyes.
Clan Leader...
At this moment, the outcome of the entire battle depended on Ying Tian and that Monarch Peak demon.
If Ying Tian could defeat the demon Monarch, Humans still had a sliver of hope.
If defeated...
A Monarch Peak demon, plus dozens of Commander Level...
Such a force could crush them into dust in an instant!
Ying Xinghe clenched his fist, the crisis at the scene weighing heavily on him, nearly suffocating him.
At the peak of the clouds, the battle raged fiercely.
Ying Tian was covered in blood, his robe long soaked through.
Yet the Demon King across from him remained composed, surrounded by Demonic Qi, showing little sign of injury.
"Human, to fight me to this extent, you may have your pride."
The Demon King’s crimson eyes were full of contempt, "But the game should end now—"
"Boom!"
Heaven-consuming Demonic Qi suddenly exploded!
The Demon King’s aura surged instantly to a peak, the terrifying pressure causing the surrounding clouds to scatter.
Though this old man was also at Monarch Peak, the same level...
there was a chasm-like difference!
Witnessing this, Ying Tian took a deep breath, his gaze peculiarly calm.
He had just commanded his Guardian Beast to unleash its strongest attack.
Yet it still failed to inflict any harm on this demon.
He was not a match for this demon!
Thus, to kill this demon by conventional means...
With his current strength, it was mere dreaming!
Thinking this, he slowly turned his head to look at the old friend alongside him.
Dragon Flame Battle Tiger!
This Guardian Beast had followed him since his childhood.
And he had cultivated it step by step to its current height using the Ying Family’s bloodline.
But as time passed, the side effects of the Ying Family’s bloodline began to show.
The stronger the Guardian Beast’s power, the faster his life force drained.
And combat would only accelerate this draining of life force.
Finally, under Long Zhenguo’s orders, he left the battlefield.
To guard the Ying Family.
And to guard the whole Blue Star Longxia Country.
"It’s been so long since I’ve fought, I’m really a bit rusty!"
Ying Tian extended his hand, his wrinkled palm gently stroking the Dragon Flame Battle Tiger’s fur.
Feeling the warmth from his palm, he slowly closed his eyes, making a firm decision.
Since conventional means couldn’t kill this demon...
Then use unconventional means!Googlᴇ search novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
The next moment, astonishing changes occurred on his body.
His silver hair visibly turned black, wrinkles receded like the tide, and his hunched figure straightened.
But this was not reverting to youth, it was...
burning the final portion of his life!
"Roar—!"
The Dragon Flame Battle Tiger let out a mournful howl, understanding what this meant.
While Ying Tian had already returned to peak status.
Staring at the demon not far away with a contemptuous face, Ying Tian slowly spoke:
"The Ying Family’s talent has only one..."
Opposite, the demon Monarch raised an eyebrow with interest, crimson eyes flickering with curious light.
He was very curious, in the face of such a vast gap in strength, what trick this Human would use.
"Life Burning!"
Blood-red flames suddenly ignited around Ying Tian, each flame flickering with the rhythm of life.
"This is the talent every member of our Ying Family awakens to..."
"And it is also the foundation of our Ying Family bloodline!"
Blood flames erupted from Ying Tian’s body, instantly enveloping the Dragon Flame Battle Tiger completely.
Under the refinement of this life fire, the battle tiger’s aura rose steadily.
"Roar——!"
Amidst the earth-shaking tiger roar, the Demon King finally changed color!
His scarlet pupils contracted violently, and he stared incredulously at the scene before him——
He had to acknowledge that although he was at the Monarch Peak, his strength...
was already infinitely close to the Half-Step Totem Level!
This was the reason he had completely disregarded Ying Tian earlier.
But now...
A trace of grave severity appeared in the Demon King’s eyes.
Under this human’s talent, he forcibly elevated the power of this Guardian Beast to the same level as him.
At this moment.
Watching the blood-colored flames completely envelop the Dragon Flame Battle Tiger, a relieved smile appeared on Ying Tian’s face.
"In the end, I’m too old..."
He sighed softly, the temperature from his palm making his eyes slightly warm.
"Even if I burn everything, I can only help you this far."
"Old friend, I wanted you to live on..."
"It seems now, we shall sleep eternally here together."
"Snort——"
The Dragon Flame Battle Tiger snorted, as if responding to Ying Tian.
Seeing this, Ying Tian smiled.
"Since we’re both prepared! Then..."
"Take action!"
Ying Tian suddenly shouted fiercely.
"Roar——!"
The domain of the Dragon Flame Battle Tiger expanded instantly, enveloping the Demon King.
Simultaneously, Ying Tian’s domain was also released, and the pressure from the overlapping Double Domain started to distort the space.
Realizing what Ying Tian intended to do, the Demon King finally panicked, his scarlet pupils contracting violently.
"Madman!"
"Is it worth it for those ants? Join us, and you could even break through to the Totem Level!"
Ying Tian merely shook his head gently:
"You don’t understand!"
"They are not ants; they are the hope for the survival of our Human Race!"
After saying this, Ying Tian’s gaze locked onto the Demon King.
He knew better than anyone that even risking his life, he could not defeat this Demon King.
The only way was to use all his and his Guardian Beast’s energy, combined with the Double Domain, to potentially perish together with this Demon Race.
The next moment——
"Boom!!!"
The Double Domain detonated simultaneously, and a terrifying energy storm instantly engulfed everything.
The Demon King, positioned at the center of the explosion, frantically activated his domain to resist...
But this was Ying Tian’s all-out strike at the peak! How could it be so easily blocked?!
After the earth-shattering explosion, the clouds were torn into a massive hole, and the entire space shattered into chaotic turbulence, erasing all traces...
Both the Demon King and Ying Tian’s figures turned to ashes within the terrifying energy!
Below.
The terrifying shockwave swept across, and the entire battlefield instantly fell into dead silence.
Ying Xinghe and the Demon Race were simultaneously frozen in place——
They all clearly perceived that the two Monarch-level auras had completely vanished.
"The Demon King... has fallen?!"
After a brief silence, the Demon Race erupted in thunderous roars:
"Kill those ants! Sacrifice the entire city with blood to honor the Demon King!"
All the Demon Race went completely mad!
Ying Xinghe’s eyes also turned blood-red, his fingernails digging deeply into his palm.
The Clan Leader... had fallen.
Watching the tide-like rush of the Demon Race, he understood that today was destined to be a deadlock.
But——
"Everyone, heed my command!"
He took a step forward, his voice hoarse yet firm:
"Fight to the last moment!"
Ying Xinghe’s voice echoed on the battlefield, and blood-colored flames instantly enveloped his entire body.
Just as he prepared for a desperate fight——
Five figures sliced through the sky like lightning, boldly thrusting into the center of the battlefield!
The youth at the forefront had a divine pattern shining on his forehead, surrounded by four Guardian Beasts exuding a terrifying aura.
"Gu Xing..."
Ying Xinghe’s pupils contracted sharply, the burning blood flames momentarily paused.
At this critical moment, he actually...
returned!!
....
....

chapters.title: Chapter 142: Demon King at the Half-Step Monarch Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 142: Chapter 142: Demon King at the Half-Step Monarch Realm!
At this moment.
Gu Xing’s icy gaze swept across the dense army of the Demon Race ahead, his eyes filled with a chilling intent to kill.
Demon Race...
The mortal enemy of humanity!
This group of beasts... dares to invade Blue Star!
The Demon Race were so shocked by this sudden change that they halted their attack.
The leading few demons vigilantly assessed the suddenly appearing human...
Could it be an expert from the Human Race?
Now that the Demon King at Monarch Peak is dead, and each spatial crack can only pass one King Level.
If this human is King Level, then the Demon King’s plan...
Will be utterly destroyed!!
However.
When they perceived Gu Xing’s true level, they burst into ear-piercing laughter:
"A mere Commander Tier One, and you dare to play the savior? Utterly foolish!"
"The Human Race are indeed overestimating fools!"
"That’s why such beings like the Human Race should be eliminated! Knowing they face death by blocking us, yet still standing in our way!"
"Wait! This human’s forehead...."
"It’s the Divine Pattern! The Divine Pattern that Lord Demon God seeks is on him!"
"Kill him! Complete Lord Demon God’s mission!"
The Demon Race, upon seeing the Divine Pattern on Gu Xing’s forehead, instantly went into a frenzy, eyes filled with greed.
And Ying Xinghe, upon hearing the words Divine Pattern, also snapped back to reality at this moment.
His gaze fell on Gu Xing’s forehead.
Seeing the conspicuous golden pattern there, his pupils contracted.
Not good!
He unhesitatingly stepped forward, shielding Gu Xing:
"Gu Xing, you shouldn’t appear here!"
His voice carried unprecedented urgency:
"As long as you and the Divine Pattern don’t fall into the Demon Race’s hands, humanity still has hope!"
Ying Xinghe knew better than anyone Gu Xing’s talent.
This young man is the most outstanding genius in the history of Longxia Country, bar none!
Even at the Extraordinary Level, he could kill Commander Level enemies across levels!
And he also awakened two great talents!
But even so...
Gu Xing must not fall into the hands of these demons!
"Gu Xing, leave here immediately!"
Ying Xinghe’s gaze was firmly locked on the demons ahead, continually urging Gu Xing to leave.
But Gu Xing didn’t move, just spoke lightly:
"Teacher Ying, what if I say I can deal with these demons?"
Hearing this, Ying Xinghe was momentarily stunned.
Deal with these demons?!
How could it be possible?!
Gu Xing had just stepped into the Commander Level, how could he be a match for this group of high-tier Commander Level demons?
What’s more terrifying is...
Among the Demon Race was a Winged Demon who had yet to act!
His aura made even Ying Xinghe shudder.
Although he hadn’t reached King Level, he had already reached the limit of the Commander Level.
Half-Step Monarch Level!
In theory, a Half-step Monarch Level demon could only be dealt with by those Beast Masters who rely on the Holy Pool to break through to King Level.
But to guard other spatial cracks, all Fake King Levels have been redeployed away from the Imperial Capital.
"Gu Xing, Commander Level demons are not that simple! The higher their level, the stronger the Domains they control!"
"A low-tier Commander Level Beast Master doesn’t even have the qualification to deploy a Domain in front of them!"
At Commander Level, battles between Beast Masters were already centered on Domains.
The stronger the mastery of the Domain, the stronger the power that could be exerted.
Ying Xinghe understood Gu Xing.
At Extraordinary Tier One, he already possessed combat power of Extraordinary Tier Ninth.
Now breaking through to Commander Tier One, he similarly believed he could be on par with Commander Tier Nine.
But obviously...
Extraordinary and Commander Levels are completely different concepts!
The remaining Commander Level Beast Masters also stepped forward to shield Gu Xing, advising:
"Old Ying is right, Gu Xing, you should leave here quickly, this battlefield has nothing to do with you!"
They weren’t afraid of death.
But feared that humanity would lose their future.
Now, the Second and Third Divine Secret Realms had fallen into the hands of the Demon Race.
They understood...
That trying to snatch it back from this group of demons was as difficult as climbing to the sky.
Therefore, the Divine Pattern in Gu Xing’s possession was the only Divine Pattern humanity had obtained.
As long as this Divine Pattern could remain in human hands...
Humanity would still have a chance!
However.
Gu Xing stepped out of the protective circle around him.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ
He understood Ying Xinghe and the others’ heartfelt intentions, but his combat power...
Couldn’t be viewed as that of an ordinary Commander Tier One!
Moreover...
His gaze fell on his four Guardian Beasts.
Each Guardian Beast required absorbing a certain amount of energy to level up.
And to upgrade all four Guardian Beasts to Commander Tier Nine required vast amounts of energy.
With so many Commander Level demons before him...
How could he miss this opportunity?!
But Ying Xinghe and the others’ concerns were not without merit, to deal with this group of demons...
Their Domains must first be crippled!
Otherwise...
No matter how strong his Guardian Beasts were, under the suppression of the Domains, dealing with so many Commander Level demons would be an impossible task!
With this in mind, a cold light flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes, and he activated his ability without hesitation.
"Absolute Forbidden Domain!"
In an instant, a blood-colored barrier unfolded, swiftly sweeping across the entire battlefield like a tide.
Ying Xinghe and others hadn’t even had time to react when they felt the Domain Power within them suddenly solidify—
What’s happening?!
The crowd, losing Domain support, plummeted from the sky, but fortunately, their formidable Commander Level physiques allowed them to land safely.
Yet at this moment, every face was filled with shock.
"My Domain... has been sealed?!"
"Even the Guardian Beasts’ Domains cannot be used!"
Witnessing this scene, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
Though this Forbidden Domain was powerful, it suppressed indiscriminately.
Even he could only barely maintain the operation of his primary Domain internally, unable to externalize it.
Meanwhile, the Demon Race camp was equally chaotic.
Except for a few winged demons, the rest fell like dumplings.
Even the always-calm Half-step Monarch Level Winged Demon changed its expression—
This human... is a problem!
To actually forbid everyone from using their Domains, could it be the effect of the Divine Pattern?
The Half-step Monarch Level Winged Demon could only attribute this bizarre scenario to the Divine Pattern!
He had no idea that this abnormal ability was actually this human’s Domain!
And Gu Xing’s gaze was locked tightly on this Winged Demon.
From this demon, he felt an intense threat!
[Winged Demon King]
[Talent: Demon King (equivalent to Legend)]
[Level: Half-Step Monarch]
[Power: 55000]
[Constitution: 53000]
[Spirit: 41000]
[Speed: 57000]
[Skills: Demon King Domain, Demon King’s Body...]
Seeing the attributes of this Demon King, Gu Xing’s expression grew solemn.
This Winged Demon King’s attributes were terrifying.
Average attributes of 50,000 points!
This was almost five times those of the Glazed Attribute!
Yet facing such a powerful enemy, he could not retreat...
If he couldn’t eliminate this strongest Winged Demon King, all efforts would be in vain!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 143: The Chance to Slay the Winged Demon King!
chapters.content:
Chapter 143: Chapter 143: The Chance to Slay the Winged Demon King!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing’s heart tightened.
This battle requires full effort!
"Soul-devouring·Start!"
Blood-colored spiritual power suddenly exploded, enveloping Qing Shuang, Liu Li, and Vera completely.
The breath of the three instantly rose to their peak status!
"Vera, the commander-level demon race on the ground is your responsibility!"
Vera nodded and dove down like an arrow.
On the ground are commander-level demon races lacking aerial abilities.
In the face of Vera’s rapidly increasing attributes—
They should pose no threat!
As for this half-step monarch-level Winged Demon King in front of them...
Qing Shuang and Liu Li must go all out to have a chance of victory!
"Qing Shuang, Liu Li!"
Before Gu Xing’s words fell, two figures had already activated their ultimate forms—
"Ghost King’s Body·Initiation!"
"Doomsday Angel Form·Start!"
The two low shouts simultaneously erupted, a terrifying pressure exploded in the center of the battlefield.
This is their first battle after reaching commander level!
Qing Shuang was instantly entangled by Netherworld Ghost Qi, and ghost patterns covered her body like a living entity.
On the other side, Liu Li’s twelve wings fully extended, and Ultimate Fire enveloped her body.
With the boost of Gu Xing’s "Soul-devouring" talent, the attributes of both began to skyrocket!
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 9000→27000]
[Constitution: 8000→24000]
[Spirit: 7000→21000]
[Speed: 8000→24000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
[Special State: Twin Resonance!]
...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Power: 9000→54000]
[Constitution: 9000→54000]
[Spirit: 9000→54000]
[Speed: 9000→54000]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain]
[Special State: Oath Guardian]
But when Gu Xing saw Liu Li’s attribute panel, he couldn’t help but gasp—
All attributes at 54000 points?!
It’s even stronger than the half-step monarch-level demon race!
This value is simply abnormal!
But Gu Xing quickly calmed down.
Such attributes alone can’t guarantee victory in this battle.Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Demon King-level demons can also temporarily enhance their attributes through demonic qi...
Thus, one must not take it lightly!
Gu Xing turned his gaze to Qing Shuang...
Power attribute at 27000 points...
If she unleashes the Ghost Race Third Technique "Heaven-Breaking", under triple amplification—
points!!
???
Commander Tier One closing in on a hundred thousand points of power attribute?!
It was only after calculating that he realized...
Qing Shuang’s power attribute had reached an abnormal extent!
But Qing Shuang’s other attributes are relatively weaker, her true combat power cannot be simply calculated by power attribute alone.
Regardless of how abnormal the explosive power is, if it can’t hit...
It’s all in vain!
At this moment, the Winged Demon King sensed two auras not weaker than its own and finally put away its contempt.
A glimpse of dread flashed in its crimson compound eyes—
Commander Tier One possessing half-step king’s battle power...
If such a human is allowed to grow...
They will surely become a Totem-level powerhouse!
What’s more frightening is that this human has established a spiritual contract with a Divine Pattern!
Killing intent reached its peak instantly!
This human must not be allowed to survive!
Realizing this, the Demon King made a decision almost instantly.
Without hesitation, it crushed a treasured demon stone, overwhelming demonic qi surged like a tide, completely enveloping it.
"Demon King’s Body!"
With a roar, its attributes started to frantically climb!
For the Demon King, Demon King’s Body is an essential skill.
It can temporarily enhance one’s attributes using demonic qi.
Witnessing this scene, Gu Xing’s eyes narrowed slightly.
His domain can forbid these demon races from using domains, turning into a pure attribute confrontation!
But...
He’s not the only one who possesses temporary enhancement methods.
For these demon races, they have them too!
[Power: 55000→75000]
[Constitution: 53000→73000]
[Spirit: 41000→61000]
[Speed: 57000→79000]
Gu Xing stared at the Winged Demon King’s rapidly escalating attribute panel, his brain operating at high speed—
Liu Li’s current attribute gap is too wide...
Direct confrontation holds no chance of victory!
While pondering, his gaze suddenly fixed on a line of small text in Qing Shuang’s status bar:
[Special State: Twin Resonance (Contracted Twins share talents with each other!)]
If Qing Shuang can use Fei Yue’s Void Travel...
Combined with an explosive power of 81000 points...
A bold plan took shape in his mind.
But before that, someone needed to hold this Demon King down tightly!
And that task....
"Liu Li!"
Gu Xing had no choice but to assign this daunting task to Liu Li.
Yet with Liu Li’s attributes around 50,000, trying to hold off the Winged Demon King with average attributes at 70,000...
It’s a huge test for her.
But Liu Li’s eyes didn’t waver the slightest.
Through the spiritual contract, she clearly sensed Gu Xing’s plan.
Faced with this almost impossible task, she showed no sign of retreat, rather her battle intent surged!
"Master, I can do it!"
Her voice was firm and calm, as if she was merely stating a simple fact.
Gu Xing gazed deeply at her and eventually nodded.
The next moment—
Liu Li’s figure suddenly transformed into a dazzling streamer, rushing straight toward the Winged Demon King!
The Winged Demon King smirked sarcastically at this sight.
Although the aura this guardian beast exhibited wasn’t weak, compared to its level... it falls short!
Its pitch-black bone wings shook violently, demonic qi surged, and it charged towards Liu Li ferociously as well!
And at the moment of their confrontation—
No one noticed, a shadowy figure silently disappeared from its place, vanishing into the void noiselessly.
Boom—!!!
Liu Li and the Winged Demon King collided heavily, an ominous energy shockwave swept out!
However, just a moment after, Liu Li’s figure uncontrollably flew backward, apparently still inferior in raw power to this half-step monarch-level demon race!
The Winged Demon King sneered coldly, eyes full of contempt.
"If your master was a bit wiser, hiding you until you reach Commander Tier Five, maybe I wouldn’t be your match."
"But now?"
"You’ll surely die here!"
It continued its frenzied assault while persistently taunting Liu Li, trying to break her will.
Yet, around Liu Li, Ultimate Fire burned brightly!
Demonic qi that touched these intense flames was instantly consumed, emitting a sharp "zzzz" sound.
With this all-consuming fire, Liu Li managed to withstand the attribute-overpowering Winged Demon King with sheer spirit attribute of 50,000 points!
But this resistance cannot last long!
In repeated attacks, Liu Li had clearly fallen behind.
Every time she had to exert full force to barely resist the demon king’s strikes.
Yet Gu Xing, witnessing this scene, showed no intention of intervening.
If he applied several Sovereign effects to Liu Li, she would indeed hold an equal ground against the Winged Demon King.
But he did not mean to do so.
The current status was what he aimed to achieve.
Only when the demon race is close to victory will it fully lower its guard.
Only then does Qing Shuang have a chance to succeed!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 144: Southern Battlefield, Peril!
chapters.content:
Chapter 144: Chapter 144: Southern Battlefield, Peril!
"Clang——!"
Amidst the Demon King’s relentless attacks, the Holy Sword in Liu Li’s hand was finally knocked away by his strike, spinning and embedding itself into the distant ground.
A sharp gleam suddenly flashed in the Demon King’s eyes.
The opportunity was found!
"It’s over!"
The ferocity in his eyes surged, and his five claws instantly formed a cone, shrouded in pitch-black Demonic Qi, thrusting straight at Liu Li’s heart!
If this strike hits...
Even Liu Li’s Constitution Attribute of 50,000 points couldn’t possibly block it!
There was only one possibility; she would be pierced through the heart by this attack and die.
As the Demon King’s claws drew closer and closer to Liu Li’s heart.
In his mind, he could already picture the scene of piercing through the angel’s heart.
Thinking of this, his gaze unconsciously fell on the human present.
His Guardian Beast was about to die, and this human’s face should surely show despair!
However, within his line of sight...
The young human’s mouth actually held a faint, illusive smile!
What’s going on?!
The Demon King’s heart suddenly convulsed, a foreboding feeling slithered up his spine like a viper.
When the claw was only an inch from Liu Li’s heart, he suddenly realized a fatal issue:
Where is the other Guardian Beast...?
In the next moment, he had his answer.
"Ghost Race Third Technique · World-Opening!"
The cold voice exploded almost right next to the Demon King’s ear, making his skin instantly bristle!
When did——?!
The pupils of the Winged Demon King sharply contracted to needlepoints, but it was already too late to defend.
Qing Shuang’s entire form was entwined with boiling Netherworld Ghost Qi, with remnants of an incompletely closed space rift lingering beside her...
Using Fei Yue’s Space Talent, she executed a deadly strike during the moment the Demon King’s focus wavered!
This fleeting chance could only be seized by Qing Shuang whose combat instincts were fully heightened.
If it were Liu Li, she might have missed this opportunity too.
But Qing Shuang would not!
The fist, condensed with Netherworld Ghost Qi, was almost within reach, and the Winged Demon King could even sense the devastating energy fluctuations.
Death beckons...
This punch would certainly shatter his skull!
At the brink of life and death, a fierce glint flashed in the Demon King’s eyes——
Even if I am to die...
This angel must accompany me in the grave!
The claws aimed at Liu Li’s heart were not retracted, but instead driven by the last burst of Demonic Qi, piercing forward at a faster speed!
However.
Reality is always the opposite of imagination!
"Divine Protection!"
Liu Li’s cold voice suddenly rang out, and a dazzling golden veil instantly enveloped her entire body.
"Bang——!"
The Demon King’s claws struck hard against the veil, yet not even a ripple was stirred.
[Divine Protection: A Divine Skill of the Blazing Angels Race, capable of blocking a fatal strike!]
The fierce expression of the Winged Demon King froze instantly, his eyes full of disbelief——
How could this be?!
But no one would answer his questions anymore.
"Boom——!!!"
Qing Shuang’s fist, entwined with Netherworld Ghost Qi, landed squarely on the Demon King’s skull.
Under the crushing force of 80,000 terrifying Power points, the grotesque skull exploded like a ripe watermelon!
It wasn’t over yet!
Commander-level Demons have tenacious Life Force and don’t die immediately even when losing their skull.
Qing Shuang wrapped an arm around Liu Li’s slender waist, and with a flicker of the Void, retreated hundreds of meters——
Defense against the last counterattack of the dying Demon King was necessary!
In the distance, Gu Xing finally let out a long breath, the tension in his nerves slowly unwinding.
Although everything was laid out according to plan, he never dared to relax until the battle ended.
Now——
The dust has settled!
With the perfect coordination of the three, the Winged Demon King, at half-step Monarch Level, was finally brought down.
Though the process was perilous, the outcome was not disappointing after all.
At the instant of the Demon King’s death, a massive reservoir of blue Energy burst forth from the corpse, splitting into two torrents and channeling into both Liu Li and Qing Shuang!
"Boom——!"
Their auras surged instantly!
Although they had just broken through to Commander Level not long ago, the Energy gained from defeating a half-step King Level Demon King was extremely abundant.Follow current novels on
Liu Li and Qing Shuang’s levels soared directly from Commander Tier One to Tier Two!
With the breakthrough of the Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing also felt the Spiritual Power within his body boiling, his Realm naturally advancing to Commander Tier Two.
Yet more surprisingly——
The remaining energy spontaneously surged towards the Divine Pattern on his forehead!
This is.....
In Gu Xing’s astonished gaze, the blue Energy pooled and slowly melded into the golden Divine Pattern as if rivers flowing into a sea...
Gu Xing was slightly taken aback.
Could the Divine Pattern actually absorb the energy of the Demon Race?
However, besides a clearer perception towards Blue Star, there seemed to be no evident changes.
Pondering over it for a moment but unable to figure it out, he decided to temporarily put aside the question.
Looking up at the horizon, the gaping space rift still hung in the sky like a tear, continuously funneling Demonic Qi into Blue Star.
It must be sealed somehow...
Otherwise, the Demon Race army will infiltrate through it next time!
As this thought crossed his mind, Gu Xing instinctively harnessed the abilities granted by the Divine Pattern.
His Spiritual Power quietly infused into the Void, and in that instant, the entire structure of the space rift appeared vividly clear to him——
So that’s how it is...
With a gentle thought, he attempted to direct the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi to mend the rift.
The next moment, an astounding scene occurred!
Spiritual Qi within a hundred-mile radius swept together as if summoned, transforming into countless beams of light flowing to the rift’s edges.
Under Gu Xing’s wide-eyed gaze, the tear slicing across the sky gradually began to heal and finally——
Vanished completely!
On the ground.
Ying Xinghe and the others were utterly frozen, disbelief written all over their faces.
How can this be?!
Ying Xinghe swallowed hard.
Gu Xing had just broken through to Commander Level, how could he slay a half-step King Level Demon King as a Tier One?!
Yet the facts before him were undeniable——
He not only felled the Demon King...
But also erased the space rift?!
As he mechanically turned his gaze to the battlefield on the ground, a more astonishing scene unfolded before his eyes:
Vera was enveloped in violent thunderbolts, with her Spiritual Attribute reaching a staggering 54,000 points, she was practically overwhelming with the dual boosts of "Soul-devouring" and "Elf Monarchy"!
Before her, the Commander-level Demons were as fragile as lambs waiting to be slaughtered.
"Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
With a clear shout, nine World-Ending Thunder Dragons roared out, and the last Demon turned to dust in the glaring thunderous light!
Thus——
The battlefield, which was on the brink of collapse, was completely reversed in the short period since Gu Xing appeared!
On the war-torn field, not a single figure of the Demon Race could be seen...
However, in the sky, Gu Xing’s face suddenly changed.
In that instant, his heart throbbed, and a surge of agony enveloped him entirely.
Who has been harmed?!
At this moment.
In the southern battlefield.
The humans who had come to block the Demon Race were nearly wiped out, and the situation had reached an incredibly perilous point.
Only the remaining Ying Bing, Gu Qianqian, and others held onto the final line of defense.
Before them stood tens of thousands of the Demon Race legion!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 145: Ying Bing’s Swan Song
chapters.content:
Chapter 145: Chapter 145: Ying Bing’s Swan Song
The southern battlefield was littered with corpses.
The few remaining were forced to retreat step by step by the Demon Race, having fallen back to the last line of defense at Lin Yuan City.
The teachers and students who came to intercept were almost completely wiped out!
Now, only Ying Bing, Gu Qianqian, and a few others were still struggling to hold on.
The reason they could survive until now was largely due to Xia Xiu’s deliberate protection!
But the status of this City Lord of Lin Yuan City was extremely dire.
His entire body was drenched in blood, indistinguishable whether it was his own or the enemy’s.
The originally robust body now had only one arm left!Googlᴇ search No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
Yet even so, he still stood like a spear at the forefront of the group.
"Crack!"
The remaining left hand clenched tightly, nails embedding deeply into the palm.
Bloodshot eyes stared intently at the demon tide surging ahead, burning with an unrelenting hatred.
Many of the teachers from the National Academy had been his comrades in life-and-death battles.
And now...
A hint of sorrow flashed in Xia Xiu’s eyes.
When intercepting the Demon Race, they fought until the last moment——
Even in death, they would self-destruct their domain to desperately take down a Commander Level demon.
But even so, the remaining number of demons still made Xia Xiu feel hopeless.
His gaze swept over Ying Bing and Gu Qianqian beside him, and his voice was eerily calm:
"You should leave..."
"We can’t hold them off."
"There’s no need to die in vain."
Although he urged Ying Bing and Gu Qianqian to leave, he himself did not move, not taking a single step back.
Not far behind was Lin Yuan City.
This action’s failure...
Would mean Lin Yuan City would inevitably be slaughtered by the Demon Race!
And as the City Lord of Lin Yuan City...
He swore to live and die with this city!
However——
As Xia Xiu’s words fell, not a single person moved.
Gu Qianqian’s body was also injured, but her eyes were full of determination:
"Lin Yuan City is where I was born and raised, and I cannot stand by and watch it be destroyed by the Demon Race!"
She paused, her tone suddenly softening when she turned to Ying Bing:
"But Ying Bing... you’re different."
"I know you like my brother, and... your talent might compare to his."
"Go, find Gu Xing... avenge us!"
Upon hearing this, Ying Bing was struck like lightning, frozen in place.
Like... Gu Xing?
The secret she had buried deepest, uncovered by Gu Qianqian just like that!
She turned to Gu Qianqian in panic, wanting to deny it.
But faced with Gu Qianqian’s certain gaze, she lowered her head.
She could not speak...
What Gu Qianqian said was the truth.
Even though she kept deceiving herself that her feelings for Gu Xing were not love.
But in front of Gu Xing’s closest person, at this moment...
All her self-deception collapsed in an instant.
"Ying Bing, leave this place!"
Gu Qianqian repeated once more.
Knowing the inevitable deadly conclusion, she didn’t want Ying Bing to stay here and die.
But Ying Bing shook her head vigorously, her hair flying in the wind.
She loved Gu Xing!
Therefore, she could not watch Gu Qianqian sacrifice herself before her eyes.
She must protect everyone related to Gu Xing!
What’s more...
Ying Bing’s gaze crossed the battlefield and looked at the majestic city in the twilight.
Is this... where he grew up?
Her slender fingers unconsciously touched her chest.
"Thump, thump, thump——"
The heartbeat was deafening, so fast it seemed like it would leap out of her chest.
So this is..... love!!
Wanting to protect everything related to him!
Realizing her feelings, Ying Bing suddenly lifted her head, her lips bit until they turned pale:
"Sis... sister..."
"Can I... call you that?"
Gu Qianqian was first stunned, then a smile appeared on her face.
Ying Bing’s words already reflected her choice!
Having such a girl like her brother was that brat’s fortune.
Gu Qianqian shifted her gaze from Ying Bing to the Demon Race, speaking slowly:
"Ying Bing, if we survive this, I’ll make that brat marry you!"
Hearing this, Ying Bing’s cheeks flushed.
Marry her?
Just imagining it made her heart race...
But the next second, her gaze swept over the surging Demon Race army, the ice-blue eyes gradually dimmed.
Unfortunately, they cannot return...
She closed her eyes slowly, her long lashes casting a shadow on her pale face.
But at least——
In the last moments, she wanted to do something for Gu Xing!
"Boom——"
Vast spiritual power erupted suddenly!
Ice-blue long hair faded to silver at a visible speed, her aura soaring continuously, and the soil under her feet began to crystallize with dazzling ice.
"This is.... the Winner’s talent?!"
Witnessing this scene, Xia Xiu’s pupils shrank, instantly realizing...
The girl was burning her life force.
Understanding this, Xia Xiu’s eyes gradually darkened.
As a soldier of Longxia Country, how could he lose to a student!
Veins bulged on his left hand as he gripped the longsword tightly.
Even without a Guardian Beast, even with only one arm...
So what?
"Swish!"
The sword edge slashed through the air, and Xia Xiu charged into the demon tide like an arrow off the string.
His thin figure appeared so small in the vast demonic qi, yet so determined——
How can a single man stop thousands of troops?!
As Xia Xiu charged alone, all Commander Level demons halted unanimously.
——This race is too insane!
They remembered clearly the determination when those human experts self-destructed their domains.
This one-armed man in front of them was clearly intending to exchange his life for theirs!
"Roar!"
With a command, countless Extraordinary Level demons surged toward Xia Xiu like a tide.
Letting these Extraordinary Level demons consume that human was the right choice!
But that was the result Xia Xiu wanted...
Using his own flesh as a sacrifice to buy time for Ying Bing’s rise.
In the center of the battlefield.
The sword light was like snow, each arc claiming the lives of several demons.
But Xia Xiu’s domain was rapidly dimming, and the arm swinging the sword began to tremble.
"It’s now!"
In the distance, a few Commander Level demons who were waiting saw this, a grin forming on their lips.
In the next moment.
A Commander Level demon vanished.
When he reappeared, he was already at Xia Xiu’s side.
"Pssst!"
The sound of claws piercing the heart echoed.
"Ugh..."
Blood oozed from the corner of his mouth, yet Xia Xiu smiled.
His bloodstained hand clamped onto the demon’s wrist like a vice:
"Got you."
The demon’s pupils contracted suddenly.
The next second——
"Boom!!!"
Dazzling white light engulfed a hundred meters around!
This Commander Level demon and the surrounding Extraordinary Level demons instantly vaporized.
In the distance.
The remaining commanders had grim faces.
This race, in thousands of years....
Was the toughest race they had ever seen!
Despite the enormous power gap, yet...
Not a single one yielded.
But all this was over!
The last human Commander Level Beast Master to pose a threat to them was dead, and now...
The moment those few remaining Commander Level demons sighed in relief.
A snowflake landed on the tip of his nose.
"This is...?"
