All of the demons simultaneously looked up.
The silver-haired girl stood in mid-air, with ice-blue eyes turned to frosty white.
She slowly raised her hand, and the whole world echoed with the sound of swords singing in the wind——

chapters.title: Chapter 146: Ying Bing Is Dying!
chapters.content:
Chapter 146: Chapter 146: Ying Bing Is Dying!
At this moment.
Ying Bing’s originally ice-blue long hair had turned completely silver, her aura climbing steadily from Commander Tier One to its peak.
Life Burning!
The winner’s bloodline talent.
Sacrificing life to fight for a glimmer of hope in this deadlock.
She slowly opened her eyes, her frost-white pupils shimmering with a faint longing.
A longing for this world.
And even more so...
For the sadness of never seeing that person again.
Her delicate hand gently raised, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix spread its wings in surging spiritual power, instantly covering half the battlefield.
Ying Bing gracefully leaped onto the head of the Ice Phoenix, her silver hair dancing with the snow.
At this moment——
She resembled a goddess wielding the power of winter.
"Rustle, rustle!"
The snow fell silently.
The Extraordinary Level Demon Race bodies began to freeze, their movements becoming increasingly sluggish, eventually turning into ice sculptures.
Seeing this, the few remaining Commander Level Demons wore expressions as dark as night.
The strength of this human woman before them had already approached the peak of Commander Level.
With just them...
They couldn’t win!
A few glances exchanged in mid-air, instantly reaching a consensus——
Summon the Demon King!
Each space rift had only one opportunity to summon a Monarch Level Demon, which they thought was too much.
But now...
These madmen!
Looking at the ground littered with Demon corpses and recalling those humans exchanging life for life, the Commander Level Demons finally realized——
Relying on just themselves, they might not...
Complete Lord Demon God’s task!
"Boom——"
They struck simultaneously.
The overwhelming demonic qi gathered into an obsidian light pillar, piercing the sky!
The space rift trembled violently under this force, as if torn by an invisible hand.
"Crack, crack!"
The sound of scales grinding against each other grew closer, a figure enveloped in terrifying pressure slowly stepping out of the rift.
Monarch Level Demon!
His cold spiritual power swept across the battlefield; upon seeing the few remaining Commander Level Demons, the Monarch’s brow furrowed deeply.
How could this be...
Clearly, in earlier reconnaissance, there wasn’t a Monarch Level presence, and the Demons held absolute advantage.
How long had it been unattended...
For the battle situation to deteriorate to this point!
The Monarch Level Demon slowly raised his head, locking his icy gaze on the silver-haired girl atop the Ice Phoenix.
Upon sensing the burning life force around this human girl, his crimson pupils slightly constricted.
Burning life to gain power?
Interesting...
But then, he curled his lip into a mocking smile.
What’s the use of sacrificing all your life?
You still can’t reach the Monarch Level!
"These..."
He waved a hand over the ravaged battlefield, "Are you responsible for all this?"
Ying Bing did not answer, her clenched hands trembling slightly.
They already knew this rift could allow a Monarch Level Demon to pass through.
Therefore, stopping the Demons was never feasible from the start.
But.....
To do the impossible, knowing it’s impossible!
This was their choice.
She took a deep breath, her gaze firmly locked onto the Monarch Level Demon.
"Frost Ring...Imprisonment!"
Her cool voice resounded across the battlefield.
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix unfurled its ice wings that covered the sky, instantly dropping the temperature to absolute zero.
[Frost Ring Imprisonment: Forced control skill!]
The Monarch Level Demon’s playful expression suddenly froze.
He was shocked to find his limbs rapidly being covered in frost...
Now reaching the peak of Commander Level...
The Frost Ring Imprisonment she cast, even for a Demon of Monarch Level, would forcibly immobilize it in place.
Though the duration wasn’t long...
It was enough for Ying Bing!
This time, it was enough for her to complete a domain self-destruction, making this Demon King pay the price!
"Screech——"
The Ice Phoenix let out a high-pitched cry, carrying her like a meteor rushing toward the Demon Monarch.
In the instant of nearing the Demon, Ying Bing fleetingly saw Gu Xing’s smiling face.
I really wish I could...
See him one more time!
Unfortunately...
No more chances!
The ice-blue domain abruptly blossomed, shrouding the Monarch Level Demon completely.
A blinding white light erupted soon after——
"Boom!"
Yet at this critical moment, the dark demonic energy surged like a tide.
The Monarch Level Demon forcibly broke free from the restraints!
"Humans... are quite interesting."
He sneered, expanding his domain, "But alas, ants are still ants!"
"Puff——"
The domain backlash made Ying Bing spit out a mouthful of blood.
Seeing the intact Demon King, she bitterly closed her eyes.
The gap was too vast!
Even though she gave it her all, she still couldn’t harm this Monarch Level Demon.
But she really tried her best...
Just before her eyes closed, it was as if she saw a familiar figure in the sky.
Is that... Gu Xing?!
Realizing this, she suddenly opened her eyes wide, her silver hair wildly dancing in the explosion’s wind.
Why is he here!
This place is too dangerous!
Ying Bing desperately wanted to shout, but could only let out a silent cry.
Her cracked lips slightly trembled, unable to utter a single word.
Meanwhile——
"Shua!"
Stepping out of the space rift with Shen Ruoxue’s assistance, Gu Xing was struck numb by the scene before him.
Ying Bing... was self-destructing?!
Seeing the shockwave about to devour Ying Bing.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
His eyes widened in rage, roaring orders:
"Fei Yue! Save her——!"
Almost at the moment he spoke, Fei Yue’s figure disappeared from sight.
Even while traversing the space rift, she felt the battle’s brutality.
So, Fei Yue was already prepared to act.
Reaching Commander Level, Fei Yue’s Void Mastery advanced further.
Almost instantly, she appeared beside Ying Bing, pulling her into the void just before the explosion hit.
"Boom!!!"
Outside, destructive energy rampantly spread, warping and shattering even the space.
Fei Yue dared not linger, immediately manipulating the Void Talent, struggling through the chaotic energy currents.
"Cough..."
When Fei Yue stumbled out of the void, her face was deathly pale.
Shaking, she handed Ying Bing into Gu Xing’s arms, her own body weakened from spiritual power depletion.
She had just given it her all!
If she had been a step slower, both she and Ying Bing would have been lost in the chaotic void.
Gu Xing instinctively caught Ying Bing, but at the touch of her silver-white hair, he felt as if struck by lightning.
The strands that should’ve been crystalline like ice were now lifelessly drooped like a wilted flower.
How could it be... so light?
The girl in his arms felt as light as a feather, her heartbeat faintly audible.
Gu Xing’s hands trembled uncontrollably, an unprecedented fear clutching at his heart.
"Ying Bing..."
His voice choked in his throat, fingertips touching skin cold as death.
The girl who always stubbornly stood in front of him now seemed as fragile as a shattered ice sculpture.
Gu Xing bit his lips hard, tasting blood.
He could sense it...
Ying Bing’s remaining life force was draining away at a terrifying speed.
She was dying!
Ying Bing was going to die!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 147: Sacrifice!
chapters.content:
Chapter 147: Chapter 147: Sacrifice!
Ying Bing felt as if she were dreaming in a daze.
The person she had been thinking about just moments ago was now vividly appearing in front of her.
Is this... an illusion?
But after sensing the warmth from Gu Xing’s fingertips, she suddenly awoke.
This is not a dream!
But the next second, immense fear engulfed her heart.
Blood spilled from the corner of her mouth.
She wanted to open her mouth to remind Gu Xing to leave here, but...
The domain shattered, and at this moment, she had already reached the end of her life.
She couldn’t control her own body.
Even more frightening was...
The aftereffects of Life Burning began to appear at this time.
Her body was aging rapidly.
Her previously smooth skin was drying and wrinkling at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Master! Quickly use Celestial Grace!"
Liu Li’s exclamation startled Gu Xing from his daze.
He trembled and activated the Sovereign Talent, a silver light swirling madly in his eyes.
"Celestial Grace!"
One after another, holy light descended, finally slowing the aging process.
But Gu Xing quickly realized that while Celestial Grace could remove negative states, it couldn’t replenish the life force that had already burned out...
"Enough..."
A wrinkled hand gently pressed against him.
Ying Bing shook her head with her last bit of strength, her voice as light as a sigh in the wind:
"Don’t waste your effort..."
"Quickly leave... Monarch Level..."
The sentence wasn’t finished...
Her eyes gradually lost focus, her long eyelashes drooping slowly like a butterfly with broken wings.
Gu Xing felt the gradually cooling body in his arms, his heart clenched tightly by an invisible hand.
No... it’s not possible...
His hands trembled uncontrollably, the young man who had never retreated on the battlefield was now consumed by an unprecedented fear.
Just as despair was about to drown him—
"Lord Gu Xing!"
Sally’s figure suddenly appeared, holding a large barrel of Spring of Life glowing with a vivid green light.
She called out urgently:
"Quickly put Lord Ying Bing inside! The Spring of Life can temporarily maintain her life force!"
Gu Xing awoke from his dream, carefully placing Ying Bing into the spring water.
With the green waves rippling, the girl’s pale face finally regained a hint of color, and the decaying aura gradually stabilized.
"Ah..."
Seeing Ying Bing’s condition stabilize, his tensed nerves were about to relax—
"Humans, did you forget my existence?"
A chilling voice slithered into his ears like a venomous snake. That Monarch Level Demon Race had finally fully recovered from the blast and was now looking down on them arrogantly.
Gu Xing slowly raised his head, a cold rage igniting in his silver eyes.
But when he saw the attributes of this Demon Race, the anger in his eyes suddenly stopped.
Because...
[Blood Demon]
[Talent: Demon King]
[Level: King Tier Three]
[Power: 100,000]
[Constitution: 100,000]
[Spirit: 100,000]
[Speed: 100,000]
[Skills: Demon King Domain, Demon King’s Body...]
Even if he could disable this Demon King’s domain, the nearly 100,000 attributes of this Demon King...
With Liu Li and Qing Shuang as they are now...
There is absolutely no chance of winning!
Escape?
With Fei Yue at Commander Level, if he wanted to leave.
No one would be able to stop him!
But...
He could leave!
But he couldn’t take the citizens of Lin Yuan City with him!
Moreover...
Looking at Ying Bing’s pale face in the Spring of Life.
The stubborn girl who would rather burn her life to protect this place, how could he easily give up?
But defeating this Demon Race...
"Lord Gu Xing!"
Sally’s voice snapped Gu Xing back to reality.
He turned to look at the little maid beside him, and saw unprecedented seriousness in her eyes.
"You must have a way to deal with this Demon Race, don’t you?"
This sentence suddenly reminded Gu Xing of the [Soul-devouring] skill—
[Soul-devouring: Unconditionally increase Guardian Beast’s attributes by 200%]
[Special State: Sacrifice (Sacrifice one Guardian Beast to make the increase effect 400%)]
A 400% boost...
With Liu Li and Qing Shuang’s current attributes...
Perhaps they could indeed counter the Monarch Level!
But sacrificing a Guardian Beast...
Gu Xing’s face suddenly turned pale!
Impossible!
Every Guardian Beast is an irreplaceable partner to him, he absolutely does not want to endure this cost.
Sally seemed to see through his hesitation and softly said:
"Lord Gu Xing, actually the prophecy of the Elf Empress has two parts!"
"The first part is that Prophet will descend upon the Elf Secret Realm, as for the second part..."
Sally didn’t continue, but instead took out a golden glowing leaf of the Life Tree from her arms.
"The second part... is our Cat Race’s mission!"
Before she finished speaking, she had already pressed the golden leaf on her forehead.
In an instant, the leaf transformed into light and merged into her body.
At the same time, Gu Xing clearly felt a spiritual link emerge in his mind—
This is...
Sally?!
Gu Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted, a terrifying suspicion surged in his heart.
At this moment, Sally was bathed in golden light, looking at Gu Xing with an unprecedented determination:
"Lord Gu Xing..."
Her voice trembled slightly, "Can I call you Master once?"
"Just this once..."
"Ever since you saved me on that day, I’ve dreamed of becoming your Guardian Beast..."
Her voice grew fainter, "But I know... my talent isn’t worthy of you..."
"So I worked hard to learn, hoping to be your best little maid..."
"But now..." her figure began to be consumed by blood-red flames, "Your little maid... just wants to call you Master once with her own voice..."
Gu Xing trembled violently.
How could this happen?!
Even though he hadn’t activated the Soul-devouring Talent, the sacrifice had already begun.
The memories of his time with Sally flashed like a series of scenes before his eyes, anger, fear, sorrow...
Various emotions churned in his chest, nearly suffocating him.Nᴇw ɴovel chaptᴇrs are published on ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
He opened his mouth, but could not utter any sound...
Sally waited for a long time without getting a response, the light in her eyes gradually dimmed.
She lowered her head, but a gentle smile still appeared on her lips:
"Lord Gu Xing... I understand..."
"If... there’s a next life..."
"Sally would still want to be your... little maid..."
The blood-red flames suddenly surged, engulfing her figure more fiercely.
"No!!!"
Gu Xing finally found his voice, shouting desperately:
"I promise you!"
"Stop!"
But once the sacrifice ceremony began, it was like a raging wildfire, unstoppable.
In the flames, Sally’s figure grew fainter, but when she heard Gu Xing’s response, she showed a relieved smile.
In her final moment, her lips opened gently.
Despite being surrounded by the raging flames, Gu Xing still clearly recognized the silent two words:
"Master..."
The blood-red flames completely engulfed the petite figure, leaving only a trace of golden light flashing in the flames, eventually turning into points of starlight and dispersing...
Sacrifice completed!
Blood-red spiritual power surged madly around Gu Xing, but he was completely unaware.
His body trembled uncontrollably, with only one thought remaining in his mind:
Today...
Ying Bing is on the brink of death, Sally has sacrificed her life...
All of this is the fault of—
"It’s all because of you!!!"
Gu Xing suddenly raised his head, his crimson eyes fiercely locked onto the Monarch Level Demon Race, his voice filled with unprecedented madness!
Kill him!
He must be killed!
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 148: Sacrifice: 400% Boost!
chapters.content:
Chapter 148: Chapter 148: Sacrifice: 400% Boost!
Under Gu Xing’s nearly frenzy gaze, the heart of this Monarch Level Demon Race tightened abruptly.
This human...
Actually made him feel as if he was targeted by an ancient beast, causing his blood to halt.
But in an instant, he suppressed the unease in his heart.
Ridiculous...
The person in front is clearly just a Commander Tier Two ant.
No matter how overwhelming the talent, it’s absolutely impossible to possess a power that rivals a Monarch at the Commander Tier!
However—
When his eyes swept across Gu Xing’s forehead, his pupils suddenly shrank into needles.
"Divine Pattern?!"
His mouth involuntarily curled up, revealing a bloodthirsty smile.
"This saves a lot of effort!"
In front of Lin Yuan City.
Gu Qianqian looked up at the familiar figure in the sky, her beautiful eyes suddenly widened.
"Little Xing?!"
She distinctly remembered her brother should still be in the Beast Taming Holy Pool, how did he suddenly appear on the battlefield?
At this moment.
Vera manipulated the vines to slowly descend, bringing Ying Bing soaked in the Spring of Life to her.
Following closely was Gu Xing’s utterly suppressed voice:
"Sis, I’m begging you!"
Gu Qianqian lowered her head towards the unconscious Ying Bing, the pale complexion of the girl made her heart tighten, she nodded heavily at once.
After holding Ying Bing in her arms, Gu Qianqian’s gaze fell onto the Monarch Level Demon Race in the sky.
After hesitating for a moment, she still did not stop Gu Xing from leaving.
She didn’t know when her brother, who always followed behind her, had already left her far behind.
Now Gu Xing had grown to a height she couldn’t reach.
Even when facing a Monarch Level Demon Race...
She firmly believed that Gu Xing could win.
If we really speak about the unlikely...
At worst, siblings, today they would be buried here together!
Above the sky.
Gu Xing felt as if his mind was repeatedly pierced by thousands of steel needles.
This kind of pain...
Usually, activating Soul-devouring State does cause some mental pressure, but it wasn’t as agonizing as this moment.
The Special State activated at this moment by the Soul-devouring Talent...
His Spiritual Power became intensely violent!
Trying to control it was incredibly difficult!
Looking at the golden Life Tree Leaf left after Sally’s sacrifice.
Gu Xing trembled as he reached out and clutched this leaf tightly in his palm.
Sally...
This was the only relic she left behind.
The activation conditions for Soul-devouring Sacrifice were exceedingly harsh.
He once tried casually contracting just any Guardian Beast for sacrifice but ended in failure.
After countless research, he finally understood:
To complete the sacrifice, three conditions must be met simultaneously—
Firstly, it must be a formally contracted Guardian Beast; a temporary contract is invalid;
Secondly, the Guardian Beast’s bloodline must come from the top-notch race;
Thirdly, and the most stringent... the Guardian Beast’s emotions towards him must reach a level of unwavering loyalty.
But... why... why did it have to be Sally...
Gu Xing trembled while holding the golden leaf.
He had imagined countless times whether he would use this talent in a desperate situation, yet never had an answer.
Losing any contracted partner, he couldn’t accept.
But now...
Faced with true despair, Sally sacrificed herself in front of him.
When the trembling Sally amidst blood flames spoke tremblingly that sentence.
"Master Gu Xing, can I call you master once?"
At that moment, he felt his heart was fiercely clenched by someone, making it difficult to breathe.
His little maid sacrifice...
Gu Xing’s body kept trembling, fingers embedded in his palm due to force.
Obviously, Sally was neither his Guardian Beast nor a top-notch race, but...
Why could she meet the conditions for sacrifice?!
Feeling the Life Tree Leaf in his hand...
Suddenly, the second part of the prophecy Sally mentioned echoed in his mind.
Prophecy?!
Could the Elf Empress foreseen today a thousand years ago?!
If so, why not leave a way to resolve it?!
Why must the Cat Race sacrifice?!
These series of questions swirled in his mind.
Yet no one could give him the answers!
He trembled as he put the golden leaf back into the Beast Taming Space, slowly raised his blood-colored eyes, and locked onto the Monarch Level Demon Race before him.
No matter what...
This Demon Race—
Must die!
"Liu Li, Qing Shuang!"
Gu Xing’s voice detonated in the wind.
The pupils of the two Guardian Beasts burned with raging fury.
This was their first time facing the loss of a companion!
No command was needed—
"Ghost King’s Body!"
"Doomsday Angel Form!"
At the moment they completed the form transformation, Gu Xing’s blood-colored Spiritual Power poured down like a tide, completely enveloping them.
400% Full Attribute Amplification!
Under this stacking of multiple states, the aura of the two Guardian Beasts climbed step by step, breaking through the limits in an instant!
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 15000→90000]
[Constitution: 14000→84000]
[Spirit: 13000→78000]
[Speed: 14000→84000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
[Special State: Twin Resonance!]
With the 1.5 times attribute bonus of the Ghost King’s Body and the 400% boost from sacrifice...
Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute directly reached 90000 points!Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
This terrifying data was infinitely close to the Monarch Level Demon King before him.
Only to see the dark ghost qi madly converging above Qing Shuang’s head, gradually forming a Ghost King Illusion that obscures the sky.
Meanwhile, on the other side, Liu Li had completed her transformation.
The Ultimate Fire covered her body like a tide, twelve wings burning with flames suddenly unfolded.
The raging Ultimate Fire poured down from the wings, turning the ground instantly into a sea of fire.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Power: 15000→180000]
[Constitution: 15000→180000]
[Spirit: 15000→180000]
[Speed: 15000→180000]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain]
[Special State: Oath Guardian]
After breaking through the Commander Tier Two, Liu Li’s Basic Attributes had soared to 15000 points.
At this moment, under the dual enhancement of the Doomsday Angel Form and Sacrifice State....
Her various attributes suddenly broke through 180000 point threshold, officially stepping into the King Domain!
The surrounding space gradually distorted and shattered because Liu Li couldn’t control this power.
Yet, even though the strength of the two Guardian Beasts had risen to the peak, Gu Xing still didn’t dare to relax even slightly.
Demon King Level Demon Race...
They all have this skill called "Demon King’s Body."
It can significantly boost their attributes.
As a Monarch Level Demon Race, this boost is even more terrifying.
Just as Gu Xing expected.
Even feeling the aura of the two Guardian Beasts at this moment.
This Monarch Level Demon King remained calm under pressure.
He instinctively wanted to deploy Domain Suppression but was shocked to find——
Domain... has failed?!
The moment Gu Xing activated Sacrifice, he had simultaneously activated the Second Domain.
And realizing the failure of Domain, this Demon Race’s gaze finally became solemn.
This human...
seems to be far more dangerous than the previous human race girl...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 149: Farewell, Elf Empress!
chapters.content:
Chapter 149: Chapter 149: Farewell, Elf Empress!
Next, this Monarch Level Demon Race member made a snap decision:
"Demon King’s Body!"
In an instant, pitch-black Demonic Qi surged like a tide, engulfing him completely.
As the Demon King’s innate Talent Ability, this Skill could instantly double all his Attributes!
[Blood Demon]
[Talent: Demon King]
[Level: King Tier Three]
[Power: 100,000 → 200,000]
[Constitution: 100,000 → 200,000]
[Spirit: 100,000 → 200,000]
[Speed: 100,000 → 200,000]
[Skills: Demon King Domain, Demon King’s Body...]
Feeling the violent Power raging inside, the Demon Race Monarch twisted his lips into a savage grin.
How long has it been...
Ever since breaking through to Commander Level, battles were often decided by Domain alone.
He could no longer remember the last time he went all out and activated Demon King’s Body like this.
But now, facing this special human...
He attacked with full force again!
And as he watched this Monarch Level Demon Race member’s All Attributes reach 200,000, Gu Xing’s heart gradually sank.
The Basic Attributes possessed by Monarch Level Demon Race were simply too high!
His two Guardian Beasts were only Commander Tier Two—raising their Attributes to this extent was already their limit.
Even trickier—
After years of tempering within his Domain, this Demon Race’s body had reached perfection; every Attribute was frighteningly balanced.
Not to mention, anyone who attains the Monarch title has fought their way through mountains of corpses and rivers of blood.
Therefore, trying to repeat the previous stealth attack tactic that Qing Shuang pulled off was nearly impossible.
But even so...
"Sovereign·Start!"
Gu Xing’s left eye suddenly flashed silver-white.
"Slaughter·Grant!"
"Guardian·Grant!"
"Heavenly Grace·Grant!"
The three powers instantly wrapped around the bodies of his two Guardian Beasts—
Liu Li was suddenly clad in blazing Flame Battle Armor, and a spear formed of pure Fire Element condensed in her hand.
Above Qing Shuang’s head, the Ghost King Illusion donned a deep violet Ghost Race battle armor, exuding an unsettling Netherworld Aura.
At this moment, Gu Xing had pushed the strength of both Guardian Beasts to the absolute limit.
This was his final trump card!
"Boom—"
Almost at the same moment, two figures tore across the sky.
The blazing Angel and the fearsome Ghost King Illusion crashed into the Demon Race simultaneously.
Terrifying shockwaves erupted continuously in the Void, shattering even space itself in the clash of such power.
But Gu Xing’s expression grew heavier and heavier.
Still... just one step short!
Even after exhausting every possible means, between the two Guardian Beasts and a true Monarch level—there was still a gap, just one step too far!
Even worse, though the enemy couldn’t fully unleash his Domain, in the midst of battle...
Gu Xing clearly saw wisps of black Domain Power constantly seeping from the Demon Race’s body.
Gu Xing’s heart sank.
His "Absolute Forbidden Domain" didn’t perfectly suppress Monarch Level beings—it could only prevent them from releasing their Domain outward, but couldn’t completely seal it off.
And even more fatal—
Sacrifice State... couldn’t last!
Realizing this, Gu Xing clenched his teeth hard.
Damn it!
Is there really no other way?
Just as the battle reached a stalemate...
Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space suddenly trembled with commotion.
He frowned and sank his Spiritual Power inside, discovering—
That golden World Tree Leaf had vanished, replaced by a breathtaking phantom.
Gu Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
This phantom...
It was clearly the Elf Empress he met in the Elf Secret Realm!
Before he could recover, the figure appeared in the real world.
Her eyes, filled with boundless wisdom, slowly opened.
"We meet again..."
The Empress’s gentle gaze fell upon Gu Xing; in that moment, time itself seemed to stop.
At this moment, Gu Xing’s throat tightened, words choked in his chest.
In the end, everything in his heart turned into a trembling question:
"Why did you leave that prophecy for the Cat Race?!"
Now he understood—the Empress had foreseen this day a thousand years ago—
Otherwise, why would there be a second prophecy, and why prepare the golden leaf as a Sacrifice medium?
Yet...
The Elf Empress gently shook her head.
"It wasn’t me who left the prophecy..."
She gazed at Gu Xing, the flow of time reflected in her eyes.
"It was you... who made me do it."
What?!
Gu Xing’s pupils shrank, as if struck by lightning.
A thousand years ago?
He hadn’t even arrived in this world at that time!
How could he possibly have made the Elf Empress do this?!
As if seeing his confusion, the Empress raised her slender hand to silence his questions.
"You... don’t need to know yet."
She whispered gently, and a faint Spiritual Light floated up from her palm.
"Someday, you’ll understand everything."
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the Empress’s palm.
Curled up there—
It was Sally’s soul!
[Cat Race (Sally)]
[Status: Soul Body]
[Talent: Ordinary One Star]
[Level: Awakening Tier One]
[Power: 0]
[Constitution: 0]
[Spirit: 1]
[Speed: 0]
[Skills: none]
"Sally!"
Seeing that soul, Gu Xing cried out in shock.
Instinctively, he tried to reach out, but when he saw Sally’s Attributes, his hand froze midair.
Sally only had 1 Spirit Attribute.
The other Attributes...
All zero!
Both Talent and Level, were the lowest possible.
If there was even the slightest mistake, she would dissipate.
At that moment, the Elf Empress gently stroked the fragile soul and said softly:
"Put her into the Soul Nourishing Pool, Gu Xing."
Hearing this, Gu Xing nodded.
The function of the Soul Nourishing Pool was to enhance Spiritual Power, and the soul-bodied Sally could only survive in the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Gu Xing carefully enveloped Sally with Spiritual Power, cradling her like a priceless treasure as he placed her into the Soul Nourishing Pool in Beast Taming Space.
Once it was done, Gu Xing suddenly looked up:
"How can I bring her back?!"
The Empress slowly shook her head.
"What do you mean?!"
Gu Xing’s eyes reddened, his voice trembling.
Did that mean Sally could never awaken again...
Yet the Empress seemed to see his thoughts:
"She is the only one who meets the conditions, that’s why I chose her."
"Chosen? What do you mean ’chosen’?"
"Time Spirit Race." the Elf Empress said quietly, "Only in such a pure Soul Body state can she possibly evolve into one of the Time Spirit Clan, and only then can she reclaim the Divine Patterns lost by the Time Spirit Race!"
As she spoke, the Empress’s form began to turn transparent.
Time was running out...
Suddenly, she looked solemn and her tone became grave like never before:
"Remember, every Divine Pattern is critical. None must fall into Demon Race hands!"
Before she finished speaking, she no longer looked at Gu Xing, but slowly turned toward the frozen Vera.
In those eyes that saw through time itself, grief and remorse built up for a millennium overflowed.
"Vera..."
The soft call made the Elf Maiden tremble all over.
"Mother... I’m sorry..."
That thousand-year delayed apology hadn’t faded before the Empress’s figure, like morning mist, began to dissolve; the golden leaf withered away with her.
Just as the last ray of light was about to vanish—
A dazzling golden Divine Pattern flashed into existence from the Void, streaking like a meteor and plunging straight into Vera’s forehead!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 150: Vera! Myth Five Stars!
chapters.content:
Chapter 150: Chapter 150: Vera! Myth Five Stars!
Vera stared blankly at that figure from deep in her memory, countless words surged to her lips—
Yet at the moment she heard this apology, all those words stuck in her throat!
What should she say...
What could she say...
Her memory was always blurry, she had even gradually forgotten her mother’s face.
But at this moment, as the Elf Empress appeared truly before her, those forgotten past events suddenly became incredibly clear—
That day, the Demon Race’s army pressed hard, and the Elf Secret Realm was on the verge of collapse.
This forever noble and untouchable Empress, at the last moment...
Sealed the entire Elf Secret Realm and exiled it beyond the Alternate Space.
Only now did she remember...
When the Elf Empress sent her into the Secret Realm, those usually majestic eyes unexpectedly showed a trace of softness:
"Vera..."
"The future of the Elf Race... is entrusted to you!"
Back then, she didn’t understand.
Didn’t understand why the entire race’s burden was placed on her alone!
Didn’t understand why her mother chose to face the Demon Race army alone!
Didn’t understand why she had to guard the Elf Secret Realm alone!
Until this moment——
When the Divine Pattern with its forgotten memories surged into her mind, she understood:
The elf bloodline must continue, and the Divine Pattern inheritance must never break!
And she, was the last spark her mother exchanged with her life.
In the last scene of her memory, the Elf Empress self-destructed, perishing together with countless members of the Demon Race.
And she, who was lucky to survive, guarded the almost extinguished Divine Pattern...
Gradually, her power began to be absorbed by the Divine Pattern, and she also lost her memory.
This is the reason why Vera, as a Myth Level Guardian Beast, even has some attributes not surpassing Demigod Level Guardian Beasts.
But at this moment...
From Sally’s hand, this Divine Pattern of the Elf Race once again returned.
"Buzz!"
The tremor of the Divine Pattern returning spread throughout her body.
Vera’s petite figure began to stretch, her golden hair cascaded like a waterfall, and the power that had been dormant for millennia was awakening...
"This..."Googlᴇ search NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Gu Xing stared blankly at the transformed elf before him, her beauty reflecting in his pupils was suffocating——
She was no longer the immature girl but had truly inherited the power of life...
An Elf Goddess!
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Strength: 6510→12000]
[Constitution: 6520→12000]
[Spirit: 15000→20000]
[Speed: 6500→12000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, Natural Domain]
[Special State: Eternal Life (Vera will gain extremely strong life recovery and spiritual power recovery)]
When Gu Xing finally saw Vera’s renewed attribute panel, all doubts were finally resolved——
So that’s why...
It wasn’t just an illusion that Vera’s strength seemed weaker before.
As the last royal bloodline of the Elf Race, she should never have been much inferior to Liu Li and Qing Shuang!
Now with the Divine Pattern returned, Vera had begun to show her true strength!
At this moment, Vera’s Spiritual Attribute had impressively reached 20000 points!
If she used the 3x amplification of "Elf Monarchy", and combined it with the 400% increase of Soul Devouring Talent...
A complete 12x multiplication!
This figure caused Gu Xing’s breath to catch.
This meant Vera’s Spiritual Attribute would completely crush that Monarch Level Demon Race!
More crucially——
The fighting style of the Spiritual Attribute is entirely different from that of the Strength Attribute.
Although Qing Shuang’s strength was astonishing, other attributes limited her ability to truly hit the agile Demon Monarch.
But Vera...
She didn’t even need to get close!
As a purely ranged attack-type Guardian Beast, she could complete her attacks while standing at her original position!
More excitingly, after absorbing the Divine Pattern, Vera’s skill panel surprisingly added a brand new skill...
[Life Blooming: Can absorb the essence of life from all plants within a hundred-mile radius, catalyzed by spiritual power into a destructive energy torrent]
At this moment.
Vera slightly raised her head, her green eyes reflected the fierce battle in the sky.
As Gu Xing’s Contracted Beast, Gu Xing did not have her participate in this battle.
She knew very well...
With her original strength, she was utterly powerless at this level of battle.
But at this moment...
Her slender feet slowly left the ground, and the emerald green Divine Ring behind her suddenly bloomed!
"Elf Monarchy" fully activated instantly, and Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring amplification descended simultaneously.
It’s time!
Vera’s arms stretched out, her ten fingers gently closed like picking a flower.
In an instant——
The plants within several miles shook wildly!
Towering ancient trees visibly shriveled at a speed visible to the naked eye, thousand-year-old shrubs turned to fly ash in an instant, and even lichens and moss lost the last hints of greenery.
And between her palms, countless firefly-like green light points were frantically gathering.
These pure essences of life kept compressing and refining, gradually forming a heart-palpitating emerald light sphere.
The entire battlefield was turning into a dead zone, and all vitality...
Was concentrated in those delicate slender hands!
In the sky.
The battle suddenly split apart, and the three figures each retreated several hundred meters.
The Demon Monarch shook his numb arm, a hint of fear flashed in his eyes, which was quickly replaced with ridicule:
"Interesting... A mere human talent can push you to such extent."
He licked his fangs, his gaze shifting between the two Guardian Beasts.
"But... How long can this state last?"
From the previous confrontation, he realized...
The power of these two Guardian Beasts truly reached Monarch Level!
If he himself hadn’t already reached King Tier Three, he might really lose to them.
But...
The Demon Monarch’s lips curled into a cruel arc.
He clearly perceived that their power completely relied on that human’s spiritual power for support.
And the human’s spiritual power...
How long can it endure?!
As long as he drags this out for a while, he will undoubtedly win this battle.
"When your strange state concludes..."
"I will break your limbs first, and then slowly tear your master apart right before your eyes!"
Each word was like a poisoned dagger, piercing precisely the two Guardian Beasts’ most fragile mental defenses.
In a Monarch Level battle, victory and defeat often depended on a single thought, as any slight flaw could become a fatal setback!
Qing Shuang’s Ghost Claw tightened unconsciously, Liu Li’s wings also trembled slightly.
Both their hearts sank to the bottom.
They had already tried all killing moves——
But none had inflicted substantial damage on this Demon Race!
Even worse, as time passed, they could clearly feel Gu Xing’s spiritual power rapidly depleting...
If this continues...
They will surely lose!
And the consequences of losing...
Both their palms clenched unconsciously.
However, at this moment.
A clear mental command suddenly stabbed into their minds!
"Control this Monarch Level Demon Race!"
Feeling Gu Xing’s instruction, their pupils contracted fiercely at the same time, exchanging glances in a split second.
Although Gu Xing’s thoughts were unclear, however...
The master’s command must be executed instantly; this is the basic duty of a Guardian Beast!
The next second, they reacted almost simultaneously!
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 151: The Invasion Ends!
chapters.content:
Chapter 151: Chapter 151: The Invasion Ends!
At this moment.
Gu Xing stood beside Vera, his pupils reflecting that increasingly dazzling emerald green light ball.
The vitality within dozens of miles had been completely extracted, turning the entire land into an ashen dead zone——
And all the life force was now compressed between Vera’s trembling, delicate hands.
Such an extent of energy...
Even with Vera’s current spiritual attribute as high as 240,000 points, controlling such a vast amount of energy left her face pale, with fine blood pearls even appearing on her slender arms.
But the girl bit her teeth and held on until the moment the light ball in her hands reached a critical point——
"Go!"
She suddenly released control, and the life torrent condensed to the extreme instantly transformed into an emerald green giant dragon!
The space shattered layer by layer like fragile glass as the giant dragon passed, rushing towards the battlefield in the sky with world-destroying might!
High above.
"Blazing Flame Spear!"
"Ghost Race Third Technique: Heaven-Breaking!"
Two furious shouts erupted simultaneously.
Liu Li transformed into a red stream of light, the Wings of the End drawing a scorching trajectory in the void.
Qing Shuang, utilizing Fei Yue’s Void Talent, mysteriously disappeared from the spot, appearing beside the Demon Race in the next second——
"Boom!"
A heavy fist enveloped in Netherworld Ghost Qi and a spear wrapped in Ultimate Fire attacked at the same time!
The Monarch Level Demon King merely snorted coldly, his arm muscles bulging as he simultaneously blocked both attacks.Thɪs novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
His left hand accurately clasped Qing Shuang’s fist, while his right hand tightly clamped Liu Li’s spear tip.
Seeing their attack, a hint of disdain flickered in his eyes.
"Stubborn fools!"
The previous battle had made him thoroughly familiar with these two Guardian Beasts’ attack styles.
Their instantaneous bursts were terrifyingly powerful!
However....
The Demon King’s hands flashed with demon patterns.
Although he couldn’t release his domain power outside his body right now....
Using domain to locally enhance his body’s strength was exceedingly simple for him.
And this was also why he could continually withstand the attacks from the Guardian Beasts!
"I’ve figured out both of your attack patterns! You can see it yourselves, causing any harm to me is incredibly difficult!"
"Give up. If you are willing to join the Demon Race, perhaps I can spare your human master!"
His scarlet eyes looked at the two Guardian Beasts with a hint of remorse.
With talents as horrific as these two Guardian Beasts, if they couldn’t join the Demon Race...
He shook his head.
What a pity!
However, just as the Monarch Level Demon King prepared to counterattack——
Liu Li and Qing Shuang suddenly changed their moves!
The two unexpectedly reversed their grips and clasped his wrists!
"Hmm?"
This unexpected turn startled the Demon Race monarch.
Something’s off!
The Demon King was alarmed. A strong combat intuition instantly alerted him——
This was a trap!
His spiritual power swept frantically over the battlefield, and in the next second, his body suddenly froze.
An emerald green dragon, without any sign of energy leakage, was tearing through the sky at terrifying speed!
How could this be?!
When?!
His pupils contracted violently.
Even though this attack contained world-destroying energy, it bizarrely leaked no fluctuations!
It was only after probing with spiritual power that he felt the unparalleled threat this attack posed to him!
"Get away!"
The Demon King let out a hysterical roar, the demonic Qi within him erupting like a volcano!
He exerted all his strength, attempting to free his arms from the Guardian Beasts’ control.
However...
At this moment, Qing Shuang and Liu Li no longer held back in the slightest!
On the left, Netherworld Ghost Qi continuously burst forth, while on the right, Ultimate Fire burned fiercely.
They both understood that this was a hard-won opportunity.
They absolutely couldn’t miss it!!
The two did everything they could to restrain the Demon Race’s body.
"Damn it!"
For the first time, fear crept onto the Monarch Level Demon King’s face.
Never in his dreams had he imagined being cornered by a mere Commander Tier Two human!
The emerald green Dragon of Life was already within reach!
The Demon King’s entire body trembled, wild demonic Qi surging within.
He launched a frenzied attack at Liu Li and Qing Shuang, but under Gu Xing’s "Sovereign Guardian" enhancement, these hasty attacks were like tickling.
It’s too late.....
Watching the approaching destructive energy, he let out a beast-like roar, all his domain power inside him surging like a breached dam towards his chest.
The black demon patterns frenziedly spread across his body surface, covering him entirely in an instant.
"You want to kill me?!"
At the very last moment as the Dragon of Life was about to strike, he finally broke free from his shackles.
But it was too late to dodge——
"Then come!"
His eyes were filled with ferocity.
He refused to believe!
He refused to believe an attack released by a mere Commander Tier Two Guardian Beast could kill him!
"Boom——!!!"
The earth-shattering explosion echoed across the clouds.
Qing Shuang reacted quickly, instantly tearing the space to escape into a fissure.
Fei Yue flashed in time, teleporting Liu Li out of the danger zone.
In the next moment——
The destructive shockwave swept across the entire sky!
The blinding white light, like the rising sun, thoroughly dispersed the thick demonic clouds.
The once-arrogant Monarch Level Demon King was nowhere to be seen.
It was over...
Gu Xing watched this scene and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Vera’s terrifying spiritual attribute of 240,000 points, combined with his "Slaughter" status that ignored defense.
This Monarch Level Demon King ultimately couldn’t withstand it!
The moment the Dragon of Life made contact with the Demon Race, the energy containing ultimate vitality melted away all the demonic Qi inside!
The body of the Demon Race began to crumble——
First the skin cracked, then the flesh dissolved, and finally even the bones turned to ashes.
In the face of this pure life torrent, he couldn’t even scream before he was utterly obliterated between heaven and earth.
Sunlight once again spilled over the land.
The exploded life energy nourished the parched earth like spring rain.
The dead zone previously drained of vitality was now reviving at a speed visible to the naked eye...
New shoots broke through the soil, fresh branches sprouted, and in the blink of an eye, they grew into even denser forests than before.
Life Blooming...
Just as the name of this skill suggests, the passing of one life cycle will inevitably bring about the blooming of another.
In front of Lin Yuan City, there was a deathly silence.
Gu Qianqian and others stood in place, staring incredulously at the sky.
The figure that was once arrogant and domineering had completely vanished.
"Did it really...succeed?"
"Gu Xing... really killed a Monarch Level Demon Race!"
After the brief shock, before the cheers even erupted, everyone’s expressions dimmed again.
Although the city was saved, those lost lives...
Would never return!
At this moment, the divine pattern on Gu Xing’s forehead greedily absorbed the energy after slaying this Monarch Level Demon Race.
As the energy flowed in, his perception of the borders of Longxia Country became increasingly clear——
This is...
The locations of the remaining four spatial rifts surfaced in his mind one by one.
After carefully sensing them for a moment.
He discovered...
Except for Lin Yuan City, the main battlefield, the other three spots were successfully defended.
With a slight movement of thought, the three rifts began slowly closing, eventually disappearing completely.
This also meant that the nationwide Demon Race invasion had finally...
Completely ended!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 152: Snow Race! Healing and Support!
chapters.content:
Chapter 152: Chapter 152: Snow Race! Healing and Support!
Although they managed to repel this Demon Race invasion, the price Longxia Country paid was simply too devastating—
The Monarch Level powerhouse Ying Tian has fallen!
Countless Commander Level and Fake King Level Beast Masters died on the battlefield!
Not to mention Sally’s sacrifice, and Ying Bing being on the brink of death...
Thinking of all this, Gu Xing’s mood grew heavier.
He subconsciously swept his Spiritual Power across the Soul Nourishing Pool at that fragile soul.
Looking at the former little maid now lying quietly in the Soul Nourishing Pool, a dull ache swept through his chest.
"Master..."
The weak voice pulled him back to reality.
Vera wobbled as she flew back to his side, her delicate little face white as paper.
The attack just now had almost drained all her Power.
Gu Xing hurriedly reached out to steady her teetering body.
Feeling the warmth in his palm, the tips of Vera’s ears uncontrollably flushed, but forced herself to calm down soon after.
Right now, there was something more important—she had to help her master pull himself together!
"Master, Sally will be fine!"
"The Time Spirit Race is the most mysterious Race in the Alternate Space, and she’s now at the critical stage of transforming into a Time Spirit."
With Vera’s reminder, Gu Xing finally noticed with his Spiritual Power...
[Time Spirit Race (Sally)]
[Status: Transforming]
[Talent: Ordinary One Star]
[Level: Awakening Tier One]
[Power: 0]
[Constitution: 0]
[Spirit: 100]
[Speed: 0]
[Skills: None]
Sally’s Race had actually become the Time Spirit Race.The most update n0vels are published on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
And—just in this brief moment...
Sally’s Spiritual Attribute had actually reached 100 points!
And her Soul Body had clearly stabilized a lot as well.
"This purest state of soul is exactly the necessary process for the Time Spirit Race’s transformation."
"As long as she completes the transformation, she will definitely wake up!"
As Power returned, Vera’s sealed memories gradually grew clear.
In the Alternate Space, only Races capable of forming Divine Patterns could be called top-tier Races.
And the Time Spirit Race—
was the first Race to ever form Divine Patterns!
She’d heard her mother mention once, that this Race even possessed the ability to manipulate time, though no one knows why it was wiped out by history.
So their Divine Pattern was lost because of this!
And with Sally now transforming into the Time Spirit Race, it means...
The lost Divine Pattern of the Time Spirit Race has a chance to return!
"So Master, don’t worry, Sally will definitely be alright!"
Gu Xing turned and met Vera’s seriously emerald-green eyes.
At that moment, the taut strings in his heart finally relaxed just a little—
It would be enough if Sally could wake up!
Just then, Fei Yue, Liu Li, and Qing Shuang finished cleaning up the battlefield and returned one by one to Gu Xing’s side.
Liu Li’s gaze landed on Vera in Gu Xing’s arms, but, in a rare moment, she didn’t say a word.
If not for this little scheming elf, there’s no way they could have defeated that Monarch Level Demon Race.
Even though she felt sour inside, seeing Vera’s face so pale it was almost translucent...
She couldn’t even maintain her usual childish look!
So even though Liu Li’s heart was burning with envy, she still chose to quietly return to the Beast Taming Space!
She would let this little scheming green elf have time with Master just this once!
Just this once!
Seeing this, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue sensibly disappeared as well.
Vera greedily took a deep breath, memorizing the familiar scent from Gu Xing’s body deep in her heart.
A moment later, she forced herself upright, gently pushing away Gu Xing’s helping hand:
"Master, I’m fine now."
"Go check on Ying Bing, quick!"
Vera knew clearly that Gu Xing’s thoughts were all on Sally and Ying Bing.
As for Ying Bing, Vera found it hard to dislike her.
That girl clearly loved Master deeply but didn’t realize it herself, even burning away her life to defend Lin Yuan City...
Compared to her...
Vera felt incredibly fortunate!
At least, she could always stay by her master’s side.
Gu Xing brought Vera to Gu Qianqian, greeted her simply, then locked his gaze on Ying Bing.
He turned to Vera, his look carrying a question—
As a Natural Spirit, Vera’s Perception of Life Force was the sharpest.
She understood instantly and checked Ying Bing’s Status.
As the investigation deepened, Vera’s brows furrowed tighter and tighter—
This...
There wasn’t even a trace of Life Force inside Ying Bing!
From her meridians to her organs, it was all as parched as a desert.
What’s worse, some strange power was clinging to her bones, constantly devouring what little vitality remained...
She instantly realized, this bizarre power was...
This was the Ying Family’s bloodline defect!
If not for the Spring of Life constantly providing Life Force, she might have already...
Vera took a deep breath, deliberated for a long time, then softly spoke:
"Master, Ying Bing’s current Status..."
"It’s very bad!"
Actually, it wasn’t just very bad—it was as bad as it could get.
Vera’s voice carried some helplessness:
"Even though I can draw Life Force from plants, her body right now..."
"Can’t endure it at all!"
"Besides, we Elf Clan aren’t good at healing others!"
Though the Elf Clan can manipulate Life Force...
Most of the time, it’s used for combat instead!
When she draws Life Force from plants it’s incredibly wild, and if she transferred it into Ying Bing, it would only hasten her death.
After hearing Vera’s explanation, Gu Xing’s eyes dimmed.
Looking at that girl lying quietly in the Spring of Life, his heart clenched painfully.
He still remembered promising Ying Tian that he would help Ying Bing solve the bloodline problem.
But now...
Let alone solving Ying Bing’s bloodline problem, whether this girl could wake up again was a question!
Gu Qianqian at the side heard this too, her voice trembling:
"Is there... really no way?"
Seeing her Master’s sister speak, Vera strained her mind for a solution.
Suddenly, her eyes lit up:
"Master, the Snow Race can do it!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing perked up instantly.
"The Snow Race?"
"In my memory, the Snow Race is the best Race at healing and support."
"If they treat Ying Bing, she should be able to wake up!"
"But the problem is..."
She paused, her face becoming grave:
"Right now, with Demon Race entrenched, the Snow Race lives in the Ice and Snow Kingdom, north of the Blood-colored Church in Alternate Space!"
"So if you want to get there, there’s only one way... to cross the Blood-colored Church!"
Hearing Ying Bing could still be saved, Gu Xing’s anxious heart finally settled down.
As for what Vera said about having to go through the Blood-colored Church...
Gu Xing didn’t hesitate!
Although he had offended the Blood Ancestor before, Ying Bing’s injuries couldn’t wait.
And also...
When he returned to the Beast Taming Academy, he’d learned another piece of news.
Light Divine Crystal!
The last material Liu Li needs to awaken!
It was in the hands of the Blood-colored Church!
One more thing.
The space passage in Longxia Country was sealed, to return to the Alternate Space, one had to go to the Council and Blood-colored Church.
So the Blood-colored Church must be visited!
But before that, the situation in Longxia Country had to be settled!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 153: Blood Race? I’ll Handle It Myself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 153: Chapter 153: Blood Race? I’ll Handle It Myself!
After the decision was made, Gu Xing planned to take Ying Bing back to the Imperial Capital Ying Family first.
After all, concerning the bloodline defect of the Ying Family, no one understands it better than themselves.
Moreover, now through the Spring of Life, they can only temporarily stabilize Ying Bing’s life force from dissipating.
This is ultimately not a long-term solution!
Therefore, going back to the Ying Family to inquire about possible solutions is the best choice.
Taking a deep breath, Gu Xing turned his head to look at Gu Qianqian.
The last time they met was before he went to the Northern Territory, and now their reunion was brief, yet they had to part again...
Whether it was Ying Bing’s injuries or delivering the news that Blue Star was safe...
Each task was urgent.
"Sis..."
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Gu Qianqian came to her senses.
Looking at the young man standing in front of her, she suddenly realized...
The boy who used to follow behind her had now grown half a head taller than her.
Clearly at Commander Tier Two, yet already capable of slaying Monarch Level Demon Race.
Seeing her brother’s hesitation, she felt a sense of relief.
As his strength grew, the responsibilities on his shoulders would only get heavier...
"Go."
She suddenly reached out and ruffled Gu Xing’s hair, just like when they were young.
"But you must promise me—"
Gu Qianqian’s gaze fell on the girl lying in the Spring of Life.
She had promised this silly girl that if she survived this time...
She would pair this silly girl with her brother.
But now...
She successfully survived, but this silly girl didn’t know when she would wake up.
Turning her head, she looked at Gu Xing with a solemn gaze:
"You must bring this silly girl back unharmed."
Gu Xing nodded heavily.
Without Gu Qianqian’s reminder, he was determined to accomplish this himself.
"Sis, I’ll leave here to you all, I’ll take Ying Bing back to the Ying Family first!"
"Hmm, go ahead."
Gu Qianqian watched her brother turn away, although the battle in Lin Yuan City had ended, but the Demonic Qi on the battlefield was still surging.
If not purified in time, new Demon Race might emerge threatening nearby cities.
At this moment, Shen Ruoxue, who had previously left, appeared from the void.
She had confirmed whether the other battlefields had issues.
Seeing Gu Xing, she spoke softly:
"The other three cracks have healed, no Demon Race remains."
"However... the Void Gate to the Alternate Space remains closed."
Although Blue Star’s crisis was temporarily resolved, over in the Alternate Space—
Long Zhenguo and the others...
What was their situation like?
None of this was known!
Thus, he needed to enter the Alternate Space as soon as possible.
"Ruoxue, take us to the Imperial Capital first!"
Shen Ruoxue nodded and used her talent to take Gu Xing and Ying Bing back to the Imperial Capital.
Gu Qianqian stood where she was until the spatial ripples completely calmed before she withdrew her gaze.
She took a deep breath, turned to everyone and said:
"Begin purifying the Demonic Qi, tally casualties—"
...
Elsewhere.
Within the Alternate Space.
Demon Race Camp.
An oppressive aura enveloped the entire camp, even the air seemed to solidify.
All Monarch Level Demon Race held their breath, even the Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings maintained a single-knee kneeling posture, their foreheads nearly touching the ground.
In the center of the tent, a tall figure stood with hands behind his back.
His face was no different from humans, but in those dark purple pupils, a Demon Pattern was reflected.
This was a genuine Demon God!
All Demon Gods resided in the Demon Abyss.
However, a thousand years ago, a change completely altered the landscape—
The passage between the Demon Abyss and the Alternate Space was sealed by mysterious forces, all Totem Level and above Demon Race were locked in the Demon Abyss, unable to descend into the Alternate Space.
Damn seal!
A trace of ruthlessness flashed in the Demon God’s eyes.
He forcibly dispersed his own Demonic Qi and dropped his power from Totem Level to Monarch Peak.
Only then did he manage to deceive the perception of the seal and descend into the Alternate Space.
But upon arriving here...
He heard bad news!
"The plan... failed?"
The icy voice made all Demon Race tremble, heads bowed even lower.
"A bunch of useless fools!"
His gaze swept like a blade over the Demon Kings, each felt soul-wrenching pain but dared not resist.
This Demon God sneered coldly, forcefully suppressing his fury.
The situation is as it is, punishing these worthless ones won’t help.
"All troops, retreat."
He ordered coldly, "Since we can’t obtain the Human Race Divine Pattern, let’s target the other races first."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
As a possessor of the Demon Pattern, he knew the Divine Pattern inside out.
The Human Race possesses three Divine Patterns, each linked to their fate.
Currently, two Divine Patterns have not emerged, so they dare not attack the Human Race.
To prevent the final two Divine Patterns from forming!
And now they’ve seized control of the Divine Secret Realm’s entrance, as soon as the Human Race’s Divine Secret Realm opens.
Those second and third Divine Patterns will definitively fall into their hands.
As for the first one...
Now that the plan to seize the Divine Pattern has failed, there’s no need to waste troops holding Longxia Country anymore.
A few Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings exchanged glances, one of them gathered courage to speak:
"Sir, although we can’t take action against the Human Race, but..."
"The Blood Race seems to be hiding within a Human Race power named the Blood-colored Church!"
This Demon God gave the Demon King a glance, a cruel curve formed on his lips:
"The Blood Race... I will personally handle."
"As for you all..."
He raised his hand, instantly condensing a map of the Alternate Space mid-air.
"Search the entire Alternate Space for me—Ghost Race, Snow Race, Fox Race, Dragon Race... not a single one should be spared!"
The voice echoed through the camp, filling the Demon Race’s eyes with fervent flames.
"Locate their positions, on the day the Demon Abyss seal shatters..."
The Demon God’s figure gradually voidified, his final words lingering like a curse:
"That will be the day these ants are exterminated!"
"As you command!"
Under deafening roars, countless Demon Race turned into a tide of black dispersing away.
...
Longxia Defense Line.
Long Zhenguo stood at the forefront of the defense line, fingers pale from excessive force.
He was completely unaware of Blue Star’s situation.
Though he had dispatched Lei Zhan to the Blood-colored Church, attempting to return to Blue Star by a different path, distant water cannot effectively quench immediate thirst.
If during this time Blue Star has already fallen...
With this possibility in mind, his heart was full of guilt.
He put too much emphasis on the Alternate Space, not anticipating the Demon Race’s ability to block the Void Gate.
And even finding a method to reach Blue Star.
This led to Blue Star being in such a predicament.
However, at this moment.
"Boom——"
Suddenly, the Demon Race army on the horizon began to retreat.
Long Zhenguo’s pupils shrank, the unexpected change froze him completely.
Retreating?
The skirmishes during this time showed him the Demon Race’s target was always the Divine Pattern.
Retreating now only meant two possibilities—
Either the Divine Pattern was obtained, or the operation failed.
Long Zhenguo’s Adam’s apple moved, palms drenched in cold sweat.
He stared at the retreating Demon Race like a tide, incessantly praying:
I hope it’s not the first possibility...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 154: Restriction Shattered!
chapters.content:
Chapter 154: Chapter 154: Restriction Shattered!
Imperial Capital, outside the Ying Family gate.
Gu Xing’s fingers hovered in the air, unable to knock on the vermilion-painted door.
He truly didn’t know how to begin...
How to tell the Ying people that Ying Bing’s life now hangs by a thread!
But this must be faced...
After hesitating at the door for a long time, he took a deep breath and finally pushed open the heavy door.
Before his eyes, there was nothing but glaring white silk, silently fluttering in the wind.
Gu Xing’s heart clenched fiercely.
It wasn’t just Ying Bing, but also Ying Tian...
Soon, Ying Xinghe received the notice and appeared in front of Gu Xing.
"I’m sorry, Teacher Ying..."
Gu Xing’s words caused Ying Xinghe’s steps to pause.
When his gaze fell behind Gu Xing—
At the girl in the Spring of Life, pale as paper, he was struck as if by lightning.
"How could this be..."
Ying Xinghe staggered back half a step, his mind shaken.
The clan leader had just fallen, and now even the young lady...
He seemed to age ten years in an instant, yet still forced himself to speak:
"No... it’s not your fault..."
"This was the young lady’s own choice!"
Back then, he had advised Ying Bing not to participate in this action.
However...
Ying Bing refused!
Without the slightest hesitation, she refused!
She decisively chose the battlefield where Lin Yuan City was, as for the reason...
Ying Xinghe’s gaze fell on Gu Xing.The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
Because Lin Yuan City was related to Gu Xing!
Seeing Ying Xinghe’s reaction, Gu Xing realized that Ying Xinghe might have misunderstood, and hurriedly said:
"Although Ying Bing’s life force is constantly depleting, she can still be saved!"
"As long as we can find the Snow Race, she can be fully restored!"
"I came here to ask whether the Ying family has any way to curb the loss of life force?"
"What did you say?" Ying Xinghe’s murky eyes suddenly burst with light, "She... can be saved?"
He just felt that Ying Bing’s condition was exactly the same as Ying Tian’s at that time.
They both sacrificed all their life force, which is why they were in a near-exhaustion state.
But now...
"There is a way!"
Ying Xinghe’s withered fingers slightly trembled with excitement as he grabbed Gu Xing:
"Come with me, quickly!"
Passing through layers of courtyards, the two reached the core ancestral house of the Ying family.
As soon as the door opened, a biting cold rushed in.
In the center of the room, there was an exquisite transparent ice coffin placed!
"This ice coffin can completely seal life force! Just place the young lady inside..."
Without a second thought, Gu Xing carefully lifted Ying Bing from the Spring of Life.
At the moment of leaving the water, the girl’s smooth skin began to dry and wrinkle at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Oh no!
He took a quick step forward, gently placing Ying Bing into the ice coffin.
With the click of the coffin lid closing, Ying Bing’s body gradually returned to normal!
"Ah—"
Ying Xinghe let out a long breath and then frowned:
"But how can you break through the Demon Race’s restriction?"
He hadn’t forgotten that now the entire Longxia Country was shrouded in the Demon Race’s restriction.
Previously, he tried, but leaving aside...
Even sending messages was difficult!
"I have a way for this!"
Regarding the restriction...
With the existence of the Breaking Realm Blade of the Angel Race, Gu Xing wasn’t worried.
Seeing this, Ying Xinghe’s tightly knit brows finally relaxed a bit.
"Right," he suddenly remembered something, "you can put the ice coffin into the Beast Taming Space. Now, it is no different from a dead object..."
Besides contracted guardian beasts, the Beast Taming Space can only store some dead objects.
Upon hearing Ying Xinghe’s words, Gu Xing immediately tried it.
His spiritual power contacted the ice coffin.
In the next moment, the ice coffin turned into a stream of light, instantly merging into his brow.
Gu Xing sensed it.
In the Beast Taming Space, the crystalline coffin quietly floated, Ying Bing’s pale face looming in the cold mist.
Seeing Ying Bing’s figure disappear, Ying Xinghe patted Gu Xing’s shoulder.
"Gu Xing, I’m counting on you!"
As he turned, his back stooped a bit more.
The clan leader had fallen, and the Ying family needed him to hold up this sky.
Just as he took two steps, he suddenly stopped.
"Wait!"
He retrieved an item from the Beast Taming Space and solemnly handed it to Gu Xing:
"This was what the young lady... specifically instructed us to find earlier."
Gu Xing’s gaze moved over.
Only then did he realize...
[Snow Crystal]
[Function: Enhance the talent of the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix clan]
Previously, he had told Ying Bing about the three materials needed to enhance the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix.
Snow Crystal, Snow Lotus, Cold Marrow!
However, he didn’t say it was needed for the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix’s enhancement.
Instead, he told Ying Bing it was what he himself needed.
Unexpectedly, the Ying family had found one of them.
"Also," Ying Xinghe’s voice pulled him back to reality.
"The Cold Marrow is in the hands of Veronica in the Council."
"You know Miss Veronica, so you should be able to get it from her."
The Council!
Gu Xing’s eyes moved slightly.
Traveling to the Blood-colored Church just happens to go via the Council, and he can conveniently obtain the Cold Marrow from Veronica.
After bidding farewell to the Ying family, Gu Xing’s gaze fell upon the restriction in the sky.
The first thing to do next is—
Break the restriction!
"Soul-devouring!"
Blood-colored spiritual power suddenly erupted, and Liu Li was simultaneously engulfed in Ultimate Fire.
Twelve wings spread behind her, instantly entering the Doomsday Angel Form!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Power: 15000→90000]
[Constitution: 15000→90000]
[Spirit: 15000→90000]
[Speed: 15000→90000]
[Special State: Oath Guardian]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain]
At the same time.
The divine pattern on Gu Xing’s forehead glowed, frantically extracting Heaven and Earth Spiritual Power to inject into the Breaking Realm Blade.
He gained insight into this usage after absorbing King-level Demon Race energy.
For the spiritual power in this region of Blue Star Longxia Country, he already had an initial mastery.
He was about to break through to Commander Tier Five after slaying so many Demon Race members.
It seemed that the divine intervention of the divine angels was forcing him to confront his domain control issues.
And skipping this step would surely limit his future achievements!
If the excess energy had not been completely absorbed by the divine pattern on his forehead, it would surely hinder his solid foundation.
Being limited in his level advancement seemed to be a blessing in disguise.
If he were to skip this step...
His future achievements would certainly not be too high!
Therefore, the divine pattern restricting his level advancement seemed to be a good thing for him as well.
"Alright, are you ready?"
Liu Li’s golden pupils reflected the restriction in the sky, and flames of Ultimate Fire burned around her.
The next moment—
The sound of judgment echoed!
The Breaking Realm Blade, carrying a destructive momentum, slashed fiercely across the restriction in the sky!
The next moment—
"Judgment!"
Liu Li transformed into a stream of crimson-gold light, fiercely slicing through the restriction in the sky, distorting the space as she passed.
With the overpowering force of the Breaking Realm Blade, she struck the restriction mercilessly!
The whole restriction collapsed with earth-shattering momentum, scattering like rain of light over the sky!
All at once...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 155: Blood-colored Church Upheaval
chapters.content:
Chapter 155: Chapter 155: Blood-colored Church Upheaval
With the barrier shattered, the only obstacle blocking his departure had disappeared.
Immediately afterward, he requested a flying beast from Ying Xinghe.
Although Commander Level already possessed the ability to fly, the council and Longxia Country were separated by the sea, and the distance was not close.
Therefore, to reach the council’s location, it was necessary to use the world’s unique mode of transportation—the flying beast.
One day later.
The outline of the council’s capital finally appeared on the horizon.
To Gu Xing’s surprise, a grand welcoming formation was already arranged outside the city gate.
Two rows of Commander Level Beast Masters stood solemnly on either side, while Veronica, in the center, wore an ink-green evening gown.
This is too much...
Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
He expected Veronica to welcome him but didn’t anticipate such a grandiose noble-style scene.
As the flying beast gradually descended, Veronica had already gracefully lifted her dress and walked over.
At this moment, Veronica fully embodied the appearance of a noble lady.
But she was originally a noble young lady!
A true noble young lady!
As the daughter of the council’s chief, her status was unparalleled in the council.
"Give me your hand."
Before Gu Xing could react, Veronica had naturally taken his arm.
???
Gu Xing instinctively wanted to shake it off.
But he heard Veronica’s low, gritted-teeth threat in his ear:
"If you dare to shake it off, you’re dead!"
This familiar tone immediately put Gu Xing at ease.
This was the Veronica he knew.
The dignified appearance of Veronica just now truly made him uncomfortable.
"What’s with the big display?" Gu Xing lowered his voice and asked, "I’m just here to collect some materials."
Veronica maintained a perfect smile, her lips barely moving as she quietly replied:
"You think I enjoy putting on airs? The old man insisted on seeing you; I was forced to do this too!"
Hearing the term "old man," Gu Xing immediately understood...
Verocan wanted to see him!
But upon second thought, it made sense.
After all, the Human Race’s first Divine Pattern was in his possession, and now that he was on the council’s territory, how could Verocan not meet him?!
Understanding this point, Gu Xing felt much more at ease.
Under everyone’s attention, Veronica led him into a lavishly decorated banquet hall.
As the door slowly closed, Gu Xing surveyed this magnificent banquet hall.ɪꜰ ʏᴏᴜ ᴡᴀɴᴛ ᴛᴏ ʀᴇᴀᴅ ᴍᴏʀᴇ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs, ᴘʟᴇᴀsᴇ ᴠɪsɪᴛ ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
Fourteen gilded long tables were arranged in a circular formation.
All twelve of the council’s Monarch Level experts were present.
They were all the Monarch Level experts of the council!
The elder in the center, who bore a slight resemblance to Veronica, should be the council’s chief, Verocan.
He was also a Monarch Peak expert, whose power was on par with Long Zhenguo.
The two empty seats intentionally left beside Verocan were clearly prepared for him and Veronica.
At this time, a servant respectfully guided him and Veronica to sit beside Verocan.
Once the two sat down, Verocan first broke the silence:
"Young friend Gu Xing is truly a promising talent! So young and already reached Commander Level Beast Master."
Verocan was genuinely praising, not merely agreeing.
From Veronica, he knew Gu Xing’s combat power was strong, having already possessed Commander Level battle power at the Extraordinary Peak.
Now that he had reached Commander Level, his strength would only be more terrifying!
The other Monarch Levels present also began to praise him.
Gu Xing wasn’t very good with such situations, so he could only nod awkwardly in response to everyone’s praises.
Noticing his discomfort, Verocan changed the subject:
"The front lines are temporarily stable, the Demon Race has retreated!"
"Although the Northern Territory has completely fallen, nothing has happened to Longxia Country!"
Hearing the last sentence, Gu Xing breathed a sigh of relief.
He was worried about the people in Longxia Country; now that he knew they were safe, the anxiety in his heart finally dissipated.
At this moment, Verocan’s gaze turned deep, staring directly at the Divine Pattern on his forehead:
"However.... this Divine Pattern, can it really allow us to break through to Totem Level?"
Kaven finally asked the most pressing question.
But this question left Gu Xing momentarily speechless.
The current discovery of the Divine Pattern’s function was indeed limited—
Besides sensing parts of Blue Star’s situation and manipulating Spiritual Qi, it seemed to have no special effect.
As for helping a Monarch Peak to breakthrough to Totem Level?
That was something he was even more clueless about.
And during this period, based on the information received from Vera.
It seemed more like a condensation of a race’s fortune.
The Demon Race’s capturing of the Divine Pattern was essentially usurping a race’s fortune.
A race that loses its Divine Pattern quickly falls into decline until extinction in a short period.
He speculated that to truly understand the use of the Divine Pattern...
Perhaps he would have to reach Totem Level to fully comprehend it.
At this time, Verocan also read the answer from Gu Xing’s expression.
He sighed lightly.
The Human Race’s history in the Alternate Space was too short.
He, Long Zhenguo, and the Empress from the Holy See, had not been at Monarch Peak for long.
Through the World Tree’s enlightenment, they knew only the Human Race with a Divine Pattern had a chance to enter Totem Level!
But the subsequent questions from Verocan made Gu Xing increasingly uneasy.
Verocan even began asking about his personal feelings and, indirectly, if he had any girls he fancied.
Just as the awkwardness was about to reach its peak, the torturous banquet finally ended.
Once again, it was Veronica who took him away.
As they were leaving, Veronica slipped an item into his hand.
[Cold Marrow]
[Function: Enhance the talent of the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix]
Just as Gu Xing was about to express his gratitude, Veronica waved him off:
"Don’t start with that!"
"This thing isn’t that important!"
But then she paused, her tone suddenly serious:
"There’s been a change in the Blood-colored Church recently, and all our connections with them are cut off. If you’re planning to go there... be careful."
Upon hearing Veronica’s kind reminder, Gu Xing nodded, indicating he understood.
As for Veronica, just as she was about to leave, she suddenly paused:
"By the way, there’s something the old man was too embarrassed to say."
"Gu Xing, if in the future the council faces difficulties, please lend a hand to the council. As for the reward..."
Even someone with Veronica’s personality rarely showed such embarrassment.
That insufferably frivolous old man!
After silently cursing him, she turned to look at Gu Xing, with a hint of hesitation in her eyes.
She took a deep breath to maintain a calm tone.
"As for the reward... it definitely won’t disappoint you!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing nodded, agreeing to the request.
He knew Verocan valued his potential, which is why he made such a request.
But he had a positive impression of the council, even if Veronica hadn’t mentioned it today....
In the future, if the council encountered any difficulty, he surely wouldn’t stand by!
Afterward, he bid farewell to Veronica and prepared to head towards the Blood-colored Church.
However, he made a slight change to the route.
Originally, he planned to reach the Alternate Space through the Blood-colored Church’s Void Gate, but now with changes there...
He chose to directly enter the Alternate Space through the council’s Gate of Space!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 156: Disgraced Lilith
chapters.content:
Chapter 156: Chapter 156: Disgraced Lilith
Alternate Space.
Blood-colored Church border.
In the small town shrouded in twilight, a group of bats gathered, gradually forming a petite figure.
Lilith stumbled and leaned against the mottled wall, her face extremely pale, her small body constantly trembling.
This once formidable Totem Level Blood Ancestor was now in dire straits!
"Damn..."
After the last Divine Secret Realm concluded.
Her strength had fallen to King Tier Five.
This information, somehow, had been discovered by a group of Blood Princes at Monarch Peak.
Strength is supreme for the Blood Ancestor.
Her decline in power was a blatant temptation for the Blood Race.
As long as they killed her, they could become the next Blood Ancestor.
Under such temptation, all the Monarch Peak Blood Race united to besiege her.
If she hadn’t been Totem Level before, she would have perished in that battle.
But even so...
To successfully escape, she nearly exhausted all the energy in her body.
Her current level had even dropped below King Level, now only at Commander Level.
However, the true threat at this moment came not from the Blood Race.
As the Blood Ancestor, she had countless ways to avoid her kin’s pursuit.
"Blood Ancestor, don’t be in such a rush to leave~"
A frivolous voice came from the eaves.
Lilith jerked her head up, seeing a slender figure lazily swinging her legs, a mocking smile on her lips.
Damn it!
Lilith’s face changed drastically.
Since she had fallen to Commander Level, this Demon Race had been shadowing her relentlessly.
Moreover, she had crossed paths with this Demon Race once.
Demon God Level!
The same level as her own.
Even though this Demon God belonged to one of the weaker races among the Demon Race—
The Disguiser race!
But for her current state...
It was still a deadly threat!
Yet this Demon Race had no intention of attacking, instead sticking to her like a leech.Nᴇw novel chapters are publɪshed on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
She tried various methods but never managed to shake him off.
"Blood Ancestor, obediently hand over the Divine Pattern, you can’t escape."
"Hmph!"
Lilith snorted coldly, her body suddenly exploding into countless bats, scattering in all directions.
The Demon Race on the eaves sneered disdainfully:
"Mere futile struggles!"
If it weren’t for fearing this Blood Ancestor’s dying counterattack, he would have finished her off by now.
However...
With time, this Blood Ancestor’s power would undoubtedly weaken.
By then, the Divine Pattern would still fall into his hands!
Thinking this, he shook his head and followed at an unhurried pace.
But he didn’t notice.....
At the spot where Lilith had stood, a drop of scarlet blood quietly seeped into a crack in the brick.
Much later, that drop of blood slowly coalesced into the form of a little girl.
Who am I?
Where is this?
The little girl blinked blankly, wobbling toward the bustling street and soon disappearing into the crowd.
...
On the other side.
