After several days of trekking, Gu Xing finally reached the border of the Blood-colored Church from the Alternate Space.
Just as he landed...
A large group of Blood Race surrounded him.
"Human, no matter where you’re from, being here makes you food and must be uniformly managed!"
The leading Blood Race bared its fangs, "Here, you have to play by the Blood Race’s rules!"
Seeing this, Gu Xing frowned tightly.
The situation was worse than he had imagined.
Though the Blood-colored Church was ruled by the Blood Race, daily management was still self-governed by humans, requiring only periodic blood tribute.
Now, even the small border town was directly controlled by the Blood Race...
However, his silent demeanor angered the Blood Race.
"Courting death!"
The Blood Race could not bear it any longer and attacked directly!
Yet, facing this group of Blood Race...
Gu Xing didn’t even bother summoning his Guardian Beast.
Moreover, having reached Commander Level, he also needed to train his actual combat ability.
This group of Blood Race came just in time!
He needed suitable real combat practice!
He glanced at his Attributes.
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beasts: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit, Ghost Race Qingshuang, Ghost Clan Feiyue]
[Contract Quota: 3/4]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 5000→6000]
[Constitution: 5000→6000]
[Spirit: 5000→6000]
[Speed: 5000→6000]
[Special State: Favor of the Human Race]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might (Beast Master All Attribute Enhancement 300%), Absolute Forbidden Domain (Prohibit Any Domain)]
Even without activating Emperor’s Might, all his attributes had reached 6000 points.
Additionally, with combat experience personally taught by Qingshuang...
His current strength was entirely on par with that of a Commander Level Guardian Beast.
So, against these riffraff Blood Race, he also wanted to try his hand personally.
However...
In the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li anxiously watched the outside world.
Although the strongest among the Blood Race was only Low Tier Commander, this was still Gu Xing’s first time personally engaging, making her inevitably worried.
"No way! Master is a Beast Master and shouldn’t take such risks himself!"
Liu Li said and was about to rush out of the Beast Taming Space.
She decided to handle these Blood Race herself.
But Qingshuang stopped her.
"No way!"
"The master isn’t a delicate flower that needs protection; he can handle all of this himself!"
Qingshuang, being of the Ghost Race, naturally wished for her master to grow stronger and stronger.
Though she too worried about Gu Xing, she believed he could face it all himself.
Vera, who saw the two about to argue, held her forehead with a sigh.
She didn’t know why, but recently, Qingshuang and Liu Li had been prone to arguments.
Could it be the mating season for the Angel Race and the Ghost Race?
She couldn’t figure it out but decided to intervene:
"Sister Liu Li, Sister Qingshuang, please stop arguing~"
"I think both of you have a point!"
Before she could finish, two icy stares shot at her, making Vera shrink her neck in fright.
Forget it, forget it!
Let them argue!
She was just a little low-ranking elf, couldn’t say anything!
However, even though she wasn’t a match for Liu Li and Qingshuang....
She could still tease another little girl who was watching the show.
She sneaked a vine around the observing Fei Yue and then quickly left the Beast Taming Space.
"Eh?"
Fei Yue was suddenly wrapped in a green vine, and before she could react, the scene turned into a battlefield.
She blinked blankly, looking at Vera beside her.
What was the meaning of this?
Vera reached out and pinched Fei Yue’s soft little face:
"Master is fighting; shouldn’t we as Guardian Beasts be supporting on the sidelines?"
Fei Yue tilted her head, looking at Gu Xing and then at her own small build.
Her, support?
That can’t be right!
Meanwhile, Gu Xing set his sights on the leading Commander Level Blood Race.
[Blood Race]
[Level: Commander Tier Three]
[Power: 10000]
[Constitution: 9000]
[Spirit: 7000]
[Speed: 8000]
[Skills: Blood Body, Blood Domain...]
Just an average level!
Capable of fighting!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 157: Sparring Partner!
chapters.content:
Chapter 157: Chapter 157: Sparring Partner!
"Emperor’s Might!"
[Power: 6000→18000]
[Constitution: 6000→18000]
[Spirit: 6000→18000]
[Speed: 6000→18000]
With the blessing of the Emperor’s Might Domain, Gu Xing’s attributes reached 18,000 points!
Though all attributes doubled...
Gu Xing realized at this moment that there was a problem.
Normally, even under the influence of the Soul-devouring Talent and various statuses, the few Guardian Beasts could still control their doubled attributes with ease.
But when it came to himself, he found out...
It’s difficult!
Attributes tripling directly led to his ability to control his body dropping to the lowest point.
The claw of an Extraordinary Level Blood Race sliced through the air, Gu Xing intended to nimbly dodge to the left, but due to unstable control of power, he shot sideways a significant distance.
The ground exploded into several deep pits beneath his feet, gravel flying before he barely stabilized his form.
"This..."
He stared at his hands in a daze.
Only now did he realize the vast difference between humans and Guardian Beasts.
Liu Li, Vera, or Qing Shuang, even when their attributes were ten times greater, could master them in a short time.
But as a human, he could not!
Apart from this...
This was his first time using the Emperor’s Might.
The surging power within vaguely hinted that this Domain was far from a mere attribute increase.
But at this moment, he could only use this one ability!
The Blood Race Commander, witnessing this scene, narrowed his eyes.
He hadn’t expected an outside Commander Level warrior in this border town.ɴᴇᴡ ɴᴏᴠᴇʟ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀʀᴇ ᴘᴜʙʟɪsʜᴇᴅ ᴏɴ ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
"Human, though I’m unclear of your purpose here, if you turn and leave, we can pretend this incident never happened, how about that?"
This Commander Level Blood Race halted other Blood Races’ attacks, instead trying to persuade Gu Xing.
Take note, the Human Race’s strength isn’t in pure combat power, it’s in the Guardian Beasts.
His gaze swept to Vera and Fei Yue nearby.
If this human’s two Guardian Beasts are also Commander Level, fighting might result in mutual injury.
However.
Gu Xing did not intend to relent.
Now he roughly understood why the Divine Pattern hindered his advancement.
He seemed to have neglected his own improvement all along.
Relying on a few Guardian Beasts, he could effortlessly dominate regardless of the opponent.
Moreover, with the Second Domain...
Absolutely fearless of Commander Level or even Monarch Level Domains.
This made him ignore his own strength even more.
But this...
After all, has its problems!
He could rely on defeating the Demon Race to enhance to Commander Peak, even advance to Monarch Level.
But what next?
He had a premonition.
If he doesn’t change now, his limit would merely be Monarch Peak.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing’s gaze suddenly sharpened, locking onto the Blood Race group before him.
From today, he must include his own combat abilities in the improvement plan.
After deciding, he pushed off with his feet, shooting like a cannonball towards the Blood Race.
Seeing Gu Xing’s actions, the Commander Level Blood Race’s face changed.
It seems this human is unwilling to relent!
"Blood Domain!"
He hardened his heart and released his Domain without hesitation.
Gu Xing stepped into the Domain’s range, feeling a sticky resistance, his form staggering.
This wasn’t due to the Domain Suppression being too strong, but his lack of control over the burgeoning power.
With just a hint of external influence, he easily lost balance.
The Commander Level Blood Race noticed this too.
Thus, his Blood Domain’s primary target was...
Vera, standing aside and watching!
As long as he dealt with this Guardian Beast, then the remaining human...
Could be finished with a mere wave of the hand!
However...
His idea was very optimistic, but reality...
As soon as the Blood Domain spread within ten meters of Vera, it hit an invisible wall and couldn’t advance further.
Vera now had a Spiritual Attribute as high as 20,000 points!
Even without releasing a Domain, she could easily counter this Blood Race’s Domain with sheer Spiritual Power.
Vera’s gaze swept over the Blood Race.
The Extraordinary Level Blood Races were ineffective and hindered her master from familiarizing himself with his body.
Eliminate them!
With just a light gesture, vines wrapped around the bothersome Extraordinary Level Blood Races, dragging them into the ground.
In a blink, only the lone Commander Level Blood Race remained on the battlefield.
This... how could it be...
The body of the Commander Level Blood Race froze completely, cold sweat soaking his back.
At this moment, he finally understood...
The strength of this Guardian Beast before him was a terrifying existence capable of crushing him effortlessly!
And now that this Guardian Beast wasn’t attacking him, could it be...
His gaze fell on Gu Xing.
Could it be that they want him to be a sparring partner?
Seeing Gu Xing shaking and adjusting his body, he immediately solidified this assumption.
As Gu Xing shook his hands, he gradually got accustomed to the new body attributes.
Though the Blood Domain’s suppression made his movements clumsy, it was exactly what he needed.
This comprehensive resistance ironically accelerated his mastery over the surging attributes.
"Continue!"
He suddenly stomped the ground, charging forward again.
The Blood Race Commander hastily activated the Domain, only to realize Gu Xing’s speed had doubled at least compared to before!
Facing the punch from Gu Xing, he desperately raised his hand to block.
But he found...
"Boom——!"
Tremendous force exploded through his arm bones, the Blood Race Commander flew back like a kite with its string cut, plowing a trench dozens of meters long.
After a while, he trembled and crawled out from the rubble, his shattered arm bones slowly healing under the Blood Race’s strong recovery ability.
This... is he really human?!
His attributes are even higher than mine?
His gaze locked onto Gu Xing who was stretching his body, cold sweat pouring.
If this continues, he certainly wouldn’t endure more than a few punches.
Should he...
While this human hasn’t fully mastered his body yet, take him down...
A trace of killing intent seeped from him.
But in the next moment...
Two fierce killing intents instantly locked onto him!
His body froze, a chill ran from his toes to the back of his head.
What’s happening?
At this moment.
Liu Li and Qing Shuang emerged from Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space, appearing next to Vera.
Their eyes were filled with icy severity.
This Blood Race actually intends to kill their master?
Both Guardian Beasts silently sentenced this Blood Race to death in their hearts.
However, Gu Xing noticed the Guardian Beasts’ gazes locked onto the Blood Race, he turned his head and said:
"Stay calm! I have my own rhythm, let me handle this Blood Race!"
Vera, Liu Li, and Qing Shuang looked at Gu Xing, their eyes softened, indicating their understanding.
But only the Blood Race understood...
Three powerful presences were firmly locking him in place.
Should he make any move, he had no doubt the three Guardian Beasts would act decisively.
"Alright, now we can continue!"
Upon hearing the human’s words, this Blood Race was struck with a sudden urge to cry.
With three such powerful Guardian Beasts, this human could easily kill him, yet chose to torment him!
He wanted to escape...
But found out, the three Guardian Beasts had unknowingly blocked all his escape routes.
"Continue, or—die now."
Qing Shuang’s calm voice plunged the Blood Race into despair.
The ensuing battle marked his most humiliating moment in his long Blood Race life.
He had to pathetically dodge the human’s attacks while precisely controlling his strength—
It couldn’t be too weak, lest he lose his opponent’s interest, nor too strong to harm the opponent.
Finally catching an opportunity to counterattack, he was about to strike—
"Hm?"
Three terrifying presences simultaneously locked onto him!
The naked threat of death instantly deflated him, forcing him to retract his killing move.
Aggrieved!
Too aggrieved!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 158: The Captive Human Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 158: Chapter 158: The Captive Human Race
As the battle continued, Gu Xing’s control over his body became increasingly proficient, each punch executed with precise force.
But this also meant that the Blood Race Commander was starting to struggle.
Something’s not right...
Gu Xing suddenly realized that from start to finish, this Blood Race hadn’t managed a single decent counterattack.
He turned his head in confusion, meeting the innocent expressions of his three Guardian Beasts, who looked like they were saying, "We behaved ourselves."
His mouth twitched.
He understood the reason why this Blood Race did not attack him.
It turned out someone was meddling!
However, he had no intention of blaming the three Guardian Beasts.
After all, Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and others were also worried about his safety.
He turned again to look at the Blood Race Commander.
The commander trembled all over, eyes looking at Gu Xing and the Guardian Beasts as though staring at a group of devils.
Torture!
This human’s various attributes were overwhelmingly strong compared to him.
However, this member of the Human Race didn’t attack him with full force, only using him to test the power of his fists.
That would be quicker than ending him directly!
But now...
This human’s atrocities finally came to an end!
He was going to be liberated!
As soon as Gu Xing stopped, the Blood Race Commander was almost moved to tears of joy.
Just...
Gu Xing turned to glance at the Guardian Beasts.ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ
This Blood Race was intentionally left by him.
It was to understand what happened in the Blood-colored Church.
For matters like this, clearly, the Guardian Beasts were more adept than him.
Upon receiving Gu Xing’s command, Vera, Qing Shuang, and Liu Li’s eyes instantly became dangerous.
Earlier, this Blood Race dared to harbor murderous intent toward their master?
Unforgivable!
In the Blood Race’s terrified gaze, the three Guardian Beasts surrounded him.
His pupils contracted, hands clutching his shoulders:
"What do you want to do?"
But the three seemed not to hear him at all.
Vera tilted her head, revealing a naive smile:
"Surely he won’t reveal what happened in the Blood-colored Church, right?"
"I think so too," Liu Li said, an Ultimate Fire appearing in her palm, "we’d better beat him up first!"
Qing Shuang nodded in agreement, "No problem!"
Seeing this, the Blood Race Commander screamed in terror:
"Wait! I’ll tell you everything you want to know!"
Unfortunately, the three showed no sign of stopping.
Next, he endured the world’s top-notch treatment.
Three...four Myth Level Guardian Beasts attacked simultaneously.
Fei Yue emerged from the Void, kicking him several times.
When this interrogation ended, the Blood Race Commander was barely clinging to life, one breath away from the gates of hell.
Seeing them finally stop, he rolled and crawled to Gu Xing’s feet:
"I’ll tell! I’ll tell everything!"
His voice was hoarse beyond recognition, fearful of being mistreated again if he was slow.
Trembling, he confessed everything without hiding anything.
From the Blood Race’s internal turmoil to the movements of various factions, and even how this border town was raising humans—all was laid bare.
The more Gu Xing listened, the deeper his frown became.
This was nothing short of a classic rebellion script:
The Blood Race Ancestor was injured, and many Blood Princes joined forces intending to hunt down the Blood Ancestor to become the new Blood Ancestor.
However, the process failed.
Meanwhile, humans loyal to Lilith in the Blood-colored Church saw many Blood Princes rebel, and the Church Court Empress led a fierce conflict with the Blood Race.
In the end, neither side could triumph over the other.
Further complicated by Lilith’s disappearance.
It created a stalemate.
But such a scenario was bitter for ordinary civilians.
Previously, ordinary Blood Race members were restrained by Lilith and dared not attack humans.
But now....
Without Lilith’s restraint, all Blood Race members unleashed their true nature.
According to this Blood Race’s description.
Now all humans in this city have been herded together and raised.
As food, to be disposed of as they please.
The Blood Race Commander finished explaining, trembling as he looked up to meet Gu Xing’s icy stare.
"So, you treat humans as cattle for slaughter?"
Beneath the calm tone lay ultimate repressed killing intent.
The Blood Race Commander now suddenly realized——
The one before him was unmistakably human!
"M-Mercy, Sir! I can take you to..."
Before he finished speaking, Gu Xing’s hand was already clutching his throat.
With a crisp "crack," the fleeting hope in those crimson pupils completely solidified, turning to ash which scattered in the wind.
Gu Xing slowly stood up, a trace of complex emotion flashing in his eyes.
He hadn’t expected that Blood Ancestor Lilith held such goodwill toward humans.
Under her restraint, this group of Blood Race members could coexist peacefully with humans.
But now...
Lilith’s disappearance caused all order to collapse.
Yet this chaos became an opportunity for him.
Originally, he was troubled about obtaining the Light Divine Crystal and how to contend with the Blood Ancestor.
After all, this Blood Ancestor had previously desired the Divine Pattern in the Divine Secret Realm.
He suspected that the rumor of the Light Divine Crystal was deliberately spread by Lilith.
The aim was still for the Divine Pattern in his possession.
Fortunately, with the current turmoil, he could exploit the situation.
But before this, Gu Xing decided to first rescue the humans being raised in this border town.
Though unfamiliar, he couldn’t stand idly by as a member of the Human Race.
...
At this moment, inside the church in the town’s center.
Dim candlelight flickered, illuminating frightened faces.
Old men tightly hugged the children in their arms, and women silently wept.
All the town’s humans were imprisoned in what should have been a sacred hall.
"Mom... I’m scared..."
"Hush... don’t make a sound..."
The suppressed sobs echoed among the stone pillars, fear palpable among the crowd.
In front of the church, several Blood Race members lazily lounged on benches, scarlet liquid swirling in crystal glasses.
At their feet lay several still-warm corpses.
At this moment, their faces were filled with satisfaction.
"If it weren’t for that woman’s decree, we would never have lived side by side with these ants."
"Even protecting their safety! Really treated us like nannies?"
"Exactly, humans are just food for us, who knows what kind of insanity made the Blood Ancestor order us to protect these useless beings."
"She’s not the Blood Ancestor anymore; when the Princes find her, the Blood Ancestor position will change!"
The Blood Race members discussed, casting glances over the humans.
Suddenly, one Blood Race member’s gaze froze, having spotted something interesting.
His figure turned into blood mist, and upon reforming, he held a silver-haired little girl.
"When did this little thing sneak in? Never noticed her before!"
The Blood Race member scrutinized the silver-haired girl, puzzled.
Having occupied the town for years, they knew every human intimately.
"What’s the act?" Another Blood Race member scoffed, "Just craving her blood, aren’t you?"
The exposed Blood Race grinned horribly:
"Indeed, I love the blood of cute little things like her..."
His fangs suddenly elongated, glittering ominously in the candlelight.
Unexpectedly, the little girl merely stared at him blankly, her red eyes under the silver hair devoid of life, seemingly unaware of impending danger.
"Turns out it’s a fool..."
"But that’s good, I won’t let you feel any pain!"
With that, he lunged to bite.
Only at that moment...
"Boom——!"
Amidst deafening noise, countless vines tore the church’s dome apart.
Moonlight flooded in, illuminating the blood race’s faces of absolute terror.
Their widened eyes reflected four figures standing in midair.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 159: A Strange Sense of Closeness!
chapters.content:
Chapter 159: Chapter 159: A Strange Sense of Closeness!
At this moment.
Above the ruined dome of the church, Gu Xing and his three Guardian Beasts are standing mid-air.
Fei Yue’s figure was hidden in the void, waiting for the right moment to strike.
Gu Xing’s cold gaze swept across below.
The Human Race cowered in the corner like lambs waiting to be slaughtered.
While the Blood Race held their crimson goblets, displaying an air of superiority.
Seeing Gu Xing arrive with the three Guardian Beasts, the group of Blood Race was momentarily stunned, but quickly recovered.
"Where did this reckless human come from?! Does being Commander Level make him think he’s invincible?!"
"Kill him! I haven’t tasted the blood of a Commander Level human yet!"
"Drain him dry! It might significantly increase our strength!"
The group of Blood Race shouted excitedly.
But they were utterly oblivious to...
what kind of monster they were about to face!
Listening to the Blood Race’s blatant discussions, Gu Xing’s eyes became even colder.
He slowly raised his hand, his voice as cold as ice:
"Leave none of the Blood Race alive!"
The moment the order was given, the three Guardian Beasts attacked simultaneously.
The Blood Race in this small town wasn’t strong.
The strongest among them were only Low Tier Commanders.
Facing the three Myth Level Guardian Beasts, they didn’t even have a chance to struggle.
"Boom——"
Ultimate Fire, Netherworld Ghost Qi, and Life Energy intertwined...
In just a few breaths, the Blood Race in the church was completely wiped out.
Until the group of Blood Race was thoroughly eliminated, the stunned crowd finally awoke as if from a dream.
"Tha... Thank you, sir, for saving us!"
"We will never forget your great kindness and virtue!"
The survivors, overwhelmed with gratitude, knelt on the cold ground, their foreheads hitting the ground heavily. Their choked voices echoed within the church.
However, Gu Xing looked at the people kneeling on the ground, his brows slightly furrowed.
As he glanced around, he found that there were very few Extraordinary Level Beast Masters among them.
The Blood-colored Church relied too heavily on the protection of the Blood Race, so besides the top Human Race experts like the Church Court Empress...
most humans basically had no self-defense capability.
But what he could do now was only to help them solve these Blood Race issues.
As for what their fate would be next...
Gu Xing could only say, let them fend for themselves!
His energy was limited, and he only had himself, definitely unable to manage so many people.
Yet at this moment, he could feel the rationality of Longxia Country’s policies.
The entire Longxia Country was encircled by a gigantic defensive line.
The Demon Race within the defensive line posed minimal threat to civilians.
Whereas the Blood-colored Church was different...
The entire nation’s territory had no protection whatsoever.
Each town was merely assigned a few Blood Race for defense.
Now, with the Blood Race rebellion, the entire Holy See territory instantly fell into crisis.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing shook his head and prepared to turn and leave.
But just at this moment...
A small figure suddenly hugged his leg.
"Hmm?"
The sudden sensation on his leg made Gu Xing pause.
Looking down, he found...
A silver-haired little girl tightly hugging his leg, looking up with a dazed expression.
How adorable!
That was Gu Xing’s first reaction.
He instinctively wanted to check the girl’s information, but found no response.
This meant she was merely an ordinary human child.
The adorable little one was always pleasing.
Gu Xing crouched down, gently picking up the little girl.
Unexpectedly, the little girl not only showed no resistance but obediently hugged his neck, resting her small head on his shoulder.
At this time, the Divine Pattern on Gu Xing’s forehead flickered imperceptibly, but he did not notice.
"Does anyone know this child?"
Gu Xing walked toward the crowd holding the little girl.
The rescued town citizens immediately responded in a cacophony:
"Benefactor, she’s not from our town..."
"She must have been captured from elsewhere by the Blood Race..."
"Never seen this child before..."
Listening to these explanations, Gu Xing instinctively frowned.
For some reason, he felt an inexplicable sense of closeness to the little girl in his arms, but he assumed it to be his imagination.
How should he arrange for her...
Looking at the naive little one in his arms, Gu Xing was at a loss.
Thinking it over, he decided to find her a suitable adoptive family.
After all, what would it mean to have her follow him?
He’d become a nanny!
"Is there anyone willing to adopt her?"
As soon as he spoke, several women in the crowd raised their hands.
Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction, ready to hand the little girl over...
"Um..."
The little one suddenly tightened her arms, like a koala, clutching his neck tightly.
Her small face buried in his neck, refusing to let go.
At this moment, Vera, Liu Li, and Qing Shuang approached Gu Xing, their eyes curiously examining the silver-haired little girl.
"Master..."
Liu Li tilted her head, a hint of confusion flashed in her eyes.
"For some reason, I feel a special sense of closeness to her."
Qing Shuang unusually nodded in agreement:
"I feel the same way."
Even Vera added with furrowed brows:
"Master, me too..."
Gu Xing was taken aback upon hearing this.
If it were just him feeling this, it could be dismissed as an illusion.The source of thɪs content is Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
But now, even his three Guardian Beasts felt the same.
This child...
His gaze deepened as he looked down at the little girl still clinging to him.
To make all three Guardian Beasts feel close, she must not be simple!
"Why not keep her for now?"
Gu Xing looked at the Guardian Beasts, seeking their opinion.
Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Vera nodded in unison.
As Myth Level Guardian Beasts, their instinctive perception couldn’t be wrong.
Being able to generate closeness with them meant that...
Keeping the little girl could only bring benefits!
Seeing the Guardian Beasts agree, Gu Xing made up his mind.
Then stay!
However, as he gazed at the silver-haired girl in his arms, he suddenly thought of something, his pupils contracted slightly.
He thought of a person...
Blood Race Ancestor Lilith!
But he quickly denied this speculation!
After all, he had already checked the little girl’s information previously.
There was no response!
That meant she wasn’t an Alien Race.
So it’s naturally impossible for her to be Lilith!
Moreover...
How could Lilith, whom the entire Blood-colored Church was searching for, be so easily found by him in a border town?
Next, Gu Xing planned to head to the center of the Blood-colored Church.
That’s where the Imperial Capital of the Blood-colored Church is!
The third Evolution material for Liu Li he needed — Light Divine Crystal, was also in the Imperial Capital!
Now, Liu Li’s upgrade materials...
Angel Divine Blood, Light Divine Crystal, Ultimate Fire!
Among these three materials, Angel Divine Blood and Ultimate Fire are already in hand.
Once he obtains the last material, Liu Li can undergo Evolution once more!
Currently, Liu Li’s Talent has reached Myth Five Stars; if she evolves again...
Is there a possibility of breaking through Myth to Myth Nine Stars?
Or even surpassing the Myth Level, reaching a realm beyond Myth!
Thinking of this, a hint of anticipation rose in Gu Xing’s eyes.
But before that...
He must first find a way to resolve the Blood-colored Church’s current crisis!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 160: I’ll Be Waiting for You in the Royal Capital, My Dear Blood Ancestor!
chapters.content:
Chapter 160: Chapter 160: I’ll Be Waiting for You in the Royal Capital, My Dear Blood Ancestor!
At the same time.
A barren wasteland hundreds of miles away from the Blood-colored Church’s territory.
Lilith staggered to a stop, her face slightly pale.
"Why not keep running? My dear Blood Ancestor~"
A mocking voice echoed from behind.
The Demon God strolled leisurely towards her, with a cat-and-mouse smile on his lips.
As someone who once stood at the Monarch Peak, Lilith, who had fallen to Commander Level strength, couldn’t possibly shake him off.
Now, it seemed the Blood Ancestor had realized this and had chosen to stop actively.
"Blood Ancestor, have you thought this through? Planning to hand over your Divine Pattern willingly?"
Lilith raised her eyes to look at the Demon Race in front of her, a trace of disdain flashing in her scarlet pupils.
If not for her damaged strength, this Monarch Peak Demon God could have been destroyed by her with a flick of her hand.
But now...
She curled her pale lips into a mocking smile.
"Want the Divine Pattern? Then come and take it yourself!"
"You’ve been following me without daring to strike, it seems you’re still not confident in your strength."
"But that suits your identity..."
Lilith chuckled lightly and shook her head, "After all, your Disguiser Race is inherently the weakest among the Demons."
"Monarch Peak is your limit! Totem Level? Heh... don’t even think about it in this lifetime."
These words were like a sharp dagger, piercing precisely into his most vulnerable soft spot.
The Disguisers, although able to transform at will.
Human Race, Demon Race, Alien Race, they could disguise as any race.
However...
Their actual combat power wasn’t particularly strong.
Compared to the Demon King at Monarch Peak, his strength wasn’t much stronger.
Although this was an unspoken truth in the entire Demon Race, being exposed by Lilith...
His face instantly became as dark as water, the Demonic Qi around him surged violently.
"Calling you Blood Ancestor, and you really take it seriously?"
"Right now, you’re nothing but a dying wretch!"
His face twisted in anger.
"As long as I kill you and absorb your Divine Pattern, I can naturally advance further, stepping into the Totem Level!"
"Then, no one would dare to belittle us Disguisers!"
Upon hearing these words, Lilith merely raised her eyes calmly:
"Then... try it!"
As soon as the words fell, a sky-high blood light erupted around her.
"Immortal Blood Body!"
Under the influence of this skill, her attributes suddenly soared.
Meanwhile, she simultaneously activated her Domain.
"Blood Domain!"
But the Demon God sneered.
Now Lilith’s level was merely at the Commander Peak.
While he was at the Monarch Peak!
Even if Lilith had once reached the Totem Level and possessed incredibly strong combat experience.
But with such a vast gap, there wasn’t the slightest possibility of defeating him.
"Demon God Domain!"
Pitch-black Demonic Qi surged like a tide, instantly engulfing and compressing Lilith’s Blood Domain.
In the face of this overwhelming power, the Blood Domain retreated step-by-step, ultimately barely protecting a three-meter radius around Lilith.
"Blood Ancestor, hand over the Divine Pattern! I will spare your life!"
"Heh..."
Lilith chuckled coldly and suddenly shot a crimson Blood Arrow with a raise of her hand.
The Demon God disdainfully waved, Demonic Qi instantly forming a pitch-black shield.
"Bang!"
The Blood Arrow collided with the shield, unable to create even a ripple.
"Stop wasting your efforts, you’re not my opponent."
Despite his words, his gaze remained vigilant.
From the force of that strike, although Lilith was now only at the Commander Level, her actual combat power definitely reached the King Level.
However, Lilith didn’t respond; in the next moment, three more Blood Arrows shot towards the Demon Race.
He lifted his hand to intercept again, but his brows furrowed ever tighter.
This Blood Ancestor knew these attacks were useless against him, so why continue?
Something was off...
As doubt crept into his mind, he suddenly caught sight of the ground with his peripheral vision.
Unbeknownst to him, the blood blocked and spattered earlier silently spread towards his feet like living creatures!
"Damn it!"
The Demon God’s hair stood on end with fear.
The most terrifying thing about the Blood Race was their absolute control over blood!
This blood had to be Lilith’s intention.
He tried to retreat, but Lilith’s cold voice exploded in his ear:
"Blood Solidification!"
The Demon God’s body froze abruptly, the Demonic Blood flowing within him instantaneously solidified.
In that moment...
The blood on the ground twisted eerily, rapidly coalescing into Lilith’s form in the blink of an eye.
"You—"
Seeing Lilith so close, the Demon God’s pupils contracted violently.
But Lilith’s actions were even more decisive than he imagined...
She suddenly compressed her Blood Domain to the extreme.
Crimson light gathered in her palm, forming a glaring Blood Pearl.
She knew, given her strength disparity with this Demon Race.
Even if she exerted all her strength, victory over this Demon Race was impossible.
Thus, she had long made preparations.
Sacrifice this body!
By doing so, not only could she escape.
But she could also manage to inflict heavy damage on this Demon Race with the body she abandoned.
At this moment, watching the Demon Race so close, a smile curled at Lilith’s lips.
"See you next time!"
In the next instant.
"Boom——!!"
The Blood Pearl, compressed to its limit, exploded fiercely, the violent energy storm instantly swept over a kilometer.
In the apocalyptic energy storm, Lilith’s figure was torn to shreds in an instant.
While the Demon God exerted all his might to open his Demon God Domain, Demonic Qi formed layers upon layers of shields on his body.
"Boom crack——"
However, in face of the self-detonation of the Blood Domain, these defenses shattered like paper.
The blast wave swept across several miles, leveling everything in its path.
Long after...
Amidst the scorched earth at the explosion’s heart, a wisp of Demonic Qi slowly regathered.
The Disguiser’s figure reappeared, but now in a sorry state.
He no longer possessed his previous grace, his face extremely pale.
In the explosion just now, he almost lost half his life.Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Cough... cough..."
He spit out a few mouthfuls of pitch-black Demonic Blood, his trembling fingers wiping the bloodstains from his lips.
"Truly worthy of being a former Totem Level Blood Ancestor! Such a disparity in strength, yet she still managed to bite me back..."
"However..."
"The Divine Pattern, I must obtain it!"
"Dear Blood Ancestor, you cannot escape..."
Violent Demonic Qi erupted from within him, instantly shrouding several miles.
Sensing the summons, Low Tier Demons swarmed like a tide, unaware of what fate awaited them.
"Puchi——"
The sound of claws piercing flesh echoed continuously.
The Disguiser coldly harvested the lives of his kin, restoring his strength by devouring their Demonic Qi.
With each absorption of Demonic Qi, his pale visage regained a hint of color.
During the massacre, his gaze was firmly locked on the direction of the Blood-colored Court Capital.
No matter where Lilith escapes to...
Eventually, she will return to the capital!
An arc of cruelty curled at his lips.
"I’ll be waiting at the capital for you..."
"Dear Blood Ancestor..."
...
