chapters.title: Chapter 161: Is She Really Blood Ancestor Lilith?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 161: Chapter 161: Is She Really Blood Ancestor Lilith?!
The other side.
Inside a town inn within the Blood-colored Church’s territory.
During this time, he swept through several towns with his three Guardian Beasts.
At this moment.
Gu Xing held the silver-haired little girl helplessly, trying to negotiate with her:
"Little one, would you like our older sisters to take you for a bath?"
As a Commander-level expert, he and his Guardian Beasts had long since been able to stay clean without washing.
But this little creature is different...
Days of travel have given her a faint odor.
Gu Xing wasn’t a clean freak, but he didn’t like carrying around a dirty child either.
Moreover, this little girl insists on sticking to him all the time.
Recently, he hasn’t even had a chance to fight.
Yet, this was exactly what the Guardian Beasts preferred.
If Gu Xing doesn’t fight, it means there won’t be any danger.
"Hmm..."
The little girl, who usually appeared dazed, seemed to understand Gu Xing’s words at this moment and decisively shook her head.
Then she pressed her little face tightly against Gu Xing’s chest, unwilling to let go.
Gu Xing: "..."
Vera shrugged helplessly, indicating she couldn’t help either.
She also didn’t understand why this little girl would only get close to Gu Xing.
"Forget it..."
Gu Xing sighed, "I will do it!"
Upon hearing this, Vera’s eyes suddenly lit up.
She looked at her petite figure, then glanced at the silver-haired little girl, and suddenly blurted out:
"Master~ I’m dirty too, can you wash me as well..."
Before she could finish speaking, Liu Li and Qing Shuang had already stopped her on both sides.
"Eh? Hold on!"
"Master, she seems to have a fever and is talking nonsense," Liu Li said, her face unchanged.
"We’ll take her to ’clear her head,’" Qing Shuang coldly added.
Not giving Vera a chance to speak, the two had already dragged her out of the room quickly.
Witnessing this, Gu Xing twitched his lips.
He didn’t understand why Vera, not being a match for Liu Li and Qing Shuang, still liked to act recklessly in front of them.
Shaking his head, he turned his gaze back to the silver-haired little girl.
Recently, he also discovered the source of his affinity.
He reached out to touch the divine pattern on his forehead.
It’s not that he is fond of this little creature, but rather the divine pattern on his forehead has an affinity for this little one.
Finding no answer, his eyes turned towards the bathtub in the center of the room.
Giving a child a bath was a first in both of his lifetimes.
But at this moment, this girl only listens to him...
"Take off your clothes!"
The little one tilted her head, took two seconds to react, and then slowly untied her worn-out white dress.
Gu Xing swiftly scooped her up and gently placed her into the bathtub.
"Splash——"
Water splashed as the little creature sat stunned in the bathtub, silver hair wetly sticking to both sides of her cheeks, completely unable to understand what was next.
Gu Xing resignedly rolled up his sleeves and picked up a towel to start wiping her down.
What was all this...
...
Meanwhile.
A stream of blood-red light was streaking across the night sky at an astonishing speed.
It was Lilith’s Spiritual Body, furiously chasing the body she had left behind.
"Damn it!"
Lilith gritted her silver teeth.
Though the last self-destruct was with full force, she was very aware——
Given the Demon God’s power, he definitely wouldn’t die.
It was the second time she had been forced into such a humiliating position:
The first time was in the Divine Secret Realm when humans destroyed her Blood Body, and now demons forced her to abandon her body again.
Just then, Lilith noticed something unusual.
The body she left should have been near the initial town, so why was the sensed position so far away now?
Was it taken by someone?
This thought made her heart tighten.
The body now lacked any self-preservation power, no different from an ordinary human child.
If it fell into malicious hands...
Soon, under her full speed, Lilith’s Spiritual Body darted toward the sensed location.
She was so eager she didn’t even observe her surroundings, charging straight into the body she sensed.
"Hmm?"
While wiping the silver-haired girl’s hair, Gu Xing suddenly frowned.
He seemed to perceive a slight spiritual fluctuation.
But scanning around, he found nothing.
An illusion?
He shook his head and turned to fetch clothes for the little girl.
He didn’t notice, however, at that moment of turning away, the little creature behind him was undergoing a startling transformation.
Crimson eyes began to form, delicate features grew even more flawless.
When Lilith’s consciousness fully awakened, the first thing she felt was...
This body...
Had it been washed?
Her vision gradually cleared, and the first thing she saw was a strange hotel room, and...
A black-haired young man turning his back to her.
Human?
No way!
The sudden trembling from the divine pattern within made Lilith’s pupils shrink abruptly.
When she saw the golden pattern on the forehead of the person before her, a hint of greed instantly ignited in her crimson eyes.
Divine Pattern holder!
The same human from the Divine Secret Realm.
Such luck indeed!
If she could consume this human’s blood, at least thirty percent of her power could be restored!
This thought made her show her fangs without hesitation, and her legs suddenly exerted force——
"Whoosh!"
Her petite frame shot toward Gu Xing like an arrow, sharp fangs aiming directly at his carotid artery.
However, Gu Xing turned at that very moment.
Hmm?
The Commander-level reaction speed made him instinctively reach out, accurately grabbing the shoulders of the small figure lunging toward him.
Lilith’s sharp fangs were only inches from his neck but could no longer move forward.
Holding the suddenly transformed little creature, Gu Xing was completely dumbfounded.
"What the hell!"
The formerly adorable human child was now glaring at him, clawing aggressively.
Crimson eyes, sharp fangs, with small bat wings fluttering behind her.
The only thing unchanged...
Was her bare body!
Lilith hung mid-air, her little legs kicking futilely.
She then realized a serious problem...
The newly merged body didn’t have any strength!
Even her power was almost nonexistent, now only slightly stronger than ordinary human children.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ No(ᴠ)ᴇlFire.nᴇt
"Let me go!"
She threatened with bared teeth, albeit with a somewhat cute aggression.
Gu Xing’s lips twitched; he casually grabbed a bedsheet and wrapped the little creature like a dumpling.
This was clearly a member of the Blood Race!
[Blood Race Ancestor (Lilith)]
[Status: Within merged body]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 10 (Increasing)]
[Constitution: 10 (Increasing)]
[Spirit: 10 (Increasing)]
[Speed: 10 (Increasing)]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Gu Xing stared intensely at the information jumping off the attribute panel, his pupil shrinking violently.
The striking text nearly made him bite his tongue...
What kind of joke was this?!
He mechanically lowered his head, looking at the bundle that was still wriggling.
The silver-haired girl he picked up, bathed and dressed, turned out to be...
Blood Ancestor Lilith?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 162: The Frustrated Lilith
chapters.content:
Chapter 162: Chapter 162: The Frustrated Lilith
Gu Xing was stunned for quite a while before reaching out to poke Lilith’s smooth forehead.
At this moment, this Blood Ancestor seemed unaware if it was due to just merging her body.
"Awoo!"
This Blood Ancestor acted like a puffed-up kitten, opening her little mouth to bite his finger.
Gu Xing hurriedly withdrew his hand, staring in astonishment at the fierce-looking young creature in front of him.
He really found it difficult to connect her with the noble, elegant, and magnificent Blood Ancestor from the Divine Secret Realm...
"You..."
The words stuck in his throat.
This unexpected turn of events left him unsure of how to speak.
And at this moment, Lilith’s crimson eyes were fixated on the throbbing blood vessels in Gu Xing’s neck.
As long as she could drink this human’s fresh blood...
Just one bite...
She would be able to restore part of her strength!
By then...
Neither the rebellious Blood Race nor the Demon God would escape her.
But at this time.
The door was suddenly pushed open.
Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang, the three Guardian Beasts, charged in with solemn expressions.
They had keenly perceived a sudden unfamiliar presence in the room.
But upon entering the room, the three Guardian Beasts were clearly startled.
"Master, isn’t this..."
Vera widened her eyes, pointing at Lilith wrapped up like a dumpling, "Isn’t this the Blood Ancestor? How is she here?"
Qing Shuang and Liu Li also turned their gaze towards her.
In the Divine Secret Realm, the impression this Blood Ancestor left on them wasn’t pleasant.
The two had almost exhausted all their strength to defeat this Blood Ancestor!
Facing Vera’s question, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
How could he answer?
Could he say that he was bathing the little one, and she suddenly transformed into the Blood Ancestor?
Unable to understand, he decided to ask the source directly.
Gu Xing lifted the "dumpling" in his hand a little, forcing Lilith to meet his gaze:
"Blood Ancestor, care to explain?!"
Seeing Gu Xing so close, Lilith finally snapped out of her craving for blood.
When she took in the three Myth Level Guardian Beasts watching her like predators and felt her empty power...
Her dazed mind instantly cleared.
Oh no!
Escaping one danger only to fall into another.
She hadn’t forgotten how her Blood Clone died at this human’s hands.
The current body was still in recovery...
The silver-haired little girl hesitated but decided to cooperate with the human for now.
Her energy had dropped to its lowest point; attempting escape from this human’s clutches...
Would be incredibly difficult!
Better to cooperate with this human first!
After all, this human likely wouldn’t forcibly take the Divine Pattern from her body.
A bit later, when her power is restored...
Even if she can’t defeat the human’s three Guardian Beasts, with the Blood Race abilities, she can escape successfully.
"Human, you found the Blood Body I condensed with the Divine Pattern!"
However—
"Bang!"
Vera unceremoniously flicked her forehead with a snap:
"You keep calling him human, but you’re a captive now; call him Master Gu Xing!"
Treated like this by Vera...
Lilith’s pupils instantly turned scarlet, her fangs instinctively grew longer.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
Humiliation!
This Elf actually dared...
"Bang!"
Another crisp forehead flick.
"What? Still wish to resist?"
Vera narrowed her eyes, Commander Tier Two Myth Level aura erupted suddenly.
And Qing Shuang and Liu Li stepped forward in unison, their terrifying presences surged towards Lilith like waves.
Feeling the oppressive force from the three, Lilith’s small face turned pale immediately.
She was really in trouble!
Lilith quickly calculated in her mind.
Even if she restored her full strength, which would only be Commander Tier One, facing three Commander Tier Two Myth Level Guardian Beasts, the odds were slim.
Moreover...
Her gaze moved towards Gu Xing, biting her lip unconsciously.
This human is practically cheating!
Not only possessing two Talents, but each Talent was extremely extraordinary.
Now this human has ascended to Commander Level, his power will only be more formidable.
"Master... Master Gu Xing..."
Lilith took a deep breath, forcing herself to bow her head.
Although once a Totem Level powerhouse, bowing to a human made her feel humiliation, the circumstances were overpowering.
And back in the years before she became the Blood Ancestor, she had done this kind of endurance for survival many times.
"Do you have... anything you wish to ask?"
Gu Xing granted Vera a appreciative glance.
Getting this proud Blood Ancestor to submit was the only way to extract valuable information.
Without hesitation, he asked the most crucial question.
"How can one break through to Totem Level?"
"I don’t know!"
Lilith reflexively blurted out.
But as soon as she spoke, she saw the eyes of the three Guardian Beasts simultaneously turn dangerous...
Noticing this, Lilith hastily supplemented.
"I really don’t know!"
"Every race has different ways to break through to Totem Level, and I reached Totem Level because the previous Blood Ancestor passed her power to me."
"Furthermore... she also asked me... to protect the Human Race."
Hearing Blood Ancestor Lilith’s response, Gu Xing frowned slightly.
He thought that finding Lilith who had been Totem Level, he could understand how the Human Race can break through to Totem Level.
But now...
The way to break through to Totem Level is still a mystery.
However, from Lilith’s answer, he somewhat understood Lilith’s reason for shielding the Human Race.
During Gu Xing’s contemplation, Lilith scrutinized Gu Xing.
Suddenly she understood why Gu Xing came to the Blood-colored Church.
"You’re here for the Light Divine Crystal, aren’t you?"
"So... let me drink a little blood; I can resolve the chaos in the Blood-colored Church and give you the Light Divine Crystal, how about it?"
Upon hearing Lilith’s words, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
This Blood Ancestor actually painted a rosy promise for him.
Not to mention she now completely lost control over the Blood Race and has no decision-making power.
Additionally...
Gu Xing’s gaze swept over Lilith.
With such a existence as the Blood Ancestor, if her power was restored.
Likely, she would strike him first.
By then, not only negotiations, even the Divine Pattern would likely fall into her hands.
Gu Xing turned and exchanged glances with Vera.
Vera instantly caught on, showing a mischievous smile.
It seems... Blood Ancestor still needs a bit more teaching!
Subsequently, Gu Xing left the room.
Some time later.
When Gu Xing re-entered the room, Lilith’s expression had already become much clearer.
Vera proudly stepped forward to claim credit:
"Master, we sorted it out!"
Lilith, wrapped in the sheets, now looked at Vera as if seeing some terrifying demon.
Seeing Lilith in such a "played out" state, Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his eye.
Though he didn’t know what means Vera used, the effect was indeed immediate.
However, as Lilith confessed everything, Gu Xing’s brows furrowed deeper.
The situation was worse than imagined:
Not only was there Blood Race rebellion, but even Demon God intervention, and worse...
Lei Zhan was involved too.
In this case, he absolutely couldn’t just sit by!
But right now everything revolved around Lilith...
He must quickly bring Lilith to the Church Court Empress before those Blood Race members.
Only then might this storm end!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 163: Lilith in Shock
chapters.content:
Chapter 163: Chapter 163: Lilith in Shock
Next morning, Gu Xing arranged for Liu Li and Qing Shuang to watch over Lilith, and the group prepared to head to the Blood-colored Court Capital at full speed.
As long as Lilith is delivered to the Church Court Empress, this turmoil could end.
However...
Lilith looked indifferent.
She understood those rebellious members of the Blood Race too well...
If she were to return to the capital, many Low Tier Blood Race members might turn against their previous rebellion out of fear of her past authority.
So to those rebels, her permanent disappearance would be the best outcome.
"The closer to the capital..."
Sandwiched between them, Lilith spoke lazily:
"The number and strength of the Blood Race will only grow stronger, you might even encounter Monarch Level Blood Race! You better think it over~"
But the response to Lilith was...
"Pop!"
A green vine suddenly stuffed into her mouth.
Vera gave Lilith an annoyed glare.
"Captive, don’t make noise!"
"Mmm...!"
Once again being treated so roughly, Lilith was furious, her face flushed red, and her silver hair flew up.
She clenched her fists tightly, cursing the damned elf a thousand times in her heart.
Just wait...
Wait until strength returns...
Ensure a payback a thousand times over!
But now...
Patience leads to peace and calm!
Next.
As Gu Xing and his group ventured deeper into the heart of the Blood-colored Church, the strength of the Blood Race they encountered grew stronger along the way.
Currently, a few powerful Blood Race blocked their path.
When their eyes fell on Lilith beside Gu Xing, they were first surprised.
Then, sensing her weakened aura, a look of ecstasy appeared on their faces.
"It’s the Blood Ancestor!"
"Prince has issued a bounty for capturing her..."
"Now it seems our luck is good! We’ve encountered the weakened Blood Ancestor!"
Seeing the Blood Race blocking their way, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed slightly.
The Blood Race before him had all reached Commander Peak strength.
He casually checked one Blood Race member’s information.
[Blood Race]
[Talent: Legend]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Power: 49,000]
[Constitution: 48,000]
[Spirit: 37,000]
[Speed: 50,000]
[Skills: Blood Domain, Blood Body...]
The attributes of these Blood Races were quite similar.
Aside from the Spiritual Attribute, all other attributes hovered around fifty thousand points.
Even though Liu Li’s various attributes had reached 15,000 points now!
And in using the Doomsday Angel Form, her attributes can reach 45,000 points.
In terms of attributes, already on par with that Commander level Blood Race.
However...
Their mastery of the domain abilities is not at the same level...
Therefore, unless he uses the Absolute Forbidden Domain, otherwise...
It’s still quite challenging for the Guardian Beasts to defeat Commander Peak-level enemies!
Thus, it is necessary to use the Second Domain!
At this moment.
Lilith couldn’t understand Gu Xing’s trump card.
She looked at the few Commander Peak Blood Races blocking the way and glanced at the silent Gu Xing, unable to resist speaking again:
"Human, you still have time to change your mind."
"As long as you offer a part of your blood, these Blood Races, I can deal with them in a heartbeat!"
"If I don’t act, undoubtedly your Guardian Beast will not be a match for this group of Blood Race!"
Though Lilith knew Gu Xing had ways to enhance Guardian Beast attributes.
Yet for Commander level, attribute enhancement of Guardian Beast isn’t so crucial.
What matters is Domain Control.
Just like her own capability.
Even if her level is only Commander Tier Six, or even lower.
She could still use her formidable Domain Control to overcome this group of Commander Peak Blood Race.
However, Gu Xing just cast a meaningful look.
Lilith couldn’t grasp what that look meant.
But she saw that this human had no intent to agree to her conditions.
Lilith snorted coldly, "Since you don’t agree, then wait and beg me in a bit!"
Looking at Lilith with that "You’ll definitely regret not listening to me" expression.
Gu Xing casually gave her a crisp flick on her forehead.
"Watch closely, learn well!"
Finishing, Gu Xing no longer paid attention to the near-furious Lilith, turning and locking his sights on several Blood Races.
When at Commander Tier One, he could slay Half-Step Monarch Demon Race, and now it’s merely a group of Commander Peak Blood Race...
"Absolute Forbidden Domain!"
A blood-red domain suddenly unfurled, encompassing the few Blood Races instantly.
The Blood Race was first shocked, then curiously felt around.
This domain seems... useless?
"What’s with this human’s domain? Why does it have no effect?"
"Probably just posturing! No need to worry!"
Contrary to this group of Blood Race’s reaction, Lilith’s response was stark.
Her crimson pupils contracted sharply, mouth involuntarily gaping:
"How... how is this possible?!"
Despite currently falling to Commander Tier One...
Even yet to fully recover, only at Extraordinary Tier Ninth.
Her insight remained!
She could immediately discern the effect of Gu Xing’s domain.
The effect of this domain is actually...
Disabling all domains!
Lilith instinctively swallowed, her little ears between silver hair perked slightly.
Could she have misread?
How could such a terrifying domain exist?
Directly disabling others’ domain?Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Living over a thousand years, it’s the first time she witnessed such a heaven-defying domain effect.
She stole a glance at Gu Xing’s back.
Erasing the thought in mind of "once strength regains, exact thousandfold revenge".
What a joke?
This human could directly disable her domain, how could she play?
Her sole reliance was her Domain Control ability, and now...
Her only reliance was directly disabled!
"Th..that, Gu Xing, your domain..."
At this moment, Lilith dared not refer to Gu Xing as a mere human.
Hearing this address, Gu Xing turned with surprise.
What’s happening?
Why such a drastic shift in Blood Ancestor’s attitude?
Previously, although labeling him Lord Gu Xing, it was under Vera’s coercion.
And now...
Initiatively changing the address?
Turned over a new leaf!
Yet, Gu Xing didn’t dwell much...
After all, settling this group of Blood Race is more crucial right now.
Moreover, it’s imperative to quickly resolve this group of Blood Race!
This place is too close to the Blood Race Royal Capital; delaying further would only attract more enemies.
"Soul-devouring!"
Without hesitation, he directly activated this Talent.
Guardian Beast’s All Attributes enhanced by 200%!
The aura of three Guardian Beasts surged instantly, then—
"Elf Monarchy!"
"Ghost King’s Body!"
"Doomsday Angel Form!"
With three clear chants, Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Vera all simultaneously activated their strongest forms.
The terrifying energy fluctuations began warping the surrounding space.
Originally, a few Blood Races felt no concern.
After all, with the domain’s presence, no matter how strong the attributes, the Guardian Beasts couldn’t possibly be their opponents.
Until...
"How is it possible?"
"Why can’t my domain be used?"
The Blood Race’s originally confident expression froze instantly.
Their proud Blood Domain, like throwing stones into the sea, couldn’t be activated despite all attempts!
Meanwhile, Gu Xing’s three Guardian Beasts wouldn’t halt!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 164: Flaws in Combat
chapters.content:
Chapter 164: Chapter 164: Flaws in Combat
"Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
"Judgment!"
"Sea Breaker!"
Three crisp shouts echoed.
Three Guardian Beasts almost attacked simultaneously.
The blue Thunder Dragon, wrapped in the figures of Liu Li and Qing Shuang, charged towards this group of Blood Race.
Now, the attributes of the three Guardian Beasts, under Gu Xing’s support, have long surpassed these few Blood Race by far....
Plus the full-force attack of the three Guardian Beasts.
Before the startled cries of the Blood Race could fall, three devastating attacks had already descended.
"Boom!!!"
In the dazzling light, several Blood Race couldn’t even let out a scream before being utterly obliterated by the rampaging energy.
After the dust settled, the traces of these Blood Race’s existence had already vanished.
Lilith stared dumbfounded at this scene, her small mouth agape enough to fit an egg.
This battle...
is pure violence aesthetics.
There’s absolutely no skill, purely attribute crushing.
Yet the driving force behind all this...
Her gaze once again fell on Gu Xing’s back.
This human’s domain can disable the enemy’s domain, and his talent can directly double the attributes of the Guardian Beasts.
In addition...
The talent of those three Guardian Beasts has already reached the peak!
The same Myth Five Stars as hers!
Under these three reasons, this human, together with his three Guardian Beasts at Commander Tier Two, can easily annihilate enemies at Commander’s peak.
When Gu Xing turned, he happened to meet Lilith’s round blood-red eyes.
Seeing this scene, he raised his eyebrows with interest:
"Blood Ancestor, any comments?"
As a former Totem Level powerhouse, Lilith’s insight is undoubtedly valuable.
After all, now he and several Guardian Beasts’ strength is roughly at Half-step Monarch Level.
But this would require him to reveal all his cards to reach it.
Therefore, he wanted to hear Lilith’s opinion, to see if they could advance further.
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, Lilith slowly returned to her senses.
Comments?
What’s there to comment on?
Such a brainless way of fighting, anyone could do it?
But looking at Gu Xing’s sincere eyes, she still seriously pondered for a moment.
"Your domain..." she chose her words carefully, "is strong!"
That’s the truth.
A domain that can lock others’ domains, in her thousands of years, she’s never heard of it.
"But..."
Lilith sneaked a glance at Gu Xing’s expression.
Confirming he wasn’t displeased, she gathered courage to continue:
"Your application of the domain is just unbearable!"
"And your Guardian Beasts, having reached Commander Level, are unaware of using the domain!"
Lilith’s words were like a clap of thunder, leaving Gu Xing stunned on the spot.
What Lilith said was right.
Whether it was the Divine Pattern stopping his further enhancement, or the performance of several Guardian Beasts in their usual battles...
They all confirmed this issue!
In any battle, his instinct would be to let the Guardian Beasts activate various statuses...
And rely on the huge attribute enhancement from his "Soul-devouring" talent to resolve the fight.
Though this combat style was effective, it restricted the Guardian Beasts’ true growth potential.
Additionally, in this period when he personally took action, he increasingly felt...
He hadn’t fully utilized the functions of the two domains he possessed.
Now it’s perhaps just the most superficial application!
After pondering for a moment, Gu Xing suddenly looked earnestly at the young Blood Ancestor before him, with a hint of seeking guidance in his eyes.
"Lilith, is there any way to enhance the control over domains for me and my Guardian Beasts?"
After all, in the Divine Secret Realm, he had seen that this Blood Ancestor’s control over domains had reached terrifying levels.
Not only could she freely control the intensity of the domains, but she could also effortlessly have the domains appear anywhere.
Such exquisite domain control ability is exactly what he...
and three Guardian Beasts are in dire need of!
This unexpected serious attitude stunned Lilith, who was originally prepared to continue criticizing.
She blinked her crimson big eyes, and her small ears among her silver hair twitched unconsciously...
Though she’s the Blood Ancestor.
But ever since her birth, she’s been constantly fighting.
Facing her kind, it’s either her dead or others dead.
This situation only eased when she became the new Blood Ancestor.
However...
Shortly after becoming the Blood Ancestor, she was injured in a battle, causing a drop in her realm.
The surrounding Blood Race wanted to kill her and take her place.
And those humans from the Holy See, only had awe for her.
Therefore...
She sneaked a look at the black-haired youth beside her.
Though receiving "special treatment" from his Guardian Beasts, this period allowed her to feel unprecedentedly at ease.
Beside Gu Xing...
She finally didn’t have to worry about being headless the next moment.
And Gu Xing also didn’t have the fear in his eyes that other humans had when looking at her.
"You want me to teach you?"
Lilith raised her little face, trying to maintain the majesty of the Blood Ancestor.
"Why should I agree to you?"Follow current novels on ɴo(v)elFɪre.ɴet
She deliberately dragged the ending sound long.
Though her heart had softened by eight parts, she still strained to maintain the remaining bit of arrogance.
But...
She seemed to have forgotten Vera’s existence.
The little one about the same height as the Blood Ancestor, maneuvering a vine, slowly appeared before Lilith.
Lilith’s pupils shrank, and the next moment, she recalled the days of torment by Vera.
She instantly became serious and spoke quickly:
"Improving one’s domain isn’t something that can be completed overnight! My domain was honed in countless battles."
"And if you want to quickly enhance your own domain control, I suggest you use less attribute enhancement methods in battles, and try using the domain against enemies."
"Your three Guardian Beasts are all Myth Level, their own domains are certainly not weak, they just haven’t yet fully utilized them."
Gu Xing thoughtfully nodded.
What Lilith said was right, the Guardian Beasts’ domains until now...
have been used very few times!
It seems that in the coming days...the strategy must change.
But at this moment, Lilith turned her gaze to Gu Xing, her little face suddenly solemn:
"Your Guardian Beasts should just learn domain application in battle, but as for you..."
Lilith paused, rarely frowning.
After all, Guardian Beasts’ battle instincts are ingrained.
Just after a few battles, they can slowly grasp the domain applications.
But Gu Xing, as a human...
"First, learn to control your Absolute Forbidden Domain, at least don’t affect your own Guardian Beast’s domain release."
"Once you can manipulate it at will, to only block enemy domains...then you’ve succeeded!"
After Lilith said these words, Gu Xing solemnly replied:
"Thank you!"
If no one told him this knowledge, he would surely spend quite some time exploring.
Therefore, he expressed his gratitude to Lilith without hesitation.
However...
This sudden formal thanks terrified the little Blood Ancestor who was initially smug.
"What are you doing!"
"This, this Blood Ancestor doesn’t need your thanks!"
She turned away awkwardly, yet couldn’t hide the reddened ears.
Only then did Gu Xing realize...
This thousand-year-old Blood Ancestor, fundamentally is an unabashedly arrogant lady.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 165: Taking the Initiative!
chapters.content:
Chapter 165: Chapter 165: Taking the Initiative!
On the journey ahead, Lilith unexpectedly took the initiative.
She used an ancient Blood Race secret technique, completely concealing everyone’s presence, rendering all Blood Race detection methods useless.
Seeing this scene, Liu Li and Qing Shuang gave Lilith a deep glance.
The straightforward Vera directly asked:
"With this ability, why didn’t you use it earlier?"
Lilith looked at the little elf who was about her height.
She turned her head and coldly snorted before speaking:
"I didn’t think of it!"
In truth, it wasn’t that she didn’t think of it.
Her original plan was to have that group of Blood Race block Gu Xing.
Approaching the Royal Capital would undoubtedly involve Monarch Level Blood Race.
At that time, when Gu Xing found himself in a desperate situation, he would have no choice but to seek her help.
She could then effortlessly obtain Gu Xing’s blood and restore her power.
However, now she had changed her mind.
She was not planning on doing it!
The time spent together these days had proven far more interesting than the days when she became the Blood Ancestor.
And with Lilith’s intervention as the Blood Ancestor.
Gu Xing and the others did not encounter a single Blood Race on their journey.
Thus, they safely arrived at a city not far from the Blood-colored Church and the Holy City.
This place is the gathering point for the Human Race of the Blood-colored Church!ᴛhis ᴜpdated by ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
When the city gate guards recognized Lilith’s figure, they immediately opened the gates respectfully and quickly sent word to the Church Court Empress.
Lilith, on the other hand, took Gu Xing directly to the center of this city.
At this moment.
Vera sneakily approached Gu Xing and asked beside him:
"Master, do you think this Blood Ancestor is up to no good? What if she has the Church Court Empress attack us later on."
Upon hearing Vera’s question, Gu Xing shook his head.
He wasn’t worried about such a situation.
After spending time together day and night, he had understood Lilith’s personality.
Although she was a lofty Blood Ancestor, her thoughts were no different from those of a child.
Moreover.....
The Church Court Empress is ultimately Human.
Even if in major decisions she would follow the Blood Ancestor’s will, she would nevertheless stand from a human perspective.
The most important factor is that Lei Zhan is here.
With his personality, he would never sit by and watch himself fall into danger.
It was after taking all these factors into account that Gu Xing felt so assured following Lilith into the heart of the Blood-colored Church.
Soon, under Lilith’s guidance.
Gu Xing, along with a few Guardian Beasts, arrived at the central chapel of this city.
When Gu Xing and his group entered, the Church Court Empress Isabelle and Saint Cecilia had long been awaiting them.
"Welcome back, Blood Ancestor!"
Both women bowed in unison, their long skirts trailing, their demeanor devout.
Lilith took this as customary, merely nodding slightly as she gracefully walked toward the seat symbolizing the highest authority at the end of the chapel.
Thud—
The small figure sat on the wide throne, yet it surprisingly didn’t seem out of place.
At this moment, although Lilith still appeared as a silver-haired loli, the aura of majesty she exuded commanded silence throughout the entire hall.
Meanwhile, Lei Zhan quietly approached Gu Xing, lowering his voice:
"Why did you come to the Blood-colored Church? Things aren’t exactly peaceful here!"
His initial plan was to return to Blue Star through the Blood-colored Church’s Void Gate for support, but on the way, he learned that the crisis had been resolved.
Coincidentally, the Blood-colored Church was undergoing a coup, and at Empress Isabelle’s earnest request, he decided to stay and help stabilize the situation.
Furthermore, the Divine Pattern concerns the fate of the Human Race!
If the chaos in the Blood-colored Church continued unchecked, the civilians here would inevitably become Blood Race’s blood food.
At that point, the second and third Divine Patterns, yet to appear, could be affected.
However, today, when the Church Court Empress told him of the Blood Ancestor’s return, he never imagined...
Gu Xing would appear together with the Blood Ancestor?!
Lei Zhan’s gaze shifted between Gu Xing and the silver-haired loli on the throne, his mind filled with questions.
How did these two seemingly unrelated individuals end up together?
Gu Xing succinctly recounted his encounter with Lilith, the changes in Longxia Country, and the purpose of this trip.
Upon hearing this, Lei Zhan learned...
About Ying Tian’s death and the deaths of most Commander Level Beast Masters.
A hint of sorrow flashed in his eyes.
Ying Tian, once his comrade-in-arms, was now worlds apart.
But the sorrow lingered in his eyes only for a fleeting moment, turning into an almost inaudible sigh.
Having experienced countless life-and-death situations, he was already accustomed to farewells.
Moreover, concerning Ying Tian’s body, he knew...
It was already a spent force.
Under Long Zhenguo’s strong persuasion, he agreed to retire in the Ying Family, taking care of the rear.
To be able to sacrifice himself on the battlefield now, perhaps...
Was the ending Ying Tian desired.
After organizing his thoughts, Lei Zhan finally turned his eyes towards Lilith on the throne.
Just then, Lilith slowly spoke:
"How have the Blood Race’s movements been recently?"
The Church Court Empress, upon hearing Lilith’s inquiry, immediately responded respectfully:
"Reporting to Blood Ancestor, the Blood Race rebels previously attempted several attacks. Fortunately, with Lei Zhan’s help, we barely held the line."
"But now... the rebels are rallying all High Tier Blood Race within the borders to move into the Holy City."
"Once they complete their assembly, they are sure to attack us again."
Hearing this news, Lilith slightly frowned.
In the Blood-colored Church, the Blood Race’s strength was still too overwhelming compared to the Human Race.
The entire Blood Race had no less than 20 Monarch Levels.
And the Human Race?
Not even ten!
The most crucial problem is...
Her current strength was only at Commander Tier One.
Even if she used the means she had left behind, her strength could only recover to Low Tier Monarch.
But the role that Low Tier Monarch could play in this battle isn’t significant.
Thus, Lilith’s gaze involuntarily landed on Gu Xing.
The best solution for now would still be to absorb this human’s blood.
To restore her power to a higher level.
However...
After pondering for a moment, she abandoned this idea.
After interacting with Gu Xing, she realized how terrifying this human’s potential was.
Dual Talents, Double Domain!
And four Myth Level Guardian Beasts!
Such potential even made her feel fear!
For a brief moment, she even felt an urge to become this human’s Guardian Beast.
But she immediately suppressed this thought fiercely.
Becoming this human’s Guardian Beast would mean...
She had to give up her Totem Level strength and start all over!
Such an outcome, she definitely couldn’t accept!
"Since the Blood Race is gathering strength..."
Lilith forced herself to collect her thoughts, her clear voice echoing in the hall.
"Then we should strike first!"
Her small hand slammed heavily on the armrest of the throne, exuding undeniable majesty despite her loli physique:
"Only by attacking proactively do we have a chance to win!"
Empress Isabelle bowed and accepted the command without hesitation.
Lei Zhan pondered for a moment and nodded as if enlightened.
This seemed the only strategy with a chance of success!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 166: How About Cooperation?
chapters.content:
Chapter 166: Chapter 166: How About Cooperation?
At the same time.
Blood-colored Church, Central Holy City.
The once solemn and majestic cathedral has now completely changed.
Scarlet drapes hang down, walls splattered with dried blood, and the air heavy with a sickly sweet metallic smell.
Having lost Lilith’s management, they have completely unleashed their true nature.
At this moment, a Blood Prince swirls the liquid in his crystal goblet and speaks slowly:
"We still haven’t found any trace of Lilith! But seventeen Monarch Level kindred have already arrived in the Holy City."
"Soon, we can completely wipe out those humans!"
Another Prince sneered and showed his fangs.
"Heh... Humans were supposed to be our blood feed; that crazy woman actually ordered protection for the food?"
"Protect food? Ridiculous!"
The Blood Princes exchanged glances and smiled grimly.
Previously, Lilith’s Level was only at Monarch Peak.
But her power far surpassed that Level.
With her control over the Domain and a profound understanding of combat, Lilith could effortlessly massacre Monarch Peak.
Therefore, despite full of grievances against Lilith, these Blood Princes did not dare to act rashly.
Now, they’ve finally caught a break.
And naturally, they wouldn’t miss it!
At this point, the lead Prince suddenly waved his hand, and the scarlet cape fluttered with a sound:
"Since we haven’t found her, then keep searching!"
"Without Lilith dead, my mind cannot rest!"
The Princes all nodded, murder intent glistening in their eyes.
As they prepared to send more men, a cold surge of Demonic Qi suddenly swept through the center of the hall.
The Blood Princes instantly went on guard.
"Demon Race?"
Almost immediately, all of them assumed combat postures.
Under their intense scrutiny, the Demonic Qi gradually solidified, and the Disguiser Demon God’s silhouette slowly emerged.
As he fully opened his pitch-black Demon Eyes, he curled his lips into a playful smile:
"Seems... you are not very welcoming of me?"
"Impudent!"
A Prince shouted sternly.
"A mere Demon Race dares to barge into the Blood Race Holy City alone? Do you really think we wouldn’t dare to kill you?"
The Disguiser Demon God ignored the threat and only smirked disdainfully:
"Words like this... do you really believe them?"
The Princes’ faces turned instantly ashen.
The words pierced their sore spot.
They could sense the aura released by this Demon Race...
On par with the previous Lilith!
Which meant, this Demon Race’s Level was undoubtedly Demon God.
To the Blood Race...
Obviously, nothing was more important than their safety.
The lead Prince raised a hand to calm his restless companions and stepped forward, feigning composure:
"You have come here specially, surely not to waste words. If there’s no urgent matter, please leave."
The Disguiser Demon God shook his head upon hearing this.
"I came to find you with another matter..."
His gaze swept across the Blood Race present.
"You’re worried Lilith will come back for power, while I want the Divine Pattern in Lilith’s body!"
"Why don’t we cooperate?"
Cooperate?
The Blood Princes exchanged glances.
Confirming they hadn’t misheard!The source of this content ɪs Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Seeing this, the Disguiser Demon God continued leisurely:
"You can’t find the Blood Ancestor’s whereabouts..."
"Nor do you have the courage to confront her head-on, right?"
These words left the Princes with mixed expressions.
The Disguiser Demon God was right.
Until now, they still feared Lilith.
Last time, despite well-prepared, Lilith escaped.
Now, she will surely restore her power and reappear...
That’s why they’re eager to find Lilith.
If Lilith regains her power, none of them can escape!
The lead Prince pondered for a long time before finally speaking:
"Tell us, how will we cooperate?"
The Disguiser Demon God grinned with a triumph gleam at this scene:
"Leave Lilith to me to handle... I guarantee to eliminate your biggest threat!"
"All I want is the Divine Pattern in her body, as for the Blood Ancestor Power..."
He paused meaningfully, "You can distribute it among yourselves."
Hearing the Demon God’s words, the Blood Princes exchanged glances.
This deal...
Seems like a surefire win!
If someone restrains the most troublesome Lilith...
As for the other humans, they aren’t feared at all.
Just a bunch of food.
"No problem! We’ll do as you say!" The lead Prince smiled grimly in agreement.
Seeing the Blood Race agree, the Disguiser Demon God showed a satisfied smile, but before leaving, he dropped a bombshell:
"A friendly reminder..."
"Your Blood Ancestor is leading the human army heading here."
His form gradually dissipated into wisps of Demonic Qi, leaving only a profound echo resonating in the hall.
On his way to the Holy City, he discovered Lilith’s movements.
He just didn’t have the confidence to deal with so many Monarch Level at once.
So, out of necessity...
He chose to cooperate with the Blood Race.
Despite agreeing to help the Blood Race against Lilith...
But when to act...
That’s up to him!
...
At this moment.
An elite squad is swiftly approaching the Holy City.
This squad, led personally by Lilith, is small in number but exudes a suffocating pressure.
All Monarch Level powerhouses, not a single Commander Level Beast Master among them.
Within the team, Lei Zhan frowned and whispered to Gu Xing beside him:
"This operation is all about Monarch Level battles, what are you doing here at Commander Tier Two?"
"If you randomly encounter a Monarch Level Blood Race, you can hardly protect yourself!"
But Gu Xing didn’t answer Lei Zhan’s question. His gaze fixed on Lilith ahead.
"Don’t worry, Commander Lei, I can definitely protect myself."
"Besides... the Blood Ancestor personally insisted I come along."
Lei Zhan’s mouth twitched involuntarily, his mind anxious.
He really couldn’t understand why Lilith had to bring Gu Xing along.
Even if Gu Xing had great talent, he was only Commander Tier Two!
If something happens to Gu Xing...
That would be a huge loss.
Thinking of this, he almost wanted to take Gu Xing away immediately.
But Gu Xing was oblivious to Lei Zhan’s many thoughts, still focusing ahead.
Before leaving, Lilith specifically approached him and instructed:
"You must be part of this battle!"
"Or else you can forget about getting the Light Divine Crystal!"
Thus, he had no choice but to participate in this operation.
Even though it’s a forced journey, Gu Xing understood clearly.
Lilith treats him as "insurance."
With his Divine Rune Blood around...
Even if the battle turns unfavorable, she can restore power at any time to reverse the tide.
A team member reminded then:
"We’ve arrived..."
In the distance, the towering outline of the Holy City is faintly visible.
The bloody twilight envelops the city walls, like an ominous layer of crimson scabs.
Gu Xing squinted slightly.
Looking at these city walls, he felt an ominous foreboding.
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 167: The Opportunity Arrives!
chapters.content:
Chapter 167: Chapter 167: The Opportunity Arrives!
Gu Xing’s speculation was quickly confirmed.
Just as the team approached the Holy City, a large number of the Blood Race suddenly appeared, surrounding them tightly.
Seeing this scene, the people’s expressions changed slightly.
They didn’t expect this group of Blood Race to be so well-prepared in advance!
But as the situation stands...
Retreat is impossible!
"Prepare for battle!"
With the command of the Church Court Empress, all the humans present were fully on their guard.
At the forefront, Lilith locked her gaze firmly on the several Blood Princes.
These Blood Princes were the fuse of the entire Blood-colored Church rebellion.
Under Lilith’s scarlet gaze, the princes instinctively averted their eyes.
Even after many days, Lilith’s aura still made them shiver instinctively.
But soon, they remembered the pact with the Demon God, relaxing their tense nerves.
As long as Lilith is held up by that Demon God, the other humans...
Are nothing to fear!
Moreover, there are currently five Blood Princes at Monarch Peak, with nearly twenty Monarch-level Blood Race.
And as for the human side?
Only two at Monarch Peak, and six or seven Monarch-level experts.
Such a huge disparity...
How could they possibly lose?
At this moment.
Lei Zhan looked at the Blood Race ahead, his expression equally heavy.
The situation is extremely unfavorable now!
The original plan was to raid the Holy City and catch them off guard, didn’t expect...
This group of Blood Race gathered so quickly!
In just this short time they’ve gathered so many Monarch-level Blood Race.
Today’s plan is hard to succeed!
Thinking of this, he discreetly moved to Gu Xing’s side, his voice extremely low:
"If the situation changes later, you retreat immediately, I’ll cover you."
If the Blood-colored Church’s action fails this time...
It will definitely affect the formation of the remaining two Divine Patterns for humanity!
He must stay!
But Gu Xing cannot!
Hearing this, Gu Xing was stunned, just about to speak when Lei Zhan interrupted sternly:
"That’s an order!"
Hearing these words, Gu Xing immediately gave up arguing.
After all, the matter of Lilith recovering strength through Divine Pattern blood is known only to him at the moment.
Lei Zhan’s current response is understandable!
Gu Xing’s eyes swept over the Blood Race, who had already formed a circle of encirclement.
The situation is already out of control, for Lilith to seize the upper hand, she must extract his blood to restore her strength.
But Lilith doesn’t seem to intend on doing so right now!
Up front, Lilith squinted her scarlet eyes, sizing up the dense army of Blood Race.
Her current strength is only at King Tier One, even with full power, she can at most hold off one Monarch Peak.
Yet the Blood Race have five at Monarch Peak!
Moreover, what worries her even more...
Is a Demon God-level Monarch Peak Demon Race lurking in the shadows.
Last time, by the restored body through Divine Pattern, she escaped a disaster, but she clearly knows...
The opponent will never let it go easily.
With the cunning of that Demon God, it is certain they can guess she’ll return to the Holy City.
The reality is indeed as Lilith thought.
At the edge of the battlefield, the Disguiser Demon God was greedily watching the silver-haired girl’s figure.
His pale fingers unconsciously stroked his chin, dangerous light flickering in his black demon eyes:
"Finally waiting for you, my dear Blood Ancestor..."
"Soon... the Divine Pattern will be mine."
The Demon God licked his sharp fangs greedily, his gaze casually sweeping over the human camp.
As long as the Blood Race holds off the others, he can focus entirely on dealing with Lilith.
This time, he absolutely cannot let the "Blood Ancestor" escape!
However...
When his gaze passed over Gu Xing, his pupils suddenly contracted.
This is...?!
His gaze was locked onto Gu Xing’s forehead.
Previously, when spotting Lilith and others, he only glanced from afar.
And now, during the confrontation of the two sides, he observed...
The young human’s forehead was clearly imprinted with a second Divine Pattern!
Heaven helps me!The source of thɪs content is NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
His eyes instantly shone brightly, even his breathing became heavy.
There are two Divine Patterns here!
One Divine Pattern is within the Blood Ancestor, and another is actually on this human of only Commander Tier Two!
Compared to dealing with the battle-experienced Blood Ancestor, killing this weak human is simply a piece of cake.
As long as he gets the Divine Pattern...
The demon god’s black pupils flashed with madness.
At that time, he will directly break through to Totem Level.
With Totem-level strength, he can easily sweep through the entire battlefield.
Then acquiring the second Divine Pattern...
His strength will further enhance!
At this moment, the Disguiser Demon God could already imagine calling the shots as a Totem-level Demon Race.
But soon, he forcibly suppressed the surging Demonic Qi, forcing himself to calm down.
The most crucial step now is to kill that human.
Currently, there are too many Monarch-level experts around that human, it’s easy to make a mistake.
But once the battle starts...
That human will definitely be isolated!
By that time, with his power, he is guaranteed to kill with one strike!
Just at this moment.
The Blood Race on the battlefield could no longer hold back.
"Kill these humans!"
"Take down the Blood Ancestor!"
These Monarch-level Blood Race gathered here were without exception rebels with lingering resentment against Lilith’s rule.
At this moment, seeing victory at hand, all the Blood Race went mad.
With deafening roars, all the Blood Race charged at Gu Xing and the others.
And the Church Court Empress, not daring to be careless, immediately commanded loudly:
"Everyone summon your Guardian Beasts! Meet the enemy!"
Because the Beast Masters could contract with multiple Guardian Beasts, and all present Beast Masters were elite among the elite.
With the help of multiple Monarch-level Guardian Beasts, the Human Race surprisingly withstood the Blood Race’s attack.
And Lei Zhan and the Church Court Empress faced the five Blood Princes together.
They each summoned their four Guardian Beasts, totaling eight.";
Although not all Guardian Beasts were at Monarch Peak, relying on the eight Guardian Beasts and their own strength...
They surprisingly managed to barely withstand the five Monarch Peak Blood Princes together!
But Gu Xing could feel that they couldn’t hold on for long.
Holding them off for a while was no problem, but as time passed, they would definitely be defeated.
At this moment, Lilith also felt this.
She also understood that she couldn’t remain inactive.
"Immortal Blood Body!"
Raging blood suddenly enveloped Lilith, her youthful appearance instantly fading.
A crimson dress like blood wrapped around her body, and her figure also rose, becoming tall and dignified.
The Red Queen descended onto the battlefield, her aura sweeping across the field.
In the instant her Attribute Enhancement was completed, she suddenly charged at a Monarch Peak Blood Prince.
She diverted one Monarch Peak Blood Prince, relieving much of the pressure on Lei Zhan and the Church Court Empress!
However...
At this time, she still kept a thread of attention, constantly guarding against that Demon Race’s move.
After all, that Demon Race was the biggest threat!
And in the shadows, the Disguiser Demon God saw Lilith finally leave Gu Xing’s side, a bloodthirsty smile played on his lips.
The opportunity has arrived!
The Divine Pattern is within reach!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 168: Blood Covenant!
chapters.content:
Chapter 168: Chapter 168: Blood Covenant!
After making up his mind, the Demonic Qi around the Disguiser Demon God suddenly surged.
He held nothing back, unleashing a full-force strike—
Even though the human before him was only a Commander Tier Two, he wanted to ensure there were no mishaps.
His figure transformed into a pitch-black arrow, carrying the terrifying pressure of a King Level, shooting straight at Gu Xing!
At the moment the Demonic Qi erupted, Lilith’s whole body tensed.
Instinctively suspecting the Demon God would sneak attack her, she immediately fully extended her domain...
Forcing back the Blood Prince in front of her, swiftly pulling away and preparing for battle.
Yet, as she focused and remained on guard, her pupils suddenly contracted—
The direction that demon shadow attacked...
It was Gu Xing!
"Damn it!"
Lilith trembled all over, suddenly realizing she had overlooked the most critical point—
Not only did she possess a Divine Pattern, Gu Xing was also a Divine Pattern bearer!
The Demon Race killing Gu Xing could achieve the same goal!
As this thought flashed by, she transformed into a crimson streak, racing toward Gu Xing.
She had to save him before the Demon Race could succeed!
Not just for the victory of this battle...
Deep down, she could not allow this human to die at the hands of the Demon Race!
"Faster..."
The crimson pupils abruptly contracted, her blood energy exploded, increasing her speed once more!
However—
The Disguiser Demon God was at Monarch Peak, while she was only King Tier One.
More fatally, the Demon Race had already acted first...
"Swish!"
The pitch-black demon shadow approached Gu Xing faster than the crimson light, Lilith could even see the trajectory of the Demon Race’s claws tearing through the air.
Time seemed to stretch infinitely—
She watched helplessly as the gleaming claw blades neared Gu Xing’s throat inch by inch, the ghastly smile at the corner of the demon’s mouth enlarging in her vision...
At that moment, her breath halted.
It’s over...
Yet.
"Bang—!"
A crisp collision sound suddenly rang out.
The Disguiser Demon God’s face changed dramatically, staring incredulously at the scene in front of him—Follow current novᴇls on NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
The suddenly appeared golden barrier had blocked his fatal strike completely!
"How is this possible?!"
His body abruptly froze, the Demonic Qi swirling claws suspended in midair.
This barrier clearly came from that human’s Guardian Beast...
But how could a mere Commander Tier Two Guardian Beast block a Monarch Peak full-force attack?!
At this moment.
Beside Gu Xing, in Liu Li’s pupils, the Ultimate Fire of crimson gold burned.
This golden barrier was indeed her skill release...
Divine Protection!
Absolute Defense!
Before the action, Lilith had already warned that the Blood-colored Church was lurking with the Demon Race.
Gu Xing specifically had Liu Li ready to activate Divine Protection, originally to protect Lilith...
Unexpectedly, the Demon Race turned and aimed directly at him!
Thus, Liu Li’s preparation exactly served its purpose.
At the moment of the Demon Race’s attack, Liu Li activated her Divine Protection skill.
Only then was this Monarch Peak Demon Race’s attack successfully blocked!
At this moment, Gu Xing’s gaze pierced through the flickering golden barrier, locking onto this Demon Race.
[Disguiser]
[Talent: Demon God]
[Level: Monarch Peak]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: ???]
[Speed: ???]
[Skills: Demon God’s Body, Demon God Domain....]
[Kill Reward: Additional Guardian Beast Contract Quota]
Gu Xing’s pupils slightly contracted, a series of question marks appeared on the data panel.
A Monarch Peak Demon God—
This was already beyond the scope he could currently explore.
But...
The throat unconsciously rolled slightly, Gu Xing felt his heart rate accelerate.
The Demon God’s killing reward...
Too tempting!
If he could kill this Demon God...
He would be able to gain another contract quota once again.
After killing the Wolf Demon God last time, he obtained an additional contract quota at the Extraordinary Level.
This contract quota allowed him to contract Qing Shuang and Fei Yue!
These two Guardian Beasts provided him immense help.
And now...
He encountered such an opportunity once more.
Only...
But reason quickly extinguished this desire.
The presence at Monarch Peak was far beyond what he could contend with now.
Gu Xing could only force himself to look away, deeply suppressing this tempting thought.
For now, he...
Could only choose to give up.
And seeing the golden barrier before Gu Xing, Lilith also froze for a moment.
But in the next moment, she snapped back to reality.
"Boom—"
The Blood Domain fully opened, violent energy violently blasted the Disguiser Demon God away!
The crimson figure flickered, and Lilith firmly stood between Gu Xing and the Demon God.
Without turning back, she pretended to ask calmly:
"Gu Xing, are you alright?"
She didn’t realize, but there was a hint of urgency in her tone never present before.
Gu Xing did not notice the anomaly in the Blood Ancestor’s tone; he simply shook his head and said:
"I’m fine, but..."
"I didn’t expect this Demon God to target me instead of you!"
Lilith still faced away from him.
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s safe response, she secretly breathed a sigh of relief in her heart.
"It was my oversight."
"You also have a Divine Pattern, and your strength... just gave this Demon God the opportunity to act."
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
Wasn’t Lilith implying that his strength was lacking?
That’s why this Demon God chose to attack him.
However, what Lilith said was also true. Gu Xing didn’t mind, merely silently checking Lilith’s attributes.
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Extremely Weak]
[Level: King Tier One]
[Power: 100000]
[Constitution: 100000]
[Spirit: 100000]
[Speed: 100000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Lilith’s attributes are strong!
Although her level is merely King Tier One, each attribute was comparable to a King Tier Three Demon King!
He pondered slightly and understood the key points.
First, she naturally had extraordinary talent;
Secondly, even if her level fell to King Level, her foundation was once that of a Totem, thus her attributes were incredibly formidable!
But even so...
His gaze turned to the Demon God.
Crossing the chasm from King Tier One to Peak was still too challenging.
Lilith was equally aware of this.
A trace of determination flashed in her blood-colored pupils—
Now, there was only one way to break the situation:
Absorb Gu Xing’s blood to recover part of her strength.
Her fingertips unconsciously rubbed together, she was now caught in a dilemma!
From her recent interactions with Gu Xing, she discovered an odd occurrence.
That is...
Whenever near Gu Xing, her dormant Divine Pattern became unusually active.
After all, the Divine Pattern was related to the Blood Race’s fortune.
By Gu Xing’s side, could the Blood Race’s fortune increase?
Though she was reluctant to admit it, judging by the Divine Pattern’s behavior, this seemed to be a fact.
Should she become Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast?
This thought reoccurred in her mind.
But soon, she again dismissed it.
No!
She could not abandon her power!
However, the guidance of the Divine Pattern was clearly to approach Gu Xing, coupled with the current situation...
Lilith gritted her teeth, making up her mind.
Since she couldn’t accept becoming this human’s Guardian Beast, then first with this human...
Form a Blood Covenant!

chapters.title: Chapter 169: You Got Off Easy!
chapters.content:
Chapter 169: Chapter 169: You Got Off Easy!
Becoming this human’s Guardian Beast would restrict her strength.
Right now, at Monarch Peak power....
Might even drop to Commander Tier Two!
But using the Blood Race’s unique Blood Covenant...
There won’t be such a worry.
The two bonded by the Blood Covenant form an equal partnership.
She can not only establish a connection with this human, ensuring the Divine Pattern doesn’t decay.
But also maintain her own strength!
When this human truly grows in the future....
She’ll then choose to become this human’s Guardian Beast!
The best of both worlds!
Moreover....
Though she doesn’t dislike this human, it doesn’t mean she’s willing to become his Guardian Beast.
Thus the Blood Covenant is the best choice!
However, the Contract requires time to prepare...
Before that——
She has to control this Demon God first!
Blood light surged in Lilith’s eyes, with waves of blood aura raging around her.
On the other side, the Demon God finally steadied his form after being knocked back.
He narrowed his eyes, staring intently at Gu Xing.
This human...
No wonder he could acquire the Divine Pattern.
Even though he, a Demon God of Monarch Peak, personally attacked, it could still be blocked.
But he also noticed...
That golden barrier seems usable only once.
He curled his lips into a cruel smile.
This Commander Tier Two human is not worth considering.
Then, his gaze shifted to Lilith.
She’s his real opponent!
At this moment, he gazed at Lilith with a touch of mockery:
"Dear Blood Ancestor, we meet again~"
"This time, can you still escape?"
During this time, he figured everything out.
Lilith must have used the power of the Divine Pattern to leave a safeguard.
Otherwise, relying solely on the Blood Race’s power to leave a body would never have deceived his Perception.
Moreover——
The power of the Divine Pattern can’t be used again in a short time!
He was completely unworried that Lilith could escape again.
"Blood Ancestor," a hint of temptation appeared on his face, "the previous terms still stand."
"As long as you hand over the Divine Pattern, not only will I let you go, but I will also help you fight these Blood Race members."
Being an enemy of Lilith is far more dangerous than opposing that group of Blood Race members.
If Lilith would willingly hand over the Divine Pattern.
That undoubtedly would be the best outcome!
But...
A chill flashed in Lilith’s blood-red pupils.
Having lived countless years, how could she be deceived by this clumsy lie?
Handing over the Divine Pattern would entrust her life entirely to the other party...
Moreover, she’s already made up her mind.
Without looking back, her voice reached Gu Xing’s ears.
"Gu Xing, prepare to enter a Blood Covenant with me!"
Gu Xing was stunned by her words.
Blood Covenant?
What’s a Blood Covenant?
His understanding of the Blood Race was limited to begin with.
Moreover...
The Blood Covenant mentioned by Lilith wasn’t something ordinary Blood Race members could access.
But at this moment.
Vera suddenly emerged from the Beast Taming Space, her small face filled with shock.
Having inherited some memories, she understood what a Blood Covenant meant to the Blood Race.
But given the current situation...
Even if Lilith didn’t request anything, her master would offer his blood to help Lilith restore her power.
After all, Gu Xing couldn’t just watch so many Monarch Level powerhouses of the Blood-colored Church all fall.
Humans would suffer extremely severe losses.
So why would Lilith propose a Blood Covenant?
But the Blood Covenant...
Vera suddenly turned, her green eyes seeing the rebellious Blood Race members.
Her pupils shrank, seeming to understand something.
It’s the Divine Pattern!
It must be the influence of the Divine Pattern!
She recalled her abnormal state when she first acquired the Divine Pattern.
Logically, with only herself left in the Elf Clan.
The Divine Pattern should undoubtedly be in a weak state.
When she first began to merge the Divine Pattern, it indeed was so.
However...
As time passed, she discovered...
The weakened Divine Pattern surprisingly started reviving slowly, and even enhancing at a visible speed.
And now, nearly the entire Blood Race has rebelled, if Lilith cleans house——
The Divine Pattern may weaken to a point near dispersion!
Therefore.
Lilith proposes to undergo a Blood Covenant with her master....
Perhaps realizing that the Divine Pattern would strengthen while near Gu Xing.The source of thɪs content is
Yet, Lilith is unwilling to become Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast, hence opting for the second-best choice of a Blood Covenant.
Thinking of this, she immediately approached Gu Xing, tugging his sleeve:
"Master, agree to it! The Blood Covenant benefits us!"
Gu Xing turned to glance at his little elf.
He had unconditional trust in his Guardian Beast.
Since Vera said to agree...
He naturally had no reason to hesitate!
And before Gu Xing.
"Blood Domain: Cage!"
Lilith’s surrounding blood aura erupted like a thunderclap, scarlet energy surged like living creatures.
"Bang——"
A monstrous blood tide instantly condensed around the Demon God, turning into a dark red cage trapping him tight.
The cost of this strike was clear.
Lilith’s figure swayed slightly, her blood-red hair concealing a visage pale as paper.
Clearly, this move nearly exhausted all of Lilith’s strength.
Having done all this, Lilith whirled around abruptly.
She could sense the Domain Cage could only hold for...
Thirty seconds!
So she had to seize the moment and contract the Blood Covenant with Gu Xing.
Lilith was in her true form, close behind Gu Xing.
Her eyes, as if capable of dripping blood, were fixed on Gu Xing:
"Human, enter the Blood Covenant with me!"
"Alright!"
Gu Xing agreed without hesitation.
This straightforward answer left Lilith momentarily stunned.
All the speeches she prepared were stuck in her throat.
But on second thought...
Gu Xing’s willingness to enter a contract was beneficial!
She glanced at the Demon God trapped in the Blood Domain.
"Crack... click..."
Cracks appeared on the surface of the Blood Domain.
Lilith’s heart tightened.
Given her current strength, trapping a Monarch Peak for such a duration was her limit...
No more delay!
"Lucky for you..."
Lilith abruptly pulled Gu Xing into her embrace, her movement brisk to leave Gu Xing unable to react.
Her sharp fangs instantly pierced the skin on Gu Xing’s neck, warm blood rushing into her mouth.
This was...
Gu Xing felt dizziness but curiously no pain.
Lilith’s blood-red eyes grew even more crimson at the moment of drinking blood, blood aura surged like a storm.
Blood energy coiled layer upon layer, soon wrapping both completely, forming a massive blood cocoon.
"Boom——"
On the other side, the Demon God finally shredded the blood cage.
His expression twisted into fierceness!
"Twice now!"
"Not only did I fail to deal with that Commander Tier Two human, but was also trapped by Lilith of King Tier One!"
Damn it!
His black eyes scanned across the battlefield.
Only to see...
Where Lilith originally stood, a blood cocoon emerged.
What’s this?
A sudden sense of foreboding climbed up his spine.
Inside the blood cocoon is Lilith?
But...
Why is the aura this blood cocoon emits rising rapidly?
And at a terrifying pace!

chapters.title: Chapter 170: Lilith’s Power Doubled!
chapters.content:
Chapter 170: Chapter 170: Lilith’s Power Doubled!
At the same time.
Just at the moment when the blood cocoon was formed—
The Blood Princes currently entangled with Lei Zhan suddenly paused.
Is that... the aura of a Blood Covenant?
Their scarlet eyes contracted fiercely, disbelief appearing on their faces.
"Has Lilith gone mad?"
"To actually make a Blood Covenant with a mere human of Commander Tier Two?!"
It should be known that within the Blood Race...
Blood Covenants have always existed only between equally powerful individuals of the same status.
And usually, the Covenant is between a man and a woman.
It’s even privately referred to as—
"A Marriage Contract!"
After all, mutual slaughter is quite common within the Blood Race.
To avoid this situation, the existence of Blood Covenants was established.
The lives of both parties signing a Blood Covenant will be shared!
If one dies, the other won’t escape!
And now, Lilith has signed a Blood Covenant with a human of Commander Tier Two.
The Blood Princes tacitly pushed back Lei Zhan, quickly exchanging glances.
Opportunity!
Previously, they were afraid of Lilith’s power.
But now, she’s bound herself.
Binding her life to a human.
Isn’t this giving them a chance?
The leading Blood Prince’s mouth curled into a sinister grin, commanding:
"You hold off these two humans; I’ll go help that Demon God deal with Lilith!"
"No problem!"
The Blood Princes responded with sinister smiles.
They know quite well.
Although the Demon God promised to deal with Lilith...
But judging from the results just now, it seems that the Demon God hasn’t gained any advantage over Lilith.
Now that Lilith has signed a contract with that human.
So, as long as they deal with that Commander Tier Two human during the battle between the Demon God and Lilith,
This battle can be completely declared over.
At this moment, inside the blood cocoon.
Gu Xing could clearly perceive—
His spiritual power was resonating wonderfully with Lilith’s.
More astonishing was the change in life force.
He noticed some kind of mystical connection established between them:
If one gets hurt, the other’s life force will automatically flow to the injured party...
For now...
Signing a contract with Lilith seems to have only benefits for him, no downsides.
After all, his rank is only Commander Tier Two.
But Lilith’s is King Level.
In comparison...
He’s more likely to be in trouble.
Moreover, Lilith’s rank has once again increased with the help of his blood!
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Extremely Weak (Recovering)]
[Level: King Tier Five]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: ???]
[Speed: ???]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
The values on the data panel kept fluctuating.
Until Lilith’s attributes also reached a point of being completely ???.
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted slightly.
He didn’t understand how much exactly Lilith had improved.
However...
Her level surged from King Tier One all the way to King Tier Five!
Currently, Lilith should handle facing that Demon God much more easily.
Even though there might still be a gap in attributes with the Demon God...
But with Lilith’s control over domains and combat experience,
These are more than enough to make up for it!
Inside the cocoon.
Lilith slowly opened her eyes.
As she withdrew her fangs from Gu Xing’s neck, a hint of crimson remained at the corner of her lips.
Her tongue unconsciously licked her lips.
Even though she seldom drank blood...
She could sense that Gu Xing’s blood was absolutely top-notch.
No one else could have such sweetness.
Only relying on the willpower of a Totem-level powerhouse, she forcibly restrained the urge to continue feeding—
Continuing might harm Gu Xing.
Even so...
She felt the surging power within her.
Now her power was sufficient!
Battle intent flared in her scarlet eyes as she gently pushed Gu Xing away.
Now it was time to settle new and old grudges with this Demon God!
Just at this moment, she sensed a presence swiftly approaching them.
"Hmm?"
Lilith’s gaze pierced behind her like a sharp blade—
The Blood Prince charging towards Gu Xing suddenly froze!
The Blood Prince’s Adam’s apple jerked involuntarily.
Being locked by Lilith’s blood-colored eyes, he felt like prey being stared at by an ancient beast...
More frightening was—
Just in that brief instant.
Lilith’s level had actually reached...
King Tier Five?!
His heart suddenly grew heavy.
But when he glanced at Gu Xing from the corner of his eye.
He breathed a sigh of relief.
No problem...
As long as they eliminate this human, no matter how strong Lilith is, she will accompany him in death!
At this point, Lilith also realized the Blood Prince’s intention.
She gently reached out, shielding Gu Xing behind her.
The Demon God had now appeared beside the Blood Prince, a rare heaviness in his Demon Eyes:
If Lilith was previously King Tier One, his victory was certain.
But now with Lilith reaching King Tier Five, his chances had dropped to four in ten.
To deal with Lilith now...
His only option was to collaborate with this Blood Prince!
"I’ll hold off the Blood Ancestor while you seize the chance to kill that human."
"No problem!"
The two quickly reached a consensus—
The Demon God turned into a black shadow leaping towards Lilith, while the Blood Prince cunningly distanced himself, those crimson eyes fixed on Gu Xing.
The situation suddenly became tense!
Even with Lilith’s greatly increased power, Gu Xing’s presence truly became her Achilles’ heel...
Yet at this moment, Gu Xing stared at Lilith’s back, suddenly thinking of something—
[Soul Devouring Talent]
[Effect: Guardian Beast All Attribute Enhancement 200%]
A bold thought appeared!
After the Blood Covenant, does Lilith... count as his Guardian Beast?
Could she enjoy the 200% enhancement from Soul Devouring?
After all, Lilith’s current power was enough to contend with the Demon God.
If her power were to double...
She could absolutely crush the Demon God!
With that in mind, Gu Xing immediately acted.
His blood-colored spiritual power surged forth!
Enveloping Lilith like tides—
If that’s the case, let’s give it a try...Google seaʀᴄh NovᴇlFir(e).nᴇt
The moment he acted, delight flashed across his face.
It turned out to be possible!
And Lilith suddenly felt Gu Xing’s power envelop her.
The next moment, her body suddenly stiffened!
She felt her power rapidly increasing...
This power...
So that’s it!
This human’s Guardian Beasts all enjoy such treatment!
Attribute Enhancement 200%!
No wonder...
In the Divine Secret Realm, even her Blood Clone, almost of Commander Middle Tier power, was defeated by two Extraordinary Level Guardian Beasts working together.
A dangerous arc unconsciously formed at the corner of her mouth.
This exhilarating feeling...
It’s simply addictive!
Lilith’s gaze shifted to the Demon God and that Prince-level Blood Race member.
Previously, she had little confidence in eliminating these two while protecting Gu Xing.
But now...
"Boom—"
A tremendous wave of blood exploded, centered around Lilith!
The enhanced Blood Domain instantly enveloped the entire battlefield.
With her attributes enhanced, Lilith could unleash a stronger domain.
An enhanced domain, to Lilith, meant enhanced combat power.
After the double enhancement...
Her power was now infinitely close to the Totem Level!
