chapters.title: Chapter 171: Blood Race Traitors—Dead!
chapters.content:
Chapter 171: Chapter 171: Blood Race Traitors—Dead!
The moment the Blood Domain enveloped the battlefield—
The Disguiser Demon God’s expression froze completely.
The four-tenths chance of victory just seconds ago, in that instant...
Instantly dropped to zero!
His body suddenly stiffened.
He could sense that the Blood Ancestor had signed a Blood Covenant with that human.
But...
Why can this human make Lilith’s power surge so terrifyingly?
To know, at their level of strength....
It is extremely difficult to enhance strength even a bit.
But Lilith...
In just that instant, her power unexpectedly doubled!
Directly going from slightly weaker than him, to the extent of crushing him!
How is this possible?!
He mechanically turned around, his Demon Eyes fixedly staring at Gu Xing!
This human...
This Commander Tier Two human he overlooked.
What exactly did he do?!
At this moment, his body subtly trembled, unable to maintain the calm expression any longer.
The situation on the scene had completely exceeded his control.
"Boom!"
Demonic Qi suddenly surged violently—
But not for attacking, instead madly rushing toward the Domain’s edge!
At this moment, any Divine Patterns, any plans were thrown to the wayside!
Only the most primitive instinct to survive remained in the Demon God’s mind:
Escape!
Must escape!
His figure transformed into a jet-black stream of light, unwilling to burn his essence to break through the Domain lockdown...
However—
The Demon God only charged two steps before his figure suddenly froze in place!
At the center of the Domain.
Lilith withdrew her gaze indifferently, and with just a mind motion, the strength of the Domain area where the Disguiser Demon God stood instantly increased tenfold.
She wanted to keep this Demon God for last!
Afterward, her gaze slowly swept over this group of Blood Race traitors.
The coldness in her blood-colored pupils grew more intense—
As the Blood Ancestor, she indeed issued the decree to protect humans...
But over the millennia, every time the Blood Race faced annihilation, it was always her who stepped up!
Even the injury that caused her to fall from Totem Level was left to protect this Blood Race.
One could say she is the savior of all Blood Race!
However...
The Blood Race she saved not only didn’t appreciate her, but instead constantly wanted to replace her.
Her eyes narrowed slightly.
If previously she had to endure this group of treacherous Blood Race to prevent the decline of Blood Race Divine Patterns...
Then now...
Her Spiritual Power scanned the Divine Pattern in her mind.
As she had guessed.
As long as she establishes a connection with Gu Xing, the Divine Pattern will slowly strengthen.
And the strengthening of the Divine Pattern means her power will gradually recover.
Realizing this, a cruel arc lifted at the corner of Lilith’s mouth.
Since that’s the case...
This group’s only use has vanished, what necessity is there for their existence?
The temperature in the Domain suddenly plummeted to the freezing point!
Meanwhile.
Under the Blood Domain’s cloak, the entire battlefield instantly fell into a deathly silence.
All Blood Race members fearfully distanced themselves from human elites—
From the Domain’s pressure, they could clearly feel Lilith’s current strength...
Absolutely surpassing the Monarch Peak!
Such strength...
Means Lilith can crush them like ants.
In an instant, this group of Blood Race members understood the situation.
"Thud—"
Almost simultaneously, all Blood Race kneeled together on the ground.The most update n0vels are published on NovᴇlFirenᴇt
"Lady Lilith! We were momentarily confused!"
"We beg for your forgiveness! We will swear undying loyalty!"
"Lady Lilith, please see through! It was those few Princes who tempted us!"
Plaintive pleas for mercy resounded throughout the Blood Domain.
Yet, although these Blood Race members were terrified, deep down, they retained a sliver of hope—
Lilith could not possibly wipe them out completely.
Otherwise, if the Blood Race declines, she would suffer backlash too.
Thus, even if they had betrayed Lilith before, or even attempted to assassinate her...
They believed that considering the bigger picture, Lilith would inevitably spare them.
It’s not just the Blood Race who thought this—
Even the Church Court Empress had the same notion.
Having dealt with the Blood Race for years, she understood the survival principles of this race.
Though Lilith detested this group of peers tremendously, even when her strength completely eclipsed this group who wished to replace her.
But she never acted to clear out the treacherous peers.
Now, all Blood Race members pleaded for mercy.
Lilith would likely tolerate this group’s continued survival.
Having accompanied Lilith all these years, she was aware of some of Lilith’s thoughts.
However...
Her gaze involuntarily turned to Gu Xing.
The only thing she hadn’t foreseen was...
The Blood Ancestor would actually establish a Blood Covenant with this human?
Even more astonishing——
The key to Lilith’s restoration of strength lies with this Commander Tier Two Beast Master!
Nonetheless, the Church Court Empress did not know.
Lilith now is far from the Lilith of old...
"Heh..."
Lilith glanced at the kneeling, pleading Blood Race members, her lips curved into a cruel cold smile.
Now you regret it?
Too late!
"This time, you have no chance."
Before the words finished, she gracefully lifted her hand, five fingers slowly closing—
While this group of Blood Race was still puzzled by what Lilith meant by those words, the next moment...
They felt an extremely terrifying pressure descending on them from all sides.
They immediately realized this was Lilith acting against them.
The Blood Race members instantly pleaded aloud:
"Lady Lilith, you cannot treat us this way."
"Aren’t you considering the Blood Race at all?"
However, Lilith’s hand showed no sign of hesitating.
What she’s doing, is precisely for the sake of the Blood Race.
If this plague continues to exist.
Someday, the Blood Race would be ruined by them.
Without the slightest hesitation, Lilith’s hands suddenly tightened.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Low Tier Monarch Level Blood Race barely had time to react, their bodies exploded into a succession of blood mist!
A few Blood Princes, due to their stronger strength, were still struggling at this moment.
"Lady Lilith! Are you truly going to destroy the foundation of the Blood Race?!"
"We have realized our mistakes, after killing so many Monarch Level Blood Race members, you should be appeased now!"
"Indeed! Lady Lilith, you should prioritize the larger picture!"
A few Blood Princes maintained a thread of hope.
Believing that Lilith was merely venting by killing these low Tier Monarch Level Blood Race members, as for them, the true elite force of the Blood Race...
Only through the death of these low Tier Monarch Level Blood Race members was a warning given.
However.
The only response was further terrifying oppression.
Lilith’s eyes were icy cold, her hands completing the squeeze without pause—
"Crack!"
The bodies of the last few Princes began to crack...
Lilith knew better than anyone.
Leaving these troublemakers behind is the most irresponsible act towards the Blood Race!
Furthermore...
She wouldn’t eradicate this group of Blood Race entirely; she would preserve their blood.
And blood is the power source of the Blood Race.
As long as this group of Monarch Level Blood Race’s blood is passed on to other Blood Race members...
It wouldn’t take long before new Monarch Level Blood Race members appear!
Lilith coldly observed the all-encompassing blood mist, without a trace of wavering.
Having vanquished this group of Blood Race members, she’ll simply cultivate another batch.
Now, without worrying about the weakening of Divine Patterns, she could completely reconstruct the Blood Race according to her vision!
"Boom——"
The Domain’s pressure suddenly escalated!
The few Blood Princes could no longer resist.
Their bodies shattered like fragile glass under absolute force!
"Crash——"
At the moment this group of Blood Princes’ bodies exploded, the entire blood-colored Church’s human elites collectively fell silent.
She truly annihilated them!
The Blood Ancestor really slaughtered all these Monarch Level Blood Race elites!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 172: Farewell, Demon Pattern!
chapters.content:
Chapter 172: Chapter 172: Farewell, Demon Pattern!
Lilith paid no attention to the shocked crowd, her cold gaze locked onto the Demon God.
The grudge of destroying her body last time, today it shall be settled!
Sensing Lilith’s killing intent, the Disguiser Demon God felt a chill run through him.
A bone-chilling cold surged from the soles of his feet straight to his crown!
I’ll die!
Today, I will die!
That thought exploded in his mind like a shockwave.
Realizing this, a trace of madness flickered in his eyes.
He hasn’t yet become a Totem Level Demon God, he still has a bright future ahead.
He must escape!
"Boom!"
The Demon God Domain and Demonic Qi erupted to the extreme.
Under the combined forces of these two powers.
The blood domain’s confinement on him suddenly lightened.
Seeing this, a hint of joy appeared on his face.
He broke free!
He still has a chance!
But the next second...
The smile on his face froze completely.
Lilith elegantly raised her hand...
The second layer of the blood domain descended fiercely!
"No... possible..."
The Demon God’s face twisted in fear, eyes reflecting the overlapping terror domains.
The body he just broke free from froze again.
Under the confinement of the double domain, he couldn’t even twitch a finger.
Seeing this, Lilith’s face was filled with coldness.
Previously, she, the Blood Ancestor, had been pushed to the brink by the weakest Demon God...
What disgrace!
But now—
This disgrace will be personally washed away by her!
After restraining the Demon God, she slowly turned to Gu Xing, behind whom stood Liu Li and Vera, and reminded them:
"See, this is one of the techniques in domain release!"
"Double domain release allows you to release the domain twice and increase the domain’s power twofold!"
"Mastering this technique can greatly enhance your strength!"
Now she and Gu Xing have signed a blood covenant, life bound to Gu Xing.
The stronger Gu Xing’s beasts, the better protection he can offer.
Therefore, she unreservedly imparts all her insights on the domain to Gu Xing’s guardian beasts.
After explaining simply to the two guardian beasts, her blood-red eyes locked onto the Demon God again:
Time to end this!
The next moment, Lilith prepared to completely solve this Demon God.
However, right at that moment...
Gu Xing suddenly spoke:
"Lilith, could you..."
"Just leave this Demon God severely injured?"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s request, Lilith instantly understood his intention.
She didn’t think twice before nodding in agreement.
It’s a well-known fact that humans enhance their strength by slaying the Demon Race.
Leaving this Demon God to Gu Xing, he can use the Demon God’s energy to greatly elevate his level!
She gently stretched out her hand, her blood-red dress fluttering without wind.
A moment later, a blood arrow condensed to the extreme appeared in her palm.
Although it looked completely ordinary...
Gu Xing felt an incomparable danger emanating from it!
Lilith lightly waved her hand.
"Whiz!"
As the sound of it breaking through the void echoed, the Demon God let out a piercing howl!
The blood arrow precisely avoided all vital points.
Yet it shattered all the Demon God Domains within him.
The once overwhelming Demonic Qi now diminished like a candle flickering in the wind...
Lilith stepped aside, her blood-red eyes signaling Gu Xing to act.
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s breath quivered slightly.
A Demon God Level demon race...
As long as he slayed him, he could acquire another contract spot.
Currently...
[Gu Xing]
[Guardian Beasts: Divine Angels, Natural Spirit, Ghost Race Qingshuang, Ghost Race Feiyue]
[Contract Quota: 3/4]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 6000]
[Constitution: 6000]
[Spirit: 6000]
[Speed: 6000]
[Special State: Human Race’s Favor]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might (Beast Master’s all attributes enhanced by 300%), Absolute Forbidden Domain (forbids any domain)]
Though he still has one contract slot vacant.
But this slot, he has decided to permanently reserve for Sally.
His Spiritual Power swept through the Beast Taming Space.
He has a feeling.
It won’t be long before Sally wakes up!ᴛʜɪs ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀ ɪs ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ʙʏ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Thus, he must reserve a slot for the little cat girl who sacrificed herself.
So that the moment she wakes up...
She can truly call him master!
As for the level increment brought by killing the Demon God...
Considering the restrictions of the Divine Pattern, he shook his head.
Domain control is more crucial now!
During this period, under Lilith’s guidance, he has been continuously practicing control over the two domains.
Now he has a preliminary grasp of the Emperor’s Might domain.
Only the Absolute Forbidden Domain...
His brows furrowed.
This domain is far more challenging to control than Emperor’s Might.
Not even on the same level!
However now...
His attention returned to the dying Demon God.
[Disguiser]
[Talent: Demon God]
[Level: Monarch Peak]
[Status: Extremely Weak]
[Power: 110000]
[Constitution: 100000]
[Spirit: 120000]
[Speed: 100000]
[Skills: Demon God’s Body, Demon God Domain...]
[Kill Reward: Increase a Guardian Beast’s contract slot]
Looking over the Demon God’s current attributes panel, Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corner of his mouth.
Even in this state, attributes can break a hundred thousand?!
Despite Lilith having beaten him to near death, to kill this Demon God....
He must unleash the full power of his guardian beasts!
Fortunately, now that the Demon God is confined by Lilith, his guardian beasts can unleash their full strength.
And this kind of instantaneous power burst....
Gu Xing summoned Qingshuang.
No guardian beast can compare to her.
But before that...
"Soul-devouring!"
"Sovereign! Bestow slaughter!"
Double augmentation fell upon her instantly!
Qingshuang’s ghostly qi surged like a volcanic eruption!
But that’s still insufficient!
And Qingshuang immediately understood Gu Xing’s wish, decisively activating her strongest form.
"Ghost King’s Body: Full Liberation!"
"Boom——"
Already skyrocketing attributes raised another 1.5 times!
But it didn’t end there...
"Ghost Race Third Technique: Heaven-Breaking!"
The heavens and earth suddenly changed—
An overwhelming ghostly qi transformed into a ghost king illusion that covered the sky, six crimson ghostly eyes simultaneously opened!
At this moment, Qingshuang’s data panel flashed wildly:
[Ghost Race (Qingshuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Two]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 15000→135000]
[Constitution: 14000→42000]
[Spirit: 13000→39000]
[Speed: 14000→42000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
[Special State: Twin Resonance!]
The strength attribute under the stacking of three states directly reached 130,000!
Though other attributes are lower...
This Demon God is immobilized by Lilith...
There’s absolutely no worry about an attack missing!
"Swoosh——"
Qingshuang’s figure sank slightly, ghost qi around her compressed to the extreme.
Next instant——
"Boom!!!"
Qingshuang and the ghost king illusion surged forth in sync, space shattered inch by inch wherever they passed!
In the terrified pupils of the Demon God, the last thing reflected was a ghost king breaking through the void...
After the world-shaking explosion...
Only a dark Demon Pattern suspended mid-air remained.
Meanwhile.
Gu Xing sensed upon his attributes panel...
[Contract Quota: 3/5]
...

chapters.title: Chapter 173: Light Divine Crystal Acquired!
chapters.content:
Chapter 173: Chapter 173: Light Divine Crystal Acquired!
The energy left behind by the death of the Monarch Peak Demon God is incredibly terrifying.
Even though the Divine Pattern is constantly absorbing this energy, however...
Merely the scattered energy directly raised Gu Xing and his Guardian Beasts to Commander Tier Four.
It directly boosted two levels!
After sensing his physical condition for a moment, Gu Xing slowly reached out toward that Demon Pattern.
In the next moment, the Demon Pattern seemed to recognize its master and directly embedded itself into his palm, appearing in the Beast Taming Space.
Gu Xing sensed with his Spiritual Power and found no difference from the Demon Pattern he had absorbed before.
That means...
Under the purification of the World Tree Leaves, this Demon Pattern can also successfully transform into a Divine Pattern.
And now...
Sally and Fei Yue still do not have a Divine Pattern.
But he has yet to understand the conditions under which Liu Li and Qing Shuang were able to absorb the Divine Pattern before.
Thus, even if he wants to allocate this Demon Pattern, he has no means to do so.
Subsequently, Gu Xing slowly withdrew his thoughts, his gaze falling on Lilith not far away.
The rebellion of the Blood-colored Church has now been completely concluded.
As for those Low Tier Blood Race...
Without the leadership of a Monarch Level Blood Race, they cannot form a real threat.
Moreover, Lilith, being the Blood Ancestor, surely has reasonable ways to handle that group of Blood Race.
"Tap, tap, tap."
As the red dress swayed, Lilith had already walked over to Gu Xing.
Her blood-red eyes stared intensely at Gu Xing.
This battle had given her an unprecedented experience.
The enhancement provided by this human to her abilities...
Tremendously terrifying!
So terrifying that it stirred her heart uncontrollably!
Almost making her unable to resist requesting to become his Guardian Beast.
But in the end, she forced down this impulse.
There will be opportunities in the future!
Becoming Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast now will benefit neither her nor Gu Xing.
The most important thing is...
She, as the Blood Ancestor, even if she were to contract with this human...
It would need to be this human who actively suggests the contract!
With her formidable strength...
Does she need to take the initiative?
Gu Xing, feeling the heat in his ears under her gaze, tilted his head slightly and then turned back:
"Blood Ancestor, now that this rebellion has ended, that Light Divine Crystal..."
After all, the purpose of coming to the Blood-colored Church this time...
Was for Liu Li’s Evolution materials!
As for intervening in this rebellion, it was only out of sympathy for the human race in the Blood-colored Church.
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s request, Lilith dismissively glanced at Gu Xing.
Did this human really think she would renege?
She directly turned around, not answering Gu Xing’s question, but rather waved her hand at the Church Court Empress.
The Church Court Empress immediately understood:
"Everyone, return to the Holy City!"
A grand group returned to the Holy City.
And Lilith directly led Gu Xing to the central cathedral of the Holy City.
Inside the sacred and majestic cathedral.
A translucent gem is embedded in the forehead of the Goddess statue, exuding pure Power of Light.
[Light Divine Crystal]
[Quality: Myth Level]
[Function: Able to enhance the Talent of the Angel Race]
Upon seeing this crystal stone, Gu Xing’s pupils contracted slightly, and his breathing became unconsciously accelerated.
After overcoming numerous difficulties, he finally gathered the final material for Liu Li’s Evolution!
Now Liu Li’s Talent has reached Myth Five Stars, if her Talent could further enhance...
Thinking about this, Gu Xing’s heart burned with excitement.
Lilith also noticed Gu Xing’s eagerness.
She lightly flicked her fingers, and the Divine Stone floated down from the statue’s forehead into her palm.
But she did not hand it over immediately; instead, she clenched her fingers:
"I can give you the Light Divine Crystal..."
"But you have to agree to two conditions!"
Upon hearing Lilith’s words, Gu Xing’s brows instantly furrowed.
Previously, Lilith had told him that as long as he helped restore her strength, she would give him the Light Divine Crystal.
And now...
Was she raising the stakes?
Yet currently, the only known Light Divine Crystal is this one...
After several seconds of silence, he took a deep breath:
"Let’s hear it."
Lilith narrowed her blood-red eyes slightly, her fingers lightly caressing the Light Divine Crystal:
"First, incorporate all humans of the Blood-colored Church into Longxia Country."
From this crisis, she also realized...
The root of the resentment among the Blood Race is her forced order to protect the humans.
But she had promised the previous Blood Ancestor that she would protect this group of humans.
And now, there must be an irreconcilable rift between the Human Race and the Blood Race.
Since that’s the case, she might as well directly incorporate all humans of the Blood-colored Church into Longxia Country.
In this way, she would have successfully fulfilled her promise!
Moreover, uniting humans...
Is also beneficial for resisting the Demon Race!
Of course...
As for the food source for the Blood Race after the humans of the Blood-colored Church leave...
That is not her concern!
Regarding this condition, Gu Xing paused for a moment.
The combat power of the civilians in the Blood-colored Church is not strong, however...
The number of human Monarch Level experts in the Blood-colored Church is indeed quite high.
If incorporated into Longxia Country, as long as they follow commands, the boost in strength to Longxia Country would be immensely significant!
But...
"I can’t give you an answer on this condition. But you can ask Commander Lei Zhan; if he agrees, then there’s no problem."
Lilith nodded nonchalantly and suddenly moved half a step closer:
"Second..."
Her red lips almost touched Gu Xing’s ear——
"I want to follow you."
Her warm breath carried a blood-scented fragrance.
Now Gu Xing and she were bound by a Blood Covenant.
And the Blood Covenant cannot be casually undone.
Her life is already tied to Gu Xing.
If anything unexpected happened to Gu Xing...
Then her life would also come to an end!
Moreover...
Gu Xing’s strength is currently too low!
With the current Guardian Beasts of Gu Xing, they cannot effectively ensure his safety.
But the deeper reason is——
She discovered that by staying by Gu Xing’s side...
She could feel an unprecedented emotion.
According to human terms...
What seems to be called a bond?!
Gu Xing, hearing Lilith’s request, stood there stunned.
Did Lilith want to follow him?
He looked at Lilith in her red dress, then looked at himself.
Lilith’s current Level is King Tier Five, while his...
Is merely Commander Tier Four!
What good is it to follow him?
But Lilith’s eyes showed no fluctuation, obviously, this condition was non-negotiable.
"Alright, alright..."
"But what about your race?"
Upon hearing this question, Lilith did not care at all.
With a casual throw, she tossed the Light Divine Crystal into Gu Xing’s hands.
What race?
She did not recognize a group that wanted to kill her... and then take her place!ᴛhis ᴜpdated by novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
Aside from the few Blood Race who steadfastly support her leadership, what does the life or death of the others have to do with her?
"As long as you agree!"
"I have already ordered a lockdown here, no one will disturb you!"
After saying this, Lilith directly turned and left.
Having just concluded a rebellion, there was still a mountain of matters waiting for her to deal with.
If not for Gu Xing’s special status, she absolutely wouldn’t waste time accompanying Gu Xing on this trip.
After Lilith left, Gu Xing then focused his gaze on the Light Divine Crystal in his hand.
With this material, Liu Li’s Talent can once again be enhanced.
Wondering whether it could break through to Myth Level?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 174: Liu Li’s Advancement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 174: Chapter 174: Liu Li’s Advancement!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing could no longer restrain himself...
"Liu Li."
With the appearance of the blue summons, Liu Li instantly stood before him.
At this moment, Liu Li’s snow-white wings also trembled slightly due to excitement.
Gu Xing’s ability to enhance Guardian Beast’s talent was something she was already aware of.
He had even told her before...
The three materials needed to enhance her talent.
Ultimate Fire, Light Divine Crystal, Angel Divine Blood!
And now...
All three materials had been gathered!
At this point, Gu Xing took out the Angel Divine Blood from the Beast Taming Space.
As for the Ultimate Fire, it had already been fused by Liu Li.
Holding the Angel Divine Blood and Light Divine Crystal in his hands, his gaze fell on Liu Li.
During this time, he discovered something:
Even though Lilith once reached Totem Level...
Her talent remained at Myth Five Stars!
Moreover, after other Guardian Beasts fused with Divine Patterns...
Their talents also stopped at Myth Five Stars!
Myth Five Stars seemed like a chasm that was hard to cross.
Limiting the upper limit of Guardian Beasts!
But now...
He believed that with Liu Li’s talent enhancement...
It would definitely break through this barrier and reach an unprecedented height.
"Are you ready, Liu Li!"
Gu Xing gazed at the girl who had been his sharpest sword all along.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 15000→25000]
[Constitution: 15000→25000]
[Spirit: 15000→25000]
[Speed: 15000→25000]
[Skills: Blazing Angel Form, Doomsday Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain]
[Cultivation Materials: Ultimate Fire, Light Divine Crystal, Angel Divine Blood]
[Special State: Oath Guardian]
With her level boosting to Commander Tier Four, Liu Li’s attributes skyrocketed from 15000 points to 25000 points!
At this moment, she has experienced a qualitative leap in power.
Even without relying on Gu Xing’s Talent Amplification, just with the support of the Doomsday Angel Form...
Liu Li’s attributes could break through to 75000 points!
This barely touches the threshold of Monarch Level.
Suppose her talent could advance further...
Wouldn’t she be able to, at the Commander Level, truly possess the power to match Monarch Level?
And Liu Li’s body trembled slightly, her eyes sparkling with intense light.
She yearned for power——
No, it’s an almost greedy longing!
But this desire is never for herself.
Her gaze always stayed on Gu Xing.
The only purpose of her longing for power is for her master.
As Gu Xing’s contracted Guardian Beasts continue to increase, she must continue to grow stronger to always stand by his side...
To become the most valued Guardian Beast of Gu Xing!
On the other hand.
The experience with the Blood-colored Church made her realize——
She is still far from being powerful enough.
In the final battle, she couldn’t even intervene.
Even when activating her strongest form, combined with her master’s Talent Amplification.
She still struggled to reach Monarch Level standards.
Should she encounter Monarch Level demons again...
Should her master therefore fall into deadly peril...
The moment this thought flashed, her heart seemed to be gripped tightly by an invisible hand.
This is absolutely not allowed!
She would never allow such a thing to happen!
Moreover, the Blazing Angels Race is still suffering...waiting for her, the princess, to save them.
Therefore, she cannot stop here.
She must become stronger, and even stronger!
"Master, I am ready! I will never disappoint your expectations!"
The amber eyes of Liu Li gleamed with determination.
Gu Xing nodded slightly, then followed the system’s guidance to activate the Light Divine Crystal and Angel Divine Blood simultaneously.
Meanwhile, fierce Ultimate Fire ignited around Liu Li——
In an instant!
Under the refinement of Ultimate Fire, the Angel Divine Blood and Light Divine Crystal burst forth with dazzling crimson brilliance,
Transforming into two scarlet streams orbiting around Liu Li like planets.
Liu Li unconsciously spread her eight holy wings.
The next moment, she slowly closed her eyes.
Ultimate Fire surged explosively.
Light Divine Crystal and Angel Divine Blood were instantly absorbed into her body...
"Boom——!!!"
A violent energy storm swept through the entire church, a blood-red light pillar pierced through the dome,
Dyeing the sky of the Holy City red!
At this moment,
All beings within the Blood-colored Holy City——
Whether human or blood race, simultaneously raised their heads to the sky, faces filled with shock.
Upon sensing this force, Lilith also immediately looked up, her scarlet pupils contracting sharply.
"This power..."
She had thought Gu Xing gathered these materials merely to help the angel break through to Myth Five Stars talent.
But the pressure emanating from the light pillar...
Even made the Blood Ancestor power within her tremble!
"How could it be..."
Her throat moved unconsciously, her neck stiffly turning towards the church.
She ultimately underestimated that human.
It seems he can help Guardian Beasts break through the Myth Five Stars limit...
Lilith’s fingertips trembled slightly, but a curve formed at the corner of her lips.
The stronger Gu Xing becomes, the greater help he provides her!
It seems this decision to sign the blood covenant...
Might be the wisest choice in her long life!
...
Meanwhile.
At the entrance of the Divine Secret Realm.
The restriction enveloping the Second Divine Secret Realm suddenly rippled with strange patterns, the once impregnable barrier began to dissolve at a pace visible to the naked eye.
The demon race soldiers stationed there immediately noticed the anomaly.
Not daring to delay for a moment, they quickly reported the situation.
Before long.
A group of terrifying Monarch Level demon kings descended from the sky.
Seeing the restriction slowly disappearing, smiles appeared on their faces.
"The barrier is disappearing slowly, the second Human Race Divine Pattern is about to emerge!"
"Judging by the speed of the barrier’s disappearance, it won’t be long before the entrance to the Divine Secret Realm successfully opens!"
"Heaven bless the demon race! Now the entrance to the Divine Secret Realm is under our control, once it opens...no race can compete with us, this Human Race Divine Pattern will surely be ours."
The eyes of many demons were filled with excitement.
Their sole goal of seizing the Northern Territory was for the Human Race Divine Pattern.
While the first Divine Pattern action failed, but...
As long as the second and third Divine Patterns fall into their hands.
That would be enough to quell Lord Demon God’s anger!ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFirᴇ.ɴet
Now the second Human Race Divine Secret Realm is about to open.
That means they are only...
A step away from success!
"Silence!"
With a hoarse shout, the Half-Step Totem Level demon king emerges from the shadows.
His gaze swept coldly across the room, then slowly spoke:
"Transmit my order——"
The demon king’s voice exploded in the ears of every demon.
"Effective immediately, the whole army contracts the defensive line! Abandon all secondary actions, all elite demons gather in the Northern Territory!"
"This Human Race Divine Pattern must not be lost!"
"More importantly——"
He suddenly raised his hand, a black demon flame shot into the sky.
"All Monarch Level demon kings immediately guard the entrance to the Secret Realm!"
"This Divine Secret Realm must not allow any alien race to touch it!"
Before the words fell, the whole world seemed to vibrate.
Countless demon warriors’ eyes ignited with fervent flames.
"We heed the lord’s command!"
....
...

chapters.title: Chapter 175: Divine Secret Realm About to Open?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 175: Chapter 175: Divine Secret Realm About to Open?!
Blood-colored Church.
Holy City Central Church.
Crimson flames surged like raging waves, completely engulfing Liu Li’s figure.
The high temperature of the Ultimate Fire caused the surrounding space to begin to distort and deform, as if even the Void was wailing.
At this moment, Liu Li’s aura was sky-high, the blood-red pillar of light around her suddenly skyrocketing!
"Boom——!!"
The violent shock wave swept in all directions, forcing Gu Xing to raise his arm to shield himself.
Through the gaps in his fingers, he saw——
The flame patterns on the eight silver wings behind Liu Li were becoming increasingly intricate and mysterious at a speed visible to the naked eye.
More astonishingly, beyond those eight wings, two entirely new pairs of wings were slowly taking shape!
Suddenly, the world fell silent.
The blood-red pillar of light surged back into Liu Li’s body like a tidal wave, while the Ultimate Fire expanded fiercely, instantly filling the entire cathedral.
Amidst this fire domain, Liu Li’s body was undergoing a profound transformation——
Her already perfect figure now exuded an added divine radiance, and her control over the Ultimate Fire reached a new realm.
"Weng——!!!"
All of a sudden.
The surging flames contracted abruptly, all merging into Liu Li’s body.
When the last trace of flame vanished——
Ten dazzling silver wings unfurled fully behind her!
This meant, from this moment forth...
The era of the Eight-winged Blazing Angels had passed, and Liu Li had successfully transformed into a Ten-winged Blazing Angel!
Liu Li’s talent had already surpassed that of her father...
And reached an unprecedented height within the Blazing Angels Race!
At this moment, Liu Li slowly opened her eyes.
In her golden pupils, a flicker of flame flashed past.
The moment her gaze locked onto Gu Xing, with merely a gentle flap of her wings...
Her figure appeared before Gu Xing.
Facing Gu Xing, now so close, Liu Li bowed deeply.
"Master, thank you!"
Her voice carried a slight tremble, her body gently quivering.
More than anyone, she understood——
If not for Gu Xing’s intervention, she would have been destroyed long ago in Lin Yuan City.
Not to mention transforming from a Legendary Level to a Myth Level today!
All of this was due to Gu Xing’s existence.
And seeing this, Gu Xing hurriedly helped the bowing Liu Li upright.
For him, cultivating his Guardian Beasts was his duty.
Moreover——
The relationship between him and Liu Li...
Had always been mutually fulfilling.
If not for Liu Li’s companionship, he too wouldn’t have reached today’s heights.
After comforting Liu Li with a few words, Gu Xing began to check Liu Li’s various attributes.
Now that Liu Li’s talent enhancement was complete, he was immensely curious about her various attributes.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 25000→30000]
[Constitution: 25000→30000]
[Spirit: 25000→30000]
[Speed: 25000→30000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form, Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain, Guardian Law]
[Cultivation Materials: Divine Pattern, Blood Core of Totem-level Demon Clan, Fortune of Angel Race]
The numbers flashing on the data panel made Gu Xing’s pupils contract slightly——
Liu Li’s four-dimensional attributes directly broke through the thirty thousand mark!
Even more astonishing was the evolution of Liu Li’s skills:
[Guardian Angel Form: Full Attribute Amplification 400%, including unique effects like Divine Protection and Judgment]
[Guardian Law: Can mobilize a trace of the Power of Laws]
The Blazing Angel Form and Doomsday Angel Form had vanished.
Now Liu Li had only one Guardian Angel Form!
But the enhancement brought by this Guardian Angel Form...
Far surpassed the previous two forms.
A 400% attribute increase was enough to raise Liu Li’s attributes to 120,000!
Truly reaching a level comparable to a Monarch Level!
As for the Guardian Law...
Seeing this Law, Gu Xing was somewhat bewildered.
Why is it Guardian?
And not the Celestial Fire Law?
For some unknown reason, Liu Li’s skills were transforming towards the Guardian type.
Now it seemed she wanted to become...
Gu Xing’s most unbreakable shield!
As for the Law...
Gu Xing had heard Lilith mention it once.
Only upon reaching Totem Level is one qualified to wield it.
And now....
Liu Li’s level was merely Commander Tier Four, yet she was already able to invoke a trace of the Law.
His Adam’s apple involuntarily moved.
With the presence of the "Law," what level had Liu Li’s strength reached...
He couldn’t ascertain!
This skill directly elevated Liu Li’s strength to an unknown level.
Additionally....
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the cultivation section.
Now that Liu Li’s talent had reached Myth Nine Stars.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
But...
Liu Li’s talent could still improve.
That meant, as long as Liu Li could be helped to find....
The three materials: Divine Pattern, Demon Core of Totem-level Demon Clan, and Fortune of Angel Race, her talent could continue to rise...
Reaching beyond Myth!
Thinking of this made Gu Xing’s heart burn with enthusiasm.
But soon, it was as if a bucket of cold water had been poured over his enthusiasm.
Although Liu Li already possessed the Divine Pattern.
However....
The Demon Core of Totem-level Demon Race.
This one condition alone left him troubled.
Currently, the level of he and his few Guardian Beasts was merely Commander Tier Four.
At the very best, their strength was just the Low Tier of Monarch Level.
There’s a long unknown path ahead to reach the Totem Level!
As for the last material...
The Fortune of Angel Race.
Gu Xing didn’t even know how to obtain it.
How could one acquire a race’s fortune?
He shook his head, temporarily putting aside the thought of seeking cultivation materials.
Then, his gaze landed on Liu Li, close at hand.
Looking at Liu Li’s conflicted expression...
Wanting to get close to him yet also showing signs of shyness.
Gu Xing stepped forward, gently embraced her.
Liu Li was startled, her body tensing by the sudden embrace.
But in an instant, her tension transformed into utter relaxation.
This is her Master.
The Master she loved deeply.
Nestled in Gu Xing’s warm embrace, she felt an unprecedented sense of security.
At the moment of breaking through realms, her one thought was to protect her Master.
Besides that, she had no other intentions.
Precisely because of this, all her awakened skills were of the Guardian System.
The Blazing Angels Race had initially excelled in attack.
After all, she held the highly aggressive Blazing Angel Fire.
However now...
She had transformed all skills into the Guardian type.
Although sacrificing some offensive capabilities, yet...
She did not regret it!
To forever protect Gu Xing’s safety was her life’s pursuit.
At this moment, curled up in her Master’s arms...
She wished time could freeze forever at this moment.
Letting her Master belong solely to her, for eternity.
Time quietly flowed by.
Finally, she slowly raised her head from Gu Xing’s embrace.
In her eyes rekindled a determined glow.
Being able to enjoy this moment with her Master had already filled her heart with contentment.
Now...
Although the threat of the Blood-colored Church had been eliminated, Ying Bing was still dormant.
As long as Ying Bing remained unawakened, it would forever be a thorn in her Master’s heart.
This, Liu Li understood thoroughly.
"Let’s go, Master! We shall inquire about the Snow Realm from the Blood Ancestor!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing unhesitatingly nodded in agreement:
"Alright!"
Yet.
Just as he was about to turn around.
The Divine Pattern on his forehead suddenly stirred, and a message suddenly surfaced in his mind.
The second Divine Secret Realm is about to open?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 176: Ghost Race Divine Pattern!
chapters.content:
Chapter 176: Chapter 176: Ghost Race Divine Pattern!
Sensing this message, Gu Xing immediately quickened his pace.
The second Divine Secret Realm is about to open.
Although the entire Northern Territory has now fallen into the hands of the Demon Race, yet...
He still wants to give it a try
Absolutely cannot hand over the second Divine Pattern to the Demon Race just like that!
Soon, he found Lilith in a splendidly decorated council chamber.
At this moment, Lilith had just finished dealing with the aftermath of the Blood-colored Church.
Seeing Gu Xing appear in front of her with Liu Li, her eyes immediately locked onto Liu Li.
As expected.
The depth of this Guardian Beast’s strength...
She could no longer discern it!
It must be understood that she is now at King Tier Five, and even she can’t see through this Angel, which means...
The Talent of this Angel has undoubtedly surpassed hers!
Her scarlet eyes slightly narrowed.
This Angel is stronger than her, indicating it has already surpassed the Myth Five Stars’ limit.
At this thought, her gaze involuntarily turned to Gu Xing.
This human...
If he can enhance the Talent of that Angel, does it mean...
He might also be able to enhance her Talent, helping her break through the Myth Five Stars’ shackles?
However, at present, her relationship with Gu Xing hasn’t reached that level.
This matter can only be discussed later.
Then, she slowly spoke:
"Is there something you need?"Follow current novels on ɴovel(ꜰ)ɪre.nᴇt
Gu Xing rushed here with Liu Li in such a hurry, obviously...
The two of them must have something urgent!
Gu Xing did not delay and immediately informed Lilith in detail about Ying Bing’s situation.
After understanding the whole story, Lilith frowned slightly.
"You want to seek the Snow Race?"
Gu Xing nodded seriously.
"Forget it!"
Lilith’s words directly interrupted Gu Xing’s plan.
Seeing Gu Xing’s confusion, she explained slowly:
"The Snow Race tends not to interact with outsiders, and they are quite disdainful of humans, you probably have no chance."
These words were like a cold bucket of water poured over Gu Xing’s head.
If they cannot find the Snow Race, Ying Bing’s injury...
His fists unconsciously clenched.
No matter what, he must heal Ying Bing.
Even if it means resorting to force...
Lilith seemed to see through his thoughts and ruthlessly broke his illusion:
"Don’t think of using force, the Snow Race has only one member per generation, and the current one is called the Snow Woman."
"Though she is not skilled in combat, she has a Guardian whose strength is close to Totem Level."
"With your current strength, you have no chance of victory."
Gu Xing remained silent, just fixedly watching Lilith.
That burning gaze made Lilith somewhat uneasy.
She sighed lightly, helplessly said:
"Don’t look at me. Even with the blessing of your Talent, I am not necessarily a match for that Guardian."
"But..."
Here, Lilith suddenly paused.
Seeing Gu Xing’s inquisitive look, she continued:
"I can send someone to take your beloved to meet the Snow Woman."
"I have some ties with her, maybe I can persuade her to help."
"Of course, there’s no guarantee, but we will do our best."
Gu Xing completely ignored Lilith’s teasing.
All his thoughts were on Lilith’s previous words.
According to Lilith, if he goes personally, the Snow Woman will never save Ying Bing.
But if Lilith mediates...
After thinking for a moment, Gu Xing finally made up his mind.
Though Ying Bing’s Life Force has stabilized, remaining sealed for too long...
The longer it takes, the more harm it does to her.
There can be no more delay!
"Alright, but you must ensure Ying Bing’s safety!"
Hearing this, Lilith nodded.
With a wave of her slender hand, a figure emerged from the shadows.
It was a female Blood Race.
"Her name is Yue, and she will escort your beloved to the Snow Realm."
"She possesses the strength of a Monarch Peak, enough to ensure safety."
As the Blood Ancestor, Lilith naturally cultivated a group of confidants over the years, but never showed them easily.
The last time she dared to lead the Human Race to attack the Holy City was because she had these trump cards in hand.
However, in the end, these reserves were not used.
"Yue, did you hear the instructions clearly just now?"
This Blood Race bowed, "My lord, I will complete the task."
She walked gracefully to Gu Xing and politely bowed.
Her blood-red eyes were full of respect for Gu Xing.
Since Gu Xing signed a Blood Covenant with Lilith, in their eyes, Gu Xing’s status was equivalent to Lilith’s.
Gu Xing hesitated slightly in front of the respectful Blood Race before finally taking out the Ice Coffin containing Ying Bing.
Considering his current relationship with Lilith, there was no reason for her to harm him.
Yue respectfully accepted the Ice Coffin, then her figure gradually merged into the shadows.
At this point...
As long as the Snow Woman is willing to help, Ying Bing can awaken.
But if she refuses...
Lilith saw Gu Xing like this, and rarely offered comfort:
"Rest assured, I once saved the Snow Woman’s life, she is unlikely to refuse my request."
"But now you should worry about this matter...."
Her gaze shifted to Gu Xing’s forehead.
"You sensed it too, right? The Human Race’s second Divine Pattern is about to appear."
"You’re not seriously considering watching it fall into the hands of the Demon Race, are you?"
These words brought Gu Xing back to his senses, his gaze refocused on Lilith.
Since learning the Divine Secret Realm was about to open, he had been troubled by the second Divine Pattern.
Rally the Human Race to reclaim the Northern Territory?
That’s impossible!
But without reclaiming the Northern Territory, there’s no way to approach the Secret Realm entrance.
Which means, having no connection with the second Divine Pattern.
At this moment, Lilith mentioned it proactively, clearly having a plan.
And Lilith did not hold back, speaking directly:
"What about your other Guardian Beast?"
Gu Xing was stunned, then understood she was referring to Fei Yue.
He frowned slightly, raised his hand and waved.
Fei Yue’s figure instantly appeared in the hall.
"What do you need Fei Yue for?"
Lilith’s lips curved into a meaningful smile:
"It’s naturally to seize that Divine Pattern."
"As long as we leverage the Void Control ability of this Guardian Beast, we might truly sneak into the Divine Secret Realm without a trace."
Hearing Lilith’s plan, Gu Xing shook his head:
"Though Fei Yue is adept with Void Power, yet..."
"With her current strength, she still can’t avoid the perception of a Monarch Level Demon Race."
He had thought of this route but ultimately dismissed it.
Lilith’s smile did not wane in the slightest:
"As she currently stands, indeed it’s impossible."
"But if she could gain the blessing of the Ghost Race’s Divine Pattern..."
"Then, even a Monarch Level Demon Race would absolutely not detect her presence."
Ghost Race’s Divine Pattern?
Gu Xing’s gaze met Lilith’s.
In those blood-red eyes, he read her intention—
She wanted him to go to the Ghost Clan’s Residence and seize the Ghost Race’s Divine Pattern!
This plan...
Unbelievably mad!
But it seems...
Truly feasible!
But seizing the Divine Pattern cannot rely on brute force...
It requires strategic planning!
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, in some sense, were essentially the bloodline of the Ghost Clan Leader.
From the information revealed by Qing Shuang, Gu Xing learned that the one who banished them from the Ghost Race...
Was not the Clan Leader, but a decision made privately by the Great Elder.
Therefore, as long as he can gain the support of the Ghost Clan Leader...
Then securing the Divine Pattern is indeed hopeful.
However...
This process is bound to be extraordinarily difficult.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 177: Qingqiu Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 177: Chapter 177: Qingqiu Race
Gu Xing pondered for a while, his gaze finally falling on Lilith.
Even if their strategy fails, with Lilith around...
And with the Soul Devouring Talent as a boost.
Lilith’s power is also top-tier among the Monarch Peak.
Therefore, as long as the Totem-level Ghost Clan experts don’t intervene...
With Lilith, they can retreat unscathed.
Besides...
Since Lilith made this suggestion, it means she has a certain level of confidence.
"What do you think?"
Gu Xing asked directly.
Lilith glanced at Fei Yue beside Gu Xing before slowly speaking:
"The little one by your side should know that the Ghost Clan holds a grand competition every year."
"The first place in this competition has the chance to be recognized by the Divine Pattern."
"However, until now, no Ghost Clan member has successfully been recognized by the Divine Pattern."
Gu Xing was momentarily stunned and then turned his gaze towards Fei Yue.
Fei Yue responded immediately:
"Yes, Master!"
"The Ghost Clan indeed holds a competition every year, but..."
Her voice suddenly became hesitant, "My sister and I have already been expelled from the Ghost Clan, I’m afraid..."
Fei Yue’s tone carried a sense of confusion.
The memories of being expelled were already somewhat blurry.
But she clearly remembered...
She and her sister were permanently forbidden to step into the Ghost Clan territory.
Therefore, there’s no point in talking about participating in the competition or striving for recognition by the Divine Pattern.
However, Gu Xing was completely unconcerned.
Even if Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were forbidden from entering the Ghost Clan, so what?
Not to mention that Fei Yue and Qing Shuang had done nothing wrong...
Moreover, they had encountered assassination attempts!
Gu Xing felt no guilt about venturing into the Ghost Clan to seize the Divine Pattern.
And having learned the whole story from Qing Shuang...
He had long made his decision.
That Ghost Clan Great Elder must pay the price.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing slowly spoke:
"Fei Yue, don’t you want to go back?"
Gu Xing stared into Fei Yue’s eyes.
This is not only to seize the Divine Pattern but also to seek justice for Qing Shuang and Fei Yue!
Fei Yue was struck by the question, standing motionless as if struck by lightning.
Go back?
Of course she wanted to!
Countless nights, she woke up from nightmares about the day they were expelled.
Until she met Gu Xing, things started to get better.
Being asked now, the extinguished flame in her eyes rekindled—
She and her sister were never the bringers of misfortune!
At this moment.
Qing Shuang’s figure suddenly appeared.
Her blue eyes were filled with determination:
"Master, I agree to return to the Ghost Clan, and I will ensure the Divine Pattern recognizes Fei Yue as its master."
She surely hadn’t forgotten...
The life-and-death scenes with Fei Yue!
This vengeance, she must repay.
Now given such an opportunity, it must not be missed.
Besides...
Acquiring the Divine Pattern was the master’s will.
Fei Yue’s gaze briefly swept across Gu Xing’s face, then quickly shifted away.
As long as it’s the master’s wish, she would risk her life to fulfill it.
After confirming Qing Shuang’s stance, Gu Xing’s gaze returned to Fei Yue.
After all, she is the one who will endure the recognition of the Divine Pattern, her choice must be respected.
Fei Yue met Gu Xing’s gaze, and nodded resolutely.
Since her sister agreed, what was there to hesitate?
Seeing both Guardian Beasts agreeing, Gu Xing also made up his mind.
What does it matter if it’s a Ghost Clan?!
If those old ones of the Ghost Clan dare to disagree...
He would let Lilith absorb more blood, aided by the Soul Devouring Talent...
And fight them until they’re convinced!
Meanwhile, Lilith looked at Fei Yue and Qing Shuang, a trace of reminiscence flashing in her eyes.
The first time she met Qing Shuang, she saw her father’s shadow in this girl.
Back then, before she became the Blood Ancestor, she received a favor from Qing Shuang’s father "Qing".
Later, she was regretful when she heard that this top talent of the Ghost Clan was penalized.
And now, by the twist of fate...
Both of Qing’s daughters are bound to Gu Xing.
Fate is truly unpredictable!
However...
She had been unsure how to repay "Qing’s" kindness.
But now...
Taking Qing’s daughters to acquire the Ghost Clan’s Divine Pattern is her way of repaying that old favor.
What’s more...
She wants to see if she can help Qing regain his strength through Gu Xing!
This kind of genius, just lingering in the Ghost Clan’s Forbidden Land, how could it be right?
...
Tongyou Valley.
Ghost Clan’s Residence.
The village where the Ghost Clan has lived for generations stands quietly.
Inside the most magnificent building at the village center, an important meeting is taking place.
Several Ghost Clan elders sit at one side of the hall, while on the opposite side sit a few extraordinarily beautiful fox women with multiple Fox Tails.
They are from the Qingqiu Race.
Also, one of the top races from the Alternate Space!
The Ghost Clan Great Elder was the first to break the silence, his voice deep yet persuasive:
"Qingqiu Princess, surely you have noticed, the Demon Race’s power has become increasingly rampant recently."
"Though your race excels in sealing and controlling techniques, but in direct combat, it is indeed lacking. If the Demon Race discovered your inhabited location..."
He stopped there.
The Ghost Clan Great Elder understood that this was precisely the dilemma the Qingqiu Race faced.
After pausing for the Qingqiu Race to think for a while, he continued:
"Our Ghost Clan happens to be a race most skilled in combat. If we join forces..."
"With your race’s support abilities and our race’s combat talents, even if the Demon Race strikes, we can handle it!"
The Qingqiu Princess lightly furrowed her brows, her slender fingers unwittingly twirling a strand of hair.
She naturally understood that the Ghost Clan Great Elder spoke the truth.
The Qingqiu Race is not particularly skilled at combat.
Therefore, after detecting unusual Demon Race activities, they started looking for collaboration among races.
Originally, her intended partners included three...
Angel Race, Ghost Clan, Human Race!
However, the recent actions of the Angel Race made her notice something unusual.
This race might have already been infiltrated by the Demon Race.
So she could only exclude them.
And as for the Ghost Clan and Human Race...
She’s still hesitant now.
The Ghost Clan, though their combat ability is formidable, but...
Collaborating with a race full of muscle-heads poses a significant risk.
As for the Human Race...
To this day, there’s not a single Totem Level race.
Nor has there been a potential breakthrough to the Totem Level in sight.
Thus, the risk of collaborating with the Human Race is even greater than with the Ghost Clan.
However...
Collaboration with the Human Race better exploits the Qingqiu Race’s abilities.
Because the diversity of the Human Race’s Beast Taming system perfectly matches Qingqiu’s control talents.Follow current novels on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
At this thought, the Princess could not help but rub her temples.
Headache!
However, the Demon Race’s threat is looming, leaving the Qingqiu Race little time to hesitate.
Facing the earnest gaze of the Ghost Clan Great Elder, she finally sighed lightly:
"If nothing goes wrong..."
"Qingqiu is willing to form an alliance with the Ghost Clan."
Upon hearing these words, the Ghost Clan Great Elder’s face instantly lit up with joy.
"Since we’ve reached an agreement," he warmly began:
"Recently, our Ghost Clan is about to hold the centennial competition, might the Princess be interested in staying to observe? It’d be a good opportunity to witness the charm of our younger generation."
The Qingqiu Princess heard this and nodded slightly.
Only by better understanding the Ghost Clan can they collaborate effectively.
Regarding the younger generation of the Ghost Clan...
She is also extremely curious!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 178: Ominous Return!
chapters.content:
Chapter 178: Chapter 178: Ominous Return!
But just at this moment, a figure burst panicked into the main hall.
"G-Great Elder!"
The Ghost Race guard’s voice trembled, "Those two ill-fated ones... they’re back! And they brought a human!"
The word "ill-fated" made the Great Elder’s brows furrow sharply, buried memories surging up like a tide.
Years ago, he’d secretly ordered an Extraordinary Level ghost to hunt down Qing Shuang’s twin daughters.
Only...
In the end, the Extraordinary Level ghost he sent never returned.
He guessed...
It must’ve been an accident, and those two little girls were rescued.
But he wasn’t too worried about it.
Those two inherently defective brats were doomed to never surpass the Extraordinary Level.
So, the idea of them coming for revenge against the Ghost Race was simply impossible.
Years passed, and just as he expected, he never heard any news of the twin sisters again.
The whole affair had almost faded from his memory...
But today, upon hearing "ill-fated," those memories flooded back into his mind.
"Ill-fated?"
The Qingqiu Princess keenly caught this term, a trace of surprise flashing in her eyes.
To be labeled "ill-fated" by the Ghost Race?
This piqued her curiosity!
So she gracefully rose, taking the initiative to speak:
"Great Elder, the Ghost Race tournament hasn’t started yet—why don’t we go and see what’s happening?"
At these words, the Ghost Race Great Elder’s expression clearly changed.
After all, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were a stain on his record.
If they pointed out what he’d done in public, his prestige...
But after reflecting for a moment, he relaxed.
The ghost he sent all those years ago could never have revealed who was behind it.
So even if those two speak up in public......
No one in the Ghost Race would believe their claims.
After all, one was someone branded ill-fated by everyone, while the other was the revered Great Elder.
Who would they trust?
Anyone with a brain would know the answer.
"Let’s go, Princess! We’ll go and have a look together."
"But those two ill-fated ones are a shame to our Ghost Race—the scene may well embarrass you!"
The Qingqiu Princess simply shook her head.
"Great Elder, you’re too modest!"
So the two of them headed for the entrance to the valley.
...
At the same time.
Tongyou Valley’s entrance.
Two groups faced off.
One side was the Ghost Race guards, lined up and tense.
The other...
Gu Xing stood with his hands behind his back, his Guardian Beasts arrayed behind him.Tʜe sourcᴇ of thɪs content ɪs N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
Fei Yue nervously gripped her sleeve, knuckles turning pale.
Qing Shuang’s face was icy cold, repressed fury flickering in her eyes.
Lilith lounged lazily nearby, her blood-red eyes roving over the crowd of Ghost Race guards with interest.
She was curious to see what faces these Ghost Race members would make once they realized those sisters they’d once called "ill-fated" and cast out......
now had power that left the Ghost Race’s younger generation far behind!
Liu Li and Vera stood on either side of Gu Xing.
Although they usually treated Qing Shuang as a rival, after hearing her story...
both Guardian Beasts burned with righteous fury!
Whatever the circumstances, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts.
They’d once been bullied by a pack of Ghost Race bastards.
How could there not be payback for that?
Right now,
the faces of the Ghost Race guards were all stern and menacing.
"This is Ghost Race territory. If you don’t leave now, don’t blame us for what happens."
"Human—leave now with your Guardian Beasts, and we’ll let bygones be bygones."
But—
Gu Xing and his Guardian Beasts utterly ignored these warnings.
The guards, seeing this, immediately turned their aggression on Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
"You two disasters! Not only did you accept a human master, but now you’ve brought a human trespassing into our lands! Have you forgotten your punishment?"
"Punishment?"
The word seemed to trigger something—Qing Shuang’s pupils shrank to pinpoints.
The chill around her dropped suddenly; even the air seemed to freeze.
"Master..."
Her voice was cold as ice, "Please allow Fei Yue and I to act ourselves."
"These debts—I want to collect them with my own hands!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing swept his gaze over the guards.
Commander Level, every single one—a testament to the fighting prowess of the Ghost Race, when even the gatekeepers had such power!
But for Qing Shuang now...
still not worth worrying about!
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 15,000 → 25,000]
[Constitution: 14,000 → 22,000]
[Spirit: 13,000 → 21,000]
[Speed: 14,000 → 22,000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
[Special State: Twin Resonance!]
Last time she killed the Monarch Peak Disguiser from the Demon Race, Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute reached 25,000 points!
With the Ghost King’s Body, that’s boosted to 37,500 points!
But you have to remember...
Qing Shuang’s greatest ace was the Ghost Race Four Techniques.
Gu Xing looked over—the Commander Level ghosts couldn’t even use the Ghost Race Third Technique, "Heaven-Breaking."
Even their boosts from the Ghost Race Four Techniques were nowhere near Qing Shuang’s insane levels.
The highest Commander Level ghost here got a 1.6x boost from the Ghost Race Second Technique Sea Break.
But Qing Shuang...
With her, the boost from the Ghost Race Second Technique Sea Break was 2x.
And the Third Technique? A crazy 3x boost.
Plus, Qing Shuang now had Twin Resonance.
She could use Fei Yue’s Void Ability within her Domain.
With all those bonuses...
Even though Qing Shuang was only Commander Tier Four,
her combat power was absolutely at Commander Peak, brushing up against Monarch Level.
And that...
isn’t even counting her Soul-Devouring Talent.
As for Fei Yue...
Gu Xing glanced at the nervous little thing.
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 3,000 → 7,000]
[Constitution: 1,000 → 7,000]
[Spirit: 1,000 → 7,000]
[Speed: 1,000 → 7,000]
[Skills: Void, Void Domain]
7,000 in her attributes.
Gu Xing sighed to himself.
Just as expected...
Fei Yue was still the weakest in the team.
He could only hope that after her Divine Pattern fused, she’d change.
Otherwise, in a Commander Level battle...
Fei Yue didn’t even qualify to participate.
With her current stats, entering the fight was suicide!
Now, Fei Yue was only useful for travel...
Gu Xing snapped out of his thoughts, giving the horde of Ghost Race guards a frosty stare.
Just about to order Qing Shuang to take care of them—
This trip wasn’t for a social call.
Conflict was inevitable!
But just then, a booming shout echoed:
"Great Elder is here!"
In the distance, a large group approached at a slow, steady pace.
Leading them, the Great Elder was broad and muscular, skin glinting bronze in the sunlight, every step seeming to make the earth quake.
Behind him came several equally massive Ghost Race elders, like a moving line of small mountains.
And among all that muscle, a few graceful figures stood out...
The Qingqiu fox girls walked lightly, snowy fox tails swaying behind them.
At their head, the Qingqiu Princess was breathtakingly beautiful!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 179: Qingqiu! Control and Sealing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 179: Chapter 179: Qingqiu! Control and Sealing!
Gu Xing looked at this group of people, feeling a bit dazed.
His gaze was involuntarily drawn to that group of Fox Race members.
He knew the Ghost Race, but this group...
Subconsciously, he began to probe the information of the leading fox girl.
[Tushan Yueli]
[Race: Qingqiu Race (Six-tailed State)]
[Identity: Qingqiu Princess]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Power: 45000]
[Constitution: 47000]
[Spirit: 60000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 55000]
[Skills: Moon Eclipse, Mirror Prison, New Moon, Heavenly Fox Domain]
Qingqiu Race?
This race was completely unfamiliar to him.
But he didn’t mind; after all, there are so many races in the Alternate Space that it’s impossible to know them all.
It’s just...
What caught his attention was the Spirit Attribute that had reached its limit!
The limit for the Extraordinary Level Myth Talent Guardian Beast is 4000 points!
And the limit for the Commander Level...
Seems to be 60000 points!
This fox girl being able to reach the limit of Spirit Attribute means...
Her attributes are top-level even among the Myth Level!
And the attributes of this Qingqiu Princess are somewhat similar to Vera.
The other attributes like Power, Constitution, and Speed are lower, all leaning towards a mage-type Guardian Beast focused on Spirit.
But...
The focus between the two is different!
Vera is more inclined towards spell attacks, while this Qingqiu Princess...
[Moon Eclipse: Using this skill can strip away 20% of target’s all attributes!]
[Mirror Prison: Group control skill; within the skill’s range, those with Spirit Attribute lower than the caster will fall into the Illusion Realm!]
[New Moon: Sealing skill; can seal enemies with Spiritual Power not exceeding 1.5 times of own power!]
[Heavenly Fox Domain: Enemies within range will suffer control, seal, curse, and various negative statuses!]
After seeing Tushan Yueli’s skills, Gu Xing unconsciously swallowed.
Desirable!
Although this fox girl’s attack power is average, if she could coordinate with his existing Guardian Beasts...
It would definitely produce an effect greater than 1+1>2!
Simply by the Moon Eclipse skill alone...
Directly stripping enemies of 20% all attributes!
And his Soul-devouring skill can enhance his own Guardian Beast’s attributes.
With this increase and decrease...
The entire team’s combat strength could definitely be elevated to another level.
Not to mention this Qingqiu Princess also possesses group control, and a powerful sealing skill!
This sealing skill can seal enemies with attributes not exceeding her own by 1.5 times.
If this Qingqiu Princess were to become his Guardian Beast, under his Soul Devouring Talent....
This Princess’s Spirit Attribute could reach 120000 points!
Then she could seal an enemy whose Spirit Attribute doesn’t reach 180000.
attributes...
This is Commander Level existence!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing became more desirous.
This sealing skill is simply a perfect match for his talent!
But wanting to contract this Princess...
The difficulty must be considerable.
After all, she is the Princess of the Qingqiu Race.
If not for special circumstances like Liu Li or Vera...
Normally, wanting to contract a successor of a race is simply impossible!
Lilith quietly approached, whispering in Gu Xing’s ear:
"Qingqiu Race’s combat strength is not strong. I guess she’s here at the Ghost Race mostly seeking an alliance."
Alliance?
Gu Xing turned abruptly, almost bumping into Lilith.
Fortunately, although Lilith had recovered some strength, for some reason she still maintained her childlike appearance.
Therefore, Gu Xing did not feel embarrassed.
But the words from Lilith allowed him to keenly catch a key piece of information.
Qingqiu Race lacks combat power; otherwise they wouldn’t seek cooperation with the Ghost Race.
Lacks combat power?!
Doesn’t the Human Race have it?
A bold idea flashed in Gu Xing’s mind:
Since it’s an alliance, is there a possibility for the Qingqiu Race to ally with the Human Race?
After all, this race skilled in sealing and controlling would be welcomed everywhere.
Moreover, given the current situation in the Alternate Space...
Every new ally is incredibly valuable for the Human Race.
Now, the Blood Race has already achieved equal cooperation with the Human Race through Lilith, if they could also secure Qingqiu Race...
Thinking this, Gu Xing lowered his voice and asked:
"Lilith, do you think there’s a possibility for Qingqiu Race to cooperate with the Human Race?"
However, to this question, Lilith directly rolled her eyes at him.
How would she know about such things?
She is not even a member of the Qingqiu Race!
Seeing Lilith’s expression, Gu Xing realized he asked a silly question.
Yet, once the idea emerged, it lingered in his mind.
Even though the Human Race doesn’t match the Ghost Race’s top combat power, it dominates in the scale of mid-low tier capabilities.
More importantly, the diversity of Human Race’s Guardian Beasts theoretically matches better with Qingqiu Race’s control talents...
Logically speaking, the Human Race would be more suitable to cooperate with Qingqiu Race!
His gaze swept over Tushan Yueli.
If given the chance, he must talk with this Qingqiu Princess.
While Gu Xing was pondering, the icy voice of the Ghost Race Great Elder suddenly rang out:
"Human, isn’t this a place where you shouldn’t be?"
His gaze intentionally skipped over Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
He absolutely disregarded these two worthless Ghost Race members.
But when he glanced over Gu Xing’s back with Liu Li and Vera, his eyes narrowed slightly.
An Angel and an Elf.
Two top-tier races!
What concerned him more was...
The Great Elder’s gaze finally landed on Lilith.
This seemingly delicate Blood Race girl made him instinctively feel danger.
This meant that the opponent was at least at the same level as him.
Although the Ghost Race never feared battle, it was unnecessary to make enemies without reason.
Making this human know his limits was the best way to handle it.
As for whether this person would stick up for those two ’ominous’ ones?
The Great Elder sneered inwardly.
Unless this human is insane, why would they offend the entire Ghost Race for two worthless members?
However, he could never have expected...
Half of Gu Xing’s purpose here was indeed to seek justice for his own Guardian Beasts!
Looking at the Great Elder’s facade of false kindness, a cold glint flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
It was this very person who almost harmed Qing Shuang and Fei Yue in the past.
If he cannot make him pay, wouldn’t he be failing as a Beast Master?
But now is not the time...
The Divine Pattern hasn’t been secured yet, turning against this Great Elder is not a wise choice.
On the way here, he had already discussed with Lilith.
To succeed in this plan, they must meet two conditions.
First, they must bring Qing Shuang and Fei Yue’s father out of the Forbidden Land, to stand by their side.
As the number one talent of the Ghost Race, his combat power is undeniably terrifying!
Only when he stands on the same front, can this Ghost Race Great Elder pay the price.
Second, they must secure support from the Ghost Clan Leader.
Only then will they have a chance to take the Divine Pattern.
If either of these conditions is unmet...
The plan will not succeed.
Gu Xing took a deep breath, suppressing the killing intent in his heart, and spoke in the calmest tone possible:
"Ghost Race Great Elder, isn’t the Ghost Race currently hosting the Ghost Race Tournament?"
"And you seemed not to have a rule against expelled members participating."
"So, we are here without any ulterior motives—"
"Just to participate in this tournament!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 180: Ghost Race Forbidden Land
chapters.content:
Chapter 180: Chapter 180: Ghost Race Forbidden Land
The Great Elder of the Ghost Race was initially stunned, but then a cold light flashed in his eyes.
Participate in the competition?
These two exiled "omen of misfortune," it was fortunate enough that they didn’t die back then, and now they dare to dream of returning to the Ghost Race to compete?
"Ignorant!" he sneered internally.
A mere Commander Level human, even with the protection of a Monarch Peak from the Blood Race, so what?
The Ghost Race has ten elders, all at Monarch Peak, and the Clan Leader is even at Totem Level...
Do they hope to challenge the entire Ghost Race with just a Monarch Peak from the Blood Race?
In their dreams!
The surrounding ghost tribesmen, upon hearing Gu Xing’s request, all looked on with ridicule.
"Did I hear wrong? A human with two exiles wants to enter our competition?"
"What a joke, do these outcasts really think they’re fit to return?"
"I think they’re tired of living, why not just..."
Upon hearing these voices from the Ghost Race, the Great Elder prepared to give the order to act.
But just as tensions reached a boiling point, Tushan Yueli suddenly spoke softly:
"Why not... just let them participate?"
Her slender fingers gently stroked the snow-white fox tail.
"Surely the younger generation of the Ghost Race wouldn’t lose to a human’s Guardian Beast?"
At this moment, the Qingqiu Princess was curiously observing Gu Xing.
A human, capable of subduing top races like Angels, Elves, the Ghost Race, and the Blood Race as Guardian Beasts?
This piqued her strong interest in this human.
More importantly—
Right now, she was hesitating over choosing allies, and the appearance of this human prodigy seemed like divine providence.
"This..."
Hearing Tushan Yueli’s voice, the Great Elder of the Ghost Race stiffened and turned his head mechanically, looking at Yueli with unspeakable intentions.
This fox....
If it weren’t for the Ghost Race’s desire to ally with other races to face the impending crisis.
He would have already driven the Qingqiu Race people out.
But now...
For the sake of an alliance, he had to heed the words of the princess.
Moreover, Tushan Yueli’s remark directly roped in the younger generation of the entire Ghost Race.
If they didn’t agree, wouldn’t it make their younger generation appear empty?
Then his gaze turned to Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
But allowing these two Ghost Race members to participate in the competition so easily was definitely out of the question.
"Qingqiu Princess, this is originally an internal matter of our Ghost Race, but since you’ve spoken today, I’m willing to give these two of the Ghost Race a chance."
"As long as they can last one day in the forbidden zone, then I will agree to let them participate in this Ghost Race competition."
"After all, letting them in directly would be unfair to the other Ghost Race members!"
"The other Ghost Race members wouldn’t agree either!"
As soon as the Great Elder finished speaking, the surrounding members of the Ghost Race erupted in agreement.
"The Great Elder is right, do these two ’omens’ really want to easily participate in the competition?"
"Either stay in the forbidden zone for a day or get out of the Ghost Race obediently!"
"Yeah, they even dared to bring outsiders to the Ghost Clan’s Residence, they should’ve been put to death directly back then!"
A flood of malice surged like a tide.
Gu Xing’s brow furrowed tightly, the depth of hostility the Ghost Race held towards Qing Shuang and Fei Yue was truly astronomical.
Just because they each had only one horn, they were ostracized by the entire race?!
Gu Xing worriedly turned to look at the two Guardian Beasts but found their expressions calm, as if they were already accustomed to such abuse.
This calmness instead pricked at Gu Xing’s heart.
As children, how much malice had they endured?
He took several deep breaths to calm himself before his gaze returned to the Great Elder.
Before coming here, he anticipated that the plan wouldn’t go smoothly.
He was even prepared for the worst-case scenario of having Lilith act directly to draw out the Clan Leader.
But the Qingqiu Princess’s intervention prompted the Great Elder to relent.
However, they added the condition of staying in the Ghost Race’s forbidden zone for a day.
"The Ghost Race’s forbidden zone..."
Gu Xing recalled the descriptions from Qing Shuang and Fei Yue. It was a place to punish errant clan members, rumored to be extremely dangerous.
But coincidentally, they had already planned to infiltrate the forbidden zone to search for Qing Shuang’s father.
Now the opportunity came presented on a silver platter!Thɪs ɴoᴠel Fɪre.nᴇt
After exchanging a glance with the Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing resolutely agreed:
"Alright! It’s decided then!"
The Great Elder’s eyes flashed with a hint of menace.
This human had no idea of the horrors within the forbidden zone—
Commander Level entrants faced near certain death, and even Monarch Level had only a fifty percent survival rate.
In his view, Gu Xing was seeking his own doom!
"Very well!" The Great Elder sneered coldly, "Later, they will send you to the forbidden zone!"
Soon after, under the lead of the Ghost Race Elder, the group arrived at the forbidden zone entrance located to the north of the village.
It was a deep, dark hole that seemed capable of swallowing everything, with an icy chill continuously emanating from within that made one shiver uncontrollably.
In front of the entrance.
The Great Elder feigned concern as he looked at Gu Xing:
"If you regret, it’s not too late. Take your Guardian Beasts and leave, and I won’t hold anything against you."
His voice was deliberately lowered:
"Even Monarch Level strong individuals have a fifty percent chance of perishing inside the forbidden zone."
Of course, this was absolutely not out of goodwill.
The Great Elder had other calculations in mind—
He could never quite fathom the depth of this human.
Especially that Angel Guardian Beast, which even made him, at Monarch Peak, feel a hint of oppression.
Yet, on second thought, a Guardian Beast’s level couldn’t exceed its master, so what waves could this Commander Tier Four human possibly make?
But just in case...
A flicker of dark intent flashed through his eyes.
On the way here, he had already secretly set up insurance measures.
A persisting threat he couldn’t eradicate ten years ago must now be thoroughly resolved!
Gu Xing ignored the Great Elder’s "advice."
After exchanging a glance with Lilith, he unhesitatingly led the Guardian Beasts into the entrance.
Because Lilith had reached Monarch Level, the Ghost Race adamantly refused her participation.
Thus, this forbidden zone mission had to be completed by Gu Xing with several Guardian Beasts.
But concerning this...
Gu Xing was indifferent.
Liu Li’s current strength was already equivalent to Monarch Level, and she could even utilize a bit of the Law, which was enough to ensure safety.
While Tushan Yueli watched Gu Xing’s silhouette disappear into the darkness, she slowly approached Lilith.
"Do you know that human well?"
Lilith turned her head to meet the curious eyes of the Qingqiu Princess.
A gleam flashed through Lilith’s eyes...
Gu Xing had tasked her with persuading this Qingqiu Princess to cooperate with humans.
Now...
The opportunity had arrived!
"Of course, I know him well!"
She curled up the corner of her lips, "Why don’t we find a place to chat?"
Upon hearing this, Tushan Yueli nodded immediately.
She had the same thought.
The two turned in tandem and left.
This scene didn’t escape the eyes of the Ghost Race Great Elder, making his expression even more somber.
These two conniving together...
It indicated that the Qingqiu Race still entertained the idea of cooperating with humans.
This kind of unexpected development must be eradicated!
"Send a Monarch Level."
He ordered coldly, "Ensure that human remains in the forbidden zone forever."
"As you command, Great Elder!"
A Ghost Race guard received the order and instantly vanished into the shadows.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 181: Ghost Race Assassination
chapters.content:
Chapter 181: Chapter 181: Ghost Race Assassination
The moment they stepped into the Forbidden Land, an overwhelming sense of oppression crashed down on them, suffocating.
Gu Xing scanned his surroundings, pupils shrinking—
This place seemed to be an isolated alternate dimension, cut off from the world.
The pitch-black sky blended seamlessly with the charred earth, the air thick with nauseating Demonic Qi—so dense, it seemed it could drip like syrup.
Several guardian beasts instantly entered battle mode, warily observing in every direction.
"Master, it seems this is no longer merely an alternate space."
Vera spoke with a frown she could not hide.
As a Natural Spirit, her perception of Life Energy was the sharpest of them all.
Yet here...
She couldn’t sense a trace of vitality, only the suffocating aura of death churning endlessly.
For a place to harbor such potent death aura....
"Master, this is very likely..."
"The Demon Race’s territory!"
This conclusion aligned perfectly with Gu Xing’s own guess.
Even the air here was flooded with Demonic Qi...
Clearly, this could not be an alternate space.
Besides the alternate dimension...
The only explanation—Demon Abyss!
Except...
The Ghost Race’s Forbidden Land had become Demon Race territory?
