He turned to Qing Shuang, inquiry in his eyes.
Last time, Qing Shuang had merely mentioned the Forbidden Land in passing, never explaining in detail.
Now, Qing Shuang pondered a moment before speaking softly:
"Master, when we were little, we heard that the Forbidden Land was not originally a place for imprisoning criminals..."
Her voice sounded particularly clear in the dead silence:
"Every so often, the Ghost Race would send people into this place."ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ N(o)vᴇl(F)ire.nᴇt
"Thinking back now...it was likely to suppress the Demon Race dwelling in this region."
"It was only as time passed that the Forbidden Land gradually evolved into a prison for criminals."
After understanding this, Gu Xing nodded slightly.
But although it was Demon Abyss, it didn’t scare him much.
The Demonic Qi concentration here may be high, but...
Most are probably Commander Level demons!
The strength of Demon Race is always measured by the intensity of Demonic Qi.
And each Demon’s habitat is related to its Demonic Qi density.
The Demonic Qi here certainly wasn’t high enough to mean Monarch Level demons everywhere.
Commander Level demons, for him now...
They posed no real threat anymore!
But right now, the top priority was to find the father of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
"Fei Yue, use Void Stealth and scout ahead."
Fei Yue, hidden in the Void, could evade even Monarch Level perception if she was careful.
So, letting Fei Yue take point was the best choice.
With a ripple of space, Fei Yue’s form faded out of sight.
Gu Xing had no intention of idling; he prepared to check for information nearby.
But...
Just as he was about to lead the others, a strange spatial ripple stirred behind him—
Swoosh!
Three figures of the Ghost Race appeared abruptly; the leader sneered:
"Human, your journey in the Forbidden Land ends here!"
His eyes brimmed with contempt.
This human who didn’t know his own limits actually dared bring back those two "calamity stars" to provoke the dignity of the Ghost Race?
Such reckless behavior demanded a price!
Although the Great Elder had only assigned him alone at first, he had secretly sent two more Monarch Levels before departure.
Deploying three Monarch Level Ghosts against a single Commander Level human?
He thought it was overkill.
But orders from the Great Elder were orders—he couldn’t say no.
Upon seeing these three Ghosts, Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Vera instinctively formed a protective wall in front of Gu Xing, shielding him.
Gu Xing’s gaze calmly swept across the trio.
In that instant, he knew whose handiwork this was.
The Ghost Race’s Great Elder!
When allowing him to join the Ghost Race’s Tournament, that elder had worn a sanctimonious mask.
But in the shadows...
Gu Xing shook his head.
Still, these three Ghosts were only Monarch Tier One—were they underestimating him?
[Ghost Race]
[Talent: Legendary Seven Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier Three]
[Power: 110,000]
[Constitution: 105,000]
[Spirit: 95,000]
[Speed: 107,000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques (Mountain Opening, Sea Breaker, Heaven-Breaking (doubles Strength Attribute) usable), Ghost King’s Body (boosts attributes by 1.2x)...]
The lead Ghost was strongest of the group.
Already Monarch Tier Three.
His Strength Attribute had reached 110,000!
But maybe it was his talent that was lacking.
The Ghost Race’s Third Technique only doubled his Strength Attribute.
Ghost King’s Body only raised his own stats by 1.2 times.
Far inferior to Qing Shuang!
Gu Xing quickly swept his gaze across his guardian beasts.
To defeat such a Monarch Tier Three Ghost...
Vera and Qing Shuang were powerful, but still a bit short of Monarch Tier Three.
Therefore, only Liu Li, whose talent was Myth Nine Stars, could do the job...
Just in time—after Liu Li’s breakthrough, he was curious just how far she’d advanced!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 30,000]
[Constitution: 30,000]
[Spirit: 30,000]
[Speed: 30,000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification +400%), Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain, Guardian Law (can invoke Power of Laws)]
[Cultivation Materials: Divine Pattern, Totem-level Demon Core, Angel Race Destiny]
Guardian Angel Form could boost Liu Li’s attributes by 400%, and with Soul Devouring Talent, Liu Li could absolutely crush a Monarch Tier Three Ghost in stats.
Most crucial of all...
Liu Li held one trump card—
Guardian Law!
She could wield a trace of Power of Laws.
This was something only Totem Level masters could touch!
Gu Xing had a strong hunch.
Once she used the Power of Laws, Monarch Tier Three Ghosts would be utterly defenseless in front of Liu Li.
However...
Lilith had warned them to improve their control over their domains.
Thus, Gu Xing didn’t intend to immediately activate the Second Domain, but instead wanted Liu Li to engage with her own domain.
Vera and Qing Shuang as well——
The other two Ghosts were only Monarch Tier One, their basic attributes under ninety thousand, perfect for sharpening their skills.
Through a Spiritual Link, Gu Xing instantly conveyed his tactics to the guardian beasts.
They immediately agreed!
During the battle against the Blood-colored Church, Lilith had crushed the Demon God with nothing but Domain Control—making them acutely aware of how vital it was.
Only by mastering domain control could their power progress further.
Besides, Gu Xing was at hand—he could instantly activate the Second Domain and seal the enemy’s domain at will.
These three Ghosts were just marginally stronger, making them the ideal opponents to hone their skills!
On the other side, the Ghosts saw Gu Xing and his beasts in a combat stance—disdain appeared on their faces.
"Human, don’t tell me you think these few guardian beasts can stand up to Monarch Level?" the lead Ghost mocked.
If this human and his beasts were at Commander Peak, maybe they’d be worth acknowledging.
But by their perception, this human hadn’t even reached Commander Tier Five.
He thought he could fight them at this level?
Laughable!
Yet the beasts couldn’t care less about his taunts.
"Guardian Angel Form·Qi!"
"Ghost King’s Body·Initiation!"
"Elf Monarchy·Qi!"
Three radically different energy surges erupted into the air.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 182: Liu Li vs. King Tier Three
chapters.content:
Chapter 182: Chapter 182: Liu Li vs. King Tier Three
At the same time.
Within the Ghost Race council hall, dim firelight cast flickering shadows on the stone walls.
Several elders of the Ghost Race sat encircling a long obsidian table, the atmosphere heavy and grim.
"Great Elder, do you truly intend to let those two ominous ones participate in the tournament? If word spreads, will that not make the other races mock us, saying the Ghost Race has no one worthy?"
An elder, his face wrinkled like dried bark, slammed his hand on the table, voice hoarse and harsh.
"Indeed."
Another elder chimed in, fingers tapping the table in agitation, "Though the Forbidden Land is perilous, but if that human really endures for a day..."
The Great Elder sat firmly at the head, fingers lightly caressing the armrest, the corner of his lips curling into a cruel sneer:
"Participate in the tournament? Wishful thinking!"
His venomous gaze swept over all present, his voice ice-cold as frozen steel:
"That human clearly came for the Divine Pattern—how could we let him succeed?"ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ
"Rest assured, I have already dispatched three Monarch-level to intercept and kill."
"He will certainly die within the Forbidden Land. By then, even if the Human Race seeks trouble with us, they will have no cause!"
Hearing this, the tense expressions of the elders finally eased, each exhaling a long breath.
"With Great Elder masterminding all, we can naturally be at ease. It’s just..."
A younger elder hesitated to speak, "Over the years, we’ve secretly sent those who support the Clan Leader into the Forbidden Land. Could this..."
"Hmph!"
The Great Elder suddenly slapped the table.
His eyes shone with a frosty gleam, his tone biting as a winter wind:
"For decades now, has there been any matter in the Ghost Race not decided by me? Clan Leader? He is but a figurehead!"
"Recently I have formed a connection with the Divine Pattern. Once full acknowledgment is secured, it shall be my time to breakthrough to Totem Level!"
"And on that day—"
The Great Elder spread his arms wide, as though to embrace the entire Ghost Race.
"I will be the true ruler of the Ghost Race!"
"Great Elder is wise indeed!"
"Under the Great Elder’s leadership, the Ghost Race shall surely rise!"
The elders promptly rose, showering flattery.
The Great Elder narrowed his eyes, savoring their praise, a twisted satisfaction surfacing on his face.
When the wave of sycophancy waned, he raised his hand for silence:
"The matter at hand, however, is forging an alliance with the Qingqiu Race."
"With their support, our strength shall rise to yet another height."
"Therefore, for this tournament, our strongest new generation of the Ghost Race must enter the stage."
"Let those foxes witness for themselves the glory of our young blood."
The elders nodded incessantly in agreement.
"However..."
The Great Elder’s voice grew sharp and cold, "That Blood Race is truly an eyesore. After the tournament, we shall find a chance..."
He left the rest unsaid, but every Ghost Race elder present understood his meaning well enough.
"Understood!"
The elders exchanged sinister grins.
Beneath the candlelight, their shadows warped and twisted across the stone walls.
...
Within the Ghost Race Forbidden Land.
Beneath the pitch-black firmament, several dazzling lights suddenly erupted.
Several Guardian Beasts, under the enhancement of their Skills, saw their Attributes spike in an instant to their very limits.
The most astonishing was Liu Li—
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 30,000→120,000]
[Constitution: 30,000→120,000]
[Spirit: 30,000→120,000]
[Speed: 30,000→120,000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form (All Attributes Amplification 400%), Blazing Burn, Celestial Fire Domain, Guardian Law (can wield a thread of Power of Laws)]
Thirty thousand basic Attributes, surging in an instant to 120,000 with a 400% amplification!
This value far surpasses an ordinary Monarch Level!
Qing Shuang and Vera’s Attributes had also nearly reached the threshold of a Monarch.
Witnessing all this—
The expressions on several Ghost Race faces abruptly contorted.
These Guardian Beasts...
Impossible!
The leading Ghost Race member, feeling Liu Li’s pressure, looked rather crestfallen.
He could tell that this Angel’s Attributes even bested his own by a margin.
But he was Monarch Level, while this Angel was but Middle Tier Commander.
Middle Tier Commander rising to Monarch Level?
This isn’t right?!
But soon, a sneer twisted his lips:
"So what if your Attributes are high? Domain is the true foundation of Commanders and Monarchs!"
His Domain would surely suppress this Angel’s.
Unless someone could nullify his Domain entirely!
But that...
Is it possible?!
No matter how prodigious this Angel’s Talent, today...
She must die!
"Ghost King’s Body!"
With a thunderous roar, his own Attributes surged again:
[Ghost Race]
[Talent: Legendary Seven Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier Three]
[Power: 110,000→132,000]
[Constitution: 105,000→126,000]
[Spirit: 95,000→114,000]
[Speed: 107,000→128,400]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques (Mountain Opening, Sea Breaker, Heaven-Breaking [doubles Power Attribute], all usable), Ghost King’s Body (can multiply Attributes by 1.2x) ...]
With the boost of Ghost King’s Body, this Ghost’s Attributes—except for Spirit Attribute—now overtook Liu Li’s.
Yet Liu Li paid this no heed whatsoever.
At this level, a gap of twenty or thirty thousand in Attributes made little difference.
What’s more, aside from Power Attribute, his other Attributes barely exceeded hers!
"Celestial Fire Domain!"
With a soft exhale, Liu Li ignited with crimson flames all around her.
A circular Domain explosively expanded from the twelve wings on her back.
And under the enhancement of Ultimate Fire, her original Blazing Angel Fire had been completely refined into a purer Ultimate Fire. The temperature across the Domain soared, even the air looked warped by the heat.
Yet, in the face of this Monarch Tier Three Ghost expert, Liu Li’s Domain Control was still immature.
The opponent only let out a disdainful laugh, and with a wave, a black Domain surged out like a tide, violently suppressing Liu Li’s Celestial Fire Domain, forcing a retreat at every step.
"Give it up!"
"Even if your Attributes barely reach Monarch Level, your grasp of Domain..."
"Is far too lacking!"
Liu Li gazed at the encroaching black Domain, face calm as ice.
From the start, she had anticipated this outcome.
Only under dire pressure can breakthroughs occur.
Lilith’s request of all of them...
To master Dual Domain release while still at Commander Level!
But to truly achieve such mastery, one must grasp it amidst life and death!
Right now, her first task was to refine control over every thread of Domain energy to its utmost.
"Ghost Race Third Technique: Heaven-Breaking!"
The Ghost expert would give her no time to recover, unleashing a killing blow at the outset.
His fist howled with Power of Destruction, punching straight at Liu Li’s face.
In Liu Li’s pupils, a flash of red flame; she exhaled sharply:
"Divine Protection!"
Facing this Ghost’s all-out blow—
260,000 points of Power Attribute. At this moment, only "Divine Protection" could barely withstand it.
"Boom—!"
The Ghost’s fist slammed hard into the golden shield, erupting with a deafening explosion.
This Ghost’s deathblow had been so easily blocked.
Witnessing this, the Ghost’s face shifted, but then his sneer deepened:
"Let’s see how many more you can block!"
He raised his hand again, shifting styles:
"Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker!"
Though Sea Breaker gave less Attribute amplification than Heaven-Breaking, for Liu Li, it was still a mortal threat.
And at this critical juncture—
"Absolute Forbidden Domain!"
A cold, clear voice rang out abruptly.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 183: Is This Human Not Afraid of Death?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 183: Chapter 183: Is This Human Not Afraid of Death?!
With Gu Xing’s cold and clear shout, the blood-red Domain suddenly unfolded, instantly enveloping the entire battlefield.
Liu Li’s Celestial Fire Domain and the Ghost Race’s black Domain trembled violently at the same time, and in the next moment, both vanished like bubbles.
Within this Blood Domain, no one can manifest their Domain.
Whether friend or foe!
For Liu Li...
Without the Soul Devouring Talent to bolster her, and unable to muster her own Power of Laws, it was by no means easy to withstand the attack unleashed by that Ghost Race beast.
What’s more, Liu Li’s "Divine Protection" had already been used once...
To take this Ghost Race’s attack head-on would leave Liu Li seriously wounded.
So Gu Xing activated his Second Domain directly.
After all, his purpose was to temper Liu Li, not let his own Guardian Beast get hurt.
As the Domain vanished, the Ghost Race beast’s body suddenly froze.
Its eyes widened, pupils filled with disbelief.
Impossible?
This human...
What did he do?
How could his Domain just fail in a blink of an eye?!
The backlash of his Domain being forcibly stripped sent his Ghost Qi into chaos in an instant.
The "Ghost Race Second Technique: Sea Breaker," which he’d been about to unleash, was harshly interrupted just like that.
Liu Li, however, was long accustomed to Gu Xing’s Second Domain.
Almost instantly, she adjusted her Status and struck with force.
"Flame Spear!"
Ultimate Fire condensed in her palm, transforming in an instant into a crimson spear.
The tip of the spear glinted with a cold light, thrusting straight at the Ghost Race beast’s chest.
"Boom—!"
After all, as a Monarch Tier Three powerhouse, the Ghost Race beast managed to forcibly stabilize his Ghost Qi at the last possible moment.
Just as the spear was about to pierce his heart, he frantically poured Ghost Qi throughout his body, forming a pitch-black shield in front of his chest while rapidly retreating.
"Sss—"
The Flame Spear grazed the Ghost Shield, leaving a scorching mark in the air.
He barely dodged the fatal blow, but cold sweat had already formed on his forehead.
So close.
If he’d been any slower...
That Flame Spear, burning with Ultimate Fire, would have pierced his chest.
The chill of death still clung to his spine, lingering for ages.
He slowly raised his hand, wiped off the cold sweat, and the previous contempt in his eyes had completely disappeared.
What replaced it was an unprecedented gravity.
"Careless..."
He muttered, his voice tinged with lingering fear.
If he hadn’t unleashed his Ghost Qi at the critical moment...
Just now, under the Angel’s strike, he would have been left for dead!
He took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
Now, he had to go all out, otherwise...
Today he really might die here!
His gaze shifted slightly, locking tightly onto Gu Xing not far away.
This human....
Terrifying!
How can he awaken such a heaven-defying Domain?
To completely seal his Monarch Level Domain!
Unconvinced, he tried again to muster Ghost Qi, but as soon as his power gathered, it was ruthlessly suppressed by the Blood Domain—he couldn’t release it at all.
"Damn it..."
Facing a mere Commander Level human, unease actually started to well up in his heart.
But at that moment—
Gu Xing spread his hands nonchalantly and said casually:
"Carry on!"
The strange bloody glow in his eyes faded like a tide, the Second Domain dissipating along with it.
Originally, he’d only meant to suppress the Ghost Race’s Domain, but because his control wasn’t yet precise enough, Liu Li’s Domain was sealed as well.
But the result was the same.
The Ghost Race’s attack missed!
Now, with the crisis lifted, the tempering could continue.
"You...!"
The Ghost Race beast, upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, instantly flared up with anger.
This human...
He glared at Gu Xing, then turned to the now-reformed Celestial Fire Domain around Liu Li...
He finally realized the human’s intent!
This human actually wanted him to serve as a practice opponent for his Guardian Beast.
Humiliation!
This was bare-faced humiliation!
He was a dignified Monarch Tier Three powerhouse of the Ghost Race—when had he ever been so belittled?
Yet he was powerless to resist the human’s humiliation.
Although his Domain could suppress the Angel, every time he tried to attack her...
The human would inevitably use that unreasonable Domain.
By then, his attack would miss again!
"Damn it!"
Soon, though, his gaze locked onto Gu Xing, as if he’d thought of something.
He narrowed his blood-red eyes, lips curling into a sinister smile.
If he couldn’t kill this Angel...
"Boom—!!"
The Ghost Race Monarch’s Domain erupted again, pitch-black Ghost Qi surging to suppress Liu Li’s Celestial Fire Domain.
But this time, instead of attacking Liu Li, he shimmered and suddenly merged into the Void.
The Ghost Race is born with double Talents—
Other than immense Power, they excel at Void Traversal!
If direct force couldn’t suppress this Angel, then he would eliminate that damned human Beast Master first!
Liu Li, suppressed by the black Domain, saw her eyes gradually light up.
She realized that as long as she fused her Spiritual Power into Ultimate Fire, and then used the flames to distribute her Spiritual Power throughout the entire Domain, she could indirectly control the whole Domain—
Though it was a bit of a cheat, it worked unexpectedly well!
Under the pressure of the black Domain, she channeled Spiritual Power into the flames with incredible speed.
Soon, the entire Celestial Fire Domain was riddled with her spiritual marks.
"I did it!"
A hint of joy swept across Liu Li’s face.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on Novᴇ(l)Fɪre .ɴᴇt
Spreading Spiritual Power throughout the Domain—this was the first step to mastering a Domain.
But the next instant, her expression abruptly froze.
"No! Master is in danger!"
At the same time, Qing Shuang and Vera, who were fighting two other Ghost Race beasts, sensed something was wrong.
Their eyes focused, and they unleashed their full strength in an instant!
"Boom—!!"
Vera’s emerald-green Natural Domain and Qing Shuang’s purple Ghost King Domain erupted together, driving their foes back.
For a Guardian Beast, nothing is more important than their master.
Neither hesitated, sprinting straight for Gu Xing—
But Liu Li was the fastest!
Twelve wings fully unfurled, the Speed Attribute of a hundred and twenty thousand points turning Liu Li into a streak of red brilliance.
She charged desperately toward where Gu Xing was, her eyes filled with anxiety.
And right then, the Ghost Race Monarch emerged from the Void—
Directly behind Gu Xing!
"Human, it’s over!"
He grinned viciously, claws lashing out for Gu Xing’s throat.
A mere Commander Level human Beast Master, before him, couldn’t possibly resist.
Once he killed this Beast Master, the remaining Guardian Beasts—no matter how powerful—would be no threat.
His claws drew ever closer to Gu Xing’s neck, a victorious grin spreading across the Ghost Race Monarch’s face...
Human, you’re dead!
Yet—
The Ghost Race Monarch didn’t see the least bit of panic in the human’s expression. Instead, there was a strange hint of a smile.
The Ghost Race Monarch’s heart jerked, a thought flashed in his mind...
This human—isn’t afraid of death?!
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 184: The Domain Endures, the Guardianship Never Ceases
chapters.content:
Chapter 184: Chapter 184: The Domain Endures, the Guardianship Never Ceases
When Gu Xing stepped into the Forbidden Land, he had already foreseen the scene before him.
As a human Beast Master, he understood this fatal weakness better than anyone—
No matter how powerful the Guardian Beast, as long as the enemy attacks the Beast Master directly...
That is the most dangerous moment.
What’s more...
This is the Forbidden Land of the Ghost Race.
If you’re not fully prepared, it’s no different than handing your life to someone else.
And now...
Although the one who attacked him is one of the most battle-proficient ghosts.
And had closed in on him, but...
He still wasn’t the slightest bit flustered.
He had long known about the Ghost Race’s Void Talent. Ordinarily...
Earlier, the safest approach would have been to keep at least one Guardian Beast at his side for protection out of the three.
Yet this time, he sent all three Guardian Beasts out.
This was his deliberate choice.
Because Lilith had previously told him some information:
Liu Li had never fully unleashed her true power.
As a Guardian Beast with Myth Nine Stars Talent, this is already the peak of Myth Talent.
But her combat strength was only slightly above Qing Shuang and Vera, just with some additional Law Control ability.
This clearly didn’t match the strength of Liu Li’s Myth Nine Stars Talent.
Gu Xing speculated it might be related to Liu Li giving up the Blazing Angels’ ultimate offensive power.
Transforming from a pure attacker into a Guardian-type, Liu Li seemed not yet fully adapted to the strength of Guardian Angels.
So, he decided to take drastic measures—
Put himself in danger.
Of course, this wasn’t a reckless gamble without preparation.
The Blood Covenant between him and Lilith allowed Lilith to store part of her power within him. This was the trump card he had prepared for the Forbidden Land.
Yet this secret was completely unbeknownst to his Guardian Beasts.
Gu Xing’s gaze turned to Liu Li.
He believed Liu Li would never betray his expectations.
At this moment.
Liu Li’s face was full of panic.
The Ghost Race’s claws were growing ever nearer to Gu Xing’s throat, almost touching his skin already.
An unprecedented sense of fear surged in, drowning her, leaving her completely at a loss.
The "Divine Protection" skill had just been used; she couldn’t activate it again to protect Gu Xing.
Though she’d already pushed herself to rush toward her master, but...
She couldn’t make it!
What to do?
What to do?!
Immense terror thundered through her soul.
If Gu Xing died...
Just that thought made her breath come to an abrupt halt.
No!
Absolutely not!
This sort of thing... how could it possibly happen?!
In that instant, the world seemed to slow down; all color faded in her vision.
Her gaze was locked dead between the Ghost Race’s claws and Gu Xing’s throat, as if the whole world narrowed to that deadly inch of distance.
She is a Guardian Angel!
If she can’t even protect her own master...
Her body began to tremble uncontrollably.
This sort of thing...
Absolutely cannot happen!
The blazing red Ultimate Fire burning around her suddenly froze, as if sensing something.
Gradually, the ferocious flames faded from their savagery...
Gradually, they were tinged with a layer of holy radiance—the red slowly transformed into dazzling golden light.
At the same time, the red Fire Pattern on her twelve wings was washed anew by the Holy Light, gradually turning to gold.
The Celestial Fire Domain changed accordingly—
Where flames once surged in red, now a sacred golden sea of fire replaced them.
And on Liu Li’s brow, an ancient Guardian Mark began to appear.
"Wooo—!!"
In a flash, a brilliant gold pillar of light burst skyward!
That golden column shot straight into the clouds, ripping open the thick layers of black cloud!
A hundred miles away, at the Ghost Clan’s Residence—
All Ghost Race elites who had entered the Forbidden Land had gathered here.
Their leader was "Qing", the one exiled here several decades ago.
Now, as that soaring column of light split the sky, Qing’s expression shifted dramatically.
"That aura..."
"Absolutely not of the Ghost Race!"
"Even less likely to be of the Demon Race!"
A thought raced through his mind...
Could another race have trespassed in the Forbidden Land?
But that’s the connection to the Ghost Race’s Forbidden Land...
How could any other race enter?
A possibility struck him.
Could something have happened to the Ghost Race?
Thinking of this, Qing barked a sharp command:
"All Monarch Level Ghost Race, follow me to the place of the light column!"
"Yes, sir!"
Led by Qing, the strong Ghost Race figures turned into streaks of darkness, dashing toward the pillar of light.
Meanwhile, the Demon Race in this region also sensed the holy aura.
Dozens of Monarch Level Demon Race members simultaneously looked toward the light column, their eyes flashing with greed.
"A new prey is delivered right to us!"
Under orders from the Monarch Level Demons, the vast Demon Race army surged toward the source of the column like a flood.
At the center of the battlefield—
Gu Xing stared at the completely transformed Liu Li, pupils frozen.
"Exactly as expected..."
"Just as Lilith said..."
Only at this moment did Liu Li fully display her entire potential as a Myth Nine Stars Guardian Beast!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 30000→120000]
[Constitution: 30000→120000]
[Spirit: 30000→120000]
[Speed: 30000→120000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification 400%), Guardian Domain, Guardian Law (can channel a trace of Power of Laws)]
Liu Li’s Basic Attributes still remained at 30,000 points—without any growth at all.
But...
Blazing Skills disappeared, and Celestial Fire Domain was gone as well.
What replaced them was a brand new Domain:
Guardian Domain.
When Gu Xing checked this Skill’s detailed description, his pupils shrank.
[Guardian Domain: After activation, the designated target protected by Liu Li gains Absolute Defense status. Unless Liu Li dies or lifts the Domain willingly, the protected will not suffer any harm]
"This..."
Gu Xing involuntarily swallowed.
This Domain’s effect...
It completely abandoned all offensive power...
But...
This is basically a Divine Skill of the Defense System!
From now on, as long as Liu Li activates the Domain, he will be invincible within its range.
"That’s insane..."
"Is this the true might of a Myth Nine Stars Guardian Beast?"
Before, he had felt the Celestial Fire Domain didn’t live up to Liu Li’s rank...
But now...
The Celestial Fire Domain had evolved into the Guardian Domain!
The effect of this Domain is like a cheat code!
Now, Liu Li was—without a doubt—the strongest Guardian-type Guardian Beast in the world!
No other Guardian Beast could match her in Guardian Ability!
Just then—
The claws of that Monarch Tier Three Ghost Race stopped dead—just one inch from Gu Xing’s throat.
The Ghost stared wide-eyed, his mouth agape.
"Impossible..."
He had gone all out, even unleashed the Ghost Race’s Secret Technique: Third Technique: Heaven-Breaking.
But even so, his claws could not advance one bit further.
Liu Li’s eyes were as calm as still water.Google seaʀᴄh novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
The golden Guardian Domain covered the entire area.
Within the Domain, the attacks of all three Monarch Level Ghost Race members were nullified.
"This can’t be?!"
Shock was etched across the faces of the ghosts.
But this is precisely the effect of Liu Li’s new Domain!
As long as the Domain endures, the protection persists!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 185: Destruction Angel
chapters.content:
Chapter 185: Chapter 185: Destruction Angel
Within Liu Li’s Guardian Domain, if this Monarch Ghost Clan wants to inflict any harm on Gu Xing...
He’ll have to step over Liu Li’s corpse first!
This is Liu Li truly embodying her will to guard!
While the master lives, I live!
Meanwhile, Qing Shuang and Vera, seeing the golden Guardian Domain, both widened their eyes in surprise.
Previously, when Liu Li completed her breakthrough in the Blood-colored Church, they still thought the gap between them wasn’t insurmountable.
Although for the various races of the Alternate Space, Myth Five Stars was already the talent ceiling.
Yet Liu Li had broken this shackle and reached the realm of Myth Nine Stars.
But at that time...
They hadn’t sensed any qualitative leap in Liu Li’s power after surpassing the limit.
But at this moment...
The two Guardian Beasts exchanged a tacit glance.
They were both Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts, and could clearly sense the effects of Liu Li’s Domain—
Once the Domain was activated...
With Liu Li’s protection, nothing could threaten Gu Xing.
This kind of bug-like Guardian Ability...
Made envy flicker in Qing Shuang and Vera’s eyes.
You have to know, the special effect of Liu Li’s Domain...
Could already compare to Gu Xing’s "Absolute Forbidden Domain."
Absolute Forbidden Domain could unconditionally seal all other Domains.
While Guardian Domain could unconditionally protect those one wished to guard.
Both Domains shared something in common...
They were already approaching the level of a concept!
As for the Domains of Vera and Qing Shuang, even Blood Ancestor Lilith’s...
Their Domains were strong, but absolutely didn’t reach such a defying level.
But Liu Li and Gu Xing’s Domains...
Were like they had utterly transcended the normal level of Domains!
At this thought, a powerful sense of crisis grew wildly in the hearts of the two.
As Gu Xing’s contracted Guardian Beasts, neither wanted to be the weakest link.
Seeing Liu Li display such a crushing leap in strength, neither could accept it lying down.
Two burning gazes simultaneously locked onto Gu Xing; there was just one thought left in their minds:
They must please the master, and upgrade their own talents!
They too wanted, like Liu Li, for their Domains to become bug-level powers.
Yet, unlike the two Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing’s brow furrowed slightly.
Although Liu Li now possessed ultimate Power of Guardian, on the flip side...
Liu Li had almost lost all offensive capability!
"Possessing only Power of Guardian but losing attack— for Liu Li..."
Gu Xing pondered privately.
This seemed like a kind of nerf?!
Except that...
Soon, Gu Xing discovered...
He was utterly mistaken!
Myth Nine Stars Talent and other Myth Levels were two completely different concepts!
Within the Domain.
That Monarch Tier Three Ghost Clan, of course, also keenly noticed Liu Li’s loss of attack power.
After probing twice with attacks, he found this Angel’s offensive was even weaker than before.
A sneer of mockery appeared on his grim face.
"Sacrificing all attack power for ultimate defense, just to protect this lowly human?"
His voice brimmed with ridicule, "What a foolish choice!"
"Power that isn’t in your own hands! Sooner or later..."
"This human will abandon you without a second thought!"
And yet, faced with this ridicule, Liu Li’s lips curled into a faint smile.
The Angel Race had always been split into two great branches:
Blazing Angels and War Angels.
Blazing Angels focused on the path of attack, and their ultimate form was known as ’Destruction Angels.’
War Angels leaned toward protection, their ultimate form being ’Guardian Angels.’Follow current novᴇls on novᴇl(ꜰ)ire.ɴet
But—
Since ancient times, no Angel had ever reached either ultimate form!
Be it War Angel or Blazing Angel.
But she, as the Princess of the Blazing Angels Race, upon breaking through to Myth Nine Stars Talent, due to her deep and abiding will to guard Gu Xing...
Unexpectedly awakened the Guardian Angel Form!
But the innate offensive instinct of a Blazing Angel, how could she so easily abandon it?
Precisely because of this...
Her skills bar now simultaneously contained:
The Absolute Defense of a Guardian Angel, alongside the ultimate offense of a Blazing Angel.
This meant her Evolution was not yet perfect.
But now...
All contradictions were finally resolved!
Liu Li gazed at the arrogant Monarch Tier Three Ghost Clan within the Domain, and slowly raised her slender hand.
"Boom——!!"
In an instant, the dazzling Golden Domain drastically changed!
The entire space instantly turned into a blinding blood-red.
The golden halo around Liu Li faded, and all twelve wings were dyed pure blood color.
Blazing blood-red flames wrapped around her graceful form.
Gu Xing witnessed this scene, his pupils contracting sharply.
This is....
He hurriedly pulled up Liu Li’s Attributes panel,
And instantly drew a sharp breath.
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form]
[Power: 30,000→120,000]
[Constitution: 30,000→120,000]
[Spirit: 30,000→120,000]
[Speed: 30,000→120,000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification 400%), Destruction Domain, Destruction Law (can channel a wisp of the Power of Laws)]
Seeing these stats, Gu Xing’s breath caught.
Just a moment ago, he had been lamenting Liu Li’s loss of offense...
Yet in the blink of an eye...
[Destruction Domain: Within the Domain, all existences are subjected to the ceaseless burning of the Fire of Destruction, until they are utterly obliterated. Effects do not distinguish friend or foe! As long as the caster lives, the Domain endures, destruction continues.]
After reading this description, Gu Xing finally understood why the Blood Domain had gone out of its way to exclude him—
Within this Destruction Domain, even Liu Li herself could not restrain its annihilating nature!
True indiscriminate attack!
This was the pinnacle of Power of Destruction!
Gu Xing’s Adam’s apple bobbed unconsciously.
At this moment, he could no longer accurately estimate Liu Li’s true fighting strength.
But at the very least...
She would be no weaker than a Monarch Middle Tier!
Unless the enemy could utterly crush Liu Li in all Attributes...
Otherwise, once trapped in the Destruction Domain, there would be no hope of survival!
What was even more terrifying...
He could further amplify Liu Li with the Soul Devouring Talent!
Such combat strength...
Simply could not be calculated!
But ordinary Monarch Levels before Liu Li wouldn’t have the strength to resist at all!
The current Liu Li holds both Guardian and Destruction Laws!
Though it’s only a wisp...
It’s enough for her strength to completely transcend the normal Monarch Level.
Afterward, his gaze swept over the frozen Vera and Qing Shuang, a blazing look in his eyes.
Guardian Beast Talent rising from Myth Five Stars to Nine Stars could bring such terrifying transformation!
In that case...
I have to help these two Guardian Beasts break through as soon as possible!
Liu Li reached Myth Nine Stars and gained Dual Forms; then what about Qing Shuang and Vera’s breakthroughs?
He believed—they would be no less than Liu Li!
And as for Vera’s upgrade materials...
[Earth Marrow, Heart of Nature, Spring of Life]
Three materials, with two already obtained.
Both the Heart of Nature and Spring of Life are in his Beast Taming Space.
Therefore, as soon as he finds the remaining Earth Marrow, Vera...
Would also break through to Myth Nine Stars.
As for Qing Shuang...
[Nether Ghost Stone, Extreme Ghost Qi, Ghost Core]
Although for now there were no leads, Gu Xing was not anxious.
He believed, it wouldn’t be long...
Before he would gather all of Qing Shuang’s Evolution materials.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 186: Miss!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 186: Chapter 186: Miss!!
Inside the Blood Domain.
Three Ghost Race members were experiencing an unprecedented horror.
Spiderweb-like cracks started appearing on the surface of their bodies.
Whether it was the two Monarch Tier One or the Monarch Tier Three Ghost Race members...
All were irreversibly moving towards collapse.
"Wh—what’s going on? I tried to slip into the Void, but I can’t even sense it!"
"And the power inside my body is actually getting weaker and weaker."
Three pairs of crimson eyes stared fixedly at the blood-colored barrier at the edge of the domain.
"It was a Golden Domain just moments ago, how did it suddenly become..."
Trembling, the two Monarch Tier One Ghost Race members looked in unison at the leader of this operation.
Right now, the Ghost Race leader’s expression was terrifyingly grim.
He’d already tried every method—
Void Ability, Power Burst, even Ghost Energy Burst...
Yet still couldn’t break free from this bizarre domain.
Now, he realized...
It was already impossible for them to leave this domain by relying on their own abilities!
But since they couldn’t leave on their own...
His crimson pupils suddenly contracted, locking dead-center on Liu Li in the middle of the domain.
"Kill her!"
The Monarch Tier Three Ghost Race member let out a hoarse, low growl.
"As long as we get rid of that angel, the domain will be released!"
The three Ghost Race members exchanged glances.
Next second—
Three black shadows sprang up at once, surging towards Liu Li with murderous resolve!
Yet.
What they faced now...
Was a terrifying being with All Attributes as high as 120,000 points!
And one of the strongest forms of the Blazing Angels Race...
Destruction Angel!
This form was nothing like the gentle, merciful Guardian Angels.
Liu Li simply raised her slender, delicate hand gracefully, and a spear forged purely from the Fire of Destruction manifested out of thin air.
With a flick of her wrist, the Spear of Destruction transformed into a blood-colored stream of light.
Carrying the momentum to obliterate everything, it tore through the air!
The three Ghost Race members felt the world-ending pressure, their faces turned drastically pale.
They dared not hesitate for a moment:
"Full defense!"
They roared as they erupted all their Ghost Qi, launching three Monarch Domains simultaneously!
But even with everything they had...
The bloody Destruction Domain continued to suppress them mercilessly.
"Ah—"
Three twisted, vicious faces contorted, merging their domains and all their Ghost Qi into one ghostly barrier, desperately trying to fend off the fatal strike.
"Boom—!!!"
When Fire of Destruction clashed with Ghost Qi, the explosion was earth-shattering, soaring up to the heavens.
The raging energy turbulence swept through the entire domain.
Qing Shuang and Vera witnessed this scene, their eyes full of shock.
The domains of three Monarch Level Ghost Race members...
Were completely suppressed by Liu Li alone!
Just a moment ago, the two of them faced off one Monarch Tier One Ghost Race domain, and even when fighting with all their strength, barely managed to resist.
But the domain Liu Li released now...
Whether in quality or quantity, had already utterly surpassed them both.
And within the domain.
When the dust settled...
The two Low Tier Monarch Ghost Race members had already been reduced to ashes!
The only remaining Monarch Tier Three Ghost Race member knelt on one knee, coughing up a mouthful of black blood.
He trembled as he looked up at Liu Li, for the first time showing deep fear in his gaze.
This angel, and that human...
Were terrifying!
His own level was only Commander Tier Four, yet he could crush three Monarch Level Ghost Race members!
With such a prodigy, to make enemies of her...
A trace of desolation flashed in his eyes; he rasped quietly:
"Maybe... maybe the Great Elder was wrong from the very beginning..."
For the first time in hundreds of years, he’d begun to doubt the Great Elder’s judgment.
But Liu Li wouldn’t give him the chance to reconsider.
Liu Li raised her hand again, blood-colored flames swirling in her palm as another Destruction Spear slowly formed.
Only now, her delicate features were a bit pale, beads of sweat breaking out on her forehead.
Although she seemed calm and in control on the surface...
Every Destruction Spear almost drained her entirely.
After all, with the power of only Commander Tier Four, to fight across so many levels against Monarch Tier Three...
She had to give it her all with each strike!
If she let this Monarch Level Ghost Race recover, the consequences would be unimaginable.
"Boom—!!"
The second Destruction Spear tore through the skies, smashing toward the Ghost Race member with unstoppable force.
This Monarch Tier Three powerhouse finally couldn’t hold on.
Under the devouring of Fire of Destruction, his body shattered, dissipating into black mist.
At almost the same moment, Liu Li withdrew the Destruction Domain.
Though the Destruction Angel form granted her unparalleled power,
with her current level, sustaining this form was still too strenuous.
Only upon reaching Monarch Level could she truly wield the full might of both her forms.
Seeing this, Gu Xing immediately rushed forward, catching Liu Li as she teetered on her feet.
Vera and Qing Shuang quickly gathered around as well, their gazes toward Liu Li complicated and unreadable.
This angel had truly left them far behind.
Just as Gu Xing was about to speak words of comfort, the Void suddenly shimmered—
Fei Yue appeared out of nowhere, face unusually anxious:
"Master, something’s wrong!"
"A large number of Demon Race are gathering here, and there are Monarch Level among them!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s brows furrowed instantly.
Liu Li was in poor Status at the moment; if the Monarch Level Demon Race were too strong...
Just as Gu Xing was pondering how to respond...
Space rippled once again.
A Ghost Race member suddenly walked out of the Void without warning, standing not far from Gu Xing’s side.
Gu Xing’s heart clenched—
He hadn’t sensed any spatial fluctuations at all!
Ghost Race Monarch!
And at least a High Tier Monarch!
"The Great Elder of the Ghost Race has really staked everything this time..."
Gu Xing’s expression grew serious, power surging within him, ready to act at any moment.
But—
The Ghost Race member suddenly raised both his hands.
"Please don’t misunderstand, I’ve come to contact you on the orders of the leader."
Leader?
Hearing this word, Gu Xing realized—this Ghost Race member didn’t seem to be one of the Great Elder’s hit squad after him.
And this Ghost Race member appeared not to recognize him at all...
Which meant he was likely one of the Ghost Race survivors from the Forbidden Land.
Just then, the Ghost Race member’s gaze swept casually over everyone.
Suddenly!
His body froze as if struck by lightning.
"Un—Unicorn?!"
His pupils contracted sharply, voice trembling.
Next second.
He flashed before Qing Shuang, then instantly appeared beside Fei Yue, staring intently at both their faces.
Qing Shuang retreated half a step warily, while Fei Yue subconsciously hid behind Gu Xing.
Gu Xing’s brow remained tightly furrowed, completely unable to guess what this Ghost Race member was up to.
In the midst of this tense confrontation—
"Thud!"
The Ghost Race Monarch suddenly dropped to his knees, voice choked with emotion:
"Miss!!"
The title thundered through the group, leaving everyone stunned.
Gu Xing: "...?"
The Guardian Beasts: "...?"
The four of them wore identical expressions—
Faces full of question marks.

chapters.title: Chapter 187: Qing
chapters.content:
Chapter 187: Chapter 187: Qing
"Miss?!"
Gu Xing stiffly turned her head, her gaze shifting back and forth between Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
For a member of the Ghost Race to call her ’Miss,’ it means...
The person before her is most likely connected to Qing Shuang and Fei Yue’s father!
There’s even a strong possibility that this Ghost is...
one of their father’s subordinates!
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue had clearly realized this as well.
Their beautiful eyes were locked on the kneeling Ghost, pupils trembling slightly.
Father?!
That title was already far, far away for them.
In their memories, "Qing," as the strongest of the younger generation of the Ghost Race, carried the heavy burden of guarding the entire clan.
During their childhood, the days they got to see their father could be counted on one hand.
Now, to be respectfully called Miss by a member of the Ghost Race all of a sudden...
Even the always composed Qing Shuang was stunned in place for a moment.
"Miss! Lord Qing thinks of you every single moment!"
The Ghost’s eyes were full of excitement as he looked at the two girls.
As Lord Qing’s right-hand man—Shan—he knew his leader’s sorrows all too well.
For countless days and nights, he had seen that powerful man sitting alone, his eyes filled with unending longing.
Back when that calamity struck...
Qing’s strength had only just broken through to Monarch Peak.
Faced with the coercion of several Ghost Race Elders, he had no choice but to compromise.
But more importantly...
The death of his beloved wife had made his own heart die as well.
That was why he willingly accepted exile to the Forbidden Land as punishment.
But now—
Lord Qing’s two daughters were right in front of him!
He firmly believed this would surely rekindle his lord’s fighting spirit!
But it was clearly not the place for conversation.
"Miss, it’s too dangerous here," Shan’s expression suddenly turned grim, "Please leave with me quickly!"
That pillar of golden light shooting up earlier hadn’t only drawn them here, but had also attracted large groups of the Demon Race.
Right now—
The leader is leading the elite of the Ghost Race to intercept the Demon army; a battle has probably already begun...
"Boom—!!!"
A deafening explosion suddenly rang out, a violent shockwave sweeping in.
Shan’s face changed drastically in an instant.
This is Demon territory—the longer they stayed, the more Demons would gather!
They had to get back to the residence as soon as possible!
Just as he was preparing to take Qing Shuang and Fei Yue and leave...
He suddenly seemed to realize something, eyes widening abruptly.
He’d been too excited upon seeing the two Misses and hadn’t noticed something important.
His Misses...
Seemed to have become this human’s Contracted Beasts!
Shan’s gaze turned icy at once, locking onto Gu Xing.
One had to know, they were not like those old traditional Ghost villagers.
As Qing’s direct line, they never cared about anything like horns or not.
In their eyes, Qing Shuang and Fei Yue were just Qing’s daughters.
They were their Misses!
But now...
Their two Misses had been contracted by a human.
Without much thought, he subconsciously believed that...
Their Misses must have been coerced by this human, and that’s why they entered into the contract.
After all, the two Misses had very low Talent. As for why this human contracted them...
Shan’s fingers suddenly clenched tight, a glint of killing intent surfacing in his eyes.
But...
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue both noticed the hostility in this Ghost’s eyes and immediately flashed in front of Gu Xing to shield her.
Qing Shuang’s icy-blue eyes flashed with a sharp, frosty light; Fei Yue even put on a rarely seen stern face.
To them, Gu Xing was not only their savior.
He was also the master they would defend for life!
He’d not only healed both of their defects, but had also raised Qing Shuang’s Talent to Myth Five Stars.
This kindness was impossible to repay.
And so, the moment they sensed this Ghost’s thoughts, the two immediately stood in front of Gu Xing.
"He is our master! He will be our master for life!"
Fei Yue spoke each word clearly, her voice carrying a conviction she’d never had before.
Qing Shuang didn’t speak, but the same conviction shone in her eyes.
When the Ghost saw their actions, he was stunned for a moment, but quickly realized he had misunderstood the human.
After all, to receive such support from the Misses meant that this human must have treated them very well.
He might have even done them a favor.
Thinking of this, regret flashed in Shan’s eyes.
Only now did he realize how rude his attitude had been earlier.
"I sincerely apologize!"
He bowed solemnly, his voice full of genuine remorse.
Gu Xing waved his hand dismissively; he didn’t mind at all.
He understood how these top races thought all too well.
For such races...
Having one of their own contracted by a human always drew the same reaction.
Especially considering the high status of Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
This kind of reaction from the Ghost was no surprise.
"Let’s get out of here first!"
Shan nodded in agreement.
In the next instant, he waved his hand.
A surge of intense Power of Space rushed out like the tide, wrapping around the group.
With a flash of silvery light, their figures became gradually transparent, until they vanished completely from the spot.
...
At the same time—
Just not far from where Gu Xing’s group had been.
Qing stood tall with his hands behind his back, his ink-black robes billowing in the Demonic Qi.
Before him, three corpses of Monarch Level Demon Monarchs were slowly dissolving into black mist.
"Chief..."
Cai stepped forward slowly.
As the second-in-command of the Forbidden Ghost Clan’s residence, her amber eyes were tinged with worry.
"The Demon Race continues to pour in reinforcements—we should retreat."
She paused, lowering her voice a little:
"Third Brother has just sent word—the people who entered the Forbidden Land this time have already returned safely..."
"Oh, and he specially mentioned, he has a surprise for you."
However, hearing that, Qing’s eyes did not show the slightest ripple.
Surprise?!
Ever since his wife died and his beloved daughters were exiled from the Ghost Race, his heart had seemed frozen forever.
Even those closest to him could hardly decipher even a trace of emotion in his gaze.
"Mm."
With that brief response, Qing slowly raised his right hand.
In an instant, a torrent of Ghost Qi surged out like a tsunami, sweeping the Demon Race away from miles around.
Afterward, he turned and stepped into the spatial rift behind him.
Cai looked at her chief’s back, sighing silently.
As one of the earliest to follow Qing, she knew better than anyone how full of vitality this Ghost prodigy had once been.
But now...
"Retreat."
With Cai’s command, several spatial rifts split open in the Void.
Several Monarch Level Ghosts dove within, and before leaving, they all, in unison, glanced toward the Demon Race’s gathering point.
Grotesque faces flickered in and out of the demonic mist.
Cai was the last to leave.
Just before departing, she sharply noticed several unfamiliar, powerful auras emerging within the Demon’s ranks, causing her slender brows to knit unconsciously.
Over the years, the Demon Race’s strength had grown far too abnormally...
With Qing’s power, the Ghost Race’s territory had remained safe until now.
But...
If the Demon Race kept getting stronger, one day...
The Ghost Race would be wiped out by the Demons!
The thought left Cai feeling cold inside.
She must persuade the chief to leave this place!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 188: The Tournament Begins!
chapters.content:
Chapter 188: Chapter 188: The Tournament Begins!
The Ghost Clan’s Residence, the space rippled.
A tall figure stepped out from the fissure, the black robe fluttering without wind.
Qing’s return made Shan, who had been waiting for a long time, light up. He quickly stepped forward, a mysterious smile on his face:
"Boss, there’s a huge surprise to tell you!"
However—
Qing’s steps did not pause in the slightest, heading straight to his resting area, his voice as indifferent as ice:
"Settle the newcomers, and by the way, get an update on the Ghost Clan’s current situation."
He raised his hand to rub his temples, "I’m tired."
Before the words were finished, his figure had already disappeared at the end of the corridor.
The third master’s outstretched hand froze mid-air, the words of retention stuck in his throat, the smile on his face gradually solidifying.
At this moment, the figure of the second master, Cai, appeared out of thin air.
Seeing the third master standing dumbfounded, her slender eyebrows furrowed:
"What are you standing here for? What about the surprise for the boss?"
She looked around, "How come even the boss’s shadow is gone?"
Shan stiffly turned his head, his lips twitching unnaturally:
"I... didn’t have time to say it, the boss left..."
A black line appeared on Cai’s forehead instantly, as she gave him a disdainful look:
"So what’s the surprise you mentioned?"
"I think... I found the young lady."
"Which young lady?"
Cai didn’t react for a moment, but the next second her beautiful eyes widened:
"You mean..."
Shan nodded heavily.
"You’re sure you didn’t see wrong?" Cai’s voice suddenly rose.
"I swear by my life!" Shan patted his chest, "That distinctive horn, I would never mistake it!"
"Something so important and you actually—"
"Boom!!!"
Furious, Cai’s slender jade legs kicked the third master flying dozens of feet away with the sound of breaking air.
However, the Ghost Clan’s bodies were thick and tough.
This little attack had no effect on someone at Monarch Level like him.
Yet Cai dared not delay in the slightest and immediately went to Qing’s resting room.
At this moment.
In Qing’s private resting room, under the dim light.
His slender fingers gently stroked the Memory Stone, where a warm image of his wife holding two little girls appeared.
Those eyes, usually cold all year round, were now rarely rippling.
"Qing Shuang... Fei Yue..."
The deep voice was unusually clear in the silent room.
"Now you should be... grown young women by now..."
Amidst this moment of warmth, the space suddenly rippled.
Qing’s eyebrows instantly tightened—
He hated being disturbed at such a moment the most.
However, before he could erupt, Cai’s excited voice had already echoed:
"Leader! Your daughters... they’re at the residence!"
"Boom!"
Qing’s figure suddenly froze, and the Memory Stone in his hand dropped to the ground with a "click".
In the next second, he flashed like a ghost before Cai.
Those usually indifferent eyes were now gleaming with terrifying brilliance:
"You... sure?"
Cai was shaken back half a step by this sudden pressure, but she still nodded heavily:
"The third master saw it with his own eyes, it’s the surprise mentioned before..."
Before the words were finished, Qing’s figure had already dissipated into the air.
Outside the reception area.
Qing’s figure suddenly appeared in front of the building, and his usually steady hands were now uncontrollably trembling slightly.
Those two familiar presences were just inches away...
His long-dead heart suddenly started pounding violently, as if trying to burst out of his chest.
This long-lost sense of tension made him find it difficult to breathe.
As the youngest Monarch Peak of the Ghost Clan, he was now hesitating like a child who had done something wrong.
His fingertips touched the door handle several times, only to withdraw as if shocked.
His daughters were inside...
But he didn’t know what stance to take when facing his two daughters.
Since childhood, he had rarely been by his daughters’ sides.
And after that incident, his two daughters had been banished from the Ghost Clan.
He had never fulfilled the responsibilities of a father!
Now, suddenly hearing news of his daughters, he fell into unprecedented panic.
Though with his strength, he could turn the entire building to dust with a snap of his fingers.
Yet this ordinary wooden door seemed like the world’s strongest barrier.
Finally, after much mental preparation—
"Crack!"
Under excessive force, the entire door instantly turned to powder.
Amidst the flying dust, Qing’s gaze pierced through the room like an arrow, locking onto the two figures he had dreamed of in the center...
...
On the other side.
Outside the Forbidden Land, the Central Square of the Ghost Clan’s Residence.
Dense crowds of the Ghost Clan surrounded the entire square, their noisy discussions rising and falling.
"Have you heard? The Great Elder has issued a direct order this time! Everyone must go all out!"
"This time, we must perform well in front of the Qingqiu Race. If we cooperate with them, we might even be able to marry into their lineage..."
"But aside from the Qingqiu Race, hasn’t that human still not returned from the Forbidden Land?"
"He must be dead in there! A mere Commander Level dared to venture into the Forbidden Land, that’s courting death!"
"But it’s best if he died in there! The Great Elder was too merciful to even let such a thing take part in the competition!"
In the midst of the discussions, Lilith and Tushan Yueli slowly walked toward the seats prepared for them by the Ghost Clan.
Upon seeing only two seats, Lilith’s red lips curled into a mocking smile.
"Heh... so eager to pronounce Gu Xing dead? Didn’t even prepare a seat!"
Tushan Yueli, curious upon hearing this, leaned closer to Lilith, her fox tail gently swaying:
"Lilith, do you really believe in that human?"
"As far as I understand the Great Elder of the Ghost Clan, he definitely won’t let that human go."
"Even if his talent is strong and his Guardian Beast is formidable..."
"He can’t possibly fight a Monarch Level at a mere Commander Level?"
Upon hearing this, Lilith’s lips curved into an enigmatic smile.
She turned gracefully, looking straight into Tushan Yueli’s eyes:
"You’ll see soon enough!"
"However..."
"Yueli, have you considered cooperating with the Human Race?"
Tushan Yueli noticeably paused, then smiled slightly.
She knew Lilith was questioning on behalf of that human.
"For now, let’s wait until that human can make it to the competition."
Seeing this, Lilith said no more.
She simply shifted her gaze silently to the center of the field.
Although she had hinted many times about Gu Xing’s strength, this Qingqiu Princess evidently didn’t take it seriously.
But soon, she’d witness Gu Xing’s performance firsthand.
At this moment.
The Great Elder of the Ghost Clan ascended the high platform, looking refreshed.
With only a moment left until the competition officially began, that human was still nowhere to be seen.
This meant the Monarch Levels he sent out must have succeeded!
These two threats were finally eliminated...
The wrinkles on the Great Elder’s face relaxed. Once he announced the start of the competition, the participant list would be finalized.
Even if that human fortunately left the Forbidden Land, it would be too late!
He raised his hand high, his voice resonating throughout the field:
"This competition, starts now—"
"Hold on!"
A voice suddenly echoed.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 189: Great Elder, You’re Not Going to Go Back on Your Word, Are You?
chapters.content:
Chapter 189: Chapter 189: Great Elder, You’re Not Going to Go Back on Your Word, Are You?
The moment that voice rang out.
"Swoosh!"
A spatial rift suddenly tore open above the high platform.
Gu Xing stepped out from the rift, flanked by Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
His gaze locked directly onto the Great Elder of the Ghost Clan.
"Great Elder, aren’t we here now? What’s got you so impatient?"
Though he was keenly aware it was this very man who sent three Monarch-level Ghosts to kill him...
Gu Xing’s face showed not a trace of disturbance at this moment.
Right now, what mattered was entering the tournament...
As for his accounts with the Great Elder, those would soon be settled!
Meanwhile, deep within the Forbidden Land.
Qing’s face was filled with icy frost.
He was now commanding every Ghost Race member at the Residence to make their final preparations.
He was going to fight his way back into the Ghost Clan!
For years, he had willingly guarded the Forbidden Land, his only concern being his two daughters.
He knew all too well the character of the Great Elder...
That narrow heart, that poisonous nature.
If punishment was not accepted, his daughters could never have safely left the Ghost Clan back then.
And if he did not obediently guard the Forbidden Land, that Great Elder would surely have sent someone to hunt his daughters down.
Thus, all these years, the thought of leaving the Forbidden Land had never crossed his mind.
Yet—he could never have imagined...
Even after all he had done.
That Ghost Clan Great Elder still refused to spare his daughters.
When he heard Qing Shuang calmly recount...
Back then, she and Fei Yue had come within a hair’s breadth of dying at the hands of their pursuers.
A wave of rage instantly devoured his reason!
To hell with the Forbidden Land!
To hell with their "punishment"!
His only thought was to claim justice for his two daughters!
As a Half-Step Totem-level powerhouse, he had never been so furious.
His wild aura swept hundreds of miles, startling the surrounding Demon Race, who scrambled to flee far from the Ghost Clan’s Residence.
Beside him, Cai and Shan sensed Qing’s repressed, overwhelming emotion, a chill gleaming in their own eyes.
"Boss, everything’s ready! We can strike back at the Clan at any time, claim justice for the young mistresses!"
"Every brother in the Residence is holding in a breath! We’re all waiting to follow you back!"
Qing’s gaze slowly swept over Cai and Shan, then landed on the throngs of Ghost Race before him.
All these were kin sent into exile by the Great Elder under false, trumped-up charges.
He drew a deep breath, his voice thundering across the field:
"All those years ago, for my daughters, I willingly guarded the Forbidden Land and kept out the Demon Race!"
"But now..."
"My only two remaining kin were nearly murdered by those Elders!"
"If I keep swallowing that humiliation, I’m not fit to be a father!"
An overwhelming aura erupted once more, sweeping in all directions.
"Any who wish to follow me, depart at once! Any who wish not to, can remain here."
But not a single Ghost stepped back.
As for those traditional, ossified old fools—
Everyone had endured for far too long!
All they lacked was a leader!
"Swear to follow unto death!"
"Back with Boss, to reclaim our home!"
...
Each bellow of rage was accompanied by soaring Ghost Qi.
In an instant, the ghostly energies wove together, coalescing above the heavens to form the colossal, sun-blocking illusion of a Ghost King.
Qing gazed up at the celestial phenomenon, his palm clenched till white.
The humiliation his daughters suffered, he would repay tenfold.
If it had not been chance that allowed them to meet that Human—
At the thought, Qing’s breath caught in his throat.
"Strike back!"
He unleashed his Domain, Ghost Qi surging skyward.
Countless figures turned into streaming lights, tearing through the sky.
...
Beyond the Forbidden Land.
The Ghost Clan Central Square.
The Ghost Clan Great Elder’s face was dark with thunderclouds.
He stared hard at the suddenly appearing Gu Xing, malice brimming in his eyes.
This human had actually arrived at the last critical moment!
Damn it!
His clenched fist made a grinding sound.
If Gu Xing appeared alive here, it could only mean...
The three Monarch-level Ghosts he sent were likely dead in the Forbidden Land.
His fingernails dug deep into his palm.
There were only two possibilities for the mission’s failure:
Either those three unlucky ghosts blundered straight into a Monarch-level Demon, or...
His venomous gaze suddenly swung to Lilith.
It had to be that damn Blood Race interfering in secret!
Otherwise, with the strength of three Monarch-levels, how could this human still be alive?
As for Gu Xing personally slaying all three Monarch-levels?
He dismissed that absurd notion at once!
A Commander Tier Four versus Monarch Tier Three?
Absolutely impossible!!
On the other side, Lilith looked at Gu Xing, who’d arrived just in time, and finally allowed her taut nerves to relax.
If he’d been even a moment later, she’d have had to activate the backup plan and forcibly postpone the tournament.
But now...
Her gaze swept past the ashen-faced Great Elder, feeling entirely delighted.
And beside Lilith stood Tushan Yueli...
Her six fox tails went rigid in shock, as she clapped her mouth in disbelief, turning to Lilith.
"This human actually—just as the Blood Ancestor said..."
"Actually made it to the tournament on time!"
At this moment, her eyes toward Gu Xing held newfound respect.
To escape both the Forbidden Land and the Ghost Clan’s pursuit unscathed—at minimum proved this human wielded Monarch-level power.
A Commander Tier Four Beast Master, reaching such a realm?
He had already surpassed the vast majority of top-tier geniuses in any race!
A flicker of marvel passed through her eyes.
If this one could grow unhindered...
Totem-level was virtually guaranteed.
And if the Human Race produced a Totem-level Beast Master...
Her long fingers unconsciously stroked her sleeve.
Any alliance plan with the Ghost Race would have to be reconsidered.
"I must inform Mother as soon as possible."
She murmured under her breath, but her gaze never left Gu Xing.
After all, a human who could cultivate Totem-level Guardians possessed value far beyond expectations.
Not to mention the Humans’ collective strength...
At the heart of the square.
Gu Xing strode forward to stand before the Great Elder of the Ghost Clan.
The Great Elder’s face flickered between emotions, but Gu Xing ignored him entirely, stepping up face-to-face and going straight for the kill:
"Great Elder, isn’t it time to announce the start of the tournament?"
Seeing his opponent slow to answer, Gu Xing twisted the blade:
"You’re not about to go back on your word, are you? I did exactly as promised, within the day."
The Great Elder’s mouth spasmed, forcing out a smile uglier than a cry:
"Of...of course I will not go back on my word."
"You may take part in this tournament."
As those words fell, the crowd erupted.
"What?! You’re actually letting these two Unicorn Ghosts take part in the sacred tournament?"
"Trash like that isn’t worthy! They disgrace the Ghost Clan!"
"Great Elder, throw them out!"
The jeers came in waves.
Hearing them, Qing Shuang’s gaze swept coldly across the audience, a spark of killing intent in her eyes.
In an instant, all noise fell dead.
"W-what’s going on? It feels like a Fierce Beast has locked onto us..."
"That aura—it’s just like the Ghost Clan prodigy Qing Ru from back in the day..."
"Terrifying..."
Qing Shuang’s eyes flashed with scorn.
After all these years, the Ghost Clan was still all bully, no backbone.
Back then, when the Demon Race invaded, they pinned all the blame on her and her sister.
"What a pack of cowards!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 190: Qing Shuang vs. Cang
chapters.content:
Chapter 190: Chapter 190: Qing Shuang vs. Cang
Despite the Ghost Race crowd voicing their opposition one after another, the Great Elder had no choice but to grit his teeth and fulfill his promise.
As the open leader of the Ghost Race, if he were to break his word in public, his authority would be utterly destroyed.
"Silence!"
A thunderous shout shook the entire venue.
"The Grand Tournament begins now! Qingshuang and Feiyue will officially participate!"
Having made the announcement, he immediately left with several elders, his face grim.
The urgent priority now was to strategize how to eliminate that pair of Unicorn Ghost Sisters during the competition.
According to the Ghost Race traditions, the winner of the Grand Tournament earns the right to bind with the Divine Pattern.
This rule was not his to change!
If a member of his own clan won the championship, with his power he could still intimidate or cajole them into willingly giving up the right.
But what if...
The thought of those sisters possibly winning and successfully binding with the Divine Pattern twisted the Great Elder’s face horribly.
"That absolutely must not happen..."
His clenched fists bulged with veins. He had poured countless efforts into forcing the Divine Pattern binding, and now had reached the final critical moment.
If someone snatched it away at this juncture...
Absolutely unacceptable!
"Call Cang here, immediately!"
Soon after, Cang pushed the door open and entered, his whole demeanor lost and distracted.
Ever since the Divine Secret Realm incident, his confidence had been annihilated.
That "trash Unicorn Ghost," cast out by the clan, had actually crushed him with overwhelming power.
This had already cast a shadow in his heart!
Yet this disgraceful matter was too humiliating; upon his return, he and the other Ghost Race members agreed on a unified story:
They were defeated by a powerful Blood Race.
Seeing his son’s slumped appearance, the Great Elder’s eyes flared even hotter with anger:
"Cang! Look at yourself! Do you have a shred of dignity left as a Ghost Race member?"
Under his father’s harsh shout, Cang finally managed to pull himself together somewhat:
"F...Father, you called for me?"
"Hmph!"
The Great Elder snorted coldly, then grew serious:
"Let me ask you—last time in the Divine Secret Realm, did you hear anything about Unicorn Ghost members? How strong are they?"
At the mention of "Unicorn Ghost Race," Cang’s body trembled violently.
He had been shut in with his Secret Realm companions all this time, so he had no idea humans had come to the Ghost Clan’s Residence.
He looked up at his father, voice shaking:
"F...Father, there was no mention of any Unicorn Ghost Race in the Divine Secret Realm."
"And the kind of Unicorn Ghost Race you’re talking about—aren’t they all born with an innate defect?"
He forced himself to straighten his back: "If I ever encountered one, I’d definitely be able to deal with them easily!"
Hearing this, the Great Elder finally gave him a meaningful look.
These words did have some merit...
An innate defect could not be remedied.
Among the Ghost Race, those specializing in the Path of Strength usually lacked skill in Void Power, and vice versa.
Ghosts like this usually ended up at the bottom.
Only those who cultivated both powers could reach the peak.
Since that pair of Unicorn Ghost Sisters had an innate defect, even if they were strong, there must be a limit.
"Cang, I’m giving you a chance."
The Great Elder’s tone grew heavy:
"Go enter this Ghost Race Grand Tournament. Though you’re only Commander Tier Three, I believe you’ll achieve good results."
Cang was stunned at first, then joy surged inside him.
For every past tournament, every time he asked to compete, his father had rejected him outright.
The champions of past years were always Commander Peak at least; with his measly Commander Tier Three, he couldn’t hope to make a splash.
Thus, his father had always forbidden him from entering, so as not to be shamed.
But now...
Father was actually taking the initiative to let him compete!
Though his cultivation wasn’t top tier in the Ghost Race, his talent was definitely in the top five.
If he performed well, he might well shine in front of everyone’s eyes.
"Yes, Father!"
Cang suppressed his excitement, his voice tremulous, "I’ll go prepare right away!"
With that, he turned and hurried away.
The Great Elder watched his son’s departing back and stroked his chin thoughtfully.
Letting Cang compete was just a test...
If those Unicorn Ghosts were mediocre, he’d need no further schemes.
But if they truly had extraordinary abilities...
A cold glint flashed in his eyes.
No accidents would be allowed to ruin the plan he’d toiled for all these years.
...
Meanwhile.
Central Square.
The Grand Tournament had begun.
Since it wasn’t yet the Extraordinary Level’s turn, Gu Xing took Qingshuang and Feiyue to Lilith’s viewing seats.
But seeing there were no seats next to Lilith, Gu Xing frowned.
He shot Lilith a glance:
Fix it!
Lilith shrugged helplessly and, with a wave of her slender hand, sent a blood-red beam that blasted the Monarch-level Ghost Race beside her clean off his seat.
Though both were Monarch-level, Lilith’s strength clearly far surpassed these Monarch-level Ghosts.
Gu Xing laid claim to the empty seat without ceremony, swaggering down next to Lilith.
"You!"
The Ghost who’d been blasted away fumed with rage, but under Lilith’s bloody gaze, he froze at once.
He had a premonition...
If he dared say a word...
That Blood Race would kill him for sure.
He stood there struggling for a long time, finally slinking off with his tail tucked.
Meanwhile, Princess Fox—Tushan Yueli—watched the whole scene in shock.
This human...
He really didn’t give Ghost Race any face.
Wasn’t he afraid the Ghost Race would attack him?
As she pondered in surprise, she realized Gu Xing’s gaze had already locked tightly onto her.
Before she could react, a large hand suddenly reached out.
"Hello, Qingqiu Princess!"
At the same moment,
As if annoyed by Lilith blocking the way...
He actually scooped her up like a child and placed her on his lap, then shifted into Lilith’s original seat.
Gu Xing’s attention was completely on the Qingqiu Princess, not the least aware of what he’d just done.
Yet Lilith, sitting on his lap like a kid, froze in absolute shock.
She, the dignified Blood Ancestor...
Had just been picked up like a doll and placed on someone’s lap?!
This human...
Lilith had just about raised a fuss, but was suddenly hugged around the waist by Gu Xing’s unconscious, habitual movement.
Clearly, it was the usual gesture he did with Vera.
But for Lilith, being caught off guard and enveloped in human warmth...
Made her forget about getting angry, her mind blanking out completely.
Tushan Yueli took in the entire scene, a hint of intrigue flashing in her eyes.
Though she hadn’t recognized Lilith’s true identity, that pure blood race aura and noble lineage were unmistakable.
Such a powerful Blood Race...
Was actually this gentle in a human’s arms?
She looked toward Gu Xing with a renewed sense of respect.
"Tushan Yueli, it’s a pleasure to meet you."
"Lilith mentioned you to me. The Qingqiu Race is indeed interested in a partnership with humans."
Lilith had mentioned the alliance with humans many times before, so Tushan Yueli readily realized this was on Gu Xing’s cue.
Thus, she chose to get straight to the point.
But before Gu Xing could respond, Tushan Yueli’s six fox tails gently swayed and she changed the topic:
"But before negotiations, let me see the strength of your Guardian Beasts."
If she was going to bet on this human,
She had to first evaluate the power of his Guardian Beasts.
"Of course," Gu Xing agreed readily.
Just then, a loud announcement rang out in the arena:
"Extraordinary Level match over! Now, the Commander Level first round begins—"
"Qingshuang vs Cang!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 191: Unlucky Cang!
chapters.content:
Chapter 191: Chapter 191: Unlucky Cang!
When the matchup list was announced, Qing Shuang turned to look at Gu Xing.
After receiving a nod from Gu Xing, Qing Shuang disappeared like a phantom and appeared on the arena.
Watching Qing Shuang on the stage, Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction.
He was completely confident in Qing Shuang’s abilities.
But as for Fei Yue.....
Only the first place in the tournament could have the opportunity to come into contact with the Divine Pattern.
However, with Fei Yue’s current attributes, achieving first place was simply impossible.
Gu Xing turned slightly and noticed Fei Yue’s face was somewhat pale.
It was clear that she also understood, with her current abilities, it was impossible to win first place.
Seeing this, Gu Xing reached out and patted her shoulder.
"Fei Yue, don’t be nervous, you can choose not to go on stage."
With Qing Shuang’s abilities, winning first place should be no problem.
Then, she could directly transfer the opportunity to bond with the Divine Pattern to Fei Yue.
But...
When Gu Xing laid out this plan, Fei Yue shook her head.
"Master, this won’t work! The Great Elder will never allow it."
Previously, Fei Yue had informed Qing of Gu Xing’s plan.
At that time, Qing’s response was:
Impossible!
Gu Xing wasn’t present back then, so he didn’t hear it.
Qing told them that the Ghost Race Great Elder was certainly bonding with the Divine Pattern.
At this critical moment, even if Qing Shuang won, the Great Elder would find various reasons to stop her from approaching the Divine Pattern.
Not to mention allowing Qing Shuang to transfer the qualification to contact the Divine Pattern to Fei Yue.
This is why Fei Yue’s face was pale, and her eyes filled with worry.
She knew well that with her current abilities, she couldn’t contend with the Commander Level of the Ghost Race.
But the most crucial part of Gu Xing’s plan was for her to obtain the bond with the Ghost Race Divine Pattern.
If they finally got a chance to participate in the tournament and failed due to insufficient abilities...
She couldn’t accept such an outcome no matter what.
After hearing Fei Yue’s response, Gu Xing frowned slightly but soon relaxed.
"Since Qing has decided to leave the Forbidden Land, conflict with the Ghost Race is inevitable."
"If things don’t work out, we might as well seize the Divine Pattern by force!"
After comforting Fei Yue, telling her not to worry too much, Gu Xing refocused his gaze on the arena.
At this moment, Qing Shuang stood on the arena, yet her opponent...
Is Cang, but there was still no sign of him.
The surrounding Ghost Race crowd began to murmur:
"Why hasn’t Lord Cang come yet? Hurry up and eliminate this Unicorn Ghost Race!"
"What do you know? Lord Cang hasn’t appeared because he thinks it’s not worth facing her seriously!"
"True! With Lord Cang’s skills, eliminating this Unicorn Ghost Race is a snap!"
But Qing Shuang completely ignored these remarks.
She just felt that the name "Cang" seemed somewhat familiar, but she couldn’t recall where she’d heard it before.
As time ticked by, Cang’s figure still didn’t appear.
Just as the crowd was about to lose patience, a space crack abruptly opened in the center of the arena.
The very next second, Cang stepped out of the crack.
The scene instantly ignited the atmosphere on site.
"Lord Cang! Get rid of this trash!"
"Lord Cang! End it quickly and drive them out of the Ghost Race!"
At this moment.
Cang, stepping out of the space crack, kept his eyes shut, savoring being the center of attention.
He purposefully arrived late to attract more attention...
As the Great Elder’s son, he had never appeared in public settings before.
But today...
It was his first time making such a high-profile entrance.
He took a deep breath.
Being the focus of the entire arena was indeed intoxicating.
When he slowly opened his eyes, he had already rehearsed numerous dazzling poses in his mind to instantly defeat his opponent.
After all, most first-round opponents are Low Tier Commanders, with his Commander Tier Three, Half-step Myth Talent...
Facing Low Tier Commanders of the Ghost Race would surely result in an instant win!
However...
When he truly saw the figure standing opposite him, he was struck dumb like being hit by lightning.
That familiar unicorn...
That familiar figure...
