His nightmare!
"You, you...what are you doing here?!"
Cang’s voice uncontrollably trembled.
Qing Shuang had long left a deep shadow in his heart, and upon meeting again, fear washed over him like a tide, rendering his limbs weak.
While Qing Shuang only furrowed her brows slightly.
What’s wrong with this Ghost Race?
Why does he look like he’s seen a ghost?
Although they had exchanged blows in the Divine Secret Realm before...
With Cang’s skills, he left no impression on Qing Shuang whatsoever.
Right at this moment, a voice draws near.
"Begin the match!"
The Ghost Qi around Qing Shuang suddenly condensed.
But...
Cang hurriedly waved his hands, cold sweat forming on his forehead.
"W- Wait!"
He was too aware of the terrifying skills of this Unicorn Ghost Race.
Back then, while both were at Extraordinary Peak, she could easily crush him.
Now, she was Commander Tier Four, while he was only Commander Tier Three, and the gap could only grow bigger.
But this was his first time engaging in an act, if he surrendered instantly...
Cang clenched his teeth:
"W-We can negotiate!"
"I... I am the Great Elder’s son, if you surrender, I can plead to my father to let you return to the Ghost Race!"
He threw all his bargaining chips he could offer.
Due to fear, his voice was somewhat intermittent.
The Ghost Race observers seeing this scene immediately caused a stir:
"What’s going on? Lord Cang seems to be afraid?"
"Must be our illusion, right? How could the Great Elder’s son fear a cast-out inferior being?"
At this point, Qing Shuang looked at Cang, her gaze gradually turning cold.
The Great Elder’s son?
Initially, she just planned to eliminate the opponent simply.
But now...
Knowing that was the Great Elder’s son, she couldn’t hold back at all.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
A rush of Ghost Qi instantly enveloped Qing Shuang, her attributes soaring frantically.
Qing Shuang’s attributes, combined with the Ghost King’s Body, already stood invincible among the same tier.
When Cang saw the Ghost Qi rising around Qing Shuang, his face turned deathly pale instantly.
He dared not hesitate, immediately activating the Ghost Qi within, also launching the Ghost King’s Body.
However, the same skill in the hands of different people displayed a world of difference in power.
Qing Shuang’s Ghost King’s Body could amplify attributes by 1.5 times, while Cang could barely reach 1.2 times.
What’s more lethal was the huge difference in their Basic Attributes, now infinitely magnified.
In face of this overwhelming power disparity, Cang didn’t even get the chance to launch his Domain.
"Boom!"
Qing Shuang’s figure appeared before Cang like a specter.
With just one hit, Cang flew backward like a kite with a broken string, crashing heavily into the wall, sending up a cloud of dust and debris.
Life or death uncertain!
The entire arena fell into sudden silence, all Ghost Race stared with wide eyes, finding it hard to believe this scene.
Lord Cang...defeated?
Just like that...with one move?
How could this be?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 192: Liu Li Replaces Fei Yue?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 192: Chapter 192: Liu Li Replaces Fei Yue?!
At the same time.
The shocking news of Cang’s defeat reached the Great Elder’s ears like a thunderbolt.
"What?! Defeated in one move?"
The Great Elder’s pupils shrank dramatically, his face full of disbelief.
As Cang’s father, he knew better than anyone his son’s strength.
Although only at Commander Tier Three, he’d definitely rank among the top thirty of the younger generation.
Even for those at the peak of Commander level, defeating Cang in a single move would be no easy feat.
Yet, Qing Shuang accomplished it!
What does this signify?
A Commander Tier Four Ghost Race possessing combat power comparable to the peak of Commander level!
The Great Elder’s heart sank heavily, and an ominous premonition arose.
If Qing Shuang seizes first place, the possibility of the Divine Pattern recognizing him...
No way!
Absolutely cannot let this Unicorn Ghost Race contact the Divine Pattern!
The Great Elder was now as if sitting on pins and needles, unable to care about anything else and immediately set out for the arena.
The competition originally hosted by experts now had to be controlled personally by him.
However, on the way there, his brain was racing, yet continuously failing to find a perfect solution.
The competition was held under the watchful eyes of the public; trying to tamper with it was extremely difficult.
Dammit!
Would the Divine Pattern have to be handed over to that Unicorn Ghost Race?
The Great Elder forced himself to suppress his inner anxiety and arrived at the scene just in time for Fei Yue’s turn.
Fei Yue faced a Ghost Race who was merely a Commander Tier One.
But even at Commander Tier One, it was still a difficult opponent for Fei Yue to defeat.
However, relying on her control over Void abilities, the Commander Tier One Ghost Race couldn’t touch her at all.
"Bang!"
Fei Yue tried to land a counterattack strike but couldn’t leave even a trace.
Thousands of Attribute Values seemed pale and weak against the strong flesh defense of the Commander level Ghost Race.
"Are you just going to keep dodging like a rat?"
The Commander Tier One Ghost Race, unable to make headway, finally couldn’t hold back and shouted angrily.
He hadn’t failed to attempt using his Void Ability, but Fei Yue’s accomplishments in the Void far surpassed his imagination.
No matter how hard he tried...
He couldn’t capture a single trace of her Void presence.
This feeling of being powerless made him resort to verbal provocation.
However, Fei Yue wouldn’t be fooled.
She knew very well that facing this Commander level Ghost Race in direct combat was no match, and thus could only rely on Void Power to maneuver between reality and nothingness, to stall time.
The Ghost Race spectators in the stands, seeing this scene, all cursed angrily:
"Truly disgraceful for the Ghost Race, just hiding like a coward!"
"Exactly! No wonder she was expelled from the clan!"
"Just surrender already, don’t waste everyone’s time!"
The rising mockery made Qing Shuang’s brows furrow.
If those words were directed at her, she wouldn’t have any reaction.
But aimed at Fei Yue...
A cold light flashed in her eyes.
Gu Xing also furrowed his brow.
He understood that for Fei Yue, retreat was indeed the only option.
Even if he enhanced Fei Yue with Soul-devouring Talent, doubling her attributes...
Fei Yue still lacked offensive Skills to deal substantive damage to the Commander level Ghost Race.
Luckily, the Ghost Race tournament rules stipulated that only when one party falls off the arena is the match considered over.
Therefore, although Fei Yue couldn’t win, at least she wouldn’t lose.
Just as Gu Xing thought this match would reach a stalemate, the silhouette of the Great Elder suddenly appeared before him.
"Human, this stalemate isn’t a solution."
"Your Guardian Beast keeps avoiding the battle; when will it end?"
Gu Xing’s gaze turned to the Great Elder who appeared in front of him suddenly.
He was very curious about what the Great Elder had in mind by suggesting this now.
Seeing Gu Xing’s expression, the Great Elder continued:
"How about this, you replace this Ghost Race with another Guardian Beast in the arena?"
After witnessing Fei Yue’s performance, a brilliant idea suddenly struck him.
This Ghost Race lacks any notable Talent, even winning first in the tournament, has almost no chance of being recognized by the Divine Pattern.
In comparison, having Fei Yue remain in the field would be far safer than facing the threat of Qing Shuang.
But to get this human to agree to these terms, he must make concessions.
"Oh?"
Gu Xing raised a brow, his eyes flashing with surprise.
Replace Fei Yue with a Guardian Beast?
Would the Great Elder be so kind-hearted?
He eyed the Great Elder sharply.
The Great Elder certainly had terms left unsaid.
Indeed...
"Of course, if you replace the Ghost Race on the field with another Guardian Beast, Qing Shuang must withdraw from this tournament!"
Hearing the additional condition, Gu Xing couldn’t help but let out a cold laugh.
Just as he had expected.
The Great Elder wanted to cancel Qing Shuang’s participation directly.
He must have noticed Qing Shuang’s strength and realized it was hard to find opponents in this competition.
Thus, proposing such a condition.
But the Great Elder would never imagine...
His strongest Guardian Beast was never Qing Shuang.
Since this Ghost Race Great Elder made such a request, he would meet it.
"All right, I agree!"
Gu Xing’s straightforward response left the Great Elder momentarily stunned, a tinge of uneasiness surged up.
This human... why agree so readily?
He had prepared threats and inducements but didn’t expect the other party to give in without negotiation.
But upon reconsideration, isn’t this aligning perfectly with his intent?
After all, Ghost Race is born as combative. Qing Shuang must be this human’s strongest Guardian Beast.
As long as Qing Shuang could be withdrawn...
"The Void Power and Path of Strength of Ghost Race are the most tricky existences for other races."
The Great Elder mused to himself, "Dealing with Alien Race is much simpler than dealing with Qing Shuang, a fellow clansman."
Thinking of these things, he forced down his uneasiness.
This human’s other Guardian Beasts could never be opponents for the young Ghost Race members.
But to ensure absolute safety, he decided to insert a Monarch Level combatant among the competitors.
"Match paused! This round is void, a rematch will occur shortly!"
The Great Elder loudly announced the news of Fei Yue’s withdrawal and Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast replacement.
This decision immediately led to cheers from all the Ghost Race:
"This should’ve been done ages ago! That Ghost Race just knows how to hide!"
"Let that human’s other Guardian Beasts feel the strength of our Ghost Race!"
"Hurry up and get out, coward!"
In the midst of Ghost Race’s taunts, Fei Yue returned somewhat crestfallen to Gu Xing’s side.
Though she had given her all... the Attribute gap was evident.
Gu Xing reached out, gently stroking Fei Yue’s hair, comforting her softly:
"It’s not your fault, combat never was your strength."
"Leave the next battle to Liu Li."
Hearing this, Fei Yue nodded.
Next, a summoning Array appeared in front of Gu Xing.
The next moment...
A blinding light pierced the sky!
Ten-winged Angel Liu Li suddenly descended into the arena.
The immense momentum, as the holy wings unfolded, swept across like a tsunami.
The terrifying pressure halted all mockery, the entire arena fell into a deathly silence.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 193: Last Champion, Ghost Guang!
chapters.content:
Chapter 193: Chapter 193: Last Champion, Ghost Guang!
At the instant he felt this surge of aura, the Great Elder of the Ghost Race’s expression changed drastically.
This aura...
Why does it feel even stronger than Qing Shuang?!
Staring at Liu Li, who dominated the arena with her presence, a sense of foreboding suddenly welled up in the Great Elder’s heart.
But he quickly suppressed that ominous feeling.
This angel’s strength cannot possibly surpass Qing Shuang!
The Angel Race values bloodline even more than the Ghost Race does.
If this angel’s talent was truly exceptional, how could the Angel Race allow her to forge a contract with a mere human?
Moreover...
He’d already hidden a Monarch Tier Five ghost among the contestants.
Even if this angel’s strength was impressive, there was no way she could stand up to that Monarch Tier Five ghost!
Only, this Monarch Tier Five ghost...
He did not want to reveal it unless absolutely necessary!
After all, if that Monarch Tier Five ghost’s strength was exposed...
The just and impartial Great Elder image he had built up over years would be destroyed in an instant.
His gaze slowly shifted to Liu Li on the arena.
Right now, the most crucial thing was to test the depths of this angel’s strength!
"Next match: Liu Li versus Ghost Guang!"
Now, as the overseer of this tournament, he could freely assign matchups among the contestants.
Thus, he directly arranged for Liu Li to face a Ghost Race commander at the peak.
Last tournament’s champion: Ghost Guang!
If Ghost Guang could deal with this angel...
That would be the best possible outcome!
And the news caused an instant uproar:
"What’s going on? Wasn’t Ghost Guang supposed to be the final act? Why is he entering now?!"
"This angel’s luck is terrible, she’s matched against Ghost Guang right away!"
"Still, everything happens for a reason! What business does an alien race have entering our Ghost Race tournament anyway?! Best to eliminate her now!"
Amid the noisy debate, a towering figure strode onto the arena with earth-shaking steps.
With each step Ghost Guang took, the stage trembled; when he came to a complete stop, the whole field seemed to sink several inches.
In the stands, Gu Xing narrowed his eyes.
Compared to Ghost Guang’s massive, three-meter-tall frame, Liu Li appeared especially delicate.
He discreetly began checking the detailed information of this ghost...
[Ghost Guang]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Power: 60,000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 55,000]
[Spirit: 20,000]
[Speed: 50,000]
[Skills: Ghost King’s Body, Ghost Race Four Techniques, Frenzy, Ghost King Domain]
Seeing this ghost’s stats, Gu Xing frowned slightly.
Strength Attribute had reached the upper limits of the Commander level.
Constitution and Speed Attributes hit the 50,000 mark!
Except for Spiritual Attribute...
This ghost was absolutely a top-tier Commander!
Gu Xing then looked at the skill panel.
[Ghost King’s Body: Increases all attributes by 1.4 times]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (increase Power Attribute by 1.3 times), Sea Breaker (increase Power Attribute by 1.7 times), Heaven-Breaking (increase Power Attribute by 2.4 times), Star Shattering (unusable)]
This ghost, like Qing Shuang, was already able to use the third technique of the Ghost Race Four Techniques.
Though the skill multipliers weren’t as high as Qing Shuang’s, if Qing Shuang faced this ghost...
Without the Soul Devouring Talent’s boost, Qing Shuang’s chances of winning would be slim!
Their basic attributes were simply too far apart!
Besides the Ghost Race’s unique Ghost King’s Body and Ghost Race Four Techniques, this ghost also possessed a special skill.
[Frenzy: Lose reason, pain disappears, becomes a ruthless combat machine]
Reading this skill’s introduction,
Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch his lips.
Really lives up to the name Ghost Guang!
Still, though this ghost was formidable...
Compared with Liu Li, there was still a huge gap!
Up on the arena.
Ghost Guang looked down at the petite Liu Li, grinning with a mouthful of bloody fangs:
"Hope you survive what’s coming! With your little body... don’t tell me you can’t even take one punch from me."
"I don’t know how you angered the Great Elder, but since you’re facing me now... prepare for death!"
Ghost Guang was definitely not a nice guy.
In the last tournament, he crippled several Ghost Race prodigies directly on stage.
And this time...
The Great Elder’s order was—
Go all out, consequences be damned!
Ghost Guang’s bloodshot eyes locked onto Liu Li, his breathing heavy and wild.
Her snowy wings shimmered with holy radiance in the sunlight, her flawless features like Heaven’s most exquisite creation.
It was this kind of beauty—destroying it was the most thrilling!
"Ghost King’s Body!"
Raging Ghost Qi surged around him instantly; his already burly frame swelled even further, muscles bulging like boulders, attribute values soaring wildly.
Those crimson eyes now held nothing but blood-lust and killing intent.
[Power: 60,000→84,000]
[Constitution: 55,000→77,000]
[Spirit: 20,000→28,000]
[Speed: 50,000→70,000]
But as she felt the ghost’s attribute rise, Liu Li was utterly indifferent.
On the contrary, she looked on with a hint of disdain.
This ghost used Ghost King’s Body differently from Qing Shuang.
When Qing Shuang used Ghost King’s Body, ghost patterns appeared, giving him a mysterious allure.
But this ghost...
Was just plain ugly!
At that moment, Ghost Guang suddenly attacked.
"Heaven-Breaking!"
He led with his killing move, no holding back.
[Power: 84,000→201,600]
Boosted by the Heaven-Breaking skill, his Power Attribute shot to 200,000!
Moreover, he could wield Void Power.
Almost instantly, his form slipped into the void.
Waiting for his one-hit kill!
But Liu Li grew serious too.
This ghost might not look impressive, but his strength was indeed solid.
"Destruction Angel·Qi!"
As these words fell, pure blood-red radiance surged from Liu Li.
Twelve wings unfolded in an instant.
Her aura soared ever higher, breaking through a certain critical threshold...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form]
[Power: 30,000→120,000]
[Constitution: 30,000→120,000]
[Spirit: 30,000→120,000]
[Speed: 30,000→120,000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification 400%), Destruction Domain, Destruction Law (can wield a shred of Power of Laws)]
Under Destruction Angel Form, all Liu Li’s attributes shot straight to 120,000.
Most important of all...
"Destruction Domain!"
With Liu Li’s cold chant, the entire arena space twisted abruptly.
Ghost Guang was forcibly ejected from the void, stumbling—his face full of shock.
The instant this angel used her domain, his Void Power was instantly sealed.
Now, his link with the void was completely cut off.
"This... impossible!"
Severing the Ghost Race’s connection with the void?
Just what kind of domain did this angel possess?
What truly filled him with despair: when he attempted to unleash his own Ghost King Domain in defense, he realized...
His Ghost King Domain was completely suppressed by the angel’s!
Meanwhile, outside the arena, the Great Elder’s pupils contracted sharply as he noticed Liu Li’s domain.
This power of destruction...
Even with his near-Totem Level strength, he couldn’t help but feel a tremor of dread.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 194: Ghost Guang Is Crippled!
chapters.content:
Chapter 194: Chapter 194: Ghost Guang Is Crippled!
Other than the Great Elder, there was another person present who felt this power particularly deeply.
Tushan Yueli.
As a member of the Qingqiu Fox Race with Spiritual Power reaching the peak, she was exceptionally sensitive to Energy Fluctuations.
At this moment, her snow-white fox ears were trembling slightly, and her six tails unconsciously tightened.
The destructive aura contained within that Domain caused her entire fur to stand on end.
What shocked her even more was...
This Angel clearly only had a Commander Tier Four Level, yet the pressure it emitted had already surpassed the Monarch Level!
Tushan Yueli instinctively turned to look at Lilith, only to find her similarly showing a shocked expression.
During this period, Lilith had been following Gu Xing, so she was very familiar with Liu Li’s aura.
But at this moment, the Energy Fluctuation surging within that Blood Domain made her blood freeze all over.
This had already far exceeded the strength she remembered!
"How could it be..."
A trace of astonishment flashed through Lilith’s ruby-like eyes.
The Angel’s power had undergone such a quality leap in such a short time?!
On the arena.
The crimson Destruction Domain completely enveloped the entire space.
Inside the Domain, the Fire of Destruction surged like a tide, dyeing every inch of space blood-red.
Initially, Ghost Guang was secretly mocking...
The flames landed on his body, yet there was not even the slightest burning sensation.
But soon, his expression froze.
Those seemingly harmless flames were silently devouring his body!
He could clearly feel his blood, flesh, bones, and even the core Ghost Qi within slowly dissolving.
"What the hell is this?!"
Fear finally appeared in Ghost Guang’s eyes.
The Angel’s Domain was too bizarre—
Clearly at Commander Tier Four, yet it could completely suppress his peak Domain.
Even more terrifying was that within this Domain, the Void Power most relied upon by the Ghost Race had completely failed!
Moreover, as time passed, he felt his strength gradually diminishing.
It couldn’t be dragged on any longer!
"Hmph, even if I can’t use Void Power..."
Ghost Guang gritted his teeth and grinned viciously, his muscles swelling again:
"Just relying on my peak Commander Attributes, I can still crush you!"
The next moment.
Ghost Guang’s figure turned into a black lightning bolt within the Domain, rushing straight towards Liu Li.
However...
"Too slow."
Liu Li slightly sidestepped, and with a Speed Attribute of 120,000 points, she easily avoided the deadly strike like a phantom.
Ghost Guang’s proud Power appeared so clumsy and ridiculous in face of the absolute speed disparity.
As long as this Ghost Race member couldn’t utilize Void Ability, it was almost impossible for him to get close to Liu Li.
And within the Destruction Domain, as time dragged on.
The collapse of the body would become more severe!
This Ghost Race member’s Level was only peak Commander...
In just a few minutes, his bronze skin was already filled with web-like cracks, like a terracotta soldier about to shatter.
"Roar—!"
Realizing death was near, Ghost Guang let out a beast-like roar.
Scarlet blood mist seeped from his pores, his eyes completely enveloped by blood-red.
He had resorted to his trump card.
Frenzy!!
The price of losing rationality was exchanged for more violent power and numbness to pain.
He was like a runaway war machine, surrounded by blood-red mist, his momentum surging again.
Seeing this scene, the stands erupted:
"Ghost Guang has been pushed to such a degree?!"
"He’s risking it all now! Isn’t this Angel’s strength at Commander Tier Four?"
But facing the frenzied Ghost Guang, Liu Li’s gaze remained calm as water.
She lightly sidestepped, once again avoiding the other’s violent attack.
"It’s over."
Without rationality, Ghost Guang completely ignored her attacks.
And within the Destruction Domain...
Liu Li possessed the ultimate attack!
"Spear of Destruction!"
With her cold voice ringing out, a spear entirely condensed from the Fire of Destruction appeared in her palm.
The blood-red flames dancing on the spear seemed as if they could burn through even space.
"Whoosh—"
Liu Li merely lifted her hand, and the Flaming Spear tore through the Void, instantly piercing Ghost Guang’s chest, nailing him firmly to the arena ground.
In this strike, she showed no mercy.
"Roar!!"
Ghost Guang struggled frantically, trying to break free from the Spear of Destruction.
But no matter how he roared, the Flaming Spear remained unmoved.
In the face of absolute strength disparity, any struggle was futile.
If Liu Li hadn’t deliberately avoided vital points, this spear would have been enough to kill him on the spot.
Yet, even so, the Fire of Destruction continued to corrode his body, leading him towards death.
Seeing the Flaming Spear pierce through Ghost Guang, the Great Elder’s pupils contracted to the size of a needlepoint.
"This is impossible!"
Though he had long expected Ghost Guang to lose, he never imagined he would lose so thoroughly.
Just one strike ended the battle?!
And Tushan Yueli unconsciously rubbed her eyes, wondering if she was seeing an illusion.
The power exhibited by that Angel had completely surpassed her understanding of Commander Level.
Her gaze instinctively turned to Gu Xing, and waves of shock surged in her heart.
This human...
A Ghost Race member rivaling the peak Commander, an Angel capable of instantaneously killing a peak Commander, and the still inactive Elf...
Each Guardian Beast is enough to cause a sensation in the outside world.
"Could it be..."
Tushan Yueli’s fox ears twitched gently, and a startling speculation surfaced in her mind:
The Talent of this Beast Master must be terrifying to make these top-tier races willingly follow!
And the enhancement this human provides to these races is so great, then what about the Qingqiu Race?
Once this thought arose, it was impossible to suppress it anymore.
We must invite this human to the Qingqiu Race!
Moreover, she had already decided; she must persuade her mother and make an alliance with humans.
Even though humans are not the strongest force now, soon...
When this human reaches Totem Level...
The Human Race will surely stand at the top of the Alternate Space!
Moreover, the Human Race and the Qingqiu Race naturally have compatibility.
The Great Elder stared fixedly at Ghost Guang struggling painfully on the arena, his knuckles turning white.
The figure pierced by the Flaming Spear still twisted futilely, with each struggle causing more cracks to burst from the wound.
"In this match... Liu Li wins!"
He nearly gritted his teeth to announce the result, simultaneously waving to forcibly dispel the Destruction Domain.
After all, Ghost Guang is a standout among the young generation of the Ghost Race; if left in that bizarre Domain, he might truly perish.
However, when he pulled Ghost Guang out, the scene before him made his heart tremble.
This once promising Ghost Race prodigy was full of web-like cracks, with Ghost Qi thin as a dying ember inside.
Simply put...
Ghost Guang was finished!
The Great Elder slowly lifted his head, his sinister gaze locking onto Liu Li like a venomous snake.
This Angel.....
Must be brought down!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 195: Ghost Race of King Tier Five!
chapters.content:
Chapter 195: Chapter 195: Ghost Race of King Tier Five!
Next, the pace of the whole tournament suddenly sped up.
All of Liu Li’s opponents turned out to be Low Tier Commander Level Ghost Race members, obviously arranged by the Great Elder.
But...
A mysterious member of the Ghost Race who was always shrouded in a black robe suddenly rose to prominence.
Just like Liu Li, not a single defeat!
Even when facing Peak Commander Level Ghost Race members, he won easily.
Soon, all the other contestants were eliminated.
The last two spots were Liu Li and this dark horse.
And at this moment, the two were arranged by the Great Elder to face each other.
"Finals Arena, Liu Li VS Ghost Jiu!"
After reading out the matchup, the Great Elder looked at Liu Li as if looking at a dead person.
This Ghost Jiu was exactly the piece he had secretly arranged, strength already at Monarch Tier Five.
He had long since given a death order...
Even if his real strength was exposed, he had to take down this Angel at all costs!
But what he hadn’t expected at all...
A playful glint flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
Ghost Jiu’s information had long been thoroughly understood by Gu Xing.
[Ghost Jiu]
[Status: Power Suppression]
[Level: Monarch Tier Five]
[Talent: Half-Step Myth]
[Power: 140,000]
[Constitution: 130,000]
[Spirit: 60,000]
[Speed: 120,000]
[Skills: Ghost King’s Body, Ghost Race Four Techniques...]
Gu Xing stared at the information on the system panel, a cold smile appeared on his lips.
The Great Elder had gone to great lengths to hide this Monarch Level powerhouse, the reason was obvious...
He was going to kill Liu Li!
Except...
Even though he knew it was a trap, Gu Xing was ready to jump in.
He turned his gaze towards Tushan Yueli, who immediately gave him a friendly nod.
Now, he could already see that Tushan Yueli wanted to form an alliance with the Human Race.
And the reason she was willing to ally with humans...
A huge part of it was because of him!
And the strength he had revealed so far was only his Guardian Beast.
To prove his true value, he intended to display his own talent.
At the same time.....
He was also curious about Liu Li’s current strength—just how powerful had she become?
"Contestants, please come to the stage!"
As soon as the Great Elder finished speaking, Ghost Jiu instantly flashed onto the stage.
The Ghost Race members in the stands immediately started chattering.
"Where did this Ghost Race guy come from? How could he take out so many Peak Commander Ghosts, and why haven’t we heard anything about him before?"
"Who cares, now it’s just this Ghost Jiu and that Angel left—he’s our last hope! We can’t just watch that Angel take first place in our tournament, right? That’d be embarrassing!"
"Exactly! It doesn’t matter who he is, as long as he’s one of us Ghost Race."
"But why hasn’t that Angel gotten on stage yet? What’s she waiting for?"
As everyone murmured, the Ghost Race Great Elder walked up to Gu Xing, confused.
"Human, why aren’t you letting your Guardian Beast take the stage?"
Gu Xing met his gaze, half-smiling:
"Great Elder, Guardian Beast and Beast Master are a single unit—why separate them?"
He glanced meaningfully at the ring:
"Besides...that Ghost Race guy on stage doesn’t seem simple, huh?"
Hearing Gu Xing’s words, the Great Elder’s heart skipped a beat.
Could this human have figured out Ghost Jiu is Monarch Level?
But soon he shook his head and ruled out that guess.
No way!
This human had just asked to enter the ring together with his Guardian Beast.
If he knew that Ghost Jiu on the stage was Monarch Level, why would he walk into certain death?
Thinking this, the Ghost Race Great Elder instantly relaxed.
But since this human wants to die...
He’ll help him out!
"You make sense."
The Great Elder put on an obviously fake smile.
"Beast Masters really ought to fight alongside their Guardian Beasts. So this match, you and your Guardian Beast can both go on stage."
A glimmer of pride flashed in his eyes—but Gu Xing saw right through it all.
Gu Xing shook his head slightly, thinking how naïve the Great Elder was to believe that a mere Monarch Tier Five could take him down?
Then, he turned and nodded to Liu Li beside him.
Liu Li immediately understood.
The next moment, she brought Gu Xing straight onto the arena.
The Ghost Race watching saw Gu Xing go on stage and were stunned, but upon learning it was arranged by the Great Elder, they didn’t say much.
Ghost Jiu’s whole body was still hidden under his black robe, like a lifeless puppet, barely even seeming to breathe.
In the stands, Tushan Yueli, relying on her powerful Spiritual Power, immediately sensed something was wrong.
"Lilith!"
She lowered her voice, "That Ghost Race guy is at least Middle Tier Monarch. How can you let Gu Xing go on stage?"
Lilith just lazily leaned back in her chair, crimson lips curled in a mysterious smile:
"Relax!"
She knew all too well...
In this bunch of Guardian Beasts, the most outrageous one was never the beast itself...
But Gu Xing—the Beast Master!
That talent which could instantly double all Attributes, combined with that totally overpowered Domain Suppression...
Not to mention Liu Li’s current power was enough to threaten even her, a Monarch Tier Five.
With Gu Xing’s buff, that Angel’s combat power was probably already at High Tier Monarch Level!
If that Monarch Level Ghost Race could even scratch Gu Xing, that would be a miracle.
So, Lilith wasn’t worried at all—in fact, she looked playfully at the Great Elder.
The Great Elder didn’t even notice Lilith’s mocking gaze.
He was totally focused on the ring, eyes gleaming with unhealthy excitement.
Soon, this damned human and that Angel would both be sent to Hell!
Plus, he’d already instructed nine other Elders to get ready...
As soon as he gives the order, they’ll move to take out the Blood Race at once.
By that time...
He could finally make the Divine Pattern recognize him as master!
"The finals, begin!"
With his order, the whole coliseum erupted in excitement.
Ghost Jiu’s black robe began to ripple with power, and a suffocating Monarch’s pressure exploded!
"Boom——!"
The wild Monarch’s pressure crashed over the arena like a tsunami, shredding Ghost Jiu’s robe to pieces, revealing a body covered in strange markings.
He didn’t waste a word—immediately activated his strongest state:
"Ghost King’s Body!"
"Star Shattering!"
He hadn’t forgotten the Great Elder’s order, so he went all out.
Under the boost of Ghost King’s Body and Star Shattering, his Strength Attribute instantly broke past 300,000!
This was the terror of Monarch Level Ghost Race!
Even though his skill boosts weren’t as good as Qing Shuang’s, with 140,000 Basic Attributes, he could still reach an insanely scary height.
Seeing all this, the stands went silent—the Ghost Race members’ eyes widened:
"Wh-What...that Ghost Race is Monarch Level?"
"This isn’t right! For the Ghost Race Tournament, the max should be Commander Level—why is there a Monarch Level Ghost Race here?"
"That Angel...is dead!"
Other than Lilith...
No one present thought Liu Li stood a chance against Ghost Jiu, Monarch Tier Five.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 196: Qing Has Left the Secret Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 196: Chapter 196: Qing Has Left the Secret Realm!
However...
Facing Ghost Jiu, who charged in like a Demon God, Gu Xing simply raised his hand unhurriedly:
"Soul-devouring!"
Blood-red Spiritual Power surged like a tide, enveloping Liu Li.
At the same time.
"Destruction Angel·Qi!"
Liu Li’s twelve crimson wings spread out fully, the aura of destruction surging upward.
With the combined boost of Soul-devouring and Liu Li’s Destruction Angel Form, she finally entered her true complete form!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form]
[Power: 30,000→240,000]
[Constitution: 30,000→240,000]
[Spirit: 30,000→240,000]
[Speed: 30,000→240,000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification 400%), Destruction Domain, Destruction Law (can manipulate a thread of the Power of Laws)]
Although Liu Li’s Strength Attribute couldn’t match Ghost Jiu, the other attributes...
surpassed Ghost Jiu by a huge margin!
Moreover...
"Destruction Domain!"
With Liu Li’s cool low chant, the entire arena was instantly shrouded in blood-red.
Under the boost of Destruction Domain, that meager gap in power was wiped away in an instant.
But...
When the Destruction Domain enveloped Ghost Jiu, this Monarch Tier Five powerhouse didn’t collapse completely like Ghost Guang had.
His Ghost King Domain tenaciously resisted within the crimson, though its range was compressed to three meters around him, it never fully shattered.
But it made no difference to the situation.
The boost the Destruction Domain gave Liu Li was extreme attack power.
Liu Li simply made a light gesture with her hand.
A Flame Spear burning with Fire of Destruction condensed out of thin air.
She didn’t even make any extra moves, just waved it carelessly...
"Pssh!"
The Flame Spear pierced Ghost Jiu’s heart like a bolt of blood-red lightning, the whole process even smoother than when she killed Ghost Guang.
This Monarch Level powerhouse’s eyes went wide—until his death he could not believe he would lose so cleanly and decisively.
All of this was entirely thanks to the traits of the Destruction Domain...
The stronger Liu Li’s Basic Attributes, the more terrifying the Destruction Domain she released.
And the stronger the Destruction Domain, the more it could raise her offensive power to an even scarier level.
This was the fundamental reason why a Monarch Tier Five Ghost Race member was powerless before her.
And when Gu Xing saw this, he rubbed his chin thoughtfully.
For a race such as the Ghost Race, with a clear weakness in Spiritual Attributes, Liu Li could easily challenge Monarch Tier Seven or even Eight powerhouses across tiers.
After all, attacks from the Destruction Domain combined both physical and spiritual traits, and could even directly seal the Ghost Race’s most relied-upon Void Talent.
Thus, only against the Ghost Race could it produce such a brilliant effect.
"However..."
Gu Xing’s gaze flickered, "If encountering a race with balanced attributes..."
Take the Angel Race—for example, without using the Power of Laws, Liu Li could at best handle Monarch Tier Three or Four opponents.
After all, the Angel Race had balanced attribute development—with no obvious weakness, dealing with them was naturally much tougher.
But how could the Ghost Race spectators in the stands understand these intricacies?
When they saw Liu Li effortlessly insta-killing a Monarch Tier Five powerhouse, the entire coliseum fell into deathly silence.
"This... how is this possible?! Since when did the Angel Race become this strong?"
"Something’s off! It wasn’t that easy for her against Ghost Guang. The damn human Beast Master must have done something!"
In an instant, all the Ghost Race’s gazes swept toward Gu Xing in unison.
Under this scorching attention, Tu Shanyue Li’s gaze burned the hottest.
Her small mouth hung open, her delicate face written all over with shock.
She had already guessed from Lilith’s reaction that Gu Xing’s Talent was extraordinary.
But...
It was only upon seeing it firsthand.
That she realized Gu Xing’s Talent wasn’t just extraordinary—it was monstrous!
Under that mysterious Talent’s boost, she could clearly perceive that Liu Li’s Attributes had at least doubled.
If she could get this kind of amplification too...
Tu Shanyue Li’s fox ears couldn’t help but twitch.
Her Spiritual Attribute would directly break through the 120,000 threshold!
Combined with her Lifebound Skill, New Moon...
[New Moon: Sealing Skill, can seal enemies whose Spiritual Power does not exceed 1.5 times one’s own!]
120,000 times 1.5... 180,000!
This meant that as long as the enemy’s Spiritual Attribute didn’t exceed 180,000, she could seal them directly.
With this kind of combat strength, she could leap directly up to Monarch High Tier!
She could even...
For a race like the Ghost Race, with weak Spiritual Attributes, even Monarch Peak or Half-step Totem level powerhouses might not reach 180,000 Spiritual!
This meant that against races with weak Spiritual Power, her combat ability could even reach Monarch Peak or Half-step Totem Level.
At this thought, Tu Shanyue Li’s eyes instantly sparkled like stars.
She looked at Gu Xing as if she’d discovered an inexhaustible gold mine, even her breathing involuntarily quickening.
But at this moment, the Great Elder felt like he’d plunged into an ice cave.
The Monarch Tier Five powerhouse he’d sent out was actually instant killed by that Angel!
This outcome left him rooted to the spot as if struck by lightning.
He had considered countless possibilities...
Ghost Jiu instantly killing Liu Li; Liu Li fighting hard and losing, or at worst...
At the very least, both sides would be evenly matched!
But the scene before him utterly shattered all his expectations.
"Commander Tier Four... instant killing Monarch Tier Five?"
The Great Elder’s fingertips trembled uncontrollably.
Even worse, this victory meant...
That Unicorn Ghost Race member would gain the right to approach the Divine Pattern!
"Absolutely not allowed!"
His gaze suddenly locked onto the fallen Ghost Race, a cold, cruel glint flashing in his eyes.
The next moment, he struck without hesitation:
"Ghost Race Tournament: No killing allowed!"
"You dare break the rules? Today, you leave here alive no more!"
Without the slightest warning, he struck directly.
His target—Gu Xing!
The intention was obvious.....
He wanted to use this as an excuse to kill Gu Xing outright!
And without Gu Xing, what waves could Qing Shuang and Fei Yue possibly stir up?
The Great Elder moved as fast as lightning, without any warning.
Even Lilith hadn’t expected that the Ghost Race Great Elder would abandon all decorum and launch a sudden attack!
The tyrannical pressure of a Half-step Totem Level erupted, paired with the ultimate Transformation Realm Void Power, his figure almost instantly broke through space constraints, Ghost Claw reaching straight for the top of Gu Xing’s skull!
If this blow landed, Gu Xing would be killed on the spot.
Yet——
"Buzz!"
At the very instant the Ghost Race member fell, the prepared Liu Li silently switched domains.
The blood-colored Destruction Domain instantly transformed into a Guardian Barrier, locking Gu Xing safely within.
"Bang!"
The Great Elder’s Ghost Claw smacked heavily atop Gu Xing’s head, but a clash like metal striking sounded in reply.
Feeling the force rebounding into his hand, the Half-step Totem Level expert’s face instantly changed!
This... how could this be?!
He was a Half-step Totem Level powerhouse!
This attack was nearly full force—even his peers wouldn’t dare take it head-on.
But this human... hadn’t budged an inch?!
And at that moment.
"BOOM——!!"
From the direction of the Forbidden Land, a thunderous explosion erupted, rocking the lands.
A pillar of Ghost Qi shot up to the sky, staining half the heavens a sinister black.
Qing, left the Secret Realm!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 197: Lilith Takes Action!
chapters.content:
Chapter 197: Chapter 197: Lilith Takes Action!
The Great Elder abruptly turned his head to look toward the Forbidden Land.
There, a presence equal to his own erupted forth.
His face instantly turned ashen.
For such a presence to burst out from the direction of the Forbidden Land...
That could only mean Qing had left the Secret Realm!
How could this be?!
After all these years, with Qing trapped inside the Forbidden Land, not only did her strength not decline—she’s actually advanced further?
He knew very well that the Forbidden Land was saturated with Demonic Qi.
Forget advancing in level—even maintaining one’s original power there was extremely difficult.
But Qing...
She truly deserves to be called the Ghost Race’s number one prodigy!
A sinister glint flashed through the Great Elder’s eyes, his gaze like a blade slicing toward Fei Yue and Qing Shuang, who stood behind Gu Xing.
Now everything made sense to him...
Qing must have come into contact with his daughter!
A miscalculation...
Sending that human in, he hadn’t considered this possibility.
After all, the Forbidden Land was vast beyond measure, and he’d even dispatched Monarch-level Ghost Race assassins...
Given those circumstances, he hadn’t thought that human would actually encounter Qing.
However...
As long as he captured those two Unicorn Ghost Race, would Qing still dare defy him?
A cold gleam flared in the Great Elder’s eyes, and Void Power surged frantically around him.
Since things had come to this, it was time to resolve the issue in the most direct way possible!
Just then—
"Shua shua shua!"
Nine figures suddenly tore through the Void, appearing above the sky.
It was none other than the nine remaining Elders who had lain in ambush for so long.
Their original plan had been to surround and kill Lilith, but the sudden twist threw all strategies into chaos.
"Qing, along with those criminals, broke the seal on the Forbidden Land and burst out from within!"
"The Forbidden Land is now practically lost!"
The Elders immediately reported all the information they had.
Upon hearing the situation, the Great Elder’s eyes darkened slightly. Then, he swept his gaze over the nine Elders and spoke slowly:
"You go delay Qing—I’ll handle things here!"
The nine Elders, hearing this, instantly transformed into streams of light heading for the Forbidden Land.
And as the Ghost Race on-site heard the name "Qing," panic broke out instantly:
"What? Qing is still alive?!"
"Wasn’t she the traitor who allowed the Demon Race to invade back then?"
"It’s over, it’s over, a disaster is coming!"
To the Ghost Race masses, Qing’s reputation had already been molded by the Great Elder—someone irresponsible, who let the Demon Race attack, a villain.
Now that she had left the Forbidden Land, she would undoubtedly pose a threat to the entire Ghost Race!
Staring at the chaos unfolding, the Great Elder roared aloud—
"All clansmen, evacuate immediately!"
Upon hearing the Great Elder’s order, the Ghost Race audience scattered in terror.
And when the last Ghost Race member fled the scene, the Great Elder’s gaze became thoroughly cold and sinister.
He stared intently at Gu Xing, cloaked within the Golden Domain, at last gleaning something crucial.
This domain...
His gaze finally settled upon Liu Li.
This domain... had already begun to nurture the embryonic form of a Law!
The discovery sent a shockwave through his heart, murderous intent surging.
This Angel and this human... must not be allowed to live!
Give them any more time to grow, and they will surely become future calamities.
But for now, hindered by the bizarre domain, he couldn’t attack the Beast Master and could only target Liu Li instead.
However—
"So the mighty Great Elder of the Ghost Race stoops to such lowly tactics."
Lilith positioned herself gracefully before Liu Li, scarlet eyes steeped in taunt and mockery.
She toyed with a strand of silver hair at her fingertips, every gesture exuding deliberate composure.
The Great Elder’s face darkened like storm clouds.
Among those present, only this Blood Race woman kept him guessing.
"You haven’t formed a contract with this human; you’re not his Guardian Beast..."
"As Blood Race, humanity is mere food for you—you have no reason to risk yourself for him!"
"Throwing your own life away here—what’s the point?"
He still clung to a final attempt.
If he could talk this Blood Race woman into leaving on her own, that would be best.
Only...
He was utterly unaware of the true bond between Lilith and Gu Xing.
Their lives were intertwined by more than mere contract!
"Throw my life away here?!"
Lilith’s red lips curled, revealing a smile colder than ice.
"And someone like you thinks you’re worthy to lecture me?"
"Boom!"
Dense blood energy erupted from her petite figure, like a volcanic explosion.
In the midst of this storm of blood, her body elongated, silver hair transforming into a lurid crimson...
The Blood Empress—her true form descended!
The Great Elder’s face went deathly pale the instant he saw Lilith’s true self.
"Blood Ancestor... Lilith!"
That name had echoed in his ears since before he ever became an Elder.
Even back then, Lilith was already a terrifying Totem-level existence!
"So you recognize me? How amusing~"
Lilith’s eyes glimmered with wicked playfulness.
Staring at Lilith, the Great Elder’s heart sank to rock bottom—yet suddenly...
He keenly detected Lilith’s current aura...
Only Monarch Tier Five?!
The realization made his sharp eyes burn with excitement.
If Lilith were still Totem-level, he’d flee without a second’s hesitation.
But now...
Even the former Blood Ancestor is merely Monarch Tier Five!
"Heh..."
The Great Elder’s Ghost Qi churned wildly.
"Even as Blood Ancestor, today you will never leave this place alive!"
On the viewing platform.
Yueli Tu Shan stood in utter shock, "Blood Ancestor" echoing in her ears.
This silver-haired girl who was always by Gu Xing’s side... was actually the founder of the Blood Race?!
Everyone knew the Blood Ancestor was a Totem-level existence, equal to her own mother!
Even more astonishing: as a natural-born battle species, the Blood Race meant Lilith’s actual combat power might even surpass her mother...
She swallowed with difficulty, eyes darting rapidly between Gu Xing and Lilith.
Now, the elite races accompanying this human included—
Elf, Angel, Ghost Race, Blood Race!
And the Blood Race itself was accompanied by its true Ancestor!
What did this signify?
If she could broker an alliance between Qingqiu and humanity, it would mean simultaneous ties with both humanity and the Blood Race!
Her heart raced further as the turmoil from the Forbidden Land hinted that Gu Xing had, apparently, already made allies among the Ghost Race opposition...
"Princess!"
A Half-Step Totem Level Qingqiu expert suddenly appeared.
"Civil war has erupted within the Ghost Race. Should we get out of here?"
Yueli Tu Shan gently shook her head, eyes shining with unwavering resolve:
"Aunt Xue, I’ve decided to ally with humanity."
"You keep your eyes on the battle. If things turn, strike at the Ghost Race without hesitation!"
The woman called "Aunt Xue" nodded slightly at the command.
As Qingqiu’s only Princess, Yueli Tu Shan’s orders would be followed unconditionally.
After giving her instructions, Yueli Tu Shan gazed up at the battlefield stretched across the sky, lips unconsciously curving upward.
She had an intense feeling—
This mysterious human was destined to bring her even more unimaginable surprises!
Not just those unparalleled Guardian Beasts and that uncanny Talent...
There had to be more awaiting her!!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 198: Destruction Law!
chapters.content:
Chapter 198: Chapter 198: Destruction Law!
The atmosphere on the battlefield was tense beyond measure.
The Great Elder glared fiercely at Lilith standing before him, his voice as cold as ice:
"Blood Ancestor, if you leave now, I’ll let bygones be bygones, but if you continue to be obstinate..."
Even as he spoke, Ghost Qi surged wildly within his body in secret.
The Ghost Race is all about explosive power!
Relying on Void Power, they can instantly close in on opponents, and with the Ghost Race Four Techniques, they multiply their Strength Attribute, killing instantly.
Thus, even when facing Blood Ancestor Lilith, the Great Elder intended to use this fighting style.
However.
"Heh..."
Lilith’s red lips curled, and a trace of mockery flickered in her eyes.
As a former Totem Level powerhouse, her perception of energy fluctuations is exceptionally sharp.
The moment the Great Elder began gathering Ghost Qi, she had already seen through his intentions.
She tilted her head slightly, exchanging a glance with Gu Xing.
No words were needed—Gu Xing instantly understood.
With Lilith currently at Monarch Tier Five, facing a Half-step Totem Great Elder... it would be tough!
So now was time for Gu Xing to step in!
"Soul-devouring!"
With Gu Xing’s clear shout, blood-colored spiritual power surged like a tide, enveloping Lilith.
With this power’s boost, her aura began to soar crazily, instantly breaking through a critical point...
"Boom!"
A blood-red pillar of light shot into the sky. Lilith’s silver hair flew wildly, a suffocating pressure swirling around her.
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Extremely Weak (Recovering)]
[Level: Monarch Tier Five]
[Power: 200,000→400,000]
[Constitution: 200,000→400,000]
[Spirit: 200,000→400,000]
[Speed: 200,000→400,000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
At this moment, Gu Xing finally had a clear look at Lilith’s attributes.
Even without Soul-devouring’s boost, her basic attributes reached two hundred thousand!
With talent amplification, she broke straight through the threshold of four hundred thousand!
What shocked him even more—at the same Monarch Tier Five, Lilith’s attributes were sixty thousand points higher than that previous Ghost Race member!
And that’s comparing only the Ghost Race’s strongest Strength Attribute...
Realizing this, Gu Xing put away all contempt towards the Monarch Level in his heart.
Originally, he thought with Soul Devouring Talent and Liu Li’s destruction form, he could take on High Tier Monarchs head-on.
But now, it seemed he had been way too naive.
Apparently, the Monarch Level was where the real gap started—the dividing line!
Even within the same tier, differences in race and talent could create a vast gulf in power...
Meanwhile, Lilith slowly closed her eyes, savoring the shock of power surging through her.
Each time she experienced this amplification, it moved her to the core!
Unconditional doubling of all attributes!
For someone like her, who perfectly controls her own power.
Doubling attributes...
Is far from just doubling her strength!
"Immortal Blood Body!"
Blood-colored energy erupted like a volcano, instantly enveloping her.
A pair of massive bat wings unfolded behind her, sending her attributes soaring again.
Fourfold amplification!
[Power: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Constitution: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Spirit: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Speed: 400,000→1,600,000]
When Lilith’s momentum soared to its peak, the entire Ghost Clan’s Residence quaked under her pressure.
This was exactly where she got the confidence to storm the Ghost Race stronghold with Gu Xing!
A full 1.6 million in every attribute...
This already granted her terrifying power nearly at Totem Level!
The Great Elder of the Ghost Race naturally felt this overwhelming power.
His face changed drastically.
At this moment, the feeling of death reached its climax in his heart.
But...
The reason he dared stay alone here was because he had his own trump card.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
Pitch black Ghost Patterns instantly spread across the Great Elder’s body.
The black patterns crawled over his body like living things—but even this wasn’t enough.
His arms trembled...
"Boom!"
The ground of the Central Square exploded, and an incredibly dense black Ghost Qi shot upward, liquid-like, covering his body and condensing into a suit of ancient-engraved Ghost Armor.
"Extreme Ghost Qi?" Lilith’s scarlet eyes narrowed slightly. "No wonder you’re so confident..."
So he had Extreme Ghost Qi as his safeguard!
This essence—Extreme Ghost Qi—could massively boost a Ghost Race member’s attributes."
And now, with this Extreme Ghost Qi, the Great Elder’s aura matched Lilith’s!
Even scarier, this was just the base amplification—he hadn’t even used the Ghost Race Four Techniques yet...
Seeing this, Gu Xing quickly checked the Great Elder’s stats.
[Ghost Race Great Elder]
[Talent: Myth Three Stars]
[Level: Half-step Totem]
[Power: 600,000→900,000→1,900,000]
[Constitution: 500,000→750,000→1,750,000]
[Spirit: 200,000→300,000→1,300,000]
[Speed: 600,000→900,000→1,900,000]
[Skills: Ghost King’s Body, Ghost King Domain, Ghost Race Four Techniques...]
With Ghost King’s Body boosting by 1.5 times, plus Extreme Ghost Qi...
This Ghost Race member’s attributes were completely on par with—maybe even surpassing—Lilith!
However, Gu Xing’s gaze was locked on that Ghost Armor.
"Extreme Ghost Qi!"
This was one of the materials Qing Shuang needed to advance!
Only, snatching it from the Great Elder now... would be incredibly difficult.
"Heh... Blood Ancestor, you forced my hand!"
The Great Elder’s voice was frighteningly hoarse.
Extreme Ghost Qi didn’t fit him at all—right now, it was savagely corroding his body.
But all of this...
Was the fault of that human!
His hate-filled eyes stabbed at Gu Xing like knives. He never imagined a human could force him this far.
Lilith’s keen senses picked up this glare.
She didn’t turn around, but her voice was more serious than ever:
"Gu Xing, leave here. For the fight ahead, I might not be able to protect you."
To face this Ghost Race elder, Lilith had to be one hundred percent focused.
If she wanted to win, she could only rely on her absolute command of domains.
"Blood Domain!"
"Ghost King Domain!"
Two shouting voices rang out almost simultaneously.
The blood-red and pitch black domains collided violently—a storm of raw energy swept a thousand meters, leveling every building!
Gu Xing had long since been whisked away from the battle’s heart by Liu Li.
But.
The two of them, having left the center, discovered that during this time, several Monarch Level Ghost Race members had gathered.
Yueli shot a look at Aunt Xue right away.
Gu Xing’s level was just too low—taking on multiple Monarch Level Ghost Race was impossible.
Now, if Aunt Xue intervened, she’d have Gu Xing owe her a favor.
Only...
"Destruction Law!"
Liu Li’s icy voice rang out—her twelve crimson wings fully spread.
In an instant, space-time within a thousand meters seemed to freeze—even the drifting dust was locked in midair.
Gu Xing knew that fighting these Monarch Level Ghost Race by normal means was pointless, so without hesitation, he had Liu Li unleash Destruction Law!
At the same time, deep in the Forbidden Land of the Ghost Race...
A pair of eyes that had lain dormant for decades suddenly opened wide!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 199: Monarch Level Ghost Race, Extermination!
chapters.content:
Chapter 199: Chapter 199: Monarch Level Ghost Race, Extermination!
As Liu Li’s clear shout fell, the Fire of Destruction spread like a living creature, and in the blink of an eye, sealed the entire space.
The Divine Pattern on her forehead shone with an eerie light, blood-colored aura forming intricate patterns that flowed along her twelve wings.
Strangely, her aura was rapidly withdrawing, finally settling into absolute calm.
Yet, the faintly twisting space around her revealed what terrifying Power lay hidden beneath that tranquility!
The Monarch-level Ghost Race that surrounded them, the strongest among them had even reached Tier Seven or Eight...
But at this moment, every one of them was mercilessly shackled in place.
This Ghost Race member discovered in horror that no matter how they twisted their bodies, their flesh didn’t respond in the slightest.
"Wh-what’s going on?! Why can’t we move at all?!"
"Damn it! What the hell did this Angel do?!"
No matter how they erupted with Ghost Qi or tried to unleash their Domains, they couldn’t break free of the restraint.
How could they possibly know...
The power that bound them now no longer belonged to the Monarch Level.
It transcended Domains, ruling over all creation!
Law!
It could fully control all within a given space!
Although Liu Li controlled only a wisp of Destruction Law,
Even so...
This group of Monarch Level Ghost Race was utterly helpless before it!
Liu Li slowly raised her eyes; there was no emotion left in those pupils, like a divine being gazing coldly on mere ants from above.
She merely lifted a hand.
The Fire of Destruction seemed to receive an order,
and from every corner of the space, surged to hunt down those Monarch-level Ghost Race.
Where the flames passed, even the air began to warp and collapse.
"No... Don’t come any closer!"
The Ghost Race powerhouses struggled in madness, despair flooding their eyes.
They could feel with chilling clarity: this uncanny flame held the power to obliterate all things.
The moment it touched them...
Death would be inevitable!
Yet no matter how much Ghost Qi they unleashed, no matter how desperately they burst their Domains, their bodies remained frozen; they could only watch helplessly as the Fire of Destruction crept ever closer...
"Chii—"
As the first tongue of flame brushed against Ghost Race flesh, their bodies fractured like fragile glass, webbed instantly with cracks!
The terrifying aspect of Destruction Law displayed itself in full—
Unlike Destruction Domain, which needed time to erode, the collapse wrought by Law was instantaneous, absolute!
"Aaaahhh—!"
Amid piercing screams, the bodies of several Monarch-level elites disintegrated at a pace visible to the naked eye.
Soon, nothing remained but scattered wisps of Ghost Qi, proof that they ever existed...
Witnessing this scene.
Snow Aunt, beside Tushan Yueli, was struck rigid on the spot as though by lightning, eyes locked on Liu Li, her voice trembling without her realizing:
"L-Law!"
Those two words weighed thousands of pounds.
To those half-step Totem Level beings, Law was something they all dreamed of attaining.
If only they could begin to master a Law, there was a chance to break through to the Totem Level.
Yet this Angel before their eyes...
Was clearly only at Commander Tier Four!
When Tushan Yueli heard the word "Law", her six Fox Tails instantly went taut and straight.
As the daughter of the Qingqiu Empress, she understood better than anyone what this meant...
"Mother once said... the earlier you comprehend Law, the stronger your Talent..."
Her mother had only brushed Law’s threshold at Monarch Peak, and even so, dominated heroes and claimed the position of Qingqiu Empress.
But this Angel before her...
Had mastered the Power of Laws at Commander Tier Four?!
Did this mean...
Her Talent far surpassed the Qingqiu Empress?!
No matter how shocked the two Qingqiu Clan members were, at this very moment, upon the battlefield...
Liu Li’s figure swayed, the Fire of Destruction retreated like the tide.
Her steps faltered; she nearly collapsed.
"Liu Li!"
Gu Xing leapt forward, steadying her tottering body.
The girl’s fragile figure was wrapped in familiar warmth, causing her to relax unknowingly.
To wield Destruction Law, for her now...
The burden was immense!
Using it even once would drain every last ounce of Energy from her body.
And Law must not be invoked lightly!
Because her physical strength hadn’t reached the required threshold, every use meant... she had to spend a full month to recover!
"Master... I’m fine." A faint smile stretched across Liu Li’s pale face, "It’s just... a little tiring."
Gu Xing, aching with concern, brought her cold, slender hand behind his neck, letting her rest against him:
"Do you want to return to the Beast Taming Space and rest?"
She could recover faster there.
"No..."
Liu Li shook her head stubbornly, her hair gently brushing Gu Xing’s chin.
This was when she was weakest; this was precisely when she most wished to stay at Master’s side.
Moreover...
The situation at hand was far too complicated.
If a Ghost Race suddenly attacked Gu Xing, what then?
She had to stand guard at Gu Xing’s side!
Seeing Liu Li resolute in her refusal to return to the Beast Taming Space, Gu Xing contemplated briefly, then supported her over to Tushan Yueli.
"Qingqiu Princess, could I trouble you to help keep watch?"
Tushan Yueli’s eyes flashed bright at those words.
She’d been fretting for an opportunity to have Gu Xing owe her a favor, and now he’d delivered it right to her doorstep!
"Snow Aunt!" she ordered at once. "Seal the perimeter, no Ghost Race must come close!"
Snow Aunt nodded slightly; Spiritual Power surged around her, and tremendous Spirit instantly blanketed a full kilometer, not even the tiniest fluctuation in the Void could escape her Perception.
"Thank you!"
Gu Xing thanked her earnestly, then turned his eyes back skyward.
There, the battle between Lilith and the Ghost Race Great Elder would decide the outcome!
At this moment, Lilith erupted with her Blood Domain, forcing the Great Elder to retreat several steps.
A flicker of astonishment flashed across her scarlet eyes...
When Liu Li used the Destruction Law just now, she had seen every detail clearly!
"Already... she’s touched the Law?"
She’d thought she’d estimated the Angel’s power high enough; but she was still too conservative.
With that wisp of Destruction Law, Liu Li could even contend with an ordinary Monarch Peak!
At that thought, a dangerous curve drew at Lilith’s lips.
Now that Liu Li had finished her fight, how could she, the Blood Ancestor, fall behind?
She licked her fangs, letting blood force surge throughout her.
"It’s time to end this!"
It was then that the Ghost Race Great Elder realized something was wrong.
The Monarch-level fighters he’d sent out—had all vanished in an instant?!
"Impossible..."
His pupils contracted violently, mind shaken to its core.
Yet in the moment of distraction—
"Whoosh!"
A streak of blood-red light struck, faster than the eye could catch!
Lilith knew well: even with her Blood Domain at the Transformation Realm, it was tough to break through Extreme Ghost Qi armor.
So she showed no hesitation in playing her final trump card—
Blood Law!
"Slash!"
The Ghost Race Great Elder’s body went stiff as a board, disbelief filling his eyes as he looked down at the bloody hole in his chest.
If he hadn’t shifted his heart at the very last instant, he’d already have been slain!
"Cough..."
Blood spilled from his lips as he staggered back several paces.
His Extreme Ghost Armor began to crumble; the Ghost Qi within him poured out, like a dam breaking.
This vessel had already reached its limit.
Lilith approached with measured steps, blood-red hair billowing without wind.
She looked down imperiously at the Great Elder, kneeling on the ground, her gaze utterly cold:
"It’s over!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 200: Meeting Gift
chapters.content:
Chapter 200: Chapter 200: Meeting Gift
At the very instant when Lilith was about to end the Great Elder’s life...
"Swish!"
A figure appeared between the two without the slightest warning!
Lilith felt her hair stand on end, instinctively retreating dozens of meters.
In that brief moment, she actually sensed a long-lost threat of death!
After steadying herself, she stared gravely at the suddenly appearing figure.
It was an elderly man with snow-white hair, his frame so thin and bent it was nearly hunched, utterly unlike the burly form typical of the Ghost Race.
Yet this seemingly frail body made Lilith feel like she was facing a formidable enemy.
"Ghost Clan Leader... You?!"
She instantly recognized who it was—a true Totem Level powerhouse!
You looked around, gazing upon the ruined Ghost Race royal city, his cloudy eyes full of confusion.
He had only secluded himself for a short while—how had the clan fallen into such a state?
As his gaze landed on Lilith, the old man’s pupils shrank sharply.
"Blood Ancestor?!"
His emaciated fingers trembled slightly, and You’s voice turned abruptly cold:
"You trespass in my clan—what exactly is your intention?"
You’s eyes were as sharp as blades, but the Great Elder, protected behind him, took the chance to distort the facts:
"Clan Leader! This Blood Ancestor brought a human to create chaos at our grand competition, even slaughtering several Monarch Level clansmen!"
You’s brows tightened into a frown.
Since when had the Ghost Race declined to such a state?
They were forced to this point by a mere Monarch Tier Five Blood Ancestor?
If he hadn’t sensed the Law fluctuations and awakened in time...
"Where is Qing?"
He suddenly demanded sternly, "Defending the Ghost Race is his duty. Where is he?"
The Great Elder shuddered, eyes darting evasively:
"I..."
"Speak!"
Crushed by You’s pressure, the Great Elder stammered out:
"Qing... he betrayed the Ghost Race!"
At this moment, he could only hope those nine elders would deal with Qing...
If the Clan Leader met with Qing, all he’d plotted these years would surely be exposed!
Now, he deeply regretted it.
If only...
Back then, he should have crushed that human to death directly!
"Betrayed the Ghost Race?"
You froze at this accusation.
If it had been other Ghost clansmen, perhaps he’d have believed it.
But Qing...
His vast Spiritual Power instantly enveloped the entire Ghost Race domain.
Only then did he discover Qing was fiercely battling the nine elders!
Could it be Qing truly betrayed the Ghost Race?
He waved his hand sharply.
With the twist of space, Qing and the nine elders instantly appeared before the crowd.
"Stop this immediately!" You snapped, his expression terrifyingly dark. "What on earth is going on?"
The nine elders, recognizing You’s figure, trembled all over, their eyes instinctively darting toward the Great Elder.
And the Great Elder’s face was ashen with despair...
It’s over, it’s all over!
You’s gaze finally fell on Qing:
"Qing, you speak."
Seeing the Clan Leader, Qing knelt on one knee, his voice ringing firm and clear:
"Clan Leader!"
As he recounted in detail the inside story of the Demon Race’s invasion, You’s expression grew ever grimmer.
"You mean..."
You’s tone was as cold as Nine Netherworld Ice: "The Great Elder has been nurturing his own faction and suppressing dissent all these years?"
"Absolutely true!"
You’s gaze stabbed at the Great Elder like a sword.
The latter’s face instantly turned deathly pale as he knelt trembling, spilling blood from his mouth:
"Clan Leader, please spare me! Over these years I’ve managed the Ghost Race with all my heart—even if I haven’t achieved much, I’ve worked hard..."
The other nine elders also dropped to their knees, scrambling to shirk responsibility:
"The Great Elder forced us into this!"
"We had no other choice!"
You looked at these elders passing the blame, and anger ignited in his chest.
"Enough!"
He roared, robe sweeping out fiercely.
The nine elders were flung away like kites with broken strings, and the heavily wounded Great Elder spewed blood, collapsing limp and dying.
After dealing with the traitors, You’s figure instantly appeared before Gu Xing.
So fast that not even the Half-Step Totem Level Xue Yi could react in time.
"Where is my granddaughter?"
His voice was tinged with urgency.
Since his daughter’s death, he’d been deeply despondent, later choosing seclusion to break through the next Realm.
Who’d have thought upon emerging, he’d learn his granddaughter had nearly been assassinated!
And now...
His granddaughter had actually been Contracted by a human!
But from Qing’s account, he also knew that Gu Xing had saved Qing Shuang and Fei Yue.
So, while his tone was not exactly pleasant, it wasn’t hostile either.
Gu Xing pondered briefly, then summoned Fei Yue and Qing Shuang.
Judging from Qing’s attitude, this Clan Leader was entirely trustworthy.
Yet—
Fei Yue, as soon as she appeared, hid behind Gu Xing, while Qing Shuang glared coldly.
Neither of them had the slightest impression of this grandfather of theirs.
Since childhood, they had rarely seen him at all.
And when the two of them were expelled from the Ghost Race...
This so-called grandfather hadn’t made any move to intervene.
Thus, they felt no affection for You whatsoever.
You’s outstretched hands froze awkwardly in midair.
His own granddaughters... actually refused to acknowledge him?!
This...
His gaze shifted to Gu Xing.
Even if his granddaughters did not recognize him, he still had to have this human dissolve the Contract.
He, the Ghost Clan Leader’s granddaughter, if bound by Contract to a human...
"Human, dissolve your Contract with Qing Shuang and Fei Yue. I can compensate you with the full resources of the Ghost Race!"
But just then...
As soon as he spoke...
Qing Shuang’s gaze grew even colder.
Even Fei Yue, who kept glancing away in nervousness, now looked at You with a tinge of anger in her eyes.
At Totem Level, You naturally noticed this.
What’s going on?
Isn’t he trying to help his granddaughters?
Why?
Qing walked up beside him now, quietly reminding him:
"Clan Leader, it’s impossible for Qing Shuang and Fei Yue to dissolve their Contract with Gu Xing. Only with Gu Xing will they receive the best cultivation!"
You heard this, just about to object, but upon turning, saw the resolve in Qing’s eyes.
The words on the tip of his tongue were instantly swallowed.
With Qing’s character, he’d never say such a thing lightly.
That meant...
His granddaughters really would be better off with this human than in the Ghost Race!
Now, his gaze toward Gu Xing held an extra layer of seriousness.
"Human, you—"
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue’s stares turned cold at the same time.
You’s forehead immediately popped with a few dark lines.
He’d originally wanted to warn this human to treat his granddaughters well, but seeing this...
His granddaughters’ loyalties had shifted utterly to this human!
He could only choke back the warning he was about to utter.
He turned slightly, his gaze slicing like a blade toward the Great Elder sprawled on the ground, his anger burning brighter.
It was all this old bastard’s fault, causing his granddaughters not to acknowledge him!
He flickered, suddenly appearing beside the Great Elder.
Noticing the Extreme Ghost Qi engulfing the latter, You snorted coldly:
"Just right, I’ll use this as a greeting gift for Qing Shuang!"
"Rip—"
With a crude yank, he stripped away the Extreme Ghost Qi, causing the Great Elder’s whole body to convulse in agony.
But You wouldn’t let him die so easily.
A wisp of Ghost Qi immediately enveloped the Great Elder, barely keeping him alive!
This debt would be settled—slowly!
"Qing Shuang..."
You returned to his granddaughter, clutching the Extreme Ghost Qi, forcing the most amiable smile of his life:
"This is your grandfather’s gift for meeting you."
Qing Shuang immediately turned to look at Gu Xing, eyes seeking approval:
"Master?!"
This instinctive gesture made You’s smile freeze on his face.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 201: Nether Ghost Stone Acquired!
chapters.content:
Chapter 201: Chapter 201: Nether Ghost Stone Acquired!
The gift I prepared for my granddaughter—she actually needs to get that human’s approval first before accepting it.
You felt as though a knife had stabbed straight into his heart.
Meanwhile, Gu Xing stared at the Extreme Ghost Qi in You’s hand, a gleam of delight flashing in his eyes.
The three materials Qing Shuang needed to advance:
[Nether Ghost Stone, Extreme Ghost Qi, Ghost Core]
Extreme Ghost Qi was one of them!
Now You had delivered it right into his hands—how could he possibly refuse?
With a glance from Gu Xing, Qing Shuang finally stepped forward.
You watched his granddaughter expectantly, only to see Qing Shuang silently take the Extreme Ghost Qi...
She didn’t even call him "Grandpa"—she just turned and walked away.
What made You feel even more stifled was how Qing Shuang handed this generous gift straight to Gu Xing.
With a wave of Gu Xing’s hand, the Extreme Ghost Qi was absorbed into the Beast Taming Space.
You: "..."
His mouth couldn’t help but twitch, and suddenly a strong sense of disillusionment welled up inside him.
His token of affection...
Had seemingly ended up in the hands of this human!
After Gu Xing accepted the Extreme Ghost Qi, his burning gaze landed back on You.
This was the Ghost Clan Leader, after all!
If he didn’t seize this chance now...
How could he miss such an opportunity to demand even more?
Besides...
This Ghost Clan Leader clearly felt guilty towards Qing Shuang and Fei Yue right now.
If he didn’t take advantage of the moment to ask for additional benefits, when would he?
Gu Xing smiled innocently, yet his tone left no room for refusal:
"Honorable Clan Leader~, since you’ve given Qing Shuang a meeting gift, surely Fei Yue deserves the same? You wouldn’t favor one over the other, would you?"
As he spoke, he deliberately shifted to the side, revealing half of Fei Yue’s face peeking out from behind him.
When You heard Gu Xing’s words, his expression instantly sharpened.
Although his perception told him that Qing Shuang was clearly stronger...
Fei Yue was still his own dear granddaughter!
At that moment, Fei Yue caught on right away, her big glistening eyes blinking and her little face full of expectation, gazing straight at You.
The Ghost Clan Leader had always doted on little girls...
Back when his own daughter passed away, this was the very reason he’d been so broken for so long.
Now, under Fei Yue’s gaze, his heart nearly melted!
"Good girl, Fei Yue," he said with a bold sweep of his hand, "Whatever you want, just say! Grandpa will scour heaven and earth to find it for you!"
Seeing how readily You had taken the bait, Gu Xing seized the opportunity, letting Fei Yue ask for the other two materials Qing Shuang needed to advance—
The Nether Ghost Stone and the Ghost Core!
You frowned slightly at this.
Both these materials held intensely violent energy. The human’s motives for collecting them...
His gaze landed on Qing Shuang, and he instantly understood.
This human, it seemed, really was trying to help Qing Shuang grow stronger!
Thinking about it, You’s earlier displeasure towards Gu Xing dissolved completely.
At least this human genuinely cared for his granddaughter.
"This is the Nether Ghost Stone!"
You swept his big hand, and a jet-black, faintly glowing odd stone appeared in his palm.
As for the Ghost Core...
"I don’t have a Ghost Core at the moment, but give me some time and I promise I’ll find one for you!"
Fei Yue gleefully accepted the Nether Ghost Stone and instantly thrust it into Gu Xing’s arms.
Unlike Qing Shuang’s coldness, the little girl sweetly called out:
"Thank you, Grandpa~"
That one "Grandpa" made You’s heart bloom with joy, and even the wrinkles on his face seemed to smooth out.
Gu Xing saw this, and immediately seized the moment:
"Honorable Clan Leader, according to the competition rules, Fei Yue won first place, so the reward..."
Gu Xing hadn’t forgotten his real purpose here and went straight to the point.
On hearing this, You was stunned, his gaze hesitantly drifting to Fei Yue.
If Qing Shuang had taken first place, he could understand—but Fei Yue...
"Uncle You," Yueli of Tu Shan spoke up right on cue, "As per the Great Elder’s rules, it really is Fei Yue who took first place in the competition."
Now You realized that the Qingqiu Princess was also present. Nodding to her, he sank into thought.
He wasn’t reluctant to let Fei Yue approach the Divine Pattern, but...
The Divine Pattern had always been kept in the Ghost Clan’s burial grounds, soaked in too much Ghost Qi and negative emotions.
If one with insufficient strength forced themselves to accept it, at best, their mind would be damaged; at worst, they could fall into madness.
His gaze turned to Qing Shuang.
If it were Qing Shuang, he’d have no concerns—but Fei Yue’s current Attributes...
He dared not risk his own granddaughter!
Yet, after a moment of hesitation, he didn’t outright refuse, and instead explained all the pros and cons of becoming the Divine Pattern’s master to Gu Xing and the others.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing also furrowed his brow.
Their entire mission hinged on Fei Yue acquiring the Divine Pattern to heighten her mastery of Void Power.
If they failed here, getting close to the second Divine Secret Realm’s entrance would be nearly impossible.
After all...
The Demon Race was determined to seize the Human Race’s second Divine Pattern.
The news they’d received earlier confirmed as much.
The Demon Race had contracted their lines, all for one reason...
To garrison the Northern Territory and hold the entrance to the second Divine Secret Realm.
So, even with You pointing out these dangers...
Gu Xing was still set on having Fei Yue give it a try.
With Celestial Grace protecting her, at least Fei Yue’s life would be safe.
As for her insufficient Attributes...
Perhaps, with the aid of the Soul Devouring Talent, there might yet be a glimmer of hope.
"Clan Leader, I understand your concerns, but I’d still like her to attempt it."
You stared deeply at Gu Xing, then finally nodded:
"Alright, but if anything seems wrong, I’ll immediately call it off!"
Judging by the human’s behavior just now, he could tell...
Gu Xing was not the sort of Beast Master who neglected his own Guardian Beast’s well-being.
Once the two had an understanding...
"Swoosh!"
You swept his large hand, and in an instant, Gu Xing, Fei Yue, Qing Shuang, and himself vanished from the spot.
Liu Li, left behind, looked worried, and Lilith walked calmly to her side:
"Don’t worry. If the Ghost Clan Leader truly wants to make a move, there’s nothing we can do to stop him."
"Totem Level and Monarch Level are two entirely different things!"
Reaching the Totem Level, one was already close to godhood.
Even with her current boosting from Gu Xing’s Talent, allowing her to stand toe-to-toe with Half-step Totem Level experts, there was simply no way she could oppose a true Totem Level expert.
Upon hearing her explanation, Liu Li finally relaxed a little.
After comforting Liu Li, Lilith turned and walked over to Yueli of Tu Shanyue.
Eyeing the Qingqiu Princess before her.
"Let me introduce myself again—the leader of the Blood Race, Blood Ancestor Lilith!"
Tu Shanyue’s Yueli gazed intently at this legendary figure, and elegantly stretched out her hand:
"Qingqiu Princess, Tu Shanyue’s Yueli."
Their hands touched briefly, then parted.
Lilith got straight to the point:
"So, about working with the Human Race—have you considered it?"
"Personally I support it, but the final decision is up to my mother."
Although she was clearly leaning towards cooperating with the humans, nonetheless...
The real authority to decide lay entirely outside her hands!
After a brief discussion with Lilith, and seeing that the matter with the Ghost Race had concluded, Yueli of Tu Shanyue announced her departure:
"Lady Lilith, we’ll return to Qingqiu for now, please let Gu Xing know..."
A trace of anticipation flashed through her eyes. "Yueli will await his arrival in Qingqiu."
"Certainly!"
As the Qingqiu party left, Lilith looked up at the Void.
By now, Gu Xing should already be guiding Fei Yue in contacting that mysterious Divine Pattern, right?
...
...
