chapters.title: Chapter 202: Myth Five Stars! Fei Yue!
chapters.content:
Chapter 202: Chapter 202: Myth Five Stars! Fei Yue!
On the other side, deep within the cemetery of the Ghost Race.
Nether led Gu Xing and the others to instantly teleport over, and the area was immediately shrouded in dense Netherworld Ghost Qi.
This was the resting place of generations of Ghost Race powerhouses, the air thick with a suffocating sense of oppression.
"Ahead lies the Divine Pattern of the Ghost Race."
Nether pointed to the center of the cemetery, where a golden pattern floated, wrapped in black Ghost Qi, radiating pulses that made one’s heart race.
"If Fei Yue wants the recognition of the Divine Pattern, she must rely on her own strength to walk to the end and touch it herself."
"But the closer you get to the Divine Pattern, the stronger the pressure of Ghost Qi becomes."
He paused, then added:
"And even if you manage to touch the Divine Pattern, you may not be recognized by it."
Gu Xing looked at the path leading to the Divine Pattern. It looked ordinary, but danger prickled at his instincts.
He could sense the terrifying energy within, as if countless wailing souls echoed all around.
Soon after, Gu Xing’s gaze landed on Fei Yue.
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 7000]
[Constitution: 7000]
[Spirit: 7000]
[Speed: 7000]
[Skills: Void, Void Domain]
points in all Attributes.
This could barely match an average Commander Level Guardian Beast.
With these Attributes, trying to approach the Divine Pattern...
It was going to be incredibly difficult!
Fei Yue was clearly aware of this as well.
Her face was pale, and her petite frame trembled slightly from anxiety.
Everyone’s expectations weighed on her shoulders, and the burden stirred up an uncontrollable fear inside...
She was scared to disappoint them.
Gu Xing keenly noticed this.
"Fei Yue."
A warm hand gently landed on her head, softly rubbing:
"Don’t worry. I’m here. Just do your best."
Even the always cold Qing Shuang rarely spoke up:
"It’s fine if you fail."
Bathed in this warmth, Fei Yue took a deep breath, and the fear in her eyes gradually faded.
She nodded hard: "Mm! I’ll do my best!"
Under Gu Xing’s encouraging gaze, Fei Yue took her first determined step forward.
As she set foot on the path to the Divine Pattern, a heavy pressure descended, like countless hands pulling at her body.
Even worse, seductive whispers began to echo around her:
"Give up... You can’t do it..."
"Your master said it himself... It’s fine to fail..."
And this was just the beginning.
With every step closer to the Divine Pattern, the pressure multiplied, and the voices grew clearer, more piercing.
In Gu Xing’s vision, Fei Yue was being dragged by several illusory Ghost Race figures.
Every step forward brought more phantoms swarming from all directions, tightly wrapping around her limbs.
"These phantoms are the embodiment of the will of Ghost Race powerhouses throughout history—they’ll do everything to stop outsiders from approaching the Divine Pattern."
Seeing Fei Yue struggle forward, Nether couldn’t help but advise:
"Fei Yue’s Attributes are too low, her mind not mature enough. She can’t possibly earn the Divine Pattern’s recognition."
"Forcing her to continue will only leave lasting damage. Bring her back!"
But Gu Xing ignored Nether’s advice, keeping his eyes locked on Fei Yue.
After only a fifth of the way, Fei Yue had already reached her limit.
Her steps grew slower and slower.
She was on the verge of total stop!
"We can’t wait any longer!"
Gu Xing’s eyes flashed with sharp light, his pupils suddenly transforming.
His left eye became holy silver-white, while the right was dyed with a demonic blood-red!
"Sovereign Celestial Grace!"
"Soul-devouring!"
Both Talents erupted at once!
Bathed in the Power of Celestial Grace, the seductive whispers around Fei Yue instantly vanished, and all negativity in her heart melted away.
Meanwhile, blood-red energy of the Soul Devouring Talent surged into her body, and every Attribute began to soar madly...
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 7000→14000]
[Constitution: 7000→14000]
[Spirit: 7000→14000]
[Speed: 7000→14000]
[Skills: Void, Void Domain]
Fei Yue’s Attributes may have doubled, but Gu Xing’s brow only knit tighter.
He could sense it clearly—the closer to the Divine Pattern, the pressure surged exponentially!
Even with the boost from Soul Devouring Talent, Fei Yue’s 14000 Attribute Value still couldn’t meet the trial’s demands.
If this kept up...
"It’s still not enough!"
Gu Xing’s gaze suddenly shifted to himself, and a bold idea flashed in his mind.
[Gu Xing]
[Contract Quota: 3/5]
[Contracted Beast: Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Power: 8000]
[Constitution: 8000]
[Spirit: 8000]
[Speed: 8000]
[Special State: Human Race’s Favor]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might (Enhances Beast Master’s All Attributes by 300%, suppresses all creatures), Absolute Forbidden Domain (disables all others’ domains)]
Gu Xing stared at his own Attribute panel, his gaze locking onto the "Emperor’s Might" domain.
Suppresses all creatures!
He looked to the phantoms entangling Fei Yue, and an idea naturally surfaced:
Could Emperor’s Might affect these Spirit Bodies too?
No time for doubts!
"Emperor’s Might, activate!"
Silver-white domain instantly unfolded, enveloping Fei Yue.
Stunningly, those phantom Ghost Race figures let out shrill screams as if meeting their worst enemy, and fled in all directions at once!
"This..."
Nether was completely dumbstruck where he stood.
Those phantoms, condensed from the will of Ghost Race powerhouses, not even a Totem Level powerhouse like him could dispel them, and yet a human’s domain forced them back so easily?!
What shocked him even more was Gu Xing’s dual-colored eyes...
This human actually possessed two Talents at the same time!
With Emperor’s Might protecting her, all restraints on Fei Yue vanished instantly.
She leapt lightly toward the Divine Pattern, reaching out without hesitation.
"Buzz!"
In that instant, dazzling purple Void Power swept through the entire space.
And Fei Yue’s Attributes underwent a transformation...
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 7000→20000]
[Constitution: 7000→20000]
[Spirit: 7000→20000]
[Speed: 7000→20000]
[Skills: Instant Flash, Voidification, Void Cutting, Void Domain]
On fusing with the Divine Pattern, Fei Yue’s Talent soared from Myth One Star straight to Myth Five Stars.
And all her Attributes leaped massively!
Average Attributes reached 20000!
Now she was on par with the other Guardian Beasts.
But...
Because Fei Yue lacked multiplier-enhancing skills, surpassing the other Guardian Beasts in combat was still impossible!
Even so, Fei Yue’s current strength could no longer be underestimated.
[Instant Flash: Instantly moves to any spot within a kilometer, can be used up to ten times in succession]
[Voidification: Body enters Void state, immune to all attacks for three seconds]
[Void Cutting: Summon three controllable Void Blades for cutting attacks]
Instant Flash and Voidification gave Fei Yue unparalleled self-preservation!
While Void Cutting gave her offensive capability!
Overall, Fei Yue was now fully worthy of her Myth Five Stars Talent!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 204: This Is Love!
chapters.content:
Chapter 204: Chapter 204: This Is Love!
Northern Territory.
Under the pitch-black sky, Demonic Qi surged like thick ink, obscuring the entire sky.
Tens of thousands of Demon Race elites stood ready and waiting.
The piercing gaze of the Monarch Level powerhouses swept around, ensuring no living beings could approach.
High above, more than a dozen Half-Step Totem Level Demon Kings stood suspended in the air, their immense Spiritual Power covering a thousand miles like a tide, detecting any subtle movements.
The last time, the contest for the first Divine Pattern ended in failure, bringing shame upon them before the Lord Demon God.
But this time...
No mistakes will be allowed!
"All heed my command! As the Secret Realm opens, kill without mercy anyone who dares to approach!"
"As you command, Demon King!"
The countless Demons below responded in unison, with Demonic Qi surging and their murderous intent soaring to the skies.
At this moment, at the entrance of the Divine Secret Realm, the ancient Restriction that spanned millennia began to slowly dissipate.
All the Demons’ eyes instantly burned with fervor.
"The Restriction is loosening!"
"The second Divine Pattern is finally about to emerge!"
"As long as we present it to the Lord Demon God, we will undoubtedly receive supreme rewards!"
With these excited feelings, the surrounding Demonic Qi intensified even more violently.
"Buzz——!"
A golden pillar of light shot up into the sky, piercing through the heavens like a divine sword of punishment!
The imposing Demonic clouds covering miles of the Northern Territory were instantly torn apart!
This sudden phenomenon not only made the Demon army’s eyes burn with greater intensity but also shook the countless races in the Alternate Space!
Blazing Angels Race.
Mi Zhan stood with arms behind him, wings trembling violently behind him.
He stared unblinkingly at the golden pillar of light rising from the Northern Territory, his knuckles white from clenching.
"Despicable Human Race..."
A monstrous killing intent surged in his pupils.
If not for the existence of the Human Race Divine Pattern, he would have long led the War Angels to slaughter the entire Human Race.
But now the Demon Race forbids him from acting against the Human Race!
He took a deep breath, suppressing the dense killing intent in his heart.
But the time limit of this prohibition is only until the third Divine Secret Realm opens.
By then, it will be the day of the Human Race’s demise.
"Issue a command! Prepare the entire army! On the day the Human Race’s third Divine Secret Realm opens..."
"I want the entire Human Race to disappear from the Alternate Space!"
The elder beside him heard this command and immediately relayed Mi Zhan’s orders.
And within the dungeon.
In the dark and damp depths of the dungeon, Liu Xia’s slender fingers clutched the rusty bars tightly.
When she heard the news that Michael was preparing to slaughter the Human Race, her face instantly turned as pale as paper.
"Lady Liu Xia..."
The elderly Blazing Angel beside her trembled as they spoke, "You wouldn’t have... hidden Liu Li in the Human World, would you?"
This question struck like a thunderclap, making all the imprisoned Blazing Angels suddenly lift their heads.
They had once been the most loyal subordinates of the missing Blazing Angels’ Clan Leader, and their sole obsession now was to protect the clan leader’s bloodline.
Liu Xia’s wings uncontrollably spread out, the white feathers trembling violently in the darkness.
She had thought sending Liu Li to the Human Race was the safest choice:
If her brother returned, he would take Liu Li back.
If her brother perished, Liu Li could peacefully live out his life among the Human Race.
But now...
Mi Zhan wanted to annihilate the entire Human Race!
"Mi Zhan!"
She suddenly beat against the Barrier frantically, her voice hoarse and terrifying:
"Bring Mi Zhan here! Get me in touch with Mi Zhan!"
But.....
There was no response!
At this moment, Mi Zhan had completely lost interest in managing the affairs of the Blazing Angels Race.
...
Elsewhere.
At the very northern peak of the Snow Country, deep within the millennia-old Ice Cave.
The female of the Blood Race, "Yue," kneeled on one knee on the translucent ice, head bowed low, not daring to look directly at the stunning figure before her.
Beside her, a transparent Ice Coffin emitted a chilling cold, with the shape of a sleeping person faintly visible inside.
"Lady Snow Woman," Yue spoke with reverence, "Lady Lilith would like to ask for your help to save this human!"
At the cave’s entrance, the Snow Woman slowly turned around.
Her silver-white hair fell like a glacial waterfall, and her ice-blue eyes were more captivating than the aurora.
Her skin was as translucent as fresh snow, and every step she took caused the moisture in the air to crystallize into fine ice particles that floated down.
This was the only member of the Snow Race, also known as the Snow Woman.
Unquestionably the strongest in the Ice and Snow World, and the ruler of the entire Snow Country.
"Lilith? Why didn’t she come to see me herself?"
The Snow Woman did not cast a glance at the Ice Coffin, only looking at Yue as she spoke.
"Lady Lilith signed a Blood Covenant with a human, and with the turmoil within the Blood Race, Lady Lilith did not come to see you."
"Blood Covenant?"
Her ice-blue pupils slightly contracted, and the delicate ices on her long lashes trembled lightly.
This answer was clearly beyond her expectations...
As someone who had known Lilith for a thousand years, she knew too well how proud the Blood Ancestor was.
"Interesting..."
The Snow Woman finally gazed at the Ice Coffin.
The Snow Woman’s eyes lingered on Ying Bing, who was sleeping in the Ice Coffin, and with a slight raise of her slender hand, the heavy cover of the Ice Coffin instantly flew to the side.
Without the protection of the Ice Coffin, Ying Bing’s skin began to wither and age visibly, her long black hair turning gray in an instant.
The Snow Woman’s brows furrowed slightly, and she elegantly turned her right hand——
"Condense."
A white breath wrapped around Ying Bing’s body like a light veil.
Nourished by this power, the signs of aging quickly reversed.
Wrinkles smoothed, gray hair returned to black, and her withered face regained vitality.
"The life source is exhausted... and there’s also a strange devouring force?"
After assessing Ying Bing’s status, the Snow Woman felt some difficulty.
This human’s body was devoid of any Life Force.
If not for the existence of this Ice Coffin and having been soaked in the Spring of Life of the Elf Clan...
She would have likely died long ago!
More troublesome was the presence within her body...
There was also a strange force constantly trying to absorb her Life Force!
"Are you sure Lilith wants me to save this human?"
The Snow Woman inquired again to the Blood Race member kneeling on the ground.
"Yes!"
Having confirmed this, the Snow Woman nodded slightly.
Her crystalline fingertips gently tapped the edge of the Ice Coffin, making a clear, crisp sound.
She lowered her gaze, staring at the sleeping Ying Bing inside the coffin, and suddenly asked an unexpected question:
"Is the one Lilith has the Blood Covenant with... a male or female?"
The Blood Race member "Yue," kneeling on the ground, visibly faltered for a moment, but quickly replied:
"It’s a male, named Gu Xing."
"Gu Xing..." The Snow Woman softly repeated the name, her lips curling into a meaningful smile, "Oh~"
She seemed to understand.
Lilith, this fellow surely fell in love!
"Being single for hundreds of years, it’s not surprising to find love..."
Her gaze returned to Ying Bing, and her fingertips gently tapped the Ice Coffin.
This girl evidently had a deep connection with that Gu Xing, and saving her would surely cause trouble for Lilith?
"But since Lilith specially sent someone to ask me..."
The Snow Woman suddenly laughed softly and shook her head.
To make the proud Blood Ancestor lower herself, it seems this time she’s truly moved!
"Go back and tell Lilith, I can save this person, but she must stay in the Snow Country and become my subject."
"Yes, Lady Snow Woman."
Yue dared not resist and could only agree.
After the Blood Race member left, the Snow Woman casually pulled out a yellowed book from beneath the Ice Crystal Throne, reclined lazily on the Ice Couch, and began flipping through it.
"Love, huh..."
She sighed softly, her ice-blue eyes shining brightly.
As a member of the Snow Race who almost never left the Snow Cave, her only delight was having the Snow Wolf Race collect literature from the Human World.
Amongst all the books, she had a particular fondness for romance novels!
The passage she was reading at the moment happened to describe the heroine sacrificing her love to save her rival.
She bit her lip as her fingers subconsciously formed a few ice flowers:
"Lilith, that fool, actually imitating the scenes from the book..."
"Truly touching~"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 205: Entering the Divine Secret Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 205: Chapter 205: Entering the Divine Secret Realm!
Divine Secret Realm entrance.
The golden pillar of light gradually gathered, finally transforming into a brilliant golden gateway suspended in the sky.
The second Divine Secret Realm officially opens!
At the forefront stood a Demon Race commander, a half-step Totem Level Demon King, unleashing mighty Spiritual Power that swept across a radius of a hundred miles like a tidal wave.
After confirming there were no abnormalities, a hint of satisfaction flashed in his crimson eyes.
"Demon Race members participating in this Divine Secret Realm, begin the operation!"
With his order, several hundred elite, carefully selected Demon Race members formed up.
These were all Peak Commander Level powerhouses, each exuding heart-palpitating Demonic Qi.
"Remember your mission!" His voice thundered, "Seize the Divine Pattern at all costs!"
"Roar—!"
The Demon warriors let out earth-shaking roars, transforming into hundreds of black streaks of light as they charged toward the golden gateway.
They understood well that, by forcefully entering the Secret Realm, the Demon Race would surely provoke repulsion...
But for the future of the Demon Race, this risk was nothing.
However, just as the first wave of Demon Race approached the gateway—
"Buzz!"
A faint ripple appeared somewhere in the Void.
Fei Yue, Gu Xing, and Lilith hid within, their bodies shrouded by a veil-thin Void Barrier.
Fei Yue’s little face was a bit pale, her forehead dotted with fine sweat.
To simultaneously evade the perception of ten half-step Totem-level Demon Race members was an immense challenge for her.
"The situation has changed."
Gu Xing lowered his voice, quickly exchanging words with Lilith.
The original plan was to use Void Travel to enter the Secret Realm directly, but upon approaching the gateway they discovered...
The space there was utter chaos—even with the Divine Pattern’s enhancement, Fei Yue struggled to pass through.
Gu Xing’s brows were tightly knit, his eyes grim as he surveyed the dense Demon Race army below.
Over a hundred Monarch Level Demon Race, ten half-step Totem Level powerhouses—the pressure alone was suffocating.
"I have to think of a way..."
He looked at Lilith at his side; the Blood Ancestor’s expression also grew grave.
Though, with her Soul Devouring Talent, she could reach half-step Totem Level strength,
to withstand the attacks of so many Demon Race...
That was simply impossible!
After some thought, Gu Xing’s gaze shifted again to Fei Yue:
"Fei Yue, what’s the closest you can get to the Secret Realm entrance recently?"
Fei Yue closed her eyes to focus, carefully perceiving the spatial fluctuations around them. After a moment, she opened her eyes and spoke softly—
"Master, with my current ability, I can only get within five hundred meters of the entrance at most."
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s eyes grew a bit more troubled.
Five hundred meters!
Neither near nor far.
If Fei Yue were alone, with her Instant Flash ability, she could cross that distance and enter the Secret Realm in the blink of an eye.
But the problem was, this Skill could not bring anyone along.
"Five hundred meters..."
Gu Xing murmured in a low voice, his brow knitting unconsciously.
For any Guardian Beast, five hundred meters was a mere instant.
But in that instant, too many things could go wrong.
As long as a half-step Totem level Demon Race reacted...
All their efforts would be for nothing!
"I can hold them off for an instant."
Lilith suddenly spoke, her crimson eyes flashing with determination.
"Take that chance—enter the Secret Realm immediately."
Gu Xing, hearing this, turned to look at Lilith.
He thought for a moment, then still shook his head:
"No."
He understood the cost of doing so...
Lilith had only just recovered her Monarch Tier Five strength; if she lost another Blood Body, she might drop directly to Commander Level.
After a prolonged silence, Gu Xing finally made a decision:
"Listen—to, as soon as we leave the Void, you two immediately enter the Beast Taming Space."
He was going to have Liu Li take action!
With the Absolute Defense granted by the "Divine Protection" Skill, Liu Li could fully withstand the Demon Race’s first wave of attack.
But every single moment must be precise...
Even a split-second’s delay and they’d have to face the assault of ten half-step Totem level Demon Race.
Lilith opened her mouth to protest, but when she saw the determination in Gu Xing’s eyes, she could only nod gently in the end.
Soon after, Fei Yue led Gu Xing to the safest spot nearest to the Secret Realm entrance.
Next was simply to wait.
Only when the Demon Race was at their most relaxed would their chance of success be highest!
The seconds ticked by. As the last Commander Level Demon Race stepped through the golden gateway, the Demon Race guardians visibly let their guard down.
The ten half-step Totem Level Demon Kings looked around, and after confirming that nothing was amiss within a hundred-mile radius, their taut nerves finally relaxed.
"Looks like the Human Race and those Alien Races have given up on competing for this Divine Pattern."
At this moment, the golden glow at the Secret Realm’s entrance was dimming—signaling that the portal was about to close.
The other nine half-step Totem Level Demon Kings wore confident smiles.
"Now we simply wait for the Divine Secret Realm to open again..."
"The Human Race Divine Pattern will be ours."
Their group’s sole purpose was to seize the Human Race Divine Pattern.
In the Demon Race deployment, every Race’s Divine Pattern had a dedicated squad assigned.
With each Divine Pattern taken, the Demon Abyss Seal would be weakened further!
And as the Demon Abyss Seal weakened...
A Totem Level Demon God would be able to descend to this world!
In the Void.
Gu Xing suddenly turned to Lilith, asking a question that had troubled him for a long time:
"Lilith, you were once at Totem Level. Why don’t you just wipe out the Demon Race in the Alternate Space?"
At his words, Lilith’s brows furrowed. She pondered a moment before replying slowly:
"You should know, there are two ways the Demon Race appear in Alternate Space—one is from the Demon Abyss, the other is through accumulated Demonic Qi!"
Seeing Gu Xing nod, she went on:
"There was once a Totem Level powerhouse who slaughtered Demon Race recklessly and then..."
Her crimson eyes flashed with grave meaning:
"The Demonic Qi from the slain Demon Race actually condensed into a Totem Level Demon God!"
Gu Xing’s pupils shrank.
He’d known Demonic Qi could spawn the Demon Race, but never expected even Totem Level beings could be created this way.
"Besides, Totem Level powerhouses can’t move around freely."
"Just like You must guard the Ghost Race Forbidden Land, otherwise..."
"The Demon Race in the Forbidden Land would break through the seal?"
Gu Xing considered for a moment before finishing her sentence.
"Exactly." Lilith nodded. "However, only some Races have such Forbidden Lands connecting to Otherworlds. For instance, our Blood Race does not."
Learning this, Gu Xing’s eyes widened slightly.
So Totem Level powerhouses had such restraints after all!
No wonder, despite the Demon Race in Alternate Space lacking Totem Level beings, no top expert had ever made a move against them.
However...
Why do only some Races possess channels linking to other worlds?
He pondered deeply, but found no answer.
So he could only bury this puzzle in his heart!
At this moment, the Divine Secret Realm entrance began to contract, the golden light gradually dimming.
Gu Xing’s gaze sharpened.
This was the exact moment he’d been waiting for!
Only now would the Demon Race’s guard be lowest.
Their chance, his and Liu Li’s, of entering the Divine Secret Realm would be highest!
"Prepare to move!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 206: Retreat to Blue Star!
chapters.content:
Chapter 206: Chapter 206: Retreat to Blue Star!
The golden portal gradually shrunk, and the demons present relaxed completely.
In their eyes, it was impossible for anyone to enter the Secret Realm at this moment!
Who could appear right under their noses without anyone noticing?
It’s important to note that a joint attack from the demons present could make even a Totem-level expert hard-pressed to retreat untouched.
However, at this critical moment...
A dazzling golden light suddenly appeared!
The instant Gu Xing’s figure emerged from the void, he quickly retracted Fei Yue and Lilith into the Beast Taming Space with incredible speed.
At the same time, within the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li had already switched to the Guardian Angel Form, ready to strike.
"Liu Li!"
Gu Xing dared not be careless in the slightest, and as he summoned Liu Li, three major amplification skills erupted instantly:
"Soul Devouring·Start!"
"Sovereign Guardian·Grant!"
"Sovereign Celestial Grace·Grant!"
With these layers of enhancements, Liu Li’s attributes soared to peak state instantaneously.
Her twelve light wings fully unfolded, and the sacred radiance illuminated the entire entrance of the Secret Realm!
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 30000→240000]
[Constitution: 30000→240000]
[Spirit: 30000→240000]
[Speed: 30000→240000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form (Full Attribute Amplification 400%), Guardian Domain, Guardian Law (able to mobilize a trace of the Power of Laws)]
An attribute of 240,000 points was nothing to a few Half-step Totem-level demons.
The only reason Gu Xing sought to fully enhance Liu Li’s attributes was for a single purpose...
"Guardian Domain!"
Liu Li compressed the Golden Domain to its utmost limit, transforming it into a membrane as thin as cicada wings that covered her entire body.
Using this moment, she charged towards the entrance of the Divine Secret Realm with all her might.
The demons were momentarily stunned by this sudden change, but quickly regained composure.
"Audacious!"
"How dare an Angel Race appear here?"
The few Half-step Totem-level demons were the first to react.
They simultaneously attacked, and ten attacks enveloped in mighty Demonic Qi bombarded Liu Li from all directions!
However...
Liu Li did not pause in the slightest!
"Divine Protection!"
With a light exclamation, a golden protective barrier instantly expanded, enveloping her and Gu Xing securely in her arms.
Gu Xing looked up to see Liu Li’s unprecedentedly determined face.
At this moment, she held only one belief:
She must deliver her master safely into the Secret Realm!
The attack from the Half-step Totem-level demons was as swift as lightning, crashing heavily onto Liu Li’s back in the blink of an eye.
But to everyone’s shock...
"Boom!"
Amidst the deafening explosion, the seemingly fragile golden barrier didn’t move an inch!
The pupils of several demon experts contracted sharply, staring at this scene in disbelief.
They clearly sensed that the angel and the human she protected were only at Commander level, so why could they withstand their full-power blow?
And at this moment...
The assault from a Monarch-level demon was already closing in!
Liu Li was only ten meters away from the entrance of the Secret Realm, but the Divine Protection skill had already run out...
She could only rely on the Guardian Domain and Gu Xing’s "Sovereign Guardian" to withstand this wave of offensives.
"Boom——!"
Numerous attacks loaded with Demonic Qi poured onto the Golden Domain like a torrential downpour, and the piercing rumble shook the skies.
Liu Li’s face instantly lost all its color, with a trickle of golden blood seeping from the corner of her mouth.
However, the impact propelled her speed rapidly upward!
"Go!"
She gritted her teeth and, using that momentum, transformed into a golden streamer.
The last ten meters went by in a flash, and under the shocked gazes of the demons, Liu Li plunged into the entrance of the Secret Realm holding Gu Xing, their figures swallowed by the golden light.
This scene left the demons present in a temporary stupor.
Not only were the Monarch-level demons dumbfounded, but even the few Half-step Totem-level experts showed expressions of astonishment.
They could never have anticipated that, under such stringent defense, a human could still break into the Secret Realm.
"Damn it!"
One of the Half-step Totem-level demons clenched his fist tightly, causing his knuckles to crack.
They had clearly laid down a Heaven and Earth Net, yet they still failed at the last moment.
However, at this moment, another Half-step Totem-level demon suddenly sneered:
"Perhaps... this is a good thing."
The other few experts immediately focused their gaze on him.
"Although it was only for a moment... I saw the Divine Pattern mark on that human’s forehead clearly."
He licked his sharp fangs, "He is the recipient of the Human Race’s first Divine Pattern!"
With these words, the demon experts immediately had a glint in their eyes.
The plan to seize the first Divine Pattern had previously failed, and now the opponent was delivered right to their doorstep...
Why refuse a delivered Divine Pattern?
Besides...
Having entered the Secret Realm, can this human really obtain the second Divine Pattern?
It’s known that the demon elites who entered the Secret Realm this time are all carefully selected peak Commander-level powerhouses.
And moreover...
The demons have a terrifying advantage:
Whenever a companion falls in battle, the spilled Demonic Qi can be absorbed by other demons.
No matter how powerful this human may be, after eliminating some demons, a Monarch-level being might emerge instead.
At that time, no matter how strong he may be, he won’t be able to turn the tide!
More importantly...
Even if this human were lucky enough to obtain the second Divine Pattern, how would he leave?
Earlier, they were caught off guard, and the Ghost Race’s Void Ability exploited an opportunity.
But this time, they have prepared thoroughly.
If this human tries to repeat his trick, it’s an impossible feat!
The moment the entrance to the Divine Secret Realm reopens.
They would thoroughly seal the space of the entrance.
By then, both Divine Patterns would inevitably fall into their hands!
...
...
At the same time.
An urgent report reached the Longxia Country command center.
"What?! Gu Xing has entered the Divine Secret Realm?!"
Long Zhenguo slammed the table, his expression turning sharply.
Verocan’s eyes widened in shock upon hearing this...
He knows better than anyone how many demon powerhouses are gathered around the perimeter of the Divine Secret Realm right now!
"How did they break through the encirclement?" Verocan murmured incredulously.
The Church Court Empress was also stunned upon hearing this news.
"Gu Xing entered the Divine Secret Realm..."
"Then the Blood Ancestor who is with Gu Xing must have also entered the Secret Realm?!"
At this moment, after quickly reviewing the information Gu Xing left behind, Long Zhenguo’s expression turned grave.
"Gu Xing stated in his message that he will definitely bring back the second Divine Pattern."
"However..."
"The demons will not let this pass and might launch a frenzied retaliation against the Human Race."
"Gu Xing suggests we immediately evacuate civilians back to Blue Star, keeping defenses only near the Void Gate."
Hearing this news, Verocan also furrowed his brows.
Though the demons are restricted from large-scale massacres of the Human Race by the rules, retaliatory attacks are inevitable.
Therefore, after urgent deliberation, the three decisively issued orders:
"Immediately execute the evacuation plan!"
"Evacuate all civilians back to Blue Star, and the entire army retreat to defend the Void Gate!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 207: Is Liu Li Hurt?
chapters.content:
Chapter 207: Chapter 207: Is Liu Li Hurt?
After passing through that brilliant golden gate, Liu Li brought Gu Xing into a stretch of primeval forest.
The vegetation here was incomparably lush, with towering ancient trees soaring over a hundred meters high, blotting out the sky and sun.
The air was filled with the damp scent of soil, mingled with the fresh fragrance unique to plants.
After setting Gu Xing down carefully, Liu Li’s body suddenly trembled.
After using the Destruction Law earlier, she could not wield the Power of Laws again for an entire month.
As a result, during the previous barrage of hundreds of Monarch Level Demon Race attacks, she had only been able to block them using her Guardian Domain and the Guardian Talent that Gu Xing had cast upon her.
Yet, although most of the attacks had been successfully blocked—
There were still...
A small portion of the attacks managed to pierce through both layers of shielding, slamming into her body.
Now that they were finally safe inside the Secret Realm, her nerves, which had been stretched to the limit, finally relaxed.
In an instant, a dizzy, spinning feeling hit her, and her long legs abruptly lost all their strength.
Seeing this, Gu Xing was quick to react, steadying her tottering form in the nick of time.
It was only then that he noticed something was off with Liu Li.
Using the physical qualities of Commander Tier Four to take on Monarch Level Demon Race attacks head-on...
Even with various buffs stacked on top of each other, bringing Liu Li’s Attributes up to 240,000 points,
These attacks had still taken quite a toll on her body.
Gu Xing gazed anxiously at Liu Li, who was breathing unevenly in his arms, hurriedly checking her stats.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Status: Infected with Demonic Qi]
[Power: 30,000]
[Constitution: 30,000]
[Spirit: 30,000]
[Speed: 30,000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form, Destruction Angel Form]
Seeing "Infected with Demonic Qi" in Liu Li’s status, Gu Xing’s brows furrowed deeply.
Getting hurt by the Demon Race, the most troublesome part wasn’t physical wounds.
But rather...
Demonic Qi would seep in through the wounds, gradually corroding them and making them impossible to heal.
And this kind of infection wouldn’t be alleviated simply by growing stronger.
Even Monarch Level powerhouses would have a hell of a time once entangled by Demonic Qi.
And Liu Li’s state right now was exactly that...
Without a moment’s hesitation, Gu Xing quickly fetched some Spring of Life water from his Beast Taming Space.
The Spring of Life had a certain suppressive effect on Demonic Qi!
"Liu Li, open up!"
Gu Xing gently laid Liu Li flat on the ground, reaching an arm around her neck,
Lifting her upper body up.
This position made a faint blush rise to Liu Li’s cheeks.
Although wounded, for her, such injuries were nothing that couldn’t be fully recovered from with a bit of rest.
Because with her Talent now at Myth Nine Stars, the effect of Demonic Qi’s corruption on her...
Was nowhere near as severe as Gu Xing imagined!
Her body had gone limp simply because she’d been forcing herself through sheer will, just to get Gu Xing safely inside the Secret Realm.
Now that she relaxed, her body hadn’t caught up yet, causing this brief moment of weakness.
However, clearly Gu Xing hadn’t realized this at all.
At this moment, a rare trace of panic flitted across his face.
Since awakening, none of his Guardian Beasts had ever been hurt.
In every battle, he’d always been able to perfectly control the field, ensuring that his team took no damage at all.
But today, something unexpected had happened...
Right then, Gu Xing suddenly realized his team was missing one crucial piece—
A healing and support-type Guardian Beast!
If he had a healing-type Guardian Beast, not only could injuries be rapidly healed, but the Demonic Qi inside her could be purified as well.
If that had been the case, Liu Li’s wounds would have already been as good as new.
"Master, I’m really okay!"
Liu Li nestled in Gu Xing’s warm embrace, feeling the security of her master’s powerful arms, a faint pink flush appearing on her fair cheeks.
She instinctively leaned her face a little closer to Gu Xing’s chest, letting her silver hair drape down lightly.
Gu Xing looked down at Liu Li’s blushing face in his arms, his heart tightening with worry.
He mistakenly assumed this was a sign her wounds were worsening, and completely lost his cool.
Almost immediately, Gu Xing summoned Vera.
"Vera, bring out some more Spring of Life. Liu Li’s injuries look really serious."
Vera crossed her arms, staring at "weak and feeble" Liu Li snuggled in Gu Xing’s embrace, her lips twitching involuntarily.
As a Natural Spirit, she was extremely sensitive to Life Energy fluctuations.
And in this moment, the Life Energy inside Liu Li hadn’t dropped at all.
This didn’t look like someone seriously injured in the slightest!
With the Angel Race’s impressive healing, these minor wounds would probably be gone after a good nap.
Right now, this sly angel was just sticking to her master’s side—
All because she wanted to enjoy the warmth of his hug!
But for now, she couldn’t be bothered to expose this little act.
"Master, actually, putting Liu Li in the Spring of Life’s springhead would make her recover much faster," Vera said with perfect seriousness, talking total nonsense.
Upon hearing Vera’s suggestion, Liu Li’s body in Gu Xing’s arms clearly stiffened for a moment.
If she went back to the Beast Taming Space, how could she keep staying with her master?
Liu Li straightened up abruptly and blurted,
"Master, I’m really fine, let me stay by your side."
"There are still hundreds of Demon Race members lurking—only with me by your side can I feel at ease."
But at this point, Gu Xing was completely unwilling to listen to Liu Li’s plea.
Gazing with pity at the angel in his arms, his tone was unyielding:
"Liu Li, be good. Go back to the Beast Taming Space and get proper rest first."
With a thought, Qing Shuang’s slender figure appeared by Gu Xing’s side as well.
"Besides, with Vera and Qing Shuang here, nothing will go wrong!"
Gu Xing spoke as he turned to his two Guardian Beasts.
The pair exchanged a meaningful glance, nodding in perfect unison.
Although their strength was indeed not on par with Liu Li’s, dealing with a few Commander Peak Demon Race members would be no problem at all.
Liu Li tilted her little face up, casting aggrieved glances between Vera and Qing Shuang, her pink lips parting as if to say something, but in the end, she kept her mouth shut sulkily.
No way she could admit right now that her fragile act had been completely faked, right?
Ultimately, even though a thousand protests raged in her heart, Liu Li still obediently followed her master’s command, transforming into a streak of flowing light and returning to the Beast Taming Space.
Watching his little angel finally head off to rest and recuperate, Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction at last.
Then, Gu Xing raised his hand to summon Fei Yue.
Even though Fei Yue already possessed plenty of combat strength, already there were enough fighting Guardian Beasts in his party—for now Fei Yue’s greatest function was still reconnaissance!
"Fei Yue, immediately search for any traces of the Demon Race!"
"Understood!"
Fei Yue replied crisply, her form dissolving into a shadow that melted into the Void, as if she’d never existed at all.
Watching Fei Yue disappear, Gu Xing set his gaze back on Vera and Qing Shuang.
"Now, our goal is clear..."
"Wipe out every Demon Race member in this Secret Realm!"
This period of time, under Lilith’s training,
He’d achieved a qualitative leap in his control over both Domains.
Now, at last, he could fearlessly absorb the Energy from slaying Demon Race members, and raise his Level!
This Secret Realm housed hundreds of Commander Level Demon Race—it was practically a natural hunting ground!
Vera and Qing Shuang both caught the chill in Gu Xing’s tone, the same glint appearing in their own eyes.
Both of them had been stuck at Commander Tier Four for a while—it was high time for a breakthrough.
Inside the Beast Taming Space.
The Spring of Life sparkled with a faint, crystalline glow.
Liu Li was soaking entirely in its waters, her silver hair flowing across the surface like a silk ribbon.
She hugged her knees with both arms, her delicate chin resting on them, occasionally blowing a stray lock of hair from her forehead, her face full of gloom.
Lilith reclined on a branch of the Tree of Life, watching this scene with a slight shake of her head.
Possessing Monarch Tier Five strength that far surpassed the limits of the Secret Realm, for now she could only stay behind in the Beast Taming Space.
"Tsk, tsk, tsk..."
"A top-tier angel, sulking over something so petty."
Lounging against the trunk, her expression was tinged with a bit of world-weary detachment.
"As expected, love really does make people lose their heads."
"Not like me..."
"No desires, no distractions! My only focus is on getting stronger!"
Yet as soon as the words left her mouth, Lilith suddenly froze.
She just remembered—didn’t she herself initially approach Gu Xing out of some inexplicable sense of fondness?
"Ahem..."
Lilith gave a slightly awkward cough, a trace of pink flooding her pale cheeks.
Nearly forgot myself there!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 208: Something’s Off About the Divine Secret Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 208: Chapter 208: Something’s Off About the Divine Secret Realm!
The outside world.
Vera suddenly turned around in alarm.
She sensed a large mass of Demonic Qi approaching.
"Master! A large amount of Demonic Qi is rapidly approaching!"
Upon hearing Vera’s warning, Gu Xing immediately instructed Vera and Qing Shuang to prepare.
Although the strength of both guardian beasts had already touched the threshold of Monarch Level,
they still needed to proceed cautiously when facing a large number of Commander Level demons.
In no time, over ten shadowy figures broke through the dense forest. They were all Commander Peak demons.
They were originally rushing at full speed to the site of the Divine Pattern formation at the center of the secret realm, but unexpectedly encountered Gu Xing and his group along the way.
"Humans?! How could there be humans in the Divine Secret Realm?"
"Impossible! The rules of the secret realm make it impossible for living beings to survive here for long!"
"Could they have come from the outside? But with the Demon King guarding the entrance, how could anyone breach the defenses?"
The demons looked at each other, unable to ascertain Gu Xing’s identity for the moment.
Suddenly, a demon in the group spoke up:
"Could it be... something happened outside after we entered the secret realm?"
Although this group of demons was full of doubt about Gu Xing’s presence, they did not see him as a threat at all.
In their eyes, any creature capable of entering the secret realm must possess power at the Commander Level.
And they were over ten demons at Commander Peak!
How could this human possibly be a match for them?!
"No matter who you are, today you must die!"
Gu Xing’s gaze swept over the demons calmly, his system panel capturing all their information in an instant.
A uniform array of Demon General Level (Epic Quality) demons.
If an ordinary Tier Four Beast Master were to encounter such a lineup, they would surely turn and flee.
But standing here was the number one ultimate Beast Master of the Human Race!
All Myth Level guardian beasts!
In addition to two major talents and two major domains!
"Vera, Qing Shuang." Gu Xing’s voice was as cold as ice, "Leave no alive."
As soon as he finished speaking, two dazzling lights burst forth.
"Elf Monarchy!"
Vera crossed her hands in front of her chest, a green crown appearing on her forehead, and a green Divine Ring manifesting behind her.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
Qing Shuang was enveloped in black Ghost Qi, and her formerly delicate features bore ferocious Ghost Patterns.
Both guardian beasts activated their most powerful forms.
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth 5 Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 20000]
[Constitution: 20000]
[Spirit: 30000→90000]
[Speed: 20000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, Natural Domain]
...
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Talent: Myth 5 Stars]
[Power: 25000→37500]
[Constitution: 22000→33000]
[Spirit: 21000→31500]
[Speed: 22000→33000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
Compared to Liu Li, the attributes of the two guardian beasts were significantly lower.
However, compared to these Commander Level demons...
Vera and Qing Shuang’s attributes were overwhelmingly dominant!
For a quick victory, they even activated the "Absolute Forbidden Domain"!
As an invisible ripple spread out, this group of demons couldn’t even use their domains!
From then on, this group of demons became mere lambs to the slaughter.
A one-sided massacre ensued.
A quarter of an hour later, only the lingering Demonic Qi on the battlefield attested to the demons’ previous presence.
With the last demon’s fall, Gu Xing’s level finally broke through the long-stalled Commander Tier Four.
He reached Commander Tier Five!
Vera and Qing Shuang’s levels also increased, their strength progressing to a higher level.
After dealing with this group of demons, Gu Xing planned to lead his guardian beasts to the center of the secret realm.
The Divine Pattern was there, and arriving first would allow them to ambush the gathering demons at their leisure.
However...
Vera suddenly spoke up:
"Master, there’s a place... that seems to have some connection to the Elf Race!"
"Hmm?"
Hearing this, Gu Xing turned around in surprise, meeting Vera’s gaze.
Could the Divine Secret Realm be connected to the Elf Race?
Vera nodded.
After entering the secret realm earlier, she felt something familiar...
But she didn’t dare confirm it.
Now, after utilizing the Power of Nature within her, she discovered that the secret realm contained a place that had been constantly drawing her.
Realizing this, she immediately conveyed her feelings to Gu Xing.
Upon hearing this news, Gu Xing also frowned slightly.
It seemed the original plan needed changing!
"Vera, lead the way! Let’s go check out the place you sensed!"
After all, the formation of the Divine Pattern would take some time, and they could use that time to explore what lay there.
With Gu Xing’s agreement, Vera immediately led him to the place she’d sensed.
Along the way, they encountered many demons.
But in front of Vera and Qing Shuang, these demons had no power to resist whatsoever.
Soon, a majestic Divine Hall enveloped by ancient restrictions appeared before them.
Gu Xing’s pupils contracted slightly...
The design of this Divine Hall was remarkably similar to the buildings he’d seen during trials after his awakening!
Vera closed her eyes, focusing her perception for a moment before saying:
"Master, it seems to be a place of inheritance left by the Elf Race..."
Just then, the restriction shrouding the hall responded to Vera’s pure Natural Qi, rippling like water and revealing an entrance just wide enough for one person to pass through.
Exchanging a knowing glance with Vera, Gu Xing was the first to step into the Divine Hall.
As soon as his foot landed, an ethereal and distant voice echoed within the hall:
"Welcome to the Elven Race’s sacred inheritance ground, Trial Taker. Pass the tests to obtain the supreme inheritance of the Elven Race!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing couldn’t help but twitch the corners of his mouth.
Elven inheritance?
What a joke!
The princess of the Elf Clan was right beside him!
If anyone was to claim the Elven inheritance, who could be more legitimate than her?
Vera showed the same confusion, her delicate brows furrowed tightly.
Indeed, the Elf Empress had set up several inheritance grounds in the outside world to store the keys to opening the Elf Secret Realm.
But this Divine Hall before him...
Something was evidently wrong!
Gu Xing and Vera exchanged a glance.
If this wasn’t a trial set by the Elf Empress, then...
Take a shortcut!
If it had been in the past when his strength was insufficient, he might have obediently taken the trial.
But now...
"Vera, are you sure there’s another restriction under the ground?"
"Yes! That’s how the Elf Race’s trials work! You have to pass the trial to activate it."
Gu Xing let out a cold laugh and gave Qing Shuang a glance.
The latter immediately understood, her body erupting with Netherworld Ghost Qi.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
"Heaven-Breaking!"
[Power: 37500→112500]
With the support of Ghost King’s Body and Heaven-Breaking, Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute soared, nearly reaching the level Liu Li achieved when activating the Destruction Angel Form.
This power completely surpassed the Commander Level, officially stepping into the Monarch Level domain!
Qing Shuang’s cold eyes locked onto the ground of the Divine Hall, veins bulging on her slender arm.
"Boom——!!!"
With a deafening crash, Qing Shuang’s heavy fist struck the ground fiercely.
The entire Divine Hall trembled violently, the exquisite floor tiles shattering like fragile glass, revealing the ancient rune-illuminated restrictive light screen beneath.
Through this transparent restriction, Gu Xing could clearly see the items inside, his eyes widening suddenly!
[Earth Marrow]
[Quality: Myth Level]
[Function: Enhance the talent of the Natural Spirit Clan]
The final material for Vera’s talent enhancement...
It was here!
However, Lilith in the Beast Taming Space frowned tightly when she saw this scene.
She keenly sensed something was amiss...
This so-called Divine Secret Realm seemed a bit off!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 209: Void Domain!
chapters.content:
Chapter 209: Chapter 209: Void Domain!
Lilith stared at the scene outside, her blood-red pupils narrowing slightly.
A nameless sense of discord lingered in her mind, yet she couldn’t pinpoint exactly what was wrong.
In the end, she could only bite her lip gently and bury her doubts deep within her heart.
Gu Xing now stood before the restriction, the Breaking Realm Blade shimmering with a starlike radiance in his palm.
As soon as this Angel Race treasure appeared, the surrounding restriction runes quivered violently, as if encountering their natural enemy.
"Open!"
With a casual swipe of the blade’s tip, the space was sliced open as neatly as silk.
After a thorough check, confirming that there was no danger within the restriction.
Only then did Gu Xing step decisively inside.
When the amber crystal, shimmering with the Power of Earth Origin, came into view, Gu Xing’s breathing grew heavy.
Liu Li had advanced from Myth Five Stars to Myth Nine Stars...
He was acutely aware of how massive that rise in power was!
And Vera’s advancement materials...
[Heart of Nature, Spring of Life, Earth Marrow]
Of the three, he had already obtained the Heart of Nature long ago in Longxia’s National Treasure Vault.
Spring of Life was already in his Beast Taming Space.
As for the last one—Earth Marrow...
It was right before his eyes!
Vera was just one step away from reaching Myth Nine Stars!
But...
Gu Xing’s outstretched hand suddenly froze in midair.
Everything was going far too smoothly—it was unsettling!
He’d just entered the Secret Realm, sensed the Divine Hall, and inside was conveniently the very last key material, almost as if the whole thing was meticulously staged.
But when he touched the Earth Marrow and felt its profound, pure energy fluctuation, he couldn’t help but shake his head with a soft laugh.
The Divine Secret Realm had existed for tens of thousands of years—who could possibly lay out such a scheme across time itself?
Besides, the system’s identification was never wrong:
"Looks like I was overthinking it."
Gu Xing finally grasped the Earth Marrow solidly, its earthy-yellow glow inside the crystal flickering across his face.
"Vera, prepare for your advancement!"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, Vera’s emerald eyes erupted into dazzling brilliance.
Her slender fingers unconsciously clenched her clothes, her chest rising and falling sharply.
Finally... it was her turn!
Watching Liu Li’s talent rise from Myth Five Stars to Myth Nine Stars...
To say she wasn’t envious... would have been a lie!
But she understood Liu Li’s place in Gu Xing’s heart.
Neither she nor Qing Shuang could compare!
So, as she saw Liu Li advance, she could only quietly bury that trace of envy inside.
And now...
The chance for talent advancement was finally hers!
Qing Shuang, watching this scene, also showed a glimmer of envy in her eyes.
Now, of Gu Xing’s three main combat guardian beasts, Liu Li and Vera would both reach Myth Nine Stars in talent—only she was left...
But she shook her head slightly and banished the thought from her mind.
She believed with certainty that Gu Xing would never leave her as the only one without talent advancement!
Yet...
Just as Gu Xing was about to follow the system prompt for advancement, his movements suddenly stalled.
Something was off!
He kept trying to combine the three materials as instructed, but the expected energy resonance never appeared.
Earth Marrow, Heart of Nature, Spring of Life—they lay quietly in his hand, like ordinary objects, utterly inert.
"How could this be?"
Gu Xing frowned deeply, unconsciously tracing the smooth surface of the Earth Marrow with his finger tips.
Could it be the rules of the Divine Secret Realm restricting things?
Unable to advance within the realm itself?!
Gu Xing’s brow furrowed. He mulled it over for a long time, but still couldn’t find why Vera’s advancement was blocked.
In the end, he could only take a deep breath and solemnly stow the glowing materials back in his Space Ring.
Looks like he’d have to wait until he left the Secret Realm to try again!
Just then, Fei Yue’s figure appeared like a phantom, emerging from the void.
"Master, all the Demon Race forces are converging at the center of the Secret Realm!"
Fei Yue’s urgent voice made Gu Xing’s gaze sharpen instantly.
He made a snap decision:
"Lead the way! We head to the heart of the Secret Realm—now!"
Gu Xing now had a clear goal in mind.
Whether it was seizing the Divine Pattern or leveling up through hunting Demon Race, both needed to happen!
Once he reached Monarch Level, he could take Liu Li back to the Angel Race in full force.
Back at the Ghost Race, when Liu Li saw Qing and Qing Shuang and Fei Yue reunite, Gu Xing noticed the worry in Liu Li’s eyes.
She was worried about her kin!
Achieving Monarch Level and heading for the Angel Race to save the Blazing Angels...
That was something Gu Xing had promised Liu Li long ago.
He definitely wouldn’t forget!
And since their route would take them right by the Qingqiu Race, he could also discuss a possible alliance with them on the way.
Soon, with Fei Yue leading, the group reached the very heart of the Secret Realm.
Before their eyes.
A soaring gold restriction covered the entire center region like a heavenly veil.
The restriction wasn’t yet gone, meaning the Divine Pattern still hadn’t fully formed.
Outside the barrier, the Demon Race army had already massed in dark, dense ranks.
Gu Xing made a quick sweep—at least three hundred Monarch-Peak Demon Race leaders had come, their surging Demonic Qi dyeing half the sky dark purple.
The situation was even trickier than he’d thought...
Qing Shuang and Vera had both broken through to Commander Tier Five, their power soaring.
But against so many strong foes, a rash attack...
Gu Xing’s gaze lingered for a moment on his two guardian beasts...
They could strike hard, but lacked Liu Li’s absolute defense.
Once caught by Demon Race swarm, the consequences would be dire.
He had to whittle down their numbers first!
After considering for a moment, Gu Xing’s eyes settled on Fei Yue.
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Four]
[Power: 20000]
[Constitution: 20000]
[Spirit: 20000]
[Speed: 20000]
[Skills: Instant Flash, Voidification, Void Cutting, Void Domain]
Fei Yue’s attributes weren’t as impressive as Qing Shuang or Vera—just 20,000 points!
But...
Gu Xing focused on Fei Yue’s skill panel.
[Void Domain: Within a set area, directly drag the enemy into the void]
This skill wasn’t about attack or defense—it had one crucial trait: near-perfect concealment.
"Fei Yue, try activating Void Domain and pull a Demon Race member into the void."
With Gu Xing’s prompt, Fei Yue unleashed Void Domain.
In the next moment.
Amid the vast Demon Race hordes, one figure abruptly vanished.
Except for the few nearby Demon Race members who noticed, no one else realized the disappearance.
In the void.
This Demon Race member stared at the sudden change in scenery.
Eyes full of surprise.
But seeing Gu Xing and his allies in the void, wariness flashed over instantly.
"Human?!"
Then glanced around the illusion realm.
And realized instantly that this was the human’s doing!
Gu Xing shot Qing Shuang a glance.
For Fei Yue, trapping the Demon Race member in Void Domain depended on that enemy having no active domain.
If he did activate his domain, Void Domain’s effectiveness would plummet.
And could even alert the others!
So Gu Xing signaled Qing Shuang to strike right away.
"Heaven-Breaking!"
With her sky-high stats, Qing Shuang sprang into action.
Plus, within Void Domain, thanks to the Twin Contract, Qing Shuang could tap Fei Yue’s void abilities.
In a flash, Qing Shuang appeared before the Demon Race member.
"Boom!"
With just a punch, the Demon’s head exploded completely.
With a successful first attempt, the rest was simple.
Just keep using Fei Yue’s domain to pull the Demon Race members into the void one by one and hunt them down.
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 210: The False World!
chapters.content:
Chapter 210: Chapter 210: The False World!
As time passed, the Demon Race army finally grew restless.
"What’s going on? Why have some demons disappeared? Even the traces of Demonic Qi have been completely wiped out!"
The surrounding demons immediately became alert at these words.
Soon, more anomalies were discovered:
"It seems so. At least dozens of demons have disappeared during this period!"
"Damn it! Is this some kind of rejection from the Divine Pattern against our Demon Race?"
"Everyone stay vigilant, don’t let your guard down for a second!"
The nerves of all Demon Race Commanders instantly stretched to the limit.
The air was thick with suffocating tension—even the Demonic Qi seemed to freeze.
If this keeps up, none of them will get out alive!
Once these Commander-level demons got serious, they too sensed the unusual signs.
A faint ripple of Void Power swept by, and in the next moment...
A demon vanished in an instant.
The group of demons instantly realized the cause behind the previous disappearances.
"It’s the Ghost Race! It’s the Ghost Race’s Void Power!"
"And this presence—it’s a Domain!"
Now they understood.
The Demon Commanders instantly deployed their Domain Defenses. In a flash, hundreds of dark purple energy screens blanketed the entire area.
Although the talent of these demons was average, their Commander Peak strength was not to be underestimated.
"Boom!"
Hundreds of Domain Powers intertwined, forming an impenetrable defense net.
The moment Fei Yue’s Void Power crashed into this "wall," it was violently repelled like hitting an Iron Wall.
Tsk... this won’t work!
Gu Xing narrowed his eyes, staring at the Demon Army lined up in battle formation in the distance.
After this period of hunting, the Demon Race numbers had been slashed from over three hundred to less than two hundred.
"Drop the disguise, Fei Yue. From here on... we change tactics."
As Fei Yue removed her Void Concealment, the four of them suddenly appeared in full view of the demons.
When the Demons saw their enemies clearly, the previous fear instantly twisted into ferocious killing intent.
Fear is born of the unknown.
But standing before them now...
Was not the unknown!
A Human, an Elf, two from the Ghost Race!
Though the Elf Race and Ghost Race are top-tier Races in the Alternate Space, and the two Guardian Beasts radiated an unusual aura...
But still...
There were two hundred Commander Peak demons left here!
With such numbers, even if they just piled in, they’d crush these two Guardian Beasts to death by sheer force.
"So the one behind the trickery is this Beast Master! Kill him!"
"Yeah, kill him! Eliminate this human and his Guardian Beasts."
"Just one person—how dare he appear before us? Overconfident fool."
Nearly a hundred Commander Peak demons flared their Demonic Qi at once, dark purple energy weaving in the air to form a Demon King phantom towering a hundred meters high.
That shadow looked down at Gu Xing’s group, letting out an earth-shaking roar:
"Kill! Crush this ant!"
Yet, facing this terrifying display, neither Vera nor Qing Shuang even furrowed a brow.
"Elf Monarchy!"
Vera called out, a green Divine Ring unfolding slowly behind her.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
Ghost Qi surged around Qing Shuang, her delicate features now marked with sinister Ghost Patterns.
Both Guardian Beasts unleashed their strongest forms.
And Gu Xing, facing this situation, activated his own Talent as well.
"Soul-devouring!"
With the boost from these States, the two Guardian Beasts’ strength soared to the peak.
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Five]
[Power: 25,000→50,000]
[Constitution: 25,000→50,000]
[Spirit: 38,000→228,000]
[Speed: 25,000→50,000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, Natural Domain]
Vera’s level advanced to Commander Tier Five, instantly pushing her Spiritual Attribute past 38,000 points.
Now, with the blessing of Elf Monarchy and Soul Devouring Talent, Vera’s Spirit Attribute shot straight to 228,000 points.
This was fully comparable to Monarch Level!
While Qing Shuang...
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Five]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 35,000→105,000]
[Constitution: 30,000→90,000]
[Spirit: 21,000→63,000]
[Speed: 28,000→84,000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
Breaking through to Commander Tier Five, Qing Shuang’s Power Attribute reached 35,000.
Although with the boost from Ghost King’s Body and Soul Devouring Talent, her Strength Attribute only just broke through 100,000...
But...
Ghost Race Third Technique: Heaven-Breaking!
This skill could triple her Strength Attribute!
Fueled by that skill...
Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute blasted right past 300,000!
And as for these Commander-level demons...
Even if you added the boost from their Demonic Qi, there was no way their attributes could even come close to breaking 100,000 points.
So, against Vera and Qing Shuang, these demons posed zero threat.
"Natural Lament!"
Vera was a Guardian Beast specialized in area attacks.
Handling a scenario like this was nothing to her.
And Qing Shuang wasn’t idle either—any demon who tried to attack Vera...
Was all blown apart with a single punch!
Vera crossed her hands before her chest, dazzling lightning madly gathering in her palms.
The sky above instantly darkened, storm clouds roiling as a lightning dragon a hundred meters long took shape overhead...
Every single scale was carved in sharp detail, each one blazing with dazzling arcs!
Spirit Attribute at 200,000—fully unleashed!
This was a power far more terrifying than ever before. Space itself twisted and trembled the moment the Thunder Dragon appeared.
"Th-this is...?"
The demons stared up at the dragon circling overhead—finally, real terror flashed in their blood-red eyes.
They could taste death on the Thunder Dragon’s approach.
"Defend with everything you’ve got! Hurry!"
The lead Demon Commander roared, his voice changing pitch in desperation.
All the demons frantically pushed their Demonic Qi, dark purple energy surging overhead to form a barrier dozens of meters thick—a black dome slamming down over their entire army.
But when Vera saw that shield, her lips curled with scorn.
"Azure Sky Thunderfall!"
In a heartbeat, the Thunder Dragon let out a world-shaking roar, then plunged as a torrent of lightning that split the sky and earth!
Blinding white light swallowed the entire Demon encampment, and the explosion’s shockwave ripped trees from the ground for miles around.
"BOOM——!!!"
After the titanic blast faded, it was as if the world was muted.
The barrier, constructed desperately by hundreds of demons, was laughably fragile before the Thunder Dragon.
"Crack!"
The first fracture appeared. In that instant, the demons’ bloodlust turned to frozen horror.
"Crack! Crack!"
Spiderweb veins raced across the shield, spreading in the blink of an eye.
The Demon Commanders stared up in despair, watching their last hope...
"Bang——!!"
The barrier exploded, scattering into millions of shards of black light.
The Thunder Dragon roared on, its destructive force smashing straight into the heart of the Demon army!
Blinding white light erased everything.
When the light faded, nothing remained on the ground where the demons once stood but charred earth.
Nearly a hundred Commander-level demons—gone in a flash, not even a scream left, annihilated by divine lightning from above.
But Gu Xing suddenly narrowed his eyes.
Just now, was that...?
The instant Vera unleashed her ultimate attack, he had caught the faintest oddity.
This world, for a split second, seemed to freeze!
That tiny abnormality—he sensed it.
And at once, he realized something was off.
This world...
Seems... fake!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 211: Commander Tier Nine!
chapters.content:
Chapter 211: Chapter 211: Commander Tier Nine!
Gu Xing’s pupils slightly contracted as his mind swiftly connected all the anomalies:
Vera’s mysterious sensing of the Elf Divine Hall, the eerily smooth Secret Realm exploration, the momentary world lag just now...
This world is odd!
He crouched down, his fingertips rubbing across the scorched soil.
Scorching heat, pungent burnt smell, ash drifting in the wind...
All sensory feedback is remarkably real.
The energy fluctuation emitted by the Divine Rune Restriction in the distance definitely isn’t fake!
What’s going on?!
But before Gu Xing could think more, a torrent of energy surged forth!
The death of hundreds of Peak Commander-level Demon Race members generated a hugely potent energy!
"Ugh—"
Gu Xing hadn’t reacted yet when he let out a groan, feeling every cell within him boiling.
His level was rapidly climbing due to this energy surge.
Commander Tier Six... breakthrough!
Commander Tier Seven... breakthrough!
...
Not only him, all Guardian Beasts were simultaneously evolving:
Vera’s Spiritual Attribute grew stronger!
Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute also transformed even more terrifyingly.
Fei Yue’s mastery over the void became more adept!
Even Liu Li in the Beast Taming Space, upon receiving this power, saw all attributes soaring.
In the next moment...
The rampant energy tides gradually calmed, and Gu Xing slowly opened his eyes.
The surging power within him reached unprecedented heights...
Peak Commander Tier Nine!
Just a step away from the Monarch Level!
Fei Yue, Qing Shuang, and the other Guardian Beasts simultaneously reached Peak Commander Tier Nine!
However, even after helping Gu Xing and four Guardian Beasts break through, the energy obtained from killing the Demon Race was not yet depleted.
Remaining energy flowed silently like a trickle towards a corner of the Beast Taming Space...
There, a cat-eared girl lay quietly sleeping in the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Pure energy was gently seeping into her slender body, causing her furry ears to twitch from time to time.
And all of this, Gu Xing was completely unaware of.
Liu Li in the Beast Taming Space was fully focused on enhancing herself, equally oblivious.
Only Lilith, her blood-red eyes unwaveringly fixed on that mysterious energy, watching it infuse Sally’s body.
In fact, Lilith discovered this special presence the day she entered the Beast Taming Space.
But each time she wanted to inquire, the words were swallowed back.
To appear in Gu Xing’s most private Beast Taming Space without being contracted...
Even if not his Guardian Beast, she must be extremely important.
At this moment.
The water in the Soul Nourishing Pool rippled slightly under the nourishment of the energy.
Then, an ancient and vast aura surged from Sally’s body, instantly filling the entire Beast Taming Space.
Lilith’s pupils contracted sharply, her centuries of accumulated composure crumbling at that moment.
Under the pressure of this ancient aura, she felt like she was back to her inexperienced self.
Fortunately, it all vanished quickly.
The horrifying aura soon dissipated, ebbing back into Sally’s body, and the Beast Taming Space returned to its usual calm.
Only the gently rippling pool water proved that what had just happened was not an illusion.
At this moment, Liu Li happened to open her eyes.
She stared puzzledly at the unusually expressive Lilith.
This experienced Blood Ancestor showed a rare expression of shock, sparking Liu Li’s curiosity.
What could have happened to affect the Blood Ancestor’s thoughts?
"Lilith, are you okay?"
Concerned for her companion, Liu Li asked with care.
Lilith snapped out of it, her gaze lingering on Liu Li’s face for a moment.
She hesitated briefly but ultimately didn’t mention the change in the Soul Nourishing Pool.
This Cat Girl’s identity, she believed Gu Xing was surely aware of.
"I’m fine!"
Lilith replied casually, but as she turned, she sneaked a glance at the direction of the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Meanwhile.
The demons before the restriction were thoroughly eradicated.
Now just awaiting the second Divine Rune to complete its final formation, this Divine Secret Realm exploration could conclude successfully.
At this moment, the restrictions outside the Divine Rune also started to dissipate slowly.
This signified that the Divine Rune was about to appear!
Realizing this, Gu Xing could only suppress his doubts for now.
He had to deliberate on securing the Divine Rune and how to break through the Demon Race blockade outside.
Fortunately, after the Secret Realm trials, several Guardian Beasts leaped from initial Commander Tier Five to Commander Tier Nine, greatly increasing their strength.
Breaking through any blockade by those Half-Step Totem-level Demon Race members would allow leveraging Fei Yue’s Void Power to retreat fully.
With this thought, Gu Xing refocused on the nearly vanished restrictions.
By now, the restrictions were almost completely gone.
"Buzz——!!"
An invisible energy ripple suddenly swept through the entire Secret Realm.
Perceiving this fluctuation, Gu Xing’s gaze immediately centered on the Secret Realm’s core.
There, a dazzling golden Divine Pattern was radiating brilliant light, with intricate runes flowing within its lines.
Glancing around, confirming there were no enemies left, Gu Xing steadily advanced towards the Divine Pattern.
[Human Race Divine Pattern]
[Quality: ???]
[Composition: Condensation of Human Race Qi]
As his fingertip gently touched the Divine Pattern, it turned into a streak of light and merged into Gu Xing’s body, flowing through his meridians straight to the Beast Taming Space.
Simultaneously, above the Secret Realm, a golden portal slowly opened, casting a dazzling light beam, as if silently urging him to leave quickly.
Gu Xing’s gaze once again scanned the entire Secret Realm space.
No anomalies detected.
"Master, should we prepare to leave now?"
Vera spoke to Gu Xing, her face serious.
The external Demon Race is incredibly terrifying, and she must be fully prepared.
When Gu Xing heard this, he nodded:
"Remember, the moment we go out, those Demon Race will definitely block the space."
"Our primary task is to break the spatial confinement to create an opportunity for Fei Yue to exert her Void Power."
"Got it!"
Vera and Qing Shuang answered in unison, both understanding the severity of the situation.
Even Liu Li, injured in the Beast Taming Space, was ready.
If any unexpected event occurred, she would surely act immediately.
As Gu Xing gradually approached the golden portal, even one foot stepped into it.
But just then...
His body suddenly stiffened in mid-air!
In his mind, Lilith’s urgent warning exploded loudly:
"Gu Xing! Don’t go out! Something’s wrong with this Secret Realm!"
This warning forced Gu Xing to retract his impending footstep.
He originally thought the vague feeling of unease was just a misconception.
After all, Vera, Qing Shuang, and Liu Li showed no doubts about this Secret Realm.
But now...
Lilith spoke up to alert him.
This instantly confirmed his inner suspicion.
This Divine Secret Realm, indeed, has issues!
After regaining solid ground, Gu Xing cautiously surveyed his surroundings, the sense of discord growing stronger.
Upon reflection, various abnormalities gradually surfaced:
The sunlight remained fixed at the same angle, never veering even slightly.
The breeze perpetually blew in a fixed direction, without any disorder.
The earthy fragrance lingering in the air also seemed deliberately concocted to remain unchanged.
Something’s off!
Nine parts of something off out of ten!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 213: The True Divine Pattern!
chapters.content:
Chapter 213: Chapter 213: The True Divine Pattern!
Under the deliberate search of Vera, Liu Li, and Fei Yue...
The Demon Race within the Secret Realm was being cleared at an extremely fast Speed by the three of them.
"Boom—!!"
As Qing Shuang finished off the last Demon Race member with a single punch, all the Demons in the Secret Realm were completely wiped out.
At the very moment when the final Demon was destroyed, an unexpected change occurred...
A portal once again appeared in the sky, but unlike the previous golden one, this one emitted a faint blue glow.
After discussing it with Lilith and Gu Xing carefully observing, they finally confirmed:
This was not the exit from the Secret Realm, but the passage leading to the true Divine Pattern!
Exchanging glances with several Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing didn’t hesitate and stepped straight in.
In an instant, the world spun upside down.
When his vision regained focus, the scene before Gu Xing made his breath catch.
They were standing on a mysterious platform suspended high in the sky, with clouds swirling all around them and golden light flowing beneath their feet like a river.
At the very center of the platform, a golden Divine Pattern—far more dazzling than the one seen before—was radiating breathtaking Energy Fluctuations.
As Gu Xing’s gaze landed on that dazzling Divine Pattern, he instinctively took out the "Divine Pattern" he had obtained earlier from the Beast Taming Space.
Immediately after, a wondrous sight occurred...
The Divine Pattern seemed to respond to his call, turning into a stream of light and shooting out, instantly fusing perfectly with the Divine Pattern at the heart of the platform.
And at that moment, Gu Xing understood...
No wonder the system couldn’t differentiate real from fake—the one he had gotten before truly was the genuine Divine Pattern, only it was a fragment of the complete pattern!
Remembering this, he quickly took out the Earth Marrow.
Sure enough, a chunk of brown crystal exuding dense earth-type Energy suddenly appeared in the nearby Void.
The Earth Marrow immediately resonated with it, merging together in the blink of an eye.
"So that’s how it is..." Gu Xing muttered, "Both the Divine Pattern and Earth Marrow are real!"
But as he tried to approach the two items, an even stranger phenomenon appeared.
No matter how he advanced, the distance between him and the items never shortened.
Though so close at hand, it was as if an insurmountable spatial barrier separated them.
"Gu Xing," Lilith’s voice suddenly sounded, "If you want to obtain the complete Divine Pattern, you’ll have to pass its trial first."
"Try touching it with your Spiritual Power. That should activate the challenge."
Following Lilith’s advice, Gu Xing cautiously released a shred of Spiritual Power, probing toward the floating Earth Marrow.
The moment his Spiritual Power touched the Earth Marrow, everything changed!
"Wong—"
The previously calm space began to shake violently, as thick, ink-black Demonic Qi frenziedly converged from all directions.
Gu Xing’s heart tightened, but he quickly realized.
These were the Demonic Qi leftovers from the Commander Level Demon Race members they had previously defeated in the Secret Realm, now being mysteriously condensed again by some unseen force.
Even more terrifying, the Demonic Qi was rapidly taking shape, gradually sketching out a sinister figure:
Back rising with bone-white wings, entire body covered in blood-red Demon Patterns, and vertical pupils burning with faint blue flames—a Demon Race silhouette gradually manifested.
It held a huge blade forged from Demonic Qi in its hand, and just standing there, it radiated a suffocating pressure.
[Demon Race Demon King]
[Talent: Half-Step Demon God]
[Level: Monarch Tier Five]
[Power: 150000]
[Constitution: 150000]
[Spirit: 100000]
[Speed: 150000]
[Skills: Demon King’s Body, Demon King Domain...]
Seeing the Demon King’s Attributes, Gu Xing’s brows knit slightly.
"Monarch Tier Five, Half-Step Demon God..."
He murmured in a low voice, privately feeling fortunate.
If not for the Divine Pattern’s rejection mechanism preventing Demonic Qi from condensing in the Secret Realm, with only Qing Shuang and Vera’s previous Levels...
It would have been a difficult task to handle a Demon of this magnitude.
But now...
Vera excelled in group attacks and Liu Li had yet to recover—clearly, Qing Shuang was the best fighter for this moment.
"Qing Shuang, I’ll leave this to you," Gu Xing commanded sternly.
"Understood!"
Cold glint flashed in Qing Shuang’s eyes, and intense Ghost Qi erupted around her.
"Ghost King’s Body!"
In an instant, Ghost Pattern covered her entire form.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 60000→90000]
[Constitution: 55000→82500]
[Spirit: 40000→60000]
[Speed: 54000→81000]
[Skills: Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King’s Body, Returning Ruins, Ghost King Domain]
At this moment, Qing Shuang’s Level reached Commander Tier Nine.
Her basic Strength Attribute in normal state had already broken the 60000-point threshold!
This was the limit of Commander Level Power!
And with the boost of "Ghost King’s Body," the value soared to a staggering 90000 points.
Even more frightening, this didn’t yet factor in the extra amplification from Ghost Race combat techniques and Gu Xing’s "Soul-devouring" Talent.
If she also activated the Ghost Race Third Technique "Heaven-Breaking," her Strength Attribute would triple once again, hitting a terrifying 270000 points!
Within the current team, aside from Liu Li, Vera and Qing Shuang both possessed genuine Monarch Level combat strength.
And they were far above the ordinary initial Monarch Level!
However...
The true trump card remained Liu Li.
After reaching Commander Tier Nine, she had no weaknesses in any Attributes.
Now, Liu Li...
Truly possessed the power to challenge Monarch Peak!
In this moment.
Qing Shuang locked her gaze on the Demon.
It seemed, influenced by the Divine Pattern, to lack any intelligence.
Yet...
That was no reason for Qing Shuang to show mercy to this Demon.
"Heaven-Breaking!"
The Ghost Qi swirling around Qing Shuang surged violently.
The next instant.
All of it gathered into Qing Shuang’s hands.
Her Strength Attribute climbed to 270000 points!
