The Demon sensed the threat and instinctively activated "Demon King’s Body."
[Power: 150000→300000]
[Constitution: 150000→300000]
[Spirit: 100000→200000]
[Speed: 150000→300000]
With the Demon King’s Body buff, the Demon’s stats hit 300,000 points.
Slightly higher than Qing Shuang’s!
But Gu Xing didn’t intend to step in.
After all, this Demon lacked intelligence...
That was its greatest flaw!
As the Demon finished its empowerment, Qing Shuang’s form suddenly blurred.
Relying on the bond with Fei Yue, Qing Shuang merged herself into the Void.
Her command over the Void was nothing compared to Fei Yue’s, of course.
But it was more than enough to fool a mindless Demon.
When Qing Shuang reappeared, she was already behind the Demon.
"Boom—!!"
With all her strength, she slammed a punch into the bone wing on the Demon’s back, erupting with a deafening bang.
Yet, bolstered by 300,000 points in Constitution Attribute, the Demon only staggered back a few steps.
Gu Xing, however, remained perfectly calm...
Qing Shuang possessed the Returning Ruins Skill.
[Returning Ruins: Qing Shuang’s Attributes become stronger as the battle goes on]
And a mindless Demon like this was nothing but a toy to Qing Shuang.
Its clumsy attacks couldn’t even touch her clothes, while Qing Shuang’s blows grew fiercer and fiercer.
Once Qing Shuang’s Strength Attribute finally surpassed the 300,000 mark, the tide of battle instantly turned!
Every punch left shocking cracks on the Demon’s body.
The Demon’s regeneration couldn’t keep up with the escalating wounds.
"It’s over."
With these words, Qing Shuang landed a crushing blow, striking through the Demon’s heart with pinpoint precision.
The Demon King’s body froze, and in the next moment, vanished entirely!
[Trial cleared]
[Earth Marrow acquisition qualified]
Within the Void, the chunk of Earth Marrow exuding thick earth-type Energy finally had all Restrictions lifted, floating gently before Gu Xing.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 214: Vera’s Advancement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 214: Chapter 214: Vera’s Advancement!
Looking at the Earth Marrow floating before his eyes, Gu Xing thoughtfully rubbed his chin.
"This test... isn’t it a bit too easy?"
He hadn’t even used his full strength...
He had breezed through it just relying on Qing Shuang’s own power.
If other Beast Masters heard this, they’d probably cough up three liters of blood in anger.
Normal Commander Tier Nine Beast Masters facing a Monarch Tier Five Half-Step Demon God would find themselves in an utterly hopeless situation.
Only a freak like Gu Xing would think such a test was way too easy.
Inside the Beast Taming Space, Lilith’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch a few times.
But when her gaze shifted to Liu Li, she suddenly realized something!
This Angel’s strength was already close to catching up to hers!
At this growth speed, it wouldn’t be long before Gu Xing reached a realm equal to her.
By then... maybe that’ll be the time when they truly form their Contract?
Lilith’s feelings grew suddenly complicated.
Once, she’d completely resisted the idea.
After all, she’d once been Totem Level.
Forming a Contract with Gu Xing meant binding herself to him—if Gu Xing couldn’t break through Totem Level...
It meant she’d never get the chance to reach Totem Level again!
But now...
Seeing Gu Xing showing more and more Talent, her resistance to the idea of contracting with him seemed to be fading.
Outside.
Gu Xing steadily gripped the earth-yellow crystal radiating thick Energy Fluctuations, feeling the vast Power of Earth within.
He turned to look at Vera at his side.
He finally had the real Earth Marrow.
This also meant...
Vera could finally welcome her breakthrough!
Her Myth Five Stars Talent was about to become a thing of the past.
"Vera."
[Natural Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Power: 20,000→50,000]
[Constitution: 20,000→50,000]
[Spirit: 30,000→60,000]
[Speed: 20,000→50,000]
[Skills: Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, Natural Domain]
At this moment, Vera had reached the Commander Tier Nine Peak, her Spiritual Attribute even touching the Commander limit of 60,000 points.
Although Power, Constitution, and Speed Attribute were still shy of the extremes, they’d already reached 50,000 points.
Hearing Gu Xing’s call, Vera straightened, soft green light shimmering around her.
As her Spiritual Power gathered, she dispelled the disguise she’d maintained for so long.
A brilliant green flash, and her originally petite, adorable form stretched like a sprouting branch.
In the blink of an eye, a tall, golden-haired elf beauty appeared before everyone.
"Master~"
Vera’s voice was no longer childish, but bore the sultry magnetism unique to a mature woman.
She stared at Gu Xing, her gaze unwavering.
Gu Xing took a deep breath, hesitated no longer.
He raised his hand and summoned three materials.
With their special resonance frequency, the three slowly rose, orbiting and dancing around Vera.
"It’s working!" A gleam of joy flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
This ceremony was going smoother than ever—no surprise at all.
The rotation sped up, the three energies gradually merging.
Finally, a dazzling pillar of green light descended from the heavens, enveloping Vera completely.
At the same time.
Countless verdant vines spread out from beneath Vera’s feet, weaving and winding as if alive.
First they formed a massive emerald cocoon that wrapped Vera inside, then, at swift speed, expanded outward to blanket the whole platform space.
"Thump—"
Suddenly, a clear heartbeat echoed from deep within the vine cocoon.
Gu Xing’s eyes lit up...
This was the sign of the Heart of Nature merging successfully!
With each beat, the aura at the cocoon’s core grew stronger.
Gu Xing unconsciously held his breath, a trace of anticipation sparkling in his eyes.
Last time, when Liu Li went from Myth Five Stars to Myth Nine Stars, she unlocked the Guardian Angels and Destruction Angels forms.
Now Vera was going from Myth Five Stars to Myth Nine Stars...
Gu Xing grew more and more eager to see Vera’s transformation!
At that moment, a ripple of emerald energy spread from the cocoon’s center.
Gu Xing felt his whole body lighten, days of fatigue vanishing in an instant—even his soul felt freshly purified.
Even more magically, the vines covering the platform simultaneously bloomed into thousands of flowers.
In the Beast Taming Space, Lilith stared blankly at everything unfolding outside, shock filling her crimson eyes.
Unlike Liu Li’s last breakthrough, this time she witnessed every step herself.
That abundant Life Energy, the very manifestation of Life Laws.
And all of this proved one thing.
Gu Xing really could enhance his Guardian Beasts’ Talent—and help them overcome the entire Myth Five Stars limit.
Last time with Liu Li’s transformation, she could still chalk it up to ’coincidence’, ’luck’.
But now, as Vera achieved the same miracle before her eyes, all thoughts of luck were shattered.
Her gaze involuntarily fell to Gu Xing—his upright figure now surrounded by a mysterious aura.
A crazed thought sprouted in her mind:
If... if she could receive an upgrade like this herself...
Maybe regaining her strength could wait a bit!
At this moment, Vera’s aura had soared to its peak.
The inexhaustible Life Energy swept through the space, transforming everything into a dazzling sea of flowers.
Countless blossoms bloomed in the void, then withered in an instant, playing out the Eternal Life and natural Reincarnation.
Off to the side, Fei Yue quietly sidled up to Qing Shuang and lowered her voice:
"Sis, don’t worry—Master will help you upgrade your Talent very soon~"
Hearing this, Qing Shuang twitched her lips and turned to glance at her little sister.
Since following Gu Xing, Fei Yue’s personality had really opened up—she even dared tease her now.
Qing Shuang flicked her sister’s forehead softly:
"Yue, Talent upgrades aren’t that important. Being able to stay by Master’s side is what matters most."
Fei Yue was briefly stunned by that answer.
Her impression had always been that her sister saw strength upgrades as the top priority.
But now...
Fei Yue glanced back and forth between Gu Xing and Qing Shuang, suddenly struck by understanding.
Her big sis must be in love with Master!
Except...
Her mind flashed to Liu Li and Vera.
That Angel always received Master’s special attention—competing for his favor would be tough.
And the elf could be cute or cool...
Clearly another powerful rival!
Thinking of this, Fei Yue instantly felt her sister’s chances were pitifully slim.
Her big sis was great at fighting, but when it came to romance...
Better not!
At that thought, Fei Yue suddenly felt a sacred sense of duty.
Her sister would need her help for sure!
Fei Yue swore to herself.
Once Master returned to the Human World with the Divine Pattern and awakened at the Holy Pool, she’d find a way to get him and her sister alone!
Just as Fei Yue was scheming, the Energy Fluctuation in the arena suddenly intensified.
"BOOM—!!"
A sky-piercing pillar of emerald light shot upward, the outpouring Life Energy making the entire space tremble.
Next, every single flower instantly wilted, boundless Life Force pouring into the center of the light pillar like rivers to the sea.
When the final drop of energy was absorbed, a graceful figure slowly emerged within the shining beam...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 215: Vera’s Flaw!
chapters.content:
Chapter 215: Chapter 215: Vera’s Flaw!
Bathed in shimmering green light, Vera’s figure finally unfurled in full.
Three emerald Divine Rings turned slowly behind her, radiating mysterious natural Law energy.
Completing her evolution, Vera gently opened her eyes, her jade-green pupils brimming with vitality.
She raised her hand lightly; vines entwining the space receded like a tide, turning into motes of green light that merged into her palm.
With a single step, Vera appeared right before Gu Xing.
Their distance was so close, they could feel one another’s breath.
Staring at Vera merely inches away, Gu Xing was a little dumbstruck.
"Master~"
Vera suddenly reached out with slender white fingers, lifting Gu Xing’s chin with a playful touch.
In her complete form, she was about the same height as Gu Xing. Now, hovering just a little, she could look him straight in the eyes.
Those emerald eyes gazed deep into Gu Xing’s, blazing with an unprecedented dominance:
"Do you like me like this?"
Gu Xing was momentarily at a loss for words.
He was used to Vera’s loli form, and now—faced with a suddenly full-blown big sister vibe from his elf—he didn’t know how to react.
Under Vera’s scorching gaze, he turned his head awkwardly, the tips of his ears growing faintly red.
This response made a sly smile curl at Vera’s lips.
She suddenly realized...
So Master actually finds it even harder to handle her mature form?
"Looks like I should use this form more often..."
Vera mused to herself, the amusement in her eyes growing deeper.
Watching from the side, Fei Yue’s eyes went round with shock.
She hurriedly turned, gripping Qing Shuang’s sleeve, lowering her voice anxiously:
"Sis! Why are you just standing there? Master’s being seduced by that elf!"
Qing Shuang, however, looked completely puzzled:
"Seduced? Isn’t Vera also Master’s Guardian Beast?"
Seeing her sister so clueless, Fei Yue was beside herself, stomping her feet in frustration.
She leaned in close to Qing Shuang’s ear, spelling out the stakes in the plainest terms:
"Think about it, sis! If Master gets won over by that elf, our position will plummet! All the dirty, exhausting work will be dumped on us!"
"And most importantly, if Master gets bewitched by that elf and doesn’t want us anymore, what’ll we do?"
As she spoke, Fei Yue nervously snuck glances in Vera’s direction.
The memory of being trussed up like a dumpling with vines—an extra thick, long vine shoved in her mouth—was still vivid.
If this vengeful elf overheard her badmouthing her, and with her strength now even greater...
At the thought, Fei Yue shuddered involuntarily.
But her words did stir Qing Shuang.
Though she firmly believed Gu Xing wouldn’t play favorites, that elf’s methods...
Recalling Vera’s habit of playing cute and innocent, Qing Shuang’s gaze became noticeably sharper.
"No way!"
Qing Shuang gritted her teeth inwardly, instantly making up her mind.
She couldn’t let that scheming elf succeed!
At this moment, Vera, still holding Gu Xing’s chin, let her gaze drift unconsciously to his tightly pressed lips.
A bold idea exploded in her mind...
Right now, Master seemed stunned by her new look. Why not seize the chance...
Determination flashed in her eyes; she rose slightly onto her toes, ready to act.
Inside the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li nearly blew her top at the scene before her eyes.
Her fists clenched so tight they creaked, violent Fire of Destruction bursting uncontrollably around her.
Lilith quietly scooted several steps away.
This Fire of Destruction—though she was Monarch Tier Five now—even she had to steer clear.
Still, watching Liu Li like that, she couldn’t help teasing:
"Wouldn’t you call this shooting yourself in the foot?"
If a Guardian Beast wants to leave the Beast Taming Space, Master has to give permission.
But Liu Li had deliberately played injured before, which led to...
Gu Xing straight up forbidding Liu Li to leave the Beast Taming Space at all while in the Secret Realm.
Which is exactly why Liu Li could only sit stewing, watching that elf try to get handsy.
"You!"
Liu Li spun around, golden eyes blazing with rage.
But seeing Lilith wisely raise her hands in surrender, Liu Li turned her gaze back to the outside at once.
One look just made her angrier!
That damned elf—she was trying to steal Master’s first kiss?!
"Boom—!"
Raging Fire of Destruction rushed through the Beast Taming Space in a storm.
Lilith hastily erected a blood-red shield for cover, deeply alarmed:
Liu Li’s power in rage mode...
Terrifying!
But the Tree of Life in the center of Beast Taming Space was suffering most of all.
Under the onslaught of Fire of Destruction, it had to curl its branches into a ball, frantically releasing Life Energy to build a shield, trembling as it weathered the disaster...
Outside.
A chill suddenly raced up Vera’s spine—making her whole body shiver.
But right now, she was totally bewitched by Gu Xing’s stunning beauty...
The arrow’s already drawn—it’s gotta be let loose!
Just as she closed her eyes, inching ever closer to Gu Xing—
"Pa!"
A crisp sound—a hand suffused with Ghost Qi suddenly blocked right between her and Gu Xing.
When Vera’s lips touched that chilling patch of skin, she snapped her eyes open.
Qing Shuang was shaking out her hand with a look of pure disgust, a faint water mark still on the back.
The sudden twist snapped Gu Xing out of it, too.
He finally realized he’d almost been... forcibly kissed by his own Guardian Beast?!
And Vera was acting even bolder than ever today—totally at odds with how she usually behaved.
Gu Xing quickly pulled up the system panel:
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars → Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: In Heat (Defect in Heart of Nature)]
[Power: 50,000 → 60,000 (MAX)]
[Constitution: 50,000 → 60,000 (MAX)]
[Spirit: 60,000 → 80,000 (MAX)]
[Speed: 50,000 → 60,000 (MAX)]
[Skills: Life Spirit (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law)]
Staring at Vera’s Attributes, Gu Xing felt slightly distracted.
The biggest shock—right there in her Status column were the bold words: ’In Heat’!
Even though Vera kept a humanoid form, Guardian Beasts did have this kind of biological cycle.
Gu Xing was certainly aware of this.
When he’d checked out Heart of Nature earlier, the system had noted this material had a ’minor defect’...
But it had clearly stated it wouldn’t affect the Talent upgrade effect, so he hadn’t thought much of it.
He hadn’t expected that the "side effect" would be Vera entering heat early!
Looking more closely at the system notes, Gu Xing finally breathed easier.
This status only amplifies Vera’s emotional impulses, especially in close interactions, causing her to act out of bounds—but it won’t cause any real harm.
Now Gu Xing understood—Vera’s weird behavior earlier...
Must’ve been triggered by the heat-cycle defect!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 216: Battling Yourself?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 216: Chapter 216: Battling Yourself?!
After confirming this special state, Gu Xing’s gaze turned to Vera’s brand-new attribute panel.
Power, Constitution, Speed—these three formerly weak attributes had all broken through to the 60,000-point threshold!
This was already the limit of the Commander level!
As for the Spiritual Attribute...
It had directly surpassed 60,000 points, reaching a terrifying 80,000 points!
At present, purely in terms of Spiritual Attribute, even Liu Li was completely no match for Vera!
And apart from various attributes...
Vera’s skills had also been completely renewed!
[Life Spirit: Upon activating this form, Spiritual Attribute is increased by 400%, and skills like Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, and Life Blooming consume half the usual energy]
[Reincarnation: Vera can complete a transformation through manipulating her own Life Energy’s budding, growing, and withering stages. Each complete cycle results in a qualitative leap in strength (current stage: Budding)]
[Life Law: Can start to invoke the Power of Life Law]
Similar to Liu Li’s Destruction Angel and Guardian Angel Forms, Life Spirit Form also granted a terrifying 400% increase.
The "Reincarnation" skill was even more incredible...
As long as Vera could successfully complete the Life Reincarnation phases of budding, growing, and withering, her strength could achieve a leap-like enhancement.
If that’s the case...
As long as Vera undergoes transformation enough times, Vera’s strength seemingly could surpass Liu Li!
As for the Life Law, it was within Gu Xing’s expectations.
After all, with the myth nine stars’ talent, comprehending a thread of Power of Laws was only natural.
After carefully checking all of Vera’s attribute changes, Gu Xing finally felt at ease.
Unlike Liu Li’s all-round approach of both offense and defense, Vera pushed her group attack ability to the extreme.
At the same time, she also awakened the one-of-a-kind "Reincarnation" skill!
This already fully justified her myth nine stars’ talent!
At this moment.
Vera was glaring at Qing Shuang with resentful eyes, her emerald eyes filled with unwillingness.
She was just a bit away from succeeding herself.
But this Ghost Race...
"Qing Shuang, why did you stop me?"
Qing Shuang’s expression remained unchanged, her cyan hair gently swaying in the energy’s ripple:
"You cannot force the master to do anything."
This sentence struck Vera like a heavy hammer, leaving her speechless.
She opened her mouth but couldn’t find any reason to refute.
Gu Xing also noticed this scene.
So he spoke up to stop the confrontation between the two Guardian Beasts:
"Alright, Vera, Qing Shuang, get ready to acquire the Divine Pattern."
As for Vera’s heat state, he would naturally find a way to resolve it after leaving the Secret Realm.
But for now...
Gu Xing looked up at the golden Divine Pattern floating in mid-air.
The urgent matter was to get his hands on it!
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s command, Qing Shuang and Vera immediately calmed their emotions and turned to face the floating golden Divine Pattern.
Inside the Beast Taming Space, seeing this, Liu Li finally breathed a sigh of relief, retracting her rampant Fire of Destruction completely.
Thankfully...
The annoying elf didn’t succeed!
Once the Fire of Destruction dissipated, only then did the Tree of Life dare to unfold its branches and leaves, swaying gently as if having survived a catastrophe.
Outside, Gu Xing focused his mind and released a thread of Spiritual Power to touch the Divine Pattern.
"Buzz!"
The entire space trembled.
Immediately afterward, a golden curtain of light descended, fully enveloping Gu Xing and his Guardian Beasts.
"This test seems different..." Gu Xing frowned slightly.
And at this moment, Lilith in the Beast Taming Space seemed to realize something and spoke up to remind:
"Be cautious! This test is likely about confronting yourself!"
Seeing Gu Xing’s puzzled expression, Lilith quickly explained:
"The previous Demon Race was generated by the Divine Pattern based on the data of the Demon Race that entered the Secret Realm."
"And now..."
"I suspect the Divine Pattern is going to replicate you as the final test!"
This hypothesis wasn’t without basis.
Ancient texts did record that some Divine Patterns would set trials based on the challenger’s own prototype.
Yet unexpectedly, after hearing this explanation, Gu Xing’s frown eased instead.
To replicate him according to the strength upon entering the Secret Realm?
It must be noted that during the Secret Realm exploration, he hadn’t used his "Soul-devouring" Talent and had kept his "Sovereign" Talent hidden.
Only Qing Shuang and Vera displayed their full strength at any point...
But now Vera was completely different from when she first entered the Secret Realm!
Gu Xing’s gaze fell upon Vera beside him, his lips slightly curling up.
This challenge, which was incredibly challenging for others, could be...
Incredibly simple in front of him!
The talent of myth nine stars and myth five stars are two entirely different concepts!
Just then, the profound mysterious aura in the space suddenly coalesced.
Not far ahead of Gu Xing, a figure identical to him was slowly taking form.
Indeed, as Lilith speculated, the Divine Pattern had truly replicated a "Gu Xing"!
Facing oneself?
Gu Xing smiled.
He intended for Vera to handle this fight!
"Vera!"
Upon hearing her master’s call, Vera immediately understood.
A trace of battle intent flashed in her emerald eyes, and three green Divine Rings suddenly lit up behind her:
"Life Spirit Form·Qi!"
As the Divine Rings radiated a dazzling brilliance, Vera’s attribute panel instantly updated:
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Heat Period (due to Heart of Nature defect)]
[Power: 60,000]
[Constitution: 60,000]
[Spirit: 80,000→320,000]
[Speed: 60,000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
With the 400% terrifying increase from Life Spirit Form, Vera’s Spiritual Attribute skyrocketed to 320,000 points!
Truly overwhelming!
As for the replicated Vera across the battlefield...
Even under the blessing of Elf Monarchy, her Spiritual Attribute was only 150,000 points...
The difference between the two was more than double!
But what Gu Xing wanted to test was not Vera’s attacking ability...
His real concern was Vera’s long-standing weakness:
Defense ability!
The replicated "Qing Shuang" on the opposite side was the perfect test subject.
The freely void-traveling Qing Shuang was initially the greatest threat to the predominantly Spiritual Type Vera.
Especially given Vera’s other relatively average attributes.
Sure enough, just as Gu Xing expected, as the battle began, replica Qing Shuang vanished into the void instantly.
The next moment, her silhouette appeared in front of Vera like an apparition, simultaneously activating "Heaven-Breaking" and "Ghost King’s Body", pushing her Strength Attribute directly to 270,000 points!
If this strike connected, the consequence would be unthinkable...
Yet at the critical moment, countless green vines emerged from nowhere, binding the replica Qing Shuang firmly like they had a life of their own.
Lined with the Life Law patterns, the vines held firm despite the replica Qing Shuang’s struggles.
This scene made both Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, standing next to Gu Xing, have their pupils contract sharply.
For the replicated Qing Shuang was entirely modeled after the current Qing Shuang.
If Vera could easily pin her down, that meant even if the real Qing Shuang took action....
It was likely the result would be the same!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 217: Trial? Instant Clearance!
chapters.content:
Chapter 217: Chapter 217: Trial? Instant Clearance!
Seeing Vera so effortlessly subdue the copy of Qing Shuang, a trace of astonishment flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
Although he had already guessed that Vera could deal with the doppelganger of Qing Shuang, he never expected that...
Vera would win so easily!
What shocked him most was that Vera’s mastery of Life Energy had reached an extraordinary, almost divine level.
If it had been the pre-breakthrough Vera, trapping Qing Shuang who had simultaneously activated "Ghost King’s Body" and "Heaven-Breaking" would have been utterly impossible.
But now...
With just a wave of her hand, those dark green vines infused with the Life Law tightly bound the fake Qing Shuang.
Even in the face of a terrifying power of two hundred seventy thousand points, those vines remained unshakable, utterly indifferent to any struggles from the other side.
Now Gu Xing could be certain:
Vera had already completed a qualitative leap.
Now, in the midst of the battlefield, she no longer needed the protection of other Guardian Beasts.
Relying on her own strength alone, she could hold an entire front by herself.
On the battlefield.
Vera ignored the copy of Qing Shuang bound by vines, instead locking her gaze onto the "other herself" not far away.
Natural Spirit versus Life Spirit!
At this moment, the doppelganger Vera struck without hesitation:
"Life Blooming!"
Back when she was Commander Tier Two, she used this move to successfully slay a Monarch Tier Three Demon King.
Now, the copy Vera opened with this same killer move.
In an instant, free-floating Life Energy in the space surged madly toward the doppelganger’s palm, gradually condensing into a fierce energy dragon.
Yet the real Vera didn’t move a muscle, simply watching the "performance" coldly...
She was no longer who she used to be; her mastery of Life Energy had reached a whole new Realm.
Just as the green dragon was about to take form, Vera raised her slender jade hand ever so slightly.
A shocking scene unfolded:
The energy dragon, which should have attacked her, obediently swam to her side like a fledgling beast returning to its den, rubbing its head affectionately against her cheek.
Fortunately, the copy created by the Divine Pattern had no emotions; otherwise, seeing its own killer blow recognize the enemy as its master would surely cause a mental breakdown.
But this also demonstrated the chasmic gap between them!
Now, with just the slightest gesture, Vera had already reached the doppelganger’s limit!
"Elf Monarchy!"
The copy Vera, unwilling to accept defeat, cast another Skill, trying to regain control of the Life Dragon.
But...
It was all in vain!
At this moment, the Dragon of Life was already fully under Vera’s control.
And having lost all interest in the game, a sharp glint flashed through her emerald eyes:
"It’s over!"
With a crisp exclamation, the Life Energy around Vera erupted in a thunderous wave.
The green dragon seemed to be nourished by its source, ballooning several times in size in an instant, mystical life runes flowing between its scales and claws.
"Roooaarr—"
The dragon let out a long howl and, under Vera’s command, lunged at the doppelganger like lightning.
No chance to dodge!
This strike even sealed the space around the copy.
The doppelganger Vera didn’t even have time to react before she was completely obliterated by this pure Life Energy.
As for the copy of Qing Shuang bound by vines?
Vera simply closed her five fingers ever so slightly, and those dark green vines suddenly tightened—her form was instantly crushed into specks of golden light, returning to the Divine Pattern.
Staring at her own victory, Vera absentmindedly spread her palm wide.
Is this really me now?
She remembered clearly: at full force, Qing Shuang could slay a Monarch Tier Five being.
But now, in front of her, not even the strength to fight back remained...
Suddenly, a bold idea sprouted in her mind:
Now, do I finally qualify to arm-wrestle the Blazing Angel?!
Do I no longer need to swallow my pride under Liu Li’s oppressive presence?
At the thought, the corners of Vera’s lips unconsciously curled up.
It seemed her era was coming!
On the other side.
Fei Yue stood next to Qing Shuang, unconsciously gripping Qing Shuang’s sleeve tightly.
This Elf had truly risen!
Her own elder sister might no longer be this Elf’s match!
Recalling her past run-ins with Vera, Fei Yue couldn’t help but shudder.
In the past, with Sister’s support, that Elf didn’t dare touch her.
But now...
Her own sister might not be able to protect her anymore!
Qing Shuang, meanwhile, gazed at Vera’s silhouette, a trace of heaviness flickering in her eyes.
She had learned her own advancement requirements from Gu Xing.
[Nether Ghost Stone, Extreme Ghost Qi, Ghost Core]
Among the Ghost Race, they’d already located the Nether Ghost Stone and Extreme Ghost Qi.
Once she found the Ghost Core, her power would break through.
But even if she completed her advancement, whether she could rival the current Vera was still unknown.
And more so...
Now, the strongest Guardian Beast in Master’s hand was undoubtedly that Angel!
She knew Liu Li’s Skills, which made her truly realize how terrifying Liu Li was.
Just the "Destruction Domain" alone...
Once trapped within it, not only would one’s body start disintegrating, but escape would be impossible.
Moreover, that Blood Ancestor was also terrifyingly strong.
Unwittingly, she and Fei Yue had become the weakest two in Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast team!
Realizing this, a sharp light flashed in Qing Shuang’s eyes.
How could she accept such a result?!
Though she’d always thought that just being by her Master’s side was enough, her pride would never permit her to be at the bottom!
"I must find the Ghost Core and advance as soon as possible..."
"Qing Shuang secretly resolved: And Fei Yue’s strength upgrade must be put on the agenda too!"
Meanwhile, Gu Xing’s attention was wholly focused on the Divine Pattern, unaware of his Guardian Beasts’ thoughts.
He stepped forward, closing the distance to the Divine Pattern step by step.
This time, there was no more of that strange "unable to approach" phenomenon.
When he finally stood before it, the golden pattern flickered with a steady breathing pulse.
Gu Xing tentatively stretched out his hand, when suddenly, sensing something, the Divine Pattern shot straight at his forehead!
"Buzz—"
The original imprint on his forehead flared, resonating mysteriously with the newly acquired Divine Pattern.
But Gu Xing could clearly feel that this new Divine Pattern was much dimmer—obviously, it was not yet at full power.
"Sure enough, it needs the Beast Taming Holy Pool to activate..." Gu Xing mused quietly.
Only by returning to Blue Star, borrowing the power of the Blood-colored Church’s Beast Taming Holy Pool, could he truly awaken this Divine Pattern.
"Boom—!!"
As a sacred golden pillar of light pierced the heavens, the second Divine Pattern mark gradually appeared on Gu Xing’s forehead.
At the same time, in the Beast Taming Space, the Soul Nourishing Pool churned violently—
The long-slumbering Cat-eared Beastman’s fingers suddenly twitched!
Immediately, her aura began to rise rapidly, and amid intense Energy Fluctuations, her dormant consciousness began to awaken!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 218: Sally Awakens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 218: Chapter 218: Sally Awakens!
In the Soul Nourishing Pool, Sally’s consciousness gradually awoke.
Cold, dark, suffocating!
These were her last memories.
In that long dream, she witnessed her idol, Lord Gu Xing, in dire straits before a Monarch Level Demon.
To fulfill the mission given by the Elf Race, she resolutely chose to sacrifice herself.
The process of sacrifice was unimaginably painful.
Her body was consumed inch by inch by an invisible force, and even her soul seemed to be torn into pieces.
That feeling was like falling into an ice cave of eternal night, where even thoughts would freeze.
Yet she never feared death.
The only thing that terrified her was never seeing that figure who saved the Cat Race again...
Just as her soul was about to disperse, a warm golden light suddenly enveloped her.
The biting cold vanished instantly, replaced by the warmth of a spring day.
In this gentle nourishment, she gradually regained her senses.
The feeling in her limbs returned, though they felt weightless, as if walking on clouds.
"Sally!"
That familiar voice...
Was it Lord Gu Xing?!
Sally’s muddled consciousness suddenly cleared, and she desperately tried to open her heavy eyelids.
Within the Beast Taming Space, people surrounded the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, and even Lilith curiously gathered around.
Lilith observed the Cat Girl in the pool, a hint of doubt in her eyes.
Judging by her aura, she didn’t seem strong, so why was everyone so tense?
Meanwhile, Liu Li and the others looked anxious.
Just now, she keenly noticed Sally’s finger moving and immediately shared the good news with Gu Xing.
Upon hearing this, the usually composed Gu Xing disregarded the newly acquired Divine Pattern, pouring all his spiritual power into the Beast Taming Space.
The little maid who, in a life-and-death moment, used her last strength to say "Sally really wants to call you Master!"...
Seemed to be waking up today!
"Sally! Sally!"
Gu Xing’s spiritual power echoed in the Beast Taming Space, calling out her name again and again.
At this moment.
Through the clear water of the Soul Nourishing Pool, Sally vaguely saw several familiar figures.
The voice that haunted her thoughts echoed continuously in her ears...
It was Lord Gu Xing calling her!
"It’s really Lord Gu Xing!"
This realization made Sally’s body tremble as she abruptly opened her amber cat eyes.
Her long-slumbering limbs were still somewhat unresponsive, but she used all her strength to sit up from the pool water.
"Splash——"
The crystalline water slid down her smooth skin, creating ripples on the surface of the Soul Nourishing Pool.
Droplets dripped from her wet cat ears, moistening her slightly trembling eyelashes.
But at this moment, everyone in the Beast Taming Space was female, so no one minded this small "accident."
As for Gu Xing...
His entire mind was focused on Sally.
He didn’t care whether Sally’s body was bare...
[Sally]
[Level: Awakened Tier One]
[Talent: Legend One Star]
[Race: Time Spirit Race]
[Power: 1]
[Constitution: 1]
[Spirit: 100]
[Speed: 1]
[Skills: Time Freeze, Time Slowdown]
Looking at Sally’s attributes, Gu Xing was slightly taken aback.
Although he had already learned from the Elf Empress about the uniqueness of the Time Spirit Race and guessed that their abilities might relate to time....
Upon seeing the descriptions of these two skills, he couldn’t help but inhale sharply.
[Time Freeze: Can pause the passage of time in a specific area]
[Time Slowdown: Can slow down the flow of time in a specific area]
The effects of these two skills were simply astounding!
Even more shocking was that this was just Sally in her Legend One Star Talent, Awakened Tier One state.
If she were to be cultivated to Myth Nine Stars and then elevated to Totem Level...
Gu Xing couldn’t imagine how powerful Sally would become then.
Perhaps, as the name of her race suggests...
Truly mastering time?!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing’s heart couldn’t help but beat faster.
If it were true, then Sally’s potential might far surpass all other Guardian Beasts!
Sally stood dazedly from the Soul Nourishing Pool, with water droplets falling from her ethereal body.
She looked around this place...
Is it Lord Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space?
As her eyes moved, she saw Lord Liu Li, Lord Vera, Lord Qing Shuang, and a formidable Blood Race stranger.
It all seemed too beautiful to be real.
Sally instinctively pinched her cheek but found her fingers passing through her ethereal visage.
"As expected... still dreaming."
She looked down in disappointment, ready to sink back into darkness.
Gu Xing’s voice exploded like a thunderclap.
Sally’s eyes widened suddenly, seeing a figure formed by spiritual power walking toward her, with that familiar silhouette, those gentle eyes...
It wasn’t a dream!
Gu Xing’s spiritual body gently extended a hand, his voice filled with irrepressible joy:
"Sally, welcome back."
Seeing that hand reaching toward her, Sally’s soul trembled violently.
Glittering tears rolled down her amber cat eyes, turning into spots of starlight in the void.
"Lord Gu Xing..."
At this moment, all grievances and pain had meaning.
...
Meanwhile.
At the border of the Longxia Defense Line.
At this moment.
A group of mountain-like figures approached the Longxia Defense Line directly, with their heavy footsteps causing the ground to tremble slightly.
The stationed soldiers immediately entered combat readiness and urgently reported the situation.
Soon, Long Zhenguo brought Wei Yuan and a group of powerful figures to the front line.
Upon seeing the arrivals, his brow furrowed tightly:
"The Ghost Race?!"
Their interactions with the Ghost Race only happened in the Divine Secret Realm.
Although Gu Xing had captured that group of Ghosts, he eventually chose to release them.
There shouldn’t be any major grievances between them!
Now, this group of Ghosts came directly to their door, but for what?
"Everyone, stay alert!"
Long Zhenguo ordered in a deep voice.
This reaction was understandable...
Since Gu Xing hadn’t conveyed the situation with the Ghosts to him, he naturally didn’t know their intentions.
However...
Just as the tense atmosphere reached its peak, a blue figure gracefully emerged from the Ghost Race ranks.
Qing hovered in midair, her voice clearly reaching the line of defense:
"No need to be nervous, we are here at Gu Xing’s behest to discuss cooperation with the Human Race."
Upon hearing this, Long Zhenguo was momentarily stunned, then his eyes flashed with delight.
Now, the situation in the Alternate Space was extremely complicated.
If Gu Xing had obtained the second Divine Pattern, the Demons’ retaliation...
The Ghost Race’s addition at this time was a timely aid.
Considering this, Long Zhenguo immediately gestured an invitation, his attitude visibly relaxed.
"Why not come in and discuss this in detail."
Qing nodded slightly, following Long Zhenguo into the defense line without hesitation.
This cooperation was mainly out of respect for Gu Xing, so he naturally had to show utmost sincerity...
Moreover...
His two daughters were still in Gu Xing’s hands!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 219: Leaving the Divine Secret Realm!
chapters.content:
Chapter 219: Chapter 219: Leaving the Divine Secret Realm!
Within the Divine Secret Realm.
Gu Xing stared at Sally before him, his brows slightly furrowed.
He discovered...
Aside from Spiritual Attribute, all of Sally’s other Attributes were shockingly at the lowest value—"one".
This meant Sally was unbelievably fragile, unable to withstand any attack!
And even if her Level increased...
Besides the Spiritual Attribute, none of her other Attributes would grow!
"This..."
Gu Xing thoughtfully rubbed his chin.
But if this situation was regarded as a unique trait of the Time Spirit Race, it wasn’t unreasonable.
After all...
The power to manipulate time was far too monstrous.
If her other Attributes were any stronger...
Then all the other Guardian Beasts might as well not exist at all.
And although all of Sally’s abilities were related to time and she possessed no direct combat capability, that did not mean she was weak.
Quite the opposite—in this moment, Sally’s strength was utterly terrifying.
As long as she slowed or suspended the flow of time in a space, no attack could so much as touch her.
Only now did Gu Xing finally understand why the Elf Empress said the Time Spirit Race was the most mysterious of all races.
They exist by relying on time itself, traversing the river of time.
Thinking of this, a thread of doubt rose in his heart...
Has the Time Spirit Race truly vanished?
If ever a Totem Level powerhouse arose within their ranks, then could it be that...
They simply aren’t present at the current temporal node?
Realizing this, Gu Xing blanked out for a moment.
And according to the Elf Empress’s account, it seemed Sally was a seed she herself left behind in the future, meant to inherit the power of the Time Spirit Race.
But if that was the intention, could it be merely for the Divine Pattern of the Time Spirit Race?
He absentmindedly touched the golden Divine Pattern on his forehead.
So far, he’d found the Divine Pattern’s function extremely limited...
Aside from being able to slightly manipulate Blue Star’s Spiritual Qi, it seemed to have no other Effect.
And the Divine Patterns Liu Li and the others obtained only enhanced their Talent, without further Function.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing let out a sigh.
There were still too many mysteries!
What he could do now...
Was to seize every moment to strengthen himself!
Perhaps only after reaching Monarch Level—or Totem Level—would he be qualified to uncover the truth.
At this moment.
Gu Xing gazed at Sally before him, a hint of gentleness in his eyes.
Instinctively, he reached out to gently pat her small head, softly saying:
"Sally, soon you won’t need to stay in the Soul Nourishing Pool anymore!"
For now, Sally only possessed Awakened Tier One strength; her Level was simply too low.
Gu Xing certainly wouldn’t risk bringing her out of the Beast Taming Space!
He would only feel at ease letting Sally leave the Beast Taming Space once she reached Commander Level!
Moreover, upgrading Sally’s Talent had to be put on the agenda!
Her Level was currently only Legendary One Star, still far behind the other Guardian Beasts!
And when Sally made her sacrifice earlier, he’d made a decision—he must make a Contract with Sally as his Guardian Beast.
Now Sally has awakened...
All these things must be achieved one by one!
But right now, what mattered most was to leave the Divine Secret Realm...
Gu Xing looked up, his gaze falling on the slowly manifesting golden portal ahead, his eyes turning sharp.
"Vera, Lilith, prepare for battle!"
With Gu Xing’s summons, two figures answered at once.
Meanwhile, within the Beast Taming Space, Liu Li also volunteered to fight.
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on the wound on her back...
Sustained by the Spring of Life, her injuries had nearly healed.
After a brief hesitation, Gu Xing nodded his approval.
After all, faced with the Demon Race’s siege, they did need the protection of Liu Li, the Guardian Angel.
And when Liu Li appeared, her gaze immediately locked onto the self-assured Vera.
This Elf, after her Talent upgrade, seemed a bit full of herself.
And, most importantly...
This Elf had tried to sneak away earlier!
Liu Li made a mental note of this grievance.
Once the Demon Race was dealt with, she’d settle accounts with the Elf.
But for now...
Liu Li’s expression grew stern, refocusing her attention.
First deal with the Demon Race—leaving this place was the priority.
....
Outside the Divine Secret Realm.
More than ten Half-Step Totem Level demon experts hovered in the air, their cold gazes locked onto the golden portal floating in the sky.
They’d already laid down the Heaven and Earth Net, sealing the surrounding space completely.
"We absolutely can’t let that Beast Master escape again this time!"
"We just got word that the Human Race is already pulling back their lines—they’re scared of our retaliation too."
A Demon King snorted disdainfully, "Foolish humans! Think sending someone in will let them seize the Divine Pattern? Even if they succeed, how’ll they even escape?"
"Though, lately these Humans really have been getting bolder and bolder."
"Once we get the second Divine Pattern, we’ll drive them all out of the Alternate Space!"
"Agreed. Now that the second Divine Secret Realm has opened, as long as we secure the final Divine Pattern, the Human Race will lose all value to us."
"But..."
"The Angel Race’s War Angel claimed he’d be the first to move against the Human Race."
"Hmph! That old mutt! Wanted him to join us, but he’s still hesitating."
"If you ask me, we should just wipe out the entire Angel Race!"
"Their Divine Pattern isn’t even in their hands—what’s the point of exterminating them!"
While these demon leaders discussed, the golden portal abruptly rippled.
"Someone’s coming out!"
At this, all the demons tensed instantly.
"Vroom—!"
The golden portal trembled fiercely; what burst out first was a thick surge of Demonic Qi.
This was the aura the Divine Secret Realm couldn’t digest, forcibly expelled as the portal opened.
"This is..."
The demon experts’ faces changed dramatically.
A Half-Step Totem Level Demon King grabbed a wisp of Demonic Qi, his pupils contracting sharply:
"Nearly all demons who entered the Secret Realm have been wiped out? Impossible!"
The other Demon Kings were all taken aback by this.
That human was only Commander Level—how could he kill hundreds of Monarch Peak demon warriors alone?
Did something happen inside the Divine Secret Realm?
The Demon Kings wore expressions as dark as water.
If their entire army was lost and the Divine Pattern remained in the Secret Realm, they’d lose the chance to obtain the final Divine Pattern...
The whole operation would be for nothing!
Yet at that very moment.
A human figure strode boldly out of the golden portal.
The Demon Kings were shocked.
The human—wasn’t dead?
Their gazes zeroed in on Gu Xing’s forehead, narrowing their eyes in unison.
The human had snatched the Divine Pattern!
The Demon Kings exchanged glances, relief flashing in their eyes.
So long as the Divine Pattern had left the Divine Secret Realm!
But as for whether this human could escape...
Impossible!
Meanwhile.
At Gu Xing’s side, three figures brimmed with fighting spirit.
Liu Li, the Guardian Angel, with twelve golden wings displayed!
Vera, the Elf, three Divine Rings floating behind her!
Lilith, her whole body swirling with blood and energy!
This was currently Gu Xing’s strongest battle lineup.
Liu Li and Vera possessed Monarch Peak combat power, while Lilith was even a top-tier existence among Half-Step Totem Level fighters.
At this moment, all three had activated every boost they could.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 220: Two Types of Law
chapters.content:
Chapter 220: Chapter 220: Two Types of Law
But as Gu Xing gazed at these Demon Race members, his eyes were grave, yet he wasn’t overly worried.
This time entering the Divine Secret Realm, naturally, he would not come in completely unprepared.
After all, this was the very heart of the Demon Race’s territory.
If an accident were to happen...
Not only would he fall here, but even Qing Shuang and Fei Yue...
They definitely wouldn’t be able to escape either!
About this, both Qing and You were naturally crystal clear!
Therefore...
Before setting off, You solemnly handed him an Ancient Jade Pendant.
This was the Ghost Race’s most treasured life-saving item, able to teleport the user away in a crisis.
This too was one of the Ghost Race’s hidden trump cards!
Yet for the sake of her two granddaughters, You handed this item to Gu Xing without hesitation.
All for one reason... to guarantee that nothing would go wrong with this operation.
However...
Gu Xing felt that, for now, he had no need for this trump card at all!
"Soul Devouring·Start!"
"Sovereign·Start!"
With two low shouts, red and blue Spiritual Power surged forth like a tidal wave, instantly enveloping Vera, Liu Li, and Lilith.
In this moment...
Gu Xing unleashed his full strength, holding nothing back.
At the same time, the power of the three Guardian Beasts soared to their peaks.
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Extremely Weak (Recovering)]
[Level: Monarch Tier Five]
[Power: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Constitution: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Spirit: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Speed: 400,000→1,600,000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
With 1.6 million Attribute Value, Lilith stood tall, her entire being enveloped by suffocating Energy Fluctuations.
And aside from these sheer Attribute Enhancements...
Slaughter—ultimate attack!
Guard—ultimate defense!
Celestial Grace—ultimate control removal!
Three supreme states converged and fused flawlessly within her.
With a millennium of battle experience, Lilith could wield these states to their very limits!
Last time, Lilith had experienced the terror of the Soul Devouring Talent, but this was her first time feeling the Sovereign Talent.
Yet, as she took a moment to sense this strength,
She finally understood...
what utter insignificance meant!
With this power blessing her, her strength...
could absolutely rival the very peak of Half-step Totem Level!
On the other side, although Liu Li and Vera were not as terrifying as Lilith...
their Attributes were equally heaven-defying!
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: In Heat (Heart of Nature defect induced)]
[Power: 60,000→120,000]
[Constitution: 60,000→120,000]
[Spirit: 80,000→640,000]
[Speed: 60,000→120,000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form, Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
With the violent amplification of Soul Devouring Power and the pure energy of the Life Spirit, Vera’s Spiritual Attribute shattered all previous limits.
This overwhelming strength warped and trembled the surrounding space, Spiritual Power rippling out in waves that became nearly tangible in the Void.
At this moment, Liu Li also exuded a terrifying presence, twelve wings bursting forth with blinding golden radiance...
The pressure alone repelled all Demonic Qi within a hundred meters.
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 70,000→560,000]
[Constitution: 70,000→560,000]
[Spirit: 70,000→560,000]
[Speed: 70,000→560,000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form, Guardian Domain, Guardian Law (Unavailable)]
Yet, despite Liu Li’s stats reaching an astonishing 560,000, she simply remained quietly at Gu Xing’s side.
Her sole task was to protect Gu Xing!
As for offense...
Lilith and Vera were more than enough.
When more than ten Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings sensed Lilith and Vera’s explosive power, their faces instantly turned grim.
That suffocating oppression finally explained why not a single Demon Race member who entered the Secret Realm had ever returned.
The aura displayed by these Guardian Beasts at this moment...
was more than enough to make things clear!
All the Demon Race who had entered the Secret Realm must have fallen at this human’s hands.
"Damn it!"
"Slaughtering so many of our people—today, you must die!"
"You really think that with just these three Guardian Beasts, you can escape here alive? Dream on!"
The leading Half-step Totem-level Demon bellowed in rage:
"Attack!"
At his roar, all Monarch Level and Half-step Totem Level Demon Race experts erupted at once.
Yet...
Gu Xing merely raised his right hand lightly.
"Absolute Forbidden Domain!"
In a split second, a Blood Domain spread out like a tidal wave, enveloping all the Demon Race within.
After so much tempering, his Second Domain had massively increased in range and was now far mightier than before.
Almost instantly, every Demon Race Domain was erased!
Even these Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings were no exception!
This sudden turn of events caused all the Demon Race to freeze in place.
The Domain Power they’d always relied on was now totally suppressed.
Without domain support, those formerly fierce attacks were immediately weakened.
As a result, these once troublesome offensives were easily neutralized by Liu Li.
Then, Gu Xing gave a resolute order:
"Vera, Lilith—attack!"
As the words fell, Vera and Lilith instantly moved just as Gu Xing had previously instructed.
"Life Law!"
"Blood Law!"
Two clear voices split the Blood Domain.
While Absolute Forbidden Domain could block all Domain Power, it could not restrain the higher manipulation of Laws.
This was Gu Xing’s trump card against the Demon Race!
With Vera and Lilith at full power wielding Laws...
aside from those dozen Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings, no other Monarch Level demon could hope to withstand them!
At this moment.
Vivid green life torrents gathered around Vera, swiftly forming a Law Space hundreds of meters across.
The trapped Demon Race members were horrified to discover their Life Energy was draining away uncontrollably.
Vera’s eyes glinted with divine light as she parted her lips:
"Reincarnation!"
In an instant, whether low-tier Demon Race or Monarch Level experts, all visibly aged and withered under that Law Power.
Their Life Force turned to countless motes of light, surging into Vera like rivers to the sea.
With this massive influx of Life Energy, Vera’s state leapt from "Sprout" to "Growth" phase.
Once she completed the final "Wilting" transformation, her strength would undergo yet another evolution.
Meanwhile, Lilith’s Blood Domain displayed even more terrifying might.
As someone who had once reached Totem Level, her command of Laws was unrivaled.
Any Demon Race within her Law Space exploded in a bloody mist before they could even scream.
Witnessing this horror, the ten remaining Half-step Totem Level Demon Race experts finally lost control.
But just as they prepared to act...
The two Law Spaces had not only slaughtered countless demons, but also ripped apart their space lockdown.
At that moment...
A member of the Ghost Race appeared beside this human.
The next instant...
Their figures abruptly vanished!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 221: Demon Race Retreat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 221: Chapter 221: Demon Race Retreat!
"Damn it!"
Witnessing this scene, all the Half-step Totem-level Demon Clan instantly flew into a rage, their demonic qi surging like a tsunami across the entire sky, shredding the clouds within a hundred miles to pieces.
As lofty Totem-level beings, when had they ever suffered such humiliation?
This lowly human dared to break into the Divine Secret Realm right before their eyes, slaughtering all Commander-level Demon Clans, seizing the precious Divine Pattern...
Even more outrageous, the other party actually swaggered away right under their noses.
This was trampling the pride of the Demon Clan into the dirt!
"Human! You must die!"
The leading Totem-level Demon Clan howled into the sky, the shockwave splitting the ground with cracks.
His scarlet Demon Eyes suddenly narrowed, locking fiercely onto the direction of the Longxia Defense Line.
That cunning human had already merged into the Void; even they couldn’t track him down.
But...
This human could run, but could that group of Human Race run as well?
"Transmit my order, all Demon Clans assemble immediately, target the Longxia Defense Line..."
"Make those humans pay the price!"
"As you command!"
Tens of thousands of Demon Clans responded in unison, their voices shaking the world.
Earlier, Gu Xing had slain nearly thirty Monarch Level Demon Monarchs with thunderous might!
As for those Commander-level and Extraordinary-level Demon Clans, the casualties were impossible to count!
Yet, to the Demon Race, battle had never been loss, but a feast!
As long as there was slaughter, they would descend into madness.
Because battle meant death, and death meant—Demonic Qi!
Though Gu Xing wiped out nearly thirty Monarch Level Demon Monarchs at once, the surging demonic qi that escaped was frenziedly devoured by the nearby Commander Peak-level Demon Clans lurking hungrily.
In just an instant, demonic qi surged, several terrifying auras shot into the sky!
New Monarch Level Demon Clans...
Had been born!
This was the most terrifying aspect of the Demon Race—
Slaughter not only could not weaken them, but would make them stronger and fiercer with every battle!
Under the orders of several Half-step Totem-level Demon Monarchs, the vast Demon Clan army surged forth like a black flood, wrapped in overwhelming demonic qi, crushing toward the Longxia Defense Line!
At this moment.
Intelligence about the Demon Clan army had already been reported at lightning speed to Long Zhenguo by a Monarch-level Blood Race.
After hearing the report, Long Zhenguo frowned slightly, a hint of gravity flashing in his eyes.
As expected—
Everything was within Gu Xing’s calculations!
After he seized the Divine Pattern, the Demon Race immediately launched a crazed retaliation!
But what most concerned Long Zhenguo was another question—
Gu Xing was clearly only Commander-level; how did he accomplish this?
Under the noses of several Half-step Totem-level Demon Monarchs, he broke into the Divine Secret Realm, seized the Divine Pattern, and retreated unscathed...
This was simply unimaginable!
However...
Now that Gu Xing had acquired the Divine Pattern, the process no longer mattered.
His gaze pierced the distance, locking unwaveringly on the advancing black tide.
The Demon Clan army was coming!
"Qing," Long Zhenguo spoke in a deep voice, "Next... I’m afraid I must trouble you to step in."
"No matter, this was my purpose in coming here all along!"
Qing smiled indifferently, paying no mind to Long Zhenguo’s request.
When his gaze swept the dozen or so Half-step Totem-level Demon Monarchs in the distance, wrapped in soaring demonic qi, a flash of icy killing intent flickered in his eyes.
Demon Clan...
He longed to strike and slaughter these monsters to the last!
But that would only result in the birth of Totem-level Demon Clans!
"Crack—"
Qing’s knuckles tensed slightly, a crack exploded in the strained air.
The next instant, a terrifying aura erupted, making heaven and earth change color...
The pressure of a Half-step Totem-level Ghost Race swept across the entire battlefield, as if substance!
At the same time—
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
Three auras of equal intensity soared into the sky!
Long Zhenguo, Verocan, Blood-colored Church Empress—none of the three held anything back; they unleashed their full power.
However...
The aura they revealed was no longer that of Monarch Peak.
But...
Half-step Totem!
This was another crucial purpose of Qing’s presence.
Under his careful guidance, the three, long stuck at Monarch Peak for years, finally pierced the shackle troubling them for so long.
Furthermore...
Owing to the Human Race’s special nature.
When a Beast Master breaks through to Half-step Totem-level, all their contracted Guardian Beasts simultaneously ascend!
So, although only three Human Race powerhouses appeared to enter Half-step Totem, their actual battle power...
"Roar——"
Earth-shaking bestial roars echoed without end!
The three—Long Zhenguo, Verocan, and the Blood-colored Church Empress—summoned their Guardian Beasts almost simultaneously. By Monarch-level standards, a Beast Master may contract up to four Guardian Beasts each.
Verocan and the Empress each summoned three, while Long Zhenguo summoned four—
Counting Qing himself, fourteen auras of Half-step Totem-level power now hung in the sky above the battlefield!
Though Long Zhenguo and the others had just broken through and their realms were yet unstable, with the aid of their Guardian Beasts it wasn’t difficult for each to hold off two Half-step Totem-level Demon Clans.
As for the remaining Demon Clan powerhouses...
"Leave them to me."
Qing’s voice was incomparably calm.
At this instant, he stood proudly at the very front of the Human Race ranks, no trace of the former despondency in his eyes—only world-shaking sharpness!
After seeing his daughter, he had finally shattered his inner demons and regained that invincible conviction of the "number one genius of the Ghost Race" from years past!
"Advance one more step—"
Qing slowly raised his right hand, Netherworld Ghost Qi tore through the sky like a raging dragon!
"Die!"
This furious shout actually caused the Demon Clan army’s charge to falter for a moment!
The leading Half-step Totem-level Demon Clan’s face was overcast as he flew to the front, confronting Qing across the gap.
"Ghost Race? You think you alone can stop us?"
Facing the Demon Clan’s questioning, Qing’s lips curled into a chilling smile.
"Ghost King’s Body—Activate!"
In a flash, ghostly qi flooded the sky, pouring into Qing’s body like rivers rejoining the sea.
Sinister Ghost Patterns instantly crawled across his skin, his aura surging by leaps and bounds!
Without the slightest hesitation, Qing struck with overwhelming force!
"Ghost King Domain—Unleash!"
The pitch-black domain instantly enveloped the insolent Demon Clan, severing all contact with the outside world.
"Endless Void!"
Qing’s figure flashed like a ghost, appearing before his foe without leaving a trace!
"Star Shattering!"
As the greatest genius of the Ghost Race in a thousand years, Qing’s talent had reached Myth Five Stars!
At this moment he pushed the Ghost Race’s two great talents to the limit; this strike had already surpassed the Half-step Totem-level threshold!
"Boom——!"
The Demon Clan had no time to react; his body exploded with a thunderous blast of ghostly qi!
After the hit, Qing’s figure flickered, elegantly returning to the Human Race formation.
In the erupting blood mist, demonic qi surged, the blasted Demon Clan struggled to reconstitute himself, but his face was pale as death...
Evidently he had burned a massive amount of Power of Origin.
Qing was not surprised in the slightest.
Half-step Totem-level Demon Clans had already grasped the Divine Pattern, nearly impossible to annihilate completely.
This strike was merely to deliver a warning blow to these arrogant Demon Clans!
And now, the effect had far exceeded expectations!
"That Ghost Race... absurdly strong!"
"When did those Human Race people break through to Half-step Totem?!"
"Damn it! Why is the Ghost Race joining forces with the Human Race?!"
The leading Demon Clan experts’ faces were clouds of gloom, but they had to admit—
With such a powerhouse as Qing holding the line, they could no longer crush the Human Race at will!
Gazing at the proud, solitary figure before them, they finally gritted their teeth and waved the order:
"Retreat!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 222: Surprise!
chapters.content:
Chapter 222: Chapter 222: Surprise!
Meanwhile, on the other side.
Gu Xing wasted no time and rushed at full speed to Blue Star via the Void Gate of the Blood-colored Church.
His top priority now was to reach the Beast Taming Holy Pool of the Blood-colored Church as soon as possible, and fully awaken his Divine Pattern!
Pushing himself to the limit, his figure soon appeared outside the capital of Blue Star, where the Blood-colored Church was located.
"Lilith, where’s the entrance to the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
Standing before the towering city gates, Gu Xing mentally communicated with Lilith inside his Beast Taming Space.
However—
"No idea!"
This answer stunned Gu Xing, and even the other guardian beasts in the Beast Taming Space all had shocked expressions.
No idea?
As a Blood-colored Church’s ancestral-level being, Lilith enjoyed the highest status within the Holy See.
But...
She actually didn’t know where the Beast Taming Holy Pool was?
Feeling everyone’s confusion, Lilith shrugged helplessly.
"I’ve always been stuck in the alternate space. Why would I have nothing better to do than ask about some Human Race Holy Pool location?"
This response made Gu Xing’s lips twitch slightly.
Thinking it through...
It did make a lot of sense!
Since Lilith couldn’t answer, Gu Xing turned his gaze toward the towering cathedral at the city center.
Looks like finding the person in charge was the only way to get clarity.
He took a deep breath and walked toward the city.
...
At that moment, inside the central cathedral of the Blood-colored Church.
Cecilia stood alone before the stained glass window; sunlight filtered through, casting dappled shadows over her pale face.
Ever since the Blood Ancestor incident settled down, the Church Court Empress had departed for Longxia Country, leaving all of Blue Star’s Church affairs in the hands of her, the Holy Daughter.
However—
"Holy Daughter, about the whereabouts of the Beast Taming Holy Pool, isn’t it time you gave me an explanation?"
"My patience is extremely limited!"
A raspy voice suddenly shattered the cathedral’s peace.
A hunched old man in white robes walked in slowly, his murky eyes flashing with dangerous light.
Aus!
Also one of the bishops of the Blood-colored Church.
His main duties were managing affairs in Blue Star!
As the Church’s main administrator in Blue Star, Aus had always paid lip service to the Empress’s rule.
He’d only tolerated it so long because his strength wasn’t enough.
But news of the Empress submitting to Longxia Country had finally ignited the rage he’d suppressed for years.
His son had once died indirectly at the hands of a Longxia Country soldier due to an accident.
So when it came to Longxia Country, he felt only deep hatred.
As soon as he heard the Empress’s decision, the first thing he did was secretly imprison another bishop loyal to her, and incite several Monarch Level powerhouses of Blue Star’s Church to start a rebellion.
The first step of the rebellion was to seize control of the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
If he could do that, he could mass-produce Monarch Level powerhouses.
Even though breaking through via the Holy Pool could only create "Fake King Level" people, it was still far superior to Commander Level.
But right now, even that first step was stuck.
Unlike Longxia Country’s public Holy Pool, the Blood-colored Church’s Holy Pool location was top secret.
Only the Empress and the Holy Daughter knew where it was.
The Church Court Empress also strongly disliked Fake King Level existences.
She’d always believed those who broke through to Monarch Level via the Holy Pool were just exploiting a shortcut.
So unless absolutely necessary, she forbade Commander Peak members from using the Holy Pool to break through to Monarch Level.
This led to a lot of Commander Peak Beast Masters feeling unhappy that they couldn’t advance to Monarch Level Beast Master.
And the support of these Commander Peak Beast Masters——
That was what gave Aus the confidence to rebel so boldly!
Now, every corner of the cathedral had Commander Peaks he’d riled up; the moment he controlled the Holy Pool, he could assemble a Monarch Level army in no time.
However.
Cecilia merely lifted her gaze, her blood-red pupils sweeping over Aus’s twisted face before regaining their calm.
This bishop only dared imprison her here—not lay a finger on her.
The moment the Empress in the alternate space discovered what was happening, this dangerous situation would dissolve on its own.
All she had to do was...
Wait quietly!
Seeing Cecilia’s stubborn attitude, Aus’s face was instantly contorted with rage.
"Cecilia, don’t think I’ll call you ’Holy Daughter’ and you’ll actually believe you are one."
"You’re just a child the Empress picked up from the outside—your talent is only slightly higher, that’s all!"
"If you won’t give up the Holy Pool’s location, even if I kill you, the Empress won’t do anything about it."
Cecilia stayed silent as frost, not even her eyelashes moved.
The Beast Taming Holy Pool’s secret—she’d rather die than reveal a single word.
Aus’s face twisted with fury, veins bulging at his neck, but he forced himself to keep his anger in check.
He spun around abruptly, his robe sweeping through the air.
"Remember, you only have one last day."
Stopping at the doorway, his voice turned icy and slow:
"If you still keep your mouth shut by this time tomorrow..."
"That old bishop who watched you grow up will pay for your stubbornness."
This sentence stabbed into Cecilia’s heart like a blade.
That other bishop—while not strong—was family, having cared for her and the Empress since childhood.
He was basically a grandfather to her and the Empress!
So, hearing this, Cecilia froze.
Her pale fingers dug unconsciously into her palm.
She was wavering.
...
Dusk enveloped the Imperial Capital in blood-red glow as Gu Xing stopped before an old inn.
The whispers of people on the street kept drifting into his ears——
"Did you hear? Tomorrow Bishop Aus is going to open the Beast Taming Holy Pool in public!"
"Now everyone stuck at Commander Peak can break through!"
"We’ve finally waited long enough..."
Gu Xing’s brows furrowed tighter and tighter. Letting a mass of Commander Levels break through by force at the Holy Pool?
Is this bishop dumb or what?!
This kind of shortcut might grant power quickly, but it would permanently damage the cultivator’s potential.
And Fake King Level Beast Masters...
What use are they against the Demon Race?
Just cannon fodder?!
Gu Xing sighed softly and shook his head.
"If this bishop really goes through with it..."
The future of the Blood-colored Church could be ruined for good.
Looks like tomorrow he had to "have a serious discussion" with Bishop Aus.
Pushing open the creaky wooden door of the old inn, Gu Xing headed straight up to a second floor guest room.
For now, he had something far more important to do——
Signing the contract with Sally!
The little cat-girl so determined to be his maid.
Gu Xing had already decided to fulfill her wish!
Once he signed the contract with Sally...
The little cat-girl would never have to call him "Master Gu Xing" again!
Instead, she’d call him...
Master!
At that thought, the corner of Gu Xing’s lips curled up in a gentle smile.
But the little cat-girl didn’t know about this decision yet!
Which meant it was the perfect surprise for her!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 223: Give Sally a Little Confidence!
chapters.content:
Chapter 223: Chapter 223: Give Sally a Little Confidence!
Inside the Beast Taming Space.
Sally is getting familiar with her new body.
In the pure spiritual state after losing her physical form, her control over power has become completely different.
At this moment, the little cat girl is curled up in the corner of the Beast Taming Space, repeatedly trying her newly acquired abilities.
"Time Freeze!"
She gazes at the Spring of Life not far away, fully activating her skills.
However...
"Splash..."
Except for a thumb-sized droplet of water strangely suspended in the air from the center of the spring, the rest of the water remained unchanged.
"Ugh..."
Sally’s ears droop dejectedly.
Originally, after breaking through to the Extraordinary Level, relying on the Cat Race’s innate agility talent, although she couldn’t keep up with Gu Xing’s combat pace, she could at least perfectly fulfill her duties as a daily maid.
But now...
Not only has her level fallen back to Awakened Tier One, but even her skills have become so useless.
Although the names of Time Freeze and Time Slowdown sound very impressive.
But after actually trying...
They are really not what they seem.
"It’s incredibly strenuous to even freeze a tiny area as small as a fingernail..."
Of course, Sally understands this is related to her current level.
But...
She can also sense now that even if her level increases...
The idea of freely controlling the time of an area is still nearly impossible.
"Clearly, I’ve gained the ability to manipulate time..."
The little cat girl lowers her head bitterly.
This ability seems to bring her no help at all!
What breaks her heart the most is...
She trembles as she extends her hand, trying to clench her fist.
But her semi-transparent fingers pass right through her palm, losing even the most basic tactile sense.
"Such a body..."
Now she can’t even serve Gu Xing with a cup of tea, let alone fulfill her duties as a maid.
"If she can’t even serve her master..."
Sally’s cat ears droop without strength.
Then what right does she have to stay by Gu Xing’s side any longer?
After a long silence, the little cat girl wipes away her tears and makes a decision—
When the time is right, she will voluntarily resign.
Returning to the Cat Race might be the best choice...
Beside her, Liu Li and Vera notice Sally’s lost expression and whisper quietly together.
"It’s strange, this little cat girl has awakened such an incredible power, why is she even more downcast?"
Vera tilts her head, her emerald eyes full of confusion.
Liu Li glances thoughtfully at Sally, curled up in the corner, and softly says:
"Probably hasn’t adapted to the new body yet."
And at this moment, Qing Shuang shifts his gaze away from Sally.
Being able to start controlling time at Awakened Tier One, this Guardian Beast also has terrifying talent!
Hearing Vera and Liu Li’s discussion, Qing Shuang subconsciously asks:
"When do you think the master will form a contract with Sally?"
Liu Li and Sally pause in thought, then answer in unison:
"Today!"
They understand Gu Xing’s thoughts very well.
As for Sally, Gu Xing has always felt a slight guilt.
Moreover...
In the past, Sally sacrificed herself, ensuring they survived the crisis.
Neither of them could bring themselves to refuse a contract with Sally.
In addition...
They are also aware of Sally’s talent.
With Gu Xing’s help, it’s just a matter of time before Sally’s talent breaks through to Myth Nine Stars.
By then...
Sally’s talent will surely further transform.
A Guardian Beast that controls time starts out invincible.
Therefore, from any perspective, Sally must contract as soon as possible.
Only...
Liu Li and Vera’s synchronized response causes their gazes to collide.
Liu Li narrows her eyes, her gaze scanning Vera with a dangerous glint.
Previously focused entirely on Sally, she had forgotten one thing...
She hasn’t settled accounts with this Green Tea Spirit yet!
And this Green Tea Spirit still maintains her mature form!
Seems she got cocky after reaching Myth Nine Stars.
But what Liu Li cares about most is Vera’s unusual physical state at the moment.
Usually maintaining her petite, youthful form, but now...
Liu Li’s gaze involuntarily falls upon Vera’s chest...
The proud fullness contrasting sharply with her slender elf figure, gently rising and falling with her breath.
"Green Tea Spirit, turn back into a kid’s form at once!"
However...
"I! Will! Not!"
Vera retorts word by word, a newfound confidence sparkling in her emerald eyes.
After reaching Myth Nine Stars, she no longer has to endure in front of Liu Li!
"You—"
Liu Li suddenly erupts with a fiery red blaze around her, her hair moving without wind.
This Green Tea Spirit actually dares...
Vera fearlessly raises her head, a dazzling Elf Power gathering in her palm.
The days of constantly yielding due to lack of strength are, starting today...
All in the past!
But just as the two Guardian Beasts are on the verge of conflict, Gu Xing’s Spiritual Power suddenly materializes in the Beast Taming Space.
In an instant—
"Master~"
Vera instantly retracts her battle stance, her hands folded in front, revealing a sweet smile.
Liu Li also immediately extinguishes the flames around her, bowing respectfully.
Both Guardian Beasts perfectly demonstrate a harmonious relationship.
After all, showing discord in front of the Beast Taming Master is a big no-no.
Gu Xing scratches his head in some confusion but doesn’t dwell on it.
Liu Li and Vera have been together the longest, there shouldn’t be any major issues.
Gu Xing’s gaze locks on Sally.
He then slowly approaches.
But Sally seems lost in self-doubt, not noticing his approach at all.
"Sally? Sally?"
It’s only on the third call that Sally snaps out of it, looking up suddenly:
"Wha- what is it? Master.....no, what instructions does Lord Gu Xing have?"
Seeing the panic-stricken Sally, Gu Xing instinctively touches his face.
Am I so frightening?
Why does it seem like Sally is scared of him?
Moreover...
Sally just called him master...
Then immediately corrected herself?
Could it be she doesn’t want to become his Guardian Beast?!
But during the sacrifice, Sally seemed willing to become his Guardian Beast?
Sally’s response directly makes Gu Xing feel a bit self-doubting.
But fortunately.....
Gu Xing notices that though she refuses to call him master verbally, she doesn’t reject his approach.
The pair of semi-transparent little hands twist nervously together, clearly struggling internally.
Gu Xing, curious, directly asks her:
"Sally, what is it?"
The little cat girl hesitates for a long time, finally mustering the courage to look up:
"Lord Gu Xing, I, I wish to continue being your maid!"
"I’ll definitely work hard to restore my body and fulfill my maid duties!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing suddenly understands.
Sally isn’t rejecting him.
On the contrary, she seems a bit hard on herself!
Thinking of this.
Gu Xing decides to give Sally a little confidence.
"Sally, I think you have better choices than being my maid."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 224: Contract Completed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 224: Chapter 224: Contract Completed!
Sally’s pupils suddenly constricted, the whole cat frozen in place as if struck by lightning.
A better choice than being a maid...?
She blankly tilted her little face up, cat ears twitching uneasily, completely unable to understand the meaning behind Gu Xing’s words.
What choice?
As Gu Xing looked at the catgirl standing somewhat foolishly in front of him, he reached out to rub her somewhat ethereal little head.
"Do you really want to be my little maid forever? Don’t you want to change your identity?!"
"You have your own thoughts, you have your own future..."
Hearing this series of words, a trace of fear appeared in Sally’s eyes.
Why would Master Gu Xing suddenly say this to her?
Could it be because she currently lacks the ability to take care of Lord Gu Xing, and he no longer wants her as his little maid?
"No!"
She suddenly lunged forward, her intangible arms clinging tightly to Gu Xing’s waist, "Please, Sally really won’t cause any trouble!"
Sally had no thoughts of her own, nor did she want a future.
All she wanted was to stay by Gu Xing’s side, forever his little maid.
Feeling the trembling little figure in his arms, Gu Xing instantly understood that Sally had definitely got the wrong idea.
He placed both hands on Sally’s shoulders, forcing her to meet his gaze:
"Sally! Calm down!"
When those tear-filled feline eyes finally met his, Gu Xing spoke clearly and slowly:
"What I mean is..."
"From now on, you will stay by my side as a Guardian Beast."
"From now on, you don’t need to call me Master Gu Xing, but instead should call me... Master!"
Master?!
This title exploded in Sally’s mind like a bolt of thunder.
As a Guardian Beast, she knew all too well what this title meant...
Only a Guardian Beast with a signed contract has the right to call their Beast Master this.
Could it be that... Master Gu Xing wants to...
A huge surprise flooded her heart like a tidal wave, only to ebb away completely in an instant.
"No! Absolutely not!"
Sally shook her head furiously, her cat ears trembling violently.
With such a poor talent, how could she take up one of Master Gu Xing’s precious Contract Positions?
Being a little maid was already an immense fortune, becoming a Guardian Beast...
"Master Gu Xing, Sally really isn’t worthy!"
Her eyes reddened with urgency, her voice tinged with tears.
But Gu Xing could see through her little thoughts at a glance and immediately put on a stern face:
"Sally, what’s the first duty of a maid?"
"It’s to, to obey orders..." the little catgirl answered instinctively.
"Then I now order you—"
Gu Xing said, word by word, "Become my Guardian Beast, will you defy me?"
"But! But..."
Sally stomped her feet anxiously but found no reason to refute.
Seeing his opportunity, Gu Xing cupped her little face in his hands:
"And who says your talent is lacking? The ability to manipulate time is what many dream of."
"Your current level is just a bit low, once you grow, you won’t be inferior to anyone."
Hearing these words, Sally’s somewhat excited body began to calm down gradually.
She looked up to see Gu Xing’s incredibly serious eyes.
It seemed that Master Gu Xing wasn’t lying to her!
Sally bit her lip, "R-really?"
Gu Xing nodded without hesitation.
This was not just comfort...
