Since his future self deliberately left Sally as part of the Time Spirit Clan, it proved she must have irreplaceable importance.
What’s more, he had indeed left his Contract Quota vacant for too long now.
[Gu Xing]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Guardian Beast: Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue]
[Special State: Human Race’s Favor]
[Divine Pattern: 2]
[Contract Quota: 3/5]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might, Absolute Forbidden Domain]
At this moment, Gu Xing was gazing at the remaining slots in his Contract Quota.
With two vacancies, his mind was already made up.
One without a doubt was reserved for the little catgirl in front of him.
As for the other...
The image of Tushan Yueli flashed in his mind.
Right now, he urgently needed a Guardian Beast adept at control.
Tushan Yueli clearly fit this requirement.
But more suitable than Tushan Yueli was actually...
Snow Woman!
A top-tier support and healing type Guardian Beast!
If he could contract with Snow Woman, it would undoubtedly be the best choice.
However...
This thought was quickly dismissed with a shake of his head.
A Totem Level being would never stoop to contract with someone not even at Monarch Level.
Putting aside any distractions, Gu Xing noticed Sally’s emotions had stabilized, and he wasted no time in proceeding.
"Sally, let’s form a contract."
Upon hearing this, the little catgirl’s ears twitched slightly.
After a brief hesitation, she finally nodded solemnly, eyes filled with a determined fire.
She vowed to repay this trust with a thousandfold effort.
A cyan Contract Array slowly manifested in Gu Xing’s palm.
At the moment their palms touched, profound runes swirled around them like stars.
"Buzz——"
A crystal blue thread condensed in the void, tightly intertwining their destinies.
At the moment the contract was completed, Sally gazed at the close-by Gu Xing in a daze, feeling as if she was in a dream.
"Master Gu Xing... am I really not dreaming?"
She timidly extended her translucent fingers, wanting to touch yet fearing to shatter this beautiful dream.
Gu Xing purposely put on a stern face:
"Still calling me Master Gu Xing?"
"Ah!"
Sally snapped out of her daze, her cheeks instantly flushed with a rosy hue.
She lowered her head, murmuring in an almost inaudible voice:
"Master... please take care of me from now on."
The last few words were quiet, but they made the corners of Gu Xing’s mouth curve upwards involuntarily.
He gently patted the little catgirl’s head, and under the infusion of his powerful Spiritual Power, her ethereal body gradually became more solid...
...
The next day.
The Central Square of the Blood-colored Church Capital was bustling with noise, masses of people so dense that not even a drop of water could trickle through.
Countless Beast Masters stuck at the peak of Commander Tier watched with fervent eyes.
They had been stuck in this Realm for far too long.
Today seemed like the time they would finally break through!
Amid deafening cheers, Aus slowly ascended to the platform in the center of the square.
Draped in a white robe embroidered with blood-colored patterns, his aged face conveyed nothing but authority.
"Everyone!"
Aus raised his arm and shouted, his voice resonating throughout the square.
"The Empress wants us to submit to Longxia Country, what an absurd decision!"
"How can our great Blood-colored Church become someone’s vassal?!"
Aus started with a passionate speech as soon as he appeared.
Given his long-term management of Blue Star’s affairs and the Empress’s rare intervention, his prestige was indeed greater here.
Moreover, having long seized control of Blue Star’s Holy See’s armed forces, any dissenters dared not speak up at this moment.
"The Blood-colored Church needs to rely on no one!"
"Agreed!"
The sounds of opposition grew louder and louder.
Seeing this scene, a satisfied smile appeared on Aus’s face.
Then, he waved his hand slightly:
"Bring Her Highness the Saintess and the other bishop up!"
"If the Saintess doesn’t reveal the location of the Beast Taming Holy Pool today, she stands against all of us."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 225: Strength Is the Foundation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 225: Chapter 225: Strength Is the Foundation!
The crowd present erupted instantly upon hearing this sentence.
In the center of the clamorous crowd, Cecilia and an elderly man with white hair were escorted onto a high platform.
As people got a clear look at Cecilia’s face, the atmosphere at the scene became more feverish.
"This time, we can finally enter the Beast Taming Holy Pool! The Empress simply doesn’t understand that not everyone can break through to the Monarch Level!"
"Why lock the Beast Taming Holy Pool? Why aren’t we allowed to use it?"
"She just wants to monopolize the energy of the Holy Pool for herself!"
Led by several Commander Level peak Beast Masters, the crowd was furious, waving their fists as if the Church Court Empress had committed an unforgivable crime.
Voices occasionally arose among the crowd to defend the Empress, but they were quickly drowned out in waves of anger.
Cecilia looked at the scene before her, a wave of indescribable desolation welling up in her heart.
She felt deeply unworthy for the Empress’s sacrifices.
She knew well that the Empress concentrated the power of the Holy Pool to cultivate Beast Masters capable of breaking through to the Monarch Level on their own.
These strong individuals could play a decisive role on the battlefield against the Demon Race.
More importantly, the wounded who had been fed on by the Blood Race needed the energy of the Holy Pool for rapid recovery.
This was the real reason why the Empress valued the Beast Taming Holy Pool so highly.
Yet at this moment, the Empress’s meticulous intentions were misunderstood by everyone.
Ironically, those leading the protest were the very people protected behind Blue Star, never having faced the threat of the Demon Race.
Cecilia’s eyes were filled with confusion and pain.
Why?
Why are the people whom the Empress protects such as these?
What is the meaning of their cooperation with the Blood Race?
Just as Cecilia was struggling with this, she failed to notice a figure among the crowd...
Gu Xing looked at the fervent crowd around him, frowning deeply.
He originally thought this was just the Blood-colored Church’s routine ceremony before opening the Beast Taming Holy Pool, but unexpectedly...
A bishop had actually rebelled!
Even more outrageous was that this bishop had imprisoned Cecilia, the Holy Daughter!?
To Gu Xing, this scene was...
Utterly ridiculous!
This bishop, living comfortably on Blue Star for too long, had forgotten...
Power is the only true voice!​
His gaze swept across the crowd; apart from two Low Tier Monarch Level Beast Masters, the rest of their power was almost entirely at Commander Level.
With just this level of strength, they dared to rebel?
The corner of Gu Xing’s mouth twitched slightly.
The bishop’s mind...
Must be missing something!
At the same time.
On the high platform, Bishop Aus slowly approached Cecilia, eyes gleaming with excitement, lowering his voice:
"Cecilia, do you see it clearly? This is the will of the people!"
"If you’re wise, tell me the entrance to the Beast Taming Holy Pool now."
"This is good for you, for me, and for everyone..."
"After all..."
He slightly turned, glancing at the bound elderly man beside him with a cold tone:
"You wouldn’t want to see another bishop, dying because of you, would you?"
Upon hearing these words, Cecilia’s resolve began to waver.
The Empress had once revealed that the Beast Taming Holy Pool was related to the Divine Pattern and instructed her to ensure the safety of the Holy Pool.
But now...
The Northern Territory had already fallen; the entrance to the second Divine Pattern was occupied by the Demon Race, and the Divine Pattern was very likely to fall into their hands.
If so, even if the Beast Taming Holy Pool...
Telling Bishop Aus seemed inconsequential?
Moreover, the bishop being held hostage was akin to a family member to both her and the Empress...
Just as Cecilia was about to relent and reveal the entrance to the Beast Taming Holy Pool...
A figure leaped onto the high platform, Gu Xing decided he could watch no longer.
He had to complete the awakening of the Divine Pattern as soon as possible!
And if Cecilia spoke out the location of the Holy Pool, it would only complicate matters, so he immediately intervened:
"Wait!"
The voice clearly reached everyone’s ears.
"I think your Empress made no mistake; opening the Beast Taming Holy Pool to these Commander Level peak Beast Masters is a waste of resources."
"It would be better to give the opportunity to me."
Gu Xing’s sudden appearance caused a stir among the crowd below the stage.
"Who is this person? How come I’ve never seen him before?"
"Daring to provoke the bishop at a moment like this, he must be tired of living!"
"Daring to step up with just a Commander Level aura? He truly doesn’t know his limits!"
The discussions incessantly reached Gu Xing’s ears, but he ignored them, focusing only on Bishop Aus.
"What do you think, Bishop?"
After seeing who it was, Bishop Aus’s heart tightened, initially thinking it was reinforcements sent by the Empress.
But after sensing Gu Xing’s aura carefully, his face immediately curved into a disdainful smile.
"I thought it was some significant figure..."
"Turns out it’s just a Commander Level nobody."
Did such a person dare to interfere in this matter?
Aus sneered and waved:
"Someone, take down this arrogant boy for me!"
In his view, if the other party were truly powerful, perhaps he would be somewhat apprehensive.
But daring to be presumptuous in front of him at a mere Commander Level?
Utterly laughable!
However.
Aus failed to notice...
Behind him, upon seeing Gu Xing, Cecilia’s pupils constricted instantly, bursting with a glimmer of hope.
She knew Gu Xing’s true strength.....
Back when he was merely Commander Tier One, he could slay a Monarch Level demon!
And now...
In such a short time since they last met, Gu Xing had already reached Commander Peak!
This meant his strength...
Could only be even more terrifying!
This crisis was savable!
And indeed, as she expected.
The Beast Masters present were mostly at the Commander Level, with the strongest being Low Tier Monarch Level.
Such strength...
Was no match in front of Gu Xing!
Even Qing Shuang, the weakest under his command...
Could easily crush Monarch Level enemies!
Thus...
In a mere instant, Gu Xing commanded a few Guardian Beasts and knocked out this group of Commander Level Beast Masters as easily as chopping vegetables.
After handling the small fries, Gu Xing leisurely approached Bishop Aus, with a strand of mockery in his gaze.
By this time, Bishop Aus had lost all ability to think rationally.
Living comfortably on Blue Star for a prolonged time, he had forgotten the most important truth...
Power is the fundamental essence of all!​​
And now, the truth was held by the young man before him.
Watching Gu Xing effortlessly deal with all the combat forces, he finally panicked.
"Wh-why would you help the Holy Daughter? What can she give you? I-I’ll give you double!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing couldn’t help but chuckle.
"She indeed can’t offer me anything."
"But..."
His gaze suddenly turned cold:
"I didn’t like your earlier behavior of denigrating Longxia Country!"
Before his voice fell, Gu Xing decisively commanded Qing Shuang to incapacitate this bishop.
He wouldn’t show any mercy to such scum.
Casually, regardless of the bishop’s wails, he approached Cecilia and unlocked her shackles:
"Holy Daughter, I’ve saved you..."
"Shouldn’t you tell me the entrance to the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 226: Divine Pattern Awakening!
chapters.content:
Chapter 226: Chapter 226: Divine Pattern Awakening!
And Cecilia gazed at Gu Xing, who was so near, momentarily taken aback.
The last time they met was within the Divine Secret Realm.
Back then, both of them were merely at the Extraordinary Level.
And now...
Gu Xing had already reached the Peak of Commander Tier Nine Realm.
And herself?
Still lingering at Commander Tier Two.
This gap...
Had become so vast!
Not to mention, Gu Xing’s actual combat power far exceeded his level, leaving her far behind.
"Hmm? Can’t tell me the location of the Beast Taming Holy Pool?"
Seeing Cecilia’s delayed response, Gu Xing slightly furrowed his brow.
Logically, since the Empress had already informed Cecilia about the association between the Beast Taming Holy Pool and the Divine Runes, she shouldn’t refuse.
"Lord Gu Xing, please follow me!"
Hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Cecilia finally came to her senses and hurriedly replied.
Although both of them were of similar age, now...
They were no longer on the same level.
Cecilia dared not call his name directly anymore.
She was well aware of her position!
And what shocked her even more was...
Two Divine Runes were prominently displayed on Gu Xing’s forehead!
This meant, he was able to seize the Divine Runes from the heavily surrounded Demon Race!
This...
How did he manage to do it?
Although her mind was filled with countless thoughts, Cecilia dared not delay her actions for a moment.
Soon, she led Gu Xing deep into the church.
The Void Passage leading to the Beast Taming Holy Pool was set with a special restriction by the Empress...
Only the Holy Daughter and the Empress herself could open it.
Even Bishop Aus was completely unaware of this.
For this reason, he was so eager to pressure Cecilia.
Soon.
With Cecilia’s skillful manipulation, the Void Passage to the Beast Taming Holy Pool finally opened slowly.
Once the passage appeared, Cecilia immediately led the way respectfully from the front.
This excessive respect surprised Gu Xing a little.
Logically, last time in the Divine Secret Realm he was not exactly friendly to Cecilia, and thought he would face difficulties this time, unexpectedly...
She behaved so compliantly.
But this was good too, saving a lot of trouble.
Passing through the Void Passage, the two quickly reached the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
Gu Xing glanced around and found that the structure here was quite similar to that of the Holy Pool in Longxia Country, but...
The remaining Spiritual Qi concentration was far higher than that in Longxia Country.
Perhaps this was the result of the Holy See’s Empress’s rigorous management.
"Lord Gu Xing, please feel free to use it."
After saying this, Cecilia respectfully stepped aside, her bowed and submissive posture akin to that of a maid.
Gu Xing was not polite, heading straight to the center of the Holy Pool.
With a thought, the Divine Runes on his forehead emerged.
Randomly, Gu Xing also summoned several of his Guardian Beasts.
Since they were at the Holy Pool, this opportunity couldn’t be wasted.
With the flashes of summoning light, several Guardian Beasts appeared one after another.
Absorbing the energy of the Holy Pool was also greatly beneficial to them.
As soon as Liu Li and Vera appeared, they tactfully took places on opposite sides, with a palpable tension between them.
But after a cold snort from the two, they silently began contesting for the energy of the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
Clearly, some rift had developed between them.
Gu Xing felt a bit helpless seeing this, but couldn’t think of a good way to mediate.
Next, Sally and Qing Shuang also refused to lag behind, immediately joining the energy scramble.
Seeing the performance of the Guardian Beasts, Gu Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Sally could quickly elevate her level through the Beast Taming Holy Pool.
And Qing Shuang could absorb the pool’s energy to prepare for the next advancement.
Both Guardian Beasts were making great efforts!
However...
His gaze shifted to Liu Li and Vera.
The absorption of the Beast Taming Holy Pool’s energy by these two was not very significant, yet now...
They were absorbing madly out of spite, trying to outdo each other.
Gu Xing was quite helpless seeing this.
Logically, these two Guardian Beasts had spent the most time together.
It was the least likely for a conflict to break out!
Yet now...
"Alas!"
Just as Gu Xing was troubled over this, a petite figure sneaked over quietly.
Fei Yue slyly approached Gu Xing’s ear:
"Master, I have a way to make Sister Liu Li and Sister Vera reconcile~"
"Hmm?"
Gu Xing cast a look of doubt.
"As long as Master takes Sister out alone tomorrow, leaving the space for me and the two sisters, I assure you they’ll be back to their old selves when you return!"
Although he thought the suggestion seemed a bit dubious, Gu Xing still nodded in agreement.
After all, he had no better solution at the moment, letting Fei Yue try was harmless.
Besides...
There was nothing inappropriate about the master going out alone with his Guardian Beasts!
Seeing her plan succeed, Fei Yue excitedly flashed a victory sign...
Finally, she created a chance for the master and sisters to be alone!
She joined the energy absorption of the Holy Pool in satisfaction, skipping along.
With Fei Yue entering the scene, six energy whirlpools instantly appeared on the spot.
The largest of them was the Divine Runes.
It almost occupied half of the entire Beast Taming Holy Pool.
Next were Liu Li and Vera, whose current talent absorbed the pool’s energy at an equally terrifying speed.
Then came Qing Shuang and Fei Yue, with Sally being the weakest.
And Cecilia, watching Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts and Divine Runes absorb the Holy Pool’s energy at such a speed, was also stupefied.
She hadn’t expected that besides the Divine Runes absorbing the pool’s energy,
Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts absorbed the pool’s energy at such a terrifying speed.
In theory, the higher the talent, the greater the energy absorption from the pool.
Those Elf and Angel...
This speed was beyond human!
She felt it was nearing the limit of the Myth Level.
Even the weakest Guardian Beast’s absorption speed was approaching Myth Talent!
Looking at this scene, Cecilia couldn’t help but swallow.
No wonder Lord Blood Ancestor signed a Blood Covenant with Gu Xing!
Immediately after.
Sally’s absorption speed slowed, gradually stopping.
Her talent was only Legend One Star, making her energy absorption from the pool extremely limited.
Now she was completely saturated!
Sally looked at Gu Xing, showing an apologetic gaze.
She really had absorbed to her fullest!
But Gu Xing didn’t mind, he just glanced at Sally’s attributes.
[Sally]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Talent: Legend One Star]
[Race: Time Spirit Race]
[Power: 1]
[Constitution: 1]
[Spirit: 2000]
[Speed: 1]
[Skills: Time Freeze, Time Slowdown]
Seeing Sally’s attributes, Gu Xing shook his head somewhat helplessly.
He initially thought that with Sally’s level increasing, her other attributes would change.
But unexpectedly...
Even now, with Sally at Extraordinary Level, her other attributes were still only 1.
Yet the speed of her Spiritual Power increase was incredibly terrifying!
Gu Xing estimated that perhaps only when Sally’s talent broke through to the Myth Level could this defect be improved.
Subsequently, the other Guardian Beasts also completed their breakthroughs one after another.
Liu Li and Vera’s talent was already at the peak of Myth Nine Stars, and there was no change after absorbing this energy.
However, after Qing Shuang and Fei Yue absorbed the power, the aura they emitted grew noticeably stronger.
Gu Xing observed with satisfaction and nodded.
After that, his gaze landed on the Divine Runes.
At this moment, he could feel that the absorption by the Divine Runes was nearing its end.
This also meant that the second Divine Rune was about to be completely awakened.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 228: Is There Something Wrong with My Body?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 228: Chapter 228: Is There Something Wrong with My Body?!
Next.
After Gu Xing helped Cecilia take control of the situation, he retreated with his mission accomplished.
However.
He did not choose to leave immediately.
After all, Fei Yue had told him earlier that there was a way to mediate the conflict between Vera and Liu Li.
It’s best to resolve gaps between Guardian Beasts as soon as possible.
Therefore, Gu Xing decided to stay here for another day.
On one hand, to give Fei Yue time, on the other hand, he needed a break for his tense nerves after these busy times.
Summoning Liu Li and Vera, Gu Xing issued a command:
"Today, you will follow Fei Yue!"
Upon hearing the command, the combative Liu Li and Vera instantly froze.
Leave the master?!
This command was the first-time Gu Xing had issued.
Almost at the same time, both objected, two voices nearly echoed simultaneously.
"No way!"
Before the words fell, they continued to glare at each other, making the air seem to spark invisibly.
Seeing this scene further solidified Gu Xing’s resolve.
Resolving the conflict between the two has become urgent.
But without a better solution, he could only place his hopes on Fei Yue.
"It’s decided, this is Blue Star, there isn’t any danger."
"Moreover, with Lilith and Qing Shuang by my side, we can handle any unforeseen events."
He paused, sweeping his gaze between the two Guardian Beasts:
"You two stay here today, and follow Fei Yue’s instructions."
After saying this, not giving the two Guardian Beasts a chance to speak, Gu Xing turned around and left.
Watching Gu Xing’s departing figure, the two instinctively wanted to chase after him.
But Fei Yue blocked Liu Li and Vera’s path.
Fei Yue nervously gulped.
Facing two sisters far stronger than herself, her legs were slightly trembling.
But thinking of her sister made her gather courage to speak:
"Liu, Liu Li sister, Vera sister, today...you have to listen to me!"
Her voice was as faint as a mosquito, with a pronounced tremor.
Even though she knew they wouldn’t really harm her, if the two got angry, they could still give her a beating.
At such close proximity, even if she wanted to use Void Power to avoid, it was completely impossible.
Luckily, Vera and Liu Li, no matter what, would obey Gu Xing’s commands.
Since the master instructed them to stay and follow Fei Yue’s instructions, it certainly had its reasons.
"Fei Yue, did the master give any specific tasks, just tell us straight." Liu Li glanced at the tense Fei Yue and spoke directly.
Seeing the two so calm, Fei Yue sighed with relief.
Quickly, her heart started to race again.
Although she was well aware of the cause of the two’s conflict, to resolve this kind of disagreement...
She didn’t have a particularly good solution either!
The confident appearance she showed in front of Gu Xing earlier was merely an act.
"Fei Yue, is the task difficult this time? Why aren’t you speaking?" Vera asked, seeing Fei Yue silent.
Although there was conflict with Liu Li, Gu Xing’s tasks must be the top priority!
Fei Yue glanced between Liu Li and Vera, and in a moment of brilliance said:
"Actually..."
"Master is not very satisfied with you two’s recent behavior, your constant clashes, master may not say it outright but is concerned inside..."
She sneaked a look at their reactions and continued to fabricate:
"So he wants me to mediate, my suggestion is... while the master isn’t here, why not just settle a score between you two!"
Fei Yue’s half-true-half-false words successfully convinced Liu Li and Vera.
After all, it’s likely in Gu Xing’s nature to issue such a command.
And recently, they were aware that their actions were somewhat excessive.
But neither would yield, leading to this situation.
Now, with the master absent, perhaps...
Almost simultaneously, both unleashed their might.
A furious aura shot skyward.
Fei Yue was stunned seeing the scene.
Though she meant settling a score, she didn’t mean this way at all.
If they started battling now, this city wouldn’t stand a chance.
"Stop, stop, stop! Not like this!"
Fei Yue waved her hands frantically, "The master specifically said no fighting!"
She panickedly looked around and suddenly spotted a nearby arcade.
"Use that! Use that to compete!"
Liu Li and Vera looked towards where she pointed, their eyes filled with fighting spirit.
Since they couldn’t fight physically, they would settle it otherwise.
The two exchanged glances, tacitly withdrew their aura, and headed to the shop together.
Watching this, Fei Yue finally relaxed completely, wiped the cold sweat on her forehead, and jogged along.
...
Elsewhere, Gu Xing walked alongside Qing Shuang down a bustling street.
Gu Xing occasionally glanced back, worry etched in his brow.
Could Fei Yue, with her unreliable demeanor, really mediate between Liu Li and Vera?
"Qing Shuang, did Fei Yue share how she plans to handle it?" he asked casually.
"N-no!"
Qing Shuang’s voice was a bit panicked, even slightly trembling.
Gu Xing didn’t look back, so he didn’t notice her odd expression.
At this moment, Qing Shuang’s cheeks were slightly flushed, her eyes flickering, she seemed rather absent-minded.
This was the first time she had been alone with Gu Xing.
Though she often told herself just being by the master’s side was enough, deep within, she still harbored a small bit of anticipation.
Since leaving the Ghost Race, she always cared for Fei Yue as a sister, gradually adopting a cold exterior as armor.
However, the longer she stayed with Gu Xing, the more her facade cracked, revealing her softer side.
The day Fei Yue suggested she and Gu Xing have time alone, though she verbally refused, she couldn’t help but look forward in her heart.
And now, she finally had that opportunity.
"Master..."
Summoning courage, she gently tugged Gu Xing’s sleeve, "Let’s explore up ahead?"
Gu Xing, still preoccupied with Liu Li and Vera, nodded distractedly:
"Alright."
However, when he regained his composure, he realized Qing Shuang had led him somewhere not just an ordinary commercial street, but...
A locale for cultivating close bonds between Guardians and their masters.
To Guardian Beasts and their masters, this place had a more colloquial title...
The Date Sanctuary!
Meanwhile, in the Beast Taming Space.
Lilith rested her chin on her hand, curiously observing the outside world.
A power struggle among Guardian Beasts?
Interesting!
But such foolishness, she would never partakes in her life.
However...
Her hand unconsciously moved to her chest, brow slightly furrowed.
Odd...
Why was there a faint discomfort in her heart?
She looked at her palm, frowning deeper.
"Could there be something wrong with my body?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 229: The Two Little Troublemakers!
chapters.content:
Chapter 229: Chapter 229: The Two Little Troublemakers!
Gu Xing noticed something was wrong the moment he stepped into this area.
All around was a carefully arranged romantic scene, with soft lighting and a faint scent of flowers wafting in the air.
Not far away, several pairs of Guardian Beasts and their masters were intimately snuggled together, creating an ambiguous yet warm atmosphere.
He paused slightly, then turned to look at Qing Shuang beside him.
The girl’s cheeks were visibly flushed, her eyes flickering, and her fingers unconsciously twisting the hem of her clothes, exuding a rare nervousness and shyness.
This....
Even if Gu Xing was slow to react, yet....
In this place right now, coupled with Qing Shuang’s unusual demeanor, he couldn’t possibly fail to understand her thoughts.
But now, it was certainly impossible to focus on these matters.
Not to mention the Demon Race eyeing like a tiger, even Ying Bing’s fate was still uncertain.
If he indulged in romantic sentiments, it would not only be irresponsible to himself but also a neglect of all Longxia Country.
Moreover...
Even if a choice had to be made, his first choice would surely be...
Liu Li!
But since Qing Shuang had mustered the courage to bring him here, he couldn’t reject her outright; that would be too cruel.
He had to think of a way not to hurt her, and to diffuse the awkwardness of the moment.
In a flash, Gu Xing had a stroke of inspiration, raised his hand and waved...
Shua!
Two figures instantly appeared beside him.
"Since we’re here, let’s take a walk together!"
Gu Xing pretended to be relaxed as he spoke, while naturally taking Lilith and Sally’s hands.
Lilith and Sally, still in a dazed state, were pulled forward by Gu Xing to walk ahead.
Lilith blinked, looked down at her small hand being held, and then looked around at the surroundings, instantly understanding something, and a playful smile curved her lips.
Human emotional games?
This is interesting!
As for Qing Shuang, upon seeing the sudden appearance of the two, the blush on her face instantly faded, restoring her chilly demeanor.
Her tenderness would only be reserved for Fei Yue and Gu Xing!
However...
There was a fleeting hint of disappointment deep in her azure eyes.
But this emotion was quickly suppressed by her.
Being able to accompany the master was already enough; one shouldn’t ask for more...
Thinking of this, she quickly followed along. Now that Sally’s body hadn’t recovered, as Gu Xing’s only combat-type Guardian Beast on his side, she had to stay vigilant at all times to ensure the master’s safety.
However, just as they took a few steps forward, a familiar figure suddenly appeared.
"Master, master, it’s bad!"
Fei Yue’s voice carried a hint of panic, "Liu Li and Vera have torn down someone’s shop!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing blinked incredulously.
Did he hear wrong?
"Liu Li and Vera... tore down someone’s shop?"
He wondered what had happened between the two while he was away.
Moreover, wasn’t Fei Yue mediating the conflict between the two?
Why did something still go wrong?!
Without hesitation, Gu Xing immediately recalled his Guardian Beasts into the Beast Taming Space and instructed Fei Yue to lead him to the scene.
On the way there, Fei Yue also apologized to him.
"Master, I’m sorry, it’s all my fault..."
Fei Yue originally wanted the two to resolve their differences through a mini-game, but it didn’t go as planned...
The two were essentially pecking at each other like novices!
Moreover, the game’s difficulty was too high.
The two instantly got heated.
Unable to contain their momentum temporarily...
Resulting in...
The whole shop being trashed.
Most importantly, both were Guardian Beasts without a penny on them.
Naturally, they couldn’t compensate the owner for the losses, hence Fei Yue immediately turned to Gu Xing.
Understanding the ins and outs, several lines appeared on Gu Xing’s forehead.
An Angel, an Elf, and they could actually get heated over a human world game.
Ridiculous!
When they arrived, they saw Liu Li and Vera at the center of the crowd, their heads hung like children who had done something wrong.
The shopkeeper stood in front of them, wanting to speak but daring not to open his mouth...
These two were humanoid Guardian Beasts; surely there must be a powerful Beast Master behind them. How could an ordinary person dare to pursue it?
"No, no problem, the shop is destroyed as it is." The shopkeeper forced a smile.
This statement made the two hang their heads even lower.
Though powerful, they were inherently good and wouldn’t escape responsibility.
Moreover, they knew that their master, Gu Xing, valued principles the most.
"Sincerely sorry."
Gu Xing stepped forward quickly, first glancing helplessly at his Guardian Beasts, then sincerely apologized to the shopkeeper, "We’ll compensate for all the losses."
As he spoke, he took out several Star Stones from the Beast Taming Space.
While lacking cash, he had plenty of Star Stones.
Seeing the Star Stones in Gu Xing’s hand, the shopkeeper was frightened and stood dumbfounded.
Due to the Northern Territory’s fall, the price of one Low Tier Star Stone had been inflated to several hundred thousand yuan.
And now, this Beast Master had several dozen Star Stones in hand, enough to buy ten of his shops.
"Master, that’s too much." The shopkeeper quickly waved his hand.
Gu Xing didn’t give him a chance to refuse, placing the Star Stones in the shopkeeper’s hand and directly led Vera and Liu Li away.
It was too embarrassing, he really didn’t feel like staying any longer!
After leaving, Gu Xing was prepared to end this short relaxation.
Next, he planned to head to the Qingqiu Race.
Now he needed to ensure cooperation between the Qingqiu Race and the Human Race.
Then they might have a chance to reclaim the entrance to the Divine Secret Realm and obtain the Human Race’s third Divine Pattern.
Furthermore...
He intended to try, to see if he could contract Tushan Yueli as his Guardian Beast.
The Snow Woman had no possibility of contracting, but there was a slight possibility with Tushan Yueli.
While leaving, Liu Li and Vera followed behind Gu Xing.
The two exchanged a glance and spoke in unison:
"Master, we’re sorry, we were wrong."
Looking at their obedient apology, Gu Xing swallowed back his intended reprimands and finally just sighed:
"You... should be more careful in the future!"
However, seeing them almost returning to normal now, Gu Xing was somewhat relieved.
Although Fei Yue’s plan hadn’t produced the desired effect.
But the unexpected incident they caused surprisingly reduced their conflict quite a bit.
Overall, it was a good thing.
Meanwhile, Fei Yue sneaked to Qing Shuang’s side, her eyes bright and lowered her voice to ask:
"Sister, how was it? Did the date go smoothly?"
Qing Shuang, upon hearing this, her eyes flickered slightly.
She gently shook her head without saying another word.
In the next second, her figure transformed into a stream of light and entered the Beast Taming Space.
"Hey? Sister!"
Fei Yue reached out only to grasp empty air.
Her face was filled with a bit of confusion.
What did sister mean by this?
Was it a success or not?
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 230: The Angel Race Visits!
chapters.content:
Chapter 230: Chapter 230: The Angel Race Visits!
The other side.
Qingqiu Fox Race.
The tranquil habitat welcomed outsiders today.
Under the astonished gazes of all, several War Angels walked toward the central great hall of the habitat.
"What are these angels here for? It’s the first time a battle race has come here."
"Haven’t the Demon Race been itching to mess with us lately? Maybe these angels are partners the Queen has invited."
"Exactly! The Angel Race is a top-tier race with formidable combat strength—they must have come to cooperate with us."
"If Qingqiu’s elders join hands with the Angel Race, won’t we finally have some peace of mind!"
These weaker races looked on at the arrival of the Angel Race, faces full of relief.
Ever since the Empress announced she’d seek alliances with outsiders, they’d been guessing which race it would be.
Now, seeing it’s the illustrious Angel Race, they were naturally elated.
The stronger the allies, the greater their security.
Before the eyes of the expectant crowd, the angels arrived at the doors of the central great hall.
At this moment, Tu Shanyue had already arrived at the hall entrance with Tushan Yueli.
When the pair saw who the visitors were, mother and daughter’s hearts simultaneously sank.
Elder Mills of the War Angel Race!
Earlier, they’d discovered traces suggesting the Angel Race was conspiring with the Demon Race.
Hence, they’d abandoned any hope of cooperation with the Angel Race, choosing instead to approach the Ghost Race.
And now...
This group of angels had come knocking of their own accord—clearly with ulterior motives.
"Your Majesty, Mills of the Angel Race offers you his respects."
Mills pressed a hand to his chest in salute, expressing his sincerity.
He was Mi Zhan’s younger brother, and also one of the War Angel Race’s elders.
Witnessing this, Tu Shanyue’s brows knitted slightly.
Although alarm bells were sounding in her heart, as clan leader, she had to maintain the minimum degree of courtesy.
After all, the evidence of the Angel Race’s collusion with the Demon Race was not yet conclusive; to suddenly burn bridges would be unwise.
What’s more...
Though she was a Totem Level powerhouse, as a fox—unskilled in combat...
If she offended the Angel Race and went up against War Angel Clan Leader Mi Zhan at the Half-step Totem Peak, the outcome would be uncertain.
"May I ask what brings the Angel Race so far to visit us?"
Tu Shanyue maintained a proper smile, but her voice held a faint, well-measured coldness.
Mills glanced about the surroundings, then at Tu Shanyue.
"Your Majesty, this doesn’t seem the suitable place for a discussion."
Upon hearing this, Tu Shanyue flicked her hand, and the group appeared in the council hall.
After everyone was seated, she spoke again, with an obvious tone of probing:
"May I ask why the Angel Race has come to visit us—a gathering of feeble races huddling together for warmth?"
Mills smiled lightly and shook his head:
"You’re too modest, Your Majesty. The Qingqiu Race is adept in arts of control and sealing. What’s more..."
He paused meaningfully, "You yourself are a genuine Totem Level expert. How can you call yourselves a small race?"
Tu Shanyue’s gaze grew ever colder.
Though she wasn’t skilled in combat, if the other party kept provoking, she didn’t mind letting these angels witness the might of a Totem Level powerhouse.
Seeming to sense the shift in atmosphere, Mills finally dropped the probing and got straight to the point:
"Your Majesty, we have come to propose establishing an alliance with the Qingqiu Race."
Alliance?
Tu Shanyue was taken aback by these words.
The anger she’d felt moments ago dissipated.
The Angel Race taking the initiative to seek cooperation with the Qingqiu Race?
Something’s not right!
Normally, it’s the weaker races that pursue alliances with the strong.
After all, those who propose the alliance lose the initiative.
And these angels would know this perfectly well. What’s more, the Angel Race, though lacking Totem Level combat power at present, still possesses Monarch Level strength—the greatest in the Alternate Space.
No other race can compare.
For such a mighty race to seek alliance with the Qingqiu Race?
Tu Shanyue’s sharp gaze swept over the angels again and again, yet their true intent remained elusive.
But one thing was certain...
She would never choose to ally herself with the Angel Race.
Not only because of their suspected collusion with the Demon Race, more importantly...
Tushan Yueli had already brought back a message—
A Human had emerged—an epoch-making genius.
Though she intended to verify this herself, with Tushan Yueli’s meticulous character, the report was almost certainly true.
"Apologies, but our Qingqiu Race has no wish to cooperate with you."
Hearing this, Mills of the Angel Race was stunned.
Tu Shanyue’s answer was wholly unexpected.
With the strength of Qingqiu, a lack of allies would leave them isolated and vulnerable.
Therefore...
Ever since Mi Zhan gave him this order, his confidence had been unshakable.
But...
Things today had turned out well beyond his expectation.
"Your Majesty, you ought to reconsider."
"Without our alliance, by Qingqiu’s strength alone, you will never withstand the Demon Race’s assault."
"That need not trouble the Angel Race," Tu Shanyue promptly dismissed him, "Yueli, see them out."
Tu Shanyue had no wish to entangle further with these angels, and signaled directly for Tushan Yueli to escort them away.
Seeing this, Mills’ face immediately darkened, but he could only acquiesce helplessly.
Though Clan Leader Mi Zhan had no fear of Tu Shanyue, as for Mills—just an elder—he did not dare show disrespect before a Totem Level powerhouse.
As they left, Mills stealthily drew several black crystals from his sleeve, and, while the guards were distracted, tossed them into hidden corners of the Qingqiu Clan Land.
Quickening his pace, he led the angels swiftly away.
The Demonic Qi swirling around those black crystals made his heart pound, yet with a mission entrusted personally by Mi Zhan, he had no choice but to comply.
Before departure, Mi Zhan had specially warned:
If alliance fails, then covertly leave the crystals in the Qingqiu Clan Land.
Though their purpose remained unclear, Mills vaguely guessed their meaning...
But this matter, he must not let any of those ordinary War Angels know.
Or else, with the average War Angel’s hatred of the Demon Race, even the Clan Leader himself... couldn’t contain them!
In the great hall, Tu Shanyue gazed at her daughter, asking in a low voice:
"Yueli, in your view, what is the true aim of the Angel Race’s visit?"
Tushan Yueli pondered briefly, worry flickering in her eyes:
"Mother, could they be probing on behalf of the Demon Race? After all, the Demon Race has always coveted the Divine Pattern in your hand..."
Tu Shanyue was silent for a long time at these words.
This was the worst-case scenario, and the last thing she wanted to confront.
Originally she’d only suspected a handful of traitors within the Angel Race had defected to the Demon Race—but if the entire Angel Race had turned...
"It... shouldn’t have reached such an extent."
Tu Shanyue murmured softly, yet even she failed to convince herself.
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 231: King-level Fierce Beast!
chapters.content:
Chapter 231: Chapter 231: King-level Fierce Beast!
On the other side.
There is still half a month’s journey left to the destination left by Tushan Yueli.
Gu Xing leads several Guardian Beasts on a swift journey, continuously clearing Demon Race outposts along the way.
This period of battles has made him clearly feel that the first Divine Pattern on his forehead is becoming increasingly full.
The golden lines are flowing with surging power, seemingly ready to break through the critical point at any moment.
"It seems that it won’t be long before the first Divine Pattern brings an attribute enhancement."
His current goal is very clear—
First, elevate his own attributes to the peak of Commander Level, while also completing the final preparations for Qing Shuang’s advancement.
In the depths of his mind, he has a premonition:
First, enhance the Guardian Beast’s talent to Myth Nine Stars, then assist them in advancing to Monarch Level, the enhancement brought will be even more astonishing!
And now...
Vera and Liu Li’s talent has already been enhanced to Myth Nine Stars.
Sally’s talent is truly too low...
Trying to enhance it to Myth Nine Stars is too difficult, hence it’s not considered.
As for Qing Shuang, only one Ghost Core material is missing.
And Fei Yue...
[Ghost Race (Fei Yue)]
[Status: Twin Contract]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Power: 20000→50000]
[Constitution: 20000→50000]
[Spirit: 20000→50000]
[Speed: 20000→50000]
[Skills: Instant Flash, Voidification, Void Cutting, Void Domain]
Although her level was recently elevated to Commander Tier Nine, all attributes have yet to reach the limit of this level.
Gu Xing is currently planning on the Commander Level...
To simultaneously elevate Fei Yue’s talent to Myth Nine Stars, striving to max out each of her attributes.
After all, even though Fei Yue isn’t particularly adept at combat, her control over the Void is an indispensable ability for him.
Moreover...
Fei Yue is also his Guardian Beast, so he certainly cannot show favoritism.
It’s just that the materials needed for enhancing Fei Yue’s talent are giving him a headache:
[Void Stone, Heart of Void, Void Insect Race Essence Blood]
Regarding the Void Stone, he has heard about it.
The other two, he has never heard of!
And as for that Void Insect Race Essence Blood...
Honestly speaking.
In the Alternate Space, Gu Xing has never heard of this race.
Let alone...
The need to obtain the essence blood from this race!
Thinking of this, he gently shakes his head.
For now, let’s focus on Qing Shuang’s talent enhancement and breaking through his own attributes.
As for Fei Yue’s materials, he can only slowly investigate them in the future.
After all, who knows when the next Divine Secret Realm will open.
When that time comes, the level allowed to enter the Divine Secret Realm will be below Totem Level.
Truthfully, in his current state, he doesn’t have absolute confidence.
Though when facing Monarch Level experts, even if the opponent is stronger, he has the confidence to fight and win.
But if confronted with a Half-step Totem Level opponent...
Gu Xing’s fingertips unconsciously rub against the Divine Pattern, his brows furrowing.
Vera and Liu Li, with just a hint of Power of Laws, can easily overpower Monarch Level experts.
If encountering an enemy with near-perfect Law Control...
Absolutely no chance of victory!
Thinking of this, Gu Xing takes a deep breath.
Though he strives to ensure each Guardian Beast receives the best cultivation, if unable to reach the short-term goals, he may have to choose to first break through to Monarch Level, securing the base combat strength.
After resting for a moment, Gu Xing prepares to call the Guardian Beasts to set off on the journey once more.
However.
"Boom—!!"
A sudden explosion shakes the earth, mountains tremble.
Gu Xing’s nerves instantly tighten, his gaze sweeping the surroundings.
"What’s going on?"
The Human Race has not explored the Alternate Space much.
This area is even more remote from Human Race territories.
Thus, utmost caution is required.
Vera and Liu Li also instantly enter combat mode.
However...
Lilith appears suddenly, a hint of urgency on her face.
"Gu Xing, have Fei Yue take you into the Void, quickly."
This is the first time Gu Xing has seen Lilith so out of composure.
Even though he doesn’t understand, he hesitates not for a moment, shouting:
"Fei Yue."
Almost the instant the command is spoken, Fei Yue has already pulled him into the Void.
At the same time, Lilith grabs the other Guardian Beasts, retreating rapidly into the Beast Taming Space.
"Lilith, what’s exactly happening?" Gu Xing urgently asks through the Spiritual Link.
Lilith’s voice rarely tightens: "You’ll find out soon..."
As soon as she finishes speaking, a shadow that covers the skies crushes the spot where they originally stood.
When Gu Xing sees the true form of that colossal creature, his pupils shrink dramatically—
It was a giant centipede several hundred meters long!
Its pitch-black shell entangled with sticky Demonic Qi, each section of its body gleaming with metal-like cold light.
As it moved, the ground was plowed open like tofu without effort.
Just when Gu Xing was in shock, the monster suddenly stopped.
The massive head, tens of meters high, suddenly lifts, hundreds of multifaceted eyes simultaneously turning to a certain spot in the Void...
The exact place where they were hiding!
As soon as he was targeted, Gu Xing’s blood seemed to freeze.
Piercing cold surged from the soles of his feet to his crown, even his breath came to a halt.
Fei Yue’s Void Concealment is difficult to detect even for Half-step Totem Level, yet this monster...
"Don’t move!" Lilith sternly warns from the Beast Taming Space, "Absolutely don’t reveal even a hint of hostility! Otherwise, we’ll all die!"
Fortunately, the horrifying centipede merely glanced casually, losing interest, and continued to swim away into the distance.
Not until the shadow that covered the skies vanished completely from view did Gu Xing feel his heart begin to beat again.
In that moment, he genuinely felt the threat of death.
If that monster had attacked him, he would surely have died.
Lilith’s figure reappears, her always calm face rare with gravity:
"Luckily, you are too weak right now to attract its interest."
Gu Xing slowly regains his composure, stiffly turning to look at Lilith.
"Fierce Beast!"
Lilith explains in a deep voice, "Not often heard of in Human Race territories? They are monsters infected by Demonic Qi but not controlled by the Demon Race."
"Fierce Beasts, at minimum, possess Monarch Level strength; these are called ordinary Fierce Beasts."
"Above ordinary Fierce Beasts, there are four King-level Fierce Beasts."
Speaking of this, Lilith’s gaze turns sharp:
"That was one of them—Nine Nether Centipede King, the same one that defeated me back then."
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing’s pupils contract.
King-level Fierce Beast!
This term is the first he’s hearing.
But to have injured Totem Level Lilith, this Nine Nether Centipede King, at the very least, is Totem Level.
Yet Lilith suddenly frowns:
"Logically, this creature should only linger in its territory! Why has it come here?"
After pondering without conclusion, Lilith shakes her head:
"Forget it, let’s keep moving, stay away from that thing. As you are now, you wouldn’t even have a chance to escape if faced with it."
"Understood."
Gu Xing solemnly nods, immediately adjusting his route, slightly veering off the original direction, and continues advancing toward the Qingqiu Race.
However, what no one noticed was that the direction in which the terrifying Nine Nether Centipede King proceeded was precisely...
The Qingqiu Race’s encampment!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 232: Evacuation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 232: Chapter 232: Evacuation!
Deep within the Ghost Clan’s Residence.
You was meditating with closed eyes, suddenly he opened them sharply, his piercing gaze penetrating the void, directly pointing in the direction of the Qingqiu Clan.
As a Totem Level powerhouse, he had certain senses about many things beyond mere awareness.
Just moments ago, a heart-pounding wave was closing in on the Qingqiu Clan Land.
"Qingqiu..." You murmured lowly, his brow furrowed.
The Qingqiu Clan Leader, Tu Shanyue, was likewise a Totem Level existence...
That which could threaten the Qingqiu Clan...
Was only a fierce beast!
You suddenly stood up, his black robe moving on its own without wind.
Immediately, he thought of the Nine Nether Centipede King residing nearby...
That creature’s territory wasn’t far from the Ghost Clan.
The space rippled, and You stepped into the void.
In an instant, his figure appeared above the lair of the Nine Nether Centipede King.
"Sure enough, not here..."
You scanned the entire area with his Spiritual Power, his expression growing increasingly grave.
The worst situation had occurred—
That troublesome fierce beast had genuinely left its lair.
Although the Nine Nether Centipede King hadn’t truly mastered the Power of Laws, not counting as a complete Totem Level, its freakishly strong body made it difficult even for combat-savvy Totem Level powerhouses to deal with.
As for those like Tu Shanyue who weren’t adept at fighting among Totem Levels...
There was absolutely no chance of victory!
The most pressing concern was...
Gu Xing was currently leading his two granddaughters toward the Qingqiu Clan!
Damn it!
You’s fist clenched involuntarily.
But now he couldn’t leave the Ghost Clan’s Residence.
Lately, the Demonic Qi within the Forbidden Land had been disturbingly volatile, with the seal on the verge of breaking, requiring his personal supervision to suppress it.
"I hope that lad can be sharp..."
You gazed in the Qingqiu direction, a flicker of concern in his eyes.
If Gu Xing and his group happened to encounter that monster...
Elsewhere.
On the outskirts of the Qingqiu Clan Base, deep within the dense forest.
Dozens of dark figures lurked in the shadows, each emitting suffocating waves of Demonic Qi...
The weakest among them were Demon Race Monarch Peak powerhouses.
These were two squads from the Demon Race.
One squad was responsible for the Divine Pattern of the Qingqiu Clan, while the other was a Demon Race team that had traveled from the Longxia Country border for the Human Race Divine Pattern.
"To seize the Qingqiu Clan’s Divine Pattern, we must first handle that old fox."
The Demon Race Commander in charge of Qingqiu affairs spoke slowly, his crimson eyes sweeping over all the present demons.
"But just relying on us..."
He shook his head.
Tu Shanyue, though not skilled in fighting, was nonetheless a genuine Totem Level powerhouse.
Attempting to forcibly seize the Divine Pattern with just these demons...was entirely impossible.
However, the Demon Race Commander responsible for Human Race affairs suddenly smirked:
"We indeed can’t deal with that old fox, but..."
He deliberately elongated his tone, "We can use a borrowed blade."
The other demons exchanged puzzled glances.
But this demon offered no further explanation.
He had personal ties with the Demon Race Commander in charge of the Angel Race.
It was through this connection that he managed to persuade Mi Zhan to dispatch War Angels to negotiate with the Qingqiu Clan.
If the Qingqiu Clan were willing to cooperate with the Angel Race, everything would become much simpler.
But if the Qingqiu Clan refused...
The Demon Race Commander’s lips curled into a cruel smile.
...
Qingqiu Clan Base, central hall.
"Lady Yue! It’s bad!"
A Fox Race scout stumbled in, his voice quivering with fear.
"The frontline reconnaissance team reported that a King-level fierce beast is attacking us! At its speed...it will arrive in at most three days!"
Because the Qingqiu Clan sheltered many weak races, they utilized quite a few strange and unusual detection techniques.
The information had just returned through a special instrument capable of transmitting images over long distances.
Tu Shanyue and Tushan Yueli exchanged a look, both furrowing their brows relentlessly.
Nine Nether Centipede King!
A true King-level fierce beast!
With Totem Level strength!
Given the current strength of the Qingqiu Clan, defeating it was entirely impossible.
Moreover, if this Centipede King went berserk, then the entire Qingqiu Clan couldn’t have a single person escape alive at that time.
"Yueli, immediately organize the evacuation of the entire clan!" Tu Shanyue decisively commanded.
Facing a King-level fierce beast head-on was not a wise move, but it was still possible to avoid its sharpness.
However, Tushan Yueli looked troubled.
The clan affairs were typically her responsibility.
Thus, she understood just how large the population of the entire Qingqiu Base was.
How many among them had lost the ability to move, and how many were elderly, women, and children.
Her voice was somewhat tense:
"Mother...the time is too tight, there’s simply no way to evacuate everyone..."
Upon hearing this, Tu Shanyue’s expression instantly became grim.
Indeed, the weaker races sheltered by Qingqiu gave them a numerical advantage, but before a being like the Nine Nether Centipede King, numbers were meaningless...
Besides letting that monster have a bigger feast!
"Start the evacuation." She finally spoke solemnly, "Get as many out as possible...in two days, I’ll personally hold it off."
Tushan Yueli gave her mother a deep look, swallowed her words.
Ultimately, she just nodded solemnly, turned on her heel, and hurriedly left to carry out the orders.
The entire Qingqiu Clan instantly fell into chaos upon receiving the news of a King-level fierce beast attack.
For these non-combatant races, even ordinary fierce beasts were a nightmare, not to mention a King-level beast standing at the apex!
"It’s over...this is a King-level fierce beast..."
"Why is our fate so harsh? We’ve barely found a place to live, but now this disaster strikes."
"Alas! Perhaps this world simply doesn’t allow the weak to survive..."
Desperate whispers spread among the crowd.
Tushan Yueli gazed at these weaker races whose faces were ashen, feeling waves of bitterness.
Three days were far too short; how difficult it was to transfer such a large population?
"Everyone calm down!"
Tushan Yueli’s clear voice spread through every corner via Spiritual Power.
Miraculously, the restless crowd began to quiet down...
On ordinary days, this Princess appeared among them more often than the Empress herself.
If they had awe for Tu Shanyue, they felt sincere affection for Tushan Yueli.
Under countless hopeful eyes, Tushan Yueli took a deep breath:
"Please trust us, the Qingqiu Clan will stand with you, retreating only when the last person is safely evacuated!"
As her words faded, the surrounding Qingqiu Fox Race responded in unison:
"We obey the Princess’s command."
Remarkably, even in the face of a King-level fierce beast’s threat, these non-combatant Fox Race members showed no trace of fear in their eyes.
They stood upright in front of the weaker races, embodying the role of guardians through their actions.
Witnessing this, the surrounding crowd instantly calmed, no longer as frantic.
"Alright, we believe in the Princess, we mustn’t cause trouble for the Princess."
"Yes, everyone quickly assist with transferring resources, prioritize getting the elderly, women, and children out first, let the youngsters help."
Watching the swiftly organized evacuation teams, Tushan Yueli’s taut heartstrings finally relaxed a little.
As long as they’ve started moving!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 233: Lilith’s Ascension!
chapters.content:
Chapter 233: Chapter 233: Lilith’s Ascension!
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.
However, the evacuation progress of the Qingqiu Race was despairing...
Not even half of the population had successfully relocated.
Tushan Yueli looked at the statistical report, her fingertips trembling uncontrollably.
The remaining people needed at least another two days to evacuate completely, but the Nine Nether Centipede King...
That fierce beast was now less than a hundred miles from the base.
With the speed of a King-level Fierce Beast, such a distance could be covered in less than half a day.
By then, not to mention clan members yet to evacuate, even the aftermath of the battle would be enough to reduce the entire base to ashes.
"Mother..."
Tushan Yueli walked heavily into the inner hall, her voice dry:
"The distress signal has been sent out, but after hearing that it’s against a King-level Fierce Beast..."
"Not a single race is willing to help us!"
"The only ones willing to help," Tushan Yueli looked up at Tu Shanyue cautiously before continuing:
"are the Angel Race!"
Hearing this news, Tu Shanyue’s pupils suddenly contracted.
The Angel Race had just left the Qingqiu Base when the King-level Fierce Beast riot occurred.
It was hard not to connect this incident with the Angel Race!
Moreover...
The strength of a King-level Fierce Beast matches that of a Totem Level. Even if the Nine Nether Centipede King is the weakest among the four King-level Fierce Beasts...
It’s definitely not something the current Angel Race can withstand!
And now, the Angel Race is willing to offer help, clearly there’s something fishy!
The greatest likelihood is that they intend to loot a burning house!
"What about the Ghost Race? Any news from the Human Race?" Tu Shanyue asked relentlessly.
Tushan Yueli shook her head bitterly: "The Ghost Race and Human Race bases are too far, and with the Nine Nether Centipede King in between... our distress signal can’t get through at all."
"Damn it!"
Hearing this, even with Tu Shanyue’s composure, she couldn’t restrain herself.
"Bam!"
She punched the jade throne, and crystalline cracks spread like a spider’s web over the armrest.
Though with her Totem Level strength, escaping alone would be a breeze.
But...
She couldn’t abandon her people!
These weaker races see her as their leader and trust her so deeply...
She took a deep breath, and seven fox tails rose high behind her:
"Pass the order, everyone must defend the base to the last moment!"
Just then, a Fox Race guard stumbled into the hall:
"Empress, something major has happened!"
Seeing this panicked fox, Tu Shanyue had an instant premonition of disaster.
"What’s happening?"
Upon Tu Shanyue’s question, the fox quickly replied:
"Empress, the people we’re evacuating..."
"They’ve been intercepted!"
Upon hearing the report, Tu Shanyue felt as though the world spun and a basin of ice water was poured over her head.
Intercepted?!
How could this be!
Everything she was doing now was for the weaker races to leave.
And now...
"Mother!"
Tushan Yueli’s exclamation snapped her back to reality.
She quickly recovered, now was not the time to collapse, she must immediately understand the situation!
"Clarify! What exactly happened?" Tu Shanyue’s voice was like ice.
The guard swallowed and said shakily:
"It’s the Demon Race... they’ve set up ambushes on all evacuation routes."
"Strangely, they only drove our people back without killing them..."
This news sent chills through Tu Shanyue.
The Demon Race intends to...
turn the entire Qingqiu Base into a sacrificial altar for the Nine Nether Centipede King!
At this moment, Tu Shanyue’s fingers clenched tightly.
Demon Race!
Angel Race!
King-level Fierce Beast!
When these three link together...
a massive conspiracy emerges!
...
Meanwhile.
Gu Xing was closing in on the Qingqiu Race base with all his might.
However, Lilith in the Beast Taming Space was lost in thought.
Encountering the Nine Nether Centipede King earlier made her realize that her current strength seemed a bit lacking.
Her original purpose of following Gu Xing...
was to protect Gu Xing’s safety!
And encountering the Nine Nether Centipede King earlier on had made her understand...
That with her current strength, ensuring Gu Xing’s complete safety was becoming challenging.
It seemed like it was time to enhance her own strength!
Gu Xing had now absorbed the second Divine Pattern.
She could also absorb Gu Xing’s blood again to restore her strength.
Moreover, now that Gu Xing had absorbed two Divine Patterns, absorbing his blood would only bring her greater enhancements.
"Gu Xing, stop for a moment!"
Lilith’s voice transmitted into Gu Xing’s mind through his Spiritual Power.
Surprised, Gu Xing, who was on the move, stopped as Lilith had asked.
"Lilith, what’s going on?"
The next moment, Lilith left the Beast Taming Space and appeared before Gu Xing.
Her petite figure hovered in the air, her blood-red eyes meeting Gu Xing’s black eyes.
"Gu Xing, you promised me, you’d help me enhance my strength!"
Under Lilith’s crimson gaze, Gu Xing was momentarily stunned, then nodded solemnly:
"Understood!"
He had promised Lilith earlier that he would do everything possible to help her restore her strength.
And Gu Xing had no intention of going back on his word!
After all, the stronger Lilith became, the more she’d be able to help him...making him even safer!
Without hesitation, he pulled open his collar and closed his eyes:
"Go ahead!"
Seeing this, Lilith twitched her lips.
Why did this scene make her feel as if she were doing something indecent?!
But since Gu Xing was so proactive...
Not cooperating would make her seem insensitive!
The scarlet mist suddenly spread, and her petite form stretched and elongated in the red light.
When the mist cleared, standing before Gu Xing was Lilith dressed in a red gown, with an aura of regal superiority in her eyes.
She was also the Blood Clan Ancestor, the once Totem-level powerhouse—Lady Lilith!
Lilith gracefully opened her arms, gently embracing Gu Xing.
Her red lips parted slightly, revealing a pair of sharp fangs.
When the sharp fangs pierced the skin of his neck, Gu Xing felt a tingling, numbing pain.
The warm blood flowed into Lilith’s mouth through her fangs, her pupils contracted instantly, and her blood-red eyes grew deeper.
"Mmm..."
A sigh of satisfaction escaped her lips.
Simultaneously, the Divine Patterns within both of them were activated, transforming into brilliant golden streams of light that emerged from their bodies.
"Buzz—!!!"
The Divine Patterns intertwined in the air, emitting a strange resonance.
Lilith’s aura began to surge wildly, her blood-red hair waving independently, the red gown fluttering audibly.
More intriguingly, the ancient Blood Contract Rune flickered between them.
In this moment of bloodline fusion, Lilith’s heart, cold for thousands of years, suddenly felt a warmth.
Accompanied by an emotion she had never before experienced...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 234: Soul Devouring Talent’s Transformation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 234: Chapter 234: Soul Devouring Talent’s Transformation!
This sudden, unfamiliar emotion made Lilith’s whole body freeze, and even her action of drinking fresh blood stopped involuntarily.
In those eyes, now even redder from blood-sucking, flashed a rare panic.
This warm yet sour feeling was far too alien for her, who had survived alone for thousands of years.
"Lilith?"
Gu Xing opened his eyes in confusion.
He could clearly sense that Lilith’s strength had only just recovered to Monarch Tier Nine, and his own body was still far from its tolerance limit.
Logically, this time he should at least help her break through to Half-step Totem.
This call snapped Lilith out of her daze.
Meeting Gu Xing’s concerned gaze, that heart of hers—silent for a millennium—began to race uncontrollably.
The always calm and elegant Blood Clan Ancestor was, at this moment, as flustered as a teenage girl.
"Enough, enough..."
She hurriedly let go with her fangs, her voice stuttering in rare embarrassment:
"Monarch Peak... is enough..."
Gu Xing’s words brought Lilith back to her senses.
The blush climbing up her cheeks looked especially striking on her always icy, regal face.
Lilith instinctively turned her face away, afraid Gu Xing might notice even more clues.
Though Gu Xing didn’t understand why Lilith no longer continued to draw blood, he wasn’t planning to dig deeper either.
However, only then did he realize...
His entire body was being tightly embraced by Lilith, and through the thin clothing, he could clearly feel the softness and warmth of her body.
Such close proximity put a hint of awkwardness on Gu Xing’s face.
After all, Lilith wasn’t his Guardian Beast, and being this close to her...
It suddenly made him feel a sense of guilt toward his own Guardian Beasts.
He instinctively wanted to pull away, but froze when he looked up.
Above their heads, three Divine Patterns continued to intertwine, and the Blood Covenant was still emitting a demonic red light, swirling around the Divine Patterns like a living thing.
"Wait!"
Just as Gu Xing withdrew half a step, Lilith’s face suddenly changed dramatically and she pulled him fiercely back into her embrace.
Her strength was astonishing; Gu Xing slammed hard into her chest, his nose instantly flooded with a cool, haunting scent.
At this moment.
Recovering herself, Lilith gazed up at the entangled Divine Patterns in the sky, a hint of shock flashing in her blood-red eyes.
Earlier, she’d been immersed in Gu Xing’s blood and forgotten to pay attention to her surroundings.
Only now did she realize...
Her Divine Pattern was strengthening at a speed visible to the naked eye!
Although she had noticed before that, by Gu Xing’s side, her Divine Pattern would slowly strengthen,
the speed of that strengthening had always been very slow.
But now...
Lilith’s gaze fell on the three Divine Patterns in the air.
Under the influence of Gu Xing’s two Divine Patterns...
Her own Divine Pattern seemed as if fed a tonic, its aura constantly amplifying.
Even stranger, she actually felt... a sense of satisfaction coming from the Divine Pattern?
This...
"Could it be..."
Lilith’s pupils contracted, as a bold speculation surfaced: "Human Race Divine Pattern can nourish other Divine Patterns?"
Once this thought appeared, it couldn’t be shaken.
Thinking back, before the Human Race Divine Pattern emerged...
Those once glorious Races had their Divine Patterns either dissipate with extinction, or fall into the Demon Race’s hands.
But ever since Gu Xing awakened his Divine Pattern, even the Elf Race, left with only one survivor, still had its Divine Pattern intact...
All signs pointed to one possibility—
The Human Race Divine Pattern seemed to be the key to sustaining other Divine Patterns!
"Weng—!!!"
The three Divine Patterns suddenly convulsed violently, exploding in dazzling light.
An incomparably profound energy enveloped both of them; Lilith realized in shock...
Her strength was autonomously rising!
And she hadn’t even absorbed any of Gu Xing’s blood—the upgrade seemed to be entirely brought by the Divine Pattern.
Meanwhile, huge waves surged in Gu Xing’s sea of consciousness.
The previously dormant Soul Devouring Talent suddenly went berserk, devouring the energy spilling from the Divine Pattern like a ravenous wolf.
This Talent was now utterly beyond control, greedily devouring every shred of power.
"What’s happening?!"
Gu Xing looked inside his sea of consciousness, only to see the blood-red Soul Devouring Power rapidly expanding its domain, even starting to invade the Sovereign Talent’s area.
The always-dominant Sovereign Talent immediately struggled to fight back; blue light and blood light collided fiercely.
Yet the Soul Devouring Talent, fed on Divine Pattern energy, seemed reborn, steadily driving the Sovereign Talent back step by step.
After several clashes, the Sovereign Talent had no choice but to retreat into a corner, curled up like a bullied wife.
Only then did the Soul Devouring Talent feel satisfied, continuing to greedily consume Divine Pattern energy.
Gu Xing sensed it using his Spiritual Power.
By continuously absorbing power from the Divine Pattern, the Soul Devouring Talent seemed to be approaching some kind of critical point...
The next moment.
"Boom—!!!"
A rumble only Gu Xing could hear exploded in his consciousness, as the Soul Devouring Talent finally broke through its shackles and completed a qualitative leap.
The Sovereign Talent curled up in the corner glowed blue in grievance, looking for all the world like a bullied bride.
Gu Xing carefully sensed the evolved Talent:
[Soul-devouring: Unconditionally doubles your Guardian Beast’s strength!]
Reading the Soul Devouring Talent’s description,
Gu Xing furrowed his brow slightly.
He vaguely remembered before, it was "unconditionally upgrade Guardian Beast, making its Attributes reach 200%."
But now...
It seemed to have changed to "double strength"?!
Two words, but what did it truly mean?
Gu Xing thought for a while but didn’t reach a conclusion.
He instinctively looked at Lilith in his arms.
Right now, the Blood Clan Ancestor had her eyes gently closed; long lashes quivering like butterfly wings, faint, hot breaths escaping her ruby lips.
[Lilith]
[Race: Blood Race]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Half-step Totem]
[Power: 800000]
[Constitution: 800000]
[Spirit: 800000]
[Speed: 800000]
[Law Control Level: 5%]
[Divine Pattern Control: 20%]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Seeing Lilith’s Attribute panel, Gu Xing’s pupils shrank.
He already expected Lilith to reach Half-step Totem Level.
But...
This time the Attribute panel was different from before.
There were two new data entries...
Law Control Level and Divine Pattern Control!
Though he didn’t know their exact meanings, his instincts told him...
These two Attributes were incredibly important at Totem Level!
But what he didn’t expect...
Even someone like Lilith, who’d once reached Totem Level, only had such low Law Control.
Wouldn’t Liu Li and Vera have even less?!
If only his Guardian Beasts could increase their Law Control Level...
This thought gave rise to a sudden guess.
Doubling Guardian Beast’s strength?!
Could it mean...
His gaze swept back and forth between "Law Control Level" and "Divine Pattern Control."
Could these Attributes also be boosted?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 235: Wife!
chapters.content:
Chapter 235: Chapter 235: Wife!
If even Law Control Level can be improved...
Gu Xing’s heart burned with excitement.
After all, he remembered with perfect clarity how Liu Li and Vera used their laws before.
The two of them, at Commander Level, could still remain undefeated even against Monarch Level foes when using Law.
And that was when both of them only had a tiny sliver of Law Control, while Lilith’s Law Control was surely far above theirs.
With Lilith’s current strength, plus his own Soul Devouring Talent boosting Lilith’s control over Law—
It seems...
It really might let Lilith have Totem Level combat power at just Half-step Totem Level.
Meanwhile, inside the Beast Taming Space, things were already in total chaos.
Fei Yue already felt like she couldn’t hold them back any longer.
"Liu Li! Vera! Calm down, you two!"
Fei Yue spread her arms wide, determinedly blocking the two in front of her, her little face flushed with anxiety.
"No way, what is Lilith doing?! She’s not even our Master’s Guardian Beast, so why does she get to hold Master in her arms?!"
"No— Even if she was Master’s Guardian Beast, she shouldn’t think she can just hold him in her arms like that!"
At that moment, Vera’s beautiful eyes were blazing with fire as she glared at Lilith, who was holding Gu Xing in her arms, absolutely furious.
Liu Li, beside Vera, felt exactly the same.
"Her power-up is already done, but she’s still clinging to Master—she’s obviously taking advantage!"
"Back when she did the Blood Covenant with Master, she must have had some hidden agenda!"
Liu Li’s face, too, was filled with anger; if she could have her way, she’d burst out of the Beast Taming Space and separate the two right now.
The fury of Liu Li and Vera made Fei Yue’s scalp tingle.
Even though Fei Yue had previously tried to help Liu Li and Vera reconcile—though it had ended a bit awkwardly—
Gu Xing saw...
That ever since then, the two actually did get along much better.
So, he simply handed over the management of the entire Beast Taming Space to Fei Yue.
One reason being that he rarely summoned Fei Yue to fight, so Fei Yue had plenty of time to stay inside the Beast Taming Space.
Another reason being that Fei Yue’s combat abilities weren’t strong.
With her managing the Beast Taming Space—even if the other Guardian Beasts had opinions—none would ever lay a hand on her.
On top of that, Fei Yue’s personality meant she always got along well with every Guardian Beast.
Therefore, Fei Yue was the most suitable Guardian Beast for this job.
Fei Yue bit her lip, nervously twisting the hem of her clothes with her little hands.
In front of her, the two elder sisters’ auras had become impossible to restrain; as the "Beast Taming Space Manager," she was completely powerless now.
"Fei Yue, stop blocking us. That Blood Ancestor is trying to steal our Master, and she hasn’t even signed a Contract with him! We’re on the same side here!"
Hearing this from Vera, Fei Yue had no grounds to object.
All she could do was nod and step aside, making way:
"S-sorry, Master..."
She apologized silently in her heart, "I really tried my best..."
As soon as Liu Li and Vera saw Fei Yue move aside, they immediately darted out of the Beast Taming Space.
Even if it was the Blood Ancestor, if she wanted to steal Master, they would never allow it.
In the corner, Sally lowered her head, her transparent spirit body trembling slightly.
She, too, wanted to be like her elder sisters, always able to guard by Gu Xing’s side.
Her greatest wish was to stay by Gu Xing-sama’s side, to be his little maidservant.
Now, having become Gu Xing-sama’s Guardian Beast, was already a tremendous fortune.
But the way she was now...
She couldn’t help Gu Xing-sama at all!
Not only couldn’t she join in battle, she couldn’t even stay by Gu Xing-sama’s side to care for him.
Sally took a deep breath, her eyes growing determined.
She needed to work even harder.
She must not let down Gu Xing-sama’s expectations.
...
Outside.
Gu Xing was still immersed in the enlightenment from his evolved Soul Devouring Talent, when suddenly he felt a powerful force yank him out of Lilith’s arms.
Immediately after, a bolt of sharp pain shot through his waist...
"Hiss!"
Even with his Commander Tier Nine Constitution, he had zero resistance to Liu Li’s grip.
His pale skin instantly flushed with angry red.
Gu Xing blinked in confusion, staring at Vera blocking in front of him, and at Liu Li, the culprit behind him. For a moment he couldn’t figure out what was happening.
Why were Vera and Liu Li here?
What just happened?
Right now, Vera looked at Lilith, a hint of hostility on her face.
"Lilith, why do you keep clinging to Master? He’s our Master, not yours."
Vera’s words made Lilith’s heart skip a beat.
Only then did she realize...
Just now, she’d completely treated Gu Xing as if he was her own Master.
Now, with Vera’s reminder, she understood...
Their relationship was simply a Blood Covenant, not the contract between Beast Master and Guardian Beast.
But that daze lasted only a moment.
In her scarlet gown, she was the unrivaled Blood Clan Ancestor!
Her lips lifted into a wicked smile:
"Oh?" She tapped her red lips with slim fingers. "What if I sign a Beast Taming Contract with Gu Xing right now?"
As Vera and Liu Li’s faces darkened dramatically, Lilith spun elegantly, her crimson dress flaring out like a blood-red rose:
"Or perhaps..."
She suddenly leaned in, breathing fragrance near Gu Xing’s ear, "And if your Master fell in love with me, wouldn’t that make me his..."
"Wife!"
The last two syllables curled seductively at the end, reverberating in the air for a long time.
Those two words exploded in Vera and Liu Li’s brains like thunder.
The two of them were instantly petrified.
Even though they were Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts, in secret...
They’d both fantasized about becoming Gu Xing’s wife!
But they hadn’t expected...
Lilith would actually say it right to their faces today.
Almost instantly, Liu Li and Vera’s gazes locked onto Lilith.
There was a clear hostility in their eyes.
Gu Xing, realizing things were spiraling, hurried to stop them.
He was all too aware now of how much trouble it caused when Guardian Beasts fought among themselves.
Even though Lilith wasn’t technically his Guardian Beast, this sort of situation should definitely be avoided if possible.
"Alright, Lilith, enough joking around. Let’s get going."
"We’re not far from the Fox Race now, and after that we still have to visit the Angel Race. We need to hurry."
Lilith was stunned for a moment, red eyes looking toward Gu Xing.
When she saw his pure, earnest expression, a sudden and inexplicable sourness bubbled up in her heart.
That line earlier—with half meant as a joke, the other half...
Was straight from the heart!
But Gu Xing didn’t seem to notice at all.
"Hmph!"
Fuming, Lilith waved her hand, her figure shrinking instantly back into a petite loli form, and promptly returned to the Beast Taming Space.
No Contract? Fine!
She was the mighty Blood Clan Ancestor; would she ever lack for contract partners?
Once her power was restored, even if Gu Xing begged her to sign a contract, she’d turn him down!
Except—she didn’t notice...
That while she’d originally refused to contract with Gu Xing, she was actually starting to waver now!
Watching Lilith suddenly disappear, Gu Xing touched his nose in puzzlement, but quickly focused on business again:
"Liu Li, you’ll take me the rest of the way at full speed."
"No problem!"
Liu Li agreed instantly.
Except for Lilith, Liu Li was the fastest among them now.
With Liu Li leading the way, they could reach the Qingqiu Race in the shortest time.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 236: King-level Fierce Beast Arrives!
chapters.content:
Chapter 236: Chapter 236: King-level Fierce Beast Arrives!
At this moment.
The Qingqiu Tribe.
Everyone was on high alert.
Standing at the forefront were the fox people of the Qingqiu Tribe, and behind them were other tribal members with some combat capability.
Tu Shanyue and Tushan Yueli gazed into the distance, their eyes heavy with grave concern.
There, the skies were filled with dust, and an ominous and terrifying aura continuously emanated.
"Yueli, this time the Qingqiu Tribe might not make it!"
Tu Shanyue had tried to open a path for the weaker tribes to escape.
However, the Demon Race refused to engage her.
Whenever she attacked, the demons scattered, and as soon as she returned to protect the main forces, they quickly regrouped and blockaded.
With this back-and-forth, time was quickly running out.
Reluctantly, Tu Shanyue had to choose to face the king-level fierce beast head-on.
She had heard of this beast’s fearsome reputation before.
The Blood Race Ancestor had once fallen to this very beast.
