Now, she, an inexperienced Qingqiu tribe member, had to face this king-level beast alone.
To be honest, Tu Shanyue herself lacked confidence.
But she had no retreat.
Her people were right behind her!
If she failed to stop this king-level beast, all her people would perish!
"Yueli, if I fail to stop this beast, you must leave! I believe with your capabilities, you can evade the Demon Race."
Saying this, Tu Shanyue gently extended her hand.
A golden divine pattern emerged from her forehead and landed in her palm.
Her eyes held a trace of reluctance as she softly caressed the divine pattern.
This divine pattern had always accompanied her, but now...
With a gentle motion, the divine pattern merged into Tushan Yueli’s brow.
Tushan Yueli, witnessing this, shook her head urgently:
"Mother, I will stay here with you!"
However, Tu Shanyue simply shook her head gently.
"Yueli, we may die, but the divine pattern must not fall into the hands of the Demon Race!"
"So, no matter what, this divine pattern must leave here!"
"But..."
Tushan Yueli wanted to speak, but Tu Shanyue stopped her.
She cupped her daughter’s face, her thumb gently wiping away the tear threatening to fall.
"Yueli, listen to me!"
Tushan Yueli’s fists clenched so tightly that her nails sunk deep into her palms.
A powerful sense of helplessness nearly overwhelmed her.
It’s all my fault...
If I were stronger, could I help Mother?!
Perhaps the Qingqiu Tribe’s crisis could be averted!
"I... understand."
She finally lowered her head, her voice hoarse beyond recognition.
Only then did Tu Shanyue nod, her gaze shifting back to the Nine Nether Centipede King.
In that brief moment, it had drawn near the base.
There’s no more time to delay!
Without further hesitation, her aura erupted, sending her totem-level pressure soaring to the sky.
Seven snow-white fox tails unfurled behind her, transforming into streaks of light rushing toward the colossal creature.
And as the king-level fierce beast sensed the totem-level aura, it halted its advance.
Though it sensed an incredibly alluring aura ahead.
Having lived for so many years, it had gained intelligence close to human level.
Seeking benefit and avoiding harm was its instinct.
But...
Upon sensing the aura of the little bug ahead.
Its compound eyes revealed a hint of derision.
Such a weak bug wants to block its path?
Ridiculous!
As Tu Shanyue stood truly in front of the beast, she truly understood what despair meant.
In the presence of the Nine Nether Centipede King, she was like an ant.
And the demonic qi wrapped around the king-level beast surged relentlessly, stalling the power flowing through her body.
But even so, she never thought of retreating.
Behind her, countless eyes were fixed upon this unequal confrontation.
"Why are king-level fierce beasts so terrifying? In its presence, I feel like I can’t breathe."
"Can the Empress truly be a match for this king-level beast? Are we going to die here today?"
"Shut up! We’re not going to die; the Empress will surely win!"
"Empress, go for it!"
This shout, like a spark, instantly ignited the entire Qingqiu Base.
The rising cheers converged into waves, reverberating across the battlefield.
Hearing the voices from behind, a slight smile of comfort appeared on Tu Shanyue’s lips.
She took a deep breath, and the seven fox tails burst forth with dazzling light:
"Today, you shall not advance a single step more!"
"Illusion Realm·Thousand Dreams!"
Her vast spiritual power, harnessing the power of laws, poured out.
She knew very well that there was no chance in a direct clash.
But if she could redirect or momentarily confuse this beast...
Then the Qingqiu Tribe’s crisis would naturally be resolved!
Meanwhile, on a hill several miles away, a group of demon clan members watched from afar.
They dared not get too close.
The Nine Nether Centipede King couldn’t differentiate between demon race and other races.
Everyone was its food.
Whether demonic qi or flesh, it accepted everything.
"This time, nothing can go wrong with the Qingqiu Tribe’s divine pattern, right?" a demon clan member asked.
"Impossible. The Qingqiu Tribe is facing inevitable doom this time!"
"No other race around is offering aid, with only one Qingqiu Clan Leader..."
"Trying to single-handedly slay the king-level beast is impossible!"
"Once the Nine Nether Centipede King annihilates the Qingqiu Tribe, we’ll seize the divine pattern amidst the chaos! Lord Demon God’s task will be complete!"
Saying this, the demon clan burst into sinister laughter.
With a seized divine pattern....
The seal of the Demon Abyss would weaken.
Then, some of the weaker Lord Demon Gods would be able to leave the Demon Abyss!
With Lord Demon God’s leadership...
Even the strongest Dragon Race in the alternate space!
They were confident in defeating them!
"Roar——!!"
The Nine Nether Centipede King suddenly let out an ear-splitting roar, containing a rare trace of fear.
Hearing this sound, a gleam of joy appeared in Tu Shanyue’s eyes.
The illusion realm was working!
Though the Nine Nether Centipede King had remarkable physical attributes...
Its spiritual attribute wasn’t outstanding.
Her plan was to use the illusion to make the king-level beast voluntarily leave.
In the intricate illusion she crafted, another more powerful king-level beast was entrenched in the Qingqiu Base.
She aimed to make the Nine Nether Centipede King retreat.
Now, the Nine Nether Centipede King’s roar confirmed that her illusion was effective.
The Nine Nether Centipede King was indeed the weakest among the king-level fierce beasts.
Facing other beasts, it would surely retreat.
"Step back..."
Tu Shanyue prayed silently, her fingertips trembling slightly from exhaustion, "Just leave..."
However, the next moment, her smile froze.
The shadow that covered the sky did not retreat; instead, it frantically twisted its hundreds-of-meters-long body, and the demonic qi erupted like a volcanic explosion!
"This is bad...."
Tu Shanyue’s face paled.
Lacking experience in confronting fierce beasts, she didn’t realize she had made a fatal mistake.
Fierce beasts never retreat in the face of threats!
Instead...
They tear apart everything before them!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 237: Desperation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 237: Chapter 237: Desperation!
"Roar——!!!"
In the scarlet compound eyes of the Nine Nether Centipede King, a creature of its kind exuding a terrifying aura arrogantly looks down upon it.
But after the initial trace of fear, its mind is completely filled with anger.
It spent so much effort just to get here, but...
Another King-level Fierce Beast is snatching its food!
How can this be allowed!
"Roar——!!!"
In the deafening roar, the Demonic Qi on the surface of the Nine Nether Centipede King’s body surges wildly, swelling several times in the blink of an eye.
Although both are fierce beasts, different fierce beasts are like water and fire!
The violent Demonic Qi starts to gather at its ferocious maw.
In just a moment, a heart-palpitating Energy Ball has formed in front of the Nine Nether Centipede King’s mouthparts.
Noticing this scene, Tu Shanyue’s face suddenly changes.
She did not expect that the Nine Nether Centipede King, being the weakest of the King-level Fierce Beasts, would have no intention of avoiding another King-level Fierce Beast.
Instead, it directly launches an attack!
Tu Shanyue’s gaze locks tightly onto the constantly expanding black Energy Ball in front of the Nine Nether Centipede King’s maw, her face growing paler.
This force...
Her face turns extremely grim as she looks behind her.
Although her speed is completely capable of dodging this attack as it approaches her.
But...
If she dodges this attack, the ordinary citizens behind her...
Under this strike, there is absolutely no chance of survival.
And those she is protecting behind her also see the dire situation on the battlefield.
Clearly, the Illusion Realm released by the Empress has no effect on this King-level Fierce Beast.
And, they also see that their Empress is completely no match for this fierce beast.
"Empress, don’t worry about us, quickly take the Qingqiu Race and leave!"
"Yes! Empress, we were saved by the Qingqiu Race back then, living this long we’ve already been very satisfied."
"Empress, don’t expend your energy on us, quickly take the Qingqiu Race and leave!"
Voices of persuasion continuously ring out.
At this moment.
Even though they know they are facing death, there seems to be no fear in their eyes.
However, upon hearing these voices, Tu Shanyue’s gaze gradually becomes firm.
The original intention of establishing this sanctuary back then was to provide a place for weak races to live and thrive.
Under her leadership, the Qingqiu Race has always adhered to the creed of "protecting the weak."
Under the influence of this creed, races with weaker combat abilities continuously gather towards here.
Gradually, this place has formed a super-large clan.
Different races cooperate with each other, prosper together, and honor her as the Empress of Ten Thousand Races.
And now...
Facing a life-and-death crisis, as the Empress, how could she abandon her original intention?
How could she choose to disregard everyone?!
Her gaze locks firmly onto the Nine Nether Centipede King.
To stop this attack, she has to fight with all her might!
"Buzz——!!!"
Pink flames suddenly ignite on her body.
This means she is fighting with all her strength.
This is the flame formed by the burning of the Law.
And under the influence of the Law’s burning, her aura is also enhanced at a terrifying speed.
However, compared to the Nine Nether Centipede King, there is still a gap!
But there’s no other choice, this is already her limit.
And at this time, the energy gathered by the Nine Nether Centipede King is complete.
A trace of madness flashes in its compound eyes.
The black Energy Ball at its mouthparts suddenly shoots out, like a black streak of light rushing towards Tu Shanyue.
Wherever it passes, even the space itself warps and shatters!
Facing this scene, Tu Shanyue’s eyes are filled with gravity.
"Absolutely cannot retreat!"
Tu Shanyue shouts sharply, pushing her hands forward fiercely.
Surging pink energy bursts forth, transforming into a giant shield spanning the heavens and the earth, firmly protecting the entire Qingqiu Base behind it.
Meanwhile, others do not sit and await death.
"The Empress is working hard, we can’t hold the Empress back!"
"Everyone, take action together!"
Under one person’s call, everyone unleashes their energy with all their might.
In an instant, countless Energy Beams rise from the ground.
People from all races do their utmost, forming another multi-colored barrier in front of the pink giant shield.
Although chaotic, it condenses their will.
And in this time, the black Energy Ball unleashed by the Nine Nether Centipede King is already inches away from the two shields.
The next moment.
The black Energy Ball touches the first multi-colored barrier.
"Boom——!!!"
A sky-shaking explosion resounds through the heavens, as if time freezes at this moment.
Subsequently, a terrifying shockwave sweeps around like a tsunami!
"Pfft——"
Everyone spits out a mouthful of blood in unison, the barrier that gathered everyone’s strength shatters instantly like it was made of paper!
"Why is there such a gap? Why are King-level Fierce Beasts so terrifying?"
"Now it’s just the Empress left, the Empress must hold on!"
The remaining momentum of the black Energy Ball smashes into Tu Shanyue’s pink giant shield.
This time, the pink Energy Shield did not shatter as easily as the first shield.
However, for her, who excels in control, it is still exceedingly difficult to withstand the attack of this King-level Fierce Beast.
"Crack, crack!"
Piercing sounds continuously reverberate, spider-web-like cracks instantly spread across the entire shield’s surface.
Seeing this scene, Tu Shanyue’s face changes.
"Hold on for me...!"
Blood oozes from the corners of Tu Shanyue’s mouth as she burns the Law once more.
The pink flames blaze into the sky, forcibly halting the spread of the cracks!
Finally, under the breathless gaze of everyone, the world-destroying black flash gradually dissipates...
"It worked?"
Tu Shanyue staggers, kneeling on one knee, a trace of joy appearing on her pale face.
But at this moment, she has also nearly reached her limit.
She has almost burned through all her Power of Laws.
This means that she is now no different from the Half-step Totem Level.
Unable to use the Law means she is no longer considered a complete Totem Level.
Moreover...
Without the Law, her life is gradually coming to an end as well.
As the black Energy Ball finally dissipates, before everyone can rejoice, their hearts sink once again.
This attack could be blocked, but what about the next one?
The Empress has reached her limit, while the Nine Nether Centipede King... remains unscathed!
Worse yet, as Tu Shanyue’s strength wanes, the Illusion Realm starts to collapse.
In the scarlet compound eyes of the Nine Nether Centipede King, the figure of that ’King-level Fierce Beast’ is gradually fading...
"Roar——!!!"
In the ear-deafening roar, the beast’s gaze locks tightly onto the tottering Tu Shanyue.
Deceived!
Mocked by such a puny insect!
Unprecedented fury causes the Nine Nether Centipede King’s entire shell to emit a piercing grinding noise.
Its most terrifying feature has never been its long-range attack, but its incredibly hard body!
Its hundreds of meter-long torso rushes towards the base like a black torrent, with an overwhelming force.
Where it passes, the earth cracks, stones shatter!
"It’s over..."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 238: Arrival!
chapters.content:
Chapter 238: Chapter 238: Arrival!
On the other side.
Not far from the Qingqiu Race, Gu Xing and his group were rushing at full speed.
Suddenly, a wave of violent energy swept over them like a tsunami!
"Master, be careful."
Liu Li reacted swiftly, her pure white wings unfurled instantly, shielding Gu Xing securely behind her.
The light screen collided with the energy impact, producing a deafening roar.
"This is..."
Faced with such a sudden turn of events, Gu Xing was startled.
However, he quickly regained his composure.
"Oh no, something has happened to the Qingqiu Race!"
At that moment, Lilith instantly appeared beside Gu Xing.
She sensed the aura of the Nine Nether Centipede King!
At this moment, her gaze towards the Qingqiu Race base turned grave.
Currently, her strength was only at Half-step Totem level, under the boost of Gu Xing’s peculiar talent...
Barely allowing her to reach her former Totem level strength!
But before, she was no match for that King-level Fierce Beast.
"Gu Xing, are you sure you still want to go?"
Her voice was unusually solemn, "That Nine Nether Centipede King... is right at the Qingqiu base."
Hearing this news, Gu Xing froze.
That King-level Fierce Beast was the most terrifying enemy he had ever encountered.
Under the gaze of the Nine Nether Centipede King, he felt like his heart had stopped beating.
And now, to face that beast head-on...
In the next second, his fist clenched tightly.
Even so, he had to go!
The Qingqiu Race was crucial to the Human Race.
Forming an alliance with the Qingqiu Race could significantly boost the Human Race’s combat strength.
Moreover, those weak races sheltered by the Qingqiu Race, though not powerful in battle, contribute in various aspects...
If they could be brought back to Longxia Country, they would surely bring tremendous improvement to Longxia.
"We have to go!"
This command confirmed Gu Xing’s resolve to Lilith.
Her lips curved into a long-lost arrogant smile.
In the next moment, a blood-colored mist enveloped them, and her petite figure stretched in the red gleam.
When the mist dissipated, the ancestor of the Blood Race, who stood supreme over the world, had returned!
Her red skirt fluttered, and massive bat wings unfurled slowly behind.
She had once been defeated by this Nine Nether Centipede King, but now...
Facing this King-level Fierce Beast once again!
The previous humiliation must be washed away by her own hands.
"Whip—"
The bat wings suddenly vibrated, stirring up a torrent of air.
Lilith turned to Gu Xing: "Send Liu Li back to the Beast Taming Space."
Seeing Lilith’s current status, Gu Xing understood her intent.
She planned to personally take him the rest of the way.
Though Liu Li’s speed was fast, compared to Lilith, who was now Half-step Totem level, it was nothing.
"Liu Li, go back."
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s command, Liu Li wasted no time and returned to the Beast Taming Space.
In one second, Lilith’s slender arm wrapped around Gu Xing’s waist.
"Let’s go!"
A blood-colored trail split the sky, heading towards the Qingqiu base at astounding speed!
...
Meanwhile.
The Nine Nether Centipede King’s mountain-like body was now close to the city walls.
Tu Shanyue pushed away her daughter who was supporting her, and without hesitation, faced it head on!
Even though she was already injured...
She didn’t hesitate to charge this King-level Fierce Beast.
"Boom——!!"
In the deafening clash, Tu Shanyue flew back like a cut kite, carving a striking blood arc in the air.
She slammed heavily against the city wall, her face already pale, turning even more haggard.
Almost all her Power of Laws was burned out, and she could scarcely muster Heaven and Earth Energy.
In this state, she was no match for the Nine Nether Centipede King.
"Mother!"
Tushan Yueli cried out, rushing forward.
On the distant hill, the Demon Race watched this scene with glee.
"Tu Shanyue can’t hold out. Even our Lord Demon God struggles against this King-level Fierce Beast, let alone their Qingqiu Race."
"Heh, it’s all her own choice! If she ignored those burdens and left with the Divine Pattern, we wouldn’t have been able to stop her."
"But, she insists on making this foolish choice, so we can’t do anything about it."
"Now Tu Shanyue is almost at her breaking point. Keep an eye out and don’t let this Nine Nether Centipede King swallow her up."
"Otherwise, without the Divine Pattern, all our efforts will be for naught!"
"Don’t worry! I’m watching. Tu Shanyue handed the Divine Pattern to her daughter."
"Soon, her daughter will definitely try to escape with the Divine Pattern. Block her daughter then."
Tu Shanyue was unaware that a group of the Demon Race was already coveting Tushan Yueli.
But even if she knew, she could do nothing about it.
She was nearly at the end of her tether.
Her internal laws were depleted, plus she had suffered a direct hit from the Nine Nether Centipede King.
Now, even moving a finger was exceptionally difficult.
Yet, the Nine Nether Centipede King’s attacks would not cease.
The Nine Nether Centipede King’s compound eyes scanned the devastated Qingqiu base.
It was the first time anyone repeatedly hindered its approach to its prey.
These ants...
Despicable!
The Demonic Qi around it surged once more.
The next moment, the familiar black Energy Ball began to slowly form in its monstrous mouth...
Seeing this, Tu Shanyue was utterly hopeless.
She now had no power left to block it again.
Turning to Tushan Yueli, she said, "Yueli, later I will activate the Qingqiu Race’s last resort to send you away."
Each word she spoke caused tiny streams of blood to flow from her lips:
"After leaving here, go to the Human Race... find the one named Gu Xing and form a contract with him, become his Guardian Beast."
Tushan Yueli trembled all over, crystal tears rolling down continually.
Yet she bit her lip hard, refusing to cry out.
"I... I understand..."
The girl choked a reply, nails digging deeply into her palms.
By this time, the energy accumulated by the Nine Nether Centipede King had reached its peak.
In the hopeless eyes of everyone, the familiar black Energy Ball once again surged towards the base.
This time, everyone had lost the ability to resist!
However.
Just as the Nine Nether Centipede King’s destructive Energy Ball was about to engulf the entire Qingqiu base.
"Boom!"
A blood-colored stream tore through the sky, crashing into the black Energy Ball with lightning speed!
As the massive bat wings spread, the attack capable of destroying a city was surprisingly kicked aside, whistling towards the distant mountain.
"Rumble——!!!"
In the earth-shattering explosion, the entire mountain was instantly reduced to dust!
As the smoke cleared, the blood-colored figure stood proudly in the air.
Her red dress fluttered, surrounded by Laws, with huge bat wings slowly flapping behind.
"Li... Lilith?!"
Tushan Yueli widened her eyes in disbelief.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 239: Lilith’s Full-Powered Strike!
chapters.content:
Chapter 239: Chapter 239: Lilith’s Full-Powered Strike!
At this moment.
The blood-colored aura emitted by Lilith dyed the entire sky red, standing in stark contrast to the Demonic Qi exuding from the Nine Nether Centipede King opposite her.
The entire battlefield was split into two.
This sudden scene left Tu Shanyue behind Lilith frozen in place.
She had naturally seen the Blood Ancestor of the Blood Race before, but...
She didn’t understand why this Blood Ancestor would help the Qingqiu Race.
Earlier, Tushan Yueli had only mentioned to her that Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast included those from the Elf Clan, Angel Race, and Ghost Race.
She hadn’t mentioned the Blood Race, so Tu Shanyue wasn’t aware of Lilith’s existence.
At this moment, Gu Xing had already arrived at Tu Shanyue’s side.
After nodding at Tushan Yueli, Gu Xing came to Tu Shanyue’s side.
"Empress, leave the rest to us."
The gentle voice made Tu Shanyue look up.
What she saw was a young human, most striking were the two dazzling Divine Patterns on his forehead!
"A holder of two Divine Patterns..."
Tu Shanyue was somewhat shocked.
But recalling her daughter’s description of his amazing Talent, then this young man should be... Gu Xing?!
However...
Right now, this genius’s level is still a bit low.
"Gu Xing, this King-level Fierce Beast... is too powerful, you should quickly take Yueli and leave."
But...
Facing this request, Gu Xing just shook his head.
Today, his purpose here is to save everyone.
No one can be left behind!
"Miss Yueli, please take your mother away from the battlefield!"
"We will handle the battlefield from here on."
Tushan Yueli heard Gu Xing’s words and looked at her extremely weak mother, then nodded:
"Alright, Lord Gu Xing!"
Saying so, she helped her mother back away.
Gu Xing, at this time, locked his gaze on the Nine Nether Centipede King.
[Nine Nether Centipede King]
[Race: Fierce Beast (King Level)]
[Level: Totem One Turn]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: 4000000]
[Speed: ???]
[Skills: None]
Looking at the information of this Fierce Beast, Gu Xing’s expression became incredibly serious.
Just the Spiritual Attribute of this Nine Nether Centipede King has already reached 4 million.
It’s important to know, this King-level Fierce Beast is least skilled in the Spiritual Attribute.
As for the other attributes like Power, Constitution, and Speed, Gu Xing guesses this King-level Fierce Beast might have reached nearly ten million.
Although it has no skills or controlled laws...
For this King-level Fierce Beast...
Its body itself is its strongest weapon!
And now Lilith...
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Immortal Blood Body Activated]
[Level: Half-step Totem]
[Power: 800000→3200000]
[Constitution: 800000→3200000]
[Spirit: 800000→3200000]
[Speed: 800000→3200000]
[Divine Pattern Control: 20%]
[Law Control Level: 5%]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Under the blessing of the Immortal Blood Body, Lilith’s attributes have reached the level of 3.2 million.
But this is still far from the Nine Nether Centipede King.
But such a gap...
Can only be filled by him!
"Soul Devouring·Start!"
The blood-colored Spiritual Power appeared in an instant, enveloping Lilith’s figure.
Under the enhancement of Gu Xing’s Talent, Lilith’s aura soared dramatically.
[Lilith]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Status: Immortal Blood Body Activated]
[Level: Half-step Totem]
[Power: 3200000→6400000]
[Constitution: 3200000→6400000]
[Spirit: 3200000→6400000]
[Speed: 3200000→6400000]
[Divine Pattern Control: 20%→40%]
[Law Control Level: 5%→10%]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
Under the assistance of the Soul Devouring Talent.
Lilith’s attributes have reached 6.4 million points.
Moreover, more importantly, the Divine Pattern Control and Law Control Level attributes have achieved a doubling effect.
When the blessing of the Soul Devouring Talent descended, Lilith looked at her hands with disbelief.
Through the blood mist surrounding her, she looked straight at Gu Xing.
This kind of blessing...
At this moment, she felt extremely fortunate for having chosen to sign the Blood Covenant with Gu Xing.
Under Gu Xing’s Talent enhancement, she felt her Blood Law control reaching unprecedented heights.
Her red lips unconsciously formed an enchanting arc.
"Gu Xing, after I take care of this King-level Fierce Beast, you can ask me any request."
Lilith’s voice carried a hint of seduction, echoing throughout the battlefield.
"I won’t refuse anything!"
And next to Gu Xing, Liu Li and Vera, both of their gazes turned to Lilith almost simultaneously.
There was a noticeable hostility in their eyes.
As for the Nine Nether Centipede King, upon seeing Lilith’s skyrocketing aura, a hint of solemnity appeared within its compound eyes.
As a King-level Fierce Beast, at this moment it bizarrely sensed a crisis.
Intuition told it, this Blood Race being...
Incredibly dangerous!
Even to the point of threatening its life.
Blocking the Nine Nether Centipede King, Lilith keenly caught that fleeting trace of dread in its eyes, and the smile on her lips gradually broadened until it turned into a wild laugh that resonated across the battlefield.
"I didn’t expect you would also have a day of fear!"
Her shoulders shook slightly, the laughter carrying a hint of madness, but it was not fear, it was excitement...
The excitement of soon crushing a nightmare with her own hands!
The Nine Nether Centipede King once forcibly knocked her down from the lofty Totem Level back to Monarch Level, and it could even be said that the subsequent betrayal of the Blood Race originated here.
"You may not remember me, but it doesn’t matter..."
Lilith’s voice was low and dangerous, as she slowly raised a hand, her sharp fingernails slicing across her wrist.
Scarlet blood gushed out instantly, trailing down her pale arm.
And her eyes, at this moment, became even more crimson, as if saturated with the purest desire for slaughter.
"I’ll make you remember!"
"Blood Dominator!"
This skill not only manipulates others’ blood but more importantly, it manipulates her own blood.
Simultaneously, the power of the Blood Law instantly merged into the blood she spilled.
The crimson blood beads did not fall but hovered eerily in the air, then began circling around her as if alive.
The blood quickly congealed on the surface of her body, forming a sinister and magnificent Blood Armor.
Furthermore, her palm slowly gathered into a long Blood Long Spear.
Despite Gu Xing’s empowerment lifting her attributes to their limits, compared to the Nine Nether Centipede King ahead, there was still a vast difference.
Therefore, she could only fight with all her might!
But...
When has she ever feared fighting to the death?!
Her position as Blood Ancestor was fought with blood and gore!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 240: Betting Life Itself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 240: Chapter 240: Betting Life Itself!
"Roar--!!"
The Nine Nether Centipede King emitted a thunderous roar, and for the first time, a solemn expression appeared in its crimson compound eyes.
It no longer dared to treat Tu Shanyue casually, as its entire body instantly erupted with overwhelming Demonic Qi.
The pitch-black energy wrapped around its massive body like a living entity, and in the blink of an eye, formed a hideous black Demon Armor.
On a distant hill, the Demon Race members who had been lurking for a long time witnessed this scene, and their faces showed disbelief.
"How could the Blood Race appear here?!"
"That Human Race! He actually dared to bring two Divine Patterns here."
"A rare opportunity! Now that the Blood Race is being held back by the King-level Fierce Beast, this is the best time to seize the Divine Pattern!"
The leading Demon Race member’s eyes flashed with a fierce look: "Move now!"
Almost instantly, the group of Half-step Totem Level Demon Race experts reached a consensus.
They transformed into several black shadows and skillfully bypassed the battle area between Lilith and the Nine Nether Centipede King, approaching Gu Xing’s location with astonishing Speed.
In their eyes, this human was only at Peak Commander level; as long as they got close, they could kill him in one strike.
However...
Long before entering the Qingqiu Race’s territory, Gu Xing had already guessed there would surely be the Demon Race’s presence.
A King-level Fierce Beast could not possibly cross mountains and rivers to attack the Qingqiu Race for no reason.
If there was no schemer behind this, Gu Xing simply would not believe it!
And the Qingqiu Race, long residing in Alternate Space, almost never made enemies with the outside world...
The only possible target against them is the Demon Race!
Therefore, there’s no need to overthink the identity of the mastermind!
So, upon arriving at the Qingqiu Race at the first moment, Gu Xing instructed Liu Li and Vera to remain vigilant.
And now...
The moment the Demon Race made their move, Vera’s Spiritual Power sensed the presence of these Demon Race figures.
Her emerald-green eyes suddenly focused:
"Master, a group of Half-step Totem Level Demon Race members are attacking us."
Given Liu Li and Vera’s current strength, dealing with so many Half-step Totem Level Demon Race members was impossible.
But faced with such a situation, Gu Xing remained completely unflustered.
All of this was within his expectations!
At this moment, the battle between Lilith and the Nine Nether Centipede King also reached a critical point.
The next moment.
The Nine Nether Centipede King’s massive body suddenly lunged forward, carrying terrifying force that seemed to tear through space as it pounced on Lilith.
However, at this moment, Lilith made a move that surprised everyone...
She did not confront the attack but instead turned into a blood-red shadow, dashing toward Gu Xing’s direction!
And Gu Xing also, at this moment, had his entire nervous system stretched to the extreme.
Plan initiated!
Earlier, he had predicted the Demon Race would seize the opportunity to attack, and the response plan was already formulated:
Let Lilith take care of those Demon Race members with thunderous action, while he and Liu Li would block the Nine Nether Centipede King’s strike!
With Lilith’s current strength, as long as he and Liu Li could withstand the King-level Fierce Beast’s strike.
During this time, these Demon Race members could be dealt with by Lilith!
"Liu Li!"
Gu Xing shouted, simultaneously utilizing his Soul-devouring Talent to continuously infuse his Power into Liu Li.
"Guardian Angel Form·Qi!"
Golden light instantly enveloped Liu Li, and twelve golden wings suddenly unfolded behind her!
The golden radiance instantly illuminated the entire battlefield.
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 70000→560000]
[Constitution: 70000→560000]
[Spirit: 70000→560000]
[Speed: 70000→560000]
[Skills: Guardian Angel Form, Guardian Domain, Guardian Law]
But facing the fatal strike of the King-level Fierce Beast, this was far from enough!
"Liu Li, Divine Protection!"
The moment Gu Xing’s command was issued, a massive golden shield suddenly unfolded, standing in front of the Nine Nether Centipede King.
"Guardian Domain·Full Release!"
"Guardian Law·Activate!"
Aside from the golden shield formed by Divine Protection, two more golden Shields of Protection appeared between the King-level Fierce Beast and Liu Li.
At the same time, Vera’s Life Energy also reached Peak.
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: In Heat (Heart of Nature defect-induced)]
[Power: 60000]
[Constitution: 60000]
[Spirit: 80000→640000]
[Speed: 60000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming and other skills), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
"Life Law!"
Vera cried out loudly, powerful Life Energy condensed before the golden shield, transforming into a jade-colored energy dragon that spiraled upward.
Despite going all out, Gu Xing’s eyes still bore heavy gravity.
Liu Li’s Divine Protection Shield could only withstand one attack.
If the Nine Nether Centipede King launched a second strike, defense would have to rely on Liu Li and Vera.
In essence, Gu Xing was gambling!
Gambling on the Nine Nether Centipede King only making one attack.
Gambling that if the King-level Fierce Beast launched a second attack, Liu Li and Vera would successfully fend it off.
And the various clans’ life forms guarded behind Gu Xing looked toward the sky, all stunned.
They didn’t understand why the powerful Blood Race would retreat but clearly knew...
If the Guardian Angel and Life Spirit in the sky couldn’t stop the Nine Nether Centipede King’s attack.
The Nine Nether Centipede King would break into their city.
Given their strength, even coming into contact with this King-level Fierce Beast would spell certain death.
On-site, only Tu Shanyue knew Gu Xing’s purpose in doing this.
Although she was injured right now,...
The Qingqiu Race’s powerful Spiritual Power still hadn’t lost effectiveness.
She could sense that the group of Half-step Totem Level Demon Race members was now closing in on the Qingqiu Race.
Precisely because of this, she felt even more alarmed and fearful...
This human dared to use such a risky strategy!
"Too crazy..."
Although letting the Blood Ancestor deal with the Demon Race was the best choice, who could guarantee they could truly stop the King-level Fierce Beast’s onslaught?
Once failed...
The consequences would be unimaginable!
At this moment.
Gu Xing was also enduring unparalleled pressure.
The situation was extremely critical, and taking such a risky approach was out of necessity.
Originally, the safest approach...
was for him not to bring any Guardian Beasts to participate in the Qingqiu Race’s event, remaining uninvolved.
However...
Could he stand idly by and watch the Qingqiu Race be destroyed by this King-level Fierce Beast?
He couldn’t!
Therefore, even at the risk of failing, he had to gamble.
As long as he won the gamble...
The Qingqiu Race could be saved!
The fierce figure of the Nine Nether Centipede King rapidly magnified within his pupils, and Gu Xing’s clenched fists turned white at the knuckles.
When the massive shadow that obscured the sky and sun was less than a hundred meters from the shield, he suddenly shouted:
"Vera, do it!"
The Jade Giant Dragon let out a deafening roar, intertwined with the golden shield.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 241: Slaughtering the Demon Race!
chapters.content:
Chapter 241: Chapter 241: Slaughtering the Demon Race!
Vera was not skilled in defense, but Gu Xing never intended for her to defend from the start!
"Life Blooming!"
With Gu Xing’s shout, the life energy around the Jade Giant Dragon suddenly surged, the emerald green glow flowing on the dragon’s body like a living thing.
Vera exerted all her force to activate the Life Law, and the mysterious power of the laws began to perfectly integrate with the dragon.
"Buzz——"
Emerald green law patterns gradually appeared on the dragon’s body, emanating vigorous vitality like ancient runes.
This was a manifestation of the laws, indicating that this strike contained the power of heaven and earth!
However, the figure of the Nine Nether Centipede King was already close!
"Roar——!!"
The Jade Giant Dragon let out a deafening roar, boldly charging towards the shadow covering the sky.
But the gap between Vera and this King-level fierce beast was simply too great.
Even if Vera struck with full force, it was impossible to stop this King-level fierce beast!
Upon seeing the Jade Giant Dragon, the Nine Nether Centipede King revealed a hint of disdain in its eyes.
An ant’s attack, trying to hurt it?
Facing the charging Jade Giant Dragon, the Nine Nether Centipede King didn’t even bother to use demonic Qi defense.
In its eyes, such a level of attack was not even worth a scratch.
"Boom——!!!"
The Jade Giant Dragon hit heavily on the dark shell, exploding with a deafening roar.
As the Nine Nether Centipede King expected, this strike indeed didn’t budge it at all.
But then...
"Sizzle..."
A creepy corrosive sound suddenly occurred!
Those seemingly harmless emerald energies clung to the shell like an affliction, violently reacting with the demonic Qi.
Life energy and demonic Qi offset each other, the defense on the Nine Nether Centipede King’s surface began to weaken visibly!
This was precisely Gu Xing’s true intention!
The life law mastered by Vera was never about its offensive power but its terrifying corrosive properties!
As long as the demonic Qi defense of the King-level fierce beast could be weakened, opportunities for subsequent battles could be created.
Feeling something wrong, the Nine Nether Centipede King angrily swung its body, scattering the remaining life energy instantly.
Though the tactic worked, the effect was ultimately limited.
Gu Xing’s gaze finally fell on Liu Li.
Only Liu Li, in Guardian Form, could block this attack.
"Roar——!!"
The Nine Nether Centipede King let out an earth-shattering roar, its scarlet compound eyes burning with violent killing intent.
The feeling of its demonic Qi being eroded enraged it completely, turning its ferocious head towards Vera...
Now it had another target it must kill.
Besides that fox that tricked it, this elf must also die.
In an instant, its enormous body transformed into a black lightning, rushing straight at Vera with overwhelming demonic Qi!
Gu Xing’s pupils contracted suddenly, and his whole body’s muscles tightened instantly.
The true test had come!
Liu Li’s divine protection could only exert its effect once.
Therefore, it could only block the first attack of this King-level fierce beast.
As for what comes next...
They could only rely on guardian law to resist!
At this moment.
All the beings protected by Gu Xing, including Tushan Yue, Tushan Yueli, held their breath.
If they could block this attack from the Nine Nether Centipede King, everyone would survive.
But if Gu Xing couldn’t block it, under the attack of this King-level fierce beast, no one would successfully survive.
"Boom——!!!"
In the earth-shaking loud noise, the huge body of the Nine Nether Centipede King fiercely collided with the divine protection shield deployed by Liu Li.
Amazingly, the seemingly fragile golden light screen blocked the full-on impact of the King-level fierce beast without a single ripple!
Tushan Yue widened her eyes, her red lips slightly parted, her face full of shock.
As a totem-level power who personally experienced the terrifying power of the Nine Nether Centipede King, she was more aware than anyone of the power of this strike...
She had tried to block it head-on earlier, only to be knocked back in just one encounter!
But now...
This human with only Commander Peak strength actually managed to block it?!
Gu Xing had no time to care about Tushan Yue’s shock, his gaze was tightly locked on the Nine Nether Centipede King, his face grave.
He had previously envisioned three possibilities:
The first was the Nine Nether Centipede King failing with one strike and retreating.
Second was the Nine Nether Centipede King, upon seeing Liu Li easily blocking it, cautiously staying in place.
The third was their attack being blocked, the Nine Nether Centipede King bursting into rage and immediately launching another attack.
And now...
From the Nine Nether Centipede King’s gaze, Gu Xing found...
The situation turned out to be the worst third possibility!
At this moment.
The Nine Nether Centipede King gazed at the golden light screen that firmly blocked it.
Boundless anger swallowed its rationality.
A group of ants...
Actually obstructed it so many times!
Almost in an instant, the corner of its mouth gathered a huge black energy ball.
Seeing this scene, Gu Xing’s face looked extremely grim.
The first attack could be cleverly blocked by divine protection.
But the second attack...
Could only be resisted!
...
On another side.
The demons rapidly charging towards Gu Xing encountered the most terrifying adversaries in their lives.
Lilith stood steadily like a war god in front of the path of these demons.
Seeing Lilith standing on the inevitable path, this group of demons stopped in unison.
"Blood Ancestor! You actually choose to block us!"
"But since you have left, what about that King-level fierce beast?"
"You signed a blood covenant with Gu Xing, if he dies you can’t escape either!"
However, Lilith ignored the words spoken by these demons.
Though blocking a totem-level King-level fierce beast with Commander-level peak strength seemed like a myth.
But it was Gu Xing who achieved this...
So, it’s possible!
Having been through various experiences with Gu Xing, Lilith had developed a blind trust in him.
"You should worry about yourselves!"
Lilith’s eyes focused, the blood glow around her suddenly intensified.
The next moment, four Liliths appeared in the sky once again.
Blood Clone!
One of the essential skills of the Blood Race!
Unlike ordinary blood clones, each clone Lilith released had about 80% of her strength.
Now, Lilith’s various attributes almost rivaled the totem level.
Plus the enhancement of the Blood Law.
Those appeared here now were almost equivalent to five totem-level Liliths.
For this group of half-step totem-level demon race, such a formation was devastating!
"Not good! Run!"
"This Blood Ancestor’s strength is not right!"
The moment they saw four blood clones appear, this group of demons immediately sensed something was amiss.
To so easily release four blood clones, Lilith’s strength must have already reached the totem level.
Faced with such an unexpected situation, this group of demons didn’t hesitate at all, turning around and fled immediately.
And this was the only correct action.
But then...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 242: Tu Shanyue’s Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 242: Chapter 242: Tu Shanyue’s Death!
Now you want to escape? It’s already too late!
When Gu Xing first proposed this plan, he never thought about letting this group of the Demon Race go.
Just right...
Now the first Divine Pattern only requires absorbing a bit more energy to fully awaken.
By then, it will be able to boost his attributes, allowing his attributes to reach the limit of the Commander Level.
Lilith’s gaze locked onto this group of the Demon Race, a bloodthirsty smile appearing on her face.
For her, the stronger the blood she controls, the greater the combat power she can exert.
As long as she kills this group of the Demon Race, the amount of blood she can control will increase dramatically.
This could significantly boost her combat power, allowing her to gain a greater advantage in the battle against that King-level Fierce Beast.
Therefore, whether for Gu Xing or for herself.
This group of the Demon Race must die!
"Crimson Calamity!"
Once Lilith takes action, she goes all out.
Although she trusts Gu Xing, that King-level Fierce Beast is still a Totem Level.
She must deal with this group of the Demon Race as quickly as possible, and then continue to handle that King-level Fierce Beast.
Four avatars and her main body simultaneously emit an intense blood glow.
Gradually, five beams of blood light begin to slowly form a Blood Domain, enveloping all the Demon Race within!
At the same time, five figures almost simultaneously rushed into this Blood Domain!
The slaughter feast officially begins!
"Ah——!!"
Within the Blood Domain, shrill screams echoed continuously.
With the empowerment of Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent, Lilith’s power had long crushed this group of the Demon Race.
Each of her strikes took away the life of a Demon Race!
When the last scream abruptly ceased, the entire domain had transformed into a sea of blood.
Lilith elegantly licked the blood off her fingertips, the bloodthirsty light in her eyes growing increasingly intense.
The bodies of those strong demons rapidly withered, all their blood turning into crimson energy swirling around her.
However...
Through the Blood Domain, Lilith suddenly saw the black Energy Ball being condensed in the Nine Nether Centipede King’s mouth!
"Not good!"
Her pupils shrank suddenly, her figure instantly dissolving into a blood mist and dissipating.
At the same time, facing the King-level Fierce Beast, Gu Xing finally felt the true pressure of death.
The destructive aura emitted by the black Energy Ball made all the blood in his body seem to freeze.
At this moment, he felt like he had been locked on by death itself.
"Sovereign Guardian!"
In this moment, Gu Xing dared not hold back in the slightest, almost squeezing out these four words through clenched teeth.
Outside Liu Li’s golden Guardian Domain, another azure barrier instantly unfolded, enhancing the defense to its peak with dual-layer protection.
At this moment, Liu Li’s expression was exceptionally grave.
She moved her body to shield Gu Xing behind her, prepared to use her body to shield her master if her Guardian Domain shattered...
Meanwhile, the black Energy Ball in the Nine Nether Centipede King’s mouth had already swollen to its limit, its destructive ripples causing the air to warp.
"Liu Li, prepare to take it head-on!"
However, at this critical juncture...
"Shut up!"
A blood-colored silhouette fell from the sky like a meteor!
Lilith’s Blood Armor reflected an eerie light in the sun, and leveraging the terrifying downward force, her long leg struck fiercely on top of the Nine Nether Centipede King’s head!
"Boom——!!!"
Amidst a deafening boom, the head of the King-level Fierce Beast was forcibly smashed into the ground, causing the terrain within a hundred-meter radius to collapse instantly!
But...
The destructive energy in the Nine Nether Centipede King’s mouth had already accumulated to its peak!
Even though Lilith’s kick altered the attack’s trajectory, the black beam of light still hurled towards the Qingqiu Race’s city!
"Liu Li!"
Under Gu Xing’s command, the golden barrier expanded to its utmost limit, and his Guardian Talent unleashed to its fullest.
The two barriers stood like the last fortress, one in front and one behind, blocking the path of the destructive beam of light.
"Boom——!!!"
At the moment of impact, Liu Li’s Guardian Domain emitted a sound as though it couldn’t bear the load and began to fracture!
"Pfft!"
Liu Li violently spat out a mouthful of blood.
The backlash from the shattered Domain instantly inflicted serious injuries upon her!
Seeing this, Gu Xing dared not hesitate.
"Sovereign Celestial Grace!"
Without hesitation, Gu Xing applied a recovery status to Liu Li, simultaneously gritting his teeth and pushing his Guardian Domain forward.
However, in the instant of contact with the black beam of light, he truly realized the terror of Totem Level.
Logically speaking, even if he were to release his Guardian Talent now, breaking it even for Half-step Totem Level should take some time.
But under the attack of this King-level Fierce Beast, he only persisted for an instant before his released Guardian Talent was instantly shattered.
Now, only Liu Li was left struggling to hold on...
"Crack crack!"
Even though Liu Li’s Guardian Angel Form was exceptionally adept at defense.
But at this moment, it was also unable to withstand it.
"Bang——!!"
Accompanied by a deafening explosion, the final golden barrier shattered spectacularly!
Liu Li still wanted to shield Gu Xing, but Gu Xing immediately retracted Liu Li back into the Beast Taming Space.
Liu Li’s Guardian Domain was shattered, making her extremely weak.
If she continued to help him block this attack, she might truly suffer serious injuries or even die.
Watching as the attack came closer, Gu Xing also prepared himself.
Although he wanted to save the Qingqiu Race, sacrificing his life here was not an option.
He had initially given orders to Fei Yue, if anything threatening their safety occurred, Fei Yue would immediately pull him out of the attack’s range.
However, just at this moment...
A silhouette suddenly appeared in front of him.
Seeing this silhouette, Gu Xing was taken aback.
He didn’t expect this to be...
Tushan Yue!
At this moment, Tushan Yue’s figure seemed especially frail in the gale, her pale face reflecting the pink Fox Fire, unable to hide the resolve in her eyes.
"Gu Xing..."
Her voice was soft, yet every word was clear, "The Qingqiu Race owes you a debt of gratitude, but for this strike..."
Before she finished speaking, the blazing Fox Fire suddenly ascended, enveloping her entire being.
In the flames, her figure began to turn translucent, as if about to dissipate in the wind at any moment.
This was a forcible enhancement of combat ability at the cost of life!
"Mother!!"
The anguished cry of Tushan Yueli tore through the sky, as she struggled to rush forward, only to be held back by the tribespeople.
Tushan Yue never looked back.
At the last moment before her figure was about to dissipate, she only transmitted her final words into Gu Xing’s ears:
"Yueli and the Qingqiu Race... I leave them in your hands!"
"New Moon—Seal!"
In an instant, heaven and earth turned colorless.
A dazzling pink beam of light soared into the sky, its crescent-moon-like radiance completely engulfing the black destructive energy.
In the disbelieving eyes of everyone, Tushan Yue’s silhouette, along with that world-shattering attack...
Both transformed into scattered specks of luminescence, vanishing between heaven and earth.
The wind stopped.
The entire battlefield plunged into dead silence, even the sound of breathing was clearly audible.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 243: Lilith! Tear It to Shreds!
chapters.content:
Chapter 243: Chapter 243: Lilith! Tear It to Shreds!
"Mother!"
Tushan Yueli’s heart-wrenching cry echoed across the battlefield, crystal tears streaming down her pale cheeks.
Gu Xing stared blankly at the empty space before him, his fingertips trembling uncontrollably.
He never expected that Tu Shanyue would resolutely choose to stand in front of him.
To block this attack for him!
"Empress!!"
The mourning of the various races’ beings rose and fell, countless pairs of eyes turning blood-red in an instant.
"Kill this beast! Avenge the Empress!"
"Everyone, attack together. Even if we die, we must tear off a piece of this beast’s flesh."
The angry shouts surged like a tide.
The sanctuary that Tu Shanyue had built from nothing had long since become an irreplaceable holy ground in the hearts of all weak races.
In everyone’s heart, Tu Shanyue was their god.
And now...
Their god had fallen!
The extreme anger instantly dispelled all fear, and flames of revenge ignited in their eyes.
This emotion not only spread among these races but also infected Gu Xing!
Although his connection with Tu Shanyue wasn’t very deep, the character of this Nine-tailed Fox Empress had deeply impressed him.
But now....
Gu Xing stared intently at the spot where Tu Shanyue had disappeared.
There was only a swaying cluster of pink energy left there.
Under his gaze, the energy suddenly split, one part shooting like an arrow toward the Nine Nether Centipede King, the other gently merging into Tushan Yueli’s body.
This was Tu Shanyue’s choice!
With her strength, if she had forcibly taken this attack...
At most, she would have been severely injured, but she would never have lost her life!
However...
Just when Lilith attacked the Nine Nether Centipede King, relying on her powerful spiritual power, she clearly sensed Lilith’s strength.
Although Lilith’s strength barely reached totem level, yet...
Truly defeating this King-level fierce beast remained a distant hope.
So...
She chose to burn everything!
The pink energy shot at the Nine Nether Centipede King was her last gift, left at the cost of her life!
The Nine Nether Centipede King instinctively wanted to dodge, but the pink energy moved like a swift ray of light, entering its brow just as it tilted its head!
"Fox Clan Seal!"
This was the ultimate forbidden technique, paid for with life!
If it were an ordinary totem level, it would be completely sealed under this strike.
But facing a King-level fierce beast, what Tu Shanyue gained by burning her life was only a partial weakening of its strength.
"Roar——!!!"
A mournful howl shattered the skies.
The hundred-zhang long body of the Nine Nether Centipede King twisted madly, the earth cracking and collapsing under its struggle.
The fox-shaped mark on its brow emitted a blinding pink light, searing its soul like a festering wound...
This pain was something it had never experienced since ascending to King level!
The unique purifying power of the Fox Race continued to erode along the mark, and a human-like fear appeared in the Nine Nether Centipede King’s scarlet eyes.
Its impenetrable carapace could resist physical attacks but could not block this soul-searing burn!
The other pink energy, like a shooting star, entered Tushan Yueli’s brow.
This was another reason why she chose to burn her life!
She knew...
Her daughter’s talent was ultimately limited.
A Myth Two Stars bloodline, in the eyes of ordinary races, was already an unparalleled genius.
But in front of Gu Xing...
From the first glance at Gu Xing, she perceived the talent of Gu Xing’s contracted beasts, at least at Myth Five Stars!
Her daughter’s talent was entirely insufficient in front of Gu Xing!
Moreover...
Securing complete recognition from the divine pattern with such talent was almost impossible.
So...
She chose to pave the way for her daughter with her own life!
"Mother... no..."
Tushan Yueli, through tear-filled eyes, was now completely enveloped by the pink energy.
In an instant, a brilliant pillar of light shot up into the sky, illuminating the entire battlefield!
Under the infusion of this pure Power of Origin from the Nine-tailed Heavenly Fox, Tushan Yueli’s aura began to rise dramatically.
Behind her original six fox tails, a seventh illusory tail slowly began to form...
In the Qingqiu Race, the number of tails represents talent!
Each additional fox tail signifies a qualitative change in bloodline.
What Tu Shanyue achieved by burning her life was the possibility for her daughter to break through her shackles!
"Buzz——"
With a clear fox cry, the seventh fox tail behind Tushan Yueli completely solidified!
Vast spiritual power surged within her, and the bottleneck that had troubled her for so long broke open.
Peak Commander, broke!
The Monarch Level aura swept across the entire field like a tide!
Simultaneously, in Gu Xing’s view.
[Tushan Yueli]
[Race: Qingqiu Race (Six-tailed State)]
[Identity: Qingqiu Race Princess]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars → Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine → Monarch Tier One]
[Power: 45000 → 70000]
[Constitution: 47000 → 80000]
[Spirit: 60000 → 100000]
[Speed: 55000 → 70000]
[Skills: Moon Eclipse, Mirror Prison, New Moon, Heavenly Fox Domain]
The energy from Tu Shanyue instantly elevated Tushan Yueli’s aptitude from Myth Two Stars to Myth Five Stars.
This already reached the limits of the Alternate Space!
Additionally, Tushan Yueli’s strength experienced a massive boost.
However...
At this moment, Tushan Yueli was utterly unconcerned with these changes.
She extended her shaking hand, trying to grasp her mother’s gradually transparent figure.
Even in death, a totem level spiritual power can momentarily linger in this world.
"Yueli..."
Tushan Yueli’s ephemeral face showed a gentle smile.
She attempted to wipe away her daughter’s tears, but could only watch as her fingers passed through that wet cheek.
"Don’t be sad."
Her voice was as soft as the wind, "When I decided to protect all weak races, I had already foreseen this day!"
"So, don’t be sad!"
In the falling snow, she gently embraced her daughter, though this hug could no longer convey warmth.
"I’m sorry... Yueli, I won’t be able to stay with you in the future! Qingqiu Race... I entrust to you."
Subsequently, her body slowly began to disperse.
In her last moment, she turned to Gu Xing, her eyes filled with trust:
"Gu Xing, my daughter... I’m entrusting her to you."
Before she finished speaking, her figure transformed into countless pink light particles, dissipating into the world.
This marked Tu Shanyue’s complete disappearance from this world, leaving not a single trace behind.
"Boom——"
With a tremendous roar, it seemed as if heaven and earth were mourning.
In the next moment.
In the midst of summer, anomalously, a heavy snow began to fall.
Gu Xing gently extended his hand, a snowflake landing on his palm.
This snowflake was not pure white but carried a hint of pink.
This snow fell from the heavens for Tu Shanyue!
Feeling the slight chill in his palm, Gu Xing’s hand gradually clenched.
A murderous intent continuously emanated from his eyes.
"Sovereign·Slaughter!"
Blood-colored spiritual power soared into the sky, completely enveloping Lilith.
However, this time it wasn’t the Soul Devouring Talent.
It was Sovereign!
The Slaughter State symbolized ultimate aggression!
At this moment, Gu Xing’s voice was colder than the ice and snow:
"Lilith——"
"Tear it apart for me!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 244: Tushan Yueli, Forming the Contract!
chapters.content:
Chapter 244: Chapter 244: Tushan Yueli, Forming the Contract!
Actually, there was no need for Gu Xing to issue that command; Lilith’s intent to kill had already been boiling.
No matter what...
As a proud empress of a race, she should not fall at the hands of a mere beast!
"Heh heh..."
Lilith’s knuckles turned white as she clutched her fist, and the blood mist around her roiled furiously.
Under the full activation of the Blood Law, strange blood-red patterns emerged on her pale skin, creeping like living creatures.
The terror of the Power of Laws was fully revealed at this moment...
It could completely control all relevant elements within the space.
And for the Blood Law, the most direct medium was...
Blood!
Lilith coldly watched the Nine Nether Centipede King twisting frantically under the torment of the sealing power, its hundred-zhang long body plowing countless ravines into the ground.
There was no trace of pity in her eyes, only icy killing intent.
As her hands slowly closed, the demon blood she had previously collected perfectly merged with the essence blood she released, transforming into a viscous blood plasma that completely enveloped the giant beast.
A blood-red domain with a diameter of a kilometer suddenly formed, and within this domain, every drop of blood became an extension of her will.
In this blood-red space, Lilith was the absolute ruler!
After all, a fierce beast is just a fierce beast, no matter how strong as a King Level, it cannot comprehend the Law.
This was Lilith’s greatest advantage!
The next moment.
A fierce gleam flashed in Lilith’s eyes, and her body suddenly appeared on the back of the Nine Nether Centipede King.
The Blood Long Spear swung along.
A wound several meters long instantly appeared on the back of the Nine Nether Centipede King.
And suffering from this blow.
The excruciating pain temporarily freed the beast from the torment of soul-burning.
Its compound eyes were already crimson like blood!
This was its most embarrassing moment!
"Roar——!!"
An angry roar sounded as this King-level fierce beast’s vision locked intensely onto Lilith.
However, looking at the eyes of this King-level fierce beast, Lilith spoke calmly:
"It seems, you still haven’t remembered who I am!"
As soon as her voice fell, Lilith struck again.
Using the same trick, she once again flashed to the back of the Nine Nether Centipede King, the Blood Long Spear aimed directly at the wound on its back.
However, just as the tip of the spear was about to pierce...
"Swish!"
The gigantic body of the Nine Nether Centipede King suddenly twisted, and its thick tail, tearing through the air, swept across with overwhelming force!
"Boom——!!!"
In the deafening impact, Lilith was sent flying like a kite with a broken string, crashing heavily against the edge of the blood-red domain.
The domain’s barrier shook violently, creating ripples.
If not for Tu Shanyue’s sealing, applied at the cost of her life, greatly weakening this King-level fierce beast’s power...
This strike would have been enough to severely injure Lilith!
At this moment.
Lilith slowly propped up her shattered body, crimson blood pearls dripping down her hair.
Yet in her scarlet eyes, there was not a hint of pain, but instead an almost frenzied fighting spirit burning brightly.
The more blood on the battlefield, the stronger her power becomes.
Whether it’s the enemy’s or her own!
As long as it’s blood, it can enhance the power of the Blood Law!
"Again!"
As soon as that word fell, Lilith’s body shot towards the King-level fierce beast like a cannonball once more.
The Nine Nether Centipede King angrily swung its tail, the mountain-like power knocking Lilith flying yet again.
"Boom——!!"
Lilith was instantly sent flying backward.
But this time, as she was sent flying, a dangerous curve appeared on the corner of her mouth.
Just now, in the instant the Nine Nether Centipede King struck, she placed the Blood Long Spear in front of herself.
And the Blood Long Spear, being the condensation of the Blood Law, combined with the support of Gu Xing’s killing status, was far more solid than a beast’s body.
Not even a King-level fierce beast can compare!
"Roar——!!"
The Nine Nether Centipede King let out a painful shriek, its tail pierced through by the Blood Long Spear, creating a ghastly blood hole.
Scarlet blood spurted like a fountain, yet was completely devoured by the Blood Domain before it could fall.
This blood transformed into pure energy, continuously feeding back into Lilith’s body.
Repairing her damaged body, strengthening every inch of her being.
It could be said that as the battle continued, Lilith’s power would keep increasing.
This was the courage she held to defeat this King-level fierce beast!
And most importantly, Tu Shanyue had sealed a part of this King-level fierce beast’s strength, which meant its every attack...
Could not harm Lilith fundamentally!
"Again!"
Lilith once more advanced with her spear, her aura now nearly double what it was initially.
Outside the blood-red domain.
Gu Xing withdrew his gaze from the battlefield.
The battle was decided...
The strongest aspect of the Nine Nether Centipede King was its body.
But within the Blood Domain, as its blood kept flowing away, its power would keep diminishing.
Eventually, there would come a moment when this King-level fierce beast would fall!
Lilith’s victory was only a matter of time.
He then turned his gaze to Tushan Yueli, standing frozen in place.
The girl’s eyes full of emptiness and grief, glistening tear marks starkly visible in the pink sheen.
Clearly, her mother’s death had dealt her a heavy blow.
Comforting others was not something Gu Xing was good at.
But after a moment of silence, Gu Xing eventually stepped forward and slowly extended his hand.
"Your mother’s last wish was for me to take good care of you."
"I can’t promise much, but as long as you’re willing..."
"All races sheltered by the Qingqiu Race can find a new home in Longxia Country. I guarantee with my life, they will be treated equally."
The falling pink snow landed on his shoulder, his voice gradually firming:
"And now... I need you to become my Contract Beast and fight against the Demon Race with me."
Hearing Gu Xing’s voice, Tushan Yueli slowly came back to her senses.
She slowly raised her head, her gaze shifting from the outstretched hand to the determined face of the human before her.
Her slender fingers subconsciously clenched, her nails deeply embedded in her palm.
Demon Race!
Hatred flashed in her eyes.
If not for this hateful race, her mother would not have died.
And to make the Demon Race pay, without power...
It’s absolutely not possible!
In the next moment, her gaze became resolute.
Without the slightest hesitation.
Tushan Yueli suddenly reached out and gripped Gu Xing’s hand tightly.
"Boom——!!!"
A dazzling pink contract light shot up to the sky, enveloping the two completely.
The moment she grasped Gu Xing’s hand, she activated the Beast Taming Contract.
Everything that the Qingqiu Race and her mother had once protected weighed on her shoulders.
Thus, she couldn’t hesitate, she couldn’t feel sorrow...
She had to bear it all!
Becoming Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast was her only choice!
"Master, Tushan Yueli is willing to become your Guardian Beast!"
Her voice no longer trembled, and a determined flame burned in her eyes.
To protect everything her mother cherished, to reclaim blood debts from the Demon Race, even if the path ahead was filled with thorns...
She would never turn back!
Seeing Tushan Yueli’s firm decision, Gu Xing tightly grasped her hand.
"Good!"
"In that case..."
"The contract is sealed!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 245: Nine Nether Centipede King—Fallen!
chapters.content:
Chapter 245: Chapter 245: Nine Nether Centipede King—Fallen!
Liu Li’s Contract Array is golden, Vera’s Contract Array is green, the sisters Qingshuang and Feiyue’s are black, and Tushan Yueli’s Contract Array...
Pink!
At this moment, the contract light enveloped both of them.
Gradually, a clear Spiritual Link was slowly forming between Gu Xing and Tushan Yueli.
And this also meant...
The contract is complete!
As the final contract pattern was completed, Tushan Yueli knelt on one knee, the seven snow-white fox tails behind her spreading out:
"Lord Gu Xing, Tushan Yueli is at your service."
Seeing this, Gu Xing hurriedly reached out to help Tushan Yueli up.
However, at the moment of contact with Tushan Yueli, he also realized that all of Tushan Yueli’s thoughts were focused on the remaining Qingqiu Race and all the beings protected by Tushan Yue.
Gu Xing fully understood this.
After all, Tushan Yue had just died, and the burden of the Qingqiu Race had fallen entirely on her shoulders.
Therefore, it was naturally impossible for Tushan Yueli to abandon everything immediately to follow him!
Gu Xing pondered for a moment and gently spoke:
"With your mother’s sacrifice, it’s not safe for the Qingqiu Race to stay here any longer!"
Gu Xing’s words were not exaggerated at all.
The Qingqiu Race was clearly targeted by the Demon Race.
This time, they came in small numbers because they wanted to seize the Divine Pattern.
If they came back in full force after his departure...
Without Tushan Yue’s protection, they would have to rely on their own strength for safety.
Gu Xing’s gaze swept over the creatures of each race still immersed in grief, sighed lightly, and directly proposed a plan:
"First take care of the matters here, and I will inform Longxia Country to send Monarch Level experts to escort everyone safely to migrate."
The journey from here to Longxia Country took Gu Xing nearly a month at his speed.
And for such a large migration of races, the time required would undoubtedly be much longer.
Moreover...
Other than the Qingqiu Race having certain combat capabilities.
The combat capabilities of the other races are weak.
Relying solely on them to migrate this long distance to Longxia Country is simply impossible.
Therefore, Gu Xing planned to have Long Zhenguo dispatch some Monarch Level experts to escort them to Longxia Country.
Now, with the addition of the Blood Race and part of the Ghost Race to the Human Race...
Even if the Demon Race returned in full force, resistance is not entirely impossible.
Therefore, even having Long Zhenguo send some Monarch Level to escort them would not significantly impact Longxia Country’s safety.
As Tushan Yueli heard Gu Xing’s orders, her eyes were full of gratitude.
Logically, as a Guardian Beast of a Beast Master.
All the thoughts of the Guardian Beast should be focused on the Beast Master.
However....
With Tushan Yue’s sacrifice, she naturally had to inherit Tushan Yue’s responsibilities.
Now that Gu Xing brought this matter up, Tushan Yueli breathed a sigh of relief.
"Lord Gu Xing, I will come to you as soon as I finish handling the affairs of the Qingqiu Race."
After respectfully bowing to Gu Xing, Tushan Yueli hurried to make arrangements for the Qingqiu Race.
While Gu Xing turned his gaze towards the battlefield where Lilith was.
By now, the battle between them was nearing its end.
Within the Blood Domain.
The body of the Nine Nether Centipede King was covered with wounds.
Black blood continuously dripped from its body, absorbed by the Blood Domain, nurturing Lilith.
And with this power boost, the aura emanating from around Lilith reached an extremely terrifying level.
"Do you remember who I am now?"
Lilith swung her long spear, her voice carrying a hint of mockery.
In the past, she gave everything she had, but she was still no match for this King-level Fierce Beast.
But now...
The blood-colored aura around her rose again!
And during the battle....
She discovered something.
The Soul-devouring Status that Gu Xing applied to her...
Was actually increasing as her strength advanced!
Previously, before absorbing the blood of the Nine Nether Centipede King, her strength barely reached Totem One Turn.
But...
After absorbing the blood of the Nine Nether Centipede King, her strength increased, and Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent also counted this temporary increase in strength.
Same double enhancement!
Now, she was only a step away from Totem Two Turn.
This discovery made Lilith’s heart tremble.
It’s important to know, the gap between each Totem Level is like a chasm.
And now, her level is merely Half-step Totem...
Yet, with various states bestowed by Gu Xing, her strength was forcibly pushed near Totem Two Turn.
Thinking of this, Lilith was astonished to realize...
The terrifying extent of Gu Xing’s enhancement!
What’s even more terrifying is...
The Angel and Elf’s talents are even stronger than hers.
Doesn’t that mean as long as Gu Xing’s level reaches Monarch Peak...
Gu Xing would have Totem Level combat power?!
But before she could think further...
"Roar——!!!"
Suddenly, the Nine Nether Centipede King let out an angry roar, its Demonic Qi surging like a volcanic eruption.
It had realized it was close to its doom!
In a life-or-death moment, it finally recognized the once trampled "insect" now above it!!
Extreme rage led the Demonic Qi to completely invade its reason, attributes surged once more!
Seeing this, Lilith slightly frowned.
No wonder this Centipede King could become a King-level Fierce Beast.
Even with such serious injuries, it could still erupt Demonic Qi once again.
But immediately, a cold smile appeared on her lips.
However, she was not who she used to be!
"Crimson Calamity!"
The entire Blood Domain began to violently contract, the blood mist in the sky condensed at the tip of the spear, like all rivers running to the sea.
In an instant...
The wind stopped! The clouds froze!
Only a glaring crimson remained between heaven and earth.
The Blood Long Spear trembled, terrifying energy causing the surrounding space to shatter, black cracks spreading like a spider’s web.
"It’s time to end!"
Lilith coldly uttered these words.
The Nine Nether Centipede King also seemed to sense the threat of death.
It frantically channeled the Demonic Qi within, the black energy in its mouth constantly compressed and condensed...
The cost was its massive body visibly shriveling with rapidity.
This meant it was also fighting for its life.
But even so...
Lilith’s eyes remained calm as ever.
Tushan Yue’s seal weakened it once, the Blood Domain weakened it again.
If it still managed to overturn the situation, she, the Blood Ancestor, might as well end her life to make amends!
"Swish——"
Lilith slowly raised her hand.
The Blood Long Spear then followed, the killing aura at the spear tip tore through the Void.
Ignoring any defenses!
This attribute helped a lot in attacking the hard shell of the Nine Nether Centipede King.
And now...
"Go."
A light word, but the spear flew like a blood-colored meteor streaking through the sky.
At the same time, the Nine Nether Centipede King’s dark ray shot out roaringly!
"Boom————!!!"
At the moment of collision, heaven and earth lost color.
Vera immediately opened a shield, protecting Gu Xing behind her.
The terrifying shockwave swept past, the walls of Qingqiu City collapsed with a roar.
Fortunately, the restriction left by Tushan Yue took effect, blocking the shockwave.
But the entire Qingqiu Base, under the aftermath, was destroyed.
And at the center of the battlefield, when the light dissipated...
There was only a blood-red silhouette left!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 246: The Final Material, Ghost Core!
chapters.content:
Chapter 246: Chapter 246: The Final Material, Ghost Core!
In the blood-colored smoke, Lilith’s proud and upright figure gradually cleared.
Before her, on the grim head of the Nine Nether Centipede King, the Blood Long Spear was deeply embedded, its tail still trembling slightly.
The next moment.
"Boom——!!!"
Accompanied by a deafening crash, the colossal body over a hundred meters long collapsed, stirring up dust that blotted out the sky.
The king-level fierce beast that once instilled fear in countless races now lay silent like a crumbling mountain.
This also means...
One of the four king-level fierce beasts, the Nine Nether Centipede King...
Has fallen!
As Lilith gazed at the fallen Nine Nether Centipede King, her eyes revealed a trace of contemplation.
After slaying this Nine Nether Centipede King, she suddenly realized...
She didn’t seem so eager to regain her strength and return to the Totem Level anymore.
It seemed that under Gu Xing’s command....
Even though her strength was only at the Half-Step Totem Level, it was no different from the Totem Level.
Moreover...
There was another extremely important point.
If she were to be contracted by Gu Xing, she could follow him to break through and ascend to the Totem Level once more.
And through this method...
She seemed to gain another opportunity to comprehend laws.
From Monarch Level to Totem Level...
Heaven and earth would grant a chance to comprehend a law.
And she had already comprehended the Blood Law; if she were to comprehend it again...
The most conservative estimate is that her mastery of the Blood Law would reach new heights.
And more likely...
Lilith unconsciously touched her heart, feeling a long-lost stirring.
Could she seize this opportunity to touch upon a second law?
Once this thought surfaced, it spread like wildfire in her heart.
Her eyes gradually became resolute.
She must become Gu Xing’s contracted beast!
But then, a harsh reality surfaced in her mind:
Gu Xing’s current contract quota was already used up.
Although a breakthrough to Monarch Level would grant new slots, however...
What if she wasn’t chosen then?
No, this cannot happen!
Her scarlet pupils flickered with anxiety.
Contracting with Gu Xing must be prioritized!
Meanwhile, at the edge of the battlefield, a wisp of peculiar demonic qi was stealthily writhing.
This was a newly formed Demon Race, condensed from the remnant souls of demons previously slain by Lilith, and its power was just reaching the Totem Level.
However, at this moment...
It was holding its breath as it stealthily crept towards the perimeter, not daring to leak even a bit of demonic qi.
Though formed from demonic qi...
It retained the memories of those Demons from their lifetimes.
So it knew better than anyone:
That fallen king-level fierce beast was a presence it could only look up to!
Yet even with such formidable strength, it fell at the hands of that Blood Race.
And it...
Its current strength merely equaled barely reaching the Totem Level.
Such strength, in the hands of that Blood Race, would likely be casually dealt with.
"I must escape..."
The newly formed Demon Race howled internally.
If it could just escape this battlefield and return to absorb enough demonic qi from the Demon Race territory...
Someday, it vowed to tear that Blood Race apart with its own hands!
But just as it was about to reach the battlefield’s edge...
"Where do you think you’re going?"
Lilith’s figure appeared behind the demonic qi like a specter, arms crossed, her crimson eyes full of amusement.
Demonic qi could condense into new Demons!
Lilith naturally couldn’t ignore this.
The earlier situation was too dire, so she went to deal with the Nine Nether Centipede King first.
Nonetheless, she hadn’t forgotten about this mass of demonic qi.
"Trying to escape, did you ask me?"
Lilith wore a cold smile.
Upon hearing Lilith’s voice, the demonic qi frantically surged, instantly forming into a hideous Demon form.
It amalgamated the features of those former Demons, appearing extremely grotesque.
Seeing this Demon, Lilith furrowed her eyebrows.
So ugly!
Such an eyesore!
The Demon observed this and threatened timidly:
"Blood Race! If we really fight, we will only end in mutual destruction! It’s better if we both step back..."
However...
"Mutual destruction?"
It was as if Lilith heard the most ridiculous joke, a trace of cruel amusement curved on her lips.
Could this trash really pose such a threat?
Lilith elegantly raised her hand, the Blood Domain instantly enveloping the Demon.
At this moment, she had absorbed all the blood of the Nine Nether Centipede King, her power at its peak.
Now, not to mention this newly stepped-up Totem One Turn weakling Demon.
Even a Totem Two Turn Demon God, Lilith had the confidence to confront!
"Annihilate!"
As her fingers clenched, the entire domain suddenly collapsed into a singularity, which then thoroughly obliterated.
The pitiful Demon didn’t even have time to scream before vanishing into nothingness.
Once demonic qi was completely purified, it could never reassemble.
And this pure energy was entirely absorbed by the Divine Pattern on Gu Xing’s forehead.
"Buzz——"
The Divine Pattern suddenly shone with dazzling golden light, and Gu Xing felt the power within him surging like a tide.
His various attributes underwent qualitative leaps at that moment!
[Gu Xing]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Guardian Beast: Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, Sally, Tushan Yueli]
[Special State: Human Race’s Favor]
[Divine Pattern: 2]
[Contract Quota: 5/5]
[Power: 40000→60000]
[Constitution: 40000→60000]
[Spirit: 40000→60000]
[Speed: 40000→60000]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might, Absolute Forbidden Domain]
Under the influence of this Divine Pattern, Gu Xing’s attributes finally reached the limits of Commander Level.
This also meant Gu Xing was one step away from breaking through to the Monarch Level!
That is, by enhancing Qing Shuang’s talent to Myth Nine Stars.
As for Fei Yue...
Gu Xing sighed softly.
Not a single material had been found...
Helping her ascend to Myth Nine Stars was already impossible.
Finding all of Fei Yue’s materials and then raising her to Monarch Level would waste too much time.
It wasn’t worth it!
Therefore, Gu Xing had already decided.
To locate the Ghost Core, help Qing Shuang enhance her talent, and then break through to the Monarch Level.
At this moment...
"Here, found this inside the Nine Nether Centipede King’s body."
"You’re pretty lucky."
Lilith suddenly appeared before him, two brilliant crystal cores lying in her pale palm.
Gu Xing’s gaze shifted over.
[Fierce Beast Blood Core]
[Quality: Myth]
[Function: Can help Blood Race enhance talent]
[Ghost Core]
[Quality: Myth]
