```
[Function: Can help Ghost Race enhance talent]
Seeing these two materials, Gu Xing was somewhat stunned.
He could understand the Fierce Beast Blood Core.
But why was there a Ghost Core in the body of the Nine Nether Centipede King?
Lilith perhaps saw Gu Xing’s confusion and explained:
"This king-level fierce beast’s habitat is near the Ghost Race’s territory. Probably, some Ghost Race carrying the Ghost Core was swallowed by this king-level fierce beast."
Gu Xing nodded; this explanation made sense.
Soon, his gaze turned fervent.
Currently, the three materials needed for Qing Shuang’s advancement...
Nether Ghost Stone, Extreme Ghost Qi, Ghost Core, had all been fortuitously gathered!
This means...
The Myth Nine Stars Qing Shuang was about to be born!
And he was about to break through to the Monarch Level!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 247: Qing Shuang’s Advancement!
chapters.content:
Chapter 247: Chapter 247: Qing Shuang’s Advancement!
The moment the Ghost Core was seen.
Qing Shuang instantly left the Beast Taming Space and appeared in front of Gu Xing.
Since Vera had advanced to Myth Nine Stars, she basically hadn’t had the chance to make a move.
Moreover, the enemies Gu Xing encountered recently were extremely challenging.
They were mostly Monarch Level, and many were even Half-Step Totem Level.
Therefore, Qing Shuang had even less opportunity to act.
However...
In a short while, this situation will completely change.
She knew beforehand that the final material to enhance her Talent was the Ghost Core, and now...
The last material has finally been gathered!
"Qing Shuang, adjust your Status to the Peak, prepare for advancement!"
Without hesitation, Gu Xing directly gave the order.
It’s better to help Qing Shuang reach Myth Nine Stars Talent soon, rather than letting time slip away!
Upon hearing these words, Lilith showed a hint of envy in her eyes.
Another Guardian Beast is about to break through the limits and reach a new level!
She just wondered when it’d be her turn?!
At that moment, Fei Yue also emerged from the Void.
"Go for it, sister!"
The little girl made a cheering gesture, her pink eyes full of encouragement.
As long as her sister’s Talent is enhanced, at the least...
Her sister can rank among the top three in the master’s Guardian Beasts!
By then...
Her sister’s chances to take action will increase.
This directly results in longer interaction time with the master, raising the likelihood of her sister winning over the master.
If her sister wins over the master, then she...
Wouldn’t she be the master’s little sister-in-law?!
Then who would dare to bully her?!
A rare excitement also appeared in Qing Shuang’s eyes.
Finally, the day has arrived!
Previously, she, Liu Li, and Vera were all the main battle Guardian Beasts for Gu Xing.
But as time went by, Liu Li and Vera had successively enhanced their Talents....
Their strength greatly improved, reaching a level she could hardly achieve!
Saying she had no anxiety at all... was impossible!
On the contrary, she constantly improved herself within the Beast Taming Space.
She even frequently entered the Soul Nourishing Pool to refine the Ghost Race’s weakest Spiritual Attribute!
However...
Even though her various Attributes nearly reached the limit of Myth Five Stars Talent....
She was still far behind Liu Li and Vera!
But now...
She can finally enhance and once again become a reliant support for the master.
"Master, I am ready anytime, my current Status is the Peak!"
Upon seeing Qing Shuang answer without hesitation, Gu Xing nodded.
In terms of these Guardian Beasts, who he trusts the most...
It definitely is Qing Shuang!
Although Liu Li and Vera are strong, their personalities...
Occasionally stirred up some troubles!
As for Qing Shuang, always quietly following by his side, executing every command perfectly.
She can be said to be a model among the Guardian Beasts!
For such a dedicated Guardian Beast, Gu Xing certainly wouldn’t let her feel disheartened.
"Since you’re ready, then..."
"Begin advancement!"
With a thought, he instantly took out the Nether Ghost Stone and Extreme Ghost Qi from the Beast Taming Space.
And upon leaving the Beast Taming Space, the Extreme Ghost Qi seemed to develop sentience and tried to escape.
However...
With just a slight leak of Qing Shuang’s aura, the Extreme Ghost Qi instantly froze in place.
Previously, the Great Elder of the Ghost Race was utterly incapable of gaining Extreme Ghost Qi’s recognition!
Thus, although he controlled Extreme Ghost Qi back then, he never utilized its Function.
But Qing Shuang is different!
If anyone in the Ghost Race could gain Extreme Ghost Qi’s acknowledgment.
Besides You and Qing, only Qing Shuang could!
Even Fei Yue couldn’t!
Extreme Ghost Qi is unlike Divine Pattern, it doesn’t completely rely on Talent to recognize its master.
It considers more of an aura...
The aura of the Ghost King!
And this aura on Qing Shuang is even stronger than You and Qing!
Seeing Extreme Ghost Qi calm down, Gu Xing then confidently used the system to merge the remaining two materials with Extreme Ghost Qi.
The moment the three materials fused, the presence of Extreme Ghost Qi multiplied several times.
Even the sky turned black under the influence of Extreme Ghost Qi.
Lilith watched this scene with a slight frown.
This Ghost Race’s breakthrough seems to be even more significant than those of the Angel and Elf!
This indeed is the case!
At this moment, Gu Xing observed the aura of the three fusing together, and his eyes flickered with seriousness.
Qing Shuang’s advancement is different from those of Liu Li and Vera!
For Qing Shuang...
All her battle prowess relies on her formidable physique.
Thus, her advancement...
Would mean destroying and remolding the original body!
This process is extremely dangerous!
If Qing Shuang can’t endure, or her belief wavers the slightest...
This advancement will fail completely!
The only outcome of failure is...
Death!
"Qing Shuang, are you sure you’ve thought it through? Once advancement begins, you can’t turn back!"
This advancement, outsiders can’t help Qing Shuang at all!
Gu Xing consulted the system, even Celestial Grace can’t intervene in this advancement.
This advancement relies solely on Qing Shuang!
Nonetheless.
Qing Shuang’s eyes showed no hint of hesitation.
"Master, let’s begin!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing nodded.
Just now, if Qing Shuang had hesitated even the slightest, he would have stopped her from initiating the advancement without delay.
But, as he expected...
Even aware that failure leads to death, she still wasn’t retreating in the slightest.
Gu Xing took a deep breath, controlling the terrifying surge of Extreme Ghost Qi towards Qing Shuang.
As the two met, Gu Xing noticed that the instant Qing Shuang’s body touched the Extreme Ghost Qi...
Her flesh was immediately consumed by the Extreme Ghost Qi, leaving only a translucent skeleton.
Seeing this, Gu Xing instantly broke out in a cold sweat.
He didn’t expect...
The destructively fast speed at which Extreme Ghost Qi swallowed the original body!
But since advancement has begun, stopping is now impossible.
He can only trust Qing Shuang!
If she can endure the grind of Extreme Ghost Qi against the Ghost King’s Bone, the flesh will begin to remold.
But during this period...
Qing Shuang’s soul will be corroded by Extreme Ghost Qi.
This phase is the riskiest part of the advancement process!
"Qing Shuang, go for it!"
Faced with this, Gu Xing can only silently cheer Qing Shuang in his heart.
If she can survive this ordeal...
Perhaps Qing Shuang’s combat power could surpass Liu Li, becoming the strongest Guardian Beast he has!
Meanwhile, Fei Yue, Liu Li, and others watched Qing Shuang’s advancement...
And couldn’t help but feel anxious.
Though not often communicating with Qing Shuang, inwardly...
Everyone had already mutually acknowledged each other as partners!
"Qing Shuang(sister), you can definitely succeed!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 248: Blazing Angels, Danger!
chapters.content:
Chapter 248: Chapter 248: Blazing Angels, Danger!
Pain!
This is the only sensation Qing Shuang can feel right now!
But...
Even though her soul is constantly being eroded by the Extreme Ghost Qi, and the soul keeps transmitting pain that ordinary people cannot endure...
There isn’t a single flicker of hesitation in her eyes!
Since the day she left the Ghost Race, she has become immune to pain.
No pain....
Could compare to the feeling of her sister’s body gradually turning cold in front of her.
Strength is the only thing that can decide everything!
For the sake of power, she can swallow any bitterness.
This mindset had somewhat calmed after meeting Gu Xing.
But...
Lately, seeing herself gradually becoming unable to help Gu Xing, this thought has slowly resurfaced.
Now...
All she needs to do is endure this pain, and her power will be greatly enhanced.
For her, this is already an incredibly fortunate thing!
Feeling the pain emanating from all parts of her soul, she slowly opened her arms.
She allowed as much of her body as possible to feel this pain.
Extreme Ghost Qi can not only temper the flesh but also enhance one’s soul strength.
And the higher the soul strength, the greater the probability of comprehending the Law!
And since the Ghost Race is not proficient in this, she must seize every opportunity to enhance herself.
"Boom——!!!"
Gradually.
Under the tempering of the Extreme Ghost Qi, her soul strength continued to increase.
At the same time, her bones, under the tempering of the Extreme Ghost Qi, had become like white jade.
Once the tempering of the bones was completed, lines of meridians, muscles, began to appear...
Quickly.
A perfectly defined body began to solidify.
Compared to Qing Shuang’s previous body...
Except for appearing slightly whiter and slimmer, there seemed to be no difference.
But...
The explosive power contained in this body is several times that of her previous body.
In Gu Xing’s sight.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars → Myth Nine Stars]
[Power: 60,000 → 90,000]
[Constitution: 55,000 → 70,000]
[Spirit: 40,000 → 60,000]
[Speed: 54,000 → 70,000]
[Skills: Ghost King Form, Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King Domain, Law of Power]
Seeing Qing Shuang’s attributes, Gu Xing couldn’t help but swallow.
Strength attribute reached 90,000 points!
Both Constitution and Speed attributes also reached 70,000 points!
Even the weakest Spiritual Attribute reached the limit of Commander Level!
You must know...
Liu Li’s attributes have just reached 70,000 points!
But Qing Shuang...
The total of all attributes actually surpassed Liu Li!
Tremendous!
What’s more frightening is Qing Shuang’s skills...
[Ghost King Form: Enhance all attributes by 200%]
[Ghost Race Four Techniques: Mountain Opening (Enhance Strength attribute by 1.5 times), Sea Breaker (Enhance Strength attribute by 1.5 times), Heaven-Breaking (Enhance Strength attribute by 3 times), Starburst (Enhance Strength attribute by 4 times)]
The former Ghost King’s Body has already evolved into Ghost King Form.
The enhancement to its attributes has increased from 150% to 200%!
The fourth technique of the Ghost Race Four Techniques couldn’t be used until the Monarch Level, but now...
Even at Commander Level, Qing Shuang has the ability to use it!
Although Qing Shuang’s skills have not changed much, yet...
If Qing Shuang activates the Ghost King Form and then uses the Starburst skill!
Then Qing Shuang’s Strength attribute will be increased eightfold!
Reaching 720,000 points!
Such an attribute even leaves Liu Li far behind!
When Vera and Liu Li sensed Qing Shuang’s aura, they exchanged a glance, a tacit understanding.
Their eyes held a hint of seriousness!
Qing Shuang’s enhancement put immense pressure on both of them.
Previously, the combat strength gap between Vera and Liu Li was not very large.
But now...
It seems Qing Shuang has overtaken them, leaving them behind.
Lilith, too, looked shocked, her vision was higher.
She could see more clearly the improvement in Qing Shuang!
This Ghost Race has already determined its future path, and is already on it.
One force conquers all!
And for a Commander level, this is terrifying.
If this Ghost Race continues along this path, upon reaching Monarch Level...
Even Totem Level, to what extent will she achieve?
Lilith doesn’t know!
But she knows it will definitely be stronger than herself now!
And much stronger!
Qing Shuang has now completed her enhancement.
She slightly waved her hand, and the remaining Extreme Ghost Qi merged into her body like subjects recognizing their ruler.
Then, Qing Shuang stepped forward and gently kneeled in front of Gu Xing:
"Master, Qing Shuang has not let you down, successfully completing the task!"
Looking at such Qing Shuang, Gu Xing’s mouth showed a hint of a smile.
"Congratulations, Qing Shuang!"
At this time, Qing Shuang happened to look up.
Just at the moment when Gu Xing’s smile was reflected in her eyes.
Qing Shuang’s face showed a slight blush, and she immediately lowered her head:
"It’s all thanks to Master Gu Xing."
Watching the modest Qing Shuang, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched.
Then he helped Qing Shuang up.
Now that Qing Shuang’s talent has broken through to Myth Nine Stars, the next task is for her to break through to the Monarch Level herself.
However, to break through to the Monarch Level...
Gu Xing has already decided!
Now the two Divine Patterns have fully awakened.
The energy from killing Demon Races will no longer be absorbed by them.
During this time, Gu Xing has figured out why breaking through from Commander Level to Monarch Level requires killing Monarch Level Demon Races...
Only Monarch Level Demon Races have enough energy to help Commander Level Beast Masters break through their shackles and reach Monarch Level.
The more energy absorbed, the more beneficial to the Beast Master!
Therefore, Gu Xing’s target now is not ordinary Monarch Level Demons.
Since improvement is needed, the strongest must be chosen!
Totem Level Demon Race!
But before that, Gu Xing turned his gaze northward.
That is his destination on this journey.
It is also where Liu Li’s heart is entwined.
The stronghold of the Angel Race!
...
Meanwhile.
In the stronghold of the Angel Race.
The Demon Race gave Mi Zhan an ultimatum.
"Mi Zhan, you have three more days to find the Divine Pattern of the Angel Race and pledge allegiance to the Demon Race! Otherwise....."
This Demon Race gave a cold humph, its threatening meaning was clear.
Immediately after, this Demon Race disappeared from the central hall of the Angel Race.
And Mi Zhan’s face turned extremely unpleasant at that moment.
He had been delaying joining in hopes of breaking through to the Totem Level through his efforts.
But now...
The Demon Race has given him an ultimatum.
This means...
He no longer has time.
And more importantly...
The Divine Pattern has always been known only by the Clan Leader of the Blazing Angels Race.
And now the Clan Leader of the Blazing Angels Race has disappeared, so how could he find the Divine Pattern?
Thinking of this, he gripped his fingers tightly, a fierce look flashing in his eyes.
Soon after, a command was issued:
"Give those Blazing Angels one last day to reveal the location of the Divine Pattern!"
"If they don’t disclose, then slaughter them all!"
Now, Mi Zhan has no other options.
He can only place hope on these Blazing Angels.
If they do not know the location of the Divine Pattern...
Then it means in three days, he must transform into a Demon, serving the Demon Race.
In such a case...
Keeping these Blazing Angels alive serves no purpose!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 249: The Final Ultimatum!
chapters.content:
Chapter 249: Chapter 249: The Final Ultimatum!
Angel Race, within the dungeon.
Liu Xia and the others sensed that the atmosphere of the Angel Race was becoming strange.
At this moment, she tentatively shouted to the War Angel guard not far away:
"Hey, can you tell me what’s been happening recently?"
Unexpectedly, under Liu Xia’s call, that War Angel actually turned around.
He looked at Liu Xia directly.
He hesitantly pointed at himself:
"Deputy Clan Leader, are you calling me?"
A trace of surprise flashed in Liu Xia’s eyes.
This newly assigned War Angel guard actually responded to her inquiry!
To know, the previous High Tier War Angels guarding them not only never talked but also deliberately kept their distance from the dungeon.
However, in the past couple of days, all High Tier guards have been urgently transferred, replaced by these young War Angels of weaker strength.
This anomalous change made Liu Xia certain that something major must be happening outside!
The War Angel saw Liu Xia nod, affirming that she was indeed calling him, and only after some hesitation did he slowly approach the edge of the dungeon.
Another War Angel who was transferred with him saw this scene and just lightly reminded:
"Xiaoqi, be careful, the Elders warn us not to go near them!"
"If you are found out, you will surely be punished!"
The War Angel referred to as Xiaoqi turned his head and replied:
"It’s fine, I’m just seeing if Deputy Clan Leader Liu Xia has any needs."
Before Mi Zhan initiated the coup, Liu Xia was the Deputy Clan Leader of the entire clan.
With her passionate personality, she had great popularity, whether among the War Angel Race or the Blazing Angels Race.
Yet now...
Looking at this War Angel who still addressed her as Deputy Clan Leader, Liu Xia felt a shred of comfort in her eyes.
At least this proved that not all War Angels had completely fallen.
Seeing Xiaoqi approach, Liu Xia hurriedly asked:
"Has anything major happened recently in the Angel Race or the entire Alternate Space?"
This War Angel appeared somewhat hesitant, as the Elders strictly forbade them from interacting with the Blazing Angels Race.
At this moment, a group of elders behind Liu Xia all spoke up:
"Xiaoqi, don’t forget the contributions our Blazing Angels Race made for the entire Angel Race."
"If it weren’t for the Clan Leader back then, how could we have safely passed through those crises?"
"Indeed, Lord Liu Xia always kept your War Angel Race in mind; perhaps you’ve even benefited from her."
"Do you also want to be ungrateful? Would you not even care to answer a question from Lord Liu Xia?"
Under the persuasion of these Blazing Angel elders, Xiaoqi’s heart finally wavered.
He looked around warily, then lowered his voice and cautiously said:
"Lord Liu Xia, the Elders have strictly forbidden us to divulge any information..."
"I can only briefly tell you..."
"The Angel Race is fully preparing for war, Lord Mi Zhan is planning to...annihilate the entire Human Race!"
This news, like a bolt of lightning, left Liu Xia frozen in place.
"Annihilate the entire Human Race? What about Liu Li?"
A rare trace of panic flashed in her eyes, and her voice trembled slightly.
Seeing this, Xiaoqi dared not say more; he hurriedly bowed deeply to Liu Xia, then quickly turned and left, his figure soon disappearing in the distance.
The other Blazing Angels in the dungeon had long guessed that Liu Xia had sent Liu Li to the Human Race.
Now, upon hearing that Mi Zhan was going to attack the Human Race, they immediately began whispering among themselves:
"Lord Liu Xia, if Mi Zhan truly intends to annihilate the Human Race, then wouldn’t Lord Liu Li be in grave danger?"
"Why would Mi Zhan choose to attack the Human Race? The Angel Race and the Human Race are so far apart, why go to such lengths?"
At this time, Liu Xia had calmed down from her initial panic.
She suddenly realized she was too worried before and had overlooked a key point...
The Human Race is different from these races; they live in another world.
"As long as Liu Li hasn’t entered the Alternate Space, she’ll be absolutely safe." Liu Xia silently reassured herself.
What’s more, Liu Li’s wings are already broken, preventing her from advancing her power, leaving her at the lowest Awakening Level.
In her current status, crossing into the Alternate Space is impossible.
Thinking of this, Liu Xia’s tense nerves finally relaxed, and the worry on her brows gradually disappeared.
Just then, a loud voice suddenly echoed:
"The Great Elder arrives!"
Upon hearing this announcement, Liu Xia immediately regained composure, her face a mask of coldness once again.
Soon, the War Angels’ Great Elder stepped steadily to the cell door.
He first turned to inquire of the guarding War Angel:
"Have they been behaving recently?"
The guarding War Angel immediately bowed respectfully and answered:
"Reporting to the Great Elder, everything is normal."
Upon receiving a satisfactory reply, the Great Elder turned his gaze to Liu Xia and the others, a flash of keen insight in his murky eyes:
"Liu Xia, tell me the whereabouts of the Divine Pattern, or....tell me where you’ve hidden Liu Li."
The location of the Divine Pattern was only known to the former Clan Leader.
And now the former Clan Leader has disappeared, so to find the Divine Pattern...
Besides Liu Xia, perhaps only Liu Li knows this secret.
Upon hearing this, Liu Xia merely snorted coldly and turned her face away, disdaining to respond.
The Great Elder seemed to have anticipated such a reaction and was not annoyed.
After all, with Liu Xia’s personality, how could she give in so easily?
More importantly...
Maybe even Liu Xia herself isn’t sure of the exact location of the Divine Pattern.
He shook his head meaningfully, his tone indifferent:
"No matter, you may choose silence, but the Clan Leader has issued a final ultimatum..."
"Within one day, if we still obtain no news of the Divine Pattern’s whereabouts, the Blazing Angels Race...prepare to vanish from this world!"
After saying this, the Great Elder turned and left without looking back, leaving only the heavy sound of his footsteps reverberating in the cell.
Liu Xia heard this news, her pupils dilated sharply, and she stood frozen as if struck by lightning.
Mi Zhan would actually give such an order!
Is he not afraid...of the Clan Leader’s return?
No, that’s not right!
With Mi Zhan’s cautious and suspicious nature, he wouldn’t make such a reckless move.
Suddenly, a terrifying thought flashed through her mind, causing her pupils to constrict suddenly.
"Could it be...Mi Zhan has colluded with the Demon Race?"
Once this thought emerged, it spread like wildfire in her mind.
She quickly recalled all the details before her brother’s misfortune...
Those seemingly coincidental events now connected, pointing to a terrifying truth:
All of this was a meticulously planned conspiracy!
"Damn it!"
Liu Xia’s hands unconsciously clenched, her nails digging deep into her palms, eyes blazing with rage.
Yet, in the next second, the chains binding her suddenly lit up with a strange red glow
"Ah——!"
The intense pain made her collapse heavily to the ground.
These mysterious chains not only completely sealed their power but also punished any resisters.
"Lord Liu Xia!"
"Stop! The more you resist, the stronger the chains’ suppression will be!"
The surrounding Blazing Angels anxiously shouted, but could only watch as Liu Xia struggled in pain.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 250: Mermaid Princess
chapters.content:
Chapter 250: Chapter 250: Mermaid Princess
At the same time.
Just as Gu Xing and his companions were about to reach the Angel Race’s territory, a sudden change occurred.
"Master, something’s happening ahead!"
Liu Li suddenly stopped alertly, her wings slightly unfolding.
Looking in the direction Liu Li indicated, they saw a group of the Demon Race furiously hunting down a strange-looking race.
These creatures being hunted had distorted bodies, their skin a bizarre bluish-gray color, with sharp bone spurs growing at the joints of their limbs...
This was a race Gu Xing had never seen before.
"Liu Li, do you recognize them?"
The little angel gently shook her head, her eyes filled with the same confusion:
"I’ve never seen such a race..."
Gu Xing immediately used their spiritual link to inquire of Lilith in the Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, the Blood Race Ancestor was lazily lying on the branches of the Tree of Life.
"Lilith, do you recognize those being hunted outside?"
"Hmm..." Lilith absentmindedly swung her feet, "No impression."
Hearing Lilith’s response, Gu Xing was a bit stunned.
Even Lilith, who has lived for thousands of years, the Blood Ancestor, had never seen them.
This...
But no matter what, since the Demon Race was hunting them.
Gu Xing had a reason to intervene.
"Liu Li, rescue them!"
"At your command, Master!"
A cold gleam flashed in Liu Li’s eyes, her ten wings suddenly unfolding, turning into a golden stream of light rushing toward the battlefield.
At this moment, the battle was extremely brutal.
A group of Sea Tribe warriors were desperately resisting the Demon Race’s pursuit.
They had strange appearances, but each was fearless in the face of death.
"Princess, you go ahead! We’ll hold them off!"
These Sea Tribe warriors, knowing they were no match, still charged into the Demon Race ranks one after another.
Whenever they reached exhaustion, they would unhesitatingly self-destruct, using their sacrifice to delay the pursuing forces.
Seeing this, the Demon Race Commander sneered and gestured with his hand:
"Slow down the chase!"
"These fleeing dogs cannot escape, no need to sacrifice our lives unnecessarily."
His cold eyes swept across the battlefield, "The Sea Tribe’s Divine Pattern is already in our hands, take your time in wiping them out."
"By your command!"
The Demon Race soldiers immediately changed their formation, no longer pursuing aggressively but instead began to systematically shrink the encirclement.
This cat-and-mouse tactic only plunged the Sea Tribe further into despair.
Princess Aliya looked around, seeing her wounded tribesmen who were protecting her, her heart wrenched with pain.
She trembled as she supported the old Turtle Race elder beside her:
"Grandpa Turtle... you should go... leave me be..."
Glistening tears rolled down her teal-blue cheeks: "Mother has fallen in battle... the Sea Palace has fallen too... I have... nowhere left to go..."
The old Turtle Race elder’s shell was covered with cracks, yet he still steadfastly stood in front of the princess:
This elder, affectionately called "Grandpa Turtle" by Aliya, had served the Mermaid royalty for generations, witnessing the rise and fall of the Sea Tribe over hundreds of years.
Looking at the young princess before him, a deep heartache surfaced on the elder’s wrinkled face.
Princess Aliya was still so young, meant to grow up carefree in the Coral Palace, now burdened with the fate of her entire race.
"Liya, don’t talk nonsense."
Grandpa Turtle’s voice was hoarse yet firm, his rough hand gently stroking the princess’s sea-blue hair.
"As long as Grandpa Turtle has a breath left, I will never let anything happen to you."
The old man raised his head towards the advancing Demon Race, a sharp glint flashing in his cloudy eyes:
"The Sea Tribe may be gone, but you are still here. As long as the Mermaid royal lineage continues, one day, we will surely restore the Sea Tribe’s glory!"
He suddenly pushed Aliya northward:
"Run towards the Angel Race’s territory! You’ll be safe there!"
Turning to face the tide of upcoming demons, insurmountable rage ignited in Grandpa Turtle’s eyes.
It was these demons who destroyed the peaceful underwater kingdom, who killed the benevolent Sea King.
Had it not been for the need to protect the young princess, he would have gladly died along with the late king on the battlefield.
"Warriors of the Sea Tribe!"
"Today, even if we bite with our teeth, if need be, we will pave a path for the princess with our lives!"
"Follow to the death!"
The remaining Sea Tribe warriors roared in unison.
Princess Aliya’s young face was covered in tear tracks.
"Grandpa Turtle... everyone..."
The ten-year-old princess’s voice shook uncontrollably, "I’m sorry!"
At an age when she should have been playing in the coral gardens, she lost her entire world in one day.
Her mother’s warm embrace, her palace home, now even the last protectors from her tribe were going to leave her.
The Demon Race commander saw this and smirked cruelly:
"Ridiculous."
He condescendingly sneered at these remnants, "If any of you escape today, I’ll go to Lord Demon God with my head in my hands!"
At his order, a ferocious gleam surged in the eyes of all Demon Race members.
But none of the Sea Tribe warriors backed down.
"For the Sea Tribe!"
Grandpa Turtle roared, his cloudy eyes now shining like stars.
All the Sea Tribe warriors unleashed heaven-shaking battle cries, ready to pave one last path with their lives for the princess.
At that critical moment, a fire-red streak of light tore through the sky—
"Boom—!!"
Along with a thunderous roar, Liu Li descended from the heavens cloaked in the Fire of Destruction, the terrifying impact creating a massive crater ten meters in diameter in the center of the battlefield.
The violent shockwave sent sand and stones flying within a hundred-meter radius, freezing both sides in place.
As the dust settled, Gu Xing calmly stood beside Liu Li, his gaze sweeping over the battlefield.
Three half-step Totem level Demon Kings, along with several Monarch level demons.
Overall strength was just so-so.
And when his gaze turned to the other side, he raised his eyebrows involuntarily.
The Shrimp, Crab, Clam, and Turtle Tribes...
Amidst these seafood, a little girl carved like jade was shivering.
Her teal-blue hair flowed like seaweed, tears in her eyes mingled with fear.
Gu Xing’s gaze locked onto this little girl, and a system panel immediately appeared:
[Aliya]
[Race: Mermaid (Royal Bloodline)]
[Level: Extraordinary Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Power: 500]
[Constitution: 500]
[Spirit: 1000]
[Speed: 500]
[Skills: Song of the Deep, Mermaid’s Protection, Sea’s Blessing]
[Description: One of the special races! Legend has it the Mermaid Race can bring good fortune]
Seeing the introduction on the system panel, Gu Xing’s pupils shrank in astonishment.
"Mermaid Race? And with a royal bloodline..."
Even more surprising was the special note from the system...
The ability to bring good fortune!
This was the first time Gu Xing saw the system provide such an explanation!
"Interesting..."
A glint flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes, and he immediately decided to save this little one.
No matter if the system’s words were true or false, this uniqueness alone was worth taking action.
Meanwhile, the Demon Race commander was frowning, assessing the suddenly appearing Liu Li.
"Angel Race?"
"Get lost! For the sake of your clan leader, I’ll let you off today."
This Demon Race commander mistakenly assumed Liu Li was a member of the Angel Race.
Therefore, his face bore a trace of disdain, shooing Liu Li away.
And this statement from the Demon Race commander instantly sank the hearts of the Sea Tribe.
Previously, seeing an angel appear at the battlefield’s center, they thought they had encountered a savior.
Never expected...
The Angel Race was in cahoots with the Demon Race.
Damn it!
"Protect the Princess!"
The remaining Sea Tribe warriors immediately changed direction, their sharp bone spurs uniformly aimed at Liu Li and Gu Xing.
However, surrounded at the center, Aliya stared with tear-drenched eyes, her gaze fixed unwaveringly on Gu Xing.
The young mermaid princess instinctively sensed this human brother exuded a warm aura.
She had a gut feeling that this human brother was not a bad person.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 251: The Sea Race’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 251: Chapter 251: The Sea Race’s Plan
The words of the Demon Race Commander not only plunged the Sea Race into despair, but also pierced Liu Li’s heart like a sharp dagger.
"The Angel Race... actually colluded with the Demon Race..."
Liu Li’s twelve wings twitched uncontrollably, her nails deeply embedded in her palms.
The thing she feared the most seemed to be becoming reality....
Those imprisoned clansmen are likely in grave danger!
Gu Xing keenly noticed Liu Li’s emotional turmoil. He quietly reached out, gently pressing the trembling shoulders of the little angel.
The warmth from his palm gradually brought Liu Li back to her senses.
"Now isn’t the time to overthink."
Upon hearing this, Liu Li slowly regained her composure.
She took a deep breath, the confusion in her eyes slowly replaced by determination.
The exact situation of her clansmen could only be known once she reached the Angel Race.
But if her clansmen have indeed met with misfortune...
A cold killing intent flashed in Liu Li’s eyes.
She swore to make all traitors and War Angels who sided with the Demon Race pay with blood to honor the deceased!
With this resolve, she slowly closed her eyes.
Upon reopening them, all emotions were buried deep within her heart.
"Master, I’m fine!"
She turned to Gu Xing, her voice now calm,
"Please explain to these Sea Race members and get them to calm down."
As soon as she finished speaking, her twelve wings suddenly shook, and she transformed into a golden stream of light, charging directly towards the Demon Race camp!
The Demon Race members, upon witnessing this, also had a change of expression.
"Courting death! I spared you earlier for Mi Zhan’s sake, and now you dare to deliver yourself on a platter!"
The leading demon’s face darkened as he issued a command:
"Make this reckless angel come to her senses!"
"Understood!"
Two Half-step Totem Level Demon Kings responded, with Demonic Qi surging around them, instantly leaving the demon ranks to intercept Liu Li.
They could clearly perceive that this angel’s true strength was only at the Commander Level, yet somehow, she had temporarily elevated it to the Monarch Level.
Nevertheless...
At Monarch Level strength, she hopes to meddle in Demon Race affairs.
Wishful thinking!
Meanwhile, Gu Xing turned and walked towards the fully alert Sea Race members.
Feeling his approach, all the Sea Race warriors tensed up, ready to act at any moment.
In the Beast Taming Space, Vera sensed something amiss and immediately appeared beside Gu Xing.
She cautiously eyed the Sea Race members.
Her master kindly saved this group of Sea Race, yet they were ungrateful.
Vera’s gaze instantly became dangerous.
At this moment, the little girl surrounded by the Sea Race hurriedly spoke out:
"Grandpa Turtle, stop, I sense no malice from this human brother!"
Aliya rushed to Grandpa Turtle’s side, grabbing his arm, a hint of urgency in her eyes.
She felt no malice from this human brother and sensed Gu Xing’s inner kindness.
This brother came to save them!
Yet they were treating their rescuer this way.
No way!
Upon hearing this, the elderly turtle from the Turtle Race slowly eased his guard.
Aliya, as the last bloodline of the Mermaid Royal Family, her intuition was no baseless speculation.
It’s a special ability of the Mermaid Royal Family’s bloodline.
Like the night before the Demon Race invasion, the Mermaid Queen had a strong ominous foreboding.
Thus, she had him prepare to escape with Aliya.
Which allowed him to successfully escape the Sea Race with the little Princess during the demon invasion.
Moreover...
His gaze shifted to Gu Xing’s forehead.
There were two golden lines.
Divine Pattern!
It is known that the Demon Race would never allow Divine Patterns to fall into the hands of other races.
Therefore...
They had surely misunderstood this human!
"Everyone, lower your weapons! He bears no malice."
With the old Turtle Clan Elder’s command, all the tense nerves of the Sea Race warriors finally relaxed.
They slightly moved aside, opening up a pathway.
Seeing this, Gu Xing slowly walked through the Sea Race members and came before Aliya and the elderly turtle.
His gaze fell on the clearly noble identity of the little mermaid, softly asking:
"Are you from the Sea Race?"
Faced with the unfamiliar inquiry from a stranger, Aliya, who had never interacted with the outside world, suddenly became overwhelmed.
Having lived in the deep sea palace since birth, she was noticeably anxious, hurriedly turning to Grandpa Turtle for assistance.
And this elderly turtle shielded Aliya behind him.
He first respectfully bowed to Gu Xing, the cracked shell emitting a faint friction sound.
"Yes, noble sir, we are from the eastern Sea Race."
"Due to the demon invasion, we had planned to seek refuge with the Angel Race, but we never expected the current Angel Race..."
At this point, the elder sighed deeply, his clouded eyes reflecting sorrow.
The Sea Race had never contacted the outside world.
Many years ago, their Queen had aided a Clan Leader of the Angel Race.
It is precisely because of this that they intended to take refuge with the Angel Race.
But they never anticipated....
After all these years, the once righteous angel had also sided with the Demon Race.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing’s heart trembled, immediately realizing the angel mentioned by the turtle elder was likely Liu Li’s father.
It’s known that all the Angel Race internal turmoil was due to Liu Li’s father’s disappearance.
Although the little girl hadn’t expressed anything, Gu Xing sensed she also longed to reunite with her father.
Thus, Gu Xing immediately inquired about information on this angel.
However, the elder didn’t know where Liu Li’s father went in the end.
Upon learning this, Gu Xing sighed heavily.
He only knew Liu Li’s father last appeared among the Sea Race.
But...
Having some information is better than none.
Following this, Gu Xing began asking about the details of the Sea Race’s invasion by the Demon Race.
Through the words of the turtle elder, Gu Xing learned of very troubling news.
The Sea Race’s Divine Pattern...
Was seized by the Demon Race!
And from Lilith, Gu Xing understood the function of Divine Patterns.
For the Alternate Space races, Divine Patterns are the key to enhancing the strength of Totem Level beings.
But for the Demon Race, they are the key to unlocking the Demon Abyss passage!
Once the passage is opened, the native Demon Abyss demons will invade en masse.
It’s known that the demon in the Alternate Space now is just formed from leaked Demonic Qi.
If the true Demon Abyss demons descend... the consequences would be unimaginable!
"The Sea Race’s Divine Pattern has fallen into the hands of the Demon Race..."
Gu Xing’s brow furrowed.
This means it won’t be long before Totem Level demon powerhouses appear in the Alternate Space, bringing ruin to all races.
With the current crises at hand, Gu Xing understood the necessity of quickly enhancing the Human Race’s strength.
He turned to the homeless Sea Race members, gravely asking:
"Do you have any plans now?"
"The Angel Race, you definitely cannot go there. Do you have any other arrangements?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 252: The Demon Gate Opens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 252: Chapter 252: The Demon Gate Opens!
That’s right.
Gu Xing wanted to recruit this group of Sea Race back to the Human Race.
Although the strength of this Sea Race group is not very strong.
But he firmly believed that every race has its own strengths.
You absolutely cannot judge a race’s power based solely on simple strength.
Just like the Qingqiu Race...
Although they are not good at fighting, they have firmly become one of the top races in the Alternate Space with their sealing and controlling abilities.
And the Mermaid Race being able to become one of the top races in the Alternate Space....
Definitely has its own special qualities!
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s words, the elderly turtle of the Turtle Race immediately heard the implication in Gu Xing’s words.
"Sir, our Sea Race is very grateful for your life-saving grace, but although our Sea Race is in trouble now, we have no intention of becoming a vassal of any other race."
Hearing this, Gu Xing understood that the elder from the Turtle Race misunderstood his intention.
"You’ve got it wrong. I have no intention of asking you to become a vassal of the Human Race."
"Now, in the Alternate Space, the Demon Race is running rampant, and now that the Demon Race has acquired the Divine Pattern, the seal of the Demon Abyss will unlock a part of it."
"The situation of each race will become more difficult."
"Therefore, we can only get through this hardship together by uniting."
"Our Human Race has now formed an alliance with the Blood Race, Ghost Race, and Qingqiu Race, the three top races."
"You can first go to Longxia Country to understand the current situation. After all, you have nowhere to go now. If you’re not satisfied, you can leave directly."
Gu Xing patiently explained to this group of Sea Race.
The elderly member of the Turtle Race fell into deep thought upon hearing Gu Xing’s words.
Indeed, the Sea Race currently has nowhere to go!
Once they left the sea, their combat ability would be greatly reduced.
And now, almost the entire sea is occupied by the Demon Race, and thinking about returning...
It’s indeed impossible!
And the previous choice to take refuge with the Angel Race resulted in such an unexpected situation...
That option could only be abandoned!
Without a destination, they could only wander in the Alternate Space.
In such a situation, this group of Sea Race warriors might not have a big problem, but the Little Princess...
She must find a peaceful place to settle down!
At this moment, Aliya gently tugged his clothes and softly spoke:
"Grandpa Turtle, this brother did not deceive us."
Hearing Aliya’s words, a trace of struggle flashed across the wrinkled face, and finally, he sighed heavily:
"Sir, we... may have to trouble you and the Human Race."
Upon hearing this response, a gleam of joy flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes.
Success!
Longxia Country is currently short of people.
With the addition of a new race, Longxia Country’s strength would increase a bit.
"Head south from here, and soon you’ll encounter the migrating team of the Qingqiu Race."
"When you meet humans, just mention my name."
The elderly turtle nodded slowly, the cracked shell making a slight scraping sound:
"Thank you, sir, for your guidance. Then we shall take our leave."
At this moment, almost every member of the Sea Race was injured, and in the distance, the battlefield was completely controlled by Liu Li.
They had nothing else to do here, so they asked to leave.
"Go ahead." Gu Xing nodded.
Although he was full of curiosity about the mysterious power of the Mermaid Princess...
But she was, after all, a princess of her race...
He naturally couldn’t let her stay alone, so he could only let her leave.
As they were about to part, Aliya suddenly turned around, her azure eyes casting a deep gaze at Gu Xing.
In this human, she felt an unprecedented warmth and tranquility, like the purest warm current in the deep sea, making her instinctively want to get closer...
After watching the Sea Race people leave, Gu Xing turned his gaze back to the battlefield.
At this moment, the Demon Race Commander, seeing that his two subordinates could not take down Liu Li, finally could not restrain himself and took action personally.
However...
Gu Xing had already applied the Soul Devouring Status on Liu Li, and now Liu Li’s attributes reached as high as 560,000 points.
Additionally, the Soul Devouring Talent doubled her control over the Destruction Law.
At this moment.
Within Liu Li’s Destruction Domain.
Three Half-step Totem Level Demon Race members resembled headless flies wildly bumping around within the domain.
They launched all-out attacks, only to find that this strange domain showed no signs of wavering.
"What kind of monstrous Angel is this?!"
The Demon Race Commander’s face contorted as he roared, clearly sensing the domain continuously devouring their power.
"Damn... this domain is weakening us!"
Only at this moment did the three Demon Race members realize with horror.
The Angel before them, who appeared to only be at Commander Level, could completely suppress these Half-step Totem Level powerhouses!
Liu Li observed the prey within the domain coldly, her eyes without a trace of fluctuation.
These three Half-step Totem Level Demon Race members were not very strong, with strength almost freshly at the Half-step Totem Level.
Thus, Liu Li could handle it so effortlessly.
And in the Destruction Domain, unless they can escape, they will gradually meet their end within this domain.
As time passed, the resistance of the three Demon Race members grew weaker and weaker.
Meanwhile, in other zones of the battlefield, the Monarch Level Demon Race were easily defeated by Vera and Qing Shuang.
Under their actions, the remaining Demon Race on site was quickly wiped out by them.
Soon, the entire battlefield gradually grew quiet.
A massive energy surged toward Gu Xing.
Yet...
He did not seize this opportunity to break through to Monarch Level but instead suppressed this energy firmly.
Not until it was gradually absorbed into his body did Gu Xing finally breathe a sigh of relief.
He sensed...
This energy would reappear when he breaks through.
Now he needs to wait for an opportunity.
With the Totem Level Demon Race as a catalyst, it will aid him in breaking through to Monarch Level!
...
In the deepest part of the Demon Realm.
Even the air was dyed black by the thick Demonic Qi.
Ten towering Demon Gates stood like ancient behemoths beneath the blood-colored firmament.
At this moment, a group of Demon Kings was nervously kneeling before the tenth Demon Gate.
The lead Demon King held both hands high, palms carrying a Divine Pattern glowing with golden light.
"Reporting to Lord Demon God, we... have acquired the Divine Pattern of the Sea Race and present it to you." The Demon King’s voice trembled slightly with reverence.
A sudden cold snort erupted from within the Demon Gate, momentarily halting the Demonic Qi for a hundred miles around.
"Trash!" The voice of the Demon God was like eternal ice, "To bring back only one Divine Pattern!"
Before the words finished, the Divine Pattern in the Demon King’s hands flew uncontrollably toward the Demon Gate.
As the Divine Pattern touched the gate’s surface——
"Boom!!!"
The entire Demon Realm violently trembled, a black-as-ink beam shot skyward, tearing a grim fissure in the blood-colored sky.
Under the suffocating pressure, the tenth Demon Gate roared deafeningly, its heavy doors slowly opening at a speed visible to the naked eye...
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 253: The Fall of the Angel Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 253: Chapter 253: The Fall of the Angel Race
Time flies, and a day passed in the blink of an eye.
The Angel Race.
The Blazing Angels Race also faced a critical moment of life and death.
"Hurry up! Stop dawdling!"
A few War Angels rudely pushed and shoved, driving Liu Xia and the other Blazing Angels out of the dungeon where they had been imprisoned for a long time.
The blinding sunlight poured down suddenly, causing the Blazing Angels who had lived in darkness for so long to squint their eyes instinctively.
Seeing this, one War Angel mocked sardonically:
"Enjoy this last bit of sunlight! You’ll never see it again!"
Hearing this, Liu Xia shot a frosty glare at the War Angel.
Feeling Liu Li’s gaze, the boastful War Angel shuddered all over.
Liu Xia had once served as the Vice Clan Leader of the Angel Race.
Now, although her power had been sealed, nevertheless...
The aura of a longtime superior still lingered.
However, in the next moment...
"Damn you!"
The War Angel, snapped back to his senses, felt humiliated and angry, rolled up his sleeves, and was about to step forward to teach Liu Xia a lesson.
"Stop!"
An older War Angel hurriedly stopped him, lowering his voice to warn:
"The Clan Leader ordered them to be taken to the plaza for public execution. If anything goes wrong during this, can you take the responsibility?"
These words were like a bucket of cold water, instantly extinguishing the young War Angel’s fury.
He dared not defy Mi Zhan’s order!
Then, he reluctantly stepped aside, spitting harshly on the ground, choking down his anger.
"Consider yourselves lucky!"
Soon after, Liu Xia and the others were escorted to the highest mountain peak of the Angel Race.
At the summit was an immensely large plaza.
At this moment, the plaza was filled with a sea of people.
It wasn’t just the War Angel Race; countless other races had gathered here as well.
At this moment, the entire plaza buzzed with discussion.
"What’s going on? Why did the Angel Race invite us all here?"
"Not sure! I heard they are going to execute a group of villains!"
"Villains? What villains?"
"Fool! It must be the Blazing Angels Race. Now that the War Angel Race holds power over the Angel Race, this group of Blazing Angels is certainly going to be purged."
"I understand the logic, but why are we all called here?"
Amid the chaotic discussions, Liu Xia and the others were escorted to the center of the plaza on a high platform.
Under the strange binding of chains, they had no ability to resist.
At this moment, they could only be bound in the center of the platform, for all to see.
However, even in captivity, every Blazing Angel stood with their backs straight.
Seeing this scene, the discussion below grew even louder.
"Even the former Vice Clan Leader is to be executed?"
"That’s near Totem Level top-tier combat strength! The Angel Race is truly deep in its foundation, discarding such powerful individuals without hesitation."
"Speaking of which, during the time of the Blazing Angels’ power, they treated various races rather benevolently. Now this War Angel Race..."
"Watch your words," an elder hurriedly interrupted, "Be careful not to get dealt with by the War Angels as well!"
Within this territory spanning hundreds of miles, the Angel Race always stood at the top of the food chain.
All races are reliant on the Angel Race for survival.
Therefore, regarding the decisions of the Angel Race, they naturally have no say.
Today, their sole purpose was to be spectators.
And just as the crowd was buzzing, a voice suddenly rang out.
"The Clan Leader is here! The Elders are here!"
The loud proclamation echoed through the skies.
The next moment, golden light burgeoned in the clouds, and over a dozen figures broke through the air.
Leading them, Mi Zhan spread his Eight Wings, exuding a sharp pressure all over.
They hovered above the plaza as if deities descending to the world.
Mi Zhan’s icy gaze swept across the audience, his voice cold as iron and ice:
"Today will be marked in the Angel Race’s annals!"
"From this moment on, the Angel Race will officially be renamed as the War Angel Race!"
"The Blazing Angels Race will become history!"
As soon as these words fell, the War Angels on the plaza erupted in cheers like mountains roaring and seas raging:
"Long live the Clan Leader, the War Angel Race shall prevail forever!"
Watching the frenzied cheering of the War Angel clansmen below, the corners of Mi Zhan’s mouth curved into a satisfied arc.
The brainwashing during this time had evidently been effective...
Now, across the Angel Race, no one spoke of the inseparability of War Angels and Blazing Angels anymore.
Then, he pressed his hands down slowly, and the noisy plaza instantly fell silent.
Mi Zhan’s gaze moved away from Liu Xia and the others, slowly sweeping over the representatives of various races below the platform.
Today, aside from executing this group of Blazing Angels, there was another important purpose.
That was...
To coerce this group of alien war teams!
Mi Zhan himself didn’t know why...
The Demon Race he was liaising with suddenly issued this order.
To summon all alien races and force them to ally with the Demon Race.
For such a command, Mi Zhan felt a bit baffled.
One must know, the Demon Race in the past only engaged in fighting and killing, matters like persuading other races to ally...
Unless it was one of the top-notch races, the Demon Race wouldn’t have this option for persuasion.
But now...
The Demon Race was actually gathering a bunch of ordinary races.
Quite strange indeed!
After all, among these races, the strongest were mostly some Monarch Level, a good one might have one or two Half-step Totem Level powerhouses.
What’s the point of these, even if they allied with the Demon Race?
He couldn’t figure it out.
But since he had chosen to ally with the Demon Race...
These were orders from above, and he had only to execute them.
He slowly closed his eyes, taking a deep breath.
When he opened them again, his gaze was filled with determination.
He had no choice!
He could only ally with the Demon Race!
Mi Zhan had tried numerous ways to break through to the Totem Level, but...
It seemed as if the heavens and earth were against him, he could never reach the Totem Level.
Now he was at a dead end, and the only road left was aligning with the Demon Race.
Even if it meant dragging the entire Angel Race into a deep abyss of suffering, he would do it without hesitation!
Thinking of this, he exchanged a glance with several War Angel elders beside him.
The elders understood and quietly spread out across the plaza, secretly blocking all exit routes for the alien races.
Seeing everything set, Mi Zhan slowly turned, approaching Liu Xia.
"Liu Xia, the last chance."
His voice was cold, devoid of any emotion:
"Tell me the whereabouts of the Divine Pattern, or the whereabouts of Liu Li."
Previously, the two of them had both been Vice Clan Leaders, a relationship that could have been characterized as colleagues.
But now...
They stood on opposite sides!
And facing these words from Mi Zhan, Liu Xia’s face was full of sarcasm.
"Mi Zhan, we’ve known each other for so many years, do you think it’s possible for you to get any information from me?"
This answer was within Mi Zhan’s expectations.
If Liu Xia would succumb, then she wouldn’t be Liu Xia.
It’s just that he never expected to get information from Liu Xia in the first place!
He turned indifferently, his gaze sweeping over the other imprisoned Blazing Angels:
"What about you? Provide clues, and I will spare your life."
The platform was dead silent.
No Blazing Angel answered.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 254: Choice!!
chapters.content:
Chapter 254: Chapter 254: Choice!!
Seeing Mi Zhan aim his spearhead at the others, Liu Xia snorted coldly and said:
"Mi Zhan, don’t even think about it, no one will tell you!"
"The Blazing Angels Race has no cowards!"
Mi Zhan completely ignored Liu Xia’s words.
Instead, he slowly walked over to a young Blazing Angel.
He spoke with a smile:
"Can you tell me where Liu Li is hidden?"
As Mi Zhan approached, the young Blazing Angel’s body couldn’t help but tremble.
"I...I don’t know..."
Not everyone faces death fearlessly, nor does everyone remain indifferent in the face of death.
This Blazing Angel was clearly unable to match Liu Xia’s level!
And upon seeing the Blazing Angel’s reaction, Mi Zhan knew...
he had found his target!
The next moment, his expression turned serious, and his right hand swung sharply.
"Bang——!!!"
In the next moment, the head of an elderly Blazing Angel beside the young Blazing Angel burst open with a sound.
Brain matter and blood rained down on the young Blazing Angel’s pale face.
Seeing this scene, Liu Xia’s eyes instantly turned red.
"Mi Zhan, you beast!"
Liu Xia’s eyes were about to burst, and the chains made a harsh clang as she struggled violently, the soul-tearing pain unable to conceal her roar.
"What kind of skill is it to attack my clan members! If you have the ability, come after me."
Hearing these words, Mi Zhan waved his hand calmly.
The next moment.
Several War Angels immediately pinned Liu Xia to the ground, gagging her with a cloth strip.
Once the screams subsided, Mi Zhan slowly walked up to the young Blazing Angel covered in blood and spoke indifferently:
"Do you know? When a person dies, they have nothing left!"
"The princess you protect with your life might not even remember your names in the future..."
His fingertips lightly brushed the trembling wings of the young Blazing Angel as Mi Zhan’s tone suddenly turned enticing:
"Why bother? Why not tell me where she’s hidden, and I might spare you."
The young Blazing Angel’s face turned paper white, his pupils trembling violently.
The Blazing Angel who had just died was his best companion.
Just moments ago, that tragic companion was in the dungeon encouraging him, promising to get through this disaster together.
But now...
"Mi... Lord Mi Zhan...."
His knees slammed heavily onto the ground, his voice fragmented.
Fear engulfed him like a flood, his fingers digging into the ground, knuckles turning white from the force.
Seeing this, Mi Zhan revealed a satisfied smile.
Even though only the Clan Leader knew the Divine Pattern’s secret.
But...
He didn’t believe that the Blazing Angel didn’t leave any measures before disappearing.
Even if Liu Xia didn’t know its location, his daughter surely knew something.
Now that he had decided to ally with the Demon Race, the Divine Pattern...
could be exchanged for generous rewards!
"Speak!" Mi Zhan’s voice was like a devil’s whisper, "If you talk, not only will you live, but you’ll also receive ample rewards..."
Upon hearing this, the Blazing Angel gradually lifted his head.
And the surrounding Blazing Angels, seeing this scene, instantly burst out in furious curses:
"What do you intend to do? Are you really going to abandon the honor of the Blazing Angels Race?"
"At worst, we die. If you dare reveal Lord Liuli’s hiding place, we won’t let you go even as ghosts."
Amidst the sounds, the young Blazing Angel’s lips trembled violently.
Mi Zhan waited patiently, believing that the young Blazing Angel would make the right choice.
Indeed, he was correct.
The young Blazing Angel had been completely terrified by him.
His voice continued to tremble:
"Mi... Lord Mi Zhan..."
"Lord Liu Li is... she’s imprisoned in the Human World!"
"It is said... it’s said that she signed a contract with a human..."
Mi Zhan’s pupils suddenly contracted, and a cold curve appeared at the corner of his mouth.
No wonder he couldn’t find Liu Li anywhere in the Alternate Space; she was hidden in the Human World!
"It’s those Humans again..."
He muttered softly, a murderous intent surging in his eyes.
This damned race, it truly lingers like a haunting shadow!
At that moment, his determination to exterminate the Human Race grew even more resolute in his heart.
"Mi, Mi Zhan Lord..."
The young Blazing Angel clung tremblingly to Mi Zhan’s leg, his eyes filled with abject pleading.
"I’ve already told you... Can you spare me now?"
However—
Mi Zhan’s hand suddenly clamped down on the young Blazing Angel’s head, his five fingers tightening like an iron claw.
"Crack!"
The crisp sound of bones cracking resounded across the square, blood and brains splattering from between his fingers.
This sudden change left everyone shocked, looking incredulously at the high platform.
"What I despise most..."
Mi Zhan flicked the blood off his hands, a cruel curve forming at the corner of his mouth, "are traitors."
He turned to face the representatives of various races, his eyes flashing coldly:
"Of course, the same goes for you all!"
"Attack!"
With this order, several War Angel Elders suddenly unleashed their full pressure.
Dazzling golden light shot into the sky, quickly forming a massive sealing barrier that enveloped the entire square.
Seeing this sight, everyone was terrified and loudly questioned:
"What do you intend to do? Why are you trapping us!"
"Mi Zhan, do you want to make enemies with so many of our races?"
However.
Mi Zhan merely sneered contemptuously, stepping forward.
"Boom!"
The terrifying pressure of Half-step Totem Peak swept across like a tsunami, the overwhelming momentum nearly suffocating everyone.
"It seems..." Mi Zhan’s voice was like Nine Netherworld Ice, "you all haven’t understood the current situation."
As Mi Zhan’s momentum continued to rise, strands of pitch-black Demonic Qi began seeping from the sealing barrier.
Like living creatures, these Demonic Qi roamed through the air, gradually coalescing into ghastly figures of the Demon Race.
"This... this is..."
"The Demon Race?! The Angel Race has colluded with the Demon Race?!"
"We’ve been deceived! Mi Zhan intends to annihilate us all!"
The representatives of various races immediately fell into panic, cries of astonishment ringing out ceaselessly.
Even more astonishing, many War Angels also showed expressions of disbelief.
"How could this be..."
"The Clan Leader has actually allied with the Demon Race?!"
Mi Zhan’s cooperation with the Demon Race was known only to the topmost echelon of the War Angels.
Now, the rank and file War Angels were equally shaken by this sudden upheaval, left at a loss.
However, these coalesced figures of the Demon Race did not immediately make a move, standing motionless like statues.
Mi Zhan slowly ascended into the air, Eight Wings unfurled, his voice thundering like a clap of lightning:
"Now, give you two choices——"
"Submit to me and embrace the Demon Race."
"Or... die!"
As his words fell, all the Demon Race released surging Demonic Qi. A black energy storm instantly swept the entire barrier, dyeing the sky ink black.
Everyone’s hearts sank to the bottom.
They knew.
If they didn’t make a choice today, they definitely wouldn’t be able to leave alive!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 255: To Live or To Die!
chapters.content:
Chapter 255: Chapter 255: To Live or To Die!
Amidst the agitated crowd.
A group of red figures was whispering among themselves.
These were the Magma Clan who had been deceived by Gu Xing in the first Divine Secret Realm!
"Clan Leader Grandpa, those up there seem to be the fellow clansmen of the Guardian Beast benefactor!"
A small magma spirit pointed to the high platform, speaking in a very low voice.
Back then, after hearing Gu Xing’s warning, they left the first Divine Secret Realm early.
Thus, when the final battle between Gu Xing and the Blood Ancestor destroyed the Divine Secret Realm, they were unaffected.
However...
The then Magma Clan Leader only knew that Gu Xing mentioned a place name in Longxia Country.
He had no knowledge of any other information.
When they exited the Divine Secret Realm, not a single person from the Human Race was present.
Therefore, they had no idea where Longxia Country was located.
So he randomly chose a direction himself...
And inadvertently ended up in the Domain of the Angel Race.
And there happened to be a volcano here, so they settled in this area.
At this moment, the old clan leader looked at the Blazing Angels imprisoned on the high platform and slowly nodded:
"Indeed... those are the angels related to our benefactor!"
"Then, Clan Leader Grandpa, should we make a move to rescue them?"
Hearing this question, the leading Magma Clan Leader’s face showed a look of concern.
Although the clan’s strength had significantly increased, relying on the volcano during this time,
he had reached Monarch Peak, and among the clansmen, there were several Monarch Level beings.
But compared to top-tier races like the Angel Race...
The gap was too vast!
The old clan leader’s magma-patterned hand trembled slightly as he spoke in a lowered voice:
"Let’s watch and see how things unfold first! Even if we want to save these Blazing Angels, we must devise a foolproof plan; otherwise, we’ll only be sending ourselves to death!"
He looked up at Mi Zhan suspended in mid-air, whose near-Totem Level oppressive presence made all races gasp for breath.
Not to mention, there were several Half-step Totem Level War Angel Elders around, and the Demon Race army continuously emerging from the Demonic Qi.
Plus, there was that golden barrier enveloping the whole scene...
He could already foresee the outcome of today.
If there’s no external assistance, perhaps they won’t be able to leave here alive! Let alone save anyone!
It wasn’t just the Magma Clan; all the races present realized the gravity of the situation.
Clearly, Mi Zhan intended to force them to make a choice between life and death!
Either they die here, or they join forces with the Demon Race!
"Damn it! The Demon Race has slaughtered so many of our clansmen. How can we work with them?"
"But if we don’t side with the Demon Race, Mi Zhan will definitely not let us go! If we die here, how will our race continue to survive?"
"However, if we side with the Demon Race, does it mean that our race won’t be targeted by them anymore, and we’ll be safe then?"
Many were firmly against it, but some began to weigh the pros and cons.
Not allying with the Demon Race would certainly mean death here, and their clansmen wouldn’t be able to escape either.
But if they accepted Mi Zhan’s offer, not only could they survive, but the Demon Race threat against their race would also be resolved.
Gradually, some weaker races began making their choice.
"Mi, Mi Zhan, we from the Yellow Rat Race are willing to join you."
"We, the Rock Lizard Race, are also willing to follow the lord!"
"Mi Zhan, we..."
Once one spoke up, it quickly spread like a plague.
These weaker races feared punishment if they hesitated to declare their allegiance and rushed to pledge their loyalty.
Seeing this scene, Mi Zhan spoke softly:
"All those who surrender, come to my right!"
"Congratulations on making a wise choice."
"As for those on the left..."
His gaze swept over the still hesitant races, "Are you choosing death?"
These words were like a death warrant, prompting another large group to quickly shift from the left side to the right.
In no time, only a few races persisted on the left.
Mi Zhan slowly raised his right hand, gathering terrifying energy in his palm:
"It seems... you’re determined to stand against me?"
Just then.
The angel named "Xiaoqi" suddenly appeared in front of the alien races on the left.
"Clan Leader, I have always believed in your leadership! I always believed when you said the War Angel Race would stand at the top of the world."
"But now you’re actually telling us to side with the Demon Race, why?"
Xiaoqi’s voice was full of questioning.
Earlier, even when the War Angel Race staged a coup, he could accept it.
But to side with the Demon Race...
His gaze shot straight at Mi Zhan.
He couldn’t accept it!
With Xiaoqi’s words, many War Angels gradually stood behind him.
Not all War Angels were willing to embrace the Demon Race!
But...
Those War Angels choosing to oppose Mi Zhan, were the weaker ones among the Angel Race.
At this moment, all eyes were focused on Mi Zhan.
They needed Mi Zhan to give an answer!
However.
Mi Zhan’s face showed a trace of a cold smile.
He had long anticipated that his proposal to ally with the Demon Race would face a lot of resistance.
Therefore, he had started to speak individually with War Angels of Monarch Level and above long ago.
Those unwilling to ally had already been dealt with by him.
Now, the high-tier War Angels left were those wise enough to follow in his footsteps.
As for those low-tier War Angels.
Their opinions...
Do they matter?
Without even Monarch Level strength, no matter how they resist, they wouldn’t affect the overall situation in the slightest.
But...
A Commander Level Angel dared to question him.
Mi Zhan’s eight wings trembled lightly.
He suddenly appeared in front of the angel named "Xiaoqi."
Mi Zhan’s icy gaze pierced Xiaoqi like a blade, his voice carrying a biting chill:
"As a War Angel, who gave you the courage to defy my orders?"
Before his words were finished, he struck suddenly, grabbing Xiaoqi’s wings.
"Rip!"
With the sound of flesh tearing, four snow-white wings were forcibly torn off.
The angel’s wings are the source of their power and life, and the pain was akin to having one’s nerves ripped out.
"Ah—!!"
Xiaoqi’s scream echoed through the sky, and then he fainted from the excruciating pain, blood gushing from his back, painting the high platform red.
Mi Zhan casually tossed the blood-stained wings aside, casting a cold glance at the other War Angels:
"Who else dares to resist?"
Under this deathly gaze, all the War Angels trembled and bowed their heads, not daring to meet his eyes.
"Since you don’t dare to resist..."
"Then get out of my way!"
The War Angels, as if pardoned, hurriedly stepped to the sides, clearing a path.
Mi Zhan stepped forward slowly, with each step, the killing intent intensified.
If these alien races are set on seeking death, then he will oblige!
...
...
```

chapters.title: Chapter 256: Restriction Shattered!
chapters.content:
Chapter 256: Chapter 256: Restriction Shattered!
At the same time,
Liu Li had taken Gu Xing to the foot of a towering mountain peak.
"Master, we’ve arrived!"
Liu Li looked up at the towering mountain before her, her eyes filled with complex emotions.
This place held too many memories for her....
It was both her home where she grew up and the place where she lost everything.
Gu Xing sensed the fluctuation in Liu Li’s emotions and gently patted her shoulder:
"Don’t think too much. Whether your people are safe can only be confirmed with your own eyes."
Liu Li took a deep breath to calm her tumultuous emotions.
She raised her head to look at the misty mountain peak and explained:
"Master, as the rulers of the sky, the Angel Race’s base is located at the very top of this alternate space’s highest mountain peak."
"From the mountainside up, there are restrictions set up, and War Angels patrol and guard it..."
Gu Xing looked up and saw layers of blue restrictions shrouding the entire mountain like a canopy, glinting coldly in the sunlight.
But he wasn’t worried about the restrictions!
The Breaking Realm Blade was the nemesis of all restrictions.
With it, no restriction was a concern.
As for the Angel Race’s guards...
A hint of coldness flashed in Gu Xing’s eyes!
"Buzz——"
Five brilliant summoning arrays lit up around Gu Xing.
Qing Shuang, Vera, Lilith, Tushan Yueli, and Fei Yue!
Appeared one by one by Gu Xing’s side.
This was the first time Gu Xing had summoned all his guardian beasts without reservation!
This was Liu Li’s battle for redemption—success was the only option, no failure allowed.
The strongest among the Angel Race was Mi Zhan, who was infinitely close to the Totem Level.
But with Lilith backing him up, Gu Xing wasn’t too concerned.
As for the other half-step Totem Level War Angels...
Liu Li, Qing Shuang, and Vera, who were Myth Nine Stars, also had the power to fight.
After taking a deep breath, Gu Xing’s eyes became serious.
"Liu Li, are you ready?!"
Liu Li’s expression was solemn as she nodded seriously.
"Action!"
With Gu Xing’s command, the Breaking Realm Blade instantly appeared in Liu Li’s hand, its blade glowing with the light of breaking through restrictions.
At the same time, Liu Li’s pupils suddenly turned deep blood red, fully activating the Destruction Angel Form.
Twelve pairs of wings suddenly unfolded, covered with blood-red Fire of Destruction!
Gu Xing simultaneously raised his hand, abruptly augmenting with the Soul Devouring Talent.
Liu Li’s aura surged instantly!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form]
[Power: 70,000 → 560,000]
[Constitution: 70,000 → 560,000]
[Spirit: 70,000 → 560,000]
[Speed: 70,000 → 560,000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form, Destruction Domain, Destruction Law]
In an instant, all of Liu Li’s attributes soared to a terrifying value of 560,000!
As her attributes skyrocketed, the power of the Breaking Realm Blade also increased geometrically.
The higher the attributes, the stronger the effect of using the Breaking Realm Blade.
"Buzz——!!"
Liu Li infused all her power into the blade, and the Breaking Realm Blade began to tremble violently.
The blade disintegrated and reformed inch by inch; under the tempering of the Destruction Law, the originally one-meter-long blade transformed into a hundred-meter giant sword, its entire body flowing with dark golden destruction patterns!
The moment the sword reformed, Liu Li’s figure flashed and transformed into a golden stream of light piercing the sky.
Meanwhile, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, and Tushan Yueli closely followed behind.
Green, black, purple, and pink streams of light tightly followed Liu Li.
And the remaining Lilith lazily snapped her fingers, her petite figure instantly stretching out.
Her scarlet dress fluttered without wind, the terrifying pressure of the Blood Queen sweeping across the entire scene!
The next moment, Lilith’s slender arm wrapped around Gu Xing’s waist, gently pulling him into her embrace.
She teasingly hooked Gu Xing’s chin with her fingertips, her scarlet eyes swirling with enchanting allure.
"Seems like I’m still the only one who truly cares for you! Why don’t you just be with me?"
Hearing these words, Gu Xing was exasperated.
Having Lilith carry him was the result of joint discussion among the guardian beasts.
After all, Lilith was the strongest, so he was safest by her side.
"Lilith, stop messing around! Hurry up and catch up." Gu Xing said with a straight face.
"Tsk, such an unromantic man~"
Lilith pouted.
In the next second, a burst of blood-red light surged around her, transforming into a crimson lightning bolt shooting straight into the sky!
In the blink of an eye, that blood-red light caught up with the four figures ahead.
Lilith lazily stretched her bat wings, steadily keeping pace with Qing Shuang and the others.
At this moment, the entire team tacitly let Liu Li fly in the forefront.
The radiant golden stream of light cut through; wherever it passed, the painstakingly arranged restrictions of the Angel Race shattered like fragile glass!
"Boom——!!!"
"Boom——!!!"
...
Thunderous blasts echoed through the sky.
The War Angels responsible for guarding each level of restrictions were horrified to discover that the runes on the monitoring array were extinguishing in large numbers.
"What’s going on?! Over a hundred restrictions are collapsing simultaneously!"
"We’re under attack! Quick, report to the Elder!"
"We can’t get in touch! All the Elders have been summoned to the square by the Clan Leader!"
"It’s over..."
The Angel Race’s prideful 108 defensive restrictions were easily dismantled as if they were child’s play.
Liu Li’s golden figure shattered through like a hot knife through butter, breaking through the last restriction in the blink of an eye.
However, just as she was about to reach the summit, Liu Li suddenly noticed...
Above the peak, there was an unseen golden restriction!
"Strange..." She frowned slightly.
She vividly remembered that the Angel Race had only 108 restrictions.
And this golden restriction...
Was it a new addition by the Angel Race during her absence?
Though filled with doubt, her hands didn’t pause for a moment.
If there’s a restriction, break it all down!
Yet...
The power of this restriction seemed stronger than all the previous ones combined!
But...
Even so, she would not be stopped!
In an instant, Liu Li’s aura surged, the blood-red Destruction Domain exploding like a tide!
She gripped the hundred-meter giant blade in both hands, slowly lifting it over her head——
An astonishing scene unfolded!
The once all-encompassing Destruction Domain now converged onto the Breaking Realm Blade like converging rivers.
This was the result of Liu Li’s dedicated training over this period...
Condensing the vast domain into a compact space!
"Buzz——"
The Breaking Realm Blade emitted a clear and harmonious sword cry, its blade igniting with blood-red Fire of Destruction.
This treasured item of the Angel Race produced a perfect resonance with Liu Li’s Destruction Law, unleashing a terrifying might that altered the heavens and the earth.
When the man and the sword reached peak harmony, Liu Li suddenly opened her eyes, her dark golden pupils seeming to contain the annihilation of stars.
"Break!!!"
The hundred-meter giant blade in Liu Li’s hand crashed down with ferocity!
At the instant the blood-red edge collided with the golden barrier, a thunderous boom erupted.
"Crack——"
The crisp sound of shattering echoed like a death knell, the once unbreakable golden barrier cracking inch by inch under the edge of the Breaking Realm Blade!
When the final fissure traversed the entire barrier...
"Bang!!!"
The sky exploded with golden light, transforming into countless light specks dissipating between heaven and earth.
As the barrier shattered, what reflected in Liu Li’s eyes were countless pairs of eyes filled with shock!
...
.....

chapters.title: Chapter 257: The Battle Begins
chapters.content:
Chapter 257: Chapter 257: The Battle Begins
Just as Mi Zhan was about to mercilessly execute the rebels.
"Boom!!!"
A thundering roar erupted suddenly!
The golden barrier, jointly constructed by several War Angel elders, instantly shattered!
Fragments of golden light rained down from the sky, and amidst the flying flecks of light, a figure that made all Angel bloodlines tremble stood in mid-air.
Twelve wings, burning with the Fire of Destruction, blotted out the sky, and crimson patterns flowed around Liu Li.
She wielded a hundred-meter long giant blade, and each step she took caused the space to tremble!
"Liu Li of the Blazing Angels Race—"
A cold voice resounded through the sky, carrying indisputable authority:
"Has returned!"
This declaration was like a bolt of thunder, instantly silencing the entire Angel Race’s encampment.
The Blazing Angels bound in chains simultaneously raised their heads, and Liu Xia was even more violently shaken...
"That voice..."
She widened her eyes in disbelief, struggling to look up towards the sky.
That soul-stirring figure was now suspended high above in the sky!
It truly was...
Liu Li!
But in the next instant, Liu Xia’s heart sank to the bottom.
Why did Liu Li return at this moment?
The Angel Race was now colluding with the Demon Race, with Mi Zhan presiding over it...
Wasn’t this walking right into a trap?!
"Liu Li, quickly le—"
She shouted with all her might, but before she could finish, Mi Zhan waved a hand—
"Bang!"
Liu Xia’s figure flew out like a kite with a broken string, heavily crashing onto the edge of a high platform, with blood spilling from the corner of her mouth.
"Noisy!"
Mi Zhan swept his cold gaze over, then looked up at Liu Li in the sky, a cruel smile curling his lips.
"Perfect... saves me the trouble of searching."
Originally, he thought the Divine Pattern was hopeless.
After all, according to his conjecture, Liu Xia was unlikely to know the whereabouts of the Divine Pattern.
And the only one who might know the Angel Race’s Divine Pattern...
Was this princess of the Blazing Angels Race!
Liu Li!
However, the Human Race was too special, existing in two worlds.
Given the likelihood of that Blazing Angel’s damaged wings never reaching the Extraordinary Level in this lifetime.
And if she couldn’t reach the Extraordinary Level...
It meant Liu Li couldn’t appear in Alternate Space, making capturing Liu Li an impossible task.
But now...
"Truly, seeking high and low without finding..."
Mi Zhan licked his lips, his gaze locked onto Liu Li.
What shocked him even more was that behind Liu Li, twelve wings were spread!
Though two appeared somewhat illusory, it indicated her normal state was already at the Ten Wings Realm...
Far surpassing him, an Eight-winged War Angel!
"A waste with merely Legendary Talent at birth, now able to achieve such a level..."
Mi Zhan’s heart pounded, a mad thought flashing through his mind:
If he could gain the secret behind Liu Li’s talent enhancement, perhaps he could break through to the Totem Level, no longer needing to abase himself to serve the Demon Race!
With this thought, a cold gleam flashed in Mi Zhan’s eyes, and he immediately shouted:
"Capture this Blazing Angel alive for me!"
At the issuance of the command, several War Angel elders instantly locked onto Liu Li.
When they clearly saw those twelve wings, their eyes first flickered with shock, then became nakedly greedy.
Helping Mi Zhan obtain the method to enhance talent.
Even if they couldn’t eat meat, they could drink some soup?!
However...
