Before they could act, five figures appeared like phantoms in front of Liu Li!
Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, Lilith, Vera, Tushan Yueli!
Five terrifying auras swept across the scene instantly!
And in the Beast Taming Space, Sally, witnessing this moment, revealed a trace of envy in her eyes.
She also wanted to help Lord Liuli take revenge!
But now, her strength...
Sally clenched her fists, a hint of determination flashing in her eyes.
Must strive harder.
Vera’s emerald eyes scanned the dense army of War Angels around, a playful curve appearing on her lips:
"Liu Li, you owe me a big favor this time..."
Before her words could fully leave her lips, radiant emerald light burst from her body!
Vast life energy surged like a tsunami, forming a massive sea of vines in the Void.
Even with her strength comparable to a Half-Step Totem Level, she had to be highly vigilant at this moment.
The Angel Race was truly one of the top clans!
Merely the War Angel Race...
Currently showcased over ten Half-Step Totem Level powerhouses.
Among them, Monarch Level powerhouses numbered nearly a hundred.
In addition to this...
The presence of the Demon Race existed here.
Their strength was no weaker than that of the War Angel Race.
Currently, under the watchful eyes of countless enemies.
Vera felt a terrifying pressure nearly overwhelming her.
Meanwhile, Qing Shuang gazed over the battlefield, battle intent gradually igniting in her eyes.
Last time, dealing with those Monarch Level demons, she hadn’t even warmed up.
But now...
So many Half-Step Totem Level existences.
She could finally get serious!
Ghost Qi gradually condensed on the surface of her body, forming a Ghost Armor.
Without turning, she softly spoke, her voice transmitted through the Ghost Armor sounding particularly deep:
"Fei Yue, be cautious yourself! Once the fight begins, just slip into the Void to avoid any stray attacks."
Hearing this, Fei Yue nodded heavily.
The fight between Half-Step Totem Level beings was already beyond her current participation ability.
Her attributes barely reached thirty thousand points; wanting to fight against these Half-Step Totem Level enemies with hundreds of thousands of points was absolutely impossible.
Similarly, Tushan Yueli felt immense pressure.
Although with Tushan Yue’s help, her talent reached Myth Five Stars.
However, the Qingqiu Race was inherently not adept at combat.
And now...
Facing such terrifying enemies.
Sweating instantly dotted her forehead.
As Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast...
Was the pressure this intense?!
It felt like one small mistake would lead to death!
Lilith lazily stretched her bat wings, her scarlet eyes scanning the battlefield:
"Fei Yue, little fox, you two just watch from the side..."
Upon hearing Lilith’s words, the two did not insist.
They were well aware of their strength, that this level of battle was beyond their participation.
After advising the two, Lilith finally locked her gaze onto Mi Zhan, a dangerous curve at her red lips.
This one was indeed her opponent!
Mi Zhan, infinitely close to Totem Level!
Also the Clan Leader of the Angel Race.
She elegantly licked her sharp teeth, blood mist surging around her:
"They say the Angel Race has no weaknesses... today, let me see how the Blood Race falls short!"
Meanwhile, Gu Xing had quietly infiltrated among the various races.
His goal was to liberate all the Blazing Angels.
Earlier, he had spotted the presence of the Magma Clan among these alien races.
Thus, a bold plan was forming in his mind.
Have the Guardian Beasts attract the attention of the Angel and Demon Races, while he led this group of the Magma Clan to rescue the Blazing Angels and others.
Though the Blazing Angels Race was covered in scars, yet...
There were quite a few Half-Step Totem Level and Monarch Level existences among them!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 258: Mi Zhan’s Trump Card!
chapters.content:
Chapter 258: Chapter 258: Mi Zhan’s Trump Card!
"Bene... Benefactor?!"
A fire spirit from the Magma Clan saw Gu Xing and immediately exclaimed.
However, as soon as he spoke, he quickly covered his mouth.
After all, they were surrounded by the War Angel Race now, and the Guardian Beast had managed to divert all the War Angels’ attention.
If his outburst exposed the benefactor...
He would be to blame even if he died a thousand times!
Moreover, the Magma Clan’s hearts were connected, and the old clan leader of the Magma Clan naturally discovered Gu Xing’s arrival through this fire spirit.
He glanced inconspicuously at Mi Zhan, who was focused on Liu Li, then quietly activated the Magma Clan’s Talent Ability.
At this moment, Gu Xing was still troubled about how to approach the Magma Clan.
Although he had already mingled with this group of aliens...
His identity as a human was too conspicuous!
Furthermore, the gaze this group of aliens gave him was full of vigilance.
After all, in their eyes, the Human Race was considered the most cunning creature in the Alternate Space!
Almost all races had no fondness for the Human Race!
Therefore, Gu Xing found it a bit difficult to get this group of aliens to make way for him, allowing him to approach the central Magma Clan.
And just as he hesitated over what method to use...
To avoid attracting Mi Zhan’s attention while still getting close to the Magma Clan.
"Whoosh!"
Suddenly, crimson flames surged up from beneath his feet, instantly engulfing him!
In an instant, Gu Xing’s entire aura completely transformed, and even his life energy was identical to the Magma Clan.
When he came to, he found himself transported to the core area of the Magma Clan.
All the little fire spirits surrounded him protectively in the center, safeguarding his safety.
The clan leader of the Magma Clan, seeing Gu Xing again, showed a hint of concern amid his excitement.
If not for Gu Xing aiding the Magma Clan in the Divine Secret Realm, this race might have already disappeared.
"Benefactor! Why do you risk entering here?!"
Time was of the essence, so Gu Xing briefly explained his purpose and made his request.
"Can you send me close to those Blazing Angels?"
Currently, all the Guardian Beasts were confronting the enemy in the sky, so he was completely without their protection.
Although his attributes had reached the limit of Commander Level, the combat prowess of the Human Race was still weaker compared to the Guardian Beasts.
Therefore, even with such high attributes, it was impossible for him to fight across so many levels like Qing Shuang and Liu Li.
There were several Monarch Level War Angels guarding the restrained Blazing Angel.
Though those Monarch Level War Angels weren’t strong, he couldn’t entirely rely on his own power to approach effortlessly.
Thus, he thought to seek assistance from the Magma Clan!
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s request, the Magma Clan’s clan leader immediately indicated no problem at all.
Having finally awaited an opportunity to repay the benefactor...
He naturally wouldn’t refuse!
Furthermore...
His gaze fell upon the few guarding War Angels.
Only a few Monarch Level Angels!
His expression turned solemn, and a terrifying Fire Domain instantly appeared on the battlefield.
During this time, by absorbing the energy of the volcano...
Although his level was at the Monarch Peak, his power already rivaled Half-Step Totem.
Thus bullying a few Monarch Level War Angels posed no problems whatsoever.
And when Mi Zhan in the sky noticed such a change, his expression immediately darkened.
He hadn’t yet dealt with this group of aliens, and they dared to stir trouble.
He snorted coldly, intending to take action against them.
Handy for exterminating this disobedient bunch.
Except, at the moment he turned, a crimson Blood Arrow soared through the air!
Sensing the terrifying energy it contained, his face changed drastically, immediately abandoning the thought of attacking the aliens.
"Buzz—!!"
A dazzling golden barrier spread instantly.
The closer to Totem Level, the War Angel Race came closer to their strongest form.
Guardian Angels!
Therefore, Mi Zhan excelled not in offense, but in defense!
"Boom!!!"
The Blood Arrow fiercely struck against the golden barrier, generating layers of energy ripples, yet failing to pierce through.
Lilith was unsurprised by this.
Her goal was merely to stall Mi Zhan, preventing him from acting against those aliens.
As for injuring Mi Zhan, she had little hope.
Though having not harmed Mi Zhan, but she wouldn’t concede verbally:
"Isn’t the War Angel Race known as one of the strongest combat races? I thought you would completely ignore my attack."
Hearing Lilith’s words, Mi Zhan’s face darkened.
That damned Blood Ancestor!
He didn’t understand why this Blood Ancestor chose to aid the fallen Princess of the Blazing Angels.
Helping Liu Li brought her no benefit whatsoever!
"Blood Ancestor! Not minding your Blood Race domain and meddling with Angel Race’s business is inappropriate, isn’t it?"
From Lilith, he sensed this Blood Ancestor’s power was merely Half-Step Totem.
But...
He knew that this Blood Ancestor used to be undeniably Totem Level.
Her mastery of laws was absolutely above his own.
Facing Lilith, his odds of losing were high!
Therefore, scaring her off was the best outcome.
Upon hearing this, Lilith raised her eyebrows and chuckled.
"How could this be considered meddling? Liu Li from the Blazing Angel Race is now my sister! I’m here to stand up for my sister; isn’t that allowed?"
Hearing such kind words, Mi Zhan’s face became exceedingly unpleasant.
Sister?!
Was this Blood Ancestor jesting?
She’s lived for millennia; how could she be sisters with a crippled Blazing Angel?
This was evidently Lilith’s excuse to intervene with the Angel Race!
"Blood Ancestor! We Angel Race don’t provoke trouble, but neither do we fear it!"
"Since you remain obstinate, I can only personally escort you away!"
"Anyone can boast, but let’s see you show some skill first!"
Before she finished speaking, Lilith transformed into a blood-red lightning bolt, charging straight at Mi Zhan!
Despite outwardly composed, Lilith knew full well...
Without Gu Xing’s Soul-devouring enhancement, her power barely reached Totem Level.
Therefore, against Mi Zhan, she had to go all out.
Witnessing this, Mi Zhan’s eyes surged with cold light.
His aura erupted forth, and the golden patterns on his eight wings burned like the blazing sun!
This Blood Ancestor was Half-Step Totem, and he was likewise Half-Step Totem.
Having spent half a lifetime, he had reached the limit of Totem Level.
Thus, regardless of the former Totem Level, how does that matter?
He was confident he could fight and win.
Furthermore...
Mi Zhan smirked inwardly, his mind scanning the pitch-black Demon Stone hovering in his Spirit Sea.
This was a treasure from the Demon Abyss, capable of instantly completing the highest-tier Demonization!
This was his true trump card!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 259: Blazing Angels Break Free!
chapters.content:
Chapter 259: Chapter 259: Blazing Angels Break Free!
Meanwhile, the roaring Fire Domain unleashed by the old Magma Clan Leader perfectly concealed Gu Xing’s presence.
He moved like a phantom through the flames, quickly approaching the imprisoned Blazing Angels.
The few War Angels guarding them didn’t last a single move under the Magma Clan Leader and turned into ash.
Seeing this, those of the Alien Race who refused to join the War Angels exchanged a glance and instantly reached a consensus.
"The Magma Clan has made a move! What are we hesitating for? Attack!"
"Damn! These War Angels never intended to let us leave alive; if we don’t fight, are we just waiting to die?"
"Exactly! While Mi Zhan is being held back, let’s move!"
Although this group of Aliens didn’t have particularly strong individuals...
Gathered together, they still formed a considerable force!
As these Aliens took action, those who had chosen to side with Mi Zhan followed suit.
Having chosen to align with him, now was the time to show their allegiance.
Right now, the War Angel Race and the Demon Race were collaborating, with dozens of Half-step Totem Level and countless Monarch Level individuals.
On the other side, there was just one Half-step Totem Level and a few Commander Levels.
Who would win?
Even a fool could see it!
They wouldn’t act stupidly!
"Stop them!"
"The time has come to serve Mi Zhan master!"
Though they didn’t dare attack the terrifying Guardian Beasts in the sky, as fellow Aliens...
What was there to fear?!
Soon, the two groups of Aliens clashed fiercely!
The entire plaza instantly plunged into chaos, with energy streams erupting everywhere, screams and roars interweaving.
In this turmoil, Gu Xing seized the opportunity to rush to the front of the imprisoned Blazing Angels!
Liu Xia looked at the human suddenly appearing before her, first stunned, then realized...
He must be Liu Li’s Beast Master!
She endured the intense pain brought by the chains, urgently whispering:
"Quickly take Liu Li away! This isn’t a battle you can interfere with!"
She could tell that Gu Xing’s strength was only Commander Level.
The Guardian Beast’s strength matched its Beast Master, so Liu Li was also just Commander Level!
How could such strength contend with the alliance of the War Angel Race and the Demon Race?!
However, upon hearing this, Gu Xing decisively shook his head.
He knew that if he stood by and watched Liu Xia and the clan suffer today, it would become an eternal heart demon for Liu Li, possibly halting her progress forever!
"Please, don’t speak," Gu Xing quickly said while carefully inspecting the chains, "the situation is urgent now..."
"You——!"
Liu Xia’s wound seeped blood again, enraged.
She was trying to protect the safety of the two, yet this human dared to rudely ask her to keep quiet.
But Liu Li was the hope of the Blazing Angel Race, so she had to suppress her anger and continued persuading:
"You are no match for Mi Zhan! Moreover, Mi Zhan has thrown his lot with the Demon Race; he could fall into their ranks at any moment, growing even stronger and harder to deal with."
"Furthermore, those who’ve shown up may not be all of the Demon Race."
"So, quickly take Liu Li and leave here forever!"
Nevertheless, at this moment, Gu Xing completely ignored Liu Xia’s words; his gaze locked tightly on the blood-red chains restraining them.
Earlier, he attempted to cut it using weapons, only to find it was of no use whatsoever.
Not to mention breaking it, he couldn’t even leave the slightest mark.
Seeing Gu Xing not listening, still vainly trying to free her from the chains, Liu Xia felt somewhat helpless:
"Don’t waste your effort. These chains should be Demon Race creations, immensely sturdy, without Totem Level strength it’s impossible to open them!"
And Gu Xing had realized this point by now.
However...
These chains sturdy?!
A gleam appeared in his eyes.
In an instant, his eyes transformed into a silver-white.
Sovereign Talent—Activate!
"Monarch·Slaughter!"
The blood-red Slaughter Aura surged like a tide, condensing into a bizarre long sword in the palm of his hand.
Liu Xia’s gaze was instinctively drawn to it, immediately shaken to the core by the overwhelming murderous intent!
In her sight, Gu Xing raised the blood-red long sword high and swung down fiercely.
"Crack—!!!"
A crisp snapping sound echoed.
The blood-red chain that they had tried desperately to escape yet couldn’t, snapped under the sword’s edge!
"This..."
She stared dumbfounded at the shattered chain pieces strewn across the ground, then gazed up at Gu Xing standing with his sword, speechless for a moment.
Gu Xing, seeing the chain completely severed in two, felt a surge of joy.
It really worked!
Earlier, he had tried every method, utterly unable to deal with these chains.
But then he had a sudden spark of inspiration, thinking of the Slaughter Aura.
It could ignore defenses!
Typically, he would empower Liu Li and other Guardian Beasts for battle using it.
Yet, the premise of Slaughter Aura ignoring defenses was its extreme sharpness.
Thus, he thought to try cutting the strange chain with the sword formed by Slaughter Aura.
And the result was as he speculated...
The Slaughter Aura effortlessly sliced the chain apart.
After severing Liu Xia’s chain, Gu Xing immediately flew towards other imprisoned Blazing Angels.
Every bit of fighting strength was crucial now!
"Crack! Crack!"
Crisp snapping sounds rang out consecutively.
This signified one Blazing Angel after another regaining freedom!
Mi Zhan could be held off by Lilith.
And although a Half-step Totem Level, three Guardian Beasts were strong.
But dealing with over twenty Half-step Totem Level opponents wasn’t easy.
He had to have this group of Blazing Angels help Liu Li alleviate the pressure.
This was why he risked coming alone to rescue the Blazing Angels!
Watching the gathering Blazing Angels nearby, Liu Xia gradually regained her senses.
She slowly clenched her hand, Spiritual Power instantly channeling within.
Feeling the long-lost Power, Liu Xia’s expression became exceedingly serious.
She never thought Gu Xing could indeed break the chains, freeing her!
She turned to Gu Xing, eyes filled with gratitude.
But she didn’t speak!
The priority now was securing victory in this battle!
Even if the chances of winning were slim this time, she had to rally the Blazing Angel Race for a fight!
Her gaze instantly locked onto the War Angel Elder, confronting Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang in the sky.
The suppressed fury finally erupted in this moment!
"Blazing Angel Race!"
Liu Xia’s voice boomed like thunder, "Follow me to aid the Princess!"
"Follow till death!"
All Blazing Angels roared in unison, their bodies still aching with numerous injuries, yet their resolve unyielding.
The shame of imprisonment, today, it must be avenged with blood!
Liu Xia’s eight wings suddenly spread wide, transforming into a dazzling red light shooting towards the clouds.
The other Blazing Angels followed closely, morphing into streams of light joining the battlefield.
The great battle, on the brink of eruption!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 260: Reunion!
chapters.content:
Chapter 260: Chapter 260: Reunion!
At the moment when Liu Xia and the others broke free from their restraints, Mi Zhan’s pupils suddenly contracted.
His face was so dark that it seemed like water could be squeezed out, and his knuckles clenched involuntarily.
To be aware, controlling the entire Blazing Angels Race so easily before was completely a sneak attack taking advantage of their unpreparedness.
After all...
Liu Xia’s strength had also reached the Half-step Totem Level and was among the top tier of that level!
Moreover, Liu Li’s talent was the same as his, also Myth Five Stars.
Coupled with the fact that the Blazing Angels were more adept in offense, their combat abilities generally surpassed the War Angel Race!
Therefore, if a real fight broke out, he might not even be Liu Xia’s match!
However...
This group of Blazing Angels was no longer at their peak!
Their War Angels were all still at their peaks, and they had the support of the Demon Race.
They still held the upper hand!
But...
Mi Zhan’s gaze locked onto Lilith’s figure like a venomous snake, his voice laden with suppressed anger:
"How did you break the Demon God’s chains?"
To successfully control the Blazing Angels Race, these were the Demon God’s chains specially taken from the Demon Abyss by the Demon Race.
Not to mention the Half-step Totem Level, even at the Totem Level...
Once bound by the Demon God’s chains, there was absolutely no chance of breaking free.
For this reason, he had confidently sent only a few Monarch Level War Angels to guard Liu Xia and the others.
But now....
Mi Zhan’s gaze involuntarily turned to the burning Fire Domain below, a hint of suspicion flashing in his eyes.
Could someone actually destroy the Demon God’s chains and rescue that group of Blazing Angels?
Hearing the words "Demon God’s chains," Lilith was also startled internally.
Anything bearing the title of "Demon God" was not simple.
Here, "Demon God" did not refer to those who hadn’t yet grown but merely had the potential of a Demon God.
It specifically referred to the ten supreme deities of the Demon Race that stood atop all races!
Even the weakest among them possessed terrifying strength beyond the Totem Level...
The power of treasures passed down from such beings was imaginable.
Though she was shocked by Gu Xing’s ability to break the chains, her face showed no trace of it:
"Mi Zhan, what you should be worried about now..."
Her red lips opened slightly, a chill flashing in her eyes, "is your own situation!"
In an instant, countless fine blood beads blossomed on Lilith’s snow-white skin. These blood beads did not fall but bizarrely floated around her, transforming into a scarlet mist.
"Immortal Blood Body!"
With a clear shout, a pair of blood-red bat wings that blotted out the sky suddenly unfolded behind her, each wing membrane flowing with ancient dark golden runes.
At the same time, her momentum soared continuously, breaking through the critical point in an instant.
Buzz!
The Blood Domain exploded, transforming the area within a kilometer radius into a surging sea of blood.
Faced with Lilith’s full power outburst, gold light surged explosively in Mi Zhan’s eyes.
"War Angel Form—Activate!"
Dazzling golden wings burst forth from his body, ten wings spread abruptly, and his aura also climbed crazily.
"Angel Domain!"
The Golden Sanctuary instantly spread out, colliding violently with the Blood Domain.
Two completely opposite forces clashed fiercely in the void, ripping and recomposing it at the junction.
Almost simultaneously...
Swoosh!
The two transformed into a golden and red stream of light, colliding violently with space-tearing speed!
Meanwhile, on the other side of the battlefield.
Liu Li and the other two stood back to back, surrounded by dozens of Half-step Totem experts from the Demon Race and the War Angel Race.
Although they possessed Half-step Totem Level combat power now, it was based on the support of Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent.
Without Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent support, the strength of the three could only be considered at the Monarch Peak.
Barely touching the threshold of the Half-step Totem Level!
Yet, even facing overwhelming disadvantage, their eyes showed no trace of wavering.
"One person, one direction."
Liu Li’s golden eyes swept over the approaching enemies, her voice eerily calm.
"No problem!"
"Okay!"
Vera and Qing Shuang replied one after another.
And the Half-step Totem Level strongmen from the Demon Race and Angel Race closing in showed mockery in their eyes as they looked at the three:
"A few Commander Level Guardian Beasts daring to intrude on the Angel Race!"
"It seems their master is brainless, too."
Even if the aura exuded by these three Guardian Beasts was strong at this moment, it was still only Commander Level.
Without mastering the Law, they couldn’t become their opponents.
And just as they were preparing to jointly eliminate these three Guardian Beasts...
A group of fiery red figures suddenly approached.
"With me here, who dares to touch a hair of the Blazing Angels Race’s princess!"
With her formidable strength, Liu Xia almost instantly arrived in front of Liu Li.
And other Half-step Totem Level Blazing Angels also stood in front of Liu Li successively.
This turn of events startled the Half-step Totem Level powerhouses of the War Angel Race and the Demon Race.
But soon, they calmed down again.
After all, these were remnants of the defeated, is there anything to be afraid of?
Now, it would be good if this group of Blazing Angels could exert half of their strength.
Moreover, they still had a numerical advantage...
"Do you think that breaking free from the restraints can reverse the entire situation?"
The War Angel Grand Elder’s eyes were filled with mockery.
"Liu Xia, although I don’t know how you escaped the Demon God’s chains, how much of your strength can you actually exert now?"
As the strongest of the Blazing Angels Race, Liu Xia naturally received special treatment.
The Demon God’s chains used by Mi Zhan on her were the strongest among everyone.
Therefore, she had absorbed the most energy.
Now, at best, she could only exert thirty percent of her strength!
Such strength, not to mention contending with Mi Zhan, was even inferior to these elders of the War Angel Race.
And Liu Xia was well aware of this fact.
It was almost impossible for the Blazing Angels Race to retreat unscathed today...
And she had already resolved herself to die.
As the vice clan leader, as that man’s sister, how could she have allowed the Angel Race to fall to such a state...
She was guilty!
Originally, under the restraint of the Demon God’s chains, she had already given up struggling.
But now...
She slowly clenched her fist, feeling the remaining power within her.
That human severed the Demon God’s chains, giving her one last chance to fight.
"Liu Li, take your master and leave! The upcoming battle is up to us!"
Liu Xia’s voice carried an undeniable finality, not daring to look back for fear of weakening upon seeing those eyes.
And the current situation, staying here was tantamount to waiting for death!
At this moment, Liu Li, looking at Liu Xia and the tribesmen standing in front of her, was in a daze.
Her master’s plan succeeded!
Her tribe was indeed rescued by her master!
Yet, before reuniting with her people, she was urged to leave, just like before.
She slowly closed her eyes, and when she reopened them, they were filled with determination.
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 261: Absolute Forbidden Domain—Activation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 261: Chapter 261: Absolute Forbidden Domain—Activation!
She’s not a child anymore!
She could never abandon her people, for she must take on the duties of a princess of the Blazing Angels Race.
"Aunt, I’m no longer the little Angel who used to hold everyone back. Now, I have my own master, my companions... all that’s left is you!"
"Therefore, I absolutely will not leave you here alone."
"If we leave, we leave together; if we die, we die together!"
Upon hearing this, Liu Xia was suddenly stunned.
But soon, she smiled.
Watching Liu Li grow up, she knew her character better than anyone.
At such a critical moment, how could this little girl possibly run away?
"Alright, be careful in the upcoming battle. I will protect you."
Vera, standing nearby, widened her eyes slightly upon hearing Liu Xia’s words.
Protect Liu Li?
This isn’t right?!
The power Liu Li can unleash now...
Definitely surpasses this group of Blazing Angels.
Moreover...
The master hasn’t even made a move yet!
As if responding to Vera’s inner thoughts, Gu Xing’s voice suddenly boomed across the battlefield:
"Soul-devouring Talent·Activate!"
Blood-red spiritual power instantly surged in several directions of the battlefield.
At this moment, Fei Yue stood beside Gu Xing.
Although her combat ability wasn’t strong.
Now, almost all enemies above the Half-step Totem Level were being held off by several Guardian Beasts.
The Monarch Level enemies posed no threat to Fei Yue.
Thus, she was more than enough to ensure Gu Xing’s safety!
At once, Gu Xing issued a command to Fei Yue:
"Fei Yue, take me to the top of the battlefield!"
"Understood!"
As soon as the words fell, Fei Yue immediately took Gu Xing into the Void.
When they reappeared, they were already at the top of the battlefield.
Gu Xing gazed down over the entire battlefield.
Except for the battlefield where Lilith was, all others were at a disadvantage.
Especially the one with Monarch Level beings!
The Blazing Angel warriors were drenched in blood, struggling under the siege of the Demon Race and War Angels.
Already weakened from long-term imprisonment, they were now being forced to their limits by enemies three times their number.
"If this continues..."
Gu Xing frowned deeply, as if he had already seen the downfall of all Blazing Angels.
Thinking of this, he took a deep breath and slowly closed his eyes.
Bzz——
Scarlet blood-like spiritual power erupted from within him.
Simultaneously, the blue spiritual power inside him exploded entirely.
"Emperor’s Might!"
[Gu Xing]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Guardian Beasts: Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, Sally, Tushan Yueli]
[Special State: Favor of the Human Race]
[Divine Pattern: 2]
[Contract Quota: 5/5]
[Power: 60000→180000]
[Constitution: 60000→180000]
[Spirit: 60000→180000]
[Speed: 60000→180000]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might, Absolute Forbidden Domain]
When Gu Xing opened his eyes again, the entire battlefield’s air seemed to halt.
His pupils had completely transformed into a blood-red color, and the surging spiritual power around him was like tangible blood mist.
At the same time, a voice resounded throughout the battlefield!
"Absolute Forbidden Domain!"
Bzz——
A blood-red light barrier rapidly expanded in a hemispherical shape, enveloping the entire battlefield in an instant.
But unlike before, this time the barrier consciously avoided all Blazing Angels, only enclosing the Demon Race and War Angels.
During this period, he hadn’t been idle.
Whenever he had time, he constantly studied his two domains.
The main function of Emperor’s Might was to enhance his attributes.
While Absolute Forbidden Domain was to seal off the enemy’s domain.
And he discovered that the stronger his attributes, the stronger the Absolute Forbidden Domain he could release.
Thus, after constant attempts.
He finally succeeded in merging both the Emperor’s Might and Absolute Forbidden Domain!
Using Emperor’s Might to enhance his attributes, then release Absolute Forbidden Domain.
And after continuous experimentation, he was able to...
The Absolute Forbidden Domain would only seal off the enemy’s domain, not his allies’ domains.
And as the Absolute Forbidden Domain enveloped all the enemies, exclamations arose continuously on the battlefield:
"What’s going on? Why can’t I release my domain!"
"Damn it! Why? Why aren’t the Blazing Angels affected at all!"
The War Angels were in terror as they found their Domain Power was like a rock sinking into the sea.
"Damn it, I get it, it’s that human!"
A sharp-eyed War Angel noticed Gu Xing standing proudly at the top of the battlefield and immediately understood that all of this must be the work of this human.
"Everyone, kill him, and we’ll return to normal!"
However...
This group of Monarch Level Blazing Angels instantly blocked their path.
They all understood that Gu Xing was their hope for a turnaround.
Of course, they couldn’t let this group of Demon Race and War Angels attack Gu Xing.
At this moment, their faces still carried traces of shock.
This lord’s domain... so terrifying!
The enemies couldn’t release their domains, yet they were unaffected at all.
It’s known that for strong beings at the Totem Level and Monarch Level, Domain Power is the foundation of strength.
The stronger the domain, the greater the combat power that can be exerted.
But now....
This group of War Angels and Demon Race can’t release their domains.
This means their strength was significantly weakened, narrowing the gap with them instantly.
The original disparity in combat strength now finally held a chance for a fair fight.
"Everyone, hear my order! Protect that lord at all costs!" a Blazing Angel shouted loudly.
Under his command, the Angels charged into the battlefield fearlessly.
Liu Xia felt the sudden change and was equally taken aback.
She subconsciously looked up at the sky——
Only to see Gu Xing standing majestically among the clouds like a god, emitting an overwhelming pressure.
At this moment.
She suddenly somewhat understood...
Why Liu Li could recover from her injuries, why her Talent could be elevated to such heights.
It was because she followed such a miraculous master!
At the same time, three earth-shaking auras erupted beside Liu Xia!
Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang simultaneously activated their strongest combat forms.
Under the blessing of Gu Xing’s Soul-devouring Talent, their strength directly doubled.
Coupled with the special influence of the Soul-devouring Talent on the Law Control Level, the combat power of the three had reached the peak of Half-step Totem Level!
Liu Li stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Liu Xia. She said with a determined gaze:
"Aunt, I am no longer the burden who needs your protection. Please let me fight alongside you!"
Liu Xia felt the powerful aura from Liu Li, which was not inferior to her own or even surpassed it, and she was stunned.
But soon, a comforting smile appeared on her lips:
"Alright! Then let us fight side by side!"
"Blazing Angel Form, activate!"
With a clear shout, Liu Xia instantly unleashed her full power.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 262: Mi Zhan’s Demonization
chapters.content:
Chapter 262: Chapter 262: Mi Zhan’s Demonization
After unleashing her full power, Liu Xia unhesitatingly charged straight at the Great Elder of the War Angels.
Among the current enemies, the Great Elder’s strength was the most formidable.
And within the Blazing Angels Race, except for her, everyone else had been severely weakened due to prolonged imprisonment, making it impossible to be a match for this Great Elder.
As for Liu Li...
As an elder, how could she let Liu Li face this Angel Race Great Elder?
This responsibility must be borne by her!
Liu Xia’s ten crimson wings suddenly quivered, and the scarlet light traced a brilliant path in the void.
In the next moment, she had transformed into a streak of light, fiercely charging at the Great Elder with a resolute momentum.
"Good timing!"
The Great Elder of the War Angels roared with fury upon seeing this.
A trace of ferocity flashed in his eyes...
If Liu Xia was at her peak, he indeed wouldn’t be her match.
But now...
This Blazing Angel, ignorant of life and death, dared to deliver herself to him, then he would gladly send her on her way!
As Liu Xia took the lead in selecting her opponent, the rest of the Blazing Angels also targeted their adversaries.
They tacitly prioritized the War Angels as primary targets, leaving the weaker Demon Race to Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang.
Vera watched this scene, with a hint of envy in her eyes.
She was gratified that Liu Li had such united kin, but soon a wave of solitude swept over her.
Such kin, she could never have again.
The Elf Clan now only had her.
But this melancholy quickly vanished.
Vera swiftly adjusted her mindset, her gaze becoming firm again.
Though she had lost her kin, she still had her most important master.
"Liu Li, Qing Shuang, we each take on four!"
There were precisely twelve half-step Totem Level powerhouses from the Demon Race present, ready for equal distribution.
For this suggestion, Liu Li and Qing Shuang nodded without hesitation.
They exchanged a glance and tacitly dispersed, each engaging four Demon Race powerhouses.
On the other side, the battle in the high sky had reached a fever pitch.
"Boom——!!"
With a deafening explosion, Lilith, clad in blood-colored battle armor, and Mi Zhan, donned in golden armor, clashed fiercely before separating in an instant.
The powerful shockwave rippled through the void in layers.
Mi Zhan steadied himself with a grave expression, clearly realizing from the confrontation just now...
He indeed was no match for this Blood Clan Ancestor!
Yet, relying on the innate robust defensive capabilities of the War Angel Race, he could barely hold on for a short period.
He raised his sinister eyes, fixating on Lilith:
"Lilith, why don’t you stay in the Blood Domain where you belong, instead of opposing the Angel Race?"
Lilith’s face showed a slight sneer.
"You’ve already allied with the Demon Race, and yet you still call yourself part of the Angel Race?"
"Leaving a perfectly good position as Clan Leader, opting instead to become a dog for the Demon Race!"
Hearing Lilith’s taunt, Mi Zhan’s face turned terribly grim.
Although he had indeed allied with the Demon Race, being pointed out as a dog for them by Lilith...
"What right do you have to judge me?"
Mi Zhan suddenly roared hysterically, his eyes turning an abnormal red.
"You inherited the Blood Clan’s Divine Pattern, enabling you to break through to Totem Level directly, but what about me?"
Mi Zhan’s face twisted with rage, his voice filled with long-suppressed resentment:
"Do you think I want to be the Demon Race’s lapdog? But I have no choice!"
His golden wings trembled violently, as if to vent centuries of pent-up grievances:
"Above me, there is always a Blazing Angel suppressing me! I will never gain the Angel Race’s Divine Pattern recognition! Without the Divine Pattern, how can I break through to Totem Level?!"
At this, Mi Zhan suddenly laughed crazily, pointing at Lilith to question:
"Blood Ancestor! Tell me! Without the Blood Clan’s Divine Pattern, could you break through to Totem Level?"
This sharp question left Lilith momentarily speechless.
She fell into contemplation...
Indeed, even with her Myth Five Stars talent, without the Blood Clan’s Divine Pattern...
It’s difficult to completely rely on herself to break through to Totem Level!
In the Law of the Alternate Space, talent level determines the growth limit of the Beast Taming:
For example:
For Excellent Level tamed beasts, Extraordinary is their limit.
An Epic Level can only reach Commander Level.
And the upper limit of Legendary Level is Monarch Level.
As for Totem Level, only Myth Talent can possibly achieve it.
However....
Possibly achieving it does not mean definitely achieving it.
Even though Mi Zhan had Myth Five Stars talent, he couldn’t break through to Totem Level.
Lilith speculated...
Perhaps only talent beyond Myth Five Stars could truly break through Totem Level without relying on Divine Patterns.
This thought involuntarily brought her mind to Gu Xing.
She clearly remembered that Gu Xing could enhance Beast Taming talent.
Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang all reached a talent level above Myth Five Stars with Gu Xing’s help.
This realization filled her with an inexplicable sense of fortune...
She was lucky to have met Gu Xing.
Although she currently was not Gu Xing’s contracted beast, over time she completely understood Gu Xing’s character.
Once he acknowledges someone, he would never mistreat them.
Plus, they were bound by a Blood Covenant.
This kind of relationship, though not an official Beast Taming Contract, was almost no different.
As long as Gu Xing had the opportunity, she was prepared to request from him to become his beast.
Bringing her thoughts back to reality, Lilith’s gaze refocused on Mi Zhan, now what she needed to do...
Was to follow Gu Xing’s command and force this angel into a corner.
"You’re right, without the Divine Pattern, I indeed might not break through to Totem Level."
"However, this does not excuse you for aligning with the Demon Race."
Lilith’s eyes carried a hint of coldness.
She wasn’t prepared to continue with this pointless exchange with Mi Zhan.
The laws she commanded surpassed Mi Zhan by far, as she had once reached Totem Level.
In the next moment.
As the blood-colored aura erupted fiercely, the Blood Domain around her began to rapidly contract.
In Lilith’s hand, a Blood Long Spear took shape.
Mi Zhan’s pupils sharply contracted, the threat of death left his whole body trembling.
He could clearly feel that if he couldn’t block this strike, he would certainly die here today!
"Blood Ancestor, do you really think you’ve won?!"
Mi Zhan suddenly let out a hysterical laugh, a trace of madness flashing in his eyes.
Without hesitation, he poured all his Spiritual Power into the Demon Stone in his mind.
"Boom——!!!"
In an instant, overwhelming Demonic Qi erupted like a volcano, utterly consuming Mi Zhan.
The golden wings on his back were eroded by black patterns at a visible speed, and the sacred light was gradually replaced by filthy darkness.
"Is this... the feeling of power?"
War angelically spread his arms, relishing the surging violent energy within him.
His voice became hoarse and distorted.
As the last trace of gold was swallowed by darkness, Mi Zhan’s aura suddenly surged to an unprecedented peak!
The terrifying pressure began to distort and collapse the surrounding space.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 263: Eight Divine Patterns!
chapters.content:
Chapter 263: Chapter 263: Eight Divine Patterns!
As Mi Zhan ascended...
"Boom——!!"
A jet-black pillar of light suddenly shot skyward, piercing the clouds.
At the same time, in the depths of the Demon Realm, the tenth seal gate trembled violently.
A gigantic foot made of sinister white bone suddenly stepped across the threshold, descending upon the world with overwhelming Demonic Qi.
When that figure, completely made of white bones and enveloped in dense Demonic Qi, fully manifested, all Demon Race strongmen fell to the ground in unison, their voices filled with reverence:
"Welcome, honored lord!"
The bone demon’s cold gaze swept over the Demon Race, releasing a disdainful snort:
"You’re all worthless!"
As a Totem Two Turn existence, the bone demon’s emergence held special significance.
The tenth seal gate was just unlocked, and for now, the Demon Abyss could only send forth weaker demons.
And he was the one chosen by the ten Lord Demon Gods as their vanguard.
His purpose was to quickly seize the Human Race’s Divine Pattern and continue unsealing the Demon Abyss.
To bring forth the true demon army into this world.
At this moment.
The bone demon slowly raised his head, and in the hollow eye sockets, a ghostly blue flame danced.
He sharply detected the surge of Demonic Qi that shot up to the sky in the distant horizon, his voice tinged with a bit of surprise:
"A newly ascended Totem-level Demon Clan?"
A Half-step Totem Level Demon King, bowing on the ground, hastily explained:
"My lord, this should be Mi Zhan from the Angel Race. He chose to ally with our Demon Race and is currently completing the demonization ceremony."
"Angel Race?"
The bone demon made a grating sound with his bones, his tone filled with amusement:
"I recall this race was always known for its arrogance, and now they’ve fallen to this point?"
Out of curiosity, the bone demon extended his spiritual power along the Demonic Qi surge.
As a Totem-level entity, his mastery over Demonic Qi had reached the Transformation Realm.
Through the Demonic Qi eruption from Mi Zhan, he instantly understood the entire battlefield situation.
However, when his spiritual power completely covered the battlefield, the dancing soul fire suddenly contracted violently.
The next moment.
His spiritual power trembled fiercely, and the stark white skeleton emitted cracking sounds due to excitement.
He sensed the breath of eight Divine Patterns simultaneously!
Two from the Human Race, one from the Blood Race, one from the Angel Race, two from the Ghost Race, one from the Fox Race, one from the Elf Race...
All eight Divine Patterns miraculously gathered at the same battlefield at this moment.
"The heavens are helping me too!"
The bone demon’s soul fire danced madly, his white bone body trembled slightly with joy.
Since the great war a thousand years ago, the Demon Race was sealed in the depths of the Demon Abyss, while nearly all Alternate Space’s Totem-level strongmen were wiped out.
The existing Totem-level mainly were just at the Totem One Turn realm.
With his Totem Two Turn prowess, as long as he avoided the troublesome Dragon Race to the east, he could roam this continent freely!
As for whether he could acquire the Divine Pattern?!
He was utterly unconcerned!
In the face of absolute power, everything else is futile!
"Crack——!!"
With the sound of space shattering, the bone demon’s figure vanished from the spot, leaving a group of bemused demons kneeling there, completely unaware of what transpired.
Meanwhile, on the battlefield at the Angel Base.
"Boom——!!"
Violent Demonic Qi erupted like a tide and then suddenly receded. Mi Zhan’s aura at this moment broke through a critical point, reaching a brand new height——
Totem Level!
He slowly clenched his fist, feeling the ocean-like surge of power within him.
As the Demon Race, they don’t need to comprehend Laws like other races——
Demonic Qi itself is their Law.
The purity and quantity of Demonic Qi directly determine their prowess.
And Mi Zhan utilized the highest-grade Demon Stone from the Demon Abyss.
Plus one critical factor:
Top-tier races, when transformed into the Demon Race, gain a qualitative leap in strength.
Thus, Mi Zhan was even stronger than when normally ascending to Totem Level!
"Blood Ancestor!"
Mi Zhan gazed down at Lilith, his eyes full of disdain, "What do you have to resist me now?"
However, surprisingly, Lilith was not panicked; instead, the corner of her mouth curled into a meaningful smile.
She clearly remembered Gu Xing’s goal for this trip—to break through to Monarch Level.
And to achieve this, what was most crucial was needing Totem-level demons as a catalyst.
And now...
A Totem-level demon had arrived, hadn’t it?
Lilith’s gaze locked onto the fully demonized Mi Zhan...
This was the best prey!
Yet she couldn’t kill him herself.
Although she could crush Mi Zhan with Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent enhancement, the energy gained from a Blood Covenant is hardly beneficial to Gu Xing.
And this is the limitation of the Blood Covenant compared to the Beast Taming Contract!
The Beast Taming Contract can form a complementary relationship between Guardian Beast and Beast Master, which the Blood Covenant can’t achieve!
Thus, Lilith wanted to establish a further Beast Taming Contract with Gu Xing!
After Mi Zhan’s thrill passed, he sharply noticed something amiss...
Seeing him ascend to Totem Level, Lilith didn’t show fear; instead, she bore a strange smile.
That made him furrow his brows unconsciously.
Mi Zhan’s brows furrowed involuntarily.
Why did this Blood Ancestor seem so confident?
Could there be some trump card hidden?!
He felt Lilith’s Level and was utterly convinced that this Blood Ancestor was just Half-Step Totem Level!
She was definitely not his match!
Though...
"Blood Clone!"
Lilith’s aura suddenly surged.
Four clones with 80% of her power instantly appeared beside her.
At the same time, watching the entire battle unfold, Gu Xing immediately applied the Soul Devouring Talent enhancement to Lilith.
Lilith’s aura suddenly skyrocketed!
But unexpectedly, she didn’t directly attack Mi Zhan. Instead, she commanded the four blood clones to join the battlefield where Liu Li was.
With the addition of these clones, the Half-step Totem level battlefield instantly gained an overwhelming advantage.
Liu Li seized the opportunity to withdraw, landing lightly beside Lilith.
And seeing Liu Li arrive at her side, Lilith subtly spoke:
"This traitor is all yours. After all, he’s the one who led the Blazing Angels Race into this disaster."
"It’s most fitting for you to end him." Lilith’s voice carried a hint of murderous intent.
Liu Li nodded slightly.
This arrangement was precisely what Gu Xing had planned ahead.
For Lilith to force Mi Zhan’s demonization, then let Liu Li take him down.
Allowing Gu Xing to successfully ascend to Monarch Level!
However...
Liu Li’s strength was still greatly inferior to Mi Zhan’s!
She needed Lilith’s help!
Liu Li turned her gaze to Lilith.
And seeing this, Lilith’s Blood Law spiraled around Liu Li like flowing water, swiftly transforming into an exquisite blood-colored battle armor.
This was the manifestation of Lilith’s Power of Laws!
Only under the enhancement of Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent could Lilith’s Law reach such a fine level.
Mysterious patterns flowed over the Blood Armor, each containing Totem-level Power of Laws.
As Blood Armor donned, Liu Li’s aura soared higher and higher, finally reaching a level where she could contend with the demonized Mi Zhan!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 264: Liu Li, Calm Down!
chapters.content:
Chapter 264: Chapter 264: Liu Li, Calm Down!
In Gu Xing’s vision.
Liu Li is surrounded by two types of laws...
The outer layer is the blood-colored battle armor formed by Lilith’s Blood Law, while the inner one is Liu Li’s own terrifying Fire of Destruction blazing fiercely.
If not for Gu Xing releasing the Soul Devouring Talent to help Lilith enhance her Law Control level, Lilith definitely wouldn’t have succeeded in perfectly merging the Blood Law with Liu Li.
And after the Blood Law fused with Liu Li, the first change was the enhancement of Liu Li’s various attributes.
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form]
[Power: 70,000→560,000→6,560,000]
[Constitution: 70,000→560,000→6,560,000]
[Spirit: 70,000→560,000→6,560,000]
[Speed: 70,000→560,000→6,560,000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form, Destruction Domain, Destruction Law]
With the dual enhancement of the Destruction Angel Form and Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent, Liu Li’s Basic Attributes have already broken through to 560,000 points.
However, even more astonishing is the Blood Law cast by Lilith...
This power of the law brought an additional six million point attribute increase to Liu Li!
When attributes cross the five million threshold, it signifies officially stepping into the Totem Level.
And Mi Zhan, after his fall into demonization, has attributes reaching an intimidating tens of millions level.
Currently, Liu Li is vastly outmatched in attributes compared to Mi Zhan.
But with Lilith’s Blood Law and her own Destruction Law, Liu Li barely has the strength to contest with Mi Zhan.
Mi Zhan stared at Liu Li, enveloped entirely in Blood Armor, a hint of bloody light flashing in his scarlet eyes.
After falling to the Demon Race, he could rely on killing races in the Alternate Space to enhance his strength.
And this is the reason for the irreconcilable conflict between the races in the Alternate Space and the Demon Race.
Looking at Liu Li with twelve wings behind her, Mi Zhan slowly opened his mouth:
"It’s truly surprising! You lost your wings back then, yet you were able to recover!"
"Now, you’ve grown to the peak of the Angel Race!"
His gaze swept over Liu Li’s twelve radiant wings, his tone full of shock.
In the history of the Angel Race, even the most outstanding ancestors only barely reached the ten-wing level after a lifetime of struggles.
And here, Liu Li has managed to break through to the legendary twelve wings at the Commander Level!
However, Liu Li had no response to these words, her eyes held only pure killing intent.
This traitor before her had divided the Angel Race, causing the War Angels and Blazing Angels to turn against each other, and left her father missing!
The flames of anger burned in her heart, and the Fire of Destruction grew even more intense.
A longsword blazing with crimson fire slowly formed in her hand, the blade trembling as it emitted a hum.
Yet, upon witnessing this, Mi Zhan’s face showed not a hint of panic.
He was now at Totem Level...
How could he possibly be threatened by a Commander Level Blazing Angel?
But...
Mi Zhan had no immediate intention to take down Liu Li.
Having just entered the Totem Level, he’s aware of the power’s true strength.
Currently, he is the strongest combatant on this battlefield!
Thus, he didn’t mind spending a little time appreciating the despair on this angel’s face.
Looking at Liu Li, whose appearance resembled that man, a twisted smile emerged on Mi Zhan’s demon-pattern-covered face:
"Your father was too foolish. If not for using the entire Angel Race’s lives as leverage back then, we truly might not have been able to make him disappear."
"Boom——!!!"
Liu Li’s Fire of Destruction surged violently around her, she abruptly lifted her head, her icy gaze locked onto Mi Zhan:
"What happened back then?!"
"Where is my father?!"
This was her last concern in her heart.
The Blazing Angels Race had already been successfully rescued; now the obsession in her heart remains one...
To find her missing father!
Seeing Liu Li finally ask, a proud and sinister smile appeared on Mi Zhan’s face, marred with Demonic Qi:
"Your father... is long dead!"
He deliberately stretched the tone, relishing in Liu Li’s pained expression:
"Back then, I meticulously planned——first poison him, and then joined several Totem-level Demon Clan to besiege him."
"I have to say, indeed, the combat strength of you Blazing Angels is terrifying, even in such circumstances, your father nearly slaughtered all Demon Race."
Mi Zhan’s tone suddenly turned cold: "Though ultimately, he couldn’t hold out."
These words were half-true.
He indeed conspired with the Demon Race to set a trap, but the truth is——
That man, even while poisoned and surrounded, managed to crush all the strong Demon Race warriors.
Even Mi Zhan, hiding in the shadows, was discovered, nearly losing his life on the spot.
Just as that man was about to deal a fatal blow, the Void within the battleground suddenly collapsed.
The man, in his final moment, was swept into the chaotic space stream, enabling Mi Zhan’s fortunate escape.
Since he did not witness the man’s death with his own eyes, he does not dare...
He is terrified of the man’s sudden return without any leverage in his hand.
But...
After so much time, gradually, he started to feel relieved.
Being swept into the space stream, even a Totem-level Blazing Angel has an extremely low survival rate!
And after all this time without any news...
That man must be dead, lost in the Void stream!
Upon hearing these words, Liu Li’s eyes instantly turned blood red.
Despite her vague memory of her father, the impression was not very deep.
He was either in battle or on the way to battle, always safeguarding the entire Angel Race.
But...
The bond buried deep in her bloodline was never severed.
The two shared the deepest blood bond.
"You....?"
Liu Li’s voice trembled with supreme rage, her aura showing slight disarray.
Witnessing this, Mi Zhan’s ugly face revealed a sly smile of triumph.
Though he had the advantage in strength, having just completed demonization, he had not yet fully adapted to the power.
If he could infuriate Liu Li, causing her to lose her composure, it would be all the better.
In the sky above, Gu Xing, who had been observing the battlefield closely, suddenly changed his expression.
Currently, Liu Li’s various attributes are inherently inferior to Mi Zhan’s.
Her sole advantage now is the uniqueness of her own laws.
Additionally, with the protection of the Blood Law, Liu Li can attack freely without needing to defend.
But if Liu Li cannot remain calm...
Her chances of winning this battle would be extremely low!
Without a moment of hesitation, Gu Xing decisively issued the order:
"Fei Yue, quickly, take me to Liu Li’s side!"
The moment Fei Yue heard Gu Xing’s order, she instantly vanished into the Void.
Reappearing, the two were already beside Liu Li.
The moment they appeared, Gu Xing instantly spoke up:
"Liu Li, calm down!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 265: Outmatched?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 265: Chapter 265: Outmatched?!
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s steady voice, Liu Li’s reason, consumed by rage, gradually returned, and her golden eyes, burning with the Fire of Destruction, cleared once more.
"Liu Li, think carefully. If your father really got into trouble..."
"Why did he imprison your aunt? Why could the Sea Race still encounter your father?"
Liu Li took a deep breath, and the restless Destruction Energy around her gradually calmed down.
She was not foolish!
With Gu Xing’s reminder, she quickly realized this was Mi Zhan’s scheme!
She looked at Gu Xing, her eyes becoming firm again:
"Master, I understand! I will no longer be swayed by emotions!"
Seeing Liu Li regain her composure, Gu Xing finally felt a bit relieved.
Anger would only cause Liu Li to reveal flaws, providing no benefit, while calmness offered her a glimmer of hope for victory.
Mi Zhan examined the suddenly appeared Gu Xing, and his demonized pupils slightly contracted.
This human is Liu Li’s Beast Master!
Was it him who helped Liu Li restore her wings?!
His gaze swept across the battlefield...
With combat power comparable to the Ghost Race and Elf Clan at Half-step Totem level!
"This human..."
Mi Zhan’s eyes were filled with fear.
A human who could contract with so many top-tier races, with each Guardian Beast having heavenly talent.
Even the seemingly weakest Qingqiu Fox Race showcased remarkable brilliance on the Monarch level battlefield.
However, the Qingqiu Fox Race was never adept at combat; they excelled at team coordination.
Mi Zhan narrowed his eyes.
If all these Guardian Beasts were allowed to grow, paired with this human’s bizarre talent ability...
Mi Zhan couldn’t help but gasp:
By then, within the same level, who could rival them?!
At this moment, Liu Li’s aura had already surged to the peak, and the Power of Destruction flowed ceaselessly on the surface of the Blood Armor.
She suddenly raised her hand and shouted clearly:
"Destruction Domain!"
A blood-red domain instantly unfolded, completely enveloping Mi Zhan within.
Within the domain, the Fire of Destruction burned wildly, causing the space to twist and collapse.
Yet Mi Zhan merely sneered, and the Demonic Qi around him erupted like a tsunami!
"Boom——!!!"
The terrifying Demonic Qi instantly filled the entire Destruction Domain, and the two forces clashed fiercely.
Within just a few breaths, Liu Li’s domain could no longer withstand and burst apart, the counterforce causing a thread of golden blood to ooze from her lips.
"Such childish tricks, don’t take them out to embarrass yourself."
Mi Zhan stood proudly at the center of the Demonic Qi, his face full of disdain.
Although this angel’s talent was incredibly terrifying...
It had not fully matured yet!
For now, there was still a huge gap between them!
Thankfully...
The Blood Law released by Lilith instantly absorbed the blood sprayed by Liu Li.
Then, it was fed back to restore Liu Li’s damaged body.
This is also one of the traits of Blood Law!
As long as Liu Li was not dealt a fatal blow in an instant, with Blood Law, she could slowly recover.
At this moment, Liu Li’s expression grew increasingly grave.
Mi Zhan’s power was arguably the strongest. She had ever faced.
Even that Nine Nether Centipede King could not possibly be a match for Mi Zhan.
"Can you do it?"
Lilith’s lazy voice carried a hint of teasing, "Do you want to switch to me?"
She elegantly stretched out her waist, her crimson eyes full of calm, not taking Mi Zhan seriously at all.
But...
Lilith certainly had such qualifications!
If blessed by Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent, Lilith’s power would be nearly on par with Mi Zhan.
And in battles between Totem level powerhouses, the key factor lies in Law Control Level.
With her mastery in Blood Law, she is fully capable of slowly wearing Mi Zhan to death.
"It would be problematic if he adapts to the power of the Demon Race." Lilith seemingly reminded easily.
Gu Xing naturally understood this.
Mi Zhan was still in the adaptation phase, his power had not yet reached its peak.
But as time passes, his control over Demonic Qi would become more and more proficient, making Liu Li’s chances of winning increasingly slim.
But if Lilith were to step in...
Gu Xing’s plan to advance to the Monarch level would be ruined again.
Yet he also knew, at the Commander level...
Trying to bypass so many levels to kill a Totem level enemy was somewhat unrealistic.
Having Lilith use Blood Law to help Liu Li was the only possible successful method Gu Xing could think of.
"Wait a little longer." Gu Xing’s eyes were fixed on the battlefield, "If the situation changes, I’ll have you intervene."
Lilith said nothing more.
And at this moment.
Mi Zhan suddenly transformed into a black lightning bolt, enveloped in overwhelming Demonic Qi, charging straight at Liu Li!
Facing this thunderous offensive, Liu Li knew she couldn’t take it head-on.
Her body glimmered, instantly switching to the Destruction Angel Form——
Her blood-red wings turned into dazzling gold, and the violent aura of destruction shifted into the holy Power of Guardian.
A golden barrier appeared out of thin air, precisely blocking Mi Zhan’s lethal attack!
"Guardian Angels?!"
Mi Zhan’s pupils constricted intensely, his face filled with disbelief.
It was clearly the ultimate form of War Angels he had dreamed of!
What shocked him even more was that this angel also had a blood-red form...
He suddenly seemed to realize something, his face turning extremely unsightly.
"Destruction Angel!"
Mi Zhan almost squeezed these four words through clenched teeth.
The ultimate form of Blazing Angels, a counterpart to the guardian form he pursued.
These two legendary forms appeared on a single angel!
Extreme envy turned Mi Zhan’s eyes blood red in an instant:
"Why... why is heaven so favored to you!"
He roared madly, the Demonic Qi erupting like a volcano, "Die for me!"
This attack contained all his resentment and power, causing space to twist and deform.
Liu Li also realized that this attack was not easy to handle.
Without hesitation, she activated Divine Protection, the only skill capable of fully blocking Mi Zhan’s attack.
"Boom——!!!"
Amid the deafening explosion, the barrier trembled violently but remained unscathed.
Mi Zhan looked at this familiar ability, a hideous smirk on his lips:
"Divine Protection... It sure is nostalgic."
He also had this skill.
However, having fallen into the Demon Race, this skill could no longer be used.
He slowly raised his Demonic Qi-wreathed hands: "But if you can block one, can you block a second one?"
Even more terrifying Demonic Qi condensed in his palms, this attack was clearly many times more dreadful than before!
And at this moment, Lilith was ready to make her move.
Currently, Liu Li was still too strained facing Mi Zhan.
Gu Xing’s brows knitted tighter and tighter.
He initially believed that with the blessing of Lilith’s Blood Law, it would be enough to bridge the level gap, but now it seemed it was indeed too idealistic.
Without laws comprehended by oneself, it was ultimately difficult to exert full power.
At the center of the battlefield, the world in Liu Li’s eyes seemed to slow down.
She could clearly see Mi Zhan’s grotesque visage, feel the suffocating pressure of the Demonic Qi.
Knowing she couldn’t compete, yet unwilling to back down——
This culprit who caused the division of the Angel Race and made her father disappear, if she couldn’t personally bring him to justice...
"Crack——"
Liu Li’s fists clenched, turning pale, her nails deeply embedded in her palms.
Golden blood dripped through her fingers, creating a strange glow on the Blood Armor.
Is she really going to admit defeat?
If only she could be a little stronger...
If only she could truly master these two forms...
At the instant this thought crossed her mind, the Divine Pattern within her suddenly trembled violently!
An unprecedented understanding welled up within her!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 266: Mi Zhan’s Defeat and Demise!
chapters.content:
Chapter 266: Chapter 266: Mi Zhan’s Defeat and Demise!
"Buzz——!!!"
An enigmatic sound of a Divine Pattern vibration seemed to pierce through time and space, and the entire world fell into a bizarre standstill at this moment.
Two entirely different radiances, golden and blood-red, simultaneously blossomed from Liu Li’s body—
The holy golden brilliance of the Guardian Angels and the scarlet blood light of the Destruction Angels, miraculously began to merge!
Under Gu Xing’s astonished gaze, the originally distinct two Powers of Law were generating some kind of incredulous resonance.
The Fire of Destruction and the Holy Light of Protection not only did not repel each other, but instead rotated slowly like a yin-yang fish, forming an unprecedented vortex of laws.
"How is this possible..."
Gu Xing muttered to himself.
He clearly remembered that previously, each time Liu Li switched forms, she could only utilize the corresponding single law.
But now, the two incompatible laws perfectly coexist!
Liu Li’s aura once again escalated under the augmentation of this force.
The two laws, Destruction and Guardian, circulated around her as if they had found an exquisite balance.
Gu Xing suddenly realized:
This might indeed be the true function of the Divine Pattern in Liu Li’s body...
Not a simple switch of forms, but achieving a higher level of fusion of two ultimate forms!
At the same time.
The golden Power of Guardian condensed into a light shield filled with holy runes in Liu Li’s left hand.
Simultaneously, the scarlet Power of Destruction in her right hand transformed into a longsword burning with black flames.
The most shocking change happened on Liu Li’s wings—
The right wing gradually stained with blazing blood-red, while the left wing turned into brilliant gold.
These two entirely different colors did not conflict; instead, they formed a peculiar harmony.
Moreover, on Liu Li’s forehead, a golden Divine Pattern abruptly emerged.
"Divine Pattern Awakening?!"
Lilith, upon seeing this scene, exhibited a trace of horror in her gaze.
She always knew Liu Li had a Divine Pattern.
But...
To specifically utilize the power of the Divine Pattern, one would need to reach the Totem Level.
And Liu Li now...
Merely at the Commander Level, she could utilize the power of the Divine Pattern.
For all she knew, it was also upon reaching the Totem Level that she first managed to harness the Divine Pattern’s power.
Even if Liu Li had a talent superior to hers, could she defy the heavens this much?
Meanwhile, Mi Zhan’s gaze was fiercely locked on the Divine Pattern on Liu Li’s forehead, jealousy almost materializing into tangible flames:
"So the Divine Pattern is with you!"
He instantly understood everything—
That man indeed left a backup plan, passing the most precious Divine Pattern of the Angel Race to his daughter!
No wonder this group of Blazing Angels insisted on guarding Liu Li’s hiding place, precisely to prevent him from obtaining the Divine Pattern.
Not only Mi Zhan but even Liu Xia, amid the battle, noticed the situation on the battlefield, and a sliver of shock appeared in her eyes.
How could Liu Li have the Divine Pattern?
She remembered her brother had taken the Divine Pattern with him back then.
Where did this Divine Pattern come from!
Amid the shocking silence of the crowd, the Divine Pattern on Liu Li’s forehead suddenly burst forth with blinding golden radiance.
When she slowly opened her eyes, the left eye flowed with holy golden light, while the right eye burned with scarlet blood light.
The two entirely different laws, Guardian and Destruction, coexisted perfectly within her!
Liu Li’s gaze slowly shifted to Mi Zhan.
In the instant those heterochromatic eyes locked onto him, Mi Zhan felt as though all the blood in his body froze.
It was a fear arising from the instinct of life, as though being stared down by the most terrifying existence between heaven and earth.
He shook his head madly and roared:
"Impossible! You’re merely a Commander-Level; how could you span such a vast gap....."
"This must be an illusion!"
Mi Zhan roared with blood-red eyes, the Demonic Qi uncontrollably running rampant, "You’re just an abandoned waste, how could you be my opponent!"
In his hysterical screams, he transformed into a black lightning bolt charging straight at Liu Li.
However, Liu Li at this moment had already thoroughly integrated the two laws—
Though the essence of power did not mix, under the harmonization of the Divine Pattern, an astounding resonance effect occurred!
"Clang——!"
Liu Li merely raised her left hand’s Shield of Protection lightly, and Mi Zhan’s full-force strike was easily stopped as if hitting an ancient mountain.
The golden runes flowing on the shield’s surface didn’t even produce a single crack.
And in the moment of blocking, the Sword of Destruction in her right hand had already traced an enigmatic trajectory.
Where the sword edge passed, the space crumbled inch by inch, the destruction flame dragging an arc in the air!
Mi Zhan frantically triggered the Demonic Qi trying to condense a shield, but before the Destruction Law, all defenses were rendered null.
That longsword burning with scarlet flames seemed to contain the purest destructive force between heaven and earth; even the dense Demonic Qi touched the sword edge and instantaneously annihilated!
"Crack——!!!"
Accompanied by a teeth-grinding shattering sound, the Demonic Qi shield Mi Zhan had condensed was torn apart like thin paper.
Under Mi Zhan’s terrified gaze, the Sword of Destruction continued with unabated momentum, precisely slashing towards his wings.
"Rip——"
Amid the sound of flesh tearing, one of Mi Zhan’s wings broke as expected!
Black Demon Blood gushed out, and he let out a mournful scream, clutching the severed wing as he staggered backward.
The intense pain finally made him sober—
The strength of the Commander-Level Blazing Angel before him had surpassed his Totem-level Demon Clan!
Though there were reasons for the Blood Ancestor’s help, yet...
Currently, he was indeed not Liu Li’s opponent!
Clutching his bleeding severed wing where Demon Blood continuously seeped from, Mi Zhan’s eyes finally showed the intent to retreat.
Continuing to fight would undoubtedly result in death, but if he fled—
With his Totem Level speed, no one on the scene could match him!
Once this thought arose, it became impossible to suppress.
Seeing Mi Zhan wounded, Liu Li’s eyes showed not an ounce of sympathy:
Her own wing was lost to the hands of the War Angel Race before.
Now, she wanted Mi Zhan to experience the same pain.
"Mi Zhan, you won’t escape! I’m going to use you to mourn all the members of the Angel Race who died because of you."
However, Mi Zhan suddenly burst into maniacal laughter:
"Mourn the Angel Race? What do they have to do with me? They’re just a bunch of weaklings!"
In the next moment, his voice suddenly turned cold:
"Besides... do you really think you can kill me?"
Just as Liu Li thought he would fight to the death, Mi Zhan’s remaining single wing explosively unleashed monstrous Demonic Qi!
But unexpectedly, this attack wasn’t directed at Liu Li; it was a feint and then used the recoil to retreat rapidly!
"Whoosh——"
The speed of a Totem Level fully erupted, Mi Zhan shot into the sky like a streak of black light, in an instant, he had already rushed out hundreds of meters!
Gu Xing could only stare in shock.
Hearing Mi Zhan’s harsh words just now, he thought Mi Zhan still had some trump card, thus he was on guard.
But unexpectedly...
His trump card was to turn and run!
But.....
Gu Xing looked a bit grim.
With Mi Zhan’s current strength, if he was determined to flee, they truly had no way to stop him.
But, just at this moment.
The space in front of Mi Zhan suddenly tore apart!
A rift, deeper and darker than Mi Zhan’s Demonic Qi, appeared out of nowhere, the terrifying aura emanating from it made everyone tremble.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 267: The Terrifying Bone Demon!
chapters.content:
Chapter 267: Chapter 267: The Terrifying Bone Demon!
"Deserting in the heat of battle?!"
An extremely cold voice suddenly rang out, as if from the abyss of the netherworld.
Mi Zhan’s fleeing form abruptly froze mid-air, even his blood seemed to freeze at that moment.
He struggled to move his eyes, looking towards the source of the voice.
He saw a bone-white skeleton standing before a void fissure, encircled by demonic qi that was a hundred times purer than his own!
Icy blue soul fire danced within its hollow eye sockets, merely gazing at it made Mi Zhan feel a chill in his very bloodline.
The strict hierarchy of the Demon Race was displayed vividly at this moment.
Without hesitation, Mi Zhan lowered his head, his voice trembling noticeably:
"My lord..."
Faced with the Upper Demon Race, resistance would only lead to a more miserable death.
Yet the bone demon allowed no chance for explanation.
A white bony claw instantly clutched Mi Zhan’s throat, the terrifying demonic qi directly sealed his entire body’s power.
"I despise cowards who flee from battle."
The bone demon’s soul fire flickered violently, its voice as cold as ten thousand year ice, "Even if you must die, it should be on the battlefield!"
Mi Zhan was horrified to discover that his totem-level strength was as powerless as a child in front of this bone demon!
Through the flickering icy blue soul fire, he clearly saw the purest intent to kill—
This bone demon truly intended to kill him!
"My lord! I still have use!"
Mi Zhan desperately struggled and roared, "I can serve the Demon Race!"
A hint of mockery flashed in the bone demon’s hollow eyes.
The angels’ betrayal was merely a temporary expedient by the Demon God, and once the divine pattern was in hand, this kind of inferior demon formed later had no value.
"Serve the Demon Race?"
The bone demon emitted a screeching sound of bones grinding, "You are not worthy!"
The demonic qi of the Demon Abyss was limited, and such demons, requiring large amounts of demonic qi for nourishment, were mere parasites wasting resources in the eyes of the true demon race.
Not to mention, demonized creatures were at the bottom of the demon hierarchy, not even qualified to act as cannon fodder!
The bone demon’s claws suddenly tightened, a terrifying suction exploded from its palm.
Mi Zhan was horrified to find that the demonic qi within him was uncontrollably flowing towards the other.
This was his other purpose all along.
To absorb the demonic qi of this newly minted totem-level to enhance his own power!
"No... no..."
Mi Zhan despairingly felt his strength rapidly drain away, the once ample demonic qi was being sucked dry.
He had thought that by siding with the demon race, he would reach the pinnacle of his life.
But unexpectedly...
He was nothing more than a pawn in someone else’s game from the start!
At this moment, a hint of regret appeared in Mi Zhan’s eyes.
If he hadn’t chosen the path with the demon race, would the result have been different?!
However, there was no antidote for regret in this world. After the demonic qi was exhausted, his life force was next!
Gu Xing gazed at the suddenly appearing bone demon, his face unprecedentedly grave.
The oppressive aura emitted by this demon was several times more terrifying than Mi Zhan earlier!
Instinctively, he activated his investigation ability, but the information he received made his heart sink:
[Bone Demon]
[Level: Totem Second Transition]
[Talent: Demon God]
[Power: ???]
[Constitution: ???]
[Spirit: ???]
[Speed: ???]
[Skills: ???]
Except for level and talent, the consistent question marks meant the opponent’s strength had already far surpassed the investigation limit.
He knew that after breaking through to the peak Commander, his investigation range should cover attributes of tens of millions.
But upon seeing the note "Totem Second Transition", Gu Xing immediately understood.
As Lilith had said, the Totem level is divided into nine transitions, each transition a qualitative leap in strength.
Above the Ninth Transition is the pseudo-god realm; even the strongest Elf Queen in the Alternate Space only reached Totem Seventh Transition.
From this demon, Gu Xing also realized that the Totem level was completely different from the previous Monarch and Commander levels.
Every transition was a step away from the mundane, stepping into the realm of gods.
The Elf Queen at only Totem Seventh Transition was able to span time with her designs, so what about the pseudo-gods beyond Totem?
An immense pressure surged within Gu Xing’s heart.
The ten great Demon Gods of the demon race, each a being beyond the Totem level!
At this moment.
Liy stood immediately in front of Gu Xing, her twelve wings radiating golden-red light simultaneously.
She could clearly sense that this bone demon was far more dangerous than all previous enemies.
Lilith also discarded her lazy posture, her blood-red eyes full of vigilance.
She slowly unfolded her Blood Domain, her voice low:
"This is troublesome... This is not some half-baked demon like Mi Zhan, but a true abyssal bone demon."
As the bone demon noticed so many gazes focused on him, he slowly turned around, his hollow eyes scanning the scene, finally settling on Gu Xing.
In those dancing soul fires, an undisguised greed and surprise appeared.
"Human, you’ve actually managed to gather eight divine patterns..."
The bone demon’s voice carried incredulous astonishment.
Logically, divine patterns would recognize their own masters.
Generally, getting the approval of one divine pattern was an enormous stroke of fortune.
But this human...
Not only did he obtain two divine patterns, but even his Guardian Beast almost had one divine pattern per beast.
If such an existence were to grow, he would surely become a major threat to the demon race.
Yet...
The bone demon’s jawbone split into a sinister arc:
"Since I’ve come across you, it ends here."
He casually tossed the drained Mi Zhan aside.
The once invincible Clan Leader of the Angel Race crashed into the rock wall like a rag and, after coughing up several mouthfuls of black blood, fell silent, meeting such a tragic end.
"Now that the bothersome pest has been cleared."
The bone demon elegantly flexed his bone-white fingers and slowly moved forward, "Let me have some fun with you."
Eight divine patterns!
If he were to bring these divine patterns to Lord Demon God, the reward he would receive...
Unimaginable!
He might just break through to High Tier Totem!
However, to obtain all this...
The prerequisite is...
His gaze locked onto Gu Xing.
First, he must eliminate this human!
With each step the bone demon took, the void quaked a bit more.
The pressure of the Totem Second Transition was palpable, almost suffocating everyone.
At this moment, Gu Xing knew he couldn’t afford any negligence.
He swiftly commanded Lilith to retract the Blood Law!
Now that Lilith was the strongest, naturally, all strength should be concentrated on Lilith.
At Gu Xing’s signal, Lilith took the initiative, fully unleashing the Blood Domain.
Yet the bone demon simply raised a hand, the white bone fingers easily tearing through the blood red barrier!
"Ants!" The bone demon emitted a sneer.
He was personally chosen as the vanguard by the ten Lord Demon Gods.
His strength, among the Demon Gods, was also considered top tier.
"Human, obediently hand over the divine patterns, and I can petition Lord Demon God to help you become the first below the Demon God!"
A trace of sincerity appeared in the bone demon’s eyes.
He seriously meant what he said.
Gu Xing’s talent was the most terrifying he had ever seen, enough to rival even Lord Demon God.
Therefore, his offer to help Gu Xing become the first below Demon God was not just empty words.
However...
Gu Xing had no interest whatsoever in this offer.
His mind was constantly racing with thoughts on how to break this deadlock.
Totem Second Transition...
How to deal with such a terrifying enemy?!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 268: Dead End!
chapters.content:
Chapter 268: Chapter 268: Dead End!
But the bone demon gave Gu Xing no chance to think.
With the powerful attributes of the second totem transformation, he almost instantly bypassed Lilith and appeared not far in front of Gu Xing.
The best way to deal with a beastmaster is to bypass his guardian beasts and solve the beastmaster himself.
As a top demon in the Demon Abyss, how could he not understand such a simple truth?!
As long as he kills this human, then even if the remaining guardian beasts are strong...
Their power would be significantly weakened!
Although he currently held the advantage, he still chose the most prudent approach.
Lord Demon God’s plan doesn’t allow for the slightest mishap!
He couldn’t take risks, even if there was only a one in ten thousand chance of letting this human escape, it would be an irretrievable failure.
At this moment.
Gu Xing watched as the bone demon suddenly appeared not far from him.
A look of seriousness flashed in his eyes.
