Too strong!
The power of this bone demon completely surpassed that of his guardian beasts.
Even though Liu Li could now use the power of the Divine Pattern, she still didn’t stand a chance against this bone demon.
Not to mention the other guardian beasts!
Lilith was now the only one able to contend with this bone demon.
However, to contend and to defeat are two different concepts.
From the moment Lilith’s Blood Domain was shattered easily by this bone demon, Gu Xing could tell...
The strength of this bone demon was much more than just a bit stronger than Lilith.
But Lilith’s Divine Pattern control was high, so although she was not a match for this bone demon, it was not easy for him to kill Lilith either.
The only thing he didn’t expect was...
This bone demon would be so decisive and choose to attack him.
This situation caught him off guard.
For a long time, under the protection of powerful guardian beasts like Liu Li, it was as hard as reaching for the sky for enemies to get close, let alone directly threaten him.
But...
Today was vastly different.
This bone demon...
His power far exceeded his guardian beasts, and they simply didn’t have the strength to stop him.
"Master, beware!"
Fei Yue, who was beside Gu Xing, saw the bone demon approaching and immediately unleashed the purple Void Power.
She wanted to escape with Gu Xing immediately.
However, the bone demon just let out a disdainful sneer and lightly clenched his white bony hand.
"Buzz!"
The surrounding space instantly froze, and the dense demonic Qi formed an absolute blockade, severing Fei Yue’s connection with the Void!
Reaching Totem Level allows manipulation of a space through laws.
Although the demon race cannot use laws, their use of demonic Qi has the same effect.
Fei Yue’s face turned pale; this was the first time she encountered an enemy who could completely suppress the Void Power.
Gu Xing decisively withdrew Fei Yue into his Beast Taming Space.
It was not the time for bravado; staying would only endanger the girl.
And the bone demon, seeing Gu Xing’s action, made no move to stop him.
Although the guardian beast also possessed a Divine Pattern, as long as the beastmaster was controlled...
The guardian beasts would comply and hand over the Divine Pattern.
"Human, think carefully, you are still young and have a great future ahead of you."
"What a pity it would be to die here!"
"Join the demon race, I promise you and that War Angel will receive far different treatment."
"Even I can be your subordinate!"
"By then, with Lord Demon God’s support and my assistance, you could not only rule this Alternate Space but also surpass the totem limit and reach the legendary... Pseudo-God Realm."
The bone demon looked at Gu Xing, his tone full of temptation.
He believed no one could resist such a temptation.
After all, the highest level that can be reached in this Alternate Space is just the ninth Totem level.
Without external help, breaking through the Totem Level and advancing further is impossible!
But...
This demon race underestimated Gu Xing.
Although he wasn’t an indigenous person of this world, the various experiences he had gone through during this period...
had already made him consider himself a part of this world.
All races avoided letting the Divine Pattern fall into the hands of the demon race. If he were to join them and give it away...
Not to mention others, even he himself couldn’t forgive such an act.
However, the bone demon mentioned something beyond the totem...
Gu Xing took the opportunity to ask his inner doubts.
"If I join the demon race, how can you guarantee that I could surpass the demon race?"
He now had a good grasp of the entire Alternate Space.
Except for the most mysterious Time Spirit Race and Dragon Race.
He had already been in contact with the other top races.
As far as he knew, almost no race had produced an existence beyond the totem level.
According to the bone demon’s words, it seemed that the demon race had a method to help them break the shackles and reach beyond the Totem Realm.
"Or put it another way, how do you demons plan to help me break through to the Pseudo-God Realm?"
Upon hearing Gu Xing’s question, the bone demon instinctively wanted to answer:
"As long as you can become..."
But halfway through the sentence, it stopped abruptly.
The bone demon’s soul fire suddenly flickered violently, and the white jawbone made a harsh grinding sound.
He realized he almost divulged one of the core secrets of the demon race...
The method to break through the totem limit is a top secret unknown even to many high-level demons!
"Cunning human..."
The bone demon’s voice suddenly turned cold as the demonic Qi surged wildly around him.
He regretted this human’s talent and thus wanted to persuade him to join Lord Demon God.
But this human did not appreciate the favor!
A terrifying demonic Qi condensed into a jet-black vortex between his bone claws, distorting and shattering space under this force.
Since this human chose a dead-end road, he didn’t mind sending him on his way.
However, just as the bone demon was about to strike, Lilith’s blood-colored domain suddenly contracted!
Taking advantage of the precious time Gu Xing gained, she had compressed the Blood Law to its limit.
The Blood Domain that initially permeated the battlefield now transformed into a blood-colored crystal ball just large enough to envelop the bone demon.
"Law compression?!"
For the first time, surprise tinged the bone demon’s voice.
The smaller the area affected by the law, the stronger the power it could unleash.
To compress the domain to this extent meant that this blood race’s grasp of the law had reached the level of the second totem transformation.
Under Lilith’s control, the compressed Blood Law completely enveloped the bone demon’s figure.
But no trace of joy appeared on Lilith’s face.
She could clearly feel that even with such efforts, it could only hold the opponent for a brief moment!
As expected.
"An ant’s struggle!"
As the bone demon’s voice echoed from within the Blood Domain...
A frenzy of black demonic Qi corroded the blood-colored barrier, causing the crystalline surface to expand violently, with countless cracks spreading like a web—
"Boom!!!"
In the deafening explosion, the blood-colored crystal ball shattered!
Amidst the scattering blood light, the bone demon’s figure reemerged.
Now, he was covered in a jet-black Demon Armor, with solidified demonic Qi burning like black flames!
The flickering soul fire in his eye sockets locked onto Lilith:
"I underestimated you... but unfortunately, you’re still too weak!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 269: Gu Xing’s Decision
chapters.content:
Chapter 269: Chapter 269: Gu Xing’s Decision
Seeing this scene, everyone’s expressions became grim.
The power of this Demon Race member was simply too strong.
Even with Lilith giving her all, she was no match for this Demon Race member.
Gu Xing clenched his fists tightly, his nails digging deep into his palms, his gaze fixed intently on the Demon Race member.
Right now, Lilith was his greatest trump card, but now...
Even Lilith couldn’t stop this Demon Race member at all!
At this moment, a trace of struggle flickered in his eyes.
He wasn’t a stubborn person.
He understood the saying "As long as there are green hills, one need not worry about firewood."
If he lost his life, everything else would be meaningless.
But if he fled...
His eyes swept over the entire Angel Race.
Now, the allied forces of the War Angels and the Demon Race had been almost completely annihilated, thanks to the efforts of the Blazing Angels and Lilith’s avatars.
Except for some War Angels who had little intention of siding with the Demon Race, who were spared by everyone...
All the other War Angels and Demon Race members, including those rebellious Alien Races, had been completely slaughtered!
This caused the entire Angel Race’s stronghold to be almost entirely drenched in blood.
At this moment, Vera, Qing Shuang, and Tushan Yueli quickly came to Gu Xing’s side.
Liu Xia also brought all the members of the Blazing Angels Race to Gu Xing’s side.
They too could see the terrifying nature of this Demon Race member.
At this moment.
Liu Xia walked up to Gu Xing, her voice heartbreakingly calm:
"Take your Guardian Beasts and leave. Staying here is of no use other than offering Divine Patterns to this Demon Race member."
"In a moment, we will burn our Life Force to try to hold back this Demon Race member. You take the Divine Patterns and leave; that way, the Angel Race can be considered to have contributed to the Alternate Space."
Hearing these words, Gu Xing’s heart was filled with turmoil.
The jade talisman given to him by the Ghost Clan Leader was in his Beast Taming Space.
With this treasure, he and his Guardian Beast would have no problem leaving here.
But, while he could leave, Liu Xia and the others...
His eyes swept over all the Blazing Angels preparing to face death.
Could he really abandon them and leave?
Liu Li also blocked in front of Gu Xing at this moment.
"Master, please take Vera and the others and leave! Liu Li can’t accompany you any longer."
The young girl who stood in front of Gu Xing was trembling slightly.
She didn’t want to be separated from her master.
But she couldn’t abandon her own kin.
So, even though her heart was filled with reluctance, she could only say these words.
Gu Xing was slightly taken aback, looking at the girl’s back.
This was the first time the young girl asked to leave his side.
And it would be the only time!
Gradually, Gu Xing snapped out of it, a faint smile appearing at the corner of his mouth, his gaze gradually became firm.
Leave?!
How could that be possible!!
He had sworn that he would never be separated from Liu Li.
And now...
If he backed down in the face of a powerful enemy, what kind of Beast Master would he still be, what kind of man?
He decisively took a step forward, grabbing Liu Li’s small hand.
"Don’t say foolish things. You are my Guardian Beast, and I am your Beast Master! No one will leave anyone!"
"Even if we are to leave, it must be after defeating this Demon Race member."
Gu Xing’s warm hand gently held Liu Li’s trembling fingers, the familiar warmth left the young girl momentarily stunned.
When she heard those words from her master, the tears in her golden eyes suddenly glowed with a brilliant light.
Indeed, this was her master!
No matter what difficulties lay ahead, he never had the slightest intention of backing down.
Liu Li tightly grasped his hand in return, the warmth from his fingertips sending a shiver through her very soul.
She turned to face the terrifying bone demon directly, twelve wings unfurling as she made her vow:
"Master, Liu Li is not only your sharpest sword—"
The Sword of Destruction coalesced in her right hand, a bloody flame soaring into the sky.
"But also your strongest shield!"
The Shield of Protection appeared in her left hand.
Her petite body stood straight, her voice ringing clearly across the battlefield:
"Anyone who wishes to harm you must first step over Liu Li’s dead body!"
At this moment, the fear of death vanished into smoke.
For her, the most terrifying thing was never dying in battle, but losing the one who gave her warmth and belonging.
Meanwhile, Qing Shuang and Vera stepped forward in unison, standing beside Liu Li.
Their decision was evident!
Determination reflected in Vera’s eyes:
"Master, it was you who woke Vera from eternal slumber, the life you bestowed is naturally meant to fight for you."
Qing Shuang silently activated her Domain, her pale fingers gathering Netherworld Ghost Qi.
Though she said nothing, her eyes, usually indifferent, burned with a loyalty more intense than words.
Seeing this scene, the bone demon let out a piercing laugh:
"Ridiculous camaraderie! This is merely a burden needed by the weak!"
"A true strongman—only needs absolute power!"
Before he finished speaking, his figure had already torn through space!
The terrifying power of his second-turn Totem Level exploded fully, and even light was consumed by the Demonic Qi wherever he passed.
This strike was clearly aimed to crush Gu Xing and his Guardian Beasts before him!
Seeing this scene, Lilith, the strongest among them, was the first to act.
A blood-red barrier appeared instantly on the bone demon’s path.
But the bone demon merely waved a claw lightly, and the blood-red barrier released by Lilith was easily shattered.
Meanwhile, Liu Xia led the Blazing Angels in creating a crimson barrier together.
However, the bone demon didn’t even pause, the wall of light collapsing amid the surge of Demonic Qi, leaving all the Blazing Angels heavily wounded!
And Qing Shuang and Vera were both skilled in offense, not defense.
Thus, both gave their all in an all-out attack.
But...
The strength they could muster now was only at a Half-step Totem Level, not even reaching the Totem Level.
Hence, they had no impact on this bone demon at the second-turn Totem Level.
With a casual strike from the bone demon, the two were sent flying like broken kites.
At this time, the bone demon spoke again:
"Human, I give you one last chance! As long as you are willing to side with the Demon Race, not only you and your Guardian Beast won’t die, I might even spare these Blazing Angels!"
But only Liu Li’s determined stance in front of Gu Xing responded to him.
The young girl opened her arms in front of Gu Xing, her eyes filled with the constantly shifting Guardian Laws:
"My master..."
"Will never bow to anyone!"
As Liu Li poured all her strength into defending, Gu Xing immersed all his Spiritual Power into the depths of his consciousness.
In his spiritual sea, two brilliant Divine Patterns hovered quietly.
This was the only way he thought of to break the deadlock.
Since Liu Li could awaken the power of Divine Patterns at the Commander Level, as a human inheritor, he ought to be able to do the same!
"If I fall here today, the lineage of the Human Race will end right here!"
He knew the Divine Patterns of the Human Race were special, and these two Divine Patterns had already developed their own intelligence.
But...
Under his outcry, the two Divine Patterns had no reaction.
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s eyes began to turn blood red.
If they didn’t react, he would force them to react.
The power of his Soul Devouring Talent instantly dyed his spiritual sea red, the violent spiritual power surging like a tsunami:
"Awaken immediately! Otherwise—we will perish together!"
Under this threat, the two Divine Patterns finally trembled violently!
At the same time.
The bone demon’s claws easily tore through Liu Li’s Guardian Law, and having already used Divine Protection, she could no longer resist.
"Pfft—!!"
Amid the heart-stopping sound of ripping, the bone claws pierced straight through Liu Li’s chest!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 270: Demon Dragon! Bone Fiend’s Trump Card!
chapters.content:
Chapter 270: Chapter 270: Demon Dragon! Bone Fiend’s Trump Card!
At this moment, the world suddenly fell into silence.
Lilith’s blood-red eyes contracted violently, Liu Xia’s wings froze instantly, and the breaths of both Vera and Qing Shuang halted simultaneously...
Everyone stared incredulously at that bone-white claw piercing through Liu Li’s chest.
This scene fiercely shocked everyone’s optic nerves.
Liu Li.... died?!
"Liu Li——!!!"
Liu Xia let out a heart-wrenching scream, her bloodstained ten wings flapping frantically, charging towards the bone demon regardless of anything.
Vera and Qing Shuang’s eyes also instantly turned crimson, and two distinctly different energies burst forth again!
They both knew Liu Li’s position in Gu Xing’s heart.
Although Gu Xing often said that all his Guardian Beasts were equal in front of him.
But, anyone could see....
Gu Xing had a special affection for Liu Li, who had been with him from the beginning.
But now...
The master’s most cherished Guardian Beast had actually fallen here!
"Damn it, Liu Li, how can you die here so easily!"
Vera’s voice quivered with extreme anger.
"Reincarnation!"
The emerald light in Vera’s eyes suddenly flared, and the power of the Demon Race she absorbed earlier crazily converged in her palm.
Reincarnation has three states: budding, growth, and withering.
With each cycle, Vera’s power steps into a new realm.
Previously, Vera was already in the growth stage.
And now...
Under the intense emotional impact, Vera directly broke through the limit.
Her body crossed directly over the withering state, completing the first reincarnation.
In contrast...
Her power increased significantly!
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Normal]
[Power: 60000→65000]
[Constitution: 60000→65000]
[Spirit: 80000→90000]
[Speed: 60000→65000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
At the instant of completing the first reincarnation, a startling wave of energy erupted from Vera’s body.
Apart from the Spiritual Attribute, all Basic Attributes instantly broke through the limit, reaching sixty-five thousand points!
And the Spiritual Attribute soared by ten thousand points, the soul strength achieving a qualitative leap.
You should know, this was just one cycle of reincarnation; as the number of cycles increases, Vera’s power will certainly reach a terrifying realm.
Moreover, after the reincarnation ends, all negative status are removed.
Thus, Vera’s previous negative status of being in heat also disappeared with this enhancement.
At this moment.
Vera concentrated all her life energy with not a shred reserved.
Though she often bickered with Liu Li and even couldn’t stand her before.
However...
Since waking, Liu Li had always been by her side.
They had long become accustomed to each other’s existence.
"You deserved to die!"
The emerald light soared into the sky, condensing a giant Elf Empress Illusion in the air.
This illusion vaguely resembled the Elf Empress.
As the illusion raised its hand, the plants within a hundred miles withered at a visible speed, all life energy was furiously extracted.
This recklessness would render this land barren for a century, but Vera could no longer care.
The vast power of life compressed and gathered in the illusion’s hand, finally transforming into a vivid Jade Giant Dragon.
The dragon roared to the sky, carrying the vigor of the entire forest, charging straight at the bone demon!
Meanwhile, Qing Shuang’s body erupted with surging Ghost Qi.
The pitch-black Extreme Ghost Qi gushed out wildly, dyeing half the sky a deep Netherworld hue.
Although she had become the master of Extreme Ghost Qi, given her current level, the power she could wield was limited.
Yet at this moment, she disregarded all consequences!
Black Ghost Patterns crawled over her body like living beings, each line operating in overdrive.
Fine Blood Pearls began to seep from her skin, her body evidently reaching its limit of tolerance.
But her eyes showed no sign of wavering.
She not only possessed the resolve to guard Gu Xing, but the faith to protect her companions.
Since becoming Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast, she was prepared to defend everyone.
But now...
The companion she intended to protect had fallen right in front of her eyes.
"Boom——!!!"
Amidst heaven-shattering roars, the vast Ghost Qi gathered into a terrifying Ghost King Illusion hundreds of meters high.
The illusion wielded a massive Netherworld scythe, standing shoulder to shoulder with Vera’s Elf Illusion, one black and one green, towering figures facing the terrifying bone demon together!
And when Lilith saw this scene, a madness flickered in her eyes.
Though she wasn’t Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast, nevertheless...
She too was part of Gu Xing’s entourage.
Seeing two Guardian Beasts, weaker than herself, achieve such feats.
As the Blood Ancestor and the strongest entity beside Gu Xing, how could she be outdone?!
"If it means risking life?" Lilith’s lips curled into a bewitching arc, "Who’s afraid of whom!!"
Before her words finished, dozens of bloodstains suddenly burst across her body!
The pure Blood Race essence surged out crazily, weaving into a spectacular river of blood in the air.
She extracted all the blood from her body, propelling the Blood Law in the most extreme manner!
The more blood the Blood Race used, the stronger the power they could unleash.
And now, Lilith held nothing back, unleashing her full strength.
The next moment.
Blood wings, vast enough to obscure the sky, unfurled with a roar, countless blood-colored runes flickering in the void.
A gigantic bat illusion, comparable to a mountain, gradually formed, with scarlet eyes like two blood moons, emitting suffocating pressure.
The Soul Fire of the bone demon flickered violently, showing a serious expression for the first time.
The power contained in these three attacks had all reached Totem level!
These reckless ants indeed exceeded his expectations.
"But do you think this is enough to win?"
The bone demon let out a sinister laugh, bringing its claws together forcefully.
Overwhelming Demonic Qi formed a massive black vortex in the air, from which a heart-shaking dragon’s roar echoed!
"Roar——!!!"
With an earth-shattering roar, a gigantic bone dragon, as massive as a mountain range, tore through the sky!
The bone-white frame entwined with pure demonic qi, eye sockets flickering with the same azure Soul Fire as the bone demon.
This was precisely why the Demon God personally appointed him as the vanguard—
This bone dragon, equal in power to him, could even unleash the terrifying strength of a three-conversion Totem when combined!
"Ants are ever just ants."
The bone demon leapt onto the bone dragon’s head, merging demonic qi and dragon’s breath perfectly.
The pitch-black Demon Armor simultaneously covered the bone demon and bone dragon, exuding a despair-inducing pressure.
Against the three world-ending assaults, the bone demon and bone dragon exploded into action simultaneously!
Demonic Qi and dragon’s breath combined with the bone demon’s demonic qi, charging forward with unstoppable momentum.
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 271: You... Deserve to Die!
chapters.content:
Chapter 271: Chapter 271: You... Deserve to Die!
"Boom——!!!"
Amidst a deafening roar that shook the heavens and the earth, the combined strike of the bone demon and the bone dragon fiercely collided with three Totem Level attacks.
In that instant, the entire world seemed to lose all its colors, leaving only the blazing white light explosion produced by the pure energy collision!
The Heaven-Reaching Giant Peak, where the Angel Race had resided for generations, collapsed like a sandcastle under this force.
The entire mountain was flattened, and the debris was ground to dust by the energy aftermath before it could even scatter.
The first to be unable to withstand it was Liu Xia.
Already not fully recovered in strength, she struggled bitterly against the world-ending impact and was blown away like a bird with broken wings, crashing heavily into the rubble with her life or death unknown.
However, what was shocking was that even without Liu Xia’s support, the attacks of Vera and the other two not only did not weaken but became even more ferocious in the extreme outburst of emotion!
The elf illusion, Ghost King’s true form, and Blood Ancestor’s bat began to merge in the collision, transforming into a destructive torrent interwoven with three colors!
The world seemed to transform into a purgatory of energy.
Emerald Life Energy, pitch-black Extreme Ghost Qi, scarlet Blood Law, and the chilling Demonic Qi frantically intertwined and collided, each power containing the might to annihilate the heavens and the earth.
"Truly impressive..."
In the Soul Fire of the bone demon, there was actually a look of admiration, "If your master were willing to submit to the Demon Race, we could have been the best comrades."
As a member of the Demon Abyss, it had been too long since he had enjoyed such a pure battle.
At this moment, watching Vera and the others take action, a trace of regret actually arose in his eyes.
However...
Vera and the others had no time to pay attention.
All their minds were focused on maintaining the energy balance that was on the verge of collapse, surpassing their limits with every second.
Lilith gritted her teeth, with blood constantly seeping from the corners of her mouth.
Even after fighting to this extent, they still couldn’t break through the bone demon’s defense!
If that’s the case....
"Divine Pattern——Activate!"
She made her final decision.
Dazzling golden Divine Patterns emerged from her forehead, this was her ultimate trump card.
Once used, it meant no turning back——
If they couldn’t kill the bone demon, she would lose the chance to shape her Blood Body and escape.
This was truly betting everything!
And as Lilith’s Divine Pattern emerged, it seemed to act as a catalyst.
In the next moment, Vera’s emerald Divine Pattern and Qing Shuang’s netherworld Divine Pattern simultaneously resonated!
The three Divine Patterns shone in the air, scattering a brilliant tri-colored rain of light.
With the blessing of this sacred radiance, the originally stalemated torrent of energy suddenly transformed in quality!
The Power of Life, Ghost Qi, and Blood Law perfectly fused, transforming into a tri-colored pillar of light piercing through the heavens, crushing the Demonic Qi’s defense with overwhelming force.
"Divine Pattern Resonance!"
The bone demon’s Soul Fire trembled violently.
He knew better than anyone what this meant.
When multiple Divine Patterns resonate, the power that erupts will increase geometrically!
The originally dominant Demonic Qi was forced to retreat, the bone dragon let out a painful wail, and its forest-white skeleton began to crack.
The bone demon’s expression finally turned completely grave:
"Damn it..."
He never expected that these ants could unleash such terrifying power.
At this moment.
Vera, Qing Shuang, and the others watched as the stalemated situation finally broke.
A glimpse of hope appeared in their eyes.
This was their strongest strike and also their limit now.
After this strike, they would lose the ability to resist, unable to use their power again.
If this strike could kill the bone demon, they would win!
If not, it meant failure!
And the consequence of failure was death!!
Watching the attack get closer and closer to the bone demon, the three once again erupted, using every last bit of strength in their bodies.
"Die, bone demon!"
Under this furious roar, their attack, like a sharp sword, instantly cut through the Demonic Qi blocking them.
Straight for his true form.
And seeing this scene, a rare panic appeared on the bone demon’s face.
This attack actually penetrated his Demonic Qi directly.
"No——!!!"
He frantically urged the Demonic Qi to try to block it, but the Divine Rune Sword seemed to ignore all defenses, aiming straight for his head!
Watching the attack get closer, it seemed as if he would die under the attack in the next moment.
The bone demon’s forest-white skeleton began to tremble violently, his Soul Fire frantically flickering.
How could it be....
He still hadn’t completed Lord Demon God’s orders, how could he die here so easily!
He wouldn’t allow it!
"Dragon!" The bone demon emitted a piercing scream.
"Roar——!!!"
The bone dragon responded with a thunderous roar, seemingly already understanding its master’s intention.
At the moment when the tri-colored Divine Rune Sword was about to penetrate the bone demon, the last of the Demonic Qi erupted from his body.
A bizarre Contract Rune flashed in the void, and the next moment——
His position and the bone dragon’s were swapped instantaneously!
This was one of the reasons he had contracted this bone dragon.
In a life-and-death crisis, he could use the Demon Race contract within him to forcibly switch places with this bone dragon.
"Boom——!!!"
Vera and the others watched helplessly as their locked attack target changed from the bone demon to the bone dragon.
But there was nothing they could do.
They no longer had the ability to change direction and attack the bone demon again.
"Bang——!!"
In that world-ending energy, the bone dragon disintegrated into ash without even having time to let out a wail.
The partner who had accompanied the bone demon through countless ages disappeared just like that between heaven and earth.
And with the release of the ultimate strike, Vera and the others’ strength was completely exhausted as well.
The glow of the Divine Patterns dimmed and retracted back into their bodies, and like birds with broken wings, they plummeted from the sky.
The bone demon hovered above the ruins, with the murderous intent churning in his Soul Fire:
"You are the first Alien Race to push me to this extent..."
"Even the bone dragon that accompanied me through countless ages died at your hands!"
With such an attack earlier, if he hadn’t this contingency,
He would have certainly fallen here.
But...
There’s no what-if, the winner takes it all!
Now, these Guardian Beasts no longer had any ability to resist.
The victory belonged to him!
The bone demon stepped forward, with each step leaving twisted marks in the void with his forest-white bone claws.
The suffocating pressure, tangible as it was, weighed heavily on the hearts of the Guardian Beasts.
"Since you are so intent on seeking death...."
The bone demon’s voice was like Ten Thousand Year Ice,
"Then I shall grant your wish!"
He hesitated no longer, gathering destructive Demonic Qi between his bone claws.
He wouldn’t give this human and these Guardian Beasts another opportunity.
This strike would end these stubborn ants once and for all, without any more accidents!
Just as the bone claw was about to descend——
"Buzz!!!"
An unprecedented divine fluctuation suddenly erupted!
The always-closed eyes of Gu Xing snapped open, with his pupils swirling with dazzling golden Divine Patterns.
Although still in the Awakening state, he clearly perceived everything happening outside.
He saw Liu Li’s chest being pierced, and he saw the blood-soaked figures of Vera and the others.
His gaze slowly fixed on the bone demon, eyes full of murderous intent.
"You....."
"Are dead!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 272: The Sound of a Heartbeat!
chapters.content:
Chapter 272: Chapter 272: The Sound of a Heartbeat!
The voice that Gu Xing squeezed out from between his teeth made the battle-hardened Bone Demon feel a piercing chill in his heart.
Could this human still have a trump card?
The Bone Demon’s gaze instantly became vigilant.
But as his eyes swept across Gu Xing’s guardian beasts that had completely lost their fighting ability, the vigilance in the Bone Demon’s eyes was quickly replaced by mockery.
This human seems not to have realized the reality!
As a Beast Master, after all his guardian beasts have lost their fighting ability, he still dares to make threats in front of me.
"I gave you a chance!"
The Bone Demon’s bony claw pointed at Liu Li, "If you had surrendered, this guardian beast need not have died!"
"All of this... you brought it on yourself!"
The guardian beast...death...
These two words completely dyed Gu Xing’s pupils with blood.
His gaze swept slowly across the battlefield:
Liu Li lay quietly in a pool of blood, the little girl who had always been by his side, determined to become the sharpest sword in his hand...
Now lay quietly on the ground, without a trace of life.
No matter how strong Liu Li’s combat power was, her strength was only at the peak of the Commander level.
She couldn’t like a Totem level existence...
Even if she lost her heart... as long as she expended the energy in her body, she could resurrect!
For Liu Li, losing her heart meant....
Death!
Gu Xing’s palm slowly clenched.
He turned his gaze to the other side:
Vera, Qing Shuang, and Lilith were all lying helplessly.
Vera’s emerald hair was stained with dust, the Ghost Race girl’s skin was pale as paper, and the Blood Ancestor’s demonic red eyes were dim and colorless...
All of this told him that in front of this Demon Race, he had reached a dead end!
Even having exhausted everything, he still hadn’t defeated this Demon Race!
And noticing Gu Xing’s actions, the Bone Demon spoke sarcastically:
"Still fantasizing about resisting? Just with these few guardian beasts that can’t even stand?"
He admitted that this human’s guardian beasts had terrifying power, and their talent was the strongest he had ever seen.
None of the guardian beasts had Totem level strength, but...
They were able to push him to his limits with levels below Totem.
Even the Bone Dragon that always accompanied him fell here.
But...
It would end here!
The bony claw slowly raised, and demonic qi gathered once more:
"Since you refuse to hand over the Divine Pattern, I’ll take it myself—"
Before he could finish speaking, he suddenly paused.
All emotions disappeared from Gu Xing’s eyes, leaving only an absolute and chilling coldness.
That gaze... as if looking at a dead object.
"Sally!"
The calm two words made the Bone Demon’s soul fire tremble violently!
He looked up suddenly and saw a petite figure appearing behind Gu Xing from nowhere.
At this moment, Sally’s eyes, usually gentle, were burning with unprecedented anger.
The revered Lord Liu Li had fallen in front of her.
Sally’s gaze locked tightly on this Demon Race.
This Bone Demon...
Unforgivable!
The existence that harmed Lord Liu Li must die!
Feeling Sally’s murderous intent, the Bone Demon’s heart instinctively tightened.
But sensing that Sally only had a Legendary level talent and Commander level strength, he relaxed immediately.
Even Myth Level guardian beasts had been defeated by him; this level of enemy was absolutely no threat.
"At your wits’ end?"
The Bone Demon’s face showed a mocking curve: "Even summoned such a wastrel..."
But before the Bone Demon could finish this sentence, Gu Xing’s cold voice interrupted him.
"Sally, Time Reversal!"
[Sally]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Legend One Star]
[Race: Time Spirit Race]
[Power: 1]
[Constitution: 1]
[Spirit: 100,000]
[Speed: 1]
[Skills: Time Freeze, Time Slowdown, Time Reversal]
The energy Vera and Qing Shuang gained from eliminating a large number of the Demon Race had allowed Sally to successfully advance to Commander Tier Nine.
As her level increased, Sally awakened new skills.
The original two skills, Time Freeze could stop time in a specific area, and Time Slowdown could slow the flow of time in a specific area.
As for the newly appeared Time Reversal....
It could reverse time in a specific area.
But in order to gain this power....
All of Sally’s attributes except her spiritual attributes were permanently locked at 1 point.
But in exchange, her spiritual power broke all records...
Even with only Legend One Star talent, her spiritual attribute surpassed all guardian beasts!
And hearing Gu Xing’s command, Sally finally used her ability for the first time on the battlefield.
Her amber cat eyes suddenly transformed into brilliant golden clocks.
The mysterious Power of Time Spirit surged out like a tide, the silver-white radiance precisely enveloping the area where Liu Li lay.
Under the Bone Demon’s incredulous gaze, time began to reverse!
The splashing golden blood defied gravity and returned to the chest, the shattered heart pieces reassembled and healed, and that ghastly wound disappeared at an observable speed...
Seeing this scene, the Bone Demon’s soul fire trembled madly, and everything happening before his eyes completely overturned his understanding.
What was this?
That Angel had clearly been killed by him; he had unmistakably felt the death of that Angel.
But why now....
The Bone Demon’s face instantly became ugly.
"What on earth is this bizarre ability?!"
The Bone Demon finally realized the severity of the situation.
No wonder previously, even after all his guardian beasts fell, this human still chose not to flee.
So he had such a trump card hidden all along!
But....
To wield such power capable of reversing life and death must come at a huge cost!
This is the law of conservation between heaven and earth!
Being extremely strong on one side means being possibly extremely weak on another.
"Boom——!!!"
He transformed into black lightning and shot straight for Sally, the speed at Totem Rank Two tearing through space.
If she continued to use her ability, that Angel...
Could really come back to life!
He had to kill both this mysterious member of the Cat Race and this human before that happened!
But still...
Sally did not just have Time Reversal as a skill!
Perhaps, to compensate for other attributes of the Time Spirit Race being only 1 point.
The Time Spirit Race could simultaneously unleash all their skills.
"Time Slowdown!"
Sally’s light words seemed to carry a strange magical power.
The Bone Demon, horrified, found himself seemingly trapped in a viscous space-time quagmire, with every action requiring a thousandfold effort!
"Damn it!"
He bellowed furiously in his heart, yet his thoughts were strangely clear.
And seeing the terrified face of this Demon Race, Gu Xing realized...
The current time ability Sally used was not yet complete.
She seemed to only affect the temporal aspect of matter!
She couldn’t influence anything on the spiritual level.
For example...
A true Time Slowdown would not only slow down this Bone Demon’s body but even his thoughts.
But...
Sally could not reach such a level yet.
Gu Xing speculated that perhaps only if Sally fused with the Divine Pattern of the Time Spirit Race could she truly control the power of time.
But for now, Sally’s ability was more than sufficient.
During the time she pinned down the Bone Demon, Liu Li’s body had completely recovered!
"Thump!"
A heartbeat suddenly sounded!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 273: Ascension Gambled on Everything!
chapters.content:
Chapter 273: Chapter 273: Ascension Gambled on Everything!
When that powerful heartbeat resonated across the battlefield, all eyes focused on Liu Li.
The dual laws of destruction and guardianship circulated anew, and the golden Holy Light intertwined once again with the crimson Fire of Destruction!
Sally’s cat ears perked up with excitement—
She actually did it!
She really helped Lord Gu Xing!
She wasn’t just some useless little cat girl.
At this moment.
Liu Li’s body slowly levitated into mid-air, her twelve wings elegantly outstretched.
The instant she opened her eyes, her gaze met Gu Xing’s.
At the moment of death.
Countless thoughts flashed through her mind.
But the most important....
What she cherished and couldn’t bear to part with the most was her master!
Thinking of never seeing that gentle figure again, her heart ached as if it were being torn apart.
"Master..."
Liu Li instantly flashed before Gu Xing, her golden eyes reflecting his face.
"Liu Li made you worry! I’m back!"
Hearing the familiar voice, Gu Xing’s heart finally settled.
He had originally prepared himself.
If Sally couldn’t save Liu Li, he would end all the Beast Taming Contracts.
He would self-destruct the two utterly different domains of Emperor’s Might and Absolute Domain.
These two highly incompatible energies, when detonated with the Divine Pattern’s enhancement, might not kill the bone demon but would cause significant damage.
But thankfully...
The worst outcome did not occur.
"Welcome back!"
Although these were just four words, they contained all of Gu Xing’s feelings.
Subsequently, his gaze turned towards the bone demon still struggling within the Time Slowdown, and the icy killing intent surged once more.
Now, it’s time to settle the score!
Meanwhile, Sally’s complexion visibly turned pale.
Forcefully controlling a Totem Second Evolution enemy for a few seconds was already her limit.
Gu Xing naturally noticed this.
He gently patted the little cat girl’s head:
"Sally, you’ve worked hard, go back and rest well."
After saying this, Gu Xing retrieved the weakened Sally back into the Beast Taming Space.
With Sally’s current Constitution Attribute, the outside world was indeed too dangerous.
The current crisis still hadn’t been resolved.
Although Liu Li had recovered, yet...
This bone demon was still essentially at full strength!
And now, the only beasts capable of fighting were Liu Li and Tushan Yueli.
Tushan Yueli wasn’t good at combat, and her ability to help in battle was minuscule.
Moreover, it had been previously verified that Liu Li....
Was completely no match for this bone demon!
"Master, what do we do?!"
Liu Li instinctively shielded the front, warily watching the bone demon.
But this time Gu Xing stood firmly by her side.
Previously, Liu Li had nearly brushed past death to protect him.
Now, he could no longer let the little girl face it alone.
"Liu Li, bet everything we have, we must win!"
Gu Xing’s voice was resolute.
Two Divine Patterns between his brows sparkled brilliantly, awakening the ancient power of the Human Race’s heritage!
And during the previous Awakening process, the Sovereign Talent also evolved again.
The original Sovereign Talent had three statuses.
Slaughter, Guardianship, and Celestial Grace!
But now.....
Another status appeared!
Link!
[Link: Can stack all Contracted Beast attributes onto a single target; can be used once each in the Commander, Monarch, and Totem Realms]
This was the first ability obtained after Gu Xing’s Divine Pattern Awakening, to channel all attributes into one beast.
To know...
He was now contracted with....
Fei Yue, Qing Shuang, Sally, Tushan Yueli, Vera, Liu Li.
A total of six Contracted Beasts!
"Sovereign·Link!"
With Gu Xing’s command, an invisible law tether instantly connected all the beasts.
An unprecedented energy storm erupted around Liu Li!
Her attribute panel began to refresh wildly:
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 70000→330000]
[Constitution: 70000→310000]
[Spirit: 70000→450000]
[Speed: 70000→300000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form, Guardian Domain, Guardian Law, Destruction Domain, Destruction Law]
Under the Sovereign Talent’s boost, all the beasts’ attributes were focused on Liu Li.
Yet, even so...
It was still not enough!
"Liu Li!"
Following Gu Xing’s command, Liu Li invoked the Guardian Law and Destruction Law.
With the help of the two laws.
Liu Li’s attributes once again improved.
[Power: 330000→16500000]
[Constitution: 310000→1550000]
[Spirit: 450000→2250000]
[Speed: 300000→1500000]
Simultaneously using the Destruction Law and Guardian Law allowed Liu Li to break through limits, enhancing her attributes fivefold.
However, it was still not enough!
Even by employing the Soul Devouring Talent now, Liu Li’s attributes would still be around 3 million points.
With that strength, there would be no hope of taking down the bone demon.
Gu Xing’s gaze fell upon the Divine Patterns.
"Let’s move!"
The next moment.
Two Divine Patterns suddenly radiated brilliant light.
This brilliant light enveloped Gu Xing, making him sense a temporary transformation in the Soul Devouring Talent.
[Soul Devouring Talent: Temporarily boosts a beast’s power by 200%]
[First Divine Pattern’s Enhancement: Temporarily boosts a beast’s power by 400% (does not affect Law Control)]
[Second Divine Pattern’s Enhancement: Temporarily boosts a beast’s power by 800% (does not affect Law Control)]
Under the resonance of the two Divine Patterns, the Soul Devouring Talent underwent a stunning transformation!
Elevated from the original 200% to 800% effect.
This was the result of the combined effect of the two Divine Patterns.
But this power also brought terrifying backlash——
Gu Xing’s body began to crack, with blood seeping from every pore!
If this continued, perhaps even before using this talent, his body might have completely collapsed.
Just at this critical moment, leaves from the World Tree in the Beast Taming Space flew out automatically.
The verdant leaves hovered above Gu Xing’s head, casting a life-filled glow.
Vast Life Energy instantly stabilized the rampaging Spiritual Power, pulling Gu Xing back from the brink of collapse!
"It’s now!"
Seizing this fleeting opportunity, Gu Xing’s Blood-colored Spiritual Power surged towards Liu Li like a tidal wave.
"Soul-devouring!"
Under the terrifying 800% boost of the Soul Devouring Talent, Liu Li’s attribute values soared like a volcanic eruption:
[Power: 1650000→13200000]
[Constitution: 1550000→12400000]
[Spirit: 2250000→18000000]
[Speed: 1500000→12000000]
When these attributes that surpassed the ten million mark completely merged into Liu Li’s body, the whole world began to tremble!
The energy fluctuations emanating from her body became tangible, and the surrounding space couldn’t withstand this power, leading to large-scale collapse.
The gold Holy Light and red Fire of Destruction intertwined into a gorgeous energy storm, and as Liu Li’s twelve wings extended, countless spatial cracks spread like a web.
Seeing this scene, the bone demon’s soul fire trembled violently, instinctively retreating a few steps.
This level of pressure had completely transcended the scope of Totem Second Evolution!
It even touched upon Totem Third Evolution!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 274: Destruction!
chapters.content:
Chapter 274: Chapter 274: Destruction!
"This is impossible!!!"
The Bone Demon’s voice trembled uncontrollably.
He truly couldn’t fathom...
How just a Guardian Beast of the Commander peak level could erupt with power close to Totem Third Turn strength.
Clearly he had already defeated all of this human’s Guardian Beasts, yet....
In the instant this human awakened, the entire situation present was instantly reversed!
"What kind of monster are you!!"
The Bone Demon’s soul fire flickered wildly, and his pale skeleton emitted a cracking sound from extreme fear.
He had fought innumerable planes, never meeting such an anomaly!
He had seen foes far more terrifying than himself, as well as many weaklings begging for mercy.
But....
He had never encountered such a bizarre enemy that grew stronger with each battle!
The thing that drove him to despair—
He was clearly much stronger than the opponent, yet was always overturned at the final moment by all sorts of unimaginable methods.
This feeling of frustration was even more soul-crushing than defeat!
However.
Gu Xing paid no attention to this Bone Demon.
His eyes were filled with coldness.
This time, he had truly reached his limits.
Vera, Qing Shuang, and Lilith, the three Guardian Beasts, went beyond their limits to use their powers.
For a long period, they had completely lost their combat abilities.
This could even cause irreversibly harm to their foundations.
Even the little girl who had always been by his side had paid the price of dying once.
Now, although the situation was successfully reversed.
But....
He had also paid an extremely heavy price.
If not for the protection of the World Tree Leaves, his body would have already collapsed.
Moreover, the Divine Pattern within him forcibly erupted to help elevate the Soul Devouring Talent this time...
The energy accumulated from the two Divine Patterns was almost completely depleted.
It could be said that this battle had nearly emptied all his resources.
Yet, even so.
A scene of Liu Li’s chest being pierced suddenly flashed in his mind.
The killing intent in his eyes reached its peak.
No matter the price, this Bone Demon must die!
"Liu Li, finish him!"
Accompanied by Gu Xing’s roar, the Twelve-winged Angels suspended in the sky moved!
With just a slight flap of wings...
With over ten million Speed Attribute enhancement, Liu Li became a stream of gold and red intertwining lights.
In just the blink of an eye, Liu Li crossed a distance of a hundred meters, appearing before the Bone Demon instantly.
A perfect arc of streaming light cut through the air, striking straight towards the Bone Demon’s head.
The Sword of Destruction condensed with Destruction Law was so dense it became tangible, tearing the space into dark fissures as it passed.
Seeing this sight, the Bone Demon’s mind frantically raised alarms!
Until now...
He finally realized, this wasn’t a dream.
This Guardian Beast’s power had truly reached the level of Totem Third Turn.
Witnessing the Sword of Destruction coming ever closer, he felt an aura of death upon it.
This was Destruction Law maximized to its extreme.
If his head was taken by this sword, even as a Totem-level Demon Clan, he would die instantly!
"Damn it!"
Faced with death, the Bone Demon relied on his centuries-long warfare experience.
He forcibly twisted his body, presenting a bizarre angle.
He narrowly avoided this strike.
And this was because Liu Li now couldn’t fully control.... so much power within her body.
Previously, whenever Gu Xing enhanced the Guardian Beast’s power, each could perfectly control it.
But this time....
The eightfold increase of the Soul Devouring Talent, coupled with Liu Li’s own fivefold enhancement.
A fortyfold increase overall, which had surpassed Liu Li’s control limit entirely.
And this was with Liu Li having Myth Nine Stars Talent, replacing her with any other Myth Level Guardian Beast...
Facing a fortyfold boost, forget fighting, even moving would be a challenge.
"Swoosh——!"
Seeing the Bone Demon dodge a fatal blow, Liu Li followed up with the Sword of Destruction striking downward.
The Bone Demon, trying to rely on battle experience to evade, found this time the sword speed was several times faster!
"Crack!"
A pale white severed arm flew up!
Despite evading critical damage, his left arm was cut off at the shoulder.
The terror of Destruction Law was that...
Once a wound appeared, it would spread and collapse from there.
Starting from the wound, the Destruction Law continued to extend.
The bones shattered like gravel as it passed!
"Aaargh!"
The Bone Demon let out a painful wail, decisively slicing off the entire shoulder with his claw.
But even after amputating the arm, the previous Destruction Law still affected the stump.
In a short time, regrowing his arm would be impossible.
"Damn Power of Laws!"
Realizing his dire situation, the Bone Demon couldn’t help but curse.
To invading races like them, Laws were like a natural restraint.
They dreaded this power that stemmed from the world’s origin—
The one force capable of completely destroying Totem-level Demon Clans!
The Bone Demon’s soul fire flickered violently, staring intently at the dual Laws swirling around Liu Li.
If this dragged on any longer, he would surely lose.
This Angel controlling two Laws, any attack from him would undoubtedly be blocked by the Guardian Law.
And that other Destruction Law posed an immense threat.
As long as he was injured, the Destruction Law would cause his body to collapse.
The best option now was naturally to leave here.
But...
If he left.
His gaze locked onto Gu Xing.
If he left, letting this human grow.
His eyes darkened.
This human would definitely surpass him, not just surpass...
He even had an ominous premonition.
Even Lord Demon God might not be his match.
"He must be slain here! Even if I remain here!"
The Bone Demon clutched his fist, having made up his mind.
But wanting to kill this human now was an impossible feat.
With this Angel watching him, he had no chance to act.
His sight suddenly shifted to the battlefield ruins where Demonic Qi had nearly formed.
This was the only way!
Simultaneously, Liu Li’s arm trembled lightly.
The burden from the fortyfold amplification had reached the limit, tearing at her meridians every second.
Although the previous two slashes seemed simple, they were almost at her limit.
If she dragged it on, she might not be able to protect her master.
A quick decisive battle was imperative!
"Destruction!"
Resolutely, she withdrew all Guardian Laws, the Twelve wings completely turning crimson red.
Completely giving up defense, only pursuing the ultimate offense!
The surging Destruction Energy caused the Void to begin collapsing, chaos spreading like a web...
This was truly a final strike betting it all!
Such a notion coincidentally aligned with the Bone Demon’s.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 275: Ascending as Monarch
chapters.content:
Chapter 275: Chapter 275: Ascending as Monarch
The void shattered inch by inch like broken glass.
However, Liu Li paid no attention to the surrounding environment, her eyes fixed intently on the bone demon.
She understood that today, she had only one objective.
Defeat the bone demon!
"Crack——!!"
Amidst the ear-piercing sound of the void shattering, her momentum rose to its peak.
The Sword of Destruction shone like the stars, devouring even light wherever it passed!
The bone demon also infused his entire being with Demonic Qi, turning his pale bony claw into a jet-black blade.
No warning, no probing.
Liu Li transformed into a crimson meteor, diving down, while the bone demon shot up like black lightning.
The entire sky was torn into clear red and black halves, a scene resembling the end of the world!
"Boom——!!!"
At the moment of impact, time seemed to freeze abruptly.
The wind’s breath ceased, all things fell silent, and then—
A world-destroying shockwave erupted violently!
The mountains where the Angel Race had resided for generations were completely turned to dust under this force, leaving the highest peak of the Alternate Space as history.
The space at the collision’s center was utterly shattered, presenting an absolute darkness that devoured everything.
Liu Li and the bone demon wrestled fiercely within the chaotic void, sparks flying where the tip of the Sword of Destruction met the white bone claw!
Forgoing defense, Liu Li was repeatedly wounded by the void, her golden-red blood evaporating the instant it emerged.
Yet her hand holding the sword was steady as a rock, with only lethal determination in her eyes!
The bone demon’s condition wasn’t any better.
His demonic body was already in tatters, the sound of bones breaking echoed continuously.
But at this moment, his Soul Fire blazed exceptionally bright, even carrying a mad excitement!
"You’ve fallen into the trap!"
Suddenly, it grinned its skeletal jaw wide.
From the start, he had no intention of leaving alive—
Every battle was to create that one deadly opportunity!
The next moment.
The Demonic Qi around him suddenly swelled.
Self-destruction!
"Boom!!!"
Without any hesitation, the bone demon detonated all the Demonic Qi within his body.
The terrifying energy instantly tore apart the entire void!
He knew that as a Totem Tier Two, he was not a match for this Angel.
Hence, his initial plan was to rely on self-destruction to hold back this Angel, allowing the just-born demon clan to kill the human.
As long as that human was dead, these Guardian Beasts could not pose a threat to Lord Demon God.
Witnessing this, Liu Li’s pupils contracted sharply, stunned for a moment.
She didn’t expect the demon to be so decisive.
Without any hesitation, she swiftly pulled back.
But...
It was already too late.
"Boom——!!!"
The self-destruction of a Totem Tier Three demon shattered the surrounding space completely.
Seeing she could not evade it entirely.
She immediately converted the Destruction Law.
In an instant.
Her entire Destruction Law transformed into the Guardian Law.
A golden barrier instantly enveloped her, twelve wings overlapping in front!
Simultaneously.
The Demonic Qi released from Qing Shuang and Vera’s earlier kills had completely solidified.
And at the moment it formed, a command rushed into its mind.
"Kill that human!"
Its scarlet eyes instantly locked onto the only black-haired youth in the field.
This was the only human it had seen on the battlefield.
Lower demons must obey the orders of higher demons.
The next moment.
It turned into a black line of death, charging straight ahead!
Only...
The bone demon’s plan encountered an unexpected variable.
It did not anticipate one factor.
That is...
At this moment, Gu Xing possessed an 800% enhancement on Spiritual Power from the Divine Pattern.
"Sovereign Guardian!"
A blue protective shield instantly enveloped Gu Xing.
With the 8-fold increase, the Guardian Status released by Gu Xing could completely defend against Totem-level attacks.
And the strength of this newborn demon clan was merely Totem Tier One.
"Boom!!!"
Accompanied by a deafening explosion, the bone demon’s plot completely vanished.
When Gu Xing blocked this attack, Liu Li also successfully withstood the shockwave from the bone demon’s self-destruction.
Recovering, Liu Li immediately focused her attention on Gu Xing.
Seeing a demon dare to attack her master, her eyes instantly filled with icy killing intent.
Although withstanding the self-destruction had almost exhausted all of Liu Li’s strength and pushed her to the limit, she was ultimately not comparable to a newly-born Totem-level demon clan.
In just an instant, she appeared in front of the demon.
She instinctively swung the Sword of Destruction...
The newborn Totem-level demon was completely obliterated, forever vanished between heaven and earth.
With the crisis averted, Liu Li’s body softened, and all her power suddenly dissipated.
Gu Xing instinctively reached out, catching her securely in his embrace.
Seeing the incredibly pale young girl, Gu Xing’s eyes were filled with heartache.
In this battle, every Guardian Beast fought with all their might.
Had any of them slackened, the outcome would have been drastically different.
"Liu Li, take a good rest."
Gu Xing tightened his arm, pulling her closer into his embrace.
Feeling the warmth emanating from Gu Xing, Liu Li finally relaxed and fell into a deep sleep.
She was truly exhausted!
Afterward, Gu Xing carefully returned Vera, Qing Shuang, and Lilith to the Beast Taming Space and turned his gaze toward the pure energy left by the demise of the two Totem-level demons.
The azure energy orb floated mid-air, pure and vast.
Gu Xing slowly reached out his hand—
The next moment, energy flooded into his body like a torrent.
In an instant, the shackles of Monarch Level were completely shattered!
"Boom——!!!"
A brilliant golden beam burst from his body, piercing the sky.
In the sky, the silhouette of a rendered human appeared, majestic and grand.
At the same time, Gu Xing’s aura began to climb madly.
Liu Li and the other Guardian Beasts, in their slumber, also experienced a surge in their aura, rapidly recovering from their injuries.
Surrounding Blazing Angels, witnessing this, had eyes full of shock.
The movement from this human’s breakthrough into Monarch Level...
Was truly terrifying!
At the same time, the entire Alternate Space saw the silhouette of the human rendered in the sky.
On the farthest east of the Alternate Space, on the most mysterious Dragon Island.
Countless dragons raised their heads to the sky, their roars echoing as an ancient and deep voice slowly spoke:
"The Human Race has risen!"
On the peak of the highest snow mountain in the Snow Country.
The Snow Woman sensed the anomaly, stepped out of the ice cavern, and gazed up at the silhouette in the sky, furrowing her elegant brows slightly.
"Human Race...?!"
Within that silhouette, she sensed a familiar aura.
"Lilith...?!"
She then shook her head.
It must be a mistake.
No matter how lovestruck Lilith might be, she wouldn’t become a Guardian Beast for a human.
If it wasn’t someone she knew, then the Human Race was irrelevant to her.
Thinking this, she turned back into the depths of the ice cavern, softly speaking:
"Xiaobing’Er, tell me some more interesting stories from your Human World."
"...Yes."
A voice, carrying a hint of helplessness, quietly responded.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 276: The Guardian Beast’s Weakened Status
chapters.content:
Chapter 276: Chapter 276: The Guardian Beast’s Weakened Status
Alternate Space, Longxia Country frontline.
Long Zhenguo was methodically arranging the Qingqiu Race and Sea Race members who had just arrived at the defense line.
"Wei Yuan," he ordered solemnly, "designate a fixed area near the direction of the Void Gate and reserve it exclusively for their stationing."
Wei Yuan accepted the order and immediately turned to execute it.
Standing aside, Verocan watched the increasingly powerful momentum of Longxia Country, with an unmistakable trace of envy in his eyes.
Once upon a time, the strength of Longxia Country was on par with the Council.
But now...
Ghost Race and Blood Race have successively collaborated with Longxia.
The Holy See has almost become a subsidiary force of Longxia.
Alongside the newly incorporated Qingqiu and Sea Races—
The strength of Longxia Country is expanding at an astounding speed, ushering in explosive growth.
And the source of all this change...
A figure slowly emerged in Verocan’s mind.
Gu Xing!
Everything changed completely because of this young man.
The entire layout of the Alternate Space was rewritten by him alone.
The only thing worth celebrating is...
The relationship between Veronica and Gu Xing is still quite good.
"Nika, go assist your uncle Wei Yuan and help settle these Races."
Verocan was not blind to the situation.
He knew clearly that future jurisdiction would inevitably be firmly in Longxia Country’s hands.
Therefore, he had to plan ahead—
Integrating Veronica into Longxia was precisely the first step of his plan.
When the time was ripe, he planned to lead the entire Council to formally join Longxia.
When Veronica heard her father’s directive, for once, she did not object.
The Council had not been peaceful during this time.
Although the Demon Race had temporarily retreated, yet...
Some Alien Races that had formed enmities with the Human Race took the opportunity for revenge.
Due to Longxia Country’s formidable strength, they dared not easily attack Longxia.
However,
They showed no hesitation toward the Council.
Thus, all accusations were directed at the members of the Council.
Veronica had no choice but to shoulder her own responsibilities.
Nowadays, she seemed to quietly conceal all her past little whims.
"Alright!"
The once lively and willful girl known as the "Little Witch" has now become taciturn.
Verocan looked at her back and sighed helplessly.
Everyone needs to grow up.
No one can be an exception.
Nevertheless, at this moment, as if sensing something—
Verocan and Long Zhenguo almost simultaneously lifted their heads.
In the sky, a massive golden figure suddenly appeared.
"What is....?"
Long Zhenguo and Verocan witnessed this celestial phenomenon, their eyes filled with shock.
From that golden figure, they sensed a familiar vibe.
The two instinctively exchanged glances.
"Gu Xing?!"
This name almost simultaneously emerged in their minds.
Among the Human Race, only Gu Xing could possibly trigger such a celestial phenomenon.
The next moment, Qing appeared instantly before the two, together with the queen of the Holy See.
"The waiting moment has arrived!"
Qing said with a serious expression, "This is precisely your best chance to break through to Totem Level!"
Qing’s face was filled with seriousness.
Although he had not reached Totem Level, he was well-versed on how to break through to Totem Level.
And upon arrival, You had explicitly instructed:
If the Human Race wishes to break through to Totem Level, it must seize the moment when Gu Xing ascends to Monarch Level.
At this moment, the fate of the Human Race will be condensed at peak; the success rate of striking Totem is highest.
Once missed, it’s necessary to wait until Gu Xing himself breaks through to Totem Level to welcome the next opportunity.
Upon hearing Qing’s words, Long Zhenguo, Verocan, and the queen of the Holy See’s expressions instantly turned solemn.
The Human Race had yet to have a true Totem-level powerhouse, which had always been a key constraint on their development.
Only by taking this step can the Human Race truly possess the power to protect themselves in the impending crisis.
Without any hesitation, all three simultaneously unleashed their full momentum.
Begun to attempt to cross the limit of the Human Race.
A mountain named Totem Level!
....
Meanwhile, Gu Xing’s body was undergoing a remarkable transformation.
The energy he was absorbing was overwhelmingly massive, almost hundreds of times of what a regular Commander Level breakthrough to Monarch Level required.
This vast energy was not only entirely infused into his Domain, greatly enhancing it...
But also a portion continuingly flushed through his body, causing his various attributes to grow rapidly.
[Gu Xing]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine]
[Talent: Sovereign, Soul-devouring]
[Guardian Beast: Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, Sally, Tushan Yueli]
[Special State: Human Race’s Favor]
[Divine Pattern: 2]
[Contract Quota: 5/5]
[Power: 60000→100000]
[Constitution: 60000→100000]
[Spirit: 60000→100000]
[Speed: 60000→100000]
[Domain: Emperor’s Might (400% attribute increase), Absolute Forbidden Domain]
Looking at his attributes, Gu Xing furrowed his brow slightly.
The biggest improvement from Commander Level to Monarch Level is...
His attributes skyrocketed by over forty thousand points.
Additionally, the boosting effect of "Emperor’s Might" increased from 300% to 400%.
But "Absolute Forbidden Domain" seems to have made no apparent change.
Just....
He still had not awakened the Law!
His Guardian Beasts had almost awakened the Law at Commander Level.
Yet his level reached Monarch Level, still hadn’t touched the threshold of the Law.
This undoubtedly indicates, his talent compared to his Guardian Beasts... is vastly inferior!
Gu Xing wasn’t overly troubled by it.
Since Monarch Level hasn’t awakened, let’s leave it for Totem Level.
After all, his current full combat ability is still focused on the Guardian Beasts.
His own strength hardly influences the battle, almost to no effect.
But thinking of his Guardian Beasts, he slowly immersed his Spiritual Power into the Beast Taming Space.
At present, Sally and Tushan Yueli were busily shuttling around the Guardian Beasts, meticulously caring for other companions.
Gu Xing then locked his gaze onto Liu Li and Vera.
His breakthrough to Monarch Level seemed to slightly restore the injuries of these Guardian Beasts.
But...
Not fully restored!
And logically speaking, with his successful advancement to Monarch Level, all Guardian Beasts should have synchronized breakthrough to Monarch Tier.
Yet now...
Except for Sally and Tushan Yueli, Liu Li, Vera, and other still-comatose Guardian Beasts seem not to have completed the breakthrough.
At this moment, perhaps due to her relatively stronger power, Lilith was the first to wake up.
With Sally’s support, she slowly stood up.
Upon checking Lilith’s information, Gu Xing discovered....
[Lilith]
[Status: Weak]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier Five]
[Power: 10000]
[Constitution: 10000]
[Spirit: 10000]
[Speed: 10000]
[Skills: Blood Dominator, Immortal Blood Body, Crimson Calamity, Blood Domain]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 277: Departure to Snow Country!
chapters.content:
Chapter 277: Chapter 277: Departure to Snow Country!
Gu Xing’s gaze sharpened—
Lilith’s level had astonishingly fallen back to Monarch Tier Five, and her various attributes had significantly dropped to around ten thousand points.
His brow furrowed as he quickly glanced over Liu Li, Vera, and other Guardian Beasts, finding that without exception, they were all in the same weakened state.
Lilith seemed to see through his confusion and softly explained:
"This is the aftereffect of forcibly using the Divine Pattern. For quite some time to come, your Guardian Beasts will likely remain in this weakened state."
Gu Xing was taken aback upon hearing this.
He himself had also used the Divine Pattern but had not experienced similar conditions.
But when his eyes landed on the hovering World Tree Leaves within the Beast Taming Space, he suddenly understood.
The World Tree Leaves did not just keep his body from collapsing during battle; they were also aware of the negative states of his body.
"Lilith, is there any way to help them recover quickly?"
Now burdened with so much responsibility, and with the third Divine Secret Realm opening at any unknown time, he did not dare to have the slightest pause.
If several of his main Guardian Beasts remained weak, his situation would become extremely perilous.
He must restore combat power as soon as possible.
Lilith pondered for a moment and provided an answer:
"Snow Country, Snow Woman."
Back then, when she first suffered a drop in strength from the backlash of the Divine Pattern, it was the Snow Woman who healed her.
However, at that time, she was already Totem Level, and the Snow Woman could not fully restore her.
But now, considering Liu Li and the others’ levels are not too high, the Snow Woman has the full capability to help them recover their status.
Hearing once more the names "Snow Country" and "Snow Woman," Gu Xing couldn’t help but be stunned.
He hadn’t forgotten—Ying Bing was precisely sent to Snow Country by Lilith.
To this day, he still did not know if Ying Bing had already recovered.
And now, Lilith mentioned Snow Country once again.
"Can the Snow Woman heal Liu Li and Vera?"
Lilith nodded.
But she immediately recalled the rule set by the Snow Woman:
She had always disliked the Human Race, although Lilith didn’t know the specific reason.
But this time... considering her own influence, the Snow Woman shouldn’t trouble Gu Xing, right?
Hesitating for a moment, Lilith ultimately did not mention the Snow Woman’s unwelcoming nature toward humans.
Upon seeing Lilith’s affirmative response, Gu Xing promptly made up his mind.
Head to Snow Country.
Whether to confirm Ying Bing’s recovery or to heal Liu Li, Vera, and other Guardian Beasts’ injuries—
This trip, he must undertake.
Thinking of this, Gu Xing already made up his mind.
Despite his worries, seeing the Guardian Beasts’ conditions gradually stabilize, Gu Xing withdrew his Spiritual Power from the Beast Taming Space.
He approached Liu Xia. With the help of the Blazing Angels, Liu Xia’s injuries had temporarily stabilized.
Seeing Gu Xing approach, she forced a slight smile.
Looking at Liu Xia’s weak yet forcedly spirited appearance, Gu Xing felt heavy-hearted but powerless.
He had no healing abilities and had no contract with a Healing-type Guardian Beast.
Although Celestial Grace could dispel negative states, it could not heal injuries.
After a moment’s hesitation, Gu Xing still opened his mouth to suggest:
"Have you considered leading the Angel Race to temporarily withdraw from here?"
His gaze swept over the entire battlefield—
The former habitat of the Angel Race had become ruins, the top combat power among the War Angels was almost entirely lost, and most survivors were severely injured.
As of now, the Angel Race’s combat power is less than one-tenth!
If they continued to stay here, facing potential attacks from the Demon Race at any time...
They might not be able to resist!
However, Liu Xia slowly shook her head, refusing his suggestion:
"Gu Xing, the Angel Race has guarded this place for generations, we cannot leave."
"You should know that the Ghost Race has its own Forbidden Land, and our Angel Race—"
"also bears the duty of guarding our Forbidden Land."
"We must stay and continue to guard this place."
Hearing this reason, Gu Xing opened his mouth but didn’t know how to persuade further.
Seeing his dilemma, Liu Xia continued speaking softly:
"Do not worry about us. Although the Angel Race’s combat power is greatly reduced now, but..."
"We still have the ability to protect ourselves."
"Even if the Demon Race attacks again, even if we can’t hold the fort, we still have a way out."
"You just need to take care of Liu Li... make sure she grows safely, and the Angel Race will be satisfied."
Hearing these words, Gu Xing gave up on persuading Liu Xia further.
He redirected his gaze toward the nearby Magma Clan.
On the previous Monarch Level battlefield, this group of Magma Clan members exhibited strength far beyond their level—
Although only at Monarch Peak, their real combat power was already nearing Totem Level.
After some thought, Gu Xing decided to let the Magma Clan stay and assist the Angel Race in guarding the place together.
These humble and fiery little beings had no hesitation about Gu Xing’s arrangement and solemnly agreed at once.
...
At the same time, at the peak of Snow Country.
The Snow Woman was still unaware that she was being "thought of" by Lilith.
At this moment, she was leisurely lying sideways on an ice bed, enjoying a tranquil and pleasant time.
Beside her stood Ying Bing, reading stories from the Human World with a touch of helplessness.
After a segment ended, Ying Bing once again asked softly:
"Snow Woman, may I ask when I can leave here?"
Upon hearing this, the Snow Woman lazily crossed her legs and slowly said:
"I am your savior. Since I saved your life, you should obediently stay here."
She had no intention of letting Ying Bing leave.
Since Lilith had taken a fancy to that human...
How could she possibly send this "rival" back?
Moreover, she discovered that this human had contracted the Frost Ice Phoenix—
A perfect match with her attributes.
Once this Ice Phoenix matures, it could well become another powerful Guardian under her command.
Therefore, she was even less likely to release Ying Bing.
Facing such a response, Ying Bing felt nothing but helplessness.
During this period, she had pleaded with the Snow Woman countless times but failed each time.
Now, her heart was filled with worries:
Why did she end up here? Is Longxia Country safe? How is Gu Xing doing?
... She had no way of knowing any of these.
It’s not that she hadn’t tried to leave Snow Country.
But every time she attempted to get out of the snow mountain range, she would be stopped by the Snow Woman’s Guardians and "invited" back to the ice palace.
These days, her only "task" was to read stories to the Snow Woman and...
Answer the Snow Woman’s endless questions.
For example:
"What kind of person is Gu Xing? Why did Lilith choose him?"
Yet, she didn’t even know who Lilith was, so how could she answer?
Soon, the Snow Woman’s voice echoed again, with a hint of teasing:
"Xiaobing’Er, continue telling me stories. Maybe one day, when I’m in a good mood, I’ll let you go?"
Ying Bing sighed gently.
The situation was beyond her control, and she could only agree once more.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 278: Snow Wolf Race
chapters.content:
Chapter 278: Chapter 278: Snow Wolf Race
Further north of the Angel Race territory lies a realm perpetually covered in snow and ice, thus known as the Snow Kingdom.
This extremely cold land is harsh and hardly any species can survive here.
The only race that has inhabited this place for generations is the Snow Wolf Race.
Besides them, the Snow Woman clan, tasked with governing the entire Snow Kingdom, also resides here.
Through Lilith’s narration, Gu Xing finally gained a clear understanding of the Snow Kingdom’s situation.
"Lilith, so if we want to meet the Snow Woman, we must first go through the Snow Wolf Race?"
Lilith gently nodded.
"That’s right!"
If she still possessed her former strength, she could have directly brought Gu Xing to the peak of the Snow Kingdom and entered the cave where the Snow Woman resides.
However...
Now, her various attributes are merely at ten thousand points.
To bypass the Snow Wolf Race directly and reach the Snow Woman, it’s beyond her current capability.
Then, Lilith’s gaze fell on Gu Xing, suddenly remembering ——
Since Gu Xing has ascended to Monarch Level, it means...
He has gained a new contract quota.
She thought for a moment, coughed lightly twice, and tentatively spoke:
"Gu Xing, you... now that you’ve reached Monarch Level, do you have any plans for your sixth Guardian Beast?"
"Eh?"
Being asked this suddenly by Lilith, Gu Xing was momentarily stunned.
He pondered slightly, then softly replied:
"Regarding the sixth Guardian Beast... I plan to contract a Healing-type one."
After experiencing this battle, Gu Xing became more aware of the importance of a Healing-type Guardian Beast.
If there had been a Healing-type Guardian Beast, perhaps Vera and Liu Li would have recovered their combat power by now.
Therefore, he had already decided to reserve this new contract quota for a Healing-type Guardian Beast that could offer recovery and support.
However...
At the mention of contract quotas, Gu Xing’s brow slightly furrowed again.
Logically, that Bone Demon had Demon God Level talent.
Upon killing it, he should have obtained a contract opportunity and a Demon Pattern.
Yet...
He carefully examined the scene back then and found nothing.
There was no trace of a Demon Pattern, and even any remnant other than Demonic Qi had vanished without a trace.
Hearing Gu Xing’s answer, Lilith’s lips twitched slightly.
She several times wanted to speak but stopped, ultimately failing to say "Why not contract me then."
No matter what, she is still the Blood Ancestor...
It never occurred to Gu Xing to consider her while thinking about contracting a Guardian Beast.
But this was actually Lilith misunderstanding Gu Xing.
In the past, Gu Xing had considered contracting Lilith.
Only...
At the time, Lilith explicitly said she could never become someone else’s Guardian Beast.
Since then, Gu Xing had never considered Lilith again.
Lilith perhaps this time...
Ended up lifting a stone only to drop it on her own foot.
Paying a small price for her previous haughtiness.
"Hmph!"
Lilith snorted softly and then transformed into a stream of light, returning to Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space.
Gu Xing wants to contract a Healing-type Guardian Beast...
Of course, Lilith could hear the implication in his words ——
He wants to contract the Snow Woman!
She disdainfully pouted her lips.
Without her help, with Gu Xing’s current Monarch Level, not to mention all his battle Guardian Beasts almost losing combat power...
He still wants to contract a Totem-Level Snow Woman?
Whether or not he can even meet the Snow Woman in person is probably an unknown.
Gu Xing noticed Lilith’s somewhat unusual attitude, thought for a moment but still couldn’t understand why she behaved that way, so he didn’t ask further.
He began heading towards the central region of the Snow Kingdom, following the direction Lilith previously pointed out.
The temperature within the Snow Kingdom is extremely low, and the only Guardian Beast currently capable of fighting is Tushan Yueli.
Gu Xing dared not rashly fly across the sky ——
That would be too conspicuous, easily becoming a target for the aerial alien races.
Hence, he could only traverse the snowfields on foot, step by step towards the center of the Snow Kingdom.
However...
Gu Xing was unaware that:
Not far away in the snow, a group of figures, concealed in the white snow, was silently observing his every move.
Behind a snow mound.
A group of Snow Wolf Race members, with wolf-like ears and snowy tails, reported respectfully:
"Lord Xue Li, that strange-looking creature seems to be human!"
The female Snow Wolf, referred to as Xue Li, frowned slightly, retracting her gaze from Gu Xing in the distance.
She had skin like snow, her ear tips covered in white fur, and a cold yet perfect beauty.
She pondered for a moment and then spoke slowly:
"All along, our Snow Wolf Race’s mission has been to collect books from the human world for the Snow Woman."
"But recently..."
"The Snow Woman has been occupied by a human, and she rarely inquires about our Snow Wolf Race’s affairs anymore."
"I sense a strong crisis, so we must capture this human alive——"
"And then extract from him the method to once again please the Snow Woman."
Upon hearing Xue Li’s decision, the surrounding Snow Wolves had their eyes light up.
Over this period, they all harbored the same concern:
The Snow Woman’s attention seems to have shifted from the Snow Wolf Race.
For generations, the Snow Wolf Race has revered the Snow Woman, who has always protected them in turn, forming a mutually dependent relationship.
But now...
