This relationship seems to have developed a crack.
Such a situation cannot continue!
All the Snow Wolves instantly steeled their resolve.
"Lord Xue Li, at your command!"
"I’ll immediately deploy an ambush along the path this human must take."
Yet Xue Li gently shook her head.
"No need to ambush, just follow along, I’ll make a move myself later."
"I want to see what kind of magic the Human Race possesses to continuously attract the Snow Woman’s attention."
Hearing that Xue Li would act personally, none of the Snow Wolves had further objections.
It’s known that Xue Li is the youngest genius in the Snow Wolf Race, her strength among the top levels in the entire younger generation.
With Lord Xue Li making a personal move, capturing this human... will surely be easy as pie.
"Lord Xue Li, with your intervention, nothing can possibly go wrong!"
"Indeed, Lord Xue Li! Once we capture this human, the Snow Woman will surely show favor to our Snow Wolf Race again!"
Xue Li, however, lightly gestured for them to stop their praises.
"This human is not our sole target; the most important matter now is to inspect if there are any appearances of the Demon Race within the Snow Kingdom."
"The Snow Woman has long issued an order: The Demon Race is quite likely to strike at her."
"We cannot allow such a thing to happen—everyone must be on high alert, vigilant at all times."
Hearing Xue Li’s order, all the Snow Wolves became immediately solemn.
The Snow Woman is their belief, and any existence attempting to harm the Snow Woman must be completely eradicated.
"Understood, Lord Xue Li! We won’t let such a scenario occur!"
"Commence actions!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 279: How to Please Lady Snow Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 279: Chapter 279: How to Please Lady Snow Woman!
On the other side.
Gu Xing noticed that after a period of slumber, Liu Li seemed to show signs of awakening.
He didn’t hesitate to summon her from the Beast Taming Space, gently holding her in his arms.
Perhaps it was the familiar aura she sensed, the girl in his arms slightly fluttered her eyelashes twice before slowly opening her eyes.
The first thing she saw was an incredibly familiar face.
"Master...?"
The long sleep left Liu Li somewhat confused.
Looking at Gu Xing, she couldn’t immediately comprehend her situation.
Hearing her voice, Gu Xing’s eyes flashed with joy.
"Liu Li, how is your body? Is there anything uncomfortable...?"
In that moment, he voiced all his worries and questions.
Seeing Gu Xing so anxious about her, Liu Li felt a warmth rising in her heart.
The battle earlier had been intense, and they hadn’t had a chance to communicate.
After defeating the Bone Demon, she had collapsed from exhaustion, leaving all of Gu Xing’s worries unspoken.
After all, Liu Li had truly died once before. What if there were any lingering after-effects...?
"Master, I’m fine. It’s just that my body still feels weak..."
She tried to clench her fist but found herself completely devoid of strength.
Gu Xing understood well enough, knowing this was a side effect of overusing the Divine Pattern.
"Don’t worry, Liu Li, take good rest during this time. When we find the Snow Woman, your body will recover."
Upon hearing the words "Snow Woman," Liu Li looked around, realizing they had left the Angel Race’s territory.
She looked at Gu Xing, a trace of worry surfacing in her eyes.
Gu Xing understood her concerns and gently explained:
"Liu Li, your aunt must stay with the Angel Race to guard the Forbidden Land, but don’t worry, your clan members are all safe and sound."
Upon hearing his response, Liu Li finally felt at ease.
Yet she soon realized they were already in the Snow Country —
A completely unfamiliar land, making her instantly vigilant.
In the next moment, she tried to get up to protect Gu Xing.
Gu Xing gently pressed her back into his embrace.
"Liu Li, there’s no need for you to act this time."
"There’s almost no Demon Race within the Snow Country, no need to be so tense."
"Moreover, even if we run into danger, Tushan Yueli is here too."
Saying this, Gu Xing summoned Tushan Yueli.
After appearing, Tushan Yueli regarded Gu Xing with clear respect in her eyes.
Back when they first met in the Ghost Race, Gu Xing’s strength had just reached Monarch Level.
Yet upon meeting again now, his combat power was comparable to Totem Level, having saved the entire Qingqiu Race from the Demon Race, becoming their savior.
Thinking about that, her gaze towards Gu Xing grew ever more respectful.
"Master, rest assured, Yueli will protect you even at the cost of my life."
Seeing Tushan Yueli still somewhat restrained, Gu Xing wasn’t sure how to comfort her.
It seemed every new Guardian Beast reacted this way at first.
Qing Shuang and Fei Yue had been like this, and so was Tushan Yueli.
Thus, Gu Xing merely offered a couple of gentle reassurances and didn’t pay much more attention.
Then, he continued on his journey with Liu Li and Tushan Yueli.
For some reason...
Now, Gu Xing wanted to spend more time with Liu Li.
Thus, he didn’t let Liu Li return to the Beast Taming Space again.
Meanwhile, in the Beast Taming Space,
Fei Yue quietly approached Lilith, who was sulking while lying on a branch of the Tree of Life.
Observing everything, her ever-considerate mind had long noticed Lilith’s true feelings.
She reached out and gently poked Lilith.
Lilith turned her head grumpily:
"What, little brat? Aren’t you going to tend to your sister? Why are you here?"
Facing Lilith’s impatient attitude, Fei Yue didn’t mind and tentatively asked:
"Lilith, how about... I ask Master to make a contract with you?"
Upon hearing this, Lilith’s body slightly stiffened, then she answered defiantly:
"Just mind your own business, I don’t need it!"
"Besides, I’ve never thought about contracting with Gu Xing. What good would it do me?"
"Before long, I’ll restore myself to Totem Level on my own!"
"Why should I give that up and contract with him, only to drop my power back to Monarch Tier One?"
Fei Yue looked deeply at Lilith.
She had given her advice.
It’s up to the other to accept it or not.
She could only turn away, silently murmuring to herself:
"Pride goes before a fall."
But just then, Lilith suddenly received a mental query from Gu Xing:
"Lilith, is there something off about our surroundings?"
Upon hearing this, Lilith briefly scanned the area —
Noticing a somewhat familiar figure, she lost interest again.
What did Gu Xing’s fate matter to her?
He wasn’t her master.
Meanwhile, without a response from Lilith, Gu Xing was momentarily stunned.
What was going on with Lilith?
She had been fine before and now suddenly ignored him?
Gu Xing pondered for a moment, assuming Lilith hadn’t detected anything unusual due to her greatly weakened Attributes, hence her silence.
With that thought, his demeanor grew more cautious.
Given that his Guardian Beasts’ combat abilities were now not as strong as before, encountering an enemy could be disastrous...
Soon, he realized—
He was already quietly surrounded by a group of white figures.
Leading them was a snow wolf with a chilling gaze and an icy demeanor.
"Human, surrender peacefully and come with us, or don’t blame us for using force."
The moment he saw them, Gu Xing immediately associated the figures with the "Snow Wolf Race" Lilith had mentioned.
Surrender?
Though only Tushan Yueli retained battle potential, and with her Myth Five Stars Talent compounded by Gu Xing’s various abilities...
Ordinary Monarch Level foes wouldn’t have been a match for them.
Yet, right at the moment he was about to act—
Lilith’s lazy voice suddenly echoed in his mind:
"If you still plan to ask the Snow Woman for help... you’d best listen to what these snow wolves say."
Upon hearing her advice, Gu Xing hesitated momentarily before signaling Tushan Yueli not to act rashly.
After all, they were here to seek aid, not to make enemies.
Seeing Gu Xing give up resistance, Xue Li decisively commanded:
"Take them!"
Gu Xing took a deep breath, raising his hands slowly to show he meant no harm.
Xue Li’s icy gaze lingered on him for a moment before signaling her subordinates to advance.
Two Snow Wolf Race members cautiously approached, using a special ice lock to bind his hands.
Tushan Yueli’s fox tails stood on alert, but under Gu Xing’s gaze, she refrained from fighting back.
Noting the man’s compliance, Xue Li nodded in satisfaction.
Leaving some behind to continue guarding against the Demon Race, she led Gu Xing back to the Snow Wolf Race’s settlement.
To inquire of this human...
Ways to appease the Snow Woman!

chapters.title: Chapter 280: The Snow Wolf Race’s Request
chapters.content:
Chapter 280: Chapter 280: The Snow Wolf Race’s Request
In a room entirely constructed of ice.
Gu Xing was escorted by two tall Snow Wolf Race members on either side, sitting on a cold ice stool.
Opposite him, Xue Li was watching him with an unabashedly inquisitive look.
Her silver-white hair cascaded like an ice waterfall, almost blending with the ice crystal decorations around her, with her icy blue eyes flickering with curiosity.
Her slender fingertips rhythmically tapped on the ice table in front of her, emitting a crisp knocking sound, then she spoke in a cold voice:
"Human, state your purpose for coming to the Snow Country."
Though she didn’t sense the aura of the Demon Race from this human.
But just in case, she still needed to interrogate him.
Gu Xing did not respond immediately but instead silently surveyed his surroundings.
He noticed everything about the Snow Wolf Race—
From tables and chairs to wall decorations, even weapons hanging in the corners...
All were forged from ice.
The entire space seemed dominated by pure white, almost excluding any other colors.
The Snow Country was isolated from the outside world, with almost no communication with it.
Yet...
He recalled the sights he passed through in the Snow Wolf Race territory:
Aside from the monarch-level presence of Xue Li, most of the Snow Wolf warriors were relatively unremarkable in strength.
Yet such an apparently weak group had surprisingly never been invaded by the Demon Race.
Strange indeed!
And seeing this human completely ignore her question, Xue Li’s eyes flashed coldly, and she suddenly stood up.
Her snow-white palm, carrying a fierce momentum, slapped heavily on the ice table, producing a "bang" sound, causing the tabletop to crack with several fine ice lines.
"I asked you a question! Answer me!"
Seeing this, Gu Xing’s mouth twitched almost imperceptibly.
In theory, the strength of this Snow Wolf...
[Snow Wolf (Xue Li)]
[Talent: Myth Two Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier Three]
[Power: 80000]
[Constitution: 70000]
[Spirit: 70000]
[Speed: 80000]
[Skills: Extreme Cold Domain, Absolute Zero....]
Scanning over the attribute panel of the Snow Wolf in front of him, Gu Xing silently assessed in his heart—
With Xue Li’s strength, she could only be considered very average.
Even the currently weakened Tushan Yueli could easily defeat her.
Only...
Gu Xing recalled what Lilith had said.
To get the Snow Woman to help treat his Guardian Beast, he must earn the recognition of the Snow Wolf Race.
And now, even if this Snow Wolf’s strength was not as great as his, he still had to swallow his pride.
"I came here to find the Snow Woman!"
"How dare you!"
Hearing that Gu Xing’s purpose was to go directly to the Snow Woman, Xue Li was instantly furious, icy blue eyes flashing with a cold gleam.
She fiercely slammed the ice table, emitting a fierce chill around her:
"Take this reckless human away and execute him!"
Gu Xing: "..."
And in the Beast Taming Space,
Lilith was leisurely leaning against the branch of the Tree of Life, watching the scene outside with interest.
Regarding the Snow Wolf Race, Lilith was more than familiar—
They were considered her old friends.
She knew very well that the seemingly fierce Xue Li in front of her was still essentially kind-hearted.
Although she was shouting to "take Gu Xing away and execute him," she was just trying to scare him.
Moreover...
With Gu Xing’s current strength, he was far beyond what this group of Snow Wolves could contend with.
Even if Liu Li and Qing Shuang were temporarily out of action, Tushan Yueli and Fei Yue alone could easily sweep through the entire Snow Wolf Race.
Therefore, she was not worried about Gu Xing’s safety at all.
The real dilemma for her was how to contact the Snow Woman.
Now she was not even one-tenth as powerful, so she really couldn’t help much.
Ultimately, it would be up to Gu Xing to gain the recognition of the Snow Wolf Race so they could lead him to see the Snow Woman.
After all, there was a powerful Guardian near the cave where the Snow Woman lived.
That was also why she couldn’t get close to the Snow Woman’s cave.
Of course, there was another important reason for not helping.
And that was...
Gu Xing still didn’t understand her desire to contract with him!
What did this mean?
Did she really have to lower her stance and actively make a request?
Liu Li, standing aside, caught Lilith’s dilemma and rolled her eyes speechlessly.
She wanted to contract with the master, yet she wouldn’t open her mouth!
But since Lilith didn’t speak, she definitely wouldn’t help either.
After all, with Gu Xing’s ability to enhance Guardian Beasts’ talent, countless Guardian Beasts longed to contract with him; it wasn’t a situation where the master should be the one begging for a contract.
Moreover...
Her gaze fell on the unhappy Lilith.
This Blood Ancestor had intentions toward the master all along, and now with just a Blood Covenant, it was already this "dangerous." If a full contract were signed with Gu Xing...
Who knows what would happen?
So delaying for a moment was all the better.
Unfortunately, Lilith had no awareness of this, stubbornly clinging to the dignity of the Blood Ancestor, not willing to lose face.
And such an outcome, she was probably bringing upon herself.
At this moment.
Facing Gu Xing’s plea for help once more, she chose to ignore him again.
Not receiving a response, Gu Xing’s brow unconsciously furrowed slightly.
This Snow Wolf had already issued an order for his execution, and he couldn’t just sit and wait for death.
Thinking of this, he was ready to summon Tushan Yueli and forcefully break through the predicament in front of him.
His goal was to see the Snow Woman, not to tangle with the Snow Wolf Race.
If he couldn’t gain their recognition, he didn’t mind using force to make them lead the way.
However, just as he was about to act—
Xue Li suddenly raised her hand, stopping the Snow Wolves that were escorting Gu Xing out.
"Wait!"
Hearing her command, the two Snow Wolves immediately halted.
Xue Li walked slowly to Gu Xing, speaking seriously:
"The Snow Woman detests humans and is not someone you can see at will."
"And your other races usually seek the Snow Woman for the same reason—to ask her to save someone."
"Am I right?"
Hearing this, Gu Xing nodded.
Seeking the Snow Woman to help his Guardian Beast was indeed a fact he didn’t intend to hide.
Seeing he didn’t deny, Xue Li continued:
"If you are willing to do me a favor, I can make an exception and take your Guardian Beast to request the Snow Woman’s help."
"With my identity making the request, it’ll be far more successful than if you went yourself."
"How about it?"
Hearing this, Gu Xing pondered carefully.
What this Snow Wolf said wasn’t unreasonable.
His goal was simply to heal his Guardian Beasts.
The process wasn’t very important.
"Deal."
Seeing Gu Xing agree, Xue Li then said:
"In that case, first tell me the most moving love story from the human world."
Hearing this, even the weathered Gu Xing froze abruptly.
"What?"
"The most moving love story?"
"Is this for real?"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 281: Homebody! Snow Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 281: Chapter 281: Homebody! Snow Woman!
At the peak of the snow mountain, deep within the ice cave.
Ying Bing reluctantly finished reading the last story, her face full of helplessness.
She set down the yellowed scroll in her hand and softly said:
"Lady Snow Woman..."
Before she could finish, the Snow Woman lazily interrupted:
"Considering you showed some diligence today, I permit you to go down the mountain for a walk."
"Go ahead, the Guardians won’t stop you."
"But—"
Her tone shifted with a slight warning, "Don’t think about escaping."
"Crisis lurks within the Snow Country; without a guide, outsiders can’t take a step."
"If you wander off and lose your life...don’t say I didn’t warn you."
Although Ying Bing was human, during their time together, the Snow Woman found her nature pure and not annoying, hence the rare reminder.
If it were someone else, she wouldn’t bother to pay attention.
Ying Bing looked at the Snow Woman’s profile, which left no room for negotiation, and nodded lightly.
At least now she could go down the mountain—
Far better than before, when she wasn’t even allowed a step past the cave entrance.
Perhaps in a few more days, the Snow Woman would truly allow her to leave.
"Thank you, Lady Snow Woman."
After bowing to the Snow Woman, she turned and quickly walked out of the ice cave.
Now that she could descend the mountain, she would certainly inquire about the outside world from the Snow Wolf Race residing there.
The Snow Woman watched Ying Bing’s departing figure and shook her head slightly.
"Clearly someone caught in the web of love."
"Such a pitiably charming appearance."
"If it weren’t for helping Lilith...perhaps I’d truly soften and let her go."
"What a pity..."
To help her dear friend, the Snow Woman had no choice but to confine Ying Bing.
However...
The Snow Woman couldn’t help but grow curious about this human named Gu Xing.
What magic did this person possess, that not only won the heart of a stunning woman like Ying Bing, but even ensnared an ancient "witch" like Lilith?
It made her curious to meet this human herself!
Only...
She didn’t know, at this moment, Gu Xing was at the Snow Wolf Race’s base—
at the foot of the mountain, within her territory on the pinnacle of Snow Country.
Meanwhile, within the Snow Wolf Race’s ice hall.
After some explanation from Xue Li, Gu Xing finally understood the intention behind her sudden question.
"Are you saying...your Lady Snow Woman is obsessed with human love stories?"
Gu Xing widened his eyes in shock.
A Totem Level being, the peak dominator of Snow Country, would actually enjoy such...
Childish things?
Xue Li also knew well that their master’s hobby was indeed difficult to talk about.
She braced herself and explained in a low voice:
"Lady Snow Woman dwells year-round in the snow mountain ice cave, her only pastime being reading."
"Who knew that upon accidentally encountering a human love novel once, she became...irresistibly hooked."
Gu Xing couldn’t help the twitch at the corner of his mouth.
This Snow Woman, she was truly beyond his expectations.
But...
Love stories?
A hint of confidence quietly flitted across Gu Xing’s eyes.
Though the literary entertainment in this world was underdeveloped, in his past life era—
Classic works were abundant, touching stories countless.
Might he not conquer an isolated...homebody Snow Woman?!
According to this Snow Wolf’s statement, as long as he could satisfy the Snow Woman,
Liu Li’s injury caused by the Divine Pattern could easily recover...
Gu Xing turned his gaze to Xue Li; at this moment, this Snow Wolf also seemed aware of how outlandish her request was.
After all, in this world’s normal human society, engagement with various entertainment modes was rare.
It was clear from their secretive trips to the Human World that finding reading material appealing to Lady Snow Woman was quite difficult.
Only...
Xue Li didn’t know, she had found a man unbelievably adept at this.
Faced with such a simple request, Gu Xing did not hesitate to agree.
"Leave it to me!"
....
Deep within the Demon Realm, dark Demonic Qi surged like a tangible entity.
Ten ancient Demon Gates loomed in the Void, faintly visible, their surfaces engraved with obscure runes.
"Damn it...the Bone Demon has actually fallen!"
A hoarse and angry voice rang out from one of the Demon Gates, vibrating the surrounding Demonic Qi:
"Who in this world can kill a Bone Demon close to Totem Tier Three?"
After a brief silence, a deep response echoed from another Demon Gate:
"Could it be...the Dragon Race?"
As the voice fell, several Demon Gates fell simultaneously silent.
The Dragon Race was undeniably the strongest Race in this Alternate Space.
Totem Level existence was a distant peak for other Races, but almost commonplace among the Dragon Race.
Born Monarch Level, with time, ascending to Totem Level was as natural as breathing.
"Damn Dragon Race!"
From the first Demon Gate, an unwilling roar erupted, "If not for this damn seal’s constraints..."
"The Demon Race’s army would have long flattened Dragon Island, grinding those long serpents to dust!"
"Saying this now is meaningless."
A relatively calm voice cut in:
"The Bone Demon’s fall is a waste; we spent significant resources sending him into that world, yet he couldn’t even capture a single Divine Pattern..."
"However, the seal on the tenth Demon Gate has begun to loosen."
Another voice interjected, "Just wait a little longer, and this gate’s restraints on us will be completely lifted."
"By then, the entire Alternate Space will tremble beneath our feet!"
"But before that..."
The calm voice spoke again, its tone heavy, "We must capture another Divine Pattern."
"Otherwise, even if the tenth Demon Gate opens, our vanguard will be no match for the Dragon Race."
"But now, we’ve almost tried all the top Races with Divine Patterns, yet all ended in failure..."
"No, there’s one more."
The calm voice decisively countered.
"Where?"
"Snow Country, Snow Race."
A deeper silence spread out.
That place, bitterly cold, where Demonic Qi struggles to extend, the Demon Race’s army finds it hard to penetrate deeply.
Moreover...
"That Snow Woman’s Guardian...is no easy opponent."
"Don’t worry, I have a plan."
The calm voice seemed to have a comprehensive scheme.
"Those insects...haven’t they always yearned to enter this Alternate Space? Let’s lend them a hand."
"Insect Race?!"
All the Demon Gates’ auras momentarily halted.
Even they couldn’t help being apprehensive when mentioning this Race.
Their sole purpose for existence is to devour and destroy, wherever they pass...
Everything becomes desolate, and several worlds have entirely perished under their swarms.
"Isn’t this too risky?"
"Risky, but worth it."
"First use them to destroy the Snow Country, we only need to reap the benefits and seize the Divine Pattern."
"As for those insects..."
"Once we regain our strength, we naturally have ways to handle them gradually."
"They have no desire for Divine Patterns and only bring pure destruction."
"Once the Snow Country falls, we will easily recover the Divine Pattern."
"Good!"
"Let’s do it!"
With the plan decided, several Demon Gates simultaneously emitted a dark light, sinister runes slowly swirling.
An intangible, malicious will pierced through the barriers of space, sending an enticing signal to a distant and famished Race.

chapters.title: Chapter 282: Reunion?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 282: Chapter 282: Reunion?!
At the same time.
Ying Bing finally stepped out of the ice cave that the Snow Woman had long forbidden her to leave.
The view suddenly opened up; all around was an endless expanse of white, the extremely cold air pure and biting.
In this icy realm, she clearly felt the spiritual power within her body becoming abnormally active.
This was no illusion.
This near-death experience was not without its benefits—
The Snow Woman had used a special method, not only perfectly curing her inherent physical defects but also returning all the life force that had been consumed and stored by her constitution.
Fortune often accompanies misfortune, and her strength instantly broke through the constraints of the Commander Level, leaping directly to the Monarch Level.
At this moment, looking at the gradually clearer outline of the Snow Wolf Race’s quarters, Ying Bing felt a long-lost sense of tension rising in her heart.
The last time before she fell into a coma, the situation of Longxia Country was very unfavorable.
The five Void Gates were simultaneously under fierce attack by the Demon Race, and the Gate of Space at the Imperial Capital surely bore the brunt of the strongest assault.
Her father...
She didn’t even dare to think deeply about it!
Moreover, she couldn’t determine whether the figure of Gu Xing she saw before falling unconscious was merely a hallucination in her near-death state.
Logically speaking, Gu Xing should have been in closed training at the Beast Taming Holy Pool to break through to Commander Level, and it was impossible for him to appear on the battlefield in Lin Yuan City.
Yet...
The moment before she closed her eyes, his figure was so clearly real.
Ying Bing took a deep breath of the icy air, her gaze gradually becoming determined.
Whether or not that was an illusion, her primary task now was to find a way to leave Snow Country.
Her trip to the Snow Wolf Race was not only to inquire about the current situation in Longxia Country but had another purpose—
To find a way to secretly leave Snow Country.
Since the Snow Woman did not allow her to leave without permission, she would find her own way.
Although the Snow Woman had saved her life, she now had more important things to do.
Only by confirming the safety of Longxia Country could she return peacefully to repay the Snow Woman’s kindness.
With this in mind, she couldn’t help but quicken her pace.
Now that her level has advanced to Monarch Level, Ying Bing’s speed was very fast.
This journey was almost completed within a quarter of an hour under her feet.
The Snow Wolf Race members guarding the entrance to the Snow Wolf Race’s land saw Ying Bing’s figure and did not stop her.
During this time, the news that this human was highly favored by the Snow Woman had spread throughout the entire Snow Wolf Race, so naturally everyone recognized Ying Bing.
However, although they did not stop her from entering the quarters, the Snow Wolves would not let her move around freely either.
Just as Ying Bing was about to head toward the most conspicuous ice house in the center of the quarters, her path was blocked by two Snow Wolf warriors.
"Ahead is the restricted area of the Snow Wolf Race, outsiders are not allowed to approach."
Seeing this, Ying Bing frowned slightly.
Previously she had tried to inquire about news from several Snow Wolf Race members in the quarters, but don’t even mention the current situation in Longxia Country...
They knew very little about the situation outside of Snow Country.
What puzzled her more was that these Snow Wolves seemed to harbor a vague hostility towards her—
Yet it was clearly the first time she had met them.
Having no other choice, she planned to seek a higher-ranking member of the race to inquire, but she was unexpectedly stopped even from approaching.
"I want to see your Lord Xue Li."
From the fragmented information, she learned that Lord Xue Li was now responsible for the major affairs of the Snow Wolf Race, so she directly mentioned the name.
However, the guards among the Snow Wolves exchanged glances and then categorically refused:
"Impossible, Lord Xue Li is currently occupied with important matters and cannot receive visitors."
Ying Bing frowned even more deeply.
It was rare for the Snow Woman to allow her to leave the ice cave; if she gained nothing from the Snow Wolf Race, wouldn’t this hard-won opportunity be wasted?
"Couldn’t you make an exception?"
"No way!"
Seeing that these Snow Wolves showed no intention to compromise, Ying Bing secretly clenched her hands—
She could not miss this opportunity.
Since they wouldn’t let her see Xue Li, she would have to try by force.
"Profound Frost Ice Phoenix!"
In an instant, the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix was summoned by her, its icy crystalline wings spread, emitting a chilling aura.
However, before she could issue a command, the door of the ice house suddenly opened, and the Xue Li she was looking for came out on her own.
"Ying Bing, why aren’t you staying with the Snow Woman and running to my Snow Wolf Race?"
Xue Li’s tone was not friendly, as in her view, Ying Bing’s presence had taken away the Snow Woman’s attention.
But Ying Bing had no time to care about the unfriendly words; seeing the main person, she asked straightforwardly:
"Lord Xue Li, I want to ask about the situation in Longxia Country!"
"Longxia Country?"
Xue Li slightly frowned, initially unwilling to answer Ying Bing’s question.
But seeing Ying Bing’s worried look, she softened somewhat and said:
"I don’t know much about Longxia Country! But I can confirm that the country should be doing fine."
Every time she went out to help the Snow Woman gather information, the place they went the most was the Holy See.
Moreover, they had never intentionally probed for external information.
Therefore, they knew very little about Longxia Country’s intelligence.
But they could confirm that Longxia Country was indeed safe and sound.
Otherwise, they would have heard some news while at the Holy See.
Upon hearing that Longxia Country was safe, Ying Bing instantly breathed a sigh of relief.
She originally wanted to ask about Gu Xing, but...
Thinking that Gu Xing might not be that well-known among the Human Race.
So, she abandoned that idea.
After asking Xue Li a few more questions, Ying Bing expressed her gratitude and turned to leave.
Knowing that Longxia Country was fine, she could be at ease.
As for a way out of Snow Country, she definitely couldn’t inquire from Xue Li.
However.
What Ying Bing didn’t know was that, just on the other side of the wall of the ice house—
Gu Xing was bent over the desk, writing down all those moving stories from his memory.
The purpose...
Was to please a certain home-loving girl.
Yet, just as Ying Bing was turning to leave, Gu Xing suddenly looked up from the desk.
In that instant, he seemed to sense a familiar aura...
Like Ying Bing.
But he had previously asked Xue Li, who clearly stated that Ying Bing was still receiving treatment in the Snow Woman’s cave.
Therefore, he assumed it was just a fleeting illusion.
Thinking of Ying Bing, Gu Xing unconsciously tightened his fingers.
He wondered how the girl’s injuries were now...
A trace of worry that could not be concealed swept across his eyes.
At the same time—
At an extremely remote corner on the border of Snow Country, a fragment of space suddenly peeled away.
A dim Void Passage was silently and slowly taking shape.
Incredibly creepy insects began migrating towards the center of Snow Country.
Where they passed, ice and snow melted, spiritual power depleted, and the world seemed to have died.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 283: Snow Country Mutation!
chapters.content:
Chapter 283: Chapter 283: Snow Country Mutation!
At this moment, near the border of the Snow Country.
A red and a green humanoid Insect Race stood silently at the front of the line, breathing the cold air of the Snow Country.
Even though this land was covered in ice and snow all year round, compared to their barren, desolate homeland...
The conditions here were significantly better!
"Indeed... the air of this world is much fresher."
The red humanoid Insect Race displayed an almost intoxicated expression.
Its shell-like arms slowly spread out, as if wanting to embrace this frigid and pure world.
However, the green Insect Race beside it did not rush to savor the moment. It pondered a bit, and cautiously spoke:
"This location we found this time... is quite peculiar."
"Why would the Demon Race, always opposed to us, voluntarily reveal the coordinates of this world to us?"
Upon hearing its companion’s concern, the red Insect Race’s expression also turned serious.
This matter indeed carried an unusual air.
Although the Insect Race and Demon Race were not mortal enemies like other races and the Demon Race, they still had their share of conflicts.
The Demon Race has no reason to help them find a new world to devour...
"Let all Insect Race members be cautious, avoid falling into a trap by the Demon Race."
"Even though our Insect Race fears no challenge, but..."
"We cannot afford senseless sacrifices either."
"However, the reason the leaders sent us here is twofold: First, to explore the reality of this world..."
"Second, to uncover the true intentions of the Demon Race."
"But—"
Its tone shifted, eyes turning icy:
"Since the Demon Race voluntarily offered up the coordinates, no matter what they’re plotting... we Insect Race must take this world first!"
The green Insect Race nodded heavily.
The number of Insect Race members was so vast it’s hard to estimate, and the energy required to sustain the entire race was astronomical.
For survival, they had no choice but to continuously invade and devour world after world.
Soon, the two Insect Race members reached an agreement.
They raised their arms and waved silently—
The swarm of insects behind them began to surge, steadily advancing towards the center of the Snow Country.
However, at that moment, a soldier bug, slightly larger than the other Insect Race members, quickly arrived in front of the two humanoid Insect Races.
Its antennae on its forehead trembled at high frequencies, transmitting information.
Only Insect Race members of Totem Level could transform into humanoid forms, while the rest maintained their insect forms, communicating through their antennae.
Upon receiving the intel from the Half-step Totem Level soldier bug, the expressions of the two humanoid Insect Races changed dramatically.
In a flash, they appeared at the forefront of the Insect Race army.
Looking in the direction indicated by the soldier bug, they discovered a cave half-covered in ice and snow, where a giant, entirely white bear was asleep...
Its body exuded a rich Life Energy, which instinctively excited them.
The Snow Country, located at the extreme northern border of an Alternate Space, was rarely approached by other races not only due to the harsh environment but also because it was home to one of the four Fierce Beasts, the "Cold Snake."
Unlike the solitary Nine Nether Centipede King, the Cold Snake ruled the entire Snow Country, commanding numerous powerful Fierce Beasts.
And this white bear was one of the Cold Snake’s capable subordinates.
At this moment, the giant bear was still in deep sleep, unaware of the looming danger—
It did not know it had been firmly targeted by a group of ravenous Insect Races, eager to feast.
Staring at the abundant Life Energy emanating from the white bear, the two Totem Level Insect Races almost drooled.
Their homeland had long been devoured to nothingness, everything barren.
Unlike the Demon Race, which valued blood as food, the Insect Race feasted on any existence imbued with Life Energy.
In the barren land of the Snow Country, even a proper plant was hard to find.
Thus, upon seeing the sleeping giant bear, greed flashed instantly in their eyes.
In the next moment, the two humanoid Insect Races could no longer restrain themselves and pounced towards the cave—
Their ferocious mandibles bit fiercely into the body of the white bear.
The sudden intense pain instantly woke the giant bear. It opened its eyes to see two bizarre creatures it had never seen before, launching an attack on it.
As the overlord of this area, being treated as prey was intolerable.
"ROAR—!!!"
The white bear let out an ear-splitting roar of rage, its massive body reared up, swinging its claws at the two Insect Races.
However, the two Insect Races, both possessing Totem Level strength, were against merely a Half-step Totem Level white bear.
Even without deliberate defense, the natural toughness of their carapaces negated any harm from the bear’s bites, instead shattering its fangs with the recoil force.
At that moment, the white bear finally realized it was no match for these strange creatures.
Without hesitation, it turned to flee.
But the two ravenous Insect Races had no intention of letting their prey escape.
They caught up with the bear almost instantly, their sharp mandibles locking tightly onto its throat.
In its final moments, knowing escape was impossible, the white bear gathered all its remaining Power within...
Sending out a signal of extreme danger towards the depths of the Snowfield.
Throughout the domain of the Snow Country, long occupied jointly by the Cold Snake and the Snow Woman’s forces.
Both sides had divided territories, maintaining a delicate balance of non-interference—
The Snow Woman and Cold Snake mutually respected boundaries, coexisting peacefully.
And at that moment, the white bear’s critical danger signal, sent at the cost of its life, swiftly traversed the desolate, cold Snowfield, reaching faraway lands.
Meanwhile, deep within a profound ice cave, a blue giant serpent several hundred meters long, covered entirely with thick ice armor, slowly raised its massive head.
"The white bear... is dead?"
Its snake-shaped vertical pupils contracted sharply, revealing a hint of shock.
The white bear’s strength ranked among the top under its command, not even managing to flee, only managing a warning of being attacked?
"Could it be... the Snow Woman’s Guardian intervened?"
Among the entire Snow Domain, capable of killing a white bear so swiftly, the first thing that came to mind was the mysterious Guardian under the Snow Woman’s command.
However...
The two forces had peacefully coexisted for many years, the Snow Woman had no reason to suddenly act against them.
The Cold Snake’s eyes flickered with deep caution.
It wasn’t reckless and foolish like the Nine Nether Centipede King.
"ROAR—!!!"
A serpeant’s roar pierced through the ice layer, its sound wave carrying a chilling cold, instantly spreading across the entire Snow Domain.
Every Fierce Beast that heard this assembly signal, regardless of their current location.
They immediately turned their direction, rapidly converging towards the Cold Snake’s ice cave location...
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 284: Insect Race Invasion!
chapters.content:
Chapter 284: Chapter 284: Insect Race Invasion!
At the peak of the snow mountain, within the ice cave.
Ying Bing had just returned to this place.
She had inquired at the Snow Wolf Race’s camp for a long time, but no one told her the method to leave the Snow Country. Helplessly, she returned to the abode of the Snow Woman.
At this moment, the Snow Woman still maintained a lazy posture, leisurely lying sideways on the ice bed.
Seeing Ying Bing return, she lazily propped herself up and glanced at her:
"Back already?"
"I thought you’d take the opportunity to escape the Snow Country."
Ying Bing merely cast a silent glance at the Snow Woman, then walked to the side without responding.
The Snow Woman appeared on the surface as a "shut-in" indifferent to worldly matters, but she actually maintained a clear grasp on the situation in the Snow Country and beyond.
If not, she wouldn’t be able to firmly hold the position of Snow Country’s master, rivaling Cold Snake.
Seeing Ying Bing’s indifferent attitude, the Snow Woman instead leapt off the ice bed and moved closer to her, a curious glint in her eyes:
"Xiaobing’Er, since you’ve already heard Longxia Country is safe, you should be at ease now, right?"
"Why not... tell me about Gu Xing now?"
When she heard the words "Gu Xing," Ying Bing suddenly froze, then turned sharply, looking shocked at the Snow Woman.
She clearly remembered that she never mentioned Gu Xing’s name in front of the Snow Woman—
How did she know?
The Snow Woman chuckled lightly upon seeing this, and directly explained:
"When you were unconscious, you kept calling this name."
Hearing this explanation, Ying Bing’s cheeks immediately flushed.
Did she really do such a shameful thing unconsciously?
Yet, before she could recover from her embarrassment, the Snow Woman’s next words utterly froze her in place:
"Also I discovered, my good friend Lilith’s man... is also named Gu Xing."
"I’m really curious, what kind of magic does this person possess, causing both of you to be so enchanted by him."
The Snow Woman underestimated the impact of this statement.
"Man?"
Ying Bing was completely shaken by these two words, her mind blank.
She never thought that just after being unconscious for a while, the person she silently held dear in her heart...
Had already become someone else’s "man."
She opened her mouth, her throat somewhat dry, hesitated for a while, and then quietly asked:
"Lilith...who is she?"
The Snow Woman took in Ying Bing’s reaction, secretly pleased—
Her scheme succeeded.
She deliberately spoke these words to completely break Ying Bing’s hope.
With this human girl’s talent, if she could utilize the unique environment of the Snow Country and her careful assistance, given time....
Perhaps she could cultivate her to the Totem Level.
By then, the safety of the Snow Country would be greatly enhanced.
Moreover, the Snow Woman could clearly feel that Ying Bing was never someone who repaid kindness with vengeance.
On the contrary, she always remembered the saving grace deep in her heart—
From her willingness to patiently narrate various stories at the Snow Woman’s request despite her reluctance, it could be observed.
She was simply the perfect guardian candidate!
The Snow Woman secretly glanced at Ying Bing.
Besides valuing the latter’s talent, her greatest goal was actually to reduce a potential love rival for her good friend.
After all, no matter what, Ying Bing was human, belonging to the same race as Gu Xing, which naturally gave her an advantage.
While her friend Lilith was the Blood Race’s ancestor, this scenario...
Had to be prevented.
"You’ve seen the Blood Race’s ancestor, haven’t you?"
The Snow Woman deliberately casually added.
Ying Bing suddenly recalled the fleeting glance of that figure in the Divine Secret Realm.
But...how did Gu Xing end up with her?
At that moment, she wished to find Gu Xing immediately and get answers to everything.
Yet...how should she approach him?
Thinking of this, she suddenly felt drained of strength, her eyes downcast.
The Snow Woman saw this and seized the moment to speak, her tone with a hint of persuasion:
"Xiaobing’Er, now that it’s confirmed that Longxia Country is safe, and the one you like..."
"That person is already with someone else."
"Shouldn’t you now be willing to stay obediently in the Snow Country?"
A slight smile of self-satisfaction appeared on her face, as if she could already see Ying Bing nodding in agreement.
However—
"I’m sorry, Snow Woman." Ying Bing raised her head, "I still want to return to Longxia Country."
Upon hearing this, the Snow Woman’s expression instantly darkened.
Without a word, she silently turned and walked to the side.
Miscalculated!
This woman...
Really stubborn!
Yet just at that moment—
A figure as pure white as snow, resembling an ice sculpture, suddenly appeared in the cave, silent yet carrying an icy chill.
Upon seeing this figure, the Snow Woman’s expression became extremely serious.
This was indeed the guardian of the Snow Country.
Under normal circumstances, the guardian would never easily appear before her.
Once they appeared, it meant something extremely serious had occurred within the Snow Country.
"What happened?" the Snow Woman asked solemnly.
Ying Bing also instantly sensed the atmosphere wasn’t right, her eyes focusing on the suddenly appearing guardian.
"Snow Woman, the Snow Country is currently facing a large-scale invasion by an unknown species."
"Invasion?"
The Snow Woman’s pupils slightly trembled.
This word could actually appear in the Snow Country—
This extremely cold land that even the Demon Race was reluctant to venture into lightly.
The Snow Country had little strategic value, and the fierce beasts under Cold Snake’s command occupied the territory. Even the Demon Race would need to weigh their options before invading.
But now...
"What’s the specific situation?"
The guardian didn’t say much, simply raising their hand with a wave.
In the next moment, a clear image materialized in the air:
Countless hideous-looking, shell-backed Insect Race creatures were surging over the snowy plains like a tide, leaving ice and snow melting and life extinguished in their path.
The Snow Woman’s face drastically changed.
Although just an image, she clearly felt the terror of these Insect Race creatures.
In the image, all visible bugs were without exception...
Commander Level!
And their numbers reached tens of thousands!
Among them were several particularly large-sized insects, with an aura clearly reaching Monarch Level.
And this is merely a section.
Beyond the image...
Who knows how many more of these bugs are surging in.
Almost instantly, the Snow Woman realized the severity of the situation—
These bugs could annihilate the entire Snow Country!
"Immediately notify the Snow Wolf Race, full armed defense!"
Ying Bing also understood the crisis in Snow Country, and she immediately stepped forward:
"I’ll go too!"
The Snow Woman turned to glance at her.
With Monarch Level power, she should at least have the ability to protect herself.
"Alright."
In the next moment, a cold and authoritative voice, as if piercing through the wind and snow, echoed throughout the Snow Wolf Race’s camp:
"All citizens, prepare for armed defense at once—the Snow Country is under invasion by foreign enemies!"
"All citizens, prepare for armed defense at once—the Snow Country is under invasion by foreign enemies!"
...
Watching stories beside Gu Xing, Xue Li immediately sat up, her face changing drastically upon hearing this voice.
"Gu Xing, stay right here! You’re absolutely not allowed to leave!"
After speaking, she dashed out without hesitation.
Almost simultaneously, Gu Xing’s spiritual link resonated with Lilith’s urgent warning:
"Gu Xing, something’s wrong! The Snow Woman herself issued a global alert, indicating the matter has become extremely serious."
....
...

chapters.title: Chapter 285: Absolute Numerical Superiority!
chapters.content:
Chapter 285: Chapter 285: Absolute Numerical Superiority!
Lilith, being a frequent visitor to the Snow Country, naturally understands the Snow Woman’s personality quite well.
This "homebody" usually has a lazy, carefree demeanor, but when it comes to serious matters, she is never vague.
The title of "Ruler of the Snow Country" is by no means an empty name.
"Gu Xing, quickly! Head to the highest peak in the northern part of the Snow Country—the Snow Woman is there!"
Without hesitation, Lilith directly revealed the Snow Woman’s location.
At this moment, she could no longer afford to be temperamental; everything had to prioritize the bigger picture.
The most important thing now is to quickly find out what exactly is happening in the Snow Country.
More critically...
Not only is her own strength difficult to exert, but several of Gu Xing’s main Guardian Beasts are also unable to fight.
If a strong enemy invades at this time...
Lilith dared not dwell on it, urging Gu Xing again to speed up.
At the moment Gu Xing received the reminder, he dashed out without hesitation, sprinting directly towards the majestic snow peak.
....
At the same time.
With the assistance of the Guardian of the Snow Country, Ying Bing had swiftly reunited with the Snow Wolf Race.
Upon seeing Ying Bing, who appeared with the Guardian, a hint of astonishment flashed in Xue Li’s eyes, but she quickly returned to normal.
Defending the Snow Country had nothing to do with this human.
This human had no reason to risk herself with them, yet...
This human was still determined to follow them.
It seems she still has a conscience.
The Snow Woman had rescued many races, yet gratitude was sparse among them.
More often, they were ungrateful wolves.
The Human Race, especially, was notorious for this.
This is a significant reason why the Snow Woman despises the Human Race.
Of course, there’s another reason—
The Snow Woman had been "poisoned" by human romance novels. Many stories depicted the Human Race as selfish and dark, further deepening her prejudice against them.
At this moment, Ying Bing approached Xue Li with a solemn expression and said in a deep voice:
"According to the Guardian’s information, this time the enemy is extraordinary, an unprecedented race."
"If we can’t stop the Insect Race... the Snow Wolf Race might have no choice but to retreat..."
Ying Bing’s gaze slowly swept over the entire Snow Wolf Race.
Compared to other places, the Snow Country, albeit relatively safe, had obvious drawbacks—
A dire lack of resources.
As a result, the Snow Wolf Race hadn’t developed into a top-tier race, with the strongest among them only reaching Monarch Peak.
With such strength...
Hoping to defeat an Insect Race army where even the lowest level is Commander Level seemed forlorn.
However, at this moment.
Xue Li glared fiercely at Ying Bing, her voice resolute:
The Snow Wolf Race will never fail! With the Guardian and the Snow Woman present, the Snow Country will never fall!"
"The Snow Country is where we’ve grown for generations, and we’re not going anywhere!"
Hearing Xue Li’s words, the surrounding members of the Snow Wolf Race immediately cast unfriendly glances at Ying Bing.
To them, the Snow Country was their only home, and they’d rather die in battle than leave.
And seeing this scene, Ying Bing also didn’t say much.
To her,
Her life was saved by the Snow Woman.
So even if she were to die here in battle this time, she had no regrets.
She just felt a little regretful not seeing the person she longed for night and day.
But this emotion quickly subsided.
Now, the most important thing was to deal with the Insect Race.
Everyone suddenly stopped in their tracks.
Before them was a terrifying sea of insects stretching endlessly—
Countless hideous insects surged like a black tide, their shells scraping with piercing sounds, blood-red compound eyes flickering with bloodlust in the snow, seemingly wanting to engulf the entire snowy plain completely.
Witnessing the overwhelming insect tide, even the previously confident Snow Wolf Race, who had faith in the Guardian of the Snow Country, was left speechless.
"What... What kind of race is this? Why is their number so terrifying!"
"It’s not just the number... I sensed no fewer than several hundred Monarch Level auras!"
"Damn it... How do we stop this? It’s suicide!"
Xue Li looked at the scene before her, her face turning extremely grim.
Faced truly with this unending sea of insects, she deeply felt the insignificance of individual power.
Even with the Guardian of the Snow Country’s powerful strength, being engulfed by such an ocean of insects would likely result in total annihilation in an instant.
Ying Bing, although she had anticipated the Insect Race’s numbers would be astonishing, was still taken aback by the sight.
According to her earlier estimates, with the Guardian of the Snow Country at the helm, and coupled with the entire Snow Wolf Race, even if they couldn’t defeat the Insect Race, they could at least delay it for a while.
But now she realized how naive she had been.
Under absolute numerical superiority, any advantage in quality became meaningless.
Ying Bing’s eyes gradually hardened.
This time, trying to stop the entire Insect Race by their own power was essentially a no-return endeavor.
Yet even so—
She stood firmly in place, without a trace of retreat.
When the insect army noticed a group of creatures standing in their path, the insects halted their advance in an orderly fashion, like a military unit.
Soon, a red and a green figure emerged slowly from the depths of the insect horde, reaching the front lines.
The red humanoid insect looked at the "blood food" blocking the road ahead, its eyes instantly glowing with bloodlust.
"The quality of these creatures is ordinary, but their numbers are quite decent..."
The green insect, on the other hand, appeared more cautious.
The strength of the creatures before it wasn’t remarkable, so it didn’t pay much attention.
Instead, it cast its gaze towards an ice mountain not far away, a cold glint crossing its compound eyes:
"Besides these exposed creatures, there seems to be another group... watching us secretly."
"Moreover, these creatures are carrying Demonic Qi, could they be sent by the Demon Race..."
Upon hearing the words Demon Race, the red humanoid insect’s eyes also turned solemn.
It hadn’t forgotten the order given by the higher-ups: to understand the Demon Race’s intentions.
Now these creatures seemed related to the Demon Race!
"Since they dare to spy... let’s capture them all!"
No matter what the Demon Race’s intentions were.
In the face of absolute power, any schemes or tricks were useless.
Though they opened a Void passage leading to this world with the help of the Void Lord.
However, this passage could accommodate only a limited number of high-level insects.
Thus, the insect species entering this world this time were mainly of lower-level swarms.
Even so, through the Void passage, an endless stream of low-level insects could continuously flood into this world.
As time passed, their strength would grow stronger and stronger!
And this was the terrifying aspect of the Insect Race!
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 286: The Ice and Snow Goddess
chapters.content:
Chapter 286: Chapter 286: The Ice and Snow Goddess
At the same time, atop a towering icy mountain not far from the battlefield.
The Cold Snake coiled at the peak of the ice-mountain, its body covered in dark blue scales that shone with a metallic coldness in the snowlight.
Behind it, a dense pack of fierce beasts stood silently, frozen in the biting cold wind like sculptures.
Its scarlet vertical pupils locked onto the distant, surging insect swarm, pupils narrowing into a dangerous slit—
—though it had lived for ages, this was the first time it had encountered such bizarre and terrifying creatures.
Despite this sea of insects, no single insect could possibly be its match.
Even those two insect leaders, who had taken human form and reached Totem Level in aura, if it were one-on-one combat, the Cold Snake had absolute confidence to tear them apart.
Yet...
When they gathered in such numbers, transforming into an endless black tide, the Cold Snake felt an unprecedented sense of oppression, so heavy it was suffocating.
Even for it, if it unfortunately fell into the center of this insect sea, it was almost impossible to escape unscathed.
One careless move, and it might easily...
... completely perish amidst this endless insect tide.
At that moment, a gigantic tiger with a snow-white body cautiously approached the Cold Snake, its fur bristling, and its amber beast eyes filled with fear:
"Master, what... what are these creatures? Just looking at them makes my limbs tremble..."
Its words immediately resonated, and the surrounding fierce beasts growled uneasily, their sharp claws carving deep marks into the ice.
Although they were called "fierce beasts," in front of this insect race, they were like a group of small pets.
The Cold Snake did not respond immediately. Its cold vertical pupils fixed on the path the insect race had taken—
The land there was utterly depleted, devoid of even a trace of Spiritual Qi.
As fierce beasts born from Demonic Qi, though they were bred in darkness, they required Spiritual Qi to grow.
And the pure icy Spiritual Qi of the Snow Country was the perfect place for it to train.
Therefore, unless absolutely necessary, it did not want to give up the territory of the Snow Country.
"Hiss—"
The Cold Snake’s tongue constantly flickered, tracing dangerous arcs through the air.
If these insect races were allowed to rampage, the Spiritual Qi of the entire Snow Country would be completely consumed.
By that time, it would be forced to leave this precious training land...
Its gaze slowly shifted to the Snow Wolf Race, who stood ready.
If it were to ally with this group of Snow Wolves...
Perhaps there would be a chance to defend the entire Snow Domain.
Moreover...
Even if unable to withstand them, it could always turn and flee.
With the Snow Wolf Race holding the fort, it would surely be able to retreat in one piece...
Thinking of this, the Cold Snake instantly made its decision.
"All fierce beasts, heed my command!"
The Cold Snake suddenly raised its head, its cold voice echoing in the wind and snow, "Temporarily ally with the Snow Wolf Race to exterminate this group of insects together!"
Amongst the fierce beasts, the hierarchy was strict, and the Cold Snake, as a King-level Fierce Beast, had its authority deeply ingrained in the heart of every fierce beast.
Thus, when it gave the command, the whole mountain resounded with deafening roars—
"Roar—!!"
"Howl—!!"
All manner of fierce beasts responded loudly in their own voices.
The sound waves rolled across the snowfield like a tangible force, even causing the distant insect tide to pause slightly.
Subsequently, dim blue scales on the Cold Snake began to glow faintly, its massive body swiftly contracting in the Spiritual Light, until it finally transformed into a man adorned in ice-blue scale armor, with a cold expression.
Faced with such an overwhelming insect tide, a large physique would only make it an easy target—
The Cold Snake would not make such a Low-Level mistake.
Though fierce beasts at the Totem Level could transform into human form, they typically preferred staying in their beast forms.
It was not only more comfortable but also allowed them to fully utilize their racial talents.
However.
When Xue Li saw the Cold Snake leading the fierce beasts forward, his eyes instantly darkened.
Facing a crisis with the insect race.
If these fierce beasts were to attack them as well...
Fortunately, Xue Li’s worries were unnecessary.
Instead, the Cold Snake walked directly towards the Guardians of the Snow Country, its cold voice devoid of emotion:
"Ask the Snow Woman for me—we’re willing to cooperate to fight this group of insects."
And since the Guardians of the Snow Country were controlled by the Snow Woman, the moment the Cold Snake spoke.
The Snow Woman, far atop the Snow Country’s peak, received this message.
And the Snow Woman, after a moment of contemplation, decided to agree.
For now, it was unlikely that the Snow Wolf Race alone could combat the insect race, and having the fierce beasts join the fight.
This increased the possibility of resisting the insect race.
However...
These fierce beasts were notoriously cunning, and even if they cooperated, there could be no laxity in vigilance.
After pondering for a moment, Xue Li conveyed the Snow Woman’s decree to Xue Li.
And upon receiving the Snow Woman’s agreement, Xue Li nodded to the Cold Snake.
"The Snow Woman agrees to cooperate!"
Upon hearing this, the Cold Snake’s scarlet tongue flicked lightly, revealing a cold smile:
"Wise!"
Nevertheless, despite reaching an agreement, the two forces remained distinctly separated, keeping a significant distance from each other.
Neither trusted the other.
But given the current situation, even forging such an alliance was no easy task.
Meanwhile, the two humanoid insects witnessed all this indifferently, making no move to stop it.
For them, having the opponents gather their strength actually made things more convenient.
Moreover...
The two humanoid insects’ gaze fell directly on the Cold Snake.
Since the Guardians of the Snow Country were entirely made of ice and snow and lacked any Life Force.
The insects had no interest in the icy being of the Snow Country’s Guardians.
But...
The Cold Snake was different.
Not only was it Totem Level.
Add to that its hundreds of meters in length, with terrifyingly formidable Life Force.
At this moment.
It shrank down to become a human.
Its body contained a Life Energy as vast as the sun!
"A supreme blood feast... can’t be missed!!"
The two insects exchanged a glance, their compound eyes gleaming with greed.
The insect race could enhance their power by devouring powerful lifeforms, and for them, the Cold Snake was undoubtedly a rare and enormous nutritional boon.
Although they could sense that the Cold Snake’s strength far surpassed them individually, for the insect race, even the strongest enemies could be overwhelmed by sheer numbers!
"All insects—attack!"
As the two humanoid insects released pheromones alongside hundreds of Monarch-level insects within the insect sea simultaneously, the entire insect sea erupted instantly!
Like the outbreak of a black tsunami, the insect horde charged forward with terrifying discipline.
...
On the other side.
Since the Guardian of the Snow Country had left the peak of the Snow Country.
Under the command of Lilith, Gu Xing encountered no obstacles and effortlessly reached the Snow Cave at the peak of the Snow Country.
And this was the dwelling place of the Snow Woman.
And also where Ying Bing was being treated!
Thinking of Ying Bing, a long-lost sense of tension welled up in Gu Xing’s heart.
Pausing for a moment, making ample mental preparation, Gu Xing stepped into the cave entrance.
As he ventured deeper...
The figure of a goddess of ice and snow suddenly appeared in his vision.
No!
The Snow Woman was indeed a goddess of ice and snow!
....

chapters.title: Chapter 287: Pure Support, Snow Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 287: Chapter 287: Pure Support, Snow Woman!
"Who?!"
The Snow Woman’s spiritual power was originally completely absorbed in the distant battlefield situation, so she did not notice anyone sneaking into the snow cave.
It wasn’t until Gu Xing was about to reach the bottom of the cave that she suddenly realized—
An outsider was approaching!
It must be noted that at this moment, the guardians of the Snow Country had been sent to the front lines, leaving her at her most vulnerable.
Though esteemed as Totem Level, the Snow Woman Race...
Almost entirely lacks combat ability!
If combat prowess were measured on a scale of one hundred:
The Angel Race and Ghost Race are considered top tier, with combat power reaching above 90 points;
The Qingqiu Race can demonstrate around 40 points of strength;
But the Snow Woman Race...
Probably struggles to reach even 10 points.
Alone at this moment, she wouldn’t stand a chance against a Totem level powerhouse, let alone any Monarch Level slightly stronger.
The Snow Woman’s nerves instantly tightened, and she quickly withdrew her spiritual power from the battlefield, focusing all her attention on the entrance of the cave.
Under her vigilant gaze, a human figure slowly walked into the ice cave.
Seeing that the newcomer was human, the Snow Woman secretly breathed a sigh of relief—
If a Demon Race appeared in front of her, that would be the worst outcome.
She carefully sensed the aura of this human...
Only Monarch Tier One?
The Snow Woman completely relaxed.
Even though she’s not skilled in combat, she absolutely could not be defeated by a Monarch Tier One human.
"Human," she spoke coldly, ice crystals shimmering around her, "this is not a place you should come."
The Snow Woman’s eyes instantly held a glimmer of danger.
In this moment of life and death, the appearance of this human here was anything but coincidental.
However, the next moment, her caution vanished.
"Xiao Xue!"
A familiar voice rang out.
Only to see Lilith suddenly appear from Gu Xing’s Beast Taming Space, gently landing on the icy surface.
Hearing this call and seeing the sudden appearance of her dear friend, the Snow Woman was momentarily stunned, then suddenly understood...
No wonder this human could appear here.
It turns out Lilith led the way!
Normally, even without guardians present, but the peak of Snow Country is full of restrictions.
It’s very difficult for outsiders to reach here!
But the Snow Woman suddenly widened her eyes, as if realizing something, her gaze firmly locked on Gu Xing.
Wait... human?!
The only human who could appear with Lilith, must be...
Gu Xing?!
Is this the human who completely captured her best friend’s heart?!
Why does he seem completely ordinary?
Meanwhile, Gu Xing was also busy scanning the Snow Woman.
[Snow Woman]
[Identity: Master of Snow Domain]
[Talent: Myth Five Stars]
[Level: Totem Second Transformation]
[Power: 1000000]
[Constitution: 1000000]
[Spirit: 9000000]
[Speed: 1000000]
[Skills: Grace of the Snow God, Revival, Winter’s Blessing, Healing Law, Healing Domain]
Looking at the Snow Woman’s attributes, Gu Xing finally understood why she wasn’t good at fighting.
As a Totem level existence, her power, constitution, and other basic attributes barely reached million-level, albeit her spiritual attribute was as high as nine million...
Yet all her skills were auxiliary and healing types, with no offensive abilities.
[Grace of the Snow God: Bestows a blessing state, greatly enhancing recovery power]
[Revival: Powerful healing skill]
[Winter’s Blessing: Slightly enhances all attributes of allies]
Three skills, two auxiliary and one healing, even her laws and domains were entirely about protection and recovery, truly embodying "pure support" to the extreme.
At this moment, Gu Xing respectfully spoke:
"Lady Snow Woman!"
After all, he sought help, so he adopted a very humble attitude.
However, the Snow Woman paid no heed to etiquette, instead curiously moving closer to Gu Xing, examining him closely:
"Doesn’t look special at all... how did you enchant our Lilith?"
Gu Xing: "???"
Why does it seem...
The Snow Woman is looking at him like a mother-in-law assessing a son-in-law?
Beside them, Lilith’s mouth twitched.
She knew that her best friend was excellent in every way except when it came to matters of emotion.
She stepped forward expressionlessly, precisely grabbed the Snow Woman’s ear, and deftly pulled her away from Gu Xing—
The movements were seamless.
"Now is not the time for your antics."
Lilith spoke coldly, "We came to see you for serious business—what is happening in Snow Country that made you issue a territory-wide alert?"
In matters of seriousness, the Snow Woman’s gaze also became solemn.
The battlefield images previously seen through Snow Country’s guardians now clearly surfaced in her mind.
"It’s the Insect Race..." her voice was low, "A true sea of insects."
Upon hearing these words, Lilith’s expression drastically changed.
Though she hadn’t personally faced the Insect Race, she fully understood the terror of this race—
They are born only to devour, their existence meant to destroy, crushing civilizations with absolute numbers, also known as "the World’s End".
Once one Insect Race appears, it means an endless flow of them will invade this world.
Lilith immediately realized the gravity of the situation: "What do you plan to do?"
Knowing it’s the Insect Race, she also understood Snow Country alone could never fend them off.
"Currently, I’ve established temporary cooperation with Fierce Beasts led by Cold Snake, to jointly resist the Insect Race."
The Snow Woman frowned deeply, "But they’re not reliable, so I’m considering..."
She took a deep breath and solemnly said, "Leaving Snow Domain."
These four words were said with utmost seriousness, the best solution she reached after careful consideration.
However, Lilith shook her head.
The Snow Woman is called Snow Woman precisely because she can continuously enhance her power only in the Snow Domain environment.
Through this trait, she reached the realm of Totem Second Transformation.
If she leaves the Snow Domain...
"First help me restore my power."
Lilith resolutely proposed, "We’ll try our best to block the Insect Race; if absolutely unbearable... then consider retreating."
"Alright."
Yet when the Snow Woman turned her focus on Lilith, she suddenly froze:
"Wait... Lilith, what’s wrong with your power?!"
"Didn’t I previously help you recover to Monarch Peak? Why now..."
Lilith’s mouth twitched slightly: "This is a long story."
She gestured sideways: "It’s not just me, a few Guardian Beasts also need your help to recover."
Gu Xing accordingly summoned Liu Li, Vera, and Qing Shuang.
The Snow Woman looked at the Guardian Beasts that suddenly appeared in front of her, her jaw involuntarily dropped—
Lilith is really...
Giving her a huge task?!
"Wait!"
The Snow Woman hurriedly raised her hand to stop.
She could understand helping Lilith recover her power.
After all, she was clearly aware of Lilith’s combat capability.
Helping Lilith regain her strength would undoubtedly be of significant help in countering the Insect Race on the battlefield.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 288: Things Have Gotten Complicated!
chapters.content:
Chapter 288: Chapter 288: Things Have Gotten Complicated!
But using her healing ability would consume a great deal of her spiritual power.
Employing such precious power on someone who is merely Monarch Tier One seems hardly worth it.
"I can understand helping you regain your strength, but to help him..."
Although the Snow Woman didn’t say it outright, both Gu Xing and Lilith understood her unspoken meaning—
She looked down on Gu Xing’s weakness, perceiving that he wasn’t much help.
However,
Lilith paid her no heed whatsoever.
"His strength surpasses yours. Hurry up; delaying further means the Snow Wolf Race might not hold on."
Hearing this, the Snow Woman was suddenly taken aback.
As far as strength is concerned, Lilith never lies.
If she said Gu Xing was stronger, then it must be true.
Though still slightly incredulous, under Lilith’s constant urging, the Snow Woman eventually took action.
"Revive!"
With a soft cry, the entire cave was instantly enveloped in a white glow.
Gu Xing, bathed in this soothing light, felt invigorated, as every pore seemed to open, a gentle yet potent force circulating throughout his body.
Nurtured by this force, not only Lilith but also Liu Li and other guardian beasts quickly returned to their peak.
....
Meanwhile, the battle on the Insect Race battlefield had erupted fully.
Countless insects surged forward like a black tide, relentlessly assaulting Xue Li and the beasts she led.
In such a grand battlefield, individual power seemed minuscule, nearly engulfed by the endless insect sea.
Xue Li stayed calm and collected, uniting the Snow Wolf Race into a cohesive unit, commanding them to advance and retreat with grace, alternating attack and defense.
Under her precise guidance, the wolf pack acted as a silver-white barrier, tearing through and repelling wave after wave of insect attacks.
Insect limbs and carcasses continually fell from the air, accumulating into a chaotic mess on the ground.
Still, the snow wolves’ eradication of insects was just a drop in the ocean for the entire insect tide.
The newly cleared gaps were quickly filled by fresh insect surges, seemingly endless.
Though the Snow Wolf Race temporarily held off the insect swarm, their stamina and demonic power were steadily depleting over time.
The battle line, though stable, had subtly turned fragile.
Once their strength wanes, annihilation will be inevitable.
Ying Bing was also within the battle line.
Despite her mere Monarch Tier One strength, her guardian beast—
The Profound Frost Ice Phoenix—enhanced its abilities significantly in this icy environment.
Each flap of its wings and every clear cry unleashed a biting cold wave, which, while not directly lethal to the insects, greatly impeded their movements.
Gradually, the insects’ offensive began to falter.
The foes whose actions slowed by frost were swiftly torn apart by the snow wolf pack.
The Snow Wolf Race keenly noticed this, starting an instinctive counterattack centered around Ying Bing and the Profound Frost Ice Phoenix, achieving a silent harmony between ice and wolf fangs.
Meanwhile, on the other end of the battlefield, the fierce beast pack was also embroiled in a battle akin to the Snow Wolf Race’s struggle.
Initially, fighting individually, they quickly succumbed to frenzied insect attacks, becoming scarred and wounded.
Harsh reality awakened them to a truth:
Only unity holds a slim chance of survival.
Thus, those fiercely solitary beasts began closing ranks, forming formations, desperately coordinating defense and counterattacks among the insect waves.
Despite continual injuries, at least—
They endured longer than before.
And across the entire battlefield, the most compelling showdown was between the Cold Snake and the two Totem-level insect adversaries.
The humanoid Cold Snake, standing amidst ice and insect corpses, locked its cold gaze on the two similarly humanoid insect champions.
Initially planning to feign engagement, observing the battle’s dynamic before deciding its moves.
Yet the instant the insects launched an all-out attack, these two Totem-level beings unexpectedly charged straight at it.
What fueled Cold Snake’s burning fury was—
Their eyes, the gaze it knew too well.
It was the gaze of looking at prey.
As though it is merely a meal awaiting indulgence.
"Mere insects... dare to regard me as food?"
Cold Snake slowly clenched its palm, knuckles slightly pale from the force.
Being one of the four reigning fierce beasts, it had never suffered such insult.
At that very moment, it was thoroughly provoked.
In the next instant, Cold Snake unleashed its entire aura without reservation—
"Boom!!!!!!!!"
A nearly tangible pressure soared skyward, enveloping the battlefield in an icy chill.
The insects of weaker existence suddenly halted motion, with even some Monarch-level insects subdued, their offensive noticeably slowed.
As an established King-level fierce beast nearing Totem Third-turn, when Cold Snake truly displayed its strength, the oppression it exerted—
Was downright terrifying!
And the two humanoid insects, sensing Cold Snake’s unleashed pressure, felt a shock deep within.
Yet soon, shock turned into uncontrollable excitement.
——Such formidable prey deserves their utmost hunt.
Should they devour this nearly Totem Third-turn fierce beast, their power would undeniably transcend current limits, reaching higher realms!
But before that, they must stabilize the erratic low-tier insect swarm thrown into chaos by Cold Snake’s pressure.
These low-intelligence insect soldiers easily succumb to aura disruptions, losing command devolves them into disarray.
The two humanoid insects exchanged a glance, birthing mutual understanding.
In the next instant,
They simultaneously released intense, stable pheromones, which spread through the insect tide like silent commands within moments.
At this moment, they became the true "brain" of the swarm.
The restless insects promptly restored order under this will’s guidance, forming an airtight offensive again, advancing like a black iron stream.
Naturally, Cold Snake wouldn’t let this opportunity slip.
Just when the two insects were distracted, pacifying their swarm, it brazenly attacked!
The nearly Totem Third-turn strength sped it to extremity, almost like teleportation, striking up to the two humanoid insects.
In its eyes, these two mere Totem Tier One insects should have been easily crushed in its grasp—
Cold Snake’s palm instantly transformed into claws, wrapped in bone-chilling frost, directly targeting the opponent’s throat!
Yet,
Just at the moment it was about to succeed, numerous low-tier insects surged forward without hesitation, forming a barrier with their flesh, blocking Cold Snake from the leaders.
Though Cold Snake was exceedingly powerful, the insect numbers were too vast, and each possessed at least Commander-level strength.
They could even distribute and absorb the energy within Cold Snake’s attack—
Every insect bore a sliver before exploding to death, fearless, charging forward relentlessly.
Under this cost-ignoring defense, Cold Snake’s claws were abruptly halted, unable to advance any further.
Witnessing this, Cold Snake’s gaze suddenly turned icy.
It intended to catch them off guard, decapitate their leader, yet didn’t anticipate these low-tier insects to be so tenacious and so—
Desperate!
Looks like things have gotten complicated!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 289: Cold Snake’s Plan
chapters.content:
Chapter 289: Chapter 289: Cold Snake’s Plan
The two totem-level humanoid Zergs seemed to have anticipated everything that was happening before them.
They didn’t even bother to dodge at all, just watched coldly as the Cold Snake was obstructed layer upon layer by the low-tier Zergs’ flesh and blood.
Seeing the Zerg corpses continuously fall from the sky, there was no trace of pity in their eyes, but rather a hint of cruel excitement.
The Zergs never lacked low-tier units.
In their resource-depleted homeland, high-tier Zergs would even order lower units to die to convert them into pure energy for their own absorption.
Therefore, to them, this consumption of lives—
Was just a worthwhile investment.
The more Zergs died, the more it proved the strength of the Cold Snake.
And the stronger the prey, the more astonishing the boost after devouring it...
"Why struggle pointlessly?"
The green humanoid Zerg suddenly spread its arms, its voice icy and mocking.
The swarm of Zergs converged towards it as if summoned, forming a pulsating shadowy wall in front.
"Even if each Zerg can only absorb a sliver of your energy—"
It cracked a grin almost grim in nature.
"But in the face of this endless sea of Zergs... how long can you hold out?"
The most fearsome part of the Zergs is their ability to feed on life force and spiritual power.
Once entangled, the victim will eventually be drained of everything, reduced to a withered husk.
However, the Zergs are not without weaknesses.
Their individual life force is extremely fragile, and their strength is far inferior to beings of the same tier.
But they never fight alone.
Overwhelming numbers are enough to cover any defects.
"We Zergs are the most perfect existence in this world!"
The green humanoid Zerg looked at the Cold Snake trapped within layers of the sea of Zergs, a cold smile upon its lips.
Even if this fierce beast’s strength far surpassed theirs, it would inevitably be exhausted to death under the onslaught of the swarm.
The Cold Snake’s expression was most grim at this time.
Although an ancient fierce beast dominating a region, it was also the first time it faced such a troublesome opponent.
Each of its attacks could shatter swathes of Zergs, but in a flash, the gaps would be filled by new ones.
At this moment, it was entirely surrounded by the dense swarm.
Its vision was filled with pulsating insect bodies, its ears overwhelmed with irritating buzzing.
The Cold Snake’s gaze deepened as it suddenly opened a ghostly blue shield to envelop itself—
This barrier was enough to isolate direct contact from the Zergs, preventing energy absorption.
However, at the next moment,
its pupils constricted.
The Zergs began to crawl all over the surface of the shield, greedily absorbing the energy of the shield itself!
Though each Zerg absorbed minimally, the sheer number devouring simultaneously caused the energy to visibly diminish...
The Cold Snake’s heart sank.
If this continued, it would indeed...
end up exhausted to death here.
Moreover, those two totem-level Zergs had yet to truly make a move, continuously observing coldly from the outskirts of the battlefield like hunters waiting for their chance.
The Cold Snake had no clue what abilities they hid, making it even more vigilant.
At this moment, it conceived the idea of retreat.
"Crack—!!"
A crisp sound suddenly rang out, the ghostly blue shield it held up finally showing cracks under the continuous devouring of countless Zergs.
This cannot continue.
Leaving the Snow Domain would only slow its growth.
Unlike the Snow Woman, it didn’t utterly depend on the extreme cold environment to survive.
Even if it left, it could still rely on absorbing the demonic Qi between heaven and earth to continue cultivating.
Though it would slow down...
But it was better than losing its life here!
Thinking of this, the Cold Snake didn’t hesitate anymore.
It would leave this mess for the Snow Woman to handle.
