It was no longer accompanying her!
But it was keenly aware that it had long been targeted by those two high-tier Zergs, so escaping wouldn’t be easy.
Fortunately...
It had long prepared a backup plan.
The reason it drew in the Snow Wolf and those fierce beasts was for such a moment.
The Cold Snake’s gaze abruptly turned cold, its entire aura explosively surging!
In the next instant,
it revealed its true form—
A giant snake spanning hundreds of meters suddenly coiled upon the battlefield, its entire body encrusted with ice-blue jade-like scales, the icy aura sweeping across all four directions.
Manifesting its true form meant it was no longer holding back any strength.
"Roar——!!!"
A snake roar thundered out, shaking heaven and earth, the terrifying sound wave mixed with frigid shock waves spreading in a ring, shattering, freezing, and obliterating tens of thousands of Zergs nearby into dust!
In an instant, a temporary vacuum was carved out of the dense swarm.
Yet the two humanoid Zergs, witnessing the Cold Snake’s true form, not only showed no fear, but their eyes glinted with greed and excitement.
"Finally willing to reveal your true form!"
They rejoiced in their hearts.
The Cold Snake in humanoid form, though nimble, was too small, limiting the number of Zergs able to attack it simultaneously, dragging out the attrition battle for too long.
But now, this body, hundreds of meters long, meant more Zergs could pounce on it simultaneously to absorb energy—
The speed of their victory would greatly accelerate.
However, they didn’t know that the Cold Snake had long lost the will to fight.
It glanced coldly at the two Zergs, and in the next moment, its massive body twisted abruptly, appearing to flee into the distance—
"You can’t escape!"
The two humanoid Zergs chuckled coldly, having long set up a heavy force composed of the most elite part of the Zerg swarm in the direction the Cold Snake might retreat towards.
If it broke through in that direction, it would only exhaust its power faster.
However, at this moment, the Cold Snake suddenly changed its trajectory, not fleeing the battlefield but charging directly towards the Snow Wolf Race!
Its goal wasn’t to escape, but—
to force the Snow Guardian into action!
The Snow Guardian, alongside the Snow Woman, reigning as the two major powers of the Snow Domain, was naturally not ordinary.
Its actual power had long surpassed ordinary totem-level beings, only seldom revealed in daily life.
This guardian, formed of ice and snow, possessed an exceedingly unique ability.
It could instantly unleash all the energy within, pushing its power to unimaginably terrifying heights, even momentarily surpassing the Cold Snake itself.
This was also one reason the Cold Snake never truly made a move against the Snow Woman.
But...
The price for this move was death.
And now, the Cold Snake sought to force the Snow Guardian down this path.
And striking at the Snow Wolf Race was the fastest, most effective method—
As long as the tribe faced an existential crisis, the Snow Guardian would never sit idly by.
The next moment, the vast snake body of the Cold Snake had rapidly approached the Snow Wolf Race’s position!
With a body as massive as a mountain range, it swung its tail with tremendous might—
The gigantic tail, covered in icy scales, descended with devastating force!
"Boom!!!!!!!!"
With just one strike, the defense of the Snow Wolf Race, painstakingly maintained, shattered audibly.
Ice shards and snow dust shot skyward, the wolf pack scattered with mournful howls, the once tidy formation instantly torn open into a massive breach.
....
....

chapters.title: Chapter 290: Power Restored!
chapters.content:
Chapter 290: Chapter 290: Power Restored!
Fortunately, the Snow Guardian stepped in just in time, and an ice wall swiftly formed, forcefully blocking the remnants of the Cold Snake’s attack, preventing any casualties in the Snow Wolf Race.
Xue Li, both shocked and furious, looked up and shouted sternly:
"Cold Snake! What on earth are you doing?! The cooperation has just begun, and you’re already going to betray us?!"
Her eyes were almost spitting fire.
Facing the Insect Race was already extremely difficult, yet the Cold Snake was now turning against them—
However, her questioning was completely ignored by the Cold Snake.
In the law of the Fierce Beasts, strength is the foundation of everything.
Without power, there is no right to speak.
"Ridiculous."
The Cold Snake cast an icy glance at her, too lazy to even offer an explanation.
A mere Monarch Level Snow Wolf was simply not worth its attention.
Its gaze remained locked on the Snow Guardian—
Only this embodiment of ice and snow was worthy of its vigilance.
Behind it, the buzzing of the Insect Race drew nearer, and a shadow like a tide surged forward.
The pupils of the Cold Snake narrowed sharply.
It could not hesitate any longer.
It had to leave immediately, even if—by any means necessary.
The next moment, it suddenly opened its gigantic mouth, and a chilling energy began to rapidly converge, the glow dazzling and the cold piercing...
Yet, its target was not the Insect Race...
But the Snow Wolf Race below, which was still in shock.
Witnessing the Cold Snake aiming its attack at the Snow Wolf Race, Xue Li’s face turned deathly pale.
The Cold Snake was a nearly Totem Tier Three beast; if it truly attacked with full force...
The consequences would be unimaginable!
Her heart tightened, and before she could even speak—
The Snow Guardian had already sensed the crisis first and blocked the entire Snow Wolf tribe in an instant.
It was born with the Snow Wolf Race, alongside the Snow Woman.
Its sole purpose in life is to protect the Snow Wolf Race and the Snow Woman.
Now, as the tribe faced the threat of extinction, it held nothing back, and the vast energy it had been suppressing within erupted forcefully!
Brilliant ice-blue light burst forth from its body, with violent energy surging madly, even causing its ice-like body to begin cracking inch by inch—
The Snow Guardian usually only used a small portion of its power because its icy body could not fully bear such terrifying energy.
Once fully unleashed, it would mean heading towards collapse.
But now, it had no choice.
The Extreme Cold Power swept around like a tsunami, freezing even the air in its path.
Numerous insects instantly turned into ice sculptures, shattering across the ground.
Seeing this, a cold glint of success flashed in the Cold Snake’s eyes.
Its goal was achieved.
The next second, the energy it had gathered in its giant mouth suddenly began to spin faster, and an energy ball intertwining icy blue and pitch black, wrapped in a breath of destruction, ferociously hurled towards the Snow Wolf Race!
The Snow Guardian spread its arms, and a thick ice wall as heavy as a mountain condensed out of thin air, meeting it head-on—
"Boom!!!!!!!!!!!!"
The moment the two forces collided, a deafening roar tore through the sky, and terrifying energy erupted in a ring explosion...
Ice, Demonic Qi, and Spiritual Power raged furiously, destroying and obliterating everything around them!
The chaotic energy currents formed a death zone, where even the Low Tier Insect Race could not approach for a while, and the battlefield center temporarily fell into a kind of post-destruction silence.
The Cold Snake seized this opportunity, its body suddenly contracted and transformed into a ghostly blue shadow, rushing towards the battlefield’s periphery with full force.
The speed of nearly Totem Tier Three was fully unleashed, and in just a flash, it had leaped beyond the horizon, disappearing without a trace.
The still-fighting fierce beasts were momentarily dumbfounded when they saw this.
Immediately, panic swiftly spread like a plague.
"The boss... is gone?"
"It abandoned us?! Why?!"
"It’s over... Without the boss, we can’t possibly withstand the Insect Race!"
They dared to confront the Insect Race head-on, solely due to their absolute trust in the Cold Snake’s strength.
But now, with the Cold Snake fleeing without hesitation, their courage crumbled instantly.
In an instant, the fierce beast camp fell into complete chaos. All the beasts could no longer care about resisting and turned away, fleeing in the direction of the Cold Snake’s escape, just wanting to leave this death battlefield as quickly as possible.
Two humanoid insects observed all of this, their faces immediately darkening.
The recent earth-shattering clash between the Cold Snake and the Snow Guardian caused massive energy turbulence, briefly interfering with their communication with the insect swarm.
In just that short delay—
By the time they regained control of the Insect Race, they found that the "prey" they were determined to capture had already seized the gap and escaped.
"Damn it... We let it escape!"
The red humanoid insect couldn’t help but curse angrily, its eyes nearly spitting fire.
The green insect’s face was also ashen, as if covered with a layer of frost.
Seeing their prey escape right under their noses was something no one could accept calmly.
But as things stood, they had to suppress their anger and turned their gaze to the remaining fierce beasts and the Snow Wolf Race on the battlefield.
"Since that snake escaped, none of these... will leave alive!"
Orders swiftly spread throughout the insect swarm, and the initially hesitant insect waves plunged into madness.
Countless Insects like a dark cloud rushed towards the scattering fierce beasts and the desperately enduring Snow Wolf Race.
Those fleeing fierce beasts were unable to organize effective resistance and were almost instantly devoured under the full-scale assault of the insect swarm.
Hundreds of Monarch Level, and a few Half-step Totem Level Fierce Beasts didn’t even manage to utter a cry before turning into nourishment for the insect swarm.
Only the Snow Wolf Race, under the Snow Guardian’s desperate protection, barely managed to hold on.
Extreme Cold Power continuously erupted, freezing and smashing wave after wave of attacking insects, forming a fragile barrier.
However, the Snow Guardian’s body was constantly cracking, and its light gradually dimmed.
Facing the endless insect sea, every outburst brought it closer to complete dissipation.
Its downfall might just be a matter of time.
....
Just as the Snow Woman was fully focused on healing Gu Xing and a few Guardian Beasts, her actions suddenly halted.
A sudden surge of sorrow pierced her heart like an icicle, freezing her body.
She hadn’t extended her Spiritual Power to the battlefield and did not know what had happened there, but the moment the Snow Guardian unleashed its energy without reservation—
She still sensed it.
It was the Ice and Snow Power that had been born from the same source as her, now burning and disintegrating...
A tear unconsciously slipped from the corner of her eye, freezing into ice.
Although the Snow Guardian could not speak and was shaped like a snowman, it had accompanied her since birth.
Throughout the long years, it silently protected the Snow Wolf Race, as well as her, becoming as close as family.
And now, that familiar and warm power was rapidly fading...
"Little Snow, what’s going on?"
Lilith noticed her change and immediately asked.
Only then did the Snow Woman snap back to reality, her voice trembling uncontrollably:
"The big guy... it’s dying..."
Lilith’s heart trembled at her words.
She knew the Snow Guardian’s strength well; it would never get to this point unless pushed to an extremity.
"Little Snow, focus and heal with all your might!"
She urged in a deep voice, "Otherwise, not only will the Guardian be lost, but the entire Snow Wolf Race will be in peril!"
The Snow Woman bit her lip, suppressed the surging sorrow, and poured out all her Spiritual Power without reserve.
Under her devoted treatment, Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, and other Guardian Beasts’ wounds swiftly healed, their bodies emanating light, their auras not only fully restored but also rapidly increasing—
Vast energy surged and broke through within them, streams of Monarch Level pressure erupting one after another!
Enabling them to step into the rank of Monarchs!
....
...

chapters.title: Chapter 291: Monarchs All Around!
chapters.content:
Chapter 291: Chapter 291: Monarchs All Around!
The first to complete the breakthrough was Qing Shuang.
Dense Netherworld Ghost Qi surged out from her body, spreading swiftly like ink-colored tides, engulfing the entire cave in darkness.
The mist churned and flowed, spontaneously condensing mid-air into a gigantic Ghost King Illusion—
With a single horn on its head, its outline remarkably resembled Qing Shuang’s true form.
As the illusion gradually solidified, Qing Shuang’s aura also skyrocketed, her attribute values experiencing explosive growth:
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine → Monarch Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Power: 90000 → 150000]
[Constitution: 70000 → 130000]
[Spirit: 60000 → 100000]
[Speed: 70000 → 130000]
[Skills: Ghost King Form, Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King Domain, Law of Power]
Observing Qing Shuang’s improved attributes, Gu Xing nodded slightly.
Lilith, at Monarch Tier Five, had each attribute around 200,000 points.
Yet, Qing Shuang, even at just Monarch Tier One,
already had a Power attribute reaching 150,000 points.
If Qing Shuang’s level reaches Monarch Tier Five, her Power attribute would undoubtedly far surpass Lilith.
Moreover, he also noticed that after stepping into Monarch Level, the attributes of Guardian Beasts started to significantly differentiate, unlike the balanced development at lower levels.
However, such a situation is not necessarily a bad thing.
For Qing Shuang...
Power is her most important attribute, above all others.
Gu Xing shifted his gaze from Qing Shuang to Vera.
He saw an aura of emerald light appearing around her, and the Netherworld Ghost Qi previously enveloping her seemed to be repelled by a gentle but irresistible force.
The air atop the snowy peak trembled slightly, Life Energy in the wind and snow began converging toward her like tides.
As a Life Spirit, when Vera breaks through, she unconsciously mobilizes any absorbable Power of Life around her.
At this moment, she resembled an invisible vortex—
Sturdy icefield moss and snow flowers, even roots buried deep under the permafrost, withered and decayed at a visibly rapid pace.
Their Life Energy transformed into wisps of light, flowing toward Vera’s location.
Moreover, tiny insects hidden in snow crevices also silently lost vitality in an instant, their minimal Life Force being ruthlessly extracted.
After experiencing a rebirth through reincarnation, Vera’s mastery of Life Law was no longer limited to plants.
Any life form with a Life Force lower than hers could become a target of her unconscious plundering.
As Life Energy from the summit of the snow mountain continuously infused her, the green light around Vera intensified, and her aura finally surged to its peak.
The next moment, her attributes began to rapidly grow, officially stepping into a new realm.
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine → Monarch Tier One]
[Status: Normal]
[Power: 65000 → 100000]
[Constitution: 65000 → 100000]
[Spirit: 90000 → 160000]
[Speed: 65000 → 100000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
Upon breaking through to Monarch Level, Vera’s Spiritual Power growth was particularly astounding—
directly skyrocketing from 90,000 to 160,000, far exceeding Qing Shuang’s growth.
However, this doesn’t necessarily mean her combat abilities are stronger than Qing Shuang’s.
Both possess top-level Myth Nine Stars talent and have comprehended the Power of Origin Laws, making it difficult to simply assess their true combat strength.
More importantly, their development paths are distinctly different:
Qing Shuang pursues extreme instantaneous burst power.
With the dual boost of "Ghost Race Four Techniques" and "Law of Power," she can unleash world-shattering force in an instant, like a thunderous strike, overwhelming strong enemies.
In contrast, Vera has taken a different path.
With her absolute control over the Power of Life, she can continuously draw energy from all living beings in her surroundings and convert it for her use.
Theoretically, as long as given enough time to store power, she can even manipulate a torrent of life far beyond her realm, crushing opponents.
As Qing Shuang and Vera successively completed their breakthroughs, their auras gradually stabilized, and Gu Xing slowly turned his gaze to the last one—
Liu Li!
After Liu Li’s last fall and rebirth, Gu Xing truly confronted the emotion in his heart that he could no longer ignore.
He realized that for this clear-eyed young girl who had always stayed by his side, his feelings exceeded the bond between master and Guardian Beast.
At this moment, Liu Li’s brows furrowed, her aura fluctuated continuously, although it was increasingly strengthening, she was still unable to break through the boundary of Monarch Level.
Worry flashed across Gu Xing’s eyes.
Qing Shuang and Vera had smooth, unimpeded breakthroughs, so why Liu Li alone ...
Could it be a hidden issue from her last death?
Just then, the nearby Snow Woman’s expression suddenly changed, and she backed away sharply.
She finally sensed the anomaly.
Initially, she was awestruck by the astonishing aura during Qing Shuang and Vera’s breakthroughs—
These two Guardian Beasts were only at Monarch Tier One, yet their breakthrough magnitude was comparable to a Half-step Totem!
She also finally understood why Lilith insisted she exhaust Spiritual Power to heal them. Their potential indeed far exceeded her imagination.
And at this moment, what horrified her even more was this Angel before her.
An exceptionally scorching aura began to seep from Liu Li’s body, slowly melting the ice that had been frozen for ten thousand years in the cave!
This was the heart of the Snow Domain, where the profound ice had remained unchanged for millennia, capable of withstanding molten lava for a brief period.
It was precisely by this extreme cold land that the Snow Woman could enhance her strength to Totem Tier Two over a century.
Yet now, this eternal ice was melting under the unconscious heat emitted by this Angel.
Gu Xing suddenly realized:
The extreme conditions were hindering Liu Li’s breakthrough.
"Fei Yue!"
With a thought, Fei Yue appeared in response.
Following Gu Xing’s silent instructions, she instantly moved to Liu Li’s side, taking her with her to outside the snow cave.
On the ice field outside the cave, the bitterly cold wind continued to howl.
Yet at the very moment Liu Li emerged from the cave—
A tremendous oppressive force exploded forth!
The scorching Fire of Destruction surged out from her body, engulfing her in fierce flames instantly.
Under this extreme heat, the snow within a hundred-mile radius momentarily halted, the air temperature rapidly climbed.
Liu Li’s aura finally ascended to its peak, with no further hindrance.
Her attributes began to rapidly grow!
[Divine Angels (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Commander Tier Nine → Monarch Tier One]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 70000 → 120000]
[Constitution: 70000 → 120000]
[Spirit: 70000 → 120000]
[Speed: 70000 → 120000]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form, Guardian Domain, Guardian Law, Destruction Domain, Destruction Law]
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 292: Solution to the Insect Race Crisis
chapters.content:
Chapter 292: Chapter 292: Solution to the Insect Race Crisis
Aside from Vera, Qing Shuang and Liu Li, Lilith had already recovered to half-step Totem strength with the help of the Snow Woman.
The Snow Woman’s ability can alleviate the aftereffects brought by excessive use of Divine Patterns, but this recovery has its limits.
For example, Lilith, limited by her current realm, can only recover to half-step Totem level.
Meanwhile, Liu Li and Vera, being only Monarch Tier One, were able to fully recover during the treatment.
At this moment, the Snow Woman’s face was filled with disbelief.
She slowly approached Lilith, her voice somewhat stiff as she quietly asked:
"Lilith... what kind of monster is this Gu Xing exactly?"
"Why is every one of his Guardian Beasts so terrifying?"
She paused, as if still digesting everything she had just felt, and continued:
"His Guardian Beast is just at Monarch Tier One... how could it possibly release the aura of half-step Totem level?"
"This...is just too outrageous!"
Hearing the Snow Woman’s words, Lilith turned her head and gave her a deep look.
Half-step Totem level?
Lilith’s mouth twitched slightly.
If the Snow Woman knew that Gu Xing had already slain multiple Totem level enemies while still at Commander Tier Nine, she would be shocked beyond measure.
However, the Snow Woman is her friend after all, and Lilith is aware that if they continue to stay in the Snow Domain, the Snow Woman will sooner or later be completely targeted by the Demon Race.
This insect invasion likely has the shadow of the Demon Race behind it.
Persuading the Snow Woman to sign the Beast Taming Contract with Gu Xing is actually the best choice at present.
But...
The Snow Woman has always been averse to humans, directly proposing this request might have the opposite effect.
"Xiao Xue, you’ve misunderstood something."
Lilith’s tone was unusually serious, "To Gu Xing, what’s truly powerful has never been his one Guardian Beast."
Seeing her unprecedented seriousness, the Snow Woman was taken aback.
Lilith slowly continued:
"What is truly powerful... is Gu Xing himself."
"His talent has long surpassed the limits of your imagination."
These words were not an exaggeration.
Gu Xing possesses two major talents—
"Sovereign" and "Soul-devouring," either of which is enough to put an ordinary Beast Master at the top of the world.
Yet he possesses both.
What is even more shocking is that Gu Xing has also gained the recognition of numerous Divine Patterns.
After all, he is their Beast Master.
Even if Guardian Beasts like Liu Li have gained the recognition of the Divine Patterns, they would still be unable to truly utilize the power of the Divine Patterns if Gu Xing himself does not obtain the acknowledgment of the Divine Patterns.
However, in the last battle, Lilith clearly realized—
No Guardian Beast encountered any hindrance in invoking the Divine Patterns.
This can only mean one thing:
Gu Xing has obtained the recognition of all the Divine Patterns.
This is an almost unbelievable fact.
Every Divine Pattern contains extremely powerful strength, and if Gu Xing can gather the power of all Divine Patterns within himself...
Lilith could hardly imagine the terrifying power he could unleash.
Under Lilith’s reminder, the Snow Woman once again turned her gaze toward Gu Xing.
It’s not that she didn’t hear the implied meaning in Lilith’s words—
She is hoping that she signs a contract with Gu Xing.
Lilith has never been one to exaggerate.
If she says Gu Xing’s talent far exceeds imagination, then it must be a fact.
But...
To have her sign a contract with a human she’s only just met, she still finds it hard to accept.
No matter how strong the other party is, she is still unwilling to easily give up her own freedom.
So she deliberately avoided the topic, instead lightly waving her hand—
The next moment, an insect that was struggling appeared in her palm.
This insect was a sample brought back earlier by the Snow Guardian, only of Commander level, yet extremely ferocious.
Even sensing that the aura of the Snow Woman and Lilith was much higher than its own, it continued to struggle relentlessly, attempting to attack them.
Seeing this, the Snow Woman’s brows furrowed slightly—
This is precisely what makes the Insect Race so difficult to deal with.
They are extremely aggressive, unafraid of threats, not fearing the strong, and only with complete extermination can their offensive be stopped.
She handed the insect to Lilith, speaking with a heavy tone:
"Lilith, this is the main Insect Race invading the Snow Domain this time."
"Look... do you have any way to counter it?"
Lilith reached out to try using the Blood Law for control.
However, the next moment, she frowned tightly.
In principle, when facing a Commander-level existence, she would only need to lightly activate the Blood Law and could easily reverse their blood flow, causing them to explode.
After all, almost no creature entirely lacks blood within their body, manipulating blood has always been her forte in defeating enemies.
But upon executing it herself, she suddenly realized—
The blood within this type of insect is scant to the point of nearly non-existent!
As Lilith’s expression changed, the Snow Woman’s face also darkened.
Earlier, the Snow Woman still had a sliver of composure left in her heart.
After all, Lilith possessed the ability to control blood; the numerical advantage of the Insect Race should have been meaningless in front of her—
As long as Lilith was healed, relying on her power, even if they couldn’t obliterate the Insect Race entirely, they could certainly fend off their offensive.
But now, she realized, maybe she had oversimplified everything.
Gu Xing also locked his gaze on the insect in the Snow Woman’s hand, attempting to probe for weaknesses with Spiritual Power, but was surprised to find no flaws at all.
He turned to look at Qing Shuang and Liu Li.
Liu Li softly spoke:
"Master, the Fire of Destruction is effective against them, but if there are too many..."
She didn’t continue speaking, but her meaning was clear.
Qing Shuang also nodded, her Netherworld Ghost Qi could cause damage, yet its effect was equally limited.
Gu Xing’s brows furrowed tighter.
He had already witnessed firsthand the near-infinite numbers of the insect swarm; if he couldn’t find an efficient way to solve it on a large scale...
This time, they might truly be in danger.
Yet suddenly, Vera, who had been quietly standing behind Gu Xing, spoke up:
"Master, to deal with these insects... I think I might have a way."
Gu Xing was startled by her words.
Since Vera’s Life Energy erosion and destruction capabilities weren’t outstanding, he hadn’t asked for her opinion before.
But now...
"Vera, what method?"
As soon as he spoke, the Snow Woman, Lilith, and everyone’s eyes instantly focused on Vera.
Vera didn’t hesitate a bit, she stepped forward, gently extended her fingertip.
A soft green glow flowed out of her fingertip soundlessly, merging into the insect that was still furiously struggling.
Almost the next instant, the insect stiffened abruptly, then its movements slowed rapidly, the fierceness in its eyes gradually faded, and it finally sank into complete silence.
This scene left everyone present utterly shocked—
They could clearly feel that Vera had hardly used any force to casually put an end to this stubborn member of the Insect Race.
The Snow Woman couldn’t help but urgently ask, "How did you do that?"
Vera looked to Gu Xing, seeing him nod slightly, she finally explained softly:
"Although these insects have abundant Life Force, their control over their own Life Energy is extremely weak."
"And I...happen to be adept at manipulating Life Energy."
She didn’t need to say much, everyone instantly understood her meaning—
The Insect Race lacks wisdom, so they are fearless unto death, but this also means their Life Force is extremely crude.
This leaves what seems a perfect Insect Race a fatal flaw.
Realizing this, hope lit up in everyone’s eyes.
If Vera can easily control the Life Energy of these insects, then does it mean...
This crisis has a solution?
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 293: Farewell, Gu Xing!
chapters.content:
Chapter 293: Chapter 293: Farewell, Gu Xing!
On the Insect Race battlefield, the situation was extremely critical.
Due to the sudden betrayal of the Cold Snake, the defense line of the Snow Wolf Race completely collapsed.
Coupled with the Insect Race launching a full offensive, it was now solely relying on the desperate support of the fully unleashed Snow Guardian to barely shelter the entire race behind her.
At this moment.
The Snow Guardian did not release an energy barrier that could be easily consumed by the Insect Race, but rather condensed a solid extreme ice shield to firmly guard the Snow Wolf Race within.
However, this ice shield was already full of cracks at this point, obviously unable to last much longer.
The icy gaze of two humanoid Totem-level Insect Race beings locked tightly onto the Snow Wolf Race.
The prior escape of the Cold Snake had already infuriated them, and now they would not let any prey before them escape —
None of the creatures here are permitted to leave!
Inside the ice shield, every face of the Snow Wolves bore a fear they could not conceal.
Though they were not afraid to die in battle, at the juncture of life and death, instinct made them feel a suffocating oppression.
Ying Bing watched all of this, her pale fingers unconsciously clenching.
Even though her power had increased significantly, in the face of such a massive insect tide, the power of Monarch Tier One seemed negligible.
Without the protection of the Snow Guardian, she would instantly be swallowed by the sea of insects.
"Crrrack—crrack—!!"
The shield released by the Snow Guardian kept cracking.
Even though the shield was not purely composed of energy, it could not withstand the relentless attacks from the Insect Race —
An ineffective offensive is compensated with hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands, until its complete destruction.
At this moment, the overwhelming masses of the Insect Race charged crazily toward the Snow Wolf Race.
Xue Li, watching the ever-approaching insect tide, whispered to Ying Bing:
"Ying Bing, this affair originally had nothing to do with you, but now you’ve been dragged into it... leaving is not an option!"
Ying Bing appeared very calm about this.
Before departing, she had already anticipated the outcome of this action —
The endless Insect Race is definitely not something the Snow Wolf Race can withstand.
But even so, she still came resolutely.
She has never been one to forget gratitude.
Despite longing to return to Longxia, when the Snow Country faced a life-or-death crisis, she still chose to lend a hand.
"This is my own choice."
Ying Bing’s voice was clear and firm, "My life was saved by Lady Snow Woman, and even if I die in battle now, it’s just returning this life to her."
Upon hearing these words, Xue Li’s form trembled slightly, her gaze toward Ying Bing containing genuine respect.
If she were in Ying Bing’s position, she might not be able to be so determined.
At this moment, the slight thorn in her heart caused by Ying Bing taking Lady Snow Woman’s attention away also completely vanished.
"Alright!" Xue Li took a deep breath, her eyes sharpening, "Then, let us fight side by side from here on!"
The Snow Guardian had expended all her power guarding, unable to launch another attack.
The shield was shattered; from this moment on, they could only rely on themselves.
"Snow Wolf Race — listen to orders!"
Xue Li exclaimed loudly, and all the Snow Wolves responded in unison, with determined gazes:
"Snow Wolf Race, here we are!"
Xue Li’s eyes condensed seriously, her voice echoing through the snowstorm:
"From now on, even if we fight to the last moment, we must kill as many Insect Race members as possible!"
"Every additional one we kill makes Lady Snow Woman a bit safer!"
"Understood!"
The face of each Snow Wolf bore the resolute determination of facing death.
As everyone watched, the ice shield that had been desperately supporting finally shattered completely —
The body of the Snow Guardian fell alongside with a thunderous crash.
At this instant, Xue Li shouted sharply:
"Snow Wolf Race — attack!"
Ying Bing was also inspired by this spirit of fighting to the death, following closely behind the Snow Wolf Race, boldly advancing toward the insect tide.
However, the disparity in power between the two sides was enormous.
Within the boundless ocean of insects, each time the Snow Wolf Race launched an attack, many of their members would fall.
After several charges, less than a hundred remained in the group, and almost everyone was wounded, with the most severe cases missing limbs, persevering only on sheer will.
Xue Li surveyed the fallen comrades around her, unable to hide the sorrow in her eyes.
Once a fallen Snow Wolf collapsed, the Insect Race would swarm over, leaving only bones within moments —
In just this short period, hundreds of white bones were added to the snowfield, all once her companions in running and fighting side by side.
Ying Bing’s arm was trembling slightly.
This was not due to fear, but from excessive depletion of power.
She took a deep breath and reignited her Life Fire:
"Life Burning!"
Having reached this point, she held no retreats.
Burning her life was her last choice.
Yet she still harbored a trace of regret:
Until the final moment of her life, she never got to see the person she most wanted to meet.
In the sky, two humanoid Insect Race beings quietly observed all this.
Even they couldn’t help but be amazed by the relentless will of the Snow Wolf Race.
Despite the race’s unimpressive power, this courage to fight to the death was extremely rare among the countless civilizations they had destroyed.
For such opponents, they decided — to show the highest respect:
By personally taking action!
The figures of the two Totem-level Insect Race beings disappeared instantly, leaving only a distorted black spatial rift.
The next moment, they appeared like phantoms at the front of the Snow Wolf Race’s formation!
Witnessing this scene, everyone was shocked.
Only Ying Bing was well acquainted with this power —
It was the "Void" Power mastered by Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast Fei Yue.
These two Insect Race beings also mastered this ability!
Luckily, besides mastering the Void Power, these Insect Race beings did not possess other overwhelming strength.
Ying Bing burning her life, and Xue Li struggling to resist, the two astonishedly withstood the blow in this desperate situation!
Traces of surprise flashed through the eyes of the two Insect Race beings.
But that was all it was.
They launched their attacks again, their voices harsh and metallic:
"You’re quite good, but this is all there is!"
"Before you die, remember the race that destroys you —"
"Void Insect Race."
Before they finished speaking, they gathered their offensive again, dark spatial energy slashed down like blades!
Ying Bing and Xue Li had exhausted all their strength and could no longer counter...
Yet at this moment—
A vast, enormous green vine suddenly burst through the ice field, rising into the sky ahead of the two, blocking the destructive energy like a canopy!
The attack from the two Insect Race beings struck the vine, giving off the sound of metal clashing.
This sudden change caused alarm within the two Insect Race beings’ hearts.
Subsequently, they retreated immediately.
From this vine, they sensed danger.
And as the leaders of the insect swarm, they would never place themselves in peril.
Upon seeing the vine, Ying Bing was momentarily stunned.
The next moment, seemingly realizing something, she suddenly looked up.
Sure enough, a familiar figure appeared in her view.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 294: Life Domain—Unleashed!
chapters.content:
Chapter 294: Chapter 294: Life Domain—Unleashed!
At this moment.
The cold wind howled, and the dark swarm of insects loomed like an endless sea of shadows, almost devouring the entire sky.
Gu Xing hovered mid-air, his robe fluttering in the piercing wind, standing behind him one by one were Liu Li, Vera, Qing Shuang, Lilith, and the Snow Woman.
The five of them intertwined their auras, forming an invisible barrier that made the surging insect swarm faintly restless.
Gu Xing’s gaze slowly swept across the battlefield, then settled on Ying Bing.
In the next moment.
Fei Yue suddenly appeared beside him, and when he reappeared, he was already next to Ying Bing.
Seeing the Life Fire still burning on her body, Gu Xing’s brows furrowed instantly.
"Celestial Grace."
His voice was low, a gentle yet magnificent golden light spilled from his hand, instantly covering Ying Bing’s body—
The originally burning Life Fire became as though lightly pressed down by an invisible hand, quietly extinguishing.
"Why use that power again?"
Gu Xing’s tone was not good.
After all, it took great effort for Ying Bing to fully recover.
Continuing to use this skill....
What if she exhausts her Life Force completely again?
Ying Bing seemed not to hear, just staring blankly at him, as if in a dream.
She had imagined countless times the scene of reuniting with him but never thought he would truly descend before her like a deity.
"Why not speak? Don’t want to see me?"
Gu Xing raised an eyebrow.
Ying Bing finally snapped back to reality.
Her face suddenly flushed with a hint of red, involuntarily bowing her head slightly.
That usually icy stance melted away without a trace at this moment.
"No... I’m not!"
She whispered, her voice almost drowning in the wind.
Seeing Ying Bing like this, Gu Xing was somewhat surprised.
After not seeing her for a long time, this ice beauty seemed to have changed... significantly.
However, now was not the time for catching up.
He just gently reminded, "Be safe," then turned his gaze once again toward the overwhelming insect race.
Right now, he had to quickly deal with these troubles.
At that moment, Ying Bing hurriedly looked up to remind him:
"Gu Xing, be careful of those two Totem Level insect races—they possess Void Power, very similar to Fei Yue’s abilities!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing was somewhat taken aback.
Originally, the void ability was exclusive to the Ghost Race, but now it seemed that the insect race could also use it.
Almost instantly, Gu Xing guessed...
This group of insects should not be creatures from an Alternate Space.
However, if it came to countering Void Power...
His lips curled slightly—Liu Li’s "Destruction Domain" was precisely the nemesis of all spatial abilities.
As long as she could unfold her domain, the greatest advantage of those two insect races would vanish completely.
The truly troublesome issue was the seemingly endless Low Tier insect sea.
Meanwhile, those two humanoid insect races recovered from their initial astonishment, and greed reappeared unabashedly in their eyes.
Cold Snake’s escape had left them feeling regret, but now a new "feast" had appeared before them—
The Snow Woman, being Totem Level, possessed pure and turbulent energy.
And the other, though appearing to be just Monarch Tier One Elf, had Life Energy within her that was stronger than anything they had ever encountered!
The insect race evolved by devouring life and Spiritual Power.
If they could absorb her...
The two insects simultaneously licked their lips—
Perhaps through this, they could break through to Totem Tier Five, or even stronger!
"Sent themselves here..."
They rasped, then immediately issued new instructions to their race:
Target switch—lock on the Elf!
In an instant, the insect race turned uniformly, like a bloodthirsty cloud, surging towards Vera!
Meanwhile, Liu Li and Qing Shuang next to Vera felt tremendous pressure immediately.
Liu Li couldn’t help but nudge Vera with her elbow, whispering:
"Hey, green tea spirit, are you really confident? If we mess this up, we’re done for, and the master is here too!"
Even the always steady Qing Shuang cast an inquisitive glance.
Vera didn’t say much, just looked back at them, her eyes filled with unprecedented calm and determination.
That gaze seemed to say:
Trust me.
The duo said no more, focusing intently and preparing for battle.
Meanwhile, the Snow Woman had descended amidst the Snow Wolf tribe.
Looking at her clan, heavily wounded and almost everyone injured, she remained silent, merely extending her hand—
"Rejuvenation."
A chilling voice like a decree, the healing power of pure ice and snow spread gently, the injuries of the Snow Wolves healed rapidly, and their strength was restored.
The wolf pack bowed deeply, offering sincere thanks:
"Thank you for your grace, Snow Woman!"
Only Xue Li kept her head low, her voice choked:
"Snow Woman...it was my failure to fulfill my duty that led to so many of our clan’s sacrifices..."
Snow Woman gently shook her head, rubbing her head lightly:
"It’s not your fault; you’ve done well enough."
After comforting Xue Li, she looked up into the distance—
The Snow Guardian had completely transformed into a lifeless ice sculpture, standing silently amidst the snowstorm.
To awaken it again, who knows how many more years it would take.
Seeing this, Snow Woman’s eyes were filled with sorrow.
But she didn’t have the power to seek revenge for the giant.
She unconsciously looked up, gazing at the human figure in the sky.
All hope was now pinned on him.
Even she hadn’t expected to impulsively entrust the entire tribe’s fate to a human she had met only once.
But at this moment, there was no retreat.
At that moment, the insect race’s assault surged towards Vera like a black wave, the swarm covering the sky, devouring even the light.
At that moment—
Everyone’s gaze was tightly focused on Vera.
Vera stood calmly, her gaze serene as water.
She slowly raised her hands, a layer of warm and bright emerald light radiating around her.
The light was not blinding but carried an awe-inspiring Life Force, spreading outwards like a tide.
The insect swarm suddenly froze for an instant, as if drawn by some invisible force.
Then, the shocking scene unfolded—
The insects charging at the forefront began to rapidly shrivel and wither, as if some force drained all life from within them.
They didn’t even have time to scream before turning to ashes, dispersing in the wind.
And the emerald glow around Vera grew even brighter.
Using herself as a conduit, she transformed the vast yet chaotic Life Force of the insect race into a pure energy torrent.
She softly spoke, her voice clearly reverberating across the battlefield:
"Life Domain—expand."
An invisible boundary rapidly expanded from her center, all insects entering the domain seemed trapped in an unseen quagmire.
Life Energy flowed uncontrollably outwards, becoming nourishment for her domain!
And the Life Energy converging around Vera soared infinitely at that moment.
At this moment.
The two Totem Level insect races finally changed expressions.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 296: Nemesis of the Insect Race!
chapters.content:
Chapter 295: Chapter 296: Nemesis of the Insect Race!
Around the Elf Illusion...
There were also emerald green Dragons of Life swirling around Vera’s Elf Illusion. They were not real creatures, but physical manifestations formed purely from Life Energy.
Each dragon radiated a shimmering glow, its scales sparkling with a jade-like sheen.
Upon seeing this, Gu Xing decided to add fuel to the fire.
The higher Vera’s Attributes, the stronger the power she could unleash.
And to enhance the power...
"Soul-devouring!"
A deep voice resounded, and crimson Spiritual Power surged out like a tide, instantly covering the entire field.
Vera, Qing Shuang, Liu Li, and even Lilith from afar were all enveloped within.
In an instant, the auras of all Guardian Beasts began to surge violently, as if dormant volcanoes had suddenly awakened.
The air was filled with the humming sound of energetic vibrations, as if the entire space was trembling.
The most astonishing change was in Vera.
A brilliant emerald glow emanated from her entire body, with Life Energy flowing tangibly around her.
The Dragons of Life swirling around her seemed to respond, letting out clear dragon cries as they became more solid.
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier One]
[Power: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Constitution: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Spirit: 160,000→1,280,000→2,800,000]
[Speed: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (includes Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
Under the influence of the Life Spirit Form and Gu Xing’s Soul-devouring Talent...
Vera’s Spiritual Attribute reached 1,280,000, while other Attributes reached the height of 800,000.
Moreover, the abundant surrounding Life Energy turned into visible green streams, continuously pouring into Vera’s body.
With the support of this power, her various Attributes once again surged—
An increase of a million points!
At the same time, Qing Shuang and Liu Li also released their battle forms.
Black Ghost Qi and blood-red Fire of Destruction burst forth suddenly.
Just that...
Their aura was not as terrifying as Vera’s.
But such aura, for an ordinary Insect Race Monarch...
Was enough to become their nightmare!
At this moment, Vera floated in mid-air, her long hair dancing like streams of Life Energy.
Her aura rose to its peak, with her eyes deep in emerald green.
She softly spoke, as if chanting, as if declaring:
"Reincarnation."
The giant Elf Illusion in the sky slowly opened its arms, the movement solemn and sacred, as if to embrace the whole sky and earth.
Instantly, the Insect Race within a few miles seemed to be shackled by an invisible chain, all frozen in place.
Their screeches abruptly ceased, and their grotesque bodies solidified in mid-air, as if the entire battlefield had been paused.
Soon after, a chilling transformation began—
On the hard, dark Insect Race carapace, unexpectedly sprouted a tender green.
The green spread and expanded at visible speed, quickly turning into resilient wild grass.
The blades of grass unfurled, blooming into various vibrant flowers, as if spring had suddenly descended upon this deathly battlefield.
Simultaneously, the bodies of the Insect Race shriveled and shrunk at a terrifying speed.
Their carapaces lost their luster, limbs snapped like dead branches, not even the Monarch Level Insect were exempt—
Under Vera’s "Reincarnation," infused with the Life Law, they were indistinguishable from low-tier Insect Races, watching helplessly as their life force was relentlessly drawn.
In an instant, the entire battlefield transformed into a peculiar sea of flowers.
Countless flowers bloomed fiercely upon the remnants of the Insect Race, radiant yet eerie, like a grand yet brutal funeral.
In the next moment—
All the flowers simultaneously withered, petals flying like snow, transforming into spots of emerald light in the air.
This imposing Life Energy rushed towards Vera like rivers converging into the sea, merging into her body, causing her aura to ascend once again.
This is the true function of the skill "Reincarnation"!
In the distance, two Totem Level Insect Races were staring intently at the battlefield.
Their expressions grew increasingly sullen, and a flicker of uncertainty flashed in their compound eyes.
"Damn it!"
The voice of the green Insect Race was hoarse and twisted, "Is our Insect Race really going to be stopped here by an Elf today?"
"Stopped? Impossible!"
A vicious and fierce light flashed in the red Insect Race’s eyes:
"It’s true she can absorb life, but with her current Level, there must be an upper limit!"
"That human forcibly enhanced her once, can they possibly do it a second time?"
It suddenly raised its front limb, pointing at the still-expanding emerald domain, "This time, even if we have to pile up corpses, we must pile through!"
"But... such losses..."
The green Insect Race was still hesitant, gazing at the swathes of insect swarms turning to ash before it, its voice clearly uncertain.
"Have you forgotten the orders of ’those adults’?!"
The red Insect Race interrupted sharply, its voice icy.
The green Insect Race’s form abruptly stiffened.
Indeed, they were under orders to establish a foothold in this world, waiting for the Void channel to stabilize further, to welcome the true bodies of ’adults’.
If even this first line of defense couldn’t be breached...
The last trace of hesitation vanished from its eyes, replaced by the coldness and ruthlessness unique to the Insect Race:
"...As you say."
"Even if we have to pave the way with corpses, we must pave through!"
It suddenly raised its head, letting out a piercing screech that penetrated the battlefield—
"All forces, charge!!"
The next moment, the dark swarm surged again like a breached black flood, frantically rushing toward where Vera stood.
They tread over their fellow corpses, ignoring the dying vanguard ahead, launching a suicidally pure, savage assault with sheer numbers.
Vera’s emerald eyes were calm as she slowly raised her hands, fully expanding the Life Domain.
The emerald glow surged abruptly, forming a barrier, majestic and dignified, spanning the battlefield.
Then—
The black flood of destruction collided with the green Wall of Life with a roar!
Countless Insect Races began to wither, bloom, and wither upon entering the domain...
Yet the Insect Race behind them continued to push forward, undeterred.
Indeed, as the two Totem Level beings had suspected.
Vera’s mastery of Life Energy had its limits.
But such limits....
Had been boundlessly elevated under the support of Gu Xing’s Soul-devouring Talent!
....
On a barren, desolate land, several imposing voices echoed from the void—
These were several high-tier Insect Races whose forms were nearly invisible to the naked eye, exchanging ideas directly through their consciousness.
"The death rate of low-tier beings is abnormal... the resistance from that world is far beyond estimation."
"Could this really be a trap set by the Demon Race?"
"Impossible! The Demon Race is equally repelled by the world’s laws; they can’t arrive in large numbers—there must be another reason."
After a brief and efficient mental exchange, the initial voice resounded again, with an undeniable tone:
"Since that’s the case, continue sending in low-tier Insect Races—crush them with numbers."
"Understood!"
From all directions came countless replies, as if the entire dead land awakened at that moment.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 296: Nemesis of the Insect Race!
chapters.content:
Chapter 296: Chapter 296: Nemesis of the Insect Race!
Around the Elf Illusion...
Numerous green Dragons of Life circled around Vera’s Elf Illusion, swirling and moving. They weren’t real creatures but manifestations composed purely of Life Energy.
Each dragon emitted a gentle glow, with scales shimmering like emeralds.
Seeing this scene, Gu Xing decided to add fuel to the fire.
The higher Vera’s Attributes, the stronger the power she could unleash.
And to enhance power...
"Soul-devouring!"
A deep voice echoed, and red Spiritual Power surged out like a tide, instantly enveloping the entire scene.
Vera, Qing Shuang, Liu Li, and even Lilith in the distance were all covered in it.
In an instant, the aura of all Guardian Beasts began to rise dramatically, like a dormant volcano suddenly awakening.
The air was filled with a buzzing sound of energy oscillation, as if the entire space was trembling because of it.
The most astonishing transformation occurred with Vera.
Around her, a dazzling green light bloomed, and Life Energy circulated around her as if it were tangible.
The Dragons of Life surrounding her seemed also to be called upon, letting out clear dragon roars as their forms became more solid.
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier One]
[Power: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Constitution: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Spirit: 160,000→1,280,000→2,800,000]
[Speed: 100,000→800,000→1,800,000]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
Under the form of Life Spirit and the blessing of Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent...
Vera’s Spiritual Attributes reached 1,280,000, and the other Attributes reached heights of 800,000.
Moreover, the surrounding Life Energy was so abundant that it turned into visible green streams of light, continuously infusing into Vera’s body.
With the enhancement of this power, all her Attributes surged once again—
An increase of a full million points!
Meanwhile, Qing Shuang and Liu Li also simultaneously released their combat forms.
Black Ghost Qi and blood-red Fire of Destruction erupted suddenly.
However...
Their aura wasn’t as terrifying as Vera’s.
But this kind of aura, for an ordinary Insect Race Monarch...
Was already enough to become their nightmare!
At this moment, Vera floated in mid-air, her long hair dancing like streams of Life Energy.
Her aura had risen to its peak, and her eyes were a profound deep green.
She spoke softly, like a chant, like a proclamation:
"Reincarnation."
The giant Elf Illusion in the sky slowly opened its arms, with a solemn and sacred gesture, as if to embrace the entire sky and earth.
In an instant, the Insect Race within several miles seemed to be shackled by invisible chains, all frozen in place.
Their screeches came to an abrupt halt, their grotesque limbs frozen in mid-air, as if the entire battlefield had been paused.
Immediately, a chilling change began—
On the tough black shell of the Insect Race, a patch of tender green emerged without warning.
That green spread and expanded at a speed visible to the naked eye, quickly transforming into clusters of resilient wild grass.
The grass blades stretched out and then blossomed into vibrant flowers of various colors, as if spring had suddenly descended upon this battlefield of death.
Simultaneously, the bodies of the Insect Race were shriveling and wilting at a horrifying pace.
Their shells lost luster, limbs snapped like dead branches, and even Monarch Level Insect Races were not spared—
Under Vera’s Reincarnation, imbued with Life Law, they were no different from Low Tier Insect Races, only able to watch helplessly as their life was frantically extracted.
In merely a moment, the entire battlefield was transformed into a bizarre sea of flowers.
Countless flowers bloomed on the remnants of the Insect Race, magnificent and eerie, like a grand yet brutal funeral.
And in the next moment—
All the flowers wilted simultaneously, the petals flying like snowflakes, and then in mid-air they turned into dots of emerald light.
These vast Life Energies converged like rivers into the sea, rushing toward Vera, merging into her body, causing her aura to rise once more.
This is the true function of the skill Reincarnation!
In the distance, two Totem Level Insect Races stared intently at the battlefield.
Their expressions grew increasingly somber, their compound eyes flickering with uncertain glimmers.
"Damn it!"
The voice of the green Insect Race was hoarse and twisted, "Our Insect Race... could it really be stopped by a single Elf today?"
"Stopped? Impossible!"
The red Insect Race’s eyes flashed with a trace of savage fierceness:
"She can indeed absorb life, but with her current Level, there is absolutely a limit!"
"That human forcibly boosted her once, can they boost her a second time?"
It suddenly raised its forelimb, pointing to the ever-expanding green Domain, "This time, even if we have to pile up the corpses, we must get through!"
"But... such losses..."
The green Insect Race was still hesitant, looking at the swathes of Insect swarms turning to ashes ahead, its voice carrying obvious reluctance.
"Have you forgotten the orders of ’Those Lords’?!"
The red Insect Race interrupted abruptly, its voice icy.
The form of the green Insect Race suddenly stiffened.
Yes, they were commanded to establish a foothold in this world, waiting for the Void channels to stabilize further, to welcome the true arrival of the "Lords."
If they couldn’t even break through this first line of defense...
The last trace of hesitation in its eyes vanished, replaced by the characteristic coldness and ruthlessness of the Insect Race:
"... Follow your orders."
"Even if it means paving the way with corpses, so be it!"
It raised its head sharply, letting out a piercing screech that cut through the battlefield—
"Full assault!!"
In the next instant, the dark swarm surged once more, like a black torrent breaching a dam, frantically rushing towards Vera’s direction.
They trampled over their kindred’s corpses, ignoring the vanguard that continued to perish ahead, launching a suicide charge in the most pure and savage numbers.
Vera’s green eyes remained calm, as she slowly raised her hands, fully unleashing the Life Domain.
The green light surged abruptly, forming a majestic barrier that spanned the battlefield.
And then—
The black destructive torrent fiercely collided with the green Wall of Life!
Countless Insect Races began to wilt, bloom, and wither the moment they entered the Domain...
And yet the Insect Race behind them persisted, undeterred in their advance.
Indeed, just as the two Totem Level ones had surmised.
Vera’s control over Life Energy had its limits.
But this limit....
Under the blessing of Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent, had been infinitely elevated!
....
On a barren, silent land, several august voices echoed from the void—
They were high-tier Insect Races, nearly imperceptible to the naked eye, communicating directly through willpower.
"The death rate of the Low Tier subjects is abnormal... the resistance of that world far exceeds estimations."
"Could this really be a trap laid by the Demon Race?"
"Impossible! The Demon Race is likewise rejected by world laws and can’t descend in large numbers—there must be another reason."
After a brief and efficient sharing of consciousness, the initial voice spoke again, with undeniable authority:
"If that’s the case, continue sending in Low Tier Insect Races—smash them with numbers."
"As you command!"
Supporting cries came from all directions, as if the entire desolate land awakened at that instant.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 298: Nothing But Two Totem Tier One
chapters.content:
Chapter 297: Chapter 298: Nothing But Two Totem Tier One
The battlefield at this moment.
The black and green torrents intertwine.
The moment the oppressive Insect Race steps into Vera’s Life Domain...
Except for Monarch Level Insect Race, the other Low Tier Insect Races quickly lose their vitality and turn to ash.
Under the effect of Vera’s Life Domain, this life force is gathered in front of Vera.
Used to replace Spiritual Power, supplying Vera to unleash attacks.
At the same time....
With every absorption of the Insect Race’s life force, Vera’s Reincarnation State takes a step into the next phase.
Budding, Growing, Withering!
Under the endless "nourishment" of the insect army, these three phases complete cycles at unprecedented speed.
And every end of a cycle means that Vera’s spiritual power ascends to a whole new height.
[Life Spirit (Vera)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier One]
[Power: 100000→105000→110000...]
[Constitution: 100000→105000→110000...]
[Spirit: 160000→170000→180000...]
[Speed: 100000→105000→110000...]
[Skills: Life Spirit Form (including Natural Lament, Elf Monarchy, Life Blooming, etc.), Reincarnation, Life Domain, Life Law]
Every time Vera undergoes a Reincarnation, her Strength Attribute increases by 50000 points, and her Spiritual Attribute by 10000 points!
This is an extremely terrifying speed!
Now Vera’s level is merely Monarch Tier One.
An ordinary Monarch Tier One’s attributes are at most around 80,000 to 90,000.
But Vera?
Even her weakest attributes like Power and Constitution have surpassed 100,000 points.
And her Spiritual Attribute is already infinitely close to 200,000 points.
Back then, when Lilith was at Monarch Tier Five, her attributes were only around 200,000 points.
Liu Li and Qing Shuang, upon seeing Vera’s growth speed, were equally shocked.
This elf....
In just a blink of an eye.
Has managed to leave both of them behind.
But this is precisely the uniqueness after Vera’s Talent rose to Myth Nine Stars.
Relying on her special Reincarnation skill, coupled with the favorable conditions provided by the Insect Race, has propelled Vera’s rapid ascent.
And as Vera’s Spiritual Attributes continue to rise, the Elf Illusion in the sky becomes increasingly substantial.
Upon seeing this, the two humanoid Insect Races’ expressions turned grim.
Something seems off!
How many Insect Races have they sent in?
One hundred thousand?
Five hundred thousand?
Or over a million?
They have lost track of the exact number.
They only know....
Until now, this damned elf shows no signs of reaching her limit.
Next, who knows how many Insect Race corpses it would take to fill this damned elf.
"We can’t let this continue!"
The two exchanged a glance, and in the next moment, their figures suddenly vanished.
Appearing again, they were right in front of Vera.
Capture the king first to catch the bandits!
As long as the two of them directly attack and kill this elf, the effect will be the same.
Yet, for the two Insect Races that suddenly appeared before her, Vera paid no heed.
Her task this time was only one: to hold up this group of low-tier insects.
As for these two Totem Level insects....
Someone will naturally deal with them!
"Bang——!!"
In the astonished gaze of the two Insect Races, their attack was blocked by a suddenly appearing Golden Shield.
"Who is it?"
The two Insect Races abruptly turned their heads.
Only to see a golden figure already closing in on them.
Guardian Angel Liu Li!
This time, Vera’s role is self-evident.
Thus, Liu Li’s Guardian Angel Form is used for the first time to protect someone other than Gu Xing.
"You’re attacking the wrong person! Your opponent is me!"
Liu Li slowly spoke, her eyes carrying an indifferent glint.
Qing Shuang slowly appeared beside Liu Li, her gaze also locking onto the two Insect Races.
"One for each of us?"
"I’ll take the red, you take the green!"
With a brief exchange, their opponents were determined.
Previously, when Liu Li and Qing Shuang were at Commander Tier Nine, their strength wasn’t enough to reach Totem Level.
But now....
Their levels had reached Monarch Tier One.
It’s time to test their skills with two Totem Level opponents.
The next moment.
The two dashed towards their respective opponents.
Liu Li faced off against the red humanoid Insect Race, while Qing Shuang took on the green humanoid Insect Race.
For the two of them....
As long as these two Insect Races are outside their swarm, their strength isn’t very formidable.
The slightly tricky part...
Is the Void Ability controlled by the two Insect Races.
However, Liu Li’s Destruction Angel Form allows entrance but no exit.
In the Destruction Domain, no ability can be activated.
Only the most primal attribute suppression can pierce through.
And the attribute of this Insect Race....
[Void Insect Race]
[Level: Totem Tier One]
[Talent: Myth One Star]
[Power: 2000000]
[Constitution: 2000000]
[Spirit: 3000000]
[Speed: 2000000]
[Skills: Insect Race Command, Void Control....]
Even though they’re of Totem Level, the attributes of these two insects aren’t strong.
In fact, in terms of pure attributes, the two Insect Races are not even as good as Lilith on Immortal Blood Body mode.
However, this is the drawback of the Insect Race.
Extremely poor in solo combat capabilities!
At this moment, Snow Woman sensed the situation in the sky and worriedly glanced at Lilith.
"Lilith, aren’t you going to help? These two Insect Races are of Totem Level, and those two Guardian Beasts...."
Although the Snow Woman could sense that Liu Li and Qing Shuang were quite powerful.
However....
A Monarch Tier One level going head-on against a Totem Tier One enemy.
No one would dare believe it.
The gap between them is a true, substantial boundary.
Moreover, from Monarch to Totem, such a leap occurs over a transformation of earth-shattering scale.
Yet Lilith appeared unhurried.
She too sensed the strength of these two Insect Races.
Compared to the Totem Level opponents they had encountered before, these two insects were already considered quite weak.
Even without Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent blessing.
Solely relying on the inherent strength of Liu Li and Qing Shuang, coupled with the laws they control.
Even if they cannot defeat these two Insect Races, they can still hold their own.
And with Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent blessing, their power doubled.
Facing these two Insect Races is quite relaxed.
"Little Snow, don’t worry, Gu Xing’s Guardian Beasts aren’t that weak!"
"They’re just two small Totem Tier One insects, don’t panic!"
Upon hearing this from Lilith, the Snow Woman’s eyes widened instantly.
Just Totem Tier One?
Totem Level, as the pinnacle combat power in this world.
Since when did they become like common goods in Lilith’s eyes?
However, Lilith’s matter-of-fact demeanor assured her....
Lilith seemed deadly serious!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 299: Totem Level Insect Race, Death!
chapters.content:
Chapter 298: Chapter 299: Totem Level Insect Race, Death!
At the same time.
Liu Li and Qing Shuang had already engaged their opponents.
"Destruction Domain!"
With Liu Li’s low voice echoing, the next moment the crimson domain enveloped the red humanoid of the Insect Race.
Yet, at this moment, the red humanoid Insect Race was not aware of the gravity of the situation.
"Domain? Something only Monarch Level trash uses!"
A hint of disdain appeared on the red Insect Race’s face.
Even though he had left the swarm, he wasn’t someone that just any Monarch Level could take down.
With a gentle wave of his hand, the next moment, Void Power instantly condensed into a sharp blade.
Following a sudden swing of his hand, the next moment, the blade was thrown towards Liu Li’s Destruction Domain.
"Clang!"
The sound of metal clashing rang sharply.
The smugness at the corner of the red Insect Race’s mouth suddenly halted.
"What?"
"No effect at all!"
His gaze fixed on the spot where he had attacked.
Where despite his near full-force attack, not a single damage was visible, not even a crack had formed.
"How is this possible?"
"You’re just a Monarch Tier One, how can your domain withstand my attack!"
"Impossible!"
A fierce look appeared on the red Insect Race’s face.
The aura from his body suddenly erupted, and the next moment, over a dozen purple void blades appeared around him.
With a fierce push of his hands forward.
The dozen void blades slashed towards Liu Li’s domain once again.
"Clang! Clang! Clang..."
The sound of void blades colliding with the Destruction Domain echoed repeatedly.
Yet, the Destruction Domain showed no sign of wavering.
The Insect Race’s body suddenly froze.
How can this be?
One should know, this was his full-force attack, yet it had no effect at all!
And Liu Li just silently watched this scene.
Compared to other opponents.
Like the Totem Tier One Demon Race and the Nine Nether Centipede King.
The strength of this Insect Race was clearly much inferior.
Not to mention, Void Ability is not particularly adept in offense.
Simply speaking in terms of attributes...
[Divine Angel (Liu Li)]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Level: Monarch Tier One]
[Status: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form]
[Power: 120,000→960,000→2,960,000]
[Constitution: 120,000→960,000→2,960,000]
[Spirit: 120,000→960,000→2,960,000]
[Speed: 120,000→960,000→2,960,000]
[Law Control Level: 2.5% (Increases attributes by 1,000,000)]
[Divine Pattern Control: 5%]
[Skills: Destruction Angel Form, Guardian Angel Form, Guardian Domain, Guardian Law, Destruction Domain, Destruction Law]
Destruction Angel Form increases attributes by 400%.
Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent increases attributes by 200%.
Moreover, using Destruction Law boosts attributes by one million points, doubling under Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent’s enhancement.
This pushes Liu Li’s attributes close to three million points!
The direct effect is that Liu Li’s Destruction Domain is completely unshakable by this Insect Race.
Within the Destruction Domain, everything would head towards collapse.
At this moment....
This Insect Race began to feel this.
Liu Li’s attributes were above his, and he distinctly felt his strength plummeting rapidly.
"Damn it!"
The red humanoid Insect Race cursed angrily.
Then, he prepared to use Void Power to leave this domain.
Since he couldn’t directly destroy this domain, he intended to avoid confrontation temporarily.
But he never expected....
He tried to sense the outer space, but there was no response at all.
It seemed everything in this domain was isolated.
"How could it be?!"
At this time, this Insect Race finally showed a change of expression.
Void Ability was their reliance, but now....
Their reliance was gone!
And on the other side.
Qing Shuang similarly released the Ghost King Domain.
In the pitch-black Ghost King Domain, Qing Shuang and this green Insect Race stood facing each other.
Qing Shuang’s domain, unlike Liu Li’s, couldn’t directly seal off the Insect Race’s Void Ability, preventing his departure.
This green Insect Race glanced at Liu Li’s crimson Destruction Domain.
Not sensing the aura of the other humanoid Insect Race, which surprised it slightly.
"What’s the effect of the domain that angel released? It made me, a Totem Level being, unable to sense my companion’s aura."
This green Insect Race looked at Qing Shuang with curiosity, awaiting her answer.
However, Qing Shuang had no intention of talking with this Insect Race.
For Qing Shuang, what she needed to do now was to eliminate this Insect Race as swiftly as possible.
"Ghost Race Fourth Move·Blast Star!"
The Ghost Race Four Techniques are the lifebound skills of the Ghost Race, also greatly enhancing the strength attribute of the Ghost Race.
This is also one of the reasons why the Ghost Race is known as the strongest combat race.
At this moment.
Qing Shuang’s Ghost Qi suddenly erupted.
The pitch-black Ghost Pattern spread across her face almost instantly.
Consequently, her strength attribute explosively surged to its peak.
[Ghost Race (Qing Shuang)]
[Level: Monarch Tier One]
[Talent: Myth Nine Stars]
[Power: 150,000→2,400,000→3,400,000]
[Constitution: 130,000→520,000→1,520,000]
[Spirit: 100,000→400,000→1,400,000]
[Speed: 130,000→520,000→1,520,000]
[Law Control Level: 1% (Increases attributes by 500,000)]
[Divine Pattern Control: 5%]
[Skills: Ghost King Form, Ghost Race Four Techniques, Ghost King Domain, Law of Power]
Ghost King’s Body doubles attributes, Ghost Race Fourth Move increases attributes by four times, plus the power boost from Law of Power, and Gu Xing’s Soul Devouring Talent.
With the enhancement of these four factors, Qing Shuang’s strength attribute breaks through three million points.
Completely outstripping the attributes of this Insect Race.
And this Insect Race also felt the extreme pressure emitting from Qing Shuang’s body, having a premonition that if it received an attack from this Ghost Race, even if not dead, it’d be in a miserable state.
However....
The prerequisite for an attack is being able to touch it.
Seeing Qing Shuang about to launch an attack, it immediately utilized Void Ability.
As long as Void Ability was there, this Ghost Race couldn’t possibly touch it....
Except.
That idea vanished into thin air in an instant.
Because Qing Shuang also utilized Void Ability.
In the Ghost King Domain, she was in her complete form.
Power, Void!
She controlled both abilities to the extreme.
The instant this Insect Race used Void, Qing Shuang also synchronized her use.
When this Insect Race appeared, it was horrified to find that this Ghost Race had already tracked it down.
"Is this.... Void?!"
The Insect Race’s eyes widened sharply.
To know that within the Insect Race, Void Ability could only be controlled by those "adults".
What they possessed of Void Ability was bestowed by those adults.
But now....
This race actually controlled this ability too.
Except...
Before it could ask why Qing Shuang had the Void Ability, Qing Shuang’s fist had already landed above its head.
"Bang!"
With three million points of strength attribute.
This Insect Race’s head was instantly blasted, leaving its head and body separated.
Meanwhile, the Destruction Domain released by Liu Li suddenly opened.
Except, there was already no sign of that Insect Race within.
This also meant the two leaders of the insect swarm...
Were dead!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 300: Kidnapping the Snow Woman!
chapters.content:
Chapter 299: Chapter 300: Kidnapping the Snow Woman!
The moment the two Totem-level Insect Races died, the entire swarm came to a halt.
Faced with Vera’s Life Domain, the swarm no longer charged fearlessly.
Instead, a sense of fear appeared in their eyes.
Previously, it was due to the suppression of the two high-level Totem-level Insect Races that the swarm could operate as a unit, displaying the full force of the swarm.
But now, with the two Totem-level Insect Races dead....
The whole swarm was now a headless dragon!
Seeing Vera’s Life Domain ahead, the swarm gradually came to a stop.
No longer moving forward.
They knew well that entering the domain would mean having their life force drained to death.
When high-tier insects in the swarm die, they are replaced by the next tier of insects.
However...
The number of Half-step Totem-level insects within the swarm was excessively large.
Each insect issued different commands, which resulted in....
Over time, the swarm began to fall into chaos.
Gradually, the swarm split into hundreds of groups.
Each group was led by a Half-step Totem-level insect.
Gu Xing observed this scene, pinching his chin in slight contemplation.
From this battle, he realized....
The strength of the swarm was indeed formidable.
If there was no method to counter them.
With their overwhelming numbers....
Only two Totem Tier One Insect Races were needed to lead the swarm to hunt a Totem Tier Five existence.
If it weren’t for Cold Snake’s clever maneuvering, escaping from the swarm’s encircling would have been impossible.
However, the swarm’s weakness was equally apparent.
That was the heavy reliance on high-tier Insect Race leadership.
As long as the leaders of the swarm were eliminated, the remaining insects were no threat at all.
However....
Taking down the leaders of the swarm was not as simple as it seemed.
If not for Vera, the Insect Race’s nemesis, solving the Insect Race’s crisis would have been virtually impossible for them this time.
At this moment.
Lilith approached Gu Xing with the Snow Woman at her side.
"What about the remaining insects?"
Lilith glanced at the remnants of the swarm.
Although Vera had previously slain part of them, the remaining numbers meant little to the entire swarm.
Even split into over a hundred groups, each group’s numbers remained overwhelming.
Even a regular Totem Tier One, encountering such swarms, faced the risk of falling.
Gu Xing was equally troubled by this.
He couldn’t think of any good solutions either.
Gu Xing had no choice but to turn to Vera.
Vera’s abilities were the key to dealing with this swarm, so he could only tentatively inquire if Vera had any solutions.
After some thought, Vera slowly spoke:
"Master, maybe I can give it a try!"
After saying this, Vera utilized a small portion of Life Energy.
The next moment.
A vine grew in the midst of the swarm.
And with this vine, Vera merely used a sliver of Life Energy.
This sliver of Life Energy couldn’t even pose a threat to a Commander-Level Insect Race.
But strangely....
The swarm, sensing the aura of this vine.
Oddly chose to avoid it, even though the vine was incredibly weak, they dared not touch it.
Seeing this, Gu Xing was a bit surprised.
But he quickly understood the reason.
It might be because the swarm’s intelligence was too low.
Vera had previously massacred the swarm, making them remember her scent and labeling her as a nemesis.
Whenever encountered, they would immediately choose to evade.
"In that case...."
Gu Xing had an idea in his eyes.
Without Totem-level Insect Race leaders, this swarm could not discern danger.
Vera could completely use the vine to encircle the entire Snow Domain.
Confine the swarm within the bounds of the Snow Domain.
If this swarm wreaked havoc in the Alternate Space, the consequences would be extremely dire.
Therefore, confining them to the Snow Domain was the best solution.
However....
Gu Xing’s gaze turned to the Snow Woman.
"Lady Snow Woman, I am planning to have Vera encircle the swarm within the Snow Domain. What do you think?"
"Of course, I will ensure that Vera surrounds the territories of the Snow Country to prevent the swarm from getting close."
Yet.
The Snow Woman was still in shock at this moment.
She never expected Gu Xing, a Monarch Tier One, to actually deal with two Totem-level Insect Races.
Moreover, the exceedingly troublesome swarm was effortlessly handled by Gu Xing.
All of this exceeded the understanding of the Snow Woman, who only ever stayed sheltered in the Snow Cave.
Next to her, Lilith nudged the Snow Woman gently with her elbow seeing she wasn’t responding.
"Xiao Xue? What are you thinking? They’re asking you something."
Reminded by Lilith, the Snow Woman slowly returned to her senses.
"Ye-yes!"
Understanding Gu Xing’s plan, the Snow Woman quickly agreed.
After all, confining the swarm within the Snow Domain only brought benefits for her.
The Snow Country’s strength was relatively weak, after all.
Moreover, with the sacrifice of the only formidable deterrence, the Snow Guardian, during this crisis.
Snow Country would certainly be in grave danger facing any onslaught from the Demon Race.
Indeed, if the Demon Race launched an attack on the Snow Country, it would have no means of resistance.
However....
As long as the swarm was confined within the Snow Domain.
It acted as an additional natural barrier outside the Snow Country.
The Insect Race couldn’t differentiate between Alien Race, Human Race, or Demon Race.
All races were just food to them.
Thus, any attempts by the Demon Race to invade Snow Country would be met with attacks from the swarm.
Agreeing to Gu Xing’s proposal brought nothing but benefits to the Snow Country.
"I have no objections!"
The Snow Woman nodded decisively, expressing she had no problem with it.
Seeing the Snow Woman’s agreement, Gu Xing instructed Vera to proceed to the borders of the Snow Domain to handle the task.
Currently, with the swarm rampaging wildly, without quickly confining them.
They might soon escape the boundaries of the Snow Domain, posing threats to other races.
And nearest to the Snow Domain was the Angel Race.
Therefore, this operation needed to be completed promptly.
Within the Snow Country, the fierce beasts were nearly extinct now.
The Demon Race wouldn’t appear in the Snow Domain at this time either.
So, Gu Xing let Vera handle the task alone.
After Vera left, Gu Xing’s gaze fell upon the Snow Woman.
He gave Lilith a subtle look.
This time, he had another goal, which was to see if he could persuade the Snow Woman to join.
Lilith, noticing Gu Xing’s subtle gesture, slightly twitched at the corner of her mouth.
The first priority of having an available spot wasn’t to form a contract with her.
It was to contract her best friend.
However, after pondering for a moment, she decided to assist Gu Xing.
After all, there was a Blood Covenant between her and Gu Xing, which was enough for now.
But as for the Snow Woman....
The current chaos in the situation, any carelessness might mean never seeing her again.
Considering all aspects, the Snow Woman would indeed be safer becoming Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 300 - 301: Gu Xing, You’d Better Stay Alive!
chapters.content:
Chapter 300: Chapter 301: Gu Xing, You’d Better Stay Alive!
The former territory of the Insect Race.
The entire atmosphere of the world suddenly stagnated, as if even time had frozen at this moment.
A few Insect Race beings, indistinct and immeasurably large, hovered quietly, surrounded by heart-stopping void fluctuations.
