They were trembling incessantly, digesting the information relayed by the previous two Totem-level Insect Race beings.
Because the Void Power wielded by the Totem-level Insect Race was bestowed entirely by them.
Thus, every time a Totem-level Insect Race falls, a strand of Void Power carries with it their final memories...
Traversing layers of void, returning to their consciousness.
At this moment, after reading those two segments of memories filled with destruction and unwillingness, a cold yet grand voice slowly resonated:
"The Elf Clan... have actually mastered a power that so restrains my race!"
"That exceptional elf must not be allowed to remain."
"If we let her continue to grow, she will surely become a major threat to our Insect Race."
"No," Just then, a distinctly different voice cut off the consensus,
"The key isn’t the elf, but rather that human—"
"The elf only acquired such bizarre abilities under his protection."
"Therefore, I suggest... prioritizing the elimination of that human."
"As long as the human is dead, the remaining elves are not worth fearing."
At these words, several Insect Emperors simultaneously fell into silence, seemingly engaged in intense deliberation within the boundless sea of consciousness.
A moment later, a command that brooked no objection erupted like thunder:
"Kill that human, at all costs, act immediately!"
The Insect Race would never allow the existence of a "nemesis," no matter which race he comes from or where he is.
The instant the command was issued, it was as if the entire Insect Race world had suddenly awoken.
Countless Insect Race beings—from the lowest tier worker insects to the nest lords guarding various regions—simultaneously lifted their heads, dark energy pouring out from their bodies, converging towards the sky like rivers returning to the sea.
The sky began to twist and tear, and a void channel stretching tens of miles gradually formed.
This was the destructive path constructed by forcibly tearing through world barriers and traversing the Endless Void with the combined strength of the entire Insect Race.
As the channel stabilized for an instant, the initial speaker among the Insect Emperors slowly extended a massive pincer—
Wherever it passed, all was annihilated, laws collapsed, even light could not escape, returning entirely to nothingness.
....
Meanwhile, the Snow Wolf Race had already evacuated completely.
Gu Xing had also given the order for Qing Shuang, Fei Yue, Tushan Yueli, and other Guardian Beasts to assist Vera in executing tasks.
Except for Sally, who due to special circumstances, could only temporarily remain in the Beast Taming Space.
At this moment, Liu Li was the only one left by his side, responsible for guarding his safety.
With another glance from Gu Xing, Lilith finally mustered the courage to tentatively speak:
"Little Snow... have you ever thought about living a different lifestyle?"
She posed the question as tactfully as possible.
After all, the Snow Woman had previously made it clear she would never become a human’s Guardian Beast.
The Snow Woman was a bit surprised at Lilith’s words, shot her a glance, then turned her head towards Gu Xing, immediately understanding the meaning behind the statement—
It was an invitation for her to join this human as his Guardian Beast.
To be honest, she had never entertained such an idea.
However, after the event of the Insect Race invasion, the Snow Woman’s thoughts quietly wavered.
She was, after all, merely a support-type Guardian Beast, unable to support the entire Snow Country on her own.
Utilizing the Insect Race to balance the Demon Race was merely a temporary measure.
No one could predict how long this balance could last.
Therefore, faced with Lilith’s question, the Snow Woman fell into silence.
To her, following this human might be a better choice than fighting alone.
She had already witnessed his talent with her own eyes—
In the entire Otherworld, it’s hard to find anyone as extraordinary as him.
Becoming his Guardian Beast would not disgrace her identity.
Moreover, by Gu Xing’s side was also Lilith....
The Snow Woman suddenly raised her head, her gaze gripping upon Gu Xing.
And Gu Xing did not avoid it, he calmly met her gaze.
Moments later, the Snow Woman took a deep breath, seemingly resolved, began to speak—
But just then...
"Crack! Crack!"
The sound of the void shattering pierced the silence, the world suddenly plunged into pure darkness.
A pitch-black spatial corridor extending tens of miles was slowly taking shape high above the sky.
The breath of destruction and sterility poured like a tide from the depths of the corridor, stripping vitality wherever it reached.
Their faces suddenly changed.
"Gu Xing, it’s wrong! This aura... it’s the Insect Race!"
Lilith cried out in shock, turning abruptly, but saw Gu Xing’s body stiff, unable to move.
And at this moment...
Gu Xing’s gaze was fixed firmly onto the void channel in the sky—
It was coming for him.
The blood in his veins nearly stagnated, his breath suffocating.
If he hadn’t ascended to the Monarch level, just the oppressive aura alone would have been enough to kill him instantly.
He gritted his teeth, using all his strength to slightly shift his gaze, seeing that Lilith and the Snow Woman were unaffected by this aura.
Evidently, this destructive lock—targeted only him.
"Want... to kill me?"
Gu Xing’s teeth ground out a creaking sound, his body uncontrollably trembling, blood oozing from his eyes.
He used every ounce of willpower to resist the invisible pressure that threatened to crush him.
"Emperor’s Might—!!"
With an indomitable will, he forcibly broke free from the energy for an instant!
Without any hesitation, Gu Xing instantly activated the Sovereign Talent.
The azure Spiritual Power surged through his body, flowing around him like armor.
Under the enhancement of triple attributes, he finally regained a faint control over his body.
A faint sound of surprise came from the depths of the void channel.
But Gu Xing had no time to care.
The instant he regained movement, he shouted hoarsely:
"Lilith—take the Snow Woman, Liu Li, Sally... run!!"
Before his words were finished, he forcibly summoned Liu Li and Sally from the Beast Taming Space.
Though the sky channel was not yet fully stable, the force remained locked onto him.
He clearly felt:
This time’s opponent was unlike any enemy he’d faced before.
All his means, all his strategies, were just dust before such an existence.
He could not... let them die here with him.
"Run—!!"
Gu Xing shouted once more, bringing Lilith back to her senses.
She did not hesitate, grabbing hold of Sally and the Snow Woman, but when she reached to pull Liu Li away, Liu Li abruptly avoided.
"I want to stay with the master!"
"You take them and go!"
Liu Li’s eyes were filled with a resolute determination never seen before—
Even if she were to die, she would stay beside Gu Xing.
Lilith gripped her hand tightly, her nails nearly embedded into her palm.
She turned to the Snow Woman and Sally—
Since she couldn’t take Liu Li, she must ensure the safety of the other two.
Sally, seeing this, tried to struggle to stay, but before Lilith, she had no power to resist, and was promptly knocked unconscious.
In the next moment, a rich blood light erupted around Lilith, enveloping her, the Snow Woman, and Sally together.
Her figure shot away like a crimson rainbow, but there remained a shout echoing between the heavens and the earth:
"Damn it, Gu Xing! I’ve signed a Blood Covenant with you!"
"If you die, I can’t live either—"
"Fight for your life to survive!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 301 - 302: Void Shattered, World Stilled!
chapters.content:
Chapter 301: Chapter 302: Void Shattered, World Stilled!
Watching as Lilith transformed into a streak of blood-red light, swiftly disappearing into the horizon with Snow Woman and Sally, Gu Xing’s tense heartstrings finally relaxed slightly.
At least... they escaped.
This time, not everyone will be buried here.
In the sky, the destructive aura ignored the escaping few —
Its target, from the beginning to end, was only Gu Xing.
"Crack—crack—"
The laws around the Void passage began to shatter successively, emitting a heart-stopping cracking sound.
The passage constructed across worlds violently disturbed the origin of this world, with the rules of heaven and earth forcibly twisted, plunging into chaos.
Gales like knives roared out from the twisted fractures.
The earth quaked, splitting open bottomless chasms.
The distant snow-capped mountains collapsed one after another, as the overwhelming snow waves roared and engulfed everything.
The entire world seemed to have had its facade of balance torn apart, falling into an apocalyptic chaos.
Dark clouds churned, lightning flickering uncertainly beside the Void passage, even the light appeared twisted and ominous.
The world seemed to have entered doomsday!
At this moment, Liu Li unfurled her wings resolutely, firmly guarding in front of Gu Xing.
The power of the Guardian Angel was unleashed without reservation, as the resplendent Golden Domain enveloped the two like a barrier, resisting the rampant Power of Heaven and Earth outside.
Gu Xing looked at the seemingly delicate yet incredibly resolute figure standing before him, and hoarsely advised:
"Liu Li, this time... it’s clear they’re coming for me, you don’t have to stay here with me."
Knowing that Lilith could successfully retreat with the others, he understood —
The killing intent that locked onto him across the Void didn’t care about anyone else.
As long as Liu Li was willing, she could leave this certain-death situation at any time.
However, Liu Li was unwavering.
She turned back, her golden eyes firmly gazing at him:
"Master, please don’t say such things anymore."
"No matter where you go, Liu Li will be by your side—"
"Until the end!!"
Her voice was light, yet it carried an indisputable weight.
Even if at this moment, they faced an enemy far beyond imagination.
Even if this time, there was not the slightest chance of escape.
Even if this time, both she and Gu Xing would remain here.
She would not retreat even a step.
Liu Li’s eyes quickly scanned the surroundings.
Everywhere her gaze landed, the heavens and earth crumbled, the Void distorted, and the raging energy storms tore the earth with countless abysses.
Yet, Liu Li’s heart gradually sank.
She tried to find a chance amidst the chaos to take Gu Xing away.
However—
Not to mention leaving, even moving was becoming incomparably difficult.
She slowly raised her head, gazing at the Void passage that covered the entire view in the sky.
It was like a massive mouth swallowing the light, continuously pouring out destruction.
Deep within the passage, the cold and immense will had long since locked onto the two.
She also realized...
The enemy would never give them any chance to escape.
If so...
Then, there was only one path to take.
If they weren’t allowed to leave, then they...
Would fight to the end!
With their bodies as shields, risking their lives, they would defend to the death!
"Master, as long as Liu Li lives, no one will be allowed to harm you!"
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing was slightly taken aback.
He looked down at Liu Li’s firm little face.
The corners of Gu Xing’s previously tight lips couldn’t help but slightly curl up, revealing a trace of soft smile.
Never mind.
He understood in his heart—
No matter how much he persuaded, Liu Li would never leave alone.
If that’s the case, then face it together!
Even if they were destined to fall in the end, they would fight till the last moment after struggling with all their might.
"Soul-devouring!"
"Sovereign·Link!"
"Sovereign Guardian!"
With no reservations, Gu Xing simultaneously activated two major Talents, pushing his Spiritual Power to the limit.
The blood-red Soul-devouring Power and ice-blue Sovereign brilliance intertwined, enveloping Liu Li.
And Liu Li’s aura soared, reaching a peak.
This was the utmost limit Gu Xing could achieve without utilizing the Divine Pattern.
Under the four-fold overlap of the Guardian Angel Form, World Law blessing, Guardian Beast Attributes gathering, and Sovereign Power...
Liu Li’s Attributes astonishingly broke through to eight million points!
Brilliant golden light burst from her body, her holy wings unfolded like a deity descending to the world.
Yet, even so—
Gu Xing’s expression did not relax in the slightest, instead, his eyes grew even more grim.
The pressure that permeated from the sky had long surpassed the Initial Tier of Totem Level, vaguely transcending the entire Totem echelon!
"Boom——!!!"
With a reverberating roar that seemed to tear through the universe, the Void passage spanning the sky was completely constructed.
The next moment, under Gu Xing’s terrified gaze—
A colossal claw seemingly capable of piercing through the heavens and earth, slowly emerged from the depths of the passage.
Just a fleeting glimpse, and Gu Xing felt his mind and soul quake as if he had suffered a heavy blow.
The surface of the enormous claw was covered with an abyssal dark carapace, flowing with the patterns of the Annihilation Law.
Everywhere it passed, space shattered inch by inch, and even light couldn’t escape its devouring.
Gu Xing clenched his teeth, forcibly suppressing his nearly rampaging Spiritual Power.
Every inch of his flesh cried out under the unbearable burden.
Beside him, Liu Li’s form also trembled slightly.
The holy Golden Domain flickered uncertainly under the pure destructive pressure, like a candle in the wind.
What...what kind of existence was this?
Just by standing in front of Gu Xing, she felt every inch of her skin, every strand of her soul screaming a sharp warning—
As long as she continued to stand here, death would be the only outcome.
And this was just the descent of that colossal claw into this realm, not yet launching a true attack...
Yet even so, Liu Li continued to bite her silver teeth, the golden light in her eyes burning brightly:
"Guardian...Domain!"
She strained to lift her hands, as radiant golden light flowed from her palms, attempting to coalesce into a solid barrier.
But under the pressure of the owner of the colossal claw, the surrounding Heaven and Earth Laws had already plunged into utter chaos, even the flow of energy had become heavy and distorted.
Every bit of strength Liu Li gathered felt like she was contending against the crushing force of the entire world.
It’s important to note, her current strength was already approaching Tier Two of the Totem Level, which under normal circumstances, was the limit of this world.
Yet, in the face of this aura beyond comprehension, even maintaining a domain was extremely difficult.
Finally, a flickering golden light domain slowly took shape under her persistent support.
Immediately afterwards, Gu Xing’s Sovereign Guardian Power also reinforced with all its might, as the ice blue and blood red dual-colored brilliance intertwined and surged into the domain, pushing its strength to the peak.
This was the final, and strongest defense they could construct at the moment...
"Liu Li, get ready—it’s about to strike!"
Liu Li’s gaze instantly solidified, her entire being poised in maximum alert.
In the sky, the colossal claw, seemingly born from chaos, slowly pressed down.
At this moment, the world plunged into a suffocating silence.
The annihilation aura it carried descended even before the claw truly landed—
Everything in its path:
The crumbling mountains, the raging storms, even the fractured void...
All silently vanished into nothingness at this moment, as if they never existed.
....
...

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - 303: The Situation Descends into Chaos
chapters.content:
Chapter 302: Chapter 303: The Situation Descends into Chaos
At the same time
Vera, Qing Shuang, and a group of Guardian Beasts were racing with all their might towards the storm center.
"Damn it... Master, you mustn’t be in trouble!"
Feeling the terrifying aura coming from where the world seemed to be collapsing, Vera couldn’t help but grit her teeth and growl softly.
Even though they were so far apart, the oppressive force that seemed to crush the soul was still clearly discernible, making her feel suffocated.
If she were in the center of the storm...
She simply couldn’t imagine it.
With this thought, Vera once again summoned all her strength, increasing her speed even further.
On the other side, Qing Shuang’s face was equally cold, her eyes full of anxiety.
She suddenly turned to Fei Yue beside her, asking urgently:
"Fei Yue, can you use the Void Power to teleport us there?"
Even when she activated the Ghost King Domain, her control over the Void Power was far from matching Fei Yue, who was naturally in tune with the Void.
Moreover, the distance from here to the storm center was too far. Reaching there quickly by conventional means was almost impossible—
The only chance at the moment was to rely on Fei Yue’s Void Travel power.
However—
Fei Yue closed her eyes and focused, sensing for a moment, her face gradually turning pale, shaking her head as she spoke softly:
"Sister, it’s impossible..."
"The storm center is filled with violent void turbulence. If we force our way through now, we’re likely to be torn apart by chaotic spatial forces before we even get there..."
"Damn it!"
Even the usually calm Qing Shuang couldn’t help but curse upon hearing this.
Since the Void Ability was unusable, she could only rely on her own strength to rush there with all her might!
"Ghost King’s Body—Activate!"
Black Ghost Patterns swiftly spread across her skin, and ominous Ghost Qi surged out like a tide.
The next moment, Qing Shuang’s attributes rose sharply, she pulled Fei Yue close,
transforming into a shadow tearing through the wind, rushing toward the storm center.
Meanwhile, Lilith had already fully unleashed her power, taking Snow Woman out of the cover of the Void Channel.
She turned back to look at the increasingly chaotic sky, her eyes full of worry.
At the edge of the Void Channel’s cover, Lilith gently set Snow Woman down.
She spoke hastily:
"Little Snow, watch over this little cat girl, don’t let her do anything foolish—I have to go back!"
Snow Woman subconsciously grabbed her sleeve at these words, speaking urgently, "I’m going too!"
Gu Xing fell into dire straits to help resolve the Insect Race crisis for her; how could she escape alone?
However, Lilith decisively shook her head, her gaze calm and determined:
"Little Snow, you’re not good at fighting, going there won’t change anything."
"Staying here is actually more meaningful—"
"If Gu Xing survives, we will still need your healing."
"But..."
Snow Woman tried to argue, but Lilith cut her off directly:
"Alright, it’s decided!"
Before the words finished, she had already turned resolutely, transforming into a blood-red stream of light, rushing towards the storm center again.
Gu Xing had a Blood Covenant with her.
If Gu Xing died, she couldn’t escape either.
Besides.
Through time spent together, she had already considered Gu Xing an indispensable part of her life.
It was just to send Snow Woman and Sally out safely.
Now that the task was completed.
She naturally needed to go back and face it with Gu Xing.
After all, the Blood Covenant is also known as....
Marriage Contract!
Apart from Vera, Qing Shuang, and Lilith....
Tushan Yueli, who helped the Snow Wolf Race evacuate, also noticed something amiss.
"You all keep leaving, I have to go back!"
After leaving a sentence, Tushan Yueli also turned towards the storm center.
Gu Xing had saved the entire Qingqiu Race.
He was her great benefactor.
No matter what, she had to stay by Gu Xing’s side.
But with her....
Was Ying Bing!
"I’ll go with you!"
Ying Bing’s eyes were equally full of determination.
She had just reunited with Gu Xing and hadn’t even had time to catch up, and such a thing happened.
She wouldn’t allow it!
Watching the two’s resolute backs, Xue Li couldn’t help but clench her fists and shout:
"You two are crazy!"
"Can’t you feel that aura? With your abilities going over there, what else can you do besides die?"
"Even Totem level beings are meaningless in front of that!"
However, Lilith and Snow Woman turned almost simultaneously, responding in unison:
"So what?"
The words hadn’t fallen before both of them exploded in full speed, heading straight for the storm’s center without hesitation.
Xue Li gritted her silver teeth, muttering quietly:
"Truly two crazy people... Knowing it’s a dead end, yet you insist on charging forward!"
But—
Since when has the Snow Wolf Race ever feared death!
She suddenly looked up, calling out clearly:
"Snow Wolf Race, everyone hear my command—follow me back to the battlefield, rescue our benefactor!"
"Yes!!"
Their resounding response echoed across the snowfield, battle fervor igniting in all the snow wolves’ eyes simultaneously.
The next moment, the wolf pack surged like a silver tide, charging towards where Gu Xing was amidst the collapsing sky and destructive aura...
....
Simultaneously, far off at the peak of Dragon Island—
A gigantic silhouette as majestic as a mountain suddenly stirred, and the hundred-meter dragon eyes, long closed, slowly opened.
The brilliant golden vertical pupils reflected ancient authority, and its gaze seemed to penetrate endless space, reaching deep into the Snow Domain.
"An enemy... dares to invade this world?"
It gathered vast spiritual power like the sea, spreading its perception towards the direction from which the fluctuation came.
The next moment, the dragon’s body paused, and an enraged dragon roar boomed from its throat:
"It’s the Insect Race?!"
"All dragons at Totem level and above, hear my command!"
The mighty dragon language spread across the entire Dragon Island like a celestial decree, causing every inch of land to tremble.
Countless dragons simultaneously raised their heads, battle fires igniting in their eyes.
"Follow me to the Snow Domain—engage the Insect Race!"
"Roar——!!!"
Dragon roars tore through the sky, immense pressure sweeping through the heavens and earth.
One by one, massive dragons spread their heaven-covering wings, transforming into brilliant and terrifying streams of light, rushing towards the direction of the Snow Country...
....
In the Northern Territory, the chilly wind swept across with broken snow.
The seals of the first and second Divine Secret Realms had long vanished, and at this moment—
The ancient restriction above the third Secret Realm unexpectedly showed web-like cracks under the impact of the Insect Race tearing through the Void,
with dim blue runes flickering in and out amidst the cracks.
"Crack... crack..."
Sounds like ice layers collapsing continuously came from beneath the permafrost.
And then—
"Boom————!!!"
A magnificent and fiery golden beam surged from the core of the Secret Realm, piercing the sky, illuminating the entire gray sky as if a Divine Country had descended.
Vast divine pressure swept across the four corners like a tidal wave, causing the thousand-mile ice plain to tremble.
Human Race, Demon Race, Alien Race, Fierce Beasts—
All the powerful beings across the continent were shaken to the core, unconsciously looking towards the north.
They clearly sensed:
The Human Race’s third Divine Secret Realm had opened prematurely!
The Demon Race’s domain instantly fell into chaos.
From the depths of the ten major Demon Gates came successive roars and angry bellows, Demonic Qi boiling like water:
"Why did the Human Race’s third Divine Pattern appear now?!"
According to common theories, the third Divine Pattern should not open until at least a year later.
But everything came abruptly—
It should be known that the Demon Race had no arrangements in the Northern Territory right now.
"Notify all the Demon Race, immediately head to the Northern Territory!"
"Prevent any Race from approaching the Divine Secret Realm!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - 304: Law Awakening?!
chapters.content:
Chapter 303: Chapter 304: Law Awakening?!
Tremble!
Even the soul is uncontrollably shivering—
This was Liu Li’s only sensation when facing that destructive attack.
Before the colossal force that seemed capable of annihilating everything, all struggle seemed futile.
However.
At that moment....
A warm and steady hand suddenly clasped her cold fingers.
Gu stepped forward, standing firmly next to her.
In every moment of crisis, Liu Li always stood before him.
But this time...
Gu Xing wanted to change.
The two would face it together!
"Master?!"
Liu Li turned her head, surprise in her eyes.
Gu Xing didn’t say much, only held Liu Li’s hand tighter.
Watching the giant force approaching, blocking out the sky, Gu Xing spoke softly, yet his voice clearly reached Liu Li’s ears:
"Liu Li, thank you for always being by my side!"
Although he was Liu Li’s master, all along...
He had always been taken care of by this little girl.
Whether in battle or in life.
However.
Liu Li immediately shook her head, her golden eyes full of determination:
"Master, guarding the Beast Master is the Guardian Beast’s duty!"
"Moreover..."
"It was you who brought Liu Li out from the abyss..."
Liu Li should be the one thanking you!"
Yet...
Gu Xing originally wanted to reply to Liu Li.
But when he looked up and saw the increasingly pressing destructive force, his expression turned exceedingly heavy:
"Liu Li—it’s coming!"
As Gu Xing’s urgent voice called out, Liu Li’s expression tightened, twelve wings suddenly unfolded, their surface shimmering with dazzling golden patterns.
The brightness and strength of the Guardian Domain intensified.
Yet—
Even when the giant force was still hundreds of meters away from the domain, its engulfing destructive aura pressed heavily.
The surface of the Guardian Light Domain began to crack inch by inch, spider web-like fractures quickly spread, emitting a heart-wrenching "crack" sound.
Before contact, just the aura was enough to render Liu Li’s Guardian Domain unable to resist.
And under this horrifying pressure, blood slowly seeped from the base of Liu Li’s twelve wings.
Liu Li was nearing her limit!
Gu Xing was also enduring unimaginable pressure.
All the destructive aura was locked onto him alone, his bones throughout his body were groaning under the unbearable weight, his heart pounding as if trying to escape his chest.
Yet despite this, he still gritted his teeth, shouting hoarsely:
"Sovereign Celestial Grace!"
A grand golden light surged from his hand, enveloping Liu Li.
With the support of this force, the bleeding between Liu Li’s wings slightly halted, and the trend of domain collapse momentarily paused.
After all, the Guardian Domain released by Liu Li now was their only reliance.
Ensuring Liu Li’s status was crucial for them to endure longer.
However, after forcibly deploying "Celestial Grace," Gu Xing’s status plummeted.
Blood uncontrollably seeped from the corner of his mouth, the excruciating pain from overextending his spiritual power felt like thousands of sharp needles simultaneously stabbing into his mind, making his vision dim intermittently.
"Master!"
Liu Li glimpsed his pale complexion from the corner of her eye, panic undisguised in her voice.
"Liu Li, focus!"
Gu Xing gritted his teeth and growled, each word squeezed between his teeth, "Don’t worry about me.... I’m fine!"
Then, Gu Xing locked his eyes firmly on the increasingly approaching monstrous force.
At this moment, the distance between them was less than a hundred meters—
He could even clearly see the dark patterns circulating on its carapace, each seemingly imbued with the power of Annihilation Law.
Meanwhile, the surface cracks of Liu Li’s Guardian Domain rapidly expanded, like a soon-to-be shattered glass, producing continuous shattering sounds under the pressure of the destructive aura.
At this rate, it seems they won’t even wait for the force to truly descend; the Light Domain will completely collapse under the dissipating aura!
Realizing this, Gu Xing’s fingers clenched tightly, nails almost digging into his palm.
Damn it... Is there truly no way out?
He had tried every means.
Under the chaotic Heaven and Earth Laws and the suppressed locked aura, even the Ghost Race jade talisman couldn’t be activated;
He forcibly used World Tree Leaves—still no response!
He even tried to urge the two Divine Patterns in his mind...
They merely flickered twice before settling back into silence.
Before this force beyond comprehension, even the power of Divine Patterns seemed to retreat.
All these made Gu Xing clearly realize—
This time, they might truly have reached the end of the road.
"Crack—!!!"
Finally, the Guardian Domain completely shattered even before the monstrous force truly touched it!
"Divine Protection—!"
Liu Li hesitated not a bit, instantly igniting her final card.
A holy radiance erupted from within her, transforming into a brilliant barrier stubbornly resisting before the force.
However...
The Divine Protection Power was strong but could only block this destructive strike—
For one second.
"Boom—!"
A dazzling golden barrier illuminated once again, forcibly keeping the monstrous force suspended in the air.
"Guardian Angel’s ability?"
From the depths of the sky came the cold sneer of a gigantic Insect Race, full of disdain.
Mere desperate struggle!
Gu Xing stared at the colossal force right before him, its coverage reaching miles, like an overturned sky pressing down.
He and Liu Li were as small as dust, like two ants fighting against a giant spanning heaven and earth.
The Divine Protection Power could only hold for an instant.
And after one second....
He and Liu Li would die!
Realizing this, Gu Xing suddenly felt as if the whole world slowed down.
Is it really... going to end like this?
Buried here with Liu Li?
But if I die....
What about Vera?
What about Qing Shuang?
What about the other Guardian Beasts?
What about Longxia Country?
A surge of unyielding will arose from the depths of his heart.
At least make one final effort!
The silver Sovereign light and the blood-red soul-devouring breath, these two originally distinct forces, began to blend and converge under the pressure of desperation.
At this moment, Gu Xing suddenly felt as if the whole world fell into stagnation.
In his eyes, countless flowing Law patterns appeared—
Water, fire, destruction, life, void...
Various Heaven and Earth Laws clearly unfolded before him.
And before this gigantic force, all Heaven and Earth Laws seemed to retreat.
I am... awakening the perception of the Laws?
Almost instantly, Gu Xing realized his status.
But...
The Law I awakened seems different from Lilith and the others.
Gu Xing previously asked Liu Li, Vera, and Lilith.
They were only able to see the type of Law they controlled.
Like Liu Li, she could only see the Guardian Law and Destruction Law.
Lilith could only see the Blood Law.
Vera could see only the Life Law.
However...
Gu Xing scanned around with his vision.
Water, fire, destruction, life, void....
Various Laws were exceptionally clear in his eyes.
But...
Even if one can glimpse the Laws, so what? Even the Heaven and Earth Laws retreat before this Insect Race, how can he possibly resist?
Yet, when he was nearly desperate, he suddenly perceived...
It seems his ability isn’t merely observing the flow of Laws between heaven and earth.
...
....

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - 305: Gu Xing Vanishes!
chapters.content:
Chapter 304: Chapter 305: Gu Xing Vanishes!
But it’s...
He can actually... create laws out of thin air?!
Realizing this, Gu Xing’s pupils suddenly constricted.
He attempted to condense a wisp of Destruction Law in his palm—
The next moment, the crimson Destruction Law flowed out from his fingertips, as if alive.
This newly formed law was identical to the Power of Destruction used by Liu Li, yet more pure and resilient.
What was even more shocking to him was that the Destruction Law he created with his own hands—
It was completely unafraid of the annihilating aura exuded by the giant pincer, hovering steadily in his palm without the slightest sign of dispersing or retreating!
The law he condensed seemed unafraid of the aura of this Insect Race!
Realizing this, hope suddenly ignited.
There was salvation!
Gu Xing decisively took out the jade talisman given by the Ghost Clan Leader from the Beast Taming Space.
The reason he couldn’t activate it before was that the surrounding Space Law had been thoroughly disrupted and dissipated.
But now... since he could create laws himself—
"There’s still time... still time!"
A sharp light suddenly glowed in his eyes.
At this moment.
The effect of Divine Protection was nearing its end.
Just at the moment when the barrier of Divine Protection was about to dissipate—
Liu Li turned around without hesitation and stood in front of Gu Xing again.
Even though Gu Xing had said they would face it together.
She was determined to die before him.
But at that very instant—
Dense Void Law suddenly erupted around Gu Xing!
He activated the jade talisman without hesitation, and at the same time, took Liu Li back into the Beast Taming Space.
In the nick of time, Gu Xing’s figure suddenly vanished from the spot.
"Boom————!!!"
The giant pincer fell fiercely, the destructive impact instantly tearing apart miles of the Snow Domain.
The earth cracked, mountains toppled, everything returned to annihilation.
"Huh?"
A startled voice came from the depths of the Void.
The Insect Race did not expect that this human could forcibly construct a trace of Space Law under its suppression and use it to escape a certain death blow.
However—
The Void Insect Race excels at manipulating the Void!
Trying to escape?
Impossible!
Its giant pincers swung again, causing the surrounding void to plunge into extreme chaos.
The terrifying shadow of the pincers tore through space, chasing relentlessly in the direction where Gu Xing fled—
But at that moment—
"Insect Race—this place is not one where you can set foot!"
A majestic and authoritative voice resounded from the heavens, and in an instant, the entire Snow Domain’s space suddenly froze.
The destructive giant pincer of the Insect Race was forcibly locked in mid-air by an invisible force!
"Dragon Race?!"
The owner of the giant pincer was shaken in spirit as it felt this ancient and vast aura.
This world... actually has the existence of a Dragon Race?!
Before it could recover from the shock, a scorching Dragon Flame several miles long had already torn through the sky, charging fiercely towards the giant pincer!
The Insect Emperor reacted extremely fast, and a layer of dark shield appeared on the surface of the pincer body in an instant.
However—
Before the Dragon Flame arrived, the mighty force of the law it carried had already hit the Void Passage!
Cracks suddenly appeared on the surface of the passage, and it seemed about to shatter completely.
The heart of the Insect Emperor sank.
Since it was engaged in cross-world combat, if the Void Passage collapsed, this giant pincer infused with its Power of Origin would probably be stuck here forever!
With this thought, it exerted force, trying to retract the giant pincer—
But how could the Dragon Race let it retreat easily?
Only to see the dragon wings unfurled angrily above the sky, gathering the Heaven and Earth Laws of the entire Snow Domain like rivers returning to the sea.
The next moment, a Dragon Flame several times more majestic than before burst forth again, crashing into the Void Passage!
"Rumble!!!"
The passage shattered in response, and turbulent chaos swept wildly like stormy waves.
The Insect Emperor’s giant pincer was severed by the violent chaos at the moment of the void rupture, falling towards reality along with the debris of the passage—
In the end, the mountain-like black giant pincer fell from the sky, crashing into the bottomless pit created by the Insect Emperor’s earlier strike.
Meanwhile, heaven and earth automatically repaired the broken space.
Shortly after the Insect Race’s Void Passage shattered, the entire space was repaired by the Heaven and Earth Laws.
When all was settled, the Dragon Monarch slowly descended, perceiving the remaining aura and traces here, its dragon eyes slightly widened.
This Insect Emperor spared no expense crossing the world, but its target was merely a Monarch Level human?
It concentrated, using its talent to recall everything that had happened, and after a moment, an understanding looked appeared in its eyes.
This human’s talent... is simply astonishing.
Creating laws out of thin air—
This is a domain even it has not touched!
It’s just a pity that the human had been swept away by the chaotic void due to the aftermath of the Insect Emperor’s attack, and now even the Dragon Monarch could not perceive which world he had drifted to.
However...
Its gaze fell on the remnant aura of the Insect Race in the sky.
This time, the Insect Race’s plan not only failed but also cost them the arm of an Insect Emperor,
perhaps the only comforting result.
At that moment, Vera, Qing Shuang, Lilith, and other Guardian Beasts finally arrived at the scene.
At a glance, they saw the giant dragon that reached the heavens and the earth, their hearts trembled—
Was this the danger their master faced?
Looking around, Gu Xing was nowhere to be seen.
The Guardian Beasts instantly went into combat mode, determined to fight to the death even if they knew they were outmatched.
However, the Dragon Monarch only gently flapped its wings, and an invisible might bound them all in place.
"Your master is still alive."
After leaving this sentence, the Dragon Monarch turned and left.
The crisis here was already resolved, and it had no reason to stay.
Moreover, it needed to notify the approaching Totem Level Dragon Race that the crisis was over.
It wasn’t until the Dragon Monarch’s silhouette completely disappeared on the horizon that Vera and the others regained their movement.
The moment they regained action, the Guardian Beasts rushed anxiously to the spot where Gu Xing’s aura remained.
However, the terrifying pressure and annihilating aura left by the Insect Emperor’s giant pincer formed an invisible barrier that kept them firmly locked out, unable to get near.
"Where is the master?!"
Vera’s voice carried rare panic.
This was the first time she completely couldn’t sense Gu Xing’s presence, as if he had disappeared entirely from this world.
Lilith was relatively calmer. After pondering for a moment, she slowly spoke:
"Gu Xing should still be alive... If he had truly fallen, I wouldn’t be standing here unharmed."
"Moreover, that dragon clearly said earlier that the master is safe."
"However..."
Her tone slightly darkened, "He’s not dead, but it seems he is no longer in this world."
Upon hearing this, Vera clenched her fists tightly, her knuckles turning white.
Qing Shuang’s face was also covered in frost, full of seriousness in her eyes.
Not in this world?
How can they meet with the master?
Vera took a deep breath, suppressing her surging emotions, and said resolutely:
"I will wait here for the master to return—do as you wish."
Since Gu Xing was no longer here, she had no heart to maintain relations with the other Guardian Beasts.
Qing Shuang cast a cold glance at Vera, said nothing more, and turned to leave with Fei Yue silently.
The Ghost Race is skilled in Power of Space; she would try to find a way to trace it across worlds.
Lilith hesitated for a moment, ultimately deciding to look for the Snow Woman first.
After all, the Snow Woman was familiar with the Snow Domain and might provide some clues.
In the blink of an eye, everyone had made their choices.
The original team shattered instantly after Gu Xing’s disappearance.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - 306: A Month Without Gu Xing
chapters.content:
Chapter 305: Chapter 306: A Month Without Gu Xing
A month passed in the blink of an eye.
The snow crisis also calmed down.
Without Gu Xing’s leadership, each guardian beast chose its own way to alleviate the longing for Gu Xing.
The once battlefield center is no longer a vast snowy plain—
The power of life released by Vera spread like a tide, dyeing this land a rich emerald green.
She stood in the center of greenery, countless vines surged out around her, like snakes and dragons, relentlessly attacking the Insect Emperor’s broken giant pincer.
Every time the vines got close, they were instantly shattered by the remaining destructive aura of the giant pincer.
But Vera did not stop, new vines broke out of the ground again, stubbornly facing the force of annihilation.
This severed pincer, after all, had lost the original support of the Insect Emperor, and under Vera’s day and night assaults, finally, some sporadic vines penetrated the barrier, touching the surface of the giant pincer, greedily absorbing the remaining energy.
All the power absorbed was transformed by her into pure life essence, continuously injected into her reincarnation skill.
A hint of pain and guilt flashed in her eyes—
If only she were strong enough back then to instantly eliminate all the Insect Race, she would never have left her master’s side, nor would she have let him disappear...
Vera clenched her fists tightly, and the energy around her surged again.
She knew clearly that the reincarnation skill was her greatest reliance.
Only by exhausting everything to tap into its potential could her strength achieve a leap forward in growth.
Next time...
When she reunites with Gu Xing—
She will have enough power to guard by Gu Xing’s side.
And Vera is not the only one with such thoughts.
Deep within the Ghost Race, Yu looked at the determined Qing Shuang in front of him with a hint of bitterness on his face.
"Qing Shuang, you don’t need to enter the forbidden land of the Ghost Race, your current strength is only Monarch Tier One, and your talent has already surpassed mine. If you just follow the routine..."
"Your future achievements will not only surpass your father, but even surpass me, becoming the greatest Ghost King in the history of the Ghost Race!"
"Moreover, your master might be returning soon, there is no need for us to risk entering the forbidden land!"
However, Yu’s words did not shake Qing Shuang’s determination at all.
"Grandfather, there’s no need to say more, I’ve made up my mind!"
Even though Qing Shuang had said the words he had longed to hear, Yu could not be happy at all.
The forbidden land of the Ghost Race connects to another unknown and dangerous world.
Yu once arrogantly explored deep within, and the deeper he went, the more terrifying the power of the Demon Race became.
In the end, he even encountered a group of totem-level Demon Clan and had to retreat in disarray.
Previously, Qing, who lived in the forbidden land, survived only because she was at the very edge of that world.
And now...
Qing Shuang plans to enter the forbidden land and head toward the center of that world.
To enhance her strength through battle.
Although, in battle, the Ghost Race indeed can exert its maximum capabilities.
However...
In the forbidden land, one careless mistake can lead to eternal doom.
Thinking of this, Yu turned to the silent Qing beside him and spoke urgently:
"Qing, persuade your daughter!"
Qing turned his head to see Qing Shuang and saw the unyielding determination in her eyes.
The words of dissuasion instantly stuck in his mouth.
From Qing Shuang’s eyes, he saw himself.
He was once the same...
Otherwise, he would not have emerged from all the Ghost Race and married the Clan Leader’s daughter.
Thinking of this, Qing fell silent.
After a long while, he spoke slowly:
"Clan Leader, let Qing Shuang go! Her character is exactly like mine back then, we can’t stop her!"
Qing Shuang, hearing Qing’s words, gave Qing a grateful look.
Afterwards, she solemnly bowed to both Qing and Yu and then resolutely entered the forbidden land.
Yu watched her disappear into the depths of darkness, his eyes gradually reddening.
He suddenly turned to Qing, still in a daze, unable to suppress his emotions:
"My daughter has already been sacrificed. If anything happens to Qing Shuang, I will banish you from the Ghost Race!"
After shouting this, Yu decisively turned and left.
Qing remained standing there for a long time before turning away somewhat dejectedly.
After the two left, a profound void tear silently appeared.
Fei Yue stepped out slowly from the rift, standing silently in front of the now-sealed forbidden land entrance.
She gazed at the thoroughly sealed door, her eyes gradually becoming firm.
During this time, she and Qing Shuang had searched almost every corner of the world yet could not perceive the slightest trace of Gu Xing.
It was only at this moment that she truly understood the meaning of Lilith’s words—
The master may indeed have gone to another world.
And this is precisely why her sister resolutely stepped into the forbidden land of the Ghost Race, determinedly pursuing another world.
Fei Yue took a deep breath, as if exhaling all hesitation and reliance.
"Sister... all this time, I’ve been living under your protection."
"By your side, I’ve never truly grown independently."
"This time, you’ve chosen to enter the forbidden land—and I am no longer willing to hide under anyone’s wings."
Her voice was solemn as a vow, echoing in the silent void:
"I swear—by the day we reunite, the Fei Yue you see will be a completely new one!"
During this time, the enemies Gu Xing faced grew stronger, yet she felt her strength gradually falling behind him.
She was unwilling... to let this continue.
Fei Yue suddenly raised her head, locking her gaze on a certain spot in the sky—
A faint yet familiar void ripple lingered there.
Since both the Insect Race and Ghost Race can control the void.
By following this remaining void aura for exploration, she would definitely be able to grow!
Meanwhile.
Tushan Yueli had already arrived in Longxia Country.
Apart from being renowned for control and sealing, the Qingqiu Race has another trait that resonates throughout the otherworld.
That is leadership skills!
The Qingqiu Race can lead almost ten thousand races, relying on their ultimate leadership capabilities.
At this moment, Tushan Yueli has been entrusted with a significant responsibility by Long Zhenguo, overseeing the overall affairs of Longxia Country.
"Yueli girl, thank you for your hard work!"
Long Zhenguo looked at the serious Tushan Yueli and sighed.
But Tushan Yueli shook her head and slowly spoke:
"No, Gu Xing saved the Qingqiu Race, and Longxia Country took us in, it’s only right that I contribute a bit!"
However, at the mention of Gu Xing, the atmosphere between the two fell silent once again.
For a long time, Long Zhenguo took a deep breath, suppressing his concern, and comforted gently:
"Yueli girl, that boy Gu Xing... won’t come to harm so easily."
"What we need to do now is to seize the third divine mark and wait quietly for his return!"
His gaze slightly condensed, looking at the faintly visible light column of the Secret Realm in the distance, he spoke solemnly:
"Now the restriction of the third Divine Secret Realm has opened, yet it remains inaccessible, and we don’t know why."
"What we can do now is to prepare as much as possible!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 306 - 307: Lord Liuli, Please Control Yourself!
chapters.content:
Chapter 306: Chapter 307: Lord Liuli, Please Control Yourself!
The other side.
Lilith and the Snow Woman looked at Sally, who was still unconscious, feeling incredibly troubled.
"Xiaoxue, are you sure there’s nothing wrong with this little cat girl’s body? Why hasn’t she woken up yet?"
Previously, she had felt that Sally’s body was extremely fragile, so she only used a tiny bit of force to knock Sally out.
But, unexpectedly, a month’s time had passed, and this little cat girl still hadn’t woken up.
At this moment, even the Snow Woman was stumped by Lilith’s question.
As a top-tier healing-type Guardian Beast.
The Snow Woman could feel that all of Sally’s skills were functioning normally.
And during this period, she had been continuously channeling her own powers into Sally.
Yet, despite this, Sally showed no signs of waking up.
Now, even the Snow Woman was unsure if the cat girl’s body had issues!
However, the Snow Woman was certain that Sally was definitely still alive.
As for why she hadn’t woken up, she didn’t know the reason either.
Perhaps...
It was because this cat girl’s body was too weak.
So, being too far from Gu Xing, unable to be replenished by Gu Xing’s Spiritual Power, caused Sally’s inability to awaken.
"It seems we can only wait for Gu Xing to return, but when that will be...." The Snow Woman shook her head.
The time required to cross from one world to another, no one knew how long it would take.
However.....
The Blood Covenant signed by Lilith and Gu Xing is not affected by the two worlds.
Now Lilith is living well, at least it indicates that Gu Xing’s life is safe.
This can be considered the only piece of good news!
....
Meanwhile, inside a remote village in the Angel Realm, within a farmhouse.
Gu Xing slowly opened his eyes, feeling unbearable pain all over his body, as if every inch of bone was crushed and reassembled.
He forced a bit of strength to look blankly upwards—
What met his eyes was a strange wooden roof.
"Where...is this?"
This was the only question that floated in his mind.
But before he could figure it out, a crisp voice suddenly came from outside the door:
"Grandpa! That strange creature has woken up!"
Gu Xing turned his head with difficulty, only to see a figure with pure white wings quickly running out of the room, the wings brushing the door frame, scattering fine dust of light.
Strange creature... were they referring to him?
Soon, an elderly angel walked slowly into the room, stopping beside the bed.
He stared at Gu Xing, with obvious vigilance and scrutiny in his eyes.
"What...exactly are you? Why did you appear in our village?"
It was then that Gu Xing suddenly realized something was wrong—
Two angels!
This place was neither the Alternate Space he was familiar with nor Blue Star...
He was actually in a completely unfamiliar world.
After all, in the Alternate Space, the Angel Race only had War Angels and Blazing Angels, two kinds.
Yet standing in front of him now seemed more like a type of angel in between the two.
Gu Xing suppressed the shock in his heart, met the other’s scrutinizing gaze, and softly asked back:
"Who...are you?"
Before the words fell, the young angel girl immediately became dissatisfied, jumping in front of her grandpa and speaking angrily:
"If it weren’t for Grandpa and me saving you, you would have died a long time ago!"
"And you’re still talking like that!"
"Quickly tell us your identity, or we’ll report you to the patrol team!"
Facing the feisty young girl, Gu Xing was silent for a moment, his gaze slowly sweeping over the simple yet tidy farmhouse.
After confirming it was these two angels who saved him, he finally spoke in a low voice:
"My name is Gu Xing, as for the Race..."
"I should be human."
Armed with no knowledge of this world, he dared not reveal too much information.
However, when he mentioned "human," both the old and young angels simultaneously widened their eyes, looking at him in disbelief, as if they had heard something incredible.
"Human...human?!"
They had originally thought Gu Xing had lost his wings due to injury, but upon careful inspection, they found no scars on his back, which led them to question.
Now hearing this answer, both were a bit dumbfounded.
This was a pure angel world, apart from the Angel Race, there were only the demonic Demon Race, whom all angels deeply despised!
Previously, they hadn’t sensed any Demonic Qi from Gu Xing, indicating he wasn’t from the Demon Race.
Yet he was also without wings, obviously not an angel either...
Both unconsciously took a step back, their voices tinged with evident wariness:
"Human...Human Race, what kind of entity is that?!"
Hearing this, Gu Xing’s mouth couldn’t help but twitch slightly.
Then, he spent nearly half a day making a strenuous effort to explain to these two angels what a "human" actually was.
At the same time, he gradually recalled what he had gone through.
Earlier, when the Insect Emperor of the Void attacked him, at the last moment, he successfully utilized the Void Laws and forcibly left using the Ghost Race Jade Talisman.
However, at the moment he left, the Insect Emperor struck at him.
This caused the Jade Talisman, originally only meant for world transmission, to malfunction.
Coupled with the Insect Emperor’s attack, which directly disturbed the surrounding void, creating intense void turbulence.
Amidst the void turbulence’s encasement, the transmission of the Jade Talisman became uncontrollable.
Eventually, they were teleported to a land of nothingness.
Where all around was violent void turbulence.
And Liu Li, in order to protect him....
Wait!
Liu Li!
Gu Xing’s eyes widened abruptly, realizing he hadn’t sensed Liu Li’s presence.
He hurriedly concentrated a bit of Spiritual Power to probe the Beast Taming Space, only to find it empty.
Liu Li wasn’t inside!
Gu Xing’s heart suddenly tightened, rushing to question the two angels:
"Have you seen an angel girl about my size? She should’ve been with me at that time!"
"An angel girl about your size?"
The old and young pair exchanged glances—such angels were common in the village.
Gu Xing immediately realized his description was unclear, quickly adding:
"She was injured along with me! She probably...has ten wings!"
Both shook their heads firmly.
"When we found you, you were the only one lying there,"
The old angel’s tone was certain, "We didn’t see the ten-winged angel you mentioned."
The young angel girl also quietly added:
"In a remote place like ours, it’s impossible for such a noble presence as the ten-winged Lord to appear..."
Upon hearing this answer, Gu Xing was initially stunned, then slightly sighed in relief.
At least...
Liu Li being in this angel realm should mean she’s much safer than he is.
The reality was indeed as he had anticipated.
At this moment, deep within the most prosperous capital city and the most majestic palace of the Angel Realm—
Liu Li was furiously attempting to throw down the gorgeous yet heavy crown she was wearing.
Yet an elder with profound presence suddenly appeared, gently raised his hand to stop her movement.
"Lord Liuli, please don’t be willful."
He spoke in a gentle yet resolute tone, "Since you have been chosen as one of the successors, you must fulfill your duties."
But Liu Li had no interest in any "duties."
"I want to find my master—step aside!"
She tried to push the elder away, yet he remained motionless.
This elder was a Totem Tier Nine powerhouse, and the gap between their strengths was as wide as heaven and earth.
"Lord Liu Li, I implore you...not to trouble your subordinates."
He bowed slightly, his posture respectful yet unwavering:
"Please restrain yourself!"
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 307 - 308: Angel Lanny!
chapters.content:
Chapter 307: Chapter 308: Angel Lanny!
In the next few days, Gu Xing’s body completely recovered.
During these days, he explored the entire village.
Only then could he be certain that earlier, it was definitely because of the chaotic Void turbulence that the two of them were swept to different places.
However....
Through this time, Gu Xing also realized.
In this world, it seems....
The most powerful talent is only the ten wings.
Moreover, the whole Angel Race is exceptionally united.
Therefore, as long as Liu Li with ten wings has not entered the territory of the Demon Race, the issue isn’t very significant.
Now the difficulty is...
how he can gather information about Liu Li in this world.
As a human, trying to walk in a world filled with angels, a misstep could lead to being mistaken for a Demon Race spy.
"Sigh~"
Thinking of this, Gu Xing couldn’t help but sigh.
Then, after taking a couple of deep breaths to calm down, Gu Xing tightened his black robe before heading toward the previous small house.
Over this period, he also learned the identity of the two angels who saved him.
The old angel is the village chief of this remote village, and the young one is the village chief’s granddaughter, named Lanny.
The village is not large, he quickly returned to Lanny’s home.
Because Lanny couldn’t stay idle by nature, and Gu Xing had nothing to do these days, he often recounted various experiences in the Otherworld to her.
This also led to...
Recently, Gu Xing’s image in Lanny’s heart has rapidly elevated.
As soon as Gu Xing pushed the door open, Lanny immediately put on a face of pretend seriousness and warned:
"Why did you run out again? I told you before, your identity is too special, if other angels discover and report to the patrol team, you’ll be in big trouble!"
With gratitude in his heart toward his saviors, Gu Xing smiled and explained lightly:
"Just went for a walk to get some fresh air."
Then, he switched the topic to the main issue: "Lanny, the information I asked you to find about Liu Li... any progress?"
Upon hearing this, Lanny couldn’t help but roll her eyes.
She didn’t believe Gu Xing’s claim that he "contracted a ten-winged angel" at all.
But seeing his sincere attitude, she still helped to gather some information.
"The ten-winged angel you mentioned can’t possibly appear in such remote areas."
She sighed, her tone softened, "Even if... even if the ’Guardian Beast’ you mentioned is truly a ten-winged lord, she is most likely in the Holy City."
"And from here to the Holy City, it’s as far as 108,000 miles—you’re a human..."
She shook her head, "Better stop imagining."
Holy City!
Upon hearing Lanny’s words, Gu Xing slightly frowned.
The distance wasn’t very important.
Although he currently doesn’t have a Guardian Beast by his side.
However, his Attributes, coupled with the Domain of Emperor’s Might, could unleash his power at the Monarch Level.
While this isn’t enough for him to roam freely in this world, it’s not a problem for traveling.
"Which direction is the Holy City?"
Without hesitation, Gu Xing decisively asked.
Lanny was surprised by his words, gazing at him incredulously:
"You... you truly want to go to the Holy City? Are you insane!"
She shook her head repeatedly, continuously saying things like "you’ll never make it."
However, under Gu Xing’s eyes as firm as a mountain, she ultimately conceded.
"It’s in the east..." she said softly, her tone still worried, "Keep heading east, and you should reach the Holy City."
"But along the way... there will be many Demon Race appearances."
"Thank you."
Gu Xing solemnly thanked her, then stood up to prepare to leave.
He couldn’t afford to delay too long.
Currently, Liu Li’s situation is entirely unknown.
Though no life-threatening danger, Liu Li must be extremely worried about him.
Moreover, his other Guardian Beasts are still in the Alternate Space.
If he is delayed too long in this world....
Who knows what kind of chaos the other Guardian Beasts might cause.
But before leaving...
Gu Xing pulled out two pieces of material from his Beast Taming Space and handed them to Lanny.
"You absolutely must accept this! And be sure to use them as I wrote!"
After saying this, without waiting for Lanny to respond, he turned and walked out the door.
What he left behind wasn’t anything else...
But materials fit for both Lanny and her grandfather’s upgrade.
After all, they saved his life.
He couldn’t immediately think of another way to repay them.
Coincidentally, he had collected quite a bit of materials in his Beast Taming Space earlier.
It just happened to include materials that would allow two Two-winged Angels to break through.
Thus, he left them behind.
Not long after Gu Xing left, Lanny’s grandfather walked in from outside.
Seeing his somewhat absent-minded granddaughter, the old man sighed.
"Lanny, we are not from the same world as him!"
Though it was only a few days, Gu Xing’s demeanor still attracted this inexperienced young girl.
Lanny herself hadn’t noticed, but as the only relative who grew up with her side by side from a young age.
He naturally understood his granddaughter’s thoughts.
At this moment, Lanny looked somewhat dazed into her grandfather.
"Grandpa, do you think what Gu Xing said about contracting a ten-winged angel is true?"
The old angel shook his head, truthfully, he couldn’t be certain either.
His gaze fell on the materials Gu Xing left behind, tentatively picking up a nearby note to examine.
After reading a few lines, his pupils contracted and, without hesitation, he tore the note to pieces, then quickly shut the doors and windows tightly.
Because the note clearly described how they might have a chance to ascend from two-winged angels to four-winged angels!
In this world, every additional two wings mean a monumental shift in status—
Two-winged angels occupy the bottom, while four-winged angels can join the middle-tier.
Now, the key capable of changing fate is laid before them.
At this moment, he suddenly found himself believing Gu Xing’s claims.
Perhaps... he really did contract a ten-winged angel.
Thinking of this, he turned sharply to Lanny, with eyes full of conviction.
The child’s parents had long perished in this border village.
This place could be invaded by the Demon Race at any time; he was old and unafraid to die, but Lanny was still young...
"Lanny, take these two pieces of material and go pursue Gu Xing—accompany him to the Holy City!"
Almost immediately, the old man made a resolute decision.
Though Lanny was still bewildered, seeing her grandpa’s unprecedentedly serious demeanor, she refrained from asking more questions, instinctively turning to chase in the direction where Gu Xing left.
Watching his granddaughter’s receding figure, the old man breathed a deep sigh of relief.
He knew what he did might upset Gu Xing.
But he had no choice.
The peace in the Angel Realm is merely an illusion; most of the territories have long been taken over by the Demon Race.
And their village at the border could be consumed by the Demon Tide, vanishing completely as soon as tomorrow.
Therefore, to ensure Lanny’s survival, he had no other option.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 308 - 309: Angel Legacy
chapters.content:
Chapter 308: Chapter 309: Angel Legacy
Not long after leaving the village, Gu Xing noticed a familiar figure swiftly chasing after him.
As the person drew closer, he realized—
It was Lanny!
She ran to him, panting heavily, her cheeks flushed from running, momentarily unable to speak clearly.
Gu Xing looked at her with slight confusion.
Lanny took a few deep breaths, finally steadying her breathing, and said earnestly:
"Grandfather... Grandfather told me to follow you, to go to the Holy City together!"
Gu Xing immediately understood the old village chief’s intention.
He did not show any aversion; instead, he nodded slightly:
"Alright, let’s go together then."
It was just right, as a Beast Master, his strength actually lay in controlling Guardian Beasts.
Whether it’s the Sovereign Talent or Soul Devouring Talent, both need to rely on Guardian Beasts to exert a good effect.
After all....
Just a single linked talent can provide contracted Guardian Beasts with hundreds of thousands of attributes.
Now that Lanny was actively following, he naturally had an idea.
"Lanny, are you willing to make a contract with me?"
"Eh...?!"
Lanny was momentarily stunned, but soon understood and nodded solemnly:
"I am, I am willing!"
Upon hearing these words, Gu Xing’s fingertips twirled with a blue glow, immediately performing a temporary contract.
Although this contract could only last for seven days and would expire unable to be renewed,
for Gu Xing, seven days—
was enough.
The azure contract light gently enveloped the two, connecting them with the Power of Laws.
At this moment, Gu Xing finally had his first Guardian Beast in this unfamiliar world!
...
At the same time.
Liu Li had been elegantly dressed, her surroundings enshrouded in sacred and luxurious adornments.
The previous Totem Tier Nine angel elder stood silently by her side, whispering a reminder:
"Lord Liu Li, shortly, we will be holding the Angel Race’s most grand meeting."
"This meeting will ultimately decide who is the true heir of the Angel God."
"And this meeting requires three heirs to open, and you are the third heir we’ve been waiting for!"
Yet, at this moment, Liu Li hadn’t taken any of these words to heart.
All her thoughts were focused on how to escape this place and find Gu Xing.
But because of the profound power of the angel beside her, she had to temporarily cooperate.
Soon, guided by this angel, she walked into a grand hall of utmost splendor.
The hall was already filled with angels; those who could enter here at least possessed Monarch Level power.
The entire hall was solemn and quiet, and everyone’s gaze was fixed on the two who had just entered.
In whispers, conversation spread among the seats:
"Is this the long unseen third heir?"
"It must be; she has ten wings!"
"Only three angels in our Angel Race have ten wings, and only they can inherit the Angel God’s legacy to lead us in defeating the Demon Race and returning to glory!"
"Despite this! But isn’t this third person’s power slightly lacking? Is she truly a competitor with the other two?"
These whispered comments vaguely reached Liu Li’s ears, making her slightly stagger.
The elder Totem Tier Nine angel beside her seemed to notice her unease, softly explaining:
"Lord Liu Li, don’t worry."
"This is merely a trial; it will not endanger your safety."
"Simply give it your best to aim for first and win the inheritance of the Angel God."
Liu Li turned to look at him directly, asking:
"What benefits does inheriting... bring?"
The elder angel was stumped by her sudden question, momentarily unsure of how to respond.
After hesitating a moment, he slowly spoke:
"Lord Liu Li, as long as you take first in the trial, you will be acknowledged as the heir of the whole Angel Race."
"Then, you will have the right to mobilize the power of the entire race..."
"And you could reach an unprecedented Twelve-wing Realm."
He paused, quietly adding:
"Moreover, the one you keep yearning to find... Gu Xing will become much easier."
Liu Li had no interest in the so-called "Twelve Wings," but the last words caught her attention instantly.
"Becoming the heir... will help find my master?!"
The elder angel’s mouth twitched involuntarily.
The term "master" he had corrected many times, but Liu Li had never changed it.
Due to her identity, he couldn’t demand it and had to let her be.
"Yes, Lord Liu Li."
"Good! Then I’ll join!"
Without a trace of hesitation, Liu Li agreed decisively.
This angel’s face darkened further.
Soon, he led Liu Li onto the high platform.
At this moment, there were two other ten-winged angels already present, one male and one female, both with unmistakable pride between their brows.
The male ten-winged angel glanced arrogantly, his gaze sweeping over Liu Li, disdainfully:
"Milo, where did you pick up this little angel?"
"The Angel God’s legacy isn’t something anyone can inherit."
"The one you brought here... seems to have just entered Monarch Level?"
The elder angel known as Milo—Liu Li’s Guardian, turned icy at his words.
"Lord Jia Bailuo, as Liu Li’s Guardian, your words can be seen as an open challenge to Liu Li."
"For challengers, I have the authority to retaliate on behalf of Liu Li."
The next moment, a vast aura emanated from Milo.
Jia Bailuo’s Guardian immediately stepped forward, unleashing Totem Tier Nine pressure, shouting:
"Milo! Dare you to attack the heir lord?"
"I don’t dare," Milo’s voice was icy cold, "I merely see someone openly challenging Liu Li."
"You——!"
Jia Bailuo’s Guardian was momentarily speechless, ultimately having no ground to argue.
At that moment, a grand and calm voice came from above:
"Enough, the meeting is about to begin."
"Are all the heirs ready?"
The Angel Race has five Totem Tier Nine strongholds.
Apart from the Guardians of the three heirs, one always keeps watch at the forefront of the battle against the Demon Race,
and the other is the "Judicator" before them.
Confronted by this Judicator, the previously arrogant two ten-winged angels instantly restrained their postures, respectfully responding:
"Already prepared."
The Judicator slightly nodded and turned his gaze to Liu Li.
With a soft reminder from Milo, Liu Li returned his gaze, softly answering:
"Prepared."
Seeing all three heirs had responded, the Judicator solemnly announced, his voice vast and dignified, echoing throughout the hall:
"Since all three heir lords are present, from this moment—
the assembly officially begins!"
Meanwhile.
During this period, Gu Xing and Lanny had reached the outskirts of the Holy City.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 309 - 310: Angel Destiny
chapters.content:
Chapter 309: Chapter 310: Angel Destiny
At the same time, at the border of the Angel Race.
This was the frontline of the conflict between Angels and the Demon Race, where scorched earth covers the wasteland, and the air is still filled with Demonic Qi and angelic presence.
The Eight-winged Angel, Liu Ye, hovered at the front line, his silver armor stained with blood, eyes as cold as ice, watching as the Demon Race retreated like a tide into the murky mist.
This was not the first time he had repelled the Demon Race’s attack!
"Master Liu Ye," an angel adjutant respectfully stepped forward, whispering:
"The grandest inheritance meeting within the clan is about to convene."
"The Demon Race’s retreat this time will take at least a few days to gather strength again... Would you like to return to the Holy City to attend the meeting?"
He looked at Liu Ye with eyes full of admiration, as if gazing at a deity descending from the abyss.
There was a time when the Angel Race was on the brink of collapse under the fierce attack of the Demon Race, when Liu Ye suddenly appeared like a meteor—
Starting from Totem Tier One, he broke through at an astonishing speed, rising to Totem Ninth Rank, becoming one of the top five peak existences in the Angel Race today.
And with his unmatched combat power and exceptional military talent, he forcibly stabilized the crumbling front line.
At this moment, Liu Ye only shook his head slightly, his gaze still fixed on the distant surging demon mist.
Although this was an unprecedented event for the Angel Race and crucial to the future direction of the Angel Race.
However, he did not intend to participate.
For he was not originally from this world.
Therefore, he had no interest in such matters.
"Forget it, I’m not good at these things, better to stay in the camp with you all."
In fact, the Angel Race’s inheritance meeting is essentially a political struggle.
Except for him and the Arbiter, the other three Totem Ninth Rank Angels each chose an heir to follow.
Whoever’s chosen heir wins the first place in the competition, the guardian of that heir will surely rise in status.
But to Liu Ye, who becomes the master of the Angel Race is not important.
What he desires is to hone his strength on the battlefield, to make his power the strongest.
Then leave this world and return to his homeland.
And regardless of which of the three heirs wins, it would not affect him, who only wants to fight against the Demon Race.
He would continue to serve as the Grand Marshal of the Angel Race.
On the side, the adjutant, knowing his master’s thoughts, nodded.
Master Liu Ye has always remained aloof from worldly affairs.
Perhaps his only interest is battle with the Demon Race, to enhance his power.
"I understand, Master Liu Ye!"
He responded softly, yet added:
"However, the Arbiter has asked me to convey this to you:"
"You have diligently held the frontline for a long time, and for this meeting, you can return to the Holy City to relax without participating."
"After all, even if you are a Totem Ninth Rank existence, you can’t always keep your Spirit stretched tight."
"Master Liu Ye... actually, this is also my thought."
"Wouldn’t you like to take this opportunity to have a vacation?!"
Hearing this, Liu Ye was slightly taken aback, realizing at last...
He seemed not to have left this place for several years.
Looking into the concerned eyes of the adjutant, he remained silent for a moment, then nodded slowly.
"Alright, I have indeed not returned to the Holy City for many years, it’s a good chance to visit."
His tone softened, yet he still reminded:
"But during my absence, you must not lower your guard."
"The Demon Race might counterattack at any time, and in the event of any maneuver, you must report to me immediately."
"Understood, Master Liu Ye!"
....
On the other side.
Hiding his human Identity beneath a black robe, Gu Xing, under Lanny’s lead, successfully entered the Holy City.
Upon entering, he immediately sensed an unusually fervent atmosphere enveloping the city.
He leaned in quietly and asked softly:
"Lanny, has anything significant occurred in the Holy City recently?"
Seeing this, Lanny hurried to gather information for Gu Xing.
Soon, Lanny returned with a hint of astonishment.
"Gu... Master Gu Xing, the third Ten-winged Angel has appeared!"
"And all the heirs have gathered because the Angel Race is about to hold the heir selection大会!"
Saying this, her eyes gazed at Gu Xing with a touch of reverence.
Just because....
The Angel Race had always had only two Ten-winged Angels.
There had never been a third Ten-winged Angel heir.
Therefore, the大会 had never been held.
But just as she probed for news, she discovered....
The third Ten-winged Angel heir’s appearance time...
Was almost the same as Gu Xing’s appearance time!
This also meant...
The claim that Gu Xing often made, that he had contracted a Ten-winged Angel as his Guardian Beast...
Was true!
With this thought, Lanny’s heart shook, and her gaze toward Gu Xing became even more respectful.
Hearing this news, Gu Xing almost immediately deduced—
The suddenly appearing third Ten-winged Angel has more than a ninety percent chance of being Liu Li!
And from Lanny’s explanation, he only then truly realized what the words "Angel Race heir" ultimately implied—
It was practically the paramount authority over the Angel Realm, whoever wins will become the true ruler of the Angel Race, controlling the destiny of the entire race.
However...
Liu Li’s ten wings were his own cultivation.
Such a "man-made" Ten-winged Angel, could even participate in the supreme heir selection of the Angel Race?
Wait—
Gu Xing suddenly recalled something.
Among Liu Li’s cultivation conditions, there were clearly three requirements listed:
[Divine Pattern], [Totem-level Demon Core], [Angel Race fortune].
The Divine Pattern, Liu Li already possessed;
The Totem-level Demon Core, over recent days the powerful demons he had slain were numerous, it had long since been gathered;
Only the "Angel Race fortune" had yet to be achieved.
He had thought, settling the dispute between War Angels and Blazing Angels would gather this fortune.
However, after that event was resolved, the system had no response, leaving him to temporarily set Liu Li’s cultivation aside.
Until this moment, hearing Lanny express the heir’s significance, he suddenly realized:
The so-called "Angel Race fortune" might refer to... the entire Angel Realm’s earthly fate?
And the fastest way to obtain this fortune is likely to help Liu Li ascend to the throne of the Angel Race!
At this point, a sharp light suddenly lit up in Gu Xing’s eyes:
"Lanny, is there a way for me to get in touch with Liu Li?"
Getting in touch with Liu Li was now of the utmost importance.
Without meeting Liu Li, everything was just empty talk.
After pondering for a moment, Lanny spoke slowly.
"Master Gu Xing, all heirs need to enter a specific Trial Space."
"But before entering the Trial Space, there is one process."
"Hm?"
Upon hearing this sentence, Gu Xing was somewhat puzzled.
"Master Gu Xing, before entering the Trial Space, there’s a competition across the entire Angel Race."
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - 311: Farewell, Liu Li!
chapters.content:
Chapter 310: Chapter 311: Farewell, Liu Li!
"And the first place in this competition..."
Lanny continued, "Will have the right to challenge the three inheritors—"
"This seems to be the only way to contact them."
Competition?!
Upon hearing this, Gu Xing was taken aback, his gaze involuntarily falling on Lanny beside him.
At present, the only temporary Guardian Beast he had was her.
Even though he could forcibly enhance Lanny’s strength using the dual talents of "Sovereign" and "Soul Devouring", yet...
Her talent was a hurdle that was hard to overcome.
[Angel (Lanny)]
[Status: Four-winged Angel]
[Level: Commander Tier One]
[Talent: Epic Nine Stars]
[Power: 7000]
[Constitution: 6000]
[Spirit: 5000]
[Speed: 6000]
[Skills: Holy Sword, Guardian, Angel Domain]
Looking at Lanny’s attributes, the corner of Gu Xing’s mouth twitched incessantly.
Lanny’s previous attributes were even lower.
It was after his enhancement that Lanny reached Epic Nine Stars in talent.
Additionally, her level had thus broken through to Commander Tier One.
However...
Yet even so, Lanny’s current attributes were still only a few thousand points.
Even if he were to use the dual talents of "Sovereign" and "Soul Devouring" to forcefully elevate her strength again,
with her current control, it would be difficult to harness such a sudden surge of power.
Moreover, Lanny’s skills...
Compared to the Guardian Beasts like Liu Li and Vera, it was even harder to describe.
Therefore, even if Lanny’s attributes were enhanced to Half-step Totem Level, yet...
The actual combat power she could exert might still be hard to estimate...
Perhaps it would be quite difficult to even maintain stability at Monarch Level.
And according to Lanny, the participants in this Angel Race competition were at least Monarch Level.
If that’s the case...
Winning the first place in this competition seems to be somewhat troublesome!
Noticing that Gu Xing’s gaze was always on her, Lanny felt a bit uncomfortable, turned around, and asked softly:
"Gu... Gu Xing master, why are you staring at me all the time?"
"Lanny," Gu Xing’s expression was serious, "we have to participate in this competition, but I am thinking about how to achieve first place."
"You could enter the competition yourself!" Lanny hurriedly said, "With your strength, there’s definitely no problem!"
Throughout the journey, she had already witnessed Gu Xing in action—even a Monarch Level demon couldn’t withstand more than a few moves under him.
However, Gu Xing shook his head slowly.
"I can’t enter the competition."
"Firstly, I am a Beast Master, and my strongest state can only be achieved by relying on a Guardian Beast;"
"Secondly, angels surround this place. If I act personally, it will easily expose my human identity."
"So..."
His gaze once again fell upon Lanny.
Lanny’s body became stiff instantly, and her voice trembled slightly:
"Gu, Gu Xing master... you don’t mean to..."
"Lanny, my current only Guardian Beast is you."
Gu Xing’s voice was calm but unyielding, "Only you can enter this competition."
"No! No way!"
Lanny frantically waved her hands, almost jumping up, "Gu Xing master, it really won’t work! I’m only Commander Level, not even qualified to compete..."
However—
Gu Xing did not give her the chance to refuse.
The competition was starting in two days, and they had to race against time to enhance Lanny’s combat power—
Both level and talent needed to break through quickly to have a chance at securing first place in this competition full of strong contenders.
He said nothing more, pulling Lanny along as he hurried out of the Holy City.
Along the way, he found a shop in the city and sold several treasured items from the Beast Taming Space, exchanging them for a large amount of Local Currency.
Under the lure of money, the shop owner smiled broadly and repeatedly promised to gather the required materials for him.
Meanwhile, Gu Xing had already taken Lanny to a place outside the Holy City, where Demonic Qi pervaded.
