Although the surroundings of the Holy City were part of the Angel Race’s core domain, this world had long been infiltrated by Demonic Qi, leading to random formation of various Demonic Qi gathering points.
Where Demonic Qi gathered, demons were born—
And where there were demons, Lanny could gain power!
...
The two days passed in the blink of an eye, and the day of the Angel Race competition finally arrived.
The entire Holy City was shrouded in a majestic and fervent atmosphere, countless angels congregated in the city center,
looking up at the majestic Twelve-winged Angel statue—
That was the Angel God, the only one in history to reach the twelve-winged realm.
Under the statue, all the angels bowed slightly, offering their sincere respect.
In the crowd, Gu Xing and Lanny, dressed in black cloaks, also imitated the gesture, quietly blending in among the people.
Lanny was somewhat dazed.
In these two days, her understanding had been completely overturned—
She never imagined that strength could increase so rapidly.
At this moment, six pure wings unfurled behind her, emitting a faint glow.
The surrounding angels looked at her with undisguised respect in their eyes.
In this world, the number of wings represented status and power; a Six-winged Angel was already considered an elite of the tribe.
While Lanny was lost in thought, the booming voice of the adjudicator reverberated over the Holy City:
"Today marks the most important moment for our Angel Race—"
"We have finally welcomed the third inheritor!"
"According to the divine decree of the Angel God, the inheritor trial will commence at this moment."
"But before that, the three inheritors must endure the challenge from the strongest of the race."
"Therefore, from this moment, the Angel Race’s pinnacle competition—officially begins!"
"The one who wins first place will earn the qualification to challenge the three inheritors."
"If the challenge is successful, you shall become..."
"The new inheritor."
These five words dropped like a spark onto a wasteland, instantly igniting the whole place!
In this race where wings are born, and destiny is predetermined, this competition is the only opportunity for countless angels to defy fate.
As long as they defeat an inheritor, their fate will be completely rewritten!
At this moment, all the ambitious angels had flames of intensity ignited in their eyes.
"If we can win first place in this competition, then we have a chance to defy fate."
"Although we are not opponents for the other two inheritors, this newly emerged Liu Li...."
"At just Monarch Tier One, even if she has ten wings, we can definitely defeat her easily!"
"That’s right, this time our target is this newly emerged Ten-winged Angel!"
Voices like this kept emerging from the crowd.
But Gu Xing frowned slightly.
Liu Li’s level was at Monarch Tier One, although she could exert Half-step Totem Level strength without the Soul Devouring Talent’s support.
But...
Amidst these angels.
There were indeed Half-step Totem Level existences.
Even...
Gu Xing also noticed a few Totem Level beings eager to act.
If those Totem Level angels decided to act....
That would be troublesome!
Just as Gu Xing was contemplating....
A very familiar figure suddenly appeared in the sky.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - 312: Lanny, Choose a Stage!
chapters.content:
Chapter 311: Chapter 312: Lanny, Choose a Stage!
Seeing this familiar figure, Gu Xing immediately attempted to use the spiritual link to contact Liu Li.
However...
His spiritual power, upon approaching Liu Li, was blocked by an invisible wall.
Unable to get close!
Realizing this, Gu Xing’s gaze narrowed, focusing on the incredibly deep-spirited old angel beside Liu Li.
Is this Liu Li’s guardian?!
The existence of Totem Tier Nine!
It seems it is because of this angel’s presence that his spiritual power is blocked when approaching Liu Li.
And aside from spiritual power....
The scene was full of bustling voices.
He wanted to rely on sound for Liu Li to notice his presence, which was almost impossible.
If so, it seems there is only one way left to see Liu Li——
Lanny must partake in this competition and seize the first place!
At the same time.
At the same time, on the high platform, Milo was softly advising Liu Li:
"Before officially entering the trial space, a full-tribe competition will be held."
"The winner has the right to challenge you three inheritors."
His tone was slightly heavy, "And you... are the weakest among the three, the winner has a ninety percent chance of choosing to challenge you."
"Therefore, you’d better prepare in advance!"
Liu Li gently nodded.
Since she was determined to become the sole inheritor of the Angel Race, she naturally wouldn’t fear the challenges along the way.
Even though she lost the blessing of Gu Xing, relying solely on her strength, she was still among the top of the totem group.
"I will be careful!"
Seeing Liu Li get ready, Milo said no more and cast his gaze back on the grand competition this time.
The Angel Race has quite a number of tribespeople, perhaps even many.
But those qualified to participate in this grand competition....
Are not many!
First, the first requirement to participate in the competition is to have more than four wings.
This alone eliminates at least 90% of the Angel Race.
The second requirement is to reach the Monarch Level in strength.
And even fewer meet this condition.
Ultimately, excluding those who don’t meet the requirements, gave up on joining the grand competition, or are not in the Holy City,
The participants left in this grand competition are only...
A few hundred people!
Among them, Lanny is one.
After registering with a Six-winged Angel, Lanny obtained the qualification to bring a relative into the arena, and thus, Gu Xing was able to accompany her into the grand competition venue.
The internal competition had already begun.
Eight arenas stood towering, the rules simple yet brutal——
On these eight arenas, anyone can go to defend.
And anyone can challenge and attack those defending.
Until the very end, the eight angels standing on the eight arenas will have successfully advanced.
The eight angels eventually standing on the arena will obtain the qualification for advancement and compete in subsequent rounds until only one triumphs.
Understanding the rules, Gu Xing nodded slightly.
As long as one can stand on the arena later, they can advance.
Logically, the later you challenge, the higher the chances of winning.
After all, each fight consumes a certain amount of stamina, the later the challenge, the higher the hope of victory.
However...
Gu Xing did not intend to do so.
Even with only two days, however...
Under the extreme stimulation of "Sovereign" and "Soul-devouring" twin talents, he forcibly elevated Lanny’s level to Monarch Tier Nine.
This is possible due to a temporary contract, where the Guardian Beast is not affected by his own level suppression.
He could therefore hunt demons without restraint to help Lanny level up.
Moreover, aside from elevating to Monarch Tier Nine, Lanny’s talent was also enhanced to Legendary Nine Stars.
Now Lanny can be said to be among the top tier of challengers here.
"Lanny, choose an arena!" Gu Xing said calmly.
"Ah?"
Lanny was stunned for a moment upon hearing this, then immediately understood Gu Xing’s meaning.
"Okay, Lord Gu Xing!"
This period of experience had led Lanny to hold the utmost respect for Gu Xing.
She would not hesitate at any of Gu Xing’s commands.
At this moment, the defenders on the eight arenas were relatively weak, almost all hovering in the low tier Monarch level, with the real experts still observing.
Lanny unhesitatingly chose the number eight arena and leaped up.
The Monarch Tier Three angel on the platform stood no chance in front of her and was instantly knocked off the platform.
Lanny thus became the defender of the number eight platform.
The angels below saw this scene and began whispering among themselves:
"Isn’t this just the beginning? Why is there such a powerful Guardian Beast on the platform already?"
"Isn’t this just picking on us low tier angels? We didn’t even intend to claim first, we just wanted to use this opportunity to show ourselves."
"This Monarch Tier Nine angel really doesn’t adhere to martial virtue! Let’s all go up together and give this angel a lesson."
"If we all go for it, even if this angel is Monarch Tier Nine, we can wear her down."
Just...
This is exactly the effect Gu Xing intended to achieve.
Now, he could see Liu Li, but Liu Li couldn’t sense him.
Therefore, he could only stir up something to draw everyone’s attention.
And provoking by letting Lanny take the stage is the simplest way to gain focus.
Meanwhile, on the high platform——
Jia Bailuo’s gaze swept over Liu Li’s figure coldly with a trace of concealed resentment in his eyes.
Milo, the strongest among the three guardians, was initially the person he strongly wanted to win over as an ally.
He once personally invited Milo to be his guardian, only to be flatly rejected with "lacking proper intent, unable to bear divine position" as the reason.
And last time, Milo even ignored his status and publicly struck to intimidate him...
All this had long buried a deep hatred in Jia Bailuo’s heart.
Since this is the case...
He darkened his gaze, a hint of insidiousness flashed in his eyes.
Milo, since you insist on protecting her, don’t blame me for preventing her from even participating in the final trial!
He slightly tilted his head, giving an icy glance to a Totem Level angel standing nearby.
The other nodded silently, then quietly retreated, his figure like mist vanishing into the bustling crowd.
Jia Bailuo’s lips curled into a cold smile.
As long as the person he arranged wins the top of this grand competition, he can, according to the rules, challenge Liu Li.
By then, under the guise of a "fair competition," he could completely crush this suddenly emerged third inheritor and remove her from the line of succession!
Not far away, another female inheritor——
Leia!
She had already seen all of Jia Bailuo’s actions.
Yet, she did not speak out, nor did she intervene, quietly lowering her eyes, as if everything was unrelated to her.
If Liu Li were eliminated, it would not only be harmless to her but also mean one less competitor.
She was happy to coldly watch all this unfold!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 312 - 313: The Third Divine Secret Realm Opens!
chapters.content:
Chapter 312: Chapter 313: The Third Divine Secret Realm Opens!
At the same time as the Angel Realm tournament was underway—
Deep within the Alternate Space, the entrance to the third Divine Secret Realm quietly exudes an ancient and majestic aura.
The Secret Realm has not yet fully opened, but the divine fluctuations it releases have swept across the entire world.
At this moment, all races realize:
The final Divine Pattern of the Human Race is about to surface!
This Divine Pattern, hailed as the strongest in potential and the most terrifying in amplification, not only draws the Human Race and Demon Race into a frenzied covet, but even the intelligent Fierce Beasts covet it fiercely.
However, amidst such intense scrutiny, the three forces have fallen into a strange stalemate.
No side dares to make the first move, fearing that once a battle breaks out between two sides, the third will reap the benefits.
At this moment, the atmosphere inside the command post of Longxia Country is heavy.
Long Zhenguo frowned, his eyes heavy as he looked at the image of the Secret Realm suspended over the sand table, and sighed in a low voice:
"Yueli girl, I never anticipated that the Human Race Divine Pattern would stir such a huge commotion..."
"Now, not only the Demon Race, but even those Fierce Beasts have targeted this Divine Pattern!"
Tushan Yueli’s face was equally grave.
Initially, they were only facing the Demon Race, which they could handle.
But now....
The addition of a Fierce Beast race has made the situation instantly become perplexing.
More troublesome is that they have discovered this time the Divine Secret Realm has set a restriction—
Alien Races cannot enter!
This means everything depends solely on the Human Race’s own power.
This twist completely disrupted Tushan Yueli’s previous plans.
She closed her eyes and took a deep breath, suppressing the waves in her heart, and turned to Long Zhenguo to speak slowly:
"Old Long, it’s alright."
"I have sent someone to the Ghost Race and Snow Country, attempting to seek help from Qing Shuang and Sister Vera."
"They have a Contract with the master and, in a sense, are considered a part of the Human Race."
"As long as they are willing to help us enter the Divine Secret Realm, our chances will increase greatly."
She paused slightly, a hint of worry flashing in her eyes:
"Yet... I’m worried that since the master is not here, Vera and Sister Qing Shuang might..."
She did not continue, just sighed softly.
She was well aware that Qing Shuang and Vera had always recognized only Gu Xing.
To other beings of the Human Race, they may seem indifferent and may not be willing to assist.
Now that Gu Xing is missing, persuading them might be somewhat difficult.
Long Zhenguo naturally knew this too, and he nodded silently.
"As things stand, all we can do... is wait."
....
Snow Country, the land of seals.
A Monarch Level Blood Race cautiously stepped into the area completely covered by green vines.
He came under Tushan Yueli’s order, seeking Vera’s help.
His every step was like walking on thin ice.
Just because...
The world before him had long been swallowed by endless vines, a dense life force permeated the air, almost solidified.
More frightening——
On the periphery of the vines are heaps of Insect Race corpses, shriveled and withered, thoroughly drained of vitality.
The Blood Race swallowed hard, his heart racing.
Even though he knows this "grown-up" shouldn’t target him, the writhing vines around him exude a suffocating pressure.
He had no doubt—if any vine saw him as a threat, he would instantly become nourishment for this green sea.
Yet, with a mission, he had no choice.
Steeling his resolve, he stepped forward again, slowly approaching the center of the vine sea.
The deeper he went, the sturdier and more menacing the vines became, the oppressive feeling almost suffocating him.
Meanwhile, at the center of the vine sea—
Vera suddenly opened her eyes, a hint of coldness flashing in them.
"Blood Race...?"
She frowned slightly, casually lifted her hand.
In an instant, a green vine coiled out like a snake, pulling the Blood Race in front of her.
"What are you doing here?"
Vera’s tone was not polite, even cold.
Since the master’s disappearance, she has used all her will to barely control herself from going berserk.
Seeing Vera in person, the Blood Race finally breathed a sigh of relief and hurriedly spoke:
"Lady Vera, Lord Long Zhenguo earnestly requests you assist Longxia Country in participating in the third Divine Secret Realm to seize the third Divine Pattern!"
Vera’s gaze suddenly fell on him.
Long Zhenguo... she naturally remembered.
However—
She just glanced coldly, her voice indifferent:
"Since my master is no longer here, I have no intention of involving myself in Human Race affairs."
"Go back and tell Long Zhenguo: if the master returns, Vera will personally seek pardon for today’s matter."
"But for now, you should leave!"
Before she finished speaking, she waved her hand—
The green vines instantly lifted the Blood Race and mercilessly tossed him outside the vine sea.
Then, Vera’s gaze turned back to focus on the giant claw of the Insect Race before her.
After draining its life force for so long, even her Reincarnation skill had cycled nine times.
The life force of this giant claw showed no sign of diminishing.
Vera’s palm gradually tightened, her gaze becoming resolutely firm again.
Earlier, she hadn’t said one thing.
"If Gu Xing doesn’t return..."
"Then she will break this world herself and seek!"
And to accomplish this, immense power is the prerequisite!
....
The Blood Race seeking Qing Shuang’s assistance from the Ghost Race was similarly met with a cold refusal.
Gazing at the Blood Race envoy, his expression was somber, devoid of politeness:
"My granddaughter is not in the clan, please leave."
Initially, he cooperated with the Human Race solely because of Gu Xing’s face.
Now that Gu Xing is missing, and Qing Shuang and Fei Yue have also left, he is in no mood for cooperation.
"Go to hell!"
After speaking, he stepped into the depths of the Ghost Race without giving the envoy any chance to speak further.
The Blood Race envoy could only leave helplessly, bringing the news back to Longxia.
Upon receiving two rejection messages in succession, Long Zhenguo’s face turned pale.
Since losing Gu Xing, everything seemed to have suddenly become difficult.
Recalling past events.
If not for Gu Xing’s repeated interventions, Longxia Country, indeed the entire Human Race, might have vanished into chaos long ago.
Who knows what it would be like!
"Alas..."
He sighed deeply.
But now that things have happened, no amount of lamentation will help.
The only thing to do now is to give everything, leading the Human Race to seek more life amidst the perilous chaos.
And just at this moment.
A heavenly golden gate suddenly descended from the depths of the sky, illuminating the entire sky dazzlingly.
The third Divine Secret Realm....
Is fully opened at this moment!
The vast aura sweeps across the lands like a tsunami.
At this instant, the Demon Race, Fierce Beasts, Human Race...
The atmosphere between the three forces instantly froze.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 313 - 314: All Opponents Are Totem Level!
chapters.content:
Chapter 313: Chapter 314: All Opponents Are Totem Level!
Angel Realm, Holy City.
The duels at the eight arenas are nearing their end.
At this moment, those still standing on the stage have reached at least Half-step Totem Level, with three having stepped into the Totem tier.
Only Lanny remains at Monarch Tier Nine.
Because of this, she has almost become the primary target for all challengers.
Below the stage, there is constant chatter, skepticism, and unwillingness abound:
"She’s fought so many battles already. Even Half-step Totem Level opponents have fallen to her. I can’t believe she still has energy left!"
"Exactly, she must be at her last breath! Let’s all go up together and make sure she’s eliminated!"
"Charge! We can’t let her advance easily!"
At the calls of instigation, challengers surged towards the eighth arena like a tide.
The arena where Lanny stood instantly became the fiercest focal point of the entire scene, with the collision of powers almost completely submerging that space.
Such commotion naturally attracted the gaze from those on the high stage.
Even Liu Li, who had always kept a frosty expression, involuntarily glanced towards the storm center of that arena.
At this moment, Liu Li’s gaze swept over the eighth arena, landing on a seemingly unfamiliar Six-winged Angel.
However...
Mysteriously, she felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity.
Beside her, Milo followed her gaze and explained softly:
"Although this Six-winged Angel is only at Monarch Tier Nine, her combat skills are very unusual."
"An ordinary Half-step Totem Level can’t withstand even a single move from her."
"But she’s not the opponent you need to worry about—what truly deserves caution are those Totem Level beings on the stage."
"They are very likely to challenge you."
"But I’ll apply to the arbiter to suppress their power to Monarch Level if they challenge you."
After all, Liu Li is now only at Monarch Tier One. If she follows the divine oracle’s rules, her inheritor status might easily change hands.
Only by limiting challengers’ power can the trial’s balance be maintained.
However, Liu Li was not concerned with Milo’s words. Her gaze was firmly locked on Lanny.
Her eyes remained locked on Lanny.
The more she looked, the more familiar it felt, as if some mark buried deep in her memory was quietly being awakened...
But for a moment, she couldn’t figure out where this familiarity lay.
Since Gu Xing couldn’t take to the stage, he could only observe changes from the audience.
The familiar feeling Liu Li sensed was precisely Lanny’s fighting style.
Similar to Liu Li’s experiences, with Gu Xing’s powerful talent bestowed upon her, Lanny could almost effortlessly sweep through her opponents with attributes far exceeding those at the same tier.
It was precisely with Gu Xing’s overwhelming attributes that Lanny could fight so effortlessly.
At this moment, the truly powerful angels had long since claimed their respective arenas and firmly sat their positions.
Those still challenging Lanny were mostly slightly weaker opportunists trying to exhaust her with a marathon battle.
Yet, in the face of an absolute power disparity, their impact was minimal.
Soon, the first phase of the arena battles concluded.
Lanny’s advancement was no surprise at all!
And the next...
Would be an even crueller elimination format—
The eight who advanced would battle one-on-one to decide the ultimate victor through rounds.
Quarter-finals, semi-finals, finals... None of the matches allowed for mistakes.
Lanny had good luck in the first round, drawing an opponent at Half-step Totem Level, and almost the weakest of the top eight.
Without much effort, she defeated them smoothly and advanced to the semi-finals.
But reaching this point, the remaining opponents were all tough.
On the field, the other three were all at Totem Level, leaving only Lanny at Monarch Level.
This meant Lanny’s next battle would have to face a Totem Level being.
And upon learning her opponent, Lanny visibly panicked beside Gu Xing:
"Gu, Gu Xing, sir, I’m really not up for the next battle!"
"Those Totem Level masters... There’s no way I can be their rival."
It wasn’t that she didn’t trust Gu Xing, but she clearly understood—
The difference between under Totem and above Totem is an entirely different tier.
The crucial thing was that she had yet to comprehend the Power of Laws, the most fundamental gap between her and the Totem Level.
Gu Xing looked at the nervous Lanny, comforting her with a gentle voice:
"Remember? Initially, you also found Monarch Level opponents to be unreachable and unbeatable."
"But now, haven’t you easily defeated them? Even Half-step Totem Level opponents can’t last a few moves against you."
"This is different!"
Lanny shook her head violently, her voice tinged with anxiety.
She knew her strength well.
She was just slightly stronger than an ordinary Monarch Tier Nine Angel.
Her ability to fight against Half-step Totem Level beings was entirely thanks to Gu Xing’s support.
Allowing her to use attributes to overwhelm other contestants.
But before the Totem Level, her attribute suppression lost its effect.
"Gu, Gu Xing sir, I’m really no match for those few."
To Lanny, a Commander Level being was already a towering strong presence in the village.
Even though her strength had rapidly improved following Gu Xing for such a short time, her mindset hadn’t fully adapted to such a leap.
Facing Totem Level opponents, she instinctively felt fear and unease.
Gu Xing noticed her panic but didn’t force her, only gently said:
"It’s okay, once you take the stage, just do your best."
"Leave the rest... to me."
Upon hearing this, Lanny nodded in agreement, though her heart was still in turmoil.
Soon, another duel decided its outcome—
The angel who had consistently followed Jia Bailuo defeated their opponent and advanced to the semi-finals.
Gu Xing couldn’t help but frown slightly.
Because he had been observing Liu Li, he naturally realized that the advancing Totem Level Angel was the subordinate of the male angel inheritor.
And for this angel inheritor to have his subordinate participate in this contest...
There could only be two reasons!
The first is he fears the contest winner challenging him, threatening his inheritor status.
But achieving Six Wings proves his talent is on par with Liu Li.
Plus, with his Totem Level strength, none of the participating angels are his match.
Thus, the possibility of this reason is very small.
And the other possibility is to eliminate his competitors through his opponent.
And this reason is the most likely!
As for eliminating his competitors, Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Liu Li.
Clearly, only Liu Li, who can best achieve this!
Thinking about it, Gu Xing’s heart tightened.
If Liu Li wants to break through her talent again, she must gain the fortune of the entire Angel Race to be the Angel God’s inheritor.
And now...
Gu Xing’s eyes grew dark.
Fortunately, he participated in this contest.
If this Jia Bailuo intends to eliminate Liu Li through such means...
Gu Xing’s gaze fell on Jia Bailuo.
Then don’t blame him for turning the tables using their own methods.
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 315: The Master Has Arrived!
chapters.content:
Chapter 314: Chapter 315: The Master Has Arrived!
Very soon, it was Lanny’s turn to take the stage.
At this moment, she was so nervous that her fingertips trembled slightly, and her palms were covered in a fine layer of cold sweat.
Opposite her was the Totem Level entity she could only look up to in the past—
A realm she never even dared to imagine before.
The Totem Level Angel looked down on Lanny, voice indifferent yet carrying undeniable authority:
"To have reached here with your Monarch Tier Nine status, you are lucky enough."
"If you wish to retain some dignity, you better concede voluntarily."
"As a Totem, I do not wish to bully you too much."
However, Lanny resolutely shook her head.
Without Gu Xing’s order, she would not retreat an inch.
Seeing her choose this way, the Angel sighed lightly, eyes turning cold:
"Since you insist on courting trouble, don’t blame me for being ruthless!"
Before the voice fell, the pressure of the Totem Level burst forth, descending upon Lanny like a collapsed mountain and sea!
At this moment, Lanny felt her breath stop abruptly, her body bones screaming under the unbearable weight—
This was completely different from any opponent she had faced before.
Overhead, Jia Bailuo casually sauntered to Liu Li’s side.
While he didn’t dare provoke another inheritor easily, he had no such qualms with Liu Li.
"Liu Li," the corners of his mouth lifted slightly, with a bit of teasing in his voice, "who do you think will win this battle?"
Liu Li merely gave Jia Bailuo a cold glance, without replying.
A Monarch Level against a Totem Level, the outcome should have been beyond doubt—
But all of this was premised on excluding her master.
Her master was the greatest variable.
On the side, Milo looked at Jia Bailuo with slight surprise.
He had practically watched this inheritor grow up and knew his temperament very well.
"Lord Jia Bailuo, if there’s nothing important, please don’t disturb Lord Liu Li!"
Rebuked by Milo, Jia Bailuo could only glare at him and swallow his fury.
Facing a Totem Tier Nine, he had no power to resist at all.
He found that Liu Li completely ignored the question he just asked.
He snorted coldly, turned around, and left.
If Liu Li’s attitude had shown a slight change just now, perhaps he would have let his subordinates spare Liu Li.
But now...
Destroy them utterly!
On the arena, Lanny found herself in a precarious situation.
Her Attributes, Talent, and practical combat experience could not compare to Liu Li.
Even though her Level had reached Monarch Tier Nine, the combat power she could exert was not even comparable to Liu Li at Monarch Tier One.
The Totem Level Angel’s offensive was like a tidal wave, forcing her to retreat step by step.
Gu Xing had anticipated this long ago and shouted without hesitation:
"Link!"
The earlier activation of the Soul-devouring Talent allowed Lanny to sweep the entire arena, but now...
Gu Xing directly activated the linking state of the Sovereign Talent.
However—
At the moment the state was activated, Gu Xing was suddenly startled in his heart.
The last time he fully exerted himself, all Guardian Beast attributes combined were just over six hundred thousand;
But now...
[Angel (Lanny)]
[Status: Six-winged Angel]
[Level: Monarch Tier Nine]
[Talent: Legendary Nine Stars]
[Power: 210000→1210000]
[Constitution: 200000→1200000]
[Spirit: 150000→1250000]
[Speed: 200000→1200000]
[Skills: Holy Sword, Guardian, Angel Domain]
Under the blessing of the Sovereign Link talent, Lanny’s various Attributes surpassed one million points.
But...
This was not the most unreasonable part of this talent.
Its real power lay in.....
It could again be enhanced by the Soul-devouring Talent.
[Power: 1210000→2420000]
[Constitution: 1200000→2400000]
[Spirit: 1150000→2300000]
[Speed: 1200000→2400000]
With the boost of the "Soul-devouring" Talent, Lanny’s attributes doubled once more,
This was the limit that Gu Xing could enhance for her through the dual talents of "Sovereign" and "Soul-devouring".
However—
Staring at Lanny’s skyrocketing million attributes, Gu Xing couldn’t help but be stunned.
Only a month since he left, why did all the Guardian Beast attributes soar from sixty thousand to over a million?
During this month... what exactly did his Guardian Beasts experience?
Gu Xing’s pupils narrowed, momentarily lost in confusion.
At this moment, Lanny was also shocked by the surging power within her body.
What on earth did Lord Gu Xing do?
Compared to her original strength, this was nearly a tenfold increase!
If not for Gu Xing previously raising her Talent to Legendary Level, she might not even be able to control such a massive power.
The Totem Level Angel on the opposite side also noticed the dramatic change in Lanny’s aura, slightly solemn in expression.
At this moment, the momentum emanating from around her had faintly touched the threshold of Totem Level.
However—
What made a Totem a Totem was the Power of Laws.
"Without Law, no Totem"—this ironclad rule applied to all races except for the Demon Race and Insect Race!
"Light Law!"
For stability, the Totem Level Angel unhesitatingly employed the Power of Laws.
Though it was among the weaker types of Laws, with or without Laws was a world apart.
Under the bolster of Laws, it could not only harness Heaven and Earth Energy to strengthen itself, but also suppress opponents with it—
Every strike carried the might of Heaven and Earth, every move bore the authority of rules!
Lanny immediately felt the increased pressure, her entire body as if mired in quagmire, actions becoming more sluggish.
The opponent pressed forward step by step with the power of Heaven and Earth, while she could only rely on her own Attributes to barely hold on.
In this dwindling situation, she gradually showed signs of decline, the light of her wings also dimming a bit.
However—
At this moment, Gu Xing decided to intervene.
Laws? So what?
Since Lanny had yet to grasp them, he would make up for it!
The ability he newly awakened was precisely "Law Creation," transcending common sense!
This power provided limited boosts to those like Liu Li and Vera, who had already grasped Laws, but for someone like Lanny who had yet to touch upon Laws—
It could be called a transformation!
With a slight movement of Gu Xing’s thoughts, the Destruction Law suddenly formed within the Void—
The next moment, pitch-black Fire of Destruction erupted from around Lanny,
like a furious lotus blossom, consuming all Laws!
The entire arena erupted in an uproar!
"What, what happened to her? Did she self-ignite?!"
"No... that’s not self-ignition! This flame... this feeling..."
"My god, isn’t this the Fire of Destruction of the Angel God? Why can this Angel wield it!"
The phrase "Fire of Destruction" triggered an instant uproar across the arena!
Even the few present Totem Tier Nine entities on the high stage instinctively turned their gaze towards Lanny, their eyes full of surprise and doubt.
Fire of Destruction?
Logically, only those who obtained the Angel God’s legacy were qualified to wield such power.
Yet now... Could it be another inheritor quietly emerged?
The peak powerhouses exchanged looks, seeing the confusion in each other’s eyes.
Their gaze shifted behind Lanny—
Six wings, clearly not reaching ten wings.
This did not meet the conditions of an inheritor...
However, the black, scorching flame that consumed all Laws was so real...
Just when everyone was baffled—
Liu Li suddenly froze on the spot, her gaze locked firmly on the dancing Fire of Destruction.
This kind of power...
Besides her, only one person could wield it.
In an instant, a thought thundered through her mind, dispelling all prior hesitation and confusion completely.....
The master has come!
...
...

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 316: Lanny’s Overwhelming Power!
chapters.content:
Chapter 315: Chapter 316: Lanny’s Overwhelming Power!
No wonder....
No wonder earlier, she felt a sense of familiarity when looking at this Angel.
It turns out this Angel is actually her master’s Guardian Beast!
But upon realizing this, Liu Li’s golden eyes suddenly froze.
Wait!
If this Angel is her master’s Guardian Beast....
Then what about herself?!
Only then did Liu Li realize this problem.
It is known that typically, a Beast Master would never contract the same type of Guardian Beast.
After all, the same type of Guardian Beast means abilities would overlap.
Therefore, unless absolutely necessary, contracting two Guardian Beasts with the same abilities is not worthwhile.
And this was the first time Liu Li left Gu Xing for so long, her emotions were already difficult to keep calm.
And at this moment——
Suddenly reuniting with Gu Xing, there was now another Angel beside Gu Xing just like her.
This completely disturbed her reasoning and judgment, her mind filled with chaotic thoughts.
And beside her, Milo keenly noticed her abnormality and couldn’t help but softly inquire:
"Lord Liuli, do you...know that Angel?"
Liu Li hesitated for a moment, then slowly nodded.
"Yes!"
No matter what, that Angel is also Gu Xing’s Guardian Beast.
It is also considered to have some relationship with her.
And hearing Liu Li nod, Milo’s eyes brightened and he promptly asked:
"Lord Liuli, do you know how that Angel acquired that kind of Law?"
Hearing Milo ask this question, Liu Li suddenly became alert.
Since Milo asked this, it means that the Destruction Law has its special aspects.
And she knew, the Angel on the arena would certainly not use this Law.
The one using the Destruction Law is her master, if Gu Xing gets exposed and something unexpected happens...
"Is there a problem with this Law?" she asked indifferently in return.
Milo didn’t overthink it and directly explained:
"Lord Liuli, the Destruction Law and the Guardian Law are exclusive to the Angel God."
"Logically, you can only use one of these two Laws after inheriting the power of the Angel God."
"But...."
"Now, even without opening the trial space, why can this Angel already use this Law?"
This is not only Milo’s confusion but also the confusion of everyone present.
Even Leia, who normally doesn’t care about anything, frowned tightly seeing Lanny use the Destruction Law.
How could it be?
Why is an Angel who is not an heir and has never been heard of able to use the power of the Angel God.
Could this trial inheritance have some unexpected change?
Leia’s eyes instantly became solemn.
On the other side, Jia Bailuo’s face was equally dark and terrifying.
He never imagined that another competitor would appear out of thin air!
More troublesome is, this new opponent’s strength...
seems to be even stronger than the newly appeared third inheritor, Liu Li!
If this Angel wins first place in the competition, the consequences would be unimaginable...
Jia Bailuo’s eyes flashed with a cold light——
This mustn’t happen!
Fortunately, he had long arranged for a Totem Level Angel to compete.
This time....
He could just use this opportunity to solve two competitors at once.
At this moment, on the arena——
Lanny stood dazed, looking at the swirling Power of Destruction around her, not knowing what to do.
This Law was too violent, especially when uncontrolled, it was like an unbridled horse, hard to tame.
Wherever it touched, everything fell apart, even the Power of Heaven and Earth summoned by the previous Totem Angel was like ice and snow meeting blazing sun, instantly collapsing!
Even more alarming is that the chaotic Destruction Energy gathered behind her on its own.
The Law turned into four blood-red wings, contrasting with her original six pure white wings.
And this was precisely the result of Lanny’s inability to control the Destruction Law.
On the other side, the Totem Level Angel could hardly believe his eyes.
"How is it possible?!"
He stared hard at the surging Power of Destruction around Lanny, his eyes filled with shock.
Just a mere Monarch Level existence, not only completely suppresses him in terms of Attributes but also overwhelms him on the level of Laws!
"Who...are you?!"
He involuntarily took a step back, his voice already containing an unmistakable fear.
Below the stage, Gu Xing looked at the stage in a daze at Lanny, helplessly rubbing his forehead.
The next moment, a gentle and clear mental message quietly entered her mind:
"I’ll help you control the Destruction Law, you just need to relax and let it flow."
Only then did Lanny snap back to her senses, relaxing her body as instructed, allowing the Power of Destruction to slowly permeate every inch of her veins.
Since this Law was originally created by Gu Xing himself, he had absolute control over it.
And with Lanny forming a temporary contract with Gu Xing, the Destruction Law regarded her as half a master as well.
Gradually, she began to perceive the Law’s pattern, and attempted to blend her Spiritual Power with it——
She actually succeeded!
As her control over the Destruction Law deepened, the remaining three pure white wings behind her started to gradually turn blood-red, as eerie as blood soaking through a snowy plain.
Seeing this, the Totem Angel on stage felt alarms ringing in his heart——
He must not let her continue gaining control!
The uncontrolled Destruction Power had easily broken his Light Law earlier, if allowed to fully master it...
This battle would certainly end in failure!
Thinking this, he didn’t hesitate to withdraw all the Light Law, merging it into himself——
Since he couldn’t suppress the opponent with the Power of Heaven and Earth, then he would put everything into strengthening himself!
The next moment, his body was engulfed in a burst of golden light, the whole person transforming into a dazzling golden stream, bravely charging towards Lanny!
The speed was so fast it almost tore the air, carrying an all-out attack at the Totem Level, vowing to utterly crush his opponent——
However——
As fast as he charged in, he flew out just as fast!
Due to Gu Xing’s influence, the Destruction Law already regarded Lanny as half a master, now not only protecting her completely but also imbuing her with power far beyond common sense.
With the Destruction Attribute roaring through her, Lanny felt her entire body filled with unprecedented enormous Energy, as if with just a casual wave, she could shatter mountains and split seas!
She instinctively raised her arm and punched——
At that moment, the Power of Destruction erupted like a storm from her fist, black light enveloping the Law of annihilating all things, clashing directly with the golden stream!
"Boom————!!!"
Amidst the deafening roar, the Totem Angel flew out like a broken kite, smashing hard into the distant stone wall!
The area on his chest where Lanny’s fist had made contact was instantly eroded by the Destruction Law, leaving it bloody and mangled!
Were it not for the immense Life Force inherent to a Totem Level being, he might have perished on the spot from that one hit.
And as the dust settled and everyone could see what happened on stage, the entire venue fell silent.
....
....

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 317: News of Liu Li
chapters.content:
Chapter 316: Chapter 317: News of Liu Li
However, Gu Xing in the audience frowned slightly upon seeing this.
He noticed a problem.
Lanny’s opponent just now, this Totem Level angel, was Totem Tier One, but.....
He didn’t seem as strong as the same Tier One existence in the Alternate Space.
The Nine Nether Centipede King alone has attributes nearing ten million points.
If the Fierce Beasts are strong due to their inherent attributes, then Mi Zhan....
Upon demonization and breaking through to Totem Level, his attributes were also around ten million.
However, that angel on stage whom Lanny defeated....
Gu Xing’s brows furrowed slightly.
Compared to any Totem Level opponent he had met, it was inferior.
Could it be because the world’s rules are different?
Or is the Angel Race’s Totem Level inherently weaker?
He couldn’t figure it out immediately and didn’t delve deeper.
At this moment, Lanny had jumped off the stage.
She still hadn’t come to her senses even as she walked in front of Gu Xing.
"How does it feel to control the Law?"
Lanny was stunned, and after a moment of silence, she replied in a low voice:
"Lord Gu Xing, I always feel..."
"This Destruction Law doesn’t seem to suit me well."
When Lanny used the Destruction Law, she noticed——
The compatibility between her and this law didn’t seem ideal.
There was always a sense of sluggishness and resistance as the power flowed, as if it wasn’t naturally integrated but was forcibly instilled.
Hearing her feelings, Gu Xing nodded slightly, unsurprised.
He chose the Destruction Law because of its instantaneous destructive power, not its compatibility with Lanny.
"No worries, you can take your time to experience other laws in the future."
"By experiencing more, you’ll eventually find one that suits you!"
Lanny: "...???"
She was utterly stunned.
Experience other laws?
She initially thought the Destruction Law was merely a power Gu Xing mastered and temporarily lent to her, but hearing his tone...
It seemed like he had more laws to choose from?
One person possessing multiple laws?!
That’s too abnormal!
On the viewing platform, Liu Li’s gaze had always been fixed on Lanny, naturally noticing that familiar figure beside her——Gu Xing.
However, when she saw Gu Xing standing so close to Lanny, seemingly in tacit understanding, a wave of bitterness surged in her heart.
That damn master...
The first moment of reunion and he didn’t seek her out first, but instead stayed so close to another angel?
Liu Li unconsciously clenched her palms, her wings trembling slightly.
Since the master doesn’t come to find me, I’ll pretend I didn’t see!
But this thought only lasted a moment before being firmly suppressed——
No!
If I let it go like this, wouldn’t it fulfill that angel’s wishes?
Only she and the master fell into this world together, this should have been her opportunity...
How could she so easily hand over this opportunity?
Absolutely not!
Liu Li suddenly raised her head, a decisive glint flashing in her eyes, and said to Milo:
"Milo, I need to go to the audience."
Milo was slightly taken aback: "...?"
Though confused by Liu Li’s request, Milo patiently said:
"Lord Liu Li, the audience is a mix of good and bad, and we don’t know which are Demon Race spies."
"That’s why I’ve always used Spiritual Power to guard you."
"If it’s not necessary, I don’t recommend you go."
But upon hearing Milo’s words.
Liu Li realized why she couldn’t contact Gu Xing.
It turned out this guy completely isolated the Spiritual Power.
However...
But with a firm gaze, she said without hesitation:
"My master is in the audience, I must see him."
Milo was slightly taken aback.
Though Liu Li had mentioned "master" several times before, he never took it seriously——
Who could be the master of a Ten-winged Angel?
But seeing her determined expression, eyes without deceit, he believed a bit more.
"If that’s the case, please allow me to accompany you."
Milo bowed respectfully, his tone solemn, "Your safety must not be compromised."
Liu Li saw his earnest demeanor, knowing this was his bottom line, and nodded in agreement:
"Alright."
To avoid causing a stir, Milo didn’t announce it, instead quietly taking Liu Li from backstage to the audience.
If outsiders knew the third inheritor personally ventured into the crowd to find a "master,"
it would undoubtedly attract innumerable objections and resistance, even shaking her right to inherit...
....
Meanwhile.
Liu Ye had already reached the gate of the Holy City.
Looking at the towering city gates.
A trace of nostalgia flashed in his eyes.
After all, back then, when he first arrived in this world, it was at the Holy City.
In a sense, the Holy City in this world was his home.
And in order to resist the Demon Race, he hadn’t returned here for several years.
However....
A touch of sorrow flashed in his eyes this time.
Sadly, this is merely his home in this world.
His true home....
Isn’t here!
He closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and slowly suppressed his surging emotions.
When he reopened his eyes, he had returned to being the cold and iron-willed chief general of the Angel Race on the battlefield.
Now what he had to do was continue to enhance his power until he was capable of breaking through the barriers of this world and returning to the Angel Race.
When the War Angels betrayed, he hadn’t managed to leave any precautions for the Blazing Angels.
Now...
He didn’t know about his daughter, his sister, or any of the Blazing Angels Race now.
Thinking about this, he didn’t hesitate anymore and stepped into the city gates.
This time’s vacation...
Perhaps should be shortened to one day.
Returning to the battlefield and improving his power was the priority.
As for this time’s inheritance selection.
Forget it.
Ultimately, he had no real connection with this world.
However, just as he planned to casually find a place to stay and visit a few old friends,
several fragmented voices of conversation suddenly drifted into his ears along the wind——
"Have you heard? The third inheritor is only Monarch Tier One!"
"Really? That’s too weak..."
"Now she definitely can’t match Lord Leia and Lord Jia Bailuo."
"By the way, do you know her name?"
"Let me think... Seems like... Liu... Liu Li! Yes, it’s Liu Li!"
Liu Ye’s body suddenly froze on the spot.
He almost thought he misheard——
Liu Li?!
In the next moment, he appeared like a gust of wind in front of those chatting angels,
his voice carrying an uncontrollable urgency:
"Did you say... the third inheritor is called Liu Li?!"
Those angels wanted to react, but once they turned around and saw him, they were completely shocked, immediately bowing in respect:
"Lord Liu Ye! When did you return?"
"Quickly answer my question!"
"Y-Yes! The inheritor is indeed named Liu Li, and..."
The angel hesitated slightly, then whispered:
"Her appearance... seems to bear some resemblance to you..."
Before he could finish speaking, he looked up again——
Only to find no one was there.
...
...
